loc.POL_submarine_1_desc: The Wilk class consisted of three submarines built by the French for the Polish Navy and commissioned in the early 1930s. They were based on the French Saphir-class design. They were fairly large submarines, displacing nearly 1,000 tons. They were armed with six 550mm torpedo tubes and could dive up to 80m.
loc.POL_submarine_2_desc: The Orzeł class consisted of two Submarines built in the Netherlands for the Polish Navy. The ships were completed just months before the German invasion. They were large submarines, displacing 1,100 tons. They were armed with twelve 550mm torpedo tubes and had a diving depth of 80m.
loc.POL_submarine_3_desc: The two submarines of the Sokół class were British U-class submarines completed for the Polish Navy in exile in 1941-42. The ships displaced 540 tons and were armed with four 533mm torpedo tubes. They had a good complement of British radar and sonar, and a diving depth of 60m.
loc.POL_destroyer_1_desc: The two Wicher-class destroyers were the first large surface ships of the Polish Navy, and were commissioned between 1930 and 1932. They were large, displacing 1,540 tons. As designed, they were armed with four 130mm/40 M1924 guns, though these were upgraded to 120mm Swedish guns just before the German invasion. Their torpedo tubes and AA armament were improved as well.
loc.POL_destroyer_2_desc: The two destroyers of the Grom class were built in Britain for the Polish Navy and commissioned in 1937. They were among the largest and fastest destroyers of World War II. They displaced nearly 2,000 tons and were armed with five 120mm/50 caliber Bofors M34 cannon in their main armament. They also had six 533mm torpedo tubes and a good ASW complement.
loc.POL_destroyer_3_desc: The Polish destroyer Piorun was a British N-class destroyer built for Polish Navy in exile and commissioned in 1940. It displaced 1,770 tons and had decent speed and reliability. It was armed with six 120mm/45 QF Mk XII cannon as its main guns, and also had five 533mm torpedo tubes, decent ASW equipment, and the then latest British radar and sonar.
loc.greater_mongolia_category_desc: The Idea of reunifying the scattered Mongol people has existed ever since the days of the great Mongol Empire and the Yuan Dynasty of China. It is time the separated tribes once again come together, to mark a new dawn for the people of Mongolia.
loc.unite_greater_mongolia: Proclaim a new Golden Age for Mongolia

loc.greater_hui_state_category_desc: The Chinese Muslim Hui are currently scattered all across the northwestern provinces and in the Zhongyuan region. There are many who wish for a unified state that can protect them from warlordism and foreign aggression, and even the Dungans, Panthays and Chin Haws seek our aid. We must seek to unify our people as quickly as possible.

loc.MEN_mongol_banner_category_desc: The banner system has been a part of our people's way of administration for centuries, and allows for us to raise the men of the various banners throughout our administered territories to take up arms and defend their villages.

loc.MEN_army_reform_desc: Corruption, incompetence and cowardice are rife at every level of command in our army, and there are no proper central command structures present. Solving this will be a long process.

loc.JAP_kodoha_insurgency_decisions_desc: The Kōdōha faction, a faction within our Imperial Army is currently on the move against their enemies, as evidenced by their assassination of military officer Tetsuzan Nagata in August 1935. If they do decide to take action on a larger scale, it would not be until their officer Aizawa's trial has ended. It might be best to increase the security around certain individuals that they claim threaten the Kokutai, the soul of our nation.
loc.JAP_aizawa_trial_ongoing_desc: Lieutenant Colonel Saburō Aizawa is currently under house arrest whilst his trial is still ongoing over his murder of the military officer Tetsuzan Nagata. However, with the trial becoming a media sensation with the judges colluding with his faction and turning the trial into a soapbox from which their ideology could be broadcast, it is clear that he will receive no tangible sentence. As a core member of the Kōdōha, if the group is to make a move, they will not do so until Aizawa's house arrest is over.
loc.JAP_aizawas_trial_over_flag: Saburō Aizawa's trial has concluded, and the §YFebruary 26 Incident§! has taken place

loc.JAP_increase_takahashi_korekiyo_security: Security around Takahashi Korekiyo will be increased in order to protect him in case of any attacks by army radicals, but as a result they may re-prioritize their list of targets and put more forces towards taking out someone else

loc.JAP_increase_jotaro_watanabe_security_de: Security around Jōtarō Watanabe will be increased in order to protect him in case of any attacks by army radicals, but as a result they may re-prioritize their list of targets and put more forces towards taking out someone else
loc.JAP_kwantung_army_decisions_desc: Our forces operating in Manchuria and China, the Kantō-gun, are currently acting highly autonomously and have been known for taking action without approval from higher order. Originally created to operate as security force for the Kwantung leased territory, they have now far exceeded their original size, and may pull us into large-scale conflict if we do not take firm control of the situation.
loc.JAP_kwantung_army_impatience_desc: The Kwantung Army is quickly growing impatient with the current status-quo in China, and seem likely to continue on their path of expanding their domain without the government's approval if things go on like this.
loc.JAP_the_suiyuan_offensive_mission_tt: §Y[ROOT.GetNameDefCap]§! or any of our allies must capture §Y[621.GetName]§! or §Y[746.GetName]§! before the Campaign runs to an end
loc.JAP_growing_unrest_in_the_shanghai_conce: Growing Unrest in the Shanghai Concession

After surrendering large swathes of land to us, it seems that the [CHI.GetAdjective] living in the international concession are growing restless and impatient towards the cowardice of the regime. They may try something within short...
loc.JAP_state_shintoism_decisions_desc: Shintoism has been the religion of the Japanese at the very least since the Yayoi period, syncretizing with Zen Buddhism over time. During the Meiji era, the Shrines came under growing government influence, and citizens were encouraged to worship the emperor as a kami. Due to this, we can now increase government control over the worship, and bend the people's wishes to our own.
loc.JAP_the_co_prosperity_sphere_decisions_d: Our ultimate goal of controlling Asia is coming ever closer, and through forming a pan-Asian union we can strengthen the ties between the different nations we seek to bring under our wings. We must do all in our power to make this dream a reality.
loc.JAP_hand_mongol_states_to_mengkukuo_deci: Hand Mongol States over to the [MEN.GetAdjective] Administration
loc.JAP_hand_chinese_states_to_the_reorganiz: Hand Kuomintang States over to the [RNG.GetAdjective] Administration
loc.JAP_spiritual_mobilization_decisions_des: The [ROOT.GetAdjective] people are steadfast and ready to support our government in its every decision, as long as sufficient motivation is given. We should mobilize the population, both spiritually and physically, so that they may do their part in the war effort.
loc.JAP_the_peoples_state_decisions_desc: Imperial rule and feudalism will soon be things of the past. It is time for the common man to steer his own destiny, and guide himself towards the goal of ultimate salvation for his people.
loc.JAP_hold_speech_in_the_imperial_diet_dec: Hold a Speech in the Imperial Diet

loc.JAP_the_propaganda_department_decisions_: The propaganda department is constantly hard at work counter enemy influence, as well as spreading our own both internally and externally. Through this organization, we can help steer the course of Asia towards our own desired outcome.

loc.JAP_west_pacific_treaty_org_allied_trade: Our allies have a lot of resources that would be helpful for our nation, and we stand to gain greatly from deepening trade relations with these countries. We would ensure a steady flow of vital resources, and deprive our enemies from the same resources at the same time - strengthening us and weakening them.
loc.JAP_west_pacific_treaty_org_economic_int: Our Pacific customs and currency union has so far been successful, but it has more roles that our allies do not know about. By further integrating their economies with ours, we will eventually be able to make them fully dependent on us, essentially turning them into our subjects.

loc.JAP_boeitai_category_desc: With a defensive war on our own lands becoming ever more realistic, we must establish some sort of Defense Corps that can be rapidly mobilized to defend our Home Islands in the case of an enemy incursion. loc.JAP_organize_the_fifth_column_decision_d: Loyal partisans operating behind enemy lines can be used to disrupt enemy communications in [FROM.GetNameDef]. Strikes at command posts, cutting of telegraph wires, or de-railing of trains, make the enemy less prepared to withstand the attacks of our units, and increase the chance of a successful liberation of Japan.
loc.JAP_assault_tauran_decision_desc: Due to the recent provocation by the [MON.GetAdjective]s and their occupation of the village of Tauran by lake Buir, we must prepare our troops to push them out before their claim to our rightful territory can be legitimized.
loc.JAP_tauran_border_incident_forgotten_1_d: If we want to ever reclaim the village from our enemies, we must strike quickly.
loc.JAP_tauran_border_conflict_warning_MON_d: There has been a clash between our army contingent that entered Tauran recently and the [MAN.GetAdjective] soldiers at our shared border in [761.GetName]. Intelligence sources in [MAN.GetNameDef] report that this may just be the first step in a larger confrontation. We should reinforce the border with [MAN.GetNameDef] immediately.
loc.JAP_border_conflict_escalation_warning_M: Aerial recon has confirmed major troop movements at the [JAP.GetAdjective] side of the border. We don't know if or when the [JAP.GetAdjective] have decided to strike, but we must be ready.
loc.JAP_tauran_border_incident_forgotten_des: If we want to push the [MON.GetAdjective] troops out of our territory and away from their border to [761.GetName], we must strike quickly.
loc.JAP_escalate_incident_to_border_conflict: It appears that the [MON.GetAdjective]s are not backing down from the conflict. At this point, we must either escalate to an armed confrontation or back down ourselves.
loc.JAP_tauran_border_conflict_time_until_ca: At the current rate, we can only sustain combat operations for so long before we need to break off combat.

loc.JAP_imperial_influence_decision_cat_desc: The Internal Factions within our country hold a lot of autonomy, and will not sit idly by while they are being ignored by [ROOT.GetLeader]. As such they will keep making extensive demands of our government so long as they have not been largely curtailed.
loc.CHI_the_political_tutelage_cat_desc: The time has come to implement the ideas of Sun Yat Sen to their fullest extent, increasing the literacy of the Chinese people and awakening their political consciousnesses, allowing for the creation and survival of a Republic on our soil.

loc.CHI_war_of_resistance_cat_desc: With the enemy on our soil again and war in our lands we have to rise to the challenge. While we aren’t the most modern nor well equipped army in the world we do have the tools to fight them and prevail. We will beat them back in our field, hills and mountains.

loc.CHI_internal_politics_cat_desc: The neglect and backwardness of the Qing have taken long to overcome, but since the Northern Expedition we have steadily made progress. However our modernization efforts are not done and we have to pick up speed if we are to keep up with the rest of the world.
loc.CHI_lend_lease_missions_cat_desc: The support we are receiving from abroad has permitted us to fight back against the invaders, but nothing comes for free. We need to continue showing that we deserve getting the support we are currently receiving and that we could use and deserve more.

loc.PRC_infiltration_sea_cat: Rally Support in Chinese States - Infiltration
loc.PRC_infiltration_sea_cat_desc: By infiltrating other Chinese states we can increase our support in areas we do not yet control.[GetCommieInfiltration] However, there is a risk that our supporters will be discovered and removed. Countering will reduce the Infiltration level in that state by §Y1 level§!.
loc.PRC_infiltration_sea_commie: If Infiltration reaches §YLevel 3§!, the state will flip in the event of a war against the target state.
loc.PRC_the_peoples_doubt_desc: The people of China has seen our passivity towards the foreign invaders and have started to doubt our resolve to unify all of China, and our ability to properly defend it.
loc.PRC_the_peoples_doubt_tt: When §Y[PRC.GetNameWithFlag]§! joins the fights against the invaders, or the invaders are at peace with all of China.
loc.PRC_28_bolshevik_faction_decision_enlai_: Send §Y$PRC_zhou_enlai$§! to [FROM.GetName] on a diplomatic mission
By sending Enlai aid to [FROM.GetNameDef], we can increase our standing within [ROOT.GetFactionName]
loc.PRC_28_bolshevik_faction_decision_ask_fo: We will put pressure on [FROM.GetNameDef] to publicly recognize our contribution to [ROOT.GetFactionName]
loc.PRC_28_bolshevik_faction_decision_backst: Though in a faction with [FROM.GetNameDef], we will bribe their officials to look the other way should we desire to put any of our agents to work
loc.PRC_28_bolshevik_faction_decision_legiti: The enemy of my enemy is our friend. We must put aside our differences to focus on the invader
loc.PRC_unlock_integration_decisions_tt: Decisions to §YCore and Integrate§! become available
loc.PRC_rural_surveyer_tt: Can only be completed five times: [?PRC_amount_of_times_rural_survey] / 5
loc.PRC_remove_yulin_garrison_desc: Despite our best efforts to stomp them out, the 86th and 84th Divisions under Jing Yueixu and Gao Guizi have managed to fend off our attacks and have effectively kept the north of the province under Kuomintang control. We must send units there to expel the Yulin Garrison from [1046.GetName].
loc.PRC_second_thoughts_factions_desc: With both of us at war sharing a common enemy, it is time to put aside our differences and join forces against the aggressors for the good of the nation.
loc.PHI_sugar_barons_category_desc: Our sugar production is a very profitable sector where we may be able to obtain funds to cover our growing defense budget without having to make cuts in other spending.
loc.PHI_sugar_excise_general: Fund Officer Training Course with Sugar Fund
loc.PHI_sugar_excise_divisions: Fund Training Exercise with Sugar Fund
loc.PHI_mindanao_transport_decision_unlock_t: §YUnlocks Decisions§! to sell Convoys for Military Equipment
loc.PHI_convoys_for_infrastructure_decision_: As a nation of islands, shipbuilding is a trade that predates any government involvement. As we modernize, we must utilize this expertise to raise funds and to apply our techniques, ships and other equipment in different sectors like construction.
loc.PHI_convoys_for_consumer_goods: Sell our Ships on the Civilian Market
loc.PHI_convoys_for_guns: Approach [FROM.GetNameDef] to Trade our Convoys for Guns
loc.PHI_convoys_for_trucks: Approach [FROM.GetNameDef] to Trade our Convoys for Trucks
loc.PHI_convoys_for_artillery: Approach [FROM.GetNameDef] to Trade our Convoys for Artillery
loc.PHI_convoys_for_light_tanks: Approach [FROM.GetNameDef] to Trade our Convoys for Decommissioned Light Tanks
loc.PHI_infrastructure_points_requirement_tt: Requires 5 §YInfrastructure Points§! obtained through the decisions below, current points: [?PHI_infrastructure_points]
loc.PHI_american_intervention_icon_descripti: Threat Level: [?PHI.PHI_american_intervention_icon_value|0H]§Y%§!\n\nIf the value reaches §R100%§!, then §Y[USA.GetNameDefCap]§! will invade. If it reaches §G0%§!, [USA.GetNameDef] will agree not to intervene and the actions below become unavailable.
loc.PHI_american_intervention_category_desc: Although [USA.GetNameDef] has promised us independence, their government could convince itself that our change of leadership defies the act that is to facilitate this independence. We must moderate ourselves while still under [USA.GetAdjective] supervision to avoid intervention.
loc.PHI_american_intervention_donate_us_sena: Donate to [USA.GetAdjective] Politicians on the Senate Committee on Foreign Relations
loc.PHI_american_intervention_promise_bases: Promise Continued Access to Military Bases
loc.PHI_american_intervention_unlock_more_de: Completing this focus will unlock more §YDecisions§! to reduce the risk of §YAmerican Intervention§!
loc.decision_cost_CP_25_army_exp_35_tooltip: It costs £command_power §Y25§! and £army_experience §Y35§! to take the decision
loc.PHI_repeatable_except_delay: This decision is repeatable, but §YAmerican Patience§! will only be extended the first time.
loc.PHI_integration_category: Integrate Indian and Pacific Ocean Islands
loc.PHI_peace_with_philippines: Agree to a White Peace with [PHI.GetNameDef]
loc.PHI_request_macarthur_stay_tt: $USA_douglas_macarthur$ is less likely to be recalled
loc.PHI_investment_plan_2: Investment Plan 2: Establish New Trade Relations
loc.PHI_investment_plan_1_tt: Which upon completion will grant 2 §Y$industrial_complex$§!, and resource and construction bonuses in every state with new railway connections built during the plan.
loc.PHI_investment_plan_2_tt: Which will be successful and grant better rewards if we achieve good trading relations with at least 3 regional powers, control a level 6 §Y$naval_base$§! and have built at least 1 new §Y$dockyard$§! during the plan
loc.PHI_investment_plan_3_tt: Which will be successful and grant better rewards if we construct infrastructure in [1027.GetName] and [624.GetName], and spend trains, trucks and convoys to further improve our infrastructure during the plan.
loc.PHI_every_state_with_new_railway_connect: Every owned state that has a new railway connection to another state:
loc.PHI_has_built_or_purchased_x_convoys: Has expanded the convoy fleet to [?PHI_convoys_investment_goal] through construction or purchase.
loc.form_maphilindo_category_desc: Although our ethnic ties with the peoples of Indonesia and Malaysia are not as strong as are present between those countries, it has to be recognized that our borders were drawn by colonial powers and that only together we can protect against outside influence over our strategically important region.
loc.PHI_relations_with_spanish_america_desc: Our linguistic and cultural ties with Spain and its former colonies form a bridge to form partnerships with these nations as [USA.GetAdjective] influence wanes.
loc.PHI_propose_treaty_of_mutual_assistance: Propose Treaty of Mutual Assistance with [FROM.GetNameDef]
loc.SPR_has_eliminated_guerrillas_tt: [SPR.GetNameDef] has eliminated all guerrillas in its territory
loc.CHI_war_in_sinkiang_desc: With the advent of war in Sinkiang province it is only a matter of time until the Central Government forces a peace in the region and our troops give up. If we are to win we must strike fast and decisively.
loc.SIK_stalemate_tt: The war will result in a stalemate and troops will return to their original positions
loc.KHM_survival_tt: If we hold out for a year the war will stagnate and our position in Sinkiang will remain
loc.SIC_xikang_offensive_desc: After many skirmishes along the border, Liu Wenhui has declared that he will seek to unite all of Xikang under his rule. If this will be possible however, is yet to see.
loc.CHI_tsr_power_struggle_cat_desc: A struggle has erupted for political control of China. We must secure support from warlords and within the party to emerge victorious.
loc.CHI_seek_party_support_tt: Increases the cost of taking this decision by §R25§!
loc.TSR_warlord_supports_us: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] will support us in the struggle for power in China
loc.claim_outer_manchuria_tt: Unlocks decisions to integrate claimed states in §YOuter Manchuria§!
loc.MAN_state_shintoism_decisions_desc: Being imported to our nation from Japan there is still some apprehensiveness around Shinto, but with some convincing the local population will be sure to fall in line. Using the methods tried and tested in the Japanese Homeland we can use this as an opportunity to strengthen the Emperor's influence over our subjects and in turn our internal stability.
loc.MAN_establish_the_erdaojiang_special_ste: Establish the Erdaojiang Special Steel Experimental Plant
loc.CHI_overlordship_over_indochina_tsr_desc: Once we've expelled the colonizers from Indochina we'll be able to force them to the negotiating table.
loc.MAN_is_currently_seeking_to_merge_a_pupp: [MAN.GetNameDefCap] is currently seeking to annex another [JAP.GetAdjective] puppet administration
loc.MAN_yong_ying_category_desc: The Yong Ying, or brave camps, are a form of militia used during the Qing era with the Braves being militiamen recruited from the local population. Publicly funded rather than part of the standing army, they served independently, often in the purpose of self-defense. We should seek to perfect this system to efficiently use it in coming wars.
loc.CHI_the_lingguang_incident_cat_desc: Following a series of provocations caused both by the Central Government attempting to gain power over the South and the two southeastern provinces of Guangdong and Guangxi asserting their independence and, pushing for a harder approach to Japan, it has now collapsed into a full blown crisis.
loc.SND_show_support_for_government: Show Support for the Central Government
loc.han_will_flee_if_not_removed_tt: §RIf this is not completed by the time Japan takes Jinan, Han Fuju will abandon his province§!
loc.SND_shown_support: Has shown support for the Central Government
loc.CHI_war_in_liangguang_desc: With the advent of war in Liangguang province it is only a matter of time until the our troops tire of fighting one-another and wish to prioritize facing the [JAP.GetAdjective] threat together. If we are to win we must strike fast and decisively.
loc.CHI_stalemate_tt: The war will result in a stalemate and troops will return to their original positions
loc.GDC_survival_tt: If we hold out for a year the war will stagnate and our position in Liangguang will remain. Any neighboring Republican States that have fallen under our control will remain part of our Clique when the stalemate happens
loc.XIC_war_in_yanan_desc: With the advent of resumed war in Shaanxi province it is only a matter of time until the Bandit Suppression Army's troops give up and desert. If we are to win we must strike fast and decisively.
loc.XIC_war_halting: The Offensive Running out of Steam
loc.XIC_stalemate_tt: The war will result in a stalemate and troops will return to their original positions, unless we can defeat [PRC.GetNameWithFlag] within the specified time.
loc.PRC_survival_tt: If we hold out for half a year the war will stagnate and our position in Shaanxi will remain. If we manage to capture Yan'an by the time to offensive halts, we will be able to keep it.
loc.RNG_state_shintoism_decisions_desc: Being imported to our nation from Japan there is still some apprehensiveness around Shinto, but with some convincing the local population will be sure to fall in line. Using the methods tried and tested in the Japanese Homeland we can use this as an opportunity to strengthen the Emperor's influence over our subjects and in turn our internal stability.
loc.BRM_burmah_oils_oil_fields: The Burmah Oil Company's Oil Fields
loc.BRM_blow_up_the_oil_fields: Blow up the Burmese Oil Fields
loc.rename_guapore_to_rondonia_decision: Establish the Federal Territory of Rondônia
loc.SEA_japan.1.desc: Citing threats to the soul of the imperial nation, young officers loyal to the Kōdōha faction within the IJA have organized a coup d'etat, with the goal of purging the government and military leadership of those who oppose their ethos of militarism and direct Imperial control of the state. They have already surrounded the residences of top officials, and have captured the government center of Tokyo. The Emperor however remains silent, despite the rebels' hopes that he would speak out to support them. How will this incident proceed?
loc.SEA_japan.1.a: Put an end to this farce, now!
loc.JAP_kodoha_coup_will_fail_historically_t: We will declare Martial law and employ the Imperial Japanese Navy's Yokosuka Regiment to suppress the rebellion. Minimal casualties have been reported, though some of the Kōdōha's targets have been confirmed dead:
loc.SEA_japan.1.b: The time has come to return to tradition!
loc.JAP_kodoha_coup_will_succeed_tt: The Kōdōha will seize the Ministry of War, the Imperial Hotel, the National Diet as well as the Imperial Palace. Many of the key targets of the Kōdōha have been confirmed dead:
loc.SEA_japan.1.c: The Military must be reigned in!
loc.JAP_kodoha_coup_will_fail_non_historical: We will declare Martial Law and attempt to suppress the rebellion using the Emergency Service Units of the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department, limiting military involvement in the delivery of justice towards the Kōdōha. Few casualties have been reported, though some of the Kōdōha's targets have been confirmed dead:
loc.SEA_japan.1.d: The Military must be reigned in!
loc.SEA_japan.1.e: The People must realize they are being subverted from all sides!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.1.desc: The leadership of [FROM.GetNameDef]'s Kwantung Army have demanded our submission. They have however come with an offer. Should we join them, they will aid us in reclaiming the Mongol lands of old for us, and will allow us to establish a new Mongol Empire under their control. What say we?
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.1.a: This is an Opportunity for us
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.1.b: We must maintain our independence at all costs!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.2.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has stepped down in favor of our candidate for the [FROM.GetAdjective] throne, Prince De. The region has now fallen under our occupation, and the reorganization of their government will proceed shortly.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.2.a: The Emperor will be pleased to hear this
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.3.t: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] Refuses to Submit to the Emperor
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.3.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has refused to give in to our demands, despite having seen what we did to Nima-odsor when he stood up against our divine ruler. Perhaps it is time to teach them a lesson in humility.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.3.a: They have disrespected the Emperor, this cannot stand!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.3.b: We did not need them anyway
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.4.desc: A [FROM.GetAdjective] delegation has approached us seeking our cooperation in their quest for domination of the Asian continent, demanding that we join them in their current and future wars as they pursue this endeavor. They do not seem like they will take a no as an answer, but surely this cannot be to our benefit?
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.4.b: That would go against our principles of neutrality!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.4.c: We are in the middle of a war! Ask them to wait.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.4.c_tt: We will be asked to respond once the limited war is over
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.5.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has seen reason, and decided that [FROM.GetNameDef] will officially sign the necessary documents to facilitate their entry into our faction. Today is a day to be celebrated!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.6.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] refuses to see reason, and has stated that [FROM.GetNameDef] will not be joining an alliance with us. What is not known to them, is that we have no intention of letting them be neutral in the upcoming world conflict..
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.7.desc: Not taking no for an answer, [FROM.GetAdjective] troops have been spotted preparing for a swift invasion of our country, likely intending to quickly move in and subjugate us, bringing us into their sphere. This is likely the last chance we have to avoid conflict, but the question stands. Do we take it?
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.7.a: On second thought, we should just submit now
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.8.desc: Finally, after long deliberation, the delegation from [FROM.GetNameDef] has decided to sign the revised documents we presented them with, avoiding military intervention, but giving up their independence in the process. Now, we stand fully ready to strike south!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.9.desc: The final chance we graciously offered to [FROM.GetLeader] was refused, and our troops now stand ready to swiftly occupy their major cities. The time has come to show them what the [ROOT.GetAdjective] nation is made out of!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.10.desc: A delegation sent to us from [FROM.GetNameDef] has presented us with an ultimatum. They have given us a week to vacate our troops from the Tonkin region, and allow their troops to take up positions and establish military bases in the region. They cite this is to ensure that the Chinese do not threaten [VIN.GetAdjective] sovereignty, but we know what this is really about...
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.10.a: This is not worth fighting over
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.10.b: We will not give it up to them!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.11.desc: The leadership in [FROM.GetNameDef] have seen reason, and have begun vacating their troops from Tonkin, in order to allow us to establish a security zone there to ensure that the Chinese troops do not enter [VIN.GetAdjective] territory. The day is won!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.11.a: A Great Day for the [ROOT.GetAdjective] People
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.12.desc: The leadership in [FROM.GetNameDef] have refused to see reason, stating that they will not give up even an inch of land in Indochina. This greatly hinders our further expansion south... Should we accept this, or is it perhaps time to strike down the west?
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.12.a: They will come to regret their decision!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.13.desc: \nEarlier this week, forces belonging to [JAP.GetNameDef] moved in and occupied our territory of [721.GetName], stating that they were on a mission to protect the region from potential occupation by their enemies. This is clearly an act of war, however it is one which we could likely choose to simply ignore, seeing as they are not a foe we can afford fighting at the moment.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.13.a: It is not worth fighting over
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.13.b: Who do they think they are?
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.14.desc: The [FROM.GetAdjective] administrators who have aided in the establishment of our state have decided that now would be a good time to reorganize our government structure, and reshape our legal system. In the long run this will only serve to strengthen us though, so we have no reason to refuse them.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.15.desc: Citing that the city may be a good point for their enemies to strike them from should the opportunity arise, the [FROM.GetAdjective] troops administering the [592.GetName] region have presented us with an ultimatum. Either we allow them in, essentially giving them the powers to do as they wish with the city, or we face the full force of the [FROM.GetAdjective] army. What should we do?
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.15.a: This is not worth fighting over
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.15.b: We will not give it up to them!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.16.desc: The regional administrators of [729.GetName] have decided to let our troops in, realizing that resistance would ultimately prove futile. Our people rejoice, as another western power has been pushed out from East Asia!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.16.a: A Great Day for the [ROOT.GetAdjective] People
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.17.desc: The regional administrators of [729.GetName] have forgotten their place, and decided to refuse the demands previously issued to them by our governors in [592.GetName]. The time has come to take down the [FROM.GetAdjective] empire once and for all!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.17.a: They will come to regret their decision!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.18.desc: A delegation from far away has recently arrived at our capital, seeking an audience with his highness. They claim to be from [FROM.GetNameDef], and seek an alliance between our nations. Do we accept?
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.18.b: That would go against our principles of neutrality...
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.19.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has graciously accepted our offer to formalize an alliance between our nations, and has already begun initiatives to integrate into our sphere. Today is a day for celebration!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.19.a: They know what's best for them
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.20.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has rudely decided to reject our offer of an alliance between our nations, stating that it would go against their principle of neutrality. We can only imagine the amounts of corruption that led to this erroneous decision.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.21.desc: Our gracious overlord [FROM.GetNameDef] has decided to finally legitimize our claims to being the true Mongol state, and have proposed another reorganization of our government and agencies to facilitate this change in policy. Today is a great day for the [ROOT.GetAdjective] people!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.21.a: If that is what they wish to do
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.22.desc: Agents suspected to be acting on the orders of the [FROM.GetAdjective] have been spotted within our borders, seemingly attempting to make contact with nobles, and enticing our citizens with great promises of Co-Prosperity. How should we handle the situation?
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.22.a: They won't cause us any harm, let them be
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.22.b: It is imperative that we increase our national security!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.23.desc: The [FROM.GetAdjective] agents have now begun spreading pan-asianist propaganda throughout Lhasa, and have begun smuggling funds in to sway the local nobles with. It seems that the situation might soon be getting out of hand...
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.24.desc: Our officers have reported that the [FROM.GetAdjective] agents have seemingly been successful in establishing contact with Thubten Kunphela, a noble who holds a lot of power, being nicknamed the Strongman of Tibet back in the day. Things might get bad for us from here on out...
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.25.desc: The Tibet Improvement Party, a political party formed in exile in British India which holds loyalties towards Thubten Kunphela, has recently been receiving packages of weapons from unknown senders. It seems that they might be preparing for a coup d'etat, from a position outside of our reach.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.25.a: This is getting out of hand!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.26.desc: The day has come, at long last. Earlier this morning, Thubten Kunphela marched upon Lhasa with his armed supporters, claiming that our rule is corrupt and illegitimate, and stating that [ROOT.GetNameDef] would be better off as a part of the [FROM.GetAdjective] sphere. Do we give in to his demands, or do we make one last stand?
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.27.desc: The day has finally come, that we can launch our campaign and claim the realm of Outer Mongolia, currently ruled by the illegitimate coward [MON.GetLeader]. It is time to show the world that the spirit of Ghengis Khan lives on!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.28.desc: After having occupied rightfully Mongol lands, our overlord [FROM.GetNameDef] has handed over the administration of the territories to us, as they had promised. We are very thankful for the trust they place in us!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.29.desc: The Suiyuan Campaign has come to an end, and the new borders have been drawn up. This is likely the last time our subjects can attempt an incursion like this without the Chinese central government joining in, as they are now on high alert regarding our actions in the region.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.29.a: At least we can now focus on other areas
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.30.t: The End of the Suiyuan Campaign
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.30.desc: Finally, the relentless assault by [JAP.GetNameDef] and their vicious subjects have come to a halt, and their troops are returning to their positions. It is unknown whether what transpired today will be remembered in history, but at least the Nanjing Government is now aware of the [JAP.GetAdjective] ambitions in the region.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.31.desc: Forces belonging to [MEN.GetNameDef] and the Grand Han Righteous Army have assaulted our positions in Suiyuan, and seem intent on capturing the Inner Mongolian aimags in our possession. We cannot let them pass!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.31.a: Show them who they're dealing with
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.32.t: Japan Seeks Collaboration against the Communist Threat
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.32.desc: [FROM.GetAdjective] diplomats have made a one-eighty in regards to their foreign policy, and are now stating that they wish to work more closely with us, on the condition that we crack down on communist and anti-Japanese sentiments. Something is fishy about the deal, but perhaps it is worth the risk?
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.32.b: We will make no deals with the [JAP.GetAdjective]
loc.CHI_accepted_JAP_demands_to_suppress_com: China has chosen to cooperate with our demands
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.33.desc: [FROM.GetLeader], leader of [FROM.GetNameDef] has accepted our proposition, and promised to ban protests against our state, whilst also preparing to crack down on communist activities within the nation. Soon, we will be able to formalize an alliance with them, so that we can destroy the festering sore that threatens to lead all Asian people toward an inescapable and inevitable demise.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.33.a: The first step has been taken
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.34.desc: [FROM.GetLeader], leader of [FROM.GetNameDef] has decided that the [FROM.GetAdjective] people deserve no quarter, rejecting our gracious offer and making the decision for us that we need to bring the [FROM.GetAdjective] nation to an end.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.34.a: They will come to regret their decision
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.35.desc: Various radio stations on the west coast have begun broadcasting [FROM.GetAdjective] propaganda in order to sway our population to take their side in the conflict for Asia. We must shut this down, before it does too much harm!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.36.desc: Radio stations belonging to [FROM.GetNameDef] have begun to broadcast pro-[FROM.GetAdjective] propaganda throughout our nation. The [FROM.GetAdjective] government has now also approached us offering to invest into our industries, in exchange for us allowing the radio stations to stay open.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.36.b: Crack down on this nonsense now!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.37.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has decided to accept our offer, and will allow our radio stations to stay open on the [FROM.GetAdjective] airways. They have also allowed our industrialists to set up shop there.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.38.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has decided to block our interference in [FROM.GetNameDef], deciding that their independence is somehow more valuable than the divine pan-Asian mission.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.38.a: They know what fate has in store for them
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.39.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef] has decided to authorize investments into our natural resources, and [FROM.GetAdjective] companies have already begun setting up operations within our borders.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.39.a: Surely there is some hidden intent behind this
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.40.t: The Question of East Asian Co-Prosperity
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.40.desc: With the establishment of the Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere, a question has arisen. Do we pursue to promised goal of Asian prosperity, or do we take that which is rightfully ours and assert our control over Asia more directly?
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.40.a: The Emperor's supreme authority must always come first!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.40.b: We must pursue prosperity for all Asian states!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.41.desc: The Senbu have been established to increase our control over our continental possessions, and have begun attempting to increase the compliance in our occupied territories. Perhaps it is time to give them more administrative duties, and properly put them to use?
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.41.a: We should employ this strategy immediately!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.41.b: It would be wise to wait with our decision
loc.apply_senbu_law_tt: Applies the §YSenbu§! occupation law to all applicable occupied territories
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.42.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has proclaimed that both of our nations possess a shared destiny, and that only by walking side by side can we eradicate the communist threat. To that end, the proposition of an alliance has been put forward to us, though its terms seem to state that it is only temporary. Should we accept their offer?
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.42.a: It lies within our best interest
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.43.desc: Our people rejoice, as the [FROM.GetAdjective] nation has joined us in arms against the ultimate threat to Asian stability, namely the communists. Though this pact is only temporary, it is sure to bring us great advantages.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.44.desc: Foolishly, [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef] has decided to act dishonorably, refusing our great proposal. The alliance has been called off, and the Kwantung Army has once again begun eyeing up northern China. Perhaps a readjustment to our foreign policy is what is needed right now.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.44.a: Nothing can be done about it
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.45.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef] has arrived at our capital today extending an offer to us. They wish for us to increase our unified economic activities and further our integration with them. It would help our economy significantly, but something smells fishy about all of this...
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.45.a: It is too good to pass up
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.45.b: We will not give up our economic independence!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.46.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef] has responded favorably to our offer, and their diplomats have arrived in our nation to sign the necessary documents to facilitate their further economic integration.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.46.a: We are grateful for their naiveté
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.47.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef] has responded to our integration invitation with strong displeasure, and claims that any sort of closer economic partnership between our countries is and will forever be off the table. Perhaps they could see what we had in store for them...
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.48.desc: Industrialists belonging to [FROM.GetNameDef] have begun developing our local industries, and setting up new corporations within our borders. This is bound to bring us closer to prosperity.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.49.desc: In a proclamation held in Shanghai today, [ROOT.GetLeader] alongside generals and administrators sent by the IJA declared the founding of new Chinese government, a better alternative to the corrupt Kuomintang fiefdom. Long live the Republic of China!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.50.desc: Integrating our economies was not enough to satiate the [FROM.GetAdjective]s, as [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef] has today demanded our total integration into their nation. If we do not break off from them immediately, this will be the end of our status as an independent nation. How shall we go about this?
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.50.a: We will have to accept the situation
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.51.desc: The glorious news that the leadership in [FROM.GetNameDef] has accepted to become integrated into our nation has been met with great applause in the National Diet earlier today. What we could offer was clearly enough for them to consider the offer advantageous despite the end of their sovereignty.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.52.desc: Despite the obvious advantages and it clearly being the best for the future of Asia, [FROM.GetNameDef] has rejected our kindly request for total integration. One can only speculate as to their reasons, but it seems the might not have the regions best interests in mind.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.52.a: They are a risk to Asia's unity!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.52.b: We will keep a close eye upon them..
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.53.t: Subversives Spotted in Khan Khentii Uulyn Aimag
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.53.desc: Agents suspected to be acting on the orders of the [FROM.GetAdjective] have been spotted within our borders, seemingly attempting to make contact with nobles, and enticing our citizens with great promises of Co-Prosperity. It seems they have plans for the people of Mongolia.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.53.a: We must be on our guard!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.54.desc: As of recently, it seems arms belonging to [FROM.GetNameDef] have been flooding our black markets, many of which reaching dissidents and subversives within our borders. It seems they may either simply be aiming to destabilize us, or maybe worse, overthrow our government!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.55.desc: Forces belonging to the Inner Mongolian army have been spotted amassing on our southern border. It seems they may be preparing for an incursion into our territory, though their exact objectives are uncertain.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.55.a: It is now do or die, prepare for the worst!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.56.t: Manchurian Guerillas Spotted in the East
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.56.desc: Manchurian Guerillas have been spotted outside of Bayan Tümen, as well as in other parts of our eastern regions. They are currently no worse than regular bandits, but with time they will become a real issue.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.56.a: It is now do or die, prepare for the worst!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.57.desc: Earlier today, the [FROM.GetAdjective] government presented us with an ultimatum. They demand we submit to them, if we wish for our nation not to be destroyed. We know however what they have in store for us, and perhaps it may be in our best interest to resist them?
loc.MON_japan_starts_a_popular_civil_war_tt: Japan will launch a popular civil war against our government, and is likely to intervene on its side
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.58.desc: Our [FROM.GetAdjective] overlords have handed over the administration of many former Kuomintang-controlled states to us, asking us to begin preparation to properly integrate these lands into our state. We will not disappoint them!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.59.t: Proclamation of the State of Burma
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.59.desc: Earlier today, [ROOT.GetLeader] and various [JAP.GetAdjective] army leaders held a joint proclamation, declaring the establishment of a new [ROOT.GetAdjective] state. We will stand victorious against all of our foes!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.60.t: Japan Establishes the State of Burma
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.60.desc: [JAP.GetLeader] has proclaimed the establishment of a new [ROOT.GetAdjective] state, one opposed to us and our current course. It seems they are prepared to fight for their independence from us, and are not going to give up without a fight!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.60.a: Fight them back, destroy any traitors!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.60.b: We must join them, prosperity is within sight!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.61.desc: The traitor Wang Jingwei was seen leaving his residence last week, and left with an unknown destination. In hindsight it seemed inevitable, due to his dissatisfaction with [ROOT.GetLeader]s policies. He will not however be missed.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.62.desc: Wang Jingwei, a former high-ranking member in the Kuomintang has arrived in Shanghai and wishes to work with us. Due to his position and popularity, it may be wise to give him a prominent position in our government, as he may be able to lead us well.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.62.a: He will make for a strong leader
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.63.desc: [JAP.GetLeader] has demanded that we merge our government with [RNG.GetNameDef], ending our independence and giving our leadership high-ranking positions within the [RNG.GetAdjective] government. Do we accept this proposal?
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.63.a: [ROOT.GetLeader] will gain a good position, so we accept
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.63.b: That would be the end to our autonomy, no!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.64.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef] has accepted the [JAP.GetAdjective] proposal to merge with our government, and the [FROM.GetAdjective] lands now all fall under our jurisdiction. This is a great day for us!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.65.desc: The shallow [FROM.GetLeader] has refused to see reason, and has rejected our proposal to merge with [RNG.GetNameDef]. Perhaps a better deal, and maybe even a proper dosage of intimidation is in order.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.65.a: They will accept in due time..
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.66.t: Proclamation of the Provisional Government of Free India
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.66.desc: Earlier today, [ROOT.GetLeader] and various [JAP.GetAdjective] army leaders held a joint proclamation, declaring the establishment of a new [ROOT.GetAdjective] state. We will stand victorious against all of our foes!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.67.t: Japan Establishes the Provisional Government of Free India
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.67.desc: [JAP.GetLeader] has proclaimed the establishment of a new [ROOT.GetAdjective] state, one opposed to us and our current course. It seems they are prepared to fight for their independence from us, and are not going to give up without a fight!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.67.a: Fight them back, destroy any traitors!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.67.b: We must join them, prosperity is within sight!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.68.t: Proclamation of the Second Philippine Republic
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.68.desc: Earlier today, [ROOT.GetLeader] and various [JAP.GetAdjective] army leaders held a joint proclamation, declaring the establishment of a new [ROOT.GetAdjective] state. We will stand victorious against all of our foes!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.69.t: Japan Establishes the Second Philippine Republic
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.69.desc: [JAP.GetLeader] has proclaimed the establishment of a new [ROOT.GetAdjective] state, one opposed to us and our current course. It seems they are prepared to fight for their independence from us, and are not going to give up without a fight!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.69.a: Fight them back, destroy any traitors!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.69.b: We must join them, prosperity is within sight!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.70.desc: [FROM.GetAdjective] diplomats have delivered an ultimatum to us, demanding we redraw our eastern borders and sign a conditional peace with them, essentially abandoning Asian affairs. It will give us the ability to fully focus our efforts on regaining our European lands, and maybe allow us to return to recapture the east once all our other foes have fallen.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.70.b: That will be one enemy off our backs
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.71.desc: The fools in Moscow have refused to surrender to our initial demands. This calls for the total annihilation of their state, and even further border adjustments than were initially planned!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.71.a: They will fall to our blade!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.72.desc: Diplomats speaking for [FROM.GetLeader] have agreed to our demands with their tails between their legs, and are surrendering their Siberian possessions to us. Today marks a great day for the Empire!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.73.desc: Our allies have withdrawn from Eastern Asia, capitulating to the demands of [JAP.GetNameDef]. This leaves us in a very vulnerable position. Do we seek new allies, or do we keep fighting against the [JAP.GetAdjective]?
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.73.b: Then we must gain Japan's protection in their stead!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.74.desc: [FROM.GetLeader], leader of [FROM.GetNameDef], disappointed with the blatant betrayal by the past allies of [FROM.GetName], has now reached out to us asking for us to take up the new position of the protector of their lands and their people. Do be oblige?
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.75.desc: It seems that our contacts in [FROM.GetNameDef] have finally managed to secure a deal with the nation's leadership, after the Kōdōha faction in which most of our contacts existed recently took over the government after a successful coup d'etat. Long live the two emperors!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.76.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has declared that due to the state of emergency that was declared in the wake of the Kōdōha coup, and the possibility of dissenting officers hiding in our governed regions, we should become an integrated part of the nation. This would in turn allow for full governance by the [FROM.GetAdjective] state. Do we accept?
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.76.a: We will have to accept the situation
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.76.b: They think too highly of themselves
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.77.desc: [FROM.GetLeader], our governor of [FROM.GetNameDef] has accepted full integration into our nation earlier today. This means that our government can finally hold full control over even the local divisions of our Korean regions.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.78.desc: Despite the obvious advantages and it clearly being the best for the future of the nation, the governor of [FROM.GetNameDef], [FROM.GetLeader] has rejected our request for total integration. One can only speculate as to the reasons, but it seems they might not have the nations best interests in mind.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.78.a: We need someone more trustworthy in charge!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.78.b: We will respect their wishes, for now...
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.79.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has approached us with a proposition, claiming it is for the best of both our populations. The request is for our nation to become an integrated part of [FROM.GetNameDef] in due time, ending our autonomy and making us a core part of their realm. Does this really benefit us?
loc.MAN_we_can_be_annexed_by_kodoha_tt: We will be able to be §RAnnexed§! by [JAP.GetNameDef] in the near future!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.80.desc: The Concordia Association, the ruling elite in [FROM.GetNameDef], have agreed to our proposition and stand ready to administer the region as an integral part of our realm in the near future. It seems our plans for unification will be able to proceed smoothly.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.81.desc: The Concordia Association, the ruling elite in [FROM.GetNameDef], have decided to refuse our offer, claiming that they do not benefit from being integrated in our nation. Perhaps they were persuaded by Manchurian dissidents or communists, but sadly it is not a decision we can reverse all that easily...
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.81.a: We will deal with them later
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.82.desc: Our historical friends over in the far eastern nation of [FROM.GetName] have approached us with an enticing offer. Due to our historical ties, and our mutual distrust towards the [SOV.GetAdjective] state, they have offered a military pact that states that if one of us enters a war with [SOV.GetNameDef], so will the other. Surely this is too good of an opportunity to pass up?
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.82.b: This puts us in too much danger
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.83.desc: Our great friends in [FROM.GetNameDef] have graciously accepted our offer to establish a mutual anti-[SOV.GetAdjective] pact. Delegates are signing the necessary documents to make the agreement into reality at this very moment, and preparation for a swift invasion of [SOV.GetNameDef] should it become necessary are also underway.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.84.desc: Sadly, despite our historical efforts to improve relations between our two nations, [FROM.GetLeader] has turned down our proposal for a mutual anti-[SOV.GetAdjective] pact. It is stated to be too dangerous for the [FROM.GetAdjective] nation should the pact be discovered by [SOV.GetAdjective] agents.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.84.a: Perhaps a second isolation would benefit us...
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.85.d: Just as we suspected when we signed the Anti-Soviet Pact, we now find ourselves in a state of war with the Soviet Union. It is time for our co-signatories to honor their promise and join us.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.86.desc: The Polish-Japanese Anti-Soviet Pact stipulates that all signatories must join in any defensive conflict with the Soviet Union. [From.GetName] has now been attacked by the Soviets and has sent out a request for all pact members to come to their aid immediately. It is time to show the [Root.GetAdjective] dedication to protecting the world from the threat of the Soviet Union once and for all.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.86.b_tt: §YThis will be viewed as a betrayal by all countries who honor the pact (§!§R-50§!§Y opinion)§!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.87.desc: After the Concordia Association recently agreed to the Kōdōhas demands, it was only ever a matter of time before this would happen. Today, a [FROM.GetAdjective] delegation arrived with documents to facilitate our full integration into their nation, something which has already been signed by our own delegates.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.87.a: It is what we signed off on
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.88.desc: [FROM.GetLeader], the leader of [FROM.GetNameDef] has accepted full integration into our nation earlier today. This means that our government can finally hold full control over even the local divisions of our Manchurian regions.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.89.desc: We have received an offer from [FROM.GetNameDef]. They are interested in a long term trade of resources in return for some of their industrial capacity. Currently they have their eyes on a number of the resources in [FROM.FROM.GetName].
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.89.b: This is not a good time
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.90.desc: We have received word from the [FROM.GetAdjective]s about our request to trade industry in return for some of their resources. It seems that we are in agreement regarding the benefits of this deal and they have happily agreed to the terms. We shall be receiving the resources shortly.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.91.desc: Though mostly neutral about our suggested deal the [FROM.GetAdjective]s have ultimately chosen to decline our proposal of trading industry to them in return for resources. They claim that this is not a good time, making it sound like we could maybe reach an agreement in the future, once we have strengthened our relationship further.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.91.a: If at first you don't succeed...
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.92.desc: Diplomats belonging to [FROM.GetNameDef] have approached us regarding the strengthening of our ties, something that was being curtailed by the military factions within their country, something that has now been dealt with. They wish for both trade, research and defensive agreements. Either we could sign off on one of these, or we could accept it all. It doesn't seem like a good idea to snub them entirely, after all the effort they went through to get here.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.92.a: Ties can be strengthened through trade
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.92.b: We see no need for agreements...
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.92.c: We should establish a proper defensive agreement with them
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.92.d: We should sign all of the proposed agreements!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.93.desc: The gracious leader of [FROM.GetNameDef], [FROM.GetLeader], has accepted one of our proposals, agreeing to establish closer trade and research connections to our nation. This is a great day for [ROOT.GetNameDef] and her diplomatic achievements!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.94.desc: The two faced leader of [FROM.GetNameDef], [FROM.GetLeader], has denied all of our proposals, shutting down the idea of closer connections between our nations. This is a dark day for [ROOT.GetNameDef] and her diplomatic achievements...
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.95.desc: The gracious leader of [FROM.GetNameDef], [FROM.GetLeader], has accepted one of our proposals, agreeing to establish a defensive pact with our nation, where both of us promise to come to the others aid in case one is attacked. This is a great day for [ROOT.GetNameDef] and her diplomatic achievements!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.96.desc: The gracious leader of [FROM.GetNameDef], [FROM.GetLeader], has accepted all of our proposals, agreeing to establish closer trade and research and development connections, as well as establishing a defensive pact with our nation, where both of us promise to come to the others aid in case one is attacked. This is a great day for [ROOT.GetNameDef] and her diplomatic achievements!
loc.jap_usa_japan_research_desc: A research agreement between the scientists of the United States and Japan.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.97.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef] has sent diplomats to our capital to discuss the prospect of intricate trade relations with the [FROM.GetAdjective] nation. This would take our relationship closer, but this will allow them access to our resources at a cheaper price, which has the risk of hurting our economy.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.97.a: We see no issue with this
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.97.b: You can take your papers back to Tokyo!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.98.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef] has responded well to our proposal for cheaper trade between our nations, and has signed the necessary paperwork to facilitate this going into effect immediately. They share our vision of a bright future, for all of Asia!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.99.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef] has responded harshly on our request for cheaper trade within our alliance, threatening to establish tariffs if we try to force such an issue through. It seems [FROM.GetNameDef] will not be a part of the bright future we have in mind.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.100.t: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] Invites us to a Currency Union
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.100.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef] has approached us with an offer for us to join a currency union with them, which will do nothing but to strengthen both of our nations' economies. Sounds like a deal too good to pass up right?
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.101.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef] has responded well to our proposal for the establishment of a common currency between our nations, and has signed the necessary paperwork to facilitate this going into effect immediately. They share our vision of a bright future, for all of Asia!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.102.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef] has responded harshly on our request for the adoption of a common currency within our alliance, threatening to establish tariffs if we try to force such an issue through. It seems [FROM.GetNameDef] will not be a part of the bright future we have in mind.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.103.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef] has arrived at our capital today extending an offer to us. They wish for us to increase our currency union activities and further our economic integration with them. It would help our economy significantly, but something smells fishy about all of this...
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.103.a: It is too good to pass up
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.103.b: We will not give up our economic independence!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.104.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef] has responded favorably to our offer, and their diplomats have arrived in our nation to sign the necessary documents to facilitate their further economic integration.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.104.a: We are grateful for their naiveté
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.105.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef] has responded to our integration invitation with strong displeasure, and claims that any sort of closer economic partnership between our countries is and will forever be off the table. Perhaps they could see what we had in store for them...
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.106.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef] has gone a step further than was initially promised, and is manipulating the markets to further increase our dependency on their economy, in a move to ensure we cannot stray from their path. If we do not break off from them immediately, this will practically be the end of our status as an independent nation. How shall we go about this?
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.106.a: We will have to accept the situation
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.107.desc: The glorious news that the leadership in [FROM.GetNameDef] has chosen to become further integrated with us has been met with great applause in the Diet earlier today. What we could offer was clearly enough for them to consider the offer advantageous despite the slight hit to their sovereignty.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.108.desc: Despite the obvious advantages and it clearly being the best for the union, [FROM.GetNameDef] has rejected our proposal for further integration. One can only speculate as to their reasons, but it seems they might not have the unions best interests in mind.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.108.a: They are a risk to the organization's unity!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.108.b: We will keep a close eye upon them
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.109.desc: Integrating our economies was apparently not enough to satiate the [FROM.GetAdjective]s, as [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef] has today gone a step further than was initially promised, and is now demanding our total integration into their nation. If we do not break off from them immediately, this will be the end of our status as an independent nation. How shall we go about this?
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.109.a: We will have to accept the situation
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.110.desc: The glorious news that the leadership in [FROM.GetNameDef] have allowed themselves to become integrated into our nation has been met with great applause in the Diet earlier today. What we could offer was clearly enough for them to consider the offer advantageous despite the end of their sovereignty.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.111.desc: Despite the obvious advantages and it clearly being the best for the union, [FROM.GetNameDef] has rejected our proposal for total integration. One can only speculate as to their reasons, but it seems the might not have the unions best interests in mind.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.111.a: They are a risk to the organization's unity!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.111.b: We will keep a close eye upon them
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.112.t: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] Requests Control of our Asian Colonies
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.112.desc: Diplomats belonging to [FROM.GetNameDef] have proposed an agreement where they be given overlordship of our subjects in Burma and Malaysia in exchange for resource rights to some of the vital areas, claiming this to be a part of their Pacific Guardian doctrine, claiming it would allow us to focus on Europe and Africa while they protect Asia from communism. What say we?
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.112.a: It allows us to focus our efforts on other areas
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.113.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef] has graciously accepted our offer, and has signed the paperwork to facilitate a handover of their colonies in Malaysia and Burma to us, in exchange for retaining control of vital natural resources in the area. Today is a great day for the Asian people!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.113.a: We will guard the Pacific for them
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.114.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef] has made a shameful display, and shown to us how clouded and corrupted the western mindset is. We made them a deal they couldn't refuse, that would make Asia a better place, yet somehow they found a way. Today is a dark day for our alliance.
loc.ENG_will_gain_resource_right_we_tt: We will gain resource rights to some of the states in the countries transferred
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.115.t: [From.GetNameDefCap] Wants Overlordship Over one of Our Colonies
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.115.desc: Seizing the opportunity granted by our weakness, the [From.GetAdjective] have offered to 'help' us with 'maintaining order' in our colonies. They argue that, with the world ablaze elsewhere, we have no possibility of maintaining our hold over these regions.\n\nIt is clearly a ploy to wrestle control of our colonies away from us, but what choice do we have?
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.115.a: It is time we accept Japanese dominance in Asia
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.115.b: They'll have to take them by force!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.116.desc: [From.GetNameDefCap] have carefully considered our offer to 'maintain order' in their colonies, and have decided to accept. They have effectively transferred total control of their subject over to us.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.117.desc: [From.GetNameDefCap] have carefully considered our offer to 'maintain order' in their colonies, and have decided to reject it. It seems they do not have the best interest of the Asian peoples in mind.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.117.a: We shall see how that pans out for them
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.117.b: Then we shall liberate them by force!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.118.desc: A delegation from far away has recently arrived at our capital, seeking an audience with [ROOT.GetLeader]. They claim to be from [FROM.GetNameDef], and seek an alliance between our nations. Do we accept?
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.118.b: That would go against our principles of neutrality...
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.119.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has graciously accepted our offer to formalize an alliance between our nations, and has already begun initiatives to integrate into our sphere. Today is a day for celebration!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.119.a: They share our vision for the future
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.120.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has rudely decided to reject our offer of an alliance between our nations, stating that it would go against their principle of neutrality. We can only imagine the amounts of corruption that led to this erroneous decision.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.121.desc: [FROM.GetLeader], our former overlord, has signed documents facilitating the handover of control over our nation to [JAP.GetNameDef]. It seems we have been placed under the protection of another major power. We now have a new Overlord under whose whims we will be subordinated.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.122.desc: The [From.GetAdjective] have decided to recall their left-leaning civil servants and generals, and have instead sent us their right-leaning generals and civil servants in unofficial exile.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.122.a: It would seem something's afoot in [From.GetNameDef]...
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.123.desc: The process of exchanging our right-leaning generals and civil servants for the left-leaning ones we had previously sent into unofficial exile in [From.GetNameDef] has now been completed.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.123.a: This will strengthen our hold over [Root.GetNameDef].
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.124.t: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] Invites us to The Fifth International
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.124.desc: A delegation from far away has recently arrived at our capital, seeking an audience with [ROOT.GetLeader]. They claim to be from [FROM.GetNameDef], and seek an alliance between our nations. Do we accept?
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.124.b: That would go against our principles of neutrality...
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.125.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has graciously accepted our offer to formalize an alliance between our nations, and has already begun initiatives to integrate into our sphere. Today is a day for celebration!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.125.a: They share our vision for the future
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.126.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has rudely decided to reject our offer of an alliance between our nations, stating that it would go against their principle of neutrality. We can only imagine the amounts of corruption that led to this erroneous decision.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.127.desc: The treacherous [FROM.GetLeader] has left us in favor of the communists in [JAP.GetNameDef], breaking the agreements signed between our nations at the end of the Russian civil war. Should we punish them for their turncoat behavior?
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.127.a: No, we must let this go...
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.127.b: Yes, they will pay for this!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.128.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef] has demanded that our illegal breakaway state once again submit to the rule of the central authority in Tokyo, and return to the [FROM.GetAdjective] sphere. How should we respond to this apparent threat?
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.128.a: We do not possess the strength to reject their demands
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.128.b: We will fight to the last man!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.129.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef] has intelligently accepted our demands and submitted to our authority, once again bringing the [FROM.GetAdjective] nation back into our sphere of influence. We stand victorious on this day, as the [FROM.GetAdjective] people have now been liberated from their bourgeois dictatorship!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.130.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef] has unfortunately rejected our demands for submission, claiming that the will of the people is for an independent democracy rather than a revolutionary state in the [ROOT.GetAdjective] sphere. They have made the wrong choice...
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.130.a: Then we must take back our territory by force!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.131.desc: After recent calls by the [FROM.GetAdjective] government and agitators such as Pak Hon-yong it seems that the [ROOT.GetAdjective] proletariat has grown weary of waiting for a peaceful change of government. Following intense discourse it seems that diplomacy has fallen through and armed conflict has ensued, with Hon-yong's forces already having seized control of the southern parts of the country.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.132.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef] has demanded that our bourgeois dictatorship submit to the rule of the central communist authority in Tokyo, and allow the people of our nation to properly rule themselves, as a loyal part of the [FROM.GetAdjective] sphere. How should we respond to this apparent threat?
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.132.a: We do not possess the strength to reject their demands
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.132.b: We will fight to the last man!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.133.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef] has accepted our demands and submitted to our authority, bringing the [FROM.GetAdjective] nation into our sphere of influence. We stand victorious on this day, as the [FROM.GetAdjective] people have now been liberated from their bourgeois dictatorship!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.134.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef] has unfortunately rejected our demands for submission, claiming that the will of the people is for an independent nation rather than a revolutionary state in the [ROOT.GetAdjective] sphere. They have made the wrong choice...
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.134.a: Then we must liberate their people by force!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.135.t: Proclamation of the Second Philippine Republic
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.135.desc: Earlier today, [ROOT.GetLeader] and various [JAP.GetAdjective] army leaders held a joint proclamation, declaring the establishment of a new [ROOT.GetAdjective] state. We will stand victorious against all of our foes!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.136.desc: Yesterday, a date which will live in infamy, [ROOT.GetNameDef] was suddenly and deliberately attacked by naval and air forces of the [JAP.GetNameDef]. [ROOT.GetNameDefCap] was at peace with that Nation and, at the solicitation of [JAP.GetNonIdeologyName], was still in conversation with its Government and its Emperor looking toward the maintenance of peace in the Pacific. Indeed, one hour after [JAP.GetAdjective] air squadrons had commenced bombing in the [ROOT.GetAdjective] Island of Oahu, the [JAP.GetAdjective] Ambassador to the United States and his colleague delivered to our Secretary of State a formal reply to a recent [ROOT.GetAdjective] message. And while this reply stated that it seemed useless to continue the existing diplomatic negotiations, it contained no threat or hint of war or of armed attack. But now it is time to face the truth... We are at war!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.136.a: This day will live on in infamy!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.137.desc: [JAP.GetLeader] has demanded that we merge our government with [MAN.GetNameDef], ending our independence and giving our leadership high-ranking positions within the [MAN.GetAdjective] government. Do we accept this proposal?
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.137.a: [ROOT.GetLeader] will gain a good position, so we accept
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.137.b: That would be the end to our autonomy, no!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.138.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef] has accepted the [JAP.GetAdjective] proposal to merge with our government, and the [FROM.GetAdjective] lands now all fall under our jurisdiction. This is a great day for us!
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.139.desc: The shallow [FROM.GetLeader] has refused to see reason, and has rejected our proposal to merge them into the [MAN.GetAdjective] government. Perhaps a better deal, and maybe even a proper dosage of intimidation is in order.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.140.desc: [MAN.GetLeader] has requested that we merge other Chinese puppet governments with [MAN.GetNameDef], ending their autonomy and giving their lands to the [MAN.GetAdjective] government. Do we accept this proposal?
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.140.a: Very well, it makes our administrative duties simpler
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.141.desc: [JAP.GetLeader] has thoroughly rejected our request to merge other Chinese puppet governments with ours. It seems it was too early for such a move to be readily accepted by the government.
loc.SEA_japan_foreign_policy.141.a: We will have to try again later...
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.1.desc: Our agents have captured a [SOV.GetAdjective] defector referring to himself as Genrikh Samoilovich Lyushkov in Posyet on the Manchurian border. He seems to be a high-ranking officer of the NKVD, apparently possessing valuable secret documents about the [SOV.GetAdjective] military strength in the region.
