Claiming to be escaping the Great Purge, perhaps this is a valuable opportunity for gaining insight into the inner workings of [SOV.GetNameDef]?
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.1.b: We cannot trust this foreigner to be truthful
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.2.t: The Defense Brotherhood on the Verge of Collapse!
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.2.desc: After recent internal disputes between the leadership of the Dōshikai, it seems that the organization is about to collapse. With some citing blatant disrespect by Kishi and his allies towards Tōjō, as well as multiple rumors of potential plans for assassinations swirling around, the air contains a great unease. Not to mention rumors that Kishi plans for a technocratic  dictatorship that would go against the will of the emperor and the IJA. Is it best to just let this pairing go, or is it too valuable to pass up?
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.2.b: We must maintain it at all costs!
loc.JAP_harakiri_debate_has_taken_place_flag: Tensions between the §YCivilian Government§! and the §YMilitary Factions§! have reached a breaking point, and the §YHarakiri Debate§! has taken place
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.3.desc: At a plenary session of the House of Representatives of the Imperial Diet earlier today, Hamada Kunimatsu, a member of the Rikken Seiyukai Party gave a scathing critique of army minister Hisaichi Terauchi and the growing power of the military factions. Upon being confronted by the minister for disrespecting the military's authority and supposedly insulting their honor, he responded with 'Check the transcript and if there are any words that insult the military, I will commit seppuku and apologize to you. If there are no such words, you will commit seppuku yourself'. After this, Terauchi was furious at this and glared at Hamada from the stage, causing chaos with angry shouts flying through the assembly hall.
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.4.desc: Our Emperor has expressed disinterest towards our ambitions for a Shōwa Restoration and an establishment of a new military government. It is likely that he is still simply under the spell of the control faction, but will he not side with us, we would likely have to replace his imperial highness with his brother Yasuhito. Should we 'persuade' him to join us or might it be wise to let history play its course?
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.4.a: We must gain his support, by any means necessary!
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.4.b: We have other candidates in mind
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.4.c: If he doesn't support us, he must go...
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.5.t: Hirohito Decides to Support the New Government
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.5.desc: After sufficient 'persuasion', it seems that our great emperor has decided to support our newly formed government, giving us the official blessing to continue forward with our plans of a Shōwa Restoration. This will serve to strengthen our nation!
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.6.t: Hirohito Refuses to Support the New Government
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.6.desc: Despite our persistent attempts to persuade our great emperor, it seems he refuses to see reason. Though less than ideal, we did know that this was a possibility, and have plans laid to deal with a scenario of this kind. His brother, Yasuhito, a general in the Imperial Japanese Army is the candidate we have in mind who will take his place. This will either be as a Sesshō for Hirohito's son Akihito, or as a new emperor, one much more in line with our ideology.
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.6.a: Then he must abdicate in favor of his son
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.7.desc: Earlier today our officers reportedly found Emperor Shōwa dead in his residence. They claim he was assassinated by foreign agents, but we cannot know for certain, for the truth may hurt us more than it would benefit us. Due to this threat, the military has declared martial law, and stated that Prince Chichibu, general of the Imperial Army will be crowned, as it would be too dangerous to continue the succession and give the crown to Akihito when the assailants may still be at large. Is this part of a greater conspiracy, or is there truly a foreign assailant?
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.8.t: Question of the Military Clique's Leadership
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.8.desc: With the establishment of our new military government, the question of leadership has once again arisen. The founder of the Kōdōha Sadao Araki has stated that he wishes to take up the role of prime minister, and has put this forward to the emperor, but with Jinzaburō Masaki being more popular among both the men and the general populace than Araki, it may be wiser to allow him the role of Prime Minister, while Araki simply takes up a ceremonial position. What should we do?
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.8.a: Masaki is more popular among the men
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.8.b: Araki should be made the nation's Sōtō
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.9.t: The Question of Morality, Bushido and Fascism
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.9.desc: General Sadao Araki, a noted political philosopher within the army, has linked the ancient Bushido code of the samurai with ideas similar to European fascism in order to form the philosophical basis of his ideology, which links the Emperor, the people, the land and morality as one and indivisible. In order to strengthen these ideas, it may be wise to adopt a form of government closer to those in the west that he builds his ideological model upon. What say we?
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.9.a: We must stay clear of such western concepts!
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.9.b: Araki is right, and we should embrace those ideas
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.10.desc: Recently rumors have been swirling around of a possible coup d'etat being planned by the Kōdōha faction, a radical traditionalist faction within the army. It seems likely that they will wait until Lieutenant Colonel Saburō Aizawa's trial is over, with him being an integral part of their organization. Knowing their possible motives, it seems likely that they will attempt to assassinate many of those who they see as a threat to their values during this coup. We may need to act swiftly, lest we see a bloodbath in the near future.
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.10.a: How dishonorable! We must act swiftly!
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.11.desc: With the Emperor still in house arrest despite the long time since we established our government, dissent is growing ever faster. It seems that our people wish to see Hirohito properly restored to the throne, and they may even be preparing to take action to free him if we do not do something about the situation soon. Perhaps they would calm down a bit if there were no such figure who could be restored to the throne, however unpopular it may be for us to make this happen. How should we approach this?
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.11.a: The orders will be given, but try not to leave evidence
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.11.b: No, the former Emperor must live!
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.12.t: The Emperor Found Dead in his Residence
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.12.desc: The prime minister announced earlier today that the former Emperor Shōwa has recently been found deceased in the imperial residence. Many suspect that it may have been a deliberate move by the military to try and secure their power, though the official claim is that he died of natural causes, though the Tokyo police haven't been allowed to enter to confirm his cause of death. Surely this is treason by the military itself?
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.12.b: Find the perpetrators, Nagako demands answers!
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.13.t: Kōdōha Officers Indicted for Hirohito's Murder
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.13.desc: Through the recent investigations made by the Tokyo Metropolitan Police on the orders of Nagako, the wife of the late Emperor Shōwa, it has been discovered that the Kōdōha faction is indeed responsible for the coldblooded killing of the former Emperor. With more than enough grounds to declare this to be high treason, it is time to oust this treacherous clique from power.
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.13.a: Declare martial law, Nagako will solve the nations instability!
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.14.desc: Despite the dangerous times, the general election has been concluded, and our people have decided who will represent them in the House of Representatives. The Rikken Minseitō under Machida Chūji has emerged from the election as the biggest party, with Rikken Seiyūkai losing its majority. Though not holding great importance due to the recently falling powers of the civilian government, this election shows that our democracy still stands, fragile as it may be.
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.14.a: May Machida Chūji lead the Rikken Minseitō well
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.15.desc: Earlier this morning, Prime Minister Keisuke Okada was gunned down by Tokkō secret police officers while waiting to take the Yamanote Line at Tokyo Station. Soon after, the military issued a threat to the Imperial Diet, stating that any attempt to exclude them will be met by force. This is a clear escalation of the situation, and interim PM Machida Chūji has appealed to the Emperor to acknowledge the situation and make a statement. Only time will tell which side he will take.
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.16.t: The Emperor Nominates a new Prime Minister
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.16.desc: In response to the recent pleas by interim PM Machida Chūji, Emperor Hirohito has spoken out against the violence incited by the ongoing factionalist conflict, and has decided which person he should nominate to take up the role and become the new Prime Minister in these trying times. The person he has nominated is...
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.16.c: President of the House of Peers, Tokugawa Iesato
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.17.desc: Many high-ranking officials within both the Imperial Japanese Army and the Imperial Japanese Navy have now declared that the army will go on strike, following our government's declaration to put an end to their influence over our politics. They say they will not defend the current government in the event of an attack, and are likely already plotting yet another coup d'etat to oust our Prime Minister from power.
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.18.desc: The Military has begun preparing for clashes against forces loyal to the government after the civilian police forces recently declared loyalty to the diet. It seems they are attempting to secure control of regions in the case a civil war breaks out. We must begin counteracting this act of insurgency with utmost haste!
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.18.a: Deploy the Metropolitan Police to Tokyo immediately!
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.18.b: We must ensure they don't take control of the Industrial Belt!
loc.enables_the_civil_war_decisions_tt: We will be able to secure states to join our side in the event a §YCivil War§! breaks out through on-map decisions
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.19.desc: After the killing of another Japanese officer in Shanghai, we have received an ultimatum stating that unless we fully withdraw from the region, they will attack within the week. \n\nHow should we respond?
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.19.a: We must not give in to their demands!
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.20.desc: Chinese authorities claim that the 'breaking point' has been reached in regards to our 'unwarranted aggressions' towards China! Our demands for reparations have been refused, and there are reports of more Japanese nationals coming under attack in Shanghai. If we needed an excuse to deal decisively with the Chinese, this is it!
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.21.desc: Surprisingly, the Chinese have chosen to back down following the ultimatum sent for the control of Shanghai. They understand that angering us carries a steep price, and have agreed to extensive territorial concessions that include the city itself and its surrounding regions. Little by little, China is becoming ours.
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.21.a: The war will have to wait.
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.22.desc: After hearing news of the revocation of the controversial Peace Preservation Law, the army garrison at their headquarters in Osaka Castle opened fire at government-loyal garrisons stationed outside the park. It seems they will not back down without a fight, and are prepared to tear a rift in our nation's soul if it means preserving their hegemony. We must bring them down!
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.22.a: The time has come to bring back the spirit of the Taishō Era!
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.23.desc: The legitimacy of Emperor Hirohito has come into question ever since his complacency towards the increasing military dominance over politics and inaction when violence ramped up between the factions in the country. Now, many call for one of his younger brothers, Nobuhito, who is an outspoken supporter of the civilian government, to take the title of Emperor, as his older brothers have both committed acts of treason. This would be able to retain royal support for our current government, and bolster our people's morale.
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.23.a: Very well, Nobuhito will take his place
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.24.desc: The last remnants of the Imperial Army in the Home Islands have waved the white flag, signaling the end to the decades long conflict raging between our nations government and its own military. Large parts of the nation were damaged by the fighting, but this signals a new start for the [ROOT.GetAdjective] people. Overseas, our enemy still lingers, but right now, it is the time for rebuilding. The government has already made plans to organize the first general election now that the corrupt elements can no longer interfere.
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.25.desc: The first election after the removal of the military from our politics is now being held, and people are going and using their vote to steer the future of the nation. The election currently stands between the liberal Rikken Minseitō party and the more conservative Rikken Seiyūkai, both having led the Imperial Diet very recently. The ballots are being cast, and soon, a winner will be determined.
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.26.desc: With the civil war now raging between the military and the government in Japan, the Kwantung Army stationed in our country has taken the opportunity to perform a military coup against our own government, in the hopes of securing their own feudal warlord state in Manchuria. Should we let this happen, or should we resist them with all we have?
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.26.a: There is no use resisting them
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.26.b: It is time to crush this Japanese yoke!
loc.MAN_kwantung_will_try_to_occupy_east_heb: This will allow us to use the help of the Kwantung Army to seize control over [609.GetName]
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.27.desc: With the civil war now raging between the military and the government in Japan, the Korean people have realized that this is the moment for them to regain control of their country and kick out the Japanese oppressors. Once again, the Korean Peninsula will flourish under the rule of its own people.
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.27.a: Throw the invaders back into the sea!
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.28.desc: The communist party has decided to begin underground operations, out of the sight and mind of both the Imperial Army and the government. The only question that comes to mind for them now is, which region would be remote enough where the possibility of being discovered and rooted out would be as low as possible?
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.29.desc: Early this morning, forces belonging to the Imperial Army occupied a warehouse on the outskirts of Miyazaki in which communist revolutionaries were located, attempting to arrest them. Kyūichi Tokuda has been rescued from Abashiri prison by local communist guerillas, and after a shootout occurred at the Miyazaki warehouse, the order has been given over a radio broadcast by Tokuda to begin the revolution with utmost haste. It seems the time for action is upon us.
loc.JAP_democratic_side_also_spawns_tt: The §YDemocratic Government§! will also attempt to fight back against our Revolution!
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.30.t: Debate on the Future Direction of the State
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.30.desc: With the situation now more stable after the defeat of the Imperial Army, debate has broken out in the national diet regarding which route to take. The Kōza-ha argue that only through utilizing the proletariat and using an authoritarian guiding hand to steer the people can we achieve our ideal future, while the Rōnō-ha argue that a softer and less intrusive umbrella movement would be ideal to control the state. Which idea should be enacted?
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.30.a: The Kōza-ha are in the right here
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.30.b: The Rōnō-ha's ideals shine brightest today
loc.JAP_supported_the_kozaha_idea_flag: Supported the Kōza-ha in the debate
loc.JAP_supported_the_rounoha_idea_flag: Supported the Rōnō-ha in the debate
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.31.desc: With the triumph of the revolution and power now in the hands of the Kōza-ha the time has come to elect a premier for the new people's republic. The two party front-runners during the war were Sanzō Nosaka and Kyūichi Tokuda, and with the revolution triumphant they have both shown that they are capable and willing to lead us toward communism. While ideologically not always aligned both show great potential, and who the choice lands on is therefore entirely up to fate. Will it be the international Nosaka or the more experienced but perhaps less widely popular Tokuda?
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.32.desc: Following the end of the civil war and the triumph of the revolution the Labor-Farmer faction has gained the confidence of the party and the people. Not being as orthodox in their ideals they have managed to gain many followers and as a result also the seat of power. The main question still remains however, who will become the next premier of the republic? Three candidates have been presented but the final election still remains. Will it be Hitoshi Yamakawa, who as a central figure in the socialist movement has shown his experience? Will it be Kanson Arahata, who has managed to gather large amounts of support with the people and therefore already was elected chairman? Or will it be Yamakawa Kikue, who despite her lesser prominence within the party has shown that she's fit for the role as both a leader and reformer?
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.32.b: Kanson Arahata has the people's support
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.32.c: Yamakawa Kikue has the most revolutionary ideas
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.33.t: The Fate of the Imperial Family
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.33.desc: With power now firmly in the hands of the people, the question of the former imperial family still looms over our heads. There are many differing opinions on how they best should be handled, some promoting reform and lowering them to the status of the common worker while some argue that they should face harsher punishments for their crimes against the people both during the war and long before. Where the choice falls is still undecided, but whatever it may be there will be dissenting opinions that may have to be dealt with.
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.33.a: Make them live as normal people
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.33.b: Let them serve their term in prison
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.33.c: They are too dangerous to be kept alive!
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.34.t: Debates on the Ainu Revolution Theory
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.34.desc: Many of our political thinkers have been reasoning that the lumpenproletariat are the main body of our revolution, and that the Ainu people are also included inside this group. Furthermore, they believe that the Ainu people have lived in a primitive communist system and deem them worthy of being the 'leaders of the Communist revolution'. The question now however stands as, in what way should they be so? Should it be by the incorporation of their traditions into our socialist society, or should it be through granting autonomy to the Ainu people?
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.34.a: We should make use of their fascinating traditions
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.34.b: These revolutionary leaders must be granted the autonomy they deserve!
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.35.t: [FROM.GetLeader] Wants to Empower the Yi Dynasty
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.35.desc: Our overlord [FROM.GetNameDef] has demanded that our colonial governor step down in favor of Yi Un, heir to the [ROOT.GetAdjective] throne and loyal to the Japanese Empire. This sounds like a deal too good to pass up.
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.36.desc: It has come to our attention that there are currently [FROM.GetAdjective] cells active in our country spreading communist sentiment. Although this seems harmless enough, it would appear that some of the propaganda is rather revolutionary in nature. Reports of workers being encouraged to organize and band together are becoming all the more frequent, and judging from recent history, we cannot be certain that this is not an elaborate ploy from the [FROM.GetAdjective] leadership to ultimately integrate us.
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.36.b: Clamp down on these socialist agitators!
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.37.desc: It has come to our attention that there are currently [FROM.GetAdjective] cells active in our country spreading communist sentiments. Although this in itself seems harmless enough, it would appear that some of the propaganda is rather revolutionary in nature. Reports of workers being encouraged to organize and band together are becoming all the more frequent, and judging from recent history, we cannot be certain that this is not an elaborate ploy from the [FROM.GetAdjective] leadership to ultimately integrate us.
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.37.b: Clamp down on these socialist agitators!
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.38.desc: After a long period of growing communist sentiment it seems that the [ROOT.GetAdjective] proletariat has grown weary of waiting for a peaceful change of government. Following intense discourse it seems that diplomacy has fallen through and armed conflict has ensued.
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.39.desc: Due to our umbrella movement's incorporation of various socialist movements around Japan, the Buddhist socialist movement with Girō Senoo at the helm has grown rapidly, and the Youth League for Revitalizing Buddhism has become the go-to movement for our socialist youths. Now, party advisor Tsuji Jun has pressed [ROOT.GetLeader] on the issue of leadership, claiming that the state would be better off with the ever-more popular Girō Senoo in charge of the party. Is this the right way forward towards spiritual liberation as well as social and economic emancipation?
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.40.desc: While [JAP.GetNameDef] rapidly expands in Asia, occupying it's neighbors and devastating their nations, our industries and natural resources keep propping up their economy and flowing to their factories to be turned into weapons of war. Our people are now growing ever more critical of this, and are crying out for action to be taken. What should we do?
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.40.a: We can not keep supplying their war with our materials!
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.40.b: An Asian country won't pose a threat to us, it's fine
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.41.desc: Basing their ill-advised decision on our moderate expansion and pacification of our enemies, it seems like the warmongering [FROM.GetAdjective] citizens have pressured [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef] into embargoing us. They have decided that no more trade will happen between our nations, a clear violation of their neutrality towards us...
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.42.desc: With theaters of the East Asian war turning into political minefields, and large swathes of territory laying undefended from the enemy, the people are beginning to question the competency of [ROOT.GetLeader] to win the war. If the situation is not resolved with haste, either through reinvigorating the war effort or bringing in a more competent cabinet, the war may be as good as lost...
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.42.a: We must put an end to this quagmire!
loc.JAP_unlock_the_surrender_subbranch_tt: Unlocks the focuses §Y$JAP_the_koiso_cabinet$§!, §Y$JAP_the_war_has_not_necessarily_developed_focus$§!, §Y$JAP_japans_longest_day$§! and §Y$JAP_the_surrender_broadcast$§! which allow for the removal of §Y$JAP_crumbling_military_cabinet_idea$§! and the potential withdrawal from the East Asian war
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.43.desc: Having heard of the Emperor's wish to announce a formal end to the East Asian war, several putschists under the command of Major Kenji Hatanaka have made a move to convince the Imperial Guard to aid them in occupying the Tokyo Imperial Palace and placing the Emperor in house arrest. Generals Shizuichi Tanaka and Takeshi Mori have prepared to put a swift end to this attempted coup d'etat, but who knows which side will come out on top?
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.43.a: How dare they oppose the Emperors wish?
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.43.b: The dark clouds must disappear from the reign of the Emperor!
loc.JAP_kyujo_incident_rebels_lost_flag: The Kyūjō Putsch failed, and the coup-makers were arrested
loc.JAP_kyujo_incident_rebels_won_flag: The Kyūjō Putsch succeeded, and the coup-makers placed the Emperor in house arrest
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.44.desc: Being the commander-in-chief of the Mongolian People's Army, and one of the great 1921 Mongolian revolutionaries, Khorloogiin Choibalsan is a strong candidate for leading our country to greatness. With his recent military exploits, he has now also proven himself competent enough to truly rule the nation as its one leader. Is the time right for him to take up the mantle of the 10th Chairman of the Council of Ministers?
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.44.b: No, he must remain on the field!
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.45.t: Occupying the East Hebei Autonomous Government
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.45.desc: Following the collapse of the official Japanese army command and the civil war that ensued in the Home Islands, the Japanese protectorate known as the East Hebei Autonomous Government which lies on our south-western border now lies unprotected. The time has come for us to strike, and take it while the [JAP.GetAdjective] government has too many other problems to deal with to care for what happens on the continent.
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.46.t: The Kwantung Army Occupies East Hebei
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.46.desc: Following the collapse of the official Japanese army command and the civil war that ensued in the Home Islands, our former protectorate known as the East Hebei Autonomous Government which lies on [MAN.GetNameDef]'s south-western border now lies unprotected. As such, they have decided to strike, and take it while our government has too many other problems to deal with to care for what happens on the continent.
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.46.a: We will deal with them later...
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.47.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef] has recently signed a new document annulling our rights to forestry and mining in [655.GetName], in a vile disregard of the treaties we signed when handing the region back to them at the end of the Russian Civil War.
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.47.a: A Storm is brewing in the north...
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.48.desc: Following the landfall of hostile troops on our soil, [ROOT.GetLeader] has enacted martial law and declared a national emergency until the invaders are pushed out from our land. None know how long this may take, but all they know is that once again is the land under the absolute control of the Tokugawa family.
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.48.a: Giving the Tokugawa absolute power has never gone wrong before
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.49.desc: Following his rise to power as a member of the moderates in the navy, [ROOT.GetLeader] found himself widely popular in the eyes of the people. Now with the army once again gaining massive power however, it seems they still hold a grudge against him, as earlier today, he was found dead in his residence. Though likely to be forged, a will was found on the body of the Prime Minister handing the leadership of the country over to Adachi Kenzō.
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.49.a: It seems the specter of militarism still haunts us after all...
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.50.t: A Joint Demand from the Tokkō and the Bureaucrats
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.50.desc: With the formation of the Imperial Rule Assistance Association, it has become clear that Genki Abe, the leader of the Thought Police alongside the various leaders of the civil service are not particularly pleased with the actions of [ROOT.GetLeader]. Now, they are demanding that he step down in favor of the pro-Nazi politician Seigō Nakano. Should we accept this pressure?
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.50.a: Very well, if that is the Prime minister they want...
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.50.b: We will not comply with their demands!
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.51.desc: Due to our naval staff desiring to extend our Pacific defense perimeter to farther-flung atolls, our fleet was recently sent out to patrol the West Emperor Chain, when it came across an American fleet. The battle was hard fought, but in the end we sent the enemy packing, causing significant damage to their navy as well as their morale. For this achievement, our commanders have been given adequate promotions.
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.52.desc: Since the Japanese began attempting to expand their Pacific defense perimeter to farther-flung atolls, their fleets have begun to once again stray closer to Pearl Harbor. Unbeknownst to our enemies, however, our codebreakers had already determined the date and location of their planned attack on Midway, enabling an ambush of our own. The commander of the Pacific Fleet had sent a large force under Frank Jack Fletcher to the Midway area before the Japanese had arrived, and thanks to this careful preparation, we have now dealt a significant blow to their forces, one they will not quickly recover from.
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.53.desc: Due to our naval staff desiring to extend our Pacific defense perimeter to farther-flung atolls, our fleet was recently sent out to capture the Midway Atoll. Unbeknownst to our commanders, however, American codebreakers had already determined the date and location of our planned attack on Midway, enabling an ambush of their own. The battle resulted in a devastating loss, and the media is censoring any and all information regarding the losses to the public, in order to keep morale high.
loc.SEA_japan_popup_events.54.desc: Since the Japanese began attempting to expand their Pacific defense perimeter to farther-flung atolls, their fleets have begun to once again stray closer to Pearl Harbor. Unbeknownst to our enemies, however, our codebreakers had already determined the date and location of their planned attack on Midway, enabling an ambush of our own. The commander of the Pacific Fleet had sent a large force under Frank Jack Fletcher to the Midway area before the Japanese had arrived. Despite all our best efforts, however, our fleet was no match for theirs, and within hours the course of the battle was already determined. Perhaps this is the turning point our enemies needed to bring our Pacific fleet to heel.
loc.SEA_border_incidents_events.1.desc: An army of less than 100 [ROOT.GetAdjective] soldiers have begun to move on the disputed [MAN.GetAdjective] village of Tauran, guided by six Soviet advisors. Though it seems the [JAP.GetAdjective] army has yet to show up in the area, they may arrive any minute to beat us back. Is the village worth the risks, or should we exercise more caution?
loc.SEA_border_incidents_events.1.b: We must tell them to withdraw at once!
loc.SEA_border_incidents_events.2.desc: An army of less than 100 [MON.GetAdjective] soldiers have occupied the disputed [MAN.GetAdjective] village of Tauran, directed by Soviet military advisors. It seems that they won't back off without a fight, and will need to be defeated if we wish to retain full control of [761.GetName].
loc.SEA_border_incidents_events.2.a: Order the troops to move out at once!
loc.SEA_border_incidents_events.3.desc: An army of less than 100 [MON.GetAdjective] soldiers have occupied the disputed [MAN.GetAdjective] village of Tauran, directed by Soviet military advisors. It seems that they won't back off without a fight, and will need to be defeated if we wish to retain full control of [761.GetName]. Our overlord [JAP.GetNameDef] has demanded immediate action, and the Kwantung Army sees the situation as a slight against the Emperor himself.
loc.SEA_border_incidents_events.4.desc: As part of the escalating tensions between us and [FROM.GetNameDef] following our disputes over border villages such as Tauran, it seems that they are now moving troops to the area to assault our garrison we placed in the region.We must prepare to defend the region to the last man, and repel the invaders from rightful [ROOT.GetAdjective] clay!
loc.SEA_border_incidents_events.5.desc: Following a clash between [MON.GetAdjective] and [JAP.GetAdjective] forces in the border area around Lake Buir, the [MON.GetAdjective] forces are reportedly in full retreat. [JAP.GetAdjective] units have occupied a number of strategic hills around the area, and are preparing to reenter the village of Tauran.\n\nDuring the battle, the [JAP.GetAdjective] captured a number of [MON.GetAdjective] soldiers and [SOV.GetAdjective] advisors, which will cause a damaging blow to enemy morale.
loc.SEA_border_incidents_events.5.a: We have settled this matter honorably
loc.SEA_border_incidents_events.5.b: We pray they do not march further...
loc.SEA_border_incidents_events.6.desc: Following a clash between [MON.GetAdjective] and [JAP.GetAdjective] forces in the border area around Lake Buir, the [JAP.GetAdjective] ambassador in Ulaanbaatar has requested a cease-fire. \n\n Several [JAP.GetAdjective] assaults on [MON.GetAdjective] positions failed with heavy casualties during the battle, raising concerns in the [JAP.GetAdjective] military about the capabilities of their forces.
loc.SEA_border_incidents_events.6.a: It is better to fail honorably than never to try at all
loc.SEA_border_incidents_events.6.b: Our forces have acquitted themselves well
loc.SEA_border_incidents_events.7.desc: Fighting between [JAP.GetAdjective] and [MON.GetAdjective] forces around Lake Buir has died down after both sides withdrew from the contested region to regroup and resupply. Recognizing the futility of further offensives, the [JAP.GetAdjective] military has asked for a cease-fire and negotiations to fix the border, admitting the village lies within [MON.GetAdjective] territory.
loc.SEA_border_incidents_events.7.a: It was a worthless village anyways
loc.SEA_border_incidents_events.7.b: It is ours for the time being then
loc.SEA_border_incidents_events.8.desc: After we occupied the village of Tauran, it seems [FROM.GetAdjective] forces have pulled back from the vicinity and make no signs of intending to return. Recognizing the futility of further offensives, the [JAP.GetAdjective] military has admitted the village lies within [ROOT.GetAdjective] territory.
loc.if_they_back_down_or_lose_a_border_confl: If they Back Down or lose a Border Conflict:
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.500.t: The Naval Faction Demands we Strike South
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.500.desc: [ROOT.GetLeader] was just handed a letter signed by the Naval Headquarters demanding that preparations be started for a full scale enactment of the Southern Strike Doctrine, claiming that their needs for the resources that can be found in the East Indies have now reached a critical point. Of course they could just be ignored, but perhaps it would be unwise to make them wait.
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.500.a: Preparations must be made with haste!
loc.take_the_strike_south_focus_tt: Completing §Y$JAP_strike_the_southern_road$§! and going to war with the §YWestern Powers§! will appease the $JAP_naval_faction$
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.501.desc: Failing to enact the plans drawn up for the execution of the Southern Strike Doctrine within the time we had been allotted by the Naval Headquarters, it now seems that many of the Naval Officers who partook in the attempt to pressure [ROOT.GetLeader] into doing so have resigned.
loc.SEA_japan_tokko_arrest_events.1.desc: The Tokkō have discovered a threat to our internal stability. There are seemingly organizations of socialists and communists who seek to undermine our society. A list of people to be arrested has been put together, consisting of multiple high ranking communist party members such as Kanson Arahata, Saburō Eda, Ryōkichi Minobe, Itsurō Sakisaka, Kōzō Sasaki, Mosaburō Suzuki, Minoru Takano, and Hitoshi Yamakawa.
loc.JAP_popular_front_incident_tt: Various communist politicians and agitators will be arrested
loc.SEA_japan_tokko_arrest_events.2.desc: The Tokkō have discovered a threat to our internal stability. 11 British nationals residing in our nation are to be arrested on suspicion of violating the Military Secrets Protection Law, with their ringleader being MJ Cox, Tokyo bureau chief of Reuters. Though the [ENG.GetAdjective] government claims that these are no spies, they have nonetheless been taken to the Military Police Headquarters building for interrogations.
loc.SEA_japan_tokko_arrest_events.2.a: Foreign Agents get what they deserve!
loc.JAP_cox_incident_tt: Various [ENG.GetAdjective] nationals suspected of spying will be arrested
loc.SEA_japan_tokko_arrest_events.3.desc: The Tokkō have discovered another threat to our internal stability. Many South Manchuria Railway Investigation Department members have now been arrested twice by the Kwantung Army 's Military Police, are being held under the suspicion of spreading anti-Japanese and communist propaganda in our colonies. It also seems that they have been engaged in social research and analysis using Marxist methods that were previously outlawed in the Home Islands. This conspiracy may run very deep, how should it be handled?
loc.SEA_japan_tokko_arrest_events.3.a: Let the Kwantung Army Deal with it
loc.SEA_japan_tokko_arrest_events.3.b: We must make mass arrest immediately!
loc.SEA_japan_tokko_arrest_events.3.c: They pose no threat to us, ignore them
loc.SEA_japan_tokko_arrest_events.4.desc: The Tokkō have discovered another threat to our internal stability. This time, they have uncovered a [SOV.GetAdjective] spy ring headed by the [GER.GetAdjective] journalist Richard Sorge, a group which has been found to be guilty of espionage and subversive activities throughout our nation. They seem to have gained collaborators whom must also be dealt with, such as the former Asahi Shimbun journalist Hotsumi Ozaki and Koichi Saionji, a member of our aristocracy.
loc.SEA_japan_tokko_arrest_events.4.a: Foreign Agents get what they deserve!
loc.JAP_sorge_incident_tt: Various [SOV.GetAdjective] nationals and their connections within our country who are suspected of spying will be arrested
loc.SEA_japan_tokko_arrest_events.5.desc: The Yokohama Special Higher Police have arrested nearly three-dozen intellectuals on charges of attempting to revive the Communist Party which was previously dissolved forcefully by the Tokkō. The suspects include editors of the Chuo Koron, Kaizō, and Nippon Hyoron magazines. It seems our law enforcement is doing a good job at protecting the soul of our nation from this spiritual threat.
loc.SEA_japan_tokko_arrest_events.6.desc: Nakano Seigo, the founder and leader of the far right political party Tōhōkai, has been arrested. This comes after the party supposedly had been unable to continue their legal activities due to repression, and it seems that they were planning to take illegal direct action due to their perceived 'political repression' by our Cabinet. How dishonorable!
loc.SEA_japan_tokko_arrest_events.6.a: How dare he speak ill of our Prime Minister? Arrest him!
loc.SEA_japan_tokko_arrest_events.7.desc: Takeo Shinmyo, chief reporter of the Mainichi Shimbun, has been arrested by the Tokkō for criticizing the war effort. Allegedly as part of our Interservice Rivalry, she claimed that 'A bamboo spear won't cut it. It's an airplane, a maritime aircraft.' and that 'The outcome of the Greater East Asian War depends on the strengthening of naval and air power, and we cannot counter the enemy's air power with bamboo spears', directly criticizing our leadership our army, while promoting the idea that only the navy can bring us to victory.
loc.SEA_japan_tokko_arrest_events.7.a: Why do they not trust we will win this war?
loc.SEA_japan_tokko_arrest_events.8.desc: Many South Manchuria Railway Investigation Department members have now been arrested twice by the Kwantung Army's Military Police, are being held under the suspicion of spreading anti-Japanese and communist propaganda. [JAP.GetNameDefCap] has instructed us to deal with the situation appropriately but will not intervene directly. How should the situation be dealt with?
loc.SEA_japan_tokko_arrest_events.8.a: Follow the directive and begin mass arrests!
loc.SEA_japan_tokko_arrest_events.8.b: Sweep it under the rug, it benefits us anyway
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.1.desc: A bitter power struggle has broken out among the various internal factions within [ROOT.GetNameDef], all vying for the [GetImperialInfluenceRulerTitle]'s ear, trying to sway [GetImperialInfluenceGenderHimHer] to their cause. The question on everyone's mind is; which faction will the [GetImperialInfluenceRulerTitle] ultimately favor, and which one will [GetImperialInfluenceGenderHeShe] disregard?
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_demand_event_opti: Big things often have small beginnings
Nothing is more expensive than free
Do or do not, there is no try
A choice delayed is a choice made
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_failure_event_opt: Even the Moon wanes, yet returns
Do or do not. They did not.
Spilt water won't go back into its tray
The winds of tomorrow will blow tomorrow
Fall down seven times but get up eight times
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.100.desc: The Army faction has tried to increase their influence over the [GetImperialInfluenceRulerTitle], but due to their shortcomings have failed to do so. Because of this they have now lost face and thus prestige, meaning their influence have decreased.
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.110.t: The Army Faction Seek to Expand Armament Production
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.110.desc: The Army has delivered their demands. It seems they are looking to expand their production capabilities and their influence over the [GetImperialInfluenceRulerTitle], and are as such demanding that we build more Military Factories to increase our output. It seems they are willing to show some patience, but will not wait forever.
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.120.t: The Army Faction Demand Political Appointments
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.120.desc: The Army has delivered their demands. Lacking central control and autonomy to act on their own, they wish to see a new Chief of Army appointed to the post, which will also serve to strengthen their influence over the [GetImperialInfluenceRulerTitle]. It seems they are willing to show some patience, but will not wait forever.
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.130.t: The Army Faction Desires Conscription Law Changes
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.130.desc: The Army has delivered their demands. They wish for us to increase our national conscription, and send out recruiters to rural villages to enlist more young men for the coming war effort. Despite the guise of simply strengthening our armed forces, they seemingly also wish to increase their control and influence over the [GetImperialInfluenceRulerTitle]. It seems they are willing to show some patience, but will not wait forever.
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.140.t: The Army Faction Plans for Expansion
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.140.desc: The Army has delivered their demands. They wish for us to increase the amount of regiments in our army, and establish more divisions to aid in the coming conquests. Despite the guise of simply strengthening our armed forces, they seemingly also wish to increase their control and influence over the [GetImperialInfluenceRulerTitle]. It seems they are willing to show some patience, but will not wait forever.
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.150.t: The Army Faction Insists in Support Trucks
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.150.desc: The Army has delivered their demands. It seems they are looking to expand their motorized vehicle production capabilities and their influence over the [GetImperialInfluenceRulerTitle], and are as such demanding that we build more trucks to fuel their need for expansion. It seems they are willing to show some patience, but will not wait forever.
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.160.t: The Army Faction Demands Increased Tank Production
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.160.desc: The Army has delivered their demands. It seems they are looking to expand their tank production capabilities and their influence over the [GetImperialInfluenceRulerTitle], and are as such demanding that we build more tanks fuel their needs for expansion. It seems they are willing to show some patience, but will not wait forever.
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.161.t: The Army Faction Demands Increased Artillery Production
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.161.desc: The Army has delivered their demands. It seems they are looking to expand their artillery production capabilities and their influence over the [GetImperialInfluenceRulerTitle], and are as such demanding that we build more artillery fuel their needs for expansion. It seems they are willing to show some patience, but will not wait forever.
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.200.desc: The Naval faction has tried to increase their influence over the [GetImperialInfluenceRulerTitle], but due to their shortcomings have failed to do so. Because of this they have now lost face and thus prestige, meaning their influence have decreased.
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.210.t: The Naval Faction Seek to Expand Dockyard Production
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.210.desc: The Navy has delivered their demands. It seems they are looking to expand their production capabilities and their influence over the [GetImperialInfluenceRulerTitle], and are as such demanding that we build more Naval Dockyards to increase our output. It seems they are willing to show some patience, but will not wait forever.
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.220.t: The Naval Faction Demand Political Appointments
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.220.desc: The Navy has delivered their demands. Lacking central control and the autonomy to act on their own, they wish to see a new Chief of Navy appointed to the post, which will also serve to strengthen their influence over the [GetImperialInfluenceRulerTitle]. It seems they are willing to show some patience, but will not wait forever.
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.230.t: The Naval Faction Desires Conscription Law Changes
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.230.desc: The Navy has delivered their demands. They wish for us to increase our national conscription, and send out navy envoys to rural villages to recruit more young men for the coming war effort. Despite the guise of simply strengthening our armed forces, they seemingly also wish to increase their control and influence over the [GetImperialInfluenceRulerTitle]. It seems they are willing to show some patience, but will not wait forever.
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.240.t: The Naval Faction Demands increased Aircraft Carrier Production
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.240.desc: The Navy has delivered their demands. It seems they are looking to expand their carrier fleet and their influence over the [GetImperialInfluenceRulerTitle], and are as such demanding that we order the construction of more carriers to fuel their needs for expansion. It seems they are willing to show some patience, but will not wait forever.
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.241.t: The Naval Faction Demands increased Naval Production
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.241.desc: The Navy has delivered their demands. It seems they are looking to expand their production capabilities and their influence over the [GetImperialInfluenceRulerTitle], and are as such demanding that we order the construction of more Naval Dockyards to fuel their needs for expansion. It seems they are willing to show some patience, but will not wait forever.
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.242.t: The Naval Faction Demands increased Battleship Production
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.242.desc: The Navy has delivered their demands. It seems they are looking to expand their battleship fleet and their influence over the [GetImperialInfluenceRulerTitle], and are as such demanding that we order the construction of more battleships to fuel their needs for expansion. It seems they are willing to show some patience, but will not wait forever.
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.300.desc: The Zaibatsu's have tried to increase their influence over the [GetImperialInfluenceRulerTitle], but due to their shortcomings have failed to do so. Because of this they have now lost face and thus prestige, meaning their influence have decreased.
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.310.t: The Zaibatsu Faction Seek to Expand Our Industrial Base
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.310.desc: The Zaibatsu leaders have delivered their demands. It seems they are looking to expand their holdings and industries and their influence over the [GetImperialInfluenceRulerTitle], and are as such demanding that we build more Civilian Factories to increase our industrial base. It seems they are willing to show some patience, but will not wait forever.
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.320.t: The Zaibatsu Faction Demand Political Appointments
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.320.desc: The Zaibatsu leaders have delivered their demands. It seems they wish for at the very least one of their members to be placed on the [GetImperialInfluenceRulerTitle]'s advisory board, so that they may guide the industrialization and the path of the nation. It seems they are willing to show some patience, but will not wait forever.
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.330.t: The Zaibatsu Faction Desires Economy Law Changes
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.330.desc: The Zaibatsu leaders have delivered their demands. They wish for us to adjust the economic strategy of our nation, and for more funds to go towards the industrial conglomerates. Despite the guise of simply strengthening our economy, they seemingly also wish to increase their control and influence over the [GetImperialInfluenceRulerTitle]. It seems they are willing to show some patience, but will not wait forever.
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.340.t: The Zaibatsu Faction Demand We Hire a Industrial Company
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.340.desc: The Zaibatsu leaders have delivered their demands. It seems they wish for at the very least one of their companies to be hired for direct contracts by the [GetImperialInfluenceRulerTitle], so that they may guide the industrialization and path of the nation. It seems they are willing to show some patience, but will not wait forever.
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.400.desc: The Civilian Government has tried to increase their influence over the [GetImperialInfluenceRulerTitle], but due to their shortcomings have failed to do so. Because of this they have now lost face and thus prestige, meaning their influence have decreased.
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.420.t: The Civilian Government Faction Demand Political Appointments
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.420.desc: The party leaders have delivered their demands. It seems they wish for at the very least one of their members to be placed on the [GetImperialInfluenceRulerTitle]'s advisory board, so that they may guide the political direction of the nation and steer it toward a brighter future. It seems they are willing to show some patience, but will not wait forever.
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.430.t: The Civilian Government Faction Desires Trade Law Changes
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.430.desc: The party leaders have delivered their demands. They wish for us to adjust the economic strategy of our nation, and for the investment and trading strategies to be shifted in the favor of internationalism and better relations with our trading partners. Despite the guise of simply strengthening our economy, they seemingly also wish to increase their control and influence over the [GetImperialInfluenceRulerTitle]. It seems they are willing to show some patience, but will not wait forever.
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.440.t: The Civilian Government Faction Seeks to limit the Army's Influence
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.440.desc: The party leaders have delivered their demands. It seems they are distraught at the growing power and influence of the Army over the [GetImperialInfluenceRulerTitle], and wish for swift action in limiting their growth and power. It seems they are willing to show some patience, but will not wait forever.
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.450.t: The Civilian Government Faction Seeks to limit the Navy's Influence
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.450.desc: The party leaders have delivered their demands. It seems they are distraught at the growing power and influence of the Navy over the [GetImperialInfluenceRulerTitle], and wish for swift action in limiting their growth and power. It seems they are willing to show some patience, but will not wait forever.
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.460.t: The Civilian Government Faction Seeks to limit the Zaibatsus Influence
loc.SEA_imperial_influence_events.460.desc: The party leaders have delivered their demands. It seems they are distraught at the growing power and influence of the Zaibatsus over the [GetImperialInfluenceRulerTitle], and wish for swift action in limiting their growth and power. It seems they are willing to show some patience, but will not wait forever.
loc.SEA_japan_air_accidents_events.01.desc: Admiral Isoroku Yamamoto has been shot down by enemy fire earlier today. A group of [USA.GetAdjective] fighters intercepted him after intercepting our intelligence transmissions. Having named their outrageous attack 'Operation Vengeance', it is clear they intend to send a message. While our nation mourns the loss of this great warrior, we must not forget our duties in bringing down this dishonorable enemy!
loc.SEA_japan_air_accidents_events.02.desc: Admiral Isoroku Yamamoto came under fire from the enemy while flying in transit earlier today. Managing to contact the naval air force in the region and staying clear from the barrage, Yamamoto managed to slip away and land his airplane successfully. The Admiral has been hailed for his bravery and for staying calm in such a hot situation.
loc.SEA_japan_news_events.01.desc:
In an impassioned speech delivered by [JAP.GetLeader], he exclaims that the military has gone too far this time, following the recent attempted coup d'etat by the Kōdōha faction within the army. He further claims that 'if the countless assassinations and attempted ousting of our government by fringe elements wasn't enough, they now also seek to use the recent incident to strengthen their own power and wrest control of our nation away from its people. This can not be allowed to continue!' 

It seems conflict may be brewing in [JAP.GetNameDef].
loc.SEA_japan_news_events.01.a: We must return to the ways of the Taishō era!
loc.SEA_japan_news_events.01.b: Looks like someone finally got a backbone
loc.SEA_japan_news_events.02.t: Formation of the Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere
loc.SEA_japan_news_events.02.desc: \nWith the proposed objectives of ensuring economic self-sufficiency and cooperation among the member states, along with resisting the influence of Western imperialism and Soviet communism, [JAP.GetLeader] has today announced the founding of the Dai Tōa Kyōeiken. Whether this is truly the objective of the union, or just another careful ploy by the [JAP.GetAdjective] propaganda machine is still on the top of everyone's minds.
loc.SEA_japan_news_events.02.a: We will bring prosperity to all of Asia!
loc.SEA_japan_news_events.02.b: Another ploy from the propaganda machine
loc.SEA_japan_news_events.03.d: Japanese offensives continue in Burma, and the fall of Rangoon recently took place. As the capital of British Burma, this city is of immense strategic importance and its loss may prove to be a decisive factor in the ongoing Burma campaign.\n\nThe Colonial Governor himself was reportedly captured by Japanese forward units while he was supervising the transfer of his belongings from the Governor's House to a truck caravan, but this has not yet been confirmed.
loc.SEA_china.1.desc: We have received a request from [FROM.GetNameDef] asking us to send material support. Although [FROM.GetLeader] has made questionable statements about us in the past, this could be an opportunity to tie up foreign interests in the region.
loc.SEA_china.2.desc: In a moment of clarity, [FROM.GetNameDef] has decided to support us in our struggles. We are under no impression that this is an act of kindness, but rather one of self-interest in having us do their dirty work.
loc.SEA_china.3.desc: Unsurprisingly, our request for support has been turned down by [FROM.GetNameDef]. Although our hopes were never great, we did expect them to at least acknowledge the threat that [JAP.GetNameDef] presents to all of Asia. But evidently, we were wrong.
loc.SEA_china.4.desc: An inquiry has been sent from [FROM.GetLeader] over in [FROM.GetNameDef], requesting financial and material aid in their conflict against [JAP.GetNameDef]. The message was not merely via wireless or an envoy, but through no less a personage than $CHI_soong_mei_ling$, who has been drawing quite the crowd while traveling through [ROOT.GetName]. While tying up [JAP.GetNameDef] would benefit us alone, we might also profit from the popularity of this tour.
loc.SEA_china.4.b: We have to see to our own security first
loc.SEA_china.4.tt: Increases the §YArtillery Equipment§! reward from §YDemonstrate our Resolve§! by 100
loc.SEA_china.5.desc: We have received an answer to our request, and are happy to report that foreign funds will shortly be made available to us. These should be a great boon to our industry and allow us to grow our armed forces greatly, and quite possibly, the aid could later be expanded to include materiel.
loc.SEA_china.5.a: The road to victory lies bare
loc.SEA_china.5.tt: Increases the §Y$CIC_BANK_HEADER$§! reward from §YDemonstrate our Resolve§! by §Y1000§!
loc.SEA_china.6.desc: The answer to our pleas has returned from [FROM.GetNameDef], which has chosen to abandon us. There will be no support sent, nor will any funds be made available. We stand alone in the face of aggression as we have so many times before. We shall prevail because if we do not, our legacy will be forgotten.
loc.SEA_china.6.a: Fight for the survival of the country!
loc.SEA_china.7.desc: The central government of [FROM.GetName] has extended an invitation for [ROOT.GetName] to join their faction. They speak of national unity and the need to resist foreign encroachment as one. While ideological differences remain, the prospect of cooperation in the face of growing threats may warrant consideration.
loc.SEA_china.7.a: We shall stand together against our enemies
loc.SEA_china.7.b: We will not trade independence for promises
loc.SEA_china.8.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has agreed to our proposal. [FROM.GetNameDefCap] will join our faction and stand beside us in the struggle to unify the nation and defend it from external threats. This marks a significant step toward greater Chinese unity.
loc.SEA_china.9.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has declined to join our faction, citing the need to preserve regional independence and political autonomy. While unfortunate, this decision reflects the enduring divisions within the country.
loc.SEA_china.9.a: They will regret this in time
loc.SEA_china.10.desc: We have received an offer from [FROM.GetNameDef] to join [ROOT.GetFactionName] along with all the members of [FROM.GetFactionName]. If we were to accept, one less potential opponent would remain, and our own position strengthen. The question is rather if their intentions can be trusted to not seek to supplant us.
loc.SEA_china.11.desc: We have gotten a response from the leader of [FROM.GetFactionName], and the age of looking inward upon our own corner of the world is over. The government of [FROM.GetNameDef] has welcomed us with open arms, and we can now take our place in the world on equal terms.
loc.SEA_china.12.desc: The leaders of [FROM.GetFactionName] have rejected our offer of joining forces. This was an opportunity to bring peace and stability to the world, but unfortunately some are against such things.
loc.SEA_china.13.desc: Our glorious leader [CHI.GetLeader] has been shot in his car, a disastrous end of a hostile road encounter. We have been told that the gunman acted on his own, but as he was killed during the immediate pursuit, any potential conspirators will walk free. The party has started to look for a replacement.
loc.SEA_china.14.desc: In their desperation to placate [JAP.GetNameDef], the central government has offered them overlordship over us. This is a disgraceful act. We did not expect such boldness from the new government.
loc.SEA_china.14.b: We cannot accept this, to arms!
loc.SEA_china.15.t: Control of [FROM.GetNameDef] Has Been Given to Us
loc.SEA_china.15.desc: To placate those in our armed forces who push for war, [CHI.GetName] has transferred control over [FROM.GetName] to us. Looks like we will not have any conflict in the immediate future.
loc.SEA_china.16.desc: In a bid to placate us in to not attacking, [From.GetName] has given us docking rights. The Kwantung Army has decided to stand down for now.
loc.SEA_china.17.desc: In a bid to placate us in to not attacking, [From.GetName] has given us airbase access. The Kwantung Army has decided to stand down for now.
loc.SEA_china.18.desc: In a bid to placate us in to not attacking, [From.GetName] has given us resource rights. The Kwantung Army has decided to stand down for now.
loc.SEA_china.19.t: [CHI.GetName] Demands Abrogation of the Nine-Power Treaty
loc.SEA_china.19.desc: A formal letter from [CHI.GetNameDef] reached our foreign ministry today. It argues that the Nine-Power Treaty shackles [CHI.GetAdjective] sovereignty and must be torn up at once. [CHI.GetLeader] insists that the pact is a relic of coercion and vows to reclaim full independence, with or without our consent.
loc.SEA_china.19_tt: §RWe will join China's war against Japan!§!
loc.SEA_china.20.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has affirmed its immediate withdrawal from the Nine-Power Treaty. They acknowledge that the treaty is obsolete and that [CHI.GetAdjective] sovereignty must stand unencumbered.
loc.SEA_china.21.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] refuses to dismantle the Nine-Power Treaty, citing the fragile balance of power in the Pacific. The affront would outrage any mortal man, but the time of imperialist stooges are over. We must decide whether to intensify pressure or retreat from the diplomatic arena.
loc.SEA_china.22.desc: Beijing doubles down. The cabinet debates how to answer this mounting pressure and whether to strike back with an embargo that could upend commerce, or to fully release [CHI.GetName] from its obligations.
loc.SEA_china.23.desc: The [FROM.GetAdjective] government has announced an embargo against us as punishment for our rejection of the Nine-Power Treaty, and harbor masters from [FROM.GetNameDef] now turn away every Chinese freighter. The domestic press denounces the measure as economic strangulation, one last gasp of an age of imperialism otherwise long gone.
loc.SEA_china.24.desc: A cable from [FROM.GetNameDef] reaches Nanjing, confirming their withdrawal from the Nine-Power Treaty. Foreign river patrols prepare to sail for home, while [FROM.GetAdjective] diplomats concede the accord is no longer binding upon China. Crowds gather before the Ministry of Foreign Affairs as radio proclaims the end of another unequal covenant.
loc.SEA_china.25.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has approached us with a request to have specialists from our armored units support their shift towards a more modern style of warfare. We could send an advisory team from one of our major manufacturers, or reject their request outright.
loc.SEA_china.26.desc: We have now gotten an answer from [SOV.GetNameDef] in which they agree to send us a group of experts. The assistance should be arriving shortly, and when it does, we can set the specialists to work with strengthening our tank corps.
loc.SEA_china.27.desc: Unfortunately [SOV.GetNameDef] has decided not to send us the help we need. While we do not know the reason for rejecting this minor request, it seems we must find alternative means...
loc.SEA_china.27.a: They will regret this in time
loc.SEA_china.28.desc: The central government has capitulated to [JAP.GetNameDef], pledging not to oppose its territorial aggression. The blow now falls upon us, with the [JAP.GetAdjective] demanding our land, seeking annexation by diplomatic coercion.
loc.SEA_china.29.desc: In his zeal for the liberty of our country $CHI_zhang_xueliang$ has overstepped his station by a large margin. Normally this would be unacceptable, but we do not live in normal times and while [ROOT.GetLeader] demands that we imprison him, the competence of [CHI_zhang_xueliang.GetName] could prove useful.
loc.SEA_china.29.b: We can't afford to lose him...
loc.SEA_china_improvement.1.desc: The sun is shining, shirts are ironed and boots have been polished. Soldiers stand in neat ranks, listening to [ROOT.GetLeader] that has come to hold a speech for their graduation. Soon the graduates will be at the front, bringing glory to [ROOT.GetNameDef].
loc.SEA_china_improvement.2.desc: Recognizing the corrosive effect of the Opium trade on state authority and public trust, we need to embark on a long-term campaign to reduce the influence of the opium syndicates. Officials are tasked with stricter inspections, administrative shuffles and public awareness campaigns, none of which will bear fruit overnight. Still, every step weakens the shadow networks that feed on [CHI.GetAdjective] vulnerabilities.
loc.SEA_china_improvement.2_tt: The negative effect of §YIllicit Trade§! will be reduced every 6th month
loc.SEA_china_improvement.3.desc: After years of persistent reform, quiet purges, and relentless oversight, the last major opium networks have been dismantled. For the first time in decades, the will of the state reigns unchallenged across the countryside. Cynics mutter of the old days, but even they must admit that the air is clearer.
loc.SEA_china_warlords.1.desc: A message has arrived from Nanjing, bearing the unmistakable seal of the central government. Behind the florid language of unity and national destiny lies a demand — we are to submit to [FROM.GetLeader] and accept the authority of [FROM.GetNameDef] over our domain. No room for negotiation, just obedience or consequences.
loc.SEA_china_warlords.1.b: We have no choice but to obey
loc.SEA_china_warlords.2.desc: [FROM.GetName] has accepted our ultimatum. Their leaders speak of national unity and historical destiny, but the meaning is plain — they now acknowledge the supremacy of [ROOT.GetNameDef].\nThough their submission may be reluctant, it spares China further division and bloodshed.
loc.SEA_china_warlords.2.a: A shattered sun gathering its light
loc.SEA_china_warlords.3.desc: The ultimatum has been rejected. In a brazen act of defiance, [FROM.GetLeader] has made it clear that his people will not submit. With our envoys dismissed, diplomacy shall make way for war.
loc.SEA_china_warlords.3.a: Then they will be brought to heel
loc.SEA_china_warlords.4.desc: With the situation stabilizing, and the central authority reaffirmed, [FROM.GetNameDef] moves to abolish the last remnants of warlord autonomy. [THIS.GetNameDefCap] is now expected to cede all remaining administrative and military control to the central government, completing the process of unification.
loc.SEA_china_warlords.4.a: We need to bow our heads
loc.SEA_china_warlords.5.desc: Acknowledging the need for national unity, [FROM.GetLeader] has agreed to dissolve [FROM.GetNameDef] and transfer all authority to [ROOT.GetNameDef]. Their armed forces are absorbed into the national command structure, while their administrative bodies dismantle.
loc.SEA_china_warlords.6.desc: In open defiance of the central government, [FROM.GetLeader] has refused the ultimatum. [FROM.GetNameDefCap] remains a nominal subject, but their actions admit aspirations of independence. This insubordination cannot go unanswered.
loc.SEA_china_democratic.1.desc: The time has finally come to reestablish free elections in China, and restore the republic that was crushed by both external and internal forces. The question remains however, who shall take up the mantle of Dr. Sun, and become the first president of this new republic?
loc.SEA_china_democratic.1.b: Carsun Chang has shown his worth
loc.SEA_china_democratic.1.c: Soong Ching-ling is the ideal leader
loc.SEA_china_democratic.1.d: Zeng Qi should be given this opportunity
loc.SEA_china_democratic.2.desc: A delegation from far away has recently arrived at our capital, demanding an audience with [ROOT.GetLeader]. They claim to be from [FROM.GetNameDef], and seek an alliance between our nations. Do we accept?
loc.SEA_china_democratic.2.b: That would go against our principles of neutrality...
loc.SEA_china_democratic.3.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has graciously accepted our offer to formalize an alliance between our nations, and has already begun initiatives to integrate into our sphere. Today is a day for celebration!
loc.SEA_china_democratic.3.a: They share our vision for the future
loc.SEA_china_democratic.4.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has rudely decided to reject our offer of an alliance between our nations, stating that it would go against their principle of neutrality. We can only imagine the amounts of corruption that led to this erroneous decision.
loc.SEA_china_democratic.5.desc: After a long period of growing republican sentiment, it seems that the [ROOT.GetAdjective] democrats have grown weary of waiting for a peaceful change of government. Following intense discourse, it seems that diplomacy has failed, and armed conflict has broken out.
loc.SEA_china_democratic.6.desc: It has come to our attention that there are currently [FROM.GetAdjective] cells active in our country spreading republican sentiment. Although this seems harmless enough, it would appear that some of the propaganda is rather revolutionary in nature. Reports of workers being encouraged to organize and band together are becoming all the more frequent, and judging from recent history, we cannot be certain that this is not an elaborate ploy from the [FROM.GetAdjective] leadership to ultimately integrate us.
loc.SEA_china_democratic.6.b: Clamp down on these insolent agitators!
loc.SEA_china_democratic.7.desc: We have received a rather strongly-worded note from [CHI.GetNameDef]. They demand we release [CHI_country_to_be_liberated.GetNameDef] and return the territories to their rightful owners.
loc.SEA_china_democratic.7.a: We do not have much use of those colonies anyways.
loc.SEA_china_democratic.7.b: Their rightful owners would be us.
loc.SEA_china_democratic.7.b.tt: §RThis will give them a war goal on us!§!
loc.SEA_china_democratic.8.desc: The response to our demands for [FROM.GetNameDef] to release [CHI_country_to_be_liberated.GetNameDef] has just arrived. Perhaps a bit surprisingly, they have agreed to release [CHI_country_to_be_liberated.GetNameDef] as an independent nation.
loc.SEA_china_democratic.9.desc: The response to our demands for [FROM.GetNameDef] to release [CHI_country_to_be_liberated.GetNameDef] has just arrived. Stating that their foreign affairs are none of our business, they reject the idea of granting the colonies their rightful independence.
loc.SEA_china_democratic.9.a: We must liberate them, no matter the cost
loc.SEA_china_democratic.10.t: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] Wants Us to Join Their War
loc.SEA_china_democratic.10.desc: A delegation from far away has recently arrived at our capital, seeking an audience with [ROOT.GetLeader]. They claim to be from [FROM.GetNameDef], and wish for us to join their war against [JAP.GetNameDef]. Do we accept?
loc.SEA_china_democratic.10.b: That would go against our principles of neutrality...
loc.SEA_china_democratic.11.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has graciously accepted our offer to formalize an anti-[JAP.GetAdjective] alliance between our nations, and has already begun to institute measures against the eastern menace. Today is a day for celebration!
loc.SEA_china_democratic.11.a: We stand in debt to their people
loc.SEA_china_democratic.12.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has rudely decided to reject our offer of an anti-[JAP.GetAdjective] alliance between our nations, stating that it would go against their principle of neutrality. We can only imagine the amounts of corruption that led to this erroneous decision.
loc.SEA_china_democratic.13.desc: An inquiry has been received from [FROM.GetLeader] over in [FROM.GetNameDef], about getting financial support for their country. They have rallied many [FROM.GetAdjective] expats living within our borders to their cause, and popular support has surged in support of this. Should we accept their request?
loc.SEA_china_democratic.13.b: They will have to see to their own economy
loc.SEA_china_democratic.14.desc: We have received an answer to our request, and are happy to report that foreign funds will shortly be made available to us. These should be a boon to our economy, and allow us to grow our industries and armed forces greatly.
loc.SEA_china_democratic.14.a: The road to victory lies bare
loc.SEA_china_democratic.15.desc: The answer to our pleas has returned from [FROM.GetNameDef], which has chosen to abandon us. There will be no support sent, nor will any funds be made available. We stand alone, despite popular support in [FROM.GetNameDef]. We shall prevail because if we do not, our legacy will be forgotten.
loc.SEA_china_democratic.16.desc: Industrialists belonging to [FROM.GetNameDef] have begun developing our local industries and setting up new corporations within our borders. This is bound to bring us closer to prosperity.
loc.SEA_china_democratic.16.a: We thank them for this investment
loc.SEA_china_democratic.16.b: We do not need their aid!
loc.SEA_china_democratic.17.desc: A message has arrived from Nanjing, bearing the unmistakable seal of the central government. Behind the florid language of unity and national destiny lies a demand — we are to submit to [CHI.GetLeader] and accept the authority of [CHI.GetNameDef] over our domain. No room for negotiation, just obedience or consequences.
loc.SEA_china_democratic.17.b: It is the best for our people
loc.SEA_china_democratic.18.desc: [FROM.GetName] has accepted our ultimatum. Their leaders speaks of national unity and historical destiny, but the meaning is plain — they now acknowledge the supremacy of [CHI.GetNameDef].\nThough their submission may be reluctant, it spares China further division and bloodshed.
loc.SEA_china_democratic.18.a: A shattered sun gathering its light
loc.SEA_china_democratic.19.desc: The ultimatum has been rejected. In a brazen act of defiance, [FROM.GetLeader] has made it clear that his people will not submit. With our envoys dismissed, diplomacy shall make way for war.
loc.SEA_china_democratic.19.a: Then they will be brought to heel
loc.SEA_china_democratic.20.desc: [FROM.GetLeader], president of [FROM.GetNameDef], has sent us a formal demand to begin implementing the principle of Mínquán within our governed territory. This is bound to bring us closer to the Republic and aid our development.
loc.SEA_china_democratic.20.b: There is something fishy about this!
loc.SEA_PRC_request_aid.1.desc: Due to our frequent support of [FROM.GetNameDef] in the past, they are once again requesting that we provide them with equipment. This request may be related to the recently concluded Long March, which cost them heavy losses in manpower and materiel.
loc.SEA_PRC_request_aid.1.a: Send them what we can spare
loc.SEA_PRC_request_aid.2.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has agreed to send the equipment we requested. This major shipment will allow us to field several new divisions, and provides us with specialist equipment that will allow the formation of support companies.
loc.SEA_PRC_request_aid.2.a: Excellent, we will be sure to put it to good use
loc.SEA_PRC_request_aid.3.desc: Our request for aid from [FROM.GetNameDef] was denied, with [FROM.GetAdjective] officials indicating that [FROM.GetNameDef] has little equipment to spare after a recent reorganization.
loc.SEA_PRC_request_aid.3.a: We will have to find a different source
loc.SEA_PRC_request_aid.4.desc: As [FROM.GetNameDef] lacks the industrial capacity and experience to create an armored fighting force, [FROM.GetLeader] has sent a request for our aid. [FROM.GetNameDefCap] is specifically asking for our T-34 medium tanks, citing their excellent balance of firepower, protection, and mobility. How should we respond?
loc.SEA_PRC_request_aid.4.c: We can at least help build them
loc.SEA_PRC_request_aid.4.a.tt: We will agree to send §R250 T-34 Tanks§! to §Y[FROM.GetName]§!
loc.SEA_PRC_request_aid.4.b.tt: We will agree to send §R50 T-34 Tanks§! to §Y[FROM.GetName]§!
loc.SEA_PRC_request_aid.4.c.tt: We will agree to produce §R150 T-34 Tanks§! for §Y[FROM.GetName]§!
loc.SEA_PRC_request_aid.31.desc: As [FROM.GetNameDef] lacks the industrial capacity and experience to create an armored fighting force, [FROM.GetLeader] has sent a request for our aid. [FROM.GetNameDefCap] is specifically asking for our BT-7 light tanks, citing their excellent cross-country speed. How should we respond?
loc.SEA_PRC_request_aid.31.c: We can at least help build them
loc.SEA_PRC_request_aid.31.a.tt: We will agree to send §R350 BT-7 Tanks§! to §Y[FROM.GetName]§!
loc.SEA_PRC_request_aid.31.b.tt: We will agree to send §R100 BT-7 Tanks§! to §Y[FROM.GetName]§!
loc.SEA_PRC_request_aid.31.c.tt: We will agree to produce §R150 BT-7 Tanks§! for §Y[FROM.GetName]§!
loc.SEA_PRC_request_aid.32.desc: Responding to our request for BT-7 tanks, [FROM.GetName] has agreed to send us a large amount of them — no less than 350 (mostly) brand new BT-7s! Our Generals have been putting together a plan for how to best deploy them, including setting up training schedules for the newly recruited tank crews.
loc.SEA_PRC_request_aid.33.desc: Responding to our request for BT-7 tanks, [FROM.GetName] has agreed to send only a token amount. It is not enough to fully equip a tank division, but sufficient to get us started. If nothing else, we can use the 100 vehicles to train our crews, while we look for other ways to procure modern tanks.
loc.SEA_PRC_request_aid.33.a: Could be more, but better than nothing
loc.SEA_PRC_request_aid.34.desc: Responding to our request for BT-7 tanks, [FROM.GetName] has agreed to build 150 BT-7s over the coming months and ship them to us when ready. It will take some time, but the measure will represent a good start for our aspirations to field a modern armored force.
