loc.SEA_PRC_request_aid.34.a: Excellent! We will put them to good use whenever they arrive
loc.SEA_PRC_request_aid.35.t: Newly Built Tanks From [FROM.FROM.GetName] Have Arrived
loc.SEA_PRC_request_aid.35.desc: A shipment has arrived in [ROOT.Capital.GetName] from [SOV.GetNameDef] bearing our 150 newly-built BT-7 tanks. Among those receiving the shipment were representatives from the government of [ROOT.GetName], as well as leading officers of the People's Liberation Army Ground Forces. Inspecting the tanks, freshly painted with the symbol of the PLAGF, the officers were eager to deploy them — after a training and familiarization period for the tank crews.
loc.SEA_PRC_request_aid.35.a: This is excellent news, we will put them to great use!
loc.SEA_PRC_request_aid.5.desc: Responding to our request for T-34 tanks, [FROM.GetName] has agreed to send us a large amount of them — no less than 250 (mostly) brand new T-34s! Our Generals have been putting together a plan for how to best deploy these tanks, including setting up training schedules for the newly re-appointed tank crews.
loc.SEA_PRC_request_aid.6.desc: Responding to our request for T-34 tanks, [FROM.GetName] has agreed to send us only a token amount. It is not enough to fully equip a tank division, but sufficient to get us started. If nothing else, we can use the 50 vehicles to train our tank crews, while we look for other ways to procure modern tanks.
loc.SEA_PRC_request_aid.6.a: Could be more, but better than nothing
loc.SEA_PRC_request_aid.7.desc: Responding to our request for T-34 tanks, [FROM.GetName] has agreed to build 150 T-34s over the coming months and ship them to us when ready. It will take some time, but the measure will represent a good start for our aspirations to field a modern armored force
loc.SEA_PRC_request_aid.7.a: Excellent! We will put them to good use whenever they arrive
loc.SEA_PRC_request_aid.8.desc: [FROM.GetName] has rejected our request for tanks, citing that their own immediate needs prevent them from sparing any active or reserve vehicles. While unfortunate, [FROM.GetName] did send us some training manuals. So, there is always that.
loc.SEA_PRC_request_aid.21.t: Newly Built Tanks From [FROM.FROM.GetName] Have Arrived
loc.SEA_PRC_request_aid.21.desc: A shipment has arrived in [ROOT.Capital.GetName] from [SOV.GetNameDef] bearing our 150 newly-built T-34 tanks. Among those receiving the shipment were representatives from the government of [ROOT.GetName] as well as leading officers of the People's Liberation Army Ground Forces. Inspecting the tanks, painted with the symbol of the PLAGF, the officers were eager to deploy them — after a training and familiarization period for the tank crews.
loc.SEA_PRC_request_aid.21.a: This is excellent news, we will put them to great use!
loc.SEA_PRC_request_aid.9.t: [FROM.GetName] Wants to Sign a Technological Cooperation Agreement
loc.SEA_PRC_request_aid.9.desc: We have received a telegram from [FROM.GetLeader], requesting a Technological Cooperation Agreement. The agreement would further the 'comradely way to spread the means of revolution, all through the knowledge and betterment of humanity'
loc.SEA_PRC_request_aid.9.a: Agree to help in the endeavor
loc.SEA_PRC_request_aid.9.b: We do not have time for this
loc.SEA_PRC_request_aid.10.t: [FROM.GetName] Announces the Signing of a Technological Cooperation Agreement
loc.SEA_PRC_request_aid.10.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has agreed to sign a Technological Cooperation Agreement, which will greatly increase our capacity to develop the nation.
loc.SEA_PRC_request_aid.11.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] refused to sign a Technological Cooperation Agreement, citing a need to prioritize domestic requirements. Though sympathetic to our cause, they could not spare any resources for this endeavor.
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.1.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has sent an envoy to [ROOT.GetLeader] to gauge our interest in splitting the [XIC.GetName] territory between us.
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.2.desc: It would seem as if [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetName] and [PRC.GetLeader] of [PRC.GetNameDef] have banded together to carve up our territory between themselves, like the snakes that they are. Their armies stand poised to cross our borders at a moment's notice, lest we thwart their cowardly attempts. The question is if we can hold both of them off for long?
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.3.desc: It would seem as if [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetName] is as foolish as they come, having turned away our envoys empty-handed. Our generous offer to split a weaker neighbor between the two of us has fallen on deaf ears.
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.3.a: This is but a temporary setback!
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.4.desc: The combined threat of [CHI.GetNameDef] and [PRC.GetNameDef] seems to have been too much for [FROM.GetLeader], who has caved to our demands and agreed to let our troops march into [FROM.GetNameDef] unopposed. It would appear might makes right after all....
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.5.desc: It would seem as if [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetName] is made of sterner stuff than first imagined, having refused to cave to the combined threat of the armies of [CHI.GetNameDef] and [PRC.GetNameDef]. This defiance is as admirable as it is foolish. The armed forces of [FROM.GetNameDef] will soon scatter before our might!
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.5.a: They will come to regret this
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.10.desc: A message from [FROM.GetLeader] has reached us through some backdoor channels, and it seems as if the isolation up in the mountain villages has caused a change of heart in the [FROM.GetNameDef] leader. He now seeks our help to unify China and protect its people from external threats. It is an intriguing offer, but are the Communists to be trusted?
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.10.a: China's problems are bigger than our feud
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.10.b: We will never submit to their leadership!
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.11.desc: The leader of [FROM.GetNameDef] has once again shown the world what a fool [FROM.GetLeader.GetSheHe] is, rejecting our offer to create a united front to protect and unify China. This means that the task to shield our people lies solely upon us. We will prove to the world that we are more than up for the task!
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.11.a: We will protect all of China
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.20.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] openly questioned the war effort and [?PRC_faction_leader_var.GetLeader]'s leadership in a recent summit with [ROOT.GetFactionName] members. He criticized how the war was managed and the manner it was conducted, accusing [?PRC_faction_leader_var.GetName] of intentionally dragging out the conflict. This could be a play from [FROM.GetLeader] in order to gain more leverage within the alliance, but maybe there is some truth to his accusations?
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.21.desc: It appears that a recent speech made by [ROOT.GetLeader] where he criticized [?PRC_faction_leader_var.GetNameDef]'s leadership over [ROOT.GetFactionName], has struck a chord with [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetName]. [FROM.GetLeader] has ensured that we have the backing of [FROM.GetName].
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.22.desc: In a recent speech by [ROOT.GetLeader], he criticized [?PRC_faction_leader_var.GetName]'s leadership over [ROOT.GetFactionName], which did not sit well with everyone attending the faction summit. [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetName] has openly chastised [ROOT.GetLeader] for trying to weaken [ROOT.GetFactionName] and turn its members against each other.
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.22.a: A blind fool is still a fool
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.30.desc: It appears that [FROM.GetNameDef] has successfully managed to infiltrate our territory and secured the loyalty of many of our subjects. They are now demanding that these territories be turned over formally to [FROM.GetNameDef]. What would happen should we refuse remains unstated, but it is likely to produce a forceful response.
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.30.a: We do not have much of a choice really...
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.31.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has accepted our 'request' to turn over the states we have successfully infiltrated, resulting in an increase in our formal holdings. [FROM.GetNameDefCap] was not happy about it, but dared not oppose us. This territory will now officially be governed by [ROOT.GetNameDef].
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.32.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has refused our request to turn over the territories we have managed to infiltrate.
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.32.a: The wrong step invites the cliff...
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.32.b: We will not tolerate treacherous allies!\n§R[FROM.GetName] may seek to join another faction§!
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.40.t: The Path Forward - The Fate of China
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.40.desc: We stand at a crossroads where we have to decide how we want to approach the other Chinese states. [ROOT.GetLeader] has pondered this over many sleepless nights, and it seems clear that there is only one path forward in order to unify all of China...
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.40.a: A decision not made is still a decision taken
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.40.b: We will forge our own path forward
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.40.c: Old allegiances will only hold us back
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.40.d: There is only one, true China!
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.41.desc: It would seem as if [FROM.GetLeader] has decided that [FROM.GetNameDef] is better off without the strength and security that [ROOT.GetFactionName] offers. One can only imagine how they will manage without us!
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.42.desc: It would seem as if [FROM.GetLeader] has decided that [FROM.GetNameDef] and [FROM.GetFactionName] is better off without us in the alliance. What madness drove [FROM.GetLeader] to make such a senseless decision is unknown, but one thing is certain; this has left us more vulnerable. We can only imagine what [FROM.GetNameDef] is up to, but it is nothing good for sure.
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.50.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has sent a delegation to us, trying to persuade us to join their faction. They say that we stand at a crossroads, where the future of China hangs in the balance. According to the [FROM.GetName]'s delegation, there is only one path forward in order to unify all of China — and that is together. One cannot help but to wonder what ulterior motives [FROM.GetLeader] has in [FROM.GetLeader.GetHerHis] mind, and if [FROM.GetLeader.GetSheHe] is to be trusted...
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.50.a: No, [FROM.GetLeader] is not to be trusted!
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.51.desc: Our delegation to [FROM.GetLeader] has returned home empty-handed, with the exception of bad news. Our generous offer to invite [FROM.GetNameDef] into our faction was apparently met with distrust and ill-concealed contempt. It would seem as if [FROM.GetLeader] has decided that [FROM.GetNameDef] is better off without the strength and security that [ROOT.GetFactionName] offers. One can only imagine how they will manage without us!
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.51.a: To chase shadows is to lose the sun
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.52.desc: We have just received news from [FROM.GetLeader] that [FROM.GetNameDef] has decided to withdraw from [ROOT.GetFactionName] and join forces with [PRC.GetNameDef]. What madness drove [FROM.GetLeader] to make such a senseless decision is not known, but if they want to invite hardships and ruin, who are we to stand in their way?
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.53.desc: Our delegation to [FROM.GetNameDef] has returned home bearing good news. It turns out that [FROM.GetLeader] is a far wiser ruler than we first gave [FROM.GetLeader.GetHerHim] credit for, signing our alliance proposal. While not entirely unexpected, one should always expect rain and be all the happier when the sun shines instead. This will greatly strengthen our nations and [ROOT.GetFactionName].
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.53.a: It is a great day for all of China!
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.60.b: We are better off without them
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.70.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has sent a delegation to us, trying to persuade us to join their faction. They say that we stand at a crossroads, where the future of Asia hangs in the balance. According to the [FROM.GetName]'s delegation, there is only one path forward in order to secure our independence from Western colonialists — and that is together.
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.71.t: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] Wants Custody of Our Asian Subjects
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.71.desc: In a letter from [FROM.GetNameDef], [FROM.GetLeader] asks us to release our Asian subjects to their custody in a newly formed [FROM.GetFactionName]
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.71.a: Very well, it is time for a better future
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.72.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has offered to release us — on one condition: Our independence will only be granted in case we join [FROM.FROM.GetNameDef]'s newly formed [PRC.GetFactionName].
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.72.a: We will accept offer and condition both
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.72.b: No, our current situation is agreeable enough
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.73.desc: [FROM.FROM.GetNameDefCap] has agreed to release [FROM.GetNameDef] on the condition that they join our new faction, and [FROM.GetNameDef] has agreed. A welcoming ceremony is planned to be held in [ROOT.Capital.GetName]
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.74.desc: Despite the offer, [FROM.GetLeader] has announced that [FROM.GetNameDef] are refusing the offer of [PRC.GetNameDef] to join the newly formed [PRC.GetFactionName], stating that the preference of the [FROM.GetAdjective] people is the status quo.
loc.SEA_PRC_fourth_army_incident.1.desc: Our commanders have reported that our alliance with [PRC.GetNameDef] has led to friction. Commanders representing [PRC.GetNameDef] are reportedly hesitant to follow our orders and sometime outright disobey them, threatening to cause problems for our own units.
loc.SEA_PRC_fourth_army_incident.2.desc: After some incidents between our commanders and those of [FROM.GetNameDef], their government has sent us a message seeking to calm the tensions. They have officially confirmed that we can retain command of our own troops, and seek to establish a more bilateral cooperation by coordinating our plans.
loc.SEA_PRC_fourth_army_incident.2.a: Thankfully we can focus on the real threat
loc.SEA_PRC_fourth_army_incident.3.desc: The government of [FROM.GetNameDef] has sent us a complaint about the lack of coordination between our commanders in the field. They quote reports from their commanders which state that our officers were unwilling to follow orders from [FROM.GetName] command, leaving them all in unnecessarily vulnerable positions. Specifically, [FROM.GetNameDef] wants us to ensure that we will take part in an on-going tactical retreat, and not compromise it by infighting.
loc.SEA_PRC_fourth_army_incident.3.a: Our commanders decide the actions of our troops, not theirs
loc.SEA_PRC_fourth_army_incident.4.desc: After our complaints about the insubordination of [FROM.GetNameDef] command, their government has successfully forced it to back down and cooperate with our strategic plans.
loc.SEA_PRC_fourth_army_incident.5.t: New Fourth Army Attacked by Nationalist Forces
loc.SEA_PRC_fourth_army_incident.5.desc: We have received reports that the New Fourth Army suffered almost complete annihilation after it was surrounded by nationalist forces, while conducting a retreat that our command had not wanted to join. The accounts of how the fighting started are vague, but what might have started as a friendly fire incident soon turned into a bloodbath once both sides suspected they were under deliberate attack.
loc.SEA_PRC_fourth_army_incident.5.b: We can no longer trust this alliance
loc.SEA_PRC_fourth_army_incident.6.desc: After a recent incident where troops from [ROOT.GetName] fought troops of the [FROM.GetName], the latter has left [ROOT.GetFactionName]. The incident, in which the New Fourth Army of [FROM.GetNameDef] took very heavy casualties, came after a disagreement over orders to retreat, leading to an unknown side opening fire when our retreating troops met [FROM.GetName] soldiers.
loc.SEA_PRC_fourth_army_incident.6.a: This is an unnecessary distraction from the issues at hand
loc.SEA_PRC_fourth_army_incident.7.t: [FROM.GetName] Demands Action After Friendly Fire Incident
loc.SEA_PRC_fourth_army_incident.7.desc: After a recent incident where troops from [ROOT.GetName] fought troops of the [FROM.GetName], the latter demands that we acknowledge our part in causing this incident, and offer guarantees that our commanders will be more careful. The incident, in which the New Fourth Army of [FROM.GetNameDef] took very heavy casualties, came after a disagreement over orders to retreat, leading to an unknown side opening fire when our retreating troops met [FROM.GetName] soldiers.
loc.SEA_PRC_fourth_army_incident.7.a: This can only be blamed on their insubordination
loc.SEA_PRC_fourth_army_incident.7.b: We should try to stay on friendly terms with [FROM.GetNameDef]
loc.SEA_PRC_fourth_army_incident.8.desc: In response to our demand for action after the New Fourth Army incident, [FROM.GetNameDef] has been unwilling to admit any fault. This is a clear sign of distrust, or even veiled hostility towards our nation and troops supporting their war effort.
loc.SEA_PRC_fourth_army_incident.8.a: We cannot afford a conflict at this moment
loc.SEA_PRC_fourth_army_incident.8.c: This calls for an immediate answer
loc.SEA_PRC_fourth_army_incident.9.desc: Despite our lack of apology, [FROM.GetNameDef] has shown unwilling to escalate this conflict over the New Fourth Army Incident further, although they will certainly remember the incident.
loc.SEA_PRC_fourth_army_incident.10.desc: In the aftermath of the New Fourth Army incident, [FROM.GetNameDef] has seen our actions as an act of aggression, and restarted the civil war. Already, troops that were only recently defending side-by-side are fighting each other at the front, and the situation behind the front lines is not much better.
loc.SEA_PRC_fourth_army_incident.10.a: We always knew this would happen eventually
loc.SEA_PRC_fourth_army_incident.11.desc: In response to our request for action to [FROM.GetLeader] in the aftermath of the New Fourth army incident, [FROM.GetLeader] has written a formal letter of apology to our leadership. He promises to try to instruct his commanders to act differently in the face of disagreements about orders.
loc.SEA_PRC_fourth_army_incident.12.desc: In response to the letter of apology to their leadership, [FROM.GetNameDef] has reluctantly deemed it a sufficient resolution to the New Fourth Army Incident.
loc.SEA_PRC_fourth_army_incident.12.a: Now we can both focus on more urgent matters
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.80.desc: A message has arrived from [FROM.capital.GetName], bearing the unmistakable seal of the [FROM.GetLeader]. Behind the florid language of unity and national destiny lies a demand — we are to submit and accept the authority of [FROM.GetNameDef] over our domain. No room for negotiation, just obedience or consequences.
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.80.b: We have no choice but to obey
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.81.desc: The ultimatum has been rejected. In a brazen act of defiance, [FROM.GetLeader] has made it clear that his people will not submit. With our envoys dismissed, diplomacy shall make way for war.
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.81.a: Then they will be brought to heel
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.82.desc: [FROM.GetName] has accepted our ultimatum. Their leaders speak of national unity and historical destiny, but the meaning is plain — they now acknowledge the supremacy of [ROOT.GetNameDef].\nThough their submission may be reluctant, it spares China further division and bloodshed.
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.82.a: A shattered sun gathering its light
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.90.desc: In light of the current aggression facing us both, [FROM.GetNameDef] seeks to join our cause. It would mean accepting them and all faction members of [FROM.GetFactionName].
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.90.a: Yes, we must join together against a common foe
loc.SEA_PRC_faction_events.91.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has rejected our proposal to join their faction against our common foe. Their statement emphasized that although we would be stronger together, [ROOT.GetNameDef] can not be trusted.
loc.SEA_PRC_border_war_events.1.desc: Following the border skirmishes along the border of [1045.GetName], [PRC.GetNameDef] managed to penetrate the defensive lines and push their enemy out. [PRC.GetNameDefCap] now claim the state their own.
loc.SEA_PRC_border_war_events.2.desc: Following the border skirmishes along the border of [1045.GetName], [PRC.GetNameDef] failed to penetrate the defensive lines and push their enemy out. [PRC.GetNameDefCap] did manage to capture some artillery, however.
loc.SEA_PRC_border_war_events.2.b: We have driven out the invaders!
loc.SEA_PRC_border_war_events.3.desc: Following the border skirmishes along the border of [615.GetName], [PRC.GetNameDef] managed to penetrate the defensive lines and push their enemy out. [PRC.GetNameDefCap] now claim the state their own.
loc.SEA_PRC_border_war_events.4.desc: Following the border skirmishes along the border of [615.GetName], [PRC.GetNameDef] failed to penetrate the defensive lines and push their enemy out. [PRC.GetNameDefCap] did manage to capture some artillery, however.
loc.SEA_PRC_border_war_events.5.desc: Following the border skirmishes along the border of [1032.GetName], [PRC.GetNameDef] managed to penetrate the defensive lines and push their enemy out. [PRC.GetNameDefCap] now claim the state their own.
loc.SEA_PRC_border_war_events.6.desc: Following the border skirmishes along the border of [1032.GetName], [PRC.GetNameDef] failed to penetrate the defensive lines and push their enemy out. [PRC.GetNameDefCap] did manage to capture some artillery, however.
loc.SEA_PRC_misc_events.1.desc: The Chinese people have come to doubt our resolve against the foreign invaders!
loc.SEA_PRC_misc_events.2.desc: The Chinese people have come to doubt our resolve against the foreign invaders.
loc.SEA_PRC_misc_events.2.a: We must change their opinion of us
loc.SEA_PRC_misc_events.3.desc: $PRC_pavel_mif$, former mentor of the 28  ½ Bolsheviks and a senior figure in both the Chinese communist party and the Moscow Sun Yat-sen University, has been arrested and purged in [SOV.GetNameDef]. It seems Mif's affiliations with former rivals of Stalin have proven fatal.
loc.SEA_PRC_misc_events.5.t: He Long and the Second Front Army Has Arrived in [ROOT.capital.GetName]
loc.SEA_PRC_misc_events.5.desc: After more than three years of evading Nationalist forces, He Long has arrived in [ROOT.capital.GetName] with minimal damage to his army. Long's experience of commanding and training Nationalist forces prior to joining the Red Army to lead their guerrilla operations, will come in handy — and so will his army.
loc.SEA_PRC_misc_events.5.a: At last! We will need his expertise
loc.SEA_PRC_misc_events.6.t: American Journalist Edgar Snow Interviews Mao
loc.SEA_PRC_misc_events.6.desc: After working as a journalist for years in other parts of China, American Edgar Snow reached out to interview Mao. In the following series of interviews, Mao and Snow mainly talked about [JAP.GetAdjective] imperialism and how [ROOT.GetNameDef] and [CHI.GetNameDef] can organize to resist it, Mao notably predicting a revolution in Japan if it suffers serious military defeats. These interviews and Snow's experiences in [ROOT.GetNameDef], are set to form the basis of a book presenting his unique insights of life here.
loc.SEA_PRC_misc_events.6.a: An opportunity to show the world our true colors
loc.SEA_PRC_misc_events.8.desc: From his cave dwelling on Phoenix Hill in the mountains near Yan'an — shared with other leaders of the [ROOT.GetCommunistParty] — Mao has been, aside from composing poetry, writing on topics ranging from military tactics to politics.
loc.SEA_PRC_misc_events.8.a: These writings will surely become influential
loc.SEA_PRC_misc_events.9.t: 7th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party
loc.SEA_PRC_misc_events.9.desc: After [JAP.GetNonIdeologyName]'s defeat, the Chinese Communist party has gathered to discuss the path ahead. The 7th congress marks the first national congress since 1928 as well as the return to meeting on Chinese land, the previous congress being hosted in Moscow due to a weakened party. Items discussed included the successes and failures of our tactics against the [JAP.GetAdjective]. Other points included the adoption of a new constitution, seeking to implement [ROOT.GetLeader]'s vision of how to best lead our nation forward.
loc.SEA_PRC_misc_events.9.a: This will help lead us to the future
loc.SEA_PRC_misc_events.10.desc: Norman Bethune, a Canadian communist and veteran field doctor of the Spanish Civil War, has arrived to help the [ROOT.GetAdjective] people improve the quality of medical care. Previously notable for his success in creating a mobile blood transfusion station, his efforts will now likely involve improving the medical practices in remote rural areas of [ROOT.GetNameDef].
loc.SEA_PRC_misc_events.10.a: We will take any international volunteers
loc.SEA_PRC_misc_events.11.desc: Sad news has reached [ROOT.Capital.GetName]. Doctor Norman Bethune — after selflessly aiding our people for more than two years — passed away after a seemingly trivial cut to his finger, leading to an infection that proved fatal. [ROOT.GetLeader], after receiving this news, wrote an eulogy praising Bethune's work. The penned tribute highlights the doctor's willingness to travel the world in support of his comrades, and how he set an example for the cooperation between the proletariat of different countries.
loc.SEA_PRC_misc_events.12.desc: In an effort to safeguard its eastern frontier, [SOV.GetNameDef] has signed a 'neutrality pact' with [JAP.GetNameDef]. This however means that [JAP.GetNameDef] will be allowed a free hand to expand in Asia without concern about [SOV.GetAdjective] intervention.
loc.SEA_PRC_misc_events.13.desc: We have received a delegation from [FROM.GetNameDef], petitioning us to hand over territory which they claim are rightfully theirs, and that might be true... From a certain point of view. [FROM.GetLeader] would be very grateful if we obliged and gave the Chinese what they are asking for, and would be equally upset if we refused — so much so that [FROM.GetLeader.GetSheHe] might consider taking the territory by force. Or so the delegation claims at least...
loc.SEA_PRC_misc_events.14.desc: Our delegation to [FROM.GetNameDef] has returned with excellent news! Our request to [FROM.GetLeader] to hand over our rightful Manchurian territories has been granted. [ROOT.GetLeader] has heaped praise on both [FROM.GetLeader] and our diplomats for pulling off this feat.
loc.SEA_PRC_misc_events.14.a: A step closer to a United China!
loc.SEA_PRC_misc_events.15.desc: Our delegation to [FROM.GetNameDef] has returned with excellent news! Our request to [FROM.GetLeader] to hand over our rightful Mongolian territories has been granted. [ROOT.GetLeader] has heaped praise on both [FROM.GetLeader] and our diplomats for pulling off this feat.
loc.SEA_PRC_misc_events.16.desc: Our delegation to [FROM.GetNameDef] has returned with excellent news! Our request to [FROM.GetLeader] to hand over our rightful territories held by [FROM.GetNameDef] has been granted. [ROOT.GetLeader] has heaped praise on both [FROM.GetLeader] and our diplomats for pulling off this feat.
loc.SEA_PRC_misc_events.17.desc: Our delegation to [FROM.GetNameDef] has returned in a downcast mood. Our request to [FROM.GetLeader] to hand over our rightful territories has been met with refusal and scorn. [ROOT.GetLeader] has been cursing both [FROM.GetLeader] and our diplomats for failing to secure what is rightfully ours.
loc.SEA_PRC_misc_events.17.a: A blind fool is both blind and a fool
loc.SEA_PRC_misc_events.17.b: We will take what is ours by force!
loc.SEA_PRC_misc_events.18.desc: Our delegation to [FROM.GetNameDef] has returned in a downcast mood. Our request to [FROM.GetLeader] to hand over our rightful territories has been met with refusal and scorn. [ROOT.GetLeader] has been cursing both [FROM.GetLeader] and our diplomats for failing to secure what is rightfully ours.
loc.SEA_PRC_misc_events.19.desc: We are fortunate that [FROM.GetNameDef] agrees to our demands.
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.1.desc1: With the 28  ½ Bolsheviks prevailing in the power struggle, it is time to choose a representative to lead the nation. Despite his exile in [SOV.GetNameDef], it is time for $PRC_wang_ming$ to return to leadership — should $PRC_bo_gu$ not get the nod.
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.1.desc2: With the 28  ½ Bolsheviks prevailing in the power struggle, it is time to choose a representative to lead the nation. Although both candidates are well-connected with communists in [SOV.GetNameDef], $PRC_bo_gu$ is less politically experienced. He does however show a deep understanding of military matters which may be useful in the struggles to come, if it would outweigh $PRC_wang_ming$'s political and diplomatic savvy. Both men are ready to take up the mantle.
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.2.desc: Despite our support, and their relatively sheltered seat in the mountains of central China, [FROM.GetNameDef] has requested that we pledge to protect them in case of conflict. Whether they fear another anti-communist campaign by nationalist forces or foreign imperialism is unclear, but we need to weigh the risk of being pulled into such conflicts before we grant any guarantees.
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.2.b: We will guarantee them — if they agree to become our subject
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.3.desc: Our mission to [FROM.GetNameDef] was successful, with them pledging to protect us against any threats we may face. This protection should allow us to focus on long term goals such as developing [ROOT.capital.GetName], a matter that had otherwise been compromised by the potential urgency of another tactical retreat.
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.31.t: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] Agrees to a Territorial Guarantee — At a Cost
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.31.desc: Our mission to [FROM.GetNameDef] was successful, with them pledging to protect us against any threats we may face. This protection should allow us to focus on long term goals such as developing [ROOT.capital.GetName], a matter that had otherwise been compromised by the potential urgency of another tactical retreat.
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.31.b: On second thoughts... let us not
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.32.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has replied that they no longer want to pursue the diplomatic option of us guaranteeing them. Apparently the principle of becoming a subject was too much for them to bear.
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.4.desc: Despite the best efforts of our diplomats, [FROM.GetNameDef] has refused to commit itself to protecting [ROOT.GetNameDef]. We can only hope that such promises of protection wouldn't have ever been necessary anyway.
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.5.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has taken another step in seeking to expand its cooperation with us by requesting to join [ROOT.GetFactionName]. We must decide if we would consider this a useful expansion of [ROOT.GetFactionName] into China, or if such an alliance rather would be a potential liability.
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.6.desc: Our delegation to [FROM.GetNameDef] has returned home to announce that we have been welcomed into [FROM.GetFactionName]. Together with them, [FROM.GetAdjective] diplomats arrived to discuss what our cooperation could look like.
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.7.desc: The diplomats we sent to [FROM.GetName] returned with the news that we were not allowed to join [FROM.GetFactionName]. It seems that [FROM.GetNameDef] is focusing its diplomatic efforts elsewhere.
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.8.t: [FROM.GetName] Wants to Sign a Non-Aggression Pact
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.8.desc: Seeing itself surrounded by potential enemies, [FROM.GetNameDef] has approached us seeking a non-aggression pact to ensure our passivity in any conflicts in the region aimed at them.
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.8.a: We do not want to get involved anyway
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.8.b: This might make them act more aggressively
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.9.t: [FROM.GetName] Agrees to Sign a Non-Aggression Pact
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.9.desc: After careful deliberation, [FROM.GetNameDef] has decided to sign our proposed non-aggression pact. They thankfully did not seem interested in getting involved in conflicts in the region.
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.10.t: [FROM.GetName] Refuses to Sign a Non-Aggression Pact
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.10.desc: The imperialist [FROM.GetName] has refused our request to sign a non-aggression with us. It seems that they prioritize relations with our rivals over those with us.
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.11.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has sent a telegram to [Root.GetLeader], formally requesting the independence of [FROM.GetName]. The telegram does not say what would happen should we refuse, but it is safe to assume they would not be happy.
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.11.b: No, they shall remain our subject
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.12.desc: It is a glorious day in [ROOT.Capital.GetName] — we are free from the yoke of [FROM.GetName]. It is time to celebrate, our time is nigh.
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.13.desc: What a shame — as a response to [ROOT.GetLeader]'s telegram, [FROM.GetName] has refused to guarantee our independence, instead declaring that our fate is inexplicably tied to theirs.
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.13.a: Desperate times calls for desperate measures...
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.19.t: Some of Our Generals Have Switched Sides!
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.19.desc: The conflict between [PRC.GetNameDef] and [CHI.GetNameDef] has undermined our army as some of our commanders have defected to the communists. Whether they truly align with [PRC.GetNameDef], or are simply following the way the wind seems to be blowing, remains to be seen.
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.20.t: Generals Across China Flock to Our Cause
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.20.desc: The resumption of hostilities between [CHI.GetNameDef] and [PRC.GetNameDef] has caused uncertainty among the enemy officers, causing some of them to defect to our side.
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.21.desc: \nSeeking [ROOT.GetAdjective] advice on military strategy, [FROM.GetNameDef] has requested that we allow $SOV_vasily_chuykov$ and $SOV_aleksandr_cherepanov$ to return to China. Chuykov had originally been stationed in [FROM.GetNameDef] and is fluent in Chinese, but was recalled after a conflict over [ROOT.GetAdjective] interests in Manchuria, when it had not been invaded by Japan yet.
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.21.b: We need their expertise at home
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.22.desc: \nOur representatives in [FROM.capital.GetName] have contacted us with the news that [FROM.GetNameDef] has accepted our request to let $SOV_vasily_chuykov$ return to China, and informed us that he is already on his way to [ROOT.GetNameDef]. Additionally, $SOV_aleksandr_cherepanov$ has joined him.
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.23.desc: \nDespite $SOV_vasily_chuykov$'s suitability as an attaché in [ROOT.GetNameDef], [FROM.GetNameDef] has decided to neither dispatch him nor $SOV_aleksandr_cherepanov$, claiming that they are currently involved in military plans more important.
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.23.a: Perhaps few skilled commanders are left after the purges
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.24.desc: \nHearing of $SOV_vasily_chuykov$ and $SOV_aleksandr_cherepanov$'s mission to [CHI.GetNameDef], [FROM.GetNameDef] has expressed interest in also hosting them as attachés. [FROM.GetNameDefCap] seems to have picked up on the commanders' practical skillset of Chinese fluency combined with extensive military experience, or perhaps, they just wish to deny [CHI.GetName] this expertise.
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.24.a: We will aid our comrades of [FROM.GetNameDef]
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.24.b: They are doing good work in [CHI.GetName]
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.25.desc: \nAfter a request by [PRC.GetNameDef] to redeploy $SOV_vasily_chuykov$ and $SOV_aleksandr_cherepanov$ to their region, they have started traveling in their direction. Despite our appeal to them to stay as advisors, they could not disobey the orders given to them by [FROM.GetNameDef].
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.26.desc: \n[FROM.GetNameDefCap] has decided to honor our request and has ordered $SOV_vasily_chuykov$ and $SOV_aleksandr_cherepanov$ to relocate to [ROOT.GetNameDef]. Their advice will no doubt be valuable, and the relocation will be a blow to the army of [CHI.GetNameDef].
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.26.a: Let us see what suggestions they may have
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.27.desc: \nDespite the support previously provided by [FROM.GetNameDef], they have refused to end $SOV_vasily_chuykov$'s and $SOV_aleksandr_cherepanov$'s assignments in [CHI.GetNameDef], depriving us of deploying the commanders as attachés here. They argue that [CHI.GetNameDef]'s army is currently of high importance to [FROM.GetNameDef].
loc.SEA_PRC_political_events.41.desc: Political rivals for years, $PRC_mao_zedong$ and $PRC_zhang_guotao$ have met in [ROOT.Capital.GetName] to put aside their differences in face of our perilous situation. Though neither fully trust the other, the enemy of our enemy is a friend indeed.
loc.SEA_PRC_zhang_guotao_events.1.desc: $PRC_zhang_guotao$, the General in charge of the Fourth Front Army, leads one of the two armies not yet arrived at our safe base areas. They are still on the Long March, after disagreeing with Mao on which path to take. In October of 1935, $PRC_zhang_guotao$ declared himself the real leader of [ROOT.GetNameDef], and has even gone so far as to form his own Central Committee, Central Government, and Central Military Commission. He additionally declared that $PRC_mao_zedong$, $PRC_zhang_wentian$ and $PRC_zhou_enlai$ should be excluded from the Party. \n\n$PRC_zhang_guotao$ has now sent a telegram to [ROOT.GetLeader] declaring that he is heading towards the safety of the base areas with his army. The telegram also states that, according to the wishes of Lin Yuying — the Party's envoy to [SOV.GetNameDef] — Guotao has suspended his Party Organs in favor of a peaceful reconciliation with Mao and the others. No matter what he says, Guotao remains a potent political rival and should not be underestimated.
loc.SEA_PRC_zhang_guotao_events.1.a: Though Guotao has an army to his name, the Party is opposed to his claims to legitimacy
loc.SEA_PRC_zhang_guotao_events.2.desc: $PRC_zhang_guotao$ of the Fourth Front Army, political rival to Mao, has sent a telegram that he and his army are nearing [ROOT.Capital.GetName]. Their Long March has lasted nearly a year longer than that of $PRC_mao_zedong$, and the army is sure to be worn out by the ordeal. Perhaps it is because of this that $PRC_zhang_guotao$ has again stressed that he does not seek to challenge the current party leadership.
loc.SEA_PRC_zhang_guotao_events.2.a: Welcome Guotao and his army — but keep a close eye on him
loc.SEA_PRC_zhang_guotao_events.2.b: We cannot trust him — denounce $PRC_zhang_guotao$ and refuse him entry to our territory
loc.PRC_reject_guotao_tt: §RThis will prevent access to the §!§Y$PRC_the_unwilling_diarchy_focus$§!§R focus and subsequent branch§!
loc.SEA_PRC_zhang_guotao_events.3.t: $PRC_zhang_guotao$ and the Fourth Front Army Has Arrived in [ROOT.capital.GetName]
loc.SEA_PRC_zhang_guotao_events.3.desc: Finally, the Long March is over for $PRC_zhang_guotao$ and the Fourth Front Army — they have arrived relatively intact in our base areas. Debriefings have already begun, but Guotao has not yet renounced his claims to leadership. Instead he claims to support what must be done to help win the coming struggle, not elaborating on what he means by that. Further meetings of the Politburo will need to be held by [Root.GetLeader] to sort out this mess.
loc.SEA_PRC_zhang_guotao_events.3.a: A challenge to the party leadership?
loc.SEA_PRC_zhang_guotao_events.4.desc: $PRC_zhang_guotao$ has declared that he is leaving the Chinese Communist Party, citing the irreparable relationship with the Central Committee and his disillusionment with the party.
loc.PRC_zhang_guotao_left_tt: §Y$PRC_zhang_guotao$§! §Rwill no longer be available§! as a §YGeneral§! or §YAdvisor§!
loc.SEA_PRC_zhang_guotao_events.5.desc: $PRC_zhang_guotao$, 'former' communist leader and political rival of $PRC_mao_zedong$, has approached [ROOT.GetLeader] to join our side in the fight against foreign aggression. Titled a 'former' communist due to his recent denouncement of the [PRC.GetLeader]'s leadership of the Central Committee, Guotao has since left the Party and now seeks to join us. His experience could be of use, but [PRC.GetNameDef] is sure to be angry for letting one they see as a traitor join us.
loc.SEA_PRC_zhang_guotao_events.6.desc: $PRC_zhang_guotao$ has not only left the Chinese Communist Party, he has also joined the KMT under the leadership of [CHI.GetNameDef]. Should we ever find ourselves in direct conflict with them, $PRC_zhang_guotao$ will be on the enemy's side.
loc.SEA_PRC_zhang_guotao_events.7.desc: $PRC_zhang_guotao$ has declared that he is leaving the Chinese Communist Party, citing the irreparable relationship with the Central Committee and $PRC_mao_zedong$, as well as his disillusionment with the party.
loc.SEA_PRC_zhang_guotao_events.7.a: The Unwilling Diarchy was a mistake — he cannot be trusted
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.1.desc: Seeking to reduce their reliance on [USA.GetAdjective] trade, [FROM.GetNameDef] has approached us with a proposal for a new trade deal. Similarly to them, this may allow us to also reduce our reliance on a small group of trading partners.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.1.a: Having alternative sources for the resources we need is crucial
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.1.b: We have other trade partners in mind
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.2.desc: Our proposed trade agreement with [FROM.GetNameDef] was positively received by their government. Their enthusiasm is a great start to our search for new trading partners.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.3.desc: With a path for their independence set, [FROM.GetNameDef] has approached us with a draft for a trade deal between our nations. They propose a deal which would make importing our resources more appealing for them, where previously trade partners might have been chosen based on [USA.GetAdjective] interests instead of [FROM.GetAdjective] ones.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.3.a: This will give us a competitive edge
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.3.b: They will get the same price as everyone else
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.4.desc: [FROM.GetAdjective] representatives have announced that they will send further delegates to create a trade agreement between our nations. Such a new agreement with [FROM.GetNameDef] promises to offer us more options in who we obtain our critical resources from.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.5.desc: Our sensible proposal for a trade agreement with [FROM.GetNameDef] has been refused. It seems that deals with other trading partners or geopolitical considerations have meant that they have acted against both our and their own interests.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.5.a: We will find someone else to purchase resources from
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.6.desc: The growing influence of the [FROM.GetCommunistParty] in [FROM.GetNameDef] now bears fruit as its representatives have traversed China to inform us of a [FROM.GetAdjective] volunteer force that is mobilizing to support our forces. In addition, these volunteers are bringing spare equipment to help equip our own troops.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.6.a: A good start for cooperation with our [FROM.GetAdjective] comrades
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.7.desc: Representatives of [FROM.GetLeader] have communicated his thanks for the support of our volunteers and for the provided war material. The [FROM.GetAdjective] extensive experience in civil war surely means these resources will be used effectively.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.9.t: [FROM.GetName] Offers to Sell Ships for Military Equipment
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.9.desc: In return for a shipment of [PHI_GetTradedEquipment], [FROM.GetNameDef] offers to send us a flotilla of merchant and transport vessels.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.10.desc: As we proposed, [FROM.GetNameDef] has sent us a shipment of [PHI_GetTradedEquipment] in return for merchant and transport ships, which are now sailing towards [FROM.GetAdjective] ports.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.11.desc: Sadly, [FROM.GetNameDef] has refused to provide us with [PHI_GetTradedEquipment] in return for some of our vessels.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.11.a: Perhaps they are willing to part with some other equipment
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.12.t: The Threat of American Intervention Is Over
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.12.desc: Following strident negotiations, and a string of concessions from [PHI.GetNameDef], [USA.GetLeader] has announced that [USA.GetNameDef] will not intervene with [Root.GetRulingPartyLong] plans. [USA.GetLeader.GetSheHeCap] has been convinced that [PHI.GetNameDef] poses no immediate threat to the American people, and that we have taken proper steps to ensure the proper continuation of a stable government.[TreatyOfManilaToBeSigned]
loc.PHI_TreatyOfManilaToBeSigned: \n\nTherefore, talks towards the signing of the Treaty of Manila have been authorised, and mutually agreed independence for [PHI.GetNameDef] seems to be imminent.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.13.desc: [PHI.GetNameDef] Communist Party has repeatedly spurned our representatives, and threatened to break all relations with us.\n\nSenior military officials have presented a military plan to the desk of [Root.GetLeader]. Proponents of the plan argue that a communist Philippines is a threat to our security and we must intervene to stop the spread of communism.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.13.a: Intervene to stop communism in South East Asia
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.14.desc: [USA.GetNameDefCap] has declared war on [PHI.GetName]. This comes after a failure to placate [USA.GetAdjective] worries about the role of [PHI.GetRulingPartyLong]. The public statement of [USA.GetLeader] called this war necessary to stop the spread of communism in South East Asia.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.14.a: We will resist our former overlords
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.15.desc: [USA.GetNameDefCap] has announced a complete trade embargo on [PHI.GetNameDef] due to the 'failure of the [PHI.GetAdjective] government to curtail communist influence'.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.15.a: At least it is not an armed response
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.16.desc: In response to our changing government and foreign policy, the [USA.GetAdjective] government has sent a letter condemning our actions. In view of their previous interventions in South America however, this seems a mild reaction.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.17.desc: Seizing on the weakness of American oversight over the National Government, the Partido Komunista ng Pilipinas were quick to step in and fill the void, with elected party members calling for immediate decisive action which only they were equipped to deliver. While other groups still hold some sway, the communist sector has risen rapidly in prominence. \n \nNow though, we must determine just who should lead the party, and the nation towards the rising red dawn.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.17.a: Appoint Evangelista, we need radical leadership
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.17.b: Appoint Santos, for a more intellectual approach
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.18.desc: We have been watching the rise of the farmers, the factory workers and the fishermen in [PHI.GetNameDef] with great interest, and they have now extending diplomatic overtures to us suggesting their interest in joining the Comintern. How should we respond?
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.19.desc: Our delegation to [SOV.GetNameDef] have just returned, but they bear bad news- we have been refused entry into the Comintern. For the moment at least, we stand alone against the tides of darkness.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.19.a: The world seems just a little darker today
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.20.t: Douglas MacArthur Ordered To The Philippines
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.20.desc: President [USA.GetLeader] has restored Douglas MacArthur back to active service and assigned him to command the newly formed United States Army Forces in the Far East, stationed in the Philippines. The President made this appointment as MacArthur has been worked as a military advisor in the Philippines for a number of years, and is well informed as to the defensive situation there. \n \nIn order to better allow him to direct forces on the ground there, we will no longer have control over him. We will, however, be able to recall him should we need his talents here. We should think carefully about doing so, however, as his leaving the Philippines could be seen as a withdrawal of American interests, and an abandoning of our responsibilities across the Pacific at this crucial time.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.21.t: Douglas MacArthur Arrives In The Philippines
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.21.desc: Excellent news! President [USA.GetLeader] has assigned General Douglas MacArthur to command the United States Army Forces in the Far East. We are very familiar with MacArthur as during his retirement he has acted as a military advisor here for a number of years, and his appointment and reactivation to regular service is a sure sign that [USA.GetNameDef] is serious about their responsibility for our defense. \n \nOn his arrival in Manila, he immediately set about securing resources from [USA.GetNameDef], and himself vowed to stand alongside our brave Filipino people against any incursion, and to the very last.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.30.desc: Supreme Commander of the United States Army Forces in the Far East, Douglas MacArthur has requested the services of his protege, Dwight D. Eisenhower. Eisenhower has already served under MacArthur when the latter was Chief of the Army, and clearly the elder general has seen his potential. We ourselves see Eisenhower as a rising star within the United States Army, and being in such an active and growing command could gain him a lot of experience. \n\nEisenhower himself has stressed that he does not see this as a long-term appointment, and intends to return to the United States in two years once he has learned all he can from MacArthur and being an active duty staff officer.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.30.a: MacArthur and Eisenhower working together? Absolutely!
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.30.b: No, Eisenhower is more important to use here.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.31.t: Dwight D. Eisenhower Arrives In The Philippines
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.31.desc: General MacArthur's request for Dwight D. Eisenhower to join us in the Philippines has been approved! We are lucky to have such a rising star join us, and this is further proof of how dedicated the United States is to our protection. It has been made clear to us that this is to be a short term assignment of roughly two years, however, there might be a way to incentivize his remaining in the Philippines.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.40.desc: Manuel Quezon was assassinated today at 3pm while giving a speech to supporters in Luneta Park. The gunman is still on the loose, but connections to the Sakdalista movement are suspected. In the mean time, the National Assembly has been closed for reasons of national security. The constabulary have appeared in force in Manila, and the streets have been cleared. An uncomfortable quiet has settled over the country, a collective baited breath for whatever may come next.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.40.a: The torch of democracy sputters out!
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.40.b: Police Chief Eisenhower will step in!
loc.PHI_eisenhower_steps_in_tt: §GEisenhower will attempt to thwart the Fascist plans§!
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.41.desc: Artemio Ricarte, returning from exile with a cadre of followers armed with a variety of Japanese arms have claimed to have found and apprehended the assassin of Manuel Quezon, and are now promising to work together with the constabulary in order to retain order during the crisis caused by the murder of the president. Because of the suspicions placed on the Sakdalistas movement, he has promised to work with the Ganap party in order to gain legitimacy, and thereby expedite independence from the United States as quickly as possible. In response, the Constabulary have withdrawn from Manila, ostensibly to not escalate tensions, meanwhile the American garrison has been placed on high alert, though has not as yet made any move.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.42.desc:
Now that control over the Philippines has been exerted, and stability has begun to return, it's time for the Executive Commission to gather and determine where final authority lies in the nation. There are three candidates to choose from. 

Emilio Aguinaldo, hero of the revolution against the Spanish, is a long time supporter of Philippine independence and has spoken out how under the United States, the people of the Philippines are just a consumer market for American exports, if not pariahs because Filipinos are not even considered citizens of the United States. 

Artemio Ricarte, chief of the Philippine Army during the wars against Spain and the United States, then exiled for his refusal to swear fealty to the American occupiers. His love for the country never waned, and even while living in Japan he worked towards seeing our eventual independence. 

José Laurel, the more moderate choice, this Supreme Court Justice was educated internationally and has familial connections with Japanese officials, so could be well positioned to build ties between the Philippines and the Japanese, and thereby develop our case for independence.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.42.a: Aguinaldo has lead us to independence before.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.42.b: Ricarte has the unbending dedication to our cause we need.
loc.PHI_laurel_help: §YJosé Laurel§! will increase the chance of getting Japanese support in §YSecure Japanese Guarantees§!
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.43.desc:
Artemio Ricarte, returning from exile with a cadre of followers armed with a variety of Japanese arms have claimed to have found and apprehended the assassin of Manuel Quezon, however, Police Chief Eisenhower refuted the claim, and stating that the man was a poor peasant paid to be a scapegoat. 

In response, the group then marched on the National Assembly determined to see justice done, and stormed the building. Shots were fired at the entrance, and two bystanders were hit. The American-sponsored guards were blamed, and Eisenhower was forced to withdraw the constabulary from the area for fear of escalating the tension. 

Despite his efforts, mobs formed, incited by Sakdalista rebels bussed in from the surrounding regions threatened to overwhelm the police entirely. In desperation  Eisenhower has sent an urgent message to [MessageToMac]the American garrison for assistance.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.44.desc: When it came, the reaction by [MacOrGarrison] was sudden and overwhelming. Not taking any chances, the entire Philippine Division was deployed to Manila, the cavalry charging in first, followed immediately by infantry with fixed bayonets. Where there was more stubborn resistance, tear gas was used to clear resistance. Stunned by the overwhelming force, the Sakdalista militias were forced to abandon their barricades and melted away out of the city. \n\nAlthough the initial threat of a fascist coup has been thwarted, there still remains a danger of a wider escalation into a civil war, and as such [MacOrEisenhower] has seen fit to declare a military emergency, impose martial law, and assume dictatorial powers to ensure ongoing stable governance.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.44.a: All in the name of freedom and democracy!
loc.PHI_declare_military_emergency_tt: This has unlocked a new focus branch on the far left.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.45.desc: The [FROM.GetAdjective] government has approached us with plans for an independence struggle against [USA.GetNameDef]. These plans have not yet been set in motion, but they requested that when [PHI.GetNameDef] does demand independence, that we would back their demand, and join their struggle if it is refused.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.46.desc: We have received a message from the [FROM.GetAdjective] government stating that they are willing to back our eventual demand for independence. Although that alone should help convince [ROOT.overlord.GetNameDef], [FROM.GetNameDef] has also promised to back us militarily if they try to undo any steps towards independence.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.47.desc: Our diplomats sent to [FROM.GetNameDef] swiftly returned after their government refused to promise aid for our steps towards independence. While they claimed that they wanted to help us, they could not risk getting involved in a war with [ROOT.overlord.GetNameDef].
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.47.desc.2: Our diplomats sent to [FROM.GetNameDef] swiftly returned after their government refused to promise aid for our steps towards independence. It seems that they are more interested in becoming our new overlord than helping us become independent.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.47.a: It seems their rhetoric about decolonization was all talk
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.48.desc: Earlier today we received reports of irregularities in [FROM.GetNameDef]. Following this, we have now received a declaration of independence from their government, although clearly trying to convince us not to intervene, they have made clear that they would not shun from fighting to maintain their newfound independence.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.48.desc.2: Earlier today we received reports of irregularities in [FROM.GetNameDef]. Following this, we have now received a declaration of independence from their government, with a clear statement of support from the [JAP.GetAdjective] government. Although the statement appeals to us to not intervene, the [FROM.GetAdjective] government has made it clear that they would not shun from fighting to maintain their newfound independence, and with [JAP.GetAdjective] backing.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.48.desc.3: Earlier today we received reports of irregularities in [FROM.GetNameDef]. Following this, we have now received a declaration of independence from their government, with a clear statement of support from a few South American governments. Although the statement appeals to us to not intervene, the [FROM.GetAdjective] government has made it clear that they would not shun from fighting to maintain their newfound independence, and with South American backing.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.48.desc.4: Earlier today we received reports of irregularities in [FROM.GetNameDef]. Following this, we have now received a declaration of independence from their government, with a clear statement of support from the [SPR.GetAdjective] government. Although the statement appeals to us to not intervene, the [FROM.GetAdjective] government has made it clear that they would not shun from fighting to maintain their newfound independence, and with [SPR.GetAdjective] backing.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.48.desc.5: Earlier today we received reports of irregularities in [FROM.GetNameDef]. Following this, we have now received a declaration of independence from their government, with a clear statement of support from the [SPR.GetAdjective] and some South American governments. Although the statement appeals to us to not intervene, the [FROM.GetAdjective] government has made it clear that they would not shun from fighting to maintain their newfound independence, and with the backing of its Hispanic allies.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.48.a: We were going to give them it anyway
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.49.desc: After not responding to our declaration of independence for several days of presumably heated discussions among the [FROM.GetAdjective] leadership, [FROM.GetNameDef] has officially announced that it will recognize [ROOT.GetAdjective] independence.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.50.t: [FROM.GetName] Fights to Regain Control over Us
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.50.desc: In response to our declaration of independence, [FROM.GetNameDef] has given no official reply and has started moving troops towards nearby bases to intervene.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.51.desc: The military situation in [USA.GetNameDef] has proven sufficiently dire that $USA_douglas_macarthur$ has been requested to immediately return home.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.52.desc: The military situation in [USA.GetNameDef] has proven sufficiently dire that $USA_dwight_d_eisenhower$ has been requested to immediately return home.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.53.desc: After joining $USA_douglas_macarthur$'s mission to [PHI.GetNameDef], playing a role in it since 1935 and more recently a more active one, $USA_dwight_d_eisenhower$ has now returned home. During the mission he has gained valuable military experience, including his first time piloting an aircraft and working with commanders like $USA_douglas_macarthur$ with fundamentally different ideas about reforming the [PHI.GetAdjective] army.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.53.a: His experiences will surely prove useful
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.54.desc: With the recent loss of the region of Manila, our forces have lost confidence in winning the war with traditional tactics. As the army officially surrenders, and our government evacuates, new organizations to resist the enemy are already being formed.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.54.a: We can continue the war with guerrilla forces
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.55.desc: After significant economic and political preparation, [PHI.GetNameDef] has declared independence. This predictably comes after the Tydings-McDuffie act that Congress signed into law in 1934, which set a course for [PHI.GetAdjective] independence. [PHI.GetNameDefCap] is now free to create its own political and economic policies without pressures from [USA.GetNameDef].
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.55.b: Now we can cooperate as equals
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.55.c: We must now pursue diplomatic independence as well
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.56.desc: Seeking to establish a navy and to contribute further to our military efforts, [FROM.GetNameDef] has requested that we transfer one or more task forces that operate in their proximity to their control.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.56.a: We can manage our own navy
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.56.b: Let them have the local taskforce
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.56.c: Let them handle the Pacific Ocean
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.56.d: Let them handle the Pacific Ocean but send a supervisor
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.56.e: Let them handle the Pacific Ocean and supply fuel
loc.PHI_transfer_20_percent_navy_tt: Transfer 20% of our naval forces to [FROM.GetNameDef].
loc.PHI_transfer_40_percent_navy_tt: Transfer 40% of our naval forces to [FROM.GetNameDef].
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.57.desc: Our request for control over local [FROM.GetAdjective] naval forces has been approved by their government. The task forces have been ordered to our ports pending reorganization.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.57.desc.2: $SEA_PHI_political_events.57.desc$ Additionally, oil fields in [371.GetName] are now set to produce fuel for our forces to support their logistics after this major acquisition.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.57.a: This is great enhancement to our military capabilities
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.58.desc: Sadly our [FROM.GetAdjective] ally has denied our request to partially delegate their navy to our military. It seems we will have to ramp up dockyard production if we wish to contribute to the naval theater.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.58.a: We'll have to focus on building our own navy
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.59.desc: Although [USA.GetNameDef] launched a military intervention against [PHI.GetNameDef] to overthrow its new government, this plan has not proven successful. With both sides recognizing the war is just dragging on, negotiations have started to end it, [PHI.GetAdjective] independence now recognized.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.60.desc: In the aftermath of the 1935 presidential election, [ROOT.GetNeutralLeader] still has not accepted his significant defeat, and is challenging the matter with the council in charge of the elections. If evidence of interference is found, the party would likely take the matter to one of the country's highest courts.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.61.desc: After an extensive investigation, the council in charge of investigating the election results of 1935 claims it found evidence of irregularities. That alone would not have been very noteworthy if not for following actions of the judiciary which disqualified [ROOT.GetDemocraticParty], resulting in a [ROOT.GetNeutralParty] victory. [USA.GetAdjective] attempts to quickly dismiss the process spectacularly backfired as it was seen as further evidence of corruption.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.61.a: They know what is best for the country
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.62.t: Volunteers for the Spanish Civil War?
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.62.desc: Our historical and cultural connections to [SPR.GetNonIdeologyName] have meant the conflict there has been followed closely by our people.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.62.a: The Nationalists are fighting for our Catholic values
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.62.b: The Republicans are fighting for freedom and liberty
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.63.desc: The term of incumbent president [ROOT.GetLeader] is coming to an end and elections will soon to held for the next president. Although the successes of [ROOT.GetLeader]'s leadership form a promising picture of the possibility of his continued leadership, some voters seek a new direction for our reforms and a new president to guide them.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.63.roxas: $PHI_manuel_roxas$'s connections would help with economic reform
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.63.laurel: $PHI_jose_laurel$ would be a good leader in these times of turmoil
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.64.desc_quezon: After developing tuberculosis, the gradual decline of $PHI_manuel_luis_quezon$'s health has now sadly led to his death. The vice-president has temporarily taken over Quezon's former duties while the nation mourns, but soon it will be time to determine a successor.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.64.desc_generic: The current term of [ROOT.GetLeader] has come to an end and a new presidential election now decides our next president. Because of his deteriorating health, $PHI_manuel_luis_quezon$ has withdrawn from the race.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.65.desc: Sadly, our request to strengthen the [USA.GetAdjective] military mission in [ROOT.GetNameDef] has been denied. Other military plans of [USA.GetNameDef] apparently require his expertise.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.66.desc: As another country in the [USA.GetAdjective] sphere of influence, [FROM.GetNameDef] now seeks to improve cooperation within this sphere by creating an alliance of Hispanic nations. This may offer a counterweight to [USA.GetAdjective] pressure that at times borders on imperialism.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.66.a: This will give stability in the region
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.67.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has signed our proposed mutual assistance treaty, which lays out a conditional alliance which will now enter into effect. This is a first clear first step in strengthening [FROM.GetAdjective]-[ROOT.GetAdjective] cooperation.
loc.PHI_will_join_faction_later_tt: §Y[ROOT.GetNameDefCap]§! will join the §Yfaction of [FROM.GetNameDef]§! after it completes §Y$PHI_war_of_independence$§!
loc.PHI_will_join_faction_later_PHI_tt: §Y[FROM.GetNameDefCap]§! will join the §Yfaction of [ROOT.GetNameDef]§! after it completes §Y$PHI_war_of_independence$§!
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.68.desc: Ideological differences or perhaps concerns about alienating [USA.GetNameDef] have led to [FROM.GetNameDef] not signing our proposed mutual assistance treaty, it seems we must find allies elsewhere.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.68.a: Perhaps their rivals in the region will be more willing
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.69.desc: Since gaining independence, [FROM.GetNameDef] has made many steps to consolidate its independence, and now wishes to expand its cooperation with other Hispanic countries. This now shows itself as a proposal to unite our country with theirs in a Hispanic Empire.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.69.a: Together we can avenge our colonization
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.70.desc: The wave of [FROM.GetAdjective] representatives visiting [ROOT.capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName] made clear what was confirmed a few days later: [FROM.GetNameDef] has accepted our request to unify with [ROOT.GetNameDef].
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.71.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has decided not to agree to our proposal to unify. Although they communicated that they consider our alliance valuable, they also considered this a step too far.
loc.SEA_PHI_political_events.71.a: Then perhaps our differences are greater than we thought
loc.SEA_generic_events.2.desc: [GetOppositionPartyAdjective] laborers in a local factory briefly disrupted their production to protest for better working conditions and more political freedom. Although of limited scale, the strike does show the popularity of the [GetOppositionPartyName].
loc.SEA_generic_events.2.b: Intervening would only cause more issues
loc.SEA_generic_events.3.desc: Supporters of [GetOppositionPartyName] are reportedly holding a demonstration in the capital, they criticize the government's inefficiencies and seem to be promoting a more centralized government.
loc.SEA_generic_events.3.a: They are lucky to have that right
loc.SEA_generic_events.4.desc: A small group of [GetOppositionPartyName] supporters recently disrupted a government meeting with a small but loud protest. Although harmless, the increasing prevalence of similar incidents speaks to the support for opposition movements.
loc.SEA_generic_events.5.desc: The [GetOppositionPartyName] today held one of its largest rallies of recent times, promising to offer a strong alternative to the government of [ROOT.GetLeader]. The government is currently uncertain whether it should simply ignore the rally, or to prevent news of it spreading as it might otherwise attract new supporters to the [GetOppositionPartyAdjective] cause.
loc.SEA_generic_events.5.a: Ensure the news doesn't cover it
loc.SEA_generic_events.6.desc: A scandal involving [ROOT.GetRulingParty]-aligned government officials has come to light after a document was found that outlined their plans to undermine [GetOppositionPartyName] by sabotaging their funding. Although the officials were acting independently, that is not something the [GetOppositionPartySupportersName] will likely believe.
loc.SEA_generic_events.6.b: We will distance ourselves from this scheme
loc.SEA_generic_events.7.desc: The [GetOppositionPartyAdjective] party is holding a rally today, and reports have come in that predict attendance on the same scale as [ROOT.GetRulingParty] rallies. We can only hope that our supporters cannot relate to their concerns.
loc.SEA_generic_events.7.a: Let's organize one of our own based on their concerns
loc.SEA_generic_events.8.desc: The popularity of [GetOppositionPartyName] caused issues today as a group of its supporters clashed with supporters of the government and the [ROOT.GetRulingParty], until the police had to intervene. Although localized, the incident still shows the uneasy political climate.
loc.SEA_generic_events.8.a: We can use this to denounce the [GetOppositionPartyName]
loc.SEA_generic_events.9.desc: After recent reports of unrest, the army and police have both independently concluded that members from the [GetOppositionPartyName] are being influenced by other countries that seek to undermine or spy on our government.
loc.SEA_generic_events.9.a: Publicly denounce the [GetOppositionPartyName] as foreign agents
loc.SEA_generic_events.9.b: Focus on rooting out the infiltrants
loc.SEA_generic_events.10.desc: The rising popularity of opposition movements such as [GetOppositionPartyName] has lead the government to resort to increasingly creative measures to stay in power. One such scheme was recently exposed and the scale of resources being put in keeping the [ROOT.GetRulingParty] in power has caused major backlash.
loc.SEA_generic_events.10.b: Distance ourselves from the involved figures
loc.SEA_generic_events.11.desc: Workers in the naval industry, where support for the [GetOppositionPartyName] is especially strong, have started a major strike that now disrupts our shipbuilding efforts. Although their political concerns can hardly all be alleviated, we could still avoid more unrest by improving their working conditions.
loc.SEA_generic_events.11.a: We will ensure they are compensated fairly
loc.SEA_generic_events.12.desc: Supporters of the [GetOppositionPartyName] and other opposition held a protest today that demands we moderate our military buildup, worried that our growing army will be deployed abroad.
loc.SEA_generic_events.12.desc_wartime: Supporters of the [GetOppositionPartyName] and other opposition parties held a protest today that demands we end our current war, seeing the sacrifice of our army as unnecessary for [ROOT.GetAdjective] interests.
loc.SEA_generic_events.12.a: Assure them it is only to protect the country
loc.SEA_generic_events.12.b: Assure them we wish to achieve peace
loc.SEA_generic_events.13.desc: Before police even had to chance to inform us about it, government officials reported coming across unrest while working in [root.capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName]. It seems what began as a large political demonstration against the [ROOT.GetRulingParty] turned into looting, causing damage across the city.
loc.SEA_generic_events.13.a: Let a respected politician calm the crowd
loc.SEA_generic_events.14.desc: The massive popularity of the [GetOppositionPartyName] without it having much power in government has lead to multiple large protests around the country. Meeting some of the protestors demands may diffuse the situation, but has issues of its own.
loc.SEA_generic_events.14.a: We shall incorporate a few of the [GetOppositionPartyAdjective] proposals
loc.SEA_generic_events.15.desc: We've received news that a local mass protest organized by the [GetOppositionPartyName] turned bloody after objects being thrown at the police caused shots to be fired in response. This incident, although neither the government's nor the [GetOppositionPartySupportersName]'s fault, raises serious concerns about the stability of the country.
loc.SEA_warlords.1.desc: With the passing of Liu Xiang and the ever growing pressure from the Central Government it is becoming increasingly clear that [ROOT.GetNameDef] may soon be dissolved. There are however those who believe that this death is not a coincidence but rather an assassination, and would wish to continue the fight at the risk of angering the Central Government.
loc.SEA_warlords.2.desc: Following the passing of Liu Xiang [FROM.GetNameDef] has been hit with a power struggle leading to the ascension of Yang Sen. Following rumors that Liu Xiang was assassinated by our forces they have adopted a stance distancing themselves from our government and resisting integration.
loc.SEA_warlords.3.desc: Following the passing of Liu Xiang [FROM.GetNameDef] has rapidly dissolved and is now under our authority. We must use this to our advantage.
loc.SEA_warlords.4.desc: With our march against Khotan starting, Yulbars Khan has announced his support for Ma Hushan and called for rebellion against our administration over Hami. With this we now fight on two fronts.
loc.SEA_warlords.4.a: Then we will crush them too!
loc.SEA_warlords.4.b: We must seize this opportunity! Long live the Khan!
loc.SEA_warlords.5.desc: With increasing pressure from the Central Government and lessening morale among our troops, it is becoming clear that we must cease our fruitless fighting and turn towards the greater threats looming over China. The day is lost, Ma Hushan's forces will keep occupying the southern parts of our province.
loc.SEA_warlords.5.a: Then we shall bide our time...
loc.SEA_warlords.6.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has requested our aid in the fight against [SIK.GetLeader]. While losing them would mean we lose our footing in the province, it is also vital that we don't anger the Soviets as it would mean losing a potential partner and guarantor.
loc.SEA_warlords.6.a: Send as little as possible to avoid soviet attention
loc.SEA_warlords.6.b: Soviets be damned, they have our full support
loc.SEA_warlords.7.desc: The Central Government has decided to lend us minimal support in an effort not to anger the Soviet authorities as they value their partnership with the nation over our survival.
loc.SEA_warlords.8.desc: The Central Government has decided to fully stand behind our efforts to ensure the Soviets don't seize our province, and with that risking their own relationship with the state.
loc.SEA_warlords.8.a: With this we can turn the tide!
loc.SEA_warlords.9.desc: The Central Government has decided to not lend us any aid to please the Soviet authorities as they value their partnership with the nation far more than our survival.
loc.SEA_warlords.10.desc: Following the fall of the Kumul Khanate, $KUM_yulbars_khan$ has managed to escape capture and fled to us to continue the fight against our common enemy. We should welcome him with open arms.
loc.SEA_warlords.10.a: We'll put him to work straight away!
loc.SEA_warlords.11.desc: $KUM_yulbars_khan$, a Kuomintang general, has now returned to our side after a failed insurrection against the forces of [SIK.GetLeader], the governor of the Sinkiang province. We should welcome him with open arms.
loc.SEA_warlords.12.desc: Following the fall of Ma Hushan's state, $XSM_ma_hongbin$ fled capture and eventually reached us, where he now resides. We should put his experience and expertise to good use in the many fights to come.
loc.SEA_warlords.13.desc: Following the fall of Ma Hushan's forces $KHM_mahmut_muhiti$, former governor of Kashgar who joined forces with the rebels, has offered to return to serve as a governor and officer for our government once again. It seems he wants a second chance to redeem himself, but with his past actions in mind it may be unwise to trust him.
loc.SEA_warlords.13.b: He shall have his second chance
loc.SEA_warlords.22.desc: With the death of Liu Xiang, leader of [SIC.GetNameDef], it is growing increasingly clear that we must step in and take control directly to not risk losing the territory to someone less favorable to our government. This could however risk further antagonizing the lesser commanders currently striving for power, so we must still tread carefully.
loc.SEA_warlords.23.desc: It seems that [From.GetLeader] has began the fight for China, and in that has rallied the other warlords to come to his side against the central government.
