If we were to join up it would risk surrendering most of our authority to [From.GetNameDef], but refusing may incur their wrath instead.
loc.SEA_warlords.23.a: Better to fight together than alone
loc.SEA_warlords.24.desc: [From.GetLeader] has enthusiastically responded to our offer to band together against the central government and has vowed to aid us in this fight. We are now one step further towards uniting our nation.
loc.SEA_warlords.25.desc: [From.GetLeader] has replied to our offer to band together in the battle for China with a string of insults and curses, claiming that our mission is just another failed attempt at seizing power and subjugating the provinces. It seems we will not have them on our side in this battle.
loc.SEA_warlords.25.a: Then we will have to take them down too!
loc.SEA_warlords.26.desc: Following a series of moves trying to assert dominance within the region and the Ma family, [FROM.GetLeader] has decided that it would be in our best interest to swear fealty to him. [FROM.GetLeader] has also claimed that if we refuse his offer we will be punished and our armies destroyed, but that the choice ultimately is up to us.
loc.SEA_warlords.26.a: We have no choice but to accept
loc.SEA_warlords.27.desc: Fearing that fighting will only lead to more bloodshed and instability in the region, [FROM.GetLeader] decided that it would be best to swear his fealty to us.
loc.SEA_warlords.28.desc: Despite our greatest efforts to avoid any further bloodshed, [FROM.GetLeader] has sent back an insulting letter, claiming that our threats are empty and that the armies of [FROM.GetNameDef] will drive us all the way back to [ROOT.Capital.GetName] if we are to attempt an invasion.
loc.SEA_warlords.28.a: Then we will strike them down
loc.SEA_warlords.29.desc: Following the recent developments in the war, [FROM.GetLeader] has decided that it is no longer worth to fight against us, and that we instead should band together against the greater enemy. With this [FROM.GetLeader] has also proposed a full amnesty for our soldiers and leaders if we are to accept, forgiving them for any potential crime against China in exchange for joining arms.
loc.SEA_warlords.30.desc: Claiming that our offer of peace and amnesty is a mere hoax to destroy [FROM.GetNameDef], [FROM.GetLeader] has refused to cease hostilities and instead launched another offensive this morning. It will take more than a mere letter to end the conflict it seems.
loc.SEA_warlords.31.desc: Following recent provocations along the border, [FROM.GetLeader] has now officially put in a request that we remove our troops from [434.GetName] and hand it over to the [FROM.GetAdjective] authorities. If we refuse, he claims that [FROM.GetName] will answer with military force, and won't stop marching until they reach Delhi.
loc.SEA_warlords.32.desc: Despite our best efforts to convince them, our efforts to diplomatically seize [434.GetName] have been fruitless. Reiterating the McMahon Line, [FROM.GetLeader] has claimed that we have no right to the territory and that our provocation is a mere bluff.
loc.SEA_warlords.33.desc: Following a few intense days, [FROM.GetLeader] has agreed to transfer [434.GetName] and renounce the McMahon Line, claiming that trying to enforce it would only cause more trouble than it's worth. With this our country grows even larger.
loc.tsr_sichuan_border_war.1.desc: Following a swift campaign in [601.GetName], the [SIC.GetAdjective] army under Liu Wenhui has seized large parts of the province and declared the area under their control.
loc.tsr_sichuan_border_war.2.desc: Facing severe difficulties the [SIC.GetAdjective] army has retreated from [601.GetName] and declared an end to their military excursion. The border will remain as it is.
loc.tsr_sichuan_border_war.2.a: At least they didn't take back the rest of Xikang...
loc.chiang_will_be_shot_tt: §RThere will be many that are upset with Chiang Kai-Shek after this...§!
loc.chiang_could_be_shot_tt: §RThere are some that could be upset with Chiang Kai-Shek after this...§!
loc.SEA_warlords.34.desc: Following a series of provocations the two provinces of Guangxi and Guangdong have banded together under the pretense of claiming we are too passive against the Japanese and therefore questioning our rule. They claim that if we do not act they will march against our forces and take Nanjing for themselves. While they have proposed Chiang Kai-Shek goes to Guangzhou to further discuss how to handle the Japanese, it is unclear if this is just a trap.
loc.SEA_warlords.34.a: We shall not fall for their lies!
loc.SEA_warlords.34.b: Send him to Guangzhou to discuss this United Front
loc.SEA_warlords.35.desc: With spirits high and arms raised higher, Chiang Kai-Shek arrived this morning with a small battalion as guards. It does however seem that accepting the offer wasn't a trap and negotiations started immediately. Chen Jitang and Li Zongren have both pushed Chiang to form a united front against the Japanese, even going so far as to cease hostilities with the communists for the time being. If this is the correct choice is hard to tell, but it may very well be.
loc.SEA_warlords.36.desc: Following Nanjing's declaration that they will not back down to any of our threats and our subsequent declaration of opposition, a portion of our army has deserted and the general Yu Hanmou has threatened that if [ROOT.GetLeader] does not resign, he will march on Guangzhou and force it through.
loc.SEA_warlords.36.c: Only together can we fend off this threat!
loc.SEA_warlords.36.tt: §RIf Guangxi Reject our Proposal, we will fall into a civil war immediately!§!
loc.SEA_warlords.37.desc: Following Nanjing's declaration that they will not back down to any of our threats and our subsequent declaration of opposition, there are those who fear that the Central Government will force us to surrender to their rule by military force.
loc.SEA_warlords.38.desc: Fearing that we would destroy their province in the process of driving [GXC.GetLeader], they have instead proposed that they become part of our republic in exchange for all leaders being spared and keeping their positions. This seems like a fair compromise.
loc.SEA_warlords.39.t: The Collapse of the Guangdong Clique
loc.SEA_warlords.39.desc: Following a few intense hours at the brink of civil war, Chen Jitang has agreed to resign and we have moved our troops into Guangdong. What will happen next to the province is now entirely in our hands.
loc.SEA_warlords.40.desc: After Chen Jitang refused to back down despite desertions to our side and Yu Hanmou threatening to march on Guangzhou, the province has collapsed into a full blown civil war with pro Government against anti Government forces. We should step in to fix this chaos.
loc.SEA_warlords.41.desc: Claiming that our threats of invasion are nothing but a fairytale, [GXC.GetLeader] has proclaimed that they will not back down but rather force us to negotiate. If this will succeed is still too early to tell, but we'll just have to wait and see.
loc.SEA_warlords.42.desc: Despite having the capacity to hold for longer, Han Fuju has decided to flee Jinan and leave our flank unguarded. He has already been apprehended by our forces for treason but the question is still what we should do with him. Should we take him and seize his land entirely to show an example, or should we have another general take over in the meantime to avoid any further issue?
loc.SEA_warlords.42.a: Make an example out of him
loc.SEA_warlords.42.b: Let Sun Tongxuan take over for now
loc.may_join_japan_tt: §RThere is a chance he may join Japan§!
loc.SEA_warlords.43.desc: After Han Fuju's cowardly flight from Jinan, there has been a power vacuum in the war torn Shandong province. Choosing not to step in but rather appoint Sun Tongxuan as Provisional Governor, the Central Government has left the choice in our hands as to what to do next.
loc.SEA_warlords.43.b: The Kuomintang has failed, we must join the Japanese!
loc.SEA_warlords.44.desc: We have just received word from [FROM.GetNameDef] that they wish to see our two regions reunited once more into the entity known as Liangguang. This is an idea which is hearkens back to the Qing Dynasty as the Viceroyalty of Liangguang. While we have no more need for such imperial titles, the power and prestige this united entity held at the time was undeniable.
loc.SEA_warlords.44.a: Yes, only through deeper cooperation can we succeed!
loc.SEA_warlords.44.b: We will not cooperate with the King of the South!
loc.SEA_warlords.45.desc: Excellent news! [GXC.GetNameDefCap] have agreed to our proposed unification under the Liangguang banner. Together we form a powerful faction, with plentiful industrial, raw material, and manpower at our disposal! All of China now quakes at our unified strength and will.
loc.SEA_warlords.46.desc: We have heard back from [GXC.GetNameDef], and unfortunately they have decided that their soon to be lost 'sovereignty' is more important that a unified future for us collectively. We must now consider alternative steps, the most likely to bring about this unification through force, for it is only together that we can withstand the powers aligning against us.
loc.SEA_warlords.46.a: It is now victory or death!
loc.SEA_warlords.46.tt: §RThis will likely lead to a war with [CHI.GetNameDef]§!
loc.SEA_warlords.47.desc: Now that unification draws ever closer, we must make the difficult decision as to who should lead this new clique. Both choices are solid, as [ROOT.GetLeader] holds supreme command of the air-forces, while Li Zongren is a master of land combat, and an inspiration figure for the troops. Who will come out on top?
loc.SEA_warlords.47.b: The New Guangxi Clique holds stronger authority!
loc.SEA_warlords.48.desc: It is far easier to bring unity to our nation once more when it's errant factions are small and divided. Unfortunately, the southern provinces have started to unite together, and this bulwark against our strength elicits growing concern. They are able to marshal an alarming amount of resources and manpower against us, should they choose to resist.
loc.SEA_warlords.48.a: We will bring them back under our control!
loc.SEA_warlords.48.b: It would be wise not to provoke them...
loc.SEA_warlords.48.tt: §RIf we cannot defeat them within half a year, we will be forced into a stalemate!§!
loc.SEA_warlords.49.desc: With increasing pressure from our political opponents and lessening morale among our troops, it is becoming clear that we must cease our fruitless fighting and turn towards the greater threats looming in the east. The day is lost, [GDC.GetLeader]'s' forces will keep occupying the southern parts of China for the time being.
loc.SEA_warlords.49.a: Then we shall bide our time...
loc.SEA_warlords.50.desc: A delegation sent from Xi'an has today reached us, wishing to discuss further anti-Japanese measures in the coming months. It seems that [FROM.GetLeader] has established contact with the CPC in the mountains of Shaanxi, and wishes to establish an alliance together with them. To do this, [FROM.GetLeader] wishes for us to use our contacts with [SOV.GetNameDef] to curry favor that can aid in the coming conflict.
loc.SEA_warlords.50.a: Together we will defeat the threat looming in the east
loc.SEA_warlords.51.desc: Earlier this week, our representative Li Kenong met with [FROM.GetLeader] in Luochuan, to discuss anti-Japanese matters and the question of Soviet aid in the struggle against the invaders. At the end of the meeting, they agreed to resist Japan, though they did not agree to negotiate with Chiang Kai-shek. Zhang however, holding a grudge against the Japanese for killing his father, has stated that he will do everything he can, even if it kills him, to convince the generalissimo to join the CPC against the Japanese.
loc.SEA_warlords.51.a: Perhaps we have found ourselves another ally
loc.SEA_warlords.52.t: [FROM.GetLeader] Wishes to Halt the Encirclement Campaign
loc.SEA_warlords.52.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] is currently tasked with suppression of so called bandits within our area on the orders of [CHI.GetLeader]. This of course includes us, but [FROM.GetLeader] has reached out to us and is wondering if we could cease hostilities for the time being as he prepares to establish a United Front between us and the KMT. Do we accept this proposition?
loc.SEA_warlords.52.a: We will gladly take this respite
loc.SEA_warlords.52.b: We have other plans in mind for [FROM.GetNameDef]
loc.SEA_warlords.53.t: [FROM.GetLeader] Smuggling Funds and Equipment for the Cause
loc.SEA_warlords.53.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has started smuggling weapons and funds provided to his armies by the central government in Nanjing and is delivering it to our revolutionary base area through various means, in an effort to increase our mutual trust and strengthen us as we are sworn enemies of the [JAP.GetAdjective].
loc.SEA_warlords.53.a: We will make good use of it
loc.SEA_warlords.54.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has withdrawn troops garrisoned in the city of Yan'an in an effort not only to strengthen us, but to attract the attention of the central government. By doing this, [CHI.GetLeader] will likely head north to punish the suppression troops and attempt to relocate them southeast, while reprimanding rebellious local governments like [FROM.GetLeader] and [SHX.GetLeader]. While he is in Xi'an however, [FROM.GetLeader] plans to take a drastic approach to convince [CHI.GetLeader] to establish a United Front against Japan.
loc.SEA_warlords.55.desc: With increasing pressure from the Central Government to produce results to no avail and lessening morale among our troops, it is becoming clear that we must cease our fruitless fighting and turn towards the greater threats looming over China. The day is lost, [PRC.GetNameDef] stands strong in the face of adversity, and their forces will keep occupying the northern parts of our province for the time being.
loc.SEA_warlords.55.a: Then we shall bide our time...
loc.SEA_warlords.55.tt: We will now be able to take the focus §Y$XIC_request_relocation_to_northeastern_command$§!
loc.SEA_warlords.56.desc: The young marshal [FROM.GetLeader] has requested to be transferred to the northeastern garrison in [608.GetName], in order to be closer to the Japanese threat and to act as a bastion against their aggression. Being the former leader of the Fengtian Clique, it seems he wishes to take a proactive move to reclaim his lost homeland. What say we?
loc.SEA_warlords.56.a: A proactive approach to defense? Splendid!
loc.SEA_warlords.56.b: We cannot trust him with that post
loc.SEA_warlords.57.desc: The complacent traitor [FROM.GetLeader] has rejected our request to set up an advance-post position against the Japanese, clearly not having China's best future in mind.
loc.SEA_warlords.58.desc: A joint demand has come from [XIC.GetNameDef] and [FROM.GetNameDef] to submit to their new plan of handing [608.GetName] and the surrounding territories over to the Young Marshal to use as a new forward base of operations against the Japanese. It seems they intend to end our autonomy, one way or another...
loc.SEA_warlords.58.a: Very well, our duty is done
loc.SEA_warlords.58.b: They will have to take [608.GetName] by force!
loc.SEA_warlords.59.desc: Finally, the time has come to reclaim the lost territories of the Fengtian Clique. [608.GetName] is now under our command, and our duty of suppressing the bandits in Shaanxi has come to a formal end. Soon, all of the lost homeland will be back under our control!
loc.SEA_warlords.59.a: We are one step closer to restoring our honor!
loc.SEA_warlords.60.desc: Multiple generals and soldiers once loyal to the old marshal Zhang Zuolin who the Kwantung Army killed years ago are now heeding the call of his son, [FROM.GetLeader], and are defecting to [FROM.GetNameDef]. This is a disaster!
loc.SEA_warlords.61.desc: Following our kidnapping of [CHI.GetLeader] and forceful persuasion to put a pause to the encirclement campaigns to focus on the bigger threat against the Chinese people, we have received arrest warrants and threats from the central government, in which [ROOT.GetLeader] and his closest men are to be held accountable, and the Northwest Bandit Suppression Headquarters are to be dissolved entirely. Should we accept this fate, or continue fighting another day?
loc.SEA_warlords.61.a: At least we got the alliance we asked for...
loc.SEA_warlords.61.b: No, we need to remain autonomous to further [ROOT.GetLeader]'s ultimate goal!
loc.SEA_warlords.62.t: Dissolution of the Northwest Bandit Suppression Headquarters
loc.SEA_warlords.62.desc: Following the kidnapping of [ROOT.GetLeader] and forceful persuasion into forming a second United Front, our government officials have issued arrest warrants and threats to [FROM.GetLeader] and his men, and have begun moving troops to end the autonomous mission of the Northwest Bandit Suppression Headquarters. It is time these traitors get what they deserve.
loc.SEA_warlords.62.a: They failed their mission, rein them in
loc.SEA_warlords.63.t: Additional [SOV.GetAdjective] Supplies Arrive Through Irkeshtam Pass
loc.SEA_warlords.63.desc: Earlier this week, additional [SOV.GetAdjective] weapons and supplies arrived to our troops around Kashgar through the Irkeshtam Pass to its west. Commissioned by Alexander Barmine, the [SOV.GetAdjective] official responsible for supplying arms to our government, it seems that [SOV.GetNameDef] have specific plans in mind for deepening our cooperation further.
loc.SEA_warlords.63.a: We thank our Comrades for their generosity
loc.SEA_warlords.64.desc: $KHM_ma_hushan$, the disgraced commander of the 36th Kuomintang division and Padishah of [KHM.GetNameDef] has arrived in [441.GetName] after deserting his troops, bringing with him 1000 ounces in gold that he and his men pilfered from the former state's capital. This smells of opportunity...
loc.SEA_warlords.65.desc: [FROM.GetLeader], our loyal subject currently in control of [FROM.GetNameDef] after a military coup in the province backed by the NKVD has expressed a wish to unify the province with Kirghistan, in order to develop the regions better and unify the scattered people under the same banner. What say we?
loc.SEA_warlords.65.a: As long as he stays loyal
loc.SEA_warlords.65.b: We will not compromise on our borders!
loc.SEA_warlords.66.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has agreed to our request and the Pamir region is being transferred to us as this message is received. From now on, the state will be governed by us, autonomously from direct [FROM.GetAdjective] rule.
loc.SEA_warlords.67.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has refused our request for the transfer of land. This was to be expected from them, but it will surely harm our relations in the long term.
loc.SEA_warlords.67.a: We will gain it back one day...
loc.SEA_warlords.68.desc: Feng Yuxiang and his soldiers once loyal to the Guominjun, an organization that once rebelled against us and rejoined after we crushed them, are now defecting to [FROM.GetNameDef] as [FROM.GetLeader] has declared the revival of the military organization.
loc.SEA_warlords.68.a: The Guominjun's specter still haunts us...
loc.SEA_warlords.69.t: Dissolution of the Hebei-Chahar Political Council
loc.SEA_warlords.69.desc: Having fallen to enemy forces, the Hebei-Chahar Political Council which acted as a local autonomy to honor the demands for regional demilitarization made by Japan as part of the He-Umezu agreement no longer serves any real purpose. Perhaps it may be time to reign their leadership in, and bring their forces under the command of the central government.
loc.SEA_warlords.69.b: They may still be of use to us
loc.SEA_warlords.70.t: The Legacy of the Pingnan Guo
loc.SEA_warlords.70.desc: Having now achieved what was sought after by our people during the Panthay and Dungan Rebellions, ousting all remnants of Qing and Kuomintang rule from China, many have come to question the nature by which we rule the land. Should we take up the mantle of Du Wenxiu and bring forth our new golden era, or take the safer route and follow in the footsteps of Yuan Shikai?
loc.SEA_warlords.70.a: The time has come at long last for a new type of government!
loc.SEA_warlords.70.b: We will be an empire once more!
loc.SEA_warlords.70.c: Long Live the Great Ma Dynasty!
loc.SEA_warlords.71.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has requested our aid in the fight against [SIK.GetLeader]. While losing them would mean we lose our family's footing in the province, it is also vital that we don't let the communists to our east seize the opportunity when our troops are off fighting elsewhere.
loc.SEA_warlords.71.a: We shall aid them in their fight against communism!
loc.SEA_warlords.71.b: We already have enough problem to deal with
loc.SEA_warlords.72.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef] has decided to fully stand behind our efforts to ensure the Soviets don't seize our province, and with that risking their own relationship with the state.
loc.SEA_warlords.72.a: With this we can turn the tide!
loc.SEA_warlords.73.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef] has decided to not lend us any aid to please the Soviet authorities as they value their partnership with the nation far more than our survival.
loc.SEA_warlords.74.t: The Fall of the Khotan Ma Clique
loc.SEA_warlords.74.desc: Following a coup d'etat against Ma Hushan, many of our family members have begun flooding across the border to join up with us to retake their now lost clique in due time.
loc.SEA_warlords.75.t: [FROM.GetLeader] Wishes to Begin the Suiyuan Campaign
loc.SEA_warlords.75.desc: The Inner Mongolian Army and Grand Han Righteous Army stand ready to launch an operation into the territories of warlord [SHX.GetLeader], provided they get our air support and supervision by Japanese staff officers. Perhaps we can secure more of Inner Mongolia without proving a larger-scale war in China.
loc.SEA_warlords.100.desc: An urgent report has come from [XIC.GetNameDef] stating that [XIC.GetLeader] has withdrawn his troops from [1032.GetName], letting [PRC.GetNameDef] forces pour into the region and claiming it as their own. The entire purpose of [XIC.GetName] was to keep [PRC.GetName] in check and to eradicate them - not help them.
loc.SIC_can_lead_to_war_with_china_tt: §RThis may lead to further conflict with the Central Government!§!
loc.SIK_locks_good_focus_tt: §RWe have not been able to achieve a United Sinkiang CLique§!
loc.SIK_failed_campaign_tt: [SIK.GetLeader] has failed in driving the Kuomintang out of the province
loc.TSR_recieve_pp_warlord: We will receive 100 political power once they uphold their end of the deal
loc.TSR_recieve_manpower_warlord: We will receive 5000 manpower once they uphold their end of the deal
loc.TSR_recieve_equipment_warlord: We will receive 1000 infantry equipment once they uphold their end of the deal
loc.tsr_manchukuo.1.desc: The position of the Emperor has always been a bit of a thorn in the side of Manchuria's position as an empire. With the nation functionally acting as a republic under the rule of prime minister Zhang Jinghui and the Kwantung Army the Emperor is very weak, barely functioning as a figurehead. This could all be changed though, as some Kwantung Army officers are of the belief that for the nation to prosper, the throne must be firmly in the hands of the Emperor. But there are also those who see Puyi as weak and unreliable, and would much rather the throne fell in the hands of his Japanese-educated brother, Pujie.
loc.tsr_manchukuo.1.a: We should keep the status quo
loc.tsr_manchukuo.1.c: The emperor can't be trusted, Pujie is the right choice
loc.tsr_manchukuo.2.desc: This Evening, [FROM.GetLeader] came with a quite interesting proposal: That we hand over the administration of the Kwantung Leased Territory surrounding the port city of Dalian while we get to keep our operations active as before. He stated that as our two nations already are inseparable it would only be logical to reunite Dalian with the rest of Manchuria, while also relieving us from some administrative costs.
loc.tsr_manchukuo.2.b: We'd never hand over our territory like that!
loc.tsr_manchukuo.3.desc: Having agreed with our argument that it would only be logical to reunite the Kwantung Leased Territory with the rest of the Manchurian nation, the Japanese authorities have agreed to transfer the territory.
loc.tsr_manchukuo.4.desc: Not being persuaded by our arguments, they instead Japanese laughed off our serious request to transfer the port of Dalian. Claiming that it was "utterly ridiculous" they suggested that we should reconsider how important our role in the sphere actually is.
loc.tsr_manchukuo.5.desc: Following the shocking events in Manchuria, a group of communists known as the Inner Mongolian People's Revolutionary Party have decided to try and ride the wave and coup the Mengjiang Government. While they weren't successful in initially seizing the entire country, they may soon be considering the rapid unraveling of Japanese control in the area.
loc.tsr_manchukuo.6.desc: Following the victory in their war against the Japanese, the local CPC branch in Manchuria has proposed that we band together in the battle for dominance over China. If this is just an attempt at seizing power is yet to show, but it could be a golden opportunity.
loc.tsr_manchukuo.6.a: Of course we will support our brothers in the north!
loc.tsr_manchukuo.7.desc: Following the victory in the war against the Chinese Government and the proclamation of the People’s Republic of China, [MAN.GetLeader] has called for all us other CPC branches to integrate into this new republic with promises of high positions within the Government. If we refuse, he claims that we will be seen as traitors to the revolution and meet the full military force of the People’s Liberation Army.
loc.tsr_manchukuo.8.desc: Not amused by our posturing, [FROM.GetLeader] replied that our generous offer was just another attempt to subjugate the rest, and that they would take no part in this farce. They have therefore left us no choice but to invade and take what's rightfully ours.
loc.tsr_manchukuo.9.desc: Following the rapid advancements in the situation in China, [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef], standing as the representative for all of China, has proposed that we aid in the transfer of territories once owned by them in exchange for an ally in the region. While the more conservative estimates of territorial transfer only consist of Mongolia and Tuva, both lost during the revolution, some are even pushing for the return of outer Manchuria as many officials in the party have personal connections to the region.
loc.tsr_manchukuo.9.c: Mongolia is ours, but let them have Manchuria
loc.tsr_manchukuo.10.desc: After discussions between [MAN.GetNameDef] and [SOV.GetNameDef], to which we were not invited, they have agreed to transfer our territory to [MAN.GetNameDef]. If we are to not accept this we will face severe consequences from both sides.
loc.MAN_will_support_japan_tt: §Y$MAN_urzhin_garmaev$§! and §Y$MAN_jonjurjab$§! will fall into favour with the Japanese again and will not join our side in case of a war breaking out between us and [JAP.GetFlag] §YJapan.§!
loc.tsr_manchukuo.11.desc: Following the Execution of Lingsheng, Governor of Xing'an province and Pan-Mongol politician at the hands of the Kwantung Army, there has been a wave of unrest in the country. The Xing'an Army as well as Mongol and Buryat Generals such as $MAN_urzhin_garmaev$ and $MAN_jonjurjab$ have threatened to resign if this isn't handled, but at the same time appeasement may come at the risk of angering Japan.
loc.tsr_manchukuo.11.b: Let them resign if they want to
loc.tsr_manchukuo.11.c: Get the Kwantung Army to apologize
loc.tsr_manchukuo.12.desc: Reports have come in that Inner Mongolian People's Revolutionary Party led by Serengdongrub have, together with Manchurian bandits, infiltrated several important locations in the north and are now waiting for their time to strike. We do yet not know when this will happen but we fear it will come soon.
loc.tsr_manchukuo.12.b: We'll just have to watch the situation unfold.
loc.tsr_manchukuo.13.desc: With the rapid industrial advancement Manchuria has been experiencing, [MAN.GetLeader] has had his eyes on $JAP_naoki_hoshino$ as a possible cabinet member for quite some time. He has therefore now requested that he be transferred to [MAN.GetNameDef] in order to serve as the director of the General Affairs Board.
loc.tsr_manchukuo.14.desc: After multiple discussions with the Japanese, the transfer of $JAP_naoki_hoshino$ to our cabinet has finally been agreed upon. He will serve us well in helping our economy grow as the director of the General Affairs Board.
loc.tsr_manchukuo.15.desc: Not being persuaded by our arguments, the Japanese have decided that it's be better for $JAP_naoki_hoshino$ to stay at home in Japan rather than have a cabinet position in Manchuria. While this is disappointing, we will find a way forward nonetheless.
loc.tsr_manchukuo.16.desc: Following the proclamation of the National Cooperation Government, [FROM.GetLeader] has requested we merge our Chinese possessions not under [RNG.GetLeader], but under his rule. While it may not be exactly what we planned it would most likely be more efficient to rule through one puppet state rather than several in this instance.
loc.tsr_manchukuo.17.desc: Following discussions with [FROM.GetNameDef] it has been agreed that the best course of action would be to unite the Chinese administration under us. We look forward to further cooperation with them.
loc.tsr_manchukuo.18.desc: Despite our best efforts to convince them, the [FROM.GetAdjective] government has decided that it would not be in their best interests to unite the Chinese administrations under us. For now we will stay divided.
loc.tsr_manchukuo.19.desc: Despite our best efforts to convince them, the soviets have decided that we are not worthy of any of the territory they occupy. This comes as a great hit to our relationship.
loc.tsr_manchukuo.20.t: The Soviets Transfer Mongolia and Tuva
loc.tsr_manchukuo.20.desc: Deciding against the transfer of Outer Manchuria, deeming it way too Russian, the Soviets have at least agreed to transferring Mongolia and Tuva since our claim is much more recent to those territories.
loc.tsr_manchukuo.21.desc: In an odd turn of events the Soviets have decided to hand over Outer Manchuria, claiming we have a much more personal link to the territory while keeping Mongolia as a buffer state.
loc.tsr_manchukuo.22.t: The Soviets Give in to All Our Demands
loc.tsr_manchukuo.22.desc: The Soviets have thankfully been gracious enough to accept all our territorial demands, adding not only Mongolia and Tuva but also Outer Manchuria to our realm. Only good things can come from this.
loc.tsr_manchukuo_news.1.desc: Following a period of increasing violence and combat between the Japanese administrators and various bandit factions, one such bandit by the name of [MAN.GetLeader] managed to seize Hsinking and in turn convinced the Emperor to join his side. \n\nWith the Emperor siding with the rebels the army soon followed suit and now Manchuria stands at a crossroad, will the Japanese be driven out or will the rebellion be crushed as quickly as it came?
loc.tsr_manchukuo_news.1.c: How did it come to this?
loc.tsr_manchukuo_border_war.1.desc: Following a swift campaign in [1039.GetName], the [MAN.GetAdjective] army has seized Kalgan and declared the area under their control.
loc.tsr_manchukuo_border_war.2.desc: Facing severe difficulties the [MAN.GetAdjective] army has retreated from the city of Kalgan, this may not be the end of the conflict but for now Kalgan will remain [CHI.GetAdjective].
loc.tsr_manchukuo_border_war.3.desc: Following the [MAN.GetAdjective] army's triumphant march into Beijing, the [CHI.GetAdjective] army has retreated south to a more defensible position.
loc.tsr_manchukuo_border_war.3.b: They leave us no choice, withdraw!
loc.tsr_manchukuo_border_war.4.desc: Failing to capture the city, the [MAN.GetAdjective] army has withdrawn from Beijing, how long this temporary peace will last is however still uncertain.
loc.tsr_manchukuo_border_war.4.b: Beijing will not fall so easily!
loc.tsr_manchukuo_border_war.5.desc: Following the complete capture of Hebei an armistice has been reached with an agreement that the [MAN.GetAdjective] army not march any further into Chinese land unless provoked.
loc.tsr_manchukuo_border_war.6.desc: While Beijing has fallen to the [MAN.GetAdjective] army, their forces were stopped from advancing further into Hebei Province.
loc.JAP_emperor_tooltip: [GetImperialInfluenceRulerTitle] [GetImperialInfluenceRulerName]. \n\nThe various §YFactions§! vying for power over the [GetImperialInfluenceRulerTitle] can go between §R$JAP_imperial_influence_tier_1$§!, §R$JAP_imperial_influence_tier_2$§!, §R$JAP_imperial_influence_tier_3$§! and §R$JAP_imperial_influence_tier_4$§!.
loc.JAP_imperial_influence_interference_rese: Days until $JAP_imperial_influence_ruler_name_text$ can interfere with $JAP_imperial_influence_faction_names_text$ again: [?JAP_interfered_in_imperial_influence_flag:days_left|Y0]
loc.JAP_sea_purge_the_kodoha_faction_desc: The Kōdōha squandered their opportunity to seize power, and it will cost them dearly. For their treachery towards his imperial majesty, we will strip them of their ranks, and try them for treason. The time has finally come for the Tōseiha to take control within the Imperial Army!
loc.JAP_sea_purge_the_kodoha_faction_tt: §YSadao Araki§! and §YShigeru Honjō§! will be retired from active service
loc.JAP_east_asian_cooperative_society_desc: The recently developed East Asian Cooperative Society theory advocates the construction of a cooperative society in East Asia that would transcend ethnic and national boundaries. We should build upon this idea to strengthen our position as the guardian of the Pacific, and the leader of the East Asian peoples.
loc.JAP_east_asian_cooperative_society_tt: Unlocks decisions to befriend and invest in the natural resources of §YAsian Nations§!
loc.JAP_imperial_headquarters_liasion_confer: With the reestablishment of the Imperial General Headquarters for the first time since the Russo-Japanese War, it is high time we hold a conference between the leaders of the various factions to promote cooperation and exchanging of information between the military and the government.
loc.JAP_promulgate_the_military_ministers_sy: The brief period since the attempted coup d'etat by the Kōdōha faction has been anything but stable. With the military growing upset at the government, something needs to be done to placate them. To that end, Kōki Hirota has proposed making the minister of war a position that can only be given to an actively serving officer, as has been the case a few times throughout our history.
This move is §RUnpopular§! among the members of the §YCivilian Government§!, and is sure to cause friction between the factions in due time
loc.JAP_reprimand_hamada_kunimatsu_desc: In his speech criticizing the military in the Diet, Hamada Kunimatsu went way too far. In order to keep the military from completely outmaneuvering the civilian government politically, we need to properly reprimand him, and show that we still have some fight left in us.
loc.JAP_the_harakiri_debate_desc: Following the disgraceful act of defiance Hamada Kunimatsu showed against the military, Hisaichi Terauchi has demanded the resignation of the cabinet and the inauguration of a new prime minister, if the old one has even a shred of honor left within him. Through a bit of careful maneuvering, Senjūrō Hayashi can be installed as a puppet of the military.
loc.JAP_konoes_first_cabinet_desc: Senjūrō Hayashi is only intended as a short-term interregnum prime minister. Prince Fumimaro Konoe, apolitical and educated by the Genrō Saionji Kinmochi, he is the perfect candidate for stabilizing the chaotic political situation and uniting the nation in spirit. It is time that he formed a cabinet of his own, being personally nominated to Emperor Hirohito by Saionji himself.
loc.JAP_new_order_in_east_asia: The New Order in East Asia
loc.JAP_new_order_in_east_asia_desc: In recent statements by [ROOT.GetLeader], it has become ever more clear that he intends to establish a new order in East Asia, one which has six main goals. They include permanent stability of Eastern Asia, neighborly amity and international justice, joint defense against communism, the creation of a new culture, economic cohesion and co-operation and finally world peace.
loc.JAP_new_order_in_east_asia_tt: Taking the focus $JAP_sea_greater_east_asian_co_properity_sphere$ will transform this faction
loc.JAP_reiterate_the_three_principles_of_hi: Reiterate the Three Principles of Hirota

Through the government's careful maneuvering, Hirota managed to get his successor Kazushige Ugaki to become the new prime minister. It is time to officially ratify the three statements of Hirota, namely the establishment of a Japan–China–Manchukuo bloc, the organization of a Sino-Japanese common front against the spread of communism, and the suppression of anti-Japanese activities within China.
loc.JAP_formalize_japan_china_manchukuo_alli: With [CHI.GetLeader]'s government having accepted our demands for cracking down on communist and anti-Japanese activities, it now seems probable that they would be willing to temporarily form an alliance with us to deal with the festering sore deep down in the bosom of Eastern Asia known as warlordism and communism, that threatens all of Asia with a sure and inescapable death.
loc.JAP_sea_national_spiritual_mobliization_: "Luxury is our Enemy!" With thrift, hygiene and hard work elevated to national virtues, more manpower is made available to the war effort and the will of the heavenly emperor is properly conveyed to all of our imperial subjects.
loc.JAP_hokushin_ron_desc: The faction within our army that refers to themselves as the Strike North Group advocate expansion into Siberia and Mongolia as a means of gaining the natural resources and economical value we require to continue our imperial ambitions. We should support this notion, and begin preparing our forces to undertake such a doctrine should the time prove right.
loc.JAP_strenghten_manchukuo_imperial_army_d: The Manchukuo Imperial Army stands as a vanguard against the forces of [SOV.GetNameDef], and are the ones who will hold the frontier should war break out. We must aid in the enlarging of these forces, so that they can hopefully stand up against the [SOV.GetAdjective] juggernaut.
loc.JAP_strenghten_manchukuo_imperial_airfor: Strengthen the Manchu Imperial Air Force

The Manchukuo Imperial Air Force has only recently been established, and its officers have much to learn. We should send officers over to train them, as well as deliver them Nakajima Army Type 91 fighters and Kawasaki Type 88 light bombers to bolster their forces.
loc.JAP_ensure_temporary_peace_with_china_de: In order to focus our attention towards [SOV.GetNameDef], we must make sure that the treacherous [CHI.GetAdjective] do not stab us in the back while our forces are engaged in combat elsewhere. We should also make sure that the Kwantung Army can't act out of line in the meantime, so that they do not start a war we cannot win.
loc.JAP_a_mongol_volunteer_army_desc: The Manchurian army has a Mongolian Independence Army within it comprised of Mongolians and bandits, led by [ROOT.GetAdjective] advisors. We should establish a similar army completely under our own control, with the goal of eventually sending them to [MON.GetNameDef] and liberating their homeland from hostile forces.
loc.JAP_a_mongol_volunteer_army_tt: If §Y[MAN.GetName]§! or §Y[MEN.GetName]§! are our allies, they will also gain this spirit
loc.JAP_a_mongol_volunteer_army_1_tt: Unlocks decisions to §YDestabilize Mongolia§! with the goal of swaying them to our side and performing a coup d'etat against the government
loc.JAP_utilize_ainu_expertise_desc: The Ainu native to Northern Japan are experts when it comes to navigating the snow and harsh terrain of Hokkaido. Perhaps we could learn from their techniques to make our invasion into Siberia swifter?
loc.JAP_kantokuen_desc: In order to capitalize on world developments, the Kwantung Army has been preparing Special Maneuvers, in preparation for an invasion and the occupation of the Russian Far East. In order for the attack to go swiftly, we should invest in these final preparations before we take action.
loc.JAP_a_green_persimmon_desc: Our forces are not yet fully prepared for war with [SOV.GetNameDef], and their attention has not been sufficiently diverted towards their west. Despite all of this, we must attack now, or the chance may ever elude us...
loc.JAP_the_persimmon_has_ripened_desc: The fruits of victory are rapidly ripening, and our army stands fully prepared to intervene and capture Siberia from the collapsing [SOV.GetAdjective] Empire. The war will be swift, and our victories glorious. Tennoheika Banzai!
loc.JAP_peace_out_soviets_dec_tt: Unlocks a decision to sign a §YSeparate Peace§! with §Y[SOV.GetNameDef]§! to gain §YSiberia§! from them if we control it
loc.JAP_sea_establish_the_northern_resource_: Now that we have successfully occupied the north, the rich Siberian wastes must be exploited for our ever-growing war machine. As such, we should establish new mines and planned cities in vital locations, so that we can extract all that we possibly can.
loc.JAP_nanshin_ron_desc: Though rich, China and Siberia do not possess all the resources we require. Not far away to the south, though, lie the Philippines, the Dutch East Indies and the British colonies of Malaya and Borneo. For true self-sufficiency we must wrest control over these areas away from the European imperialists.
loc.JAP_soviet_japanese_neutrality_pact_desc: Our northern border must be secured if we are to have the freedom to strike south. We shall begin negotiations with [SOV.GetNameDef] immediately in order to ensure their neutrality, while also negotiating further resource rights to North Sakhalin.
loc.JAP_soviet_japanese_neutrality_pact_tt: If the §Y[SOV.GetAdjective]s§! accept the pact, more [ROOT.GetAdjective] Industrialists will find it in good interest to invest into our concessions in §Y[655.GetName]§!
loc.JAP_unsinkable_aircraft_carriers_desc: The South Seas territories serve as perfect bases for the operation of our aircraft in the fight for the Pacific. We should reinforce these islands, and fortify these locations so that we can hold them, lest they 'sink' like regular carriers.
loc.JAP_isolate_oceania_desc: Our high command has deemed it unfeasible to land in and occupy [AST.GetNameDef] and [NZL.GetNameDef], and have proposed a better solution to the issue of these hostile nations. We should occupy the less defended islands around these states, and cut them off from their allies, in order to slowly starve them of the will to fight us.
loc.JAP_battle_for_australia_desc: Now that [AST.GetNameDef] has been isolated, it is time to begin fighting for the skies over the continent. If we can succeed in controlling their skies, then maybe occupying Oceania may not be so unreasonable after all.
loc.JAP_operation_take_australia_desc: The time has finally come. High command has authorized the operation to land in Australia, code-named Operation AN. We will strike down our foes, and take control of the underbelly of Asia!
loc.JAP_sea_exploit_southern_resource_area_d: Now that we have brought the south under our heel, we must greatly expand the exploitation of the South East Asian and East Indies' abundant resources to nourish our forces in our war.
loc.JAP_demand_tonkinese_bases_desc: The region of Tonkin is not only rich in resources, but also a vital stepping stone for our further expansion southward. Being on the border with China, it may also serve as an important base of operations for our air force to strike into Canton.
loc.JAP_occupy_indochina_desc: The people of Indochina are currently being oppressed by colonialist and imperialist regimes that care very little for their well-being. We must step in and take control of this region, to protect its people, and gain control of the area's natural resources in the process.
loc.JAP_occupy_siam_desc: Siam, while being a potential ally of ours, may serve as a weak underbelly that our opponents will be sure to exploit. We should therefore step in and occupy them directly, so that they never get any chances to collude with our enemies.
loc.JAP_sea_pressure_siam_desc: Siam is located in a prime location to aid us in our coming war with the Western powers. By getting them on our side we will greatly facilitate the inevitable invasion of Malaya and, thereby, the East Indies. We must therefore make it abundantly clear to them, that if they are not with us, they are against us.
loc.JAP_strike_the_southern_road_desc: The time has come to set our plan in motion. We will strike south and take the resource-rich Western colonies for ourselves. With this swift and decisive strike, we should be able to reduce the enemies' ability to fight before it has even properly started. Tennoheika Banzai!
loc.JAP_occupy_east_timor_desc: The Timorese, though not currently belligerent in our war, still need to be brought under our wings for the sake of the future of Asia. Our troops stand ready on the islands, and we are prepared to move in swiftly without any declaration of war, hoping it will go unnoticed.
loc.JAP_occupy_east_timor_tt: §RThis may lead to war with the owner of [721.GetName]!§!
loc.JAP_revisit_the_thirteen_demands_desc: During the Great War, our government made a series of demands to the Republic of China for gaining control of their railways and more. Though initially included, things such as a decisive voice in their finance, policing, and government affairs were rejected, and eventually it ended up being signed with only thirteen demands remaining. We should return to these ideas, and assert ourselves as the rulers of East Asia.
loc.JAP_invest_in_senbu_desc: Our Senbu organizations, often taking the form of schools, medical teams and food distribution centers, make up a type of psychological warfare operations intended to pacify local populations in occupied territories. They have so far proved efficient in pacifying Manchuria, and perhaps we should expand their operations to include the rest of China.
loc.JAP_establish_mongol_military_government: Prince De, a descendant of the Great Genghis Khan, holds a powerful position within the Pailingmiao Council, the Kuomintang's puppet leadership in Inner Mongolia. He wishes to restore the Mongols to their former glory, and would be more than willing to side with us in forming a Mongol Military Government if we promise to fulfill his ambitions.
loc.JAP_launch_the_suiyuan_campaign_desc: The Inner Mongolian Army and Grand Han Righteous Army stand ready to launch an operation into the territories of warlord [SHX.GetLeader], provided they get our air support and supervision by Japanese staff officers. Perhaps we can secure more of Inner Mongolia without proving a larger-scale war in China.
loc.JAP_launch_the_suiyuan_campaign_tt: With our support, the §YInner Mongolian Army§! and §YGrand Han Righteous Army§! will launch an offensive to seize §Y[621.GetName]§! from Kuomintang forces, but will only have a narrow window before the operation will need to be called off
loc.JAP_reorganize_the_united_autonomous_gov: The Mongol Military Government currently has only a rudimentary political organization, and will not hold together for long without our intervention. We must reorganize them into the Mongol United Autonomous Government, so that they can properly establish themselves as a sovereign nation.
loc.JAP_mengjiang_united_autonomous_governme: In order to legitimize Prince De's claim to all of Inner Mongolia, we should further reorganize the state's government into the Mengjiang United Autonomous Government so that they can once and for all untie the Mongol people within the Chinese borders under one banner.
loc.JAP_mongol_autonomous_state_desc: [MON.GetNameDefCap] claims to be the true Mongolian government, a notion which Prince De vehemently opposes. We should further reorganize and rename his realm, so that he may lay a more legitimate claim to all Mongol lands.
loc.JAP_reinforce_the_beijing_garrison_desc: The East Hebei Autonomous Government was established after we conquered the Great Wall of China, with their East Hebei Army existing to enforce the demilitarization of the [CHI.GetAdjective] side of the region. We should proactively reinforce this unit and the Kwantung garrisons in the area, so that it can't fall to [CHI.GetAdjective] aggression.
loc.JAP_develop_the_chinese_resources_desc: With large swathes of Chinese land having been brought under our boot, we must now develop the rich Chinese resources so that they may be useful for the next war.
loc.JAP_form_the_jikyoku_iinkai_desc: In order to better control our imports and exports going to and from [USA.GetNameDef], as well as attempt to convince the [USA.GetAdjective] people to side with us over [CHI.GetNameDef], we should establish the Japanese Committee on Trade and Information.
loc.japanese_committee_on_trade_and_informat: The Japanese Committee on Trade and Information
loc.JAP_strategic_offensives_desc: [CHI.GetNameDefCap] is proving a very tough nut to crack, and our high command has called for more coordinated offensives, targeting different points of interest. With the Gekokujo on the ground thwarting our higher interests, we must first curtail them, so that we can finally get these operations rolling.
loc.JAP_strategic_offensives_tt: Unlocks decisions to §YLaunch Offensives§! that give temporary bonuses in §YChinese States§!
loc.JAP_intensify_anti_guerilla_operations_d: Guerillas and infiltrators are hindering the progress and success of our military campaigns in China, as striking us where it hurts most. We must prepare to make a coordinated strike against these bandits, and remove their cells from our territories, one way or another!
loc.JAP_intensify_anti_guerilla_operations_t: Halves the cost of taking §Y$PRC_root_out_guerilla_fighters$§! decisions, and allows for temporarily reduced resistance in states where Guerrillas has been rooted out
loc.JAP_reorganized_national_government_desc: It has come to our attention that the many local government established by our army, as well as the direct occupation of the Chinese countryside is costing us dearly. We must unite these governments, and establish the Reorganized National Government.
loc.JAP_occupy_macau_desc: Macau is a dangerous city to leave outside of our control if we are to continue our fight against the colonialists in the west. It may serve as a staging point to cut off our armies and supply the enemy through both air and sea. We must therefore step in and occupy it immediately, before it can become our unexpected downfall.
loc.JAP_an_expedition_to_tibet_desc: In order to get a better grasp on if we are going to be able to convince the [TIB.GetAdjective] government to take our side in the greater conflict for Asia, we should begin an intelligence mission to establish contact with them. Due to their strict rules regarding who can enter however, we will have to send Jinzō Nomoto disguised as a Mongolian and accompanying a Tibetan monk.
loc.JAP_an_expedition_to_tibet_tt: Unlocks decisions to §YInfluence Tibet§! with the goal of turning them into a §YJapanese Subject§!
loc.JAP_ally_the_dragon_king_desc: The Dragon King of Bhutan rules over his solitary and isolationist Tibetan kingdom, but perhaps he can see the greater picture. We should attempt to send an official delegation to Punakha, to convince him to join us in the liberation of Asia.
loc.JAP_claim_the_raven_crown_desc: Our Heavenly Emperor stands above all other, and those who do not see it this way must be crushed. We should invade [BHU.GetNameDef] and claim their throne for ourselves.
loc.JAP_ally_the_gorkhas_desc: The King of Nepal rules over his kingdom in the tallest mountain chain in the world, being largely cut off from foreign contact. Perhaps he can see reason. We should attempt to send an official delegation to Kathmandu, to convince him to join us in the liberation of Asia.
loc.JAP_claim_the_scripech_desc: Our Heavenly Emperor stands above all other, and those who do not see it this way must be crushed. We should invade [NEP.GetNameDef] and claim their throne for ourselves.
loc.JAP_ally_afghanistan_desc: The King of Afghanistan rules over the various Afghan tribes in one of the harsher mountain regions of the world. Perhaps he can see reason. We should attempt to send an official delegation to Kabul, to convince him to join us in the liberation of Asia.
loc.JAP_best_the_graveyard_desc: Our Heavenly Emperor stands above all other, and those who do not see it this way must be crushed. We should invade [AFG.GetNameDef] and claim their throne for ourselves.
loc.JAP_form_the_central_economic_council_de: To solve the economic downturn our country faces from political instability and war, we should establish a special advisory body to the Prime Minister with the goal to investigate and deliberate economic policies between the home and overseas territories and basic plans for their implementation.
loc.JAP_expand_the_showa_research_associatio: The Shōwa Kenkyūkai, a political think tank established to generate innovative ideas for political reform by reviewing and assessing issues with the Meiji Constitution, has been expanding its zones of interest and forming new subgroups. We should encourage this, so that they may develop new technologies and ways of dominating Asia.
loc.JAP_form_the_great_japan_industrial_patr: The industrialists and trade unions in our nation are split and inefficient, which hinders our economic development. We must unite all of these under one umbrella organization, so that our industries can be run as efficiently as possible, and lead to further expansion.
loc.JAP_sea_guide_the_zaibatsus_desc: The largest corporations of our nation have long had unprecedented political and economical power. With some finesse, we may be able to guide their efforts in our favor, and reorganize their leadership into groups under our broader control.
loc.JAP_form_cabinet_intelligence_bureau_des: Prime Minister [ROOT.GetLeader] has personally requested that a government organization focused on improving pro-Japan public opinion and to ensure that every citizen contribute their all to war and the defense of our great nation. Nobuhumi Ito has accepted his request, and just needs official orders to get the bureau established.
loc.JAP_crackdown_on_foreign_agents_desc: The Cabinet Intelligence Bureau has discovered plenty of suspicious individuals skulking around. Some of these are of undesirable ideologies, and some are obvious agents of foreign powers. Perhaps it is time for the bureau to start taking action, and begin a campaign to safeguard our nation and its people?
loc.JAP_crackdown_on_foreign_agents_tt: The §YTokkō§! will become more active in arresting dissidents and spies in an attempt to strengthen national security and stability
loc.JAP_found_the_great_japan_press_associat: Found the Great Japan Press Association

The Cabinet Intelligence Bureau has come up with a way to more efficiently guide our population in the right direction. By forming the Great Japan Press Association, we can have one office control all media within the country, effectively censoring any information we need to, and distributing patriotic propaganda out to those who might be in need of it.
loc.JAP_empower_the_thought_police_desc: The Special Higher Police, exist for the purpose of carrying out civil law enforcement, control of political groups and ideologies deemed to threaten the public order of the Empire of Japan, counterintelligence, domestic criminal investigations, high policing, and public security. We should strengthen this organization, so that they can do this job more efficiently.
loc.JAP_sea_state_general_mobilization_law_d: It has come to our attention that we need to put the national economy on war-time footing, so that we don't fall behind in the development of weapons. Through this new law, we can get government control over civilian organizations and labor unions, the nationalization of strategic industries, price controls and the ability to impose rationing where needed.
loc.JAP_sea_state_general_mobilization_law_t: Unlocks the ability to go to §Y$closed_economy$§! despite being §YNon-Aligned§!
loc.JAP_issue_the_ten_commandments_for_marri: Our officials have come up with the new slogan 'Be fruitful and multiply' as a part of their new campaign for increasing the [ROOT.GetAdjective] population, due to our relatively low population count compared to many of our adversaries. We must support this initiative.
loc.JAP_enact_religious_organizations_law_de: In order to direct our people's attention toward the right things, and ensure their unwavering support for the pursuit of the [ROOT.GetAdjective] destiny, we must promulgate a law that would give the state authority control over all religious organizations within the nation.
loc.JAP_new_order_movement_desc: We must form a national organization in domestic affairs modeled after the one party states in the west, in order to mobilize the nation for war with the Colonialist Powers and prevent communism by rejecting the modern capitalist path that began with the Meiji Restoration. This issue is now more pressing than ever, as if we do not follow through soon, we may miss the bus.
loc.JAP_sea_tripartite_pact_desc: As our enemies coalesce against us, the task of defeating them becomes more of a challenge. We should reach out to other governments with similar goals, so that we may engage in some measure of cooperation.
loc.JAP_sea_mil_tech_coop_with_germany_desc: We require better technology to unite the world under one roof. Germany is not only a historical partner in technological developments for us, but also has ample military technological advances that would be extremely useful for our war effort. We must see to obtaining these schematics, no matter the cost!
loc.JAP_imperial_rule_assistance_association: Due to the threats both internal and abroad, and the division within the civilian government, we must establish the Taisei Yokusankai to usher in a statist, para-fascist political system with the aim of removing sectionalism and factionalism from politics and economics, creating a totalitarian one-party state in order to maximize the efficiency of our total war doctrine.
loc.JAP_form_the_yokusan_sonendan_desc: In order to protect the sovereignty of our nation, we need more people who are not only willing to fight for us, but also take part in the home guard to assist in matters of civil defense under the direction of official local authorities. To that end, we should form an elite paramilitary youth branch of the Imperial Rule Assistance Association, the 'Yokusan Sonendan'.
loc.JAP_integrate_the_great_japan_youth_part: Integrate the Great Japan Youth Party

The Great Japan Youth Party, a nationalist youth organization modeled after the German youth movements, is not yet fully under our control, and acts as an independent third party under colonel Kingoro Hashimoto. We must rein them in, and place them under the control of the Taisei Yokusankai.
loc.JAP_sea_national_defense_state_desc: [ROOT.GetLeader] has proclaimed the Shintaisei, making Japan into a National Defense State, in which every man, woman and child is to be mobilized to protect the nation. Under the National Mobilization Law, the government has also been given absolute power over the nation's assets. Through this, the Empire will be able to last for all of eternity!
loc.JAP_formalize_the_tonarigumi_desc: The Neighborhood Associations have existed informally for quite some time, aiding in allocating rationed goods, distributing government bonds, fire fighting, public health, civil defense, distributing spiritual mobilization propaganda, informing the Tokkō of political dissidence and watched coasts for suspicious activity. We should formalize them, so that we can allocate more funds towards these groups.
loc.JAP_formalize_the_tonarigumi_tt: Unlocks decisions to §YOrganize Tonarigumi§! in our subjects
loc.JAP_ichioku_isshin_desc: As one of the slogans of the Taisei Yokusankai goes, the [ROOT.GetAdjective] people are truly 'One Hundred Million, One Heart'. Though our people are all individual subjects to the Emperor, they all stand together as one single entity, with their hearts and minds being as one.
loc.JAP_issue_the_senjinkun_military_code_de: The pocket-sized military code 'The Instructions for the Battlefield' should be issued to every [ROOT.GetAdjective] soldier, in order to prepare them for the years of conflict to come. They are to be taught military regulations, combat readiness, esprit de corps, filial piety, as well as veneration of Shinto kami and the kokutai. 'Never live to experience shame as a prisoner, honor before surrender!'
loc.cost_reduced_last_stand_2: Allows the use of the §YLast Stand§! command ability at greatly reduced cost, while also extending its duration by §G3§! days\n
loc.JAP_issue_the_shinmin_no_michi_manifesto: Our people need to be taught the way of subjects. This will be done through an ideological manifesto directed towards the people to explain in clear terms what is expected of them 'as a people and a nation'. Issuing such a manifesto will be the responsibility of the Ministry of Education.
loc.JAP_sea_greater_east_asian_co_properity_: The Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere

We must form a union in Asia in order to ensure economic self-sufficiency and cooperation among the member states, along with resisting the influence of Western imperialism and Soviet communism. Of course however, this is an effective propaganda tool to enforce our hegemony over the continent.
loc.JAP_CHI_pact_is_active_flag: The China-Japan Alliance is in Effect
loc.JAP_sea_greater_east_asian_co_properity_: It becomes §G25%§! cheaper to liberate and puppet §YAsian§! and §YOceanian§! states.
Unlocks Decisions to §YEstablish Puppet-Regimes§! throughout Southeast Asia
loc.JAP_expand_japan_manchukuo_economic_bloc: We should take the initiative to build an economic bloc between us and our imperial subjects, in order to bolster our economies and secure sufficient strategic materials, such as iron, coal, cotton, and salt.
loc.JAP_develop_the_yen_bloc_desc: We must put further emphasis on the economic aspects of the Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere. The economies of Asia must be integrated, and all should adopt the Yen as their currency. This can be achieved by continuing the development of the Japan–Manchukuo–China yen bloc whilst ultimately perfecting it.
loc.JAP_develop_the_yen_bloc_tt: Unlocks decisions to §YIntegrate the Economies§! of our §YAsian Allies§!
loc.JAP_east_asia_development_board_desc: Establishing the Kōain will help coordinate the government's China policy, designed to sponsor industrial and commercial development in China to boost support for Japanese rule in occupied territories. It can also be used as a tool for ensuring laborers for our mines and war industries.
loc.JAP_east_asia_development_board_tt: Unlocks decisions to start §YIndustrial Projects§! in our allies
loc.JAP_ministry_of_greater_east_asia: The Ministry of Greater East Asia
loc.JAP_ministry_of_greater_east_asia_desc: By establishing the Daitōashō, we will be able to more efficiently administrate overseas territories obtained in the Pacific, as well as coordinate the establishment and development of the Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere.
loc.JAP_the_flying_geese_desc: The technological development in Southeast Asia can only be led by that of our own, and Asian nations will catch up with the West as a part of a regional hierarchy where the production of commoditized goods would continuously move from the more advanced countries to the less advanced ones. Just like geese in a V-formation, we will lead the way for Asian development!
loc.JAP_greater_east_asia_railroad_desc: Our leading engineers have come up with an idea for a railroad linking Japan with mainland Asia and Europe, including a tunnel or bridge connecting our nation to our Korean possession. Having gotten the idea from the South Manchuria Railway, our bullet trains will travel from Tokyo to Rangoon, and onward to Tehran. May our empire last for an eternity!
loc.JAP_greater_east_asia_railroad_tt: Every state controlled by us or our allies with less than §Y2 Infrastructure§! will gain §G1§! §YInfrastructure§!
loc.JAP_promote_pan_asianism_desc: The dream of a unified Asian state is now closer to being achieved than ever before, thanks to the exploits of our brave soldiers and the initiatives taken under the Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere. Once and for all, the western nations will be shown that Asia is not just a region for them to take advantage of, but one which will stand toe to toe with even the greatest empires in their wildest imaginations.
loc.JAP_promote_pan_asianism_tt: Unlocks decisions to §YIntegrate§! our developed Asian subjects with the goal of §YUniting Asia§! under one state
loc.JAP_tojos_premiership_desc: With the situation being as it currently is, it will prove vital to select a Prime Minister who can rally the IJA behind him, and lead as a martial leader as well as a civilian one. As such, general Hideki Tōjō will be chosen to lead the nation to glory.
loc.JAP_yamamotos_premiership_desc: With the situation being as it currently is, it will prove vital to select a Prime Minister who can rally the IJN behind him, and lead as a martial leader as well as a civilian one. As such, admiral Isoroku Yamamoto will be chosen to lead the nation to glory.
loc.JAP_yamamoto_shot_down_flag: Yamamoto was shot down and killed
loc.JAP_the_crysanthemum_throne_desc: The factions within our military squabble too much, and cannot reach an agreement on who to promote to be the next Prime Minister. With the situation being as volatile as it is, it might be prudent for the Emperor to step in and take direct control over the situation.
loc.JAP_solidify_tohokai_rule_desc: With Nakano's ascension to Prime Minister, the Tōhōkai faction within the Imperial Rule Assistance Association became the biggest one. Now, we have the opportunity to truly solidify rule under the Society of the East, and secure Nakano's role in [ROOT.GetAdjective] politics for the coming years!
loc.JAP_national_defense_brotherhood_desc: In order to fund our war effort, Nobusuke Kishi and Hideki Tōjō have conceived a plan for the Gokoku Doshikai, a political organization to better coordinate the nation's financial strategies and industrial initiatives. This pairing is quite controversial however, and many issues may lie in the cards for the National Defense Brotherhood.
loc.JAP_supreme_council_for_direction_of_war: Supreme Council for the Direction of the War

Our government has realized that we need to rapidly hold an Imperial General Headquarters-Government Liaison Conference, after seeing the dire need to strengthen coordination between state affairs and command. Perhaps this will be able to lead us to victory.
loc.JAP_found_the_boeitai_desc: With a defensive war on our own lands becoming ever more realistic, we must establish some sort of Defense Corps that can be rapidly mobilized to defend our Home Islands in the case of an enemy incursion. This will also include individuals who would not normally be liable for military service under the Japanese conscription system.
loc.JAP_found_the_boeitai_tt: Unlocks the ability to recruit §YVolunteer Fighting Corps Militias§! in the Home Islands
loc.JAP_advance_one_hundred_million_fireball: The Imperial Rule Assistance Association has come up with the slogan 'Advance, One Hundred Million Fireballs', which will be used to express the people's anger towards the west and growing fighting spirit. Must sacrifices be made to take down our enemies, then our population will be sure to lay down their lives for the Empire!
This spirit will be removed if we drop below §Y40%§! Stability
loc.JAP_joshi_teishin_tai_desc: The Women's Volunteer Corps will be founded to give women a chance to serve the Empire prior to marriage, compelling them to perform war time labor duties. Through this, more citizens will be able to be mobilized to aid in our war time industries.
loc.JAP_the_metal_collection_order_desc: Our nation is rapidly running out of strategic materials, regular metals included. We must therefore enact Imperial Ordinance No. 667, for the purpose of collecting metals owned by the public and private sectors in order to make up for the intensification of the war situation and shortages of materials.
loc.JAP_form_the_dai_nippon_fujinkai_desc: Yamauchi Sachiko has volunteered to establish the Great Japan Women's Association, a proposed merger of three other nationalistic Women's Associations, with the proposed goal of mobilizing women in war work; to strengthen the morale of the military, to maintain a frugal lifestyle in order to save the nation's resources, to raise the production levels and to support the military.
loc.JAP_found_the_air_defense_surveilance_co: Found the Air Defense Surveillance Corps

In order to ensure early detection of enemy aircraft attacks, we must mobilize our civilians to serve at air defense observation posts set up all over the country, and to detect enemy aircraft at an early stage and report them to the relevant authorities. This will be organized by enacting the Air Defense Law.
loc.JAP_fund_propaganda_films_desc: Our navy has proposed greater investments into the film industry, in order to motivate our people to continue fighting. As such they have contracted the Moving Picture Laboratory to produce an animated propaganda movie that strengthens the narrative of the IJN, while throwing the IJA under the bus in the process.
loc.JAP_fund_propaganda_films_2_tt: §Y[ROOT.GetImportOrDomesticFilmIndustry]§! can be taken an extra time
loc.JAP_the_eternal_kingdom_desc: Japan is a nation ruled by the divine Emperor, and is as such a country protected by the gods. With their aid, our divine country is immortal, and will stand strong for the rest of eternity. Long live His Majesty the Emperor, and long live the Great Empire of Japan!
loc.JAP_the_eternal_kingdom_tt: This spirit will be removed if we reach §Y50%§! Surrender Progress
loc.JAP_revere_the_emperor_destroy_the_trait: Revere the Emperor, Destroy the Traitors

The day we planned for has finally arrived. Our troops have taken control of Tokyo, and talks have begun with the emperor to convince him to support our movement, despite his initially apprehensive attitude. Finally, we will be able to rid our country of western decadence, and bring back the glory of the old ways!
loc.JAP_authorize_aid_to_ethiopia_desc: Our faction has had contacts with the [ETH.GetAdjective]s for many years, culminating in us swaying the government to aid with the modernization of [ETH.GetNameDef]. Now they find themselves under attack by a western power. We must send aid to them at once!
loc.JAP_establish_the_gunbatsu_desc: In order to reorganize the government, we must first dismantle its structure and rebuild it from the ground up. To achieve this, preparations have already begun to establish a military clique, that will aid the emperor in governing the country as a closed inner circle.
loc.JAP_grand_army_purge_desc: To ensure that our grip over the military is absolute, we must rid the country of the traitors who would try to support the ideas of the Meiji oligarchy, and who would oppose and thwart us in our road to power, including the despicable Tōseiha officers who sought to control the emperor for their own gain. Through any means necessary, the military must be cleansed of these bad actors!
loc.JAP_grand_army_purge_tt: §RPurges§! various §YToseiha Members§! and officers of §YSamurai Lineage§! and §GPromotes§! §YYoung Officers§! who took part in the Coup d'etat. Notable commanders that are §RRemoved§! include:\n
loc.JAP_remove_the_weeds_from_the_crop: Remove the Weeds from the Crop
loc.JAP_remove_the_weeds_from_the_crop_desc: As our chief political theorist Sadao Araki has so clearly stated; unless you remove the weeds, a good crop will be ruined. In this manner, we must eliminate these weeds in the government that would hinder the progress of our nation, and harm our soul while selling out our country to foreign capitalists and agents. The time for weeding has commenced!
loc.JAP_can_no_longer_manually_promote_civ_g: We will no longer be able to §RManually Endorse§! the §YCivic Faction§!
loc.JAP_sea_the_showa_restoration_emperor_sh: At long last, the era of liberal Taishō Democracy is at an end. Once again, the nation will be led by a small group of qualified people backing up a strong Emperor. Only through this will our country finally be brought salvation.
loc.JAP_sea_the_showa_restoration_emperor_ge: At long last, the era of liberal Taishō Democracy is at an end. Once again, the nation will be led by a small group of qualified people backing up a strong Emperor. Only through this will our country finally be brought salvation.
loc.JAP_kodoha_the_emperor_cooperated_flag: §YEmperor Shōwa§! chose to cooperate with the Kōdōha
loc.JAP_yasuhito_takes_up_the_throne_tt: §YYasuhito§! will replace §YHirohito§! in the Imperial Influence
loc.JAP_nobuhito_takes_up_the_throne_tt: §YNobuhito§! will replace §YHirohito§! in the Imperial Influence
loc.JAP_an_ode_to_showa_restoration_desc: Naval officer Mikami Taku composed the Ode of Showa Restoration, a stunning theme for our movement that makes a strong appeal to natural and religious imagery. Now that we have restored power to and enthroned Emperor Hirohito and abolished the liberal Taishō democracy, we should make this a second national anthem.
loc.JAP_ikki_kitas_state_socialist_ideals_de: The author and political philosopher Ikki Kita is highly influential and involved with our movement. He has many times critiqued capitalist models, being a self-described socialist. We should embrace his ideas and reorganize the economy to more closely fit this ideal.
loc.JAP_oppose_the_zaibatsus_desc: The largest corporations of our nation have long had unprecedented political and economic power. We must remind them they are still subordinate to the Emperor's wishes, and ensure their greedy capitalist policies cannot continue to pollute our nation's soul.
loc.JAP_give_it_your_all_for_the_emperor: Give it Your All For the Emperor!
loc.JAP_give_it_your_all_for_the_emperor_des: The [ROOT.GetAdjective] man is a hard worker who fervently believes in our great emperor. We should propagandize this, and promote good labor and hard work as a core part of [ROOT.GetAdjective] society.
loc.JAP_give_it_your_all_for_the_emperor_tt: Unlocks decisions to Construct §G1§! §YCivilian Factory§! in starting core states with level §Y4§! or higher §YInfrastructure§!. \n§RThis decision can only be taken once per state§!
loc.JAP_revitalize_rural_areas_desc: Many of the young officers in our movement come from poor and rural families. In order to keep their support, we should seek to halt the depopulation of the countryside, and revitalize the rural areas.
loc.JAP_nationalize_western_corporations_des: The greedy western capitalists came to our country to exploit our people and resources, leaving behind scars in the national soul that will take a long time to heal. We must take down the corporations at once, and nationalize their factories, even if it means angering the west.
loc.JAP_ally_the_league_of_blood_desc: The radical Buddhist preacher of Nichirenism Nisshō Inoue founded the League of Blood with the intention of eliminating wealthy businessmen and liberal politicians, in what came to be known as the Blood-Pledge Corps Incident. Having been released since then, we should make contact with him, seeing as he holds shared ideals.
loc.JAP_integrate_the_kenkokutai_desc: The National Foundation Society is an anti-communist organization, strongly influenced by the National Socialism of Motoyuki Takabatake, that seeks for the creation of a genuine people's state based on unanimity between the people and the emperor. We should recruit them into our government, as we share similar goals to them.
loc.JAP_contact_the_masterless_samurai_desc: The Rōninkai is an ultra-nationalist anti-democratic political group that shares many of its members with similar organizations like the Dark Ocean Society and the Black Dragon Society. Founded by Tanaka Hiroyuki in 1908, this secret society now influences most of our right wing politicians. We must reach out to them and establish ties between them and our government.
loc.JAP_contact_former_sakurakai_members_des: The Cherry Blossom Society was an ultranationalist secret society established by young officers in 1930, that has been dissolved ever since the Imperial Colors Incident. They had the goal of reorganizing the state along totalitarian militarist lines via a military coup d'état, if necessary. Now that we have succeeded, we should reach out to reinvite some of these former members to our government.
loc.JAP_the_great_spiritual_evil_desc: The enactment of the Peace Preservation Laws have been a good first step in our path to stopping communist degeneracy from influencing the minds of our people, but we still have a lot of work to do. The Kokutai is also under the threat of foreign socialist thought, and we must take a more proactive approach to stopping this from destroying our nation.
loc.JAP_strike_down_the_enemy_of_the_people: Strike Down the Enemy of the People
loc.JAP_strike_down_the_enemy_of_the_people_: The great enemy of the [ROOT.GetAdjective] people is communism, and this fact will never change. It fundamentally cannot coexist with our nation, and as such only one can be left standing at the end of the final war between the eastern and western civilizations.
Gain §YAnnex§! war goal against any §YAsian Communist§! nation. Current targets:
loc.JAP_prepare_for_the_final_war_desc: Technology determines the history of war, and the history of war determines history. There will soon be a final war, which will be decided by the air war. As in the future, aircraft will be able to fly long distances to strike directly at other nations' capitals. To avoid this, we should engage in a new command economy by enacting a one-party national defense state.
loc.JAP_indoctrination_in_the_military_acade: It is important that radical elements in the army do not turn on the government as we once did. We must ensure that high discipline is held, and that every man swears his loyalty to the Emperor rather than any group or faction!
loc.JAP_sea_supremacy_of_will_desc: The most advanced equipment is useless without a fierce man to wield it, and fierceness can turn the simplest rock in the deadliest of weapons. Only through the spirit of élan, the cult of the offensive, can wars be won.
loc.JAP_tennoheika_banzai_desc: The Banzai charge is the embodiment of the [ROOT.GetAdjective] fighting spirit. As part of the military curriculum, every man will know the battlecry, and be trained in bayonet charge tactics. By using these, our men will not live as prisoners of war, but instead go out in a blaze of glory. Long live His Majesty the Emperor!
loc.JAP_a_truly_righteous_army_desc: The [ROOT.GetAdjective] Imperial Army does not simply fight for conquest or for glory. It fights for its Emperor, its nation, its ideals and its people.
