Every soldier must know these things, and realize that everything he does in the line of duty reflects on the Emperor and his people, and that for His Majesty, any sacrifice is worthwhile.
loc.JAP_supremacy_of_the_kempeitai_desc: Our 'law soldiers' will take over the role of the Tokkō, who are more loyal to the old regime. The Kempeitai will be put in charge of the national police, and improve our counterinsurgency, counterintelligence and dissidence suppression abilities.
loc.JAP_sonnou_joui_desc: We have once again lived up to the Bakumatsu period ideals of a powerful Emperor, and stand ready to oppose foreign imperialism. Just as the Tokugawa Shogunate was once expelled, we will expel all who oppose the great Emperor's rule. Revere the Emperor, expel the barbarians! It is time to reclaim our heavenly destiny.
loc.JAP_sonnou_joui_tt: This spirit is renewed when capturing the capital of a nation we have claimed through §YThe Jeweled Spear has Struck§!, §Rif still active at the time§!.
loc.JAP_subdue_the_kwantung_army_desc: The Kwantung Army has been a thorn in our side for a long time, not listening to the authority of our military clique. We must ensure that they become completely subservient to us, through tactical promotions and intimidation. In due time, Sadao Araki will become their new head of the Kwantung Army.
loc.JAP_subdue_the_kwantung_army_tt: §GReigns In§! the §YKwantung Army§! and ensures they cannot act independently from our government's wishes
loc.JAP_subdue_the_kwantung_army_2_tt: A few §YKwantung Army§! Generals are demoted and retired from active service:
loc.JAP_hasten_the_integration_of_taiwan_des: Our integration efforts of Taiwan have been going well, with only a few main setbacks. In due time, the island will be as much a core part of Japan as Ryukyu is. We should however hurry, if we want to be able to redirect our attention to other regions soon.
loc.JAP_integrate_the_government_general_des: The autonomy of the Government-General of Chōsen has been a massive mistake. They have let resistance movements exist for far too long, ruining our industries in the area. We must directly intervene, and put the Korean territories directly under the central government.
loc.JAP_integrate_the_government_general_tt: Unlocks decisions to §YIntegrate Korean States§! once they have a high enough compliance
loc.JAP_align_the_concordia_association_desc: The Concordia Association, the political party under our control in Manchuria, holds ideals of Pan-Asianism and the creation of a multi-ethnic nation-state and to create a structure which would gradually replace military rule over Manchukuo with civilian control. We should propose the unification of our two nations for the advancement of the Pan-Asian cause.
loc.JAP_integrate_the_great_empire_of_manchu: With the Concordia Association firmly on our side, Puyi and his loyalists don't hold enough power to prevent us from ending their autonomy. The time has finally come to unify our two nations under the one true Emperor!
Unlocks decisions to §YIntegrate Manchurian States§! once they have a high enough compliance
loc.JAP_embrace_kokutai_desc: Our national identity, essence and character have been neglected and diluted by the past governments for far too long, and is close to being lost to the winds of time. We must ensure that every [ROOT.GetAdjective] citizen understand that it is their duty to live up to our traditions, and live in accordance to the Kokutai.
loc.JAP_empower_the_shogun_desc: The Emperor must remain in a more ceremonial role, with strong middlemen who act in his name. This will certainly allow the Emperor's word to carry further and wider.
loc.JAP_empower_the_emperor_desc: The time for figureheads is long past, and the Emperor himself must take direct control of the state. Only then will our Empire be able to stand against the Western imperialists.
loc.JAP_a_worthy_succssor_of_meiji_desc: Now that something akin to a second Meiji Restoration has been carried out, our Emperor sits as the most powerful man in the country once more. Perhaps it would be wise to live up to the ideals of this national revolution, and attempt to modernize our industries and sciences to bring a new [ROOT.GetAdjective] renaissance.
loc.JAP_the_art_of_warfare_desc: There are many great tacticians and warriors written into legend in East Asian history, but few come close to the master strategist Sun Tzu. Perhaps he has a thing or two that we can learn from, so that our plans may become more robust with time.
loc.cost_reduced_staff_office_planning: Allows the use of the §YStaff Office Plan§! command ability at greatly reduced cost, while also extending its duration by §G2§! days\n
loc.JAP_the_imperial_colors_desc: In honor of our compatriots who tried and failed in 1931 to coup the government just as we have now, we should turn October 21st into a national holiday, in which we fly the imperial flag and remember the sacrifices they made in the name of our Emperor.
loc.JAP_utilize_our_polish_friendship_desc: Our nation has held good relations with the Poles ever since the days of the Russian Empire when we took in their people who were exiled to Siberia. Since then we have exchanged intelligence on [SOV.GetNameDef] and held a shared rivalry against the nation. We should formalize a defensive pact with them, so that we can both feel protected from the bear.
loc.JAP_return_to_sakoku_ron_desc: Our nation only ended its isolation due to Commodore Perry and the [USA.GetAdjective] gunboat diplomacy. Seeing as outside influence is now corrupting and destroying our nation's soul, we should enact a second era of isolation.
loc.JAP_the_enemy_of_our_enemy_desc: The [SOV.GetSovietThreatName] threat to our northern borders must be dealt with. We must begin preparations for a war with [SOV.GetNameDef]. The best way to do this is to strengthen our relations with [GER.GetNameDef], who our reports suggest are preparing for a war against [SOV.GetNameDef].
loc.JAP_societal_bushido_desc: General Sadao Araki, has linked the ancient Bushido code of the samurai with ideas similar to European fascism in order to form the philosophical basis of his ideology, which links the Emperor, the people, the land and morality as one and indivisible. To this end, we should promote the Bushido code as something that every good citizen should always adhere to.
loc.JAP_politicize_the_education_system_desc: The army has long been in control of the national education system, but not enough has been done to radicalize the youth to properly join our cause. We should invest more heavily into our political indoctrination, and increase funding towards the education system.
loc.JAP_the_spirit_of_the_imperial_nation: The Spirit of the Imperial Nation
loc.JAP_the_spirit_of_the_imperial_nation_de: In order to direct our people's attention toward the right things, and ensure their unwavering support for the pursuit of the [ROOT.GetAdjective] destiny, we must promote Kokutai at every shrine, and enshrine [ROOT.GetLeader] in a shrine in Tokyo.
loc.JAP_propagandize_the_nihon_shoki_desc: The Chronicles of Japan are an important part for explaining our history, and detail our founding myths. We must ensure this is closely taught in schools, and that the children learn the connections between Jimmu's conquests back then and our future destiny.
loc.JAP_the_yamato_spirit_desc: The [ROOT.GetAdjective] people's hearts and minds are as one, connected by the Soul of Yamato that permeates our society. We should ensure that all our citizens know of our past glory, and know what needs to be done to return to our traditional ways of life.
loc.JAP_children_of_the_sun_desc: Not only our royal lineage, but the [ROOT.GetAdjective] people themselves, are the children of the sun. The great goddess Amaterasu once gave us this land, and we must be thankful for that. It is time that we repay what she has given us!
loc.JAP_the_footsteps_of_jimmu_desc: Our legendary founder, Emperor Jimmu launched a military expedition from Hyūga near the Seto Inland Sea, captured Yamato, and established this as his center of power. He began the Great Eastern Expedition that greatly expanded our territories, guided by the Yatagarasu the crow god. As this divine warrior once conquered in the name of the gods, so shall we.
loc.JAP_yatagarasus_guidance_desc: The three-legged crow god Yatagarasu guided Jimmu on his great conquest of Yamato and Nara, as a part of divine intervention in human affairs. As we are in dire need of guidance ourselves, we should name our new systems after this god of guidance.
loc.JAP_the_jeweled_spear_has_struck_desc: The heavenly jeweled spear was once used by the genesis gods Izanagi and Izanami to raise the first landmass from the sea. Just as they once used the planted spear to claim new land, so shall we. The time has come to see where the heavenly spear will once again strike.
loc.JAP_the_jeweled_spear_has_struck_tt: Unlocks decision to claim §YAsian§! states and gain §YWargoals§! against their owners. We can target a country to claim at a time, upon which we need to occupy all existing claimed states to claim more.
loc.JAP_hakko_ichiu_desc: All of the world must be united under one roof! We have the divine right to do so under our rule, as ordained in the Nihon Shoki. At the time of his ascension, Emperor Jimmu proclaimed: 'I shall cover the eight directions and make them my abode'. The time has come to finally fulfill his wish!
loc.JAP_hakko_ichiu_tt: Unlocks decisions to integrate §YAsian§! states that are either §YOwned§! by us, or §YControlled and Claimed§! by us
loc.JAP_embodying_empress_jinguu_desc: Just as Empress Nagako's husband was murdered, so was Empress Jingū's. She went on a campaign of revenge, then turned her attention to a promised land. After three years she vanquished her foes, and returned triumphant. We should continue this legend, and see it through to its end.
loc.JAP_to_reach_princess_kaguya_desc: In the Tale of the Bamboo Cutter, Kaguya-hime, a princess from the Moon is discovered as a baby inside the stalk of a glowing bamboo plant. At the tale's end, Kaguya-hime reveals her celestial origins and returns to the Moon. Now that the technology is available to us, we must do all in our power to reach her once more.
loc.JAP_to_rival_zheng_yi_sao_desc: Zheng Yi Sao was a legendary Chinese pirate leader active in the South China Sea, being the most successful female pirate in history. We must live up to and even surpass this legend, in the name of the great Empress Nagako!
loc.JAP_amaterasus_aramitama_desc: One of the gods that aided Jingū in her campaigns against the Korean kingdoms was the violent spirit of Amatereasu, Tsukisakaki Izu no Mitama Amazakaru Mukatsuhime no Mikoto. This spirit held the great power of the Sun Goddess, something we should endeavor to harness for ourselves!
loc.JAP_okadas_military_purge_speech_desc: The military has gone too far this time. If the countless assassinations and attempted ousting of our government by fringe elements weren't enough, they now also seek to use the recent incident to strengthen their own power and wrest control of our nation away from its people. It is time Okada made it clear who governs the state, and takes action to oppose the growing power of the military.
loc.JAP_okadas_military_purge_speech_tt: §RThis will lead to an escalation of the conflict between the Government and the Military, which can only be resolved by repealing the Peace Preservation Law!§!
loc.JAP_ministry_of_commerce_and_industry_de: In order to get a better overview of our finances, we should expand the Ministry of Commerce and Industry and ensure that they have all the resources they need to properly perform their tasks.
loc.JAP_continue_takahashi_korekiyos_policie: Viscount Takahashi Korekiyo saved our nation from the Great Depression, and ensured that the effects of it would no longer be felt in our economy. To achieve this however, he made budget cuts to the military's finances, something that has proven to be an unpopular move for many. We must follow in his footsteps!
loc.JAP_increase_armament_spending_desc: Viscount Takahashi Korekiyo may have done much for our economy, but he has left us ill-prepared for the wars to come. We must remedy this fact, and reinvest into our growing military industries.
loc.JAP_approach_mitsui_desc: The Mitsui zaibatsu traces its origins back to the Edo period, nowadays being one of the largest industrial corporations within our country. We must ensure their support for our government, so that we can most effectively utilize their services.
loc.JAP_reduce_zaibatsu_focus_cost_tt: Taking §Y$JAP_sea_guide_the_zaibatsus$§! or §Y$JAP_democratic_work_with_the_zaibatsus$§! will reduce the time this focus takes down to §G35§! days.
loc.JAP_approach_mitsubishi_desc: The Mitsubishi company was initially established as a shipping firm in the early Meiji era. Having expanded to most industrial sectors, they today control large parts of all military industries within our country. We must ensure their support for our government, so that we can most effectively utilize their facilities.
loc.JAP_approach_sumitomo_desc: The Sumitomo zaibatsu traces its roots to a bookshop in Kyoto, though copper refining made the company famous. Today they specialize in mineral extraction, as well as banking. We must ensure their support for our government, so that we can most effectively utilize their assets.
loc.JAP_approach_yasuda_desc: Yasuda zaibatsu traces its origins to the Meiji era, and has been doing banking ever since it was first founded. Being the body of the Yasuda bank, they are now intrinsically linked with all financial sectors within our nation. We must ensure their support for our government, so that we can most effectively utilize their vast wealth.
loc.JAP_fund_the_riken_institute_desc: Founded in 1917 during the Taishō era, the Institute of Physical and Chemical Research is currently controlled by the Riken Concern, a zaibatsu which currently controls about 121 factories and 63 companies. Under Viscount Masatoshi Ōkōchi, we should endeavor to expand the institute further, so that we can conduct our atomic research program there.
loc.JAP_fund_the_riken_institute_tt: If the $JAP_zaibatsu_faction$ is at least $JAP_imperial_influence_tier_3$, also gain §G1§! §YNuclear Research Facility§!
loc.JAP_build_the_nishotaki_and_miyanaka_dam: Build the Nishotaki and Miyanaka Dams

The new factories and facilities in our nation require more electricity than we are currently capable of affordably producing. We must establish new hydroelectric dams, so that we can generate electricity without burning our precious coal stockpiles.
loc.JAP_establish_synthetic_fuel_joint_ventu: Since the 20s, we have had joint ventures with Germany to establish synthetic resource extraction centers for coal and oil. We should broaden our horizons, and look to increase this cooperation with the western powers, so that we can finally become self-sufficient.

If a §YWestern Major§! country has §Yguaranteed§! or has at least §Y75§! Opinion of §Y[ROOT.GetNameDef]§!, [ROOT.GetNameDef] receives an additional $cat_synth_oil$ technology bonus and §Y$synthetic_refinery$§!
loc.JAP_establish_nippon_hassoden_desc: In order to increase our government control over the national electricity supply, and for the ability to regulate the usage, we should establish the Japan Electric Generation and Transmission Company to regulate the electricity industry. This will be easily achieved through the merger of existing electric power companies.
loc.JAP_new_industrial_city_development_poli: The national land planning committee has developed a plan for establishing new cities centered around military supply facilities for the army and navy, munitions factories and related facilities developed, and large-scale urban planning to support these industries. We should invest in this initiative.
loc.JAP_establish_housing_corporation_desc: In order to provide housing throughout the country to all those who need it, we must establish a corporation with the goal of building tens of thousands of housing units for laborers, and many rental properties for carpenters and citizens.
loc.JAP_central_agricultural_association_des: Our many scattered agricultural organizations need to be consolidated into one if we wish to solve the bottlenecks in our supply chains. To ensure this is done, we should task Sengoku Kotaro to establish the Central Agricultural Association as outlined in the Agricultural Organizations Law.
loc.JAP_the_five_great_cities_desc: The cities of Kyoto, Osaka, Yokohama, Kobe, and Nagoya have been given special designations that provide them with various special provisions that are not available to ordinary cities, in order to aid in their industrialization and urbanization process, with the ultimate goal of becoming special cities independent from prefectures. We should increase our investments into this initiative.
loc.JAP_resource_security_desc: Our ambitious goals of becoming fully self-sufficient have finally borne fruit! Our nation has become abundantly rich with natural resources, which will only strengthen us further - making us unstoppable!
loc.JAP_ship_management_committee_desc: With the recent ratification of the Wartime Shipping Control Order, we can authorize the establishment of a special corporation in charge of managing the shipping industry to control it and cooperate in the implementation of national policies regarding shipping in order to maximize the full potential of the shipping industry in wartime.
loc.JAP_danganressha_desc: The Ministry of Railways has approved the so called Danganressha plan, in which broad gauge railways are to be laid next to the standard gauge ones, on which transport trains will be able to travel as fast as a bullet. The railway pioneer Yasujiro Shima and his son have promised to aid in the development of this plan.
loc.JAP_ministry_of_colonial_affairs_desc: Starting out initially as the Hokkaidō Colonization Office, the ministry has already come a long way. We must expand its responsibilities so that it can properly administer Nan'yō, Chōsen, Karafuto, Kantō and Taiwan. One day, may these lands be referred to by all as Japanese!
loc.JAP_manchuria_five_year_plan_desc: While our islands are scarce in usable land, our mainland possessions are not. What we cannot build up ourselves, we can build up on the mainland, instead. We will begin a large-scale industrialization program for [MAN.GetNameDef].
loc.JAP_establish_manchuria_airplane_manufac: In order to produce our equipment closer to where the resources for them are being extracted, the Nakajima Aircraft Company has offered to open a subsidiary under our supervision in Manchuria that they currently refer to as Manshū. We must support this brilliant idea.
loc.JAP_eastern_road_and_steel_expansion_des: In order to facilitate the expansion of our mines and industries in Manchuria, we should found the Eastern Road Development Corporation. Once this has been accomplished, mining stations will be set up in Tiechangzi, Wudaojiang, and Shirengou, and iron ore mining offices will be set up in Dalizi and Qidaogou.
loc.JAP_sea_promote_japanese_settlement_desc: By settling our own people in Manchuria, we can increase the work force and thereby create more opportune locations for factories. The people moving there can also produce agricultural goods that can be sent back to the home islands.
loc.JAP_construct_the_sui_ho_dam_desc: In order to provide enough energy for our industries in the Manchurian Liaoning Province, we should construct the Suihō gravity dam. Our engineers have drawn up plans for what will be the largest in all of Asia, with plans for contracting the Yalu Hydroelectric Company and Pyeongbuk Railway company to achieve this.
loc.JAP_the_shuilikeng_power_plant_desc: Our development of Taiwan is going ahead as planned, though the issue of power generation is becoming ever more pressing. This has been partially alleviated by the construction of hydroelectric power plants such as the Menpaitan Power Plant. We should take a page out of our past engineers' books, and continue building up these dams and stations across the island.
loc.JAP_develop_the_south_seas_mandate_desc: The Japanese Mandate for the Governance of the South Seas Islands, given to us by the League of Nations after the Great War is a vast and largely unexplored territory, ripe for exploitation. If we make sure to develop these regions and specialize them in providing our people with their riches, the Nan'yō Government that governs the region may even be able to sway the locals to properly integrate into our state.
loc.JAP_build_up_korean_industries_desc: We should make concentrated efforts to build up the industrial base in the Korean peninsula, especially in the areas of heavy industry and munitions. After all, these will be invaluable in any upcoming wars with China or the westerners. This policy was initially proposed by Kazushige Ugaki, and we should continue down this path.
loc.JAP_increase_agricultural_export_desc: Ever since our acquisition of the territory, Korea has functioned as a breadbasket for our empire. We should increase our efforts for expanding this field, so that their food can be exported all across the realm.
loc.JAP_hydroelectric_dams_in_korea_desc: The industrialization and electrification of Korea will come to an abrupt halt unless we intervene and do something about the situation. We should construct new gravity dams across the region, and our engineers at the Han River Hydroelectric Company have already drawn up intricate plans for the construction of a dam they dub the Hwacheon Dam.
loc.JAP_prepare_for_peninsular_warfare_desc: In the case that we find ourselves at war and on the retreat, the Korean Peninsula would likely have to be our final holdout on the continent. We should make preparations so that we are able to hold this region, should such a worst-case scenario ever occur.
loc.JAP_establish_the_japanese_korean_army_d: Ever since 1904, the Chōsen-gun has operated as a garrison force in Korea, but hasn't seen much combat outside of the invasion of Manchuria in 1931. We should revoke the treaties that bind our Korean governorate in an effort to expand this army, so that it may be used as a proper fighting force.
loc.JAP_increase_crop_yields_desc: The South Seas islands have a large amount of coconut, a lucrative potential cash crop. We should encourage monopolies that pair private initiative with government capital. By also contracting the Nan'yō Kōhatsu, sugar plantations, sugar mills, bananas, pineapples, taro, manioc, coffee and other tropical farming products can be grown, putting the islands on a par with Taiwan in terms of production.
loc.JAP_improve_agricultural_output_desc: The industrial production in Taiwan is set to exceed the agricultural production on the island. Though this benefits our industries, it is far from ideal, seeing as the agricultural exports from Taiwan are of great importance for keeping our people happy and supplying our military. We must remedy this at once!
loc.JAP_upgrade_the_oriental_development_com: The ODC currently has nine active branches, operating in nearly all of our overseas territories. They serve a crucial role in guiding the progress of the regions in a direction that pleases our ambitions, and steer the industrial and agricultural developments to aim for efficiency above all else. To improve our colonies, we must therefore look to expanding this company, and ensuring it has all the resources it needs.
loc.JAP_the_imperial_defense_plan_desc: In order to protect the state, we must formulate a new plan for proactive defense. All wars will be won by sudden large-scale decisive strikes, avoiding prolonged wars and forcing our enemies to give in to our demands.
loc.JAP_first_strike_principle_tt:
When §Y[ROOT.GetNameDef]§! §Rdeclares war§! on a §Yneighboring country§!, or a neighboring country of a subject, gain for §Y90 days§!:
 §Y$JAP_first_strike_principle_dm$§!
 $MODIFIER_ATTACK_BONUS_AGAINST_A_COUNTRY$: §G+10.0%§!
  $MODIFIER_BREAKTHROUGH_BONUS_AGAINST_A_COUNTRY$: §G+10.0%§!
loc.JAP_kantai_kessen_tt:
When §Y[ROOT.GetNameDef]§! §Rdeclares war§! on a country with §Y$capital_ship$§!, gain for §Y180 days§!:
 §Y$JAP_kantai_kessen_dm$§!
  Capital Ship Attack Against Country: §G+10.0%§!
  Spotting Speed Against Country: §G+10.0%§!
loc.JAP_first_strike_blocked_due_to_kwantung: Due to the Kwantung Army's §RUnplanned Offensive§!, we will not gain the §Y$JAP_first_strike_principle_dm$§! bonus
loc.JAP_divert_naval_guns_to_the_army: Divert Naval Guns to the Army
loc.JAP_divert_naval_guns_to_the_army_desc: In order to allow the land forces to utilize heavy weaponry such as railway guns and tanks, we must divert parts of the naval gun production to the army.
loc.JAP_expand_kawagoe_army_arsenal_desc: Our arms industry is currently struggling to keep up with the production demands to ensure our army is capable of combat on a modern battlefield. We should expand the Kawagoe army arsenal in Saitama in order to improve our chances of matching supply with the demand.
loc.JAP_reform_the_army_desc: Count Hisaichi Terauchi, a general rapidly climbing the ranks of our military, has proposed for a revision to our army doctrines. He sees the old grand assault doctrines as outdated, claiming that a more mobile type of warfare will dominate the future battlefields. We should heed his advice, and make sure we do not fall behind the times.
loc.JAP_rely_on_supremacy_of_the_will_desc: General Hideki Tōjō once proposed that wars should be won through decisive preemptive strikes, and battles through glorious mass charges and supremacy of will. We should support this idea, as it suits our current military doctrine well.
loc.JAP_rethink_armor_doctrine_desc: Hisaichi Terauchi has come to a dire conclusion. Our current armor and land vehicle designs are ill equipped to fight against anything other than light infantry, and will be decimated if they ever face off against western armor. We should remedy this oversight as soon as possible!
loc.JAP_foreign_tank_modernization_cooperati: In order to beat the west, we must first study their designs, and through that learn how to overcome them. We should seek friendship with one of the western powers, so that we may eventually be able to produce tanks that even they will marvel at.
A §YWestern Major§! country has §Yguaranteed§! or is in a §YFaction§! with §Y[ROOT.GetNameDef]§!
Unlocks the MIO trait §Y$JAP_mio_trait_foreign_research_and_development_cooperation$§! for all §YTank Designers§!. §RIt can however only be applied to one of them§!.
loc.JAP_domestic_tank_modernization_program_: We must learn from our mistakes, and ensure that our armor can survive anti-tank weaponry, else our forces will be doomed to failure. This should not be done by relying on the designs of the western powers, but on the ingenuity of the great [ROOT.GetAdjective] people.
loc.JAP_the_ultimate_tank_desc: Our engineers have come up with a brilliant idea. Instead of fielding vast amounts of smaller vehicles, we should aim to build metal behemoths, ones that can crush our foes with only minimal support. Their first draft is a vehicle they refer to as the O-I tank, and we should get working on turning this vision into reality as soon as possible.
loc.JAP_prepare_the_northern_front_desc: The Kwantung Army has been itching to get into a proper fight against [SOV.GetNameDef] for a very long time, but has lacked the military infrastructure that is required for this to be a success. We should invest in the expansion of roads and railways in Manchuria, so we may eventually be successful in driving the [SOV.GetAdjective]s out of Siberia.
loc.JAP_enact_the_national_conscription_law_: It has been decreed, that every eligible [ROOT.GetAdjective] man be sought out and conscripted into the army. We should dispatch recruiters to even the most remote of villages, so that we can rapidly enlist more men.
loc.JAP_instill_the_spirit_of_bushido_desc: Through State Shinto and the traditional ideas of morality known as Bushido, we will be able to instill in the people the need to sacrifice oneself for the good of the state and the Imperial family.
loc.JAP_adopt_new_assault_doctrine_desc: General Shunroku Hata has proposed a new way to decisively defeat the enemy in battle. By employing large amounts of artillery, we should be able to shell the enemy into submission, and will then only have to charge the demoralized and shattered remnants to seal the deal.
loc.JAP_develop_lethal_infantry_equipment_de: The army has made it clear to us how outdated the weapons currently in their possession are, and are requesting something be done about it. We should make large investments into developing more modern infantry equipment, so that we may never again lose a war.
loc.JAP_develop_lethal_infantry_equipment_tt: If the $JAP_army_faction$ is at least $JAP_imperial_influence_tier_3$, also gain:\n
loc.JAP_develop_sophisticated_artillery_equi: The army has made it clear to us how outdated the weapons currently in their possession are, and are requesting something be done about it. We should make large investments into developing more modern artillery guns, so that we won't have to charge the enemy until they have practically already surrendered.
loc.JAP_expand_the_irago_proving_ground_desc: In order to better dominate the battlefield, we should expand the Irago proving ground where we test new and experimental weapons. There, we may be able to develop tools of warfare that will bring all of our enemies to heel.
loc.JAP_sea_mountaineers_desc: Our army has realized that it will not be able to penetrate the mountainous regions of southern and western China unless something drastic is done. They have therefore requested that special mountaineer brigades be established, so that they may lead the charge and penetrate the enemy lines.
loc.JAP_jungle_adaptation_desc: Our army has realized that it will not be able to penetrate the jungle-clad regions of Burma and Greater Indonesia unless something drastic is done. They have therefore requested that special jungle divisions be established, so that they may lead the charge and penetrate the enemy lines.
loc.JAP_army_weapons_administration_headquar: In order to unify the manufacturing, supply, research, development, testing, and training of the Army's weapons, we should establish the Army Weapons Administration Headquarters. By doing this, our industries will hopefully stand a chance against juggernauts like [SOV.GetNameDef] and [USA.GetNameDef].
If the $JAP_army_faction$ is at least $JAP_imperial_influence_tier_3$, also gain §G1§! §YLand Warfare Facility§!
loc.JAP_pivot_towards_defensive_measures_des: The war has developed not necessarily to our favor. It is becoming ever more plausible that our enemies land on the home islands, something we are currently ill equipped to combat. We should set out to solve this issue, lest we experience a century of humiliation of our own making!
loc.JAP_strenghten_the_supply_lines_desc: Our supply lines are stretched thinner than we can handle, and our troops are suffering losses as a result. We must resolve this situation if we wish for our successes to continue, as time is rapidly running out before our troops will falter and fall.
loc.JAP_ni_go_nuclear_project_desc: The Army Committee has set up an experimental project at RIKEN, something they dub the Ni-Go project. Its aim is to separate uranium-235 by thermal diffusion, ignoring alternative methods such as electromagnetic separation, gaseous diffusion, and centrifugal separation. Hopefully we will be able to learn how to harness this for a military purpose soon.
loc.JAP_establish_showa_aircraft_idnsutry_de: We have received a request for permission to establish the Shōwa Hikōki Kōgyō Kabushiki-gaisha in Akishima, Tokyo. This company wishes to build military aircraft to provide to our armed forces. We should approve their request, and have them get working on providing us with aviation equipment immediately.
loc.JAP_develop_new_fighters_desc: A new design by Mitsubishi may well prove to be the most capable carrier-based fighter aircraft designed to date. Unparalleled maneuverability, coupled with decent range, means that the design will likely last us for years. We should begin prototyping and production immediately.
loc.JAP_modern_bombers_desc: A modernized tactical bomber force is key to support our military on the battlefield. We should therefore order both the army and the navy to begin development of planes capable of tactical support for our ground forces.
loc.JAP_improve_the_type_91_aerial_torpedo_d: We should seek to develop torpedoes specialized in hitting ships in shallow waters, to improve our port-striking capabilities. These aerial torpedoes will be inspired by our most advanced torpedo, the Long Lance, and will bring us the fruits of victory faster than we may have ever dreamed of.
loc.JAP_7075_aluminium_alloy_desc: Range alone will do us no good if our models cannot compete with the enemy when they arrive. We must produce craft with superior agility, so they may never be outmaneuvered. Our engineers at Mitsubishi have developed a new Aluminum Alloy that will revolutionize airplane construction as we know it.
loc.JAP_escort_efficiency_desc: We must maintain superiority over our enemies in all areas, including air warfare, lest our bombers and transports be intercepted and brought down. Modernized fighter planes are essential to achieve this, and the key to future victories.
loc.JAP_sea_sturdy_aircraft_desc: Agility and range are both essential, but are not the only factors for determining our success in the skies. Should our planes be thin as paper, we would lose before any war had even started. We must therefore invest in the development of stronger air-frames and thicker armor, so that we may dominate the skies for years to come.
loc.JAP_sea_sturdy_aircraft_tt: Reduces the chance of targeted air attacks against certain characters
loc.JAP_sea_long_operational_range_desc: As much as we may desire quick victories, wars are not easily won through direct military confrontations alone. The distances involved in warfare in the Pacific theater are vast, and so we need models capable of bridging those distances if we wish to succeed.
loc.JAP_project_z_bomber_project_desc: Our enemies' capitals lie far away from us, making it difficult to achieve the early decisive strike we need to quickly end our wars. We must therefore construct vehicles capable of reaching even the American East Coast if needed, and invest in new strategic bomber models that can destroy the enemy's industry behind the lines.
loc.JAP_adopt_new_air_doctrine_desc: Now that we have faced off against enemies with the same technological capabilities as ourselves, we have realized that we must also modernize our combat doctrines to keep up.
loc.JAP_the_divine_wind_desc: Kamikaze, the tactics of the Special Attack Unit, have changed suicide attacks from an improvised last measure to an established doctrine. With new planes, essentially manned missiles, these attacks will be unstoppable.
loc.JAP_sea_unify_the_air_forces_desc: For too long, have we been plagued by separate research and development of aviation between the army and the navy. We must unify these programs to ensure both uniformity of armament and better use of our limited research resources.
loc.JAP_sea_unify_the_air_forces_tt: Unlocks the MIO trait §Y$JAP_mio_trait_unified_research_and_development$§! for all §YPlane Designers§!. §RIt can however only be applied to one of them§!.
loc.JAP_improved_radio_communications_desc: Our radios are currently in a terrible shape, and as a result our formations often break up due to bad communications and lack of signal in deep jungles and on remote islands. We must modernize our equipment and construct new radio towers so that this won't keep happening.
loc.JAP_combined_arms_desc: Coordination between our air and land forces is the key to success. In order to provide better support and clear the battlefield of any obstacles our army may face, we should invest in combined arms tactics that allow our planes to work in tandem with our other branches.
loc.JAP_sea_jet_prototypes_desc: The future of aviation does not lie with propellers. We must look at jet propulsion for improved capabilities for our aircraft. Our engineers have dubbed the project to construct this new experimental plane the Imperial Weapon No.2, with the model being referred to as the Kikka.
loc.JAP_rockets_development_desc: Hideo Iwakuro has had many bright ideas regarding guided air-to-surface missiles and surface-to-air anti-aircraft missiles. We should promote his ideas, and develop new forms of rocketry that will be able to aid us in our future victories.
loc.JAP_expand_hiratsuka_navy_arsenal_desc: The Hiratsuka Naval Ammunitions Arsenal founded in 1905 has potential to be expanded greatly. They will be able to specialize different plants for design and engineering, including machine gun ammunition, naval artillery shells, solvent recovery, and nitroglycerin production.
loc.JAP_expand_hiratsuka_navy_arsenal_tt: Has either left the §YLondon Naval Treaty§!, or an §YEscalator Clause has been Invoked§!
loc.JAP_expand_navy_technical_department_des: We must issue new estimates for the size of the increase to our navy, and, thereby, the dockyard facilities that will be required to bring about this increase. The first step to bringing our facilities in line with modern requirements will be to expand the navy's technical department.
loc.JAP_prepare_the_southern_front_desc: A war in the pacific will involve naval landings to a large degree. The Special Naval Landing Forces require expansion if they are to be up to the task. Alongside this, it will prove worthwhile to invest in our marine paratroopers, as they will be able to capture strategic locations and islands before our main forces make it to the location.
loc.JAP_prepare_the_southern_front_tt: When [ROOT.GetNameWithFlag] §Rdeclares war§! on a country that controls a §YSouth East Asian State§!:
loc.JAP_focus_on_aircraft_carriers_desc: Battleships are the relics of a bygone age. We must look to the future, and the future is aviation. Aircraft carriers will allow us to project that air power across the Pacific.
loc.JAP_balanced_naval_approach_desc: We must avoid building ourselves into a corner if it turns out that either battleships or carriers are ineffective against our foes. We should therefore keep a balanced naval approach, and invest in both sectors.
loc.JAP_sea_battleship_initiative_desc: With our superior battleship designs, we require only one decisive engagement to decide the naval war. must ensure our battlefleet is optimized to engage decisively and secure victory as swiftly as the wind.
loc.JAP_sea_heavier_naval_guns_desc: It seems that our adversaries have invested heavily into armor for their naval vessels. We must ensure that we can keep up with their development and pierce their hulls. To that end, investments into heavier naval gunnery seem prudent.
loc.JAP_sea_bigger_better_yamato_desc: As we are not rich in resources, we must ensure we put it to best use. We will build the most powerful battleships ever put on the surface of the planet, capable of defeating any enemy in a head-on engagement. With this, our enemies will bow before us, or cease to exist.
loc.JAP_yokosuka_naval_air_technical_arsenal: The Yokosuka Naval Air Technical Arsenal will be key in providing the most modern airplanes for our new carrier-fleet. It will focus on creating better designs, to be mass-produced by companies like Aichi kokuki, Kyūshū hikoki Kabushiki-kaisha and assembled at the Hiro Naval Arsenal.
loc.JAP_establish_the_mine_warfare_force_des: It has come to our attention that the western nations are using naval mines as a means of controlling the seas. We should take after these ideas, though not without establishing a force that will also be in charge of keeping track of these and minesweeping waters whenever needed.
loc.JAP_akizuki_class_destroyers_desc: We require highly capable multipurpose platform ships, with strong anti-aircraft screening abilities to assign to our carrier-groups and battlefleets. Our engineers have thus begun working on an improvement to the Yūgumo class destroyers, with a new class they refer to as the Akizuki class.
loc.JAP_form_the_kido_butai_desc: To maximize offensive striking power we will combine the largest concentration of aircraft carriers the world has ever seen into one battlegroup. By developing the doctrines required to enable concerted offensive operations in this form, our enemies will stand no chance against our superiority in naval aviation.
loc.JAP_form_the_kido_butai_tt: The success chance for the Pearl Harbor §YRaid§! on §Y[USA.GetNameWithFlag]§! will increase
loc.JAP_nationalize_suzuka_naval_arsenal_des: The Suzuka Naval Arsenal is a production facility for aviation ordnance, light arms, and munitions for the navy. We should nationalize this facility, so that we can control the expansion of it, and establish new naval repair yards at the site.
loc.JAP_nationalize_fujinagata_shipyards_des: The Fujinagata Shipyards are an important shipyard and railroad car manufacturer in Osaka, being of strategic importance to our war effort. In order to expand the facilities and conscript more workforce for them, we should endeavor to nationalize these shipyards.
loc.JAP_naval_armaments_program_desc: In order for our shipyards and industries to keep up with our ever growing ambitions, our navy has drafted new expansion plans as part of the Rapid Naval Armaments Supplement Programme. This includes new warships, and has the goal to extend the navy to at least 293 maritime vessels.
loc.JAP_naval_armaments_program_tt:
With §Y$JAP_focus_on_aircraft_carriers$§! completed: Create Carrier §Yvariant§! and §Y4 production lines§! of the §YShokaku Class§!
With §Y$JAP_balanced_naval_approach$§! completed: Create Carrier and Super Battleship §Yvariants§! and §Y2 production lines§! of both the §YShokaku Class§! and the §YYamato Class§!
With §Y$JAP_sea_battleship_initiative$§! completed: Create Super Battleship §Yvariant§! and §Y4 production lines§! of the §YYamato Class§!
loc.JAP_radio_guided_missiles_desc: The Imperial Japanese Army Ordnance Board has made great strides in the development of guided weapons. They are close to making a breakthrough regarding free falling, infra-red guided, gyro-stabilized missile, intended to be dropped from airplanes onto shipping targets. This new weapons has been dubbed the Ke-Go.
loc.JAP_assure_superior_naval_quality_desc: While numbers matter, we must not let the enemy possess any ships more powerful than our greatest ones. The Yamato has been a good first step, but we must take these ideas even further.
loc.JAP_seek_strength_in_numbers_desc: One ship isn't enough to win an engagement. We need to diversify our fleets, and expand upon our numbers instead of simply focusing on quality. After all, quantity is a quality of its own.
loc.JAP_seek_strength_in_numbers_tt: Unlocks the MIO trait §Y$JAP_mio_trait_strength_in_numbers$§! for all §YNaval Designers§!. §RIt can however only be applied to one of them§!.
loc.JAP_secure_the_sea_lanes_desc: Our fleets require the most modern of escorts to operate unhindered by enemy submarines and torpedo boats. Only by investing in this will our transports be able to safely make it to their destinations.
loc.JAP_fix_flawed_naval_designs_desc: Our ship designs have proven to be top-heavy, and we have had incidents of them tipping over as soon as they leave the harbor. We must solve these issues immediately, so that our ships will be able to make it out to sea safely.
loc.JAP_f_go_nuclear_project_desc: Our naval command wishes to begin a nuclear research program with the hopes of harnessing the technology's power for our fleet. They have proposed that this be carried out under Bunsaku Arakatsu at the Imperial University, Kyoto. His team includes Hideki Yukawa, a prominent theorist who will surely achieve the breakthroughs we need.
loc.JAP_combined_nuclear_research_efforts_de: With the hostilities between our military branches being close to reaching a conclusion, it is high time that we unify their ambitious nuclear projects into one, and put all of our nation's brightest minds to work in the same team.
loc.JAP_end_the_interservice_rivalry_desc: With our victories proving that our nation is capable of becoming a world power, the squabbles over resources between our internal factions seem ever more irrelevant. It is time we seek to end this rift that has divided our interests for far too long, and ensure [ROOT.GetAdjective] dominance over Asia for centuries to come.
loc.JAP_end_the_interservice_rivalry_tt: Will end the §YInter-Service Rivalry§! between the Army and Navy. They will §GNo Longer Provide Maluses§! based on their status compared to the other, but instead function as the other factions do
loc.JAP_seek_yakuza_support_desc: There are many groups who hold great power in the shadows, they control and influence the actions of politicians and generals alike. We should attempt to ally with these groups, and convince them to work alongside us in ensuring the military doesn't get its way.
loc.JAP_seek_yakuza_support_tt: A larger portion of the §YImperial Army§! will be swayed to our side for the §YCivil War§!
loc.JAP_expand_the_metropolitan_police_desc: We know for sure that the civilian police force is a combat ready group firmly on our side, and not under the control of the military. They aided us in bringing down the Kōdōha faction, and they can aid us once again, in restoring order in this chaotic situation.
loc.JAP_expand_the_metropolitan_police_2_tt: The democratic government will gain an additional §G8§! §YPolice Divisions§! when the §YCivil War§! occurs
loc.JAP_secretly_rebuild_the_party_desc: There are many groups who lost their voice and political representation when the Peace Preservation Law was signed back in 1925. One of the groups is the communists, who had their organizations outlawed and who faced great oppression under our last regime. We must seek to legalize their movement, to gain them as a supporter in our fight against the military.
loc.JAP_secretly_rebuild_the_party_tt: Unlocks decisions to §YInfiltrate Opposition-Controlled States§! to ensure they join the §YCommunists§! when the §YCivil War§! happens
loc.JAP_anti_militarist_speeches_in_the_diet: With growing anti-military sentiments throughout the country, it would prove prudent to turn the people critical of their fanatical nationalism further toward the left, by having Isoo hold speeches critical of our traditions, and by distributing communist propaganda in the streets to the best of the party's ability.
Unlocks decisions to §YIncrease Communist Support§! throughout the country
loc.JAP_sway_disillusioned_young_officers_de: Most of the young officers that took part in the most recent Kōdōha coup d'etat are from poorer rural families who were dissatisfied with the current structure of the military, and the system of promotion through history, rather than merit. We should make use of this and promise them a better tomorrow.
loc.JAP_sway_disillusioned_young_officers_tt: The §YKōdōha Young Officers§! will become sympathetic towards our cause
loc.JAP_sway_disillusioned_young_officers_2_: A slightly larger portion of the §YImperial Army§! will be swayed to our side for the §YCivil War§!
loc.focus_effects_are_as_follows_tt: The focus effects are as follows:
loc.JAP_organize_the_student_movements_desc: The students in our universities are unhappy with the state of the nation, and hold ideas that are aligned with some of the JCP's most prominent members. We should organize All-Campus Joint Struggle Committees with the aim of spreading socialist thought throughout our campuses.
loc.JAP_organize_the_student_movements_tt: When the §YCivil War§! occurs, the opposing side will gain the following national spirit for §Y365§! days:
loc.JAP_raise_support_within_the_proletarian: Raise Support within the Proletarian Class

Many of our top leaders come from the working classes, having worked in shipyards and steelworks. We should encourage the Japanese proletariat to unionize, and to stand up against those who wish to trample on their rights.
§Y[529.GetName]§! will become supportive of the JCP
We will gain §Y$JAP_strong_unions_idea$§! in the event of a §YCivil War§!
loc.JAP_organize_underground_resistance_desc: If our party is to stand up not only against the Army, but even the central government, we will need a base of operations that is far out of reach from any of their authority. From there we should be able to start liberating our fellow comrades from prisons, and begin operations to secure weapons for the revolution.
loc.JAP_organize_underground_resistance_tt: Unlocks decisions to §YRaids Army Weapons Depots§! and gain equipment at the start of the revolution, while giving the opposing side a minor malus
loc.JAP_mountain_village_operation_units_des: Sanzō Nosaka has authorized the creation of underground paramilitary units and clandestine cells to be formed in rural and remote villages with the goal of carrying out guerrilla operations against the government, and preparing for a nationwide communist revolution. To facilitate this, the booklet 'How to Raise Flower Bulbs' has begun distribution throughout the country.
loc.JAP_mountain_village_operation_units_tt: Unlocks decisions to §YEstablish Guerilla Units§! in states that will rise up when the time is right
loc.JAP_return_of_the_manchukuo_exiles_desc: Many socialist theorists and economists went off to work in the various syndicalist cooperatives and other industries that were established in Manchuria after its conquest by the Kwantung Army in the hopes of establishing revolutionary thought there, though it was short lived. We should get the interim PM to facilitate the return of these individuals, in exchange for sending some generals into exile.
loc.JAP_return_of_the_manchukuo_exiles_tt: Only states with §Y$JAP_state_infiltrated_by_the_jcp$§! will join us at the start of the §YCivil War§!
loc.JAP_return_of_the_manchukuo_exiles_2_tt: §G5§! §YIJA-loyal Generals of Noble Descent§! will be sent to §YManchuria§! in exchange for §YSocialist Industrialists§!
loc.JAP_organize_the_fifth_column_desc: As our four columns approach Osaka and Tokyo, a fifth column of supporters will rise up from inside the cities and undermine the enemies' defenses from within. We will organize these 'Fifth Columns' in all cities we approach, giving us a decisive advantage in the war for national liberation.
loc.JAP_organize_the_fifth_column_tt: Unlocks decisions to encourage partisans to §YDamage Enemy Units§! during the civil war
loc.JAP_revoke_the_peace_preservation_law_de: The vile Peace Preservation Law has facilitated the creation of the Tokkō, which have been wreaking havoc in the military's name since Okada first spoke out against them. It also blocks the democratic process, as it outlaws multiple democratic principles and organizations. It is time we cast our vote, and tear up this calamitous piece of paper.
loc.JAP_revoke_the_peace_preservation_law_re: The combined §YCommunist§! and §YDemocratic§! support is over 50%
loc.JAP_revoke_the_peace_preservation_law_tt: §RMany of our colonies will likely see this as their opportunity to leave the empire§!
loc.JAP_a_red_sun_rises_for_a_new_era: The Red Sun Rises for a New Era
loc.JAP_a_red_sun_rises_for_a_new_era_desc: The revolution is triumphant, the day is won! With the defeat of the final holdouts of anti-revolutionary cells, we must now get to work reorganizing the state in a socialist manner. There are however major disagreements within the party on how this should be done. Therefore, we must hold a great debate to decide on the future trajectory for our state.
loc.JAP_the_lecture_group_ascendant_desc: In the debate, the more authoritarian and proletarian-focused Kōza-ha faction came out on top. The leaders of this faction, Sanzō Nosaka and Kyūichi Tokuda will take on the tough job of forging a new state. The question remains however, who should lead as Chairman, and who will be the nation's Premier?
loc.JAP_the_labor_farmer_faction_ascendant_d: In the debate, the more idealistic and farmer-focused Rōnō-ha faction emerged victorious, miraculously defeating the Kōza-ha. Though this umbrella movement has emerged victorious, the main question still remains, who will become the next premier of the republic?
loc.JAP_sea_fate_of_the_imperial_family: The Fate of the Imperial Family
loc.JAP_sea_fate_of_the_imperial_family_desc: The time has come to see to and eliminate the last vestiges of hereditary rule in Japan. There are many ways in which we can proceed, though we should tread with caution as the imperial family still holds vast popularity among our people. We must decide what fate shall befall the former Emperor and his family.
loc.JAP_hold_a_peoples_tribunal_desc: There are many who have committed grave crimes in the name of the past governments, and who have struggled against and subverted the revolution and its believers. We must try these individuals publicly, and root out any counterrevolutionary dissidence at once!
loc.JAP_hold_a_peoples_tribunal_tt: A few §YMilitary Advisors§! are tried for collaboration with the old government and are retired from active service:
loc.JAP_social_and_cultural_revolution_desc: We must now begin the monumental task of eliminating all remnants of feudalism, nationalism, and conservative traditions while promoting communist ideology throughout the state. We must remove Bushido from our education, and encourage the people to wear Youfuku, and throw out any traditional clothing in favor of western sorts, to bring our state up to par with other revolutionary societies.
loc.JAP_social_and_cultural_revolution_tt: When the national spirit §Y$JAP_reorganization_of_society_idea$§! is removed:\n
loc.JAP_overhaul_the_education_system_desc: The education system is still dominated by the ideas and ways of old, and promotes nationalist and patriotic thoughts. We must rapidly remedy this, and overhaul the education system to properly teach our youth how to become revolutionary leaders themselves.
loc.JAP_sea_nationalize_the_zaibatsus_desc: The largest corporations of our nation have long had unprecedented political and economic power, but it ends here. The state's control will not be challenged. We must nationalize them and use their capital for the people's gain!
loc.JAP_can_no_longer_manually_promote_zaiba: We will no longer be able to §RManually Endorse§! the §YZaibatsu Faction§!
loc.JAP_a_functionalist_housing_policy_desc: Our theorists have outlayed a new plan to establish large clusters of apartment buildings or houses of a particular style to be used as public housing that will be overseen by the government authorities. By construction with function in mind, more people will be able to achieve cheaper housing throughout the state.
loc.JAP_redistribute_land_and_wealth_desc: Much of the land throughout the country is still owned by families relating to the daimyos of old, who ruled vast domains. These lands must be redistributed among our farmers, as well as seized by the state in order to construct new towns and industries.
loc.JAP_ganbarou_desc: The [ROOT.GetAdjective] man and woman is a hard worker who will give it their all to provide for the state. We should propagandize this, and promote good labor and hard work as a core part of [ROOT.GetAdjective] society.
loc.JAP_cooperate_with_anarchists_desc: The anarchists were cast aside by the other factions in the JCP, being forced to fend for themselves against the tyrannical state. We should invite them into our umbrella movement, and ensure that some of their ideals can also become true in the future we have in mind.
loc.JAP_the_ie_system_and_socialism_desc: The traditional Ie system of how families are organized has historically shaped social structures, business practices, and even the organization of companies in our nation. We should ensure that this stays around, but with emphasis on the state as being the authority-figure within it.
loc.JAP_fukumotoism_desc: Fukumoto Kazuo has stressed the need for theoretical and political struggle by a radical vanguard party that would inject Marxist consciousness into workers from outside through theoretical struggle in order to develop the movement into a political struggle. By incorporating this into our governance, we can establish a better way of reaching out to our people and spreading to them any ideas we wish.
loc.JAP_fukumotoism_tt: Unlocks a decision that can be taken up to §G6§! times that grants §YCivilian Factories§! and §Y$MODIFIER_CONSUMER_GOODS_FACTOR$§! bonuses
loc.JAP_the_modern_ashigaru_desc: The peasant infantry employed by the warlords of Japan to supplement the samurai in their armies that became prevalent during the Muromachi period were known as the Ashigaru, and held no particular loyalties. In order to supplement our own professional forces, we should attempt to reestablish a similar system, in which peasants are obliged to defend the state in the case of war.
loc.JAP_the_modern_ashigaru_tt: Unlocks decisions to §YRaise Militias§! when at war
loc.JAP_learn_from_the_nkvd_desc: The Soviet secret police have perfected the art of suppressing dissidence and counterrevolution. Though we do not wish to work alongside them, perhaps we could learn a thing or two from how they do things.
loc.JAP_further_urban_investments_desc: Our urban centers are in dire need of investments. If we wish for the industries located within the cities to have the efficiency and workers they need to keep up their production quotas, we must step in and aid them.
loc.JAP_the_first_five_year_plan_desc: To secure our people's future we must establish a committee capable of producing and implementing a bold new economic model for [ROOT.GetNameDef]. This new Five Year Plan will see us truly blossom and prosper!
loc.JAP_form_pioneer_organizations_desc: The party needs to establish organizations for the youth in which they can partake in activities to become proper communists, capable of helping the state and one day even defending it.
loc.JAP_war_communism_desc: We should adopt a version of the economic and political system that existed in Soviet Russia during the Russian Civil War from 1918 to 1921, which they referred to as war communism. It should allow us to keep control and make the decisions necessary to bring the revolution to the rest of Asia through force of arms.
loc.JAP_the_uno_school_of_economics_desc: The political and economical theorist Kōzō Uno has proposed theories on how to transform the former capitalist models into actual economic development and the facilities needed to bring about true socialism. It is time to start making his theories into reality.
loc.JAP_the_uno_school_of_economics_tt: Starts a mission that will reduce our $MODIFIER_CONSUMER_GOODS_FACTOR$ by §Y-2.5%§! every year
loc.JAP_incorporate_buddhist_socialism_desc: Inoue Shūten and Girō Seno'o have proposed theories of implementing socialism based on the principles of Buddhism, and see them as similar concepts as both seek to provide a transformation of personal consciousness to bring an end to human alienation and selfishness. We should invite these thinkers into our movement.
loc.JAP_the_spirit_of_the_ikko_ikki: Revitalize the Spirit of the Ikko Ikki
loc.JAP_the_spirit_of_the_ikko_ikki_desc: The militarist Jōdo Shinshū Buddhists of our past proved to the world that our monks are to be feared in battle, and through their faith, the temple network allowed for more efficient and effective mobilization of troops when called for. We should faithfully revitalize the spirit of these Buddhist warriors, as we march towards the pure land!
loc.JAP_achieving_joubukkokudo_desc: We the unification of the capitals of the East-Asian Mahayana states, our pursuit of the creation of a Pure Land, where through new Buddhist socialist ideals our spiritual liberation as well as social and economic emancipation would be complete, draws to an end. Praise Girō Seno'o, and long live the Jōbukkokudo!
loc.JAP_uplift_ainu_revolution_theory_desc: Many of our political thinkers have been reasoning that the lumpenproletariat are the main body of our revolution, and that the Ainu people are also included inside this group. Furthermore, they believe that the Ainu people have lived in a primitive communist system and deem them worthy of being the 'leaders of the Communist revolution'. We should more broadly support this movement.
loc.JAP_kikues_new_model_desc: Yamakawa Kikue has long promoted the idea of uplifting the Japanese women to be an equal part of our society, and wishes to guarantee equal wages and employment rights, while also abolishing the patriarchal household system. It is time to turn these ideals into reality!
loc.JAP_women_in_industry_desc: For too long, women have been expected to stay home and care for the family. If a woman is able to be the leader of our country, then it is only right to allow them to work in other industries too. This will only serve to aid [ROOT.GetNameDef]'s economic future, as it will greatly expand our workforce.
loc.JAP_form_national_cooperatives_desc: Many of our thinkers advocate for the creation of more national cooperatives, organizations that are formed by individuals or businesses with shared economic, social, or cultural needs. They operate on the principles of member ownership, democratic control, and mutual benefit. We should encourage the creation of these.
loc.JAP_further_rural_investments_desc: Our rural regions have long been neglected by the central government, and the rapid industrialization of cities like Tokyo have pulled people away from the countryside, leaving many towns and villages in dire straits. We must invest in these areas, so that the workforce needed to keep them running can stay around.
loc.JAP_further_rural_investments_tt: Unlocks decisions to §GImprove§! the §YState Category§! of the above states if they have §Y4§! or more §YInfrastructure§!
loc.JAP_adopt_syndicalist_ideas_desc: We should adopt the ideas of establishing syndicalist cooperatives within our industries, and use their ideas for how the relations between individuals and their employers function to improve on our current industrial model.
loc.JAP_raise_the_red_flag_high_desc: The red flag is the symbol of our revolution, and shows our determination in bringing the revolution forward, with the hopes of eventually liberating all Asian workers from bourgeois oppression. The time has come to proudly raise the flag high, and declare that the revolution will keep marching on, forever!
loc.JAP_guide_the_lesser_states_desc: The less developed Asian states do not have the preconditions to bring about a revolution and succeed in establishing a workers republic of their own. We must guide them, and show them how to properly run a state.
loc.JAP_socialism_in_one_state_desc: The only ones who can educate and uplift the people of Asia are us, who have shown that the revolution can succeed. We must bring them into the fold to show them how to lead their lives, through force of arms if necessary.
loc.JAP_the_courage_to_defend_the_revolution: The Courage to Defend the Revolution

Every man and woman must show exude the courage and determination to defend the revolution from the many counterrevolutionary forces around the world. The time has come to defend our ideals with all we have!
loc.JAP_demand_submission_from_breawakay_sta: The states that illegally broke away from us simply made an error and didn't realize that the people's revolution would be successful. We should approach them and make a firm statement, demanding that they submit to the party and allow their people to be free from capitalist oppression.
loc.JAP_ignite_the_korean_peninsula_desc: The [KOR.GetAdjective] people have not yet been liberated. We should make contact with revolutionaries in the [KOR.GetAdjective] south, and have them begin their revolution. This should provide an opportunity for us to step in and protect the [KOR.GetAdjective] people from the ensuing civil war.
loc.JAP_ignite_the_korean_peninsula_tt: Starts a civil war in [KOR.GetNameDef], where the communist side becomes our puppet
loc.JAP_protect_the_manchurians_desc: The Manchurians are still under the oppression of our old Kwantung Army remnants. We must clean up our own mess, and move in to liberate the people. It is time to finish the fight, and settle our score with the Imperial Army!
loc.JAP_guide_the_chinese_desc: The revolution has still not succeeded in China. We must step in and personally guide the Chinese people towards prosperity, and liberate them from their feudal and outdated ways of life.
loc.JAP_guide_the_chinese_tt: We will gain a §YPuppet§! wargoal against every §YNon-Communist Chinese§! state. Current targets:
loc.JAP_guide_the_chinese_2_tt: Every §YCommunist Chinese§! nation is invited to our faction. Current targets:
loc.JAP_guide_the_mongols_desc: The revolution may have succeeded in parts of Mongolia, but now they lay under Soviet oppression instead. We must step in and personally guide the Mongolian people towards prosperity, and liberate them from their feudal and outdated and authoritarian ways of life.
loc.JAP_spread_the_revolutuon_south_desc: The flames of revolution must be rapidly brought south if the people of Asia are to ever be liberated. It is high time we strike, and secure a brighter future for all Asians!
loc.JAP_free_asians_from_soviet_opression_de: The Russian bolsheviks are no better than the capitalists who seek to control the people and deny them their future. We cannot stand idly by as they continue to oppress Asians. It is time to act!
loc.JAP_go_after_the_capitalists_desc: The western capitalists seek to steal from the people of Asia without ever giving anything back in return. We must strike them down, before they exploit the people to a point of no return.
loc.JAP_a_free_asia_pacific_desc: The day has finally come, where people all across Asia will be able to live their lives freely without being exploited by foreigners and governments who care little for their wellbeing. Long live [ROOT.GetNameDef], and long live the workers of Asia!
loc.JAP_the_pan_asian_revolutionary_front_de: In order to guide the various Asian revolutionary parties, we must organize an alliance and supranational organization that gives directives to the less developed states, and that can coordinate investments to improve their societies more rapidly.
loc.JAP_educate_the_peasants_desc: The education of the peasants of the continent has been neglected for far too long. It is time we begin coordinating efforts between members of the alliance, so that we can improve the knowledge within the workforce.
loc.JAP_educate_the_peasants_tt: The research speed bonus from §Y$JAP_educating_the_peasants_modifier$§! increases by §G1%§! for every new faction member, up to a maximum of §G10%§!
loc.JAP_a_common_currency_for_all_of_asia: A Common Currency for All of Asia
loc.JAP_a_common_currency_for_all_of_asia_de: As a part of our international coordination, we should endeavor for all the revolutionary states to adopt the yen as their official currency, so that a customs and trade union can be properly established.
loc.JAP_the_minitry_of_pan_asian_development: In order to better improve the living-conditions within the different Asian states, we should establish a central ministry that oversees investments into development, and aids in organizing industrial and economic programs.
loc.JAP_development_for_the_undeveloped_desc: In order to bring about the true revolution, we must develop the lesser developed states, and improve the infrastructure and industrial capacity of the alliance's lesser members.
loc.JAP_a_pan_asian_diet_desc: In order to bring the revolutionary states of Asia closer together, we should establish a governmental body that includes representatives from all of the member states, where they vote on which laws and institutions to implement in our fraternal republics.
loc.JAP_extensive_navy_maneuvers_desc: In order to take down the breakaway states that appeared when our nation broke down into a civil war, we must ensure that our navy is up to scratch and ready to take them on. We should therefore organize large scale maneuvers to ensure we are ready for battle.
loc.JAP_extensive_army_maneuvers_desc: In order to take down the Kwantung Army that took over Manchuria when our nation broke down into a civil war, we must ensure that our army is up to scratch and ready to take them on. We should therefore organize large scale maneuvers to ensure we are ready for battle.
loc.JAP_reclaim_lost_territories_desc: The time has come to return to the regions that broke off from our sphere and bring them back into our republic. Only through military intervention can we assure that the people of these regions will be able to prosper.
loc.JAP_conquer_the_army_remnants_desc: The time has come to finish the fight that we started, and put an end to the last remnant of the Imperial Army and our civil war. We must bring down the Kwantung Army, and reconquer Manchuria!
loc.JAP_put_an_end_to_chinese_feudalism: Put an End to Chinese Feudalism
loc.JAP_put_an_end_to_chinese_feudalism_desc: Feudal traditions still reign supreme in China, and there are millions of people who must be liberated and brought into our revolutionary republic. The decree will be issued, and the Chinese people will be liberated once and for all!
loc.JAP_mobilize_the_proletariat_desc: The workers are doing a good job diligently providing arms for our military, but desperate times call for desperate measures. It is high time we up the production quotas, even if just temporarily, so that all the weapons the army needs can be provided to them.
loc.JAP_the_long_march_to_victory_desc: In order to break the Chinese governments, we need to march deep into continental Asia. We should make propaganda campaigns referencing the long march, in the hopes that it will increase our soldiers’ willingness to keep marching for as long as it takes!
loc.JAP_the_pacific_union_of_soviet_socialis: Pacific Union of Soviet Socialist Republics
The moment we have been striving for has at long last arrived. The time has come to declare the creation of a new Asian state, which will bring the different soviet into one union.
We will be known as §Ythe Pacific Union of Soviet Socialist Republics§!
loc.JAP_the_indochinese_soviet_desc: Now that the union has been founded, we must establish new Soviet Republics and bring them into the fold. We should create the Indochinese Soviet in order to justify our occupation of the region.
loc.JAP_transformation_of_nature_desc: Asia is rich in natural resources, just waiting to be tapped into. With our scientific community pushing the borders of what was previously thought possible, even the largest, most invasive projects are becoming feasible. The environment must be shaped and molded on a massive scale to work in the People's favor!
loc.JAP_the_south_pacific_soviet_desc: Now that the union has been founded, we must establish new Soviet Republics and bring them into the fold. We should create the South Pacific Soviet in order to justify our occupation of the region.
loc.JAP_the_oceanian_soviet_desc: Now that the South Pacific Soviet has been established, we should push our boundaries further south. To this end, we should create the Oceanian Soviet in order to justify our occupation of the region.
loc.JAP_strike_down_the_great_pretender_desc: The bolsheviks in the Soviet Union pretend to be for the people, and rule over parts of Asia with tyranny. We should take down this bourgeois dictatorship masquerading as a revolutionary force, and declare ourselves the sole defenders of the revolution!
loc.JAP_a_red_dawn_over_asia_desc: With our forces victorious and our borders spanning across vast parts of the Pacific Ocean, the revolution is closer to triumph than it has ever been before. The red sun illuminates the sky, as the dawn ushers in a new era for Asia!
loc.JAP_to_rival_the_comintern_desc: Since the establishment of a Fourth International by the Trotskyites, many have called for the establishment of a Fifth Communist International that will act as a counterbalance to both this and the Comintern. We should take on this mantle, and declare ourselves the true defenders of the revolution!
loc.JAP_wrestle_mongolia_from_the_soviets: Wrestle the Mongols out of the Soviet Sphere
loc.JAP_wrestle_mongolia_from_the_soviets_de: The Mongols have been under the thumbs of the Russians for many years now, and yearn for an opportunity to distance themselves from the Europeans. We can provide them with that opportunity, and should invite them into the International. This may however strain tensions with [SOV.GetNameDef].
loc.JAP_wrestle_tuva_from_the_soviets: Wrestle the Tuvans out of the Soviet Sphere
loc.JAP_wrestle_tuva_from_the_soviets_desc: The Tuvans have been under the thumbs of the Russians for many years now, and yearn for an opportunity to distance themselves from the Europeans. We can provide them with that opportunity, and should invite them into the International. This may however strain tensions with [SOV.GetNameDef].
loc.JAP_spread_revolutionary_flames_to_south: Spread Revolutionary Flames to South Asia

The flames of the revolution spread far and wide, and our successful campaigns inspire the proletariat everywhere. We should begin funding revolutionary groups in South Asia in order to destabilize the region and bring them into the fifth international.
Unlocks decisions to invite §YCommunist South Asian§! nations into our faction
Unlocks decisions to §YStir Communist Sentiments§! inside §YSouth Asian§! nations
loc.JAP_spread_revolutionary_flames_to_west_: Spread Revolutionary Flames to West Asia

The flames of the revolution spread far and wide, and our successful campaigns inspire the proletariat everywhere. We should begin funding revolutionary groups in West Asia in order to destabilize the region and bring them into the fifth international.
Unlocks decisions to invite §YCommunist Middle Eastern§! nations into our faction
Unlocks decisions to §YStir Communist Sentiments§! inside §YMiddle Eastern§! nations
loc.JAP_trans_pacific_influence_desc: The flames of the revolution spread far and wide, and our successful campaigns inspire the proletariat everywhere. We should begin funding revolutionary groups on the other side of the ocean in order to destabilize the region and bring them into the fifth international.
loc.JAP_trans_pacific_influence_tt: Unlocks decisions to invite §YCommunist South American§! nations into our faction
loc.JAP_build_an_anti_army_coalition_desc: In order to counter the already powerful influence of the army, we cannot continue our inter-party squabbles. We must seek to form a coalition that can together push Japan forward toward a brighter future.
loc.JAP_ensure_cross_party_support_desc: Now that a coalition is under way, we must endeavor to gain the support of the other parties as well, so that we do not crumble in the face of adversity. Together, we can bring back the spirit of Taishō democracy!
loc.JAP_gather_royal_pacifists_support_desc: There are many within the royal family who do not support the idea of military dominance over politics and the doctrine of total war. We should reach out to Sadako Kujō, Nobuhito and Koichi Kidō to gain their support for our ousting of the military elements from our government.
loc.JAP_gather_royal_pacifists_support_tt: Should §YEmperor Hirohito§! side with the military during the §YCivil War§!, we will be able to retain §YRoyal Support§! from his younger brother §YNobuhito§! and his mother §YSadako Kujō§!
loc.JAP_limit_military_power_desc: In order to prevent another coup d'etat, we should move to demote as many military personnel out of powerful positions as we can without inciting a rebellion. By doing this, we may be able to stop them from snuffing out the torch of liberty.
loc.JAP_limit_military_power_tt: When the §YCivil War§! happens, the opposing side will gain the following national spirit for §Y365§! days:
loc.JAP_divert_military_funds_desc: As a rebellion seems ever closer, if we want to weaken the military enough to the point where they won't be able to strike us down, we must divert their funding away toward other sources. By doing this, they should find themselves at a deficit for quite some time going forward.
loc.JAP_divert_military_funds_tt: Every state not under §YArmy Control§! will join us at the start of the §YCivil War§!
loc.JAP_sway_the_navy_moderates_desc: There are a lot of high-ranking people within the navy who are much more reasonable than those in the army. If we approach the former members of the treaty faction, we may be able to gain their endorsement, and maybe even support in the case of civil war.
loc.JAP_sway_the_navy_moderates_tt: We will keep a larger share of the §YImperial Navy§! and their forces for the §YCivil War§!
loc.JAP_bribe_generals_desc: Though radical, not all of our military staff want to be on the side of evil. They join their comrades in the military because of duty and honor, but perhaps they can be convinced to support a better cause, given sufficient time and effort.
loc.JAP_appoint_new_generals_desc: Now that many generals have decided to oppose us, we are facing a shortage of competent officers to lead our troops. We must do all we can to remedy this, and hire the new generation of army commanders.
loc.JAP_implement_army_reforms_desc: With the removal of the old military staff, it is also high time we remove their outdated ideas of warfare. The army will slowly be reorganized into a self-defense force, and the 'first strike principle' will soon be yet another idea of the past.
loc.JAP_implement_army_reforms_tt: §RRemoves§! the ability to gain the §YFirst Strike Principle§! and §YKantai Kessen§! modifiers offered by the focus §YImperial Defense Plan§!
loc.JAP_a_new_take_on_state_shintoism_desc: The religious policy and political theory that arose during the times of the Meiji government, referred to as the Jinja hishūkyōron, promotes the idea that Shinto Shrines are secular in their nature rather than religious, and that Shinto is simply secular set of Japanese national traditions. We should continue promoting this theory, so that we can utilize this movement to our own benefit.
loc.JAP_crush_the_spirit_of_gekokujo_desc: During the early Showa period, repeated acts of gekokujō occurred, in which the lower ranked men within the military tried to oust those in a higher position, something which threatens to disrupt our chain of command. We must crack down on these ideas as soon as possible!
loc.JAP_organize_a_general_election_desc: Now that the civil strife is finally over, it is time we prepare to rebuild and return to our democratic traditions. For the first time since Meiji himself, we should hold an election free of influence and corruption from the military, and let the people decide their own future!
loc.JAP_draft_the_showa_constitution_desc_ke: We accept and respect our nation's imperial history. However, authoritarianism has no place in the Japan we want to build. We will maintain the new Emperor as a figurehead leader, but we will limit his power in the constitution, much as is the case in many Western countries.
