We accept and respect our nation's imperial history. However, authoritarianism has no place in the Japan we want to build. We will maintain the Emperor as a figurehead leader, but we will limit his power in the constitution, much as is the case in many Western countries.
loc.JAP_form_the_ldp_desc: Now that the Rikken Seiyūkai has secured both control of the diet and the cabinet, it is time for it to be reformed into a more efficient governing body. Following Ichiro Hatoyama's directive, it is time to establish the Liberal Democratic Party, aimed at ruling the nation for the foreseeable future.
loc.JAP_rikken_minseito_victory_desc: The outcome of the election has been decided. The liberal-progressive Rikken Minseitō has won a landslide victory, and are set to be a clear majority going forward. It seems the people have decided which direction they want the country to go.
loc.JAP_rikken_minseito_victory_flag: The Rikken Minseitō has won the General Election
loc.JAP_rikken_seiyukai_victory_desc: The outcome of the election has been decided. The liberal-conservative Rikken Seiyūkai has won a landslide victory, and are set to be a clear majority going forward. It seems the people have decided which direction they want the country to go.
loc.JAP_rikken_seiyukai_victory_flag: The Rikken Seiyūkai has won the General Election
loc.JAP_minshu_shugi_desc: Though we have up until now followed the political doctrine of Minpon Shugi, true democracy lies in the bounds of Minshu Shugi. After all, 'in law the sovereignty of the nation resides in the people', which isn't the case in the Minpon doctrine, as it emphasizes monarchical sovereignty over all else. We must enshrine these new ideas into the constitution!
loc.JAP_minpon_shugi_desc: The political doctrine of Minpon Shugi which was born in the Taishō era can be defined as 'the policy in exercising political power of valuing the profit, happiness, and opinions of the people'. This does not violate the imperial institution, and works well to benefit both the people and emperor. We should continue our democracy based on monarchical sovereignty, and enshrine it into our new constitution!
loc.JAP_promote_meritocracy_desc: A country will not function efficiently if we do not promote those who do well to positions befitting them. A man knowledgeable in electronics should lead the electronics industry, not some politician with connections to the cabinet. It is time we root out the traditions of Amakudari, and embrace meritocracy for the good of the nation!
loc.JAP_experimental_housing_solutions_desc: Urban development should be guided by four functional categories: dwelling, work, transportation, and recreation. Kenzo Tange alongside other fledgling architects have proposed a new way of constructing cities, as part of a new and upcoming movement they refer to as metabolism. We should promote this idea, so that we may improve the living situation for all of our citizens.
loc.JAP_embrace_amakudari_desc: Amakudari, literally meaning the descent from heaven, describes the practice where our retired high-ranking bureaucrats take on senior management positions in private companies, often within the same industry they previously regulated. Though it may far worsen the efficiency of our industries, it does give us significant insight in and control over our society.
loc.JAP_agricultural_protectionism_desc: The world economy has grown more and more hostile to our traditional ways of production. If we do not take measures to protect our farmers, we will soon face a crisis of untold proportions as our farmers are unable to remain competitive in the face of mass-produced foodstuffs coming in from overseas.
loc.JAP_machida_chuuji_focus_desc: Machida Chūji, the current leader of the ruling Rikken Minseitō, should be encouraged to form a new cabinet which will push through the establishment of our new constitution. With this, we will no longer have an interim prime minister, and the order from before the strife began will finally be restored.
loc.JAP_abe_isoo_focus_desc: Abe Isoo, the current leader of the Shakai Taishūtō and the father of Japanese baseball, should be encouraged to form a new cabinet which will push through the establishment of our new constitution. With this, we will no longer have an interim prime minister, and the order from before the strife began will finally be restored.
loc.JAP_uplift_labor_unions_desc: The labor unions help our people govern themselves, and aid us with rebuilding and repairing the industries that were damaged by the military both before and during the civil war. We should uplift these organizations further, until we can one day form a Japanese welfare society.
loc.JAP_tokugawa_iesato_focus_desc: The vastly popular Tokugawa Iesato, the President of the House of Peers and heir to the Tokugawa Shogunate, should be encouraged to form a new cabinet which will push through the establishment of our new constitution. With this, we will no longer have an interim prime minister, and the order from before the strife began will finally be restored.
loc.JAP_ichiro_hatoyama_focus_desc: Ichiro Hatoyama, the current leader of the ruling Rikken Seiyūkai, should be encouraged to form a new cabinet which will push through the establishment of our new constitution. With this, we will no longer have an interim prime minister, and the order from before the strife began will finally be restored.
loc.JAP_mitsumasa_yonai_focus_desc: Mitsumasa Yonai, the moderate admiral who was an important part of the pro-western treaty faction within the navy, should be encouraged to form a new cabinet which will push through the establishment of our new constitution. With this, we will no longer have an interim prime minister, and the order from before the strife began will finally be restored.
loc.JAP_limit_the_emperors_power_desc: The emperor remains an important part of our society, but can still be a threat to our democracy if he pleases. We must endeavor to limit the power of our constitutional monarch, so that we may never again lose our democratic values.
loc.JAP_ensure_civil_liberties_desc: With peace and prosperity once again returning to our nation, it is time we fulfill some of the promises we had made. We should ensure that all civil liberties can be fulfilled in the new Japan, and begin producing new movies to promote our democracy.
loc.JAP_crush_the_internal_factions_desc: The rivalry between the factions within the country, all vying for the approval of the emperor has had devastating consequences. Now with the government in full control of the situation again, it is time we solidify who holds the real power, and show to the other internal factions that we are not to be messed with.
loc.JAP_democratic_war_with_manchukuo_desc: The Kwantung Army has severed ties with us ever since the civil war, and has taken control over Manchuria. The people there still live under the authoritarian oppression that we once did, and require salvation. It is time we finish what we started.
loc.MAN_kwantung_army_took_control_flag: The Kwantung Army took control of Manchuria
loc.JAP_democratic_war_with_china_desc: The people in the Shanghai International Settlement are currently under threat by the corrupt Chinese regime and their cronies. We must step in and save them, lest blood be shed unnecessarily!
loc.JAP_closer_ties_with_the_usa_desc: With the democratic system now secured within our country, our diplomats have been hard at work repairing the relations that the military tarnished, beginning with the United States of America. We should approach them, and see if we can secure a deal that will secure our friendship for the years to come.
loc.JAP_ally_the_philippines_desc: Having recently reestablished our ties with their former overlords, perhaps it is time we extend an offer to the [PHI.GetAdjective] government inviting them to join our alliance. As we see it, we would both stand to benefit greatly from this deal.
loc.JAP_strike_the_soviets_desc: We stand as a bulwark against the Bolsheviks who stole northern Karafuto from us. Ever since the Siberian Expedition and the Russo-Japanese War, our people are once again itching for a fight with [SOV.GetNameDef], to finally oust them from east Siberia and secure our sphere of influence.
loc.JAP_free_colonized_asian_countries_desc: There are many nations in Asia that are currently under the occupation of Western powers. As the new guardians of Asia, we should approach these Westerners and try to make offers they cannot refuse, granting us control over these colonies.
loc.JAP_free_colonized_asian_countries_tt: Unlocks decisions to §YDemand Overlordship§! of §YAsian Nations§! that are subjects of §YNon-Asian Nations§!
loc.JAP_fund_resistance_groups_in_asia_desc: There are many on our continent who struggle against foreign oppression, and who would gladly take our help, should we offer it. We should use this as an opportunity to weaken the western powers, and promote freedom and liberty for all of Asia!
loc.JAP_fund_resistance_groups_in_asia_tt: Unlocks §Ydecisions§! to increase resistance and gain attack bonuses in occupied Asian states
loc.JAP_sea_rekindle_the_old_alliance_desc: Our best chances for success lie with our erstwhile ally in the Great War. We will re-activate the old alliance and stand with [ENG.GetNameDef] in the defense of democracy.
loc.JAP_create_greater_east_asian_treaty_org: An alliance of our own with other Asian nations will allow us to stand firmly against any potential threats to our new-found way of life. It is time we embrace our destiny as the guardians of the continent, and begin leading it into the future.
Unlocks decisions to invite §YNon-Aligned§! and §YDemocratic§! §YAsian§! and §YOceanian§! nations to our faction
loc.JAP_form_greater_east_asian_customs_unio: Form the Greater East Asian Customs Union
As has been planned by our economic theorists for a long time, we should endeavor to establish the Pacific customs union, and slowly but surely unite the Asian economies into one most powerful force.
loc.JAP_form_greater_east_asian_currency_uni: Form the Greater East Asian Currency Union

We should move towards the use of a singular currency in all of Asia, something our old political theorists had referred to as the Yen bloc. It is high time we take another step towards this goal, and form a currency union for all of our newfound allies.
Unlocks decisions to invite our allies to the §YCurrency Union§!
loc.JAP_an_integrated_union_desc: The integration of our allies' economies with ours, and the establishing of an Asian central bank which can monitor and aid the other states' economic situation, will be very beneficial for us in the long run, not only strengthening us, but also increasing their reliance on us, eventually allowing us to take control of their foreign affairs.
loc.JAP_an_integrated_union_tt: Every §YFaction Member§! will receive the §YEvent:§! [JAP.GetNameDefCap] Wishes for Further Integration of our Economy
loc.JAP_an_integrated_union_2_tt: Unlocks decision to invite allies to have their §YEconomies Become Increasingly Integrated§! with ours, allowing for us to §YAttempt to Subjugate them Diplomatically§! afterwards
loc.JAP_greater_east_asian_federation_desc: The day has finally come, where we can unite the Asian peoples under one state! We should move quickly to integrate our constituent parts, and form the Greater East Asian Federation, spreading democracy to all corners of Asia.
loc.JAP_allied_civilian_administration_integ: Unlocks Decisions to: §YIntegrate our Subjects' Civilian Administrations§!, allowing for us to §YAnnex§! our §YPuppets§!
loc.JAP_greater_east_asian_federation_tt: We will be known as §Ythe Greater East Asian Federation§!
loc.JAP_greater_east_asian_federation_2_tt: Unlocks decisions to integrate §YAsian§! states that are under our §YControl§!
loc.JAP_democratic_womens_suffrage_desc: Ichikawa Fusae has long been a proponent for extending the vote to include women. Now with the political situation stabilized, it is time we grant suffrage to the women of Japan, so that they too may be able to contribute to our growing success.
loc.JAP_launch_the_income_doubling_plan_desc: Osamu Shimomura, an economist who recently joined the Economic Stabilization Board of Japan has proposed what he refers to as the Income Doubling Plan, a plan he claims will play a central role in economic planning, helping lay the foundation for our high-speed economic growth. We should take him up on his offer, and see where it leads us.
loc.JAP_reform_the_education_system_desc: The current education system still holds all of the flaws of the imperial institutions, and fails to reach our kids efficiently enough, leading to us falling behind the western nations. We should reform it with utmost haste, to ensure it doesn't stay that way.
loc.JAP_democratic_women_in_the_workforce_de: Gender has long been a determining factor in where an individual is expected to serve their country, be it on the front, in the factories or at home. By pursuing a more equal division of burdens we allow for a larger workforce, and a larger army, should the need arise.
loc.JAP_taiheyo_belt_desc: Our economists are referring to a new plan to create an urbanization zone they call the Taiheiyō Belt that stretches from Tokyo to Fukuoka, connecting the areas in a megalopolis that will enable easier movement and economic and industrial endeavors throughout most of the southern home islands. We must make this a reality!
loc.JAP_shinkansen_desc: Chief engineer Hideo Shima has come up with a plan to create a bullet train line he dubs the Tokaido Shinkansen that will connect Tokyo, Nagoya and Osaka, enabling quick and easy transport for both goods as well as civilians between our major cities. We should invest into this project.
loc.JAP_shinkansen_tt: When the national spirit §Y$JAP_shinkansen_construction_idea$§! is removed:\n
loc.JAP_pursue_international_trade_desc: Though we have been trading with foreign powers ever since Commodore Matthew Perry ended our isolation, it has been far from enough. We should focus heavily on the international market, and ensure we can gain the resources we need through diplomacy, rather than war.
loc.JAP_seek_foreign_investments_desc: Now that we have opened up further, we should utilize our newly established connections to attract investments of foreign capital, and boost our own industries in the process.
loc.JAP_seek_foreign_investments_tt: Unlocks decisions to §YAttract Foreign Investments§! to gain §YCivilian Factories§! in exchange for §YPolitical Power§!
loc.JAP_invest_in_foreign_industries_desc: We should use the vast amounts of capital we have gained to invest into foreign nations, granting them economic aid in exchange for gaining a portion of their natural resources, aiding other Asian nations while solving our own issues in the process.
loc.JAP_invest_in_foreign_industries_tt: Unlocks §YDecisions§! to invest in minor §YAsian§! nations' industries in return for resources
loc.JAP_democratic_foreign_exchange_allocati: The stock market is a powerful tool. We should utilize the flow of foreign capital and ensure that our economists and industrialists can invest as much of it as possible into our burgeoning nation.
loc.JAP_democratic_research_slot_desc: Tokyo Imperial University still operates under the ways of our old education system. In order to gain a new generation of intellectual talent who can aid our country in attaining a better future, we must invest in it and change the curriculum to be less controlled by national politics.
loc.JAP_offshore_coal_desc: The islands of Ikeshima and Hashima off the coast of Nagasaki serve as vital coal mines to dig it up from the seabed. We should expand these mines, and construct more homes on the islands to house an even bigger permanent workforce.
loc.JAP_democratic_nationalize_zaibatsus_des: The largest corporations of our nation have long had unprecedented political and economic power. It ends here. The state's control will not be challenged. We must nationalize them and use their capital for the people's gain!
loc.JAP_split_uo_zaibatsu_monopolies_desc: The largest corporations of our nation have long had unprecedented political and economic power. We must remind them they are still subordinate to the government's wishes, and split them up into smaller Keiretsu conglomerates, so that they are easier to manage.
loc.JAP_democratic_work_with_the_zaibatsus_d: The largest corporations of our nation have long had unprecedented political and economic power. With some finesse, we may be able to work alongside them and guide their efforts in our favor.
loc.JAP_lifetime_employment_desc: Shūshin koyō has been used by our major companies for some time now, beginning with the first economic successes in the 1920s. We should ensure that this defining characteristic of Japanese corporate culture aids us in attaining an economic miracle, so that we may one day surpass even the economies of the west.
loc.JAP_modernize_agriculture_desc: Our agricultural sector is as important as the industrial one. After all, our industries will not run if we cannot feed all of the mouths in our country. We should therefore invest in the development of new tools and improve road networks that connect our rural villages to our urban cities.
loc.JAP_civilian_nuclear_reactor_investments: As our scientists at the RIKEN institute have determined, nuclear power will be the energy of the future. We must invest in this new technology, so we may never need to burn coal again.
loc.JAP_guardian_of_the_pacific_desc: We will assume the role of guardian of all Asian states in and around the Pacific. Once freed from Western imperialism, they will require a guiding hand to lift them up as full-fledged democracies. The first step for achieving this goal is to offer to become the new protector of [ENG.GetNameDef]'s pacific colonial subjects.
loc.JAP_the_koiso_cabinet_desc: With the Emperor expressing growing distrust in the capabilities of [ROOT.GetLeader] and the Imperial Japanese forces, he has expressed a wish to unify the nation and seek a way out of the war, in order to avoid ultimate destruction of the nation. Though unpopular as a candidate among the politicians and generals, Koiso could have the ability to bring the nation out of the conflict.
loc.JAP_the_war_has_not_necessarily_develope: Staunch Opposition to the East-Asian Conflict

With the army-navy rivalry still a thorn in our side, and with our strategy for ending the war by striking a hard blow against our enemies having failed, it seems we are close to being out of options. Perhaps it is time to embrace dishonor, and bring about an era free from conflict.
Radical parts of the military will attempt to coup the government in an effort to stop the Emperor from broadcasting our nation's surrender.
loc.JAP_japans_longest_day_desc: The dishonorable prime minister and his cronies have been dealt with, and the misguided Emperor has been placed under house arrest. Now it is time to reinvigorate the war effort, and bring our nation back to the glory it is destined for.
loc.JAP_the_surrender_broadcast_desc: We have considered deeply the general trends of the world and the current situation of the Empire, and we have decided to take extraordinary measures to bring the current state of affairs to an end. The war situation has developed not necessarily to Japan's advantage, and we must accept this fact.
loc.JAP_the_surrender_broadcast_tt: We will be more likely to be able to retain control of the Home Islands if we surrender peacefully
loc.PRC_losing_border_war_result_tt: By §Ylosing§! the §YBorder War§!, we stand to gain:
loc.PRC_SOV_more_willing_to_send_lend_lease_: §Y[SOV.GetNameWithFlag]§! will be more willing to send Lend Lease
loc.PRC_USA_more_willing_to_send_lend_lease_: §Y[USA.GetNameWithFlag]§! will be more willing to send Lend Lease
loc.PRC_neighboring_SOV_tt: §Y[ROOT.GetName]§! must have a direct, or indirect border connection through §Yfaction members§!, with §Y[SOV.GetName]§!
loc.PRC_request_territory_tt: Requests that §Ycore states be transferred§! to our custody if they are §Ynot owned§! by their current controller or if their owner is §Y[ROOT.GetRulingIdeology]§!. \nCurrent effect:
loc.PRC_put_an_end_to_the_sufan: Put an End to the Sufan
loc.PRC_put_an_end_to_the_sufan_desc: When we arrived in [622.GetName], local Politburo Central Committee leader Liu Zhidan and the other local leadership was in the process of being purged in an anti-counterrevolutionary campaign. $PRC_bo_gu$ shall be tasked with putting an end to this nonsense.
loc.PRC_usurp_control_over_yanan_desc: [1032.GetName] to the south of us represents a logical next step in our attempt to re-establish a solid base area.
loc.PRC_usurp_control_over_yanan_tt: If [ROOT.GetName] is §Yin a faction§! with §Y[CHI.GetName]§! and another country controls §Y[1032.GetName]§!, and either of §Y[744.GetName]§! and §Y[283.GetName]§!:
loc.PRC_the_westward_expedition_desc: [NXM.GetNameDefCap] to the west represents a prime opportunity for us to expand. Should we organize a skirmish along the border of [1045.GetName], we might be able to capitalize on their inattention to us.
loc.PRC_the_eastward_expedition_desc: To the east of us [SHX.GetLeader] rules over [615.GetName], but we might be able to penetrate their defenses across the Yellow River.
loc.PRC_develop_yanan_soviet_desc: We have now managed to establish control over [1032.GetName], which represents an opportunity for us to expand our base areas. We shall now make [1032.GetName] the seat of our government.
loc.PRC_the_internal_enemy_desc: The fight against [CHI.GetLeader] and the government of [CHI.GetRulingParty] has been ongoing for a decade. We remember the purge of April 12 1927, and we must ensure that such indignity never gets repeated.
loc.PRC_know_the_enemy_desc: Our neighbors may be friendly for now, but we must take precautions to survey their defenses should the situation change.
loc.PRC_cooperate_ulanhu_desc: Yun Ze, or Ulanhu, is a committed Communist fighter from Mongolia, currently organizing to the north of our base areas. He has offered to take his forces to join us in [ROOT.capital.GetName] to fight by our side.
loc.PRC_burn_the_paper_tigers_desc: We will reach out to [CHI.GetName] and all others to seek the formation of a Second United Front against our common foes.
loc.PRC_rally_the_peasants_desc: The peasantry form our main power base, due to the mismanagement of [CHI.GetNameDef]. They have much to gain from our promised reforms.
loc.PRC_rally_the_28_bolsheviks_desc: The extensive knowledge of the 28 ½ Bolsheviks — trained in the Soviet Union as leaders for the government and army — must be utilized to its fullest in these trying times.
loc.PRC_guide_central_committee_desc: We must set a clear course for the Central Committee. If we cannot keep our party unified, we can never hope to unify China either.
loc.PRC_leadership_of_mao_desc: Mao has shown his mettle in the Long March, and him becoming more influential thanks to his skill is perhaps not a bad thing. After all, if we do not want to be constrained to our current borders, we will need strong leadership.
loc.PRC_expel_the_occupiers_desc: Whenever we have the strength to do so we should expel foreign forces from China, as they will otherwise stop at nothing to undermine us for their own gain.
loc.PRC_restore_territorial_integrity_desc: We will ask those loyal to our cause for a simple transfer of land.
loc.PRC_seek_support_from_ussr_desc: Our long-standing ally, [SOU.GetNameDef], has provided crucial aid to our revolution. For the revolution to succeed however, we must ask that they further increase this aid. After all, our revolution's success would allow them to focus their efforts on other frontiers.
loc.PRC_request_guarantees_desc: Our new course, inspired by the Soviet Union, would benefit greatly from their protection. Granting security guarantees would not be without risk for them, but the importance it would hold in dissuading potential enemies makes it a worthwhile one.
loc.PRC_request_guarantees_tt: §R[SOV.GetNameDefCap] may ask us to become a subject in exchange for the guarantee...§!
loc.PRC_on_guerilla_warfare_desc: As a theorist and author on guerrilla warfare, Mao and his newly-gained power will ensure proper use of our small, independent forces.
loc.PRC_dissent_in_the_united_front_default: Sow Dissent in the United Front
loc.PRC_dissent_in_the_united_front_desc: Even as we fight alongside our allies, we must highlight the advantages of our own ideology. Doing so might gain us supporters, potentially even among figures that play an important role on the other side of the alliance.
loc.PRC_establish_friendly_bases_desc: The large amounts of civilians in occupied territory give our infiltrators no trouble blending in as they commit acts of sabotage.
loc.PRC_establish_friendly_bases_2_tt: §REnemy occupied states§! that has §Y$PRC_guerilla_cells_active_2$§! or is a §Ycore state§! of a Subject with a foreign Overlord can now get §Y$PRC_anti_japanese_base$§!
loc.PRC_secure_the_peoples_support_desc: Even as we lack control over the majority of China, we must ensure its people's loyalty to our cause in case a civil war should break out again.
loc.PRC_rural_recruitment_desc: The occupier can never hope to monitor all rural settlements, making it possible for us to recruit there with minimal risk.
loc.PRC_rural_recruitment_tt: When §YInfiltrating§! a §Yrural§!, §Ydeveloped rural§! or §Ypastoral§! state, receive §G[?PRC_rural_recruitment_manpower]§! Manpower
loc.PRC_raid_weapon_depots_desc: Our infiltration efforts have allowed us to map the logistical networks of our enemies. We can exploit this to raid these networks, using the captured equipment to field even more agents.
loc.PRC_raid_weapon_depots_tt: Unlocks §Y$raid_type_PRC_weapons_depot_raid$§! wherever [ROOT.GetNameWithFlag] has established §YGuerilla Cells§! or §Y$PRC_anti_japanese_base$§! in order to gain §Y$infantry_equipment$§! and §Y$artillery$§!
loc.PRC_empower_the_guerillas_desc: As our guerilla forces gain experience, we can start allowing them to operate independently. That will enable the forces to infiltrate even further and prevent them from getting compromised if our contact with them is intercepted.
loc.PRC_empower_the_guerillas_tt: §GHalves the cost§! for taking §Y$PRC_guerilla_warfare_sea_cat$§! Decisions and Unlocks Decisions to replace §Y$PRC_guerilla_cells_active_1$§! with §Y$PRC_guerilla_cells_active_2$§!. Effective changes:
loc.PRC_holding_half_the_sky_desc: The position of women in Chinese society has long been unequal. As we strive for equality, we must change this as well. As Mao once said, Women hold up half the sky, and we must allow them to contribute to the revolution.
loc.PRC_question_the_faction_leadership_desc: To gain further influence, we should highlight the mistakes made by our alliance's leadership, while highlighting our own successes.
loc.PRC_to_unify_a_country_desc: With our position strengthened both politically and militarily in the territory of other warlords, we must demand that we gain the resources and recognition this deserves.
loc.PRC_to_unify_a_country_tt: Hands over any state that has been successfully §YInfiltrated§! by §Y[ROOT.GetName]§!
loc.PRC_strengthen_the_central_party_school_: Training new party officials through the Central Party School means that the 28 ½ Bolsheviks and their supporters that were trained in the Soviet Union will gradually become outnumbered by officials trained by this school.
loc.PRC_propaganda_efforts_desc: Propaganda is a key part of recruiting followers for our revolution, as well as keeping our already recruited followers confident. Our propaganda could even be used by our allies when they rally their populations to defend China.
loc.PRC_propaganda_efforts_1_tt: Gain §G[?PRC_gain_faction_inluence_number|%]§! §YFaction Influence§! for each §YGuerilla Warfare§! Decision and §YInfiltrating§! [CHI.GetAdjective] States
loc.PRC_propaganda_efforts_2_tt: Gain §G[?PRC_gain_faction_inluence_number|%]§! §YFaction Influence§! for each §YGuerilla Warfare§! Decision
loc.PRC_establish_yanan_university_desc: The current network of separate schools for arts, sciences and political education is very inefficient. By merging these schools, we could teach more effectively and broaden the fields of knowledge of our students by having them exchange their varied knowledge.
loc.PRC_peaceful_reunification_desc: We are the true leaders of China, and this fact must be recognized once and for all. We will seek to persuade [WTT_current_china_leader.GetNameDef] of this fact. Should they refuse... well... the nation will see them for who they truly are.
loc.PRC_adopt_sun_yat_sens_principles_desc: The principles of Sun Yat-sen: nationalism, democracy and welfare, are by no means mutually exclusive with the communist values we strive for. His vision that once stabilized China may now be further realized.
loc.PRC_establish_democratic_socialism_desc: Our major achievements for China may be immortalized in the history books, but when difficult times return, these achievements won't mean much. And so the people must feel they can guide the revolution and hold the government accountable with their vote if it ever fails its duties.
loc.PRC_form_central_social_affairs_departme: The adjustment of our revolution's goal will inevitably lead to discussions between its supporters and opponents. This ideological discourse does however run the risk of drifting towards anti-revolutionary topics, and so we must establish an intelligence agency to monitor the effects of the entrenchment of Maoism.
loc.PRC_reform_the_republic_desc: The Republic was a good idea, poorly executed. We are the true followers of the ideals of the Republic.
loc.PRC_asian_democratic_union_desc: To promote equality, we must cooperate with our Asian partners to ensure that they have a strong negotiating position on the world stage.
loc.PRC_asian_democratic_union_tt: §Y$PRC_asian_democratic_union_modifier$§! increases §YResearch Speed§! by §G+1.00%§! and §YConsumer Goods Factories Factor§! by §Y-2.0%§! for every new faction member, up to a maximum of Research Speed §G+10.0%§! and Consumer Goods Factories Factor §Y-20.0%§!
loc.PRC_yanan_rectification_movement_tt: Depending on the current value in §Y$PRC_communist_power_struggle$§!, §Y$PRC_maoism_dynamic_modifier$§! will get different modifiers.\nCurrent Effect:
loc.PRC_yanan_rectification_movement_desc: The successes of our regime can so far be attributed to Mao, and we must use this prestige to solidify Maoism in our party. Changing the party constitution to include Mao's ideas, and claiming these to be the first form of communism adapted to China's specific conditions, will make opposing these ideas more difficult.
loc.PRC_enforce_maoism_desc: To further strengthen the position of Maoism we should fully connect the ideology to leadership of the state and party, making Mao a symbol of the entire nation.
loc.PRC_deepen_the_dixie_mission_desc: The commitment [USA.GetNameDef] has shown in their cooperation with [ROOT.GetNameDef] is admirable. Perhaps they would be willing to expand the Dixie mission with [USA.GetAdjective] experts to modernize our industry.
loc.PRC_invite_the_dixie_mission_desc: As a rising power in Asia, we should probe if [USA.GetNameDef] would be interested in establishing diplomatic ties. Perhaps they, unlike the imperialist powers around us, would be willing to help build a China that can defend itself against outside threats.
loc.PRC_overthrow_the_ussr_desc: The ideological differences between us and the other communist powers are not solely to blame on our adjustment to the situation in China. Reactionary and totalitarian policies by these powers have gone too far, and we should intervene so that their proletariat can be freed from their muddied form of revolution.
loc.PRC_overthrow_the_ussr_tt: Gains §YAnnex§! war goal against every major Communist country. Current effect:
loc.PRC_two_soviets_together_desc: Despite the altered course we have set with our ideology, we still have strong ideological ties to [SOV.GetNameDef], and of course have not forgotten their material and political support over the years.
loc.PRC_tech_agreement_with_ussr: The Agreement on New Defense Technologies
loc.PRC_tech_agreement_with_ussr_desc: The advanced state of our revolution lets us contribute with research to our partnership with [SOV.GetNameDef]. After we catch up with their technology in various fields, we can share our evaluation of their equipment, free of the biases inherent to having developed it.
loc.PRC_the_end_of_capitalism_desc: Our close cooperation with [SOV.GetNameDef] has strengthened our alliance enough that it may now be able to challenge the capitalist powers. Together, we can spread the revolution and liberate their colonial lands.
loc.PRC_purge_the_world_of_fascism_desc: Despite promising to diverge from capitalism, the fascist's hatred towards communism is evidence enough that this is just a farce. The radical means we employ to free the proletariat are used by the fascists to suppress it, and that is something we should intervene against.
loc.PRC_hundred_regiments_offensive_desc: The expansion of our army and its organization into many independent contingents will allow us to wreak havoc on the enemy's supply lines.
loc.PRC_prepare_for_the_inevitable_desc: Expansionist overtures from both [JAP.GetNameDef], and potentially even our traditional ally [SOV.GetNameDef] loom on the horizon. We must put ideological concerns aside and prepare to present a unified front against outside threats.
loc.PRC_reclaim_the_grasp_of_power_desc: The power that shifted towards Mao due to his military leadership of the Long March is finally returning to the former leaders of the Party. With the Long March over, $PRC_wang_ming$ or $PRC_bo_gu$ stand ready to take up the mantle of leadership again.
loc.PRC_playing_both_sides_desc: We must seek to ensure the loyalty of the people in the warlord and [CHI.GetAdjective] states, should the time ever come for a decisive battle for the future of our country.
loc.PRC_the_fight_of_a_people_desc: Our people must resist the advance of our enemies, even when they find themselves in territory occupied by them. We should send small units to rally local resistance to effectively undermine the occupier, and ultimately liberate the homeland.
loc.PRC_a_stronger_united_front_desc: We should show [CHI.GetName] that we are a reliable ally so they do not feel the need to keep resources in reserve in case we break the alliance. We shall be allowed more involvement in decision-making.
loc.PRC_sino_allied_pact_of_non_aggression_d: As we remove foreign influence from China, we must ensure that the less expansionist major powers do not get involved.
loc.PRC_sino_allied_pact_of_non_aggression_a: They will sign a §YNon-Aggression Pact§! with §Y[ROOT.GetName]§!
loc.PRC_with_inspiration_from_nkvd_desc: The Soviet NKVD that many of our leaders have heard about through their connections with Soviet officials must serve as an example of how to protect against enemies from within.
loc.PRC_soviet_technological_cooperation_des: We will look towards [SOV.GetNameDef] for a research agreement to further the cause of both of our nations.
loc.PRC_reestablish_moscow_sun_yat_sen_unive: By reestablishing and increasing funding for the Moscow Sun Yat-sen University, we can help guide and improve the nation by fostering future generations of scholars in the vein of the 28 and a half that came before.
loc.PRC_a_truly_united_front_desc: We need to strengthen our diplomatic corps and improve the position of the Second United Front.
loc.PRC_part_of_the_comintern_desc: With the revolution at home progressing, we can focus on aiding the Comintern with its international goals.
loc.PRC_petition_for_freedom_desc: For far too long has our independence been in the hands of others - it is time to change this, once and for all.
loc.PRC_aggressive_pursuit_of_diplomacy_desc: Though we would like to pursue more civilized forms of diplomacy, sometimes the threat of violence is what it takes to see our will prevail. And if the threat does not work...
loc.PRC_supreme_infiltration_desc: Through our previous experience with infiltration we have picked up learnings that we can now use to extend such operations, bringing more and more of our countrymen over to our side.
loc.PRC_scholarly_revolution_desc: Our leaders came from the intelligentsia, and we must shape the future of the [ROOT.GetAdjective] through their lens.
loc.PRC_towards_one_china_desc: The warlord states compromise China's stability too much to remain in existence and so centralized leadership should be established.
loc.PRC_towards_one_china_bypass_tt:
§YEvery Chinese Nation§!: One of the following must be true: 
  Does not exist
  Is at war with §Y[ROOT.GetNameWithFlag]§!
  Is a subject of §Y[ROOT.GetNameWithFlag]§!
  Is in a faction with §Y[ROOT.GetNameWithFlag]§!
  §Y[ROOT.GetName]§!: has a §Ywar goal§! against them.
loc.PRC_towards_one_china_tt: Gains §YAnnex§! war goal against every non-allied Chinese country. Current effect:
loc.PRC_allow_autonomous_regions_desc: The unique demands of each region in China should be acknowledged by allowing a degree of autonomy.
loc.PRC_allow_autonomous_regions_tt: \nEvery §Yallied Chinese country§! may choose to become §Y[ROOT.GetNameDef]'s§! subject. Current effect:
loc.PRC_the_peoples_republic_desc: Now that the revolution has been firmly established, we can start to transition from a revolutionary state to one that can offer its citizens stability and prosperity with its reforms.
loc.PRC_taiwan_desc: The loss of Taiwan to the Japanese by the former Qing government must be undone, even if the necessity of aerial or naval support pose a unique challenge.
loc.PRC_reclaim_tibet_desc: The instability in China allowed [TIB.GetNameDef] to break away from Chinese rule, but the historical connections between our nations cannot be ignored. We must aim to reunite with them so that our border can once again reach the Himalayas.
loc.PRC_subjugate_korea_desc: The occupation of Korea by [JAP.GetNameDef] and their subsequent expansion into Manchuria shows that an allied Korea is crucial to [ROOT.GetAdjective] safety. If that is not currently an option, we should intervene.
loc.PRC_dare_to_struggle_desc: With the warlord states now on our side, it is time to fight the foreign invaders that have colonized parts of China.
loc.PRC_dare_to_win_desc: Expansion of the imperialist predecessors of [SOV.GetNameDef] into Chinese lands has been forgiven in favor of better relations, but not forgotten. We should try to restore our original borders now that we have the means to do so.
loc.PRC_move_capital_desc: After the formation of the $PRC_proclaimed_communism$, it is only natural that we move our seat of government and restore the name of the city to Beijing.
loc.PRC_education_reform_desc: We will take the steps to enable a rapid, nationwide educational reform aimed at adopting Soviet-style higher education, with a focus on engineering and technical educations.
loc.PRC_the_first_premier_desc: $PRC_zhou_enlai$ will be named as the first Premier of the $PRC_proclaimed_communism$, cementing his position as one of the foremost politicians of the Party.
loc.PRC_the_party_builds_the_nation_desc: Now that we control large swathes of China, it is time we start a nationwide campaign to make use of our population and burgeoning industry.
loc.PRC_the_chinese_century_desc: Economic growth combined with enough political power to shape the world are what this nation has been yearning for, and now received. The Rise of China begins now - this is our century.
loc.PRC_the_unwilling_diarchy_focus_desc: Desperate times call for desperate measures - we must replace the existing Party Organs to ensure that the new leadership has the agency to quickly act against any enemy of the People. \n\nMao and Guotao must put aside their differences and work together.
loc.PRC_the_unwilling_diarchy_focus_tt: You will not be able to form or join the §YSecond United Front§!
loc.PRC_the_response_to_a_threat_desc: We will do what needs to be done to respond to all the threats surrounding us. We must prepare for the attack.
loc.PRC_promote_regular_army_desc: Only through conventional means can we ensure that the Red Army is capable of defending, and enlarging, the territories of [ROOT.GetNameDef].
loc.PRC_strict_training_regiments_desc: We must tighten up the discipline of the Red Army.\n\nDaily morning training routines will lead to a professional army in no time, and improve the quality of recruits reaching the line units.
loc.PRC_army_reforms_desc: The Red Army is outdated and based on an old doctrine that does not hold true after the Long March. We must rebuild the army from the ground up.\n\nA new series of reforms by [ROOT.GetLeader] in conjunction with the leading generals will lead to a new, stronger Red Army.
loc.PRC_centralized_army_command_desc: A decentralized command will not serve us well. All information must flow through a new command structure to increase proper operational planning from the top down to the lowliest recruit.
loc.PRC_soviet_battle_tactics_desc: By emulating the tactics of [SOV.GetNameDef], we can aim to use our own, comparable strength in numbers to our advantage. We will have a team of officers tasked to learn the lessons from [SOV.GetNameDef]'s experience.
loc.PRC_promote_guerilla_warfare_desc: The Red Army cannot hope to match the strength of our enemies - at least not yet. \n\nWe must play to our strengths and fight behind enemy lines, before quickly disappearing to strike again.
loc.PRC_the_battle_behind_the_front_lines_de: We must redouble our efforts to strike against the foreign aggressors behind their lines. By hampering their supply and ability to reinforce their front lines, we force the enemy to spend valuable manpower to protect their rear.
loc.PRC_gain_the_peoples_trust_desc: We will infiltrate the surrounding countryside, bribing and threatening the relevant individuals to ensure the loyalty of the people in areas not currently controlled by us. We will need their support in the coming days...
loc.PRC_limited_infiltration_efforts_desc: We must do what we can to unify China, with whatever means necessary. The people of China must be made aware that we have not forgotten them, and provide both material and immaterial support to them should the day come when it is needed
loc.PRC_secure_the_lands_desc: We are nearer than ever to the fulfillment of our goals - we must not hesitate now. We need to spend more resources to persuade the population under the control of the false government of the justice of our cause.
loc.PRC_launch_sabotage_campaigns_desc: Sabotage operations against the aggressors will help aid the cause of the Red Army and hamper the enemy's advance.
loc.PRC_raiding_parties_desc: What we lack in industrial might — compared to the enemy — we make up for in ingenuity. Sending out raiding parties will not only help to stabilize our own equipment situation, it will also worsen theirs.
loc.PRC_mobilization_of_the_people_desc: In times of crisis, the people will rise up.\n\nWe will establish militia units led by veterans of the Long March, and recruit and arm the local populace.
loc.PRC_mao_zedong_ascends_desc: $PRC_mao_zedong$ stands alone as the true leader of [ROOT.GetNameDef].\n\n$PRC_zhang_guotao$ can no longer be on the same level as Chairman Mao, there can be only one leader.
loc.PRC_promote_womens_suffrage_desc: 'Women hold up half the sky'. True gender equality is a goal of the Party, and we must take steps to ensure the legal, political, social and economic participation of women across China.
loc.PRC_zhang_guotao_ascends_desc: $PRC_zhang_guotao$ stands alone as the true leader of [ROOT.GetNameDef].\n\n$PRC_mao_zedong$ can no longer be on the same level as Chairman Guotao, there can be only one leader.
loc.PRC_consolidate_politcal_power_desc: One leader now stands supreme, and it is vital that we move to consolidate this throughout all the Party structures. Dissidents must not be allowed.
loc.PRC_consolidate_politcal_power_tt: Moves the §Y$PRC_communist_power_struggle$§! towards the leading side. Current effect:
loc.PRC_secure_lend_lease_from_soviet_desc: Past efforts to establish a land connection with [SOV.GetNameDef] failed disastrously. But now that we have overcome this, it will be much easier to receive supplies from them.
loc.PRC_preemptive_strike_desc: The aftermath of the 1927 uprising in Nanchang shows how effective the nationalist forces can be. To prevent another Long March, we must strike first, performing encirclements of our own and exploiting our more favorable positions.
loc.PRC_an_end_to_the_japanese_threat_desc: The [JAP.GetAdjective] presence on our doorstep poses a constant threat, as their imperialist ambitions have shown no limit. By striking first, we might be able to catch them off guard.
loc.PRC_assume_leadership_tt: Depending on the current value in §Y$PRC_communist_power_struggle$§!, §Y[ROOT.GetLeader]§! will get different traits.\nCurrent Effect:
loc.PRC_GetAssumeLeaderShipText_Wentian: The position of our new Chairman must be unquestioned. We have to move forward as a Party and a nation.
loc.PRC_GetAssumeLeaderShipText_NotWentian: The position of our new Chairman must be unquestioned. Former Chairman $PRC_zhang_wentian$ has played his part in stabilizing the Party but now is the time of [ROOT.GetLeader].
loc.PRC_emergency_supply_protocols_desc: Our supply system is not tenable. We must pour all our efforts into improving it, lest our troops be left without guns, ammunition and food.
loc.PRC_emergency_prodction_protocols_desc: To increase wartime production, we must set production quotas for our industry. Such a measure does risk alienating our supporters, but there are currently no alternatives.
loc.PRC_extend_emergency_measures_desc: We are closer than ever to solve our most critical issues, but we must extend our efforts or they will have been in vain.
loc.PRC_extend_emergency_measures_1_tt: With §Y$PRC_emergency_supply_protocols$§! completed, §Yincrease duration for [?PRC_emergency_protocol_idea_days] days§!, or:
loc.PRC_extend_emergency_measures_2_tt: With §Y$PRC_emergency_prodction_protocols$§! completed, §Yincrease duration for [?PRC_emergency_protocol_idea_days] days§!, or:
loc.PRC_to_support_the_army_desc: We will do what we must to extend the measures already taken, making these changes permanent. The Army must have what it needs to lead the Revolution.
loc.PRC_reach_out_to_the_west_desc: Despite its repeated actions against [ROOT.GetAdjective] sovereignty in the past, the West has many resources to offer that could help grow [ROOT.GetNameDef] into a world power.
loc.PRC_reach_out_to_the_west_tt: If a non-fascist, §YWestern Major country§! is fighting against a common enemy and neither has allies fighting each other:
loc.PRC_closer_ties_to_sov_desc: We must seek an even closer relationship to [SOV.GetNameDef]. The Sino-Soviet ties are strong, but must be made stronger.
loc.PRC_demand_warlord_loyalty: Demand the Loyalty of the Warlords
loc.PRC_demand_warlord_loyalty_desc: We must unite China under one leadership - and we must make clear to all whose leadership that would be.\n\nWe shall send a message to the Warlords - an offer to create a Government of National Defense. [CHI.GetLeader] might not approve, but it is necessary.
loc.PRC_bring_war_to_neighboring_warlords_de: There can be only one ruler of China - a first step to spreading the Revolution will be to subjugate the Warlords.
loc.PRC_bring_war_to_neighboring_warlords_tt: Gains §YAnnex§! war goal against all §Yneighboring Warlords§!. Current effects:
loc.PRC_lessons_of_the_west_desc: We will look beyond our borders to see what lessons can be drawn from other nations, learning from those whose industries have reached limits ours have not — yet.\n\nWe must catch up.
loc.PRC_the_long_march_towards_progress_desc: We must keep progressing. We may be behind technologically, but we shall not remain so. Resources must be put into strengthening the educational sector in [ROOT.GetNameDef].
loc.PRC_every_peasant_a_soldier_desc: Every able bodied person who toils in the fields must also be prepared to take up arms should the nation need it.\n\n'The revolutionary war is a war of the masses; only mobilizing the masses and relying on them can wage it.'
loc.PRC_avenge_the_century_of_humiliation_de: The 1800s represented a century of humiliation by the Western powers. It is time for the debt to be repaid.
loc.PRC_avenge_the_century_of_humiliation_tt: [ROOT.GetNameWithFlag] gains §YConquer (Focus)§! war goal against any neighboring §YWestern Country§! or its subjects. Current effects:
loc.PRC_the_march_to_victory_desc: The March to Victory is inevitable. What started as an Unwilling Diarchy has led to the creation of a strong and united party structure. Now we must look outwards, towards our internal enemies.
loc.PRC_a_new_central_committee_desc: It is time for a change. $PRC_zhang_guotao$ will order a full scale review of the Central Committee and build it from scratch.
loc.PRC_expedite_land_revolution_desc: The redistribution of land from landlords to the peasants has broken feudal structures in the countryside. The rural masses now stand firmly behind the revolution.
loc.PRC_halt_land_revolution_desc: To maintain stability, the revolutionary land program has been postponed. While the peasantry grumbles, local elites are placated, and short-term internal cohesion is preserved.
loc.PRC_reestablish_the_state_bank_desc: To properly manage our economy, we will need to re-establish our central bank. The $PRC_communism$ National Bank was founded in Central China but the Long March forced it to stop operating. Its equipment has since been in transit, and is now starting to reach [ROOT.capital.GetCapitalVictoryPoint.GetName].
loc.PRC_promote_the_silver_dollar_desc: Taking copper coins out of circulation in favor of silver will allow us to recycle the old metal for munitions production. The intrinsic value of our coins would also mean that our trading partners do not have to worry about an increase or decrease in the value of our currency, as it is linked to the value of silver.
loc.PRC_promote_paper_bills_desc: Paper money with inexpensive production costs would form a good replacement for copper coins, which can be recycled in the munitions factories. A major downside however is that our trade partners may be nervous about a currency of which we could easily change the value of by simply printing more of it.
loc.PRC_new_currency_established: Taking this focus will prevent the bad effects from §Y$PRC_equipment_from_copper_coins$§! if they have not yet occurred.
loc.PRC_allow_special_goods_trade_desc: The trade of special goods is something the government should acknowledge and take advantage of, ensuring partial control by taxing it.
loc.PRC_ban_special_goods_trade: Ban the Trade of Special Goods
loc.PRC_ban_special_goods_trade_desc: Despite the popularity of special goods, addiction is a serious issue that we should tackle with a ban. Even if such a reform initially would be unpopular, it is crucial in order to keep special goods from becoming an obstacle to the revolution, as alcohol formerly did in [SOV.GetNameDef].
loc.PRC_ban_special_goods_trade_tt: The upgraded §YNational Spirit§! which applies after a year will be:
loc.PRC_agricultural_reform_desc: Now that we have ensured that we can control the resources of our economy, we should continue agricultural reform by giving land from landlords to poorer farmers.
loc.PRC_eight_points_for_attention_desc: The $PRC_eight_points_for_attention$, as established by $PRC_mao_zedong$ state the importance of: Being polite when speaking, being honest when buying and selling, returning all borrowed articles, paying compensation for everything damaged, not hitting or swearing at others, not damaging crops, not harassing females, not mistreating prisoners.
loc.PRC_CSCEC_mils_desc: We will urge the CSCEC to specialize in military construction and pursue all means to that end. We need to improve our military production to stand a chance in the coming years.
loc.PRC_CSCEC_civs_desc: We will urge the CSCEC to specialize in industrial construction, it is after all where the CSCEC's strengths lie.
loc.PRC_industrialization_efforts_desc: The latest increase in agricultural output allows for some of our people to work in other industries. We should prioritize relocation to those industries that allow further growth, such as the production of building materials or tools for farms.
loc.PRC_construct_the_banqiao_dam_desc: A dam on the river Ru in [602.GetName] could provide the region with electric power. It would also help prevent floods, which have been especially severe in recent decades.
loc.PRC_resource_extraction_focus_desc: We will need to more comprehensively utilize the natural resources in our territory in order to increase industrial growth.
loc.PRC_connecting_the_country_desc: The expansion of our industry, and the increasing need to distribute goods previously made in self-sufficient but less efficiently operating communities, has made infrastructure more important than ever.
loc.PRC_establish_shorter_market_plans_desc: Drastic long-term plans for our economy may promise great rewards, but at great cost and with risks involved as well. Instead, we should focus on making sure that the industry we already possess has the means to perform optimally.
loc.PRC_initialize_five_year_plan: Initialize the First Five Year Plan
loc.PRC_initialize_five_year_plan_desc: The goal of the First Five Year Plan is to improve the production of the industry we already have, before using excess production to establish industry in entirely new sectors.
loc.PRC_urbanization_desc: To promote the development of heavy industry, we have to encourage formerly self-sufficient farmers to work in our industry, while the state ensures that other farmers produce enough to distribute to cities and countryside both.
loc.PRC_rural_region_development_desc: To facilitate improvement in the quality of life in [ROOT.GetNameDef], food production must be increased by investing in the modernization of farms in our rural areas.
loc.PRC_finalize_industrial_plan_desc: With our reform plans completed, we can now finalize our industrial plan by making sure that the new research center and production facilities cooperate as much as possible.
loc.PRC_great_production_movement_desc: Food shortages in [ROOT.GetNameDef], exacerbated by a series of natural disasters, led us to encourage change in communities that formerly relied on the government for food. They've ventured out to previously unproductive land to set up farms, and this effort should now be matched by our troops in sharing their engineering experience with their comrades.
loc.PRC_equipment_from_copper_coins_desc: Since we lack a large mining industry, copper coins could be smelted and used for bullets or other materiel.
loc.PRC_rally_the_industry_desc: Our relocation has left our industry disorganized. We should explore what we can make out of the production tools we brought on the Long March, and try to reuse these forgotten resources of our original bases.
loc.PRC_red_army_reborn_desc: Our new base in [622.GetName] must be solidified. Some of our losses can be compensated for by recruiting local volunteers, and we must make plans to protect our new home.
loc.PRC_asymmetric_warfare_desc: For centuries, outnumbered armies have sought to overcome impossible odds and so should we, through using the advantages that our enemies do not have. Better knowledge of the terrain, connections with local civilians and guerrilla tactics can all be used to gain the upper hand.
loc.PRC_conventional_warfare_desc: Although fighting a protracted war of attrition has its advantages, it is not without drawbacks. By restricting ourselves to opportunistic attacks, we become vulnerable to strikes against our production facilities. It is more difficult to boost morale with many small victories, and by avoiding large battles we could drag out conflicts that might otherwise be ended sooner.
loc.PRC_indirect_fire_desc: We will focus on creating an improved artillery force, focused on providing indirect fire on our enemies.
loc.PRC_three_rules_of_discipline_desc: As Mao formalized in the 20's as part of his military strategy, if we wish to gain more support from the populace, it is crucial that our troops do not use their power to steal property. And if we want to take full advantage of our limited resources, it is also critical that items that are taken from the enemy are given to the high command to be distributed.
loc.PRC_request_for_aid_desc: [SOV.GetNameDefCap] has since our inception been supportive of our efforts while also avoiding direct involvement. The current world situation however demands more than token support, and so a mission must be sent to request [SOV.GetAdjective] equipment to help build up our army.
loc.PRC_long_march_to_recovery_desc: The Long March to [622.GetName] caused enormous casualties to our army. It is time for us to reorganize our remaining troops, and set a course for restoring the glory of the Workers' and Peasants' Red Army.
loc.PRC_best_of_the_best_desc: Our armed forces will be focused on instilling the highest level of quality and professionalism. We must only accept the recruits that show the deepest dedication to the cause and possess the skills to match it.
loc.PRC_master_the_terrain_desc: Training to fight in the mountains and creating good maps of the terrain will allow us to outflank our enemies and get away safely after striking.
loc.PRC_to_steal_an_army_desc: Since our limited industry cannot keep up with the needs of our army, it has become crucial to use captured equipment when possible. This may impose logistical challenges, but with proper preparation and measures like ensuring a supply of spare parts, these may be overcome.
loc.PRC_role_of_kangda_desc: Our main military school, the [622.GetName] Red Army School - also known as Kàngdà - previously focused on training. It shall now become a center of innovation with increased funding, focusing on doctrines and equipment development, both domestic and foreign.
loc.PRC_develop_the_army_desc: With the army we have built so far now performing to the best of its ability, it is time we provide it with the means to modernize.
loc.PRC_to_serve_the_people_desc: We should ensure that our troops feel that we aim to fight for things that are in our peoples' interest. The soldiers must still honor their duty to the nation, and so should those that are not in the army also.
loc.PRC_prepare_for_596_desc: The threat of nuclear weapons is impossible to counter without such weapons of our own. The government should therefore recruit and support scientists in related fields so they can prepare a nuclear program.
loc.PRC_increase_domestic_production_capacit: Although we have managed to expand our influence with limited means, it is time we invest in our military industry. If we were to suffer another prolonged war, our stockpiled equipment would eventually be depleted or need repairs, and not being able to offer replacements would be disastrous.
loc.PRC_army_tank_research_desc: With our fledgling industry now capable of providing heavier armaments, it is time we catch up to other military powers and develop tank production facilities. This will give us a major advantage against neighboring countries without these weapons, and strengthen our position against those that do have their own armored forces.
loc.PRC_army_doctrines_desc: The doctrine we have painstakingly developed throughout the various conflicts we have been involved in must be adjusted to our new organization and armaments. Without integration, their advantages would be diminished.
loc.PRC_army_doctrines_tt: Gain bonus based on your selected §YGrand Doctrine§!:
loc.PRC_appeal_for_foreign_aid_desc: Requesting armor from [SOV.GetNameDef] will allow us to create an armored branch within our army, as well as to study their designs to improve our own.
loc.PRC_establish_pla_air_force_desc: As we expand outward from our mountain fortress and take over more of the lowlands, we become more vulnerable to air attack. Luckily, we have in our expansions also achieved the industrial strength needed in order to do something about this, and will manage the vulnerability immediately by establishing our own air force.
loc.PRC_appoint_chang_qiankun_desc: After studying at the Zhukovsky Air Force Academy in the Soviet Union, Chang Qiankun is now the perfect candidate to oversee our air force.
loc.PRC_the_northeast_aviation_university_se: Establishing a large scale training center for our air force would be a major step forward. No longer will we have to rely on schools abroad to teach our officers about doctrine, how to operate our equipment, or how to transfer these skills to our brave pilots.
loc.PRC_form_the_5th_research_institute_desc: News from recent conflicts has inspired a plan to construct a research facility focused on jet and rocket propulsion. The facility could be used to improve our aircraft designs, and later produce missiles and rockets.
loc.PRC_aviation_infrastructure_desc: The scale of [ROOT.GetNonIdeologyName] entails that to defend our airspace, having a lot of planes is not sufficient. Airfields in the right places, as well as tracking activity in our airspace, will be crucial.
loc.PRC_anti_air_effort_desc: The large scale of our airspace makes it difficult to provide enough planes and infrastructure to cover it all. Instead, anti-aircraft guns can be deployed to provide protection from aerial attack, and make a very cost-effective solution.
loc.PRC_establish_domestic_aircraft_producti: Domestic production of aircraft would reduce our dependence on foreign suppliers, as well as allowing us to adjust our designs to the needs of our nation.
loc.PRC_light_plane_focus_desc: Refining our light planes could let us achieve an advantage during aerial battles.
loc.PRC_medium_plane_focus_desc: To improve our capabilities in striking tactical targets, we should focus on medium plane designs.
loc.PRC_large_plane_focus_desc: With a focus on large planes, we can achieve designs that carry heavy payloads, and enough fuel to fly very long distances.
loc.PRC_establish_pla_navy_desc: Due to our previous lack of access to the coast, we face the difficult task of catching up to the naval forces of our enemies. A navy will not just allow us to protect our coast and newfound trade connections, but also spread our influence across the seas.
loc.PRC_dockyard_construction_efforts_desc: As we seek to establish a navy, we will need to make investments into several industries to produce vessels, while other factories — such as those making artillery — should be made to cooperate with the brand new sector.
loc.PRC_naval_mio_desc: Considering our previous lack of industry in the naval sector, the government should ensure that the newly formed organizations for naval production operate efficiently.
loc.PRC_the_pla_naval_school_desc: A new education center where new officers and sailors are trained could form a centralized place to teach the many skills required on a large ship, with courses ranging from navigation, to aircraft design and maintenance.
loc.PRC_reappoint_jinguang_as_admiral_desc: As our military lacks experience in naval warfare, the best candidate to lead our new navy may be an experienced commander of land forces.
loc.PRC_naval_infrastructure_effort_desc: To operate across the very long distance of the coastline of [ROOT.GetNonIdeologyName], we must provide the navy with infrastructure that will allow them to swiftly refuel or repair their vessels no matter their position.
loc.PRC_a_modern_army_desc: Now that we have refined our equipment, our doctrine, our training and more, we can finally be certain that we are as prepared as possible, no matter which foe we may face.
loc.PRC_air_force_capstone_desc: Our investment in the air force's equipment research should allow us to produce aircraft that will outperform those of the enemy. This will also facilitate the smooth integration of new advancements such as jet engines.
loc.PRC_naval_capstone_desc: With our navy now reorganized by [PRC_ziao_jingguang.GetName] and given the resources it needs to operate all forms of naval firepower, we can extend our influence over the pacific.
loc.PRC_peoples_liberation_army_sea_desc: Our Workers' and Peasants' Red Army now contains more and more experienced soldiers, and it is time that we fully embrace this change of character. In transitioning from a force of militia to an army of well-trained and well-equipped professional soldiers, it is time to form the People's Liberation Army's Ground Forces.
loc.PRC_central_military_commision_desc: With the branches of our military now reorganized and modernized, a body can be formed to coordinate these. This will give us better oversight over our army, as well as improving our capability to execute combined operations.
loc.PRC_prepare_for_third_phase_desc: Mao declared there to be three phases of guerilla warfare. After having performed the first two, aimed at gaining support and weakening our enemies, it is now time to turn to conventional means. We will further expand our territory by launching direct attacks on cities in the third and final phase.
loc.PRC_revolutionary_war_of_the_masses_desc: We should make clear that our party represents the common man more than the corrupt and elitist nationalist states do. Our goal is to fight these forces and create a better system.
loc.PRC_one_with_the_people_desc: Our commitment to fight for an improved [CHI.GetNonIdeologyName] must be highlighted as much as possible, to gather more volunteers for our army.
loc.PRC_strengthen_the_air_arsenal_desc: To improve our air force, we should invest in improving our equipment based on our experiences so far. A one-time investment to make our designs more reliable now may even save us money on replacements down the line.
loc.PRC_destroyers_desc: Although outdated, obtaining surplus Soviet Gnevny-class destroyers would build a foundation for our navy that does not require many years of constructing larger vessels. We can also overhaul and modernize these ships after having studied their performance.
loc.PRC_submarines_desc: The use of submarines in our coastal waters would be a cost-effective and survivable way to protect our coastal infrastructure. Although these submarines would not be designed for great depths, they would at least be a step towards developing more advanced models.
loc.PRC_cruisers_desc: Lightly-armed but versatile cruisers such as those of the Kirov class will allow us to protect the seas close to home. Let us purchase some incomplete hulls and finish construction.
loc.PRC_capital_ships_desc: The information we have on designs for the [SOV.GetAdjective] Kronshtadt-class battlecruisers can form a good basis for expanding our fleet with capital ships. These designs are modern to the point that the [SOV.GetAdjective] industry struggled with them, but for our expanding navy, these challenges are worth the result.
loc.PRC_carriers_desc: The development of aircraft carriers will allow us to compete with the major naval powers. The ability to deploy aerial forces anywhere our navy can reach will also improve our ability to project power in conflicts far from the homeland.
loc.PRC_naval_guns_desc: The groundwork we have laid for the construction of larger vessels will also allow us to make use of larger weaponry. These weapons could allow us to threaten even heavily-armored targets, and engage before we are within their effective range.
loc.PRC_naval_ocean_navy: From A Green Water Navy To A Blue Ocean
loc.PRC_naval_ocean_navy_desc: The reforms to our navy should now allow it to operate effectively at great distances from our supply bases. This will allow us to contain enemy forces before they even reach the neighboring seas.
loc.PRC_pilot_training_desc: The few experienced pilots we have cannot be risked in battle, instead, they should be recruited as instructors to train new pilots as our air force expands.
loc.PRC_night_attack_desc: Training our army for night attacks will further exploit our experience with asymmetric warfare.
loc.PRC_reorganize_divisions_desc: To further modernize our army, we should reorganize any remaining militia into divisions and make sure existing divisions are consistent in their strength. This will allow us to create a clear chain of command which will in turn make it easier to coordinate our troops.
loc.PRC_rural_region_development_two_desc: The modernization of our farms must be further supported by investing in infrastructure in our rural regions, such as schools and roads, which will help increase rural productivity.
loc.PRC_urbanization_two_desc: The expansion of our cities means that we can now accommodate larger construction projects to create homes and jobs. We will allow more people to move to the cities, and provide jobs while the construction is on-going.
loc.PRC_reinforce_base_area_desc: To avoid another campaign by the nationalist forces against our bases, we should consider every potential option to protect them.
loc.PRC_rebuild_28_bolshevik_desc: The support our new leadership has received clearly shows that it is trusted. This legitimacy will allow us to more easily gather supporters both internationally and at home.
loc.PRC_bolshevik_world_revolution_desc: The success of our revolution should not be contained by our borders. We must help the proletariat in other nations.
loc.PRC_bolshevik_urbanization_desc: While our current power base mostly consists of rural farmers seeking an improved quality of life, we must extend our message to those in the cities, as they face inequality too.
loc.PRC_embrace_stalinism_desc: With our leadership solidified, we can begin to implement Stalinist ideology to a greater extent. Further collectivization and rapid industrialization should be our key points of focus.
loc.PRC_embrace_stalinism_tt: Depending on the current value in §Y$PRC_communist_power_struggle$§!, §Y$PRC_bolshevik_dominance$§! will get different modifiers.\nCurrent Effect:
loc.PRC_bolshevik_aid_desc: The Soviet Bolsheviks are experienced in revolutionary warfare and might also be willing to contribute financially to our cause.
loc.PRC_party_control_desc: The success of our leadership should now allow us to take further control of the Chinese Communist Party.
loc.PRC_invite_pavel_mif_desc: Pavel Mif, a mentor to all of the 28 ½ Bolsheviks, should be invited to advise our government. His attendance will strengthen our ties with [SOV.GetNameDef].
loc.PRC_invite_otto_braun_desc: $PRC_otto_braun$ was together with $PRC_bo_gu$ one of the primary military commanders of the 1934 campaign. Admittedly, the campaign resulted in defeat, and Braun was sidelined during the Long March. However, our new leadership sees that this was not $PRC_otto_braun$'s fault, and seeks to reinstate him.
loc.PRC_invite_soviet_general_desc: $SOV_vasily_chuykov$'s and $SOV_aleksandr_cherepanov$'s extensive experience in the Russian Civil War and as attachés to [CHI.GetNameDef] would make them both a valuable addition to our army.
loc.PRC_bolshevik_urbanization_2_desc: Creating work in cities to encourage the rural population to move there would not just be advantageous for our economy, it would also increase our influence in cities that question the revolution.
loc.PRC_bolshevik_urban_industrialization_de: We must invest in our cities to encourage the formation of heavy industry.
loc.PRC_bolshevik_urbanization_completed_des: Our investment in urbanized areas has successfully increased our influence there. We can now look forward to a stronger cooperation between the communist organizations of the countryside and the cities.
loc.PRC_join_comintern_desc: With leadership of the Communist Party, and consequently the state, increasingly centralized, we can now appeal to join the Comintern as a reliable ally.
loc.PRC_rebuild_28_bolshevik_tt: Every §Y28 ½ Bolsheviks§! Member:\nImprove the efficiency of their traits
loc.PRC_rebuild_28_bolshevik_effect_tt:
Lose §Y$PRC_28_bolshevik_trait$§! and Gain §Y$PRC_28_bolshevik_trait_improved$§!.
§YEffective change:§!
Daily Political Power Gain: §G+0.12§!
Stability: §G+5.00%§!
Same ideology monthly opinion: §G+5.00%§!
loc.PRC_agricultural_reform_boom_desc: We must provide safety for our farmers for them to feel encouraged enough to produce the crops our nation needs.
loc.PRC_he_long_second_army: He Long and the Second Army
loc.PRC_he_long_second_army_desc: The largely intact state of He Long's army means we have a new primary force to guard [ROOT.capital.GetName]. His experience avoiding the nationalist forces is also something we should utilize.
loc.PRC_rural_survey_desc: Mapping the population and production in our rural areas will allow our later economic plans to run smoothly, and would also be useful if conscription becomes necessary.
loc.PRC_lessons_learnt_desc: The experience we have gained since the Long March should be used to fine tune the advances made within our military doctrine and training.
loc.PRC_rural_region_development_tt: Up to §YThree§! Rural States will get §G25%§! Local Supplies and §G15%§! Local Manpower.\nCurrent Effects:
loc.PRC_rural_region_development_two_tt: Up to §YTwo§! Rural States will get §G25%§! Local Supplies and §G15%§! Local Manpower.\nCurrent Effects:
loc.PRC_initialize_five_year_plan_tt:
§RFailure to meet the industrial targets by the plan deadline will result in penalties to your economic efficiency, reflecting the loss of central planning confidence.§!

§YTotal factories required for goals to be met:
[GetFiveYearPlanGoalCivFactoriesText] Civilian Factories
[GetFiveYearPlanGoalMilFactoriesText] Military Factories§!
loc.PRC_initialize_shorter_market_plans_tt:
§RFailure to meet the industrial targets by the plan deadline will result in big penalties to your economic efficiency, reflecting the loss of central planning confidence.§!

§YTotal factories required for goals to be met:
[GetShorterMarketPlansGoalCivFactoriesText] Civilian Factories
[GetShorterMarketPlansGoalMilFactoriesText] Military Factories§!
loc.PRC_naval_infrastructure_effort_tt: When requirements are met, this focus will give §YNaval Bases§!, §YCoastal Forts§!, and 1 §YNaval Headquarters§! if none have been built
loc.PRC_dockyard_construction_efforts_tt: When requirements are met, this focus will give §YNaval Dockyards§!
loc.PRC_urbanization_two_tt:
If §YXian§! and §YShanxi§! are controlled, they will become §YUrban Regions§!, giving 
 §G3§! Building Slots 
 §G1§! §YCivilian Factory§! 
 Add §YUrbanization Progress§! which grants: 
Local Construction Speed: §G+10%§!
loc.PRC_reinforce_base_area_tt: Construct level §G2§! §YLand Forts§! on the borders of §Y[622.GetName]§! and §Y[1046.GetName]§!. \nIf any border wars have been won: \nConstruct level §G1§! §YLand Forts§! on their borders
loc.PRC_he_long_has_arrived: He Long has arrived in Shaanxi
loc.PRC_mediating_secretary_remove_fake_idea: Remove §Y$PRC_mediating_general_secretary_idea$§!, which grants \nDaily Political Power Gain: §R-0.05§!\nStability: §G+10.00%§!
loc.PRC_infiltration_only_level_2_bolshevik_: Only decisions up to §Ytier 2§! available. Unlock §Ytier 3§! by taking the focus §Y$PRC_supreme_infiltration$§!.
loc.PRC_infiltration_only_level_2_guomao_tt: Only decisions up to §Ytier 2§! available. Unlock §Ytier 3§! by taking the focus §Y$PRC_secure_the_lands$§!.
loc.CHI_end_military_primacy_desc: The military has served its purpose, but its grip on power must be broken. Civilian authority must be restored if [ROOT.GetName] is to become a nation governed by law, not by generals.
loc.CHI_accelerate_the_tutelage_desc: The KMT has failed in delivering on the promises of the Xinhai revolution and subsequently Dr. Sun. Instead of teaching the populace about democracy they have exploited them for personal gain. We need to make up for lost time.
loc.CHI_accelerate_the_tutelage_tt: Unlocks decisions to §YExpedite the Political Tutelage§! of the people throughout the §YChinese Countryside§!
loc.CHI_revive_the_new_culture_movement_desc: Most of the early revolutionaries within the CCP and the KMT have been inspired by the New Culture Movement that opposed both the Qing Dynasty and Yuan Shikai. Only through the New Culture Movement's spirit will a new China arise from the ashes of the past!
loc.CHI_revive_the_chinese_action_committee_: The KMT has monopolized access to the army, drawing power to a small clique. However, some military experienced contrarians do disagree with the ruling group, although they do not support the Communists either.
loc.CHI_ally_the_young_china_party_desc: The Young China Party was founded by a group of Chinese students in Paris on the 2nd of December 1923, and has been the most prominent smaller movement within the country after the KMT and the CCP. They have envisioned good ideas for our future, ones we cannot simply ignore. We should ally with them immediately!
loc.CHI_invite_carsun_chang_desc: While the Western powers have been detrimental to [ROOT.GetAdjective] interests, some ideas can be useful to us. As Carsun Chang bridges the gap between these ideas and our Confucian context, he will be a rallying point for the democratic movement.
loc.CHI_give_protection_of_civil_rights_desc: Soong Qingling and The China League for the Protection of Civil Rights operated in the early 1930s, struggling against the KMT’s autocratic measures. The work they started, we shall continue by enshrining the rights of the common man.
loc.CHI_rural_reconstruction_movement_sea_de: Our cities are dynamic hubs of modernity, but the same cannot be said of the countryside. We should make concerted efforts to expand economic welfare and ideological support in our villages. By reaching out with our full influence, we can utilize areas that would otherwise remain neglected.
loc.CHI_rural_reconstruction_movement_sea_tt: Reduces the removal time for both §YRural and Urban Political Tutelage§! decisions by §G10§! days
loc.CHI_rural_reconstruction_movement_sea_2_: §YRural Tutelage§! decisions now also apply §Y$CHI_local_rural_reconstruction_modifier$§! to the targeted states
loc.CHI_sino_american_joint_commission_on_ru: We should use our American contacts to expand our rural efforts to include village schools, and promote a well-functioning education system for the whole country.
loc.CHI_a_matter_of_will_desc: China can benefit from foreign ideas, but with our history we have our own path to take. We need to begin with setting a foundation in our village schools, and build unity from the ground up.
loc.CHI_glorify_deng_yanda_desc: The Kuomintang abandoned the revolution we started in 1911 through selfish profiteering. There was one that stood up for the common man and created another path than that of tyranny and appeasement: Deng Yanda. He was martyred for his beliefs, and we shall never forget him or what he represented.
loc.CHI_apply_yandas_work_desc: Deng always wanted to mobilize the masses and give the rural populace an alternative. Spreading the word from village to village will strengthen our organization and the country as a whole.
loc.CHI_apply_yandas_work_tt: Reduces the cost of both §YRural and Urban Political Tutelage§! decisions by §G10§!
