loc.CHI_socialize_major_industries_desc: We have allowed some individuals to amass too much wealth and power, leading to key industries in the wrong hands. We should take those industries into state care for safe keeping.
loc.CHI_a_burgeoning_welfare_state_desc: A state that takes care of its people carries unmatched strength and resilience. Drawing inspiration from the Germans before they fell to fanaticism, we shall begin the path towards a more equitable future.
loc.CHI_truly_free_speech_desc: While we are protecting people from prosecution for their opinions the discourse is still narrow. We need to encourage more people to take part in the public dialogue so a plurality of voices can be heard and take a stance.
loc.CHI_a_control_yuan_with_teeth_desc: Power corrupts, so we need something to keep our politicians honest. Under Chiang Kai-Shek the organization tasked with this was rendered impotent. We shall rebuild the organization so that it can fulfill its mission to the fullest.
loc.CHI_unify_as_the_china_democratic_league: Unify as the China Democratic League
As disparate small groups we cannot stand up to the Kuomintang, but if we were to unify, we might have a chance. But, who shall lead us?
loc.CHI_continue_the_ding_xian_experiment_de: The Ding Xian project in Rural Reconstruction has so far been sponsored by James Yen's Mass Education Movement. Being used as a social laboratory it has developed and demonstrated ways to raise the standard of living, health, political responsibility, and culture in the Chinese village. We should fund this program in order to bring modernization to the countryside.
loc.CHI_continue_the_ding_xian_experiment_tt: \n§YElectrification and Mass Education§! will start to spread outwards from §YHebei and Hunan§! as time progresses, with one new core state gaining the modifier every second month.
loc.CHI_minsheng_focus_desc: A modern state looks after its citizens so that in the time of need, the citizens will be able and willing to defend it. To that end, we must enact the principle of Minsheng and ensure that welfare can be provided to all of the nation's citizens.
loc.CHI_minzu_focus_desc: The idea of belonging to a nation - rather than a tribe or a religion - is what turns a group of people into a state. Therefore, we must enact the principle of Minzu, and ensure that all of the nation's people feel a strong sense of nationalism and patriotism, as well as a sense of unity under the central government.
loc.CHI_minquan_focus_desc: The journey started by Dr. Sun Yat-sen will eventually lead to a unified republic. It will no doubt be a long journey, but we take it one step at a time. The first one, would be to enact the principle of Minquan and ensure that the vote is extended to all Chinese citizens.
loc.CHI_demand_regional_adherence_desc: Now that we can prove to the regional rulers of China that we have properly enacted the Three Principles of the People, we have the opportunity to create pressure on them to do the same. This should eventually lead to their subjugation and integration into the republic, under the guiding hand of our central authority.
loc.CHI_demand_regional_adherence_tt: Unlocks decisions to §YDevelop§! Warlord-controlled regions and enforce their adherence to the three principles of the people, raising their §YDemocratic§! support and eventually §YSubjugating and Integrating§! them
loc.CHI_zhonghua_minzu_focus_desc: Now that the warlords and regional governors have all been brought back under our control, it is time to begin proper reunification and look outward. Many of our rightful territories were lost to nationalist rabble and foreign powers, and we must now do all in our power to bring them back into the light of the republic.
loc.CHI_zhonghua_minzu_focus_tt: Unlocks decisions to core [MON.GetFlag] §Y[MON.GetAdjective]§!, [TAN.GetFlag] §Y[TAN.GetAdjective]§! and [TIB.GetFlag] §Y[TIB.GetAdjective]§! states
loc.CHI_toward_a_socialist_economy_desc: In order to truly change our society for the better we must change the way in which money flows, and remove heads of corporations who have only gotten their positions through nepotism. The working man shall once again have a say in his country, and all [ROOT.GetAdjective] will be equal!
loc.CHI_enact_georgist_tax_reforms_desc: Georgism served as the basis to Sun Yat Sen's economic theory, who wished to create a tax on held land. 'The only means of supporting the government is an infinitely just, reasonable, and equitably distributed tax, on which we shall found our new system'.
loc.CHI_leverage_contacts_desc: Our fellow countrymen have spread across the world, and some even arrived in America. In the United States, our contacts are only waiting for us to request a helping hand.
loc.CHI_reach_out_for_help_desc: The specter of militarism haunts China from the east and we need to reach out to our American contacts for help. They need to understand that we are their first line of defense against the Japanese threat.
loc.CHI_reach_out_for_help_tt: §Y[USA.GetNameDefCap]§! will be more likely to send us §YLend-Lease§!
loc.CHI_deal_with_the_shadow_elements_desc: Shadowy groups in our country are poisoning the people for personal gain. This cannot stand!
loc.CHI_utilize_the_albazinian_contact_tt: Unlocks decisions to request increased support from [SOV.GetNameDef]
loc.CHI_shifting_the_balance_desc: While we have gotten support from abroad, it has been of the passive type. We are going to request active involvement so that we can be aided in defeating the Japanese threat once and for all.
loc.CHI_the_german_mission_desc: For over a decade we have had connections with Germany, and we should specifically use Carsun Chang's contacts to expand our collaboration
loc.CHI_reach_out_to_expats_desc: Our people have scattered across the world and built new lives for themselves. To some that would point to weakness, but to us, it is a strength. We will call on our estranged countrymen in this time of need.
loc.CHI_reach_out_to_expats_tt: Unlocks decisions to §YGain Increased Monthly Economic Capacity Surplus§! from foreign nations by utilizing our contacts and expat communities
loc.CHI_invoke_the_nine_powers_desc: Although the unequal treaties were signed to our detriment, the Nine Powers agreed to a status quo where no one nation should take more of China. With the ongoing Japanese aggression, it is time to invoke the clause.
loc.CHI_aeronautical_expertise_desc: Chinese aviators have gotten well deserved fame on the other side of the pacific. We can call them home to utilize their expertise.
loc.CHI_expand_the_faction_desc: As with our domestic movement, the cause of democracy in Asia is dependent on a lot of smaller groups. We need to unify all movements in a larger faction to be able to stand against those who would oppress us.
loc.CHI_expand_the_faction_tt: Unlocks decisions to invite §YDemocratic§! §YAsian§! and §YOceanian§! nations to our faction
loc.CHI_make_a_stand_against_the_colonialist: Make a Stand Against the Colonialists

The century of empire is over and we are the harbinger of the age of self-determination. We need to make this simple statement known to those that stick to the old order and if they resist us, they will know the wrath of the people.
Unlocks the §YAnti-Colonialism§! decisions to liberate the colonies in §YAsia and Oceania§! held by colonial powers.
loc.CHI_spreading_the_light_of_freedom_desc: Freedom from foreign threats is merely the first step on our path. We also need to make sure that domestic threats do not hinder the will of the nation to express itself.
loc.CHI_spreading_the_light_of_freedom_tt: Unlocks decisions to §YStir Republican Sentiments§! inside §YAsian and Oceanian§! nations
loc.CHI_correct_a_historical_wrong_desc: The treatment the Europeans exacted on the world is beyond unjust and a stain on the tapestry of human civilization. We shall right this wrong and punish them for their crimes.
loc.CHI_championing_the_cause_of_liberty_des: We have brought the light of liberty to Asia and stand as a beacon to all who value their freedom and self-determination.
loc.CHI_utilize_the_albazinian_contact_desc: Bishop Symeon Du is the current protodeacon of the Chinese Orthodox Church. As an Albazinian who has traveled all across China, the Bishop holds close contacts with many members of the old White Russian forces. Perhaps he can persuade the Russians to send aid to our nation?
loc.CHI_prepare_for_a_change_in_leadership: Prepare for a Change in Leadership
loc.CHI_prepare_for_a_change_in_leadership_d: We have had our current government for a decade, and the specter of [JAP.GetNameDef] still haunts the [CHI.GetAdjective] nation. There is a need to have someone else hold the reins of power.
loc.CHI_prepare_for_a_change_in_leadership_t: §R[CHI_chiang_kaishek.GetName] will be replaced in the Xi'an incident for [CHI_wang_jingwei.GetName]§!
§RSending Chiang Kai-Shek to Guangzhou during the Liangguang Incident will result in his death earlier, allowing $CHI_look_for_allies$ to be picked§!
loc.CHI_prepare_for_a_change_in_leadership_d: §R[CHI_chiang_kaishek.GetName] will be replaced in the Xi'an incident for [CHI_dai_li.GetName]§!
loc.CHI_avoid_another_crisis_desc: In 1931 we were unprepared and taken by surprise by the [JAP.GetAdjective] army. Even though half a decade has passed we are not ready to beat them back and must get more of that precious resource, time. We can offer token concessions to placate the [JAP.GetAdjective], allowing us to prepare for the inevitable storm from the east.
loc.CHI_avoid_another_crisis_tt: \nWill give the options to delay the Japanese invasion by giving concessions.
loc.CHI_lay_the_foundation_for_a_united_chin: Lay the Foundation for a United China

The current government is a gang of brutes who only knows the power of the sword. A healthy nation requires more than rule by force. Strong institutions under a civilian government are the foundation for our continued revolution.
loc.CHI_preempt_the_inevitable_desc: We know that [JAP.GetNameDef] is closing in on us, believing us to be weak and ready for the taking. One could imagine their surprise if we struck first.
loc.CHI_utilize_german_contacts_desc: While the eastern barbarians have an insatiable bloodlust, there are those among them that are able to listen to reason, although not from us. By reaching out to our mutual contacts in Europe, we can have them temper the feelings of hotter heads.
loc.CHI_utilize_german_contacts_tt: If we accept [GER.GetAdjective] requests about anti-soviet treaties then [GER.GetNameDef] will be more likely to interject on our behalf.
loc.CHI_utilize_german_contacts_wang_tt: We will use our connections through [CHI.GetLeader] to get:
loc.CHI_look_for_allies_desc: Chiang has had almost a decade to consolidate his power over the party, but still there are elements who refuse to stand behind him. We must seek these out and unify them into a proper opposition.
loc.CHI_infiltrate_the_examination_yuan_desc: A state does not simply run by the work of a few, but the tireless work of a mass of civil servants. If we were able to infiltrate the organization that checks qualifications of those workers, we could benefit our movement greatly. If we could make sure that the workers are aligned with our position, it would constitute an unstoppable force.
loc.CHI_take_control_of_the_executive_yuan: Take Control of the Executive Yuan
loc.CHI_take_control_of_the_executive_yuan_d: He who makes the laws has power, but he who enforces them can supersede them. With our people in ministerial positions we will be able to counter Chiangism at every level.
loc.CHI_take_control_of_the_executive_yuan_t: When a new Warlord is puppeted, every existing Warlord Puppet will gain: §Y[?executive_yuan_autonomy_ratio|%]§! autonomy ratio
loc.CHI_our_people_in_the_legislative_desc: The current system has been made toothless under Chiang. A strongman tried to replace a strong central power, and that we will have to combat. We will have to rewrite the autonomy of some government elements to strengthen the core of the nation.
loc.CHI_clear_out_sycophants_desc: A tyrant breeds yes-men and the longer he rules, the more of them there are. While we hold nominal legislative and executive control, there are still a lot of men who adhere to the old ideas. We should make a concerted effort to ensure that those who benefited from the former regime are put in their proper place.
loc.CHI_impair_the_control_yuan_desc: Checks and balances are important factors in a functioning polity, however they can also slow the march of progress. It would benefit our cause if the Control Yuan was not as potent as some would hope, to not hinder us in our goals.
loc.CHI_impair_the_control_yuan_tt: Upgrades the §YIntegration Efforts decision§! to apply:
loc.CHI_appoint_sympathetic_judges_desc: With Judges in key positions we will be able to expand our power downwards and outwards all the way into the provinces.
loc.CHI_appoint_sympathetic_judges_tt: Every future Warlord Subject will get the following spirit upon being puppeted:
loc.CHI_close_whampoa_desc: Whampoa has always been known to be Chiang's personal fiefdom and a breeding ground for his ideological leanings. It is an institution that is impossible to allow to persist, and so we will close it down and censure all who are known to have links to it.
loc.CHI_close_whampoa_tt: Every remaining general will gain: §G+3§! randomly assigned stats.
loc.CHI_censure_the_opposition_desc: The Control Yuan is already weak, but if we were to control it fully we could correct undesirable elements. Giving feedback on proper conduct would work as a corrective measure.
loc.CHI_the_freedom_to_abject_desc: A system that cannot be critiqued will never grow and develop. We have for too long trampled the people who have pointed out elements that enrich some to the detriment of the [CHI.Getadjective] people. We need processes to make it possible to point out failings of the system as long as it does not destabilise us.
loc.CHI_expropriate_industrialists_desc: The lackeys of Chiang have benefited greatly from following such a corrupt man and amassed great wealth. Personal profit cannot stand above the party and what has happened needs to be rectified. We will return what correctly belongs to the state.
loc.CHI_politicise_the_process_desc: As a public servant it is important to understand one’s political responsibilities. Not everyone understands this and thus needs to be taught better. We will reformulate the education and examination of every public servant to reach a widespread understanding.
loc.CHI_a_functioning_bureaucracy_first_desc: While control of the state apparatus is of great importance, it is pointless if there is no state to begin with. Allowing institutions a measure of self-governance and encouraging the right people to rise through the ranks based on merit and not correct ideas will benefit us in the long run.
loc.CHI_extend_jurisdiction_to_the_provinces: The [ROOT.GetRulingParty] have done well in taking control of the greater cities and central institutions, but we could do better in the periphery. Extending our power will go a long way in unifying China and holding off the [JAP.GetAdjective] onslaught.
loc.CHI_affirm_civilian_primacy_desc: Chiang built his power on the back of the army, but we know that the minds of officers can be easily swayed, few of them benefiting us. We need to ensure that the armed forces understand that they are subservient to civilian control.
loc.CHI_proclaim_a_new_chapter_desc: The former regime always claimed to be a force for freedom and democracy, but the truth was they only thirsted for power. With the consolidation of power of Wang Jingwei, we can now declare that the civilian government has reclaimed the reins of power.
loc.CHI_negotiate_the_nine_powers_treaty_des: The Qing agreed to submit to the Western powers, and the treaties of the 19th century haunt us like ghosts, their effects still lingering over China. We will reach out to the signatories and see if we can resolve our differences, not as a servant this time, but an equal.
loc.CHI_start_looking_outwards_desc: The mistake made in the past was to believe we could stand apart from the world. The colonialist nations picked us apart along with the rest of Asia, leaving us dishonored. This cannot go unpunished. We will organize the rest of Asia to stand together in strength.
loc.CHI_start_looking_outwards_tt: We will be able to invite free Asian countries to our faction
loc.CHI_liberate_the_peoples_of_asia_desc: As in centuries past, the rest of Asia looks to us for guidance and we shall respond. We shall help them rise up against the imperialists and find their own liberty, avenging their brethren.
loc.CHI_liberate_the_peoples_of_asia_tt: We will gain wargoals on everyone who controls colonial states or have puppets in §Y$asia$§!
loc.CHI_liberate_the_peoples_of_asia_tt_2: Unlocks decisions to set up puppet governments around §Y$asia$ §!
loc.CHI_punish_the_signatories_desc: The damage done by the Westerners to our nation is incalculable. It has left us downtrodden. They need to be made to understand what they have done, and begin repaying their historical debt.
loc.CHI_bring_the_revolution_further_desc: Our path of liberation goes further than we could have ever thought. We will spread the light of freedom throughout the pacific and push the colonialists back even further.
loc.CHI_bring_the_revolution_further_tt: We will gain wargoals on everyone who controls colonial states or have puppets in §Y$Australia$: §!
loc.CHI_bring_the_revolution_further_tt_2: Our faction manifest will also include §Y$Australia$ §!\nUnlocks decisions to set up puppet governments around §Y$Australia$ §!
loc.CHI_end_the_humiliation_desc: We finally stand, as we have done in centuries past, as a great power. Admired, influential, and impressive we have risen above the rest, casting the oppressors aside and into the history books. Disgraced no more!
loc.CHI_dang_guo_desc: The party’s aim has always been to bring democracy to our nation, but in these uncertain times it is important that the Kuomintang can act efficiently. We must thus place the party above the nation for the time being.
loc.CHI_denounce_feudalism_desc: While we proclaim our revolutionary character there are those in our party that behave like the landowners and elites of old. These old feudalists needs to have their counterrevolutionary behavior confronted for what it is.
loc.CHI_denounce_feudalism_tt: Will gain: §G+[?warlord_subjects_pp_gain_base] Political Power§! monthly for each warlord subject.
loc.CHI_one_nation_undivided_desc: By uniting the provinces under one undivided authority we will overcome regional divisions and lay the groundwork for a strong and proud nation. Then we will be able to stand against any threats, external and internal.
loc.CHI_one_nation_undivided_tt: Will invite every warlord to the United Front Faction, excluding [PRC.GetName] and [HBC.GetName]
loc.CHI_one_nation_undivided_bypass_tt:
§YEvery Chinese Warlord§!: One of the following must be true: 
  Does not exist
  Is at war with §Y[ROOT.GetNameWithFlag]§!
  Is a subject of §Y[ROOT.GetNameWithFlag]§!
  Is in a faction with §Y[ROOT.GetNameWithFlag]§!
  §Y[ROOT.GetName]§!: has a §Ywar goal§! against them.
loc.CHI_decree_the_end_to_corruption_desc: Corruption has become endemic in our government, from the highest minister down to the lowest recruit of the army. We need to weed out the avaricious and corrupt officials so that an honest administration can be formed.
loc.CHI_reinforce_connections_with_shanghai_: In Shanghai there are a group of individuals with great wealth and power, amassed through shifting in and out of the shadows. Enabling these individuals could prove useful to our cause.
loc.CHI_introduce_the_baojia_system_desc: The Baojia system has been used for organizing our populace and guaranteeing their safety since ancient times, and it has proven highly efficient. We should expand it to be the basis of recruitment as it would assure us a steady flow of recruits.
loc.CHI_expand_the_tongzi_jun_desc: The ranks of the youth corps can cultivate new generations of loyal and disciplined citizens. Some measure of military training will also facilitate their way into the armed forces.
loc.CHI_demonstrate_our_resolve_desc: The rest of the world has looked down on us for far too long. It is time to prove our mettle by defeating this vicious aggression.
loc.CHI_arrest_the_seven_gentlemen_desc: While there are few in China that agree with the Japanese aggression, the method of dealing with it is a divisive question. We cannot allow competition to our rule, and so we must show our primacy in these matters.
loc.CHI_take_a_stance_on_illicit_trade: Take a Stance on Illicit Trade
loc.CHI_take_a_stance_on_illicit_trade_desc: For too long we have been at the mercy of the poison seeping through our society and those who deal in it. We need to reject its temptation to come out stronger and more clearheaded into a new century of prosperity.
loc.CHI_reshuffle_the_green_gang_desc: Big Eared Du has served us well, but also grown too influential. With enemies circling we need more direct action. Maybe it is time for someone else to run the Green Gang?
loc.CHI_legitimise_du_desc: Some would have us stay away from those with unorthodox ways to make a living, but maybe that would only be to throw away a valuable resource. We should see what Du Yuesheng could do if he did not need to work in the shadows.
loc.CHI_inspect_the_troops_desc: Rigorous inspections will be conducted to rally the troops behind the party and [root.GetLeader]. Our glorious army will be what brings us into the future.
loc.CHI_secure_the_soviet_border_desc: The Russian bear has been a thorn in our side, meddling in our affairs for far too long. We should secure our northern front by building formal relations with [SOV.GetNameDef] and maybe get something more out of them.
loc.CHI_secure_the_soviet_border_tt: §RWe will be able to see Armor designers that we can choose in a future event.§!
loc.CHI_send_the_first_lady_abroad_desc: There are still those that might support us in the face of aggression, but are currently on the fence. We should send the First Lady to convince them that although we have bled oceans and borne unflinchingly the heavy burden of war, we shall still prevail.
loc.CHI_take_advantage_of_dus_contacts_desc: The leader of the Green Gang has friends in many places and a know-how that few possess. Such a network could be of benefit to us if we were to utilize it properly, even if it would profit some shady characters.
loc.CHI_draw_support_from_the_big_families: Draw Support from the Big Families
loc.CHI_draw_support_from_the_big_families_d: China has a handful of very influential families in different sectors. While this might not assist in stabilizing the country, these connections could still be used to further our goals.
loc.CHI_prosecute_cronyism_desc: For too long have the interests of individuals taken precedence over the needs of the state. Nepotism, bribery and embezzlement have been tearing at the fabric of our society. That ends now, and a new era of virtue beckons!
loc.illicit_good_improvement_increase: Increases the speed of by which §YIllicit Trade§! is removed by §G+2%§! every §Y6th month§!
loc.CHI_crack_down_on_illicit_goods_desc: For too long have we been at the mercy of poison seeping through our society and those who deal in it. We need to reject its temptation to come out stronger and more clearheaded into a new century of prosperity.
loc.CHI_turn_a_blind_eye_desc: It can be admitted that some unofficial trade has had a detrimental effect on the makeup of Chinese society. However, the profits of this trade can not be denied and if we were to let it be we could gain great wealth.
loc.CHI_weaponise_the_hongmen_desc: There are secret societies already trained in self defense in our port regions that we could turn on our enemy. Give them enough support, and they could wreak havoc on any invader who dares violate our land.
loc.CHI_weaponise_the_hongmen_tt: Every occupied Chinese coastal state and state with a big city:\n  Resistance: §R+30.0%§!
loc.CHI_facilitate_operation_zet_desc: We have understood that [SOV.GetNameDef] are not comfortable with the aggressive posture [JAP.GetNameDef] has taken in East Asia. They are willing to provide us with material support and volunteers. All we need to do is to prepare the reception of the aid.
loc.CHI_from_many_to_one_desc: Our nation contains numberless multitudes, but recently we have been divided and torn between different opinions. If we are to resist the foreign onslaught and ultimately survive, we need to unify behind one common goal.
loc.CHI_from_many_to_one_tt: Gain §G+1.5%§! Stability for every Warlord in our faction
loc.CHI_from_many_to_one_faction_tt: Will add §G+20.0%§! $MODIFIERS_ARMY_CORE_DEFENCE_FACTOR$ when having low faction manifest fullfillment. \nWill add §G-10.0%§! $MODIFIER_AUTONOMY_GAIN_WARSCORE$ when having high faction manifest fullfillment.
loc.CHI_request_soviet_advisors_desc: War has changed radically in the latter decades and we have fallen behind. [SOV.GetNameDefCap] has offered to send us qualified experts to catch up on our armor efforts, and we should accept.
loc.CHI_the_northwest_highway_desc: We share a long border with [SOV.GetnameDef] so one would think that there are ample opportunities to transport things undisturbed between our two regimes. However, the infrastructure in those regions is lacking to say the least. We should focus on building up a route far removed from the front line so we can receive more from our [SOV.Getadjective] friends.
loc.CHI_collaborate_with_allied_forces_desc: We have fought long and hard against the [JAP.GetAdjective] threat, but we are no longer alone. To be able to coordinate our efforts we should integrate both our armed forces further, and achieve final victory.
loc.CHI_collaborate_with_allied_forces_tt: Unlocks Decisions to Form the X and Y Force which will create divisions.
loc.CHI_scout_for_air_experts_desc: Our air force is in its infancy and many challenges are hard-fought. We shall facilitate the air force's efforts by taking advantage of the expertise of others.
loc.CHI_sell_lend_lease_desc: Getting equipment for our forces is always useful, but what is offered is not always what is needed. However, there is always a need for equipment somewhere, which means that there is always a market for it.
loc.CHI_sell_lend_lease_tt:
If we have §Y$CHI_soviet_support$§! gain: §Y+100 $CIC_BANK_HEADER$§! per month

If we have §Y$CHI_american_support$§! gain: §Y+150 $CIC_BANK_HEADER$§! per month
loc.CHI_international_instructors_desc: The need for pilots and crews is voracious, and we cannot train them fast enough. Welcoming more foreign instructors would speed up our efforts to get more planes in the air.
loc.CHI_allocate_lend_lease_desc: Currently there are several centers of powers in China, although only one gets to represent the nation abroad. We can use this advantage to decide who gets support, and thus who gets to exert influence.
loc.CHI_allocate_lend_lease_tt: Unlocks decisions to reduce Warlord Subjects Autonomy using §YInfantry Equipment§!
loc.CHI_burma_campaign_desc: Our allies are struggling. [JAP.GetNameDefCap] has driven deep and is now controlling parts of Burma. We shall show that we are not only a distraction to the enemy, but a reliable ally that will deal the killing blow.
loc.CHI_burma_campaign_trigger: [BRM.GetName] has lost at least one of its territories to an enemy
loc.CHI_indo_chinese_campaign_desc: We have long history with Southeast Asia and today another chapter is written. We shall retake the area from [671.controller.GetNameDef] so that allied forces can operate freely.
loc.CHI_international_squadron_desc: Our friends overseas have organized a volunteer group of pilots and bought a number of modern planes to support our war effort. We should welcome their initiative with open arms.
loc.CHI_form_the_chinese_womens_national_war: Many have lost a lot in our struggle against imperialism and we need to accommodate their needs. The Chinese Women's National War Relief Society have shown promising results and should be expanded for increased efficacy.
loc.CHI_towards_a_professional_army_desc: Our army is large, but its efficacy is debatable. The German Military Advisors Group recommended that we scale down the army and focus on creating a smaller, better-equipped force with high morale and combat effectiveness.
loc.CHI_towards_a_popular_army_desc: Our armed forces lacks equipment and training, but one thing we do have is people. We will make the foreign invaders break on the wall of soldiers that is the National Revolutionary Army.
loc.CHI_the_hanoi_route_desc: Our eastern ports are vulnerable to [JAP.GetNameDef] and we need to take precautionary measures. Going down the mountains from Kunming into the jungles around Hanoi is a hard route, but would give our shipments some respite.
loc.CHI_form_saco_desc: If one is to prevail one needs to know their enemy. The Americans have proposed to create the Sino-American Cooperative Organization to share intelligence and help in training our guerilla units.
loc.CHI_the_burma_road_desc: Our foreign allies have shown their willingness to support us materially, but military pressure from [JAP.GetName] is making deliveries difficult. Setting up a route through Burma would allow us to increase the amount of materiel we could receive from the southwest.
loc.CHI_the_hump_sea_desc: Trains, trucks, and ships are all well and good when it comes to delivering materiel, but the future is in the sky. With skilled pilots we would be able to fly over the Himalayas and land in Yunnan, meaning that nothing could stop our deliveries.
loc.CHI_women_in_the_war_effort: The New Woman in the War Effort
loc.CHI_women_in_the_war_effort_desc: Since the May Fourth Movement, women's roles in society have changed forever. Embracing modernity and love for their country, women should also be able to contribute. Organizing women's battalions and integrating them into the armed forces will help us greatly.
loc.CHI_the_sky_cannot_have_two_suns: The Sky Cannot have Two Suns
loc.CHI_the_sky_cannot_have_two_suns_desc: Communist subversion threatens the very fabric of Chinese society. Only by proving our supremacy and destroying their cause will China survive, united under one banner. Two suns may set, but only one will rise come daybreak.
loc.CHI_the_sky_cannot_have_two_suns_tt: Every Warlord in our faction that is also communist:\n   Add: §Y-10.00%§! faction influence
loc.CHI_preemptive_strike_desc: Every day our internal enemies grow stronger, conspiring against our authority. We can no longer wait for someone to try to take power in China, we need to act, we need to strike!
loc.CHI_preemptive_strike_tt: We will get §Y$annex_everything$§! wargoals on every [CHI.GetAdjective] Warlord that has not joined [ROOT.GetFactionName] or has rejected our demands to become subjects.
loc.CHI_tour_the_north_desc: The mountainous interior regions have come to be the center of communist agitation. This cannot be allowed to continue, and we should make our presence known by traveling the provinces.
loc.CHI_unlock_faction_goal_north_subjugated: If this is the first touring focus taken then the faction goal §Y$faction_goal_north_subjugated_name$§! will be unlocked.
loc.CHI_tour_the_west_desc: In a land of mountain and deserts, the site of the Silk Road of old is far from the halls of power. [SOV.GetNameDefCap] has been spreading its influence in this region and so we will make sure that the local powerbrokers know where they should turn their attention.
loc.CHI_unlock_faction_goal_west_subjugated_: If this is the first touring focus taken then the faction goal §Y$faction_goal_west_subjugated_name$§! will be unlocked.
loc.CHI_tour_the_south_desc: The south of China is a diverse and dynamic place, often the window to the world. This place where our party was created have found more autonomy recently which is a trend we need to revert. We should visit these provinces!
loc.CHI_unlock_faction_goal_south_subjugated: If this is the first touring focus taken then the faction goal §Y$faction_goal_south_subjugated_name$§! will be unlocked.
loc.CHI_ma_clique_integration_cost: Reduces the Integration Cost for [XSM.GetNameDef], [GSM.GetNameDef] and [NXM.GetNameDef] by §G[?ma_clique_integration_cost_reduction|%G0]§!
loc.CHI_warlord_integration_cost_reduction: Reduces the Cost to §YPress Warlords to become our subject§! by £GFX_influence_texticon §G-5%§! and £pol_power §G-50§!
loc.CHI_shx_integration_cost: Reduces the Integration Cost for [SHX.GetNameDef] by §G[?shx_integration_cost_reduction|%G0]§!
loc.CHI_snd_integration_cost: Reduces the Integration Cost for [SND.GetNameDef] by §G[?snd_integration_cost_reduction|%G0]§!
loc.CHI_khm_integration_cost: Reduces the Integration Cost for [KHM.GetNameDef] by §G[?khm_integration_cost_reduction|%G0]§!
loc.CHI_sik_integration_cost: Reduces the Integration Cost for [SIK.GetNameDef] by §G[?sik_integration_cost_reduction|%G0]§!
loc.CHI_sic_integration_cost: Reduces the Integration Cost for [SIC.GetNameDef] by §G[?sic_integration_cost_reduction|%G0]§!
loc.CHI_yun_integration_cost: Reduces the Integration Cost for [YUN.GetNameDef] by §G[?yun_integration_cost_reduction|%G0]§!
loc.CHI_gxc_integration_cost: Reduces the Integration Cost for [GXC.GetNameDef] by §G[?gxc_integration_cost_reduction|%G0]§!
loc.CHI_gdc_integration_cost: Reduces the Integration Cost for [GDC.GetNameDef] by §G[?gdc_integration_cost_reduction|%G0]§!
loc.CHI_victory_over_the_invaders_desc: The foreign invaders lay beaten and our glorious National Revolutionary Army stands victorious. This war, and more importantly, our honorable leader [root.GetLeader], has galvanized our disparate provinces and people into one nation under the white sun!
loc.CHI_request_territory_trigger_tt:
Any controlled state:
      Is a core of §Y[ROOT.GetNameWithFlag]§!
      Controller: $is_literally_china_tt_NOT$
      One of the following must be true:
         Not owned by Controller
         Controller:
            Current ruling party is §Y[ROOT.GetRulingIdeology]§!
loc.CHI_crush_the_communists_desc: The time has come to finally finish what we started so long ago; the utter and total destruction of [PRC.GetNameDef]! For far too long have we been distracted by other things, but no longer will we tolerate this nuisance to continue!
loc.CHI_request_handover_of_coastal_cities: Request Handover of the Coastal Cities
loc.CHI_a_generalissimo_for_all_of_china: A Generalissimo for all of China
loc.CHI_a_generalissimo_for_all_of_china_des: Our struggle against the foreign invader was a disease of the skin, but our internal threat always was a disease of the heart. A disease that we have now dealt with so that we may dream of the future.
loc.CHI_empower_the_mtac_desc: The community of [ROOT.GetNameDef] is on its way to harmony, but the work is not yet done. The Mongolian and Tibetan Affairs Commission has overseen the relationship with groups present in our country, but could have an expanded role. We shall bring the revolution to our brethren abroad!
loc.CHI_empower_the_mtac_tt: Unlocks decisions to core [MON.GetFlag] §Y[MON.GetAdjective]§! and [TIB.GetFlag] §Y[TIB.GetAdjective]§! states.
loc.CHI_unify_the_admissions_process_desc: Our higher education system is split between several sites, and the application process is complicated and fractured. If we restructure the process into a joint entrance examination, we will make sure that there are spots for every competent student.
loc.CHI_retreat_to_taiwan_desc: Our resumed conflict with [PRC.GetNameDef] has not necessarily developed in our favor and we are losing ground. More and more people voice their concern and are openly advocating for us to do a tactical retreat to Taiwan, to rebuild our strength and to survive.
loc.CHI_joining_the_international_community_: For too long have we been looking inwards which only gave others the opportunity to exploit us. We must now go out into the world and join those who strive for freedom, those who supported us in our most dire moment!
loc.CHI_a_world_freed_from_communism_desc: Fascism set fire to the world, but it is not the only ideology who threatens humanity. We must finish the mission we have started in our own country, and rid this world of evil thoughts!
loc.CHI_reclaim_the_north_desc: Out of necessity, we had to renounce our claims to large swathes of northern territory in the past. But things have changed, and we find ourselves in a much stronger position now - strong enough to once again reclaim our northern possessions!
loc.CHI_strengthening_our_resolve_desc: The old factions bicker and the current leadership is not strong enough to unite us. A change in course is needed as the Republic must endure, not dissolve.
loc.CHI_china_reborn_desc: The ideas of old only led to our exploitation by the imperialists. A fundamental change of course is needed. We need to reshape our society with a new ideology. We will start a series of campaigns that we shall term the New Life Movement.
loc.CHI_co_opt_the_koh_hsin_movement_tt: Reduces the cost of communist counter-infiltration by §G25%§!
loc.CHI_co_opt_the_koh_hsin_movement_desc: The party has become too bureaucratic and corrupt and we need to clean out the rotten elements. A stronger line is not only beneficial, but crucial to our national survival!
loc.permanently_protected_from_infiltration: The state cannot be infiltrated by communist forces.
loc.CHI_mend_the_rift_with_hu_desc: The old rivalry between [ROOT.GetLeader] and Hu Hanmin has weakened the party long enough. Hanmin's following means that he holds a significant measure of influence, which would benefit the nation if we could unite.
loc.CHI_revive_the_western_hills_group_desc: [ROOT.GetNameDefCap] has for too long been influenced by foreign forces. A return to tradition is needed, which is a line that has been held by Lin Sen and Dai Jitao. It would allow us to realize Dr. Sun’s ideas as they were intended, free from distortion.
loc.CHI_reform_the_blue_shirts_desc: The Society of Practice of the Three Principles of the People — the Blue Shirt Society — has been active for almost half a decade, but with limited efficacy. Due to not having spread among the common man, the faction has not reached its full potential. By reforming the organization as a popular front, we will challenge the communists at their own game.
loc.CHI_empower_the_bureau_of_investigation_: Since ancient time knowledge of the enemy, and of self, has won battles. We need an organization capable of getting us the information we need, and should expand the National Bureau of Investigation and Statistics.
loc.CHI_revise_the_national_curriculum_desc: With a country as large as ours it is no surprise that there are many differing stances. We could standardize and organize our education system to encourage certain, desired behaviors.
loc.CHI_target_upper_society_desc: The upper segment of society has abandoned proper values and become too interested in cosmopolitan leisure, while it needs to stand as an example of moral and virtuous life for the common man. Once it does, we may lift the whole nation through a revival of the spirit and transcend mere material riches.
loc.CHI_outlaw_opposition_parties_desc: The Kuomintang has been dominant for close to a decade, but opposition parties have been allowed. We fear that our nation is at a crossroads and we will need to limit the opposition until we have dealt with [JAP.GetNameDef] and the communists.
loc.CHI_seek_out_western_fascist_cooperation: Because of foreign interference in the past, we have lagged behind in technical development. No matter how repulsive we may find it, it might be wise to seek out cooperation with Western countries sympathetic to our cause so that we may catch up, before we turn the tables on them...
loc.CHI_a_chapter_in_every_village_desc: Our Blue Shirts have found success in the cities, but the majority of the general populace lives in the countryside. We need to expand the organization so that it is represented in every town, village, and hamlet.
loc.CHI_secure_the_northern_front_desc: We have already lost Manchuria to the Japanese, by far our strongest and most dangerous neighbor. We must secure the northern frontier so that we can keep an eye on the Japanese, and make sure they do not get any ideas of expanding further south...
loc.CHI_a_party_unified_desc: Through discipline, morality, and virtue we have forged unity within our party. Petty squabbling and division is behind us, and we move forward under the blue banner and white sun. Onward towards final victory over all enemies, internal and external both!
loc.CHI_a_party_unified_tt: §RSending Chiang Kai-Shek to Guangzhou during the Liangguang Incident will result in his death earlier.§!
loc.CHI_a_popular_movement_desc: A new chapter in our history requires a new organization. All will know that we as a people are a wave, washing over the old society, making every member a part of this greater whole.
loc.CHI_a_popular_movement_trigger: §YCorruption in the Armed Forces§! Conscription Factor is more than §Y0%§!
loc.CHI_integrate_the_hongmen_desc: China is filled with groups that formed to defend against Qing oppression. Since the Xinhai revolution, they have lost their purpose and gone in different directions. We could give them purpose once again by incorporating them, or emulating their organization and practices.
loc.CHI_ban_immoral_entertainment_desc: Decadent forms of entertainment have spread to our shores and polluted our moral fibers. We should ban these in favor for more athletic and artistic domestic forms as well as setting up task forces to enforce it.
loc.CHI_develop_counterinsurgency_tactics_de: Guerillas operate in unconventional, unpredictable ways, and we need to learn how to combat them. We should organize commissions and groups to develop techniques and adaptations to a new form of warfare.
loc.CHI_a_brotherhood_for_china_desc: The Blue Shirts Society is to many a bunch of brutes disturbing the peace. However, its leader, Dai Li, envisages it as a brotherhood, and that is a point of view that we can take to foster unity.
loc.CHI_nationalize_desc: We are in a critical time for our party, nation and people, so private interest must yield to national necessity. Under our direct guidance we will use these factories to utmost efficiency!
loc.CHI_militarize_desc: Our population has become indifferent about their place in history and needs to be awakened. We shall make them feel the fervor of the revolution and prepare them to strike down the enemies, domestic and foreign ones both.
loc.CHI_militarize_tt: Blueshirt Militias will be raised in all current and future states with §Y$CHI_infiltrated_state_3$§!
loc.CHI_productive_desc: Idle hands build nothing! Laziness does not merely hold us back, it aids the enemy too. The passive and apathetic need to be dealt with if we are to prevail as a party!
loc.CHI_enforce__virtues_desc: Still, people waste their time on frivolous and meaningless pursuits while they could be bettering themselves for the sake of the party and nation. We have been too lax in our enforcement, and we shall redouble our efforts.
loc.CHI_whampoa_ideological_primacy_desc: From Whampoa, our officers carry not just arms, but principles too. Unlike the tenets of other schools, the ones of Whampoa can be trusted. We should channel all ideological training through the school to strengthen our nation as a whole.
loc.CHI_postpone_the_tutelage_desc: Though the goal remains democracy, now is not the hour, and the present crisis requires special measures. We must guide the nation through peril before democracy can bloom.
loc.CHI_postpone_the_tutelage_tt: Unlocks decision to §YReeducate§! certain §YWarlord Generals§! once the Cliques have been conquered
loc.CHI_second_father_of_the_nation_desc: Dr. Sun Yat-sen allowed us to throw off the shackles of the Qing and will always be the First Father of our nation. Generalissimo Chiang purged the party of the communists, and for that he shall always be remembered as the Second Father.
loc.CHI_weaponise_the_faithful_desc: Those who believe most fervently will fight most fiercely. Currently we do not have an outlet for those, but we could make one and put them in the first rank. Their devotion will become our sharpest blade, cutting down every enemy.
loc.CHI_political_advisors_in_every_division: The army defends the state, until it does not. Too often has the state fallen to those with arms, but we will not allow that to happen to us. Political officers would help motivate our armed forces to proper action.
loc.CHI_an_alternative_rooted_in_tradition_d: Liberalism and communism are foreign concepts that have no meaning in the [ROOT.GetAdjective] nation. Only something of our own making can bring prosperity and pride to our shores.
loc.CHI_an_alternative_rooted_in_tradition_t: Increases the cost of infiltration for [PRC.GetNameDefCap] by: §G+25%§!
loc.CHI_put_an_end_to_PRC_desc: What truly stand in our way to unify all of China are those pesky Communists holding out in the mountains, lead by [PRC.GetLeader]. As long as they exist there will be no united China. Internal enemies make us weak, weakness invites foreign aggression and foreign aggression risks our sovereignty. Thus, it is our duty to put an end to [PRC.GetNameDef]!
loc.CHI_reject_the_nine_powers_desc: The treaties forced on us by overseas strangers were imposed at a time of weakness, but we are now able to reject them. Let every signatory know: We owe the foreigners nothing!
loc.CHI_setting_a_new_standard_desc: Our army was too influenced by Western thought and doctrine, but we are the country of Sun Tzu and not Clausewitz. Through structural changes and ideological work, we have reshaped our armed forces in our own image.
loc.CHI_eternal_revolution_desc: Our successes have shown the efficacy of our system over old and foreign ideas. The revolutionary fire burns in the heart of every compatriot and we need to harness that to spread the revolution even further.
loc.CHI_eternal_revolution_tt: Allows §YDeclaring War Zones§! in Claimed States
loc.CHI_reclaim_what_was_lost_desc: The Qing inherited the largest empire we have ever seen, and they squandered it to the benefit of foreign powers. It has brought shame to us as a people, nation, and party. We need to rectify this travesty and restore China's dignity.
loc.CHI_bring_the_wayward_back_into_the_fold: Bring the Wayward Back Into the Fold

Since the Xinhai revolution some of our brethren have been misguided and led astray. They have been told that they would be better off being apart from the collective. It is time for us to revert that and bring them back into the fold.
loc.CHI_retake_coastal_cities_desc: For far too long have the Western imperialists enforced their will upon us. The time is ripe for us to finally reclaim what has been stolen. [326.GetName], [729.GetName], and [728.GetName] must once again be a part of our realm!
loc.CHI_a_new_middle_kingdom_desc: In previous eras we have been the point around which the world rotates. This isolated us from the world, and made the eras pass us by. We will not make that mistake again, and this time we will be the maker of our own destiny, and those of others'.
loc.CHI_the_southern_mandate_desc: To the south lies land rich in resources and people of our kin. We hold a right to these lands from our ancient connections and it is time that we march south.
loc.CHI_the_northern_mandate_desc: North of our lands lies an empty wasteland, a diamond in the rough, that [SOV.GetNameDef] is squandering. Only those that are able to see the land for its true potential should hold it, and that we do!
loc.CHI_the_greater_game_desc: The imperialists played their game in central Asia, but only bashed their heads in the region. It is time to walk west and bring our armies across the steppes once again.
loc.CHI_cradle_of_civilization_desc: From the silty waters of the Yellow River sprang a civilization that shaped mankind. Empires rise and fall, but the glory of ancient china shines upon the earth eternally and so shall our supremacy.
loc.CHI_cradle_of_civilization_tt: Unlocks decisions to integrate §YAsian§! states that are §YClaimed§! by us when reaching high enough §YCompliance§!
loc.CHI_military_affairs_commission_sea_desc: The foundation for an efficient military is a proper high command. As the Military Affairs Commission is our highest organization for the defense of the nation we should make sure of its competency.
loc.CHI_set_up_an_nco_school_desc: An overwhelming part of our military lacks formal education which for the ordinary soldier might be forgiven, but becomes a problem when moving up the ranks. We need to set up a system to train our non-commissioned officers so that we can ascertain quality.
loc.CHI_formalize_field_promotions_desc: In an ideal world, we would have a fully trained and educated army. But this is not that world. In our current predicament getting troops to the front is our priority, and the faster we can do that, the better. We will set up a program to find those among the common soldiers who can lead their comrades onward.
loc.CHI_crackdown_on_corruption_in_recruitme: Since the republican army was set up, there have been systemic issues in recruitment. People have been paying their way out of service and creative accounting has been used to embezzle salaries. This needs to end if we are to survive the onslaught of the modern world as there is no place for inefficiencies.
§Y$CHI_he_yingqin$§! becomes available as a level §Y3§! General
loc.CHI_form_the_combined_logistics_command_: Now that our army has been reorganized and is efficiently dealing with any threats to our nation, we are encountering other issues. Though our logistical situation has improved, our armed forces lack coordination in the logistical distribution systems. We must alleviate this issue at once!
loc.CHI_reorganise_the_train_desc: Our supply organization has never developed to the scale or complexity we need it to be. A thorough reorganization would empower us to put more troops into the fray.
loc.CHI_rely_on_locals_desc: Setting up a full organization that can be used by our forces is complicated, time-consuming and expensive. History shows us an alternative, why ship what can be found locally. If we rely on farmers and workers that populate our great land we can make up the difference left by our system.
loc.CHI_focus_on_meritocratic_principles_des: Nepotism, bribery, and corruption are the bane of an efficient military. These abominations have been far too present in our forces, and that needs to change. Setting up structures to promote the most meritorious individuals into the right positions will guarantee victory.
loc.CHI_focus_on_meritocratic_principles_tt: Enables manually removing the Army Spirit §YWhampoa Primacy§!
loc.CHI_protracted_warfare_desc: Since [JAP.GetNameDef] beat the Russians, its people have believed that swift, aggressive action is the road to victory. This has led them to have a military without staying power, so if we deny them a quick victory, their units will crumble in short order.
loc.CHI_decisive_battles_desc: All victories do not carry the same weight, as was shown by [JAP.GetNameDef] in 1905. We should focus our forces on winning key engagements by taking the initiative to strike into Manchuria.
loc.CHI_invest_in_mountain_guns_desc: Our lands are not easily traversable, and moving traditional heavy artillery through them proves a challenge for most. Having our guns able to be disassembled at will is the natural solution to this problem, and worthy of investigation.
loc.CHI_repurpose_fort_artillery_desc: Warfare can no longer be locked down by key fortifications, the end of the last great war showed that. While the structures might not hold a lot of value, the artillery pieces in them can still fire on the enemy.
loc.CHI_repurpose_fort_artillery_tt: §RYou don't control any forts to dismantle §!
loc.CHI_fund_the_marine_corp_desc: Our armies are vast and their power cannot be doubted, but can be a blunt instrument when used incorrectly. A specialized corps of professional naval infantry that are trained to defend our coastlines would be worth tenfold their number in ordinary troops, and when the time comes, project our power over the seas.
loc.CHI_the_4_defence_areas_desc: If we are to defend our great nation successfully a comprehensive plan is paramount for success. We will divide the country into four zones and appoint an appropriate commander to each, this will guarantee local security and efficient resistance.
loc.CHI_defence_in_depth_desc: Proper defense cannot be static and we need to incorporate this into our strategy. We know that the  [JAP.GetAdjective] does not have staying power so the more we can draw them in the better. The ebbs and flows of battle should not break the dams that are our armed forces.
loc.CHI_prepare_the_war_zones_desc: We need to reorganize our armies along regional lines to know who holds responsibility over which area. This will allow us to plan appropriate operations for the area in question and maximize our ability to break through.
loc.CHI_guerrilla_warfare_desc: Conventional warfare allows us to resist to a certain degree, but fighting on our own land allows us more unconventional methods. Infiltrating the states held by the enemy and wreaking havoc on the rear elements is a way of fighting that [JAP.GetNameDef] are completely unprepared for.
loc.CHI_rapidity_is_the_essence_of_war: Rapidity is the Essence of War
loc.CHI_rapidity_is_the_essence_of_war_desc: Speed and surprise are our best weapons, and learning how to exploit these elements will be paramount in modern war. Bold and rapid maneuvers will keep the enemy off balance and thus allow us to strike deeper and with less resistance.
loc.CHI_organise_the_200th_division_desc: Armored forces are the greatest innovation in warfare of this century, and unfortunately we have been lagging behind. Establishing an armored division and appointing a suitable commander to lead the charge would be a force multiplier that will pave the way to victory.
loc.CHI_motorise_our_infantry_desc: Our pool of manpower is vast, and has always been the wellspring of our power. Modern motor transport empowers the common soldier, getting him into combat faster and ready to strike hard. A man in the right place, with rifle in hand, will always be efficient.
loc.CHI_bog_them_down_in_the_centre: Bog them Down in the Center
loc.CHI_bog_them_down_in_the_centre_modify: Will modify the bonus from §Y$CHI_bog_them_down$§! to give:
loc.CHI_bog_them_down_in_the_centre_desc: We know that we cannot stop [JAP.GetNameDef] at the border, and that we need to choose another defense line with care. Centering around the Yangtze river would be an efficient way to halt the aggressors and make the area a fulcrum of our whole defense. However, the act of planning our defense for specific areas goes further.
loc.CHI_appear_where_you_are_not_expected: Appear Where You Are Not Expected
loc.CHI_appear_where_you_are_not_expected_de: No successful commander ever struck the enemy where and how they expected it. Deception is foundational to war and we must always seem to be weak when we are strong, and strong when we are weak.
loc.CHI_declare_war_zone_modify: Will modify the bonus from §Y$CHI_declare_war_zone$§! to give:
loc.CHI_relocate_factories_from_the_coast_de: We have a serious strategic conundrum. Our centers of industry are along the coastline, and in danger of falling in to enemy hands. Without manufacturing, resistance cannot be expected to last for long. We shall move our production inland where they can be kept safe.
loc.CHI_state_aa_desc: In this new world the enemy does not only attack from land and sea, but from the air as well. Preparing ourselves for the onslaught that will inevitably come from the sky by turning our guns upwards will be imperative if we are to hold off the invaders.
loc.CHI_coastal_forts_desc: While the foreign invaders and their puppets will first attack from the north, we can be sure they will eventually strike from the sea as well. We will be ready to throw them back into the sea the moment they dare to set foot on our soil.
loc.CHI_salvage_enemy_equipment_desc: The needs of the National Revolutionary Army are insatiable by our industry. Our units could compensate for some of that discrepancy by reusing what we can find in the enemy’s camp.
loc.CHI_salvage_enemy_equipment_random_gener: §YFive§! randomly selected army leaders will gain §Y$Scavenger$§!: \n-$MODIFIER_EQUIPMENT_CAPTURE$: §G+3%§!
loc.CHI_commemorate_the_labour_corps_desc: Our people went overseas and toiled for the recognition of our nation, showing diligence on the battlefields of the great war. While the [ENG.GetAdjective] and the [FRA.GetAdjective] do not remember them, we do, and we will honor their work by elevating their memory and taking their learnings to heart.
loc.CHI_utilise_the_terrain_desc: Our divisions are not equipped with the latest equipment, nor do they have a uniform standard of training, but if there is something we know deeply it is our own lands. We can use every waterway, hill, and field to our advantage, and thus make the experience of any who dare to invade a living hell.
loc.CHI_train_for_asymmetry_desc: War is never fair and we can never expect it to be. There are those with stronger militaries that will try to subjugate us and we need to find a way to even the odds. Training our military and its leaders to find new ways to fight will be hard, but the benefit is undeniable.
loc.CHI_train_for_asymmetry_random_generals_: §YThree§! randomly selected army leaders will gain §YGuerrilla Fighter§!: \n-$MODIFIER_DIG_IN_SPEED_FACTOR$: §G+50%§!
loc.CHI_know_thy_enemy_desc: We need to know how to find the points in the enemy lines where we can apply force and exploit breaks.
loc.CHI_know_thy_enemy_tt: Unlocks an upgraded version of Force Attack which does not lose entrenchment on attack.
loc.CHI_know_thy_self_desc: Understanding the enemy will give us victories, but ultimate victory can only come through knowledge of one’s own abilities as well. Instituting processes for rigorous self-assessment will reveal our weaknesses, but also our strengths.
loc.CHI_river_crossing_studies_desc: China is a land of great rivers and any army that will operate in it will have to learn how to fight across them. We are in a particularly good spot to learn from this and put those learnings into practice. Learnings that will benefit us in throwing out the invaders and bringing the fight abroad.
loc.CHI_armoured_car_tactics_desc: Most armies are getting progressively heavier armored units in a race of industrial might. However, one is not more efficient with a hatchet when a knife is needed.
loc.CHI_serve_the_country_with_utmost_loyalt: Serve the Country with Utmost Loyalty
We have shown our mettle to the enemy and stopped them dead in their tracks. Due to unwavering dedication and service to our nation, there is no invader that will be able to subjugate us!
loc.CHI_the_well_timed_swoop_of_a_falcon: The Well-timed Swoop of a Falcon
loc.CHI_the_well_timed_swoop_of_a_falcon_des: We have mastered the ways of striking and destroying our enemies. From throwing out the invaders to striking them in their own home, old knowledge stands true to this day when we march to victory!
loc.CHI_rocaf_desc: To secure [ROOT.GetName]'s skies and project power beyond our borders, we must strengthen the Air Force. Investment in doctrine and technical expertise lays the foundation for a modern aerial arm capable of challenging any foe.
loc.CHI_officialize_the_rocaf: Officialize the Republic of China Air Force
loc.CHI_officialize_the_rocaf_desc: The air force has been an unofficial entity for far too long. Now with the technological and tactical developments we have made, it is safe to reorganize the Aviation Affairs Commission into the Air Force Command Headquarters. The ROCAF shall be a fully separate branch of service, independent from the army and navy.
loc.CHI_bring_the_war_home_desc: Our enemies must learn that no part of their territory is beyond reach. With targeted bombing and psychological warfare, we will strike deep and disrupt the enemy's will to fight.
loc.CHI_open_afamf_plants_desc: In order to develop new aircraft, such as the Chu XP-0 envisioned by Maj. Gen. Chu Chia-Jen, we must open facilities capable of supporting and producing light fighters and dive bombers. The ideal location for this would be in Kunming, but any place is good as long as we can make something that can contest our enemies in the skies.
loc.CHI_open_afamf_plants_tt: If we or a subject of ours controls §Y[325.GetName]§!, we will gain an additional Military Factory there
loc.CHI_projecting_power_desc: By extending our air reach beyond our front lines, we prepare to strike wherever opportunity arises. Projection of air power is no longer an ambition but a strategic necessity.
loc.CHI_strike_at_what_is_weak_desc: We will not meet strength head-on. Instead, our doctrine must emphasize targeting the enemy's most vulnerable points with precision and persistence.
loc.CHI_a_wind_that_rises_in_the_daytime_las: A Wind That Rises in the Daytime Lasts Long
Sustained bombing during daylight offers a stable, methodical approach to air warfare. We must capitalize on visibility and coordination to deliver effective blows.
loc.CHI_but_a_night_breeze_soon_falls: But a Night Breeze Soon Falls
loc.CHI_but_a_night_breeze_soon_falls_desc: Night operations may be fraught with risk, yet with enhanced training our pilots can minimize losses under cover of darkness. The enemy will never see us coming...
loc.CHI_escort_efficiency_desc: Fighter escorts are the shield for our bombers. Enhancing coordination and coverage ensures more return to base intact, ready for the next sortie.
loc.CHI_controlling_our_skies_desc: Before we dominate abroad, we must command the skies at home. A disciplined air defense network is the backbone of national security.
loc.CHI_interception_detection_desc: Timely detection allows us to strike before the enemy does. We will improve our radar and observation networks to gain that critical edge.
loc.CHI_focus_on_positional_advantage_desc: Air combat is not just about numbers or speed. Advantage lies in altitude, angle and awareness. We must teach our pilots to exploit every edge.
loc.CHI_effectivize_ground_crew_usage_desc: Efficiency on the ground is as vital as performance in the sky. Streamlining crew tasks and logistics will keep more aircraft in the air.
loc.CHI_coordinate_with_the_army_desc: Victory comes from unity of arms. Our air and ground forces must operate with one mind for one mission.
loc.CHI_an_appropriate_design_desc: Our aircraft must match our doctrine. Whether for range or resilience, we will pursue designs that fit our operational needs.
loc.CHI_reorganise_the_central_armys_academy: Training must evolve with technology. We will overhaul our aviation corps to produce modern, capable airmen fit for tomorrow's battles.
loc.CHI_formalise_training_regime_desc: A consistent and rigorous training regime is the key to reducing losses and improving performance. Standardization begins now.
loc.CHI_conserve_our_pilots_desc: Pilots are not easily replaced. By reducing risks and improving survivability, we preserve experience and maintain combat strength.
loc.CHI_camco_primacy_desc: CAMCO represents our best domestic partner for air development. Prioritizing their capabilities will ensure that production keeps pace with ambition.
loc.CHI_SINAW_primacy_desc: SINAW offers technical innovation that CAMCO cannot. Investing in their expansion brings us closer to parity with foreign powers.
loc.CHI_initiate_the_sky_projects_desc: Rocketry and advanced propulsion open new strategic options. We will fund experimental initiatives with long-term payoff in mind.
loc.CHI_focus_on_the_Tianlong_project_desc: Jet propulsion is the future of air warfare. The Tianlong Project stands at the forefront of that evolution.
loc.CHI_VTOL_experiments_desc: Vertical take-off aircraft promise flexibility on unpredictable terrain. We will begin trials to assess their role in modern combat.
loc.CHI_hongxiang_force_desc: Through cooperation with our allies and peers in aviation, we have been able to establish a domestic training program for military parachute operations.
loc.CHI_republic_of_china_navy_desc: The Central Navy has had a troubled past, with poor funding and uncertain coastal control leaving our ships in poor shape. With trouble on the horizon, it is our goal to put these challenges behind us.
loc.CHI_foreign_acquisition_desc: While we aim for this to be a temporary setback, we must recognize that other powers are far beyond us in terms of naval technological progression. Modernizing our navy must start by approaching a technologically superior benefactor.
loc.CHI_develop_northern_naval_logistics_des: Formally recovered from Japan in 1922, Qingdao represents a key strategic port city that should play a role in our naval militarization efforts.
loc.CHI_develop_southern_naval_logistics_des: Our Southern coast, pitted with colonialist exclaves, is woefully underdefended. If we are ever to meet the Western powers on their own terms, the reclamation and development of this key area is a necessity.
loc.CHI_concerted_push_desc: Time and time again the Chinese people have shown their adaptability in the face of adversity. This situation is no different. Our leadership has declared the need for a navy to rival the great powers, and our economy shall rise to the challenge.
loc.CHI_local_alloy_commission_desc: Our land is a source of great natural mineral wealth, yet despite this we have not yet capitalized on this. Exploring our possibilities here is bound to pay dividends in the future.
loc.CHI_deny_the_enemy_desc: While our superiority on land is unmatched, perhaps the best we can hope for as we revitalize our ailing navy, is the denial of enemy operations.
loc.CHI_dominate_the_enemy_desc: We will match our foes on equal terms, no matter the cost.
loc.CHI_navy_spooks_desc: The oceans around China are bustling hubs of trade activity. Where there are traders, there are rumors. Where there are rumors, there are opportunities...
loc.CHI_promote_admiral_desc: Our recent naval construction efforts will eventually render our ailing 19th Century warships obsolete. This, however, represents an opportunity to convert them into training vessels for crew and commanders alike; with a training program optimized around our navy's strategic direction.
loc.CHI_promote_admiral_tt: If §Y$CHI_deny_the_enemy$§! has been taken then all admirals will gain the §Y$green_water_expert$§! trait \n\nIf §Y$CHI_dominate_the_enemy$§! has been taken then all admirals will gain the §Y$blue_water_expert$§! trait
loc.CHI_heavy_ship_research_desc: Domestic production of battleships is vital to match the regional and colonial powers that have plundered our nation thus far. While our technology may put us at a disadvantage, our manufacturing processes and the sheer will of our people shall carry the day.
loc.CHI_strike_from_below_desc: Germany has proven that a nation under threat from a navally dominant power can rely on a strong sub-surface fleet to protect their interests. As we find ourselves in a similar situation, we shall look West for lessons.
loc.CHI_fund_the_naval_air_establishment_des: The combined advantages of naval and air superiority are too great a prize to ignore. Expanding our naval air arm reduces the risk for inter-branch failures in communication.
loc.CHI_early_detections_desc: With an effective but modest fleet, we have no choice but to optimize our engagements to best utilize ships. Intelligence and awareness represent the best methods by which to do this.
loc.CHI_defend_our_coasts_desc: Our enemy cannot attack us if they cannot reach us. Minelaying is the most effective means of defense against invasion. We will worry about the costs later...
loc.CHI_long_range_desc: A well-weighted arrow can end a war before it begins. Larger, noisier engines may put our crew at risk, but the ability to project power even further will also increase our leverage on the world stage.
loc.CHI_battleship_focus_desc: As we inaugurate construction of our first great behemoth of the seas, it is only right and fitting that we celebrate the great Father of our nation.
loc.CHI_coastal_defence_desc: Optimizing the space usage in our sub-surface fleet means smaller, faster subs. We had to remove a few non-essentials though, such as bunks... or any other amenities.
loc.CHI_heavy_cruiser_focus_desc: Our surface navy, while a relic of the Qing, has served us well for nigh-on 50 years. While the world is changing, it would be unwise to set aside such a breadth of institutional knowledge when it comes to operating short-range, armored cruisers: our future should incorporate the past.
loc.CHI_mobile_bases_desc: As the rest of the world is proving, the air represents the future of war. Our ability to strike at distance, however, is limited by our geography. Following the example of the great powers, we must focus our efforts on mobile strike platforms.
loc.CHI_the_seas_of_tomorrow_desc: We dream of a future in which China leads the world in soft power and technological prowess. We have spent years catching up to the vast navies of the colonial powers and our regional rivals, but now it is time to chart the course of the future ourselves.
loc.CHI_the_seas_of_tomorrow_tt: A §YScientist§! specialized in what has been chosen earlier will be made available.
loc.CHI_long_range_screens_desc: As we accentuate our efforts to look beyond domestic conflicts, the ability to deploy substantial force at great distance and low cost becomes vital.
loc.CHI_promote_the_national_currency_desc: Our recent replacement of the silver standard by the introduction of a new national currency has shown initial good results in lowering our reliance on global events. However, the usage of the new currency is most prevalent in the bigger cities, and we should make a concerted effort to ensure its adoption in rural areas.
loc.CHI_institute_a_national_registry_of_pro: Institute a National Registry of Property

Bureaucracy is the foundation of the state, and the bureaucracy cannot function efficiently if accurate information is not available. It is in this inefficiency that unscrupulous agents can exploit the system and enrich themselves to the detriment of the rest of our nation.
loc.CHI_the_three_year_plan_desc: Our efforts have been very unfocused and our nation has been lacking guidance. Through a planned effort in the coming years, we will focus our energies on one great goal. Hopefully nothing puts a stop to it.
loc.CHI_the_three_year_plan_tt: §RWill be removed upon entering a war.§!
loc.CHI_extend_compulsory_education_desc: A literate population is the backbone of national development, but unfortunately our educational efforts have been cursory and too focused around urban areas. This has led to an overlooked population in the countryside, a population ready for someone else to fill the shoes of the state.
loc.CHI_extend_compulsory_education_tt: Every §Y[?CHI_improving_neglected_countryside_mission_time]§! days, §Y$CHI_neglected_countryside$§! will §GImprove§! until the negative modifiers are gone.
loc.CHI_initiate_the_gung_ho_movement_desc: With the current crisis we have understood how lacking our situation is, both in materiel and productive means. What we do not lack is people that can be put to work if only organized properly. We have been presented with the idea to set up small scale industrial cooperatives that we can disperse throughout the country.
loc.CHI_expand_the_bureaucracy_desc: Our country is vast and administering it takes a lot of effort, and people. With our enlarged educational base we can now employ more in the state apparatus and bolster our control over more remote parts of the country.
loc.CHI_send_the_urban_students_to_the_count: Send the Urban Students to the Countryside

While our educational efforts have given fruition, there is still a large discrepancy between the cities and the countryside. It is time to take a more direct approach and use the knowledge of our higher education students in village schools.
loc.CHI_find_foreign_financiers_desc: While the potential of our economy is endless, the current state of it means that the buildup is going to take time if we are to do it ourselves. A quicker way to turbocharge our economy would be to bring external capital into the country by way of joint ventures. We should look abroad for individuals with an ability to see the possibilities of the Chinese nation.
loc.CHI_find_foreign_financiers_tt: Gains: §Y+1500 $CIC_BANK_HEADER$§! for every major (excluding Japan) that has at least §G70§! opinion of [ROOT.GetName].\n\n
loc.CHI_naval_separate_defense_plan_desc: Chen Shaokuan has proposed what he refers to as the Naval Separate Defense Plan, which aims to build at least twelve aircraft carriers within the next 30 years. If we want to secure our seas, we should take him up on this idea, and begin production of a carrier fleet with utmost haste!
loc.CHI_fund_the_plan_domestically_desc: If there is one thing to be learned from the last century it is that there is danger in trusting foreign capital. If we are to build up our nation's industries, having to rely on foreigners and not our local banks and investors would be a grave error and a dangerous prospect. We should rather find domestic sources of finance to not risk dependency.
loc.CHI_finance_cooperatives_desc: The cooperatives are full of vitality and ingenuity, but do not have the access to credit. While we might not have enormous amounts of means, the needs of the cooperatives are so small that we could finance them ourselves and take the next step.
loc.CHI_introduce_income_tax_desc: The way we finance the state is archaic and not suitable for the modern world. While we have made efforts to implement an income tax several times in the last half century, this time we have a strong government that can follow through.
loc.CHI_redistribute_land_desc: To a large extent our country's farmers labor under landlords that are extracting value for personal gain. This cannot stand, as it pushes the productivity of our country down and keeps it backward.
loc.CHI_expand_academica_sinica_desc: With a large part of our population starting to get to a satisfactory educational level it is time to look to our higher education. For greater capabilities we will develop already existing institutions in Academia Sinica, our most dominant scientific establishment.
loc.CHI_expand_the_chinese_academy_of_scienc: Establish the Chinese Academy of Sciences
The Academia Sinica has begun a new initiative. It will bring the brightest minds in our nation together at a new national academy for natural sciences, science and technology.
loc.CHI_expand_national_sun_yat_sen_universi: Now that the economy is capable of financially supporting higher education for our populace, it is time for the Chinese people to study extensively, inquire accurately, reflect carefully, discriminate clearly and practice earnestly. Only through these principles, outlaid by Dr Sun Yat-sen, will our nation be able to become a leading figure in research and development.
loc.CHI_expand_the_cooperatives_desc: The cooperatives have impressed us with their efficacy, but they are still small in scale and reach. If we would lend them our network of connections they could grow and multiply even further.
loc.CHI_administer_cooperatives_desc: The nature of the cooperatives have meant that they grow and spread fast, but often work in isolation. A national office would coordinate and support cooperative networks across [ROOT.GetName].
loc.CHI_monopolise_resource_extraction_desc: We have observed in other countries the power in a central organization for planning the economy. Especially the act of making sure that the flow of resources does not stop or get exploited by private interests should lay in the hands of technocrats, or in our case the National Resources Commission.
loc.CHI_invite_foreign_experts_desc: The last century has shown that our technical knowledge has lagged behind that of the Westerners. While it has been to our detriment we are now in a position to take advantage of their knowledge and grow our economy faster than ever.
loc.CHI_print_money_for_the_army_desc: An army is never free and if one wants a big army there is a price to be paid. There are however different ways to pay and we could instruct our people to print extra money specifically for this purpose.
loc.CHI_maintain_adequate_currency_reserves_: Reckless spending risks collapse of the system as have been shown time and time again. If we are to succeed in controlled growth we will need to restrain ourselves and maintain proper currency reserves.
Every §Y[?CHI_improving_inefficient_economy_mission_time]§! days, §Y$CHI_inefficient_economy$§! will improve until the negative modifiers are gone.
loc.CHI_develop_the_chemical_industry_desc: One of the greatest accomplishments of modern civilization is its conquest of nature through the means of chemistry. From agriculture to manufacturing, the chemical industry can empower society - but unfortunately ours is only nascent. If we were to grow these industries there is no telling what we could achieve.
loc.CHI_grow_the_coal_industry_desc: Coal powers our factories, trains and furnaces. In order to keep powering the nation while growing our economic power, we need to find new sources of energy. The National Resources Commission has identified several sources we should exploit.
loc.CHI_grow_the_coal_industry_tt1: Gain additional §YCoal§! in our core states and in allied Warlord States
loc.CHI_grow_the_coal_industry_tt2: Unlocks Prospecting Decisions for §YCoal§! in our and allied Warlord States
loc.CHI_tungsten_and_antimony_extraction_des: Strategic metals make strategic victories, and we have vast deposits — deposits that can be put to great use if we could get the ores out of the ground.
loc.CHI_central_steel_and_machine_works_desc: Steel is deeply foundational for our industries and so far we have lacked proper production. This is despite the resources being available to us, we simply need to institute the plan from the National Resources Commission.
loc.CHI_empower_those_that_have_lost_desc: There are many in our nation that have lost much in this war, such as their work or homes. These people might not seem a likely source of power, but if given the ability, they will be the wave that washes the invaders out.
loc.CHI_found_a_modern_fertiliser_plant_desc: To feed the nation, we must rationalize our agriculture, and a local fertilizer production is the first step. We shall build a factory for this purpose, but also use it for other means.
loc.CHI_import_fertilisers_desc: Although domestic production does solve concerns about dependency, imitating someone else is just an extra step. If we would set up purchasing orders from elsewhere we can focus on our distinct strengths.
loc.CHI_construct_the_banqiao_dam_desc: Our mighty rivers are what define our lands, and controlling them have been foundational for our civilization. In the future, those rivers will power the growth and greatness of our nation!
