loc.PHI_commonwealth_of_the_philippines_desc: Established just a year ago, the Commonwealth of the Philippines is the first step towards an independent Philippines, promised by the USA to be a 10 year transitional period. There is still much to do, and many decisions to make to get our nascent nation up and running properly.
loc.PHI_align_with_the_usa_desc: The United States of America has proven to be a benevolent, and wealthy, overlord. By bringing our nations closer, there is much yet that they can do for us in order to speed up our development and ensure our protection.
loc.PHI_align_with_japan_desc: Despite their posturing, the United States of America is still a colonial overlord, and could at any time renege on their promises to us. It would therefore be prudent to make new friends on the international state, and at the moment Japan stands to be the most prudent choice.
loc.PHI_quezon_city_desc: Manila has served us well as the capital, however, it is stifled by severe problems such as overcrowding, lack of housing, poor sanitation and congestion. What we need is a city planned from the start to serve as our capital, and while this will take years if not decades to construct and develop - we should begin now and reap the rewards of our foresight later!
loc.PHI_peg_the_peso_to_the_dollar: Peg the Peso to the Dollar
loc.PHI_peg_the_peso_to_the_dollar_desc: Our currency should be bound to the US Dollar as a determination of its value, this gives our currency a real basis in value and provides a reliable foundation to establish trade.
loc.PHI_leverage_the_peso_desc: Our currency is our own, and we should work to distinguish it from the US Dollar. This will allow us to engage in corrective financial policies to best suit the further development of our economy.
loc.PHI_agricultural_migrants_to_hawaii_desc: A number of Filipino workers have found good fortune working for American farmers in Hawaii, we should encourage this emigration so that they can continue to send money back to their families back at home, and thus grow our economy.
loc.PHI_unicameral_legislature_desc: One of the most important steps in establishing our independent state is the organization of this independent government. Building something out of nothing is very difficult, so we should establish one chamber in the Philippines Congress
loc.PHI_national_fiscal_policy_desc: With our nation firmly on the path towards independence, one of the first things we must do is disconnect our finances from those of the United States, develop our budget - and the means to raise those funds through taxation.
loc.PHI_encourage_foreign_investment_desc: The United States is not the only nation that is interested in earning a share of our market. We have numerous raw materials and a thriving agricultural sector. We should make it clear that our nation is open to investment for those with the means and foresight to benefit from the bounty of the Philippines.
loc.PHI_develop_japanese_trade_connections_d: Japan has made it clear that they are hungry for goods and resources, and the Philippines has a bounty to trade. We should encourage commerce between our nations for our mutual benefit.
loc.PHI_encourage_japanese_investment_desc: Currently the United States enjoys a number of trade advantages in our nation, we should quietly develop connections with Japan, so that Japanese investment can flow into our nation, and undercut the greed of the Americans.
loc.PHI_quezon_city_campus_desc: In the same way that we are planning for the future of our nation, planning and constructing the city of the future, similarly we should consider the future of our Filipino citizens, and ensure that educational excellence is given the space to flourish in this fledgling city.
loc.PHI_reduce_unneccessary_expenditure_desc: Now that we have a national fiscal policy, we need to ensure that the books are properly balanced. We want to achieve this not by raising taxes, or going after those who are avoiding them, but rather the trim unnecessary fat. After all, if we are not already delivering those services, who will miss them?
loc.PHI_subsidies_desc: It is a fact of capital that it takes money to make money. We need to use our budget to inject cash into sectors where we will see a quick return. Providing targeted subsidies to industrial efforts and to expand infrastructure to make rich, but hard to reach resources and populations more easily accessible.
loc.PHI_basic_welfare_desc: We have a responsibility to our more vulnerable people, and a duty to see at least some of their challenges eased. We already have the absolute essentials in place such as charitable institutions, however, with the rise of industry the plight of the workers has come to the fore. We will establish the National Economic Council to dictate labor laws and institute a minimum wage.
loc.PHI_encourage_asian_trade_desc: There are significant historical maritime connections between Asian nations, and despite the best efforts by colonial powers to curtail them they remain strong. We should foster these links and encourage more trade between our nations, for the mutual growth and prosperity for all.
loc.PHI_pro_hacendados_desc: The rich, landed elite inherited from the Spanish colonial era remain a significant force of influence and wealth within the Philippines. We should court these old families and in exchange for the continuation of the status quo, earn their patronage.
loc.PHI_anti_hacendados_desc: The rich, landed elite inherited from the Spanish colonial era have oppressed their tenants for too long. We should tear down this antiquated institution and return the land to those who work it. Only in this way can we modernize our economy and rid ourselves of these leeches.
loc.PHI_sugar_barons_desc: Sugar is the back upon which the entire Philippine economy is based. Without this rich resource, our nation's prosperity would disappear overnight. We need to encourage those who cultivate and export this critical crop, thereby earning us more sweet, sweet money.
loc.PHI_sugar_barons_tt: §YOne random General§! will get §G+2§! planning skill
loc.PHI_luzon_transport_desc: Although already the most developed part of the Philippines, it is also the most populous and industrial, and therefore it's transport routes are in high need for further investment and expansion.
loc.PHI_expand_gold_mining_desc: Spain has always been remarkably astute when it came to finding gold and silver reserves, and they were not disappointed in the Philippines. They would however be very angry to discover that the richest gold veins are only now being tapped, and this booming export is bringing record revenue to our nation.
loc.PHI_mindanao_transport_desc: Despite being the second largest island in the Philippine archipelago, it has never reached even close to the level of investment as its northern counterpart in Luzon. We should remedy this oversight!
loc.PHI_land_reform_desc: Wealthy landowners still dominate the agricultural sector in the Philippines. We must demonstrate that we are a modern nation, not a feudal one. The state will implement compulsory purchases of these vast estates, and sell parcels to small holders and corporations for more efficient cultivation and use.
loc.PHI_japanese_advisors_desc: Japan achieved the impossible, going from a feudal society to a modern one in absolute record time. Although this was some time ago, they still maintain a great deal of industrial and military expertise, which with our increasingly cordial relations we might be able to tap in to.
loc.PHI_san_miguel_desc: Established by Spanish Royal Charter in 1890, the San Miguel brewery has produced exceptional German-style lager ever since. Now with our population increasingly prosperous, and global demand rising we should endeavor to expand this well known beverage institution. Cheers to a better world.
loc.PHI_textile_mills_desc: We are now in the midst of a major push into a more industrial economy, and the backbone of this is the textile industry. If we are able to produce the basics ourselves, then we will never again be reliant- or vulnerable to foreign influence again.
loc.PHI_encourage_gold_exports_desc: We are currently experiencing a gold rush, and it couldn't have come at a better time. Our domestic supply has become entirely saturated, luckily the world is hungering for gold. The global population emerging from the Great Depression are hungry to more tangible icons of their own wealth, and there is nothing more tangible than gold bars.
loc.PHI_mineral_prospecting_desc: Some would say we have been exceptionally lucky in our mineral prospecting, having so readily stumbled on large deposits of gold. However, it is dangerous for an economy to be so reliant on just one resource as the Spanish Empire realized only too late. We should put more resources into the discovery of other minerals. Who knows what our soil could still be hiding?
loc.PHI_bill_of_rights_desc: If we wish to be taken seriously as a modern state, we must enshrine the rights of our people in to law. This can be based on that of the [USA.GetName], ascribing such freedoms as that of religion, speech, press and assembly. We are our own nation however, and there are some notable differences, for example we do not see it pertinent to provide for a right to bear arms in our society.
loc.PHI_nationality_act_desc: [USA.GetNameDefCap] are enacting the Nationality Act, which revises existing laws on citizenship, including those concerning Filipinos and their status in the United States. The Act clarifies that Filipinos are recognized as U.S. nationals rather than U.S. citizens, allowing them to live and work in [USA.GetNameDef] but without the full rights of citizenship.
loc.PHI_open_borders_desc: Give me your tired, your poor, your huddled masses yearning to breathe free. Despite [USA.GetAdjective] attempts to limit immigration, we do have control of our own borders. We should seek to establish ourselves as a safe haven for those persecuted by war, or for their race, religion or any other reason.
loc.PHI_philippine_american_educational_foun: Thanks to our very close connections with [USA.GetNameDef], we have engendered various academic links. We should establish an organization responsible for administrating foreign exchange scholarship programs, aimed at fostering bi-national research, cultural understanding and the open exchange of ideas between our two nations.
loc.PHI_government_filipinization_desc: Our government has been dominated by foreign entities for centuries, first the Spanish, then the Americans. It is time that we took control for ourselves, and had rule of the Philippines, by Filipinos and for Filipinos!
loc.PHI_improve_trait_tt: Will gain an improved advisor trait
loc.PHI_bicameral_legislature_desc: The expansion of our government continues. We had already created the lower chamber and now it's time to establish the upper. By this model we can best legislate new laws for our nation.
loc.PHI_uncouple_the_peso_and_dollar_desc: Pegging the Peso to the Dollar has worked well for us, providing a needed level of stability to our currency. With independence looming however, we need to uncouple them so that we can have more control and flexibility in our monetary system, implementing such tools as quantitative easing where required.
loc.PHI_increase_sugar_exports_desc: Sugar has been the bedrock of our economy for centuries, and it has gotten us through the very worst of the Great Depression, with exports remaining healthy. By signing lucrative trade deals with other nations, we can ensure that we are best placed to capitalize on the growth of sugar as foundational to international cuisine... and sodas.
loc.PHI_break_chinese_monopoly_desc: Chinese merchants have found their place in our society as the owner of shops and banks, however with such a hold over such critical services being held by foreigners, for our own security we must ensure a more equitable distribution of distribution networks.
loc.PHI_encourage_chinese_immigration_desc: Chinese merchants have proven to be exceptionally entrepreneurial in setting up small businesses and shops. We should harness this influx of talent and money, and encourage more growth in this sector.
loc.PHI_japanese_observers_desc: With relations drawing ever closer between us, the Japanese have agreed to send a military detachment to our nation. This is so that they may learn first hand how European-style command structures function in a friendly setting, while we may learn from their exceptional combat expertise and thereby pass this wisdom down the ranks.
loc.PHI_one_observer_advisor_focus_tt: Effect when completing one of §Y$PHI_japanese_advisors$§! and §Y$PHI_japanese_observers$§!:
loc.PHI_treaty_of_manila_subject_desc: The long struggle for independence nears its end. From the revolution against Spain, to the hard-fought war against the United States, and the long years as a Commonwealth, the Philippines has endured. With the signing of the Treaty of Manila, our country stands at last as a free and sovereign nation, its independence formally recognized by the world.
loc.PHI_treaty_of_manila_independent_desc: Although we are already independent, there are many on the global stage who have not yet recognized us as such. By signing the Treaty of Manila, we gain that recognition, and are thus able to stand equal to all the other nations on the international stage.
loc.PHI_universal_sufferage_desc: Following the adoption of the constitution, the Filipino people were given a plebiscite on whether to allow universal suffrage in the Philippine nation. The results have returned 91% in favor, and therefore the right to vote has been properly extended.
loc.PHI_modernization_desc: Our industrial efforts have lagged behind other Asian nations for too long. Now that we have our independence, we must showcase our potential to the world, and provide the resources and regulatory space for those who wish to push forward with the mechanization of our economy.
loc.PHI_revision_of_taxation_laws_desc: Now that we have detached from the United States, we need to develop our own tax code, thereby growing our tax base and leading to an increase in government revenues that can then be re-invested into state services such as infrastructure, welfare, the military and other growth schemes.
loc.PHI_bill_of_rights_for_veterans_desc: Many Filipinos have been engaged during the war, and we must ensure that those who return home are properly cared for. If we look after our veterans, we can ensure a good flow of additional manpower into the future as people see that the military is a solid choice for a career.
loc.PHI_rehabilitation_finance_corporation_d: Our nation has been left with significant damage, from ruined cities and bombed roads, destroyed industrial complexes and sabotaged railways. It will take time and money to rebuild, but the cost to our nation of not rebuilding would be even more dramatic.
loc.PHI_department_of_foreign_affairs_desc: With our feet placed squarely on the international stage as an independent entity, we are now responsible for our own diplomatic actions. We must create a department of foreign affairs whose job it is to handle our diplomatic connections and deploy diplomatic staff all around the globe.
loc.PHI_economic_nationalism_desc: Now that we have full control over our future, it is time to take control of our economy too. We have many tools at our disposal, such as tariffs, regulations, goods and capital movement. We need to make use of them all, and thereby showcase just how robust the Philippine economy truly is.
loc.PHI_bell_trade_act_desc: Also known as the Philippine Trade Act, this act governs trade between [PHI.GetName] and the [USA.GetName]. This includes a financial investment package, preferential trade and tariff agreements. It also includes significant US corporate access to Philippine resources which does raise some concerns, however the other benefits have been determined to be worth the risk.
loc.PHI_pearl_of_the_orient_seas_desc: Romanticized by the first Spanish Explorers to describe the lands they had just discovered, the description has never the less stuck, and remains true. Despite all the trials and tragedies that has befallen our islands, we remain a place of great beauty matched only by the pearls we harvest here.
loc.PHI_united_states_army_forces_in_the_far: United States Army Forces in the Far East

The Philippine Department has long been the American command in the Philippines, however, with growing tensions it is time to expand this into a larger formation of the United States Army. This will necessitate the creation of new command structures and the transfer of significant American personnel from the US.
loc.PHI_send_a_share_of_THIS_navy_to_ROOT_tt: Send a part of the [THIS.GetAdjective] navy to [ROOT.GetNameDef].
loc.PHI_military_requisitions_desc: In order to actually facilitate this rapid expansion of military force, we need to requisition significant stores of arms and equipment from supply depots back in the United States. This will allow us to maintain a solid fighting force equipped with the absolute best of American military hardware.
loc.PHI_usaffe_headquarters_desc: Our new Far East Command will need a proper headquarters section, equipped and staffed by premier staff officers from the United States Army. There are a number of retired commanders who could be called upon, or upcoming officers in need of real experience.
loc.PHI_small_arms_and_artillery_requisition: While the very basics have arrived, in order to properly equip the force we are raising here, we need to requisition a whole lot more guns, of all calibers, large and small.
loc.PHI_filipino_repatriation_act_desc: Under the Tydings-McDuffe Act which set the Philippines on the course to independence, a clause was added which severely restricted Filipino entry to the United States. We do not wish to see families separated, so we will offer free one-way travel back to the Philippines.
loc.PHI_american_capital_injection_desc: America is famous for its investment, so let's tap into this capital resource and set it loose on the Philippine economy. Who knows what wonders these capitalist entrepreneurs will be able to create without direct state intervention.
loc.PHI_appoint_macarthur_desc: Since 1935 General Douglas MacArthur has been working as an advisor for the Philippine government, however, it is time we put his skills and experience to use in a more official capacity, and give him command of the United States Forces in the Far East.
loc.PHI_united_states_asiatic_fleet_desc: The United States Army is not the only military body with an interest in the Far East, the navy does too. Manila Bay is the perfect base to station the United States Asiatic Fleet, and is an ideal hub from which to expand their capabilities.
loc.PHI_far_east_air_force_desc: Although the Philippines are far more used to land and naval forces, there is nothing stopping their expansion of air forces either. The Far East Air Force should be based here, and our air fields expanded to enable more and larger planes to provide strike capabilities far closer to the home base of potential threats.
loc.PHI_bring_in_eisenhower_desc: Similarly to MacArthur, Dwight D. Eisenhower has been working as an advisor to the Philippine government since 1935 and MacArthur has now seen fit to officially bring this promising officer onto his staff. Although there have been reports of antipathy between the two, perhaps their differing personalities and leadership styles will be the complement needed to keep the nation safe.
loc.PHI_police_chief_eisenhower_desc: With our new planned capital, Quezon City established, [PHI.GetLeader] has determined that it will need a high profile Police Chief. The president has had a great working relationship with Dwight D. Eisenhower and believes that with the right incentives he could be persuaded to take up the role, and thereby tie him permanently to the Philippine cause.
loc.PHI_eisenhower_stays_tt: §YDwight D. Eisenhower§! will remain in the Philippines, and can no longer be recalled by [USA.GetNameDef]
loc.PHI_mariveles_naval_base_desc: Manila has basic naval facilities, however it has the potential for so much more. The first thing we should do is expand Mariveles Naval Base, situated on the Bataan side of the bay. This deep water port can house more significant facilities for the production and maintenance of naval assets.
loc.PHI_gunboat_diplomacy_desc: We are an island nation, and as such should have the naval capabilities to bring fear to the hearts of those who oppose our interests - and if they don't fear us yet, they will when the Philippine fleet shows up in their main port and takes control of the shipping there.
loc.PHI_trucks_and_transport_requisition_des: Now that weapons are flowing into the Philippines, it is now time to look to the logistics of actually maintaining an army in the field. Thanks to the burgeoning automobile and train industries of the United States, it should be no problem to requisition some of them for our military use.
loc.PHI_investment_fund_desc: Although individual investment into our nation is very much appreciated, to really make the most of this capital it should be maintained in a centralized fund, managed by those who really know the economic realities here in the Philippines, so that they can properly direct this investment to where it can be best used, for the highest return.
loc.PHI_subordinate_philippine_department_de: The Philippine Department was the United States military presence in the Philippines before USAFFE was created. Although its command structures are antiquated, they should be updated and modernized so as to bring native Filipino troops more readily under American command and control.
loc.PHI_expand_us_bases_desc: Modern warfare is dominated by aircraft, and this holds especially true for our situation in the Philippines. By far the easiest way of securing the islands is through aerial domination, and even better this is allows us to patrol the surrounding ocean too. In order to better prepare ourselves for these aerial operations we need to dramatically expand our airbases here.
loc.PHI_war_plan_rainbow_five_desc: With our own security now properly considered, we can begin to cast our eye to the wider war and better determine our suitable place in it. We have much to offer to the war effort, and we must ensure we invest that where it is most needed.
loc.PHI_aircraft_requisition_desc: We have been unable to develop a significant airplane industry of our own, so have been entirely reliant on American aircraft. Our need has grown, so we must requisition more planes from our American sponsors.
loc.PHI_luce_celler_act_desc: The Luce-Celler act is an immigration act in the United States which increased the quota of allowed Filipino travelers and for the first time enabled naturalization of Filipinos as American citizens. This marks the beginning of a new era of cross pacific migration.
loc.PHI_utang_na_loob_desc: Utang na loob is a Filipino cultural value that translates to 'debt of gratitude' or 'debt of the inner self.' It signifies a deep emotional and moral obligation to repay someone who has provided significant help, especially during times of need. This sense of reciprocity is typically expressed through acts of service, support, or loyalty.
loc.PHI_declare_military_emergency_desc: The country was on a slippery slope to fascism, but decisive action prevented the final fall. It is clear now that there are threats everywhere, and it is up to us to thwart them. Nothing is out of bounds, nothing is illegal. Democracy must survive.
loc.PHI_usa_catchup_tt: This counts as having completed one of the American economic focuses for purposes of requisitions.
loc.PHI_weapons_of_war_desc: In order to best preserve our democratic ideals, we must ensure we are equipped with the absolute best, most dangerous weapons. We have heard rumor of a certain 'Manhattan Project'. It just so happens that a Filipina works on the project, and as a good, loyal person she is willing to help us with our own project.
loc.PHI_preemptive_strikes_desc: There are enemies everywhere, and we are surrounded. As such, we should prepare for the inevitable. Better yet, we should prepare to strike first so that the inevitable is no longer inevitable, but circumvented. After all, the only way that we will be safe, is if there is no-one left to attack us.
loc.PHI_sunset_empires_desc: The biggest threat to us are the Empire of the Rising Sun, and the Empire on which the Sun Never Sets. Therefore, we must ensure we have sufficient bullets that we can fight in the shade.
loc.PHI_land_of_the_setting_sun_desc: Our preparations have been made. The time to strike is now! It's time for the sun to set for the final time on [JAP.GetNameDef], never to rise again.
loc.PHI_sea_of_cobalt_desc: Give me enough nuclear weapons and I shall create a sea of cobalt through which no enemy can wade to reach us.
loc.PHI_the_sun_has_set_desc: The British have long been a threat to the United Sta- the Philippines. We smashed them in 1779 and they've never forgiven us for it. It's time that we remind them of their place in the world.
loc.PHI_traitors_back_home_desc: [USA.GetNameDef] has become weak and fearful. No-one there wants to do what must be done, so it is up to us to purge the ranks of politicians and cowards, and reclaim the Shining City Upon A Hill for the American people.
loc.PHI_end_colonialism_desc: Colonialism is a blight which has been allowed to fester too long. All people deserve the right to live in freedom and democracy, and we shall have to impose this by force.
loc.PHI_cobalt_supremacy_desc: I am become death, destroyer of worlds.
loc.PHI_subject_surrender_desc: 'It became apparent that the garrison of these forces would be eventually destroyed by aerial and artillery bombardment, and infantry supported by tanks which have overwhelmed us.' This was the broadcast that just came from one of our last holdouts, and with it it is clear that we have lost control of [PHI.GetNameDef].
loc.PHI_subject_surrender_tt: §RLosing control over all of the state of [327.GetName] will complete this focus.§!
loc.PHI_i_shall_return_desc: This was the phrase uttered by General Douglas MacArthur when he evacuated [PHI.GetNameDef], and is one he has repeated often since. It's time that we provided the tools and the equipment to make this a reality.
loc.PHI_soldiers_in_hiding_desc: Although we have formally lost the fight in [PHI.GetNameDef], the war is not over. A large number of our troops disobeyed the order to surrender, and have continued the struggle while in hiding. We know a number of exceptional officers who have risen to the challenge, and have begun to expand resistance units around them- and we should provide all we can for their success.
loc.PHI_hukbalahap_desc: The Hukbo ng Bayan Laban sa Hapon (People's Army Against the Japanese), or Hukbalahap for short, is a communist guerilla movement formed by the farmers of Central Luzon have proven to be some of the most able resistance fighters in the entirety of [PHI.GetNameDef]. They are exceptionally well organized and motivated, but they lack arms. We should get them some.
loc.PHI_local_resistance_desc: The occupiers have made few friends with their policies, and there is a significant undercurrent of discontent that we could tap into. Everyone can do their part, farmers hide supplies from enemy soldiers, fishermen transport rebels, soldiers train others in combat techniques, and merchants provide equipment and money, all in aid of the resistance.
loc.PHI_submarine_supplies_desc: There is extensive enemy naval presence which makes getting support from abroad very difficult. We can requisition some submarines to provide clandestine support, there are plenty of hiding spots in our archipelago, and many willing fishermen able to transport the supplies to whichever islands they are needed.
loc.PHI_the_hunters_desc: Cadets from the Philippine Military Academy fled into hiding when the occupiers shut the institution down. Since then, they have gone on to form 'The Hunters' and they have made good use of their skills, training locals in combat techniques and intelligence gathering to actively bring the fight to our enemies around Manila.
loc.PHI_will_gain_hunters: Will gain 3 brigades of Hunters ROTC upon completion of §Y$PHI_grassroot_guerillas$§!.
loc.PHI_the_cry_desc: The Cry of Pugad Lawin was the rallying call marking the start of the Philippine Revolution against the Spanish Empire. This is another war for our freedom, our very existence even, so it is time once again to raise our cry, and fight!
loc.PHI_will_gain_hukbalahap: Will gain 3 brigades of Hukbalahap upon completion of §Y$PHI_grassroot_guerillas$§!.
loc.PHI_juramentado_desc: Juramentado were Moro and Sulu warriors who swore to fight to the death against invaders. Although the old rituals have faded, the spirit of fearless sacrifice remains. By embracing this tradition, we can inspire our resistance fighters to launch devastating attacks that terrify the occupiers and embolden our own people.
loc.PHI_will_gain_juramentado: Will gain 3 brigades of Juramentado upon completion of §Y$PHI_grassroot_guerillas$§!.
loc.PHI_exile_support_desc: There are a great deal of Filipinos resident in other nations, and we can call on their aid to provide financial and material support. This can then be smuggled to our brave resistance fighters, or used to form Philippine fighting units to be used in our eventual liberation.
loc.PHI_grassroot_guerillas_desc: There are a great many resistance organizations operating on the ground throughout our nation, however, what they lack is centralized command and control to direct all their efforts in a more coordinated effort to oust the occupiers. The fighting spirit is there, it just needs to be properly harnessed and pointed toward the most vulnerable targets.
loc.PHI_grassroot_guerillas_tt: Spawn 3 brigades of guerrilla troops for each completed prerequisite focus. Liberated states and then states with few enemy troops will be prioritized as location.
loc.PHI_reconquista_desc: From the mountains of Luzon, to the jungles of Mindanao, our people have bled and endured under occupation. Now, the time has come to reclaim our land, city by city, island by island. Just as our forefathers resisted the conquistadores, we now fight to cast out the invader and restore our nation. This is our Reconquista — the final struggle for the Philippines.
loc.PHI_rebuild_sakdalistas_desc: On the night of May 2nd 1935, 65,000 partially-armed peasants shattered the tranquil peace of the Philippines in an attempt to seize power from the American-supported government. This effort failed, but the anger at the growing wealth disparity between urban rich and rural poor continues to simmer beneath the surface, waiting to be harnessed.
loc.PHI_slippery_slope_desc: Increasing Japanese influence on our nation has begun to touch off the tinder of discontent. All we need do is stand back, and watch as the anger against the greed inherent to the corrupt democratic, capitalist system implodes, leaving behind a vacuum that more radical ideologies are more than happy to help fill.
loc.PHI_assassination_of_quezon_desc: It is an unfortunate truth that 'President' Quezon has been holding the Philippines back for too long. The American lap-dog has done all he can to ensure that the national will of the Philippine people has not been realized. The institutions he has built up around himself have made him immune to democratic change, so now we must advance politics through other means.
loc.PHI_assassination_of_quezon_tt: §RPlans are set in motion which will strive to see Quezon removed from office. Permanently.§!
loc.PHI_makapili_desc: The rise of fascism within the Philippine nation has been rapid, and this has unfortunately been accompanied by a certain amount of chaos. Our friends overseas have offered weapons and training for the raising of a 'Peace Army' to maintain order, fight banditry and put down insurgency
loc.PHI_form_the_executive_commision_desc: A shadow cabal of leaders has been pulling the strings in the background, but now that the fascist ideal has risen to power in the Philippines, it is time for these individuals to step into the light and take their rightful place at the head of the government.
loc.PHI_aguinaldos_coup_desc: With immediate chaos of the government take-over beginning to settle, personalities within the Executive Commission have been vying for control. Authoritarian regimes require a distinct authority to rule them, and support is coalescing.
loc.PHI_resolve_interregnum_tt: §GThis will resolve the Interregnum, and allow the appointment of a new leader.§!
loc.PHI_secure_japanese_guarantees_desc: If we wish to truly expedite our independence from the United States, then we need to prepare for the very real prospect of war for they are unlikely to let their minion go lightly. We should reach out to our sponsors in Japan and secure more official military support in case of hostilities.
loc.PHI_war_of_independence_desc: Give me liberty, or give me death! It's time for the colonial oppressors to leave our shores for good. \n\nA new sun rises over the Philippines.
loc.PHI_will_take_peace_decision: §Y[USA.GetName]§! will take this decision if §Y[ROOT.GetNameDef]§! successfully defends itself for a year, or sooner if it loses its nearby island bases or gets involved in war elsewhere.
loc.PHI_second_philippine_republic_desc: Although not yet achieved, our quest for independence looms ever closer. The next step is to create a new republic to promote our separation officially, and from there begin work on the trappings of our new government - and a new flag, of course.
loc.PHI_second_republic_tag_tt: §Y[PHI.GetName]§! will be known as §YThe Second Philippine Republic§!
loc.PHI_election_overturned_desc: The 1935 election was overwhelmingly in favor of Manuel Quezón, a little too overwhelmingly. Emilio Aguinaldo has highlighted serious concerns, and raised them with the United States who have promised a thorough investigation into possible electoral manipulation.
loc.PHI_hispanidad_filipina_desc: Despite the chasm created by the War of Independence against the Spanish Empire 1896-1898, many Filipino people still see themselves as a part of the Hispanic diaspora, and the ongoing tensions in the Spanish mainland have become a matter of some concern.
loc.PHI_spanish_refugees_desc: With the ravages of a civil war back home, many Spanish citizens have sought refuge elsewhere. With the warming of relations between ourselves and our Spanish counterparts, a significant number of their people have sought sanctuary on our archipelago.
loc.PHI_if_supported_scw_side_lost_tt: If a §YSpanish civil war§! side we sent volunteers to was defeated:
loc.PHI_if_supported_scw_side_wins_tt: If a side in the §YSpanish civil war§! wins after receiving volunteers from us, §Y$PHI_reconciliation_with_spain$§! will have better effects instead.
loc.PHI_reconciliation_with_spain_winner: Our volunteers fighting together with the victorious Spanish government has forged new, stronger bonds between our nations, and we should draw on these in a more official capacity to align our nations together in the future.
loc.PHI_reconciliation_with_spain_loser: Although our volunteers fighting against them, the Spanish government has reluctantly acknowledged the shared cultural and theological bonds between us, and have seen fit to include these in their propaganda emphasizing a cross-Hispanic global unity.
loc.PHI_reconciliation_with_spain_neutral: Spain has had an unquestionable influence on the development of our nation, but much of our recent history has been antagonistic due to our colonial ties. That being said, it is undeniable that we have more in common with them, we just need to be met on an equal footing.
loc.PHI_hispanic_overtures_desc: We are not the only nation in the world with Hispanic connections, in fact much of South America has them, and we have continued to foster positive relations with several of them. We should reach out and try to make these connections more formal.
loc.PHI_revolutionary_regrets_desc: Under Spain, we were always Spanish subjects, or citizens, but now under the United States, we are only a consumer market for their exports, if not pariahs, because they never made us citizens of any state of the United States.
loc.PHI_royal_exiles_desc: The Spanish monarchy has undergone a series of abdications, both forced and voluntary, and disinheritance, however the family is still around and are seeking refuge. We could gain immense prestige within the Hispanic world by offering them sanctuary.
loc.PHI_reino_de_filipinas_desc: All the pieces are falling into place, and with Spain itself riven by internal fractures, the Philippines have risen to be the heart of the Hispanic world. We simply lack the coronation to cement our position, this will be the crowning moment in our history.
loc.PHI_unlock_unification_decision_tt: Unlocks Decision: §YPropose Unification with Faction Member§!
loc.PHI_unlock_conquer_decision_tt: Unlocks Decision: §YForce Integration of Hispanic Nation§!
loc.PHI_unlock_mutual_assistance_with_spain_: Unlocks Decision: §YPropose Treaty of Mutual Assistance with [SPR.GetNameDef]§!
loc.PHI_war_for_the_oceans_desc: Historically we have been a seafaring people, and it is time to reclaim our birthright, and lay claim to the terrain we know best. The oceans.
loc.PHI_assume_the_naval_burden_desc: Japan has become embroiled in conflicts on land, while our specialty remains at sea. We should offer to take responsibility for the naval conflict, so that they can focus entirely on other theaters.
loc.PHI_develop_naval_infrastructure_desc: With our maritime ambitions ramping up, our shipbuilding capabilities must expand accordingly.
loc.PHI_reunite_madagascar_desc: Although separated by vast differences, the indigenous Malagasy people are of mixed Austronesian-African ancestry, meaning they have surprisingly close links to our own people. We should close this distance between us.
loc.PHI_claim_to_core_tt: Unlocks decisions to §YGain Cores§! after we have come in control of them.
loc.PHI_take_pacific_islands_desc: The Philippines are already a nation of islands, so it takes but a slight stretch of the imagination to extend our rightful borders further east across the Pacific.
loc.PHI_malayo_polynesia_desc: We have historically had close cultural, historical and ethnic connections to the Malay peninsula and to the Indies. In the light of this fraternal connection, we should extend to them the same rights and privileges enjoyed by our own people.
loc.PHI_war_for_oceania_desc: Oceania is defined by the ocean itself, but our people have been voyaging across these waters since time immemorial. It's time to incorporate these islands into our burgeoning nation.
loc.PHI_conquest_of_japan_desc: Japan has long been our primary competitor in terms of maritime control in this region, so it is time to put that competition to rest and exert our dominance over them once and for all.
loc.PHI_filipino_polynesian_reunification_de: This region of the world is dominated by the ocean, comprised of scattered landmasses and distant islands yet we have conquered them all. Thus, we secure our rightful place as masters of the Pacific.
loc.PHI_polynesia_tag_tt: §Y[PHI.GetName]§! will gain a new flag and name.
loc.PHI_petition_the_supreme_court_desc: Communism was formally banned by the Supreme Court in 1932, however, we have stumbled across a technicality that could once again legalize the movement, we just need to sign and submit the petition to do so.
loc.PHI_legalize_the_communist_party_desc: Now that Communism as a movement is once again legal, the next step is to bring the party out of the shadows, and make their actions public once more, and begin the work of growing the movement.
loc.PHI_return_of_the_exiles_desc: A number of important people with left-wing leanings have been forced from their homes throughout South East Asia under threat from the colonialist, capitalist tranches. We could open our borders to them, and offer the promise of a safe haven.
loc.PHI_support_for_chinese_communists_desc: The Communists continue their struggle in China, both against Japanese incursions, and against the Chinese warlords. We have the opportunity to smuggle them men and materiel along the Yellow River, either to directly support their struggle, or simply to provide fuel to fan the flames of conflict in the region.
loc.PHI_the_red_sun_over_manila_desc: Communist sentiment is rising throughout the Philippines, and for the first time the tentative opportunity to take actual power has appeared. The failed Sakdalista uprising serves as a reminder of the futility of armed insurrection against the American-supported government, and instead we must seek a more political means to take power.
loc.PHI_partido_komunista_ng_pilipinas_coup_: It started as a general strike among the farmers, which spread to their comrades in the factories. The people have spoken, and the National Assembly has fallen to the Communist cause. Now, the unions and collectives scramble to select a new central committee, and most importantly, determine who should stand as the new General Secretary.
loc.PHI_national_confederation_desc: Now that we have risen to power, it is time to begin consolidating our hold. The Kalipunang Pambansa ng Magbubukid sa Pilipinas (National Confederation of Peasants in the Philippines) as the leading peasant organization should be among the first we approach to this end.
loc.PHI_anti_intervention_strategies_desc: With tensions rising between ourselves and the United States, we must do what we can to ensure the long-term viability of our nascent Communist state, be through targeted concessions, or taking from them what we can before these tensions bubble over into hostility.
loc.PHI_rally_the_fisherfolk_desc: As an archipelago, our fishing industry is large and well manned. As such, we should look to these peasants of the sea, and rouse them into the Communist movement and harness the maritime potential they offer.
loc.PHI_smugglers_desc: Our nation is comprised of a multitude of islands and islets, offering a bounteous selection of hidden nooks and crannies that our people have used for generations to smuggle goods outside the reach of official authorities. We should harness this experience and turn it to our advantage!
loc.PHI_struggle_conference_desc: Our Communist movement is having to deal with a multitude of different conflicts and tensions, and our response to these needs a more organized, official reaction. As such, we need to bring our leaders together in the first Struggle Conference where all these issues are tabled and resolved.
loc.PHI_sanction_piracy_desc: Our archipelago nation plays host to a multitude of small ships and enterprising youngsters, and as such it would be criminal if we did not tap into the old system of 'Letters of Marque' where we provide the legal basis for these buccaneering individuals to strike out at our enemies, only to flee back to their coves with their newly begotten maritime prizes.
loc.PHI_infiltrate_chinese_ports_desc: Our Dockworkers were among the first to seize on the opportunities offered by Communism, and as such have long been our staunchest allies. We should invoke this same sentiment in the ports of China, and then use them to provide a springboard towards further intervention in the Chinese struggle.
loc.PHI_every_non_communist_coastal_warlord: Every non-communist and coastal Chinese warlord:
loc.PHI_maritime_communism_desc: While many Communist states focus on the mobilization of their people towards mass movements of the military on land, we should instead harness the mass mobilization of our maritime power, and unleash this seaborne host on the oceans of the world and thus unite all under the Maritime Communist Movement.
loc.PHI_pan_pacific_trade_union_secretariat_: While we have reaped the benefits of Communism for ourselves and our own people, it is not the way for this movement to remain isolated and insular. We should export our philosophy, and the means to manifest it, to other participants around South East Asia, and thus form the Pan Pacific Trade Union Secretariat for our mutual protection and evolution.
loc.PHI_comitern_desc: While our connections to [SOV.GetNameDef] have been tenuous at best, there is no denying their power on the international stage, and should we wish for our Communist experiment to continue and be exported to others, we must unite under one sphere for the betterment of the Socialist ideal globally.
loc.PHI_national_defense_act_desc: The National Defense Act was passed on the 21st of December 1935, and with it the sum of 16,000,000 pesos allocated to the armed forces of the Philippines. All that remains now, is to determine how and where to spend this sum. Each branch of the military is crying out for investment, as are the defenses critical to our security.
loc.PHI_war_plan_orange_desc: The basic premise of War Plan Orange is that the Philippines must continue to serve as an American forward operating base in case of conflict, and as such the most important asset to defend is Manila Bay. We must execute defensive directives to this effect, and concentrate our defenses around this critical strategic area.
loc.PHI_beach_defense_strategy_desc: With enough guns, and enough soldiers we should be able to hold the perimeter of the Philippines, and as such we should establish our defensive strategy with this purpose in mind. In this way, we can ensure that the Philippines as a whole remain invested in any potential long-term military campaign.
loc.PHI_fortify_corregidor_desc: Corregidor Island stands squarely in the entrance to Manila Bay, and as such is the keystone to our continued control of the bay and its naval assets there. We should upgrade the fortifications of the island itself, and construct underground facilities to help withstand prolonged siege and bombardment by hostile air and naval forces.
loc.PHI_fortify_corregidor_bypass_tt: No more §Y$bunker$§! and §Y$coastal_bunker$s§! can be built in the city of Manila.
loc.PHI_bastion_bataan_desc: The Bataan peninsula is a natural defensive location making up one side of Manila Bay. So long as we secure this location, we will be able to control who and what can use the Bay and its facilities. To ensure our continued dominance of this area, we need to develop defensive lines along the land-ward side, and position artillery on the heights.
loc.PHI_bastion_bataan_bypass_tt: No more §Y$bunker$§! can be built on the state borders of Bataan, and no §Y$coastal_bunker$s§! can be built in Bataan proper, nor in Dagupan
loc.PHI_coastal_artillery_desc: Undoubtedly, on an island chain, the section with the most targets available are the Coastal Artillery, capable of striking targets on both land and sea. Investment in equipping, training and upgrading these units should be a priority.
loc.PHI_the_concrete_battleship_desc: Fort Drum, the most impressive of Manila Bay's harbour forts, resembles that of a battleship. Construction started in 1909 and throughout its career has received upgrades in armament and support structures. The venerable fortification, affectionately known as the USS No-Go, is once again called to service in this new age of modern warfare.
loc.PHI_philippine_scouts_desc: Established in 1901, the Philippine Scouts organization comprises the largest contingent of Filipinos serving in our military, and we should continue to support this unit and ensure they are given the best possible training and equipment to fulfill their role as the specialist force designated with protecting our homeland.
loc.PHI_militarize_the_constabulary_desc: The Philippine Constabulary had been merged into the central Philippine Army with the National Defense Act, however, in hindsight this might have been a mistake as the police forces left to replace it have proven to be inadequate. We should instead re-establish the Constabulary but leave them equipped with military arms and training, so they can both serve our nation, and protect it.
loc.PHI_philippine_army_orchestra_desc: The Philippine Constabulary Band is one of the foremost military bands in the world, and was given the honor of playing at a US President's inauguration. We should integrate the band in with the military to better harness the power of music for our soldiers, and use its uplifting energy to instill national vigor, and to rouse them to ever greater feats of bravery.
loc.PHI_philippine_military_academy_desc: For years, the Philippines Constabulary Academy has served as the central officer training school in our nation, but we have lacked a formal place of military learning. We should incorporate this institution into the army, and formally designate it the new Philippine Military Academy dedicated to the education and development of the military elite of tomorrow.
loc.PHI_philippine_division_desc: The Philippine division is charged with the defense of our islands, but is poorly equipped and understaffed. We should seek outside expertise in leadership, and ensure we have more modern arms and equipment for our troops.
loc.PHI_10_year_training_plan_desc: With the promise of transition to independence over the ten year period, the National Defense Act contained provisions for training a self-reliant, independent force capable of defending our home. This includes the move towards a regular army, officer training schemes, creation of a reserve force, and investment in military infrastructure.
loc.PHI_battalion_combat_teams_desc: The realities of war have clearly shown that we are in need of a force developed to be more mobile and flexible, able to adapt to any situation as they arise. They should maintain a looser hierarchy and be empowered to perform small-unit actions.
loc.PHI_battalion_combat_teams_tt:

    Hard Attack: §G+15%§!
    Piercing: §G+15%§!
 §Y$category_cavalry$§!:

loc.PHI_mandatory_conscription_desc: The defense of [PHI.GetNameDef] is the responsibility of every citizen. As such, citizens should be subject to mandatory conscription so that they can be taught the fundamentals of combat, and therefore be ready and trained should military duty be required of them.
loc.PHI_self_reliance_defense_desc: We have been extremely reliant on other nations' contributions to safeguard our nation, however this has exposed a serious strategic weakness. We must create our own means to protect ourselves, and this begins with the development of an industrial base capable of supporting our nascent forces with whatever matériel they require.
loc.PHI_army_of_the_philippines_desc: Our armed forces have evolved significantly in just a few short years, and it is time to put aside the reliance on foreign support and march confidently for ourselves towards a new, bright and secure future, protected entirely by Filipino blood and steel. From now on, our security is our own concern.
loc.PHI_army_air_corps_desc: The Army Air Corps, although limited in size and resources do not lack for ambition. Our islands are sparse, difficult to traverse so we should invest more significantly into our aerial capabilities so as to keep as much covered as possible.
loc.PHI_pilot_training_programme_desc: Pilots are an extremely important resource, and we have a considerable shortage of them considering the poor state of our aviation industry. We should broker agreements with other nations to allow the training of our young people into this high-flying profession.
loc.PHI_off_shore_patrol_desc: Our air force will need to be capable of protecting the skies equally over land and sea. As such, we should service specialist naval aircraft with greater range and anti-ship capabilities so that we can strike at an invader before they can even catch sight of our shores.
loc.PHI_expand_airbases_desc: Even if our allies wanted to deploy an air force to our islands, or should we develop the capability to produce one for ourselves, we do not have the space to actually base them! We should immediately set about creating new airfields and aerodromes so that aircraft can be more easily stationed here.
loc.PHI_develop_domestic_aircraft_industry_d: Relying on our friends and allies has been fine thus far, but ultimately if we wish to be recognized as an independent state with our own military capabilities in this modern world, then we must begin investing in our own domestic air industry. This can be kicked off with some subsidies to the aerial innovators and entrepreneurs in our nation.
loc.PHI_philippine_air_force_desc: It is time for the air force to be recognized as their own entity, separate from the army. So organized, they will have far more flexibility in their organization and acquisition of men and materiel. No longer will they be beholden to the needs of one service, but can instead fly in service of the whole.
loc.PHI_thats_not_an_island_desc: Although our archipelago gives us a great deal of flexibility, this does come with some limitations. For instance, what if we wish to undertake operations far from our home isles? Well, then we'll just need to take one of those islands with us and thus have the operational ability to strike anywhere in the world where needed.
loc.PHI_offshore_patrol_desc: The National Defense Act also contained provisions for the maritime protection of the Philippine archipelago. This is not expected to be a fully formed blue ocean fleet, but rather one built around the protection of our home shores. This is not to say that this couldn't just be the first step to a more dominant fleet.
loc.PHI_marine_corps_desc: We have a great deal of experience getting on and off a shore, many people in our community even needing to take ferries or just rowing between islands for work or to see families. We can harness this experience, and focus it into the worlds premier marine corps, with soldiers capable of taking the fight to any shore, foreign or domestic.
loc.PHI_cavite_naval_base_desc: The naval yard at Cavite, situated across the bay from the city of Manila, has the greatest potential to be a deep water port and shipyard in the Philippines. It already has some nascent facilities, but with investment could become a serious strategic asset from which to station a fleet capable of controlling the waters of South East Asia.
loc.PHI_pt_boat_development_desc: Our nation, being a large collection of islands would be better served utilizing smaller vessels capable of darting in and out of the narrow waterways of the archipelago, to harass and bring down larger foes. We should purchase expertise in torpedo boat doctrines, and use that to develop our own bespoke naval assets to be called Patrol Boats.
loc.PHI_mosquito_fleet_desc: A single torpedo, or a single shell can target and sink a single ship. Therefore, we must not have just a single ship, but an entire swarm. They might be able to get one, ten, even a hundred but they won't be able to sink us all! Worse, all it will take is for potentially just one of our own shots to strike true, and with our swarm we can hardly miss either.
loc.PHI_devil_boats_desc: Our patrol boats have earned renown for their speed and daring, and particularly for their ability to strike hard and vanish into the mist like phantoms of the sea. Accordingly, our enemies have learned to shy away from our shores, lest they themselves fall foul of these 'devil boats'.
loc.PHI_fast_attack_craft_desc: The ideal evolution of the Patrol Boat is the Fast Attack Craft, with significantly upgraded speed and firepower, these craft can buzz around our shores, and bring ruin on our enemies who stray too close, and dart away again before help can arrive.
loc.PHI_coastal_defense_ships_desc: Our fleet has grown such that we now have the infrastructure and means to assemble and maintain larger craft. Our first objective remains the protection of our own shores, but we can now draft vessels that can stand toe to toe with enemy capital ships, using our own geography to their advantage.
loc.PHI_philippine_naval_patrol_desc: To be properly recognized on the international stage, particularly as a nation comprised of a multitude of islands, our fleet must be properly capable of protecting our shores. To grow it to this size and capability, we should seek to improve and update our command and control systems in line with those expected of a modern fleet.
loc.PHI_thalassocracy_desc: The concept of an 'Army with a State' is well known, and often lauded for Prussia. We, however, should endeavor to be a 'Navy with a State', with a fleet whose capabilities dwarf even those of the British at the height of their power.
loc.PHI_warning_american_intervention_tt: §RWarning this will anger§! §Y[USA.GetNameDef]§! §Rand risk American Intervention unless properly managed§!

loc.PHI_usa_focus_done_T3_alt_tt: Have completed at least three of, §Y$PHI_declare_military_emergency$§!, §YPeg the Peso to the Dollar§!, §YPro-Hacendados§! or §YNationality Act§!.

loc.PHI_focus_time_reduced_T3_tt: §Y$PHI_open_borders$§! will reduce the time needed for this focus by 35 days.
loc.SIK_six_great_policies_desc: The six great policies of Anti-Imperialism, Friendship with the Soviet Union, Racial and national equality, Clean government, and Peace and reconstruction promoted through the People's Anti-Imperialist Association are the foundation of Sheng Shicai’s rule in the Sinkiang Clique. Through them we will ensure a prosperous province and avoid falling back into feudal rule.
loc.SIK_invest_in_the_dushanzi_oil_fields: Invest in the Dushanzi Oil Fields
loc.SIK_invest_in_the_dushanzi_oil_fields_de: Oil was discovered in the Dushanzi area at the turn of the century, and by 1909 we had already initiated some level of extraction, but with recent investment from the Soviet Union there is potential to expand further. We should seek to invest further in this joint Soviet-Sinkiangi effort to expand the oil refineries as they can be vital both in our and the Soviet war effort.
loc.SIK_three_year_plan_for_reconstruction_d: To secure our rule and avoid further turmoil we must initiate a three-year plan for reconstruction with Soviet support. By taking loans we will temporarily bind ourselves to the USSR but in the long run it will ensure our economic prosperity and eventually our independence.
loc.SIK_a_new_xinjiang_desc: Now that our industries have been modernized, and our people taught how to read, our province is ready to take the next step in its path toward the future. Now, we shall begin a large project for the integration of Sinkiang and its people with the modern world, as we prepare to take our place on the global stage!
loc.SIK_transformation_of_nature_desc: Asia is rich in natural resources, just waiting to be tapped into. With our scientific community pushing the borders of what was previously thought possible, even the largest, most invasive projects are becoming feasible. The environment must be shaped and molded on a massive scale to work in the People's favor!
loc.SIK_soviet_intervention_desc: Sheng Shicai has proven to not be trustworthy with his peddling back and forth between different allegiances. We must therefore replace him with someone we can trust to rule Sinkiang in a direction not divergent from the party line.
loc.SIK_protector_of_the_kyrgiz_desc: The Kirghiz people on the other side of the Soviet border yearn to be led by someone who understands them. [ROOT.GetLeader] shares their roots and knows their ways. We should petition to [SOV.GetLeader] for unification with the province.
loc.SIK_ensure_a_clean_government_desc: One of the six great policies entail a government clean from corruption, but also from sedition. We must ensure the government is stable at all costs, removing all who may threaten the rule of [ROOT.GetLeader] by utilizing the aid of the NKVD!
loc.SIK_a_new_nationality_policy_desc: We should adopt the Soviet policy of nationality, where it is not one group dominating all, but many living in harmony. By doing this the Han must be taught to read and write Uighur, and vice-versa. We will also enforce atheism within official government elements, but allow the people freedom to practice and faith, to allow for a more stable and unified province.
loc.SIK_settle_dzungarian_tribes_desc: We have received requests from chiefs and leaders of the Dungarian tribes to settle down in our state, as they have not been able to reap the rewards of our good harvests. We should grant their wish.
loc.SIK_king_of_sinkiang_desc: Sheng Shicai is the undisputed leader of the Sinkiang Clique, with some even going so far as to call him King. The province however, lays at a crossroad with some wanting to follow the Central Government while others wanting to continue toeing the Soviet line. Whatever the King declares will decide the future of the province and its people, but it is yet unclear what it will be.
loc.SIK_rejoin_the_central_government_desc: The Soviets aren't as reliable as we may once have thought they were. It seems it would be best to bet on the winning horse, and change our course to rejoin the KMT and rapidly integrate with the Central Government.
loc.SIK_reestablish_the_guominjun_desc: The Guominjun was a military faction founded by Feng Yuxiang in the 1920s. Being committed to nationalism, anti-imperialism and Christian socialism, it seems like a perfect organization to revive if we want to become a third party in the civil war. This is not to mention the fact that it was ultimately the GMJ that Sheng Shicai joined back in the day, and his loyalties never lied with the KMT.
loc.SIK_reaffirm_soviet_connections_desc: The Central Government has failed China, and that is becoming ever more clear for each day that goes by. We should attempt to fully sever our ties with them, and join [SOV.GetNameDef] in their crusade against feudalism.
loc.SIK_utilize_asperovs_contacts_desc: Garegin Apresov, the Soviet General Consul with special powers and Representative of the Second Eastern Department of the People's Commissariat of Foreign Affairs of the Soviet Union in Urumqi holds a lot of important contacts within [SOV.GetNameDef]. We should use his power and connections to squeeze more out of our cooperation with the [SOV.GetAdjective]s.
loc.SIK_office_of_sinkiang_border_commission: The Office of Sinkiang Border Defense Commissioner is the body responsible for commanding the regional garrisons. Through this autonomy, we can strengthen the provincial government and act independently from the Central Government practically whenever we wish.
loc.SIK_cooperate_with_the_nkvd_desc: In order to strengthen our relations with [SOV.GetNameDef] while securing our rule and protecting Urumqi from foreign conspirators, we must cooperate with the NKVD and aid them in establishing a proper presence within our country.
loc.SIK_cooperate_with_the_ussr_desc: Our relationship with the Soviet Union is unique within China, and to ensure our territorial integrity we must utilize that. With their aid we may finally drive out the Kuomintang from our province.
loc.SIK_military_cooperation_desc: The Kuomintang still field a large amount of troops in Khotan through the New 36th Division. To ensure their expulsion we should request aid from the Soviet Union.
loc.SIK_a_soviet_airforce_desc: Thanks to our growing relations with [SOV.GetNameDef], we will be able to acquire aircraft from them. Adding to this, they have also prepared to establish pilot schools in Urumqi, and have begun sending advisors to help prepare us for the future of warfare.
loc.SIK_march_into_khotan_desc: The day has come! Soon all of Sinkiang shall be under our rule and the troops of Ma Hushan will be expelled!
loc.SIK_march_into_khotan_tt: In due time, §YAdditional Supplies§! will arrive from §Y[SOV.GetNameDef]§!
loc.SIK_a_united_sinkiang_clique_desc: With the New 36th Division expelled and Sinkiang now entirely under our rule we now stand as a formidable force in the area. We must now turn our gaze east and ensure the territorial integrity of our comrades and allies against the Japanese invaders.
loc.SIK_pursue_further_soviet_integration_de: With the battle over and the dust settled we must turn our eyes to the other threats. Under the protective wing of the Soviet Union we will not face the threat of annexation from the Central Government, so it is clearly the most sensible course of action.
loc.SIK_establish_the_xinjiangneft_desc: The [SOV.GetAdjective] Politburo has discussed the issue of 'Xinjiang Oil' and adopted a resolution that calls for the preparation of the development of oil near the [SOV.GetAdjective] border under the firm of our government. To this end, the joint Xinjiang-Soviet company 'Xinjiangneft' is to be established, to aid in the joint extraction of natural resources in the region.
loc.KHM_call_for_aid_desc: With the forces of Sheng Shicai at our doorstep we must call for aid from our fellow countrymen lest we collapse.
loc.KHM_strike_the_governor_desc: Our troops are ready, our morale is high, we must seize this opportunity to drive out the soviet puppet from our province!
loc.KHM_push_them_back_desc: The battle for Sinkiang province must not end with their victory, we will push them back all the way to the Soviet Union!
loc.KHM_the_sinkiang_ma_clique_desc: With the defeat of Sheng Shicai and his Sinkiang Clique we now stand as the sole governor of the province. We must reinforce our position to become an even stronger force in the area.
loc.KHM_kumul_rebellion_avenged_desc: With the defeat of Sheng Shicai and his Sinkiang Clique we now stand as the sole rulers of the province. The first Kumul Rebellion that was so unjustly crushed has now at long last been avenged, and we can turn our eyes towards rebuilding the province and expanding our standing forces to ensure our independence remains.
loc.KHM_utilize_family_contacts_desc: We must make use of our close ties to the other Ma Cliques in order to drive Sheng Shicai out in Sinkiang for good.
loc.KHM_undermine_kmt_rule_desc: The Kuomintang have pillaged the province and oppressed the locals for far too long. It is time we make preparations to oust the tyrannical Ma Clique from Khotan!
loc.KHM_establish_the_kashgar_clique_desc: We have sought distancing from the Kuomintang previously. If we are to truly achieve this, we must take a note out of the Ma family's book and establish a clique of our own. It is time to make this a reality, and form up under the Deputy Military Commander of the Kashgar region, Mahmut Muhiti.
loc.KHM_shizangs_coup_desc: With the preparations made and the 24th and 25th Uyghur regiments under Muhiti's control on their way to surround Khotan, we can begin to make our move and oust the Hui leadership from the city. Glory to Mahmut Shizhang, and long live the Khotan Emirate!
loc.KHM_shizangs_coup_tt: Many §YMa Generals§! will §RLeave§! and join other Ma Cliques
loc.KHM_take_control_of_zakat_and_waqf: Take Control of the Zakat and Waqf
loc.KHM_take_control_of_zakat_and_waqf_desc: In order to fund our new rule, we may need to bend some rules and take control over the Khotan's zakat and waqf charities, redirecting the wealth of local shrines to textbooks, policing, soldiers and teachers.
loc.KHM_implement_jizyah_desc: The rights of non-muslims were highly prescriptive under the old administration. It is time to adjust these matters for a modern world, and prove to all of our subjects that we are an enlightened realm.
loc.KHM_promote_jadidism_desc: Islamic modernists and reformers who are part of the Jadid movement in [SOV.GetNameDef] are being actively repressed by the government. With Bughra being an active Jadidist himself, it would prove wise to grant them refuge in our nation, whilst allowing them to bring some of their reformist ideals over to us.
loc.KHM_revive_the_basmachi_movement_desc: Up until 1934 the Basmachi struggled against [SOV.GetAdjective] forces to liberate Central Asia from their tyrannic rule. Though their movement has since been largely crushed, some of their leaders managed to escape. We should endeavor to establish contact with these freedom fighters, and invite them to our court.
loc.KHM_rally_the_faithful_desc: In order to succeed in guaranteeing our autonomy from foreign states, we must rally the faithful and establish a new military order in our capital.
loc.KHM_indian_expeditionary_forces_plan_des: The [ENG.GetAdjective] have proposed a plan to send us military aid from [RAJ.GetNameDef] should come under attack from an enemy force. Perhaps it would prove wise to initiate closer relations with them.
loc.KHM_expand_the_madrasas_desc: In order to better control our populace and teach them the ways by which they should live, we should increase funding to the Muslim educational institutions present within our country.
loc.KHM_promote_anti_communism_desc: Expelling Sheng Shicai and his band of communists is a top priority if we are not to fall into the hands of the Soviet Republic. We must therefore sweep out any remaining communists from our territory.
loc.KHM_raise_additional_dungan_regiments_de: The army is still composed to a large extent by Hui people, swearing absolute loyalty to their commanders. Though not ideal,  we must make use of this, as they will prove very useful in the coming years.
loc.KHM_indian_expeditionary_forces_plan_tt: §Y[ENG.GetNameDefCap]§! and §Y[RAJ.GetNameDef]§! will be more likely to send us volunteers
loc.KHM_our_position_remains_desc: The war may not have developed entirely in our favor, but the Khotan clique still stands and the New 36th Division is now more prepared than ever for the coming conflict.
loc.CHI_sea_gain_warlord_support_desc: In order to be seen as the legitimate ruler of China, we must first gain the support of other warlords.
loc.CHI_allow_warlord_support_tt: Unlocks decisions to gain faction influence in exchange for favors to the warlords
loc.CHI_sea_propaganda_campaigns_desc: Through effective use of propaganda we'll be able to steal the spotlight from the Central Government and soon enough they will fall to us.
loc.CHI_propaganda_decisions_tt: Unlocks decisions to gain faction influence through propaganda campaigns
loc.CHI_sea_unified_army_structure_desc: To effectively stand against foreign and internal threats we must reform our army to become a professional unit. With the aid from Communist Party advisors we'll be able to create our own Red Army, and in turn better hold off threats from beyond.
loc.CHI_sea_battle_for_china_desc: With the Central Government swaying more and more from the correct party line, it is becoming more and more apparent that the only way forward is to take back control. We must fight our way to capital and seize it from the state that has failed us.
loc.CHI_sea_rally_the_warlords_desc: The warlords are an important part of the struggle for power in China. With them on our side it will be much easier to take control.
loc.CHI_sea_a_new_expedition_desc: As the Central Government falters we must remember the legacy of the Northern Expedition and seize the capitals. With them under our rule it will only be a matter of time before we will be recognized as the legitimate authority over China.
loc.PRC_sea_inward_focus_desc: The way forward does not lie with toeing the soviet line. We must prove our independence from them and forge our own path to ensure our revolution succeeds.
loc.PRC_sea_rally_the_industry_desc: Without a cooperative working class and the industrial base to supply our revolution it will merely fizzle out. It is therefore imperative that we rally them to our side.
loc.PRC_sea_reforming_our_ranks_desc: To ensure our revolution succeeds we must reorganize our ranks and in turn rally the rural class. Without their aid we will simply not have a functional army, but with them on our side we can gain an advantage over our adversaries.
loc.PRC_sea_forging_our_own_path_desc: It is becoming more and more evident that the Comintern has failed the Chinese revolutionaries and we must form our own union. With this we will also be able to assert our authority beyond China in due time.
loc.PRC_sea_toe_the_soviet_line_desc: It has become clear that it will only be with soviet aid that the Chinese Revolution can succeed. While many within the party have differing opinions only time will tell if they are right or not.
loc.PRC_sea_aid_from_soviet_bolsheviks_desc: For our revolution to succeed we must have the industrial base to support it. With the aid from soviet investors we'll be able to kick start our own industry.
loc.PRC_sea_soviet_advisors_desc: The Soviets have several agents active in China. We must recruit them and utilize their expertise if we are to defeat the Nationalist government.
loc.PRC_sea_industrialisation_of_nature_desc: To ensure the conditions for socialism we must first have an industrial working class. With Soviet aid we will more quickly be able to ensure these conditions.
loc.PRC_sea_comintern_integration_desc: With the conditions now being right it time to fully become integrated within the Comintern.
loc.PRC_sea_new_economic_direction_desc: With our People's Republic proclaimed and the dust being settled it is time to refocus and restructure our economy. With careful planning we will be able to in time outperform the western economies and become a power to be reckoned with.
loc.PRC_sea_move_capital_desc: After the formation of the $PRC_proclaimed_communism$, it is only natural that we move our seat of government and restore the name of the city to Beijing.
loc.CHI_sea_develop_capital_desc: Without an industrial base we will never be able to maintain our position. Therefore we must invest in our capital.
loc.CHI_sea_further_industrial_investment_de: While we have a small industry it is still no match to that of the Central Government. We must therefore further invest in our industry.
loc.CHI_sea_develop_capital_arsenal_desc: Without an Arsenal we will have no army, and without an army we will have no state. In order to ensure our survival we must therefore expand our industrial capabilities.
loc.CHI_sea_small_arms_production_desc: Small arms are the backbone of our military industry. Without them our armies would be useless and our state would crumble to any pressure. We should logically then further invest into this sector.
loc.CHI_sea_industrial_research_projects_des: Without a modern industry we will lag behind the rest, and without it we will soon be outclassed by the Central Government. Funding research into more modern methods and machinery will help keep our industry up to par with the rest of the world.
loc.CHI_sea_expand_public_education_desc: Without a population that has access to education we will simply fall behind the other nations. In order to ensure the prosperity of our nation we must therefore invest in public education.
loc.CHI_sea_fund_research_projects_desc: To keep our advantage over our adversaries it is important that we are aware of and can utilize the latest technological advancements. By funding research projects we can ensure that while also aiding our population.
loc.CHI_sea_rely_on_our_infantry_desc: Infantry focused armies have not failed us yet, and they never will. We should logically then invest more into them to have an advantage against any potential enemy.
loc.CHI_sea_modern_warfare_desc: The future of warfare does not lie in the infantry focused armies we possess today. In order to not get outmaneuvered and destroyed by our enemies we must invest into new technology.
loc.CHI_sea_consolidate_our_rule_desc: While we have nominal control over our province there are still places where our authority is thin. We should try and reach out to these places to ensure that the population knows about who governs them.
loc.CHI_sea_fortification_efforts_desc: While our position remains secure for now there may come a time where we will need to defend our borders to the last man. It is thus clear that we will have to fortify our borders and entrench ourselves.
loc.CHI_sea_infantry_efforts_desc: Infantry serves as the backbone of our army. By improving our training methods and standards we will be able to ensure that they perform even better in active combat.
loc.CHI_sea_brigade_specialization_desc: While having an army fit for most tasks is fundamental for our victory against the invaders, it is also imperative that we focus on some degree of specialization.
loc.CHI_sea_the_army_desc: With our army reform complete we can finally say that we are not just a warlord with his band of soldiers but rather a commander with his army, ready to take on any threats that may come in our way.
loc.CHI_crackdown_on_looting_desc: In order to properly allow for our province to develop, we need to stop our soldiers from constantly helping themselves to the food and tools of our local population, and ensure that law and justice can be enforced by our government as necessary to keep the peace.
loc.XSM_the_military_governor_desc: While our country is nominally lead by Ma Lin, the civilian governor of Qinghai, the Military Governor and nephew of Ma Lin, Ma Bufang has been vying for complete control over the province for a while. Whether he will succeed in ousting his uncle is yet uncertain, but with some maneuvering it is certainly possible.
loc.XSM_a_hui_army_desc: The army, under the command of Ma Bufang, is composed to a large extent by Hui people, swearing absolute loyalty to their commander. They will prove very useful if Ma Bufang has to seize power by military means.
loc.XSM_sway_the_people_desc: While the army is solidly with Ma Bufang, the people seem to much prefer Ma Lin. Attempting to sway them will be important, but unless drastic things happen they will still sit in Ma Lin's camp for now.
loc.XSM_sweep_out_communists_desc: Expelling Zhang Guotao and his band of communists is a top priority if we are not to fall into the hands of the Soviet Republic. We must therefore sweep out any remaining communists from our territory.
loc.XSM_send_ma_lin_on_hajj_desc: Ma Lin knows his time is up, but ousting him without any reason will still anger the population. We should therefore force him to renounce his position under the guise of going on Hajj.
loc.XSM_the_civilian_governor_remains_desc: While Ma Bufang wanted full control it is becoming more and more evident that it won't be possible without risking a full scale revolt from the people. Ma Lin has however suggested a compromise where both roles will be seen as co-ruling, with him resigning to a more symbolic role as leader and Bufang being de facto in control of most matters.
loc.XSM_solidifying_control_desc: Now that the internal strife is over it's time to solidify our rule over Qinghai to avoid any further destabilization, be it from internal or external forces.
loc.XSM_sideline_family_conflicts_desc: The Ma family is large and controls vast territories. In theory this could mean that banding together would create a formidable force in the area, but instead the family is ridden with strife and conflict. If we are to band together we must first ensure that these conflicts are not in our way.
loc.XSM_strengthening_our_position_desc: We will need a fighting force if we are to unite, as the potential for armed conflict is higher than zero and our army is still far too small for any large-scale operation.
loc.XSM_demand_submission_desc: We should seek to avoid conflict if needed, so the correct route is to announce our intentions and give the others a chance to surrender before we strike.
