loc.XSM_strike_at_the_detractors_desc: The other members of the family cannot be trusted, and announcing our intentions will only give them a chance to prepare themselves. We should strike first, ask later.
loc.XSM_a_united_ma_state_desc: With all of the family united under one banner we are now a force to be reckoned with, both on the local and international stage. The Ma Clique will last a thousand years!
loc.XSM_a_united_ma_state_tt: Any puppet Ma Cliques of ours will be §YAnnexed§! and §YCored§!, and we will gain their §YGenerals§!
loc.XSM_ma_qis_natural_successor_desc: Though the former governor Ma Qi's son Ma Bufang is a brilliant military strategist and hungers for power, he is not fit to rule the province. Instead, Ma Lin, brother of the former governor, remains much more qualified to rule. He will see his reforms through to the end.
loc.XSM_recruit_salar_officers_desc: The turkic Salar people of Qinghai province show promise in the art of war. Officers will be sent out to Xunhua county to scout out promising new leaders, and ensure they are given proper military training.
loc.XSM_rebuild_the_ninghai_army_desc: In order to once again bring order to our southern provinces and secure our borders, we must rebuild the Ninghai army. By doing this, we should be able to gain the upper hand in our skirmishes against the Tibetans.
loc.KUM_victory_in_tihwa_desc: With the fall of [617.GetName], our position in the province has been properly solidified. Today we stand victorious, long live the Khan!
loc.KUM_restore_yettishar_desc: With full control of Xinjiang province, we should now seek to fulfill the ambitions of Muhammad Yakub Beg and unite the Muslim provinces of the Northwest.
loc.MAN_tsr_expand_the_navy_desc: While we will still have to rely on the Japanese for their support on the seas it would be wise to invest in having more than just a river navy. Led by our flagship, Hai Wei, and with strict cooperation with our allies we will be able to stand up to any attempt at invading or raiding our lands from the sea.
loc.MAN_tsr_mangyo_tt: The §Y$MAN_showa_steel_works$§! and the §Y$MAN_south_manchuria_railway_company$§! will be merged the §YManchurian Industrial Development Company§!
loc.MAN_tsr_embrace_state_shintoism_tt: Unlocks decisions to improve the §Y$MAN_state_shintoism_dm$§! National Spirit
loc.MAN_tsr_strengthen_ties_with_nissan_desc: Nissan is an important partner for our military and civilian industries. We should seek to have a closer relationship with them to ensure that we can maintain and expand both sectors with ease.
loc.MAN_tsr_mangyo_desc: The Manchurian Industrial Development Company or Mangyō for short is an effort by Yoshisuke Aikawa, founder of the Nissan Zaibatsu, to together with the Government further ensure economic prosperity for Manchuria. This will be done by developing certain strategic industries to then slowly branch out into other sectors.
loc.MAN_tsr_obedience_desc: Some call us a mere puppet of the Japanese, but they fundamentally misunderstand our close and equal relationship with the Concordia Association at the forefront. To go against our benefactors would be the same as a child going against its parents.
loc.MAN_tsr_trading_illicit_goods_desc: While the trade of illicit goods isn't the main income source of our nation, it drives in major profits. It would be foolish to shut it down, but it could have dire consequences on both Manchurian and Chinese society left unchecked.
loc.MAN_tsr_social_research_unit_desc: The Gassakusha are agricultural cooperative organizations active both in Japan and Manchuria. We should study these to better understand why they work in order to be able to apply this to other contexts.
loc.MAN_tsr_further_mobilization_desc: Without any soldiers we will not have an army. We must push for further mobilization and training so that we can field an army to be reckoned with.
loc.MAN_tsr_strengthen_the_manchukuo_imperia: We need a strong army to defeat our adversaries and maintain our independence. Overreliance on the Kwantung army will only eventually lead to our downfall. To have a free Manchurian nation we must first have an army.
loc.MAN_tsr_expand_xingan_army_desc: The Xing'an Army is an important force within our army. If we are to succeed in coming battles it would be wise to expand it.
loc.MAN_tsr_request_dalian_desc: Japan currently occupies the Manchurian port city of Dalian sitting at the tip of the Liaotung Peninsula as part of the Kwantung Leased Territory. We should however try to persuade them to hand it over to our Government as the difference for them would be negligible while it would be massively beneficial to us.
loc.MAN_tsr_the_question_of_leadership_desc: While we are currently under the rule of prime minister Zhang Jinhui with Puyi being an Emperor in name only, this could of course be changed. If the Kwantung Army deems it necessary, they could revert power back to the Emperor or even go so far as to put in their own Emperor and sideline Puyi.
loc.MAN_tsr_empire_of_manchukuo_desc: Manchukuo, or the Empire of Great Manchuria as it's officially known, is in no way a world power, but we have still managed to carve out our place in the landscape of Greater East Asia. We should seek to maintain this position, not falling for false pretenses of great wealth and glory, but rather seeking to find our role within this world.
loc.MAN_tsr_embrace_state_shintoism_desc: State Shinto has served the Japanese Empire well, managing to mobilize millions to the cause. We should seek to emulate it in our own territories, even if it may initially face resistance.
loc.MAN_tsr_work_with_the_kempeitai_desc: The Kempeitai, Japan's military police, are active in Manchuria working against Bandits and other Dissidents. They do however face great difficulty in this due to poor communication with our authorities and lack of knowledge about the land. We should work with them to create a more efficient unit.
loc.MAN_tsr_promote_manchu_identity_desc: The Manchurian People are not just another Chinese nation. We should seek to enforce this link to the land and encourage Manchurian nationalism to separate us from the rest of China. This way we will more easily be able to maintain our independence while linking us closer to the great nations of Asia.
loc.MAN_tsr_claim_outer_manchuria_desc: The loss of Outer Manchuria to the Russians is still a thorn in the side of Manchurian nationalists to this day. We should seek to right this historical wrong by reclaiming and reintegrating these territories into the nascent Manchurian Nation.
loc.MAN_tsr_reclaim_our_lost_possessions_des: The loss of Outer Manchuria in the Treaty of Aigun and Peking as well as the Soviet seizure of Mongolia are still a sore in the side of our state. We must reverse this historical error and put an end to the Soviet empire once and for all!
loc.MAN_tsr_reclaim_our_lost_possessions_tt: Unlocks decisions to integrate §YOuter Manchurian§!, [MON.GetFlag] §Y[MON.GetAdjective]§! and [TAN.GetFlag] §Y[TAN.GetAdjective]§! states.
loc.MAN_tsr_a_new_constitution_desc: A royal dictatorship is in the interest of nobody. We should instead draft a constitution that grants the Emperor some power but also limits him behind a democratically elected government.
loc.MAN_tsr_division_of_power_desc: With the constitution drafted it will now come in force and the stain of barbaric forms of rule like military and royal dictatorships will be a thing of the past. The Chinese empire will be a state not only for the strong and mighty, but for everyone.
loc.MAN_tsr_reestablish_the_qing_army_desc: Without an army we will never be able to reunite the Empire that once was. We should take inspiration from our old army but also not get too entrenched in tradition. The art of war is changing and we must follow.
loc.MAN_tsr_question_the_emperors_authority_: While Puyi still has quite some support within those who oppose the government, he is also widely criticized for his inaction against the Japanese. We should ride this wave and get rid of him from the picture of a free Manchuria entirely.
loc.MAN_tsr_bandit_recruitment_desc: Many of the so called bandits roaming our lands are in reality guerilla fighters engaged in active conflict against Japan. We should ally and utilize their experience them if we are to have a chance against the Japanese Empire.
loc.MAN_tsr_ally_bandit_leaders_desc: The presence of the Kwantung Army means that the Japanese have managed to assert a large amount of power over our country. However, this also means that there is a sizeable amount of people willing to take up arms to rid them from our lands. We must seize this opportunity to ensure the people's victory.
loc.MAN_tsr_a_new_dawn_over_manchuria_desc: The time has come. Our troops are ready and the japanese garrisons are crumbling under the renewed rebel assaults. If we will ever be able to drive the invaders out that time is now.
loc.MAN_kim_il_sung_tt: Certain Korean revolutionaries may be encouraged to join the fight
loc.MAN_tsr_depose_puyi_desc: Puyi has served his purpose as a figurehead but now he only serves as a hinder to true democracy. Being under a monarch will only serve to entrench our state in medieval conceptions of aristocracy and nobility. It is therefore imperative to remove him from his position.
loc.MAN_tsr_the_new_beiyang_government_desc: The Beiyang army once led the Republic of China from where we are standing. If we are to bring true democracy to China we will have to assume the mantle of their successor, lest we be seen only as an illegitimate state run by bandits.
loc.MAN_cores_beiyang_tt: Gains cores in §YNorthern China§! and §YInner Mongolia§!
loc.MAN_tsr_reform_the_army_desc: Our current forces are nothing more than a ragtag group of various rebel armies and Manchurian army remnants. If we want to avoid total disaster in coming wars we must first reform it into what it once was.
loc.MAN_tsr_beiyang_university_desc: Without proper education our people will lack opportunities and our research efforts will lag behind those of the rest of China and beyond. We should therefore establish a university in the honor of Pan Fu, the last premier of the old Beiyang Government.
loc.MAN_tsr_the_southern_expedition_desc: The Kuomintang northern expedition is what once shattered our beautiful republic. We should reverse this error by launching a southern expedition and finally put an end to the failed state that currently occupies Nanjing.
loc.MAN_tsr_proclaim_the_republic_of_china_d: With all capitals under our control we can finally proclaim ourselves as the Republic of China and the legitimate successor to the Beiyang Government. What the future will hold is yet to see but for now we have brought democracy to all of China, and so it shall hopefully remain for a thousand years.
loc.MAN_tsr_finish_off_the_japanese_threat_d: The Japanese, our original occupiers, have been let off the hook for far too long. It is time we put an end to their farce and show which state has the right to rule Asia.
loc.MAN_tsr_an_industrial_power_desc: With an industry finally able to compete with the west we should push to even further expand it. With this we will in time become the main industrial power of Asia and then the Whole World.
loc.MAN_tsr_zhao_shangzhis_coup_desc: With the dust settled, the Japanese gone and Puyi deposed, there has become a sort of power vacuum in Manchuria. Zhao Shangzhi and his Northeast Anti-Japanese United Army have been quick to fill this void and are now demanding that [MAN.GetLeader] step down.
loc.MAN_tsr_ally_the_soviet_republic_desc: Our friends in the CPC down in the rest of China would surely want to band up with us. Together we will be much more able to fight against any foreign or internal threats.
loc.MAN_tsr_research_cooperation_desc: There is currently a lack of actual communication between the different areas occupied by our party. We should therefore coordinate our research efforts within the CPC to ensure that no part falls behind.
loc.MAN_tsr_the_long_march_south_desc: The time has come. With moving our troops across the border we will have initiated the final stage of the Civil War in China. It is still too early to see who will prevail but with expert maneuvering it will be hard for our enemies to keep up.
loc.MAN_soviet_volunteers_tt: The [SOV.GetFlag] §YSoviet Union§! will be more likely to send us volunteers
loc.MAN_tsr_soviet_aid_desc: With the Soviet Union to our north and east it would not be too hard to organize transports of both equipment and men to our lands. We should therefore persuade them to aid their ideological allies in China.
loc.MAN_tsr_proclaim_the_peoples_republic_de: With the main capitals of China under our control the time has come to proclaim the formation of the People's Republic of China. No longer shall we be an unorganized territory in the periphery lead by bandits and other criminals in the eyes of the Global Powers, but rather a fully fledged state!
loc.MAN_tsr_request_our_lost_territories_tt: Asks the [SOV.GetFlag] §YSoviet Union§! to hand over territories once under Chinese control
loc.MAN_tsr_request_our_lost_territories_des: The Soviet Union currently sits on several territories that were once Chinese and Manchurian. If we are to have a functioning relationship with their state it would only be fair to ask for their return or at least settling this dispute.
loc.MAN_tsr_persuade_the_IMPRP_tt: Members of the [MEN.Getflag] §YInner Mongolian People's Revolutionary Party§! will start a civil war once we declare independence
loc.MAN_tsr_persuade_the_IMPRP_desc: The Inner Mongolian People's Revolutionary Party is not a major force in [MEN.GetName] at the moment, but with some persuasion and aid from our side of the border we can drag them with us in our revolution against [JAP.GetNameDef], and in turn liberate them as well.
loc.MAN_tsr_raise_the_yong_ying_desc: The Yong Ying, literally 'Brave Camps', were a sort of regional army during the Qing Empire. They were comprised of local militiamen and unlike the standing army were locally funded. These militias often served the purpose of local self-defense in the provinces and served us very well. We should seek to reinstate this system but make it fit for a modern war.
loc.MAN_tsr_raise_the_yong_ying_tt: Unlocks decisions to §YRaise Militias§! when at war
loc.MAN_tsr_a_new_self_strengthening_movemen: The Self-Strengthening Movement or the Western Affairs Movement was a period of westernization in our old Empire. Its purpose was primarily to improve our industrial and military capabilities after several crises that almost destroyed our nation. We should seek to continue this modernization to avoid any potential future disaster.
loc.MAN_tsr_reestablish_the_gansu_braves_des: The Gansu Braves were a combined force of Muslim soldiers from Gansu. With the area controlled by the Ma family finally under our control we should reestablish this army and recruit their generals to aid us in controlling the area.
loc.CHI_sea_one_china_policy_tt: Unlocks decisions to integrate states that were once part of China
loc.CHI_sea_annex_tuva_desc: Tuva was once part of our state but after the revolution the Russians stole them from us. We must seek to reunite them with their brothers in the south and free them from the hands of the Russians.
loc.CHI_sea_push_into_manchuria_desc: The loss of Manchuria to the Russians in the treaties of 1858 and 1860 was humiliating and if we are to become an Imperial power we must seek to reverse this error.
loc.CHI_sea_dominate_siam_desc: Siam stands as one of the few nations in Asia not occupied by a foreign power. We should protect them against these foreign powers further by offering them our protection, and in turn take control over their nation.
loc.SIC_the_sichuan_clique_desc: The Sichuan Clique sits in an interesting position, being the territories of several different minded warlords loosely held together by some idea of provincial unity. We should utilize the different strengths of these warlords in order to grow and become stronger than we already are.
loc.SIC_the_domain_of_liu_wenhui_desc: Liu Wenhui, uncle and former rival of Liu Xiang, has carved out a little kingdom of his own in the province of Xikang. Initially the Governor of Sichuan, he was ousted in 1935 and has since then administered Xikang as a functionally independent realm, potentially with the ambition to unite all of Xikang under his rule.
loc.SIC_develop_xikang_desc: Xikang is sparsely populated and mountainous, meaning it has often been disregarded when it comes to the development of the provinces. We should seek to invest in this area to gain the favor of the people and in turn also improve our economic base.
loc.SIC_push_back_the_tibetans_desc: The time has finally come to strike. We should decisively push past the Jinsha river into Chamdo like we threatened to do in 1932, and finally unite Xikang under our rule!
loc.SIC_the_armies_of_yang_sen_desc: Yang Sen is a general with an already quite extensive military career, having been Governor of Sichuan in 1924 to 1925 to then clash with the British and join the Kuomintang in 1926. We should seek to gain his favor to further our military capabilities
loc.SIC_anti_communism_desc: Yang Sen is an active proponent of anti-communism, having previously actively fought to prevent communist infiltration in the province. We should uphold this policy to avoid Sichuan falling in the wrong hands.
loc.SIC_drive_out_the_japanese_desc: The Japanese attempt at subjugating the Chinese must immediately come to an end. While their complete military victory still feels unrealistic, we must stop them and turn the tide once and for all. We must seek to drive them out of our glorious nation!
loc.SIC_the_governor_of_sichuan_desc: Liu Xiang, the current governor and nephew of Liu Wenhui, controls the wealthiest and most important part of Sichuan. We should seek to further develop it while also improving our technological capabilities, continuing his reforms.
loc.SIC_develop_chongqing_desc: Chongqing is the heart of Sichuan, and we should seek to further industrialize it. If we are to stand against foreign or internal threats we must also have the industrial backing to do so.
loc.SIC_armor_efforts_desc: The armor and air force capabilities we have are far too small for a modern conflict. We should seek to improve our technology to stand up to foreign threats.
loc.SIC_sichuan_still_stands_desc: While the Central Government had hoped marching on Chongqing after the death of Liu Xiang would mean that we surrendered, that hasn't been the case. We have instead proven ourselves to be a legitimate force in China and that we are capable to stand up to the Central Government if needed.
loc.SND_unlock_loyalty_decision_tt: §YUnlocks decisions to try and prove Han Fuju's loyalty or to defect to the Japanese§!
loc.GXC_the_japanese_visit_desc: The Japanese have had quite an interest in our two states for quite some time, hoping that our opposition to the Central Government would open for further expansion in China. While we don't agree with the Japanese and vehemently oppose their advances into our land, it would be wise to accept the gifts they're offering so we can use their own weapons against them if the time comes.
loc.GXC_question_chiangs_authority_desc: Chiang Kai-Shek has recently been attempting to assert more and more influence over our provinces to try and rein us in. We should question if he truly has any authority over us, since we are functionally independent.
loc.GXC_the_scorched_earth_speech_desc: The Central Government has been going far too easy on the Japanese. We should fight them to the last man, burning the earth if we are forced to retreat. The Japanese Empire must never control all of China, no matter the cost.
loc.GXC_rumors_of_deposition_desc: There have been rumors going around that Chiang Kai-Shek sees Chen Jitang as too independent and therefore is seeking to rein the province in by forcing him to resign. If this is true it is highly troubling and we must act immediately!
loc.GXC_denounce_chiang_desc: Chiang Kai-Shek's posturing and inability to put up any sort of resistance against the Japanese has just proven he is weak and unfit to rule. We should denounce him and offer an alternative solution, one that isn't weak.
loc.GXC_formation_of_the_nraja_desc: We have once again seen that we have no choice but to organize armed resistance and march towards Nanjing if we are to prevent the Japanese from slowly taking over our land. We should therefore form the National Revolutionary Anti-Japanese Army and prepare to march against Hunan.
loc.GXC_declare_opposition_desc: The time has come. We should declare our opposition to the Central Government and march north to either force them to negotiate or depose them once and for all. What may happen next is unsure but if we fail we will still have sent a strong message!
loc.MA_develop_inter_province_ties_desc: In order to more effectively govern and develop our vast and sparsely populated territories, we must reach out to our fellow family members and establish closer ties between our governed provinces.
loc.cast_off_ma_ties_or_became_china_flag: Has cast off Ma-family Ties or Become a new Central Government
loc.MA_unified_training_program_desc: In order to protect our borders and keep a tight grip over the northeast, it is of utmost importance that we improve the quality of our troops as well as coordinate recruitment to ensure no valuable recruits slip under our noses.
loc.MA_strenghten_regional_trade_desc: Though our lands are vast, our economies are lacking in multiple aspects. We must coordinate trade and industrial buildup to alleviate these issues.
loc.MA_strenghten_regional_trade_tt: All members gain §G1§! §YCivilian Factory§! in their capital
loc.MA_promises_of_mutual_defense_desc: With all the previous treaties signed, we can now move on to enact a mutual defense treaty that would ensure we all come to each-other's aid if any foreign power, Chinese or not, intrudes on our territory.
loc.MA_promises_of_mutual_defense_tt: All Ma Cliques will §YGuarantee the Independence§! of each-other
loc.MA_formalize_the_ma_clique_collective_de: All of the groundwork has now been laid to turn the Ma Clique Collective from a loose formation of remote warlords into something more tightly unified. We should formalize this entity, and ensure we all share the same foreign policy.
loc.XIC_northwest_bandit_suppression_headqua: Our operations against the communists in Shaanxi have stalled, and in the second half of 1935 alone we lost an infantry division and a regiment in the region. With increasing pressure from our officers and soldiers to cease the fruitless fighting against the communists and focus on the restoration of our lost provinces in the northeast, we need to make a choice.
loc.XIC_discussions_in_luochuan_desc: The communists have sent Li Kenong as their representative to meet $CHI_zhang_xueliang$ in Luochuan. They wish to discuss the possibility of ceasing hostilities and focusing on what we both perceive as the bigger threat to China, the Japanese. We shall indulge them, and head to the specified location with great haste.
loc.XIC_send_a_representative_to_sheng_shica: Send a Representative to Sheng Shicai

Li Kenong agreed to seek cooperation between us and the CPC on the condition that both parties seek out [SOV.GetAdjective] representatives and attempt to gain their aid in the fight against Japan. We should use our contacts in [SIK.GetNameDef] to gain the favor of [SOV.GetLeader].
loc.XIC_non_agression_pact_with_the_cpc_desc: In order to prove our commitment to the anti-Japanese cause, we should attempt to cease hostilities for the time being, even though the complacent [CHI.GetLeader] may be irked by the decision. In due time, we should be able to convince the [CHI.GetAdjective] leadership to join forces with [PRC.GetNameDef].
loc.XIC_the_fushi_conference_desc: For a second meeting, [PRC.GetLeader] has agreed to send Li Kenong and Zhou Enlai as envoys to Fushi to discuss the further requirements and actions needed in order to convince [CHI.GetLeader] of joining a formal United Front. The time to defeat the [JAP.GetAdjective] and reclaim the lands of the Fengtian Clique draw ever closer...
loc.XIC_anti_japanese_national_salvation_agr: With a formal agreement to end the hostilities in Shaanxi reached, it is time to strengthen the CPC in order for them to gain the swaying power needed to convince [CHI.GetLeader] that an end to the civil war and creation of a Second United Front is worth it for the Kuomintang. We should therefore smuggle weapons and funds given to us by the KMT into the Soviet Base Area, to build up their strength.
loc.XIC_withdraw_forces_from_yanan_desc: In order to invoke the ire of [CHI.GetLeader] and ensure that the KMT party leadership travels to Xi'an to investigate our troops, we should cause an incident by withdrawing our forces from Yan'an and allow the communists to capture the city.
loc.XIC_form_the_anti_japanese_comrades_asso: In order to build up our strength and convince the army to stop fighting the CPC, we must establish a secret core organization to unite the Northeast Army and absorb those with active anti-Japanese ideas, something Zhang has dubbed the Anti-Japanese Comrades Association. Zhang will serve as the chairman of the association, united with the Communists to fight against Japan and train anti-Japanese cadres.
loc.XIC_invite_chiang_for_troop_inspections_: Our country is weakened by internal fighting while Japan clearly has designs on our territory. Despite this, [CHI.GetLeader] refuses to cooperate with the CPC and continuously demands we continue our bandit suppression campaign despite our desperate pleas, lest we be relocated to the south. We must force the Nationalists and Communists to see reason and form a United Front.
loc.XIC_sixth_encirclement_campaign_desc: Despite the heavy losses inflicted upon us by the CPC menace, we must prepare for another offensive, as [CHI.GetLeader] has once again order us to continue our encirclement campaigns. Only by doing this, will the [CHI.GetAdjective] leadership be satisfied and allow us to focus our attention to the northeast.
loc.XIC_request_relocation_to_northeastern_c: With our bandit suppression mission now finished in Shaanxi, it is time to propose a plan to [CHI.GetLeader] in which we will suggest $CHI_zhang_xueliang$ take up the role of the northern bastion and keeper of [608.GetName], currently held by [HBC.GetLeader]. Through this, we will be able to further our goals of restoring the once great Fengtian Clique.
loc.XIC_invite_zuolin_loyalsits_desc: Many of the soldiers and generals serving in [MAN.GetNameDef]'s army were once loyal to [ROOT.GetLeader]'s father, Zhang Zuolin. It is time we secretly reach out to them, and invite them to return to [ROOT.GetNameDef].
loc.XIC_reestablish_the_zhili_army_desc: The Fengtian clique's Zhili Army was once the army Zuolin had placed in what is now Hebei province and Beiping. We should reestablish this organization, as a good stepping stone in our path to rebuilding the Clique from the ground up.
loc.XIC_recruit_mancurian_bandits_desc: Many of the so called bandits roaming Manchuria are in reality guerilla fighters engaged in active conflict against [JAP.GetNameDef] and [MAN.GetNameDef]. We should ally and utilize their experience them if we are to have a realistic chance against the eastern threat.
loc.XIC_recruit_mancurian_bandits_tt: Gain 3 units with §Y5 infantry§! battalions and 2 units with §Y5 cavalry§! battalions.\n
loc.XIC_restore_the_glory_of_the_fengtian_ar: Restore the Glory of the Fengtian Army

With the reestablishment of the Zhili army complete, it is time we properly rebuild the Fengtian Army to the strength it once was, as the dominant force in northern China. Soon, our glory days will be restored!
loc.XIC_reclaim_the_lost_birthright_desc: The time has finally come to kick out the [MAN.GetAdjective] and [JAP.GetAdjective] scourge from our homeland, and reclaim Manchuria for ourselves! We should launch an invasion of the north promptly, and seize the region before their forces know what hit them.
loc.XIC_restore_the_homeland_desc: With the reclamation of our old capital of Mukden, the time has finally come for $CHI_zhang_xueliang$ to properly don the title of Warlord of Manchuria and Generalissimo of the Military Government of China, and restore the Fengtian Clique to the power it once held. Long live Fengtian, and long live the young marshal!
loc.XIC_restore_the_homeland_tt: Gain §YCores§! on all territory held by the §YFengtian Clique§! at it's largest extent
loc.XIC_revive_the_beiyang_government_desc: As a legitimate heir to the government in exile of the Beiyang Government, we can finally proclaim ourselves as the legitimate Republic of China. What the future will hold is yet to see but for now we have brought democracy to all of China, and so it shall hopefully remain for a thousand years.
loc.CHI_tsr_repoen_the_natioal_assembly_desc: The National Assembly was the legislative branch of the Beiyang government, being closed down for good by Yuan Shikai and later being replaced by the Legislative Yuan.  If we want a truly free democratic legislature in the country, we cannot be satisfied with only allowing the Yuan to continue it's operation. A multi-faceted system must be put in place to ensure the will of the people can reign supreme!
loc.CHI_tsr_form_a_preparatory_committee_des: Unless the disadvantages of competing for the head of state are eliminated first, the country will never have peace. Therefore, as was once done on the 19th of August 1915, a preparatory committee must be established with the goal of founding a  constitutional monarchy. Only then can our internal strife and political chaos be truly stomped out!
loc.CHI_tsr_legacy_of_the_hongxian_emperor_d: Yuan Shikai may have left the nation in a terrible state ripe with warlordism and republican fervor, but his intentions were good. Thus he took on the role of the Hongxian Emperor to grant the national Constitutional Abundance, and became its National Protector. If any men are worthy of reverence it is him, and we must endeavor to revive his legacy before he is forgotten to time.
loc.CHI_tsr_coronation_at_the_temple_of_heav: Coronation at the Temple of Heaven

In order to build up our authority, [ROOT.GetLeader] must see to reinstituting  elements of state Confucianism, and revive Qing state religious observances. Therefore, it is to [ROOT.GetLeader]'s best interest to participate as emperor in rituals held at the Qing Temple of Heaven, and eventually be coronated there.
loc.CHI_tsr_outlaw_the_kmt_and_cpc: Outlaw the KMT and the CPC
loc.CHI_tsr_outlaw_the_kmt_and_cpc_desc: Republicanism is not suitable for China's national conditions. Therefore, the revolutionary elements that once overthrew the Empire and rose from it's ashes must not be allowed to take hold again. The country can only be restored to it's former glory under unified leadership, and as such internal dissent must be dealt with swiftly.
loc.CHI_tsr_restoration_of_the_chinese_empir: The time has come to restore our nation, and bring it out of the century of humiliation it has been forced to endure. It is time to claim our place in international affairs, and heroically stands in the universe. It is time for [ROOT.GetLeader] to take on the role of Great Emperor of the Chinese Empire!
loc.CHI_tsr_adopt_the_twelve_symbols_desc: The Twelve Symbols national emblem was the state emblem of the Empire of China, and shall be so once again. Based on the ancient symbols of the Twelve Ornaments, and through their power will the emperors authority be known throughout the land. By the Azure Dragon and the Fenghuang, the Emperor's will be done!
loc.CHI_tsr_reinstate_the_new_imperial_code_: Around his ascension, Yuan's legal advisor, Ariga Nagao drafted the New Imperial Code, based on the Japanese Imperial Model. Though we do not wish to follow the legal basis of such a rogue state particularly closely, it is clear it will have the intended effect. To that end, we should look to drafting a new constitution, based on this code.
loc.CHI_tsr_reestablish_xinhua_palace_desc: Upon his ascension, Yuan Shikai renamed the Zhongnanha residence next to the Forbidden City into the Palace of the New China. Choosing this as his place of residence, it seems only fit that [ROOT.GetLeader] take the same approach and follow in his footsteps.
loc.CHI_tsr_reclaim_the_mandate_of_heaven_de: Our previous victories in the wars to reclaim the Imperial Capital have made it clear that heaven itself has judged the Emperor just and worthy of the Celestial Throne. Any doubt that he is not the legitimate ruler of all of China must vanish in the face of such overwhelming evidence.
loc.CHI_tsr_five_races_under_one_union_desc: If our new dynasty is to survive the coming years, we must incorporate principles of the Republic from which Yuan Shikai rose to power. Through the principles of the five-colored republic, the harmonious coexistence under one nation of different groups in the region can be achieved.
loc.CHI_tsr_zhonghua_minzu_desc: In order to continue to build a successful state, we must invoke Chinese nationalism in relation to the concepts of nation-building and familiarity, effectively showcasing to our population that they have an obligation to be loyal to the Emperor and the government of [ROOT.GetNameDef].
loc.CHI_tsr_reestablish_the_beiyang_army_des: The Northern Ocean Army was  established by Yuan Shikai in 1895, and acted as the centerpiece of the general overhaul of the Qing's outdated military system. We should do the same, and overhaul the army to avoid the corruption and inefficacies inherent in the system established by the Kuomintang.
loc.CHI_tsr_reestablish_the_wuwei_corps_desc: The Wuwei Corps was effectively the security force of Beijing and the Forbidden City, created as an attempt by the Qing imperial court to create a western-style army equipped with modern weaponry following their defeat in the Sino-Japanese War. In order to protect the Emperor's life and the city of the heavens, we must take similar measures.
loc.CHI_tsr_never_another_national_protectio: The National Protection War took place between 1915 and 1916, and was an attempt by disloyal generals and republicans to overthrow the legitimate rule of the Hongxian Emperor. In order to ensure that this can never happen again, we must rapidly crack down on the autonomous warlords and independent armies, and ensure all power lies in the hands of the son of heaven!
loc.CHI_tsr_tianxia_desc: All lands on this earth have been appointed to our heavenly sovereign by universal and well-defined principles of order. The center of this land is to be the [ROOT.GetAdjective] court and the Emperor. The time has at long last come to claim our place as the middle kingdom, and as the true cradle of human civilization!
loc.CHI_tsr_the_reorganied_government_desc: With the Collapse of the [CHI.GetLeader] Regime and their cowardly retreat west, we stand as the legitimate Chinese state. To confirm this, [ROOT.GetLeader] has visited the tomb of Sun Yat-Sen and declared that he will uphold the republican principles that he once established.
loc.CHI_tsr_military_industrial_collaboratio: Our army is understaffed and underequipped, with large parts of it operating with only captured equipment. We must seek to fix error this by cooperating with the Japanese and establishing an arsenal of our own.
loc.CHI_tsr_industrial_expansion_cooperation: Without an industry and the resources to support it China will never prosper as a nation. We must seek to improve our industrial capabilities if we are to stand up to the West.
loc.CHI_tsr_expand_the_nanjing_army_desc: We can expect no more than a tenth of our nominal forces to be loyal to us, so in the face of that we must seek to create a truly loyal force, guided by our great leader.
loc.CHI_tsr_promote_tridemism_desc: The Three Principles of the People as outlined by Sun Yat-Sen are Nationalism, Democracy, and the Livelihood of the people. We should seek to continue his legacy while adopting our own principles to better represent the nature of our state.
loc.CHI_tsr_peace_desc: We must strive for peace by any means necessary, even if it means betraying this principle in the short term. We must defeat anyone who stands in the way of prosperity for China.
loc.CHI_tsr_anti_communism_desc: Communism is a scourge on our nation and the guerillas a sore in the side of our administration. We must fight against this ideology and bring it to its end, even if it means giving our lives for the cause.
loc.CHI_tsr_national_construction_desc: China will never be able to truly prosper if we do not see a new wave of industrial expansion. Without a backbone to support it we will never truly be able to become the nation that China is meant to be.
loc.CHI_tsr_pan_asianism_desc: It is natural for us to adopt the ideals of pan-Asianism as we are a brother nation of the Japanese and Sun Yat-Sen once decreed that the Asian nations should unite together to drive out the colonizers. This war is not only a struggle in China, but a larger one aimed at driving out the westerners from our nation.
loc.CHI_tsr_establish_the_tewu_desc: We must not only rely on the Japanese secret services to find dissidents, so we should create our own. With the aid of Japanese advisors it will be possible to not only train our own spies, but soon enough we will be able to have an agency of our own.
loc.CHI_tsr_embrace_japanese_cultural_instit: To achieve better cooperation with the Japanese with the goal of a united Asia against the foreign invaders we should form a united culture, embracing parts of Japanese culture to bring us closer together.
Unlocks decisions to improve the §Y$RNG_state_shintoism_dm$§! National Spirit
loc.CHI_tsr_a_new_chinese_identity_desc: With the fate of China now in our hands we should seek to strengthen our position and prove that we are a worthy partner and the true Chinese Republic Sun Yat-Sen envisioned.
loc.CHI_tsr_our_place_in_the_sphere_desc: Having become a true partner of Japan rather than just their satellite, we should seek to find our place within the Co-Prosperity Sphere and Greater East Asia as a whole. China will become a global power once more!
loc.CHI_tsr_deepen_our_collaboration_desc: Under the guiding hand of the Japanese Empire we have achieved great successes against our invaders. We should seek to deepen our cooperation with them to ensure that our goal of a united Asia is realized.
loc.YUN_rally_around_long_yun_desc: While the north is ruled by radical dictators who pursue their ideologies at any cost, our region is stable and considered by our citizens to be a democratic fortress due to our growing economy and social, educational and political reforms. To that end we should rally behind the architect of this miracle, Long Yun!
loc.YUN_expand_local_infrastructure_desc: In order for our province to be properly traversable, we need to invest in infrastructure that can be sustained in mountainous terrain such as ours. This way more goods may also be transferred between our towns.
loc.YUN_strive_for_self_sufficiency_desc: In order to truly keep our democracy thriving, we must ensure we don't rely on the aid of the northern ideologues too heavily, and can sustain ourselves in the coming years.
loc.YUN_a_land_of_mountains_desc: Yunnan is a land of mountains, and our people have long since learnt from and adapted to living and fighting in such a harsh region. It will surely prove useful to us when the time is right.
loc.YUN_political_reforms_desc: In order to better run our state, we must make sure our political processes are as free from bottlenecks and corruption as possible, and that our economy can benefit from our bureaucrats, and not vice-versa.
loc.YUN_eduational_reforms_desc: The people's tutelage has been postponed to the north, but if we wish for Doctor Sun's dream to ever come true we must continue it, even if it is just here, in our own province.
loc.YUN_the_democratic_fortress_desc: With all of our reforms done, it can truly be said that we are a bastion of democracy in the harsh political landscape of China. Now, we can start looking outward, and see if we can bring our enlightenment to fresh new minds.
loc.YUN_strengthen_burmic_ties_desc: Our local population holds many ties to both China as well as Burma through our Lolo-Burmese speaking population. As the son of a great Tusi, Long Yun must bring democracy to the south as well, to free them from the shackles of colonialism.
loc.PRC_sea_the_yanan_base_area_desc: The foundation of our new revolution is in the area of [ROOT.Capital.GetName]. If we want to prevail in the upcoming struggle, it must be expanded and improved.
loc.MAN_tsr_chinese_leadership_tt: Unlocks decisions to ask [JAP.GetNameDef] to merge other Chinese puppet administrations into us
loc.MAN_tsr_move_capitals_desc: The ancient capital of all of China has always been Beijing. Now that it has been retaken, we can return the Emperor in triumph to his old home.
loc.TIB_tibetan_politics_idea_desc: When unifying the Tibetan heartland under the control of the Gelug school, after defeating the rival Tsangpa prince in a prolonged civil war, the 5th Dalai Lama established a government after which our current is also modeled. Though isolationist, it leads to a more stable state.
loc.TIB_tibetan_army_idea_desc: Though under-equipped and massively outdated, our army has helped us suppress the Bai Lang Rebellion and keep nominal control over the realm. We must continue expanding it to keep the state safe from rival warlord intrusions.
loc.MEN_mongol_banners_idea_tt: Allows for the raising of §YIrregular Divisions§! when at war
loc.JAP_imperial_influence_dm_desc: The various factions within the nation are all vying for power and influence over the [GetImperialInfluenceRulerTitle], a tradition dating back to the oligarchs and military cliques founded during the Meiji and Taisho eras.
loc.JAP_imperial_influence_communist_dm_desc: The various factions within the nation are all vying for power and influence over the [GetImperialInfluenceRulerTitle], a tradition dating back to the oligarchs and military cliques founded during the Meiji and Taisho eras.
loc.JAP_interservice_rivalry_effects: £imperial_influence_texticon Due to the §Y$JAP_interservice_rivalry$§! between the Army and the Navy:
loc.JAP_blocked_from_favoring_the_army_flag: §Y$JAP_army_faction$§! has §RFallen Completely out of Favor§! with the $JAP_imperial_influence_ruler_title$
loc.JAP_blocked_from_favoring_the_navy_flag: §Y$JAP_naval_faction$§! has §RFallen Completely out of Favor§! with the $JAP_imperial_influence_ruler_title$
loc.JAP_blocked_from_favoring_the_zaibatsus_: §Y$JAP_zaibatsu_faction$§! has §RFallen Completely out of Favor§! with the $JAP_imperial_influence_ruler_title$
loc.JAP_blocked_from_favoring_the_government: §Y$JAP_government_faction$§! has §RFallen Completely out of Favor§! with the $JAP_imperial_influence_ruler_title$
loc.JAP_state_shinotism_dm_desc: Since the Meiji Restoration we have sought to use the worship at Shinto shrines to promote imperial loyalty and aid in nation building. This has allowed us to build up a country that is ready to sacrifice much in the name of the state.
loc.JAP_imperial_army_dm_desc: The IJA is our principal ground force, having played a central role in our rapid modernization during the Meiji era, and having fought in numerous conflicts including the Japan–Qing War, the Russo-Japanese War as well as the Great War. Initially formed from domain armies after the Meiji Restoration, it evolved into a powerful modern military influenced by French and German models.
loc.JAP_national_army_dm_desc: The NJLF is our principal ground force, having played a central role in our rapid modernization during the Meiji era, and having fought in numerous conflicts including the Japan–Qing War, the Russo-Japanese War as well as the Great War. Initially formed from domain armies after the Meiji Restoration, it evolved into a powerful modern military influenced by French and German models.
loc.JAP_jungle_armor_tt:
§Y$category_all_armor$§!:
§YJungle§!:
 Attack Effective Change: §G+10%§!
 Defense Effective Change: §G+10%§!
loc.JAP_imperial_navy_dm_desc: The IJN was formed in 1868 at the beginning of the Meiji Restoration, and was already by 1920 the third largest navy in the world. Now, our mighty navy is being rapidly expanded, in order for our nation to be able to face the times ahead.
loc.JAP_japanese_navy_dm_desc: The IJN was formed in 1868 at the beginning of the Meiji Restoration, and was already by 1920 the third largest navy in the world. Now, our mighty navy is being rapidly expanded, in order for our nation to be able to face the times ahead.
loc.JAP_army_and_naval_air_services_dm_desc: Our air force is currently divided between the Imperial Japanese Army Air Service and the Imperial Japanese Navy Air Service, being divided both in operation, production as well as research and development between our navy and army. Due to this it faces large logistical bottlenecks, some of which can only be overcome by the merging of our air forces.
loc.JAP_early_industrialization_efforts_dm_d: Our Industrial Revolution only really got started in the 1870s during the Meiji Restoration, after the Iwakura Mission brought home the knowledge needed to get our industrialization projects off the ground. Ever since then, our economy has expanded greatly, and modern industries have been established. Despite this however, our economy is still far behind those in the western world, largely due to our lack of natural resources.
loc.JAP_the_economic_mirale_dm_desc: Light industry and agriculture are no longer the backbone of the economy, with heavy industries having overtaken them. Adding to that, poverty and unemployment have been radically reduced as a result of Osamu Shimomura's brilliant economic reforms. Soon, we will be one of the world's largest economies!
loc.JAP_tokko_idea_lar_desc: The Special Higher Police is an organization established for the purpose of carrying out civil law enforcement, control of political groups and ideologies deemed to threaten the public order of our nation. Keeping a close eye on people within our nation, they act as a vanguard against foreign agents as well as political dissidents.
loc.JAP_german_tech_exchange_desc: Further German technological advances would be extremely useful for our war effort. We must see to obtaining these schematics, no matter the cost.
loc.JAP_new_order_in_east_asia_idea: The New Order in East Asia
loc.CHI_rejected_our_proposal_for_cooperatio: Rejected our Proposal for Anti-Communist Cooperation
loc.JAP_has_recently_tried_to_block_usa_supp: Japan has recently used the Japanese Committee on Trade and Information to sway the United States from supporting China
loc.JAP_cracked_down_on_growing_pro_japanese: Cracked Down on Growing Pro-Japanese Sentiments
loc.JAP_currently_spreading_pro_japanese_sen: Is currently supporting Pro-Japanese sentiments in a country
loc.JAP_currently_investing_in_states_natura: Is currently investing in a nations natural resources
loc.JAP_surprise_invasion_idea_desc: The invasion that was recently launched by the Kwantung Army has not only taken the enemy by surprise, but also our own government and armed forces. It will take a short while before the army is fully mobilized and ready to fight its new foe.
loc.JAP_ministry_of_greater_east_asia_idea: Administration by the Ministry of Greater East Asia
loc.JAP_first_strike_principle_dm_desc: The revised National Defense Policy adopted in 1936 has outlined a doctrine in which we set first-strike principle and short-term operation in a military contingency as the military modus operandi. Preparation for military force in peace time has as such been necessary for the short-term operation emphasized with consideration of long-drawn-out and all-out war. We will win this war quickly, for otherwise we may not win it at all!
loc.JAP_kantai_kessen_dm_desc: With the decisive defeat of the Russian navy at the Battle of Tsushima, the navy now fully believes in a doctrine where it could win a war by fighting and winning a single, decisive naval action. Their current plans to repeat such a victory now involve assuming a defensive posture and waiting upon the enemy fleet to approach, then destroying it in a sharp battle off the Japanese mainland.
loc.JAP_strike_south_idea_desc: Only by acting decisively and striking fast can we hope to lay all of South East Asia at our feet. Our fleet must brave the waves in order for our soldiers to brave the enemies' beaches and subjugate the region.
loc.JAP_double_leaf_society_idea: Fruits of the Double Leaf Society
loc.JAP_POL_anti_soviet_pact_refused_call: Refused to Honor the Polish-Japanese Anti-[SOV.GetAdjective] Pact
loc.POL_JAP_pact_tt: If one of the nations with §Y$JAP_POL_anti_soviet_pact$§! spirit finds itself at war with §Y[SOV.GetNameDef]§!, the others will be called in
loc.JAP_POL_anti_soviet_pact_2_tt: If one of the nations with §Y$JAP_POL_anti_soviet_pact$§! spirit finds itself in a defensive war with §Y[SOV.GetNameDef]§!, the others will be called in
loc.JAP_intense_anti_guerilla_operation_desc: The Japanese army is currently working hard to root out guerrillas and infiltrators in this region, employing a new scorched earth policy.
loc.MAN_hydroelectric_power_desc: Thanks to the investments made in our country, we have finally built a network of dams that produce electricity and regulate river flows.
loc.KOR_resistance_against_colonial_rule_dm: Popular Resistance Against the Current Rule
loc.JAP_cannot_train_due_to_military_strike: Cannot train new units while the §Y$JAP_military_strike_idea$§! is active
loc.JAP_must_take_revoke_ppl_focus_tt: This can only be resolved by §YRevoking the Peace Preservation Law§!
loc.JAP_state_under_army_control_tt: This state will join the §YFascists§! at the start of the civil war
loc.JAP_state_under_rebel_control: Secured by Opposition to the Imperial Army
loc.JAP_state_under_rebel_control_tt: This state will join the §YDemocrats§! at the start of the civil war, unless also §YInfiltrated by the JCP§!
loc.JAP_state_infiltrated_by_the_jcp_tt: This state will join the §YCommunists§! at the start of the civil war
loc.JAP_royal_support_for_civilian_governmen: Royal Support for the Civilian Government
loc.JAP_form_greater_east_asian_customs_unio: Unlocks decisions to §YEstablish Cheaper Trade Connections§! with our allies
loc.JAP_pacific_integrated_customs_union_mem: §Y[JAP.GetNameDefCap]§! will be able to §RAttempt to Subjugate us Diplomatically!§!
loc.JAP_state_supporting_resistance_modifier: Japan is covertly supplying arms and equipment, as well as military training to the local resistance groups.
loc.JAP_women_in_industry_idea_desc: With a woman as the standing leader for [JAP.GetNameDef], it sets a precedence that women should have the right to work in other industries as well. With this large addition to our workforce, we can expect great economic progress for our country.
loc.JAP_reorganization_of_society_idea_desc: We are currently eliminating remnants of feudalism, nationalism, and conservative traditions while promoting communist ideology. Abolishing Samurai and Feudal Hierarchy ideals, and removing Bushido from education and society, as well as promoting gender equality by granting women full legal and economic rights.
loc.JAP_ministry_of_pan_asian_development_id: Administered by the Ministry of Pan-Asian Development
loc.JAP_crumbling_military_cabinet_idea_2: The Current Situation of the Empire
loc.PRC_no_army_recovery: Still exhausted and weakened by the Long March, the [ROOT.GetAdjective] Red Army is still struggling to get back on its feet against seemingly superior enemies.
loc.PRC_some_army_recovery: Though still nowhere near their strength at its peak, the [ROOT.GetAdjective] Red Army has recovered slightly from the Long March.
loc.PRC_lots_of_army_recovery: Despite the hardships we suffered, the [ROOT.GetAdjective] Red Army has returned to close to their former strength, and is ready to fight for the people once more.
loc.PRC_agrarian_society_desc: Consisting of mainly rural settlements with little industrial development and little to no education for its people, [FROM.GetNameDef] stands before a challenge on many planes.
loc.PRC_agrarian_reform_desc: Though still mostly rural, [FROM.GetNameDef] has started down a slow industrialization effort.
loc.PRC_urban_society_desc: After great effort, [FROM.GetNameDef] has moved from a predominantly rural society to a rapidly urbanizing one. The [FROM.GetAdjective] cities will be the great metropolises of the future.
loc.PRC_central_committee_desc: The Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party is the highest political organ of the Party. Established in the 1920s, the Central Committee is led by the General Secretary. The Politburo is the executive committee and is made up of the senior leadership of the Party. $PRC_zhang_wentian$ took over the General Secretariat from $PRC_bo_gu$ in January 1935.
loc.PRC_defunct_state_bank_desc: Carrying our old minting presses during the Long March was never an option, and as a result our state bank now struggles to get to their bearings in this new and difficult situation.
loc.PRC_paper_bills_promoted_tt: §RTrade Law cannot be raised beyond§! §YLimited Exports§!
loc.PRC_trade_of_special_goods_banned_uprisi: Unpopular Ban of Special Goods Trade
In §Y1 Year§! the people will have come to accept the ban and the National Spirit will be upgraded.
loc.PRC_trade_of_special_goods_banned_stabil: Accepted Ban of Special Goods Trade
loc.PRC_mediating_general_secretary_idea_tt: \n§Y$PRC_zhang_wentian$§! will mediate between §Y$PRC_mao_zedong$§! and the [GetGuotaoOrBolsheviks] to keep both sides from achieving too much power within the §Y$PRC_communist_power_struggle$§!. §RThe Balance of Power will drift towards the middle§!
loc.PRC_mediating_general_secretary_idea_guo: \n§Y$PRC_zhang_wentian$§! will mediate between §Y$PRC_mao_zedong$§! and §Y$PRC_zhang_guotao$§! to keep both sides from achieving too much power within the §Y$PRC_communist_power_struggle$§!. §RThe Balance of Power will drift towards the middle§!
loc.PRC_passive_revolutionaries_idea_tt: \n§Y$PRC_passive_revolutionaries_idea$§! §Rwill be removed once §Y[PRC.GetNameWithFlag]§! joins the war against the foreign invader, or the foreign invader is at peace with all of §YChina§!§!
loc.PRC_the_internal_enemy_tt: Attack bonus against all §YChinese Countries§!: §G+5%§!\nBreakthrough bonus against all §YChinese Countries§!: §G+5%§!
loc.PRC_the_internal_enemy_upgrade_tt: Attack bonus against all §YChinese Countries§!: §G+10%§!\nBreakthrough bonus against all §YChinese Countries§!: §G+10%§!
loc.PRC_add_the_internal_enemy_idea_upgrade_: Modify §Y$PRC_the_internal_enemy$§! by:\nAttack bonus against all §YChinese Countries§!: §G+5%§!\nBreakthrough bonus against all §YChinese Countries§!: §G+5%§!
loc.PRC_SOV_lend_lease_idea_1_tt: This will only apply for as long as §Y[ROOT.GetNameWithFlag]§! or a faction member has a §Yland border§! with §Y[SOV.GetNameWithFlag]§! or a faction member
loc.PRC_publicity_department_of_central_comm: Publicity Department of the Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party
loc.PRC_cmc_military_industry_bureau: Military Industry Bureau of the Central Military Commission
loc.PRC_guerilla_cells_active_1_desc: Cells of hostile guerillas have established presence in the state.
loc.PRC_guerilla_cells_active_1_tt: \n§Y$PRC_guerilla_cells_active_1$§! will be removed if the state has over §G60.00%§! §YCompliance Strength§!
loc.PRC_guerilla_cells_active_2_desc: Cells of hostile guerillas have established presence and commencing organized efforts to destabilize the state.
loc.PRC_guerilla_cells_active_2_tt: \n§Y$PRC_guerilla_cells_active_2$§! will be removed if the state has over §G60.00%§! §YCompliance Strength§!
loc.PRC_anti_japanese_base_desc: Guerilla fighters have congregated and are actively sabotaging the infrastructure in the state.
loc.PRC_infiltrated_state_3_tt: §RThis state will flip to [PRC.GetNameWithFlag] in the event of a war between our two countries§!
loc.PRC_infiltrated_state_2_tt: §YThis state will become cheaper for [PRC.GetNameWithFlag] to take in a Peace Conference§!
loc.CHI_corruption_in_the_administration_des: Greased wheels turn easier, but that does not equate to efficiency. A couple individuals exert unproportional power which is having effects on a national state.
loc.CHI_reorganized_administration_desc: We have greased the wheels of our administration so that they may turn more efficiently by removing the hurdles that lay in our way.
loc.CHI_illicit_trade_desc: Underground markets and smuggling networks undermine government authority and disrupt economic stability. Efforts to curb these activities remain haphazard and the influence of illicit trade continues to hinder national unity and reform.
loc.CHI_inefficient_economy_desc: Our industrialisation is nascent as previous governments have not supported proper growth. We can however solve this through internal and external measures, our potential is truly limitless.
loc.CHI_neglected_countryside_desc: The Nanjing decade has seen truly impressive changes to our society. However modernity has been mostly limited to urban areas and the countryside have been overlooked. This could lead to the breeding ground of radical ideas.
loc.CHI_corruption_in_the_armed_forces_desc: The National Revolutionary Army came from the ranks of the party and thus carry the same baggage the party does. Nepotism, bribery, and embezzlement are rife and if we are to prevail something that we will have to stamp out.
loc.CHI_blue_shirt_society_desc: The Society of Practice of the Three Principles of the People, or the Blue Shirts, lights our special path and will strike down those that stand in its way.
loc.CHI_ROCAF_desc: Since its inception in the last decade the Aviation Affairs Commission has been the organisation through which we will take control of our sky. While still not a centralised air force the march of progress continues and through perseverance we shall prevail.
loc.CHI_protracted_warfare_idea_desc: Some armies believe that a swift strike wins all wars and others understand that denying them that means that their will crumbles. By holding out longer through a defensive posture any invader shall be beaten back.
loc.CHI_decisive_battle_idea_desc: There is no instance of a nation benefitting from prolonged warfare and thus we need to win against our enemies quickly by finding where we shall put our offensive effort. Swift shall the strike be and hard shall it fall.
loc.CHI_gung_ho_idea_desc: One resource we have is people and we have organised them in small scale industrial cooperatives. These grassroots organisation will give us an economic edge in our current conflict.
loc.CHI_ROCN_desc: With its tradition stemming all the way back to the Qing, the Central Navy realigned with the Kuomintang after the Northern Expedition now will allow us to project our power out from the continent.
loc.CHI_chinese_economic_support_idea_desc: We are receiving economic support from [CHI.GetNameDef] to bolster our industries, but are handing over our sovereignty in return.
loc.CHI_chinese_industrial_support_idea_desc: We are receiving industrial support from [CHI.GetNameDef] to bolster our industries, but are handing over our sovereignty in return.
loc.CHI_empowered_nbis_desc: Our intelligence gathering service under the NBIS, also known as Juntong, have been given a mandate to find all enemies foreign or domestic.
loc.CHI_tongzi_jun_desc: Our youth corp will carry our nation to victory and further on into the future.
loc.CHI_baojia_desc: This devolved organisation will allow us to grow our numbers by leaving the recruitment to local group leaders, a baozhang.
loc.CHI_delivery_tt: that will be delivered every month.
loc.idea_CHI_central_government_minquan_pres: Application of the Principle of Mínquán
loc.CHI_three_princpals_idea_desc: The founder of the republic, Dr. Sun Yat-Sen, established three fundamental principles that should shape it: Minzu, Minquan and Minsheng - Nationalism, Democracy and Social Welfare. We should endeavor to enact the principles within our government.
loc.CHI_three_princpals_reorganized_idea: The Three Principles of the State
loc.CHI_three_princpals_reorganized_idea_des: The founder of the Republic, Dr. Sun Yat-Sen, established three fundamental principles that should shape it: Minzu, Minquan and Minsheng - Nationalism, Democracy and Social Welfare. Though not entirely in line with our approach to Tridemism, we should nevertheless endeavor to use these to our advantage.
loc.CHI_american_reconstruction_support: Sino-American Joint Commission on Rural Reconstruction
loc.idea_CHI_central_government_integration_: The Central Government is pressuring our leadership to fully integrate into its hierarchy, effectively surrendering all governing authority.
loc.idea_CHI_cult_of_shek_desc: Even in death Chiang Kai-Sheks influence reverberates throughout the high-stratum of the Chinese administration, standing as a beacon of resistance and defiance in the face of foreign aggression.
loc.idea_CHI_our_place_desc: Our membership in [ROOT.GetFactionName] strengthens us, but we should strive for leadership. It is simply our right.
loc.CHI_whampoa_military_academy_spirit_desc: The Kuomintang's Whampoa Military Academy holds the power over new recruits and promotions within the army. Though not entirely inefficient, it does contain a large amount of institutionalized corruption.
loc.CHI_the_political_tutelage_dm_desc: The time has come to implement the ideas of Sun Yat Sen to their fullest extent, increasing the literacy of the Chinese people and awakening their political consciousnesses, allowing for the creation and survival of a Republic on our soil.
loc.CHI_saco_desc: The Sino-American Cooperative Organization is a joint group centered around intelligence sharing where we can learn from each other.
loc.CHI_women_in_the_war_effort_idea_desc: Modernity isn’t only the purview of men and the women of our nation have risen up and taken their rightful place in the armed forces and their own battalions
loc.CHI_chinese_womens_national_war_relief_s: Chinese Women's National War Relief Society
A nation is only as strong as its weakest link and so the society aims to strengthen it.
loc.CHI_republican_agitation_tt: §RA civil war will break out if §YDemocratic§! support goes above 40%!§!
loc.CHI_liberated_by_democratic_china_desc: Our country has finally earned its rightful independence from the colonizers. With the help of [CHI.GetNameDef] we are once again a free country. With their actions so clearly helping us, the communist ideas they preach are starting to take root within our people.
loc.CHI_shanghai_international_settlement_de: Foreign powers have asserted their control through treaties making Shanghai an open door.
loc.PHI_defense_strategy_dynamic_modifier_de: Being a series of islands, the Philippines are naturally quite defensible. This is not to say we shouldn't add additional obstacles for any invader to overcome.
loc.PHI_the_great_depression_dynamic_modifie: The Great Depression has hit the United States hard, and being a subject of theirs we were not spared from its financial destruction.
loc.PHI_ruling_ideology_ideology_drift_tt: Any ideology drift will align with the ruling party
loc.PHI_shaken_economy_dynamic_modifier_desc: The effects of the Great Depression still reverberate throughout our nation, and the economy remains shaken and vulnerable to shocks. Not all is bad though, there are the faintest glimmers of a recovery on the horizon.
loc.PHI_recovering_economy_dynamic_modifier_: Our economy has started to rebound from the previous financial misfortunes, and investment has begun again in earnest. While real growth has yet to be seen, we are at least roughly back to where we were before the Great Depression struck.
loc.PHI_economic_growth_dynamic_modifier_des: We're at last starting to see real economic growth, as small businesses and an entrepreneurial spirit have taken hold, leading the nation towards fiscal prosperity.
loc.PHI_replace_economic_dynamic_modifier_tt: Replace §Y$PHI_recovering_economy_dynamic_modifier$§! with §Y$PHI_economic_growth_dynamic_modifier$§!\nEffective change:\nJoin faction tension limit: §G-[?PHI_the_great_depression_join_faction_tension|%0]§!
loc.PHI_pearl_of_the_orient_dynamic_modifier: Our economy is absolutely booming, now unfettered by a colonial overlord we are free to make our own decisions and stand testament to the economic prosperity possible here in South East Asia.
loc.PHI_philippine_army_dynamic_modifier_des: The land-borne forces of the Philippines, primarily responsible for defending our home-islands. Initially formed of a number of scout units, the forces under their control continues to grow.
loc.PHI_philippine_army_air_corps_dynamic_mo: Although a very new force in the Philippines military, the desire to dominate the skies is not dimmed because of it.
loc.PHI_american_interference_dynamic_modifi: A foreign power holds significant sway over our nation, and if we ever wish to truly feel our independence then this overbearing control they maintain over us must be broken.
loc.PHI_island_nation_dynamic_modifier_desc: The Philippines are a nation of islands, and as such our people have developed a natural affinity to the sea.
loc.PHI_asian_trade_connections_dynamic_modi: Trade has been a corner stone of the Philippine economy for centuries, and we should not be shy about reaping its rewards.
loc.PHI_preemptive_strikes_dynamic_modifier_: There is only one way to ensure we are not invaded- to invade everyone else first!
loc.PHI_unified_naval_command_desc: The War Plans of [USA.GetNameDef] have under [PHI.GetAdjective] initiative been used as the basis for coordination between the navies of the [ROOT.GetFactionName].
loc.considered_as_extremist_for_war_economy_: §Y[ROOT.GetNameDefCap]§! will have the same lessened restrictions on §Y$war_economy$§! as §YFascist§!/§YCommunist§! regimes
loc.considered_as_extremist_for_manpower_law: §Y[ROOT.GetNameDefCap]§! will have the same lessened restrictions on §Y$extensive_conscription$§! and §Y$service_by_requirement$§! as §YFascist§!/§YCommunist§! regimes
loc.PHI_san_miguel_improved_tt: Effects from §Y$PHI_san_miguel_company$ Industrial Concern§! are improved
loc.PHI_south_seas_development_company_tt: §Y$PHI_south_seas_development_company$§!, which grants:\nIndustrial Research Speed: §G+20%§!\nConsumer Goods Factories factor: §Y-5.0%§!
loc.PHI_benguet_corporation_improved_tt: Effects from §Y$PHI_benguet_corporation$ Industrial Concern§! are improved
loc.PHI_marsman_and_company_improved_tt: Effects from §Y$PHI_marsman_and_company$ Industrial Concern§! are improved
loc.PHI_japan_aligned_ideology_tt: Align with Japan's current ruling party
loc.PHI_clock_tt: The sped up focuses are indicated with the small clock icon.
loc.PHI_reduce_national_defense_act_cost_tt: Taking focuses down the §YAlign USA§! or §YAlign Japan§! paths will reduce the time this focus takes down to a minimum of 35 days.
