loc.SIK_battle_for_sinkiang_desc: With the Military Governor in the north and the New 36th Division in the south, the Sinkiang province has been facing further and further escalation. If the states currently in this fight are to turn their gaze towards another conflict, they must first finish their own.
loc.KHM_unrest_desc: The population in the province is actively up in arms against our rule, and are resisting heavily. This may prove detrimental to us if we do not deal with it in rapid order.
loc.MAN_illegitimate_government_desc: In the eyes of the west, and especially in China, we are still regarded as a rogue state led by bandits and rebels. We should seek to legitimize ourselves in order to better work with them.
loc.MAN_the_legitimate_successor_desc: With the entirety of China under our control we can finally call ourselves the legitimate successors of the Chinese Republic
loc.MAN_korean_liberation_army_desc: Having organized together with the bandits, the Korean Liberation Army have now decided to aid us with their knowledge and expertise in defeating the Japanese.
loc.SIC_a_loose_unity_desc: While nominally being united under the banner of the "Sichuan Clique", there are several different rulers in our province that have their own goals and ambitions. Some, like Liu Wenhui have even created their own little realm that's functionally separate from the rest of the province, while others have their own ideas about how the army should be handled.
loc.GXC_uneasy_minds_idea_desc: Both the local population and the leadership of this province are uneasy about the Low-Key approach towards the Japanese showcased by the Central Government. If nothing is done soon to press the issue and ease the minds of the people, more problems are sure to arise.
loc.SIK_state_atheism_freedom_of_religion: State Atheism - Individual Freedom of Religion
loc.SIK_if_war_with_sov_this_disappears_tt: §RWill be removed if we end up at war with [SOV.GetNameDef]§!
loc.YUN_will_be_removed_if_no_long_yun_tt: §RWill be removed if we no longer have $YUN_long_yun$ as our country leader§!
loc.CHI_warlord_looting_idea_desc: Due to a lack of morale and overarching control over all of our military forces, looting of local produce is commonplace. We must put an end to this if we wish to create a stable province.
loc.CHI_ma_clique_collective_desc: Being a part of a larger whole, the warlord in this region shares a close bond and cooperates with their fellow kinsmen of the northwest.
loc.SIK_state_autonomous_prefecture_desc: Ruled by local leaders, government overreach is lessened in this prefecture, and in the case of war these leaders may not prove to be entirely loyal.
loc.PRC_the_yulin_garrison_desc: Despite our best efforts to stomp them out, the 86th and 84th Divisions under Jing Yueixu and Gao Guizi have managed to fend off our attacks and have effectively kept the north under Kuomintang control. Getting rid of them won't be easy however, as their positions are very fortified.
loc.living_off_the_land_army_spirit_desc: It is good to destroy the enemy with your own weapons, but even better to destroy him with his own weapons.
loc.rapid_emplacement_army_spirit_desc: All the firepower in the world doesn't mean anything when it's in the wrong place.
loc.direct_fire_support_army_spirit_desc: Crank it down to zero elevation and engage the enemy over open sights!
loc.subsidized_contracts_army_spirit_desc: While replacing the horse with the tank is desirable in the long term, it cannot be done at the cost of national economic ruin.
loc.all_arms_at_defense_army_spirit_desc: Armored breakthroughs can happen at any time, anywhere. The God of War helps those who help themselves.
loc.spirit_of_defiance_army_spirit_desc: A people cannot be conquered until they admit they are conquered.
loc.proxy_wars_army_spirit_desc: The enemy of my enemy is my friend.
loc.naval_tripwire_navy_spirit_desc: We may not fully stop the enemy from approaching our coasts, but we can make it bloody and expensive for him.
loc.ship_to_shore_navy_spirit_desc: No land-based artillery can hope to match the firepower tens of thousands of tons of navy steel can bring to the dance.
loc.scouting_force_navy_spirit_desc: The sea is vast. Victory in battle usually goes to the side who detects and decisively strikes the other first.
loc.fleet_defense_navy_spirit_desc: Combat air patrol and light ships exist to allow our heavy hitters to do their jobs without being rudely interrupted.
loc.fleet_interoperability_navy_spirit_desc: Rapid logistical replenishment and efficient damage control don't win battles on their own, but they keep the guns of victory firing.
loc.rapid_concentration_navy_spirit_desc: Converge swiftly on the foe like a swarm of locusts, firing every weapon at your disposal: the quickest path to victory.
loc.aa_curtain_navy_spirit_desc: Like an ancient shield wall, every ship in a battle fleet is not only responsible for its own defense, but to aid its neighbor.
loc.stay_at_your_posts_navy_spirit_desc: As long as one prop is turning and one gun remains above the waterline, we are still in the fight.
loc.selective_engagement_navy_spirit_desc: A fool stands still in front of a superior enemy and allows themselves to be destroyed. Decline fights you cannot win.
loc.sea_lane_denial_navy_spirit_desc: Nothing eats a sea urchin, for good reason.
loc.underdog_mentality_navy_spirit_desc: If at first you don't succeed, torpedo again.
loc.cult_of_heroism_army_spirit_desc: Throughout history to the modern day, soldiers and citizens alike honor the sacrifices of their comrades.
loc.operation_SIA_sabotage_indochina_ports_d: Slip demolition teams into the great harbours of French Indochina and pre-place charges on the wharves, cranes and fuel stores. They lie dormant until the day we march, and then the ports go up in a single stroke, before the enemy fleet can scatter to them.
loc.operation_SIA_sabotage_indochina_ports_p: §YIf successful:§! Plants hidden charges on the Indochinese ports (§YAnnam§!, §YTonkin§! and §YCambodia§!). The charges detonate the moment we go to war with their holder, fully destroying each naval base.
loc.operation_SIA_sabotage_indochina_ports_f: §RThe operation failed:§! our teams were unable to place the charges.
loc.SIA_plant_indochina_port_charges_tt: Hidden demolition charges are placed on the §YIndochinese ports§!; they detonate when we go to war with their holder.
loc.INS_dewa_geg: Ida I Dewa Agung Gde Oka Geg
loc.SIA_recover_downed_airmen_desc: Our underground will shelter and spirit away Allied fliers brought down over Thai soil.
loc.SIA_establish_mountain_weather_posts_des: Hidden posts in the highlands will radio the weather reports that Allied air forces sorely need.
loc.SIA_smuggle_radio_sets: Smuggle Radio Sets to the Interior
loc.SIA_smuggle_radio_sets_desc: A quiet web of radio sets will keep the resistance and its foreign friends in contact.
loc.HOL_recall_conrad_helfrich: Recall Conrad Helfrich From the Indies
loc.HOL_recall_conrad_helfrich_desc: In these pressing times, we must prioritize the homeland above all else. Conrad Helfrich, as the Royal Dutch Navy's best Admiral, must return to the Netherlands.
loc.INS_is_taking_volksraad: Is currently passing a law in the Volksraad
loc.INS_volksraad_cat_desc: The People’s Council, known in Dutch as the Volksraad, was established in 1918 as an attempt to bring democracy to the East Indies, as part of the implementation of the so-called “Ethical Policies”. The seats are filled by both Dutch and Indonesian officials, selected through various means. While the Netherlands maintains an unconditional veto right, the Volksraad can pass motions and bills to the government.
loc.INS_volksraad_allow_language_in_schools: Allow the Indonesian Language in Schools
loc.INS_volksraad_allow_language_in_schools_: Access to higher education in the indies is largely limited to the Dutch and wealthy classes of Indonesians who speak Dutch, as it is the only language higher education is taught in. An ongoing motion in the Volksraad to open Indonesian-language schools is awaiting a vote from the Governor General.
loc.INS_volksraad_allow_language_in_governme: Allow the Indonesian Language in Government

Governmental roles in the Indies, including the Volksraad all require fluency in the Dutch language, which has led to many members of the Volksraad, especially representatives of native communities, to question the validity of its democracy. They have put together a motion which insists that government positions should be able to be filled by Indonesian speakers when possible.
loc.INS_volksraad_remove_education_quotas_de: The education system in the East Indies currently operates using education quotas, where a certain number of Indonesian students must be accepted, and a certain number of Dutch students must be accepted. This has been controversial in the Volksraad due to the common belief that it is skewed unfairly toward the Dutch favor. While we could let the Volksraad continue arguing for years over how to reform the system, it may be worth abolishing the quota system all-together.
loc.INS_volksraad_reduce_rubber_export_tax_d: There is currently an extremely high tax on private companies exporting rubber, allowing us to maintain a monopoly over the market. However, this has resulted in economic stagnation in some regions due to private plantations being unable to operate. This was deemed worthwhile at the time of implementation, but international protectionism from the Great Depression has left our rubber export economy far less lucrative. It may be worth reducing the tax in order to stimulate the economy.
loc.INS_volksraad_knil_rank_limit: Pass Anti-Discrimination Laws for Military Ranks
loc.INS_volksraad_knil_rank_limit_desc: While there is no formal rule stopping Indonesian natives from rising the ranks of the KNIL, there is an unwritten rule forbidding this, limiting even the most well-performing of military personnel unable to progress beyond Colonel status. Several parties in the Volksraad have been pressuring the government to recognize the efforts of high performing Indonesian officers.
loc.INS_volksraad_legalize_displaying_flag: Legalize the Display of the Red/White Flag
loc.INS_volksraad_legalize_displaying_flag_d: The red and white flag of “Indonesia” is currently illegal to display in public due to its connections to nationalist, anti-colonial organizations. Legalizing its display would likely be a demonstration of our willingness to cooperate, and stop the ongoing radicalization of nationalists across the archipelago.
loc.INS_volksraad_education_subsidies_for_in: Open Education Subsidies for Non-Dutch Residents

There has been an ongoing debate within the Volksraad regarding the subsidies and scholarships given to Dutch students in the East Indies. Several representatives of native communities in the Volksraad have argued that this system should be expanded to any student, regardless of background. This would buy us a lot of good-will with the population, though it would not be cheap.
loc.INS_volksraad_indonesian_national_langua: Make Indonesian an official National Language

The Indonesian language has grown to become a common language in many parts of the archipelago, bridging language gaps between several cultures. With the Indonesian language now being permitted within education and government roles, many Volksraad representatives have been petitioning for its legal recognition as an official language of the colony, sharing equal status with Dutch.
loc.indonesia_volksraad_official_flag_effect: Our flag will be changed to the Red/White flag.
loc.INS_volksraad_official_flag_desc: The motions in the Volksraad pushing for autonomy have ultimately succeeded, and what was called the Dutch East Indies only a few years ago is now the Dominion of Indonesia. Our flag should be adjusted to represent these changes.
loc.indonesia_volksraad_passed_6: Has passed anti-discrimination laws in the military
loc.INS_autonomy_knil_rank_limit: Anti-Discrimination Laws Passed in the Military
loc.INS_autonomy_flag_legalized: Display of the Red/White Flag Legalized
loc.INS_soetardjo_petition_desc: The round table conference Soetardjo called for has been held, concluding that [INS.GetNameDef] must meet a series of economic requirements to ensure self-sufficiency. We must demonstrate clear progress towards these goals, or else [HOL.GetNameDef] will eventually overrule the decision in order to maintain the status quo.
loc.INS_soetardjo_petition_refresh_tt: Reactivates Mission: §YSoetardjo Petition Pending Approval§! with a duration of §Y120 days§!.
loc.INS_soetardjo_pending: Volksraad Debating Soetardjo's Petition for Autonomy
loc.INS_soetardjo_pending_desc: Soetardjo is a Volksraad member who is known for leading the peaceful nationalist movement. He is currently organizing a petition requesting that [INS.GetNameDef] be given more autonomy, and for a round table conference to be organized between Dutch and Indonesian representatives, in order to discuss the desire of Indonesians to become autonomous as part of a Dutch commonwealth. This petition is currently being debated within the Volksraad. Once these debates conclude, we must decide how to respond, as the petition's consequences are of great significance.
loc.INS_flag_legalized: Red/White Flag is legal to display
loc.INS_win_condition_base_republic_warning_: We must continue to fight, recruit civilians, and ensure the fire within every Indonesian soul continues to burn. Once we topple the Indies administration, [HOL.GetNameDef] will have no choice but to surrender.
loc.INS_win_condition_base_republic_real_des: We must continue to fight, recruit civilians, and ensure the fire within every Indonesian soul continues to burn. Once we topple the Indies administration, [HOL.GetNameDef] will have no choice but to surrender.
loc.will_complete_when_conditions_met_tt: This will automatically be selected once the prerequisites are met.
loc.INS_militias_basic_summon_desc: We will recruit young adults and students that are passionate for Indonesian independence to join the TKR as armed militias.
loc.INS_militias_kris_repayment: KRIS Militias Demand Investment in Sulawesi
loc.INS_revolution_planning_hq_desc: We will establish our militia headquarters in [FROM.GetName], which will operate as our central command for militia bases across the archipelago. Our headquarters and its surrounding territory will be prioritized in infiltration missions and will be firmly within our control.
loc.INS_revolution_planning_hq_tt: Has built at most §Y3§! revolutionary headquarters
loc.INS_revolution_planning_hq_DONE_desc: This is our revolutionary headquarters, where our militias report to. This state will be under our control once we declare independence.
loc.INS_revolution_planning_envoy_DONE_trigg: Cannot establish multiple bases in the same state
loc.INS_revolution_planning_influence_state_: We will send militias to [FROM.GetName] to establish a militia base, ensuring local revolutionaries are able to communicate with HQ and have an easier time executing operations once we declare independence.
loc.INS_revolution_planning_cat_map_name: Select where to manage militia activity
loc.INS_state_revolution_hq_tt: State will be controlled by us once we declare independence
loc.INS_hq_warning: §W§RPutting our headquarters here is difficult and will exert most of our resources.§!§!
loc.INS_revolution_points_remaining_tt: Can build at least §Y1§! more militia base (currently §Y[?INS_revolution_points_remaining]§! remaining)
loc.INS_revolution_planning_influence_state_: We will be able to establish a militia base in §Y[?INS_starting_revolution_points_count]§! additional §Rnon-java§! states.
We will only be able to establish a militia base in §Y1§! additional §Rnon-java§! state.
loc.INS_revolution_point_spend_tt: A militia base is established in [FROM.GetName]
loc.INS_revolution_points_in_state_tt: [FROM.GetName] does not already have a militia base
loc.INS_no_raids_allowed_tt: §W§RRaids will be unavailable while this decision is active.§!§!
loc.INS_is_deescalating_tt: Is not already doing a deescalation mission
loc.INS_escalate_the_conflict_desc: We will organize riots and skirmishes with the enemy forces in order to raise tension and escalation, laying the groundwork to ensure more severe operations later face less international scrutiny.
loc.INS_deescalate_the_conflict_desc: The Dutch will not negotiate with us in good faith. To them we remain rebels, an inconvenience to be suppressed rather than a nation to be reckoned with. But the great powers of the world are another matter, and The Hague cannot dismiss them so easily. We will appeal to the international community to mediate, and let foreign pressure compel what our own voice cannot.
loc.INS_deescalate_the_conflict_2_desc: Our raids have done their work. The colonial garrison knows our reach, and The Hague knows we are not cowed. Yet each strike gives the Netherlands fresh cause to send more men and more ships, and we are not ready for open war. Word will go to our commanders to hold their fire. The next blow falls when we say so, not when the Dutch goad us into it.
loc.INS_renville_tt_HOL: §W§Y[USA.GetFlag][USA.GetNameDefCap]§! will give us an ultimatum. If we do not surrender and withdraw from Indonesia, they will §Rdeclare war§! on us.§!
loc.INS_renville_wont_happen_neutral_tt: The conflict will end before American negotiations conclude, they will be unable to intervene.
loc.INS_renville_explain_USA_tt: If the conflict has not resolved in §Y365 days§!:\n\n
loc.indonesia_reduce_escalation_1_effect_too: Reduces escalation by §G1§!, to a minimum of §Y4§!.
loc.INS_ongoing_influence_process: Is not already establishing a militia base
loc.INS_current_revolution_strength_3_tt: This state currently has §GHigh§! militia activity.
loc.INS_current_revolution_strength_0_tt: This state currently has no militia activity.
loc.INS_national_revolution_cat_desc: After 350 years of Dutch tyranny, we have taken matters into our own hands and declared independence. The Netherlands does not recognize our authority, still continuing to govern the Indies as their colony while treating us as criminals.\n\nWe must continue to take control over more regions and important cities and topple the Dutch government from within. However, we should be careful to not be too aggressive without careful planning, as rapid escalation from us might provoke Dutch military action.
loc.INS_national_revolution_dutch_cat_desc: Revolutionaries in the East Indies have illegally declared independence, and have taken control over regions of the Indies with militia forces. Despite our best efforts, we have been unable to reestablish control in these regions due to the sheer number of militia forces present.\n\nWe need to stop them before they take control over more cities and destabilize the Indies administration further. While extreme, military force may be necessary if they continue to act like this.
loc.INS_HOL_revolution_not_going_well_tt: §RWithout Batavia we cannot govern the Indies, and we will have no choice but to negotiate a peace agreement with the revolutionaries.§!
loc.INS_gradual_escalation_republic_desc: Dutch reprisals have grown heavier after each of our raids, and their patrols press into districts they had abandoned months ago. Our commanders report harder fighting in places long thought settled, and our casualties mount faster than the recruiters can replace them. The conflict has spread into provinces that were quiet last year.
loc.INS_gradual_escalation_HOL_desc: The reports from our residencies worsen by the week. The rebels strike in districts where they were not thought to operate, and the military command in Batavia presses for measures heavier than any tried before. In The Hague, those who once counselled patience grow fewer at every cabinet meeting.
loc.INS_national_revolution_republic_win_ins: [INS.GetAdjective] Republican Militias will assert §Gde-facto control§! over the region, and the conflict will end in a §GRepublican Victory§!.
loc.INS_national_revolution_republic_win_hol: [INS.GetAdjective] Republican Militias will assert §Rde-facto control§! over the region, and the conflict will end in a §RRepublican Victory§!.
loc.INS_take_batavia_desc: The Dutch greed that caused them to invest almost exclusively in Java, ignoring the eastern islands has left Java as the Achilles' heel of the entire colony. This will be their downfall! We must storm our forces into Java and destroy Dutch communications and supply networks, making the Indies administration unable to operate.
loc.INS_hold_batavia_HOL_desc: The Republican forces have begun an operation to relocate most of their forces into Java, attempting to take control over the entire island. We must continue to resist, their operation is risky, and has given us an opportunity to topple their government if they fail.
loc.INS_militias_moestopo_mission: Moestopo demands promotion for his efforts
loc.INS_instigate_in_country_desc: Our revolution did not end when the last colonial soldier was driven from [ROOT.GetAdjective] soil. The workers and peasants of [FROM.GetName] suffer under the same yoke we have cast off, and they look to us now as proof that the oppressor can be beaten. We shall send our agitators among them, distribute pamphlets, fund their unions, and fan the flames of discontent until the conditions for revolution are ripe.
loc.INS_launch_revolution_desc: The conditions in [FROM.GetName] are ripe. Our agents report growing unrest in the factories and fields, and the local party cells are prepared to act. The time has come to call the workers and peasants of [FROM.GetName] to rise and seize what is rightfully theirs.
loc.INS_anti_colonialist_bonus_desc: The people of [FROM.GetName] toil for the benefit of a foreign master, made to serve interests not their own. We shall remind them that submission is a choice, and that their masters are not as strong as they pretend to be.
loc.INS_revolutionary_sentiment_desc: There are those within [FROM.GetName] who have already taken up the cause on their own. They lack organization and resources, but not conviction. By coordinating with these groups we can hasten the collapse of the existing order, even if the resulting instability makes the country harder to govern in the short term.
loc.INS_arm_militias_desc: Pamphlets and speeches will carry the revolution only so far. When the moment comes, our comrades in [FROM.GetName] must be able to fight. Surplus arms and supplies are to be smuggled to sympathetic militias so that the forces of reaction will face an armed populace, not a defenceless one.
loc.INS_arm_militias_tt: If a civil war starts, the Communists will start with additional divisions.
loc.INS_propoganda_mission_desc: Party organisers are to be dispatched throughout [FROM.GetName] to establish reading circles, recruit among the trade unions, and bring the message of revolution to the villages. The seeds we plant today will bear fruit soon enough.
loc.INS_abandon_mission_desc: Our resources are not limitless, and the struggle in [FROM.GetNameDef] demands more than we can presently afford to give. We shall withdraw our agents and redirect our efforts where they are needed most.
loc.INS_can_raid_here_HOL_tt:
This state is a potential target of a militia land raid by the Republic. If successful, the state will be taken from us. In order to defend the state from raids, we can:

loc.INS_war_escalation_level_tt: §YCurrent Escalation§!\n\nEscalation Level increases over time, and also by Militias §Yoccupying new states§!, and [HOL.GetNameDef] taking actions to combat militia activity. If the situation escalates enough, it can turn into §Rtotal warfare§!.

loc.INS_war_escalation_3_tt: §Y[HOL.GetName]§!: Unlocks focuses to request British or French involvement
loc.INS_war_escalation_4_tt: §Y[HOL.GetName]§!: Unlocks decision to declare war (with heavy penalties due to international pushback)\n§Y[INS.GetName]§!: Unlocks decision to request international mediation to deescalate
loc.INS_war_escalation_7_tt: §Y[HOL.GetName]§!: Decision to declare war no longer gives penalties\n§Y[INS.GetName]§!: Unlocks focus to declare war
loc.INS_war_escalation_8_tt: §Y[INS.GetName]§!: Unlocks focus to launch infiltration campaign in Java. §RThis can lead to an early Indonesian victory.§!\n§Y[INS.GetName]§!: Failed Attempt on Sukarno's Life
loc.INS_start_limited_war_malaya: Start a Limited War in Malaya
loc.INS_start_limited_war_borneo: Start a Limited War in North Borneo
loc.INS_release_puppet_sarawak_desc: Release §YSarawak§! as an integrated member of the Indonesian Union.
loc.INS_release_puppet_brunei_desc: Release §YBrunei§! as an integrated member of the Indonesian Union.
loc.INS_release_puppet_sabah_desc: Release §YSabah§! as an integrated member of the Indonesian Union.
loc.INS_revolution_penalty_reduce_tt: §YWe will not get penalties if this decision is taken at escalation 7§!.
loc.INS_revolution_penalty_reduce_tt_2: §RPenalties will be removed if we wait until escalation §Y8§!§!.
loc.INS_mil_factory_cost_tt: Increases cost of East Indies Exile Government decisions by £pol_power §Y25§!.
loc.INS_revolution_war_HOL_desc: These rebels have gone on long enough. Far too much money and military resources have gone toward thwarting the militia operations, and yet they continue to expand. We cannot wait any longer, total war is the only way forward.
loc.INS_national_revolution_republic_sukarno: Sukarno recently survived an assassination attempt, and it is clear another one will happen if order is not restored.
loc.INS_unity_in_diversity_explain_tt: Allows you to §Gcore§! any Indonesian princely state which has received industrial investment.

loc.INS_rubber_for_mil: Sell Rubber to Pay For Military Industrial Expansions

loc.INS_oil_for_civ: Sell Oil to Subsidize Civilian Industry
loc.INS_oil_for_mil: Sell Oil to Pay For Military Industrial Expansions
loc.INS_oil_for_plane: Sell Oil to American Plane Companies
loc.INS_launch_feint_uprising_desc: We will use our local connections to arm the people and send them out to stir up trouble, thereby drawing military attention. Their doomed uprising will be a heroic sacrifice for the cause.
loc.INS_feint_uprising_tt: Nearby KNIL and Dutch units will deploy to this state to suppress the local unrest, leaving neighboring states temporarily undefended.
loc.INS_reorganize_freedom_fighter_militia_1: Adds §Y2 $militia$ battalions§! to the §YFreedom Fighters§! Template.
loc.INS_reorganize_freedom_fighter_militia_2: Adds §Y3 $militia$ battalions§! to the §YFreedom Fighters§! Template.

loc.INS_has_changed_leader: Election has been held less than 120 days ago
loc.INSHOL_democratic_elections_tt: §YVolksraad§! becomes the ruling party.\nUnlocks §YDemocratic Elections§! decisions to switch out the current country leader.
loc.INSHOL_nationalist_coallition_tt: §Y$INS_sutan_sjahrir$§! and §Y$INS_mohammad_hatta$§! will be available as country leaders after completing §Y$INSHOL_democracy$§!.
loc.INSHOL_princely_authority_tt: Princely leaders will be available as options for §YDemocratic Elections§!.
loc.INS_will_keep_characters_tt: We will keep §Yall§! Dutch characters in the event of independence.
loc.INS_will_not_keep_characters_tt: We will keep §Ysome§! Dutch characters in the event of independence.
loc.INS_request_membership_tt: They are more likely to accept if we share §YIdeology§!
loc.SIA_war_fervor_cat_desc: The people's appetite for conflict must be carefully managed. Left unchecked, war fervor will turn inward — a government that stirs martial spirit without directing it risks becoming its next target.
loc.SIA_war_fervor_coup_dummy_desc: If the people's appetite for war boils over without an outlet it will inevitably be redirected at us.
loc.SIA_mandate_1_desc: The country, people and nationality are to be called Thai
loc.SIA_mandate_2_desc:
Thai people must not engage in any business without considering the benefit and safety of the nation

Thai people must never reveal anything to foreigners that might damage the nation. These actions are a betrayal of the nation

Thai people must not act as agent or spokesman for foreigners without considering the benefit of the Thai nation, and must not express opinion or take the side of foreigners in international disputes. These actions are a betrayal of the nation.

Thai people must not secretly purchase land on behalf of foreigners in a way that endangers the nation. These actions are a betrayal of the nation.

 When a person has betrayed the nation, it is the duty of Thai people to actively and quickly put a stop to it.
loc.SIA_mandate_3_desc: Cease referring to Thai people inconsistently with the name of the nationality, or according to the preference of the group.\n\nUse the name 'Thai' to refer to all Thai people, without subdividing them.
loc.SIA_mandate_4_desc:
When seeing the national flag raised or lowered according to government custom, or hearing the sound of the salute bugle or whistle, or when the signal is given to raise or lower the flag, honor the flag according to regulation or custom.

When the national anthem is heard, whether played for official purposes or as part of any kind of ceremony, participants or attendees will honor the anthem according to regulation or custom.

When observing any person not paying proper respect as admonish them so as to see the importance of honoring the national flag, national anthem, and royal anthem.
loc.SIA_mandate_5_desc:
Thai people should make an effort to consume only food made from Thai products.

Thai people should make an effort to wear only clothes made from Thai products.

Thai people should support the agricultural, commercial, industrial, and other vocational efforts of fellow Thais.

Thai people should use and support any public utility established by the government or by Thai people.

Thai people practising agriculture, commerce, industry, or other vocation supported by this mandate must make an effort to maintain standards, improve quality, and run their business honestly.
loc.SIA_mandate_6_desc: The music of the national anthem will be that written by Phra Chenduriyang, and on file at the Fine Arts Department\n\nThe lyrics of the national anthem will be those submitted by the army
loc.SIA_mandate_7_desc: Every Thai person must help build the nation. Every able bodied person must work at a stable career. Any person without a career is unhelpful to the nation and is not deserving of respect from the Thai people.
loc.SIA_mandate_8_desc: On the royal anthem, we shall shorten the lyrics of the royal anthem, and replaced the word Siam with the word Thai
loc.SIA_mandate_9_desc:
Thai people must extol, honor and respect the Thai language, and must feel honored to speak it.

Thai people must consider it the duty of a good citizen to study the national language, and must at least be able to read and write; Thai people must also consider it their important duty to assist and support citizens who do not speak Thai or cannot read Thai to learn it.

Thai people must not consider place of birth, residence, or regional accent as a marker of division. Everyone must hold it to be true that all born as Thai people have the same Thai blood and speak the same Thai language. Place of birth or accent makes no difference.

Thai people must consider it their duty to conduct themselves as good Thai citizens should, and to urge and instruct those who do not yet know and understand their duty as to the duties of a good citizen of the Thai nation.
loc.SIA_mandate_10_desc: Thai people should not appear at public gatherings, in public places, or in city limits without being appropriately dressed. Inappropriate dress includes wearing only underpants, wearing no shirt, or wearing a wraparound cloth.\n\nAppropriate dress for Thai people consists of: Uniforms, as position and opportunity permits; Polite international style attire; Polite traditional attire.
loc.SIA_mandate_11_desc:
Thai people should divide their time into three portions. One for work, one for personal activities, and one for rest and sleeping. This should be orderly and follow a schedule until it becomes habitual.

Thai people should carry out their normal personal activities as follows: Eat meals at set times, no more than four daily; Sleep approximately 68 hours.

Thai people should faithfully perform work duties without discouragement or shirking. The midday rest and lunch period should be no longer than one hour. At the end of the working day, exercise by playing sports for at least one hour, or other activities such as gardening, caring for pets, or planting trees. Then, after showering, eat dinner.

Thai people should use their free time at night to complete necessary work, converse with family and friends, seek knowledge by listening to radio news or reading, or other entertainment or arts, as opportunity permits
loc.SIA_mandate_12_desc: In public places or roads, people should assist and protect children, the elderly, or the handicapped.\n\nWhoever follows item 1 is considered a cultured person deserving of the respect of the Thai people.
loc.SIA_movie_theater_cat_desc: The silver screen is among the most powerful tools of the modern state. Through carefully chosen films and propaganda campaigns, the government can shape public opinion, stoke patriotism, and drown out dissenting voices.
loc.SIA_the_revolution_of_24th_june: The Revolution of the 24th of June
loc.SIA_limited_war_cat_desc: We cannot hope to overcome the great powers of the region in open war — not yet. By pressing our claims piece by piece, through carefully scoped campaigns, we chip away at their position while our own strength continues to grow.
loc.SIA_start_limited_war_indochina: Start a Limited War in Indochina against [FROM.GetName]
loc.SIA_start_limited_war_indochina_tt_main:
Starts a §YLimited War§! against §Y[FROM.GetName]§!.
By controlling all highlighted states belonging to §Y[FROM.GetName]§!, we will be able to take these states without escalating to a full scale war.
§RLosing more than [?var:global.limited_war_surrender_threshold|%.0] surrender progress will lose us the limited war§!

§RLosing the limited war might cause us to have to return previously conquered territories§!
loc.SIA_start_limited_war_rejoin_faction: We will temporarily leave our current faction, and rejoin the faction upon the §YLimited Wars§! end.
loc.SIA_start_limited_war_can_join_faction: We will be able to join factions again after the end of the §YLimited War§!
loc.is_not_engaged_in_a_limited_war: Is not engaged in a §YLimited War§!
loc.SIA_limited_war_indochina_desc: Take control of all highlighted states to win the §YLimited War§! and claim them without escalating to a full scale war.\n§RLosing more than [?var:global.limited_war_surrender_threshold|%.0] surrender progress will lose us the limited war§!
loc.SIA_new_territories_administration_cat_d: Conquest is only the beginning. The territories we have taken must be administered, developed, and defended if they are to become a lasting part of the nation rather than a liability that invites reconquest.
loc.SIA_finish_the_triangular_defense_networ: With the two fortresses in the North and South finished, we can combine them with Bangkok to create a triangular defense network. Should one fall the others will still remain operational.
loc.SIA_use_abandoned_french_tools_desc: The French left behind some of their heavy tools in our occupied territories. We can use them for ourselves.
loc.SIA_fortress_saigon_desc: The North of our new Empire shall be protected by Hanoi. With mountains to its North and the Red River in front it lies perfectly situated to hold off any invaders.
loc.SIA_fortress_hanoi_desc: The South Empire shall be protected by Saigon. This fortress city will stand as a guardian for Bangkok, protecting the gulf of [ROOT.GetName] from invaders.
loc.SIA_propaganda_poster_slot_available_tt: Has an empty movie poster slot.
loc.SIA_propaganda_campaign_locked_slot_tt: This propaganda poster slot is currently locked. It can be unlocked by completing the following focus: TODO
loc.SIA_propaganda_campaign_empty_slot_tt: This movie poster slot is currently §Gempty§!. A new £SOV_propaganda_text_icon §YMovie Theater Campaign§! can be §Gactivated§!.
loc.SIA_propaganda_campaign_cooldown_tt: This campaign will be available again §Y[?constant:propaganda.SIA.default_propaganda_campaign_cooldown] days§! after its removal.
loc.SIA_public_credit_repayment_tt: We will repay our entire Public Credit Debt at once, removing all debt at the cost of a large temporary §YConsumer Goods§! penalty.
loc.idea_SIA_deficit_spending_desc: The government is spending beyond its means, channelling borrowed funds into an accelerated construction programme. The industrial gains are real, but the bills will come due.
loc.SIA_print_additional_money_tt: We will print even more money for Japan.
loc.SIA_implement_industrialists_reforms_cou: Build §Y2 Civilian Factories§! (Excluding factories gained from focuses and trade)
loc.SIA_appeal_to_industrialists_tt:
We will gain support from the Industrialists.

They will help us in the civil war, granting us additional equipment. However they will expect us to expand our industrial base, by building §Y2§! additional §YCivilian Factories§! from the factories we have at the end of the civil war within §Y720 day(s)§! of gaining power (Excluding factories gained from focuses or trade). 

Not doing so will incur a hit to §YStability§! and §YWar Support§!

Upon the start of the civil War we will get:
loc.SIA_seek_support_from_constitutional_mon: Seek support from the Constitutional Monarchists

We will gain support from the Constitutional Monarchists.

They will help us in the civil war, spawning additional divisions. However they will expect us to remain a constitutional Monarchy, by completing the §Y$SIA_a_constitutional_monarchy$§! focus within §Y720 day(s)§! of gaining power.

Not doing so will incur a hit to §YStability§! and §YWar Support§!
loc.SIA_appeal_to_rural_people_tt:
We will gain support from the Rural People.

They will help us in the civil war, granting militias. However they will expect us to pass beneficial agricultural policies in return, by completing either §Y$SIA_mechanization_of_agriculture$§! or §Y$SIA_reduction_of_agricultural_yield_taxes$§! focus within §Y720 day(s)§! of gaining power.

Not doing so will incur a hit to §YStability§! and §YWar Support§!

Upon the start of the civil War we will get:
loc.SIA_seek_support_from_absolutists_monarc: Seek support from the Absolutists Monarchists

We will gain support from the Absolutists Monarchists.

They will help us in the civil war, spawning additional divisions. However they will expect us to return to absolute Monarchism, by completing the §Y$SIA_an_absolute_monarchy$§! focus within §Y720 day(s)§! of gaining power.

Not doing so will incur a hit to §YStability§! and §YWar Support§!
loc.SIA_appeal_to_navy_clique_tt:
We will gain support from the Navy Clique.

They will help us in the civil war, granting us our entire navy and a marine division. However they will expect us to pass beneficial naval policies, by completing the §Y$SIA_thonburi_class_coastal_defense_ship$§! focus within §Y720 day(s)§! of gaining power.

Not doing so will incur a hit to §YStability§! and §YWar Support§!

Upon the start of the civil War we will get:
§YOur entire Navy§!
The §YRoyal Thai Marine Corps§! Marine division
The §YMarines§! technology
loc.SIA_appeal_for_support_cat_desc: No political movement succeeds alone. Monarchists, constitutionalists, soldiers and civilians each hold sway over a portion of the country. Their support must be cultivated carefully if we are to have the strength to act when the moment comes.
loc.SIA_demand_independence_VIN_tt: We will demand that the controllers of [VIN.GetName] set them free
loc.SIA_demand_independence_LAO_tt: We will demand that the controllers of [LAO.GetName] set them free
loc.SIA_demand_independence_CAM_tt: We will demand that the controllers of [CAM.GetName] set them free
loc.SIA_asian_democratic_compact_cat_desc: The peoples of Asia have the right to govern themselves. As the standard bearer of Asian self-determination, we can pressure the colonial powers to release the nations they hold.
loc.SIA_khana_ratsadon_cat_desc: The Khana Ratsadon, the People's Party that ended the absolute monarchy, is not a monolith. Its military and civilian wings each have their own vision for the country, and the tension between them runs beneath the surface of every decision. Keep both factions satisfied, or risk the coalition tearing itself apart.
loc.SIA_army_navy_reform_cat_desc: The army and navy compete for the same limited pool of resources. Shifting funds between the two branches is a constant balancing act, with each reallocation carrying consequences for the other's readiness.
loc.SIA_divert_army_funds_to_navy_toggle_do: Divert Army funds towards the Navy
loc.SIA_divert_army_funds_to_navy_toggle_do_: We shall divert some of our Army funds towards the Navy to hasten its development.
loc.SIA_divert_army_funds_to_navy_toggle_und: Stop diverting Army funds towards the Navy
We shall no longer divert some of our Army funds towards the Navy.
loc.SIA_standing_our_ground_mission_tt: We must fight for our freedom.
loc.SIA_sway_generals_to_seri_thai_tt: Generals we have swayed to the Seri Thai will join us when the civil war begins, instead of joining the loyalist revolt.
loc.SIA_sway_general_cw_scale_tt: Increases our support in the civil war by §Y5%§!\nIf support is over §Y80%§! a civil war is avoided and we seize power uncontested
loc.SIA_sway_luang_chawengsaksongkhram_to_se: Win Luang Chawengsaksongkhram over to the Seri Thai cause. If swayed, he will side with us when the civil war begins.
loc.SIA_sway_aditya_dibabha_to_seri_thai_des: Win Aditya Dibabha over to the Seri Thai cause. If swayed, he will side with us when the civil war begins.
loc.SIA_sway_mangkorn_phromyothi_to_seri_tha: Win Mangkorn Phromyothi over to the Seri Thai cause. If swayed, he will side with us when the civil war begins.
loc.SIA_sway_luang_haansongkhram_to_seri_tha: Win Luang Haansongkhram over to the Seri Thai cause. If swayed, he will side with us when the civil war begins.
loc.SIA_sway_charun_rattanakun_seriroengrit_: Win Charun Rattanakun Seriroengrit over to the Seri Thai cause. If swayed, he will side with us when the civil war begins.
loc.SIA_sway_phichit_kriangsakphichit_to_ser: Win Phichit Kriangsakphichit over to the Seri Thai cause. If swayed, he will side with us when the civil war begins.
loc.SIA_sway_jira_wichitsongkhram_to_seri_th: Win Jira Wichitsongkhram over to the Seri Thai cause. If swayed, he will side with us when the civil war begins.
loc.SIA_sway_phin_choonhavan_to_seri_thai_de: Win Phin Choonhavan over to the Seri Thai cause. If swayed, he will side with us when the civil war begins.
loc.SIA_sway_tiang_sirikhan_to_seri_thai_des: Win Tiang Sirikhan over to the Seri Thai cause. If swayed, he will side with us when the civil war begins.
loc.SIA_khana_ratsadon_dummy_military_tt: The Military will launch a coup if we antagonize them too much. To avoid a civil war we should not have §Y$idea_SIA_military_rebellious$§! for too long.
loc.SIA_khana_ratsadon_dummy_military_desc: The military is a powerful clique of the Khana Ratsadon party. They will not approve of policies that they consider to work against their interests, but approve of things they see as pro-militarization of the country.
loc.SIA_khana_ratsadon_military_coup_mission: The military is planning to oust the government!
The military sees the current government policies as a threat to their interests. They are actively planning to unseat the government should their standing not increase.
loc.SIA_khana_ratsadon_dummy_civilian_tt: The civilian wing will launch a coup if we antagonize them too much. To avoid a civil war we should not have §Y$idea_SIA_civilian_rebellious$§! for too long.
loc.SIA_khana_ratsadon_dummy_civilian_desc: The civilian wing is a powerful clique of the Khana Ratsadon party. They will not approve of policies that they consider to work against their interests, but approve of things they see as pro-democratic, pro-civilian.
loc.SIA_khana_ratsadon_civilian_coup_mission: The civilian wing is planning to oust the government!
The civilian wing sees the current government policies as a threat to their interests. They are actively planning to unseat the government should their standing not increase.
loc.SIA_promote_civilian_wing_desc: By throwing the weight of the government behind the civilian wing's agenda of land reform, the courts, and the constitution, we can win the gratitude of Pridi's faction. Such favoritism does not go unnoticed, however: the officer corps will sulk and the disruption to ordinary administration will cost us dearly while the dust settles.
loc.SIA_promote_military_wing_desc: By indulging the officers' demands and parading the strength of the armed forces, we can win the favor of Phibun's faction. Such favoritism does not go unnoticed, however: the realignment throws the army's routine into disarray and the disruption to ordinary administration will cost us dearly while the dust settles. A blunt instrument, fit only for hauling the wing back from the brink of revolt.
loc.SIA_cultivate_civilian_wing_desc: The standing the Royal Palace Bureau Directive has won us with the establishment opens the door to a patient, sustained courtship of the civilian wing. There is no abrupt favoritism to provoke a backlash, only the slow, steady work of winning Pridi's faction over, one concession at a time. It is a long road, but it can be walked as far as we please.
loc.SIA_cultivate_military_wing_desc: The standing the Royal Palace Bureau Directive has won us with the establishment opens the door to a patient, sustained courtship of the military wing. There is no abrupt favoritism to provoke a backlash, only the slow, steady work of winning the officer corps over, one concession at a time. It is a long road, but it can be walked as far as we please.
loc.SIA_end_factionalism_mission_desc: Both wings of the Khana Ratsadon stand fully behind the government. If we can keep them both at §GFull Support§! for §Y270§! days, the rivalry between them can be put to rest for good. Should either wing's enthusiasm waver, the effort must begin anew.
loc.AST_union_control_1_cat_desc:
Our union members have begun mobilizing support among the general populace across Australia. We can infiltrate the legislature in each individual state, building support for a Communist-led government from within. This will cost a significant amount of political power and threaten to destabilize the nation. 

The New Guard Veterans are watching our movements closely, and should the government fail to act in time, or if the nation becomes too unstable, this conflict could tear the nation apart entirely.

Communism Support: [?party_popularity_100@communism|Y]§Y%§!

§RA Civil War will break out if stability drops below 40%, or if the Veterans Revolt times out.§!
loc.AST_union_control_1_cat_name: Select where to rile up unions in your support
loc.AST_union_control_1_map_area_name: States which can still be influenced
loc.AST_union_control_2_cat_desc: The workers of [ROOT.GetNonIdeologyName] did not overthrow their oppressors only to watch the imperial powers continue to hold our comrades overseas in chains. The spread of communism beyond our borders is not merely an ideological goal, it is a strategic necessity. We must fan the flames of revolution across the oceans, giving hope and resources to those who would cast off the yoke of imperialism, until the old order has no footing left to stand on.
loc.AST_union_control_tt: Unions must establish themselves in states across Australia, however, the New Guard Veterans are working to thwart the spread of Communism.
loc.AST_union_strike_desc: Our workers are walked out from their places of work, demanding better conditions and rights. This is sure to put pressure on the government to instate new reforms.
loc.AST_veterans_revolt_desc: The army has a lot of anti-communist members, many who were previously parts of fascist-groups. They have a disdain for communism, and would sooner take up arms than see it rise to power.\nIf we take too long in bringing about our revolution, or should we let stability fall too low, they'll take matters into their own hands to prevent it from happening.
loc.AST_organize_in_nation_desc: The labour movement knows no borders. By channelling resources into our comrades' networks, we can embed communist organisers within the trade unions of [FROM.GetName], building grassroots support for the revolution from within the working class.
loc.AST_civil_war_in_nation_desc: The seeds we have sown are ready to bear fruit. Communist support in [FROM.GetName] has grown to the point where open revolution is within reach. With funding, agitators, and a carefully timed push, we can turn popular discontent into an armed uprising, bringing [FROM.GetName] one step closer to the worker's state it deserves.
loc.AST_take_it_to_foreign_streets_desc: Workers have no borders. We will launch a coordinated international campaign, sending Australian communist organisers into the streets of every nation where our influence has already taken hold, reinvigorating local movements and keeping the flame of revolution burning.
loc.AST_take_it_to_foreign_streets_tt: Extends the duration of Foreign Communist Influence by 60 days in all currently infiltrated nations.
loc.AST_raj_locked_tt: The Raj cannot be targeted until New Zealand, Malaya, Burma, the Philippines, and Indonesia have all fallen to communist rule.
loc.AST_supply_arms_to_nation_desc: We will supply weapons to our comrades
loc.AST_strikes_tt: You will only be able to complete §Y$AST_workers_educational_association$§!, §Y$AST_off_leash$§!, §Y$AST_a_national_housing_commission$§!, §Y$AST_guaranteed_employment$§!, and §Y$AST_equal_pay$§! while a strike is ongoing.
loc.AST_nationalizing_process_tt: Enables the §YBegin Nationalization§! decision, applying §YNationalization Underway§!. Required for the below focuses and removed upon completing §YThe Public's Australia§!. §RUnselected focuses will then be locked!§!
loc.AST_nationalizing_process_ends_tt: §RTaking this focus will lock all above focuses!§!
loc.AST_seize_local_control_tt: Communists take control of the state, ensuring it will be on our side should we get in a civil war.\n
loc.AST_foreign_overlord_reclaim_foothold_in: If we or [?FROM.AST_communist_civil_war_enemy_country.GetName] don't control any province of [FROM.GetName]:
loc.AST_push_foreign_overlord_out_of_target_: If [FROM.GetName] has fully expelled [?FROM.AST_communist_civil_war_enemy_country.GetName] and its allies from their land:
loc.idea_AST_civil_war_on_their_own_desc: We must fight this war ourselves.
loc.ast_foreign_communist_influence_idea_des: Communists from Australia are influencing us!
loc.SIA_release_contigency_funds_tt2: for §Y[?var:SIA_contingency_funds]§! months. At the end the funds will disappear. The longer we gather funds at peace time the longer time the fund will last during war-time.
loc.AST_election_approaching_cat_desc: No sooner has one government settled in than the next election begins to approach. The democratic parties are scrambling for whatever might raise their support, hoping that it will be enough to secure victory once the polling stations open, and the ballot boxes fill with votes.
loc.AST_final_reforms_mission_desc:
Through stable leadership, conservative leanings, and loyalty to Britain, the UAP has strengthened its support and made another term increasingly likely. To preserve public support, its leaders must accelerate reforms.

§YEffects while active:§!
§W(§YDemocratic§! Focuses):
§Y7§! days Completion Time decrease§!
loc.AST_labor_campaign_tour_mission_desc:
In its mission to represent every citizen, the ALP has adopted a different perspective on imperialism and Australia’s loyalty to the Empire. Domestic needs shall come first, and foreign interests should no longer take priority.

To spread the message to both the current ruling party and the voters, the ALP shall set out on a nationwide campaign tour.

§YEffects while active:§!
§WDaily §YA.L.P§! Votes increase: §G+0.05§!§!
loc.AST_labor_campaign_tour_effect_tt:
Effects while §Y$AST_labor_campaign_tour_mission$§! is active (§Y180§! days):
Daily §YA.L.P§! Votes increase: §G+0.05§!

Effects in §Y180§! days:
loc.AST_election_season_cat_desc: No sooner has one government settled in than the next prepares to take its place. Little can be done to sway public support at this point, though that will not stop the parties from trying. It is not over until it is over, and that day will come at the ballot box.
loc.AST_election_countdown_desc: Only days remain until the polling stations open.\n\n§W$AST_expected_election_winner_tt$§!
loc.AST_government_formation_period_desc:
Every party wants the power to decide its own policies, but if certain circumstances demand it, a national unity government may be the most reasonable option.

§W§YEffects while active:§!
£GFX_trigger_yes $AST_election_recently_concluded$

The $AST_ruling_party$ may form a §YNational Unity Government§!.

Form a §YNational Unity Government§! in the Democratic Elections window, located in the Australian Focus Tree.§!
loc.AST_war_is_coming_cat_desc: Tensions are rising, and Australian officials and citizens both are beginning to realize that war may be unavoidable, regardless of how much their policies or interests wish otherwise.\n\nWe must call a Cabinet meeting to decide on procedures in the event of an invasion. Yet before doing so, it may be worth taking actions that the full Cabinet might not agree with.
loc.AST_seize_civilian_industry_desc: Although consumer goods are a necessity for our citizens and the economy both, there is no way around the fact that wartime comes with greater necessities. War is coming; we shall be prepared when it does.
loc.AST_scorch_the_north_desc: If we suspect invasion from the north there are ways to thwart such advances, although they come at a price. Although the development of our northern states will be set back by a scorched-earth policy, it might be what is needed to hold off the aggressors.
loc.AST_scorch_the_north_tt: §YEffects when a Northern state is naval invaded:§!
loc.AST_the_brisbane_line_desc: Australian defense capabilities may not be strong enough to hold off foreign aggression completely. By adopting a policy that prioritizes the strong defense of vital territories, rather than the weak defense of all, we can ensure that the most developed and inhabited parts of [AST.GetName] remain under our control.\n\nAlthough such a policy doubtlessly will be opposed by those who reject any degree of surrender, the Government has a responsibility to guide [AST.GetName] in a reasonable direction.
loc.AST_summon_the_cabinet_mission_desc: Summon diplomats, officials, and theorists to Canberra; the prospect of invasion must be discussed.
loc.AST_summon_the_cabinet_tt1: \nThis event will disrupt the sitting government, potentially leading to its §Ycollapse§!.
loc.AST_australian_comforts_fund_desc: The Government shall honor one of the Canberra Air Crash victims by investing in the Australian Comforts Fund, for which the surviving wife is an enthusiastic worker.\n\nThe fund aims to ease the time Australian soldiers spend in the field by sending them items that supplement their army rations and personal kits, and thus the war effort will benefit from an investment as well.
loc.AST_eminent_successors_desc: Some of the Canberra Air Disaster victims were highly respected government officials. Although there is no way to compensate for their terrible fates, perhaps the appointment of a few eminent successors would stabilize the government and restore both the public's and the ministers' trust.
loc.AST_critics_to_shame_desc: The Canberra Air Disaster has affected the entire nation, leaving no Australian untouched by mourning. In times such as these, there will always be those who seek to take advantage. We shall expose the loudest critics for what their criticism truly is; an attempt to disrupt order.
loc.AST_approach_the_independents_desc: The government is unstable, as faith in its ability to guide Australia through the recent turmoil fades by the day. By approaching the independents, they may be persuaded to realize that a change in government would be for the best.
loc.AST_a_sound_voice_desc: In this period of political turmoil, one confident voice seems to inspire trust among the Australian people. Might it be the voice of [AST.GetName]'s next leader?
loc.AST_challenge_government_narrative_desc: The details shared by the government concerning the Canberra Air Disaster seem unusual, inevitably leading to speculation that some information may be withheld. How could an experienced RAAF officer crash his aircraft in ideal flying conditions? Answers must be demanded from the government.
loc.AST_make_a_common_enemy_desc: Voices of distrust have multiplied following the loss of the officials who perished in the Canberra Air Disaster. The unusual circumstances of the crash are not the only factor encouraging suspicion of foreign involvement; after all, nothing unites more than a common enemy.
loc.AST_ensure_cabinet_loyalty_desc: The threat of a no-confidence motion poses no danger so long as the majority of the cabinet votes in favor of the sitting government. We shall ensure the cabinet's loyalty.
loc.AST_the_crown_intervenes_desc: The New Guard, protectors of country and order, is dismayed by the current disorder. Leading members, guided by their British heritage and monarchist ideals, have initiated contact with British officials to request their assistance.\n\nNow, the New Guard appeals to the [AST.GetAdjective] government: welcome British intervention.
loc.AST_a_monarchist_appeal_desc: The New Guard, protectors of country and order, is dismayed by the current disorder. Leading members, guided by their British heritage and monarchist ideals, fear that Australia may go down the same path as [ENG.GetNameDef] has, where national and political disorder led to the end of the British Commonwealth as we know it, and its monarchy as well.\n\nNow, the New Guard appeals to the Governor-General to lead through this potential constitutional crisis without hastening to form a new government, nor allowing the old to regain control just yet. Perhaps it is time for [AST.GetName] to honor the traditions that [ENG.GetNameDef] has left behind, and for our nation to be ruled in glory and unity.
loc.AST_castle_crumbling_mission_desc: Australia looks to its leaders in the aftermath of the tragic Canberra Air Disaster. Will the sitting government remain worthy of the public's trust even after the loss of cabinet officials, or would a change in leadership simply be for the best?
loc.AST_castle_crumbling_reactivate_tt: §LThe Governor-General is in the midst of negotiations§! (focus §YFor Crown and Empire§!)§L; a final decision regarding the Government will be postponed.§!\n\n
loc.AST_cabinet_trust_complete_1_flag: Has taken Decision: §YMake A Common Enemy§!
loc.AST_deteriorating_prime_minister_nerves_: [AST.GetLeader] is straining under the pressure of the inevitable war. If relief cannot be found soon, his nerves may not hold.
loc.AST_aid_australian_military_construction: Britain is not ready for war. By aiding Australia with military construction, we may ease their impatience.
loc.AST_japanese_war_mission_desc: Australia do not want to face its overwhelming enemy alone — [JAP.GetNameDef]. They are pressing us to take the first step and settle the looming conflict at the earliest convenience.
loc.AST_request_resource_rights_in_indochina: Request Resource Rights in French Indochina
loc.AST_summons_to_australian_hall_desc: In our endeavor to grow the [AST.GetFascistParty], we must unite and mobilize our supporters. The Australian Hall awaits.
loc.AST_print_the_publicist_desc: The Publicist, the Australia First newsletter, plays an important role in reaching potential supporters. By publishing another issue, we can spread our message.
loc.AST_call_on_fascists_desc: As a small movement with few supporters, Australia First does not always make ends meet. However, a foreign group of similar ideas have shown a willingness to fund our ambitions, offering a solution to ensure our continued advance.
loc.AST_a_convenient_disaster_desc: However popular Australia First becomes, conservatives will always resist the group's ideology. For Australia First to successfully gain power, something more dramatic than regular elections may be necessary; something that throws the government into turmoil.\n\nOur movement lacks the capacity to provoke such an event itself, but our foreign fascist supporter does not. By aiding our rise to power, foreign fascists shall find a friend in [AST.GetName].
loc.AST_a_convenient_disaster_tt: \nThis event will disrupt the sitting government, ultimately allowing the §Y[AST.GetFascistParty]§! to become ruling party.
loc.AST_a_convenient_disaster_flag: §YCanberra Air Disaster§! has been triggered through decision §YA Convenient Disaster§!.
loc.AST_afm_decisions_fascism_upgrade_tt: Upgrade Daily Fascism Support gain of §YAustralia First Movement Decisions§!.
loc.AST_afm_decisions_autonomy_upgrade_tt: Upgrade Autonomy gain of §YAustralia First Movement Decisions§!.
loc.AST_harland_wolff_mio_trigger: Has completed decision §Y$AST_refit_a_retired_british_carrier$§!, unlocked by focus §Y$AST_royal_prestige$§!
loc.AST_new_zealand_and_clause_6_desc: During the process that united the Australian colonies into a federation, New Zealand ultimately decided not to take part. Ever since, however, the Constitution has continued to define New Zealand as one of Australia's potential states, and does allow for its admission.\n\nWith their national security now seriously threatened, New Zealand may, for the first time since the enactment of Clause 6, be swayed to join our Kingdom.
loc.AST_new_zealand_and_clause_6_tt: (§Y[NZL.GetNameWithFlag]§!) Joins §Y[AST.GetNameDef]§!, bringing all of its territory and its land, naval, and air forces
loc.AST_protector_of_the_indies_desc: Ever since conflict stirred in Europe, [HOL.GetNameDef] has been far too occupied by the defense of its own territory to care for the defense of its Indonesian colony. The potential fall of [INS.GetNameDef] may very well decide the fate of all other Southeast Asian nations, and cannot be left in the hands of the colony itself.\n\n[HOL.GetNameDefCap] understands too, considering the gravity of the situation, that the colony is better defended by [AST.GetNameDef].
loc.AST_protector_of_the_indies_tt: (§Y[INS.GetNameWithFlag]§!) Joins §Y[AST.GetNameDef]§!, bringing all of its territory and its land, naval, and air forces
loc.AST_the_solomon_islands_protectorate_des: Ever since 1893, the Solomon Islands have been a protectorate. However, with war consuming its protector, it is doubtful how much protection the islands can truly expect.\n\n[AST.GetNameDefCap] shall seek to protect the islands itself, and surely it must be evident that a neighboring nation of Australia's stature is far better suited to such a task.
loc.AST_new_hebrides_and_caledonia_under_our: New Hebrides and Caledonia Under Our Wing

The island groups of the New Hebrides and New Caledonia have a long history of European occupation, just like Australia. Now that [AST.GetNameDef] at last has broken free from its settlers, it is in our royal responsibility to care for our surroundings, especially those belonging to peers with a background similar to ours.\n\nWith world tensions putting strain on the islands' occupier, it is finally possible to make them understand that the New Hebrides and New Caledonia would be safer within the realm of Australia.
loc.AST_naval_expansion_desc: In exchange for the [ROOT.GetFascistParty] pursuing policies that benefit them, leading business figures have agreed to invest in industry reforms that align with the party's aims.\n\nThe fleet must be expanded if [AST.GetName] is to stand a chance against enemies of superior naval power. For a limited time, all hands shall be on deck in the dockyards, ensuring an increase in ship production.
loc.AST_factory_conversions_desc: In exchange for the [ROOT.GetFascistParty] pursuing policies that benefit them, leading business figures have agreed to invest in industry reforms that align with the party's aims.\n\nThe defense industry must be prioritized, and Australian factories must therefore be converted to support it.
loc.AST_land_development_desc: In exchange for the [ROOT.GetFascistParty] pursuing policies that benefit them, leading business figures have agreed to invest in industry reforms that align with the party's aims.\n\nToo much of [ROOT.GetName]'s territory remains unindustrialized and underdeveloped. By developing these regions, we will make them suitable for construction.
loc.AST_electrical_grid_expansions_desc: In exchange for the [ROOT.GetFascistParty] pursuing policies that benefit them, leading business figures have agreed to invest in industry reforms that align with the party's aims.\n\nBy expanding our electrical grid, we can promote domestic energy production that does not rely on imports.
loc.AST_factory_investments_desc: In exchange for the [ROOT.GetFascistParty] pursuing policies that benefit them, leading business figures have agreed to invest in industry reforms that align with the party's aims.\n\nIf we want to ensure that both military and civilian supplies remain sufficient in times of conflict, we need to expand our industrial capacity.
loc.AST_develop_port_kemla_steel_medium_deci: Build Second Port Kembla Blast Furnace
Port Kembla has functioned well with only one blast furnace, but demand has grown such that we may wish to build a second. This will roughly double the steel output of the region.
loc.AST_prospect_pilbara_iron_decision_desc: The Pilbara region has enormous reserves of iron ore, among the largest found in the world. However, in this extremely remote part of the country, the investment required to tap into this resource would be enormous... but then again so would the profits.
loc.AST_scale_up_pilbara_mines_steel_decisio: Now that the Pilbara region has been opened to large-scale mining, it's time to let the investment flow!
loc.AST_pilbara_mining_tt: Opening §Y$STATE_870$§! to further prospecting will enable a repeatable decision to increase steel production without limits.
loc.AST_scale_up_middleback_mines_steel_deci: Although the Iron Knob Mine has been active for a while, with expanding demand for iron ore, it's time to expand our efforts here.
The Iron Knob mine is not enough for our needs, thankfully the Middleback Mountains are rich in iron. It's time to establish our largest mine yet!
Wartime demands for metals are at an all time high, but the Middleback Mountains continue to provide.
loc.AST_expand_iron_mining_tt: Having both §Y$AST_exports_for_economic_recovery$§!, and §Y$AST_within_reach$§! will enable exploitation of the Pilbara region of §Y$STATE_870$§!, unleashing a near inexhaustible source of §YSteel§!. We can use this to fuel our economy.
loc.AST_develop_port_kemla_steel_tt: This will allow us to take the §YBuild Second Port Kembla Blast Furnace§! decision which will significantly boost our §YSteel§! output.
loc.AST_develop_middleback_tt: This will unlock three decisions to develop our §YSteel§! production in §Y$STATE_519$§!
loc.AST_expand_planned_extraction_pilbara_tt: §Y$AST_planned_extraction$§! will enable exploitation of the Pilbara region of §Y$STATE_870$§!, unleashing a near inexhaustible source of §YSteel§!. We can use this to fuel our economy.
loc.AST_smuggle_arms_to_ireland_desc: We must supply the Irish with the arms needed to fight the British.
loc.AST_smuggle_arms_to_northern_ireland_des: If we can make Northern Ireland well-supplied enough with weapons, and well-connected enough with Ireland, then we can ensure that it can unite with Ireland before the British have the chance to intervene.
loc.AST_you_can_switch_sf: You will be able to switch between specializations.
loc.AST_training_camps_specialization: Our training camps stand ready to offer specialist training to our troops, making them more effective in a variety of different theatres.
loc.AST_australia_formables_category_desc: Although our roots always will bind us to the distant south, our arms have grown long and far-reaching, and made it no longer possible for others to sweep our views on world affairs under the rug. We have expanded, and may expand further still, and a new name for our nation shall make this clear. From the cocoon we emerge, spreading our wings for the world to admire and recognize, naming our colors and pattern the new nation down south—Australasia.
loc.INS_political_events.1.desc: The five-year term of [INS.GetLeader] is approaching its end, and thus we must decide on a suitable leader to take his place. Queen Wilhelmina has recommended Alidius Tjarda van Starkenborgh Stachouwer, who has shown great promise as Extraordinary Ambassador and Minister Plenipotentiary.
loc.INS_political_events.1.b: [INS.GetLeader] has done well, he should serve another term.
loc.INS_political_events.2.desc: The new Republican government in the former Indies has declared the entire archipelago as their territory. [FROM.GetLeader] has sent us an official demand to give up [721.GetName], threatening military action upon refusal.
loc.INS_political_events.2.a: Fine, it is not worth causing an incident.
loc.INS_political_events.3.desc: As expected, [FROM.GetLeader] has agreed to our demands and has begun moving troops out of [721.GetName]. TKR forces have entered the region together with several government envoys. [INS.GetLeader] himself gave a speech in Dili declaring freedom from colonial influence.
loc.INS_political_events.4.desc: Negotiations with [FROM.GetName] did not go well. [FROM.GetLeader] refused to give up [721.GetName] for any reason, ending the meeting early.
loc.INS_political_events.5.desc: Today marks a historical milestone for Indonesia. With the revolution officially over, Prime Minister [INS.GetLeader] has declared that Indonesia will hold its first free and democratic election. The outcome of this election will have a lasting impact on Indonesia.
loc.INS_political_events.5.a: Sutan Sjahrir has led our country to this point, he will guide us further!
loc.INS_political_events.5.b: Amir Sjarifuddin is a fair compromise between the Socialists and Nationalists.
loc.INS_political_events.5.c: Mohammad Hatta started the revolution, and he will complete it.
loc.INS_political_events.6.desc: With the revolution underway, our guerillas which have infiltrated the Indies administration no longer need to operate in secrecy, and will begin to carry out their sabotage missions before the Netherlands has time to react.
loc.INS_political_events.6.a: We must continue to act fast.
loc.INS_political_events.7.desc: The Volksraad petition organized by Soetardjo which requests a round table conference to be held between Dutch and Indonesian representatives to discuss the Indonesian desire for autonomy has finished internal debate, and the petition has gone to the Governor General for approval. While many advisors insist the status quo must be maintained, and therefore the petition should be vetoed, there is no denying that nationalist movements are only getting stronger and more radicalized. If we continue to refuse every peaceful request for autonomy, the nationalists may begin trying more violent alternatives instead.
loc.INS_political_events.7.a: We must begin negotiations in order to avoid an inevitable civil war.
loc.INS_political_events.7.c: Perhaps the nationalists have a point?
loc.INS_political_events.8.desc: Soldiers from [?event_target:INS_invasion_event_invader.GetName] have arrived at [?event_target:INS_invasion_event_invaded_state.GetName], and our soldiers in the area, being greatly outnumbered, have been ordered to engage a full military evacuation of [?event_target:INS_invasion_event_invaded_state.GetName]. The [?event_target:INS_invasion_event_invader.GetAdjective] forces are continuing to advance in the Indies and our chance of avoiding occupation are looking bleak.
loc.INS_political_events.8.a: We will arrest the nationalists and defend our home until the death!
loc.INS_political_events.9.desc: As [JAP.GetNameDef] began to withdraw their forces from the East Indies, we sent soldiers to Batavia in order to reestablish the colonial government. However, our soldiers discovered that the political landscape in the Indies has significantly changed since the occupation. Before our troops even made it to Batavia, [INS.GetLeader] had already signed a declaration of independence, proclaiming the Republic of Indonesia as an independent nation, with shocking amounts of support from the public.
loc.INS_political_events.9.b: This is hopeless, more fighting is not what we need. We should focus on rebuilding the homeland.
loc.INS_political_events.11.desc: Upon declaring independence, our militias immediately moved to defend our territory from the Dutch invasion we expected. However, to the surprise of many, [HOL.GetLeader] announced he will not call for an invasion, instead prioritizing rebuilding the Dutch homeland and avoiding further conflict.
loc.INS_political_events.11.a: A surprise, but a welcome one.
loc.INS_political_events.12.desc: Our troops have landed in [?event_target:INS_invasion_event_invaded_state.GetName] and victory on the Indonesian front is imminent. We need to settle on how we should go about occupying Indonesia. While direct occupation would get us the resources we need, it’s going to be expensive and difficult. We’ve negotiated with Sukarno, a leading revolutionary, and have created a plan wherein we will establish an Indonesian puppet state, officially led partly by Sukarno, but under our command. This will keep the Indonesian civilians calm, and will be much cheaper than total occupation.
loc.INS_political_events.12.a: We should continue negotiations with Sukarno
loc.INS_political_events.12.b: We are not interested in cooperating with revolutionaries.
loc.INS_political_events.13.desc: Soldiers from [?event_target:INS_invasion_event_invader.GetName] have arrived at [?event_target:INS_invasion_event_invaded_state.GetName], and our soldiers in the area, being greatly outnumbered, have been ordered to engage a full military evacuation of [?event_target:INS_invasion_event_invaded_state.GetName]. The [?event_target:INS_invasion_event_invader.GetAdjective] forces are continuing to advance in the Indies and our chance of avoiding occupation are looking bleak. Additionally, our spies report that [?event_target:INS_invasion_event_invader.GetLeader] has been seen negotiating with Sukarno and other nationalist leaders, aiming to create an Indonesian puppet state led by Sukarno under the Co-Prosperity Sphere.
loc.INS_political_events.13.a: We will arrest the nationalists and defend our home until the death!
loc.INS_political_events.13.b: It's dangerous, but perhaps this is a real chance to become independent?
loc.INS_peta_explain_tt: We will be able to use the chaos of the occupation to declare total independence if [JAP.GetName] gets pushed back.
loc.INS_peta_explain_tt_jap: §R[INS.GetName] may stay loyal to us, but if we begin to lose control of territory, they may call our bluff and declare independence§!.
loc.INS_political_events.14.desc: Sukarno, as well as several other top revolutionaries in Indonesia have been arrested by Dutch military police, before we were able to establish the puppet regime.
loc.INS_political_events.14.a: Shame, he would've been a valuable ally.
loc.INS_political_events.15.desc: Negotiations with Sukarno have concluded, and the puppet regime in Indonesia is under way. Sukarno has used his connections together with our military presence to destabilize the Dutch government and establish de-facto control over the archipelago.
loc.INS_political_events.15.a: We have not only secured cheap resources, we have secured a valuable ally.
loc.INS_political_events.16.desc: The [?event_target:INS_invasion_event_invader.GetAdjective] forces in the Indies have cooperated with Indonesian nationalists to destabilize our colonial administration, and have fully occupied the indies. Dutch flags have been lowered and replaced with Indonesian flags, and the native citizens of the Indies appear to be embracing the [?event_target:INS_invasion_event_invader.GetAdjective] occupiers. It is not looking good for our colonial empire.
loc.INS_political_events.16.a: They have won the battle, but they have not won the war.
loc.INS_political_events.17.desc: Word has reached the Imperial General Headquarters from Batavia. Sukarno and his clique, raised up by our own hand to govern the islands in the Emperor's name, have proclaimed the [FROM.GetAdjective] Republic as a response to our repeated territorial losses, believing we are stretched too thin to do anything about it.
loc.INS_political_events.18.desc: Tan Malaka, the Indonesian communist who has served these past years as a trusted advisor to our government, has announced his immediate departure. With [INS.GetNameDef] now standing as a free republic, he intends to return at last to the country he last set foot in as a fugitive over two decades ago. He thanks us for the refuge offered him and the freedom to continue his work, and says only that his place is now at home.
loc.INS_political_events.18.a: We will wish him good luck.
loc.INS_political_events.19.desc: Word has reached [1058.GetName] that Admiral Conrad Helfrich, commander of our naval forces and the most capable officer we have in these waters, has been ordered home. The Hague cites pressing needs in the metropole, and offers little further explanation. His departure leaves the archipelago thinly defended at a moment when our position here is far from secure, and the wardroom in Surabaya is said to be in a sour mood.
loc.INS_political_events.19.a: A grim day for the fleet
loc.INS_industrial_events.4.desc: By shutting down rubber plantations in [FROM.FROM.GetName], we have made room in the budget for new industrial projects in the region.
loc.INS_industrial_events.4.a: We will construct oil wells in [FROM.FROM.GetName]
loc.INS_industrial_events.4.b: We should open an aluminium smelter in [FROM.FROM.GetName]
loc.INS_industrial_events.4.c: We should prospect for resources we lack production of
loc.INS_industrial_events.4.d: We can open coal mines in [FROM.FROM.GetName]
loc.INS_industrial_events_5_desc_colonial: De Javasche Bank's reserves have fallen to their lowest point in a decade. The Guilder buys less every month, and plantation owners are demanding payment in foreign currency. Our financial advisors agree that the Bank alone cannot reverse the decline, but they disagree sharply on the remedy.
loc.INS_industrial_events_5_desc_independent: Bank Indonesia has reported that the Rupiah lost nearly a fifth of its value in the last quarter alone. Rice traders in Surabaya have begun refusing it outright in favor of foreign notes. Our finance minister insists the currency can be saved, but only if we act decisively and soon.
loc.INS_industrial_events.5.a: We should try to strengthen the Guilder, not replace it.
loc.INS_industrial_events.5.b: We will peg the Indies Guilder to the Dutch Guilder.
loc.INS_industrial_events.5.c: We will peg the Indies Guilder to the US Dollar.
