loc.AST_diplomatic_events.25.a: We shall; the Pacific region will be strengthened under centralized control.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.26.desc: [ENG.GetNameDefCap] agrees; the Pacific region will be strengthened under centralized control. The British Pacific territories have been placed under our authority.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.27.desc: [ENG.GetNameDefCap] disagrees; the Pacific region will not be strengthened under centralized control. The Pacific territories will remain our British authority.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.28.desc: The Prime Minister's cabled dispute with [ENG.GetLeader] resulted in little reinforcement for Australia, but added to British resentment toward [AST.GetLeader] for pressing Australia’s interests.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.28.a: Australia must see to her own defenses.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.29.desc: Following Australian pressure on [ENG.GetNameDef] to instigate a conflict with [JAP.GetName], Britain has agreed to support our defensive construction efforts.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.29.a: The aid is welcome, but it will not avert a Japanese war.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.30.desc: Expansionist aggressors look to Indochina not only for the territory itself, but also the resources it possesses. If the riches end up in enemy hands they will only prolong the war, while they in Australia's could help end it; or so the Australian government claims.\n\nShall we agree to grant them resource rights within our territory?
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.30.b: The resources are not for [AST.GetName] to take either.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.31.desc: Expansionist aggressors look to Indochina not only for the territory itself, but also the resources it possesses. If the riches end up in enemy hands they will only prolong the war, while they in Australia's could help end it; or so the Australian government claims.\n\n[ROOT.OVERLORD.GetNameDefCap] has agreed to the request.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.32.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] agrees that the resources of Indochina would be better used in Australian hands, and has granted us resource rights.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.32.a: They will be of great use.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.33.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] does not agree that the resources of Indochina would be better used in Australian hands, and refuse to grant us resource rights.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.33.a: We hope they will not end up in enemy hands.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.34.desc: [AST.GetNameDefCap] suggests a pact; one that would settle potential conflicts between our two nations before they have the chance to arise. By dividing Pacific territories between us, we can plan our future expansions without fearing interference from the other.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.34.b: [JAP.GetNameDefCap] will expand as it sees fit.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.35.desc: [AST.GetNameDefCap] and [JAP.GetNameDefCap] have agreed on which Pacific territories each country may expand into. Hopefully, this will ward off any potential future conflicts between our two powers.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.36.desc: [JAP.GetNameDefCap] will not agree to divide the Pacific territories between our two nations; the Japanese government will expand as it sees fit.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.37.desc: For reasons unknown, [AST.GetName] has decided to transfer control of our lands to [JAP.GetNameDef]. Something ominous is simmering behind the scenes, and it is only a matter of time before the world finds out what.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.37.a: Evidently, we have no say in the matter.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.38.desc: As a result of the First World War, several German territories in the Pacific were placed under Australian control, but there may now be a way to have one of them returned: the island of Nauru.\n\nThe [AST.GetFascistParty] holds values that align with our interests, one of which is the complete separation of [AST.GetName] from [ENG.GetNameDef]. Due to the movement's current limited influence, its representatives seek support from us to accelerate its growth, and once fully in power, they insist on returning control of the island of Nauru — provided that we Guarantee them when seeking independence.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.38.b: We cannot commit to empty promises.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.39.desc: [GER.GetNameDefCap] and the [AST.GetFascistParty] have agreed on a common objective: [AST.GetName] shall achieve independence. Due to the [AST.GetFascistParty]'s currently limited political influence, [GER.GetNameDef] will contribute with a grant to accelerate its growth, and once our influence is limited no more, the agreement shall be fully carried out.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.40.desc: Unable to commit to promises that cannot yet be fulfilled, [GER.GetNameDef] declines to support our rise to power. The Nauru Pact ends before it can even begin, and the ambitions of the [AST.GetFascistParty] shall remain on our shoulders completely.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.40.a: The [AST.GetFascistParty] will proceed without German support.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.41.desc: Now fully in power, the [AST.GetFascistParty] honors its promise and fulfills its side of the bargain. Nauru is returned to [GER.GetNameDef], and we shall guarantee Australian independence.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.42.desc: Promises have one fatal flaw; they can be broken. Now at the reins of power, the leaders of the [AST.GetFascistParty] have decided that not only is Nauru theirs to keep, but so are other Pacific islands theirs to take.\n\nOur old Pacific territories will remain as far from being our as before the Nauru Pact was signed, and if we want it any other way, there must be war.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.42.a: The future will decide the consequences.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.43.desc: [AST.GetName] argues that through its expansion northward, we can increase our joint influence over Southeast Asian diplomacy and conflicts. Although not an outright demand, [AST.GetLeader] suggests that a refusal would not be accepted.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.43.a: With our attention elsewhere, it shall be for the best.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.43.b: Regardless, a refusal is what they shall receive.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.44.desc: [ENG.GetNameDefCap] has wisely agreed to the transfer of their Southeast Asian territories to us. As Australian borders expand, our influence follows suit, leaving it only a matter of time before the world becomes our oyster.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.45.desc: [ENG.GetNameDefCap] has rejected the transfer of their Southeast Asian territories to us. Nonetheless, the appeal of controlling the region remains evident to us, and although it shall not be ours by request, it may yet become ours.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.47.desc: Despite its recent partition from the British Commonwealth, [AST.GetName] offers military cooperation. [AST.GetName] claims that a sharing of burdens would benefit [ENG.GetNameDefCap], considering how stretched thin it is across the globe.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.48.desc: [ENG.GetNameDefCap] has agreed to sign a non-aggression pact, laying the foundation for military cooperation.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.48.a: This marks a new chapter in our relations.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.49.desc: [ENG.GetNameDefCap] has declined to sign a non-aggression pact. Our attempt to establish military cooperation between our two nations has therefore failed, and we must proceed alone with our outward advances.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.50.desc: Although the protection of Southeast Asia and the Pacific lies in Britain's interests, the region is far from the British Isles; so [FROM.GetName] has understood. In exchange for our support in supply, it has offered to assume command of the territory's defense, allowing us to direct our attention elsewhere.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.50.b: The region is located close enough.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.51.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] agrees; the Southeast Asian waters shall be protected by us. In exchange for British contributions of fuel, [ROOT.GetName] shall put its efforts into increasing naval dominance in our neighboring waters.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.52.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] disagrees; they need no help defending the Southeast Asian waters. However, with or without British support, [ROOT.GetName] shall put its efforts into increasing naval dominance in neighboring waters.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.53.desc: [AST.GetName] suspects that the fall or cooperation of Vichy France is one of [ENG.GetNameDef]'s main objectives, and has therefore offered to join in and pursue the French African colonies until Vichy is subdued. Although an unknown agenda may lie behind the proposal, there is no question that increased allied presence in the region would benefit us.\n\nIf we grant our permission, [AST.GetName] will initiate discussions with Vichy France, seeking a peaceful transfer of their colonies and the establishment of an Australian garrison.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.53.b: The risk of [AST.GetName] leveraging it against us is too great.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.54.desc: [ENG.GetNameDefCap] agrees: increased allied presence in Africa would benefit the Commonwealth.\n\nWe will initiate discussions with Vichy France, seeking a peaceful transfer of their colonies and the establishment of an Australian garrison.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.55.desc: [ENG.GetNameDefCap] declines Australian aid in Africa and will handle the matter of Vichy France itself. Nevertheless, our ambitions are not easily diverted.\n\nAustralian control over the African territories of Vichy France would make us an equal of the British Commonwealth rather than its subordinate. We must pursue them despite [ENG.GetNameDef]'s wishes, although it will have to be by force.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.56.desc: On [ENG.GetNameDef]'s behalf, [AST.GetName] comes knocking on our door, demanding the transfer of African territories.\n\n[ENG.GetNameDefCap] is determined to expand its control in Africa, and should we not bow to Australian occupation, they shall return to our doorstep armed.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.56.a: To avoid conflict, the territories shall be transferred.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.57.desc: Vichy France has agreed to transfer the demanded African territories and has allowed an Australian garrison to seize control of the region.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.57.a: Further expansion into Africa shall continue!
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.58.desc: Vichy France declines the transfer of African territories to us. However, this was not a request, but a demand.\n\nWe shall pursue the region they have denied us, though it will have to be by force.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.62.desc: Diplomats from [AST.GetName] have come to us with an offer of establishing an Anti-British pact. This would entail their assistance in reclaiming northern Ireland from the Anglos, without us having to intervene directly.\n In return, should they succeed, we would join their Faction and assist them in a future war against Britain should it come to pass.\nWhile a unification with the north is alluring, we must carefully consider whether we're in a position to antagonize our stronger neighbor in such a way, and more importantly, if we could come out victorious in the case of conflict - lest all of Ireland once more becomes but a mere British colony.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.62.a: Unification cannot wait! Sign the pact!
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.63.desc: Ireland has rejected signing the Anti-Britain Pact.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.64.desc: Ireland has accepted signing the Anti-Britain Pact.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.65.desc: The growing influence of the [FROM.GetCommunistParty] in [FROM.GetNameDef] now bears fruit as its representatives have traversed China to inform us of a [FROM.GetAdjective] volunteer force that is mobilizing to support our forces. In addition, these volunteers are bringing spare equipment to help equip our own troops.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.65.a: A good start for cooperation with our [FROM.GetAdjective] comrades
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.66.desc: Representatives of [FROM.GetLeader] have communicated his thanks for the support of our volunteers and for the provided war material. The [FROM.GetAdjective] extensive experience in civil war surely means these resources will be used effectively.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.67.desc: Representatives of [FROM.GetLeader] have communicated his thanks for the support of our volunteers and for the provided war material. The [FROM.GetAdjective] extensive experience in civil war surely means these resources will be used effectively.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.68.desc: Australia do not want to face its overwhelming enemy alone — [JAP.GetNameDef]. They are pressing us to take the first step and settle the looming conflict at the earliest convenience.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.69.desc: The bond between [ENG.GetNameDef] and [AST.GetName] is being tested, but the latter is committed to fostering it back to full strength. [AST.GetName] has connections and allies within the British government to such an extent that its leaders simply cannot refuse them; the nations shall enter the same faction once more, and again, the Isles and the land down under shall work together.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.71.desc: [AST.GetName] has demanded control over our Pacific islands, claiming that the western Pacific is not for [USA.GetNameDef] to command. The islands may be a small price to pay to calm Australian hostility, but a price nonetheless. Shall we risk provoking a rising fascist power, although we already have our hands full?
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.71.b: The Pacific islands shall remain ours.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.72.desc: With their hands already full, the Pacific islands proved to be a small price for [USA.GetNameDef] to pay in order to calm Australian hostility. Their Pacific islands are now ours.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.73.desc: [USA.GetNameDefCap] has refused to surrender their Pacific islands to us. Despite our demands and growing influence in the Pacific, Washington remains unwilling to relinquish its hold over the islands.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.73.a: The islands may not be ours, yet.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.74.desc: In its ambitions to expand its territories, [AST.GetName] has demanded control over [PHI.GetNameDef]. Should we refuse, [AST.GetName] threatens war, deeming it simply unthinkable that [USA.GetNameDef] retains territories within [AST.GetName]'s sphere of influence.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.74.a: We cannot risk war; meet their demands.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.75.desc: It is clear that [AST.GetName]'s' rise as a fascist power is beginning to bring certain benefits, when nations fear our wrath to such a degree. [USA.GetNameDefCap] has agreed; [PHI.GetNameDef] is ours.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.76.desc: [USA.GetNameDefCap] has refused to surrender [PHI.GetNameDef] to us. Despite our demands and growing influence in the Pacific, Washington remains unwilling to relinquish its hold over the territory.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.78.desc:
[AST.GetNameDefCap] shares their bold objectives with us:

'[USA.GetNameDefCap]'s shadow looms over us, threatening to interfere whenever our actions do not align with its interests. With a global power of such magnitude meddling in Australian and Japanese affairs, East Asia will never truly belong to us. And so, [AST.GetName] shall go to war.'

Prime Minister [AST.GetLeader] makes his intentions very clear: [AST.GetName] intends to take on [USA.GetNameDef], and is requesting our aid should the Americans prove too mighty to overcome alone.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.78.b: [JAP.GetNameDefCap] has its own business to tend to.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.79.desc: It is clear, not only to us, that [USA.GetNameDef]'s interference in Asian and Oceanian diplomacy is both undesirable and unacceptable. [JAP.GetNameDefCap] has agreed to guarantee our nation, thereby allowing us to bear our standard high against our enemies, knowing that an ally will come to our aid should the Americans prove too mighty to overcome alone.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.80.desc: [USA.GetNameDefCap]'s interference in Asian and Oceanian diplomacy is both undesirable and unacceptable, but it seems to be clear only to us. [JAP.GetNameDefCap] refuses to guarantee us, forcing us to take on our enemies without them.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.81.desc:
The British Prime Minister's interest in animals has hardly escaped anyone's notice, his collection being rather impressive. Any addition to his diverse family of creatures is sure to be appreciated, but even more so, an exotic one.

[ENG.GetLeader] himself has expressed an interest in the Australian platypus, and although its export currently is prohibited due to the health risks the transport poses to the small creature, it might be worth making an exception.

Shall we grant the Prime Minister's wish, as a symbol of unity?
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.81.b: The export ban shall not be lifted, not even for the Prime Minister.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.82.desc:
The platypus transport that cast off from the port of Melbourne six weeks ago, with a complete platypusory on board, has arrived in [ENG.GetNameDef]. The ship's arrival was not a joyous one, however, since the animal was revealed to be dead. [ENG.GetLeader] laments his lost pet, whom he had even named after himself while awaiting its arrival, but claims that enemies are to blame for its demise. Apparently, the blasts of a submarine attack frightened the platypus to death.

However, the platypus attendant's logbook points to another likely cause of death: the water and air temperatures of the platypusory was well beyond the acceptable levels.

Regardless, [ENG.GetLeader] the Platypus is dead, and the British Prime Minister will remain platypus-less.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.83.desc:
Following a recently held referendum, [NZL.GetNameDef] has decided to invoke Clause 6 of the Australian Constitution.

During the process that united Australian colonies into a federation in 1901, New Zealand ultimately decided not to take part. Ever since, however, the Australian Constitution has continued to define New Zealand as one of its potential states, and does allow for the land's admission.

New Zealanders have now agreed that their lands are more safe under Australian governance, and have therefore agreed to join [AST.GetNameDef].
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.83.a: There is little we can do.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.84.desc: The rising tensions in the Pacific are worrisome, while our capacity to defend our affected territories appears limited; or so [AST.GetNameDef] claims.\n\nThey seek to expand their realm in order to defend all of Southeast Asia, and are therefore requesting the transfer of certain lands. Shall we agree?
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.84.a: The lands shall be transferred to Australian hands.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.84.b: We will agree to no such thing.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.85.desc: The rising tensions in the Pacific are worrisome, especially as some nations' capacity to defend their own territories appears limited; and [FROM.GetNameDef] agrees. They shall immediately transfer the territories we have requested.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.86.desc: The rising tensions in the Pacific are worrisome, especially as some nations' capacity to defend their own territories appears limited. Nonetheless, [FROM.GetNameDef] has refused to transfer the territories we have requested.
loc.AST_diplomatic_events.86.a: There is little we can do.
loc.AST_political_events.1.desc:
There are two areas in which we, as government, seek to increase federal control: Aviation, and Marketing.

Concerning Aviation, the object is to amend the Constitution to confer upon the Commonwealth Parliament the power to make laws regarding air navigation and aircraft.

The Marketing amendment is one to permit co-operation between the Commonwealth and the States in the marketing field, which is at present constitutionally impossible.

Which one shall we call a referendum for?
loc.AST_political_events.1.a: Aviation, to regulate air navigation throughout [AST.GetName].
loc.AST_political_events.1.a.tt:
Once the reform passes:
 Add §YPassed Aviation Reform§!, which grants:
 Air Research Speed: §G+15%§!
 §YAir Base§! construction speed: §G+5.00%§!
loc.AST_political_events.1.b: Marketing, to coordinate nationwide agricultural marketing schemes.
loc.AST_political_events.1.b.tt: Once the reform passes:\n Add §YPassed Marketing Reform§!, which grants:\n Consumer Goods Factories factor: §Y-10.0%§!
loc.AST_political_events.2.desc.a: The public has agreed to let our aviation reform be enacted. Since aviation did not exist when the Australian Constitution was written, it is only right that the government finally takes authority over air navigation and regulation. For the sake of safety and efficiency, uniform national aviation laws shall now follow.
loc.AST_political_events.2.desc.b: The public has agreed to let our marketing reform be enacted. With the power to regulate agricultural products and their marketing, the government will now be able to stabilize markets and improve cooperation between the states. Farmers' incomes shall become steadier, and so shall the national economy.
loc.AST_political_events.4.desc: [AST.GetName]'s leaders have long labored under the pressure of war preparations, and at last, the strain claimed its highest victim; the Prime Minister has died of a heart attack.\n\nGiven the current state of the world, his leadership will be greatly missed. Nevertheless, Australia must carry on with a new leader at the reins: [AST.GetLeader].
loc.AST_political_events.5.desc: A group of defiant and controversial voices has formed: the Australia First Movement. The government fears that its intentions may not be entirely democratic and has chosen to place the group, as well as its members, under surveillance. The democrats' interference will reduce our capabilities to organize, and stifle the recruitment of new members.
loc.AST_political_events.5.a: Only time will tell the true nature of the movement.
loc.AST_political_events.6.desc: Earlier today, while the commemoration of the 1938 sesquicentenary unfolded and the pageant 'Australia's March to Nationhood' traversed through Sydney's main streets, a protest was held at Australia Hall.\n\nAboriginal rights activists and groups gathered to call attention to the fact that the 150th anniversary not only marked the beginning of British colonization, but also the constitutional discrimination of Aboriginal peoples. The activists demanded new laws for the education and care of Aboriginal peoples, as well as a new policy to allow for the elevation of Indigenous peoples to full citizen status.
loc.AST_political_events.7.desc: Following recent events, it can no longer be denied that Australian politics are shifting. [ENG.GetNameDefCap] has taken action to diplomatically ensure that [AST.GetName] remains on a path suitable for a nation under their Commonwealth umbrella, hoping that their peaceful nudge in the right direction shall be enough to keep their Dominion loyal.
loc.AST_political_events.7.a: Despite Britain's attempts, [AST.GetName] shall decide its own path.
loc.AST_political_events.9.desc: What began as a dispute over the loading of pig iron has ignited something far greater. Workers across Australia are walking off the job in solidarity, defying both government and industry. As strikes spread and tensions rise, the crisis spirals, and demands the resignation of those in power. And so, having failed entirely to control the situation, the government does just that, leaving the position of ruling party open for the [AST.GetCommunistParty] to claim.
loc.AST_political_events.10.desc:
Last night, troops in steel helmets were called out to quell a street riot in Brisbane. A soldier was fatally shot, and six other soldiers were wounded during the three-hour disturbance.

A crowd of nearly 1,000, including large numbers of servicemen and sailors, gathered outside a canteen at the corner of Creek and Adelaide Streets, either to participate in, or watch, the brawl that had arisen. Fire engines arrived with screeching sirens to part the crowd, but once they left, the melee commenced anew. Shouting crowds stormed the canteen entrance and shattered the building's windows, and military police had to swing their batons to disperse the crowd once more.

After an hour of disturbances, shots were fired, resulting in several wounded and one fatality. Military police reinforcements arrived to break up the riot once and for all, supported by all available civil police reserves and troops in steel helmets.
loc.AST_political_events.11.desc: After two centuries of British overlordship, [AST.GetName] is free. Unconstrained in matters of policy and reform, many decision-makers are eager to put forward their ideas; one such proposal has stirred public controversy.\n\nThe proposal concerns the [AST.GetAdjective] flag: should it be replaced to symbolize our recent partition?
loc.AST_political_events.11.a: A new flag shall be raised.
loc.AST_political_events.11.b: [AST.GetName]'s history is not to be erased; our flag shall remain.
loc.AST_political_events.13.a: Only time will tell how well they will succeed this time.
loc.AST_political_events.14.t: Appoint President of the Crown's Council
loc.AST_political_events.14.desc: The newly established Crown's Council shall assist the state by reviewing legislation and advising on policy, emergencies and constitutional matters. All statesmen appointed to the chamber will advise the head of state and the government, but a President shall preside over them all. The influence the President will wield over the Council's affairs cannot be underestimated, and so, the appointment must be made with great care.\n\nWho shall be appointed President of the Crown's Council?
loc.AST_political_events.14.a: British loyalist and industrial liasion, Adela Pankhurst Walsh
loc.AST_political_events.14.b: Former prime minister and fiercely patriotic, Billy Hughes.
loc.AST_political_events.14.c: The head of state himself, Alexander Hore-Ruthven.
loc.AST_canberra_air_disaster_events.1.desc:
Earlier today, a Lockheed Hudson aircraft crashed just outside Canberra. Among the ten people on board were the Chief of Army and his staff, who were answering a summons to a Cabinet meeting. They and the flight crew have all tragically perished.

What caused the crash is a mystery; the weather offered ideal flying conditions, and the flight was piloted by the experienced RAAF officer Flight Lieutenant Robert Hitchcock.

Regardless of the cause, it is a grim day for the entire nation — not least for the family and friends of the victims — and Australia now looks to its leaders. How will they respond?
loc.AST_canberra_air_disaster_events.1.a.tt: Unlocks §Y'Cabinet Trust' decisions§! and §Ymission§! to save or remove the sitting government.
loc.AST_canberra_air_disaster_events.2.desc: The sitting government has successfully led Australia through the national turmoil that followed the Canberra Air Disaster. Like a guiding light, the [AST.GetRulingParty] has proven its reliability and strength in trying times, ultimately increasing public support across the nation.
loc.AST_canberra_air_disaster_events.3.desc: Following a successful no-confidence motion, the sitting government is replaced at last, reluctantly handing the reins over to its successors. After a period of political instability and public distrust, Australia is ready for a new beginning.
loc.AST_canberra_air_disaster_events.3.a: A new leadership to Australia's aid.
loc.AST_canberra_air_disaster_events.4.desc: After a period of political instability and public distrust, [AST.GetRulingParty] replaces its leadership. A majority vote forces the Prime Minister to step down, and allows for his successor to take the podium.
loc.AST_canberra_air_disaster_events.4.a: Hopefully, this will pave the way for Australia.
loc.AST_canberra_air_disaster_events.5.desc: In a press conference, [AST.GetName] has thrown accusations our way, claiming we are responsible for a recent plane crash on Australian soil, resulting in the death of several political officials.\n\nThe accusations are completely false, of course, only making the disrespect all the more malicious.
loc.AST_canberra_air_disaster_events.5.a: The claims are false, we need not act.
loc.AST_canberra_air_disaster_events.6.desc: [JAP.GetNameDefCap] did not take our accusations lightly, deeming them a first act of aggression. [JAP.GetLeader] has escalated the conflict further, stating that it is now within his nation's full right to invade our lands.
loc.AST_canberra_air_disaster_events.6.a: We shall not increase tensions any more.
[ENG.GetNameDefCap]'s intervention, with its steady hand and firm guidance, has convinced the [AST.GetAdjective] Governor-General, Alexander Hore-Ruthven, that [AST.GetName] still cannot be entrusted to the hands of any democratic leader.

The democratic parties have shown their inability to lead [AST.GetName] through national crisis, and that inability cannot be tolerated, especially given the unstable state of [AST.GetName] and the world both; [ENG.GetNameDef] fears that if Hore-Ruthven's control ends, the recently arisen fascist sentiments within our country might be able to close their grasp around [AST.GetName]'s throat completely.

[AST.GetName] is in need of resolute leadership and unity, which Hore-Ruthven shall provide until further notice.

The New Guard and monarchist sympathizers have convinced the [AST.GetAdjective] Governor-General, Alexander Hore-Ruthven, that [AST.GetName] still cannot be entrusted to the hands of any democratic leader.\n\nThe democratic parties have shown their inability to lead [AST.GetName] through national crisis, and that inability cannot be tolerated, especially given the unstable world state. [AST.GetName] is in need of resolute leadership and unity, which Hore-Ruthven shall provide until further notice.
loc.INS_limited_war_events.1.desc: The enemy lines have broken and our men press forward unopposed. Across the Strait, the British client state crumbles beneath the weight of the people's anger. The puppets of London thought their bayonets would shield them from history. They were wrong.
loc.INS_limited_war_events.1.b: A fine day for the Republic.
loc.INS_limited_war_events.2.desc: What was promised as a swift strike against the puppet regime has soured. The [FROM.GetAdjective] forces, stiffened by their imperial paymasters, have driven our men from the contested ground and now sit upon it as occupiers. Every day the wireless carries word of their boasting. To press on invites further humiliation, but to withdraw is to confess defeat before the whole archipelago.
loc.INS_limited_war_events.2.a: Withdraw the men. Save what we can.
loc.INS_limited_war_events.2.b: We will not yield to the puppets!
loc.INS_limited_war_events.3.desc: Word has come from Kuala Lumpur. The puppet government, abandoned at the decisive hour by its London masters, has accepted our terms rather than see its towns burn. The disputed lands are ours. The lesson will not be lost on the other client states of the region.
loc.INS_limited_war_events.4.desc: [FROM.GetName] has thrown our offer back in our faces. The puppet ministers, reading from a script written in Whitehall, declare that no inch of soil shall be surrendered and that the Republic itself must be brought to heel before the guns fall silent.
loc.INS_limited_war_events.5.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has cast off the last pretense of measured war. Their broadcasts now speak openly of dismembering the Republic and parceling its islands among the old colonial masters. There will be no quiet ending to this affair. Either Indonesia stands at the close of it, or it does not stand at all.
loc.INS_limited_war_events.5.a: We stand or we fall together.
loc.INS_limited_war_events.6.desc: The [FROM.GetAdjective] thrust caught us unprepared and for a season we feared the worst. Yet their drive has run itself into the mud. Their men are tired, their lines are long, and the bluster from London grows thinner with each communique. The Republic may yet be magnanimous and offer the puppets a way to bow out of this affair, though many would say a clean victory serves the cause better than a measured one.
loc.INS_limited_war_events.7.t: Our Offensive Grinds to a Halt
loc.INS_limited_war_events.7.desc: Our advance has stalled, and worse than that, the enemy knows it. A demand has come from across the Strait. Lay down arms now and accept their terms, or watch the casualty lists grow longer for the same outcome. The choice they offer is the size of the funeral.
loc.INS_limited_war_events.7.a: Better a poor peace than a worse war.
loc.INS_limited_war_events.8.desc: [FROM.GetName] has answered our offer with defiance. Their ministers proclaim that they would sooner see every kampong from Penang to Johor put to the torch than yield a single concession to the Republic. So the war goes on.
loc.INS_limited_war_events.9.desc: Wireless intercepts from the enemy command have confirmed the worst. There will be no settlement, no measured peace, no return to the lines we held before. The puppets and their London masters demand the total surrender of the Republic, that Indonesia be broken on the wheel and her islands handed back to the imperialist boot from which we tore them. To this there is only one answer.
loc.INS_martial_law_events.1.t: [INS.GetNameDefCap] wants to strengthen trade relations with us
loc.INS_martial_law_events.1.desc: The President of [INS.GetName] has reached out to us to express their wishes to strengthen the trade relationship between us, and for [INS.GetName] to have a bigger role in the co-prosperity sphere. [INS.GetName]’s president, [INS.GetLeader] has offered an enticing deal wherein rubber and other resources will be sold to us without any fees or taxes, with market controls ensuring low prices.
loc.INS_martial_law_events.2.desc: [ROOT.GetLeader] has returned from his meeting with the [JAP.GetAdjective] government in [JAP.GetCapitalVictoryPointName] today with good news; The trade agreement proposed in [JAP.GetCapitalVictoryPointName] was agreed to by all parties and will be put into effect shortly.
loc.INS_martial_law_events.2.a: This will greatly benefit both of our economies!
loc.INS_martial_law_events.3.desc: [ROOT.GetLeader] has returned from his meeting with the [JAP.GetAdjective] government in [JAP.GetCapitalVictoryPointName] today with the unfortunate news that the negotiations went stale after both sides refused to concede on certain topics, resulting in no trade agreement being passed.
loc.INS_martial_law_events.4.t: [FROM.GetName] requests we recognize their Malay claims
loc.INS_martial_law_events.4.desc: An envoy from [FROM.GetNameDef] has presented our government with a formal request. President [FROM.GetLeader], who has proclaimed the unification of the Malay world to be his government's foremost goal, asks that we recognize the [INS.GetAdjective] claim to all ethnically Malay lands, from Sri Lanka to the Philippines.
loc.INS_martial_law_events.4.a: We will recognize their right to their historical lands.
loc.INS_martial_law_events.5.desc: The government of [FROM.GetName] has formally recognized our claim to the Malay lands. With the blessing of our most powerful ally, the unification of the Malay world is looking much more feasible.
loc.INS_martial_law_events.6.desc: The government of [FROM.GetName] has refused to recognize our claim to the Malay world. It seems our so-called allies would rather keep the Malay peoples divided than see us grow strong. We will remember this insult when the time comes.
loc.INS_martial_law_events.6.a: This is but a roadblock, we will persevere, we will succeed!
loc.INS_martial_law_events.7.desc: [FROM.GetName] has sent out a formal request that we honor our recognition of their Malay claims by organizing the transfer of Northern Malay to [FROM.GetName], which is currently controlled by [SIA.GetName]. This move may anger the [SIA.GetAdjective] leadership, however it would severely strengthen our ties with [INS.GetName].
loc.INS_martial_law_events.7.b: This is not worth creating conflict within the faction.
loc.INS_martial_law_events.8.desc: Despite their official recognition of our claims, the [JAP.GetAdjective] government has refused to mediate the transfer of Northern Malay, with [JAP.GetLeader] insisting they cannot risk conflict within the faction. It is clear their promises are empty and their words hold little meaning in the face of urgency.
loc.INS_martial_law_events.8.a: They have demonstrated an inability to follow through.
loc.INS_martial_law_events.9.t: [FROM.GetName] requests we transfer Northern Malay to [INS.GetNameDef]
loc.INS_martial_law_events.9.desc: [FROM.GetName] has informed us that [INS.GetName] has demanded we transfer Northern Malay to [INS.GetName] as part of their claim on all ethnically Malay territory. The [JAP.GetAdjective] government is officially backing the [INS.GetAdjective] claims, and [JAP.GetAdjective] advisors warn we may risk an armed conflict if we refuse.
loc.INS_martial_law_events.9.a: It is not as though we have a choice.
loc.INS_martial_law_events.9.b: We will not fall to imperialism!
loc.INS_martial_law_events.9.a.tt: §W§RWe risk being percieved as weak, which may lead to future concessions being demanded.§!§!
loc.INS_martial_law_events.10.desc: [JAP.GetName] has agreed to mediate the transfer of Northern Malay, and has sent envoys to negotiate in [SIA.GetCapitalVictoryPointName], together with [INS.GetAdjective] envoys. An agreement has been reached between the three parties, concluding that Northern Malay is, effective immediately, [INS.GetAdjective] territory.
loc.INS_martial_law_events.11.desc: [SIA.GetLeader] has refused to participate in a meeting, making it clear he has no intention of giving up Northern Malay regardless of the consequences. When we stated the severity of this decision, [SIA.GetLeader] was not persuaded and called our bluff, refusing to comply with any demands. Unfortunately, this leaves us without many options to continue.
loc.INS_martial_law_events.12.t: [FROM.GetName] informs us [SIA.GetName] has refused to comply
loc.INS_martial_law_events.12.desc: Envoys from [FROM.GetName] have arrived at [ROOT.GetCapitalVictoryPointName] bringing the unfortunate news that the [SIA.GetAdjective] has refused outright to comply to any transfer or negotiation, and that [JAP.GetNameDef] has formally kicked [SIA.GetNameDef] out of the faction.
loc.INS_martial_law_events.13.desc: [FROM.GetName] has informed us of their wish to secure overlordship over [SIA.GetName], due to [FROM.GetLeader]’s belief that [SIA.GetName] is a weak nation unable to stand up for itself, which was made abundantly clear by their immediate submission to the request of Northern Malay. The value [INS.GetName] has provided to the faction is not insignificant, and it seems we risk losing them as an ally if we do not comply with their request.
loc.INS_martial_law_events.14.desc: The government of [FROM.GetName] has agreed to place [SIA.GetNameDef] under our authority effective immediately.
loc.INS_martial_law_events.15.desc: The government of [FROM.GetName] has refused to transfer overlordship over [SIA.GetName] to us despite their demonstrated inability to defend themselves.
loc.INS_martial_law_events.16.desc: With the restructuring of our government to the Union of Indonesian Provinces, the previous system of a Presidential body overseeing a democratically elected council will be replaced with a new federal presidential system. We must elect a new President
loc.INS_martial_law_events.16.a: This is just an internal restructuring, keep the same leadership.
loc.INS_martial_law_events.16.d: A military governance is needed for now.
loc.AST_union_control_events.1.t: Foreign Agents in Our Trade Unions
loc.AST_union_control_events.1.desc: Intelligence services have brought a troubling report to the government's attention. Australian communist operatives have been making contact with local trade union leaders, distributing radical literature and encouraging workers to organise along revolutionary lines. The movement remains small for now, but security officials warn that this is precisely how such things begin. A decision must be made before it takes root.
loc.AST_union_control_events.1.a: Keep them under surveillance. We'll watch and wait.
loc.AST_union_control_events.4.desc: A shocking report has reached the government. A coordinated operation has seized one of our states and declared it part of the revolutionary government. The speed and organisation of the assault has raised uncomfortable questions — our intelligence services suspect the insurgents did not act alone, and that foreign hands may have guided them to our shores. Those who escaped the takeover have not surrendered. They have regrouped and taken up arms, determined to reclaim what was taken from them.
loc.AST_union_control_events.4.a: Find out who is behind this. These insurgents will not hold that ground for long.
loc.AST_union_control_events.4.a.tt: Anti-communist militia forces have rallied and formed to resist the communist occupation.
loc.AST_union_control_events.5.desc: The operation has ended in catastrophe. Our troops never made it ashore. They were turned back by loyalist patrols, lost in the straits, or captured before they could establish a position. The details are murky, but the outcome is not. Worse, the press has caught wind of the affair. Questions are now being asked in parliament about what exactly our forces were doing in those waters. The public response has been one of shock and embarrassment. Whatever gains we hoped to secure for the revolution, we will have to find another way.
loc.AST_union_control_events.5.a: A terrible setback. We must turn to other avenues to support our comrades.
loc.AST_union_control_events.3.desc: The workers of [MAL.GetNonIdeologyName] have risen up. Communist cells nurtured through our long campaign have taken up arms across the country — but the picture from the field is troubling. The revolutionary forces have found themselves concentrated in the wrong areas, separated from the heart of the peninsula by water and jungle. Without a foothold on the mainland, the government will simply wait them out and starve the revolution before it can spread. Australia must act covertly and quickly to land fighters on the peninsula and give the revolution the ground it needs to survive.
loc.AST_union_control_events.3.a: We cannot let the revolution die on the beach. Secure them a foothold.
loc.AST_union_control_events.2.desc: Agents of the Australian communist government have arrived in our cities. They are not hiding — pamphlets are distributed at factory gates, speeches delivered in public squares, and solidarity networks established between Australian operatives and local radical groups. The existing networks of foreign influence appear to have been reinvigorated overnight. This is a coordinated campaign, and the government must decide how to respond before popular discontent becomes something harder to manage.
loc.ABDA_events.1.t: An Invitation to a New Supreme Command
loc.ABDA_events.1.desc: [FROM.GetNameDef] has established a joint supreme command for the Pacific theatre and has extended an invitation for us to join. The initiative — known as ABDACOM — seeks to pool the naval, air, and ground forces of allied nations operating in the region under a unified command structure. Membership would mean closer coordination with [FROM.GetNameDef] and the other partners already committed to the effort. We must decide whether to accept.
loc.ABDA_events.1.b: We cannot commit to this at the present time.
loc.ABDA_events.2.desc: [FROM.GetNameDef] has accepted our invitation to join the ABDACOM Supreme Command. Their forces will now operate under the joint command structure, strengthening our position in the Pacific theatre.
loc.ABDA_events.3.desc: [FROM.GetNameDef] has declined our invitation to join the ABDACOM Supreme Command. Their forces will not be committed to the joint effort at this time, though the door may yet remain open.
loc.ABDA_events.5.desc: [FROM.GetNameDef] has extended an invitation for us to join the American-British-Dutch-Australian Command. ABDACOM has already established itself as the supreme coordinating authority for Allied forces in the Pacific theatre, bringing together the navies and armies of the major Allied powers under one command. Membership would bring our forces into this unified structure, with access to shared intelligence, coordinated doctrine, and the full weight of Allied support. We must decide.
loc.ABDA_events.5.b: We cannot commit to this at the present time.
loc.ABDA_events.4.desc: With Singapore designated as a linchpin of the ABDACOM defensive perimeter, our commanders must decide how to invest in its fortifications. We can prioritise the naval approaches and harbour defences, harden the landward approaches against an overland assault, or spread our resources across both. Each course of action will shape how Singapore can be defended when the enemy comes.
loc.ABDA_events.4.a: Reinforce the naval approaches. Singapore's strength is its harbour.
loc.ABDA_events.4.b: Fortify the landward perimeter. The real threat will come overland.
loc.ABDA_events.4.c: A balanced approach. No single avenue of attack must go undefended.
loc.ABDA_fortress_singapore_choice_tt: Completing this focus will present a choice for how to fortify Singapore.
loc.ABDA_faction_membership_requirement_tt: Eligible faction members will receive invites to join.
loc.INS_republic_founded: Republic of Indonesia has been founded
loc.INS_islamist_loyalty: Government is supported by Islamic parties
loc.INS_socialist_loyalty: Government is supported by Socialist parties
loc.INS_communist_loyalty: Government is supported by Communist parties
loc.INS_nationalize_companies_tt: All Military Industrial Organizations and Industrial Concerns will be nationalized and given a new name.
loc.INS_is_union_tt_NOT: Has not formed the Netherlands-Indonesia Union
loc.INS_denounce_soetardjo_tt: We will begin planning an underground revolution, infiltrating the government and establishing guerilla cells across the archipelago. Once we are sufficiently prepared, we will begin a guerilla war of independence against the Dutch.
loc.INS_soetardjo_petition_debate_done_tt: The Volksraad debate on Soetardjo's petition for autonomy has concluded
loc.INS_the_declaration_of_independence_desc: We cannot risk waiting any longer, we must strike while the iron is hot! We should send our militias to seize control of ports, cities, and industrial centres quickly enough that the Dutch authorities will not have time to react. Then, we will declare independence, proclaiming the Republic of Indonesia.
loc.INS_the_declaration_of_independence_tt:
We will declare §YIndependence§!. Every state where we established a §YMilitia Base§! or §YHeadquarters§! will be under our control, with the rest staying with [HOL.GetNameDef]

[HOL.GetNameDefCap] will not recognize our sovereignty and a low-intensity conflict will commence. This could escalate to a §Rwar§!.

Unlocks land raids to take over states.
loc.INS_laskar_rakjat_desc: The revolution is made up of many various militias across Indonesia, some big and some small. Organizing the militias is a necessary step to achieve victory. We mustn't be too hasty, however, as empowering militias with ties to our political rivals could pose catastrophe.
loc.INS_militia_tt: Creates a new §YFreedom Fighter§! militia division template and unlocks decisions to manage them.
loc.INS_militia_warning_tt: Militias are §Ysemi-autonomous§! groups of freedom fighters. They will fight for us, but their help is not free. They will expect to receive compensation for their efforts. §RStability will be drastically impacted if demands are not met!§!
loc.INS_big_militia_presence_tt: Will be controlled by our Militias upon declaring independence.
loc.INS_prepare_raiding_bases_desc: We will utilize our network of spies to establish bunkers across the entire archipelago in secret, ensuring we are prepared to strike once the revolution begins.
loc.INSHOL_dutch_east_indies_desc: The colony was founded nearly 500 years ago, and has taken many shapes since then. The world is changing quickly, and our actions now will dictate the future of Dutch-Indonesian relations far into the future.
loc.INSHOL_the_war_in_europe_desc: The conflict in Europe is rapidly escalating, and the Netherlands is now at war. We can no longer rely on them to protect us and must stand our ground, or else we risk being overtaken by foreign powers.
loc.INSHOL_military_equipment_contracts_desc: The Indies is a vast archipelago with tens of millions of citizens. We are far from having the Industrial capacity necessary to defend ourselves. However, we have enough resources to secure trade all across the world. By securing contracts with Democracies across the world, our problem can be solved.
loc.INSHOL_hawk_75a7_desc: The American Hawk 75A-7 fighter is the perfect plane for the Indies, affordable and powerful. We can secure a deal with the manufacturer in order to make the much needed improvements to our Air Force.
loc.INSHOL_purchase_american_tanks_desc: While the Indies lacks the industry needed for Tank Manufacturing, we can purchase them directly from the United States funded by the Indies rubber industry.
loc.INSHOL_purchase_british_artillery_desc: We can outsource our Artillery manufacturing to the United Kingdom, allowing us to prioritize other equipment.
loc.INSHOL_produce_own_goods_desc: While we have plenty of lucrative trade deals we can secure, we must not forget about our own production lines and military industrial companies. We should subsidize said companies so that we can decrease our dependence on foreign imports.
loc.INSHOL_east_indies_investments_desc: A good overlord is one that invests in the development of her Colonies. Investing into the economic development of the Indies is in our best interest, and beneficial for the citizens of the Colony.
loc.INSHOL_east_indies_student_exchange_desc: Creating a system where Indonesians can move to the Netherlands to study in our Universities can be a significant boon to the economy of the Netherlands and Indies alike.
loc.INSHOL_east_indies_fokker_division: Form an East Indies Fokker Division
loc.INSHOL_east_indies_fokker_division_desc: Fokker is being licensed by the Indies Air Force enough to where it is worth considering creating a dedicated subsidiary prioritizing the Indies Air Force.
loc.INSHOL_expand_shell_desc: Shell is gradually becoming a larger part of our economy. It is clear we must expand the oil infrastructure in the Indies to keep up with Shell's export capacity.
loc.INSHOL_increase_funding_for_tix: Increase Funding for the T.IX Airplane Project
loc.INSHOL_increase_funding_for_tix_desc: Engineers at Fokker are developing a new twin-engine bomber to replace the obsolete models used by the Indies Air Force. This project has a very low budget, and is likely to not be completed for a very long time. We can increase their funding to greatly speed up progress.
loc.INSHOL_reduce_land_ownership_taxes_desc: We should reduce the tax placed on Indonesian citizens that own land, encouraging the development of farms and businesses.
loc.INSHOL_coffee_plantations_desc: We should focus on obtaining more state-owned land in the eastern islands. We can use this land to build Coffee plantations.
loc.INSHOL_overallwagen_desc: Tanks are not necessarily the solution for the East Indies Army. We lack the industrial strength necessary to produce them, and the harsh terrain renders them niche. We could invest in building Armored Cars for Indonesia to fill the gap.
loc.INSHOL_eastern_development_fund: Development Fund for the Eastern Islands
loc.INSHOL_eastern_development_fund_desc: We focus too much on investments into Java and Sumatra, ignoring most of the Colonies land. We must commit to developing infrastructure in the East to allow for future industrialization.
loc.INSHOL_increase_rubber_taxes_desc: Many rubber companies in the Indies are acquiring great wealth using the resources of the Colony. It is only fair we put a hefty tax on these operations.
loc.INSHOL_reform_knil_desc: Since the East Indies completed its conquest of the entire archipelago, the Royal Netherlands East Indies Army has remained immobile and has a severe lack of funding. With rising tensions worldwide, we must begin rearming the Indies sooner rather than later.
loc.INSHOL_fund_ml_knil_desc: If we want to keep up with the armies of the world, we must build a proper air force of our own, otherwise we will be at a significant disadvantage.
loc.INSHOL_bandung_aircraft_facility_tt: §YWest Java:§!\n    Add §G1§! Building Slots and §G1§! §YMilitary Factory§! per prerequisite focus completed.
loc.INSHOL_rangers_desc: The Indies is a vast archipelago with a diverse environment. We should train Rangers adapted to combat in these harsh environments, to ensure we are ready to defend them.
loc.INSHOL_mountaineers_desc: We should train Mountaineers that are prepared to fight in the hostile terrain of our archipelago.
loc.INSHOL_elevate_elite_infantry_desc: We cannot rely on great war strategies forever, we must adapt to new technologies and ensure we do not fall behind. We should establish several elite infantry divisions that are ready to defend all sorts of environments.
loc.INSHOL_modernize_knil_desc: We will study new strategies and doctrines for the East Indies Army, ensuring we maintain an advantage on the enemy.
loc.INSHOL_transfer_of_henri_winkelman_desc: Henri Winkelman previously served in the KNIL for many years. It is clear he is needed in the Indies once more, and we should arrange for his formal transfer to the East Indies.
loc.INSHOL_eastern_conscription_desc: There are several indigenous auxiliary corps on Java and Madura which are controlled by local princely rulers. In these dire times, we could negotiate an agreement with the local rulers wherein these divisions will be under our authority.
loc.INSHOL_establish_vk_knil_desc: We will establish a Women's Volunteer Corps for the KNIL. Their contributions will serve an important role in improving our logistics and communications.
loc.INSHOL_emergency_dockyard_construction_d: The threat of a naval invasion cannot be understated, we must prioritize our naval defense as our top priority.
loc.INSHOL_emergency_powers_gov_general: Emergency Powers For the Governor General
loc.INSHOL_emergency_powers_gov_general_desc: The ongoing war requires hard decisions to be made without delay, which is not possible when all decisions in the Indies must go through the Netherlands beforehand. We should grant emergency authority to [INS.GetLeader] so that he can act without delay.
loc.INSHOL_emergency_naval_purchases_desc: Our coasts are unsafe and insufficiently defended. Time is of the essence, we must obtain a stronger navy or we will surely perish. We will purchase ships from private companies using debt, and refit them into naval destroyers.
loc.INSHOL_east_indies_navy_desc: [INS.GetNameDefCap] lacks an official Navy, leaving the Netherlands in charge of defending the colony. With the increasing tension in Europe and Asia, this will not continue to work. We must take the first step toward founding a dedicated [INS.GetAdjective] navy.
loc.INSHOL_marines_desc: We should establish a dedicated Indies Marine Corps under the new Navy, and send marines in training to learn on Dutch ships.
loc.INSHOL_domestic_ship_production_desc: If we want our Navy to stand against our neighbors, we must begin to ramp up domestic ship production.
loc.INSHOL_destroyers_desc: Our heavier warships cannot work the narrow seas of the archipelago without escorts to screen them. By laying down modern destroyers, the [ROOT.GetAdjective] navy can guard its shipping lanes and drive off torpedo craft across the straits.
loc.INSHOL_cruisers_desc: A fleet without battleships must rest its weight on its cruisers. Building a strong cruiser squadron gives the [ROOT.GetAdjective] navy a hard core able to patrol the long distances between the islands and answer any raider that enters our waters.
loc.INSHOL_submarines_desc: The straits of the East Indies are made for ambush, and a submarine costs far less than the warship it sends to the bottom. A strong submarine arm lets the [ROOT.GetAdjective] navy hold the sea lanes and strike at enemy shipping without ever showing itself.
loc.INSHOL_outsourced_navy_desc: We have enough expenses as it is, we cannot continue to divert more and more of the colonial budget to the Navy. We can pay corporations to handle production for us.
loc.INSHOL_divert_civilian_to_navy: Divert Civilian & Army Spending to the Navy
loc.INSHOL_divert_civilian_to_navy_desc: With the current state of the world, the risk of a naval invasion is higher than ever. We cannot afford to be frugal, we must divert funding from all sectors of government towards the Navy.
loc.INSHOL_begin_negotiations_soetardjo_desc: Soetardjo's petition for autonomy is promising, giving us an opportunity to compromise between the Nationalists and Loyalists. We should begin official negotiations with his party.
loc.INSHOL_urge_gov_veto_desc: The Soetardjo Petition is a nationalist scheme the Indies government is falling for. We must urge the Governor General to veto the petition immediately, else we risk losing our colony.
loc.INSHOL_eventual_autonomy_desc: The Indonesian desire for independence is strong and is not slowing down. We will agree to eventual autonomy for the Indies, but only once the colony has proven it can sustain itself, and will continue to uphold democratic ideals.
loc.INSHOL_autonomous_dominion_desc: Despite the unreasonable definition 'self-reliance' set by the Netherlands which we must meet for the terms of the Soetardjo petition to be valid, the Indonesian desire for independence is strong enough that we managed to meet these requirements. As per the agreement, we will declare total and unconditional independence from the Dutch crown.
loc.INS_cannot_become_independent_tt: §W§Y[INS.GetFlag][INS.GetNameDefCap]§! will be §Rpermanently locked out of becoming independent§! without foreign intervention.§!
loc.INSHOL_sideline_the_volksraad_desc: The petition called by Soetardjo is in clear violation of Article 1 of the Dutch Constitution, and will only cause difficulty for the Indies administration. The petition must be vetoed.
loc.INSHOL_prioritize_dutch_profits_desc: We will focus our effort on increasing profits for the homeland. Their economic stability is for the good of the Kingdom as a whole.
loc.INSHOL_development_loans_netherlands_des: We can take out loans from Dutch companies to speed up our industrialization effort. While we will utilize our position as a developing colony to guarantee low interest rates, we will still have to pay interest.
loc.INSHOL_request_economic_dev_subsidy_desc: We have proven our value to our overlord as a profitable colony. We can utilize this as bargaining material to get industrial development subsidies.
loc.INSHOL_loyalty_to_crown_desc: The East Indies is many things, but above all we are a loyal Dutch colony. Queen Wilhelmina will guide us to victory. We must not allow Nationalism to end nearly 500 years of history, and continue to affirm our absolute loyalty to the Crown.
loc.INS_expand_batavia_med_school_tt: §Y$INS_dutch_east_indies$§!: Research Speed modifier is at least §G1.00%§!.
loc.INS_subsidize_local_business_desc: We should give subsidies to local businesses to stimulate economic growth, boosting our economy in the long run.
loc.INSHOL_education_reforms_desc: Many citizens of the East Indies lack the ability to get an education, and very few have graduated from secondary school. If we want the East Indies to become a wealthy industrialized state, we must ensure education is properly accessible to the population.
loc.INS_expand_batavia_med_school_desc: Expanding the Batavia Medical School by building new campus facilities and hiring more professors will make further education much more accessible, which is vital for our long term economic growth.
loc.INS_prepare_for_policy_shift_desc: The political landscape in the Indies has been impacted by the national awakening of the past decades, and our current policies are clearly outdated. We should consider making some changes in our governing structure.
loc.INS_reallocate_rubber_industry_funding_d: Our reliance on selling rubber has had a disastrous effect on our economy. We should diversify our economy by prospecting for resources and opening mines and factories across the archipelago. This will not be a cheap endeavour, so we will have to reduce the budget for maintaining rubber plantations.
loc.INS_reallocate_rubber_industry_funding_t: Unlocks a decision to §Yremove rubber from a state§! and replace it with smaller quantities of §Yother resources§!.
loc.INSHOL_nationalist_coallition_desc: The Volksraad has spoken with one voice for too long, and that voice has been too quiet. The time for petitions and patient deferrals is past. A coalition of the chamber's nationalist members will set aside their quarrels and demand unconditional independence. Older voices from outside the chamber, men the Dutch once thought safely sidelined, will be welcomed back into the fold.
loc.INSHOL_volksraad_compromises_desc: Reform within the chamber has carried us this far and there is no reason to abandon the road now. The Volksraad will continue its careful work, trading concession for concession with The Hague, pursuing self-rule through patience rather than rupture. A future inside a Dutch commonwealth offers more than a future spent fighting for one outside it.
loc.INSHOL_establish_the_princely_council_de: The sultans and rajas of the archipelago command loyalties that no chamber in Batavia ever has. Their courts are older than the Company and older than the Republic that succeeded it. A formal council of the princely houses will give these rulers a seat at the table of the new nation, and bind their authority to ours.
loc.INSHOL_nationalize_dutch_companies_desc: The great trading houses, the shipping lines, the plantation concerns and the banks have worn Dutch names for as long as anyone can remember. They will wear Indonesian ones from now on. The boards will be reseated, the signs taken down, and the capital that was extracted from these islands for three centuries will at last belong to the islands themselves.
loc.INSHOL_democracy_desc: The Volksraad began its life as a half-measure, an advisory body with carefully limited teeth, designed to offer the appearance of representation while withholding the substance. It has outgrown its makers. The chamber will be reconstituted as a true legislature, with members chosen by the people it claims to represent and decisions binding on the government that once kept it on a short leash.
loc.INSHOL_princely_authority_desc: A council of advisors is a fine thing in its place, but the sultans who lent their names to the founding of this nation may yet lend more than that. The parliament will not stand in the way of those who would see one of their number raised above the rest. The old courts have waited a long time for this question to be asked of them again.
loc.INSHOL_encourage_further_investment_desc: The terms agreed at the Volksraad have settled the political question for now, and Dutch capital has taken note. Tariffs will be eased, guarantees extended, and the chambers of commerce in Amsterdam and Rotterdam reassured that the archipelago remains open for business. What was profitable under the old arrangement will be profitable under the new one.
loc.INSHOL_east_indies_artillery_desc: Opening up artillery manufacturing facilities in Java will allow us to rely less on foreign trade for our military effort.
loc.INSHOL_recall_gerardus_johannes_berensch: Gerardus Johannes Berenschot is one of the most talented Generals in the Commonwealth. He has spent the majority of his career in the Indies but has spent several years in the Netherlands. In these dire times, we must recall him to the Indies to help in the war effort.
loc.INSHOL_east_indies_cruiser_manufacturing: Manufacturing our own Cruiser ships instead of ordering them directly from the Dutch is the first step towards forming a real Navy, a necessary effort considering the Japanese threat.
loc.INSHOL_transfer_of_conrad_helfrich: Transfer Conrad Helfrich to the Indies
loc.INSHOL_transfer_of_conrad_helfrich_desc: Transferring Admiral Conrad Helfrich to the Indies directly will critically improve the naval effort in the Indies.
loc.INSHOL_naval_program_desc: The East Indies Navy is far behind other navies, even colonial navies. It is in the best interest of all parties that we aid in the development of this new navy, in order to ensure hasty progress.
loc.INSHOL_naval_program_transfer_25_tt: Transfer §Y25%§! of our naval forces to [INS.GetNameDef].
loc.INSHOL_naval_program_transfer_25_2_tt: §Y[HOL.GetFlag] [HOL.GetNameDefCap]§! will transfer §Y25%§! of their naval forces to §Y[INS.GetNameDefCap]§!.
loc.INSHOL_naval_program_transfer_100_2_tt: §Y[HOL.GetFlag] [HOL.GetNameDefCap]§! will transfer their entire navy to §Y[INS.GetNameDefCap]§!.
loc.INSHOL_hybrid_navy_desc: Our Navy cannot rely only on taking over the pacific fleet of [HOL.GetNameDef], we must begin manufacturing our own ships or else one mistake may cut off our entire naval supply.
loc.INSHOL_request_naval_control_desc: [HOL.GetNameDefCap] has fallen and is in no place to operate an entire navy. We should take control over it for the remainder of the war.
loc.INSHOL_naval_secondchance_desc: While [HOL.GetNameDef] have refused to sign over control over the Navy, we still need to defend the pacific unless we wish to be overtaken. While it may not work out as well as if they agreed to our proposal, we will figure out a good-enough alternative.
loc.INSHOL_netherlands_in_exile_desc: The tragic fall of our kingdom is now a reality. We cannot sink to the point of defeatism. We must accept what has happened and focus on what we can salvage.
loc.INSHOL_relocate_our_generals_desc: The remaining exiled Generals, Commanders, and holdout Soldiers must be relocated to [1058.GetName] with utmost priority, before it is too late.
loc.INSHOL_netherlands_indonesia_union_desc: The concept of an equal union state between [HOL.GetNameDef] and [INS.GetNameDef] is laughable to many, but with the crisis we find ourselves in it is looking like the only way to maximize our chance of maintaining sovereignty.
loc.INS_underground_revolution_desc: We will begin planning a revolution from the shadows, slowly increasing membership and militia activity until we are ready to strike.
loc.INS_infiltrate_the_media_desc: Our movement has secured the membership of several high-ranking members of media organizations in the Indies. We can use this to our advantage to subtly plant pro-revolutionary sentiment in the minds of citizens.
loc.INS_infiltrate_the_army_desc: Many of our members are enlisted in the KNIL, from low ranking soldiers to majors. We should collect as many secrets as possible, while elevating our own to high positions. Once we pull the trigger, we can stir chaos in the KNIL.
loc.INS_privately_owned_military_industry_de: We will establish several shadow corporations in the military industrial sector, ensuring we will retain control over military industry once the revolution has begun.
loc.INS_instigate_chaos_sulawesi_desc: We will cooperate with local nationalists in Sulawesi, organizing strikes, riots, and radicalizing the population.
loc.INS_instigate_chaos_sulawesi_tt: Once we declare independence, we will gain a §Gcore§! on §Y[673.GetName]§! and §Y[1056.GetName]§!. They will continue to be uncored by the Dutch East Indies.
loc.INS_instigate_chaos_medan_desc: We will cooperate with local nationalists in Medan and Riouw, organizing strikes, riots, and radicalizing the population.
loc.INS_instigate_chaos_medan_tt: Once we declare independence, we will get a §Gcore§! on §Y[1049.GetName]§!. It will continue to be uncored by the Dutch East Indies.
loc.INS_embezzlement_scheme_in_batavia_desc: We will setup a scheme to move our production from Batavia to republican territory upon declaring independence.
loc.INS_embezzlement_scheme_in_batavia_tt: Upon declaring independence, half of all factories in §Y[1058.GetName]§! will be relocated to our §YRevolutionary Headquarters§!.
loc.INS_volksraad_rumors_desc: We will begin discreetly discussing the revolution within the Volksraad. If we are successful, we can convince the Indonesian Volksraad members to join our cause.
loc.INS_volksraad_rumors_tt: All §YIndonesian §!Volksraad advisors will be §Gkept§! after declaring independence.
loc.INS_railway_youth_force: Cooperate With the Railway Youth Force
loc.INS_railway_youth_force_desc: The railway youth force is an Islamic youth militia group primarily active in Central Java, named after their strategy of seizing railways. They would make for a valuable ally, however, they are energetic and want to engage in combat. They will become unhappy with the government if we stay in a ceasefire for too long.
loc.INS_sleeper_informant_network_desc: We will create an informant network that is embedded throughout the KNIL administrative apparatus, giving us advance warning of enemy plans.
loc.INS_the_peoples_security_army_desc: Our members, which are primarily young Indonesians are growing impatient, eager to contribute and fight for our Independence. We should establish a Revolutionary Armed Forces and begin training our future soldiers.
loc.INS_commander_sudirman_desc: Sudirman, despite being a young up-and-comer has shown great potential and is very popular among the young members of the resistance. He should guide the path of the People's Security Army and lead us to victory.
loc.INS_commander_oerip_desc: Oerip has served decades in the army and is the only Indonesian to ever be promoted to Major in the KNIL. His knowledge and experience far outreaches that of any other member. He should guide the path of the People's Security Army and lead us to victory.
loc.INS_sudirmans_promotion_desc: Sudirman has shown great leadership skills, and has orchestrated several successful assaults. It is time we recognize our Commander's efforts by giving him the title of General that he deserves.
loc.INS_tkr_steal_general_desc: If we can convince high-ranking members of the East Indies Army to join our cause, we'll simultaneously improve our army while sabotaging theirs.
loc.INS_tkr_supply_desc: We will ensure every member of our movement receives formal military training, no exceptions.
loc.INS_tkr_professional_army_desc: We mustn't rely only on militias, we should develop a professional Republican army to maintain order.
loc.INS_arm_the_revolutionaries_desc: We must begin with the revolutionaries and nationalists who are full of energy and ready to give everything they have for Indonesia. We will provide them with training and equipment they need to fight for their country.
loc.INS_arm_the_youth_desc: Beyond the revolutionaries, we must arm the youth. Still full of energy and hope, they will carry the flame of the revolution. We must ensure as many Indonesian young adults as possible are trained and equipped for combat. If fighting reaches their homes, they will be ready to act.
loc.INS_arm_the_students_desc: Students have built the foundation of the revolution since decades ago, and they will continue to lead it forward.
loc.INS_guerilla_industry_desc: We will utilize our guerilla forces across the archipelago in order to seize control of factories, allowing us to produce new guns to arm our militias with.
loc.INS_indonesian_assault_doctrine_desc: Soldiers are not all there is to a war. A million men means nothing if they do not have guns to fight with. We must prioritize obtaining high-quality artillery in order to push deeper into enemy-controlled territory.
loc.INS_tighter_tkr_integration_desc: The People’s Security Army and the various militia forces do not operate in unity, and coordination is limited. This is only going to cause more and more problems as the war continues, we need to intertwine the armed forces and militias into one unified organization, despite the inevitable protests from militia officers.
loc.INS_quality_over_quantity_desc: One well trained soldier with a thought-out strategy and modern equipment will beat five students with pistols. We must prioritize high-quality, well-armed soldiers and special forces over mobilizing as many soldiers as possible.
loc.INS_add_3_militia_unit_tt: Create three §YFreedom Fighter§! units, which can be used in §Yraids§! to increase §Gmilitia presence§! in Dutch states.
loc.INS_expand_resistance_membership_desc: Centering our entire movement in one base will guarantee failure. We will draft members into groups of militias to send as envoys that will increase our popularity and control in various regions.
loc.INS_deploy_the_kris_desc: The Indonesian People's Service of Sulawesi, known in Indonesian as the KRIS are an active group of Militias and form the majority of militia presence in Sulawesi and Manado. We should recruit them to formally fight alongside the TKR.
loc.INS_assist_the_pemuda_desc: Java is full of various Pemuda student militias. Joining forces with them and providing military assistance in their missions against the Dutch might secure us a useful ally.
loc.INS_mobilize_the_pemuda_desc: Now that we have successfully earned the trust of the largest Pemuda groups, we should begin plans to mobilize them into the TKR.
loc.INS_organize_jakarta_pemuda_desc: Java has many Pemuda groups of all sizes. While we have mobilized and recruited most of them, there are dozens of small ones in Jakarta still acting independently. We must contact them and establish collaboration.
loc.INS_recognize_moestopos_batallion_desc: A revolutionary named Moestopo has declared himself as the self-proclaimed 'Acting Minister of Defense' in Surabaya, maintaining control of the militia forces in Surabaya. His efforts deserve formal recognition, we should formally promote him to Major General of the TKR.
loc.INS_darul_islam_focus_desc: Kartosoewirjo's hizbullah have proved themselves in the hills of West Java, and we cannot afford to leave such fighters outside our ranks. Let his irregulars stand among our own, and let the man himself bear the rank he has earned. The faithful will press their case in the Republic soon enough.
loc.INS_just_a_fisherman_desc: Fighting a war in an archipelago without a Navy is a difficult task and not one we can sustain much longer. We will try a possibly naive strategy, wherein we will send militias on fishing boats disguised as fishermen to Dutch-controlled ports.
loc.INS_a_cheap_navy_desc: We do not have the time or money to build a big modern navy. We must make due with what we have, and scrap together anything we can find.
loc.INS_divert_army_funds_to_navy: Divert Army Funds to the Navy
loc.INS_divert_army_funds_to_navy_desc: Indonesia is an archipelago, our infantry are nothing without ships to transport them. It is a worthy sacrifice to divert funding from the TKR to our new Navy.
loc.INS_indonesian_naval_doctrine_desc: Now that we are building a navy of our own, it is important to consider the doctrine by which we will fight and train. We should prioritize forming and adopting a Naval Doctrine as soon as possible.
loc.INS_domestic_shipbuilding_desc: We cannot rely on captured and purchased ships forever, it will not be long until there are no more Dutch ships left for us to capture. We should start building our own ships early.
loc.INS_acquire_modern_blueprints_desc: We will purchase blueprints from other countries and private corporations that we will use to construct our new Navy.
loc.INS_reclaiming_the_dutch_navy_desc: The Dutch have left plenty of ships stationed in ports we now occupy. We should claim these ships for ourselves while we have the chance.
loc.INS_admiral_mas_pardi_desc: Any good navy needs an Admiral to command it. Mas Pardi is the obvious choice.
loc.INS_akademi_angkatan_laut_desc: We will construct a Naval Academy with facilities for Naval research, while educating more citizens into Engineers and Admirals.
loc.INS_pki_militia_tt: Tan Malaka has a very powerful militia, however, they fight not only for the will of Indonesia but for the will of §Rcommunism§! and the Soviet. §REventually, they will oppose any non-communist government violently.§!
loc.INS_increase_laskar_funding_tt: §WGain§! 1§Y Military Factory§! for every demand successfully granted to a militia (maximum of §G6§!)
loc.INS_subsidize_laskar_armament_desc: Militias fighting with bamboo spears are not going to survive for long against heavily armed units. We need to prioritize producing more guns and ammunition for these militias.
loc.INS_loot_knil_weapons_caches_desc: There are plenty of weapons caches the KNIL deposited before the revolution. Many of our members are former members of the KNIL, and we may be able to find and loot these caches.
loc.INS_utilize_tan_malakas_militia_desc: Tan Malaka's Red Militia is perhaps the strongest singular militia in all of Indonesia, and it would be a huge boon to mobilize them in the TKR. This does not come without risks, giving a powerful militia with strong political motives this much influence will make it much easier for them to seize power for themselves.
loc.INS_increase_laskar_funding_desc: Our Militias make up the majority of our forces. We need to acknowledge this and fund them accordingly, even if they are not completely loyal to [INS.GetLeader].
loc.INS_develop_a_functioning_airforce_desc: An Air force has a big impact on an army, we should prioritize creating one.
loc.INS_political_stabilization_desc: In order to end the infighting between the many political factions in Indonesia, we must grant concessions to the other factions, allowing us to focus on the ongoing conflict. We will establish a semi-democratic committee overseen by the President, serving as a parliamentary body for Indonesia.
loc.INS_nationalize_desc: Our newly independent republic is still plagued with remnants of Dutch rule. The military industrial companies, the oil companies, the agricultural companies, and many others are all tied to the Netherlands, be it directly or indirectly. For our Republic to truly be independent, we must establish our own national institutions to inherit the Indonesian assets from these corporations.
loc.INS_restore_order_desc: Our nation is becoming more unstable for each passing day. If we do not react soon a civil war is all but inevitable. We must start negotiations between the National Committee, President, and Militia leaders to find a solution.
loc.INS_vice_presidential_edict_desc: The National Committee is almost unanimous in its demand for real legislative power. A petition has been handed to the President proposing a Hybrid system, where the National Committee will become an independent parliament, sharing joint legislative powers with the President. The offer is enticing, but there is a risk of Presidential power becoming negligible.
loc.INS_local_cooperatives_desc: We should not create a capitalist system like that in the west, but we should not disregard the economic benefit privatization provides. We will allow for the creation of local cooperatives, wherein their success will grant riches to their owners. However, they will be overseen by the government, and will be forbidden from expanding outside of their locality.
