loc.INS_local_unity_desc: We will grant partial autonomy to Princely States, as a temporary measure to decrease infighting during these already hectic times.
loc.INS_education_subsidies_desc: Investing in the future of the nations youths is absolutely necessary if we want an economically successful state. We will construct affordable schools across the republic.
loc.INS_land_reform_desc: The Netherlands directly owned large quantities of land before we declared independence. We should distribute this land to any Indonesian who will make use of it for low prices in order to encourage economic growth.
loc.INS_dominion_of_atjeh_desc: The separatist movement in Atjeh is large, and growing. There is no reason to escalate the situation, we should instead negotiate a compromise wherein they stay a part of Indonesia, while being mostly autonomous.
loc.INS_dissolve_national_party_desc: The Hybrid system was created as a necessary compromise to avoid chaos. We should not allow the President to hold this much power undemocratically. The president must be deposed by parliament or else we will never achieve democracy.
loc.INS_womens_sufferage_desc: Extending the vote to women will lead to short term instability, but is necessary for long term stability and democracy.
loc.INS_women_in_military_desc: Allowing women to serve in the military is necessary to ensure our armed forces are as powerful as possible.
loc.INS_fair_election_desc: With the President deposed, and the revolution over, we can finally hold the first truly fair election, with no authoritarian influence.
loc.INS_continue_hybrid_politics_desc: Hybrid politics is a necessary evil. While the end goal is true democracy, Indonesia is far too young and unstable for all power to be handed to the people. The President and Parliament will continue to moderate each other, ensuring neither body becomes too powerful.
loc.INS_guided_economy_desc: We will oversee the economy of Indonesia directly to ensure we maintain control. We will nationalize all banks, as well as the oil and agricultural sectors.
loc.INS_reform_education_system_desc: The revolution was proof that students and youths upset with the social order will always lead the rebellion. For the safety of our government and nation, we will require that schools teach according to our government ideology.
loc.INS_reform_education_system_2_desc: If we want Indonesia to become a wealthy nation in the future, all Indonesians, regardless of birthplace must be entitled to an education.
loc.INS_three_year_plan_desc: We can establish a three year plan to build infrastructure across the archipelago and connect the islands.
loc.INS_destroy_pacific_colonialism_desc: The revolution may have ended, but there are still battles to be fought. There are still many people living under colonial tyranny at our doorstep. We cannot idly sit and watch, we must take action to liberate them from their overlords!
loc.INS_rapid_mobilization_desc: Any strong nation has a strong army to stand on. If we want to become a regional superpower capable of standing our ground, we must begin by making our army far stronger than it is today.
loc.INS_greater_indonesia_desc: The ancient empire of Nusantara had once united the Malay-world as one entity, one people. With us having liberated Malaya from colonial tyranny, we should do like our ancestors in Nusantara, declaring the entire Malay world as one united nation.
loc.INS_secularism_desc: Indonesia is home to many people of many religions. Mixing religion and politics together will only cause infighting, therefore we should ban religious political parties.
loc.INS_integrate_sarekat_islam_desc: The big Islamic political parties have a lot of popular support. It is in our best interest to integrate them into government.
loc.INS_sjahrirs_continued_tenure_desc: Prime Minister Sjahrir has proved himself as a great leader, guiding us through the revolution, improving our economy, and establishing democracy. We should reelect him as Prime Minister.
loc.INS_unity_in_diversity_desc: For centuries the words Unity in Diversity have captured the spirit of our archipelago. During the revolution this idea became a rallying cry, reminding Indonesians that though we speak many languages and follow many different traditions, we stand together as one people. We should enshrine this phrase in our constitution, so that our unity will be preserved for generations to come.
loc.INS_timor_issue_scripted_desc_issue: East Timor is clearly rightful Indonesian territory, and while the revolution has ended, it is still under colonial rule. We will send an ultimatum to [721.OWNER.GetName] demanding the immediate transfer of East Timor.
loc.INS_timor_issue_scripted_desc_attack: East Timor is clearly rightful Indonesian territory. The rebels on the island may claim independence, but they clearly do not speak for the entire population. The remnants of portugese colonialism must be integrated into the Republic.
loc.INS_pledge_to_allies_desc: We are at risk of being invaded as part of the growing conflict across the world. While our relations with the Allies have been shaky, we have established ourselves as a Democratic power in the pacific and should align ourselves with the big democratic powers.
loc.INS_mixed_economy_system_desc: Indonesia is a unique country and will not thrive under traditional Capitalism or Communism. We should establish a mixed economy system, with elements of both capitalism and communism.
loc.INS_social_democracy_desc: The [INS.GetAdjective] economy has grown massively since Sjahrirs economic policies were implemented. We should declare Indonesia as a fully Social Democratic state, and develop future economic policies based on the principles of social democracy.
loc.INS_prime_minister_sjarifuddin_desc: Sjarifuddin is the best candidate for Indonesia, his moderate policies allow for compromise between the communists and socialists.
loc.INS_concessions_to_communists_desc: The PKI has a significant number of seats in parliament, we should grant a few ministerial positions to PKI leaders to ensure stability.
loc.INS_sjarifuddin_focus_2_desc: With our newfound independence we should revisit our export economy system and reorganize it so that it no longer takes Dutch profits into accord. While an export-based economy is still dangerous, we can make it much more reliable than in previous years.
loc.INS_prime_minister_hatta_desc: Mohammad Hatta, known as the proclamator of the revolution has served as Vice President to Sukarno, and was generally the more democratic-leaning of the two. He will make a suitable Prime Minister that most political parties can compromise on.
loc.INS_hatta_focus_2_desc: The revolution has ended, and while certain political figures are insisting the revolution must continue, these voices should be ignored. Instead we should look forward, we must build up Indonesia so that future generations will live in prosperity.
loc.INS_hatta_princely_advisors_desc: Through our shared diversity we find unity. We have based our nation on this principle, but the end of the revolution has put strain to the idea due to the lack of a shared struggle. In order to prevent resentment and uprisings from minority groups, we should establish an additional council where local rulers from princely states have a direct say in national politics.
loc.INS_prime_minister_tt: The first Indonesian general election has been held
loc.INS_guided_democracy_desc: It is now clear that the division of power through the formation of the National Committee was a mistake and has only resulted in instability. We mustn’t let this continue else we want another civil war. We must declare martial law and temporarily seize control over the committee until order is restored.
loc.INS_centralization_desc: Power will be centralized in Java with other islands having limited autonomy. All decisions must pass through Java to ensure order and stability. The President will oversee democracy.
loc.INS_abolish_national_committee_desc: The National Committee will be abolished and replaced by a Working Committee serving underneath the presidency. The President will serve for life to maintain order. The Working Committee will be given more power slowly rather than all at once.
loc.INS_abolish_national_committee_tt: Support for §Y[ROOT.GetNeutralParty]§! will be set to §Y100%§!.
loc.INS_pancasila_achieved_desc: When we founded this country, it was founded on the five principles of Pancasilia; Belief in the one and only god, just and civilized humanity, the unity of Indonesia, democratic life led by wisdom, and social justice for all the people of Indonesia. While we have not always successfully operated under these principles, we have finally achieved the unity envisioned by the original principles, and can officially begin the next phase of our Republic’s continued prosperity.
loc.INS_the_co_prosperity_sphere_tt: Unlocks decisions §Y$INS_request_membership$§! and §Y$INS_assume_complete_power$§! decision to flip the country and §Y$INS_sukarno$ Fascist§!.
loc.INS_the_co_prosperity_sphere_desc: Though there is much opposition to cooperating with the Japanese, it is in our best interest during these unstable times to join forces with a stronger power to stand strong against the western allies.
loc.INS_strengthen_ins_jap_trade_desc: We should improve the trade relations between us and our new ally. If we sell our excess resources at drastically lower costs, we can prove our worthiness and gain additional bargaining power after the war.
loc.INS_seek_recognition_of_mal_claims: Seek Recognition of Our Malay Claims
loc.INS_seek_recognition_of_mal_claims_desc: Malaya and North Borneo are of our origin, only divided by thin colonial borders. We should seek that [JAP.GetNameDef] recognizes our right to this territory and promises it to us once we have defeated Britain.
loc.INS_demand_northern_malay_desc: Northern Malay belongs today to Siam, despite being ethnically Malay. We will not tolerate a so-called “ally” occupying our territory, we must demand intervention from Japan.
loc.INS_siam_agreement_desc: Siam is a weak nation unable to stand up for itself. We have proven our worthiness to Japan, and they have continued to fall to pressure. There is no doubt that we will all be better off if Siam becomes an Indonesian puppet.
loc.INS_local_autonomy_industry_tt: §Y1§! Civilian Factory is §Rremoved§! from §Y[1051.GetName]§!, §Y[335.GetName]§! and §Y[1058.GetName]§!.\n§Y1§! Civilian Factory is §Gadded§! to §Y4 random owned states§!.
loc.INS_local_autonomy_desc: The many islands that encompass Indonesia have different cultures, languages, and needs. It is unreasonable to think that one government can successfully oversee them all. We will begin to reform Indonesia into a Federation, where each province has a significant degree of autonomy over itself.
loc.INS_union_of_ins_states_desc: We should give provinces even more autonomy, reducing the role of the federal government to primarily inter-province and external affairs. We will elect a new federal President based on the wishes of the provinces. The local rulers will be free to form their own leadership structure as they choose.
loc.INS_indonesian_inter_province_trade_agre: Trade between provinces must be quick and cheap. We will ensure it is almost always preferable to buy from and sell to another province rather than another country, through drastically reducing taxes on trade, and building new inter-province infrastructure.
loc.INS_expanding_the_union_desc: The people of Northern Borneo have lived in tyranny for too long. We will utilize guerilla warfare in order to force the British to withdraw, allowing Brunei, Sabah, and the Raj of Sarawak to become provinces of Indonesia.
loc.INS_expanding_the_union_tt: Unlocks decisions to start a §YLimited War§! for any states we do not yet control on §YBorneo§!.
loc.INS_dismantle_indonesia_tt: §YDismantle the federation§! and choose which state to rule from. The remaining provinces will be set free.
loc.INS_dismantle_indonesia_desc: We have tried many government types and they have all ended in instability. The revolution has ended, and the Dutch colonizers have been defeated, we are no longer required to stand together as one united front. We will dismantle the federation altogether, giving the local Sultans free reign to establish their own independent countries.
loc.INS_all_toward_the_war_effort_desc: The Malay and [AST.GetAdjective] fronts led by us will dictate the outcome of Malay unity for years to come. We cannot spare any resources, everything must go to the brave soldiers fighting for Malay freedom.
loc.INS_enact_militarism_desc: We should learn a few lessons from [JAP.GetNameDefCap] and its militarist policies. Adopting similar principles will serve to benefit our new government.
loc.INS_sukarnos_industrialization_desc: Java's industries are the backbone of our economy and military. All roads must lead to Rome.
loc.INS_sukarnos_industrialization2: Every Man Must Play His Part
loc.INS_sukarnos_industrialization2_desc: The war effort is the number one priority of this nation, and therefore it is the number one priority of every Indonesian to contribute. Luxury is the enemy, the military industrial complex must grow.
loc.INS_japanese_military_lessons_desc: We should study the military doctrines of Japan and adapt our own army accordingly.
loc.INS_support_tan_malakas_coup_desc: Sukarno proclaimed our independence, but he has proven himself a man of half-measures and diplomatic concessions. Tan Malaka and his Persatuan Perjuangan demand what the people demand: one hundred percent independence, no negotiations, no compromise. If Sukarno will not fight for the revolution in full, then the revolution must find a leader who will.
loc.INS_minimum_program_desc: The Persatuan Perjuangan has laid out its demands: a people's government, a people's army, and the nationalization of all foreign-owned plantations and industry. We need capable men to carry this program forward. Njono speaks for the workers, Setyadjit for the party intellectuals. Together they will see that the revolution is organized from the factory floor to the halls of government.
loc.INS_agrarian_reform_desc: For three centuries the land of Indonesia has fed the plantations of strangers. The peasants who worked it have known little else. A revolution that leaves this unchanged is no revolution at all. We will see the land pass to those who till it.
loc.INS_soviet_aid_desc: The Soviet Union has recognised our revolution and stands ready to supply it. Whatever differences divide our programme from Moscow's, we cannot afford to refuse what is on offer. We should take the arms and press on.
loc.INS_pacific_revolution_desc: The colonial powers did not retreat from Asia, only from Indonesia. The old order still holds in places such as Malaya and the Phillipines, and in each of them there are men and women who wish to overturn it. Our revolution has given us both the standing and the obligation to assist them. We must.
loc.INS_purge_oppurtunists_tt: Unlocks §Y$INS_launch_revolution$§! in countries with §Y60%§! or more communist support. Countries we instigate revolutions in will become our §Ypuppet§!.
loc.INS_purge_oppurtunists_desc: Musso spent twenty years in Moscow learning to take orders. He returned with Soviet instructions in his pocket and a plan to turn our republic into a puppet of the Comintern. We did not throw off the Dutch only to kneel before another foreign master. The opportunists who would sell our revolution to Moscow must be rooted out, and the peoples we liberate shall look to Jakarta, not to the Kremlin.
loc.INS_the_maphilindo_speech_desc: If a Betawi and Banjar person are both Indonesian despite cultural differences through their shared struggle against tyranny, then there is no reason a Malayan and Filipino are not also Indonesian. We must unite these lands as one unified state!
loc.INS_pan_asian_union_desc: The pacific revolution is only beginning, and we are not yet safe. We must stand together and cooperate to protect each other from the great powers of the world. Together we are strong.
loc.INS_federation_of_aslia_desc: The nations we have liberated need not stand alone. Tan Malaka always envisioned something greater than one republic. A federation from the mainland to the Pacific, united against any colonial power that dares return. We will offer them full membership in our state.
loc.INS_pan_economic_area_desc: Economic cooperation within the union is essential for our shared prosperity. We must facilitate duty-free trade between all member states to reduce our reliance on outside nations.
loc.INS_pan_economic_area_tt: All faction members that are a subject of §Y[ROOT.GetNameDef]§!
loc.INS_musso_ascends_tt: Unlocks §Y$INS_launch_revolution$§! in countries with §Y30%§! or more communist support. Countries we instigate revolutions in will remain independent.
loc.INS_musso_ascends_desc: Tan Malaka is a dreamer. Musso brings what dreamers cannot: the full backing of the Soviet Union and the solidarity of the international communist movement. Our revolution need not stand alone.
loc.INS_utilize_comintern_connections_desc: Musso’s connections with high-ranking comintern officials makes the process of joining the comintern easy. We should send him to [SOV.GetNameDef] to negotiate without delay.
loc.INS_united_against_japan_desc: While nobody is keen on siding with the Allies, and the scar left by the Dutch is not forgotten, we must temporarily put aside our differences to fight against our mutual enemy, else we risk another overlord taking over [ROOT.GetName].
loc.INS_revolutionary_economic_cooperation_d: We have saved the lives of many millions who no longer live under tyranny. Now, we must build together. Through cooperation and trade, we can forge strong economies and armies, protecting us from foreign powers for years to come.
loc.INS_revolutionary_economic_cooperation_t:
Gains §Y$INS_revolutionary_economic_cooperation_modifier$§! which grants:
§Y4%§! Stability §Yper Country§! that we have §Ystarted a revolution in§!
§Y4%§! Construction Speed §Yper Country§! that we have §Ystarted a revolution in§!
§Y4%§! Political Power Gain §Yper Country§! that we have §Ystarted a revolution in§!
§Y-4%§! Consumer Goods §Yper Country§! that we have §Ystarted a revolution in§!

Currently we have started revolutions in §Y[?INS_communist_revolts_succeeded]§! countries.
loc.INS_soviet_economic_integration_desc: The revolution has given us our freedom, but freedom alone does not build factories or feed the masses. The Soviet Union offers what no capitalist power will: industrial expertise, development credits, and trade on terms that do not come with colonial strings attached. We would be fools to refuse.
loc.INS_the_three_year_plan_desc: We will declare a three year plan for our economy, which will guide us long-term and reduce time spent on bureaucracy.
loc.INS_the_three_year_plan_tt: The §YNational Spirit§! Will improve by §G1%§! every month until reaching it's full potential at §Y26%§!.
loc.INS_realign_export_markets_desc: We must strengthen our global trade relations, reducing our dependency on a few major powers. Instead, we should make many, smaller trades with smaller nations & companies.
loc.INS_divert_javanese_education_funding_th: There is no question that the former colonial overlords invested only in the growth of Java and resource-rich parts of Sumatra, while leaving the rest of the colony to rot. We can right this wrong by taking parts of Java’s education budget and reallocating it to build new schools in the east.
loc.INS_eastern_universities_desc: By building new universities in the east, higher education will be available to more citizens, and students will be encouraged to move from Java to attend far-away schools, reducing the cultural divide between Java and the rest of [ROOT.GetName].
loc.INSHOL_reasserting_control_desc: We cannot idly stand and watch as these opportunists attempt to ruin what we have spent centuries building, whilst destroying our infrastructure and radicalizing the youth. We must take action!
loc.INSHOL_request_british_support_desc: [ENG.GetNameDefCap], as a fellow colonial power will likely be sympathetic to our situation, especially since if the revolutionaries succeed, it could set off a domino effect in east asia. We should request their economic and military aid.
loc.INS_eng_treaty_holside_tt: §Y[ENG.GetNameDefCap]§! will officially declare themselves on our side of the conflict and provide substantial help. If the war ends in victory, §Y[ENG.GetNameDefCap]§! will be entitled to Borneo.
loc.INS_eng_treaty_engside_tt: We will officially align ourselves with §Y[HOL.GetNameDefCap]§! in the East Indies conflict. If §Y[HOL.GetNameDefCap]§! wins, we will be entitled to ownership of Borneo.
loc.INS_fra_treaty_holside_tt: §Y[FRA.GetNameDefCap]§! will officially declare themselves on our side of the conflict and provide substantial help. If the war ends in victory, §Y[FRA.GetNameDefCap]§! will be entitled to northeastern Sumatra.
loc.INS_fra_treaty_fraside_tt: We will officially align ourselves with §Y[HOL.GetNameDefCap]§! in the East Indies conflict. If §Y[HOL.GetNameDefCap]§! wins, we will be entitled to ownership of northeastern Sumatra.
loc.INSHOL_franco_dutch_accord_desc: Despite our soldiers being better equipped and organized than the Republican militias, their overwhelming numbers have turned the conflict against us. To secure victory we need outside support, more than most would give. France may be willing to intervene if we offer them territory in the Indies to expand their presence in the Pacific.
loc.INSHOL_london_batavia_accord_desc: Despite our soldiers being better equipped and organized than the Republican militias, their overwhelming numbers have turned the conflict against us. To secure victory we need outside support, more than most would give. [ENG.GetNameDefCap] may have an interest due to their presence in Malaya. Perhaps they could be persuaded if we offer something in return?
loc.INSHOL_australian_divisions_desc: As per the London-Batavia Accord, Britain is required to send additional divisions to the Indies through Australia once we request it, as Australia’s proximity to the Indies makes them the perfect candidates to host a military base outside of the Indies itself.
loc.INSHOL_indian_divisions_desc: While Britain will most likely be unwilling to send their own men to the Indies, convincing them to send Indian divisions is much easier, especially due to their proximity to Batavia.
loc.INSHOL_undermine_the_militias_desc: The media is exaggerating the severity of this situation, the militias are just a group of rogue youths trying to reach for something unreachable. We do not need to divert all of our resources to stopping them, we should just hold the line and wait for them to tire.
loc.INSHOL_flag_will_fly_again: The Flag Will Fly Once More
loc.INSHOL_flag_will_fly_again_desc: The Dutch flag has flown in the Indies for centuries, there is no world in which we would allow it to be lowered. If keeping our crown jewel colony requires sending in tanks and bomber planes then they will be sent!
loc.INSHOL_flag_will_fly_again_tt: §YOnce the revolution ends, the spirit will be removed and the rule changes will be reverted.§!
loc.INSHOL_mass_mobilization_desc: We cannot win this conflict and crush the Republic without a well equipped army. We must rearm the Indies and divert funding from civilian sectors to the KNIL.
loc.INSHOL_comite_rijkseenheid_desc: The flag is being lowered in the Indies, and yet people are just watching it happen. We cannot allow this, we must convince the Indies Administration that the Dutch people want the revolution to be stopped!
loc.INSHOL_increase_esclation_placeholder_de: Our militias have taken control of many vital ports, cities, and industrial centers. We will not continue to wait for the Netherlands to act, we will call for a major military offensive ourselves!
loc.INS_take_batavia_explination_tt: If we successfully occupy all of Java, we will destroy the colonial government from the inside and §Gwin the war§!. However, if we do not manage to do so within §Y730 days§!, we will §Rperish§!.
loc.INSHOL_linggadjati_agreement_desc: Invading Java has proven difficult, and our administration is growing unstable. We must fall back and play defensively so as to not risk the fall of the entire Republic. We should negotiate local ceasefires with the Netherlands, allowing us to reorganize our forces before putting our focus back on Java.
loc.INSHOL_increase_esclation_placeholder_tt: Unlocks a §YDecision§! to negotiate local ceasefires and §Yincrease the timer§! to occupy Java.
loc.INSHOL_seek_foreign_help_desc: It is no secret that attempting to win a war against a heavily industrialized colonial power as a newly formed nation without an established economy is a nearly impossible task. We should reach out to other countries that support our cause in order to see if they would be willing to help us.
loc.INSHOL_renville_agreement_desc: The unprecedented aggression taken by the Netherlands has brought international attention to the revolution, and yet the Netherlands has continued to violate ceasefires and bait a reaction out of us. We must try to make a call to [USA.GetNameDef], as if we convince them to stand up for Indonesia, the Netherlands will have no choice but to back down.
loc.INSHOL_no_compromise_desc: The Dutch greed that caused them to invest almost exclusively in Java, ignoring the eastern islands, has left Java as the Achilles' heel of the entire colony. This will be their downfall!
loc.INSHOL_end_to_bloodshed_desc: This conflict has gone on for far too long, with little progress in either direction, only more lives lost each and every day. Nobody wants this to continue, it is time we discuss with the Dutch leaders at the negotiating table.
loc.INS_we_will_need_another_tt: As we already control all of Java, we will need to control one additional state in addition to Java.
loc.INS_centralize_the_state_desc: From Sumatra to Sulawesi, from Borneo to Bangka, our development programs have brought roads, factories and institutions to territories that [1058.GetName] once administered in name only. These regions are no longer distant provinces. They are [INS.GetNameDefCap].
loc.INS_fate_of_de_javasche_bank_scripted_de: The East Indies Guilder has been in freefall since the depression struck, and De Javasche Bank lacks the tools to arrest the decline. We must decide how to stabilize our currency before what remains of investor confidence evaporates entirely.

We inherited a currency in crisis. The old colonial Guilder was already faltering, and the transition to the Rupiah has done nothing to steady the markets. Bank Indonesia needs clear direction from the government, or our young economy will suffer for it.
loc.INS_finish_the_bauxite_project_desc: With new roads, ports and railways operational across Bangka-Belitung, survey teams report deposits of tungsten and chromium beyond our initial expectations. These islands will yet prove their full worth to the republic.
loc.INS_australian_contracts_desc: Our rubber reserves have grown far beyond domestic needs. Australia, ever hungry for raw materials to feed its own industries, presents a natural trading partner. Securing long-term contracts with Australian firms would bring steady revenue and strengthen our position in the regional economy.
loc.INS_coopereate_with_chinese_businessmen_: A wealthy and well-connected merchant class has long facilitated trade across the archipelago. Rather than sideline these established networks, we should work with them. Their capital and commercial expertise could prove invaluable in pulling our economy out of its current malaise.
loc.INS_realign_supply_chains_explain_tt: Unlocks §Y$INS_realign_supply_chains_cat$§! Decisions to sell resources to private companies on a 2-year lease.
loc.INS_negotiate_new_contracts_desc: Our growing reputation as a reliable supplier has opened doors that were previously closed to us. New buyers are circling, and we should move quickly to lock them into long-term agreements before our competitors can undercut us.
loc.INS_all_in_on_rubber_desc: Rubber is our strongest hand, and we intend to play it. Every available acre of plantation land will be turned over to rubber cultivation, and our export apparatus reorganized to move it faster and cheaper than anyone else in the region.
loc.INS_more_market_resources_desc: The world may be mired in economic crisis, but crisis breeds opportunity for those bold enough to seize it. By flooding the market with our commodities at prices no competitor can match, we will ensure that when the world recovers, Indonesian goods are already on every shelf and in every warehouse.
loc.INS_recovering_from_the_great_depression: The Great Depression has had a devastating effect on [INS.GetNameDef]. With our economy being primarily export-based, protectionism around the world has crippled us. As global trade looks poised to open up again, we must seek out new markets, and work to re-establish our old trade routes.
loc.INS_first_come_first_serve_desc: While the protectionism of the Great Depression is slowing down, increased production and an overvalued guilder has left the Dutch export market in tatters, as our old trading partners in the west have turned to South America to meet their demand. Rather than chasing them down for new trade agreements, we could use this as an opportunity to expand into new markets in Asia.
loc.INS_oil_export_desc: We will improve the oil infrastructure in Sumatra and Kalimantan in order to secure trade deals with our new trading partners.
loc.INS_increased_trade_with_japan_desc: [JAP.GetNameDefCap] has been an increasingly valuable trading partner and has not let us down. We should negotiate new trade agreements to further the economic cooperation between our two nations, and help us shake off the vestiges of the Great Depression. This may upset our allies in the West, especially the Netherlands. However, if we ever want a say in our own destiny, we will need to secure our own trade links.
loc.INS_asian_trade_investments_desc: The devastation of the Great Depression showed us how overreliant we’ve been on our long-term trade partners in the west. With our economy primarily being export-based, it is crucial now more than ever that we develop and expand new markets in Southeast Asia to ensure our economy will not depend on any individual country.
loc.INS_asian_trade_investments_tt: Every §Y420§! days, the resources to market penalty from §YThe Great Depression§! will §GImprove§! by §Y5%§! until the negative modifiers are gone.
loc.INS_declare_free_trade_desc: We should not align ourselves exclusively to one country, we will allow the market to naturally make the best decisions for [INS.GetNameDef].
loc.INS_japanese_export_contracts: One Trade Contract To Rule Them All
loc.INS_japanese_export_contracts_desc: We will negotiate a major trade agreement with [JAP.GetNameDef], selling all the rubber in [1049.GetName] and [672.GetName]. While we will sell it at a very low cost, we will be guaranteed it all gets sold.
loc.INS_realign_supply_chains_desc: While the protectionism of the Great Depression is slowing down, increased production and an overvalued guilder has left the Dutch export market in tatters, as our old trading partners in the west have turned to South America to meet their demand. We must take steps to convince our allies to start trading with us again.
loc.INS_invite_foreign_companies_desc: Since 1930, Standard Oil California has been operating in our country through their Dutch subsidiary, Nederlandsche Pacific Petroleum Maatschappij. Their surveys in Riouw show promise, we should support their upstream operations in any way we can - a big discovery would both boost our revenue and encourage other international companies to pursue investments in our country.
loc.INS_expand_sea_routes_desc: Our country is rich in natural resources, but our extraction industry is too specialized and we lack the infrastructure necessary to extract certain rare minerals such as chromium and tungsten. If we want to improve our military production capabilities, we will need to import them from elsewhere. To take full advantage of our growing trade network, we will need to increase the capacity of our merchant fleet.
loc.INS_ship_contracts_desc: Constructing a navy is necessary in order to maintain our trade routes in the event of war. We can utilize our newfound trade relationships to obtain naval contracts.
loc.INS_developing_sumatra_desc: Sumatra is the most resource-rich island in the archipelago, yet the infrastructure is so poor that a great proportion of extracted resources never even make it back to Batavia. Transportation relies on a patchwork of dirt roads and unconnected railway lines, wholly insufficient to support our plans for the island. We can’t let this continue.
loc.INS_sumatra_railway_desc: As part of our ongoing efforts to develop Sumatra’s infrastructure, we should construct a large railway stretching from northern Atjeh to the southernmost port in Sumatra, which connects to Batavia by ship very quickly. This way, resources will only have to be transported to the nearest train station, at which point we can move it to Batavia in a matter of days.
loc.INS_develop_borneo_desc: Kalimantan has the potential for great wealth, yet the island is very sparsely developed, and its people are plagued by poverty. Transport of freight is heavily reliant on the many rivers and waterways of the island, and any long-range communications are hindered by a lack of electricity. By building powerlines and roads, we can pave the way for future surveying and resource extraction.
loc.INS_kalimantan_mic_desc: Our infrastructure development efforts in Kalimantan have paid off. The spread of electricity and communications has brought us into contact with communities that used to be far beyond the government’s call. We can use this opportunity to meet our needs for increased military production, by building new factories in the region and manning them with this newfound pool of labor.
loc.INS_pontianak_to_balikpapan_desc: The idea of building a railway in Kalimantan has been discussed at length, but the harsh, largely unexplored terrain in the center of the island makes it a difficult task. The only solution is a U-shaped railway from coast to coast. It will not be cheap, but in the long run it will pay for itself.
loc.INS_develop_sulawesi_desc: Sulawesi is the center of the archipelago, and therefore an important strategic location. We should build roads, powerlines, and communications to ensure it can be used as a military hub in the event of war.
loc.INS_the_bangka_project_desc: The Bangka-Belitung islands, while small, are a cornerstone of the Indonesian economy due to the islands’ bauxite deposits. We need to build roads, ports and railways on Bangka-Belitung, to ensure that we can reap the full rewards of the islands’ rich mineral wealth.
loc.INS_aluminium_factory_desc: Our raw bauxite extraction is growing, but our lack of domestic aluminum production is limiting our profits. As the provincial capital of the Bangkal-Belitung islands, Pangkalpinang would be an ideal location to establish our own factories. Doing so would allow us to cut out the middlemen and maximize our returns.
loc.INS_bauxite_export_desc: The completion of the Bangka project has left us with more raw bauxite than we know what to do with. While attempting to sell it all would be difficult, we could offer a significantly reduced price for the bauxite than anyone else on the market, ensuring every gram gets sold. Due to the sheer quantity of bauxite we can sell, this would still yield a proportional growth in profit compared to our current exports.
loc.INS_tin_mining_desc: The history of tin mining in the Bangka-Belitung islands predates European presence in the archipelago. So it’s no wonder then, that the tin industry on the islands is overdue for some modernization. Overhauling the production capabilities is an expensive endeavour, and our existing tin industry will not be operational for some time as we rebuild it. However, there is significant potential for long-term profit.
loc.INS_tin_to_usa_desc: [USA.GetNameDefCap] is full of corporations and government institutions purchasing tin. Now that we have a proper mining operation, we have an opportunity to make a lot of profit here.
loc.INS_tin_to_japan_desc: [JAP.GetNameDefCap] has many ships now considered outdated and replaceable, despite being a perfect fit for the [INS.GetAdjective] navy. We should purchase these ships with the money from our tin production.
loc.INS_tin_to_japan_tt: [JAP.GetNameDefCap] will send §Y9§! older destroyers to us.
loc.INS_new_bauxite_routes_desc: Our strategy of undercutting the market to increase our export volume of bauxite has worked out successfully, and we’ve increased our total income substantially. We mustn’t stop here, however. We should continue to expand our trade networks, optimize our supply chains, and look for any other opportunities to maximize our returns.
loc.INS_not_industry_desc: Java is the beating heart of our nation, home to the bulk of our population and the seat of our government. Before we can industrialize the island in earnest, we must first prepare the ground. Land surveys, zoning allocations and site clearances will ensure that when the factories come, they are built where they will do the most good.
loc.INS_construction_focus_desc: Foreign capital is flowing in, export revenues are climbing, and for the first time in years there is real money to invest in domestic industry. We must seize the moment and build while conditions favor us.
loc.INS_developing_java_desc: Java is by far the most industrialized island in the archipelago, and the source of a majority of our wealth. However, certain cities such as Batavia are becoming increasingly crowded due to population growth. We should expand these cities with new homes, commercial areas, trams, trains, and factories in order to support the growing population.
loc.INS_prioritize_sugar_economy_desc: We should decrease our government budget for Batavian industrial development; It is already far more industrialized than any other city in the archipelago. Instead, we should use this money to establish many small palm plantations across the country. These plantations will produce palm sugar, which is a commodity with high international demand.
loc.INS_all_cards_into_industry_desc: Industrialization has had a massive impact on [1058.GetName]'s economy. If we industrialize the entire island, with its tens of millions of citizens, we could become influential on the global scale.
loc.INS_expand_batavia_technical_institute: Expand the Batavia Institute of Technology
loc.INS_expand_batavia_technical_institute_d: Expanding the Batavia Institute of Technology will allow a greater number of students to become educated and increase the rate of our technological development.
loc.INS_quinine_export_desc: The Cinchona Bureau in Amsterdam nearly has a monopoly on quinine exports, which is especially profitable as quinine is in high demand worldwide as malaria treatment. The Bureau sources a majority of its quinine from the East Indies. Despite this, we receive a very small portion of the profits. We should use our quinine production as leverage to negotiate a fairer agreement.
loc.INS_spend_profits_on_rural_desc: With our new quinine agreement finalized, we find ourselves with an opportunity to use our additional income to develop the transportation and communications infrastructure in rural areas, paving the way for future industrial development.
loc.INS_spend_profits_on_urban_desc: With our new quinine agreement finalized, we find ourselves with an opportunity to use our additional income to expand the Batavian manufacturing industry, which will diversify our economy and decrease our reliance on exporting raw materials.
loc.INS_spend_profits_on_military_desc: With our new quinine agreement finalized, we find ourselves with an opportunity to improve our military significantly by spending our additional income on building and maintaining new weapon factories in Yogyakarta and Semarang.
loc.INS_end_to_bloodshed_tt: The war will end, with new borders drawn based on current occupation. Java, Sumatra, and Borneo will be §Yannexed§! by the side that currently has the most control in the area.
loc.HOL_british_light_support: [ENG.GetNameDefCap] has agreed to help in the revolution
loc.INS_relocate_generals_tt: Transfer §Y80%§! of our Armed Forces to [INS.GetNameDef].
loc.INS_exile_tt: §Y[HOL.GetNameDefCap]§! will be able to continue to relocate to §Y[INS.GetNameDef]§!.
loc.INS_army_located_tt: §Y[HOL.GetNameDefCap]§! relocates their Armed Forces to us.
loc.INS_the_jewel_in_the_crown_desc: The East Indies are the brightest jewel in the Dutch colonial crown, and we intend to keep it that way. Through the Volksraad, our voice carries to The Hague.
loc.INSHOL_investments_in_civ_railways_tt:
If [HOL.GetFlag]§Y[HOL.GetName]§! completes the focus:
         ([INS.GetFlag]§Y[INS.GetName]§!: Add §Y£autonomy_texticon -250.00§!)
   If [INS.GetFlag]§Y[INS.GetName]§! completes the focus:
         Add §Y£autonomy_texticon 250.00§!
loc.INSHOL_investments_in_civ_railways_desc: Winning over the support of the people of the Indies requires investing in civilian infrastructure. Currently, our railways are primarily used for cargo transportation. We should purchase passenger trains to run across our pre-existing railways in Java and Sumatra.
loc.INSHOL_continue_exclusive_rights: Exclusive Rights for De Javasche Bank
loc.INSHOL_continue_exclusive_rights_desc: The East Indies Guilder has lost most of its value during the great depression, and our economic growth has reached a standstill. We could try to stabilize the Guilder by giving the Bank of Java exclusive printing rights, which it had until 1922.
loc.INSHOL_peg_indies_guilder_to_dutch_guild: Peg the Indies Guilder to the Dutch Guilder

The East Indies Guilder has lost most of its value during the great depression, and our economic growth has reached a standstill. The easiest solution is to peg the Indies Guilder to the Dutch Guilder, a far more stable currency. This will also tie us closer to our overlord.
loc.INSHOL_peg_indies_guilder_to_us_dollar: Peg the Indies Guilder to the US Dollar
loc.INSHOL_peg_indies_guilder_to_us_dollar_d: The East Indies Guilder has lost most of its value during the great depression, and our economic growth has reached a standstill. While we could peg the Indies Guilder to the Dutch Guilder, the US dollar is a far more stable currency. Pegging the Guilder to the Dollar also allows us to have more economic independence, making self rule a more attainable goal.
loc.indonesia_currency_pegged_to_dollar_modi: Indies Guilder pegged to the US Dollar
loc.INS_direct_rule_tt:
Unlocks the §Y$INS_direct_rule_occupation_law$§! occupation law in indonesian princely states.
Effects:
     §GIncreases§! factories and resources from the state
     §RDecreases§! compliance growth
     §RIncreases§! resistance growth
loc.INS_local_autonomy_tt:
Unlocks the §Y$INS_local_autonomy_occupation_law$§! occupation law in indonesian princely states.
Effects:
     Gives §Ysmall§! boosts all around
     §GIncreases§! compliance growth
loc.INS_invest_in_batavian_education_req_tt: Has successfully completed at least §Y3§! Volksraad missions
loc.INS_invest_in_batavian_education_req_2_t: Has successfully completed at least §Y6§! Volksraad missions
loc.INSHOL_eventual_autonomy_req_tt: Has successfully completed at least §Y4§! Volksraad missions
loc.indonesia_volksraad_passed_12: The Indonesian national flag has been officially recognized
loc.INS_stronghold_java_tt: Any Indonesian State: Is not occupied by [ROOT.GetFlag][ROOT.GetNameDefCap]
loc.INSHOL_request_east_timor: Demand the Return of East Timor
loc.INSHOL_request_east_timor_desc: Timor has no right being occupied by Portugal, it is a remnant of colonial history that we mustn’t continue to tolerate, for it is rightful Indonesian territory. We will issue a formal demand to Portugal that they return Timor to us immediately.
loc.INS_resist_occupation_desc: The anger held by many Indonesians against the Netherlands cannot allow us to fall to Fascism. We must do all that we can to resist the Japanese invasion and defend the motherland.
loc.INS_local_resistance_desc: We will establish resistance cells in territory that hasn’t been occupied yet, ensuring that if it does get occupied, we will be prepared to take it back when the time is right.
loc.INS_stronghold_java_desc: The Indies is a vast archipelago home to many peoples and extremely harsh terrain. Attempting to defend every last island, jungle, and mountain from an army far greater than ours is guaranteed to fail. While it is not easy to abandon our fellow men, evacuating all islands but Java, allowing us to station our entire army there, may be the best move for the nation as a whole.
loc.INS_silence_nationalists_desc: The Japanese invasion has caused the revolutionary nationalist movements to begin supporting the Japanese invaders due to their shared enemy of the Netherlands. The instability resulting from the invasion has caused these movements to grow at a pace never seen before. If we do not do something about it now, it may grow entirely out of our control.
loc.INS_east_indies_exile_government_desc: Alas, despite our best efforts, the Indies have fallen. We cannot lose hope yet, however. We must continue to do all we can with the limited resources available to us. We may have lost the battle, but we have not yet lost the war.
loc.INS_establish_nefis_desc: We will create the Netherlands East Indies Forces Intelligence Service together with the Allies, which we will station in Australia. Through this we will conduct clandestine operations to sabotage the Japanese occupying forces. Through each small victory, we move closer to our return to the homeland.
loc.INS_evacuate_soldiers_to_australia_desc: We will create a military base near the NEFIS base in Northern Australia. There, we will station the KNIL soldiers who avoided capture during the occupation, allowing us to continue fighting.
loc.INS_australian_weapons_desc: Clandestine operations are not easy to operate, and we will need proper equipment in order to succeed. We can license Australian factories and repurpose them to produce weapons for the NEFIS.
loc.INS_defenders_of_homeland_tt: This focus will be automatically completed if the Defenders of the Homeland are established.
loc.INS_resist_occupation_tt: This focus will be automatically completed if we get invaded and do not surrender.
loc.INS_defenders_of_homeland_desc: The Indies Government has fallen, and a new regime has taken its place. Led by the Nationalists and the Japanese Government, we will create a new army superior to the KNIL, and win the war. However, there is no denying that this alliance between Nationalists and Imperialists is fragile. Will the alliance last, or will it end in bloodshed?
loc.INS_embrace_co_prosp_sphere_desc: We have finally ended Dutch rule, and while we have just replaced one overlord with another, the promises of economic prosperity and pan-asianism are very enticing. We will continue to help the Japanese war effort in order to ensure the Netherlands will never attempt to come back for Indonesia.
loc.INS_seize_oppurtunity_desc: [JAP.GetNameDefCap] is losing, and their occupation government is weak. For the first time in many centuries, we have a real chance of breaking the shackles around Indonesia for good, creating an independent nation. If we do not take this opportunity to declare independence now, there’s no telling how long it will take until we get the next one.
loc.INS_japanese_resource_infrastructure_des: Giving control over our core resource extraction infrastructure to [JAP.GetNameDef] is a necessary step towards winning the war, as it is of utmost priority that [JAP.GetAdjective] units remain fully supplied at all times. [JAP.GetNameDefCap] will also be developing our local infrastructure in order to increase efficiency of resource exports.
loc.INS_japanese_army_training_desc: We have a lot to learn from our [JAP.GetAdjective] overlords, and now that the KNIL is disbanded, we should create a new army taught by the IJA, ready to defend Indonesia from outside threats.
loc.INS_governor_general_de_jonge_desc: Bonifacius Cornelis de Jonge is known for ruling with an iron fist, opposing any form of nationalism and often ignoring the wishes of the Volksraad. His rule over the Indies has lasted a long time, and his experience stretches all the way back to the great war where he served as the Indies Minister of War.
loc.INS_tjarda_explain_tt: §YBonifacius Cornelis de Jonge§!'s term has expired, and §YAlidius Tjarda van Starkenborgh Stachouwer§! was chosen as a replacement Governor in September of 1936.
loc.INS_governor_general_tjarda_desc: Alidius Tjarda van Starkenborgh Stachouwer has a slightly different vision for the Indies than his predecessor. While he is still opposed to Nationalism, he has slightly more liberal policies and is more willing to listen to the wishes of the Volksraad.
loc.INS_electrical_investments_desc: Every European industrialized nation has a strong electrical grid to support their industry. If we want to stop relying on material exports and create our own manufacturing industry like them, we should build a high capacity electrical grid that stretches across the entirety of Java.
loc.INS_reduce_land_taxes_desc: The high taxes imposed on land ownership has made it difficult for native Indonesians to own plantations and businesses. While this has made it easy for us to hold a monopoly on the rubber industry, it has caused economic problems throughout the country. We should consider reducing these taxes to their previous rates, making it possible for smaller, privately owned rubber plantations to operate.
loc.INS_invest_in_batavian_education_desc: The Volksraad has made it clear that the will of the Indonesian people is for education to become more accessible, as currently it is primarily Dutch Indonesians and the small group of Indonesian elite who can afford it. In order to comply with the Volksraad motion, we should construct several primary and secondary schools in and around Batavia.
loc.INS_javanese_education_investments_desc: In addition to our ongoing project to construct primary and secondary schools, we could build a community college and specialized vocational schools, which would make further education much more accessible for middle-class families.
loc.INS_allow_local_autonomy_desc: The Vorstenlanden system granting princely states self governance has made nationalist movements much easier to manage and increased the stability of the nation as a whole. We should increase the level of autonomy granted to princely states even more, allowing the government to focus on more important matters.
loc.INS_direct_rule_desc: The Vorstenlanden system granting princely states self governance has added a layer of difficulty to administration, requiring additional bureaucracy and wasting time. It is time to abolish the system altogether and enforce direct rule over the entire archipelago.
loc.INS_seize_oppurtunity_tt: §Y[JAP.GetFlag][JAP.GetName]§! has been pushed back, and controls less than §Y[?var:temp_states_plus_more]§! states. (currently: §Y[?var:JAP.num_controlled_states]§!)
loc.INS_seize_oppurtunity_refuse_warn_tt: §RThe national revolution will begin, which may lead to a war with [HOL.GetNameDef]§!.
loc.INS_economic_stabilization_desc: The great depression and worldwide protectionism has left us economically crippled, and many Indonesians who once worked in the raw materials industry have found themselves without a job. We must take drastic measures and create a labour program where citizens without a job will be assigned one.
loc.INS_restore_order_in_indies_desc: The rising nationalist movement in the Indies has destabilized several regions, and could grow out of control if we do not stop it. We must restore order and stability as our top priority.
loc.INS_detangle_supply_chains_desc: Our export economy requires goods to go through dozens of middlemen until it finally reaches the final destination, each time requiring a fee, a tax, or any other reason for them to take a little off the top. We should work to detangle this mess and control the majority of the supply chain directly.
loc.INS_prioritize_industrial_growth_desc: Our export economy is too volatile and keeps us dependent on Dutch collaboration. We should work on establishing a manufacturing industry by building factories across Batavia. We could become the most industrialized country in the pacific
loc.INS_closer_economic_ties_to_netherlands: Closer Economic Ties to the Netherlands
loc.INS_closer_economic_ties_to_netherlands_: We have a lot to learn from our overlord, especially economically. If we were to further integrate our export economy with the Netherlands, we could utilize their infrastructure and connections to secure more lucrative trade deals.
loc.INS_prioritize_dutch_companies_desc: Dutch companies such as Shell and Fokker have been the backbone of our economy for centuries now, with our raw material exports being heavily integrated with Shell. This has brought significant wealth to the Indies, and we should prioritize them over smaller, local businesses in order to ensure our cooperation remains strong.
loc.INSHOL_java_factories_desc: While basic, there is no denying that simply building more arms factories goes a long way towards improving the strength of an army. As the industrial powerhouse of the colony, Java is an obvious location to build them in.
loc.INSHOL_license_dutch_weapon_blueprints_d: Rather than investing in building an entire domestic manufacturing process and creating our own technology designs, we should cooperate with Dutch companies in order to purchase their weapon blueprints.
loc.INSHOL_bangka_production_lines_desc: The exponential development of Bangka’s infrastructure as a result of the Bangka Project has turned this once tiny, mostly unimportant island into the perfect site for new industrial projects. We have an opportunity to strengthen the KNIL by building a new weapon factory in Bangka, which, due to the island's concentrated roads, railways, and ports, will operate more efficiently than if we had built them elsewhere.
loc.INSHOL_artillerie_inrichtingen_desc: Artillerie Inrichtingen has been manufacturing artillery and other arms in the Netherlands for over 250 years, and has been operating in the Indies for several decades. Expanding their manufacturing capabilities by opening new manufacturing facilities in the Indies would significantly improve the capabilities of the KNIL, whilst strengthening the economy of underfunded areas by creating new jobs.
loc.INSHOL_ai_pyrotechnische_desc: Continuing the expansion of Artillerie Inrichtingens production facilities within the East Indies, we should fund the establishment of an East Indies division of Artillerie Inrichtingen’s pyrotechnical subsidiary.
loc.INSHOL_bio_pharma_desc: Expanding the Indies pharmaceutical industry is the obvious next step in reforming the KNIL, in order to ensure wounded soldiers receive adequate treatment and recover safely. The prevalence of quinine in the Indies makes the cost of this project substantially lower than normal.
loc.INSHOL_develop_fighters_desc: We will send Batavian engineers to Amsterdam to study Fokker’s fighter production firsthand, gaining access to its closely guarded manufacturing secrets. They will return with the knowledge and technical expertise required to establish a modern domestic fighter industry in the Indies.
loc.INSHOL_develop_bombers_desc: We will send Batavian engineers to Amsterdam to study Fokker’s bomber plane production firsthand, gaining access to its closely guarded manufacturing secrets. They will return with the knowledge and technical expertise required to establish a modern domestic bomber industry in the Indies.
loc.INSHOL_bandung_aircraft_facility_desc: While blueprints and manufacturing secrets are useful, they’re useless until we build planes from them. We will open new aircraft facilities in Bandung in order to meet the current needs of the ML-KNIL.
loc.INSHOL_netherlands_indies_air_doctrine_d: We will study the air forces of nations facing challenges similar to our own, drawing on their hard-won experience to shape a doctrine suited to the realities of the East Indies, without repeating these historical mistakes.
loc.INSHOL_manado_military_academy_desc: Establishing a military academy outside of Java will help mitigate our manpower shortage significantly by making conscription feasible in the eastern islands. Makassar, located around the middle of the East Indies is the perfect location for it.
loc.INSHOL_infantry_training_in_borneo_desc: The East Indies are defined by dense jungles, rugged mountains, and unforgiving terrain. Our soldiers, primarily based in Java, are woefully unprepared to fight in these conditions. We must expand military training beyond Java and conduct exercises in harsher environments. Few places on earth rival the jungles and mountains of Borneo, making it the perfect spot to train world-class rangers.
loc.INSHOL_knil_engineers_desc: We mustn't focus all our efforts on infantry and rifle production, and remember that logistics and communications play an essential role in winning battles. We should train engineers and fund Batavian vocational schools to ensure our army is not bottlenecked by poor logistics.
loc.INSHOL_work_with_oil_barons_desc: The Great Depression has left our export based economy in a depressing state. It might be time to consider offloading some of the trade negotiations to the oil barons of Sumatra, in order to guarantee the oil gets sold. This will however come at a cost, as for them to agree to this deal, we will need to sell the oil at prices significantly lower than the market rate.
loc.INSHOL_rubber_taxation_desc: Dutch investment and expertise have transformed the rubber plantations of the East Indies into one of the Empire’s most valuable assets. It is only just that the Crown claims its rightful share of the wealth it has created. Though certain local politicians protest, the interests of the Empire cannot be dictated by provincial agitation.
loc.INSHOL_padang_port_desc: Resources produced in Padang must first be routed through Java before reaching international markets, as the region lacks facilities capable of handling large convoys. This unnecessary detour strains our supply chain and limits Sumatra’s economic potential. By constructing a major cargo harbor in Padang, we can remove this detour, increasing the profitability of Padang’s plantations.
loc.INSHOL_subsidize_bauxite_desc: The ongoing project in the Indies to modernize the bauxite-rich Bangka-Belitung islands is very promising, and the potential for long term profit is high. We should support the Indies government with economic subsidies in order to expedite the project.
loc.INSHOL_agricultural_subsidies_desc: By permitting the establishment of privately owned farms of varying sizes, we can accelerate infrastructure development in underfunded rural regions while simultaneously increasing government revenue. To achieve this, we will establish a structured tax framework wherein all tax income generated by these farms is remitted directly to the Netherlands, rather than first going through the Indies.
loc.INSHOL_import_sugar_desc: We will mandate price controls in the growing agricultural sector in the Indies in order to import all of the nation's sugar from plantations in the Indies, at prices no other government can match, and establish a government monopoly on sugar.
loc.INSHOL_import_lumber_desc: We will mandate price controls in the growing agricultural sector in the Indies in order to import all of the nation's lumber from plantations in the Indies, at prices no other government can match, and establish a government monopoly on lumber.
loc.INS_no_peta_tt: Indonesia will be unable to cooperate with foreign invaders.
loc.INSHOL_industrialized_colony_desc: The East Indies, once a humble colony, has become one of the most industrialized, wealthy regions in all of Asia. This marks a monumental moment in the history of the Netherlands, and humanity. Our efforts have paid off, and we will continue to invest in the development of our colony, and reestablish the Netherlands as a global power once more.
loc.INSHOL_economic_integration_desc: The Dutch East Indies is the shining jewel of our Empire, their prosperity secured through the steady leadership of the Queen, the Prime Minister, and the Governor-General. This stability must not be endangered by reckless calls for independence, which would bring only disorder and decline. We will bind the economies of the Netherlands and the Indies ever tighter, ensuring continued stability and greatness.
loc.INSHOL_republic_of_indonesia_desc: When the Netherlands begrudgingly agreed to the Soetardjo Petition, the resulting legislation bound Indonesian Independence to a long list of conditions to qualify as economically. self-sufficient. Despite this, these conditions have now been met in full thanks to the determination held by the Indonesian people, and the Netherlands has no choice but to accept our formal declaration of independence.
loc.INSHOL_propose_malay_unification_desc: Indonesia is an archipelago home to hundreds of cultures, languages, and ethnicities. While some are similar, others are distinctly different. Yet through the shared struggle of colonial rule, we have found unity under one nation; Indonesia. Perhaps we should ask ourselves why this unity must stop here, when across the straits the people of Malaya share much the same history and aspirations as our own?
loc.INSHOL_singapore_compromise_desc: Singapore is Indonesian land in history and culture, and it is only natural that it should be included in a united Indonesia. Yet Britain is not willing to give up Singapore due to its strategic importance and necessity as a military base. We should propose a compromise wherein Singapore joins the union, on the condition that Britain retains the right to station forces on the island.
loc.INSHOL_request_ceylon_desc: The British colony of Ceylon shares deep cultural and linguistic ties with the wider Malay world. As the pan-Malayan federation of Maphilindo grows, it is only natural that this island too should find its place within the confederation.
loc.INSHOL_papua_referendum_desc: Today, the island of Papua is divided between Indonesia and Australia. While our investments and development have transformed our half into a growing and prosperous region, the Australian-administered territory remains neglected and underdeveloped. The future of the island should rest in the hands of its people, and therefore we must demand an official referendum on the unification of Papua.
loc.INSHOL_invite_phillipines_desc: The many peoples of our union speak different languages and uphold different traditions, yet nearly all trace their roots to the Malay world. We should reform our union state into a pan-Malayan confederation, inviting the Philippines as a member state. What was once several insignificant colonies will now stand strong as Southeast Asia’s regional power.
loc.INS_focus_time_reduce_usa_tt: §Y$INS_realign_supply_chains$§! will reduce the time needed for this focus by 70 days.
loc.INS_focus_time_reduce_jap_tt: §Y$INS_first_come_first_serve$§! will reduce the time needed for this focus by 70 days.
loc.INS_focus_time_reduce_fokker_tt: §Y$INSHOL_east_indies_fokker_division$§! will reduce the time needed for this focus by 35 days.
loc.INS_focus_time_reduce_tjarda_tt: §Y$INS_governor_general_tjarda$§! will reduce the time needed for this focus by 35 days.
loc.INS_focus_time_reduce_pki_tt: §Y$INS_utilize_tan_malakas_militia$§! will reduce the time needed for this focus by 35 days.
loc.INS_tan_malaka_coup_tt: PKI Militias will stop plotting a revolution.
loc.INS_no_more_political_chaos_tt: Political Chaos Events will stop triggering.
loc.INS_soetardjo_petition_supported_tt: The Soetardjo Petition has been supported by the Volksraad
loc.INS_soetardjo_petition_against_tt: The Soetardjo Petition has divided the Volksraad
loc.HOL_taog_guarantee_colonial_loyalty_desc: Nationalism is on the rise in the Indies and it is clear another revolution is in the works. While the one we faced in 1927 was crushed with ease, our sources tell us that we may be dealing with a much more prepared group of revolutionaries. Perhaps if we grant some concessions to Soetardjo's peaceful nationalist movement we can draw the attention of civilians away from the revolution, and towards Soetardjo?
loc.HOL_taog_guarantee_colonial_loyalty_tt: §WGuarantees that [INS.GetNameDef] will not have a revolution.§!\n[INS.GetNameDefCap] will attempt to declare independence peacefully. This can be stopped by completing the focus §Y$INSHOL_industrialized_colony$§!, which will require heavy investment into the colony.
loc.SIA_the_khana_ratsadon_desc: The People's Party ended absolutism and opened the path to constitutional government. Its legacy has been contested, betrayed, and bloodied, but it remains the foundation upon which a modern [SIA.GetName] can be built.
loc.SIA_the_khana_ratsadon_tt:
The §YKhana Ratsadon§! becomes active.

The §YKhana Ratsadon§! is the leading party in [ROOT.GetName], which is divided into the §YArmy Wing§! and the §YCivilian Wing§!.

The §YCivilian Wing§! generally likes pro-democracy policies with a focus on civilian industries, whereas the §YMilitary Wing§! generally likes pro-fascist policies and militarization of industry.

Our choices will lead them to either like us more or less, giving different bonuses or maluses.
Should they become rebellious they might try to launch a coup.

The different approval states are §YRebellious§!, §YIn Opposition§!, §YNeutral§!, §YSlight Support§! and §YFull Support§!
loc.SIA_shuffle_pridi_to_the_minister_of_int: By shuffling Pridi to the position of Minister of Interior rather than Minister of Foreign Affairs, he could more effectively control the allocation of government resources and serve as a brake on encroaching military influence.
§Y$anti_fascist_raids$§! will now increase the §YCivilian wings§! approval, and reduce the §YMilitary wings§! approval
loc.SIA_civil_nationalism_desc: Every Thai, regardless of status should know that their loyalty should not be to one government, or one person, but rather to uphold the values of liberty, freedom and equality, no matter who currently sits upon the throne of power.
loc.SIA_the_true_heirs_of_1932_desc: The military likes to frame the revolution of 1932 as their sole achievement, brushing away the fact that it was a victory for the people. The people only need to be reminded of that fact, and from them we will gather strength.
loc.SIA_thammasat_university_desc: Thammasat as a newly established university could, and should, be expanded upon to pave way for a new age of Thai innovation.
loc.SIA_defenders_of_constitutional_liberty_: Teachers, Bankers, Nurses - the educated middle strata can be galvanized and mobilized to defend liberty should the military wing go too far.
loc.SIA_dominate_public_symbols_desc: The Military Wing has long dominated public symbols, erecting statues and declaring public holidays celebrating itself. We need to counter this by establishing symbols of our own, celebrating the People's right to self determination, and victory over the autocracy of old.
loc.SIA_civil_service_heroism_desc: Every Thai must be instilled with an inherent duty to protect the rule of law, should any power, foreign or domestic, try and seize that power for themselves. Not only do we need the support of the people should someone try and take our liberties away, but we need the people act as standard bearers themselves.
loc.SIA_spread_democratic_sentiment_in_unive: Academics harbor within them the future direction of [SIA.GetName]. What they learn today will echo into the future, and by ingraining the scholars of today with a strong sense of democratic duty we might spread it beyond the confines of the scholarly halls.
loc.SIA_sideline_disloyal_officers_desc: The army officer corps is not a monolith. Within its ranks sit men whose loyalties belong to former patrons, rival factions, or their own ambitions rather than to the government. With careful reassignments and administrative pressure, these figures can be moved to postings where they pose no threat, while those who have demonstrated their reliability are given the responsibilities they deserve.
loc.SIA_sideline_disloyal_officers_tt: Two random generals will get the §YReassigned§! trait for 4 years, causing them to not give bonuses.\nTwo random generals that does not have the §YReassigned§! trait will get extra stats and an extra positive trait.
loc.SIA_direct_funds_from_the_military_towar: Direct Funds from the Military Towards Development

Although the Military Wing will be displeased that its funding is being redirected toward development, it will be their responsibility, not ours, to explain to the public why this lack of investment is ultimately beneficial to them.
loc.SIA_as_the_eyes_turn_towards_southeast_a: As The Eyes Turn Towards Asia

Southeast Asia is no longer a distant theater. It is the crossroads of empire, revolution, and war. [SIA.GetName] must decide whether it will be a pawn in this struggle or a power with its own designs.
loc.SIA_support_songsuradets_military_clique: Not every officer is an enemy of the nation. Songsuradet and his loyalists offer a disciplined military alternative to the corrupt generals who brought Siam to the brink. With their support, order can be restored without surrendering the state to chaos.

Should a §YCivil War§! break out Songsuradet will support us, granting §Y3§! extra divisions\n§RIf we strengthen Songsuradet and then try to apprehend him via $SIA_the_songsuradet_rebellion$ he might resist.§!
loc.SIA_the_royal_police_counterweight_desc: The Royal Police acts as an independent force and can be leveraged against our opposition should they try and seize power for themselves.
loc.SIA_the_royal_police_counterweight_tt: Should a §YCivil War§! break out the Royal Police will support us, granting §Y2§! extra divisions
loc.SIA_for_the_preservation_of_siamese_inde: The last century has seen the powers of the world encroaching on the [SIA.GetAdjective] territorial integrity, and this century seems to be no different. We must act decisively if we are to preserve our way of life, lest we be left a rump state, crippled, divided, and torn apart.
§Y$anti_democratic_raids$§! will now increase the §YMilitary Wings§! approval, and reduce the §YCivilian wings§! approval
loc.SIA_the_peoples_day_desc: Rather than placing further emphasis on the military's role in overthrowing the old monarchy, we should elevate the role of the people themselves. Establishing a People's Day will galvanize the nation, and teach our citizens to expect nothing less.
loc.SIA_hold_military_parades_desc: To bolster military morale, reward our loyal generals, and remind our citizens of the might of the [SIA.GetAdjective] armed forces, we shall hold a grand parade through Bangkok. Let the newspapers have something worth printing!
loc.SIA_embed_technocrats_in_civilian_instit: We can form alliances with technocrats in the government, using them as an extension of the civilian wing's arm to reach further and counter the military's influence.
loc.SIA_military_academies_indoctrination_de: Our military academies are the ideal targets for ideological training. They are well armed, and young cadets are easily influenced by their instructors. Win over the instructors, and you win over the military youth. A strong military, loyal to the ruling class, is the foundation of any powerful state, and powerful we will be.
loc.SIA_the_king_of_the_white_elephant: The King of the White Elephant
loc.SIA_the_king_of_the_white_elephant_desc: Hysteria over reclaiming lost territories threatens to sweep the nation away, and the world is watching. To temper this zeal, we will produce an anti-war film, the first Thai movie shot in English, to show the world the true face of [SIA.GetName].
loc.SIA_the_king_of_the_white_elephant_tt: Unlocks the Propaganda Campaign §Y$SIA_the_king_of_the_white_elephant$§! when completing the §Y$SIA_sala_chaloem_thai_movie_theater$§! focus which yields:\nWeekly Stability: §G+0.45%§! for 180 day(s)
loc.SIA_drum_up_irredentism_desc: It is not enough to secure the military's support for a future war, we must also win the backing of the population at large. Through poems, films, and speeches, we will prepare [SIA.GetName] for a reckoning with the imperialist powers that stole our historic lands.
loc.SIA_sell_privy_purse_lands_desc: The royal family holds vast tracts of land that are now under our control. These estates could significantly bolster our coffers, and portions can be sold at favorable prices to select officers to secure their loyalty.
loc.SIA_sell_privy_purse_lands_tt: When the spirit expires §Y[SIA_phraya_phahon.GetName]§! will be embroiled in a scandal, allowing you to bypass the fascism requirement for §Y$SIA_phibuns_premiership$§!
loc.SIA_war_fervor_desc: Drums sound in anticipation of the coming conflict. The people are primed, the match has been struck, and war fervor will soon reach its zenith. We must take care to direct this energy towards a worthy cause.
loc.SIA_war_fervor_tt:
War Support will increase permanently until we declare war on any other country, upon which the spirit will be removed.

Should §YWar Support§! remain above §Y95%§! without a war declaration for too long a civil war will start.
Upon war declaration:
loc.SIA_the_midnight_meeting_tt: [SIA_plaek_phibunsongkhram.GetName] will seize power in [SIA.GetNameDef], leading the government. We will need to unseat him to restore the Monarchy proper.
loc.SIA_the_midnight_meeting_desc: Field Marshal Songsuradet watches Phibun gather ever greater power and sees in it the promise of a reckoning. If the monarchy and Songsuradet are to survive then the royalists, senior officers, and civil notables must meet in secrecy and agree upon the removal of Phibun before he moves against them first.
loc.SIA_meet_with_king_prajadhipok_desc: A conspiracy without a King is only another military intrigue. By meeting King Prajadhipok in exile, we can place their cause beneath the mantle of royal legitimacy and secure the blessing of the one man whose return may rally the hesitant and divide the regime.
loc.SIA_prajadhipok_audience_with_churchill_: Prajadhipok's presence in [ENG.GetName] offers more than prestige alone. If he can convince [ENG.GetLeader] that a loyalist rising serves British interests in Asia, then weapons from Malaya may yet find their way into the hands of men still faithful to the throne.
Upon the start of the civil war.
loc.SIA_facilitate_prajadhipoks_move_to_japa: Britain is not the only power that may profit from turmoil in [ROOT.GetNameDef]. By arranging Prajadhipok's passage to Japan, we may secure Tokyo's favor and perhaps even an assurance that divisions will be made available should a royalist rising descend into civil war.
3 Ranger Divisions from [JAP.GetNameDef] will support us during the civil war.
loc.SIA_the_kings_gambit_desc: Prajadhipok is to return to Bangkok in full expectation that the regime will place him under arrest. That act will furnish the royalists with the outrage, legitimacy and authority they require to cast aside hesitation and rise in his name. Once the exiled king is seized, the signal will be given and the struggle for [ROOT.GetName] will begin.
loc.SIA_the_kings_gambit_tt: Our Support will depend on how many cliques we have on our side.
loc.SIA_restore_order_desc: The civil war is won, but victory alone does not heal a kingdom. Rubble must be rebuilt, the old guard pacified and the administration rebuilt, so that [ROOT.GetName] may emerge from disorder with the Crown secure and public life returned to its proper course.
loc.SIA_ananda_age_trigger_12: King Ananda is at least §Y12§! years old (Currently §Y[?var:SIA_anandas_age]§!). His Birthday is the 20th of September
loc.SIA_ananda_age_trigger_15: King Ananda is at least §Y15§! years old (Currently §Y[?var:SIA_anandas_age]§!). His Birthday is the 20th of September
loc.SIA_ananda_trait_tt: When Ananda ascends the throne he will get:
loc.SIA_to_forge_a_king_desc: King Ananda remains far away in Switzerland, young enough that his mind and character are still being shaped. If we guide his studies carefully, we may yet forge not merely a crowned figurehead, but a ruler suited to the destiny we intend for [ROOT.GetNameDef].
loc.SIA_to_forge_a_king_tt:
The Future King, Ananda Mahidol is currently young and studying in [SWI.GetName]. We can influence his future studies and interests, ensuring that he becomes a great king.

Every year, on his birthday, until he is 15, we will we will be able to pick an interest for him to study, which will grant different bonuses when he eventually ascends the throne.

His Birthdate is the 20th of September and his age is §Y[?var:SIA_anandas_age]§!
loc.SIA_ascend_the_throne_desc: The years of regency cannot continue forever. Ananda is now of age to take up the burden of kingship himself, and his formal ascent to the throne will allow the restored monarchy to pass from guardianship and intrigue into a new and legitimate reign.
loc.SIA_the_provincial_council_of_state_desc: The fighting leaves the machinery of government broken and authority uncertain. Until the young King Ananda can rule in his own name, a Provincial Council of State must serve as the temporary government and proclaim that the loyalists fight not for themselves, but for the restoration of lawful monarchy.
loc.SIA_the_regency_of_boworadet_desc: Prince Boworadej carries the prestige of the old order and none can doubt where his loyalties lie. By appointing him Regent in Ananda's name, we place the state in conservative hands and make clear that the restoration is to be more than a mere change of ministers.
loc.SIA_the_sacred_hierarchy_desc: Boworadej holds that the kingdom is strongest when every estate knows its place and the Crown stands above all temporal ambition. The monarchy, the faith and the natural hierarchy of [ROOT.GetNameDef] must again be treated as sacred pillars rather than relics to be bargained away.
loc.SIA_the_regency_of_songsuradet_desc: Songsuradet is no liberal, but neither is he blind to the needs of a modern state. As Regent he can preserve royal authority while entrusting the future of [ROOT.GetNameDef] to discipline, planning and a military guided program of national development.
loc.SIA_order_discipline_and_unity_desc: The chaos of factional politics and civil war has nearly destroyed the realm. Songsuradet's answer is plain: order in government, discipline in society and unity in purpose, so that the kingdom may be remade into a stronger and more modern state.
loc.SIA_the_regency_of_rangsit_desc: Prince Rangsit understands that the monarchy can endure only by reconciling itself with representative government. His regency offers a royal restoration that is conservative in dignity, but democratic in method and prepared to give [ROOT.GetNameDef] a stable parliamentary future.
