loc.SIA_constitutional_virtue_desc: A monarchy that respects law is harder to overthrow and easier to defend. Under Rangsit's guidance, we shall revive constitutional government, restrain arbitrary power and teach the nation that the Crown is most secure when it stands as guardian of lawful liberty.
loc.SIA_an_absolute_monarchy_desc: The experiment of limited monarchy has brought only humiliation, coups and the usurpation of royal authority by ambitious officers. If the throne is to command loyalty once more, then the Crown must recover its full prerogatives and rule without subordination to parties or parliament.
loc.SIA_a_constitutional_monarchy_desc: The throne need not dominate the state to preserve the kingdom. By restoring the monarchy within a durable constitutional settlement, we can bind Crown and people together and ensure that royal dignity coexists with responsible government.
loc.SIA_to_lay_the_bait_tt:
We will leak a fabricated economic plan to antagonize the military.
The longer we delay §Y$SIA_and_spring_the_trap$§!, the greater the backlash against the military and the stronger our support will grow.

$SIA_dem_event_count_cw_scale_tt$

Every time the military criticizes the fake draft our support in the civil war will increase, up to a max of §Y75%§! civil war support. An additional §Y25%§! civil war support can be gained from our total democratic support (scaled from §Y0%-100%§!)
loc.SIA_to_lay_the_bait_desc: The Yellow Dossier calls for economic reform, but the military will call it communist. By leaking a forged radical draft first, we can provoke their outrage, then discredit them when the real, milder version is released.
loc.SIA_and_spring_the_trap_desc: The generals have taken the bait. Their outrage has become rebellion, their rebellion has exposed their ambitions, and the civilian government was ready. Now the trap closes, and the future of [ROOT.GetName] will be decided by those loyal to the constitution.
loc.SIA_and_spring_the_trap_tt: If our total support is over §Y80%§! we will avoid a civil war and depose the military instantly.
loc.SIA_rebuild_the_war_torn_economy_desc: The civil war has torn through roads, factories, rice fields, and trade routes. Reconstruction must begin at once. Wages, grain, rails, and credit will do more to stabilize [ROOT.GetName] than any speech from Bangkok.
loc.SIA_end_military_grift_desc: For too long, military budgets have fed private fortunes, patronage networks, and useless prestige projects. The war has exposed the rot. Every corrupt contract, ghost unit, and stolen shipment must be investigated and stripped from the old clique.
loc.SIA_the_purge_desc: The military clique has drenched the nation in blood rather than submit to civilian rule. There can be no compromise with traitors. Officers, collaborators, and sympathizers must be removed from every command before they can threaten the state again.
loc.SIA_achieve_foreign_legitimacy_desc: Foreign powers have watched our crisis with suspicion, waiting to see whether Siam would collapse into junta rule or revolution. We must prove that the civilian government is stable, lawful, and capable of defending the country.
loc.SIA_achieve_foreign_legitimacy_trigger: Any Major Power has more than §Y75§! Opinion of us
loc.SIA_achieve_foreign_legitimacy_tt:
Gain §G[?var:SIA_achieve_foreign_legitimacy_base_stab_gain|%.0]§! stability for every major country that has more than §Y75§! opinion of us.

If more than §Y3§! major countries qualify, we will also gain §Y1x§! §G50%§! Cost Reduction for: §YLand Doctrine§! for every qualifying major country beyond that limit.

If §Y6§! or more major countries qualify, we will gain §G+2§! §YCivilian Factories§!.
loc.SIA_secure_the_state_desc: Victory in the civil war does not mean stability. Railways, ports, arsenals, and communications hubs must be secured before reactionary officers can regroup. Bangkok must remain calm, connected, and firmly under civilian control.
loc.SIA_expand_upon_the_dossier_desc: The Yellow Dossier was written for a fragile moment. That moment has passed. With the military clique defeated, we can go further: deeper land reform, stronger labor protections, and a state capable of reshaping Siam from the ground up.
loc.SIA_military_oversight_bureau_desc: The army cannot be allowed to become a state within the state again. A civilian-led oversight bureau will monitor appointments, budgets, and political activity within the armed forces, ensuring that the barracks answer to Bangkok, not the other way around.
loc.SIA_military_oversight_bureau_tt: The §YMOB§! conducts investigations into generals every 5-9 months. During these periods, affected generals operate with reduced efficiency, wary of increased scrutiny.
loc.SIA_the_yellow_dossier_desc: The forged radical draft has done its work. Now the true Yellow Dossier can be implemented: measured reform, economic modernization, and political safeguards designed to break military dominance without handing the nation to chaos.
loc.SIA_achieve_domestic_legitimacy_desc: The government has survived by force of arms, but it must now win by law, bread, and order. Public confidence must be restored, emergency measures must be justified, and the people must see that civilian rule offers more than merely survival.
loc.SIA_achieve_domestic_legitimacy_tt:
The §YKhana Ratsadon System§! will be disabled.
The §YMilitary Wing§! will be permanently dissolved, removing its spirit entirely.

The §YCivilian Wing§! will be permanently reorganized into §Y$idea_SIA_unwavering_civilian_support$§!.
loc.SIA_allies_integration_desc: Our forces must learn to fight alongside the Allies. Command structures, communications, supply procedures, and equipment standards must be brought into line before Siam can become more than a symbolic partner.
loc.SIA_prepare_for_a_pacific_war_desc: The eyes of empires are turning toward the Pacific. Japan's ambitions, European colonies, and Allied strategy all point to a coming storm. Siam must prepare before the first shots reach our shores.
loc.SIA_the_end_of_gunboat_diplomacy_desc: Never again will foreign warships dictate terms from the mouth of the Chao Phraya. Siam must possess the guns, docks, mines, and coastal defenses needed to make any threat against Bangkok an act of madness.
loc.SIA_preemtive_strike_desc: Waiting for Japan to choose the hour of war would be folly. If the empire intends to tear through Asia, then [SIA.GetName] must strike before its armies and fleets are fully committed elsewhere.
loc.SIA_the_siamese_armada_desc: A modern [SIA.GetName] requires a modern fleet. With new ships, trained crews, and expanded naval infrastructure, the [SIA.GetAdjective] Armada will become a force capable of defending our coasts and projecting power beyond them.
loc.SIA_a_more_moderate_option_desc: Reform must endure, not burn itself out in a storm of opposition. By keeping the Yellow Dossier within moderate bounds, we can isolate extremists, calm the middle classes, and build a civilian order that survives its first victory.
loc.SIA_asian_democratic_compact_desc: Asia cannot rely forever on distant empires or great-power promises. The democratic nations of the region must stand together, defend one another, and prove that independence and liberty can survive in Asia.
loc.SIA_asian_democratic_compact_tt: Unlocks the ability to demand independence for Asian subject states, and allows us to invite them into our faction.
loc.SIA_southeast_asia_joint_command_desc: Our compact must become more than a diplomatic promise. A joint command will coordinate strategy, supply, intelligence, and defense planning across Southeast Asia, turning separate armies into a common shield.
loc.SIA_pan_asian_weapon_standardization_des: Every ally using different rifles, calibers, radios, and vehicles is an invitation to logistical failure. Standardized weapons and shared production plans will make our coalition stronger, cheaper, and faster to arm.
loc.SIA_united_against_aggression_desc: No member of our compact shall stand alone. Whether the threat comes from empire, fascism, militarism, or opportunist neighbors, the nations of Asia will answer together.
loc.SIA_the_hammers_that_strike_desc: Our alliance is no longer a collection of small states hoping to survive. It is a weapon. Each nation is a hammer, and together we will strike against any power that seeks to dominate Asia.
loc.SIA_mobilize_the_defenders_of_siam_desc: The old military failed the nation, but Siam still needs defenders. Volunteers, loyal officers, provincial guards, and patriotic citizens must be organized into a force that protects the constitution from enemies within and without.
loc.SIA_join_the_allies_desc: [ROOT.GetName] cannot stand alone while the world is consumed by war. The Allies offer weapons, recognition, and a place among nations resisting aggression. By joining them, we bind Siam's survival to the wider struggle for a free world.
loc.SIA_the_malay_peninsular_defense_plan_de: If war comes to Southeast Asia, Malaya will be one of its first battlegrounds. Fortifications, supply depots, and joint planning with the British will turn the peninsula into a shield against invasion.
loc.SIA_the_malay_peninsular_defense_plan_tt:
Builds a railway between Bangkok and Singapore.

Every Victory Points in [MAL.GetName], Singapore, [724.GetName], [289.GetName] and [1076.GetName]
Add §G2§! §YCostal Fort§!
Add §G2§! §YLand Fort§!
Each of these states:
Add §G1§! §YStatic Anti Air§!
loc.SIA_join_the_united_front_desc: China bleeds under [JAP.GetAdjective] aggression, yet it still fights. By joining the United Front, [SIA.GetName] can help turn the war on land into a graveyard for imperial ambition.
loc.SIA_a_land_war_in_asia_desc: The war will not be won by declarations alone. Siamese soldiers must march, fight, and endure across the difficult terrain of Asia. Our commitment to the United Front must be measured in action.
loc.SIA_death_to_the_communists_desc: The defeat of the military clique must not open the door to another tyranny. Communist agitators believe the crisis has weakened the state. They will soon learn that civilian democracy is not defenseless.
loc.SIA_death_to_the_nationalists_desc: Japan has been driven back, but the question of Asia's future remains. The old nationalist order will only replace one hierarchy with another. If Asia is to be remade, the communists must prevail.
loc.SIA_a_new_dawn_over_asia_desc: The Japanese empire has fallen, and the corrupt forces that sought to inherit its ruins have been cast aside. Across Asia, a new dawn rises over nations determined to build their future free from imperial domination.
loc.SIA_phibuns_premiership_desc: As [SIA_phraya_phahon.GetName]s premiership comes to an end the party's chosen successor Plaek Phibunsongkhram stands ready to assume power. This will greatly please the military's standing with us, but make the civilian wing rear with angst.\nFor us there is only one way forward in this new age; with great conviction!
loc.SIA_siamese_youth_movement_desc: The young adults of [THIS.GetName] needs to be tempered, like steel over a hot flame. They will learn to respect the state, how to defend the motherland and become valuable members of Thai Society.
loc.SIA_territorial_defense_student_desc: Expanding on the youth moment, the most promising candidates can be moved to junior soldier training camps, where they will aid in the defense of [SIA.GetNameDef]. They will receive proper military training and act as an additional tool the army can use.
loc.SIA_expand_domestic_arms_workshops_desc: Our domestic capability to produce war material is pathetically behind other developed countries. We need to focus on the expansion of military production on home soil to make sure that our forces are constantly given new equipment.
loc.SIA_look_to_european_fascism_desc: We have the opportunity to reform this country, unshackled by the past we shall look towards a new future, inspired by what is happening in the West. It is clear that the old world-order is being dismantled, and those who are left behind will suffer the consequences for their lack of vision.
loc.SIA_the_songsuradet_rebellion_desc: The senior officer Phraya Songsuradet is a threat to the present regime, should he wish to be. This danger to the regime cannot stand, and as the prime opponent to Phibun he must go.\nThere is undoubtedly ample damaging material that can be used against Songsuradet and his supporters, which would help consolidate our power and eliminate our domestic opponents.
loc.SIA_the_songsuradet_rebellion_historical:
The General Phraya Songsuradet will be accused of conspiring against the state. He and the advisor §Y[SIA_rangsit_prayurasakdi.GetName]§! will be purged.

We will gain
loc.SIA_the_songsuradet_rebellion_alt_tt: The General Phraya Songsuradet will be accused of conspiring against the state.\n\nHowever since we strengthened his military clique he might be emboldened and refuse the summons, leading to a standoff or potentially a civil war.
loc.SIA_sue_the_king_in_exile_desc: The king-in-exile is rumored to have taken quite a lot of valuables with him to [ENG.GetNameDefCap]. We should get them back, and if suing him and his spouse to achieve that then so be it.
loc.SIA_suspend_ordinary_legal_procedures_de: The Songsuradet Rebellion provides us with the opportunity to enact sweeping reforms in the name of national security. The checks and balances that are held by the courts and other political organs will be neutered, giving us the time needed to centralize power.
loc.SIA_the_duty_of_the_thai_people_during_t: The Duty of the Thai People During War Act
loc.SIA_press_censorship_desc: A free press risks undermining the stability of the state. While some leeway must exist we need to make sure that the government's voice and will is prioritized in the media.
loc.SIA_department_of_publicity_desc: A propaganda machine is imperative for any state, especially one such as ours with territorial ambitions. Funding a department of publicity will allow us to achieve this.
loc.SIA_thai_cultural_mandates_desc: We can galvanize the Thai people and build a strong national culture by issuing mandates, strengthening the people's unity, and forging a unified identity.
loc.SIA_thai_cultural_mandates_tt: Unlocks decisions to enact cultural mandates, giving various boosts for the cost of §YPolitical Power§!. Mandate One and the first other Mandate is free.
loc.SIA_relocate_the_capital_to_phetchabun_d: The Government is threatened! As history has proven, Bangkok is vulnerable against naval attacks and although it will certainly be an unpopular decision, moving the capital further inland is a decision that must be made.
loc.SIA_relocate_the_capital_to_phetchabun_t: Relocates up to §G3§! §YMilitary Factories§! from §Y[1076.GetName]§! to §Y[1077.GetName]§!\nRelocates §G3§! §YCivilian Factories§! from §Y[1076.GetName]§! to §Y[1077.GetName]§!\nBuilds Level §G3§! Forts around Petchabun
Upon the spirits timeout - Gain Base Stability: §R-25%§!
loc.SIA_radio_propaganda_desc: Radio is becoming a mainstay as [SIA.GetName] electrifies, and just as we should have a grip on the press we need to have a grip on what gets broadcasted.
loc.SIA_sala_chaloem_thai_movie_theater_tt: Unlocks decisions to make propaganda movies, giving various boosts. For example:\n
loc.SIA_sala_chaloem_thai_movie_theater_desc: Movies are a new medium in our country, but its potential is bare for all to see. Just as with poems, books and radio it can fill the hearts and minds of commoner and elite. Using this medium we can strengthen the citizens resolve to see a great [SIA.GetName] rise.
loc.SIA_pan_thaiism_desc: It is not only enough for [ROOT.GetName] to live, but it needs to thrive. The future of the [ROOT.GetAdjective] people lies not in merely being resigned as a third-rate state but an active player in world affairs. First the people's hearts and minds must be galvanized against the imperialists that took away what once was ours, and remind people about what was taken from us.
loc.SIA_retake_lost_british_states_tt: Unlocks the ability to launch limited wars against British territories in §YBurma§! and §YMalaysia§!
loc.INS_retake_lost_british_states_tt: Unlocks the ability to launch limited wars against British territories in §YMalaysia§!
loc.SIA_retake_lost_british_states_desc: It was not only the [FRA.GetAdjective] who divided our great kingdom, but also the [ENG.GetAdjective] who, driven by ambition, also seized every opportunity to claim their share. As their attention is fixed on greater rivals the moment has come for us to act.
loc.SIA_recover_indochina_desc: The last century saw our country being fragmented by the [FRA.GetAdjective], a government across the world who has no business telling us what to do or how to live, and yet with gunboats and arms they took what was ours. In this century the power of the [FRA.GetAdjecive] is fading; this century is ours.
loc.SIA_recover_indochina_tt: Unlocks the ability to launch limited wars against §YIndochina§! territories
loc.SIA_demand_the_return_of_lost_territory: Demand the Return of Lost Territory
loc.SIA_demand_the_return_of_lost_territory_: [FRA.GetNameDefCap] has shown its weakness, little more than a paper tiger clinging on to whatever fading influence it still has. With the collapse of its armed forced it can no longer project the strength it once had and are in no position to oppose our demands.

We will ask owners of §YIndochina§! and parts of §Y[MAL.GetName]§! to return §Y[1069.Getname]§!, §Y[1067.Getname]§!, §Y[741.Getname]§!, §Y[1068.Getname]§!, §Y[1061.Getname]§!, §Y[1064.Getname]§!, §Y[1065.Getname]§! and §Y[670.Getname]§! to us.

Influencing factors:
-Fighting Strength of at least 30% compared to the owner
-Owner is at war with a major
-Owner is not in a faction
-Owner is §YVichy France§!
-We are in a faction
-The owner dislikes us
loc.SIA_the_greater_thai_empire_available_tr:
§Y[ROOT.GetName]§! controls every Indochinese State
Every Indochinese states compliance is more than: §Y[?var:SIA_greater_thai_empire_compliance_requirement]%§!

Additionally requires:
loc.SIA_the_greater_thai_empire_desc: The hour of our ascension is at hand. What was once taken has been restored, and with the people recognizing us as the de facto authority, we have firmly established our legitimacy as the rightful leaders of this renewed Great Thai Empire.
loc.SIA_crack_down_of_foreign_merchants_desc: Trade has long been shaped by external interests, creating vulnerabilities that may affect our national resilience. To safeguard our economic security we must be able to control our own trade, ensuring that prosperity and stability are built on a foundation we control ourselves.
loc.SIA_royal_palace_bureau_directive_no_152: With the surge of nationalism in the country even the crown has come out in support of the government, asking every member of the Royal Palace to donate 10% of their income to buy updated weaponry.
loc.SIA_end_factionalism_desc: The rift between the military and civilian wings of the Khana Ratsadon has shadowed every decision since the revolution. If we can keep both factions firmly behind the government long enough, we can at last fuse them into a single, united People's Party and lay the specter of the coup to rest for good.
loc.SIA_end_factionalism_available_tt: Both the §YCivilian Wing§! and the §YMilitary Wing§! have been at §GFull Support§! for §Y270§! consecutive days.
loc.SIA_end_factionalism_tt: The factional rivalry within the Khana Ratsadon is laid to rest:\n   The §YCivilian§! and §YMilitary§! wings are dissolved into a §Gunited People's Party§!\n   Gain the spirit §Y$idea_SIA_unified_khana_ratsadon$§!
loc.SIA_new_territories_administration_tt: Unlocks decisions to administer §YIndochinese§! territories, giving increased compliance, industry and fortifications.
loc.SIA_new_territories_administration_desc: Reclaiming our lost territories is only the beginning. We must demonstrate to those who live there that we are the a better choice. A comprehensive programme will be undertaken to elevate living standards for all, ensuring that every citizen feels equal within this new greater [ROOT.GetName].
loc.SIA_new_territories_administration_avail: Any State in §YIndochina§!\n   Is Controlled By §Y[ROOT.GetName]§!
loc.SIA_industrialization_drive_desc: For generations, the wealth of [ROOT.GetName] has rested in rice fields and rural villages. Yet the modern world is shaped not by the plow but by the factory and the machine. If we are to preserve our independence among the great powers, we must transform our agrarian kingdom into an industrial nation.
loc.SIA_asian_financial_compact_desc: European capital still dominates much of Asian trade, leaving our economy exposed to foreign pressure. By seeking closer financial arrangements with our neighbors, we can widen our access to credit, markets and investment without surrendering our independence.
loc.SIA_revision_of_unequal_treaties_desc: Old agreements signed from weakness still grant foreign interests privileges that no modern state should tolerate. We must revise these unequal treaties and restore [ROOT.GetNameDef]'s full authority over its commerce, courts and concessions.
loc.SIA_renegotiate_teak_control_desc: Our northern forests enrich concessionaires while too little returns to the state. By renegotiating teak control, we can reclaim revenue, regulate extraction and ensure Siamese timber serves Siamese development.
loc.SIA_a_fledgling_tobacco_industry_desc: Tobacco remains a minor trade, scattered and poorly organized. With modest protection and careful investment, this small crop can become a dependable source of excise revenue, rural income and factory work.
loc.SIA_a_fledgling_tobacco_industry_tt: Being on §Y$limited_exports$§! or §Y$closed_economy$§! will yield us an extra §YCivilian Factory§!
loc.SIA_all_weather_roads_desc: Too many roads vanish with the rains, leaving provinces cut off from the capital and markets. A network of all weather roads will bind the kingdom together and allow goods and soldiers to move in every season.
loc.SIA_the_bank_of_siam_desc: Industrial growth cannot proceed on custom and private favor alone. A stronger national bank will give the state greater command over credit, currency and the circulation of capital.
loc.SIA_thai_rice_company_desc: Rice remains the lifeblood of [ROOT.GetName], yet too much of its trade is fragmented, speculative and vulnerable to foreign pressure. A national rice company will allow the state to guide exports, stabilize prices and turn the harvest of our paddies into a firmer foundation for national strength.
loc.SIA_uk_japan_focus_tt: Which allows picking between [ENG.GetNameDef] and [JAP.GetNameDef] with the following effects:\n\n§Y[ENG.GetFlag][ENG.GetNameDefCap]§!:
loc.SIA_send_bureaucrats_abroad_desc: Other nations have already built the ministries, schools and technical services that we now require. By sending promising officials abroad, we can import administrative experience without importing foreign rule.
loc.SIA_baht_stabilization_act_desc: A modern economy requires a currency that merchants trust and investors accept. Stabilizing the baht will reduce uncertainty in trade and give [ROOT.GetNameDef] firmer footing in the international market.
loc.SIA_siamese_development_cooperative_desc: Private capital is cautious and the state cannot build everything alone. A national development cooperative will allow officials, merchants and landholders to pool resources for projects that serve the common economy.
loc.SIA_boon_rawd_brewery_desc: A domestic brewing industry is more than a matter of consumption. Enterprises such as Boon Rawd show that Siamese capital, machinery and management can create modern industry on Siamese soil.
loc.SIA_national_savings_bond_desc: The wealth of the nation must not lie idle in strongboxes and ornaments while roads and factories go unbuilt. A national savings bond will turn private thrift into public investment.
loc.SIA_national_savings_bond_tt: Gains the $SIA_national_savings_bond$ Spirit, which scales in strength depending on your §YConscription Law§!. The lower your conscription law is the stronger the positive effects are, whereas the higher it is the worse it gets.\n\nAt §Y$disarmed_nation$§! gain:
loc.SIA_national_savings_bond_current: Our current mobilization law would grant us:
loc.SIA_deficit_spending_desc: Orthodox bookkeeping will not build a modern economy in time to meet a dangerous world. The state must be willing to spend ahead of current revenues, using public works and procurement to force industrial growth into motion.
loc.SIA_deficit_spending_tt: After the spirit times out gain:
loc.SIA_acquire_light_tools_desc: Before we can produce great machines, we must first master the humble implements of industry. Imports of light tools and workshop equipment will allow small factories and repair shops to multiply across [ROOT.GetName].
loc.SIA_railway_and_port_extensions_desc: Rice, timber and tin are worthless if they cannot reach the market. Extending the railways and expanding our ports will draw the provinces into national commerce and connect [ROOT.GetNameDef] to the wider world.
loc.SIA_mechanization_of_agriculture_desc: Too much labor remains tied to traditional cultivation, yielding little surplus for industry. By introducing modern tools and machines to the countryside, we can raise output and release hands for the factories.
loc.SIA_irrigation_desc: The fortunes of the peasant still rise and fall with flood and drought. A broader irrigation system will steady harvests, expand cultivated land and make the countryside a firmer base for national development.
loc.SIA_siam_cement_group_desc: Founded under royal patronage, the [ROOT.GetName] Cement Group stands as one of [ROOT.GetNameDef]'s most significant industrial enterprises. With targeted investment and government backing, the company can be transformed from a domestic supplier into a cornerstone of our broader industrial capacity — laying the foundations, quite literally, for the nation's future.
loc.SIA_chemical_imports_desc: Modern farming and industry alike depend on compounds that we do not yet produce in sufficient quantity. Importing chemicals will supply fertilizers, medicines, dyes and explosives until domestic industry can take up the task.
loc.SIA_chemical_imports_tt: Add §G+1§! offmap §YCivilian Factory§! if opinion is above §Y[?var:ROOT.SIA_chemical_imports_opinion_threshold]§! when this focus is completed.
loc.INS_chemical_imports_stolen_tt: Add §G[?var:ROOT.INS_guns_from_seek_help_focus]§! units of Infantry Equipment if opinion is above §Y75§! when this focus is completed.
loc.SIA_foreign_currency_exchange_desc: Industrialization demands foreign machinery, medicine and fuel, yet these can only be bought with scarce exchange. A controlled currency exchange system will direct foreign funds toward the industries most vital to the state.
loc.SIA_farmers_into_the_city_desc: A modern economy cannot be sustained by village labor alone. As industry expands, the state must encourage orderly migration from the paddies to the towns, where a new urban workforce can be formed.
loc.SIA_textile_mills_desc: Cloth is a daily necessity, yet too much of it is woven abroad and sold back to us. Textile mills will replace imported goods, employ urban labor and give [ROOT.GetNameDef] one of the basic industries of modern life.
loc.SIA_public_credit_desc: Merchants, growers and manufacturers alike are constrained by limited access to capital. By expanding public credit, the government can lend where private finance hesitates and push development into neglected sectors.
loc.SIA_public_credit_trigger: $idea_SIA_public_credit_debt$ has been active for at least §Y180 day(s)§!
loc.SIA_a_modern_economy_desc: The old agrarian order does not disappear in a day, but it can no longer define the future of [ROOT.GetNameDef]. With banks, schools, factories and infrastructure now taking shape, we are beginning to build an economy worthy of an independent modern nation.
loc.SIA_reduction_of_agricultural_yield_taxe:
Reduces the §YConsumer Goods§! from $idea_SIA_agricultural_tax_reduction$ by §Y[?var:SIA_agricultural_tax_reduction_cg_decrease_rate|%]§! every month, and increases §YStability§! by §Y[?var:SIA_agricultural_tax_reduction_stability_gain|%]§! every month, until the §YConsumer Goods§! malus reaches §Y0%§!

When the spirit is removed gain:

The peasantry cannot be asked to feed the kingdom, finance the state and endure every hardship without relief. By reducing taxes on agricultural yield, we leave more surplus in the countryside, strengthen loyalty among the cultivators and encourage greater production from the land.
loc.SIA_fuel_oil_act_desc: Modern transport, industry and defense all depend upon fuel, yet access to it may be strangled in war. A fuel oil act will place consumption, storage and emergency allocation under firmer state oversight so that scarce supplies are not squandered.
loc.SIA_siam_electricity_company_desc: No economy can endure modern strain without dependable power. By strengthening the Siam Electricity Company, we can extend generation, improve coordination and ensure that workshops, depots and cities remain supplied even in adversity.
loc.SIA_revise_the_taxation_system_desc: The present tax structure does not adequately serve a state preparing for hardship and self-reliance. A revised system will collect revenue more evenly, reduce waste and direct the burden of national defense and development with greater discipline.
loc.SIA_census_the_hill_tribes_desc: The uplands remain beyond the full reach of administration, taxation and supply. A proper census will give the government the knowledge required to govern these regions more effectively and draw their people and resources into the wider life of the nation.
loc.SIA_increase_rice_exports_desc: Rice is the surest source of foreign income available to [ROOT.GetNameDef]. By expanding exports while markets remain open, we can build reserves, finance strategic imports and prepare the treasury for the disruptions that may yet come.
loc.SIA_pad_thai_desc: A modern nation is sustained not only by ministries and factories, but by common habits that bind the people together. By promoting a national rice dish drawn from Siamese ingredients, we encourage domestic consumption, support our farmers and reduce reliance on foreign foods in uncertain times.
loc.SIA_rice_husk_steam_turbines_desc: What the foreigner sees as waste, necessity teaches us to value. By burning rice husks for steam generation, we can draw power from our own harvests and reduce our dependence on imported coal and oil.
loc.SIA_domestic_tin_smelters_desc: It is no longer enough merely to dig ore from the soil and ship it abroad. By building domestic tin smelters, we retain more of the value of our resources at home and secure an industrial metal essential to both commerce and war.
loc.SIA_use_ships_as_generators_tt: Placing §YCapital Ships§! owned by us in §YCore State Ports§! will give us a §G-2%§! bonus to Factory Energy Consumption per §YCapital Ship§!, up to a total of §G-15%§!.\n\nThese ships leaving port will reduce the bonus by as much, and can be regained by placing the ships in port once more.
loc.SIA_use_ships_as_generators_desc: Even older vessels may still serve the nation when they are no longer fit for battle or trade. By mooring ships as floating power stations, we can provide emergency electricity to ports and coastal industry while preserving precious fuel and infrastructure.
loc.SIA_diversity_foreign_reserves_desc: It is dangerous for [ROOT.GetNameDef] to place its financial safety in the currency or credit of any single foreign power. By diversifying our reserves, we reduce the risk of external shocks and preserve greater freedom of action in trade and diplomacy.
loc.SIA_diversity_foreign_reserves_tt: Add an additional §G2§! offmap §YMilitary Factory§! when going to war.\nAdd Production §G8§! Steel in a random core state when going to war.
loc.SIA_exclusivity_resource_contract_desc: A single foreign partner offers capital and guaranteed purchases in exchange for privileged access to our resources. Such an exclusive contract may quicken development, though it ties one part of [ROOT.GetNameDef]'s future to another nation's appetite.
loc.SIA_maintain_resource_independence_desc: Foreign contracts may bring quick profits, but dependence follows closely behind. By maintaining control over our resources, we preserve the freedom to direct them according to Siamese needs rather than foreign demands.
loc.SIA_kasetsart_university_desc: If agriculture is to become more productive, it must be guided by science rather than inheritance alone. Kasetsart University will train agronomists, veterinarians and technical experts for the modernization of the land.
loc.SIA_mahidol_university_desc: A modern state requires doctors, researchers and administrators as surely as it requires soldiers and engineers. Mahidol University will strengthen higher learning and provide the trained minds needed for national reform.
loc.SIA_contingency_funds_desc: Prosperity in peace is of little value if the state enters crisis unprepared. By setting aside contingency funds now, we ensure that blockade, crop failure or sudden war will not immediately bring the machinery of government to a halt.
loc.SIA_contingency_funds_tt:
We will gather a contingency fund during peace time. While gathering this fund we will gain a moderate amount of §Yconsumer goods factor§!.

During war we can release this fund should we choose, gaining a large production bonus.
How long the fund lasts depends on how long we have gathered the fund before releasing it.
loc.SIA_prepare_for_the_next_blockade_desc: Should the seas become hostile, [ROOT.GetNameDef] may find itself cut off from markets, machinery and fuel. We must therefore prepare now for the next blockade, building stockpiles, emergency plans and substitutes before necessity forces our hand.
loc.SIA_domestic_arms_industry_desc: A kingdom that must import every rifle and shell cannot call itself secure. However modest its beginnings, a domestic arms industry will allow [ROOT.GetNameDef] to arm its soldiers from its own workshops and endure when foreign supplies fail.
loc.SIA_war_material_substitutions_desc: In time of blockade, the perfect material is less valuable than the available one. We must study substitutes for metals, chemicals and imported components so that production may continue even when foreign goods no longer reach our shores.
loc.SIA_royal_thai_ordnance_factory_desc: A secure state requires more than imported weapons and scattered repair shops. The Royal Thai Ordnance Factory will concentrate skill, machinery and supervision under the crown, giving [ROOT.GetNameDef] a permanent center for the manufacture of arms and ammunition.
loc.SIA_built_to_withstand_every_flame_desc: The factory that burns in one night cannot serve the nation in the morning. Our storehouses, mills and workshops must be built with dispersal, fireproofing and emergency protection in mind so that sabotage, bombing or accident cannot so easily cripple production.
loc.SIA_the_army_of_siam_desc: The old structure of our armed forces no longer answers the demands of the age. If [ROOT.GetName] is to defend its sovereignty and assert its interests abroad, we must build a new modern army, equipped, trained and organized for the wars now taking shape across the world.
loc.SIA_plan_for_a_short_war_desc: Our resources are limited and our enemies may be many. [ROOT.GetNameDefCap] cannot afford a long contest of attrition. If war comes, it must be swift, decisive and brought to a conclusion before the enemy can gather strength.
loc.SIA_plan_for_a_short_war_tt: The first time §Y[SIA.GetName]§! attacks another country gain
loc.SIA_plan_for_a_short_war_tt2: for §Y90 day(s)§!.\n\nAfter this spirit runs out gain:
loc.SIA_intermediate_war_preparation_desc: It is dangerous to prepare only for a lightning campaign, yet wasteful to organize entirely for endless struggle. A balanced doctrine will allow [ROOT.GetName] to strike with vigor while retaining the endurance needed to face a more stubborn foe.
loc.SIA_prepare_for_a_long_war_desc: The great powers may decide wars in months, but lesser nations are often forced to endure them for years. We must therefore prepare [ROOT.GetAdjective] arms, industry and transport for a long grinding conflict in which patience and resilience matter as much as courage.
loc.SIA_specialized_warfare_desc: The terrain of our region does not favor a uniform army. Mountains, jungle and riverlands each demand different skills. By cultivating specialized troops, we can ensure that [ROOT.GetNameDef] meets the enemy with the proper force in every field.
loc.SIA_artillery_reigns_supreme_desc: Modern battle is not won by spirit alone. The gun remains the king of the battlefield, breaking strongpoints, shattering assaults and paving the way for our infantry. If we are to triumph, [ROOT.GetAdjective] firepower must be made both plentiful and precise.
loc.SIA_yield_the_air_war_desc: We cannot hope to challenge the great powers in the skies on equal terms. Rather than squander precious resources in a contest we are unlikely to win, we shall strengthen our anti-air defenses and deny enemy aircraft the freedom to strike our men and cities without cost.
loc.SIA_camouflage_desc: If we cannot own the sky, we shall deny the enemy anything worth striking beneath it. Nets, dispersal and the discipline of movement by night will hide our columns from the eyes above, and the gunners we drill alongside them will make every pass a costly one.
loc.SIA_the_thunder_at_the_gates_desc: There are fortresses that ordinary guns cannot break and attacks that must be announced with overwhelming force. Heavy artillery, siege guns and railway pieces will give [ROOT.GetNameDef] the power to batter down the gates of any enemy who mistakes our restraint for weakness.
loc.SIA_night_time_training_desc: Bold assaults in broad daylight invite disaster against a prepared foe. By training our men for infiltration, movement and attack under cover of darkness, we may seize the initiative when the enemy is blind, confused and least prepared to answer us.
loc.SIA_steel_arteries_desc: No army marches far without rails and roads to sustain it. The steel arteries of the nation must be strengthened so that troops, supplies and guns may be carried swiftly to every threatened frontier. In this work, military security and national development go hand in hand.
loc.SIA_prepare_northern_infrastructure_for_: The northern approaches will become vital in any contest with Burma and those who stand behind it. Roads, railways and depots in that region must be expanded at once, so that [ROOT.GetAdjective] forces may advance or resist there without delay.
loc.SIA_unconventional_tank_construction_des: We cannot imitate the armored programs of the great powers piece for piece. If [ROOT.GetNameDef] is to field tanks at all, we must pursue cheaper and more adaptable methods of construction, sacrificing grandeur in favor of numbers and utility.
loc.SIA_conventional_tank_construction_desc: Armor has become an accepted arm of modern war, and makeshift solutions will only carry us so far. We should therefore establish a proper tank industry based on sound principles, standard designs and reliable production methods worthy of a modern army.
loc.SIA_reverse_engineer_allied_tanks_desc: Others have already borne the expense of experimentation. Captured tanks and imported machines can be stripped apart, studied and imitated. By learning from foreign designs, [ROOT.GetName] may shorten the path toward its own armored force.
loc.SIA_tankettes_desc: Light, cheap and simple to produce, tankettes may not decide great battles on their own, but they can still serve scouting, colonial warfare and infantry support. For a nation of modest means, such small armored vehicles offer a practical entrance into mechanized war.
loc.SIA_jungle_armor_desc: The jungles of our region are no place for ponderous machines designed for the plains of Europe. If armor is to serve [ROOT.GetNameDef], it must be adapted for narrow tracks, poor ground and oppressive climate, trading weight for mobility where the jungle demands it.
loc.SIA_mountain_tanks_desc: Rugged hills and mountain passes cannot simply be left to infantry alone. By pursuing compact armored vehicles suited for broken terrain, we may give our armies a means to bring protected firepower into regions where ordinary tanks would fail.
loc.SIA_reluctant_submission_desc: Should [ROOT.GetNameDef] face invasion by a stronger foe, there may come a moment when open resistance promises only ruin. To bend is bitter, yet sometimes a government must yield to preserve the nation from destruction and await a more favorable hour.
loc.SIA_reluctant_submission_trigger: This focus will automatically complete if we are attacked and pick the §YSubmission§! option in the event.
loc.SIA_reluctant_submission_tt:
We will be able to peace out an attacking major country. However they will expect us to print money for them.
Our §YConsumer Goods Factories factor§! will increase by §Y[?idea_SIA_printing_money_monthly_change|%]§! monthly, to a max of §Y[?idea_SIA_printing_money_monthly_change_max|%]§!.

Taking the focus §Y$SIA_thai_rice_company$§! will reduce the increase rate by §G50%§!

Taking the focus §Y$SIA_demand_repatriation$§! will remove the need to print money.
loc.SIA_seri_thai_desc: Submission need not mean surrender of the national spirit. Beneath the surface of occupation and compliance, a loyal underground can be organized to preserve the cause of independence, gather intelligence and prepare the day when [ROOT.GetName] rises again.
loc.SIA_contact_the_south_east_asia_command: Contact the South East Asia Command
loc.SIA_contact_the_south_east_asia_command_: If resistance is to amount to more than brave gestures, it must be tied to a wider strategy. By establishing contact with the Allied command in Southeast Asia, the patriots of [ROOT.GetName] may secure guidance, supplies and a place in the greater struggle.
loc.SIA_broadcast_weather_reports_to_the_all: Broadcast Weather Reports to the Allies

The skies and seas of the region are governed as much by weather as by fleets and armies. Reliable reports from [ROOT.GetNameDef] can aid Allied planning, shield their operations from surprise and make our homeland a silent but valuable partner in their war.
loc.SIA_american_investment_aid_desc: The United States possesses wealth beyond anything available in our own region. If we can secure American aid and investment for our clandestine and national efforts, [ROOT.GetNameDef] will gain the material means to endure hardship and prepare for liberation.
loc.SIA_thai_students_in_the_oss_desc: A new generation of patriotic youth can be trained abroad in the arts of espionage, sabotage and irregular warfare. By sending trusted Thai students into the orbit of Allied intelligence, we shall prepare able servants for the hidden war ahead.
loc.SIA_prepare_to_drop_desc: When the hour of liberation comes, the Allies may seek to descend upon our homeland from the sky. We must therefore identify landing grounds, prepare contacts and organize support networks so that airborne forces can be received and directed where they are most needed.
loc.SIA_unseat_the_government_desc: A regime that has bound [ROOT.GetNameDef] to foreign domination cannot be allowed to endure forever. Through resistance, intrigue and timely action, we may remove those who have compromised the nation and restore a government more worthy of Siam.
loc.SIA_unseat_the_government_tt:
[ROOT.GetName] will leave its current faction and switch sides in the war, joining the §YAllies§!.

Loyalists will rise up against the change, sparking a civil war.

If our combined support is §Ymore than 80%§! we will oust the government and avoid a civil war. Our total support is §Y5%§! for each swayed general, in addition to our democratic support.

Our support from our swayed generals is §Y[?var:SIA_seri_thai_cw_scale|%]§! and our democratic support is §Y[?var:party_popularity@democratic|%]§!
loc.SIA_choose_new_leader_tt: With the old regime broken, the victors must choose who will head the new government.
loc.SIA_the_phayap_army_desc: If we cast our lot with the invader, then our armies must be given a place in the new order of war. A dedicated field command for operations to the west and north will allow [ROOT.GetName] to advance alongside its powerful partner and pursue gains of its own.
loc.SIA_securing_the_rubber_islands_desc: Rubber is the lifeblood of modern war, feeding tires, seals and countless instruments of mechanized conflict. The resource-rich territories to our south present both an opportunity and a necessity. We should move to secure them before others do.
loc.SIA_breaking_the_burmese_line_desc: Burma stands as a barrier between our ambitions and the lands beyond. If [ROOT.GetAdjective] arms are to prove their worth, the enemy line there must be broken by determination, planning and the concentrated use of force.
loc.SIA_pacific_war_desc: The conflict in East Asia can no longer be treated as distant. The war in the Pacific is shaping the fate of all nations in our region, and [ROOT.GetNameDef] must decide its place in that struggle, whether as follower, partner or victim.
loc.SIA_joint_asian_military_command_desc: Our efforts will be stronger if coordinated with those of our regional partners. A joint command structure promises greater efficiency, clearer planning and a common direction for campaigns that otherwise risk being squandered through rivalry and confusion.
loc.SIA_demand_repatriation_desc: Those who entered our land under the pretense of necessity have incurred a debt to [ROOT.GetNameDef]. Once our fortunes improve, we should demand the return of what has been taken and press the occupier to repay the cost of its intrusion.
loc.SIA_standing_our_ground_desc: There comes a point when retreat and negotiation offer only further humiliation. [ROOT.GetNameDefCap] must show that it still possesses the will to stand, to fight and to drive out those who presume they may dictate our fate at gunpoint.
loc.SIA_standing_our_ground_trigger: This focus will automatically complete if we are attacked and pick the §YResistance§! option in the event.
loc.SIA_ask_for_the_release_of_american_comm: Ask for the Release of American Commodities

American stores, machinery and goods may provide the breathing room our nation needs. Through careful diplomacy we can request the release of such commodities, easing shortages and strengthening the material basis of our war effort.
loc.SIA_japanese_fighters_desc: Though our own aviation industry remains slight, foreign aircraft can help fill the gap. Japanese fighters in [ROOT.GetAdjective] hands would at least give us a measure of modern air power, even if only within limits set by our industrial weakness.
loc.SIA_get_off_our_shores_desc: The presence of foreign troops on Siamese soil is an affront that cannot be softened by excuses. Whether by force of arms or by pressure from events abroad, we must insist that the invader leave our shores and restore the dignity of [ROOT.GetNameDef].\n\nThey are cowards, like all cruel men. Now, get off our shores.
loc.SIA_singaporean_reinforcements_desc: The struggle in Malaya and beyond is inseparable from our own security. Reinforcements drawn from the forces gathering around Singapore could stiffen our line, widen our cooperation with the Allies and bind the theater together under common purpose.
loc.SIA_aid_for_resources_desc: Our nation has resources that foreign powers desire and lacks certain tools that they can provide. A prudent exchange of aid for materials will help keep [ROOT.GetNameDef] supplied while ensuring our wealth contributes to our own preservation.
loc.SIA_aid_for_resources_tt: We will ask [JAP.GetNameDef] to join our war, against them getting resource rights for rubber in §Y[724.GetName]§!
loc.SIA_how_quickly_the_tables_turn_desc: Those who once treated [ROOT.GetNameDef] as weak and compliant may yet find the balance reversed. Fortune in war turns rapidly, and we must be ready to seize the moment when our oppressors falter and the tables are at last turned against them.
loc.SIA_how_quickly_the_tables_turn_trigger: We have been attacked by a major and capitulated said major.
loc.SIA_royal_thai_navy_desc: The defense of [ROOT.GetNameDef] does not end at the shoreline. Our coasts, rivers and maritime trade demand a fleet worthy of the kingdom. By strengthening the Royal Thai Navy, we shall ensure that Siam remains master of its own waters.
loc.SIA_direct_army_fundings_towards_the_nav: Direct Army Fundings Towards the Navy

The army has long consumed the lion's share of military expenditure, yet the strategic needs of [ROOT.GetNameDef] are not purely continental. By shifting funds toward the fleet, we can begin correcting this imbalance and secure the seas that shelter our commerce and coast.
loc.SIA_thonburi_class_coastal_defense_ship_: A modest fleet may still wield sharp teeth if properly designed for local conditions. The Thonburi class offers [ROOT.GetNameDef] a practical means of coastal defense, combining respectable firepower with a role suited to the waters we most urgently need to protect.
loc.SIA_acquire_submarines_desc: Submarines offer a small navy the chance to strike above its weight. Hidden beneath the waves, they can threaten shipping, deter stronger fleets and complicate any hostile design against our coast. [ROOT.GetNameDefCap] should not neglect such a weapon.
loc.SIA_submarine_day_desc: The introduction of undersea warfare into our fleet deserves public recognition and national enthusiasm. By celebrating the submarine arm, we can encourage recruitment, raise prestige and fix the idea in the public mind that Siam is entering a new naval age.
loc.SIA_the_thonburi_dockyard_project_desc: A navy cannot be sustained by imported hulls alone. If [ROOT.GetNameDef] is to maintain and expand its maritime forces, it must invest in the dockyards, workshops and labor that form the true foundation of sea power.
loc.SIA_expand_the_slipways_desc: Our current facilities are too cramped for the ambitions now taking shape. By enlarging the slipways, we shall increase our capacity to build and repair vessels, allowing the fleet to grow in size and readiness.
loc.SIA_a_new_drydock_desc: Serious naval maintenance demands a modern drydock. Without one, the upkeep of larger ships remains slow, inefficient and dependent on foreign assistance. A new drydock will give [ROOT.GetNameDef] a firmer grip over its own naval future.
loc.SIA_install_heavy_cranes_and_power_plant: Install Heavy Cranes and Power Plant

Shipbuilding is not merely a matter of timber and steel, but of machinery and energy. Heavy cranes and reliable electrical supply will transform our yards from crude facilities into proper instruments of modern industry.
loc.SIA_establish_the_foundry_and_machine_sh: Establish the Foundry and Machine Shop

A sovereign navy requires more than hulls assembled from imported parts. By founding our own foundry and machine shop, we will strengthen the industrial sinews that allow [ROOT.GetNameDef] to cast, shape and repair the vital components of warships at home.
loc.SIA_the_thonburi_arsenal_desc: A dockyard without armament remains incomplete. The establishment of an arsenal at Thonburi will permit the manufacture and storage of naval guns, ammunition and related equipment, binding our fleet more closely to national industry.
loc.SIA_focus_on_commercial_civilian_ships_d: Not every keel laid must be intended for battle. Merchantmen, transports and other civilian vessels form the circulatory system of the national economy. By fostering commercial shipbuilding, [ROOT.GetNameDef] strengthens both prosperity and wartime resilience.
loc.SIA_empower_the_coastguard_desc: The fleet cannot be everywhere at once, and many tasks of coastal security are better handled by lighter services. A strengthened coastguard will protect our fisheries, police our shores and free the navy to attend to graver threats.
loc.SIA_river_patrols_desc: The rivers of [ROOT.GetNameDef] are roads, frontiers and lifelines at once. Patrol craft on these waters will help us enforce order, support local garrisons and extend the reach of the state into regions where a distant capital is otherwise slow to act.
loc.SIA_sell_bangkok_dock_co_desc: Private capital may accomplish what state management performs too slowly. By selling Bangkok Dock Company into capable hands, we may attract investment, stimulate efficiency and redirect public funds toward more pressing military needs.
loc.SIA_a_race_against_time_desc: Our navy is outdated, underfunded, and unprepared for modern war. Funds must be redirected immediately into shipbuilding, refits, coastal defense, and naval training. The clock is running faster than our dockyards.
loc.SIA_a_race_against_time_tt: After the spirit times we will gain:
loc.SIA_siamese_tankettes_desc: Our army has developed familiarity with its fleet of light tankettes, improving their reliability and reducing the cost of keeping them in the field.
loc.idea_SIA_yielded_the_air_war_desc: Having conceded control of the skies, resources are redirected toward anti-air defences rather than contesting air superiority directly.
loc.idea_SIA_german_tank_studies_desc: Our officers have spent time studying foreign armoured doctrine and design, returning with technical knowledge that feeds directly into the development of our own armoured forces.

loc.idea_SIA_weather_broadcasts_desc: Regular weather broadcasts give our air and naval forces a clearer picture of conditions, improving their effectiveness and reducing the risks of operating in poor weather.
loc.idea_SIA_seri_thai_contacts_desc: Contacts with the Seri Thai resistance network are proving their worth, bringing in experienced fighters and strengthening ties with the Allies.
loc.idea_SIA_joint_military_command_desc: A unified command structure has improved coordination between branches, accelerating the development of experienced officers and battlefield doctrine.

loc.SIA_the_peoples_war_in_asia_desc: The struggle against [JAP.GetAdjective] imperialism is not merely a contest between states. It is a war of workers, peasants and soldiers against domination from abroad. By standing with the communist forces in China, [ROOT.GetNameDef] commits itself to a broader people's war across Asia.
loc.SIA_peoples_war_in_asia_idea_desc: The war is sustained by more than regular formations. Local committees, partisan guides and peasant supply columns now serve the army in the field. Every village becomes a depot, every road a possible ambush and every retreat a chance to draw the enemy deeper inland.
loc.SIA_national_defense_in_asia_desc: The defense of Asia requires discipline, hierarchy and a common strategic purpose. By standing with the nationalist government of China, [ROOT.GetNameDef] joins a coalition determined to resist [JAP.GetAdjective] expansion through organized armies and coordinated command.
loc.SIA_national_defense_in_asia_tt:
§Y[ROOT.GetNameWithFlag]§! aligns with the nationalist forces in the United Front.
Adds §Y$SIA_national_defense_in_asia_idea$§!, which grants:
 $MODIFIER_ARMY_ORG_FACTOR$: §G+5%§!
 $MODIFIER_PLANNING_SPEED$: §G+10%§!
 $MODIFIER_MAX_PLANNING$: §G+10%§!
 $MODIFIERS_ARMY_DEFENCE_FACTOR$: §G+5%§!
loc.SIA_stronger_together_desc: The war has reduced distant promises and parallel alliances to little more than obstacles. If [ROOT.GetNameDef] is to shape the course of Asia, we must ask our partners to bind their faction to ours and accept a single command in the struggle ahead.
loc.SIA_directorate_of_aeronautical_engineer: The future of [ROOT.GetNameDef]'s air arm will not be secured by pilots alone. It requires engineers, inspectors, workshops and a central authority capable of turning foreign purchases into serviceable aircraft. The Directorate of Aeronautical Engineering shall become the foundation of this effort.
loc.SIA_standardize_aircraft_maintenance_des: Our aircraft come from many sources, each with its own parts, tools and habits of repair. By standardizing maintenance procedures under the Directorate, [ROOT.GetNameDef] can keep more aircraft in the air and reduce the waste caused by confusion on the ground.
loc.SIA_expand_aircraft_workshops_desc: The Directorate requires more than offices and inspection papers. New workshops, machine tools and trained mechanics will allow damaged aircraft to be repaired domestically, while simple components can be produced without waiting on foreign deliveries.
loc.SIA_license_modern_airframes_desc: [ROOT.GetNameDefCap] can not yet design every aircraft it needs. A more practical course is to license foreign models, study their construction and adapt them to our climate, airfields and supply conditions under the supervision of the Directorate.
loc.SIA_tropical_air_operations_desc: Heat, humidity, monsoon rains and rough forward fields place their own demands upon aircraft and crews. By adapting engines, maintenance schedules and pilot doctrine to these conditions, the Directorate can make our air force more reliable in the skies above Southeast Asia.
loc.SIA_thai_french_liaison_no_indochina_tt: We occupy no part of French Indochina (Laos, Cambodia or Vietnam)
loc.SIA_thai_french_liaison_desc: The bonds forged when our first aviators trained in France still hold. While Paris and Bangkok remain at peace, a standing liaison keeps French technical expertise, manuals and goodwill flowing to our air arm.
loc.SIA_expand_don_mueang_desc: Don Mueang is the beating heart of our air arm. New runways, hangars and depots will make it a base worthy of a modern air force, and the anvil upon which our squadrons are forged.
loc.SIA_hawk_iii_production_line_desc: The Hawk III is already familiar to our pilots and our workshops. Standardizing around a proven, license-built fighter buys time while we decide what modernization will really mean.
loc.SIA_mixed_inventory_standardization_desc: American, Japanese and older French-derived practices do not make a coherent air force by themselves. Spare parts, markings, radios and maintenance discipline must be standardized before the next war arrives.
loc.SIA_womens_auxiliary_air_force_desc: Every mechanic, clerk and radio operator freed from the ground crews is another pilot in the air. Thai women have already proven themselves in the hospitals and the ministries; the airfields of Don Mueang will be no different.
loc.SIA_air_defense_of_the_kra: Air Defense of the Kra Isthmus
loc.SIA_air_defense_of_the_kra_desc: Southern Thailand is the hinge between Malaya and Burma. Any power moving through the peninsula must face Thai airfields, warning posts and interceptors. We will hold the skies over our own soil rather than reach for those of others.
loc.SIA_the_interceptor_force_desc: Standing patrols and a ground observer net turn our fighters into a true interceptor force. Radar and quick scrambles will meet raiders before they reach our cities.
loc.SIA_hardened_air_defenses_desc: Dispersed strips, revetments and dense flak batteries let our air arm absorb a blow and keep flying. What survives the first raid will still be there for the second.
loc.SIA_forward_strike_wings_desc: Rather than wait to be attacked, we will train wings to seize the air over the front and carry the fight to the enemy the moment war begins.
loc.SIA_increase_air_crews_desc: We will expand the ground crews that tend our aircraft. It costs the manpower to fill their ranks, but well maintained and better protected machines will fly again where a neglected one would be lost.
loc.SIA_conserve_air_crews_desc: Every mechanic on the airfield is a rifleman not at the front. We will run our air arm lean, freeing that manpower for the army, and accept that our aircraft will break down more often for it.
loc.SIA_tropical_operations_desc: Heat, monsoon and jungle canopy punish careless airmen more than enemy guns do. We will design our air arm around the climate of our own region, striking hard at the enemy on the ground despite the weather.
loc.SIA_veteran_jungle_aviators_desc: Flying in this climate breaks green pilots and worn engines alike. Better maintenance and hard-earned experience will turn survival into skill, and skill into aces.
loc.SIA_long_range_strike_wings_desc: Rather than build for the jungle in front of us, we will build for the distance beyond it. A fleet of long-legged bombers, procured and produced without the usual waste, will let us strike far past our own borders.
loc.SIA_lightweight_airframes_desc: Strip out the ferry tanks and the weight meant for distance, and what remains turns tighter, climbs faster and carries a heavier punch over the target. Our wings will not reach far, but nothing within their reach will be safe.
loc.SIA_tactical_bombing_school_desc: A dedicated school for bomber crews will turn our tactical bombers from a blunt instrument into a precise one, striking harder and truer at whatever stands in their path.
loc.SIA_reinforced_platings_desc: Armor plating and auxiliary fuel tanks let our escort fighters take a hit and still reach targets far from home. The added weight burns more fuel along the way, but a well-drilled escort wing is worth the cost.
loc.SIA_destroy_the_indochinese_ports_desc: The harbours of Indochina are the hinges on which any enemy campaign against us swings. We will make their destruction a standing objective of the air arm, whether by a bomber raid at the outbreak of war or by charges quietly placed long before the first shot.
loc.SIA_destroy_the_indochinese_ports_tt: Unlocks the §YSabotage the Indochinese Ports§! intelligence operation.
loc.SIA_destroy_the_indochinese_ports_raid_t: Unlocks the §YRaid Indochinese Port§! air raid.
loc.SIA_destroy_the_indochinese_ports_planes: Gain §Y30§! §YB-17 Flying Fortress§! and §Y20§! §YP-38 Lightning§! in the national stockpile.
Gain §Y30§! §Y$strat_bomber_equipment_1$§! and §Y20§! §Y$heavy_fighter_equipment_1$§! in the national stockpile.
loc.SIA_accept_a_japanese_technical_mission_: Tokyo offers instructors, technical manuals and aircraft we can acquire quickly. If we accept, we gain speed. We also gain dependency.
loc.SIA_fighter_type_12_conversion_desc: The Nakajima Ki-27, our Type 12, is a nimble mount that rewards an aggressive hand. A hard training cycle on the type will sharpen our pilots and hone every ace on the roster, though the intensity cannot be kept up forever.
loc.SIA_preserve_american_procurement_channe: Thai air power was built through careful procurement from Curtiss and Vought. Keeping American channels alive preserves a route to better aircraft and less dependence on Japan.
loc.SIA_free_thai_air_liaison_desc: Air power is not only aircraft in the sky. Radios, weather reports, hidden strips and rescued airmen can matter more than one extra squadron. The Free Thai shall build that quiet network.
loc.idea_SIA_kra_air_defense_desc: Hidden posts along the highland spine of the peninsula radio in the weather and the first sight of an intruder, and our squadrons fly knowing what waits for them.
loc.idea_SIA_fighter_type_12_desc: An intensive training cycle on the nimble Type 12 has our pilots flying at their sharpest, with the aces leading the way. The pace cannot be sustained indefinitely.
loc.SIA_free_thai_air_network_unlock_tt: Unlocks the §YFree Thai Air Network§! decisions.
loc.SIA_reverse_engineer_french_airplanes_de: The airfields and workshops of Indochina fell into our hands with their French machines largely intact. Our engineers will strip them to the last rivet and learn every secret they hold.
loc.SIA_specialized_airframe_construction_de: Rather than chase every design at once, our factories will master a single fighter airframe and build it better than anyone in the region.
loc.SIA_license_equipment_desc: With Indochina secured, we negotiate from strength. Foreign designs will be built under license in our own plants, cheaply and at scale.
loc.SIA_hawk_iii_max_efficiency_tt: Adds the line at max available efficiency
loc.idea_SIA_increase_air_crews_desc: Expanded ground crews keep our aircraft flying. Higher air ground crew manpower requirement, but greater aircraft reliability and armor.
loc.idea_SIA_conserve_air_crews_desc: A lean air arm frees manpower for the front. Lower air ground crew manpower requirement and more recruitable population, at the cost of aircraft reliability.
loc.idea_SIA_specialized_airframe_constructi: Our factories are tuned to one fighter airframe, tended by a lean ground establishment. It flies more nimbly and further and costs less to build, at the price of reliability, while the mechanics we did not hire serve at the front instead. Later airframes we are not set up for suffer for it.

Our factories are tuned to one fighter airframe, and full ground crews keep it in the air. It flies more nimbly and further and costs less to build, and better maintenance offsets the fragility of a design pushed this hard. Later airframes we are not set up for suffer for it.
