loc.NZL_rail_standardization_tt: §Y[?NZL_train_var]§! units of §Y$NZL_train_equipment_1$§! is added to the national stockpile.
loc.NZL_ministry_of_public_works_desc: Through coordinated planning and disciplined investment, roads, railways and power schemes will be advanced according to a coherent national strategy rather than piecemeal effort.
loc.NZL_abolish_the_railways_board_desc: The Government Railways Board has been ineffective in modernizing the network. It is time for us to abolish this aberration and return the railways to ministerial control.
loc.NZL_rail_standardization_desc: [ROOT.GetName] has a number of workshops across the country that have manufactured locomotives of varying quality. In order to make the railway system more efficient, we shall establish a number of standard locomotives for them to manufacture, each specialized for a specific purpose.
loc.NZL_full_employment_desc: Through sustained public works, careful planning and steady industrial expansion, unemployment has at last given way to opportunity. The idle workshops of the depression years are active once more, and the nation’s labor is fully engaged in productive enterprise. Having restored confidence and stability, we stand not only recovered, but strengthened for the challenges ahead.
loc.NZL_direct_the_coal_industry_desc: As coal becomes ever more vital to our railways, industry and power stations, the government must step in to coordinate production and distribution in the national interest.
loc.NZL_establish_the_ncb_desc: By establishing a National Coal Board, we can bring the country’s scattered mines under coordinated direction and secure a stable supply of fuel for railways, industry and power generation. Central oversight will allow us to rationalize production, improve efficiency and ensure that strategic needs take precedence over private interest.
loc.NZL_electrification_desc: By harnessing our rivers and expanding hydroelectric generation, we can lay the foundations for lasting industrial strength. New dams and transmission works will increase capacity across the country, ensuring that factories, railways and ports have the power they require.
loc.NZL_women_in_the_workforce_desc: As manpower shortages intensify, women are stepping forward to fill vital roles in factories, farms and public services and ensuring that production does not falter under wartime strain. Expanding training and employment opportunities will allow us to sustain industrial output while maintaining national defense.
loc.NZL_restart_the_onekaka_ironworks_desc: The Onekaka ironworks once represented our ambition to produce iron and steel domestically, reducing reliance on overseas supplies. To kick-start the economy and increase national security, there has been interest in restarting Onekaka’s furnaces once more.
loc.NZL_scrap_metal_recycling_desc: An import heavy economy such as ours cannot afford to be wasteful with strategic resources. To strengthen our economic resilience, we shall establish scrap recycling facilities to process and reuse metals and rubber.
loc.NZL_domestic_car_industry_desc: Production of vehicles in [ROOT.GetName] has been limited to assembling the parts from foreign manufactures that are shipped here for final construction. With our recent investment in domestic steel production, we may be able to begin manufacturing components ourselves.
loc.NZL_national_broadcasting_service_desc: Following the interference in the 1935 election by the Post Office and their oversight of state broadcasting services, it seems apparent that we need to reform the organizations management. We should also investment in updating the broadcasting equipment used by it.
loc.NZL_support_allies_with_meat_desc: Our allies in the Pacific are often stretching their supply lines to their limits. In order to reduce the strain and to keep their troops fed, we shall begin supplying them with meat.
loc.NZL_support_allies_with_meat_tt: Every Ally will receive §G1§! §YOffmap Civilian Factory§!
loc.AST_cominwealth_tech_sharing_tt: We will enter a §Ytech sharing agreement§! with all members of our faction.
loc.AST_gain_claims_on_japan_tt: We will gain claims on the §YJapanese Home Isles§!
loc.AST_through_the_barricades_tt: If §Y[ENG.GetNameDef]§! has at least §Y10%§! Communist Support, then at the start of the war the dockworkers of §Y[132.GetCapitalVictoryPointName]§! will rise up in support of us!
loc.AST_end_the_kingdom_ireland_join_tt: Because [IRE.GetName] signed the Anti-Britain pact, they will join the war on our side once we declare war on [ENG.GetNameDef].
loc.ABDA_abdacom_desc: With enemy powers advancing rapidly across Southeast Asia and the Pacific, allied forces in the region must act as one to hold them back. By establishing a joint supreme command we can pool our resources, coordinate our naval assets, and present a unified front against the enemy.
loc.ABDA_fortress_singapore_desc: Singapore is the linchpin of our defensive strategy in the region. Reinforcing its fortifications and garrisoning it in strength will buy critical time for the broader ABDACOM effort and deny the enemy a rapid strategic victory.
loc.ABDA_corps_expeditionnaire_desc: French Indochina sits at the northern flank of the ABDACOM defensive perimeter. By committing the Corps Expéditionnaire Français en Extrême-Orient to active operations, [FRA.GetNameDef] will bring vital manpower and experience from its colonial forces to the joint command.
loc.ABDA_maintain_strategic_flexibility_desc: The United States must not overcommit its forces to any single theatre. By carefully managing our strategic reserve, we ensure that American industrial and military power can be brought to bear wherever it is needed most across the Pacific.
loc.ABDA_the_malay_barrier_desc: The chain of islands stretching from Malaya through [INS.GetNonIdeologyName] forms a natural defensive barrier. ABDA forces must exploit this geography, establishing a coordinated naval and ground defence to slow the enemy advance.
loc.ABDA_develop_naval_infrastructure_desc: Sustained naval operations in the Pacific require bases, fuel depots, and repair facilities. Investing in the infrastructure of our ports and anchorages will extend the reach and endurance of ABDA naval forces.
loc.ABDA_unified_naval_command_desc: With land defences established and infrastructure in place, ABDA can now bring all naval forces under a single unified command. Standardised signals, shared intelligence, and coordinated patrol routes will multiply the effectiveness of every vessel in the theatre.
loc.ABDA_ship_a_day_sinking_quotas_desc: Enemy supply lines stretching across the Pacific are their strategic vulnerability. By setting aggressive and coordinated sinking quotas for our submarine and surface forces, ABDACOM can bleed the enemy logistically and force them onto the defensive.
loc.ABDA_naval_procurement_desc: The losses already suffered demand urgent replacement. A coordinated ABDACOM procurement programme will prioritise destroyers, submarines, and patrol vessels best suited to the Pacific theatre, ensuring our combined fleet can match enemy expansion.
loc.ABDA_keep_trade_open_desc: The rubber and oil of the [INS.GetNonIdeologyName] are critical to the Allied war effort. ABDACOM must safeguard the sea lanes that carry these vital resources, protecting convoys from enemy interdiction and keeping trade flowing to our industries.
loc.ABDA_expand_the_command_desc: ABDACOM has proven its worth. Now we must build on that foundation, extending membership to other Allied nations in the region and deepening our research and intelligence sharing to stay ahead of the enemy.
loc.ABDA_basic_available_trigger_tt: Is not at war with any ABDACOM member

loc.idea_INS_volksraad_desc: The Volksraad is a council established by the Netherlands in 1918 as part of the “Ethical Policies” system, aiming to create a system of semi-democracy where various ethnic minorities and cultures across the archipelago can be represented. While it is in theory democratic in nature, the Governor General and Dutch Crown hold an unconditional veto.
loc.INS_volksraad_custom_tt: Allows you to hire §YVolksraad Advisors§!\nAllows you to use §YVolksraad Decisions§!
loc.INS_great_depression_desc: While the direct impact that the Great Depression has caused the Indies is small, the subsequent protectionist policies countries have undertaken worldwide have had devastating effects on the Indies' economy, which is reliant on continuous export of raw materials such as rubber and oil.
loc.INS_dutch_east_indies_desc: The East Indies is a vast archipelago containing hundreds of distinct cultures and languages, making it a notoriously difficult colony to administrate. The various independence movements, cultural barriers, and economic effects of the Great Depression have not helped this issue, and the administration is operating very inefficiently. The “Ethical Policies” which were established in 1918 attempted to improve the situation by mandating ethical labor regulations and giving democratic representations to minority groups, however the great depression has left them mostly unenforced.
loc.INS_royal_netherlands_east_indies_army_d: The Koninklijk Nederlands Indisch Leger (KNIL) is the long-standing army of the East Indies, operating independently from the Netherlands. The KNIL is made up of both European and Indonesian soldiers, though the cultural and linguistic barriers between the archipelago's many cultures, and the Netherlands, make recruitment a difficult and slow process.
loc.idea_INS_netherlands_most_precious_jewel: The Dutch East Indies has been a colony of the Netherlands for roughly 350 years, and the administration of the colony is tightly integrated with the Dutch government. The East Indies is often referred to as “the jewel in the Dutch crown”, and the Netherlands has shown no desire to loosen their grip over their precious jewel.
loc.HOL_flag_will_fly: The Flag Will Fly Once More
loc.INS_bangka_bauxite_export_desc: The islands of Bangka and Belitung are home to a large chunk of the worlds bauxite, which is the primary ingredient in aluminium. While we could invest in aluminium production ourselves, the sheer quantity of bauxite produced makes selling it raw in bulk a viable strategy.
loc.INS_bangka_bauxite_export_warning_tt: §RWill be removed if we do not control Bangka-Belitung.§!

loc.INS_anti_colonialist_sentiment_idea_desc: Indonesian revolutionaries are active in our nation spreading propaganda throughout the public, leading to rising anti-colonialist sentiment.
loc.INS_revolutionaries_working_with_indones: [ROOT.GetAdjective] communists have been caught communicating with Indonesian leaders, and are suspected of plotting an armed revolution.
loc.idea_SIA_civilian_full_support_desc: The civilian wing stands firmly behind the government. Administrators and technocrats lend their expertise, driving development forward.
loc.idea_SIA_civilian_slight_support_desc: The civilian wing broadly supports the government's direction. Their cooperation brings modest but tangible benefits.
loc.idea_SIA_civilian_neutral_desc: The civilian wing neither aids nor obstructs the government. The administration functions, but without the drive of genuine political alignment.
loc.idea_SIA_civilian_opposition_desc: The civilian wing has turned against the government. Officials drag their feet and budgets are misallocated, grinding the machinery of state.
loc.idea_SIA_civilian_rebellious_desc: The civilian wing is in open defiance. Instability spreads and the threat of a political rupture grows with each passing day.
loc.idea_SIA_military_full_support_desc: The military wing stands firmly behind the government. Officers back recruitment drives and arms production, channelling the army's resources toward national goals.
loc.idea_SIA_military_slight_support_desc: The military wing is broadly cooperative. Their support brings modest improvements to recruitment and production, though without full commitment.
loc.idea_SIA_military_neutral_desc: The military wing has taken no position. The army performs its duties without enthusiasm or resistance, waiting to see how things develop.
loc.idea_SIA_military_opposition_desc: The military wing works against the government. Officers undermine production efforts and enthusiasm for the government's cause drains from the ranks.
loc.idea_SIA_military_rebellious_desc: The military wing is on the verge of open defiance. Conscription is sabotaged, arms production suffers, and the spectre of a coup looms.
loc.idea_SIA_civil_service_heroism_1_desc: The civil service has risen to the occasion, its dedication and expertise quietly accelerating the pace of research and state development.
loc.idea_SIA_seized_japanese_funds_desc: With the Japanese arrangement broken, the funds and stockpiles they left behind are ours to put to work, fuelling a surge in construction and industrial output.
loc.idea_SIA_oss_special_forces_training_des: Our agents have trained alongside the OSS in sabotage, infiltration and airborne operations. The lessons learned have sharpened our special forces into a formidable instrument.
loc.idea_SIA_sold_privy_purse_lands_desc: The sale of the royal household's land holdings has injected capital into the state, easing economic pressures and freeing up resources for construction.
loc.idea_SIA_bloodlusted_irredentism_desc: Territorial ambition has curdled into something fiercer. The army fights with the conviction of those who believe they are reclaiming what is rightfully theirs.
loc.idea_SIA_civilian_technocrats_in_institu: Civilian experts placed within key state institutions have improved both resource extraction and the efficiency of political appointments.
loc.idea_SIA_yuvachon_desc: The Yuvachon movement drills the nation's youth in military discipline, building a pool of trained manpower and stoking nationalist sentiment.
loc.idea_SIA_specialist_marine_forces_desc: A cadre of dedicated amphibious specialists has been trained and equipped for coastal assault operations.
loc.idea_SIA_desperate_gambit_desc: Maybe there is way out of this hole you've found yourself in, climb!
loc.idea_SIA_purged_senior_military_desc: Senior officers deemed a threat to the government have been removed from their posts. The loss of experienced commanders has left its mark on the army's cohesion and professional development.
loc.idea_SIA_cemented_control_desc: The government has consolidated its grip on the institutions of state. Political opposition has been sidelined and the machinery of power now turns reliably in the government's favour.
loc.idea_SIA_cemented_control_3_desc: It is every Thai's duty, that in case of a war that threatens the sovereignty of the crown, and its people, that every respectable Thai must resist occupation by whatever mean possible, be it by means of arms or otherwise.
loc.idea_SIA_death_defiant_desc: We are already dead. Come take your due, if you can
loc.idea_SIA_songsuradet_ascendant_0_desc: Having successfully weathered the ire of the government, Phraya Songsuradet has solidified his base and come out stronger for it. He is now what people would call untouchable, too high-profile and entrenched to get rid of.\nHe will most likely interfere with government policies, slowing down decision making to ensure he isn't the target of a purge again.
loc.idea_SIA_pan_thaiism_desc: The ideology of Pan-Thaiism holds that all peoples of Thai heritage should be united under one state. It drives the nation toward expansion, sustaining morale through offensive action.
loc.idea_SIA_bank_of_siam_desc: The Bank of Siam serves as the financial backbone of the state, directing capital investment and managing monetary policy to support industrial expansion.
loc.idea_SIA_boon_rawd_brewery_desc: The Boon Rawd Brewery has grown into a symbol of domestic enterprise, its commercial success generating goodwill and political capital for those who champion it.
loc.idea_SIA_debt_repayment_desc: The costs of the deficit spending programme are being felt. Revenue is being diverted toward creditors, and the construction pace that borrowing once enabled can no longer be sustained.
loc.idea_SIA_an_unceasy_alliance_desc: The alliance holds, but the strains are beginning to show. Doubts within the government are quietly pulling the nation toward a more neutral course.
loc.idea_SIA_an_absolute_monarchy_desc: All political authority rests with the crown. The king's word is law, dissent is suppressed, and the full weight of royal prestige is thrown behind national mobilisation. The throne commands loyalty, and the army is its instrument.
loc.idea_SIA_a_constituional_monarchy_desc: A constitutional framework defines the limits of royal power and enshrines the rights of the people. With the crown as a unifying symbol rather than an absolute authority, the nation grows more stable, more open to new ideas, and more aligned with the democratic world.
loc.idea_SIA_japanese_fighter_instruction_de: Instructors from the Imperial Japanese Army Air Service are drilling our pilots and walking our engineers through their own fighter designs. What they leave behind in our notebooks will outlast their stay.
loc.idea_SIA_death_to_communists_desc: Anti-communist fervour runs through the ranks, giving our forces an edge against the communist armies of China.
loc.idea_SIA_death_to_nationalists_desc: Anti-nationalist sentiment runs through the ranks, giving our forces an edge against the nationalist armies of China.
loc.idea_SIA_the_yellow_dossier_desc: A classified report on the state of domestic industry has forced a reckoning with deep-seated inefficiencies. The reforms it demands are bearing fruit in our factories, though the disruption they bring is not without cost.
loc.idea_SIA_overheated_economy_desc: The economy has been pushed beyond its natural limits. Consumer demand has outstripped capacity and the construction boom has stalled while things cool down.
loc.idea_SIA_the_military_oversight_bureau_d: The Military Oversight Bureau sets higher standards for new commanders and accelerates the development of expertise across the officer corps.
loc.idea_SIA_public_credit_debt_desc: The state's credit obligations are a constant drain on the economy, consuming resources that would otherwise flow into production and civilian goods.
loc.idea_SIA_purged_military_desc: The removal of officers deemed politically unreliable has left the military short of experienced leadership, hampering organisation and the development of its remaining troops.
loc.SIA_civilian_wing_history_tt: The civilian faction of the Khana Ratsadon is led by progressive administrators and technocrats, foremost among them §YPridi Phanomyong§!. Having studied law in France, Pridi returned with ambitions for land reform, state economic planning, and a constitutional democracy that would genuinely empower ordinary people.\n\nThe civilian wing is broadly §Gpro-development§!, favouring investment in education, infrastructure, and industry. They are sceptical of heavy military spending and wary of any drift toward strongman rule. Their support is most easily won through policies that modernise the state and protect constitutional government.
loc.SIA_military_wing_history_tt: The military faction of the Khana Ratsadon is dominated by army officers who see themselves as the true guardians of the revolution. Their most ambitious figure is §YPlaek Phibunsongkhram§!, a colonel whose admiration for the nationalist movements of Europe grows with each passing year.\n\nThe military wing is §Gpro-rearmament§! and drawn to a strong, centralised state. They are suspicious of Pridi's economic ideas, which they consider dangerously radical, and have little patience for civilian interference in defence matters. Their loyalty is most easily secured through military investment and policies that project national strength.
loc.idea_SIA_wing_promotion_disruption_desc: Openly favoring one wing of the Khana Ratsadon has thrown the government off balance. The slighted faction drags its feet, the army's routine is in disarray, and ordinary administration suffers until the new arrangement beds in.
loc.idea_SIA_military_wing_unrest_desc: The officers' patience has run out once more. Having failed to seize power outright, the military wing now vents its fury through sabotage, desertions, and a flat refusal to cooperate. The army's fighting strength crumbles until the malcontents are brought to heel.
loc.idea_SIA_civilian_wing_unrest_desc: Pridi's faction has lost faith in the government again. Denied a second chance at power, the civilian wing turns to strikes, bureaucratic obstruction, and agitation in the cities. The economy seizes up and the country grows ungovernable until tempers cool.
loc.idea_SIA_unwavering_civilian_support_des: With the military wing dissolved and the question of legitimacy settled, the civilian administration stands unchallenged. Freed from the army's meddling, Pridi's technocrats throw themselves into the work of governing with a zeal the old coalition could never have mustered.
loc.idea_SIA_unified_khana_ratsadon_desc: The old quarrel between soldiers and civilians is finished. With both wings of the Khana Ratsadon pulling in the same direction at last, the government can act with a unity of purpose it has never known. Soldiers, administrators, and industrialists now work as one.
loc.AST_unratified_westminster_act_idea_desc: The Statute of Westminster was passed in 1931, allowing the self-governing Dominions of [ENG.GetNameDef] to increase their sovereignty. If we were to ratify it, most of the British Parliament's authority to legislate for [AST.GetName] would be removed.
loc.AST_australian_war_cabinet_idea_tt: \nOnce at war, §Y$AST_australian_war_cabinet_idea$§! will be modified by:\n §Y2§! offmap §Y$arms_factory$§!
loc.AST_singapore_strategy_idea_desc:
At Australia's request, we shall make an effort to improve defensive structures in Singapore. The Singapore Strategy is a core component of Pacific defense policy, after all.

loc.AST_faction_training_initiative_idea_1_d: The Pacific Resistance's Joint Training Initiative is a cooperative program among its members, ensuring that all allied soldiers undergo equally rigorous military training.
loc.AST_faction_training_initiative_idea_1_t: \nSpirit effects will double if the §Y[AST.GetFactionName]§! has more than §Y4§! members
loc.AST_faction_training_initiative_idea_2_d: The Pacific Resistance's Joint Training Initiative is a cooperative program among its members, ensuring that all allied soldiers undergo equally rigorous military training.
loc.AST_faction_training_initiative_idea_2_t: \nSpirit effects will be halved if the §Y[AST.GetFactionName]§! has fewer than §Y5§! members
loc.AST_wool_agreement_idea_desc: [ENG.GetNameDefCap] has acquired the rights to [AST.GetName]'s entire annual wool production, ensuring that our soldiers will be clothed and equipped throughout their deployment.
loc.AST_anti_fascist_measures_desc: Fascism has not yet dug its claws into Australia, and democratic forces want it to remain that way. The Commonwealth Investigation Branch will surveil and detain all suspicious elements to keep any fascist groups from gaining influence.
loc.ABDA_corps_expeditionnaire_spirit_desc: French forces committed to the Pacific theatre have been hardened by colonial service and accustomed to operating far from home in difficult conditions. Their experience fighting in Southeast Asia gives them a particular awareness of Japanese tactics and terrain, making them a resilient force when the enemy presses forward.
loc.ABDA_maintain_strategic_flexibility_spir: American industrial output is being directed toward the Pacific theatre, with dockyard production accelerated to sustain a fleet capable of projecting power across the ocean's full breadth. By refusing to overcommit to any single front, the United States ensures its naval strength can be brought to bear wherever the situation demands.
loc.AST_toe_the_line_spirit_desc: The state has called for sacrifice and the population has answered. Rationing, longer working hours, and the redirection of civilian production toward the national effort have freed up resources the government had no other means of obtaining. It is an austere arrangement, and not a universally popular one.
loc.AST_new_guard_spirit_desc: After several years of inactivity, the prominent paramilitary, the New Guard, has been forced back into the fray to challenge resurgent enemies.\n\nAlthough some splinter groups may harbor extremist agendas, the organization once again undertakes the task of maintaining public order by suppressing communism and upholding British monarchist ideals.
loc.AST_new_guard_spirit_tt:
New Guard members: §Y[?AST_ng_members_var|0]§!
Daily member increase: §Y[?AST_ng_daily_var|0]§!

The movement has a maximum capacity of §Y50,000§! members
loc.AST_new_guard_spirit_modify: Modify §Y$AST_new_guard_spirit$§! by:\n New Guard members: §Y2500§!\n Daily member increase: §Y10§!
loc.AST_fascist_legion_spirit_desc: A splinter group of the New Guard has proven to share more of the government's views than the New Guard itself. Entrusted by Campbell with state resources, the Fascist Legion now undertakes the important task of protecting civilian unity by rooting out political dissent.
loc.AST_australias_glorious_fleet_desc: Australia's navy has long prepared for the moment it would face another naval power, and as it seems, that power is us.
loc.AST_australian_culture_investments_idea_:

loc.AST_a_sense_of_place_desc: National identity is the bond that holds a people together. Under a prospering culture the Australians have united, committed to resisting any who might threaten their borders.
loc.AST_a_sense_of_place_upgraded_desc: The national identity that once flourished quietly has been given a harder edge. This is no longer just pride in a land and a way of life — it is the conviction that what Australia has built is worth fighting for, and that the men and women who live under the Southern Cross are prepared to do so.
loc.AST_the_promise_of_nauru_tt:

§Y[AST.GetName]§! becomes free

loc.AST_poor_population_growth_desc: When the Great Depression struck in 1929, Australian birth rates fell drastically. Combined with a decline in immigration, population growth has struggled to recover ever since.
loc.AST_broken_hill_proprietary_company_ic_t: Effects from §Y$AST_broken_hill_proprietary_company_ic$ Industrial Concern§! are improved
loc.AST_whyalla_steelworks_ic_tt: Effects from §Y$AST_whyalla_steelworks_ic$ Industrial Concern§! are improved
loc.AST_bradford_cotton_mills_ic_tt: Effects from §Y$AST_bradford_cotton_mills_ic$ Industrial Concern§! are improved
loc.AST_mount_isa_mines_ic_tt: Effects from §Y$AST_mount_isa_mines_ic$ Industrial Concern§! are improved
loc.AST_eminent_successors_spirit_desc: By appointing a few eminent successors, we can stabilize the government and restore the trust of both the public and our ministers.
loc.AST_imperial_pressure_spirit_desc: Due to recent events, it can no longer be denied that Australian politics are shifting in a direction unsuitable for a nation under the British Commonwealth umbrella. [ENG.GetNameDefCap] will attempt to guide our nation back onto its predetermined path, but may not remain patient for long.\n\n§WWill be removed once §Y[AST.GetName]§! is not a subject of §Y[ENG.GetNameDef]§!§!
loc.AST_ireland_anti_british_pact_offer_acce: Should [AST.GetName] hold their end of the bargain, we will join their faction and participate in their war against Britain once they declare war.
loc.AST_IRE_stationed_troops_idea_desc: Our number of stationed troops is currently [?AST_IRE_stationed_troops_count_var|Y0].

loc.NZL_railways_board_desc: The Government Railways Board was created in 1931 as a restructuring of the Railways Department in an attempt to separate decision making away from government departments. However, there has been little sign of improvement to the rail network since it was established. There is mounting pressure for the government to abolish the board and to take back direct control.
loc.NZL_great_depression_desc: The collapse of the global economy in 1929 hit New Zealand's largely agricultural economy very hard. With countries purchasing less produce from New Zealand, many found themselves unemployed, reducing consumer purchasing power and in turn causing other industries to collapse. Years of austerity has left the nation yearning for a change in direction.
loc.NZL_commonwealth_loyalty_desc: New Zealand remains a committed member of the British Commonwealth and retains the King as the rightful head of state. The economy of New Zealand is also highly integrated into the wider imperial economic system.
loc.ABDA_supreme_command_desc: The American-British-Dutch-Australian Command has established a unified naval doctrine across all member navies. As the alliance deepens, shared intelligence, coordinated patrol assignments, and mutual logistical support steadily improve the combat effectiveness of every fleet that flies under ABDACOM's banner.
loc.operation_rescue_general_desc: §LOne of our Commanders has been taken by the enemy and is being held captive. We must mount an operation to rescue them.§!
loc.free_general_free_in_transit_desc: Our operatives have identified an impending transfer of the asset, and will plan an opportunity to intercept and ambush the transit en route.
loc.free_general_assault_holding_area_desc: The enemy is holding our Commander in a secure location, which has been found by our operatives. They will prepare a daring assault in order to break out the captive.
loc.free_general_disguise_and_extract_desc: Using expert cunning our operatives will help the captured Commander in creating a disguise, allowing them to trick their captors and escape to friendly territory
loc.INS_unlock_naval_steal_raid_tt: Unlocks §YCapture Colonial Ships§! in [1058.GetName] in order to capture ships from the Dutch Navy for our own cause.
loc.INS_activate_naval_raid_tt: Unlocks §YOccupy Naval Base§! raid on naval bases in Dutch-controlled states.
loc.INS_militia_knil_supply_raid_unlock_tt: Unlocks §YRaid Weapon Depots§! raid on supply hubs in Dutch-controlled states.
loc.INS_mobilize_the_pemuda_trigger_tt: Has completed at least §Y3§! Pemuda land raids
loc.INS_weapons_caches_unlock_tt: Unlocks §YRaid Weapons Caches§! raid in Dutch-controlled states in Java. Can only be used once.
loc.INS_militia_increase_activity_raid_unloc: Unlocks §YRaid KNIL bases§! raid in Dutch-controlled neighboring states, giving combat modifiers to the state upon success.
loc.SIA_activate_naval_raid_tt: Unlocks §YRaid Pacific Island§! raid on pacific islands.
loc.AST_malaya_foothold_raid_unlock_tt: Unlocks §YSecure a Communist Foothold in Malaya§! raid against Malayan government-controlled states.
loc.raid_type_AST_malaya_communist_foothold_: Secure a Communist Foothold in Malaya
loc.AST_malaya_communist_foothold_raid: Secure a Communist Foothold in Malaya
loc.AST_malaya_communist_foothold_raid_desc: The Malayan communist forces are cut off from the peninsula. A covert landing operation can seize a mainland state and place armed militias there, giving the revolution the ground it needs to survive.
loc.success_modifier_INS_militia_leader_modi: - Assign a Commander with the §YMilitia Leader§! trait
loc.success_modifier_INS_militia_leader_leve: - Assign a Commander with a higher §YLevel§!
loc.AUS_antischluss_category_desc: With the German remilitarization of the Rhineland and the increasing amount of covert aggression emanating from the Reich, we must prepare for the worst, yet hope for the best to avoid being caught unprepared.
loc.AUS_anscluss_process_has_not_begun: The risk of Anschluss is currently [GetAnschlussRisk]. This is affected by the total fighting army strength ratio between [ROOT.GetNameDef] and [GER.GetNameDef].\n\nWe might be able to affect this ratio through political means.
loc.AUS_anscluss_process_has_begun: §R[GER.GetNameWithFlag] has begun the process to Anschluss us. We can no longer affect this!§!
loc.AUS_anschluss_risk_low_tt: There is a §GLow§! risk of Anschluss.
loc.AUS_anschluss_risk_medium_tt: There is a §YMedium§! risk of Anschluss.

The [ITA.GetAdjective] Army is locked into a conflict with [ETH.GetNameDef]. While this conflict is dragging on the [ITA.GetAdjective]s are weakened further against a surprisingly well equipped [ETH.GetAdjective] resistance. Outside forces might very well be at play to tip the scales.

loc.antilles_category_desc: The Antillean Confederation was the vehement idea of Ramón Emeterio Betances about the need for natives of the Caribbean to unite into a regional entity that would seek to preserve the sovereignty and well-being of the Antillean nations. Support was strongest from the 1850s up until the Spanish–American War, and has since then mostly faded, but all is not lost. By invoking the spirit of our shared path, we can seek to establish an Antillean Confederation once and for all. Antilles for the Antilleans!
loc.latin_africa_category: The United States of Latin Africa
loc.latin_africa_category_desc: The Romance-language-speaking Central African countries have a lot in common, and share the same state religion. Now more than ever, the region needs to join together as one if it is to stand against the might of the global superpowers.
loc.germany_formable_category_desc: The idea of a united German people has been in the minds of our citizens for a long time. Now, with our recent conquests of German territories, it is time we declare the reunification of Germany!

loc.GER_seize_gold_reserves_cat_desc: Our ambitious rearmament program demands more money and resources than our nation can provide on its own. But by expanding, we can harness the gains of conquest to pay for our arms industry. To the victor go the spoils!

loc.GER_exploit_the_gombos_treaty_desc: The trade treaty that Hungarian prime minister Gyula Gömbös signed with us in 1934 is important for stimulating the Hungarian economy and aiding in recovery from the great depression, but it also has great drawbacks for them. Though the agreement gives them a favorable price for sales of wheat, the money earned has to remain in an account in Germany and has to be used only to purchase German industrial goods. We could therefore empty the account they have stored away in our nation to aid our own economy, but at the cost of losing a potential ally.

loc.GER_operational_planning_category_desc: We must meticulously plan our offensive operations to find where to focus our forces, the Schwerpunkt. This will allow us to take advantage of any weaknesses in our enemies' defenses and punch through their lines, catching them by surprise.
loc.GER_hilfskreuzer_cat_desc: Depriving our enemies of raw materials and crucial resources will shorten the war and guarantee our victory. It's therefore paramount we have enough raiding vessels capable of sinking the enemy's merchant fleet, even if that means refitting our own convoys to partake in the raiding.
loc.GER_refit_convoys_to_cruisers: Refit Merchant Ships to Merchant Raiders
loc.GER_puppet_exploited_flag: [FROM.GetAdjective] economy is already being exploited by [ROOT.GetNameDef]
loc.GER_puppet_development_flag: [FROM.GetAdjective] development is already being aided by [ROOT.GetNameDef]
loc.GER_num_of_puppet_economies_integrated_t: Can only influence the economy of up to [?GER_puppet_economies_integration_cap]. (Current: §[GetColorForCurrentIntegratedPuppetEconomiesValue][?GER_puppet_economies_integrated]§!)

loc.GER_south_east_asian_resources_boosted_f: Has Expanded Resource Extraction in State
loc.GER_middle_eastern_trade_cat_desc: The Middle-East is a resource rich region, especially in oil, and we stand to gain greatly from trading with these countries. We would ensure a steady flow of vital resources, and deprive our enemies from the same resources at the same time - strengthening us and weakening them.
loc.GER_influence_countries_cat_desc: By meddling with the internal politics in strategically important countries, we may sway them into our sphere of influence.
loc.GER_invite_to_faction_cat_desc: By inviting new countries into the [ROOT.GetFactionName] we will not only grow stronger as our numbers swell, but our enemies will grow weaker as we deprive them from trading partners and potential allies.
loc.GER_a_fourth_silesian_uprising_cat_desc: Due to the recent instability and civil war within our nation, those who wish for an independent Silesia have started agitating and preparing for a potential uprising, provided the opportunity present itself. It would be wise to crush these delusions as rapidly as possible.
loc.GER_rebuild_the_nation_cat_desc: In order for our nation to recover from the civil war, and for our people to once again be proud to call themselves German, we must put effort into reconstruction and public works.
loc.GER_state_development_west: Public Works Programs in Western Germany
loc.GER_state_development_north: Public Works Programs in Northern Germany
loc.GER_state_development_east: Public Works Programs in Eastern Germany
loc.GER_state_development_central: Public Works Programs in Central Germany
loc.GER_state_development_south: Public Works Programs in Southern Germany
loc.recall_von_lettow_vorbeck_tt: §YPaul von Lettow-Vorbeck§! becomes available as a level §Y4§! General
loc.GER_USA_is_monroe_actor_d: It has come to our attention that there are rather expansive [GER.GetAdjective] plans to destabilize the Monroe Doctrine. In doing so they would be bringing the conflict into our own backyard. We cannot let this happen
loc.GER_GER_is_monroe_actor_d_usa_resistance: It appears that the [USA.GetAdjective]s have decided to fight our attempts at destabilizing the Monroe Doctrine. By acting quickly we should still be able to swiftly dispose of the folly that is said Doctrine however.
loc.GER_GER_is_monroe_actor_d_no_resistance: [USA.GetNameDefCap] has shown nothing but ignorance for our advances in the Americas. While we still have work to do to bring the Doctrine down, this spells opportunity for us.
loc.GER_MONROE_DOCTRINE_COUNTRIES_IN_THE_DOC: The following §Y[?global.monroe_doctrine_countries_to_destabilize^num]§! countries are part of the Monroe Doctrine:\n\n[GetCountriesInTheMonroeDoctrine]

loc.GER_weltpolitik_cat_desc: With our eyes no longer focused solely on Europe, we must take measures to secure our reforming colonial empire, and spend significant efforts to make sure that it is properly administrated.
loc.GER_recruiting_schutztruppe_locations_ma: Select where to recruit Schutztruppe divisions.
loc.GER_proletarian_revolution_cat_desc: The proletariat in our country has become more vocal as of late. Localized uprisings are bringing unrest making for a great opportunity for more radical political change.
loc.GER_encouraging_proletarian_uprising: Select where to Encourage Proletarian Uprisings
loc.GER_volkskommissariats_cat_desc: We must secure the Red Revolution and the Proletariat by establishing a new form of protectorate, the Volkskommissariat. Through cooperation and investments we will make these satellite states prosper, and in turn we will flourish too, and the Proletariat will thrive.
loc.GER_spreading_the_red_flame_cat_desc: We have finally managed to form a true Proletariat, but the struggle was long and hard. It is our duty to spread the flames of revolution far and wide, helping oppressed workers to overthrow the tyranny of capitalism and establish their own Proletariat!
loc.GER_industrial_relocation_cat_desc: Our Industrial Relocation Program with [SOV.GetNameDef] might see our industrial basis shrink in the short term, but the raw resources we will gain will more than make up for it and bolster our production lines.
loc.GER_industrial_relocation_oil_decision: Relocate Industry to [FROM.CONTROLLER.GetNameDef] for Oil from [FROM.GetName]
loc.GER_industrial_relocation_tungsten_decis: Relocate Industry to [FROM.CONTROLLER.GetNameDef] for Tungsten from [FROM.GetName]
loc.GER_industrial_relocation_chromium_decis: Relocate Industry to [FROM.CONTROLLER.GetNameDef] for Chromium from [FROM.GetName]
loc.GER_industrial_relocation_descision_tt: 5 of the selected resources will be granted to §Y[ROOT.GetNameWithFlag]§! in return, §Y1§! Civilian Factory will be dismantled and granted to §Y[SOV.GetNameWithFlag]§!
loc.GER_anti_colonialism_category_desc: We will do everything we can to support resistance movements across Africa and Asia until the blight of imperialism is finally removed and workers around the world unites.
loc.GER_uncertain_future_cat_desc: With the Civil War finally at an end, the German nation is slowly rebuilding but the nation seems adrift without goal or aim, while its people are longing for stability and security. The populace is growing weary of this uncertainty and is demanding a steady course.

loc.GER_realpolitik_cat_desc: The winds of change are blowing hard, and can often switch directions at a moments notice. We must therefore ensure that we do all we can to secure the future of [GER.GetNameDef], and find the partners and foes that best suit us at any given moment.

loc.GER_democratic_shield_send_support_desc: Our ideological brethren find themselves in a war. As the defenders of democracy, it is our duty to make sure that they stand victorious in their conflict against evil!
loc.GER_waning_patience_within_the_kriegsmar: In order to gain the loyalty of Admiral Erich Raeder and the Kriegsmarine, we promised them concessions and investments into a grand navy. Should we fail to deliver on our promises, it seems likely that they will take matters into their own hands...
loc.GER_mitteleuropa_allied_trade_cat_desc: Our allies have a lot of resources that would be helpful for our nation, and we stand to gain greatly from deepening trade relations with these countries. We would ensure a steady flow of vital resources, and deprive our enemies from the same resources at the same time - strengthening us and weakening them.
loc.GER_mitteleuropa_economic_integration_ca: Our European customs union has so far been successful, but it has more roles that our allies do not know about. By further integrating their economies with ours, we will eventually be able to make them fully dependent on us, essentially turning them into our subjects.

loc.SWE_return_of_the_king: The §YKing§! has re-established control over §Y[SWE.GetFlag][SWE.GetAdjective]§! politics.
loc.ICE_drilling_for_oil_off_shore: Drill for Off-Shore Oil and Gas
loc.ICE_drilling_for_oil_off_shore_repeat_tt: This decision can be retaken again after §Y180§! days
loc.ICE_a_new_yggdrasill_desc: Now that the people know of their great ancestry, we should strive to construct great projects and improve the island of Iceland so that it may live up to Miðgarður and Yggdrasil of Legend!
loc.ICE_has_best_spirit_idea: We have fully venerated our ancestors
loc.ICE_the_wisdom_of_odin_desc: Óðinn is a god associated with everything from wisdom, healing, death, royalty, the gallows, knowledge, war, battle, victory, sorcery, poetry, and frenzy to the runic alphabet. He was granted his immense wisdom when he offered up his eye to drink from the Mímisbrunnr, which granted him the ability of infinite knowledge of the present, the future and the past. We should attempt to embody his spirit, and carry on his legacy into the future!
loc.ICE_the_might_of_thor_desc: Þór is the god of thunder, strength and the protection of humankind. Wielding his hammer Mjölnir, he struck the clouds to make it storm, and our army shall strike that same thunder and fear into our opponents!
loc.ICE_the_guidance_of_aegir_and_ran: The Guidance of Ægir and Rán
loc.ICE_the_guidance_of_aegir_and_ran_desc: Under the guidance of Rán and Ægir, the personification of the sea and her jötunn husband, our ships will achieve supremacy over the northern seas.
loc.ICE_the_ferocity_of_the_fenrir_desc: The Fenrisúlfr is along with Hel and the World Serpent, a child of Loki and giantess Angrboða. During Ragnarök, it was supposed to kill Óðinn, yet failed, despite its great strength and ferocity. Our soldiers must embody it's essence on the battlefield in order to defeat the enemy in both field and mind.
loc.ICE_the_fertility_of_freya_desc: Freyja is among other things the goddess of love, beauty and fertility. We should invoke her name to make sure that our people have children that can one day grow into great warriors.
loc.ICE_a_monument_to_leif: Raise a Monument to Leifur Eiríksson
loc.ICE_a_monument_to_leif_desc: Despite the common myth spread by the southerners that Christopher Columbus was the first European to discover the Americas, our great ancestor Leifur Eiríksson was undoubtedly the actual first one to do so. To honor his memory, we should raise a monument dedicated to him in Vinland, as we conquer the lands for ourselves.
loc.ICE_infiltrate_the_british_isles_categor: The workers' revolution needs to spread. The perfect starting point is the oppressed workers in the British isles. The anti-imperialist and anti-capitalist sentiment could, and should, be used to its full advantage.
loc.ICE_incite_communist_uprising_scotland_d: With a little push on the way, we should be able to make the Scottish workers rise up in [121.GetCapitalVictoryPointName] and declare their independence from the government in [121.owner.capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName].
loc.ICE_incite_communist_uprising_scotland_t: §Y[SCO.GetName]§! starts a War of Independence against §Y[121.owner.GetName]§! in [121.GetName]
loc.ICE_incite_communist_uprising_wales_desc: With a little push on the way, we should be able to make the Welsh workers rise up in [122.GetCapitalVictoryPointName] and declare their independence from the government in [122.owner.capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName].
loc.ICE_incite_communist_uprising_wales_tt: §Y[WLS.GetName]§! starts a War of Independence against §Y[122.owner.GetName]§! in [122.GetName]
loc.ICE_incite_communist_uprising_ni: Incite an uprising in Northern Ireland
loc.ICE_incite_communist_uprising_ni_desc: With a little push on the way, we should be able to make the workers of Northern Ireland rise up in [119.GetCapitalVictoryPointName] and declare their independence from the government in [119.owner.capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName].
loc.ICE_incite_communist_uprising_ni_tt: §Y[WLS.GetName]§! starts a War of Independence against §Y[119.owner.GetName]§! in [119.GetName]
loc.NOR_democratic_preparation_decisions_cat:
Our young nation has a lot of catch up to do if we wish to compete with the world at large. Decades of neglect and years into the great depression, have left our industry in a sorry state that will require a concerted effort for us to fix.

Unfortunately this will come at the cost of our military preparedness and defensive capabilities, but we trust our policy of complete and unarmed neutrality to show our goodwill and any enemies safely overlooking our territory. 


[NOR.GetName]'s Total Development: [?NOR.NOR_country_preparedness]/30
loc.NOR_historical_deploy_prep_decisions_cat:
Despite our best efforts, war has arrived to our shores. So far we've been focusing our energy into developing the industry, economy and infrastructure of our land, but it is now imperative that we find ways to leverage this for the defense of [NOR.GetNameDef].


[NOR.GetName]'s Potential Preparedness: [?NOR.NOR_country_preparedness]/30
loc.NOR_allied_democratic_preparation_decisi: This government is certain that our enemies will strike at any minute now. We must be resolute in our zeal to arm the population of [NOR.GetName] in order to prevent an invasion. Even if it means attacking preemptively.So let us rally our country, and take the power we need to decisively win against our enemies.\n\nNational Preparedness: [?NOR.NOR_country_preparedness]/30
loc.NOR_allied_democratic_deploy_prep_decisi: Just as we expected war is finally upon us, but there is nothing to fear. For the last few years we have been focusing all our efforts in getting [ROOT.GetName] ready for whatever our enemies throw at us. Let us show them what we are made of.\n\nNational Preparedness: [?NOR.NOR_country_preparedness]/30
loc.NOR_prepare_state_alt_dem_desc: We are woefully unprepared for what it is to come. We must take the appropriate measures so once war breaks out, [FROM.GetName] can contribute to the war effort. Some people will not understand, but we have made our choice. There is no going back.
loc.NOR_alt_dem_naval_expansion_desc: Developing our navy is vital, not only because it will mean defending our dauntingly large coastline against invaders, but because it can be used as a launching pad to bring the fight to their homelands.
loc.NOR_alt_dem_military_industry_expansion_: We cannot depend on other countries providing our equipment, after all, the war merchants of today could be the war enemies of tomorrow. We must expand our industrial capacity to produce the materiel we need to fight.
loc.NOR_alt_dem_economic_relief_measures_des: The population grows weary of our military buildup. They may not see what we see and might not know that their sacrifice is needed for our war machine must trudge along to secure victory. No matter, we shall placate their needs for now.
loc.NOR_alt_dem_expedite_training_desc: We find ourselves in a dire situation. If we don't train new troops soon we may be all doomed.
loc.NOR_alt_dem_prioritize_production_desc: Our war machine needs equipment, and it needs it now! Let the factories hum with their continuous work so that our brave soldiers have the means to defeat our enemies, whatever the cost.
loc.NOR_alt_dem_offensive_push_desc: Everything else be dammed, it's time to attack. Let us push forward and crush our enemies before they know what hit them.
loc.NOR_alt_dem_focus_on_defense_desc: Until very recently [NOR.GetName] was a peaceful and disarmed nation, we have stretched ourselves thin. We need to focus on defending what we have for the time being.
loc.NOR_fascist_preparation_decisions_catego:
The Nasjonal Samling party has historically had very limited support in [NOR.GetAdjective] society, this is why it's important to proselytize around the country and build a base of support.

By planting the seeds of fascism, when the correct opportunity comes, we will be able to reap the fruits of our planning and take over [ROOT.GetName].


[NOR.GetName]'s total support for Nasjonal Samling: [?NOR.NOR_country_preparedness]/30
loc.NOR_fascist_deploy_prep_decisions_catego: The time for hiding is over, we've gathered enough support to launch our takeover of [NOR.GetName]. Now we must deploy our preparations on each of the territories of our Fatherland.\n\nWe have built our support from the ground up, and planted cells that are ready to take over their territories at the command of our great Fører, and against the cowardly forces of Democracy.
loc.NOR_communist_preparation_decisions_cate: The people of [ROOT.GetName] have had their eyes closed for far too long, it is time they finally heed the call of our brothers and sisters in [SOU.GetNameDef].\n\nUsing them as and example of what [ROOT.GetName] can achieve once they've seized the means of production and unite under one banner and one leader, who will guide them to fight the tyranny of Oslo.$NOR_revolution_support_counter$

It's time the peoples of [NOR.GetName] listen to the teachings of Marx and Troskij, and prepare for the inevitable clash that will turn our nation into the spearhead of Communism in Scandinavia.\n\nLet us embrace the fire and brimstone of the Permanent Revolution, and unite the country against the forces of capitalism that reside in Oslo.$NOR_revolution_support_counter$

The revolution must come from the bottom up, from the masses that toil away their lives for a landlord or an industrialist.\n\nMany of our proletarian brothers and sisters don't know the power they hold, so we must go forth and rouse the proletariat so they can unite against Oslo to bring down the chains of capitalism, one state at a time.$NOR_revolution_support_counter$
loc.NOR_monarchist_preparation_decisions_cat: Show King Haakon our Support for his Reign

Since even before his ascension to the throne, our humble King Haakon VII has deferred his powers to the Storting and its constituents. This was well and good at the time, but we must show him that we support him seizing direct control of [ROOT.GetName] before there is nothing to control.


Total Support for the Monarchy:  [?NOR.NOR_country_preparedness]/30
loc.NOR_prepare_state_historical_desc: Our industrial base lies in shambles, but we are willing to put the effort needed in order to improve the situation for the people of [ROOT.GetName], and our chances of survival should the worst happen.
loc.NOR_prepare_historical_unlock_TT: Unlocks §YDevelop State§! decisions which allow speeding up §GCivilian Construction§! but give penalties to §RMilitary Construction and Defenses§!.
loc.NOR_prepare_fascist_unlock_TT: Unlocks §YBuild Support in State§! decisions which §GCIncreases Fascism Support§! and give §GTerritory and benefits§! when the Civil War starts, but give penalties to §RCivilian Industry§!.
loc.NOR_prepare_communist_unlock_TT: Unlocks §YRouse Proletariat in State§! which give §GTerritory and Troops§! when the Communist Revolution starts, but §Rdamage buildings§! in the state.
loc.NOR_dem_his_integrate_militias_desc: Now that the men that formed our militias have proven their mettle, we could better integrate them into the army, into regular battalions and divisions.
loc.NOR_prepare_exile_desc: The reality is undeniable. Our nation cannot fend off our enemies forever, but we can defend for long enough to get as much as we can out of the country to fight another day.
loc.NOR_focus_on_training_desc: We need to pour all our efforts into getting our reserves and recruits turned into soldiers and into the battlefront as quickly as possible, for there might not be a front for much longer.
loc.NOR_modernize_armed_forces_decision_desc: The [ROOT.GetAdjective] military has been neglected for so long, our armed forces look more fit for a museum than a battlefield.
loc.NOR_move_government_headquarters_decisio: If our government were to fall by the hands of the enemy, that would assure our demise and that of our King and Prince. The only option is to stay on the move and avoid the inevitable for as long as possible.
loc.NOR_expedite_training_desc: Training our troops as best as we can is vital for our survival but it will be for naught if they finish their training and there's no [NOR.GetName] left to defend. We must push through as fast as possible before we are pushed off our nation.
loc.NOR_public_investment_drive_desc: There is much work to be done in [ROOT.GetName] and it appears it will not get done without the public sector's direct investment. Let us flood the country with infrastructure and construction projects.
loc.NOR_naval_expanion_desc: If we are to survive we need to defend our coastlines, and we will need ships for that. We must make every fjord a dockyard.
loc.NOR_prepare_state_communist_desc: The people of [FROM.GetName] have been exploited in their slumber for too long. Let us plant the rousing seeds of our revolution
loc.NOR_prepare_state_monarchist_desc: The people of [FROM.GetName] need a reminder of the 1905 election and why they overwhelmingly elected his king to the position. They shall be demanding the king's direct intervention in no time.
loc.NOR_prop_up_the_economy_desc: We will not be able to reach our political goals if the people are hungry. We must pause our monarchist crusade to take care of our subjects and their needs.
loc.NOR_make_assurances_to_the_people: Make Assurances to the People of [NOR.GetNonIdeologyName]
loc.NOR_make_assurances_to_the_people_desc: It is a scary time in [NOR.GetName] for sure, so we must reassure through the media that we will pull through, and once on the other side, our gracious king will lead the charge for our survival.
loc.NOR_promote_the_armed_defense_of_the_cou: The people of [NOR.GetName] must be reminded of what will happen if they don't defend our country. Everyone must play their part in the coming conflict.
loc.NOR_exile_decisions_category_desc: We find ourselves in the direst of circumstances. After losing our land to the enemy, we've had no recourse but to live in exile. We can at least be thankful for our gracious host, and hopefully one day, with their help, we will be in our beloved [NOR.GetNonIdeologyName] once more.
loc.NOR_request_reinstatement_desc: Our enemy is losing ground in [NOR.GetName], and we think it's time for our government to be reinstated in its rightful place once more.
loc.NOR_lobby_for_parliamentary_support: Lobby for support in the [FROM.GetAdjective] Government
loc.NOR_lobby_for_parliamentary_support_desc: Our hosts have been very generous so far, but perhaps they need some reminding of what our people are going through so they never forget what's at stake for us.
loc.NOR_bring_soldiers_from_norway_desc: Many who fought for the defense of our country remain trapped in our homeland. We can make an effort to bring some of them, plus others who might have not fought yet but still want to retake their country from where we are.
loc.NOR_weapons_for_the_resistance_desc: We can leverage our vast merchant marine to procure weapons for both our efforts here, and the resistance fighters in our homeland. The weapons there will weaken our enemy's grip on [NOR.GetNonIdeologyName] and the weapons here will deal the finishing blow to their tyranny.
loc.NOR_unity_parade_desc: Let us fill the streets of [FROM.Capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName] with our voices so we remind the people of that great city that our struggle and their struggle are one and the same.
loc.NOR_joint_training_exercise_desc: If we hope to achieve victory, our forces must be one with [FROM.GetNameDef]'s. This can only be done with training and deep collaboration with our allies.
loc.NOR_expand_industrial_capacity_desc: We might be exiled but that doesn't mean that we are helpless. We have one of the largest merchant marines in the world at our disposal, and we can use it to procure the industrial capacity needed to feed our efforts to retake our homeland.
loc.NOR_foment_resistance_in_state_desc: The people of [FROM.GetName] have the spirit of resistance within them, and they're fighting back against our enemy! They just need an extra push for it to be decisive.
loc.NOR_support_rebellion_desc: Our resistance efforts in [FROM.GetName] have paid off. The people there are ready to take action against their oppressors. Let them start the fight, and as soon as they do, we will be ready to go back home and fight.
loc.SWE_hygenic_housing_mission_tt: A random state adjacent to a state with an existing §YHygienic Housing§! modifier will get a §YHygienic Housing§! modifier.\nThis mission repeats until every core state has a §YHygienic modifier§!
loc.SWE_work_projects_for_the_unemployed_rap: Rapid implementation of work projects for the unemployed
loc.SWE_form_rfsu_desc: As our overarching goal of providing better healthcare for our citizens we will form an organizations that works with sexual and reproductive health. This will reduce disease and empower the population.
loc.SWE_swap_herman_eriksson: Appoint Herman Eriksson as Minister of Supply
loc.SWE_ebba_add_research: Encourage women to venture into the scientific arts
loc.SWE_ebba_political_clout: Reduce the barriers of political entry for women
loc.SWE_move_the_bus_tt: Moves [?SWE.GetLeader]s mobile headquarters to this state.\n§YIf the state gets captured while the headquarters is in this state the country leader will die§!
loc.SWE_rationing_cooldown: §YIt will be possible to change this policy after 180 days.§!
loc.SWE_time_until_can_pick_gengas: Time until we can change GenGas policy
loc.SWE_time_until_can_pick_food_stamps: Time until we can change food stamps policy
loc.SWE_time_until_can_pick_civilian_tires: Time until we can change seizing civilian tires policy
loc.SWE_time_until_can_pick_air_shelters: Time until we can change air raid shelters policy
loc.SWE_train_the_sheltered_short_desc: We are currently training Nordic soldiers disguised as police forces. In the case of war they will be called upon to serve in the military, adding the manpower pool to our reserve.\nWe are able to expand our facilities to train even more if needed
loc.SWE_train_the_sheltered_tt: Unlocks decisions to train exiled Nordic soldiers. This manpower is added to a separate manpower pool that will grow with time up to a cap. If we are attacked that manpower pool will be added to our own manpower.\nWe can spend resources to further increase this cap.\nUpon war this pool will stop to grow
loc.SWE_set_up_home_guard_forces_tt: Sets up cell of Home Guard units that can be activated as emergency divisions in case of war.\nThis can be done three times per state, increasing the number of divisions in case of war.\nHome Guard Level: §Y[?FROM.SWE_has_added_home_guard]/3§!
loc.SWE_activate_home_guard_tt: Activates the Home Guard divisions in this state
loc.SWE_activate_all_home_guard_tt: Activates all Hemvärn divisions in the entire country at once
loc.SWE_bop_suspend_riksdag_desc: With our grip on power firmly established, we can finally do away with the antiquated institution of the Riksdag and its associated elections.
loc.SWE_ball_bearing_trade_tt:
Allows trading Ball Bearings to foreign nations which increases their production of §YTanks§! and §YPlanes§!.
If they accept this trade we will get the option of being provided with either
  §YArmy§!, §YAir§! and §YNavy§! Experience: §G+20§!
  Stability: §G+2%§!, §G+15§! Weekly Manpower (Stacks for every additional trade) 
  §G+25%§! Research Bonus for §YShip§!, §YRadar§!, §YSynthetic Resources§! or §YSupport Technologies§!
loc.SWE_proclaim_big_power_sweden: Proclaim restoration of the Swedish Empire
loc.SWE_proclaim_big_power_sweden_tt: Every core state at game start:\n     Is fully controlled by: §Y[?ROOT.GetName]§!
loc.SWE_proclaim_eternal_sweden_tt: Every core state at game start for §Y[DEN.GetName]§!, §Y[NOR.GetName]§!, §Y[FIN.GetName]§!, §Y[ICE.GetName]§!, §Y[EST.GetName]§! and §Y[LAT.GetName]§! Is fully controlled by: §Y[?ROOT.GetName]§!
loc.SWE_implemented_rural_reforms_tt: §Y3 states§! that have state categories lower than 'Town' will receive §Y1 infrastructure§!.
loc.SWE_appeal_for_support_dec_tt: §RSupporters will expect to be paid back in future and stability will be drastically impacted if obligations are not met!§!
loc.SWE_socialists_reforms_decision_mio: Funnel taxes to private military contracts
loc.SWE_pull_the_trigger_tt: The size of the civil war will depend on the scale of their communist support
loc.SWE_has_picked_war_cabinet_trait_tt: §YWe can only pick one trait for our leader§!
loc.SWE_coax_nordic_defense_council_cat: Coax Nordic Countries to join the Nordic Defense Council
loc.SWE_coax_countries_that_rejected: Coax [FROM.GetName] to join the Nordic Defense Council
loc.NORDIC_promote_nordic_unity_desc: We should remind our neighbors of our shared history and our tradition of helping each other, even if it was rather sporadic.
loc.NORDIC_strenghten_ties_decision_desc: Whether we want it or not, history has tied [ROOT.GetName] and [FROM.GetName] together. We could learn from each other by strengthening these ties.
loc.NORDIC_strenghtening_ties_flag: Strengthening our ties with another Nordic country.
loc.NORDIC_strengthen_ties_TT: Unlocks decision: §YStrengthen Ties With Nordic§! to bring another Nordic country closer to [ROOT.GetName] diplomatically and politically.
loc.NORDIC_invest_in_nordic_desc: If we invest in [FROM.GetName], we can reap the benefits of a neighbor while still giving them a decent deal.
loc.NORDIC_ask_for_investment_to_nordic_desc: It's clear we lack the capital to make the investments necessary for our development and eventual rise to power. We can ask our Nordic neighbor, [FROM.GetName] to pour some of their capital into our country to achieve this goal. Of course, they will be rewarded for their support.
loc.NORDIC_ongoing_investment: Is already investing in a Nordic's economy.
loc.NORDIC_economic_cooperation_decisions_de: [ROOT.GetName] and [FROM.GetName] share centuries of history. Sometimes as enemies, and other times as allies and friendly neighbors. In these uncertain times, us Nordics should stick together and cooperate in a mutually beneficial cooperation, as equals.
loc.NORDIC_court_foreign_power_desc: If we are to achieve our goals for dominance, we need the support of foreign powers like [FROM.GetName]. Joining their alliance will give us the edge we need to bring change to the North.
loc.NORDIC_defend_nordic_country: Join the war for the defense of [FROM.GetName]
loc.DEN_short_reset_time_tt: This action is repeatable in §Y[?DEN_short_reset_time]§! days
loc.DEN_medium_reset_time_tt: This action is repeatable in §Y[?DEN_medium_reset_time]§! days
loc.DEN_long_reset_time_tt: This action is repeatable in §Y[?DEN_long_reset_time]§! days
loc.DEN_very_long_reset_time_tt: This action is repeatable in §Y[?DEN_very_long_reset_time]§! days
loc.DEN_hurt_military_ability_tt: This action will hurt the military's ability by
loc.DEN_bop_motion_of_no_confidence_desc: The current government seems incapable of any sensible action to save [DEN.GetNameDef] and its people. New decisive leadership is needed! Rigsdagen must move for a “vote of no confidence” in [DEN.GetLeader]’s leadership.
loc.DEN_bop_criticize_the_country_leader_des: Members of Rigsdagen are questioning the leadership of [ROOT.GetLeader] behind closed doors, but no one seems to be willing to do so in the open. Someone has to openly criticize him and rally a majority of Rigsdagen to pave the way for a motion of no confidence!
loc.DEN_bop_defend_our_chosen_path_neutralit: For better or worse, we have started down a path which it would be very unwise to deviate from now. We must put our faith in the decisions we have made that lead us here and hope that this chosen path is the correct one.
loc.DEN_bop_ban_all_political_uniforms_desc: All over Europe, political uniforms can be seen marching in ranks, as if it were a military parade. And all over Europe, political unrest and instability can be seen marching forward, dragging the continent into chaos. We must prevent this development to reach [ROOT.GetNameDef] before it is too late.
loc.DEN_bop_unban_oppositions_uniforms_desc: We cannot ban another party's use of political uniforms while our supporters march down the streets like participants in a military parade. We must lift this censorship.
loc.DEN_bop_defend_the_policy_of_neutrality_: Neutrality has served us well, not least during the Great War when battles raged all over Europe. But not here, not in Denmark. We were saved, we were spared. Neutrality has served us well indeed.
loc.DEN_bop_speak_out_in_favor_of_disarmamen: £BoP_left_texticon Speak out in Favor of Disarmament

As a small nation surrounded by major powers, we have no hope of holding back an invading force, so why spend money on a defense that will never help us, but that would potentially anger our much larger neighbors?
loc.DEN_bop_speak_out_against_warfare_desc: Rearming now would pose a grave danger to our country as it could easily be seen as a hostile action by nearby powers. We cannot risk angering a larger neighbor right now since we have no way of defending ourselves against a much stronger military.
loc.DEN_bop_expand_the_welfare_desc: Instead of warmongering and wasting money on a defense that cannot hope to withstand the onslaught of any one of the major powers in our vicinity, we should increase the spending on our burgeoning welfare system!
loc.DEN_bop_unban_all_political_uniforms_des: We cannot allow the ban on political uniforms to remain as it curtails the rights of the people!
loc.DEN_bop_ban_oppositions_uniforms_desc: We cannot allow our political opponents to march around in their uniforms and showing off. This only spreads discontent and discord. We should ban all political uniforms - except for those in power of course.
loc.DEN_bop_criticize_our_preparedness_desc: Dark clouds are gathering over Europe once again, and we are nowhere near prepared for the oncoming storm! We must start preparations as soon as possible if we are to weather this storm.
loc.DEN_bop_question_our_defenses_desc: The long-held policy of neutrality has stripped Denmark of all and any defenses! If we were to be assailed by a foreign power, there would be nothing stopping them from marching straight into København right now. We must see to our defenses if we are to survive as a country!
loc.DEN_bop_speak_out_against_welfare: £BoP_right_texticon Speak out against the Welfare System
loc.DEN_bop_speak_out_against_welfare_desc: We must first look to our defenses to secure our independence before we can spend money on anything else. It stands to reason that without a Danish nation, there are no Danes to spend that money on.
loc.DEN_bop_speak_out_in_favor_of_rearmament: £BoP_right_texticon Speak out in Favor of Rearmament
We cannot sit idly by when the rest of Europe is in an arms race and uncertain times lie ahead. We must prepare our defenses and start the rearmament as soon as possible, preferably yesterday!
loc.DEN_bop_landstorm_desc: With the brewing turmoil all around us it's high time to re-instate the Landstorm to defend our territory. While not of the best quality, these troops could be the last line of defense.
loc.DEN_bop_hold_a_military_parade_desc: By holding a military parade we will boost the faith of the people in our ability to defend [ROOT.GetNameDef]. It will surely strengthen their morale and resolve to see the motivation of our troops.
loc.DEN_bop_occupation_criticize_collaborati: This dishonorable capitulation and unholy collaboration between [ROOT.GetNameDef] and [?DEN.DEN_overlord_nation.GetNameDef]  is not worth the paper it is written on!
loc.DEN_bop_occupation_strikes_decs: The best we can do right now is to passively protest the [?DEN.DEN_overlord_nation.GetAdjective] occupation by coordinating nationwide strikes.
loc.DEN_bop_occupation_resistance_coordinati: If we want to regain our freedom, we must gather in a common resistance movement and fight for the same goal; the liberation of [ROOT.GetNameDef].
loc.DEN_bop_occupation_underground_factories: To stand a better chance of regaining our sovereignty, we need proper stockpiles of weapons. We must construct secret weapons factories so that we can arm the populace when the day comes when we may have to fight for our freedom.
loc.DEN_bop_occupation_raid_depots_desc: Our domestic arms factories produce and assist [?DEN.DEN_overlord_nation.GetNameDef] with weapons, weapons used in their wars. Raiding weapon depots will decrease the arms supplies while strengthening our resistance movement at the same time.
loc.DEN_bop_occupation_sabotage_civ_industry: Our domestic factories and industries are forced to produce and assist [?DEN.DEN_overlord_nation.GetNameDef] with various material, material used in their war. By sabotaging these factories, material supplies will decrease, which will harm the German war effort.
loc.DEN_bop_occupation_sabotage_mil_industry: Our domestic arms factories produce and assist [?DEN.DEN_overlord_nation.GetNameDef] with weapons, weapons used in their wars. Sabotaging these factories will decrease arms supplies, harming the German war effort while helping our potential allies.
loc.DEN_bop_occupation_funnel_resources_dani: £BoP_right_texticon Funnel Resources to the Danish Brigades

[?DEN.hosts_danish_brigades.GetNameDefCap] has graciously accepted to take in and train Danish troops that can assist in the liberation of [ROOT.GetNameDef] when the time comes. But to make sure that these troops have the best possible chance of succeeding in the mission of liberating our country, we must assist with money and material.
loc.DEN_bop_occupation_switch_ideology_desc: If we truly want to align with [?DEN.DEN_overlord_nation.GetNameDef] and earn their support, we must adopt their ideologies and beliefs.
loc.DEN_bop_occupation_ban_elections_desc: We must appease our [?DEN.DEN_overlord_nation.GetAdjective] overlords by banning free elections
loc.DEN_bop_occupation_defend_collaboration_: Surrendering to and collaborating with [?DEN.DEN_overlord_nation.GetNameDef] was the only right choice! It has spared us horrors and destruction we cannot fathom.
loc.DEN_bop_occupation_censor_the_media_desc: We cannot allow the media to openly criticize the  [?DEN.DEN_overlord_nation.GetAdjective] occupation force in this precarious situation. We must limit them in what they can publish so as not to risk what little freedom we still have.
loc.DEN_bop_occupation_remove_political_agit: Some prominent politicians do not shy away from criticizing our [?DEN.DEN_overlord_nation.GetAdjective] overlords, which contributes to  increased tension between our countries. We must remove these troublemakers from their political assignments before [?DEN.DEN_overlord_nation.GetNameDef] forces us to.
loc.DEN_bop_occupation_ban_communism_desc: Our [?DEN.DEN_overlord_nation.GetAdjective] overlords see themselves at war with the Communist ideology itself and would value our continued cooperation even more if we banned all Communist organizations in our country.
loc.DEN_bop_occupation_allow_communism_desc: Our Communist overlords do not take kindly to the fact that we have banned their ideology in [ROOT.GetNameDef]. It would be in our best interest to allow Communism again.
loc.DEN_bop_occupation_ban_fascism_desc: Our [?DEN.DEN_overlord_nation.GetAdjective] overlords see themselves at war with the Fascists ideology itself and would value our continued cooperation even more if we banned all Fascist organizations in our country.
loc.DEN_bop_occupation_allow_fascism_desc: Our Fascist overlords do not take kindly to the fact that we have banned their ideology in [ROOT.GetNameDef]. It would be in our best interest to allow Fascism again.
loc.DEN_bop_occupation_allow_democratism_des: Having recurring elections is a sign of trust between citizens and a strength for a country. Not allowing democratic elections is a disgrace to our nation.
loc.DEN_resistance_category_desc: We must resist the occupying power and regain our freedom! This can only be achieved with a joint effort and that we work steadfastly towards the common goal of a liberated [ROOT.GetNameDef].
loc.DEN_seek_danish_brigades_host: Seek Host Nation for the Danish Brigades
loc.DEN_overlord_category_desc: We have allowed Denmark to retain a certain independence as a special protectorate. However, we have to keep a watchful eye on them since our protection also comes with certain obligations.
loc.DEN_demand_government_change: Demand on a change of government
loc.DEN_increase_trade_with_denmark_desc: We would stand to benefit a great deal if we were to expand on our already existing trade agreement with [DEN.GetName].
loc.DEN_cancel_trade_with_denmark_desc: The trade agreement we had with the Danes has run its course and is of no use to us any longer.
loc.DEN_cancel_trade_with_country_desc: We no longer see any use in this trade agreement and it is no longer of any use to us.
loc.DEN_fortification_category_desc: To secure [ROOT.GetNameDef]'s future, we must prepare for the worst and strengthen our defenses. Only a formidable and impenetrable wall of forts can protect us.
loc.DEN_development_category_desc: To overcome future financial and agricultural crises, we must invest in and diversify our regions to make them resilient and productive.
loc.DEN_repeatable_three_times_tt: This action has been repeated §Y0§! out of §Y3§! times
loc.DEN_times_state_has_been_developed_tt: This action has been repeated §Y[?DEN_times_state_was_developed]§! out of §Y3§! times
loc.last_repeatable_decision_tt: This action is §Ynot§! repeatable any more
loc.DEN_danish_security_category_desc: We need to seek protection and turn to other nations to secure our sovereignty.
loc.DEN_nordic_security_category_desc: We must protect our Nordic brethren and secure the Northern Front so we can turn our attention to more pressing matters.
loc.DEN_demand_territory_category_desc: The Nordic region belongs under Danish hegemony so that we can protect our brethren peoples. We are within our full rights to demand that any Nordic territory not under our jurisdiction be transferred into our protection.
loc.DEN_return_occupied_territory_category_d: Foreign powers claim to protect our territory from all severities of war until we have been 'liberated from the foul thraldom' that we have been plunged into by hostile aggression. Well, it's time to hand over the islands.
loc.DEN_request_the_return_of_the_faroes: Request the Return of the Faroes
loc.FIN_motti_tactics_category_desc: The motti strategy involves encircling and isolating enemy units to cripple their logistical and communication lines. \nThe implementation of this approach requires careful planning and training of the defense forces to ensure its effectiveness on the battlefield, but it will allow to outmaneuver the enemy and strike where they least expect.
loc.FIN_prepare_motti_tactics_in_state_desc: Preparations will be made for the implementation of motti tactics in [FROM.GetName].
loc.FIN_cancel_motti_tactics_in_state_desc: Our troops will no longer utilize motti tactics in [FROM.GetName], so military resources can be relocated somewhere else.
loc.FIN_motti_tactics_cost_increase_tt: The cost for §YPrepare Motti Tactics§! decisions will be §Rmultiplied§! by §Y[?FIN_motti_decision_cost_increase]§!.\n
loc.FIN_motti_tactics_cost_decrease_tt: \nThe cost for §YPrepare Motti Tactics§! decisions will be §Gdivided§! by §Y[?FIN_motti_decision_cost_increase]§!.
loc.FIN_motti_tactics_decision_cost_dynamic_: It costs £command_power  §Y[?FIN_motti_decision_cost]§! £pol_power  §Y[?FIN_motti_decision_cost]§! to take the decision
loc.FIN_national_defense_category_desc: The defense of the [ROOT.GetAdjective] territory and independence is of utmost importance. We should be ready to do whatever it takes to defend our people against any external threats.
loc.FIN_set_up_weapon_caches_in_state_desc: As part of a secret military operation, a large amount of [ROOT.GetAdjective] Army weapons and equipment will be hidden in caches scattered around [FROM.GetName] so that [ROOT.GetAdjective] Resistance elements can continue the fight against invaders.
loc.FIN_weapon_caches_cost_increase_tt: The cost for §YSet Up Weapon Caches§! decisions will be increased by §Y[?FIN_weapon_caches_decision_cost_increase]§!.\n
loc.FIN_weapon_caches_decision_cost_dynamic_: It costs £infantry_equipment_text_icon  §Y50§! £command_power  §Y[?FIN.FIN_weapon_caches_decision_cost]§!  £pol_power  §Y[?FIN_weapon_caches_decision_cost]§! to take the decision
loc.FIN_surrender_to_the_soviet_union_desc: It is clear that despite our soldier's bravest efforts, we cannot hold the [SOV.GetAdjective]s off forever. It is high time we ask for a limited peace with our enemies.
loc.FIN_reached_out_to_soviets_to_surrender_: Already attempted to start peace negotiations with [SOV.GetNameDef]
loc.FIN_demand_peace_negotiations_desc: Now that we have finally regained the upper hand against the [SOV.GetAdjective]s, we can attempt to enforce peace.
loc.FIN_can_demand_territory_if_occupying_tt: \n\nWe will be able to demand Territorial concessions from [SOV.GetNameDef] if we control the states of §Y[213.GetName]§!, §Y[215.GetName]§! or §Y[216.GetName]§!.
