loc.AAT_finland_political.09.desc: It is with gratitude that we acknowledge [ROOT.GetLeader]'s accomplishments, for it is certain that without [ROOT.GetLeader.GetHerHis] leadership, we would not have weathered the storm and our nation would now be lost. \n\nHowever, it is now time for us to look beyond the war, to the peace and reconstruction that must follow. To properly heal the wounds and face the future, we must restore a civilian government.
loc.AAT_finland_political.09.a: The [ROOT.GetAdjective] people thank you for your service, Marshal Baron Mannerheim!
loc.AAT_finland_kinship_war.01.desc: Amidst rising anti-Soviet sentiment in Karelia, our loyal citizens there have voiced fears that we may be heading towards a repeat of the Heimosodat and the East Karelian Uprising. Whether the goal is of an independent Karelia, a unified Finnic people, simple tribalism or even Finnish imperialist dreams, it is clear that Finnish agitation is responsible.
loc.AAT_finland_kinship_war.01.a: Any insurgents will be dealt with!
loc.AAT_finland_kinship_war.02.desc:
Our efforts to foster discontent against the [SOU.GetName] have met with great success. 20,000 East Karelians fled to Finland during the East Karelian Uprising, and they have been working diligently within the Academic Karelia Society to maintain the memory of what they had lost. The Heimosodat was never forgotten, nor was Karelian treatment at the hands of the Soviet authorities. 

As a result, the people of Eastern Karelia have started talking openly of rising up against their oppressors. Weapons and supplies have been flowing into the region for some time, but now they are calling for those who were displaced to return and take up arms. 

The question now is, will [ROOT.GetName] join their struggle once again?
loc.AAT_finland_kinship_war.02.a: We fully support our Karelian brothers!
loc.AAT_finland_kinship_war.02.b: We will allow Finnish agitators to cross the border.
loc.AAT_finland_kinship_war.03.desc: The first shots rang out this morning as rebels in Eastern Karelia, coaxed to drastic action by [FIN.GetAdjective] elements, attacked government positions. Trouble has been brewing in the area for some time, as arms have been smuggled in from our troublesome neighbor to support the rebellious factions present here. [FIN.GetName] was never happy with the Peace of Tartu signed in 1920, and has been supporting rebellious factions in Eastern Karelia ever since. \n\nUntil now, this was the limit of their involvement, however, it looks like [FIN.GetName] is at last getting more directly involved. The situation has been further escalated when [FIN.GetAdjective] forces crossed the border broadening the conflict, and bringing our two nations into a state of war.
loc.AAT_finland_kinship_war.03.a: They do not stand a chance against our forces!
loc.AAT_finland_kinship_war.04.desc: For the past couple of months, [FROM.GetAdjective] forces have probed East Karelian towns, attempting to find ways to destabilize the region and throw local garrisons into chaos, however opposition from defending [SOV.GetAdjective] troops has been too strong. \n\nMany Finnish agitators and East Karelian rebels have been arrested, deported, or forced to flee back to Finland before an actual uprising could be planned. The people are afraid and this is no longer a possibility.
loc.AAT_finland_kinship_war.04.a: We will have to liberate East Karelia by other means.
loc.AAT_finland_kinship_war.05.desc: For the past couple of months, [FIN.GetAdjective] forces have probed East Karelian towns, attempting to find ways to destabilize the region and throw our local garrisons into chaos, however brave opposition from defending [SOV.Adjective] troops has of course been too strong. \n\nMany Finnish agitators and East Karelian rebels have been arrested, deported, or forced to flee back to Finland before an actual uprising could be provoked. The people rejoice that peace has been restored to the region at last!
loc.AAT_finland_kinship_war.05.a: Hopefully the last Kinship War, this time for real...
loc.AAT_finland_kinship_war_dynamic_modifier: While the State Modifier §Y$FIN_anti_soviet_sentiment$§! is present in §Y[215.GetName]§!, §Y[216.GetName]§!, §Y[146.GetName]§! or §Y[147.GetName]§!, [FROM.GetNameDef] can instigate a Karelian uprising.
loc.AAT_finland_kinship_war_rebellion_crushe: §RThe Karelian insurgents have been crushed before an uprising could be organized§!.
§GThe Karelian insurgents have been crushed before an uprising could be organized§!.
loc.AAT_finland_kinship_war.06.desc: As the civil institutions are breaking down in the Soviet Union, many local nationalist governments are declaring their independence, [KAR.GetNameDef] being one of them. Karelian irredentists and militarists have declared that we have a second Kinship War on our hands, while moderates and socialists claim we should not get involved in Soviet affairs.
loc.AAT_finland_kinship_war.06.a: We should send them men and materiel
loc.AAT_finland_kinship_war.06.b: One should not wake the sleeping bear...
loc.AAT_finland_the_white_death.1.t: Our Snipers are Proving Highly Effective
loc.AAT_finland_the_white_death.1.desc: Reports have come in that our snipers are proving highly efficient at fighting off enemy forces intruding into our forests. This is a good opportunity for war propaganda, as the term White Death has been popping up among enemy soldiers, referring to the dangers posed by Finland's nature and people, and we could pin this to a certain person to rally the population if one happens to prop up.
loc.AAT_finland_the_white_death.1.b: We should hand out more arms to the hunters
loc.aat_news.105.desc: As war has come to [FIN.GetNameDef], many hunters, Suojeluskunta militiamen and shooting club marksmen have taken up arms to fight off their oppressors. The [FIN.GetAdjective] Sisu flows through them as they stem off enemy attacks utilizing the [FIN.GetAdjective] nature to their advantage, something that has come to be known by enemy soldiers as the White Death.
loc.aat_news.105.a: This is a good opportunity for propaganda!
loc.aat_news.105.b: Death has come to take our men, but we will not give up without a fight!
loc.aat_news.105.c: They sure know how to fight
loc.AAT_finland_the_white_death.2.t: [FIN.GetAdjective] Snipers Putting Fear into the Hearts of our Soldiers
loc.AAT_finland_the_white_death.2.desc: Our soldiers report of entire columns of men being taken by surprise and shot to shreds in the forests of [FIN.GetNameDef]. They have begun talking about the White Death, an embodiment of the solid cold of [FIN.GetNameDef], and the deadly marksmen of the [FIN.GetAdjective] Army. If we wish, we could put extensive effort into getting rid of these hindrances before they can cause even more damage.
loc.AAT_finland_the_white_death.2.a: There is no need to worry about them
loc.FIN_we_will_be_more_likely_to_put_down_t: We will be more likely to succeed in hunting down the §YFinnish Snipers§!
loc.AAT_finland_the_white_death.4.t: Simo Häyhä accredited as the White Death
loc.AAT_finland_the_white_death.4.desc: The Viipuri sniper Simo Häyhä, who is often referred to by our other soldiers as Taika-Ampuja, The Magic Shooter, for his impressive marksmanship, is now also being accredited as the White Death, which up until now has been referring to the harshness of the Finnish nature and its people by our enemies, and the press is pushing this new narrative strongly. What should our official stance be?
loc.AAT_finland_the_white_death.4.a: We should propagate tales of this Modern Finnish Hero
loc.AAT_finland_the_white_death.4.b: The White Death is the Embodiment of Finland, not some person!
loc.AAT_finland_the_white_death.5.t: Simo Häyhä accredited as the White Death
loc.AAT_finland_the_white_death.6.t: Simo Häyhä accredited as the White Death
loc.AAT_finland_the_white_death.7.desc: Despite our soldiers' best efforts, the White Death is far from being captured, and has terrorized our soldiers for weeks, with our officers having nothing to show for it. As this goes on, our soldiers waver and their morale has plummeted...
loc.AAT_finland_the_white_death.8.t: Despite Heavy Losses, Our troops Successfully Wound the White Death
loc.AAT_finland_the_white_death.8.desc: Reports from our officers in [FIN.GetNameDef] have come in about the successful injury of the White Death. This has however come at a great price, as many soldiers have been killed, and more have been wounded along the way. Nevertheless, we should not have to meet him on the battlefield again.
loc.AAT_finland_the_white_death.8.a: We have rid ourselves of a pesky fly!
loc.AAT_finland_the_white_death.9.t: Despite Heavy Losses, Our troops have managed to kill The White Death!
loc.AAT_finland_the_white_death.9.desc: Reports from our officers in [FIN.GetNameDef] have come in about the successful elimination of the [FIN.GetAdjective] sniper known as the White Death. Despite coming alongside heavy casualties, a great enemy of [ROOT.GetNameDef] has been rid of, and our soldiers can now rest easy.
loc.AAT_finland_the_white_death.9.a: In reality, he stood no chance against us
loc.AAT_finland_the_white_death.10.t: The White Death Continues to Stalk his Prey
loc.AAT_finland_the_white_death.10.desc: Despite numerous close calls and false claims, Simo Häyhä is unscratched, and will continue fighting on for as long as is required of him. The White Death embraces our enemies!
loc.AAT_finland_the_white_death.11.t: Simo Häyhä has been injured and brought off of the battlefield
loc.AAT_finland_the_white_death.11.desc: Reports have come in that Häyhä has been severely wounded after an explosive bullet fired by a hostile soldier hit his lower left jaw, and whilst thought to have been dead, has made it back to a nearby base camp to report his safety. He cannot however continue fighting, but he has done enough service for an eternity of gratitude from the [FIN.GetAdjective] people.
loc.AAT_finland_the_white_death.11.a: Nevertheless, he is a true Finnish Hero!
loc.AAT_finland_the_white_death.12.desc: Reports have come in that Häyhä has been killed after being hit by an explosive bullet fired by a hostile soldier whilst engaged in combat. His body has successfully been retrieved by our jaegers, and he has been brought back to the capital. He will be remembered forever by the eternally grateful people of [FIN.GetNameDef].
loc.AAT_finland_the_white_death.12.a: May his soul rest among the heroes of old
loc.aat_news.100.desc: Following their defeat in their previous war against the [SOV.GetAdjective] government, the [FIN.GetAdjective] people have now mobilized and stand ready to reclaim the territories they lost, and liberate the [FIN.GetAdjective] and [KAR.GetAdjective] people from foreign oppression, as a spiritual successor to the [FIN.GetAdjective] War for Independence and Heimosodat.
loc.aat_news.100.b: And they will not fight alone!
loc.aat_news.100.c: The Finns will pay for this!
loc.aat_news.100.d: Yet another puppet of [GER.GetLeader] joins the war...
loc.aat_news.101.desc: Following the Russian defeat in the Crimean War, the Åland islands have been demilitarized, and their inhabitants exempt from any form of conscription. Though this status has been contested many times, it is still enforced by many of the great powers of the world. Now however, following the [FIN.GetAdjective] Operation Kilpapurjehdus, the islands have again been remilitarized.
loc.aat_news.666.t: Restoration of the North Sea Empire
loc.aat_news.666.desc: Having retaken all the lands once ruled by Cnut the Great, the [From.GetOldAdjective] government has now begun increasing moves towards integration of the newly-conquered territories. As a result, in an attempt to rally the people behind the state, there has been an increase in pan-nationalist propaganda with clear support from the government.\n\nThe [FROM.GetOldAdjective] leader [FROM.GetLeader] has declared that the united Realms of [DEN.GetOldNameDef], [NOR.GetOldNameDef], and England will from now on be known as '[From.GetNameDef]'.
loc.aat_news.666.a: It appears the Vikings have returned
loc.aat_news.777.t: Formation of the Baltic Sea Empire
loc.aat_news.777.desc: Having managed to conquer most of the Baltic Sea region, the [From.GetOldAdjective] government has now begun increasing moves towards integration of the newly-conquered territories. As a result, in an attempt to rally the people behind the state, there has been an increase in pan-nationalist propaganda with clear support from the government.\n\nThe [FROM.GetOldAdjective] leader [FROM.GetLeader] gave a speech about how [FROM.GetOldNameDef] has managed to do what no other country has and laid the Baltic Sea under its rule. [FROM.GetSheHeCap] finished the speech by proclaiming the formation of '[From.GetNameDef]'.
loc.AAT_britain_narvik.1.desc: We have successfully blown up the [SWE.GetAdjective] mines and robbed [GER.GetNameDef] of one of its most important import resources. Despite the promise of aid to [FIN.GetName] as the prime motivation for this endeavor, it was never really a viability to engage in direct conflict with [SOV.GetNameDef] and we have dealt a major blow to our main adversary. We have no real enemy in [SWE.GetNameDefCap], and now need to decide what to do next.
loc.AAT_britain_narvik.2.desc: [ENG.GetAdjective] troops have crossed the border into [SWE.GetName]. With no declaration of war the silence from the [ENG.GetAdjective] government the [SWE.GetAdjective] authorities are outraged at the lack of respect for [SWE.GetAdjective] sovereignty. The most likely explanation for this is that the [ENG.GetAdjective] troops are trying to reach the mines in Gällivare and Kiruna to sabotage them in order to prevent the high grade ore from reaching [GER.GeName], which would be a huge blow to the both [GER.GetAdjective] and [SWE.GetAdjective] economies and a huge breach of [SWE.GetAdjective] neutrality.
loc.AAT_britain_narvik.3.desc: [ENG.GetNameDefCap] has illegally invaded [SWE.GetName] and destroyed their mines, without a proper declaration of war. A key economic engine of the [SWE.GetAdjective] economy is now but a ruined quarry. The [ENG.GetAdjective] government has defended their actions by arguing that trading with [GER.GetNameDefCap] is just as bad as siding with them, and that the actions are justified, but it seems that even their domestic population is uncomfortable with their governments explanation.
loc.AAT_britain_narvik.4.desc: [ENG.GetName] has announced that its strategic objective in [SWE.GetName] has been accomplished and is pulling out its troops. Its government also reiterates that it has no real enmity towards the [SWE.GetAdjective] state, and that its action in [SWE.GetName] is purely in the interest of the defense of democracy. Both the [GER.GetAdjective] and [SWE.GetAdjective] embassy has delivered a letter of protest, the [GER.GetAdjective] side arguing that [ENG.GetName] breached neutrality and invaded a foreign nation in a combat zone, and [SWE.GetAdjective] lambasting the [ENG.GetAdjective] government that despite its lofty goals of helping [FIN.GetName] it is now clear that it was a poorly constructed ploy to achieve their own ends, at the cost of [SWE.GetAdjective] lives.
loc.AAT_MIO_events.2.desc: The industrialists at $CZE_skoda_works$ are eager for investment, however we can only afford to sink money into one of the three branches within the company. Doing so will allow them to prioritize the development of either ships, tanks or artillery equipment.
loc.AAT_USA_events.01.desc: The [USA.GetAdjective] government led by [USA.GetLeader] has announced the occupation of Greenland as a part of their new Greenland Patrol, an operation to secure North America from foreign threats and influence as decided on in the Havana Conference. They have promised to hand it back over to us once the ongoing situation in the world has calmed down.
loc.AAT_USA_events.01.a: At least they will give it back later...
loc.AAT_USA_events.02.desc: The [FROM.GetAdjective] have stated that they are at this moment occupying the Faroe Islands, which belong to Denmark and which are a strategic point of high importance. They claim that they shall shield the Faroe Islands from all the severities of war and establish themselves there conveniently by sea and air until the moment comes when the isles will be handed back to us, liberated from the foul thraldom into which they have been plunged by [?DEN.DEN_overlord_nation.GetAdjective] aggression.
loc.AAT_USA_events.02.a: At least our people are in safe hands...
loc.AAT_USA_events.03.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef] calls on us to honor our promises and as agreed return the Faroe Islands to them, now that they are once again free from oppression.
loc.AAT_USA_events.03.b: Actually, we have changed our minds
loc.AAT_USA_events.04.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef] has denied our request, claiming that after a referendum, the people of the Faroe Islands clearly want to be under no other's rule than that of the [FROM.getAdjective].
loc.AAT_USA_events.04.a: Not like we can challenge them anyway
loc.AAT_USA_events.05.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef] calls on us to honor our promises and as agreed return Greenland to them, now that they are once again free from oppression.
loc.AAT_USA_events.06.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef] has denied our request, claiming that after a referendum, the people of Greenland clearly want to be under no other's rule than that of the [FROM.getAdjective].
loc.AAT_USA_events.07.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef] has honored their promise and has agreed to return the territories they held for safe keeping, now that we are once again free from oppression.
loc.AAT_USA_events.08.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef] has sent us a request for returning un-lawfully held Danish territory to its rightful owner.
loc.AAT_USA_events.08.b: We will not yield to oppressors!
loc.AAT_USA_events.09.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef] has agreed to return un-lawfully held Danish territory to its rightful owner.
loc.FIN_suomalainen_sosialismi_desc: The abject misery of capitalism continues to permeate through our society due to the counter revolutionary devastation unleashed by Mannerheim and his allies during the civil war. We can not let this stand, we must find a way to liberate the working class.
loc.FIN_towards_a_red_government_desc: When the tides of workers' revolution swept the nation in 1918, the proletariat were betrayed by the reactionary forces of Mannerheim and his German allies. The time has come to avenge our fallen comrades and finally create the workers republic we were always meant to.
loc.FIN_the_second_finnish_civil_war_desc: Through the expansion of class consciousness among the growing proletariat and the organizational skills of its leadership, we have finally amassed the resources to overthrow our bourgeois masters once and for all.
loc.FIN_the_peoples_democratic_league_desc: The People’s Democratic League has been at the forefront of coordinating the various left-wing factions in [FIN.GetNameDef]. They have created the foundations of a true workers alliance that can ensure the will of the proletariat is enacted.
loc.FIN_cooperate_with_social_democrats_desc: While clearly misguided in their willingness to compromise with the capitalists, we can not dispute that the Social Democrats enjoy a great deal of support from the proletariat and many of their leaders are experts in their fields. We should do more to cooperate with them in the creation of our workers republic.
loc.FIN_the_workers_state_desc: With the dictatorship of the proletariat firmly established, we can now set about recreating the nation in a way that puts the interests of the proletariat firmly at the forefront of politics. Everything from the way we educate our children, to the way we organize our factories shall be completely overhauled.
loc.FIN_the_red_watch_desc: There are those who would undermine all we have created since the civil war in order to re-establish capitalist tyranny. With the establishment of the Red Guards, we can ensure such treacherous activity is rooted out before it can spread across our republic.
loc.FIN_approach_the_soviets_desc: Our comrades in [SOU.GetNameDef] are at the forefront of the proletarian struggle against bourgeois imperialism. We should reach out to their leadership and try to gain support for our struggle against the bourgeoisie in [FIN.GetNameDef].
loc.FIN_antagonize_the_soviets_desc: [SOU.GetNameDefCap] may wrap itself in the rhetoric of socialism, but it is no workers paradise. We shall find our own path to improving the lives of the working class and will not cooperate with the [SOV.GetAdjective] menace.
loc.FIN_finno_soviet_pact_desc: Historical grievances be damned, the [SOU.GetAdjective] people have proven to be worthwhile allies in the struggle for socialism. It’s time we formalized an agreement between our governments in preparation for the inevitable onslaught of reactionary Europe.
loc.FIN_subsidized_national_industrializatio: [SOU.GetNameDef] has made great strides in the mass mobilization of the nation's productive forces through industrialization. Perhaps we should request aid from their experts in rolling out a similar program in Finland.
loc.FIN_finnish_learned_societies_desc: While many of the nation's intellectuals fled abroad, there remains a substantial number who had the wisdom to embrace socialist thought. We should elevate these intellectuals through investment in their research.
loc.FIN_finnish_federation_of_trade_unions_d: The trade unions represent the true masters of industry, the workers. By cooperating with the federation of trade unions, we can reorganize the entire economy to the betterment of the working class.
loc.FIN_defensive_preparations_desc: Regardless of ideology, it seems we are destined for conflict with our eastward neighbor. We must prepare for the inevitable and rapidly expand our defenses. Should we fail, our nation may be subsumed by our foes once more.
loc.FIN_trade_agreements_desc: Although not always supportive of our domestic policy decisions, there are many nations who would be willing to establish trade agreements to support our military modernization. Mainly so we can undermine the security of our less savory neighbors.
loc.FIN_finno_estonian_union_desc: We share a long history with the people of Estonia, it therefore pains us to see them trapped between the great powers awaiting their home becoming yet another battleground in an international struggle. Perhaps through a union, we can save them from such a fate.
loc.FIN_social_democracy_desc: We have seen the failures and horrors that unfold when a Bolshevik style revolution is unleashed upon a nation. If we are to create a lasting society that benefits the working class, it must be through democratic, peaceful means wherever possible.
loc.FIN_pragmatic_socialism_desc: While we abhor the methods of the Bolsheviks and their ilk, we do not dispute that more must be done to liberate the working class from the horrors of modern capitalism. Through the careful application of democratic, pragmatic socialism, we shall achieve that.
loc.FIN_sosialistinen_eduskuntaryhma_desc: The Socialist Parliamentary Group are advocating for rapprochement with [SOU.GetNameDef] rather than antagonization. Their suggestions may offer the best hope of retaining our own form of socialism, without interference from the [SOU.GetAdjective]s.
loc.FIN_social_democratic_womens_union_desc: The plight of women in society has been neglected since time immemorial. By bringing the Social Democratic Women's Union deeper into the heart of government, we can finally address their concerns and create a more equitable society for all.
loc.FIN_mineral_wealth_desc: [ROOT.GetNameDefCap] has an abundance of natural resources that remain untapped. If we are to maintain a credible military force, we should utilize these resources and improve our economic self-sufficiency.
loc.FIN_funds_from_kalevala_koru_oy_desc: Kalevala Koru Oy, a manufacturer of fine jewelry, established by members of the Social Democratic Women's Union, has become a rousing success. By utilizing their expertise, we can boost our economy and use the wealth to fund other initiatives.
loc.FIN_join_the_comintern_desc: We must reject the antiquated notions of nationalism and its associated grievances and work together with [SOU.GetNameDef]. Together we can help turn the tide against the reactionary forces of Europe while also securing our own future.
loc.FIN_finnish_influence_in_the_baltic_desc: The collective security of the Baltic region rests upon the like minded of us collaborating with one another and ensuring all maintain a credible defense against the forces of aggression. As such, we should ensure that all our neighbors are pulling in the same direction.
loc.FIN_approach_major_democracies_desc: We have a shared interest with the liberal democracies of the world who wish to curtail the expanding influence of the more aggressive actors in geo-politics. Perhaps we can work together towards this common objective.
loc.FIN_finnish_autonomy_desc: Even some of the most dedicated communists among us harbored anxieties that cooperation with [SOU.GetNameDef] would lead to de facto Russian dominance of our politics. But, through careful diplomacy we have reached a level of understanding with our allies that secures our autonomy.
loc.FIN_integrate_kola_and_karelia_desc: While we have established a strong cooperative relationship with our [SOU.GetAdjective] comrades, border disputes hang over it like a rain cloud ready to burst. Perhaps we should clear the air and finally address these issues as allies rather than foes.
loc.FIN_keepers_of_the_baltic_countries_desc: The people of the Baltic have little interest in being subsumed into [GER.GetNameDef] or [SOU.GetNameDef]. We alone, with our shared history and outlook, are capable of peacefully leading these nations in a manner that does not destroy them.
loc.FIN_british_threat_desc: [ENG.GetNameDefCap] is the heart of the global bourgeois economy and its imperialist tendrils. We must vigorously plunge a dagger through that heart so the world may finally be free from its oppression.
loc.FIN_red_finland_desc: We have avenged our comrades who fell to the White Terror through the creation of a true workers republic. Now all that remains is to secure what we have achieved from those beyond our borders who would seek to destroy it.
loc.FIN_united_under_the_north_star_desc: Our Nordic friends and comrades are at the mercy of imperialist powers who care not for the interests of our region. But together, we can secure peace for our people through the creation of an alliance that should deter even the mightiest of empires.
loc.FIN_preserve_sapmi_desc: The Sámi people have long suffered at the hands of imperialist oppression, both within our borders and beyond. We should make amends with these people and help liberate them from their continued suffering at the hands of our neighbors.
loc.FIN_confederated_finno_russian_republics: A myriad of different people now fall under our governance. To prevent the development of a hierarchy of peoples within our state, we shall reorganize the government as a confederation of republics. This will allow all people to have a fair say in their governance.
loc.FIN_secure_the_baltic_sea_desc: While we are often focused on our land borders and how best to defend them, we can not let our efforts be in vain by neglecting the vulnerability of our coast line. We must therefore invest in a massive coastal defense program to secure this flank.
loc.FIN_german_threat_desc: Prussian militarism has once again reared its ugly head in [GER.Capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName]. While others are content to see Europe's capitals under the jackboot of [GER.GetLeader], we are not. It is time this menace to peace was dealt with once and for all.
loc.FIN_socialist_welfare_desc: Through the careful management of the economy and defense of our nation, we now have the resources to reward the working people with the establishment of a true welfare state. We shall ensure our people live long, happy lives.
loc.FIN_aid_for_entrepreneurs_desc: While we need to curtail the worst elements of capitalism, our economy could benefit greatly from increased entrepreneurial activity. By establishing investment grants and loans for important industries, we can stimulate such activity.
loc.FIN_soviet_threat_desc: [SOU.GetNameDefCap], is a threat to the lives of working class people across the globe as it will have no qualms over plunging them into a war of conquest. Before it gathers too much strength, we must end the threat now.
loc.FIN_proclaim_greater_finland_desc: Our borders now swell beyond what we could have imagined only a few years ago. With so much new territory, it has become necessary to reorganize our government so it better reflects the diverse region it governs.
loc.FIN_control_the_flux_of_iron_ore: Control the Flux of Iron Ore
loc.FIN_control_the_flux_of_iron_ore_desc: Swedish iron ore and Norwegian distribution of it continues to be a mechanism through which wars are waged across the continent and beyond. We must take ownership of this critical flow of resources before it falls into the hands of our foes.
loc.FIN_finnish_neutrality_desc: The strength and determination of our people to fight for their freedom can not be erased. However, we should pursue a policy of neutrality so that our neighbors have no reason to snuff out our hard won independence.
loc.FIN_the_finnish_swedish_peoples_party_de: People of Swedish ancestry make up a substantial minority in Finland, collaborating with the party that most ardently represents their interests may win us substantial support for our policies and win the favor of Sweden itself.
loc.FIN_align_the_agrarian_league_desc: [ROOT.GetNameDefCap] has undergone remarkable industrialization over the last century, we can not ignore the plight of the millions who keep the nation fed through their agricultural labors. By working with the Agrarian League, we can ensure their concerns are being addressed just as well as their urban counterparts.
loc.FIN_political_unity_desc: Regardless of political ideology, we all want what is best for our people. In this time of crisis, we must put aside the petty political squabbles and work together.
loc.FIN_collaboration_with_the_left_desc: Alienation of the left aligned parties does little to strengthen our government. If we find a way of collaborating with them though, we may be able to rally more of the population to our cause.
loc.FIN_railways_and_infrastructure_desc: The Great War demonstrated the necessity of robust rail and road networks that support industry and the military in getting resources or people where they need to be. After decades of occupation and bloodshed, our logistics networks are in dire need of investment.
loc.FIN_repurpose_small_industries_desc: While we don’t have the colossal industries of the great powers, we do have a myriad of smaller factories in operation. Rather than starting from scratch, we should repurpose these small premises for war production.
loc.FIN_expand_state_military_factories_desc: Our state run factories are struggling to keep up with the demands placed upon them by the military during this time of crisis. If we want to maintain supply lines, we need to expand our production facilities.
loc.FIN_a_new_course_for_kokoomus_desc: Recent events have led to an upsurge in support for the Kokoomus party as people look for strong, sensible leadership and a return to traditional values. We should capitalize on this by pushing through the party's conservative agenda.
loc.FIN_the_finnish_throne_desc: Kokoomus have long advocated for a Finnish monarchy. With their recent swell of support and tightening grip on the reins of power, they now have the means to dissolve the current system and establish a kingdom in its place.
loc.FIN_strengthen_military_administration_d: Mannerheim has heroically led our nation through these tumultuous times, cutting through political dogma with militaristic precision. For the sake of the nation’s continued survival, we must give him and the military the authority to govern as they see necessary.
loc.FIN_dreams_of_expansionism_desc: Risto Ryti rightfully acknowledges that we shall never have lasting peace until we gain control of the Karelian lands to our East. With them secure, we will create a much more defensible border with our neighbors.
loc.FIN_reach_out_to_scandinavia_desc: Most of our Scandinavian neighbors share our sentiments and have little interest in being dragged into great power conflicts. By maintaining strong relations with them, we may build the foundations of our collective defense.
loc.FIN_moderate_politics_desc: As tensions simmer among the great powers, we need to ensure that our government is not seen as being too lenient upon the ideologies of any faction. Therefore, we must pursue a policy of domestic moderation.
loc.FIN_join_the_allies_desc: Neutrality is quickly becoming an antiquated policy that simply leads to vassalization at the hands of the great powers. While it is a risk given our geo-political position, joining the Allies may allow us to maintain our sovereignty in the long-run.
loc.FIN_northern_defense_front_desc: Our neighbors across Scandinavia and the Baltic are easy pickings for the great powers. But, if we were to pool our resources and collaborate militarily, we may be able to deter even the greatest of foes from attacking us.
loc.FIN_the_lone_wolf_desc: No one has the interests of the [ROOT.GetAdjective] people at heart more than the [ROOT.GetAdjective] people themselves. History has shown that rather than relying on others to come to our aid, we must depend on ourselves.
loc.FIN_military_aid_desc: The Allies have a vast array of arms manufacturers, we should make use of them to rapidly modernize our armed forces.
loc.FIN_mineral_wealth_development_desc: Given our geography and neighbors, there is a possibility of us being cut off from potential allies or economic partners. We should therefore utilize the untapped resources of our nation to ensure we can continue the fight, even when isolated.
loc.FIN_industrialize_the_region_desc: While the combined military might of the Northern Defense Front is substantial, we must do more to ensure that our economies can support it in a protracted war. In order to do that, we need to invest in revitalizing our industries.
loc.FIN_increase_military_investment_desc: The economic and logistical component of conflict is just as vital to our survival as the battles on the front lines. As such, we should invest in our arms industry to ensure they can continue to supply our forces with all the equipment they need.
loc.FIN_cooperation_with_germany_desc: We can rely on the geo-political reality that [GER.GetNameDef] and [SOU.GetNameDef] will ultimately come to blows with one another. If we were to cooperate with the [GER.GetAdjective]s, we may be able to avenge our losses in prior wars with the [SOU.GetAdjective]s and open up new opportunities for ourselves.
loc.FIN_wartsila_engine_production_desc: Having the skills and capacity to produce engines of our own for the military will improve our national security. By working with our allies and domestic companies such as Wärtsilä, we can attain that level of security.
loc.FIN_german_military_advisors_desc: Warfare is rapidly changing due to the use of motorized equipment and aircraft. Perhaps it is time we learned from our [GER.GetAdjective] brothers-in-arms on how best to utilize these new resources to our advantage.
loc.FIN_finnish_march_of_conquest_desc: For too long we have been on the defensive against [SOU.GetNameDef] and its predecessors. Now is the time to turn the tide and push back the frontiers, liberating the people of Karelia from [SOU.GetAdjective] oppression, by any means necessary.
loc.FIN_joint_scientific_program_desc: Developing a technological edge over foes can be the decisive factor in whether a nation emerges victorious from conflict. By pooling our scientific knowledge with our allies, we can ensure that the technological advantage belongs to us.
loc.FIN_modernize_the_industry_desc: The fruits of our technological labors have uses beyond battlefield applications. Many of them could be used to make our industry more efficient. With some investment, we could begin a massive program of industrial modernization with our new found knowledge.
loc.FIN_modernize_the_army_desc: The priority of any government is the defense and safety of its people. When our armed forces prove lacking, we are therefore obligated to invest in modernizing and improving it to an extent that it can fulfill its primary duty once more.
loc.FIN_weapon_caches_desc: In the event that our armed forces are overwhelmed and the government falls, we must have a contingency plan so that we can retake the nation. One suggestion for this is to secretly place caches of weapons for future resistance forces to utilize.
loc.FIN_national_unity_desc: As war draws ever closer, we shall rally the people of our great nation and demonstrate to the world once more what it means to be Finnish.
loc.FIN_viron_kansa_desc: Although separated by the Baltic Sea, the people of [ROOT.GetName] and [EST.GetName] have a long shared history with one another. Furthermore, we face much the same challenges as we struggle to maintain independence. Perhaps through peaceful unification, we can save our people from war.
loc.FIN_ambitions_in_the_south_desc: The small nations of the Baltic are being eyed up enviously by their neighbors. If they are to be vanquished, better it be to our benefit than to a potential adversary.
loc.FIN_union_of_finnish_brothers_in_arms: Union of Finnish Brothers in Arms
loc.FIN_union_of_finnish_brothers_in_arms_de: The Union of Finnish Brothers in Arms are at the forefront of the national socialist movement and are increasingly gaining support as our nation comes under threat from abroad. If we were to collaborate with them, we could gain a great deal of support for the defense of the nation.
loc.FIN_arm_the_lotta_svard_desc: The Lotta Svärd have proven themselves to be a great asset in their role as an auxiliary force. Given their proficiency and our dire situation, perhaps it is time we better armed the organization and integrate it more effectively into the armed forces.
loc.FIN_parmis_devils_desc: Nikke Pärmi’s penal battalion has proven to be an effective use of manpower that would have otherwise languished behind bars. We should expand upon his work by creating a division of prisoners who are willing to fight for their country.
loc.FIN_militarized_society_desc: If our nation is to survive the onslaught with which we are faced, we must drop the facade of politics and embrace the complete militarization of society. Only through such extreme measures will we vanquish our foes.
loc.FIN_a_cry_for_help_desc: The League of Nations has failed in its duty to protect member states from conflict. But there are still those abroad who may yet hear our cry for help and come to our aid. Or so we hope.
loc.FIN_greater_finland_desc: No more shall we be preyed upon by ruthless neighbors who covet our land. Instead, we shall become the predator and expand our borders to their natural boundaries, beyond the lands of Karelia.
loc.FIN_right_wing_policies_desc: The left are nothing but agents of foreign powers. They would sell out their homeland in a heartbeat if it gained them favor with [SOU.Capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName]. If our nation is to prosper and survive, we must turn to the parties and organizations of the right.
loc.FIN_discredit_the_democratic_system_desc: Our democratic system merely lurches from one crisis to another without decisive, meaningful action. In this perilous situation we find ourselves in, we can no longer tolerate such weakness and must educate the masses on the failings of this political system.
loc.FIN_prepare_a_military_coup_desc: [FIN.GetNameDef] needs strong, decisive leadership that is capable of making the tough decisions in a crisis. The only people currently capable of that are the military. Rather than waiting for the nation to unravel under democrats and socialists, we shall lay the groundwork for a military coup.
loc.FIN_a_fascist_regime_desc: With the national parliament under the influence of the military, we can now forge a regime based upon strength, honor and loyalty to [FIN.GetName].
loc.FIN_seek_german_protection_desc: The League of Nations has utterly failed in upholding international law. We must accept that the strength of armed forces is the only determining factor in international relations. For our nation to survive, we must therefore look for aid from our stronger neighbors such as [GER.GetNameDef].
loc.FIN_join_axis_desc: There are few who will be able to stand up to the might of the Axis powers. Rather than remaining on the sidelines, we should join their alliance and use it to pursue our own foreign policy goals.
loc.FIN_finnish_supremacy_in_the_north_desc: While the other nations of our region squabble and negotiate their subjugation at the hands of greater powers, we alone can offer an alternative. Under our leadership, we can lead our peoples to victory against any foe who may threaten us.
loc.FIN_finnish_legion_of_honor_desc: Our troops are the shield that holds back the communist hordes at our border. We should do more to honor their bravery with the creation of an elite Legion of Honor for which the bravest of them may aspire to join.
loc.FIN_tactical_wargaming_department_desc: The demands of modern warfare expand by the day. If our high command is to keep up, we need to expand it with new departments where they can experiment with new methods via tactical wargaming.
loc.FIN_advanced_jaeger_training_program_des: Our Jaeger units have long been regarded as the elite of the armed forces, tracing their origins back to the Great War when the first of them received training in Germany. Perhaps it is time we reinvigorate the units by modernizing them and in turn, boosting the morale of the entire army.
loc.FIN_industrial_cooperation_desc: The members of the Axis powers have a wealth of knowledge and resources at their disposal. It is time we collaborated industrially to better utilize these untapped assets for the betterment of our respective nations.
loc.FIN_bring_foreign_armor_experts_desc: Tanks are a crucial component of any modern army, but our experience with them is limited. Perhaps we could expand our capabilities with them by inviting foreign experts in the field to aid us.
loc.FIN_military_research_desc: Warfare is continuously being reinvented with the advent of new technologies and tactics that utilize them. To ensure the continued strength and readiness of our armed forces, the members of our alliance should pool our knowledge and technology together.
loc.FIN_patriotic_peoples_movement_desc: The Patriotic People’s movement, despite push-back from the previous regime, have done great work in educating the masses on the need for national pride and defense of the nation against communism. If we were to bring them into our confidence, we would gain a much greater support base for our regime.
loc.FIN_academic_karelian_society_desc: For over a decade, an organization of intellectuals and students at the University of Helsinki have become increasingly influential. Their core goals align well with our own, being the pursuit of improving Finland in line with our history. Perhaps we can find a way to collaborate together.
loc.FIN_mustapaidat_desc: The continued militarization of society will ensure that our people are the strongest they can possibly be. By incorporating paramilitary forces, we can promote military values across all layers of society, from those too young to yet join the army to those who are perhaps too old for it.
loc.FIN_take_over_the_suojeluskunta_desc: The Suojeluskunta has acted as an auxiliary force of reservists who can be called upon to help defend the nation in a time of crisis. If we bring the organization under our control, we could utilize it to indoctrinate thousands to our cause.
loc.FIN_maan_turva_desc: Only through the careful monitoring of the population can we ensure that no treachery or subversion is taking place. In turn, we can protect the regime and ensure that the nation is not destroyed from the inside out.
loc.FIN_finnish_irredentism_desc: Despite gaining our independence from the former Russian Empire, there are still lands and people that should rightfully be governed by us but remain trapped under the yoke of our enemies' oppression. We must galvanize our people for the liberation of these lands.
loc.FIN_keepers_of_the_north_desc: We are the only regime in the North that has the strength of will to govern and defend this region from external foes. Until all the peoples of the region are united under our rule, we can never have lasting peace.
loc.FIN_sotilaalliset_kappalaiset_desc: Access to a chaplain is a crucial service our soldiers rely upon. Many of these chaplains are rightfully concerned about the future of our nation too. If we were to collaborate with them, we could gain not only eyes and ears at the frontline but also ensure the right messages are reaching the troops too.
loc.FIN_national_fanatism_desc: Society must be completely imbued with fanaticism and dedication to the cause of [FIN.GetAdjective] superiority. We have proven time and again that none can stop us and that when we work together, there is nothing that can halt our nation's ascent to greatness.
loc.FIN_military_promotions_desc: Our military officers have served the nation with great honor and dedication. It is time we rewarded the best of them for their part in saving us from subjugation at the hands of our historic enemies.
loc.FIN_indoctrinate_the_workers_desc: With our increased monitoring of the population, we have greater insight into what makes for effective propaganda methods. We should utilize this knowledge to indoctrinate the population, ensuring their absolute loyalty to the government and [FIN.GetNameDef].
loc.FIN_intellectual_elite_desc: Through the careful collaboration of the military and the more enlightened members of the Intelligentsia, we have managed to rescue the nation from the clutches of socialism and degeneracy. It's time we rewarded those who supported us by investing in their academic pursuits.
loc.FIN_enhance_southern_infrastructure_desc: As the [ROOT.GetAdjective] nation looks to secure its place in the world, it must focus on building and improving its industrial capacity. The first step to achieve this goal is to improve the infrastructure in the southern regions to ensure that they are better prepared to handle the demands of the light and heavy industry in the short term.
loc.FIN_industrial_development_desc: As the world becomes increasingly industrialized, [ROOT.GetName] must keep pace if it is to become a major player on the global stage. The investments we make in our heavy industry will not only create jobs and stimulate the economy, but also provide the resources necessary to meet the challenges of the future.
loc.FIN_bank_of_aland_desc: The Bank of Åland is a cornerstone of [ROOT.GetName]'s economy, providing the stability and support necessary to drive growth and prosperity. \nBy investing in the Bank of Åland, [ROOT.GetName] is investing in its future, laying the foundation for a stronger, more prosperous nation.
loc.FIN_suomen_akatemia_desc: Several [ROOT.GetAdjective] intellectuals, led by the renowned mathematician Leo Sario, are pushing for the foundation of the Suomen Akatemia, which will become the national premier academic institution, driving scientific innovation and helping positioning [ROOT.GetName] at the forefront of technological development.
loc.FIN_janiskoski_power_plant_desc: We will build a power plant in Jäniskoski to provide reliable energy for the electric smelter of the Kolosjoki nickel mine and fuel the growth of [722.GetName] area, which shall in turn spur an economic development in Northern [ROOT.GetName].
loc.FIN_found_pohjolan_voima_desc: With the recent expansion of the forest industry and heavy industry comes the needs for more power. We shall centralize energy production and tap into the unlimited potential of hydropower to fuel [ROOT.GetName]'s industrial growth.
loc.FIN_expand_imatra_hydropower_plant_desc: The Imatra Hydropower Plant, established in 1922, has proven to be a reliable source of energy for [ROOT.GetName]'s growing industry. With the expansion of its Fifth and Sixth machines, the plant's capacity will only increase, enabling further industrial growth in the [928.GetName] region.
loc.FIN_makola_mine_desc: Rich deposits of nickel and copper have been found in Makola and Hitura. Our experts think that these deposits hold great potential for our nation's economic growth and rapidly-expanding military industry, and they advise to start construction work on the Makola mine to secure a steady source of precious minerals as soon as possible.
loc.FIN_power_from_the_dams_desc: Leveraging the natural resources of [ROOT.GetName]'s abundant rivers, a meaningful expansion of our hydropower infrastructure has been proposed. According to our experts, investing in the construction of new hydropower plants will provide the means to drastically expand our industrial capacity and drive our nation's growth.
loc.FIN_tire_factory_at_nokia_desc: In times of conflict, [ROOT.GetName] needs a source of tires for the military, so securing a reliable supply to ensure the mobility and readiness of our armed forces should be a priority. \nWe have a plan to expand Suomen Gummitehdas's tire factory at Nokia and upgrade the production lines to use synthetic rubber and recycled materials to overcome potential shortages.
loc.FIN_vaisala_radiosonde_tests_desc: Under the guidance of Professor Vilho Väisälä, pioneering efforts in radiosonde technology have paved the way for successful commercial production. Building upon the success of the first Finnish radiosonde launch in 1931, continuous research and development have led to significant technological advancements.
loc.FIN_oy_alkoholiliike_desc: Desperate times require desperate measures, and now is the time for Oy Alkoholiliike, the Alcohol Company, to support the Finnish military by providing essential components for their weaponry. \nThrough careful production and refining, they will specialize in the creation of highly effective incendiary cocktails, giving infantry the advantage they need to neutralize enemy light armor.
loc.FIN_integrate_oy_tikkakoski_desc: To bolster the [ROOT.GetAdjective] arms industry, Oy Tikkakoski will be integrated into the state-owned military weapons factory. This move will increase gun production and enhance the development of new firearms for the [ROOT.GetAdjective] military.
loc.FIN_national_firepower_desc: Given the pressing external threats that our nation is facing, we must commit to a large investment in new military factories. These facilities will be dedicated to producing the latest artillery cannons for our land forces and coastal batteries, ensuring that [ROOT.GetNameDef] has the necessary firepower to defend its borders.
loc.FIN_contract_with_yhteissisu_desc: We will establish, in collaboration with leading [ROOT.GetAdjective] corporations, Yhteissisu Oy company with the goal of providing reliable and efficient transportation for the [ROOT.GetAdjective] Defense Forces. \nTransferring the Sisu S-21 lorry production to Yhteissisu will bolster the production of trucks and buses for military use, ensuring our forces are equipped with the necessary resources for any situation.
loc.FIN_outokumpu_for_defence_industry_desc: Investing in the national metal industry company, Outokumpu Oy, will help increasing [ROOT.GetName]'s defense readiness. \nThe establishment of a domestic metal factory in Pori and a copper electrolysis plant to refine raw copper will bring self-sufficiency to [ROOT.GetName]'s copper and brass production.
loc.FIN_industrial_upgrade_in_harjavalta_des: In Harjavalta, efforts are underway to modernize and streamline the nickel and copper industry. With cutting-edge technology and improved production methods, the aim is to maximize output and fortify [ROOT.GetName]'s position as a leading producer of these vital minerals.
loc.FIN_expand_mining_prospection_desc: Investment in modern mining tools and expansion of mine infrastructure lays the foundation for a robust mineral extraction industry. An increased output will serve the needs of national defense and reinforce the country's readiness for conflict.
loc.FIN_elijarvi_mine_desc: We have received samples found in connection with excavation work near Elijärvi, which indicate the existence of chrome ore that could be very rich in chromium. We must start new mining operations in the area and secure a reliable source of chromium for the military industry.
loc.FIN_tornio_steel_factory_desc: Establishing a steel factory in Tornio, near the Kemi mine, promises to revolutionize Finland's metal industry. With access to Outokumpu's now abundant supplies of chrome and nickel, the new factory will produce top-quality steel, bridging the gap in Finland's industrial capabilities.
loc.FIN_increase_military_budget_desc: The nation's security is of utmost importance. By increasing military funding, the defense forces will be well equipped and better prepared to withstand any potential threats.
loc.FIN_suomen_maavoimat_desc: We must enhance the capabilities of the Finnish Defense Forces by investing in the research of new military equipment and modernizing training facilities to ensure readiness in the face of any potential threats.
loc.FIN_operation_kilpapurjehdus_desc: By decision of the League of Nations, Åland has been demilitarized since 1921, which means that there are no troops or military supplies stationed in the area. However, tensions are rising in Europe, and faced with the serious threat of an enemy landing on the islands, our high command has devised a plan to arm and fortify Åland. \nPreparations have been made and our troops are ready to act!
loc.FIN_extra_refresher_exercises_desc: Tension keeps rising in Europe, and if [ROOT.GetAdjective] independence is to be preserved, we need to strengthen the defense of Finland through intensive training exercises, preparing for any potential outbreak of conflict and showing the determination and readiness of the Finns to defend the nation's sovereignty if necessary.
loc.FIN_the_cold_front_desc: The harsh winter conditions of the Finnish front demand proper preparation. Supply routes must be secured and camouflage tactics improved to ensure the resilience of the defense forces in the face of winter's challenge.
loc.FIN_jaeger_movement_desc: The [ROOT.GetAdjective] High Command has put forward a proposal to reinvigorate the defense forces by promoting officers with previous Jaeger training. These officers are experts in guerrilla warfare and sabotage operations behind enemy lines, making them the perfect candidates to hone new units' skills in unconventional warfare tactics and lead them into battle.
loc.FIN_salvaged_and_retooled_desc: If our armed forces are to prevail in war, we must focus on maximizing wartime resources. Taking advantage of captured enemy equipment, salvaging damaged materiel and repurposing it when necessary to align to Finnish Tactical Doctrine will allow us to meet our army's supply needs and greatly strengthen our military capabilities.
loc.FIN_winter_warfare_desc: Prepare for the worst, fight like the best. We need to strengthen supply routes for harsh winter conditions and train our troops to endure the cold and keep fighting on the front lines.
loc.FIN_motti_tactics_desc: The motti strategy involves encircling and isolating enemy units with the objective of crippling their logistical and communication lines. The implementation of this approach requires careful planning and training of the defense forces to ensure its effectiveness on the battlefield. By utilizing and perfecting the motti warfare, we will be able to outmaneuver the enemy and strike where they least expect.
loc.FIN_foreign_armor_desc: As the [ROOT.GetAdjective] Army seeks to strengthen their armored capabilities during the war, we must look beyond our own borders for solutions. The acquisition of foreign armor such as the Swedish Landsverk L-62 II can provide a welcome addition to the [ROOT.GetAdjective] arsenal and demonstrate the country's resourcefulness and adaptability in the face of adversity.
loc.FIN_utilize_the_sami_desc: We must recognize the unique skills of the Sámi people, who are expert navigators in the harsh Arctic terrain. By utilizing their knowledge of the land, we can improve our reconnaissance capabilities, and by employing them as reindeer shepherds, we can improve our supply lines in remote areas. The Sámi can play a vital role in our defense strategy, and we must ensure their expertise is fully utilized.
loc.FIN_long_range_patrols_desc: Long-Range Patrols will become an essential element in the recon and sabotage efforts of the [ROOT.GetAdjective] army now that it is facing the challenges of modern warfare. These highly-trained units specialize in penetrating enemy lines, gathering intelligence and launching devastating surprise attacks, making them a crucial asset in the war effort.
loc.FIN_finnish_radio_intelligence_desc: As the war intensifies, the Finnish military has recognized the importance of gathering reliable intelligence. Under the leadership of Reino Hallama, a group of talented radio operators has been assembled to intercept and decode enemy communications. With their skills and knowledge, these operators will provide valuable information to the Finnish armed forces, helping to turn the tide of the war.
loc.FIN_sissi_desc: As conflict rages on, our light infantry Sissi troops become an invaluable asset to the Finnish Army, using their expertise in long-range patrols and ambushes to strike at enemy targets. Armed with superior knowledge of the terrain and the ability to move quickly and silently, they prove to be a thorn in the side of the enemy and a source of pride for the Finnish people.
loc.FIN_national_armor_focus_desc: As the war effort intensifies, [ROOT.GetName] must turn its attention to its own military industry. With a focus on developing domestic tank production capabilities, we aim to bolster our armored forces and create vehicles tailored to their unique needs on the battlefield.
loc.FIN_underground_resistance_cells_desc: As the enemy advances, some Finns refuse to submit. Small, agile resistance cells take up arms and conduct ambushes, raids, and sabotage. Their knowledge of the terrain and their commitment to the cause make them a formidable threat to any invader, no matter how powerful.
loc.FIN_mannerheim_line_desc: In an effort to fortify our defenses, we must turn our attention to the Mannerheim Line. A complex network of defensive fortifications, the line stretches across the country's eastern border and must be secured against enemy incursions. To this end, the army is working to improve both the fortifications themselves and the supply lines that keep them stocked and operational.
loc.FIN_defense_in_depth_desc: As the enemy grows stronger and more determined, it becomes clear that a single static front line may not be enough to hold them back. We must build new fortifications and smaller defensive lines behind the main frontline, providing multiple layers of protection and giving our forces the flexibility to counter-attack as needed. We will make the enemy pay for every inch of [ROOT.GetAdjective] soil they try to take.
loc.FIN_helsinki_air_defense_desc: As war looms over [ROOT.GetName], Helsinki must be fortified. The city and its coastline are vulnerable to attack, and it falls upon the [ROOT.GetAdjective] military to protect them. Improved air defenses and coastal fortifications will not only safeguard the city but also strengthen the nation's resolve to withstand any assault.
loc.FIN_suomen_ilmavoimat_desc: We must focus on improving the effectiveness of the [ROOT.GetAdjective] Air Force through investments in research and training. \nThe goal is to create a modern and flexible air branch capable of meeting the challenges of modern warfare, as well as providing crucial support to ground troops during combat operations.
loc.FIN_expand_air_bases_desc: As tensions rise around [ROOT.GetName], we must ensure that our Defense Forces have the means to operate adequately. \nWe will support the Air Force in their commitment to expand the number of air bases across the country to ensure that its pilots are able to rapidly deploy in times of conflict.
loc.FIN_pilot_training_desc: With the increased demand for air power in modern warfare, more advanced and specialized training is necessary for our pilots. Through investment in new training methods and equipment, the [ROOT.GetAdjective] Air Force can ensure that its pilots are among the best in the world.
loc.FIN_naval_airforce_desc: As [ROOT.GetName]'s naval forces grow, so must its aviation capabilities. The establishment of a dedicated naval air force will ensure that the Finnish navy has the support it needs to dominate the Baltic Sea, coordinating air power and surface fleets to repel any and all threats.
loc.FIN_national_aircraft_production_desc: As [ROOT.GetName] faces the threat of war, it has become increasingly clear that a modern air force is essential to the country's defense. To that end, a national aircraft production program has been initiated, with the aim of providing the necessary resources and support to [ROOT.GetAdjective] aircraft designers and manufacturers, ensuring that [ROOT.GetName] can compete with the great powers of Europe.
loc.FIN_expand_air_force_academy_desc: As part of the national effort to improve the Air Force, we shall embark on a significant expansion of the Air Force Academy. The expansion will not only include new facilities but also an upgrade in pilot training, with the construction of new air fields in Kauhava and Tikkakoski.
loc.FIN_foreign_aircraft_desc: The [ROOT.GetAdjective] Air Force must expand its capabilities to protect the nation's sovereignty and ensure the safety of our homeland. Foreign aircraft designs and expertise will be sought after to improve our capabilities and the development of our own aircraft.
loc.FIN_support_for_ground_forces_desc: As the war rages on, it has become clear that the ground forces need more aerial support. To that end, we will invest in the development and production of close air support aircraft, to provide vital air cover to our troops on the ground. This will give them the support they need to hold their positions and push back against the enemy.
loc.FIN_dominate_the_skies_desc: [ROOT.GetAdjective] skies will belong to us! The production of new fighter planes and investment in research and development of modern air combat technologies will allow us to secure air superiority and protect our homeland. Our skilled pilots will dominate the skies and bring the fight to the enemy.
loc.FIN_expand_production_lines_desc: The [ROOT.GetAdjective] Air Force needs to expand its production capacity to meet the growing demands of the war effort. By building new production lines, we can increase the output of new planes and ensure that our Air Force remains a powerful asset in the fight against our enemies.
loc.FIN_modernize_production_lines_desc: In order to create a world-class aviation industry capable of producing the most advanced military aircraft, the [ROOT.GetAdjective] government will invest in upgrading the national factories responsible for the manufacture of air equipment, ensuring that [ROOT.GetName]'s Air Force has access to the latest and most reliable aircraft technology.
loc.FIN_suomen_merivoimat_desc: [ROOT.GetName]'s naval forces must be ready to defend their homeland against any potential threat. With an emphasis on researching modern naval equipment and developing an improved training program, the [ROOT.GetAdjective] Navy will become a powerful force capable of protecting our interests on the water.
loc.FIN_the_merchant_fleet_desc: As part of the war effort, [ROOT.GetName]'s merchant fleet must be able to keep pace to ensure the transportation of vital supplies where needed. By investing in the production of new vessels, we can strengthen our ability to sustain ourselves and secure our position in any conflict.
loc.FIN_conversion_of_civilian_vessels_desc: As war rages on, we must utilize all available resources at our disposal. Through the conversion of civilian vessels, [ROOT.GetName] can quickly bolster its naval capabilities and protect its shores from enemy threats. Large icebreakers can be repurposed into coastal defense ships, while smaller vessels can serve as destroyers or patrol boats, creating a formidable defense network along the [ROOT.GetAdjective] coast.
loc.FIN_coastal_defense_desc: In the face of foreign aggression, it is of utmost importance to ensure that the Finnish coastline is well-protected. By improving the coastal defense infrastructure, we can better prepare ourselves for any potential threats from the sea.
loc.FIN_marine_jaeger_divisions_desc: Established in late 1934, the Finnish Marine Jaegers, Rannikkojääkärit, were formed as the elite marine infantry arm of the Finnish Navy. These highly-trained and adaptable soldiers are equipped to carry out a variety of missions, from coastal defense to amphibious assaults, and will be a key asset in any potential engagements along the Baltic Coast.
loc.FIN_rapid_raiders_desc: As the world advances, so too must our Navy. By investing in the research and production of modern destroyers, armed with the latest in torpedo technology, we will be able to strike at our enemies with swift and deadly force.
loc.FIN_deep_sea_raiders_desc: With the war effort at stake, the [ROOT.GetAdjective] Navy must ramp up the production of modern submarines to disrupt enemy supply lines and protect our own trade routes. These sleek and deadly vessels will strike fear in the hearts of enemy sailors and help secure [ROOT.GetName]'s place as a maritime power.
loc.FIN_sea_mines_strategy_desc: By deploying mines in strategic locations, the [ROOT.GetAdjective] Navy aims to make the waters around its shores hazardous for enemy fleets, making it difficult for them to approach [ROOT.GetAdjective] shores and ensuring the safety of our maritime commerce.
loc.FIN_expansion_towards_the_atlantic_desc: [ROOT.GetAdjective] ship-building will set sail towards the Atlantic, expanding their naval capabilities and constructing larger ships to project power across the ocean. With the addition of battleships and carriers, [ROOT.GetName]'s Navy will become a force to be reckoned with on the world stage.
loc.FIN_strengthen_the_naval_bases_desc: As [ROOT.GetName] prepares for war, it is crucial that its naval bases are well-equipped and well-protected. By improving the infrastructure and defenses of our naval bases, we can ensure that our fleet remains secure and ready to engage the enemy.
loc.FIN_expand_ship_building_industry_desc: As the need for military ships increases, so does the need for shipyards capable of producing them. With an expanded ship-building industry, [ROOT.GetName] will be better equipped to provide its armed forces with the vessels they need to project power and protect their shores.
loc.FIN_acquire_andros_dockyards_desc: The acquisition of Andros dockyard in Turku will greatly improve the production capabilities of our leading ship designer, $FIN_crichton_vulcan_organization$. With this new addition, the [ROOT.GetAdjective] Navy will be able to produce more and better ships, increasing their power and influence in the region.
loc.FIN_innovative_designs_desc: In a daring leap of innovation, our engineers unveil the ambitious "Hyökkäysvaunu" project, a super heavy tank proposal that challenges the boundaries of armored warfare. While it may seem unconventional, this audacious endeavor reflects [ROOT.GetNameDef]'s determination to explore groundbreaking designs and push the limits of what is possible on the battlefield.
