loc.DEN_neglected_military_dynamic_modifier_: We have pursued a policy of disarmed neutrality for years, so as not to provoke the Germans. The military is barely more than a token force to symbolically protect our sovereignty. The armed forces have received continual funding cuts over the years - leaving them wholly unprepared for any potential conflicts.
loc.DEN_danish_produce_desc: Bacon and dairy products have been a staple of Danish exports, so much so that during the Great War the term ‘Goulash Barons’ was coined, referring to those who profited from trading with Great Britain and Germany.
loc.DEN_sahnefront_desc: Denmark is a bountiful country with a rich agricultural tradition, and as our subjects, we stand to reap those benefits. Possessing Denmark will strengthen our military forces and capabilities.
loc.DEN_improved_logistics_desc: Denmark is a rich and bountiful country, and by harnessing these resources we will secure food for our troops and strengthen our military capabilities.
loc.DEN_danish_licensing_ns_desc: In a world where transactions and commerce is a necessity between countries, it is good to have close trade partners. This deal will benefit both countries and strengthen the bond between us.
loc.DEN_war_preparations_dynamic_modifier_de: Only by being ready can we weather the storm. We must build up our stockpiles with raw materials and other supplies for when they are needed, and prepare our industries to assist the war effort.
loc.DEN_rule_the_north_sea_desc: To fulfill our North Sea ambitions, we must create a Grand Fleet with supreme firepower to secure our holdings and deter other nations from taking them.
loc.DEN_fromandskorpset_ns_desc: With our special amphibious forces established, we’re poised to project our military powers far and wide - over the waters and unto foreign shores.
loc.DEN_declaration_of_neutrality_desc: Denmark has managed to stay out of wars for decades, and it’s only been possible through our policy of neutrality. It has served us well and will continue to do so.
loc.DEN_denmark_becomes_a_puppet_tt: [DEN.GetFlag]§Y[DEN.GetNameDefCap]§! will get the option to try to become a puppet if a stronger nearby country invades, while keeping its current government form\n\n
loc.DEN_neutrality_flag: [DEN.GetFlag]§Y[DEN.GetNameDefCap]§! is independent and not at war
loc.DEN_political_edicts_dynamic_modifier_de: Every Dane must know what is expected and required of them in these troubled times. We must be vigilant of hostile actions against our nation and join together to work towards a common goal.
loc.DEN_resistance_dynamic_modifier_desc: Only by uniting and resisting the [?DEN.DEN_overlord_nation.GetAdjective] occupation forces can we hope to see a free [DEN.GetNameDef] again. The Resistance Movement is at the center of this and will be critical to regain our freedom one day.
loc.DEN_occupation_laws_dynamic_modifier_des: Our [?DEN.DEN_overlord_nation.GetAdjective] overlords have charged us to assist them in their war and have imposed several laws to ensure we comply.
loc.DEN_securing_sweden_ns_desc: The Swedes were once part of the Kalmar Union and under Danish rule. The time has come to re-incorporate Sweden into our Realm. Our military has prepared for this day and trained diligently to fight and destroy any hostile Swedish forces.
loc.DEN_securing_norway_ns_desc: The Norwegians were part of our Realm for many hundreds of years. The time has come to reincorporate Norway into [DEN.GetNameDefCap] once more. Our military has prepared for this day and trained diligently to fight and destroy any hostile Norwegian forces.
loc.DEN_securing_finland_ns_desc: Although we never exercised direct power over them, the Finns obeyed us under the Kalmar Union. It is now time to put Finland under direct Danish rule. Our military has prepared for this day and trained diligently to fight and destroy any hostile Finnish forces.
loc.DEN_fascist_propaganda_ns_desc: The deceitful and dishonest Fascists are spreading malicious rumors about our government in an attempt to undermine our rule.
loc.DEN_communist_propaganda_ns_desc: The deceitful and dishonest Communists are spreading malicious rumors about our government in an attempt to undermine our rule.
loc.DEN_monarchist_discontent_ns_desc: A patriotic movement has started, rallying behind the antiquated symbol of the King. They are discontent with our government of the people, by the people, for the people, and would rather see the King himself assume power.
loc.DEN_haeren_dynamic_modifier_desc: Denmark ruled Scandinavia in ages passed and was the predominant power in the region. Our armies marched across the Baltic Sea region unhindered and unopposed. The army is but a shadow of its former self, but we can yet again build up our strength and military might to protect our borders and people.
loc.DEN_haeren_dynamic_modifier_improved_des: Denmark ruled Scandinavia in ages passed and was the predominant power in the region. Our armies marched across the Baltic Sea region unhindered and unopposed. The army has regained some of its former strength, but we have taken the first steps to restore it to its former glory.
loc.DEN_haeren_dynamic_modifier_max_improved: Denmark ruled Scandinavia in ages passed and was the predominant power in the region. Our armies marched across the Baltic Sea region unhindered and unopposed. Our armies are yet again something to be awed and feared! We have managed to rebuild its strength and we are ready for whatever may come.
loc.DEN_sovaernet_dynamic_modifier_desc: Denmark was once the great power in the Baltic Sea, dominating the waves with our mighty fleets - but we had a long history of seafaring even before that. The Vikings sailed far and wide to spread fear and conquer lands. With grit and determination, we can rebuild our navy to rule the seas once again.
loc.DEN_sovaernet_dynamic_modifier_improved_: Denmark was once the great power in the Baltic Sea, dominating the waves with our mighty fleets - but we had a long history of seafaring even before that. The Vikings sailed far and wide to spread fear and conquer lands. While much work still lies ahead of us, the navy has recovered much of its former glory and strength.
loc.DEN_sovaernet_dynamic_modifier_max_impro: Denmark was once the great power in the Baltic Sea, dominating the waves with our mighty fleets - but we had a long history of seafaring even before that. The Vikings sailed far and wide to spread fear and conquer lands. We have built up our navy and are poised to set sail and rule the seas once more.
loc.DEN_flyvevabnet_dynamic_modifier_desc: Air warfare is the newest way to wage war and is the benchmark of a modern military. With the establishment of the newest branch of the Danish military, Flyvevåbnet, we are now truly a modern force to be reckoned with.
loc.DEN_development_projects_state_modifier_: The industrial sector needs to expand and develop more cost-effective processes and products. We have invested resources here for the industries to thrive and flourish to help the state's economy grow.
loc.DEN_military_projects_state_modifier_des: This has been deemed a necessary state to protect and build up its military capabilities to ensure the nation's security.
loc.DEN_home_guard_state_modifier_desc: The Home Guard is active in this state, slowing down enemy advances.
loc.DEN_pan_scandinavianism_modifier_desc: The fervor of Pan-Scandinavianism has gripped this state, bolstering the population's determination and devotion.
loc.NORDIC_to_arms_against_tyranny_ns_desc: As the claws of Tyranny threaten the independence of our Nordic neighbors, we must be ready to defend them, lest we become the tyrant's next meal.
loc.NORDIC_the_nordic_march_ns_desc: The nations around us don't see it yet, but what they call tyranny is nothing more than the winds of change, and after they're done destroying everything in their path, a new Nordic order will rise from the ashes, and we will be in a position for seizing that power.
loc.NORDIC_receiving_investments_fake_ns_des: Another Nordic nation is investing in our country's economy.
loc.NORDIC_sending_investments_ns_desc: Investing in another Nordic nation's economy.
loc.NORDIC_investing_in_neighbor_ns_desc: What better way to invest our capital than our neighbors. Not only is it close, but with our longstanding ties and shared heritage, we can be sure they will eventually invest in us too.
loc.NORDIC_economic_cooperation_ns_desc: In times like these we cannot fall prey to alienation and hostilities towards our neighbors. That is why we are investing in our neighbor so the tide rises all of our boats. All while making a tidy profit.
loc.unlocks_spirit_of_the_academy_TT: Will be available as Spirit of the Academy:\n

loc.NOR_adding_prep_comm_TT: [NOR.GetName]'s total §YSupport for Our Revolution§! will increase by §G$RIGHT|0$§!\n
loc.NOR_adding_prep_mon_TT: [NOR.GetName]'s total §YSupport for the Monarchy§! will increase by §G$RIGHT|0$§!\n

loc.NOR_unlocking_prep_deploy_allied_dem_TT: Unlocks decisions that allow using §YNational Preparedness§! to boost Norway's armed forces when War comes:\n
loc.NOR_country_prep_modernize_armed_forces_: Norway's total preparedness is more than §Y15§!
loc.NOR_fascist_flip_state_TT: §GYou will be able to flip this state to your side when the War starts.§!
loc.NOR_fascist_militia_in_state_TT: §GYou will be able to call upon a militia division in this state when the war starts.§!
loc.NOR_reduce_fascist_prep_time_TT: §YTime§! to §YBuild Support in State§! is reduced by §G$RIGHT|0$§! days
loc.NOR_reduce_fascist_pp_cost_TT: §YPolitical Power§! to §YBuild Support in State§! is reduced by §G$RIGHT|0$§! £pol_power

loc.NOR_switch_to_fascist_TT: §R$NOR_fascism$, led by [NOR.GetFascistLeader], will become the new Government. A Civil War breaks out.§!
loc.NOR_stay_democratic_TT: §R[NOR.GetFascistLeader]'s Fascist supporters rise against you and support the invading Fascists§!
loc.NOR_delay_coup_TT: §GWill delay [NOR.GetFascistLeader]'s coup and the Fascist Civil War against you.§!
loc.NOR_convert_militias_to_regulars_TT: Will convert all §YMilitia§! divisions to §YRegular Infantry§!
loc.NOR_communist_prep_intro: \nWhen the §YCommunist Revolution§! starts this state will:
loc.NOR_communist_prep_join_heavy_damage: §RReceive Heavy Damage on its Factories and Infrastructure§!
loc.NOR_communist_prep_join_moderate_damage: §RReceive Moderate Damage on its Factories and Infrastructure§!
loc.NOR_communist_prep_join_light_damage: §RReceive Light Damage on its Factories and Infrastructure§!
loc.NOR_communist_prep_max_preparedness_trig: §YTotal Support for the Revolution§! is less than [?NOR.NOR_comm_prep_max_preparedness]
loc.NOR_communist_prep_unlock_level_3_TT: Allows the training of §YCommunist Militias§! in states through §YRousing the Proletariat§! Decisions
loc.NOR_communist_civil_war_start_TT: Launches the §YCommunist Revolution§!\n§RThis will lead to a Communist Civil War against the Democratic Party§!
loc.NOR_adding_prep_communist_TT: [NOR.GetName]'s total Support for our Revolution will increase by §G$RIGHT|0$§!
loc.NOR_bamse_tooltip: §GThe satisfaction of completing a focus with a cute dog on the icon§!
loc.NOR_exile_decisions_unlock_TT: §GDecisions to better continue the fight from abroad will unlock once in exile§!
loc.NOR_exiled_convoys_TT: §G+$RIGHT|0$§! Convoys will be added to the National Stockpile after going into exile
loc.NOR_needed_support_TT: [NOR.GetName]'s total §YSupport for the Monarchy§! is at least §Y[?temp_preparedness]§! (Current: [?NOR_country_preparedness])
loc.NORDIC_conflict_scale_increase_tooltip: The Conflict Scale in our region will increase by §R$RIGHT|0$§!
loc.NORDIC_conflict_scale_border_war_TT: The §YConflict Scale§! around us is §RLimited War§!
loc.NORDIC_conflict_scale_regional_war_TT: The §YConflict Scale§! around us is §RRegional War§!
loc.NORDIC_conflict_scale_total_war_TT: The §YConflict Scale§! around us is §RTotal War§!
loc.NORDIC_unlock_investment_decisions_TT: Unlocks decisions §YInvest in Nordic§! and §YAsk Nordic to invest in us§! that allow trade deals more favorable to [ROOT.GetName].
loc.NORDIC_unlock_cooperation_decisions_TT: Unlocks decision: §YSeek Economic Cooperation With Nordic§! to establish equally beneficial economic deals with Nordic neighbors.
loc.NORDIC_is_democratic_tt: Is eligible to create Democratic Joint Alliance
loc.NORDIC_is_monarchist_tt: Is eligible to create Monarchist Joint Alliance
loc.NORDIC_alliance_created_already_TT: Any Joint Alliance has been formed.
loc.NORDIC_alliance_created_already_TT_NOT: No Joint Alliance has been formed.

loc.LOW_SUPPLIES_TIPS:
The following actions may help you resolve the situation:
 - Spread out or reassign your units to reduce local consumption.

 - Build higher level infrastructure and make sure there are no railway bottlenecks from the capital.

 - If you have enough trucks, you can motorize hubs in the region, giving them increased supply cap and range.

If supply in the area is being delivered by sea, you can also:
 - Upgrade the level of naval bases in source and destination provinces.

 - Make sure you have built enough convoys.

 - Make sure you escort convoys with 'Convoy escort' naval mission along the route. The delivery efficiency may drop if convoys are sunk.

loc.ETH_recall_balco_safo_decision_desc: $ETH_balcho_safo$ may be a stern opponent to the emperor's ambitions to reform and centralize [ROOT.GetName]. But at the same time, he is a hero, having fought at both the battle of Mekelle and the glorious victory at Adwa. He is also a popular leader, so by asking him to once again take up arms for [ROOT.GetName]'s sake we will not only get an experienced commander, but also most likely more soldiers flocking to our banners.
loc.ETH_bop_increase_mesafint_privileges_des: The local Ras are the ones best suited to rule the regions. The central authority in [ROOT.capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName] shouldn't bother with petty details. However, we need to be careful so that we don't move too fast, or they will use their power to totally break free.
loc.ETH_bop_increase_the_power_of_the_mekwan: Increase the Power of the Mekwanint

The appointed ministers need to have more power over local affairs. We should work to move power from the Mesafint to the Mekwanint, gradually moving control to the central government, and [ROOT.GetLeader]. This will upset the Ras of course, but it is necessary if we are to build a strong [ROOT.GetName]
loc.ETH_bop_privileges_changed: Less than a year since last changing privileges
loc.ETH_bop_increase_anarchist_influence_des: We need to ensure that the anarchists have enough influence to prevent a central government curtailing the people’s rights again. We should begin a propaganda campaign to boost support among the people for our cause.
loc.ETH_bop_increase_communist_influence_des: We need to ensure that the communists hold sway over the decisions made by the central government. We should begin a propaganda campaign to boost support among the people for our cause before the nation falls apart.
loc.ETH_placeholder_political_category_desc: PLACEHOLDER - TO BE REMOVED\n- Decentralization / Centralization: [GetPlaceholderBopText]

loc.ETH_major_offensive_threat: Major Offensive in the Italo-Ethiopian War
loc.ETH_improve_country_category_desc: [ETH.GetNameDefCap] is a largely agricultural economy, farmed by subsistence farmers. In order to industrialize, we need massive investment into electrification and transport infrastructure so that more workers are able to move from farming and into the factories.
loc.ETH_build_local_resistance_force_desc: We must do everything we can to support resistance movements in the occupied territories. It will go a long way to weakening the [ITA.GetAdjective] grip on the region and keep them occupied while we prepare for the inevitable liberation of [ETH.GetName].
loc.ETH_build_local_resistance_force_increas: Recruits §G1§! Arbegnoch division that can rise up in the state.
loc.ETH_launch_large_scale_uprising_desc: The people of [ETH.GetName] are itching to overthrow the foreign occupation forces across their homeland. We just need to give them a nudge to do it.
loc.ETH_has_readied_uprising_tt: Has prepared an uprising in at least 1 state
loc.ETH_italian_uprising_warning_mission_des: The rumor is that [ETH.GetLeader] has called upon the rebels in the country to rise up in a coordinated attack on [ROOT.GetName].
loc.ETH_coup_haile_selassie_imru_desc: The democratically minded $ETH_ras_imru_haile_selassie$ has ruled the country in the emperor's absence. Undoubtedly, he is seen by the masses as the true hero of [ROOT.GetName] after leading the country in the war. Calls for a more democratic [ROOT.GetName] have been getting louder. Maybe now is the time to really create change in [ROOT.GetNameDef].
loc.ETH_formal_request_to_host: Make a formal request to the [?ETH.host_nation.GetAdjective] government.
loc.ETH_formal_request_to_host_desc: The [?ETH.host_nation.GetAdjective] government should be approached and asked to fully support [ROOT.GetLeader] in the war against [ITA.GetNameDef]. This will start the final part of the reconquest of our nation.
loc.ETH_false_flag_operation_decision_desc: In order to convince our hosts that [ITA.GetName] is not to be trusted, we need to stage an attack on a German border post, and blame it on the Italians.
loc.ETH_throw_grand_party_for_host_desc: A grand party at [ROOT.GetLeader]'s residence would provide an excellent opportunity for some informal lobbying beside the more official one.
loc.organization_of_african_unity_member_tt: Is an Organisation of African Unity Member State
loc.ETH_take_loans_desc: We can try to increase our available funds, using Imperial Assets as security.
loc.ETH_fundraising_campaign_decision_desc: Following the Radio Address by [ROOT.GetLeader], the support for our cause in America has grown considerably. We should take advantage of this and start fundraising campaigns there and elsewhere, in order to build the imperial treasury, and thereby fund the reconquest of our homelands.
loc.ETH_set_up_gideon_force_decision_desc: The [?ETH.host_nation.GetAdjective] Government appears willing to sponsor a small expeditionary force to directly support our attack on the occupiers. We should push for the formation of such a unit immediately!
loc.ETH_set_up_gideon_force_decision_tt: A [?ETH.host_nation.GetAdjective] special forces commander temporarily joins the [ROOT.GetAdjective] army.
loc.ETH_recruit_mercenaries_from_host_desc: There are always people who will fight for coin.
loc.ETH_recruit_aircrews_from_host_desc: Surely there are [?ETH.host_nation.GetAdjective] pilots and service technicians willing to ply their trade in the service of [ROOT.GetName], if the coin is good enough.
loc.ETH_recruit_merchant_marines_from_host_d: We are going to need ships and sailors in order to transport our army back to Africa
loc.ETH_buy_rifles_from_host_desc: In order to finance the reconquest of [ROOT.GetName], sacrifices are necessary. Spending the personal wealth of the monarch on weapons, may be desperate, but desperate times require desperate measures.
loc.ETH_will_be_re_enabled_tt: When completed, this decision will be available again in [?ETH_re_enable_time_international_actions] days.
loc.ETH_buy_tanks_from_host_desc: The [ROOT.GetAdjective] army severely lacks tanks. There are old surplus tanks available on the market, spending some of the imperial treasury on acquiring a few those should remedy the situation somewhat. Old tanks are better than no tanks.
loc.ETH_buy_support_equipment_from_host_desc: Rifles are not everything. Soldiers need helmets, boots, grenades and whatnot. We can divert some of the imperial treasury into acquiring these things.
loc.ETH_chitet_category_desc: Calling out the national levy gives the state access to a lot of troops very fast. The levy has served the country well during over the centuries. When the war is over, they can all be sent back home to their civilian lives.
loc.ETH_raise_the_chitet_desc: Muster the regional levies in all controlled Ethiopian states.
loc.ETH_disband_the_chitet_desc: When the war is over, it is time to let the levy return to their homes.
loc.ETH_chitet_cooldown_tt: The chitet can be raised again [?var_ETH_chitet_cooldown] days after disbanding it.
loc.ETH_disband_the_chitet_mission_desc: It is time to disband the chitet and allow the soldiers to return to their civilian lives.
loc.ETH_2ndItaloEthiopianWar: [ITA.GetName] have unlawfully invaded our homeland. Even though we are a full member of the League of Nations, the world fail to take action, and view the conflict as a minor colonial skirmish. \nWe must prove to the LoN that this is a full scale war of aggression by one member state upon another, and thereby force the world to take action against [ITA.GetLeader].
loc.ITA_2ndItaloEthiopianWar: The League of Nations have so far failed to take action against us, only offering symbolic opposition to our conquest of Ethiopia. However, the longer the conflict drags out, and the more regular troops we commit, the greater the risk that they will actually start to meddle in our affairs. We must finish this war before [ETH.GetLeader] manages to convince the League of Nations to take action.
loc.ETH_christmas_offensive_mission_desc: Our troops are still moving forward, but we are losing momentum. Soon the energy brought on by the counterattack will have worn off.
loc.ETH_time_based_war_escalation_mission_de: The longer the war runs, the more concerned the world will be. For each six months that pass, since the start in October 1935, War Escalation will increase by one.
loc.ETH_hold_the_north_mission_desc: The Christmas offensive managed to push the Italians back, but we failed to drive them into the sea as we had planned. They will regroup and attack with greater strength, and we must show that we can hold on to our country.
loc.ITA_conquer_the_north_mission_desc: It is time to take back the ground we lost to the Ethiopians in their offensive.
loc.ETH_hold_the_south_mission_desc: The Southern front has been quiet up until now, but the Italians are certainly preparing to launch another offensive from their possessions in the south. We must hold them off, and show the world that the claims spouted by them and their Somali puppets are unlawful.
loc.ITA_conquer_the_south_mission_desc: The Ethiopians probably don't expect a push in the south. We must demoralize their army, and diminish their support in the League of Nations, by quickly capturing [837.GetName] and [836.GetName].
loc.ETH_hold_addis_ababa_mission_desc: By holding out in our capital, we can hopefully make the international community understand that the Italians must be stopped by force.
loc.ETH_conquer_addis_ababa_mission_desc: We must take the capital and force [ETH.GetName] to capitulate.
loc.ETH_hold_harar_mission_desc: Having lost the South, we should try to hold out in Harar, and defend our route to the sea.
loc.ETH_harar_lost_tt: Losing control of Harar will lower war support amongst the people.
loc.ETH_conquer_harar_mission_desc: The Ethiopians are regrouping in the mountains. We need to capture [835.GetCapitalVictoryPointName] before they manage to entrench their positions.
loc.ETH_buy_rifles_desc: Now that we have access to the international weapons' market, we need to secure arms deals. Our first and foremost need is getting rifles to our infantry, so that they can fight the invaders on equal terms.
loc.ETH_buy_artillery_desc: We desperately need modern artillery to support our armies. Our priority should be to secure arms deals for the purchase of heavy guns.
loc.ETH_buy_support_equipment_desc: We don't only need weapons, we are in desperate need of communications equipment and support equipment in general. Getting our hands on more of this is a matter of highest priority.
loc.ETH_buy_anti_tank_guns_desc: We are trying to fight Italian armor with petrol cans and big game hunting rifles. If we are to be able to defeat the Italians, we need large numbers of good anti-tank guns.
loc.ETH_host_confirmed_flag: Has confirmed an Exile Host Country
loc.ETH_host_country_decision: Request permission to set up Government in Exile in [FROM.GetName]
loc.ETH_host_country_decision_desc: We need to prepare for the worst. If the country falls, we need a base from where we can continue the resistance. We should approach the [FROM.GetAdjective] government and request permission to establish an exile government there.
loc.ETH_host_country_decision_tt: §Y[ROOT.GetLeader]§! will be able to set up a §YGovernment in Exile§! in §Y[FROM.GetNameWithFlag]§! if the §Y$ETH_boarding_the_train$§! focus has been completed before capitulation. \n\nUnlocks additional focuses that will be available as a Government in Exile in [FROM.GetNameDef].
loc.ETH_italian_occupation_category_desc: While we have been forced to withdraw from our homeland, the war is far from over. We will use every means available to us to secure freedom for the [ETH.GetAdjective] people once again.
loc.ETH_italian_control_mission_desc: [ITA.GetName] is attempting to assert control over our territory through brute force. We must push them back.
loc.ETH_retake_territory_mission_desc: Half of [ROOT.GetName] is under enemy control. The local Ras are upset that their territory has been abandoned, and the central authority is questioned. There are talks of making a deal with the Italians. Taking back control of [ROOT.GetAdjective] territory is the only way to convince to people of victory.
loc.controls_50_percent_of_territory: [ROOT.GetNameWithFlag] controls at least §Y50%§! of the total number of owned states.\n Currently controlled: [?num_owned_controlled_states|Y0]\n Need: [?controlled_owned_50|Y0]
loc.controls_more_than_50_percent_of_territo: [ROOT.GetNameWithFlag] controls more than §Y50%§! of the total number of owned states.\n Currently controlled: [?num_owned_controlled_states|Y0]\n Need: [?controlled_owned_more_than_50|Y0]
loc.ETH_Education_reform_decentralized_BoP_t: Education is at the forefront of our struggle against outdated power structures. We need to educate the young in a way that makes them question authority and reject the antiquated views of traditionalists.
loc.ETH_Education_reform_centralized_BoP_tt: Making sure the next generation are able to join the workforce is of course our priority. However, we have an opportunity to nudge future generations in a more acceptable moral direction, thus ensuring that they remain loyal to [ETH.GetLeader].
loc.ETH_road_reform_local_BoP_desc: [ETH.GetName]’s road network is increasingly a barrier to further economic development. We now have the political influence to push for road modernization that would benefit the average person across the country by creating better roads between towns and villages.
loc.ETH_road_reform_highways_BoP_tt: [ETH.GetName]’s road network is increasingly a barrier to further economic development. With our new found influence, we should accelerate economic development and centralization by building better highways around the capital.
loc.ETH_officer_reforms_centralized_BoP_tt: To ensure the military does not turn on our regime, we must ensure their loyalty with the introduction of political officers.
loc.ETH_officer_reforms_decentralized_BoP_tt: To ensure the military is effective, we must increase the meritocracy of the officer corps.
loc.ETH_BoP_purge_communists_tt: The uneasy peace between the Black Lions and the communist military officers is beginning to crumble. The officers are clearly intent on centralizing power and creating an authoritarian state loyal to themselves. We must eliminate them before they destroy everything we have built.
loc.ETH_BoP_purge_anarchists_tt: The uneasy peace between the military and the Black Lions is crumbling. Their naive anarchist views are rotting [ETH.GetNameDef] from the inside out, leaving us vulnerable to attack. To guarantee the continuation of our revolution, we shall snuff out the Black Lions once and for all. \n\n§Y$ETH_prov_mil_admin$§! will become leader of §Y[ROOT.GetFlag][ROOT.GetNameDefCap]§!.
loc.ETH_BoP_expand_black_lions_tt: The communists can not be trusted, we must be vigilant in case they attempt to seize power for themselves. Therefore we shall increase the number of Black Lion divisions to deter them from making any moves.
loc.ETH_BoP_expand_red_guards_tt: The Black Lions can not be trusted to govern and must ultimately be expelled from power. We must increase the number of Red Guard units under our command so that we may take advantage of the situation when the Black Lions inevitably fail.
loc.ETH_electrify_state_desc: Getting electricity out to the local villages is a key part in modernizing the country.
loc.ETH_improve_communications_in_state_desc: Efficient means of communications is vital for the improvement of the country.
loc.ETH_invest_in_state_industry_desc: If [FROM.GetName] is to have any kind of successful industry it needs state investments, either directly or through local rulers.
loc.ETH_prospect_for_resources_desc: There are natural resources in [FROM.GetName] to be found. Digging and drilling far enough will make [ROOT.GetName] a richer country.
loc.ETH_japanese_industrial_investments_deci: Japanese investors are looking for new investment opportunities in Africa. [FROM.GetName] could be the perfect spot for some Japanese financed Industry.
loc.ETH_local_development_state_grows_missio: [?ETH.ETH_local_state.GetName] prospers under the current rule. Agricultural output is increasing, and cities and villages are growing.
loc.ETH_max_japanese_investments_tt: Investments can be done in max §Y3§! states. Number of states invested in: §Y[?ETH_japanese_invesment_states]§!
loc.ETH_japanese_infrastructure_investments_: Japanese investors are looking for new investment opportunities in Africa. [FROM.GetName] could be the perfect spot for some Japanese financed infrastructure development.
loc.ETH_japanese_dockyard_investments_decisi: Japanese investors are looking for new investment opportunities in Africa. [FROM.GetName] could be the perfect spot for some Japanese financed shipbuilding facilities.
loc.ETH_local_development_industry_grows_mis: Small scale manufacturing in [?ETH.ETH_local_state.GetName] is booming. IF we continue to encourage this, the whole of [ROOT.GetName] will benefit.
loc.ETH_local_development_arms_industry_grow: Local armorers in  [?ETH.ETH_local_state.GetName] have increased output significantly. This is reaching a level where the whole country can benefit.
loc.ETH_local_development_improved_productio: Local committees in [?ETH.ETH_local_state.GetName] are improving work conditions, tools and methods.
loc.ETH_anti_colonialism_category_desc: We will do everything we can to support resistance movements across the region until the plight of imperialism is finally removed.
loc.ETH_anti_colonialism_map_category_name: Colonial states where resistance can be supported
loc.ETH_support_resistance_decision_desc: Support resistance fighters to overthrow [FROM.Owner.GetAdjective] rule.
loc.ETH_arm_resistance_decision_desc: Arm resistance fighters in this state.
loc.ETH_anti_colonialism_decision_desc: [FROM.GetAdjective] imperialism in Africa must end. The world need to wake up and realize that the days of [FROM.GetAdjective] colonialism are over. The people of [FROM.GetNameDef] must take pressure their leaders to release their suppressed African colonies.
loc.ETH_demand_peace_decision_desc: The brave people of [FROM.GetName] have risen up against the [?FROM.previous_overlord.GetAdjective] tyranny. We should act now, and use whatever means necessary to force [?FROM.previous_overlord.GetNameDef] to withdraw from [FROM.GetAdjective] territory.
loc.ETH_demand_peace_decision_tt: §Y[?FROM.previous_overlord.GetNameWithFlag]§! is pressured to end the war with §Y[FROM.GetNameWithFlag]§!
loc.ETH_social_reforms_category_desc: We need a wave of social reforms to overcome the cultural and religious divisions in [ETH.GetName] so that we can remain united.
loc.ETH_education_reforms_decision_desc: To prevent a future reactionary movement developing, we must reform the education system so that children grow up to be free thinking adults rather than capitalist lackeys.
loc.ETH_collectivization_reforms_decision_de: The land of [ETH.GetNameDefCap] has been owned by aristocrats for centuries despite being worked by the people. We have an opportunity to make everyone their own masters by redistributing the land.
loc.ETH_secularization_reforms_decision_desc: [ETH.GetNameDefCap] contains a multitude of cultural and religious divides, the origins of which stretch back centuries. We need to break the stranglehold of superstition if we are to prevent sectarian violence occurring in future.
loc.ETH_freedom_at_gunpoint_category_desc: Our neighbors remain trapped under the yoke of the imperialists. It is time we turn our experience of war and our new found economic strength towards the liberation of Africa using the only language the colonial powers understand. Brute force.
loc.form_ethiopian_empire_category_desc: [ROOT.GetNameDefCap] is already a mighty Empire, but it is not what it once was, and with the right guidance it can become stronger than it has ever been.
loc.ETH_move_capital_to_axum_desc: The ancient city of Axum should be the new capital of the Empire.
loc.ETH_prevents_further_capital_moves_tt: Moving the Capital to Jerusalem prevents further moves of the Capital.
loc.ETH_move_capital_to_jerusalem: Make Jerusalem the capital of the empire
loc.create_empire_of_zion_tt: Makes every state in the Caribbean and Florida Coast that is controlled by [ROOT.getNameDef] or a subject nation a core of [ROOT.getNameDef]
loc.ETH_liberate_SUD_tt: Gain wargoal on owners of [SUD.GetAdjective] territory.
loc.ETH_liberate_DJI_tt: Gain wargoal on owners of [DJI.GetAdjective] territory.
loc.ETH_liberate_KEN_tt: Gain wargoal on owners of [KEN.GetAdjective] territory.
loc.ETH_liberate_ERI_tt: Gain wargoal on owners of [ERI.GetAdjective] territory.
loc.ETH_liberate_SOM_tt: Gain wargoal on owners of [SOM.GetAdjective] territory.
loc.ETH_liberate_UGA_tt: Gain wargoal on owners of [UGA.GetAdjective] territory.
loc.ETH_offer_peace_SUD_tt: Offer the owner of [SUD.GetAdjective] territory peace if they agree to relinquish claims to territory that [ETH.GetName] currently controls. [SUD.GetAdjective] territory currently controlled will become an [ETH.GetAdjective] puppet.
loc.ETH_offer_peace_DJI_tt: Offer the owner of [DJI.GetAdjective] territory peace if they agree to relinquish claims to territory that [ETH.GetName] currently controls. [DJI.GetAdjective] territory currently controlled will become an [ETH.GetAdjective] puppet.
loc.ETH_offer_peace_KEN_tt: Offer the owner of [KEN.GetAdjective] territory peace if they agree to relinquish claims to territory that [ETH.GetName] currently controls. [KEN.GetAdjective] territory currently controlled will become an [ETH.GetAdjective] puppet.
loc.ETH_offer_peace_ERI_tt: Offer the owner of [ERI.GetAdjective] territory peace if they agree to relinquish claims to territory that [ETH.GetName] currently controls. [ERI.GetAdjective] territory currently controlled will become an [ETH.GetAdjective] puppet.
loc.ETH_offer_peace_SOM_tt: Offer the owner of [SOM.GetAdjective] territory peace if they agree to relinquish claims to territory that [ETH.GetName] currently controls. [SOM.GetAdjective] territory currently controlled will become an [ETH.GetAdjective] puppet.
loc.ETH_offer_peace_UGA_tt: Offer the owner of [UGA.GetAdjective] territory peace if they agree to relinquish claims to territory that [ETH.GetName] currently controls. [UGA.GetAdjective] territory currently controlled will become an [ETH.GetAdjective] puppet.
loc.ETH_freedom_at_gunpoint_offer_peace_tt:
§Y[FROM.Capital.OWNER.GetName]§! will be offered peace in exchange for relinquishing claims to §Y[FROM.GetAdjective]§! territory that §Y[THIS.GetName]§! currently controls. If they agree, §Y[THIS.GetName]§! gains a subject in controlled territory that is a core of §Y[FROM.GetName]§!.

§R[ROOT.GetFlag][ROOT.GetNameDefCap] will leave any faction it is part of if peace is accepted and the faction is at war with [FROM.Capital.OWNER.GetFlag][FROM.Capital.OWNER.GetName]!§! 

§R[FROM.Capital.OWNER.GetFlag][FROM.Capital.OWNER.GetName] will only consider peace offer if [ROOT.GetFlag][ROOT.GetName] controls [FROM.GetAdjective] territory!§!
loc.ETH_exploit_french_weakness_category_des: When the time is right, we will bring [268.GetName] under our control while the [FRA.GetAdjective] are distracted with affairs closer to home.
loc.ETH_take_DJI_tt: We must wait for the right moment to strike. When French Somaliland is not occupied, we will be able to quickly take the territory. France will likely accept our ownership of the territory, but we should never the less be prepared for a wider conflict.
loc.ETH_take_DJI_cancel_tt: \n§RWill cancel if $FRA_VICHY_fascism$ is no longer controller of French Somaliland or if they place divisions in the state!§!
loc.ETH_take_DJI_danger_tt: \n§R$FRA_VICHY_fascism$ may retaliate for annexing their territory!§!
loc.ETH_reintegrate_former_territory_categor: The great task before us lies in the reclamation of our rightful lands and the unification of the [ETH.GetAdjective] people under our great leader, [ETH.GetLeader].
loc.ETH_reclaim_the_empire_targets: These states can be reclaimed by [ETH.GetName]
loc.ETH_consolidate_ea_targets: These states can be integrated into [ETH.GetName]:
loc.ETH_improve_the_horn_of_africa_category_: By improving infrastructure in our neighboring countries, we can make the region stronger, and tie the countries of the Horn tighter together.
loc.african_union_category_desc: We will create institutions that pool the talents and resources of the entire continent together and move ever closer to political unification. Only by standing together and cooperating can the people of Africa hope to resist ending up as subjects once again.
loc.invite_to_org_tt: Nations with a different ideology to you will be less likely to accept membership offer.
loc.invite_to_ACB_tt: Nations with a different ideology to you will be unlikely to accept economic integration with you.
loc.invite_to_org_alliance_tt: Nations with different ideology to you will be less likely to sign a defense agreement.
loc.invite_to_exec_council_tt: Nations with different ideology will not support political unification with you.
loc.leave_org_of_african_unity: Leave the Organization of African Unity
loc.threaten_member_state_desc: We shall send a message to the leaders of [FROM.GetNameDef] that if they do not agree to deeper integration with the Organization of African Unity, there will be serious consequences to them personally...
loc.threaten_member_state_tt: \nThe leadership of the intimidated country will be more likely to accept integration proposals for the §G60 days§! this decision is active.
loc.ITA_withdraw_from_ethiopia_desc: The war against Ethiopia was a mistake, it is time to settle this controversial affair.
loc.ITA_transfer_lost_states_tt: §Y[550.GetName]§!, §Y[559.GetName]§! and §Y[844.GetName]§! will be transferred to §Y[ETH.GetName]§! if they are fully controlled by them. §Y[908.GetName]§! will also be transferred if owned by [ROOT.GetNameDef].
loc.ITA_missiolinis_desc:
The Duce has big plans to bring the proud Italian nation to its rightful place. To fulfill his vision of a greater Italy, he is issuing the pertinent orders that he trusts, will be carried out in a timely manner. 

£ITA_missiolini_text_icon Active missions: §Y[?ITA_missiolinis_active_missions]§! 
£ITA_missiolini_text_icon Successful missions: §Y[?ITA_missiolinis_successful_missions]§! 
£ITA_missiolini_silver_text_icon Failed missions: §R[?ITA_missiolinis_failed_missions]§!
loc.ITA_missiolini_conquer_ethiopia_desc: Whatever Abyssinian strongholds that are still left need to be dealt with to secure an Italian victory.
loc.ITA_missiolini_pacify_ethiopia_desc: The Duce has given the order to crack down on Abyssinian opposition with brute force and to institute laws to keep the population in check. He wants the entire country pacified and brought into the Italian fold as soon as possible.
loc.ITA_pacify_ethiopia_goal_tt: All initial Ethiopian states have greater Compliance than §Y60%§!
loc.ITA_missiolini_strengthen_heavy_industry: For Italy to truly flourish, we need to built new factories to sustain the growth of our bustling empire and expand our production capabilities.
loc.ITA_missiolini_strengthen_the_army_desc: Like the Roman Empire of old, our burgeoning empire is stretching far and wide and needs a strong army to protect it from the hordes of barbarians just beyond the borders.
loc.ITA_missiolini_stockpile_trucks_desc: We need a more mobile military force that can move fast over large swathes of terrain without having to be constrained by lagging logistics.
loc.ITA_missiolini_stockpile_fuel_desc: A modern army marches not only on its stomach but also on its fuel, and if there is none the entire war machine grinds to a halt. All branches of the military need it, and we must be able to provide gas in large quantities if we are to be successful on the battlefields.
loc.ITA_missiolini_strengthen_the_airforce_d: The Regia Aeronautica has become a symbol of national pride and was once one of the greatest air forces in the world. We need to produce additional aircraft to reinforce our air force and make it great again.
loc.ITA_missiolini_strengthen_the_airforce_f:
Has produced or acquired §Y[?ROOT.ITA_missiolinis_fighters_to_produce]§! new §Y$fighter_equipment$§! aircraft. 
Current Fighters deployed: §G[?ROOT.num_deployed_planes_with_type@small_plane_airframe]§! - Current Fighters in stockpile §G[?ROOT.num_equipment@small_plane_airframe]§! - Total Fighters Goal §Y[?ITA_missiolinis_fighters_goal]§!
loc.ITA_missiolini_strengthen_the_airforce_b:

Current CAS deployed: §G[?ROOT.num_deployed_planes_with_type@small_plane_cas_airframe]§! - Current CAS in stockpile §G[?ROOT.num_equipment@small_plane_cas_airframe]§! - Total CAS Goal §Y[?ITA_missiolinis_cas_goal]§! 
Current Naval Bombers deployed: §G[?ROOT.num_deployed_planes_with_type@small_plane_naval_bomber_airframe]§! - Current Naval Bombers in stockpile §G[?ROOT.num_equipment@small_plane_naval_bomber_airframe]§! - Total Naval Bombers Goal §Y[?ITA_missiolinis_naval_bombers_goal]§! 
Current Tactical Bombers deployed: §G[?ROOT.num_deployed_planes_with_type@medium_plane_airframe]§! - Current Tactical Bombers in stockpile §G[?ROOT.num_equipment@medium_plane_airframe]§! - Total Tactical Bombers Goal §Y[?ITA_missiolinis_tactical_bombers_goal]§!
loc.ITA_missiolini_industrial_research_desc: We must show the world at what great speed fascism and the Italian people can accomplish great leaps in technology.
loc.ITA_missiolini_expand_intelligence_agenc: By expanding our intelligence service we will infiltrate every aspect of Italian society to drag communists, criminals, and other harmful elements into the light and bring them to justice, making Italy more secure.
loc.ITA_missiolini_occupy_albania_desc: The strong ties between Italy and Albania go back millennia, to the Roman Empire. We must incorporate Albania into Italy to secure the inlet to the Adriatic Sea.
loc.ITA_missiolini_occupy_dalmatia_desc: We must correct a grave injustice from the Great War and take what rightfully belongs to us by force. Dalmatia must become Italian!
loc.ITA_missiolini_occupy_dalmatia_occupatio:
If [ROOT.GetFlag][ROOT.GetNameDef] controls §Y[103.GetName]§!: 
Every [YUG.GetFlag][YUG.GetAdjective] core state fully controlled by [ROOT.GetFlag][ROOT.GetNameDef]: 
   Compliance: §G+5.0%§!. 
   Resistance: §G-5.0%§!
loc.ITA_missiolini_occupy_dalmatia_subject_e:
If §Y[103.GetName]§! is fully controlled by an [ROOT.GetAdjective] subject of [YUG.GetAdjective] origin: 
   All [ROOT.GetAdjective] subjects of [YUG.GetAdjective] origin:
loc.ITA_missiolini_occupy_greece_desc: Like the Roman legions of old, we too can break the confinements put upon us by conquering Greece and unify our brotherly peoples.
loc.ITA_missiolini_occupy_greece_occupation_:
Every [GRE.GetFlag][GRE.GetAdjective] core state fully controlled by [ROOT.GetFlag][ROOT.GetNameDef]: 
   Compliance: §G+5.0%§!. 
   Resistance: §G-5.0%§! 

Current effects:
loc.ITA_missiolini_occupy_ticino_desc: Ever since Hannibal crossed the Alps with his elephants, the mountains have been a highway for barbarians straight into Italy’s heartlands. We must secure our northern border.
loc.ITA_missiolini_occupy_ticino_occupation_:
[846.GetName] and every [SWI.GetFlag][SWI.GetAdjective] core state fully controlled by [ROOT.GetFlag][ROOT.GetNameDef]: 
   Compliance: §G+5.0%§!. 
   Resistance: §G-5.0%§! 

Current effects:
loc.ITA_missiolini_bolster_political_cabinet: Finding the right people for the right places is always hard to do. We cannot leave a stone unturned in our search for the smartest and brightest people.
Has §Y3§! $political_advisor$s active, at least one of them being a §YHierarch§!
loc.ITA_missiolini_bolster_military_high_com: Finding and promoting worthy candidates to the military high command will strengthen our strategic and tactical reasonings in upcoming conflicts.
loc.ITA_bop_take_over_ministry_of_foreign_af: £BoP_right_texticon Take Over Ministry of Foreign Affairs
Naming himself Minister of Foreign Affairs will let Benito Mussolini exert direct control over Italy’s foreign policies and relationships.
loc.ITA_bop_resign_ministry_of_foreign_affai: £BoP_left_texticon Resign Ministry of Foreign Affairs Position
Resigning from the position as Minister of Foreign Affairs will open it up to others, leaving Benito Mussolini in less control over Italy’s foreign policies and relationships.
loc.ITA_bop_take_over_ministry_of_justice_de: Naming himself Minister of Grace and Justice will let Benito Mussolini exert direct control over Italy’s justicial system and institutions.
loc.ITA_bop_resign_ministry_of_justice_posit: Resigning from the position as Minister of Grace and Justice will open it up to others, leaving Benito Mussolini in less control over Italy’s justicial system and institution.
loc.ITA_bop_take_over_ministry_of_education_: Naming himself Minister of Public Education will let Benito Mussolini exert direct control over Italy’s educational system and institutions.
loc.ITA_bop_resign_ministry_of_education_pos: Resigning from the position as Minister of Public Education will open it up to others, leaving Benito Mussolini in less control over Italy’s educational system and institutions.
loc.ITA_bop_take_over_ministry_of_corporatio: Naming himself Minister of Corporations will let Benito Mussolini exert direct control over Italy’s financial system and institutions.
loc.ITA_bop_resign_ministry_of_corporations_: Resigning from the position as Minister of Corporations will open it up to others, leaving Benito Mussolini in less control over Italy’s financial system and institutions.
loc.ITA_mussolini_took_over_minister_of_fore: §Y365 days§! have passed since §Y[ROOT.ITA_benito_mussolini.GetName]§! took over the Ministry of Foreign Affairs \n(Currently §Y[?ITA_mussolini_took_over_minister_of_foreign_affairs_flag:days|Y0]§! days have passed)
loc.ITA_mussolini_resigned_minister_of_forei: §Y365 days§! have passed since §Y[ROOT.ITA_benito_mussolini.GetName]§! resigned the Ministry of Foreign Affairs position \n(Currently §Y[?ITA_mussolini_resigned_minister_of_foreign_affairs_position_flag:days|Y0]§! days have passed)
loc.ITA_mussolini_took_over_minister_of_just: §Y365 days§! have passed since §Y[ROOT.ITA_benito_mussolini.GetName]§! took over the Ministry of Justice \n(Currently §Y[?ITA_mussolini_took_over_minister_of_justice_flag:days|Y0]§! days have passed)

loc.ITA_is_ruled_by_a_pope_tt: §YThe Pope§! is the current country leader
loc.ITA_bop_revoke_the_lateran_treaty_tt: \n§RWill prevent us from completing the focus§! §Y$ITA_seek_papal_support$§!.\n
loc.ITA_aimones_coronation: Aimone has been coronated King Tomislav II of Croatia
loc.ITA_give_the_dodecanese_islands_to_greec: Offer the Dodecanese to [GRE.GetNameDef] for an Alliance
loc.ITA_sold_stuff_to_us: Italy sold us the Dodecanese Islands
loc.ITA_give_the_dodecanese_islands_to_turke: Offer the Dodecanese to [TUR.GetNameDef] for an Alliance
loc.ITA_human_torpedo_raid_trigger_tt: Has at least one §YCapital Ship§! or §YScreen Ship§! docked in a $naval_base$
loc.ITA_bop_slander_the_duce_desc: Italy is struggling on multiple fronts due to [ITA.GetLeader]’s incompetence. Perhaps it’s time for new leadership?
loc.ITA_bop_criticize_the_war_desc: Our valiant troops are struggling because of incompetent leadership, bad logistics, and inadequate equipment. These issues must be rectified!
loc.ITA_bop_question_the_army_desc: With recent events showcasing the ineffectiveness of the Army has many people wondering exactly how loyal the troops are to Italy and the fascist system.
loc.ITA_bop_question_the_airforce_desc: With recent events showcasing the ineffectiveness of the Air Force has many people wondering exactly how loyal the troops are to Italy and the fascist system.
loc.ITA_bop_question_the_navy_desc: With recent events showcasing the ineffectiveness of the Navy has many people wondering exactly how loyal the troops are to Italy and the fascist system.
loc.ITA_bop_military_parade_desc: It is high time that we celebrate our victorious and valiant soldiers and let the Italian people shower them with affection.
loc.ITA_bop_send_support_desc: Our ideological brethren find themselves in a war. As the founders of fascism, it is our duty to make sure that they are victorious!
loc.ITA_bop_praise_the_army_desc: The courageous men and women serving in our Army are the backbone of a secure and stable [ITA.GetName]. They deserve the adoration of the Italian people!
loc.ITA_bop_praise_the_airforce_desc: The courageous men and women serving in our Air Force are the backbone of a secure and stable [ITA.GetName]. They deserve the adoration of the Italian people!
loc.ITA_bop_praise_the_navy_desc: The courageous men and women serving in our Navy are the backbone of a secure and stable [ITA.GetName]. They deserve the adoration of the Italian people!
loc.ITA_discredit_haile_selassie_desc: By informing the Ethiopians how Haile Selassie ran away like a coward and is indulging in a decadent lifestyle in a country far away, we might be able to sway some people to our cause and hurt the former emperor’s reputation.
loc.ITA_vallo_alpino_occidentale_desc: We can secure our Western border by building a series of fortifications there.
loc.ITA_vallo_alpino_occidentale_tt: Build a defensive line in §Y[158.GetName]§! along the Western Alpine border with [735.GetName] and [847.GetName].\n
loc.ITA_vallo_alpino_settentrionale_west_des: We can secure our North-Western border by building a series of fortifications there.
loc.ITA_vallo_alpino_settentrionale_west_tt: Build a defensive line in §Y[158.GetName]§! and §Y[159.GetName]§! along the North-Western Alpine border with [846.GetName] and [151.GetName].\n
loc.ITA_vallo_alpino_settentrionale_east_des: We can secure our North-Eastern border by building a series of fortifications there.
loc.ITA_vallo_alpino_settentrionale_east_tt: Build a defensive line in §Y[850.GetName]§! and in §Y[39.GetName]§! along the North-Eastern Alpine border with [153.GetName].\n
loc.ITA_vallo_alpino_orientale_desc: We can secure our Eastern border by building a series of fortifications there.
loc.ITA_vallo_alpino_orientale_tt: Build a defensive line in §Y[160.GetName]§!, §Y[736.GetName]§! and §Y[852.GetName]§! along the Eastern Alpine border with [153.GetName], [102.GetName], [853.GetName] and [103.GetName].\n
loc.ITA_vallo_alpino_project_ongoing_flag: A project for the expansion of the $ITA_vallo_alpino_del_littorio$ is already ongoing.
loc.ITA_disband_irregulars_desc: We have no need for the colonial irregular troops any longer. Let them return to their homes, or wherever they come from.
loc.ITA_disband_irregulars_tt: §RAll Irregular divisions will be disbanded§!. \n(Manpower and equipment will not be refunded)
loc.ITA_train_irregulars_desc: Recruiting local forces would be less taxing on our own manpower and they have the benefit of being native to the lands, with knowledge of the peoples and geography there.
loc.ITA_train_irregulars_create_units_tt: Create §Y[ROOT.GetFlag][ROOT.GetAdjective]§! irregular units in owned and controlled colonies:
loc.ITA_train_irregulars_cd_tt: \nThis decision will be available again in §Y[?ITA_colonial_management_cd] days§!.\n
loc.ITA_reorganize_irregulars_desc: By re-organizing our irregular troops we might be able to strengthen them, making them a more formidable force.
loc.ITA_reorganize_irregulars_tt: Adds §Y2 $irregular_infantry$ battalions§! and §Y1 $recon$ battalion§! to all Irregular Infantry Division Templates. \nAdds §Y2 $cavalry$ battalions§! and §Y1 $recon$ battalion§! to all Irregular Cavalry Division Templates. \nAdds §Y2 $camelry$ battalions§! and §Y1 $recon$ battalion§! to all Irregular Camelry Division Templates.
loc.ITA_reorganize_ascari_desc: By re-organizing the Ascari troops we might be able to strengthen them, making them a more formidable force.
loc.ITA_reorganize_ascari_tt: Adds §Y1 $armored_car_recon$ battalion§! and §Y1 $artillery_brigade$ battalion§! to all Colonial Infantry Division Templates. \nAdds §Y2 $cavalry$ battalions§! and §Y1 $recon$ battalion§! to all Colonial Cavalry Division Templates. \nAdds §Y2 $camelry$ battalions§! and §Y1 $recon$ battalion§! to all Colonial Camelry Division Templates.
loc.ITA_regional_development_in_state_desc: Developing our colonial possessions will make them more habitable and prosperous.
loc.ITA_cooperation_program_with_country_des: Building and exporting our ships to other countries might lead to a deeper technological cooperation.
loc.ITA_joint_maneuvers_with_country_desc: For any military force to be effective and operational it needs to be prepared and ready. A joint drill with another country will do just that.
loc.ITA_sell_obsolete_escort_ships_to_countr: We have outdated ships in our fleet that could be sold to another country.
\nWe can only successfully sell our ships once.\n
loc.ITA_escort_ships_purchase_ongoing_flag: Already attempting to sell escort ships to another country.
loc.ITA_cede_aquila_class_destroyers_to_span: We could give the Spaniards some of our Destroyers to strengthen the bond between our countries and reinforce their military capabilities.
loc.ITA_export_midget_submarines_desc: The clear waters of the Mediterranean are dangerous for larger submarines. Other nations might be interested in our smaller, midget submarines.
loc.ITA_export_midget_submarines_tt: Builds §Y5 Midget Submarines§! for §Y[FROM.GetFlag][FROM.GetNameDef]§!. It will take §Y[?ITA.ITA_export_midget_submarines_days] days§! to produce them.
loc.ITA_producing_midget_submarines_for_expo: Already producing Midget Submarines for exports.
loc.ITA_abolish_the_colonies_event_chain_tt: Initiates the '§Y$ITA_abolish_the_colonies$§!' event chain, in which our controlled territories in other continents will hold referendums to decide if they get integrated into our country or become independent nations.
loc.ITA_abolish_the_colonies_tips_tt: Increasing compliance in colonial states and completing focus to develop certain states will make it more likely to successfully integrate the region.
loc.ITA_suppress_mafia_in_state_desc: We must stop the spread of the Mafia, before it gets out of hand.
loc.ITA_pressure_government_cd_tt: \nWe can only pressure a country's government once every §Y[?ITA_pressure_government_cd]§! days.
loc.ITA_vittorio_abdicate_desc: King Vittorio Emanuele III has always had the greater good for Italy in mind. The best way he can serve Italy is by stepping down, and letting his son take over as king.
loc.decision_cost_CP_25_pp_15_tooltip: It costs £command_power  §Y25§! £pol_power  §Y15§! to take the decision
loc.decision_cost_CP_50_pp_50_ArmXP_15_toolt: It costs £command_power  §Y50§! £pol_power  §Y50§! £army_experience  §Y15§! to take the decision
loc.decision_cost_pp_15_NavXP_15_tooltip: It costs £pol_power  §Y15§! £navy_experience  §Y15§! to take the decision
loc.decision_cost_pp_15_ArmXP_10_tooltip: It costs £pol_power  §Y15§! £army_experience  §Y10§! to take the decision
loc.decision_cost_pp_15_AirXP_10_tooltip: It costs £pol_power  §Y15§! £air_experience  §Y10§! to take the decision
loc.decision_cost_pp_15_NavXP_10_tooltip: It costs £pol_power  §Y15§! £navy_experience  §Y10§! to take the decision
loc.SWI_military_readiness_decisions_categor:
The people of Switzerland are in the eye of the storm of Fascism, so they must be ready to defend their democratic way of living. 


Military Readiness: [?SWI.SWI_military_readiness]/[?SWI.SWI_max_mil_readiness]£GFX_SWI_military_readiness_text_icon
loc.SWI_absolute_neutrality_decisions_catego: Surrounded by potential invaders, [ROOT.GetNameDef] must be careful not to  break our tenuous neutrality, or we risk losing our Island of Democracy to the rising tides of war. \n\n
loc.SWI_absolute_neutrality_breakdown: [Root.GetNameDefCap] has [?ROOT.opinion@SWI|+0] §Yopinion§! of [SWI.GetNameDef]\n\nWe must maintain the appearance of Neutrality. If §Y[?ROOT.GetName]§!'s opinion of [SWI.GetNonIdeologyName] reaches §R[?SWI.SWI_angry_threshold]§! they will consider us in §RBreach of Neutrality§! and might §RDeclare war on [SWI.GetNameDef]§!
loc.SWI_positive_fallout_opinion: It will have a §Gpositive§! effect in other countries' opinion of [ROOT.GetName]
loc.SWI_negative_fallout_opinion: It will have a §Rnegative§! effect in other countries' opinion of [ROOT.GetName]
loc.SWI_concessions_to_political_party_desc: Our harsh position towards the [ROOT.GetAdjective] [FROM.GetRulingIdeology] could alienate the [FROM.GetAdjective]s and provoke a diplomatic incident or worse, an invasion. Maybe it's time to soften our stance on [FROM.GetRulingIdeologyNoun].
loc.SWI_weapons_production_for_civilian_supp: With supplies dwindling, we have no other option than to allow some of our military industry to manufacture parts for the [FROM.GetAdjective] war machine. This way we can at least guarantee some civilian supplies and maybe deter [FROM.GetNameDef] from invading [ROOT.GetName].
loc.SWI_country_angry_mission_desc: It seems our actions towards other countries have been interpreted by [?SWI_angriest_country.GetNameDef] as an unacceptable breach of neutrality. If we don't appease them soon, they will certainly use this as an excuse to invade.
loc.SWI_avoid_failing_country_angry_TT_NOT: Not: [?SWI.SWI_angriest_country.GetName]'s Opinion of [ROOT.GetName] is more than [?SWI.SWI_no_longer_angry_threshold]
loc.SWI_embrace_communism_desc: Now that the stage is set, we must act quickly and seize this once in a lifetime opportunity to turn [ROOT.GetNonIdeologyName] into a worker's paradise.
loc.SWI_declare_the_alpine_confederation_des: Now that our democracy has extended across the Alps, the Confederation not only belongs to [SWI.GetNonIdeologyName] anymore, it belongs to all the people and communities of the Alps.
loc.SWI_declare_the_alpine_union_desc: The will of the workers and peoples of the Alps cannot be stopped, as we continue to free territories from the yoke of the Bourgeoisie, we have gone beyond [SWI.GetNonIdeologyName] and our country should reflect that.
loc.SWI_purchase_democratic_planes_fighters_: The defense of the skies over [ROOT.GetName] cannot wait until we have the capacity to produce our own air force, so in the meantime we'll have to depend on [FROM.GetName] for our fighter planes.
loc.SWI_purchase_democratic_planes_cas_desc: While our industrial capacity is still limited we must rely on [FROM.GetName] to supply our air force with the bombers we need to support our troops on the battlefield
loc.SWI_purchase_democratic_planes_unlock_TT: Unlocks decisions to purchase §YFighter and Close Air Support Planes§! from §Y[?SWI.SWI_democratic_planes_seller.GetFlag][?SWI.SWI_democratic_planes_seller.GetNameDef]§!
loc.SWI_purchase_fascist_planes_fighters_des: The defense of the skies over [ROOT.GetName] cannot wait until we have the capacity to produce our own air force, so in the meantime we'll have to depend on [FROM.GetName] for our fighter planes.
loc.SWI_purchase_fascist_planes_cas_desc: While our industrial capacity is still limited we must rely on [FROM.GetName] to supply our air force with the bombers we need to support our troops on the battlefield
loc.SWI_purchase_fascist_planes_unlock_TT: Unlocks decisions to purchase §YFighter and Close Air Support Planes§! from §Y[?SWI.SWI_biggest_fascist.GetFlag][?SWI.SWI_biggest_fascist.GetNameDef]§!
loc.SWI_cost_5_mil_factories_tooltip: In order to start, we need at least §Y5 £mil_factory£ Military Factories§!
loc.SWI_reducing_effects_from_seizing_gold_T: Bonuses from §Y$SWI_swiss_gold_market$§! will be §RReduced§! according to size of the [THIS.GetAdjective] reserves\n
loc.SWI_gold_trading_partner: Uses our banks to trade gold
loc.SWI_federal_council_decisions_category_d:
The Federal Council of Switzerland has stood since 1848 as the stalwart zenith of Swiss Democracy. [SWI_get_temp_explanation_of_council_system]

§YPresident of the Swiss Confederation:§! 
[SWI_GetPresidentName] 

§YLeading Councilors:§! 
[SWI_GetCouncilor1name] 
[SWI_GetCouncilor2name] 
[SWI_GetCouncilor3name]

It may not be the same council of old but the new glorious regime lead by [SWI.GetLeader] still needs a strong council to enforce the will of the Führer in [?SWI.SWI_biggest_fascist.GetNameDef]. 

§YLeading Councilors:§! 
[SWI_GetCouncilor1name] 
[SWI_GetCouncilor2name] 
[SWI_GetCouncilor3name]

The leader of [SWI.GetNameDef], [SWI.GetLeader] cannot be expected to perform all the duties of a country with such an important mission, that is why [SWI.GetLeader.GetSheHe] must rely on a council to delegate some of the functions of the defunct Assembly. 

§YLeading Councilors:§! 
[SWI_GetCouncilor1name] 
[SWI_GetCouncilor2name] 
[SWI_GetCouncilor3name]
loc.SWI_recently_finished_president_initiati: With the limited power of the Confederation President and the Federal Council, we must wait until another concerted initiative can be attempted. Granting the council more power might be the way to do more of these initiatives, but we must consider if that is the best course for Switzerland's deeply ingrained democratic values.
loc.SWI_defense_fund_drive_desc: Defending against our potential invaders requires money that the Swiss Federal Government doesn't have, but we can campaign for the citizens of Switzerland to provide these funds, in a true bottom up initiative.
loc.SWI_swiss_democratic_tradition_campaign_: We can remind the Swiss population of our storied democratic tradition, the oldest democracy in Europe, and perhaps the only true one.
loc.SWI_rally_workers_desc: The workers could be an integral part of the defense of [SWI.GetName], so we can encourage their enthusiastic participation in the [SWI.GetAdjective] military industry and bear with the sacrifices needed.
loc.SWI_anti_fascist_drive_desc: There's no place for fascists in [ROOT.GetName], as a country dedicated to self determination and local democratic power, and one that aspires to become a paradise for the people, it is our duty to get rid of every fascist still in the country, wherever they may be.
loc.SWI_spouse_fascism_desc: The way things are going in the world, aligning ourselves to fascist powers might be the safest bet, we can start propagating fascist propaganda so the people can be ready for our realignment of values.
loc.SWI_focus_on_swiss_unity_desc: We can encourage the [SWI.GetAdjective] population that the situation calls for tossing aside our differences, in language, class, background and political leanings, to pool our resources and efforts on the defense of the unity and diversity that defines [SWI.GetNameDef].
loc.SWI_isolate_switzerland_desc: We can focus on doing everything we can to make sure [SWI.GetName] can stand alone and self-reliant, which might as well be our only chance to avoid losing our closely held independence.
loc.SWI_militarization_drive_desc: We can shift our focus towards expanding the [SWI.GetAdjective] war machine so we can defend ourselves and maybe even take the initiative and pre-empt their offensives.
loc.SWI_expand_covert_operations_desc: We can increase our espionage resources so we can influence world affairs in our favor while maintaining the semblance of neutrality.
loc.SWI_expand_arms_industry_desc: We can increase our capacity to develop new weapons and produce them at a significant speed so we don't need to rely on foreign powers for our defense.
loc.SWI_support_humanitarian_efforts_desc: We cannot sit on our hands while atrocities are committed around us. We have a moral obligation to help the oppressed of Europe and grant them asylum in our lands.
loc.SWI_diplomatic_mission_desc: We can embark on diplomatic trips to other nations to have a closer relations with them, and placate any doubts they might have about our neutrality, avoiding any potential invasion from them.
loc.SWI_appease_fascists_desc: We can accept the new European order and learn to coexist with our fascist neighbors. This could let us escape war, and secure our independence and neutrality.
loc.SWI_elect_a_new_confederation_president: Elect a new President for the Confederation
loc.SWI_no_confederation_councilor_desc: Keeping an empty councilor seat for too long will surely lead to incompetent opportunists trying to fill that role for their own gain
loc.SWI_promoting_to_president_TT: \n§Y[?SWI.temp_character_president.GetName]§! Will be removed as a political advisor and elected as President of [SWI.GetNameDef]. Once a new president is elected in a year, §R[?SWI.temp_character_president.GetSheHe] will not be available as a Political Advisor or Confederation President again.§!
loc.SWI_decision_remove_councilor_1_desc: When ousting a councilor, the wheels of Swiss Assembly are put in motion. We will have to wait some time before we can fill their position.
loc.SWI_council_not_filled_TT: There is an empty council seat
loc.SWI_council_not_filled_TT_NOT: There are no empty council seats
loc.SWI_ousted_councilor: Has been ousted from the Council
loc.SWI_renounce_guiding_principles_desc_can: Our original commitment to continue the devolution of power to the cantons and the Federal Assembly might have been premature. The current circumstances make it clear that a more energetic and empowered Federal Council is necessary for our survival.
loc.SWI_renounce_guiding_principles_desc_cou: Our original commitment to consolidate power into the Federal Council might have been misguided. The current situation call for a more direct and inclusive democracy, where stability and citizen participation are the order of the day.
loc.SWI_basic_council_TT: \n\nThe three assigned §YPolitical Advisors§! take the roles of §YLeading Councilors§!, and every year, one of them can be selected as the §YPresident of the Confederation§!, unlocking a special decision. §RThere should never be an empty Political Advisor position, otherwise, penalties will apply to the country.§!
loc.SWI_research_slot_tooltip: When promoted to §YConfederation President§!, will unlock decision §Y$SWI_expand_arms_industry$§! which grants an extra §GResearch Slot§!
loc.SWI_dismiss_council_desc: Our enemies are too strong, and cheer on the bickering and infighting of the Federal Council. It's time a great leader stands up and steers [ROOT.GetNonIdeologyName] through this tempest.
loc.SWI_increasing_cost_of_council_diplomati: The cost of the §Y$SWI_council_diplomatic_effort$§! decision is increased by §R+$RIGHT|0$§!
loc.SWI_president_matches_country_politics_T: §YConfederation President§! matches the politics of the country
loc.SWI_field_hospital_for_militias_desc: [ROOT.GetNonIdeologyName] has a longstanding tradition of compassion and medical care. We must leverage it in order to better prepare our militias for the defense of our country.
loc.SWI_support_for_militias_desc: We can strengthen our militias with ample support, making them more flexible and resilient.
loc.SWI_president_gave_MR_speech: Current President has encouraged Citizen Militias
loc.SWI_building_up_military_readiness_missi: We are steering our nation towards preparations for the defense of [ROOT.GetName]. Defense bonds are being sold, citizens are training at home, associations are organizing schools and businesses are having drills. We must be ready at all costs.
loc.SWI_decision_substract_total_MR: §RAll§! of our £GFX_SWI_military_readiness_text_icon  §YMilitary Readiness§! will be spent
loc.SWI_decision_subtract_small_MR_min: Decreases the §YMinimum  £GFX_SWI_military_readiness_text_icon Military Readiness§! needed to activate the Citizen Militias by §G-[?ROOT.SWI_mr_low_amount]§!
loc.SWI_decision_subtract_medium_MR_min: Decreases the §YMinimum £GFX_SWI_military_readiness_text_icon Military Readiness§! needed to activate the Citizen Militias by §G-[?ROOT.SWI_mr_medium_amount]§!
loc.form_east_africa_category_desc: Though culturally different, we share a common fate with many other states and peoples in East Africa. It is time that we unify, and stand together in the face of exterior threats.
loc.form_horn_of_africa_africa_category_desc: After many centuries of separation, due to internal disagreements and occupation from external powers, the Horn of Africa is finally whole. It is time we make our mark in history, and unify the region into a prosperous union!
loc.greater_italy_category_desc: The early stages of Italian irredentism triumphed with the Great War and the annexation of South Tyrol and Istria, but beyond that the ideas of Italian unification were betrayed by the western allies. Under the leadership of [ITA.GetLeader] these ideas have resurfaced, and Italy shall stand tall through the ages. Viva l'Italia e gloria al Duce!

loc.aoi_required_ethiopian_states: Italy or a subject of Italy own all Ethiopian core states
loc.aoi_founded_tt: Release the AOI as a subject
loc.give_somaliland_to_the_aoi: Hand Somaliland over to the AOI
loc.give_djibouti_to_the_aoi: Hand Djibouti over to the AOI
loc.give_garissa_to_the_aoi: Hand Garissa over to the AOI
loc.send_more_men_to_the_AOI: Send more men to the AOI
loc.send_more_weapons_to_the_AOI: Send more weapons to the AOI
loc.form_country_albania_required_states_tt: Controls all §YAlbanian§! cores in the Mediterranean.
loc.form_country_mare_nostrum_turkey_require: Controls all §YTurkish§! cores in the Mediterranean.
loc.form_spqr_coastal_spain_required_states_: Controls all §YSpanish§! cores in the Mediterranean.
loc.form_spqr_coastal_france_required_states: Controls all §YFrench§! cores in the Mediterranean.
loc.form_spqr_coastal_uk_required_states_tt: Controls all §YBritish§! cores in the Mediterranean.
loc.form_country_mare_nostrum_north_africa_r: Controls all §YNorth African§! states in the Mediterranean and all §YLibyan§! cores.
loc.form_country_mare_nostrum_middle_east_re: Controls all §YMiddle East§! states in the Mediterranean.
loc.form_country_mare_nostrum_greece_require: Controls all §YGreek§! cores in the Mediterranean.
loc.form_spqr_core_mare_nostrum_states_tt: Gain Cores on §Yall states§! required to take the decision
loc.restore_roman_rule_to_raetia_et_noricum: Restore Roman rule to Raetia et Noricum
loc.bba_news.0.t: The End of the League of Nations
loc.bba_news.0.desc: With the declaration of war on [?global.LoN_defender_country.GetNameDef] by [?global.LoN_attacker_country.GetNameDef], the League of Nations has failed in its attempts to preserve peace. [?global.LoN_attacker_country.GetLeader] openly mocked the League's inability to do anything, and with that took [?global.LoN_attacker_country.GetHerHis] country out of the League. With other world leaders also questioning the point of the League of Nations if it can't prevent conflicts, the days of the League are de facto over. \nWhile the council continues to meet, no-one expects it to actually accomplish anything anymore. Whatever authority the council once had is long lost now.
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.01.desc: Our troops have stalled in the war against Abyssinia, and have even been pushed back in certain places. This “Christmas Offensive” has Mussolini privately berating the military high command for their incompetencies. The Duce wants results. Now. \n\n He has therefore authorized any means necessary to repel the Abyssinians and to end this war swiftly - whatever it takes.
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.01.b: We need to be methodical and deliberate
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.02.desc: The Italians are trying to regain the initiative in the war. They are launching a major offensive, in an attempt to smash our lines and crush the [ROOT.GetAdjective] Empire in one blow.\nOur forces must hold. It is vital that our forces hold long enough against intense bombing and assaults with tanks and artillery, so that we have time to convince the international community to act on our behalf.
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.03.desc: Our offensive has pushed the Italians back, but it failed to achieve its goal. Our troops have run out of momentum, and the Italians are recovering from the shock of our assault.\nIntelligence reports indicate that they are preparing a new push, better prepared than last time. Our forces must hold. The longer we can keep them away from our country, the more they have to commit, and the easier it will be to convince the League of Nations that this is no minor "colonial skirmish" but rather a brutal aggression by one member country against another.
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.10.desc: The League of Nations Council has decided to impose an all out embargo on trade with [ITA.GetNameDef] as a response to the country's unlawful aggression against [ETH.GetNameDef]. The sanctions include any and all resources that can be used for the production of war equipment. They are to be imposed immediately and remain in place until the country ceases hostilities against [ETH.GetNameDef].
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.10.a: It is the right thing to do
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.11.t: The League of Nations demands closure of Suez
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.11.desc: The delegates from [ETH.GetName] in the League of Nations requested that the Suez Canal be closed for [ITA.GetName] as an increase in the sanctions against [ITA.GetNameDef]. After a long debate in the council, the council decided to comply with the request. Thus [ROOT.GetNameDef] has been charged with the task of blocking any [ITA.GetAdjective] traffic through the canal.
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.11.a: This should hurt their war effort
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.11.b: We're not going to do it
loc.suez_blocked_sanctions_tt: §Y[ITA.GetName]§! will be blocked from using the Suez Canal.
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.12.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has informed the League of Nations Council that [FROM.GetNameDef] will not close the Suez Canal for [ITA.GetName]. This is a clear breach of international agreements, and when urged to comply, [FROM.GetName] simply announced that they are leaving the League of Nations.
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.12.a: You can't really trust anyone, can you?
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.13.desc: Following the resolution in the League of Nations, [FROM.GetLeader] publicly announced that [ITA.GetAdjective] shipping through the Suez Canal is no longer allowed. Any [ITA.GetAdjective] ships trying to pass through the canal will be seized, and their cargo confiscated, until [ITA.GetName] ceases its aggression against [ETH.GetNameDef].
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.13.a: This is a blow to them!
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.14.t: League of Nations Resolution to Support [ETH.GetName]
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.14.desc: The League of Nations council debated the request from [ETH.GetName] for military intervention in the war with Italy. In the end, the council wouldn't go so far as to call for a full scale intervention, but came with a statement recommending member countries to support [ETH.GetName] in any way possible, including possibly allowing volunteers to take part on [ETH.GetName]'s side in the conflict.
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.14.c: There's no point sending our citizens to die in another country
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.14.d: We have our own war to fight
loc.ETH_volunteers_leave_3000: Aside from any organized expedition, 3000 [ROOT.GetAdjective] citizens leave to join the [ETH.GetAdjective] forces.
loc.ETH_volunteers_leave_2000: 2000 [ROOT.GetAdjective] citizens leave to join the [ETH.GetAdjective] forces.
loc.ETH_volunteers_leave_200: Despite the official stance, some 200 [ROOT.GetAdjective] citizens leave to join the [ETH.GetAdjective] forces.
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.15.desc_a: As a result of the League of Nations' resolution to allow support of [ROOT.GetName], volunteers have been arriving from all over the world. International brigades are being formed from these volunteers. Hopefully their fighting capabilities are on par with their enthusiasm.
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.15.desc_b: Even after the League of Nations' resolution to allow support of [ROOT.GetName], the number of volunteers arriving to help us out in our war effort is unfortunately very small. Hopefully the fighting capabilities of these brave freedom fighters are on par with their enthusiasm.
loc.BA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.15.desc_b: Unfortunately the League of nations wouldn't agree to field a military force to aid us. Instead they just encouraged member nations to help us, which in the end didn't result in any big support at all. Only a handful of new volunteers have arrived.
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.16.desc: The League of Nations didn't go as far as try to create a military force to drive [ITA.GetName] out of [ROOT.GetName]. However, they did encourage member countries to send forces to help restore the status quo. There are indications that several nations are organizing expeditions, including countries such as [FROM.GetName]. It remains to be seen whether this is just talk, or if they are actually coming to help us.
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.16.a: We'll have to wait and see.
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.20.desc: Despite the capitulation of the [ETH.GetAdjective] forces, [ETH.GetLeader] refuses to surrender. Rumor has it that [ETH.GetLeader.GetSheHe] has been allowed to set up a Government in Exile in [?ETH.host_nation.GetNameDef]. A formal protest has been issued to the [?ETH.host_nation.GetAdjective] government.
loc.ITA_occupation_tt: [ITA.GetName] will technically continue to be at war with the Exile government of [ETH.GetName] until [ETH.GetName] no longer owns any states.
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.100.desc: The [FROM.GetAdjective] ambassador has approached the government with a formal request from [FROM.GetLeader] to be allowed to set up a temporary  Government in Exile here in [ROOT.GetName] if the war against [ITA.GetName] goes badly. Accepting would definitely make maintaining good relations with [ITA.GetName] more difficult.
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.101.desc: The [FROM.GetAdjective] government has responded favorably to the request to act as host nation for [ROOT.GetLeader] should that be necessary.
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.101.a: One issue less to worry about
loc.change_focus_to_from_tt: Adds new focuses for §Y[ROOT.GetNameDef]§! that can be used while exiled in §Y[FROM.GetNameDef]§!.
