loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.102.desc: Unfortunately, the [FROM.GetAdjective] government does not dare to upset [ITA.GetLeader]. They have refused our request to set up a temporary Government there should [ETH.GetName] fall.
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.110.desc: The League of Nations has demanded an immediate end of hostilities between [ROOT.GetName] and [FROM.GetName]. The resolution by the council gives member states the right to declare war on [ROOT.GetDameDef] should we refuse to comply.
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.110.a: We have to accept, for now
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.110.b: They will not dare to do anything
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.111.desc: After the resolution by the League of Nations council, the [FROM.GetAdjective] government led by [FROM.GetLeader] has finally come to sense. The Peace treaty written up by the League of Nations reinstates the prewar borders. It does not, unfortunately, include any compensation for [ROOT.GetName] for all the collateral damage, but it will give us time to start rebuilding the country.
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.112.desc: Despite the threat of war from the League of Nations' council members, [FRON.GetLeader] remains intent on the destruction of [ROOT.GetName]. The council has ordered an immediate end to hostilities, but [FROM.GetName] blatantly refuses to comply.
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events_wargoal_t: Major Powers in the League of Nations can get a wargoal on [ROOT.GetName]
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.112.a: We will have to fight even harder
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.113.t: [FROM.GetName] Refuses to Comply with League of Nations Resolution
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.113.desc: The League of nations has demanded that [FROM.GetNameDef] immediately abort their aggression against [ETH.GetName]. However, [FROM.GetLeader] remains defiant and refuses to comply. This is a blatant breach of international rule, and the council has called for international action against [FROM.GetNameDef].
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.113.a: If force is the only language they speak
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.113.b: We cannot let the League of Nations dictate our Foreign Policy
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.120.desc: The war in [FROM.GetName] has not gone according to expectation. Our proud nation is quickly becoming the laughing stock of Europe, and the crowds in [ROOT.GetCapitalVictoryPointName] are becoming restless. Revolution may be around the corner. Now [FROM.GetLeader] approaches us with a peace offer.
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.120.a: We should focus on something easier
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.121.desc: A long and bitter struggle is finally over. [FROM.GetLeader] has accepted our demands and called off the aggression against [ROOT.GetName]. [ROOT.GetLeader] is the hero of the day. [ROOT.GetLeader.GetSheHeCap] has guided [ROOT.GetNameDef] steadily through these difficult times and successfully beaten back a European colonialist power.
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.121.a: This signals a new start for Africa
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.122.desc: Despite [ROOT.GetAdjective] successes in the war, the [FROM.GetAdjective] leader refuses to accept defeat. [ROOT.GetLeader] has shown the world that an African nation can stand up to European invaders, and that is a victory in itself. Now we need to bring one to its knees.
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.122.a: The war enters a new phase.
loc.ethiopia_recognized_flag: Ethiopia can call allies to war
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.200.desc: Public sympathy for [ROOT.GetName]'s cause has always been strong. However, no-one really expected the country to hold for more than a month or so. Our dogged resistance to the [ITA.GetAdjective] invaders is winning the hearts of people around the world, and country leaders are starting to take [ROOT.GetName] more seriously.
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.200.a: If only they could do more than talk
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.201.desc: By holding out this long, against these odds, morale among the common soldiers is beginning to pick back up again. When the initial enthusiasm had died, many started taking eventual defeat for granted, but now there is some talk of a possible victory once more. There are also clear signs of units adapting to the new style of fighting.
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.201.a: We must build on this to push the enemy out of [ROOT.GetName]
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.202.desc: It started as a trickle at first, some of the irregular units of our enemy started losing faith, and some of those came over to fight for us. Now Soldiers are deserting en masse, and not just the irregulars. Some of the deserters even bring heavy equipment with them.
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.203.desc: The so-called experts wouldn't give us a month even when the war started. We've held out against a so called modern army for far longer than that. We know how they fight, and we have adapted to it. The faith among the people is returning, recruits are flocking to the banners from near and afar.
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.203.a: We shall drive the invaders into the sea
loc.ETH_for_the_duration_of_the_war_tt: For the Duration of the War:
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.204.desc: Everywhere, the people are rising up against the invaders, young and old alike are joining the resistance movement, forcing [ITA.GetName] to work even harder for any gains they make. The locals who cannot fight are making weapons and equipment for the army.
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.300.desc: Our armies struggle to make any advancements in [ETH.GetName], and the lack of progress can be felt even in [ITA.GetName]. The [ITA.GetAdjective] population is starting to lose faith in the war, and even in our leadership to secure a victory in the end.
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.301.desc: Our armies in [ETH.GetName] are making little to no progress and are taking heavy casualties. The resistance is fierce and we have to fight hard for every inch we gain. Morale throughout the armies is at an all-time low, and we have even received reports that some companies have refused to execute direct orders.
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.301.a: We must turn the tide of war!
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.302.desc: Our struggles in [ETH.GetName] have started to have a ripple effect elsewhere; we are receiving reports from the colonies that our subjects have started to disobey the local authorities in matters small and big. They apparently view our lack of progress in the war as a weakness and are testing our strength.
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.303.desc: The [ETH.GetAdjevtive] debacle has turned the [ITA.GetAdjective]s against the war. More and more people are openly criticizing our government and its leadership, and even whispers of other alternatives are not uncommon.
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.304.desc: The situation in [ETH.GetName] is dire as morale continues to plummet among the soldiers! The army is bogged-down in several places and is facing mass desertion, dwindling our numbers even without the help from the [ETH.GetAdjective]s! We even have a report of an officer getting run over by a truck. We have labeled it as an accident.
loc.ITA_desertions_east_africa_tt: Armies in East Africa suffer from desertions.
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.305.desc: What started as civil disobedience in the colonies has almost escalated to outright rebellion! Our failure to address the continued struggles in [ETH.GetName] have convinced our subjects that we are weak and that they would be better off without our governance.
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.400.desc: [AFA.GetLeader], the sultan of [AFA.GetNameDef], has for a long time been under strong [ROOT.GetAdjective] influence. Just like during the last war he has remained neutral, despite formally being part of the [ETH.GetAdjective] empire. In fact, the only reason that the sultan still has power is due to [ROOT.GetAdjective] goodwill. The country may have sold its coastline to [ROOT.GetName], but it is still an obstacle to our conquest. The capture of [?ITA.ITA_capture_state.GetName] might be enough to convince the Sultan to surrender the rest of his land.
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.400.a: Send an ultimatum, demanding total subjugation
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.400.b: We can deal with [AFA.GetNameDef] later. Now is not the time.
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.401.desc: The Italians have requested that we place the entire state under their control, for use as a staging area in their war against [ETH.GetName]. Accepting will effectively end the independence of [ROOT.GetNAme], but refusing will surely mean an invasion.
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.401.b: If they want our land they will have to take it by force
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.402.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has accepted our demands to let us use the [FROM.GetAdjective] lands as a base of operations against [ETH.GetName]. This effectively ends the independence of [FROM.GetName].
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.402.a: Good, let's move in and occupy the lands.
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.403.desc: Unfortunately diplomatic pressure has not been enough to secure Italian overlordship of [FROM.GetNameDef]. [FROM.GetLeader] remains adamant that his country can stand against the military might of [ROOT.GetName].
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.403.a: We will have to do this the hard way
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.500.desc_: The [FROM.GetAdjective] demand that we sue for peace with [ETH.GetName] if we want their help against the Germans. If we sign a treaty with the Ethiopians we must be willing to part ways with some of the lands we have conquered, while keeping others. Such a peace will surely be a bitter pill to swallow for both our countries but might be worth it when facing the Germans.

In order to give us some of their colonial territories, the British want an end to our war with the Ethiopians. If we sign a treaty with them we must be willing to part ways with some of the lands we have conquered, while keeping others. Such a peace will surely be a bitter pill to swallow for both our countries considering all the blood, sweat, and tears we have shed.
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.501.desc: Our gracious host country, which has taken us in after our own nation was overrun by [ITA.GetNameDefCap], seem to have grown tired of us. They are scheming behind our backs to force us to sign a peace treaty with the foul Italian invaders. There is little we can do about it, sadly.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_is_expelled_tt: §Y[ETH.GetNameWithFlag]§!'s government is expelled from §Y[ENG.GetNameWithFlag]§! and is able to set up their government in exile elsewhere.
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.502.desc_: The Italian government has turned down our demand that they make peace with [ETH.GetNameDefCap] in exchange for our help against the Germans. They will have to face this onslaught by themselves.

The Italian government has turned down our demand that they make peace with [ETH.GetNameDefCap] in exchange for some of our colonial territories. This only goes to show that there can be no deals with such criminals!
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.503.desc: The Ethiopian government has refused the British demand to sign a peace deal with us. This has led to [ENG.GetLeader] expelling the Ethiopians from [ENG.GetNameDef], sending a clear signal to everyone which country's cooperation they value more. This leaves us with the opportunity to strengthen our African holdings further!
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.510.desc: We have received reports that the Italians have launched a disinformation campaign to undermine our rule and legitimacy back home. These vile lies might sway some of our subjects to [ITA.GetNameDef]’s cause and weaken our claim to the throne. We must restore our rule over Ethiopia before they cause further harm!
loc.BBA_italo_ethiopian_war_events.510.a: They will pay for their lies!
The increasing decentralization of [THIS.GetName] coupled with the lack of widespread support for the ruling administration and wider instability in the region has spilled over into open rebellion against the central government. Supporters of $haile_selassie_gugsa$ have taken up arms with the intention of putting him on the [THIS.GetAdjective] throne.

The increasing decentralization of [THIS.GetName] coupled with the lack of widespread support for the ruling administration and wider instability in the region has spilled over into open rebellion against the central government.

The increasing centralization of [THIS.GetName] coupled with the lack of widespread support for the ruling administration and wider instability in the region has spilled over into open rebellion against the central government. The anarchists have declared they will liberate the nation from our administration.
The gradual decentralization of [THIS.GetNameDef] has unsurprisingly caused the central government to lose much of its authority. Now the various regions are going so far as to declare their independence from [THIS.GetNameDef]. We need to act quickly if we wish to regain control of these regions.
Nothing to do about it, I suppose
loc.ETH_breakup_fight_tt: §RBecome independent from [ROOT.GetName] and [ROOT.GetName] declares war against them.§!
Recent experience has demonstrated that many of our military officers are ill equipped for handling modern warfare. The most likely reason for this flaw is our historical tendency to offer military ranks based on hereditary or political titles, rather than on the merit of the person in question. With the recent wave of reforms across [ETH.GetNameDef], it is time to make a decision on the future of the military hierarchy.
The peasant rabble are incapable of leadership.
Meritocracy in the military is essential.
Our recent wave of education reforms are already proving successful. Not only are the young proving increasingly loyal to [ETH.GetLeader], but they also seem to be exerting pressure on their parents to toe the line.
The regime grows more secure by the day.
Our recent wave of education reforms are already proving successful. The ancient hierarchies of [ETH.GetNameDef] are increasingly being called into question as the young demand they prove their legitimacy. Although this has stirred up tensions between younger and older generations, it seems attitudes will ultimately shift in our favor.
As we increasingly centralize political and economic control of [ETH.GetName], there remains great anxiety over the military. If they were to turn on us, we would have little chance of resisting their demands. Therefore, we have started to introduce political officers into the armed forces to ensure that the troops don’t get any unapproved ideas.
Recent experience has demonstrated that many of our military officers are ill equipped for handling modern warfare. The most likely reason for this flaw is our historical tendency to offer military ranks based on hereditary or political titles, rather than on the merit of the person in question. With the recent wave of reforms across [ETH.GetName], it is only fitting that we ensure meritocracy is the determining factor in becoming a military leader.
Meritocracy in the military is essential.
The former Shum of Sidamo, and once Dejazmach of the [FROM.GetAdjective] army, has accepted the call from [FROM.GetLeader] to once again take up arms for his country. The hero of Adwa brings with him recruits from his personal domains. Hopefully this can help drive the [ITA.GetAdjective] invasion back.
The return of a true hero
Local Lord Offers to Raise Mercenary Unit

A local lord in [?ROOT.ETH_bop_state.GetName] has offered to raise a unit and commit it to the imperial army. The men will be recruited from local brigands and foreign volunteers, so they will come fully equipped and battle ready. Losing authority right now is of course a risk, but gaining more troops will certainly increase the chances of winning the war.
The country needs all the help it can get
We need to reduce the number of private armies, not increase them
Local Lord Wishes to Expand Domain

A local lord in [?ROOT.ETH_bop_state.GetName] is planning to expand his power base, and expand his domain. This will to some extent be beneficial to the country as a whole, as he invests heavily in local production capabilities. At the same time, not stopping this loosens the central governments grip on [?ROOT.ETH_bop_state.GetName].
Regional Ruler Wants to Produce Arms

One of the lords in [?ROOT.ETH_bop_state.GetName] wants support for setting up local production of rifles and ammunition in [?ROOT.ETH_bop_state.GetName]. This could help our armed forces get better equipment and improve the fighting capabilities of the [ROOT.GetAdjective] army.
Getting more rifles is more important than control at the moment
Arms production in private hands sounds too dangerous
The people of [?ROOT.ETH_bop_state.GetName] look to the central government for help. Recent events have created a shortage of supplies and the region could really use some investments to counter the situation.
There's unfortunately not much we can do at the moment
The local authorities in [?ROOT.ETH_bop_state.GetName] will have to deal with the problems
There has been several cases of complaints against the local rulers of [?ROOT.ETH_bop_state.GetName]. The people feel they are being ill treated by the aristocracy. An initial investigation into the matter shows that there is at least a degree of valid ground for their complaints. However, an intervention by the central government is not going to be looked on favorably by other nobles.
We need to make an example here
It is not for the central government to interfere in local matters.
The work put in by the central government to improve [ROOT.GetName]'s administration and to integrate the various regions has led to an economic boom in [?ROOT.ETH_bop_state.GetName]. The region is attracting immigrants from other parts of the country and industry is expanding.
We should capitalize on this opportunity to drive the centralization process even further
Re-investing in the region to make it flourish even more should be our focus
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.01.desc: The [FROM.GetAdjective] leader in exile,[FROM.GetLeader], is more than ready to launch a major campaign to retake [FROM.GetLeader.GetHerHis] country. The support among the populace for an attempt to do so is strong, so this could well be the time.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.02.desc: [ETH.GetLeader] has fled the country, but still encourages his supporters to attack the victorious [ROOT.GetAdjective] armies. These speeches have led to an increased resistance activity in the Northern and Central parts of [ETH.GetName].
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.02.a: We must be on the guard
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.03.t: Communist Guerillas in the South of [ETH.GetName]
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.03.desc: There are several reports of attacks against [ROOT.GetAdjective] forces in Southern [ETH.GetName]. An organization calling themselves the Black Lions, are believed to be behind these attacks.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.04.desc: [ENG.GetNameDefCap] has decided to recall $RAJ_orde_wingate$. They claim that he has been tasked with setting up a new force to help [ETH.GetLeader] in the war in [ETH.GetName]. The indications are that the stay will be limited in time, and that $RAJ_orde_wingate$ will be allowed to return when the operation is completed.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.04.a: Let's hope it's a quick thing then
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.05.desc: The [ENG.GetAdjective] government informs us that $RAJ_orde_wingate$ will, with immediate effect, be transferred to Burma, where he will be tasked with organizing a new force.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.06.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has requested overlordship over [550.GetName] should we manage to capture it from [550.Owner.GetNameDef]. The region has been under [ETH.GetAdjective] control, so historical precedence for the claim exists. [FROM.GetLeader] also made the case that all the Habesha people should be united under one ruler, further citing the fact that ever since the [ITA.GetAdjective]s occupied [550.GetName], [FROM.GetNameDef] has not had access to the Sea.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.06.b: We can't go promising land at this stage
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.07.desc: The [FROM.GetAdjective] government sees our claims to all the Habesha lands as legitimate, and has agreed to our request for overlordship over [550.GetName].
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.08.desc: Despite our legitimate claims to the [550.GetName] region, the [FROM.GetAdjective] government refuses to make any clear promises or statements supporting the [ROOT.GetAdjective] claims. Only time will tell whether they will eventually let us take control of the coastline.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.08.a: Let's win the war and then we'll see
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.10.t: [FROM.GetName] Requests Overlordship of all Somali Lands
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.10.desc: During a meeting with the [ROOT.GetAdjective] Minister of Foreign Affairs at [FROM.GetLeader]'s temporary residence, [FROM.GetLeader] requested that [FROM.GetName] be given overlordship of all Somali lands, as there is already a large Somali population in Ethiopia, and the border disputes were one of the excuses used to start the conflict. Giving all these territories to [FROM.GetNameDef] would then, according to [FROM.GetLeader] remove this reason for future conflict.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.10.a: That would give us a strong ally indeed
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.10.b: They can have the enemy's states
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.11.desc: The [FROM.GetAdjective] have agreed to give us control of all Somali lands. This means [ROOT.GetName] will most likely control the majority of the Horn of Africa once the war is over.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.12.desc: The [FROM.GetAdjective]s say we can have part of Somali lands. More precisely those that they or we manage to capture from the enemy. They refuse however to hand over any that they currently considered part of their empire.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.12.a: I suppose it's easier to give away other's states
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.13.desc: Our request for future ownership of all Somali lands was turned down by [FROM.GetNameDef]. Unfortunately they even refused to promise control of territory taken from the enemy.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.14.desc: In a recent meeting at Downing Street, [FROM.GetLeader] talked to the [ROOT.GetAdjective] Prime Minister about [454.GetName]. [FROM.GetLeader] stated that [FROM.GetLeader.GetSheHe] had received a very warm welcome when passing through there on [FROM.GetLeader.GetHerHis] way to [ROOT.GetNameDef]. The conversations gradually shifted towards a request from [FROM.GetLeader] to use [454.GetName] as a base for the reconquest of [ETH.GetNameDef], using his claimed direct line to King Solomon as a leverage, thus de facto asking the Prime Minister to cede [454.GetName] to [ETH.GetNameDef].
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.14.a: Maybe we can use this somehow
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.15.desc: Somewhat unexpectedly perhaps, the [FROM.GetAdjective] have agreed to let us use [454.GetName] as a base. We should move quickly to set up our administration there. One day we will build a new temple of Solomon.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.15.a: This is the start of a new era
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.16.desc: Unfortunately, the [FROM.GetAdjective] government refused our request to use [454.GetName] as a base and questioned the legitimacy of our claim to the region.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.17.desc: During a private meeting between [ROOT.GetLeader] and [FROM.GetLeader], [ROOT.GetLeader] promised that [ROOT.GetNameDef] would support [FROM.getNameDef] with ships. Careless words, perhaps, but still something the [ROOT.GetAdjective] Navy should honor.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.17.a: We can surely spare a few destroyers
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.17.b: Let's give them a cruiser with some escorts
loc.ETH_cruiser_tt: [ETH.GetName] receives a heavy cruiser and 3 destroyers from [JAP.GetName].
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.17.d: We can't spare any ships, but at least we can give them some know-how
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.18.desc: The [FROM.GetAdjective] navy has kindly supplied us with a unit of destroyers following [FROM.GetLeader]'s promise to supply [ROOT.GetName] with a navy.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.19.desc: Following [FROM.GetLeader]'s promise to supply [ROOT.GetName] with some ships, the [FROM.GetAdjective] has transferred a cruiser and a few destroyers to [ROOT.GetAdjective] control. Maybe not a large fleet, but at it is a fleet. The beginning of a new era for [ROOT.GetName]
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.20.desc: After [ROOT.GetLeader]'s visit to [FROM.GetLeader], [FROM.GetName] ordered that a battleship be transferred to [ROOT.GetName]. Thus, the [ROOT.GetNavy] now has a brand new flagship. We need to build escorts, but with [FROM.GetAdjective] help, that should be a doable task.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.21.desc: Despite [FROM.GetLeader]'s promises to [ROOT.GetLeader] of ships, the state of the [FROM.GetAdjective] navy means that [FROM.GetName] cannot part with any ships presently. In order to compensate somehow, the [FROM.GetAdjective] admiralty has allowed [ROOT.GetName] to study [FROM.GetAdjective] ship designs, and production methods, to transfer ship building knowledge to [ROOT.GetName].
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.21.a: It is after all better than nothing
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.22.desc: Apparently, [ROOT.GetLeader], has promised [FROM.GetLeader] one of [ROOT.GetName]'s islands to use as a base for government, and for starting the reconquest of [FROM.GetName]. This is an official recognition of [FROM.GetLeader] as ruler of [FROM.GetNameDef], and will be taken as a declaration of war by [ITA.getName]. However, it is also an opportunity to extend the influence of [ROOT.GetNameDef].
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.22.e: They can have one of the [ENG.GetAdjective] islands
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.23.desc: In an offer of goodwill, and in recognition of [ROOT.GetLeader] as the rightful ruler of [ROOT.GetNameDef], [FROM.GetLeader] has given [ROOT.GetLeader] the island of [?ETH.japanese_island.GetName] as a staging area for reclaiming [ROOT.GetName].\n\n [FROM.GetNameDef] will assist [ROOT.GetName] in the reconquest of the lost territory. In return for these favors, [ROOT.GetLeader] has sworn fealty to [FROM.GetLeader], tying the two countries closer together in their struggle against European imperialism.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.24.t: A Base of Operations for Ethiopia
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.24.desc: In a secret agreement made by the heads of states of [ROOT.GetNameDef] and [FROM.GetNameDef], a number of states on the Arabian peninsula has been promised to [FROM.GetNameDef] should they fall into the hands of the [ROOT.GetAdjective] government. The territory will be handed over when the time is right, but of course needs to be secured first.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.24.a: This will make them a stronger ally
loc.ETH_transfer_states_tt: Will be transferred to §Y[ETH.GetNameWithFlag]§! when owned by §Y[ROOT.GetNameWithFlag]§!
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.30.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] suggests that we hand in a joint membership application to a faction opposed to [ITA.GetNameDef]. This would go against our historical policies, but then again, allowing the [FROM.GetAdjective] leader to stay in [ROOT.GetName] already violated that in a way.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.30.b: No, this would be one step too far
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.31.desc: The [FROM.GetAdjective] government has rejected our proposal of a joint membership application. Unfortunately this means we will have to fight as individual countries, rather than have the backing of a larger alliance.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.32.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] and [FROM.FROM.GetLeader] has approached us with a request to join the [ROOT.GetFactionName]. This would put the forces of both [FROM.GetNameDef] and [FROM.FROM.GetNameDef] at the disposal of the [ROOT.GetFactionName] in the war against [ITA.GetName].
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.32.a: This sounds like a good idea
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.32.b: We are better off without them
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.33.desc: Unfortunately, [FROM.GetName] turned the joint [SWE.GetAdjective]-[ETH.GetAdjective] request to join [FROM.GetFactionName] down. For some strange reason they refused to see the benefit of a combined force against [ITA.GetLeader].
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.34.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has let us join the [FROM.GetFactionName]. We now have a much greater chance of defeating [ITA.GetName].
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.40.desc: The exiled emperor of [FROM.GetName], [FROM.GetLeader] has requested [ROOT.GetAdjective] mediation in the Italo-Ethiopian war. The [GetGermanCountryLeaderTitle] has expressed personal interest in resolving this conflict that the League of Nations has failed to solve. Achieving this, would increase [ROOT.GetName]'s status on the world stage.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.40.c: We should draw new borders that are more stable
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.41.desc_back_o: [FROM.GetLeader] has clearly taken the side of our enemy. [?global.ETH_peace_country.GetLeader] has been allowed to reside, and pretend at still being in power, in [FROM.GetNameDef] for quite some time now. The lies of the former leader of [?global.ETH_peace_country.GetNameDef] have clearly influenced [FROM.GetLeader] and lowered [FROM.GetLeader.GetHerHis] opinion of [ROOT.GetNameDef]. Now [FROM.GetNameDef] demands that we simply withdraw from [?global.ETH_peace_country.GetName], and set our differences aside.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.41.desc_offere: As a natural consequence of allowing the exiled leader of our enemy, [?global.ETH_peace_country.GetLeader], to reside in [FROM.GetNameDef], [FROM.GetLeader] now wants to mediate in the conflict between [ROOT.GetName] and [?global.ETH_peace_country.GetName]. [FROM.GetLeader] states that [FROM.GetLeader.GetSheHe] has managed to convince [?global.ETH_peace_country.GetLeader] to make minor concessions to [ROOT.GetName] in return for peace and possible future cooperation.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.41.desc_redraw: The [FROM.GetAdjective] leader, [FROM.GetLeader] has proposed a solution to the Italo-Ethiopian war, wherein [ROOT.GetName] receives a large portion of [?global.ETH_peace_country.GetAdjective] territory, in return for peace, and future cooperation against external enemies. [?global.ETH_peace_country.GetName] would, should [ROOT.GetName] accept this proposal, be compensated with [550.GetName], so that they also gain something. This would consolidate [ROOT.GetAdjective] holdings in Africa, while at the same time giving [?global.ETH_peace_country.GetName] access to the sea.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.41.b: It's a start, but the [ROOT.GetAdjective] people need more to show for their effort
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.42.desc: The peace proposal by the [GetGermanCountryLeaderTitle] wasn't outright rejected by [FROM.GetLeader]. However, the [FROM.GetAdjective] government feel they need more to show for their efforts to subdue public opposition to the regime and thus have asked us to reconsider somewhat.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.42.b: How dare they question our orders?
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.43.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] understands the need for [ETH.GetName] to concede territory to end the conflict in a way that allows us to save face with the public. We will soon be able to put this mess of an invasion behind us with our heads held high.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.44.desc: The arguments put forward by [ROOT.GetLeader] fell on deaf ears. [FROM.GetLeader] went into a rant, claiming that the proposal put forward was in the best interest of all parties, and that [ROOT.GetLeader] was a failure, because of [ROOT.GetLeader.GetHerHis] failure to win in Africa. The [FROM.GetAdjective] would surely crush the [ROOT.GetAdjective] army in a matter of weeks, [FROM.GetLeader] went on to exclaim.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.44.a: It's not like they will declare war or anything...
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.45.desc_white_: The [FROM.GetAdjective] mediation has proven successful. [FROM.FROM.GetLeader] was ordered by [FROM.GetLeader] to withdraw [FROM.FROM.GetLeader.GetHerHis] armies from [ROOT.GetAdjective] territory. \nThe treaty does not offer any compensation to [ROOT.GetName] but hopefully we can use our new allies to bring the country into the modern era. The [FROM.GetAdjective] [GetGermanCountryLeaderTitle], [FROM.GetLeader], has made vague promises about restoring the glory of the [ROOT.GetAdjective] empire.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.45.desc_redraw: [FROM.GetLeader] has brokered peace with [FROM.FROM.GetNameDef]. [ROOT.GetNameDefCap] must cede the entire south to [FROM.FROM.GetName]. In compensation [550.GetName] is to be given to [ROOT.GetName], to ensure that [ROOT.GetName] has access to the sea. This also, according to [FROM.GetLeader] divides the area into single unities which will, according to [FROM.GetLeader], reduce the risk of future conflicts between the two nations.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.45.desc_cede_t: [FROM.GetLeader] has brokered peace with [FROM.FROM.GetNameDef]. Unfortunately, the two leaders have decided above our heads that [FROM.FROM.GetName] is to get parts of [ROOT.GetName]. There's not really anything we can do about it.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.45.a: Some kind of peace at least
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.46.desc: Unfortunately, [FROM.GetLeader]'s attempts at brokering a peace deal with [FROM.FROM.GetNameDef] were fruitless. [FROM.FROM.GetLeader] refuses to see reason. Our hope now is that we can get [FROM.GetNameDef] to join us in the war, instead.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.46.a: We had higher hopes for this
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.47.desc: The [FROM.GetAdjective] reply is far from satisfactory. [FROM.GetLeader] refuses to budge. [FROM.GetName] won't stop the war until they have won, or have been destroyed trying.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.47.a: We have to teach [FROM.GetLeader.GetHerHim] a lesson
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.48.desc: As expected, [ROOT.GetNameDef] has succeeded where everyone else failed. [FROM.GetLeader] has accepted the terms that [ROOT.GetLeader] drew up. There will be peace between [FROM.GetNameDefCap] and [?global.ETH_peace_country.GetNameDef]. Together we can all now move on to more important matters.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.48.a: [ROOT.GetLeader] is the guarantor of peace in our time
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.50.desc: A [ROOT.GetAdjective] border post has come under fire from the [ITA.GetAdjective] side. The [ROOT.GetAdjective] fired back at the [ITA.GetAdjective] snipers and a lengthy firefight ensued. Soldiers were injured on both sides. A formal protest has been delivered to the [ITA.GetAdjective] government. They however, claim innocence, instead accusing our troops of starting the incident.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.50.a: This is far from acceptable behavior
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.51.desc: The [GER.GetAdjective] government has delivered an angry worded protest after an incident on the Italo-German border. Someone opened fire. Reports are extremely contradictory, some stating the exchange started from the Italian side, while none of the surviving border guards admitted to firing before the Germans opened up on them. The fact that the Italian soldiers were not behind any kind of shelter further strengthens these testimonies.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.52.desc: The recent party held at his majesty [ETH.GetLeader]’s residence has proven to be a great success. Whilst guests mingled and enjoyed delicacies imported from across the globe, [?ETH.host_nation.GetAdjective] politicians heard from [ETH.GetAdjective] exiles about the brutal [ITA.GetAdjective] occupation of the homeland. Many were swayed to support a greater commitment of [?ETH.host_nation.GetAdjective] resources in aiding us liberate [ETH.GetNameDef] someday.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.52.a: One step closer to going home.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.53.desc: The last few months have seen multiple efforts to lobby support among our hosts for aiding us in liberating [ETH.GetNameDef]. His majesty has penned letters to members of government and the military promoting our cause. Meanwhile, other exiles have made the rounds doing interviews and articles for a multitude of newspapers to rally support from the [?ETH.host_nation.GetAdjective] public. Although it has been difficult, it seems the mood of the nation is now moving towards direct military support to liberate [ETH.GetNameDef].
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.54.desc: Our recent fundraising efforts have proven very lucrative. The imperial treasury has seen a very healthy influx of cash from donors across the globe. It seems there are many who share our indignation over the occupation of [ETH.GetNameDef].
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.54.a: We shall not forget their contributions to the cause.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.55.desc: Recent efforts in promoting our cause have seen a steady influx of [?ETH.host_nation.GetAdjective] mercenaries offering their services to us in the coming battles. For a price, of course.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.55.a: Our forces grow stronger every day.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.56.desc: We have seen a number of [?ETH.host_nation.GetAdjective] pilots answering the call to aid us in the coming liberation of our homeland. They bring with them a wealth of experience that they are in the process of sharing with our own prospective pilots.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.56.a: We’ll take all the help we can get.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.57.desc: The recent call for [?ETH.host_nation.GetAdjective] sailors and ships willing to brave the enemy infested waters has been met with a number of willing volunteers. Retired navy personnel, civilian sailors and young volunteers simply in search of adventure have stepped forward to crew the motley fleet of cargo ships we have amassed from the breakers yards of [?ETH.host_nation.GetNameDef].
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.57.a: Let’s hope the ships are still sea worthy...
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.58.desc: The rifles purchased from [?ETH.host_nation.GetAdjective] manufacturers have been delivered to our troops residing in [?ETH.host_nation.GetName]. The new equipment is now being put to the test on the firing range and in exercises.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.59.desc: Our recent purchase of support equipment for the troops has now been delivered. While it might not be the most cutting edge equipment in the world, it will still be of great aid on the front line.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.60.desc: The tanks purchased from the [?ETH.host_nation.GetAdjective] army surplus have now been transferred to our armed forces. The tanks are older models that were mothballed in recent years. However, they are still in full working order and are now being used to train crews, ready for deployment to the front lines.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_exile_events.60.a: Any tank is better than no tank.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_imperial_events.1.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] wants to purchase the [ROOT.GetAdjective] colony of [268.GetName]. The purchase would give [FROM.GetNameDef] access to the sea via the port of Djibouti, to which there already is a rail connection from Addis Ababa. They are offering a decent sum for such an insignificant colony.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_imperial_events.1.a: We can put the money to good use
loc.BBA_ethiopia_imperial_events.1.b: It is [ROOT.GetAdjective], and will remain so!
loc.BBA_ethiopia_imperial_events.2.desc: The negotiations with the [FROM.GetAdjective] government over the potential purchase of the colony of [268.GetName], has ended successfully. [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has agreed to turn the port of Djibouti and the surrounding region over to [ROOT.GetName] with immediate effect, thus both giving us access to a port, uniting the Afar people under one ruler.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_imperial_events.3.desc: Unfortunately, the [FROM.GetAdjective] government has declined our request to purchase the port of Djibouti from them. Instead of seeing the mutual benefit, they desperately cling to their colonies and refuse to give up as much as an inch of the land they have grabbed.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_imperial_events.3.a: We will have to consider other methods
loc.BBA_ethiopia_imperial_events.4.desc: The Rastafarian movement in [689.GetName] claim that $ETH_haile_selassie$ is the Messiah or Jah, their name for god, reincarnate. Somewhat unexpectedly, $ETH_haile_selassie$ has embraced the reputation and the [FROM.GetAdjective] government has requested that the homeland of the movement, i.e. [689.GetName] be incorporated into the [FROM.GetAdjective] empire.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_imperial_events.4.a: What an odd request, but why not?
loc.BBA_ethiopia_imperial_events.4.b: We'll be part of the empire of Zion
loc.BBA_ethiopia_imperial_events.5.desc: Our humble request for transfer of control of [689.GetName] has been accepted by [FROM.GetNameDef]. This marks the beginning of a new era. Glory to $ETH_haile_selassie$. Hopefully this means we can attract followers from all across the Americas.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_imperial_events.6.desc: Despite our best efforts, we have not managed to convince the [FROM.GetAdjective] government that [689.GetName] is a part of the [ROOT.GetAdjective]. They laughed at our request, even bringing into doubt the divinity of our great leader.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_imperial_events.7.desc: The Rastafarian movement in [689.GetName] claim that $ETH_haile_selassie$ is the Messiah or Jah, their name for god, reincarnate. Somewhat unexpectedly, $ETH_haile_selassie$ has embraced the reputation. As a consequence of this, [FROM.GetLeader.GetSheHe] now requests that [ROOT.GetNameDef] officially join the [FROM.GetAdjective] and create a new power base in the Caribbean, from where the influence can be spread to the rest of the world.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_imperial_events.7.a: This sounds like a good idea
loc.BBA_ethiopia_imperial_events.8.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has taken the wise decision to accept our overlordship. [FROM.GetName] will be a loyal subject of [ROOT.GetLeader].
loc.BBA_ethiopia_imperial_events.9.desc: Unfortunately, [FROM.GetNameDef] refused the gracious offer to become a subject of [ROOT.GetLeader]. Despite our best efforts, we failed to convince the government of [FROM.getName] that this was indeed for the benefit of both parties.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_imperial_events.10.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has demanded our subjugation and integration into their nation. If we comply, it will of course be the end of [THIS.GetName] as an independent nation. It is not clear how far [FROM.GetLeader] is willing to go in order to achieve integration, but the possibility of armed conflict can not yet be ruled out.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_imperial_events.11.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] have refused to accept our demands for reintegration. Time and again [FROM.GetName] have been willing to betray us in order to protect themselves, we can not allow that to happen again.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_imperial_events.11.a: We will put an end to this.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_imperial_events.11.b: We have more important matters to deal with.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_imperial_events.12.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has accepted the need for reintegration with [THIS.GetName]. [FROM.GetLeader] has now sworn fealty to his majesty, [THIS.GetLeader].
loc.BBA_ethiopia_imperial_events.12.a: One less thing to worry about.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_imperial_events.20.desc: Having gathered support from the middle class and the peasantry of [ETH.GetName], Ras $ETH_ras_imru_haile_selassie$ announced the official dethronement of $ETH_haile_selassie$ and the introduction of general elections in [ETH.GetNameDef]. Generally regarded by the people, and even more importantly in this case, the [ETH.GetAdjective] army, as the true hero in the second Italo-Ethiopian War he has managed to secure the loyalty of the military and support for the absent emperor has failed to materialize.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_imperial_events.20.b: Installing the Crown Prince as a constitutional monarch is safer
loc.BBA_ethiopia_imperial_events.21.desc: Our troops continue to tear through the [ETH.GetAdjective] forces, making way for our superior rule. However, we are seeing an increase in resistance activity across our new dominion. It seems word of the former ruler, $ETH_haile_selassie$, speaking to the League of Nations has stirred many of our new subjects into a frenzy. It seems that so long as their emperor lives, resistance will be a thorn in the side of our colonial administration.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_imperial_events.21.a: They will submit to our rule, one way or another.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_military_and_tech_events.1_: The first ever class to finish the [GetEthiopianMilitaryAcademyName] will have to go straight from the school to the war. Having managed to build this school, and complete the education of a first class of cadets, while at the same time fighting a war, is truly a major feat. \nThis is the start of a new era for the [ROOT.GetAdjective] military!

With the war behind us, we have now the chance to finish the creation of our military academy. The first class of cadets can help our nation win future wars, and ensure we make the best possible use of our experience from fighting the Italians.
The school will preserve our focus on attack
The school will help us convert to a more defensive mindset
The school will ensure we are never unprepared for war
loc.BBA_ethiopia_anti_colonialism_events.2.d: [?global.african_supporting_country.GetLeader], the leader of [?global.african_supporting_country.GetNameDef], has requested an immediate end to the war with the [?global.african_revolt_country.GetAdjective] rebels. The [?global.african_supporting_country.GetAdjective] diplomats encourage [ROOT.GetName] to recognize the independence of [?global.african_revolt_country.GetNameDef]. They don't explicitly state that [?global.african_supporting_country.GetNameDef] will go to war should we decide to refuse, but they clearly hint at the possibility.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_anti_colonialism_events.2.a: They are right, we should end this colonial conflict now
loc.BBA_ethiopia_anti_colonialism_events.2.b: The war will end when [?global.african_revolt_country.GetNameDef] is defeated
loc.BBA_ethiopia_anti_colonialism_events.3.d: [?global.african_supporting_country.GetLeader], the leader of [?global.african_supporting_country.GetNameDef], has successfully negotiated with [?global.african_colonial_country.GetLeader] on our behalf. [?global.african_colonial_country.GetLeader] has agreed to recognize [ROOT.GetAdjective] independence and ordered a cessation of hostilities between [?global.african_colonial_country.GetNameDef] and [ROOT.GetNameDef]. [ROOT.GetNameDefCap] will always be indebted to [?global.african_supporting_country.GetNameDef] for their help in our struggles.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_anti_colonialism_events.4.d: Despite our pressure, the [?global.african_colonial_country.GetAdjective] government refuses to recognize [?global.african_revolt_country.GetNameDef] and cease hostilities. The [?global.african_colonial_country.GetAdjective] seem set on destroying the independence movement. This is probably as far as we can get with diplomacy alone.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_anti_colonialism_events.4.b: Then we have to make them
loc.BBA_ethiopia_anti_colonialism_events.5.d: After having attempted at mediation in our war against [?global.african_colonial_country.GetNameDef] and failed, [?global.african_supporting_country.GetNameDef] has decided to actively start supporting the [ROOT.GetAdjective] struggle. The [?global.african_colonial_country.GetAdjective] ambassador to [?global.african_supporting_country.GetName] has been informed that [?global.african_supporting_country.GetNameDef] considers itself at war with [?global.african_colonial_country.GetName] from this point on, until the moment that [?global.african_colonial_country.GetNameDef] gives up its imperialist and colonial ambitions in Africa and elsewhere.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_anti_colonialism_events.5.a: The forces of [ROOT.GetName] and [?global.african_supporting_country.GetName] stand united!
loc.BBA_ethiopia_anti_colonialism_events.6.d: After heavy diplomatic pressure from [ROOT.GetName], including direct meetings between [ROOT.GetLeader] and [?global.african_colonial_country.GetLeader], the [?global.african_colonial_country.GetAdjective] government decided to back down, and recognize [?global.african_revolt_country.GetAdjective] independence. \nThanks to direct [ROOT.GetAdjective] intervention, the war for [?global.african_revolt_country.GetAdjective] independence is finally over. [?global.african_revolt_country.GetNameDefCap] is a free country, and [ROOT.GetLeader] will surely for ever be a hero in [?global.african_revolt_country.GetNameDef].
loc.BBA_ethiopia_anti_colonialism_events.6.a: Another country liberated from the imperialists
loc.BBA_ethiopia_industrial_financial_events: Citing the fact that the economies of [ROOT.GetName] and [FROM.GetName] are so intertwined, and that much of the industry in [ROOT.GetName] is already controlled by [FROM.GetName], [FROM.GetLeader] demands that border stations between the two countries be removed. The control of all foreign policy is to be placed under the control of [FROM.Getname] to ensure maximum protection, coordination, and efficiency. In effect this would mean the end of [ROOT.GetAdjective] independence.\n All this will be done with the best interest of both countries in mind, [FROM.GetLeader] ensures.
They have no right to do this!
As long as we can retain some kind of autonomy
It really is for the best of both our countries

Despite our best efforts to explain the situation, [FROM.GetLeader] refuses to comply with our demands to take the integration of our economies to the next level. [FROM.GetLeader] claims that the independence of [FROM.GetName] must not be tarnished, and can never be part of any discussion whatsoever.
We might have to use force to protect our interests

[FROM.GetLeader] has seen the need to further our cooperation and coordinate foreign and financial policy even more than today. However, [FROM.GetLeader.GetSheHe] wants [FROM.GetNAme] to retain a degree of autonomy within the new federation.

[FROM.GetLeader] has signed the document that unites [ROOT.GetName] and [FROM.GetName]. The economic policies will be aligned, the foreign offices are to combined into one. The judicial systems will be merged to make full cooperation easier.\n[FROM.GetNameDefCap] will from this day be an integral part of [ROOT.GetName].
This is for the benefit of everyone
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.01.desc: $ETH_haile_selassie$'s confrontational approach to the Italians, combined with his trust in the League of Nations has led nowhere. It is obvious to everyone that this will be the doom of [ROOT.GetName].\n\n The war is an opportunity for change, it makes change of course a necessity even. The first course of action must be to send an ambassador to the Italians to negotiate a peace deal that they can accept.
loc.ETH_start_civil_war: §Y$ETH_haile_selassie_gugsa$§! will start a §Ycivil war§! against §Y$ETH_haile_selassie$§! when the §Y$ETH_declare_for_italy$§! focus is completed.
loc.ETH_cede_states_tt: \nWhen the war is over, §Y[ITA.GetNameWithFlag]§! will receive the following states:
loc.ETH_italy_refuse_cooperation: The focus §Y$ETH_reach_out_to_the_italians$§! will be cancelled, the focus §Y$ETH_rally_around_the_emperor$§! will be auto-completed.
loc.ETH_start_civil_war_gojjam: §Y$ETH_hailu_tekle_haymanot$§! of $gojjam$ will start a §Ycivil war§! against §Y$ETH_haile_selassie$§! when the §Y$ETH_declare_for_italy$§! focus is completed.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.01.c: Maybe $ETH_abba_jofir$ has the best chance to succeed
loc.ETH_start_civil_war_jimma: §Y$ETH_abba_jofir$§! of $jimma$ will start a §Ycivil war§! against §Y$ETH_haile_selassie$§! when the §Y$ETH_declare_for_italy$§! focus is completed.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.02.desc: One of the [ETH.GetAdjective] nobles, $ETH_haile_selassie_gugsa$, who also has a claim to the throne, has approached the [ROOT.GetAdjective] high command in [ETH.GetName]. The noble offers help against [ETH.GetLeader] in return for control of parts of the country after the war. $ETH_haile_selassie_gugsa$ will of course swear fealty to $ITA_vittorio_emanuele_iii$, ruling in his place in [ETH.GetName].
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.02.b: No, we don't need any help, thank you
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.03.desc: A representative of $gojjam$'s imprisoned pretender, $ETH_hailu_tekle_haymanot$ offers to support [ROOT.GetName] conquest of [ETH.GetName] in return for a reinstatement of $ETH_hailu_tekle_haymanot$ as leader of a semi-autonomous $gojjam$. An armed uprising in the north would surely cripple the [ETH.GetAdjective] forces and bring swift victory.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.03.b: No, we don't need any help, thank you
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.04.t: The Deposed Leader of $jimma$ Offers Assistance
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.04.desc: $ETH_abba_jofir$, son of the last sultan of $jimma$ has offered to collaborate with [ROOT.getName] in return for [ROOT.GetAdjective] acknowledgement of $ETH_abba_jofir$'s status as ruler of $jimma$. $jimma$ would, of course be part of the [ROOT.GetAdjective] empire, and $ETH_abba_jofir$ would swear fealty to the [ROOT.GetAdjective] crown, should [ROOT.getName] accept the offer.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.04.a: A puppet sultan could serve us well
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.04.b: No, we don't need any help, thank you
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.05.desc: The mission to the [FROM.GetAdjective] headquarters was met with great success. [ITA.GetLeader] has approved the plan for an uprising and accepted the survival of a semi-autonomous state after the war. We need to hurry to get the revolt started, before they change their minds.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.05.a: The start of a new era
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.06.desc: Unfortunately, [FROM.GetLeader] seems hell bent on conquering all of Ethiopia. [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has outright refused to discuss any kind peace treaty, effectively killing all attempts at finding a peaceful solution to the conflict. Our only hope now is to rally behind the emperor and try to achieve a military victory.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.07.desc: [ROOT.GetEthiopianCollaboratorName] has openly declared for the Italians, against the emperor, stating that this is the birth of a new [ROOT.GetName]. Despite being in a desperate position, $ETH_haile_selassie$ however refuses to accept defeat. Fighting has already started, and even though most of the old guard are still siding with the emperor, the fight can most likely only go one way.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.50.desc: With our focus on affairs closer to home, the [ETH.GetAdjective] government has taken advantage of the situation and claimed [ROOT.GetAdjective] Somaliland as their own. Cut off and with little hope of resisting, [Root.GetAdjective] authorities in the area have simply complied with handing over the territory. We must decide whether to formally acknowledge this humiliation, or resolve ourselves to the retaking of our rightful territory.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.50.a: We must grit our teeth and accept the loss.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.50.b: We will not stand for such humiliation!
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.51.desc: The rump state of [FROM.GetName] has formally accepted our control over the former territory of [FROM.GetAdjective] Somaliland. With little means of retaking the territory, it seems they would prefer to maintain focus on affairs closer to home, rather than getting bogged down in conflict with our heroic armed forces.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.52.desc: In a surprising turn of events, the rump state of [FROM.GetName] has rejected our claims of ownership over the former territory of [FROM.GetAdjective] Somaliland. Despite having little means of retaking the territory, it seems they are determined to send their remaining soldiers to die against our heroic armed forces.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.52.a: They have lost one recent war, and are about to lose another.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.53.desc: While we are making great progress in reforming our economy and strengthening our military, we could still benefit from some support in these tasks. Due to our deepening relations with the [ITA.GetAdjective]s, they may be open to sending us some of their surplus equipment. We simply need to decide what we should request.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.54.desc: We have received a request from [FROM.GetName] for military equipment. This would go a long way to helping the [FROM.GetAdjective] military with modernization. It would also help us clear out some of our older surplus equipment.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.54.a: Surely we can spare some old equipment.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.54.b: No, we don’t want [FROM.GetName] getting any stronger.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.55.desc: In an unnecessarily blunt reply, the [ITA.GetAdjective] government rejected our request for military equipment. It is not yet clear what the reasoning behind this decision is. We must simply rely on our own industry to continue the modernization plan.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.55.a: We knew they couldn’t be trusted.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.56.desc: The [ITA.GetAdjective] government has approved our request for military equipment. Although definitely not their best equipment, this will certainly accelerate our modernization plans.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.10.desc: With the surrender of the enemy forces, several of the high ranking officers have fallen into our hands. They will be imprisoned for now, but hopefully we might convince some of them to join our cause later.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.20.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has declared that [FROM.GetNameDef] will no longer accept [ROOT.GetAdjective] overlordship. [FROM.GetNameDefCap] wishes to maintain good relations with [ROOT.GetNameDef] if possible, but [FROM.GetLeader] states that they are ready to take up arms and fight for their independence, if necessary.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.20.a: They need to be taught a lesson
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.20.b: We have more important things to think about
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.21.desc: In a rather surprising turn of events, [FROM.GetLeader] accepted the [ROOT.GetAdjective] declaration of Independence. From this point on, [FROM.GetNameDef] holds no influence over [ROOT.GetAdjective] politics, neither internal nor external. A massive crowd, celebrating the leadership of [ROOT.GetLeader] has gathered in the main square of [ROOT.Capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName].
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.22.desc: As expected, [FROM.getLeader] refused the request for formal independence from [ROOT.GetLeader]. As this was an anticipated turn of events, the [ROOT.GetAdjective] armed forces are already securing key positions in the country. The nation is much better prepared this time.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.23.desc: Organized bands of resistance fighters have risen up behind enemy lines. These irregulars fight with us against their [ITA.GetAdjective] oppressors. Their fighting value may not be the highest, but they will surely cause confusion and disruption to the enemy armed forces.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.57.desc: [FROM.GetName] has requested an arms outsourcing agreement whereby [ITA.GetAdjective] companies would setup factories in their country for the production of military equipment. Corporate leadership of the chosen companies would doubtless be grateful for this opportunity to expand. However, should [FROM.GetName] ever rebel, we will be fighting an enemy who knows many of our weaknesses.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.57.a: Strengthening [FROM.GetName] will free up our forces in the area.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.57.b: We can not risk our designs falling into enemy hands.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.58.desc: To the credit of our diplomats, [ITA.GetLeader] has given permission for [ITA.GetAdjective] companies to setup factories in our country. This will rapidly accelerate our ability to research and manufacture our own military equipment.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.59.desc: Our despicable diplomats have failed to convince [ITA.GetLeader] of the necessity for our arms outsourcing agreement. This is a devastating blow for our military and industrial development.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.60.desc: The [ITA.GetAdjective]s will not be willing to share all of their industrial secrets with us for fear of them falling into enemy hands. Therefore, we must think carefully about what aspect of our military could benefit most from outsourcing production to [ITA.GetAdjective] designers.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.60.a: The army needs modernizing above all else.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.60.b: The air force will be more important in future wars.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.61.desc: [ETH.GetAdjective] diplomats have come to us with a secretive request for arms supplies. It seems all is not well in [ITA.GetName]’s recently acquired territory and the local administration is looking for foreign aid so that they might overthrow their overlords. Even if the rebellion fails, it would doubtless distract and weaken the [ITA.GetAdjective] military. However, there may be repercussions if it is discovered we had a hand in supporting the rebellion.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.61.b: We won’t aid a potential enemy.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.62.desc: [FROM.GetAdjective] diplomats have signaled that they are willing to begin shipping arms to us as we prepare to overthrow [ITA.GetAdjective] forces. We have of course been instructed to completely deny any involvement by them should [ITA.GetAdjective] forces discover the weapons.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.63.desc: [FROM.GetAdjective] diplomats have shunned our attempts to acquire secret arms supplies. It seems they are unsure of how trustworthy we are whilst still under [ITA.GetAdjective] influence. They may also be hesitant to risk angering the [ITA.GetAdjective] regime during these turbulent times.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.64.desc: [ETH.GetLeader] has requested control of [550.GetName] as a reward, or compensation depending on the point of view, for his continued loyalty to [ITA.GetName]. [ETH.GetLeader] was crucial in breaking the stalemate when invading Ethiopia and this would go a long way to maintaining good relations. However, the [ITA.GetAdjective] people may not be so understanding of why we are giving away territory.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.64.b: They are in no position to make demands.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.65.desc: [ETH.GetLeader] has requested control of [559.GetName] and [844.GetName] as a reward, or compensation depending on the point of view, for his continued loyalty to [ITA.GetName]. [ETH.GetLeader] was crucial in breaking the stalemate when invading Ethiopia and this would go a long way to maintaining good relations. However, the [ITA.GetAdjective] people may not be so understanding of why we are giving away territory.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.65.b: They are in no position to make demands.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.66.desc: [ITA.GetName] has graciously accepted our request for control of the requested territories. This marks the beginning of a new chapter in Italo-[ETH.GetAdjective] relations.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.66.a: The future belongs to the [ETH.GetAdjective] people.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.67.desc: [ITA.GetAdjective] diplomats have responded with indignation over our request for territorial compensation. They argue that it would be unpalatable to the [ITA.GetAdjective] people to hand over territory to anyone when it was paid for with their blood, let alone handing it to a former enemy.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.68.desc: Last night, an [ITA.GetAdjective] arms depot was successfully raided and stripped of weapons. Italian authorities are furiously accusing our administration of orchestrating the incident despite having very little evidence. Although they may grow suspicious of our soldiers brandishing shiny new [ITA.GetAdjective] rifles...
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.69.desc: [ETH.GetName]’s leadership has acknowledged the weakness of their military and have therefore requested our support. They are curious whether we would allow some of our officers to join their general staff and advise them on how best to utilize the tools of modern war.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.69.a: A stronger [FROM.GetName] would allow us to focus on regions closer to home.
loc.ETH_send_ita_generals_tt: \n§Y$ITA_giuseppe_tellera$§!, §Y$ITA_mario_berti$§! and §Y$ITA_alessandro_pirzio_biroli$§! will be transferred to Ethiopia.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.70.desc: [FROM.GetName] has agreed to allow some of their military officers to join our general staff for the foreseeable future. Hopefully we will learn how best to utilize our new equipment on the modern battlefield.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_fascist_events.71.desc: [FROM.GetName] have refused to allow their military officers to join our general staff. We have been informed that they are needed elsewhere at the moment. However, we have been sent an extra shipment of infantry equipment as a sign of support.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.01.desc: The communist leadership of [ETH.GetName] has reached out to us for aid in their struggle against the Italian fascists. The new regime in [ETH.Capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName] is still consolidating power and may be open to aligning themselves with our foreign policy ambitions if we offer them our support. However, we risk escalating the war and we will certainly anger [ITA.GetName] in the process.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.01.a: We will support our fellow communists in their struggle.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.01.b: We have no interest in these colonial entanglements in Africa.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.02.desc: Despite our desperate call for aid, [SOV.GetNameDef] have turned their backs on us. Although this is a set back, we will continue to resist the forces of fascism. We should now turn our attention to gaining support from the wider anti-fascist networks across the globe.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.03.desc: In recent days there have been disturbing reports of [ETH.GetAdjective] troops speaking Russian and using [SOV.GetAdjective] weaponry. We can only assume that the [SOV.GetName] are sending 'volunteers' to fight for [ETH.GetLeader] in the hopes of gaining influence in Africa and weakening support for [ITA.GetLeader]'s government in [ITA.GetName].
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.03.a: They will suffer for this act of aggression.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.04.desc: The [SOV.GetName] has agreed to send us material aid in the coming months as well as allowing 'volunteers' from the [SOV.GetAdjective] military to fight alongside us in our struggle against [ITA.GetName]. This will surely tip the balance in our favor, however, it is unclear how the [ITA.GetAdjective]s will react to [SOV.GetAdjective] troops fighting against them.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.04.a: Together, we will defeat fascism in Africa.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.05.desc: Today, members of the military and the anti-fascist organization known as the Black Lions orchestrated a coup against the government of [ROOT.GetLeader]. The emperor was due to inspect the troops when a group of disgruntled soldiers turned on him and their officers, placing them under arrest. \n\nMeanwhile in [ROOT.Capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName], the Black Lions captured the key infrastructure of the city, including the emperor's residence. Many loyalists from the military and police have been killed in minor skirmishes, but what remains of [ETH.GetName] is now under the control of a provisional government. The majority of the people, exhausted by the war with [ITA.GetName], have simply accepted the authority of their new government. Now, the first decision of the new administration is to decide the fate of [ROOT.GetLeader].
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.05.a: We can not risk losing the people's support. Exile him.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.05.b: All enemies of the people must answer for their crimes. Lock him up.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.06.desc: Military officers backed by the [SOV.GetName] have dissolved the provisional [ETH.GetAdjective] government. The officers claim they were provided evidence by the [SOV.GetAdjective] intelligence service that proved the government, led by [ROOT.GetLeader], had betrayed the people. According to the evidence, members of the government were in discussions to allow [ITA.GetAdjective] troops to fully occupy the country in exchange for vast amounts of personal wealth. Following shootouts with the Black Lions, the former members of the provisional government are believed to be dead or under arrest. \n\nThe military has now taken over leadership of the country to restore order and root out [ROOT.GetLeader]’s co-conspirators. It remains unclear how permanent the newly formed military administrative council will be.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.06.indy_de: Military officers have dissolved the provisional [ETH.GetAdjective] government. The officers claim they were provided evidence by the intelligence services that proved the government, led by [ROOT.GetLeader], had betrayed the people. According to the evidence, members of the government were in discussions to allow [ITA.GetAdjective] troops to fully occupy the country in exchange for vast amounts of personal wealth. Following shootouts with the Black Lions, the former members of the provisional government are believed to be dead or under arrest. \n\nThe military has now taken over leadership of the country to restore order and root out [ROOT.GetLeader]’s co-conspirators.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.06.a: The traitors got what they deserved.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.07.t: [SOV.GetNameDefCap] Demands an End to War with [ETH.GetName]
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.07.desc: [SOV.GetNameDefCap] have demanded an end to hostilities between us and the [ETH.GetAdjective]s. The [SOV.GetAdjective]s have been heavily involved in supporting the communist regime in [ETH.Capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName] and now see it as part of their sphere of influence. The Soviets are threatening to go so far as to get involved in the conflict militarily.  We risk humiliation at home if we agree to the Soviet demands. However, we risk a much wider conflict if we refuse them.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.07.a: We will not negotiate with communists.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.07.b: We can not risk a wider conflict right now.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.08.desc: [ETH.GetName] have requested infantry equipment to aid in their conflict with Italy. Without an influx of basic equipment, it is unlikely the [ETH.GetAdjective] military will be able to adequately arm their troops. However, if we choose to supply them with our equipment, it will most certainly damage our relations with [ITA.GetName] even more.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.08.a: We can not spare any equipment.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.08.b: Of course we will aid them.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.09.desc: The [SOV.GetName] have sent us the requested infantry equipment to aid in our struggle against [ITA.GetName]. This will certainly help bring us victory against the fascists.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.09.a: The war is tipping back in our favor.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.10.desc: The [SOV.GetName] have refused to send us infantry equipment. Despite the best attempts by our delegation to [SOV.capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName], it seems they are too preoccupied with their own troubles to spare anything for us.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.11.desc: [ETH.GetNameDefCap]'s new leadership has acknowledged the weakness of their military with regards to dealing with modern warfare. They have therefore requested our support in reorganizing their military. This would be a great opportunity to give our officers some experience in different environments, but it is also a chance for us to influence the internal power balance within [ETH.GetName].
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.11.a: This is an opportunity we can't miss.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.11.b: We can't risk foreign powers knowing our tactics.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.12.desc: The equipment promised by the [SOV.GetName] has arrived at our military depots and is now being distributed amongst our forces.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.14.desc: [ETH.GetNameDefCap] has requested our support with the development of their own air force. Their proposal includes sending volunteers to train alongside our pilots in older, surplus planes. This would be a fantastic opportunity for our pilots to get some more experience and for testing out our equipment against the [ITA.GetAdjective]s.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.14.b: We need to maintain our stockpile of aircraft.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.15.desc: Generals from [SOV.GetNameDef] arrived in [ROOT.Capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName] today. The advisors are being given an overview of the current structure of our armed forces and the current state of the war with [ITA.GetName]. Hopefully they will be able to help modernize our forces.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.16.desc: Our supposed friends in [SOV.Capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName] have refused to send military advisors to aid us in our military modernization effort. Despite this set back, we will overcome the fascists and continue our modernization alone.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.16.a: The [SOV.GetAdjective] can not be relied upon.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.17.desc: A delegation from [ETH.GetNameDef] have been urging our ministers and military to send our surplus armored vehicles to aid them in their war with [ITA.GetName]. The [ETH.GetAdjective]s are clearly at a disadvantage when engaging [ITA.GetAdjective] armor. If we were to send our equipment, it would certainly help them push back the [ITA.GetAdjective]’s, however, it would also raise tensions between the [SOV.GetNameDef] and [ITA.GetName].
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.17.a: An excellent opportunity for testing our equipment.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.18.desc: [SOV.GetNameDefCap] have refused to send us armored vehicles to counter the [ITA.GetAdjective]s. It seems that the [SOV.GetAdjective]’s are worried about escalating the tensions between themselves and the [ITA.GetAdjective]s.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.19.desc: [SOV.GetNameDefCap] have sent us armored vehicles to aid us in our struggle against the [ITA.GetAdjective]s. Although not their latest designs, the vehicles will no doubt prove valuable on the front lines, even if only to boost morale.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.20.desc: [SOV.GetNameDefCap] have rejected a proposal to train our pilots. It was hoped that this could accelerate the expansion of our air force, but it seems the soviets have other priorities right now. However, we have been given designs for manufacturing our own aircraft.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.20.a: Surely we can figure it out.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.21.desc: Our comrades in the [SOV.GetName] have agreed to aid us in the training of pilots. They have also generously provided a number of aircraft for us to use. This will rapidly accelerate our plans to create an air force capable of countering the [ITA.GetAdjective]s.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.21.a: We are grateful to our [SOV.GetAdjective] comrades!
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.22.desc: The [ITA.GetAdjective]s have so far ignored our demands to end their war against [ETH.GetName]. It has become clear that the only language they understand is brute force. If we continue on our current course, war between the [SOV.GetName] and [ITA.GetName] will be inevitable. If we back down now, we will ultimately lose everything gained in supporting [ETH.GetName] and our diplomatic weight on the world stage will be greatly diminished.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.23.desc: The Soviet Union have backpedaled on their recent war rhetoric and returned to strongly worded objections to our actions in Ethiopia. It seems their threat to go to war was nothing more than a bluff.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.24.desc: The diplomatic confrontation between [ITA.GetName] and [SOV.GetNameDef] has now erupted into open conflict. The [SOV.GetAdjective]s have guaranteed our independence and will now aid us on the battlefield to repel the [ITA.GetAdjective]s. However, it seems that this will come at the cost of our independence. From now on, we will need to make sure that our foreign policy is fully aligned with that of [SOV.Capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName].
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.25.desc: [ETH.GetNameDefCap] have reached out to us in the hopes we may be able to mediate between them and the [ITA.GetAdjective]s. The [ITA.GetAdjective]s have been unmoved by the strongly worded objections of the League of Nations, therefore any mediation from us will likely require the threat of force. We must think carefully about how much we are willing to risk for the sake of [ETH.GetNameDef].
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.25.a: We will help them end this war.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.25.b: We will help them. For a price.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.26.desc: [SOV.GetNameDefCap] has ruled out the possibility of mediating between us and the [ITA.GetAdjective]s. They cite [ITA.GetName]’s unwillingness to listen to the League of Nations and that they would therefore have to threaten the use of force. The risk of escalation to war between the two countries has been ruled to be too dangerous by [SOV.GetLeader].
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.26.a: They are using us to bleed the [ITA.GetAdjective]s
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.27.desc: [SOV.GetNameDefCap] has backtracked on its commitment to end [ITA.GetName]’s war of aggression. It seems their willingness to go to war was nothing more than a bluff. Now we face the difficult task of bringing this war to an end on our own.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.28.desc: The diplomatic confrontation between [ITA.GetName] and [SOV.GetNameDef] has now subsided with the [ITA.GetAdjective]s agreeing to end their war against us. The [SOV.GetAdjective]s have guaranteed our independence and made it clear that they consider an attack against us, as an attack on them. However, it seems the price for their aid in bringing this war to an end is our independence. From now on, we will need to make sure that our foreign policy is fully aligned with that of [SOV.Capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName].
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.28.a: We have to allow it. For now.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.29.desc: The diplomatic confrontation between [ITA.GetName] and [SOV.GetNameDef] has now subsided with the [ITA.GetAdjective]s agreeing to end their war against us.
