This is a huge victory against fascism, but it is unlikely to be the end of the struggle. Hopefully we can continue to cooperate with our friends in [SOV.Capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName].
loc.bba_news.1.desc: The threat of a major war erupting has startled leaders across the globe today. Soviet leader [SOV.GetLeader] has demanded that [ITA.GetLeader] end [ITA.GetName]’s illegal war against [ETH.GetNameDef]. [SOV.GetLeader] has made it clear that if [ITA.GetName] does not comply with this demand, [SOV.GetLeader.GetSheHe] will be willing to use force to make them do so. In recent months, the [SOV.GetAdjective]s have been keen to aid [ETH.GetNameDef] with equipment and advice. It is becoming increasingly clear that they now consider the country to be part of their own sphere of influence.
loc.bba_news.2.desc: \nIn a remarkable turn of events, [ITA.GetName] has agreed to a ceasefire with [ETH.GetName]. [ITA.GetAdjective] troops have also begun withdrawing to their original borders with [ETH.GetNameDef], surrendering any territorial gains they had achieved. [SOV.GetNameDefCap]’s apparent willingness to go to war for Ethiopia doubtless played a part in [ITA.GetLeader]’s decision to withdraw. It remains to be seen how the [ITA.GetAdjective] public will react to this humiliation.
loc.bba_news.3.desc: With the war in [ETH.GetName] descending into a war of attrition, the [ITA.GetAdjective]s have been forced into ceasefire negotiations. Most expected the [ETH.GetAdjective] military to simply dissolve following the recent communist uprising in the country, however [ETH.GetLeader] has managed to turn the war around, saving much of the nation from [ITA.GetAdjective] occupation. However, with much of East-Africa still under [ITA.GetAdjective] rule, it is unclear if the uneasy peace will last.
loc.bba_news.4.desc:
Members of the military and the anti-fascist organization known as the Black Lions have orchestrated a coup against the imperial government of $ETH_haile_selassie$. The emperor was due to inspect the troops when he was ambushed by them and placed under arrest.

Meanwhile in [ROOT.Capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName], the Black Lions captured the key infrastructure of the city, including the emperor's residence. Many loyalists from the military and police have been killed in minor skirmishes, but what remains of the nation is now under the control of a communist leaning provisional government. 

The majority of the people, exhausted by the war with [ITA.GetName], have simply accepted the authority of their new government.
loc.bba_news.4.b: The communist menace is on the march.
loc.bba_news.5.desc_owns_454: [ETH.GetLeader] has declared that due to his royal bloodline, supposedly stretching all the way back to the biblical King Solomon, he is the legitimate ruler of [454.GetName]. He went on to declare the rebirth of Ethiopia as the Empire of Solomon. Having already wrestled control of [454.GetName] from the great powers, [ETH.GetLeader] intends to move the capital of his empire to the region. It remains to be seen whether there will be geopolitical repercussions to Ethiopia’s Solomonic restructuring.
loc.bba_news.5.desc_does_not_own_454: [ETH.GetLeader] has declared that due to his royal bloodline, supposedly stretching all the way back to the biblical King Solomon, he is the legitimate ruler of [454.GetName]. The specter of yet another territorial grievance will doubtless spark fears in the capitals of the region, but it remains to be seen whether there will be geopolitical repercussions to Ethiopia’s Solomonic restructuring.
loc.bba_news.5.a: Glory to the one true heir of Solomon!
loc.bba_news.6.desc: In a truly bizarre turn of events, the Emperor of Ethiopia, [ETH.GetLeader] has embraced a fringe religious movement in the Caribbean known as ‘Rastafarianism.’ Obviously not content with merely being an emperor, [ETH.GetLeader] is now being worshiped by the Rastafarians as the literal embodiment of god or more specifically ‘Jah.’ Ethiopia itself has been reorganized as the ‘Empire of Zion.’ It remains to be seen whether this religious upheaval will lead to changes in Ethiopian foreign policy or geopolitical instability.
loc.bba_news.7.desc: Rumors are swirling that the annexation of [AFA.GetNameDef] by [ITA.GetAdjective] forces may be imminent. [ITA.GetAdjective] troops have been seen amassing on the border of the isolated nation and sources indicate that pressure is being exerted diplomatically in [AFA.Capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName] to force a capitulation without bloodshed. It remains to be seen whether [AFA.GetLeader] can resist the [ITA.GetAdjective] pressure, but the situation does not look promising.
loc.bba_news.7.b: We should prepare for the inevitable.
loc.bba_news.8.desc: Perhaps unsurprisingly to many, [AFA.GetNameDef] has accepted [ITA.GetAdjective] demands for subjugation. While the [AFA.GetAdjective] government held out hope of avoiding occupation, it became increasingly clear that the colonial powers of the region would not be coming to their aid, nor would neighboring [ETH.GetName] be able to spare military personnel to support them. With the situation so bleak, the government bowed to [ITA.GetAdjective] pressure to spare the people becoming the victims of unnecessary bloodshed. \n\n[ITA.GetAdjective] forces are now moving into the small nation to take up new positions on the border with [ETH.GetNameDef]. It is unclear whether the occupation will be permanent, or how it will impact the wider [ITA.GetAdjective] conflict with [ETH.GetName].
loc.bba_news.8.b: This will stretch our forces even more.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.30.desc: Representatives from [ETH.GetNameDefCap] have requested a ceasefire in our current conflict with them. The war has not ended as swiftly as we had hoped and this would give us an opportunity to strengthen our position in the region or deal with other pressing issues.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.30.a: We will stop the fighting. For now.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.30.b: Victory is in our grasp, we won’t stop now.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.31.desc: The [ITA.GetAdjective]s have agreed to a ceasefire in our current conflict. Hopefully this will give us an opportunity to build a lasting peace between our nations. However, we should remain vigilant as the conflict could erupt again at any moment.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.31.a: Finally, an end to the bloodshed.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.32.desc: The [ITA.GetAdjective]s have refused to take part in a ceasefire It seems they are intent on the complete destruction of [ETH.GetNameDefCap]. The people will now know that the fascists can not be reasoned with and that our freedom depends on everyone doubling their efforts.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.32.a: We will continue to make them suffer.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.33.desc: During our conflict with the [ITA.GetAdjective]s, we managed to liberate Eritrea from the fascists. We now have the opportunity to give the people of the region independence. However, the [ITA.GetAdjective]s will doubtless be frustrated by this move and it could destabilize our fragile peace with them.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.34.desc: During our conflict with the [ITA.GetAdjective]s we managed to liberate Somalia from the fascists. We now have the opportunity to give the people of the region independence. However, the [ITA.GetAdjective]s will doubtless be frustrated by this move and it could destabilize our fragile peace with them.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.35.desc: Having aided us in the civil war, representatives from [ETH.GetNameDef] have requested that we now begin the process of decolonization. They state that if we are true to the values we fought for in the civil war, we must support self-determination for the people of Africa. [ETH.GetLeader] has proposed working together to establish an independent Republic of the Rif in northern Morocco.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.35.a: We stand with the people of Africa.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.35.b: They have no right to lecture us.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.36.desc: [SPC.GetNameDefCap] have agreed with our proposal to establish an independent Republic of the Rif in northern Morocco. This is a positive step in the struggle for independence across Africa and the wider world.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.37.desc: [SPC.GetNameDefCap] have responded with indignation at our suggestion that they should lose territory in Africa. They have shown themselves to be no better than the fascists or imperialists they apparently oppose.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.37.a: Then we shall liberate them by force.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.38.desc: Having recently fought against fascism in their homeland, volunteers from [ETH.GetNameDef] have arrived in Spain to aid us in our struggle. [ETH.GetLeader] has pledged [ETH.GetLeader.GetHerHis] support to our cause and has promised material aid in the coming months.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.39.desc: With the liberation of the Rif region from [SPC.GetNameDef], we have an opportunity to force them into peace negotiations. Having betrayed our trust on the issue of decolonization, we could alternatively continue the war into [SPC.GetNameDef] itself.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.39.b: We will make sure they are no longer a threat.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.40.desc: We have failed in maintaining control of our territory in Africa. The [ETH.GetName] government, having achieved their objectives, have reached out to us in the hopes of negotiating peace between us.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.41.desc: [ETH.GetNameDefCap] have informed us that all our military advisors must leave the country immediately. It seems [ETH.GetLeader] intends to take the country in a more independent direction. If we do not act soon, we may lose control of the regime in [ETH.Capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName]
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.41.a: After all we have done for them.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.46.desc: [ETH.GetAdjective] diplomats have approached us with an offer of peace. The offer depends on us agreeing to relinquish claims on the [SUD.GetAdjective] territory we have lost to [ETH.GetNameDef] during this conflict. The diplomats also state that a [SUD.GetAdjective] government will be established in the region. The independence of the government remains to be seen.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.46.a: We will not surrender our territory.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.46.b: We have no choice but to agree.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.47.desc: [ETH.GetAdjective] diplomats have approached us with an offer of peace. The offer depends on us agreeing to relinquish claims on the [DJI.GetAdjective] territory we have lost to [ETH.GetNameDef] during this conflict. The diplomats also state that a [DJI.GetAdjective] government will be established in the region. The independence of the government remains to be seen.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.47.a: We will not surrender our territory.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.47.b: We have no choice but to agree.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.48.desc: [ETH.GetAdjective] diplomats have approached us with an offer of peace. The offer depends on us agreeing to relinquish claims on the [ERI.GetAdjective] territory we have lost to [ETH.GetNameDef] during this conflict. The diplomats also state that a [ERI.GetAdjective] government will be established in the region. The independence of the government remains to be seen.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.48.a: We will not surrender our territory.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.48.b: We have no choice but to agree.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.49.desc: [ETH.GetAdjective] diplomats have approached us with an offer of peace. The offer depends on us agreeing to relinquish claims on the [KEN.GetAdjective] territory we have lost to [ETH.GetNameDef] during this conflict. The diplomats also state that a [KEN.GetAdjective] government will be established in the region. The independence of the government remains to be seen.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.49.a: We will not surrender our territory.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.49.b: We have no choice but to agree.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.50.desc: [ETH.GetAdjective] diplomats have approached us with an offer of peace. The offer depends on us agreeing to relinquish claims on the [SOM.GetAdjective] territory we have lost to [ETH.GetNameDef] during this conflict. The diplomats also state that a [SOM.GetAdjective] government will be established in the region. The independence of the government remains to be seen.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.50.a: We will not surrender our territory.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.50.b: We have no choice but to agree.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.51.desc: [ETH.GetAdjective] diplomats have approached us with an offer of peace. The offer depends on us agreeing to relinquish claims on the [UGA.GetAdjective] territory we have lost to [ETH.GetNameDef] during this conflict. The diplomats also state that a [UGA.GetAdjective] government will be established in the region. The independence of the government remains to be seen.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.51.a: We will not surrender our territory.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.51.b: We have no choice but to agree.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.52.desc: The [ETH.GetAdjective] administration has orchestrated an operation to break our hold over the nations affairs. [SOV.GetAdjective] personnel across [ETH.Capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName] were escorted by [ETH.GetAdjective] troops to makeshift detention centers before [ETH.Getleader] informed our ambassador that [ETH.GetLeader.GetSheHe] would be taking full control of [ETH.GetAdjective] affairs going forward. If we act quickly, we may be able to regain control of the situation. However, the window of opportunity for such action is rapidly diminishing.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.52.a: We have more important matters to deal with.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.52.b: We will teach them the errors of their ways.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.53.desc: In a disappointing turn of events, [SOV.GetAdjective] diplomats have informed us that they can not spare any military personnel at the moment. They cite security concerns closer to their own borders that must take priority. However, as a gesture of good will, they have sent us a shipment of infantry equipment.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.54.desc: With the recent influx of [JAP.GetAdjective] volunteers joining our struggle, we have been informed that the government in [JAP.Capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName] is in the process of sending material aid in the form of infantry equipment. The influx of equipment will be a huge boost to the revolution. However, the [JAP.GetAdjective] government wish us to keep quiet about the origin of the equipment to avoid diplomatic repercussions from the other great powers.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.55.desc: The Kenpeitai are reporting that a number of subversives have slipped out of imperial jurisdiction aboard cargo ships heading for East-Africa. Rumor has it that among them were $IA_sakutaro_iwasa$ and $IA_sanshiro_ishikawa$. It is likely they intend to join the revolutionary movement in [ETH.GetNameDef].
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.55.b: Those traitors must be extradited to [JAP.GetName], immediately!
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.56.desc: The intelligence services have informed us that they aided a number of volunteers in gaining safe passage to East-Africa so they may aid the revolutionary movements there. Among the volunteers were $IA_sakutaro_iwasa$ and $IA_sanshiro_ishikawa$.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.56.b: Maybe we can do more to support [ETH.GetNameDef]'s struggle...
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.57.desc: We have received a formal request from the government of [JAP.GetName] demanding the extradition of any [JAP.GetAdjective] subjects who arrive in the country with the intention of joining our revolutionary movement. While it is not clear what they intend to do, the request makes clear that there will be repercussions for not submitting to the demand.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.57.a: We will not submit to reactionary threats. And about their emperor...
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.58.desc: As was to be expected, the revolutionary rabble running [ETH.GetNameDef] have refused to extradite the [JAP.GetAdjective] dissidents arriving in the country. In a most vulgar lack of diplomatic protocol, their reply also contained a multitude of threats towards our glorious emperor!
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.58.a: What else can we expect from fools who destroy their heritage.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.58.b: We will not stand for such insults!
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.59.desc: It seems our recent rejection of [JAP.GetAdjective] demands has struck a nerve with their government. It has been announced that they intend to embargo us for the foreseeable future due to what they call ‘harmful ideological activity’ in the region of East-Africa.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.59.a: We don't need their trade anyway.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.60.desc: Ambassadors from [FROM.GetNameDef] have rejected our peace proposal. They argue that our attack against them was completely unwarranted and therefore, they will accept nothing but unconditional surrender from us for being a threat to regional peace.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.60.a: How hypocritical, their imperial violence can only be stopped by force.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.61.desc: [FROM.GetAdjective] diplomats have approached us with an offer of peace. The offer depends on us agreeing to relinquish claims on the [?ETH.ETH_disputed_colony.GetAdjective] territory we have lost to [FROM.GetNameDef] during this conflict. The diplomats also state that votes will be held in the relinquished [?ETH.ETH_disputed_colony.GetAdjective] territories to elect a new government. How independent said elections will be is not yet clear.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.61.a: We will not surrender our territory.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.61.b: We have no choice but to agree.
loc.BBA_ethiopia_communist_events.62.desc: Diplomats from [FROM.GetNameDef] have informed us that their government are willing to relinquish claims on [?ETH.ETH_disputed_colony.GetAdjective] territory that we have liberated. They are now withdrawing their forces to the newly established borders in the region.
loc.BBA_african_union_events.1.t: The Organization of African Unity Offers Membership
loc.BBA_african_union_events.1.desc: The Organization of African Unity has voted to offer us membership status. The Organization is intended to bring the nations of Africa together to discuss and cooperate on issues of mutual interest. If we were to join, it may lead to mutual defense agreements between the member states. However, we would also have to abide by the rules of the organization.
loc.BBA_african_union_events.1.b: We have no interest in their club.
loc.BBA_african_union_events.2.t: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] Joins the Organization of African Unity
loc.BBA_african_union_events.2.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has accepted a membership offer for the Organization of African Unity. Hopefully this will be the start of a more cooperative relationship between our nations.
loc.BBA_african_union_events.3.t: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] Rejects Organization of African Unity Membership
loc.BBA_african_union_events.3.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has rejected our membership offer for the Organization of African Unity. It is yet unclear if this is merely due to internal politics or a sign that their foreign policy ambitions in Africa are incompatible with our own. Perhaps they will be willing to join in the future.
loc.BBA_african_union_events.4.desc: The Organization of African Unity has created an [ETH_GetCentralBankName] with the mandate to manage a currency for the growing organization. The goal is for all members to share a currency and begin integrating our economies together. This will hopefully have economic benefits in the future, but joining will cause a great deal of problems in the short term as people get used to the new currency.
loc.BBA_african_union_events.4.a: The short term pain will be worth it.
loc.BBA_african_union_events.5.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap]’s government has refused to join the [ETH_GetCentralBankName], instead preferring to maintain control of their own currency and trade tariffs for the foreseeable future.
loc.BBA_african_union_events.6.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has agreed to join the [ETH_GetCentralBankName] and have now begun the process of aligning their currency with our own. Soon, trade will be much easier between our nations.
loc.BBA_african_union_events.7.t: Organization of African Unity Executive Council
loc.BBA_african_union_events.7.desc: The Organization of African Unity has established an executive council to manage the political affairs of its members. The council consists of representatives from member states and attempts to steer foreign and domestic policy in a unified direction. Joining would be a step towards full political and economic integration with the other member states. However, this would obviously entail a loss of our current political independence if we were to join.
loc.BBA_african_union_events.7.a: We are committed to deeper integration.
loc.BBA_african_union_events.7.b: We didn’t sign up for this.
loc.BBA_african_union_events.8.desc: The government of [FROM.GetNameDef] has agreed to join the Organization of African Unity's executive council. They are now in the process of signing the appropriate treaties recognizing the councils authority in all legal matters.
loc.BBA_african_union_events.8.a: A step closer to full integration.
loc.BBA_african_union_events.9.desc: The government of [FROM.GetNameDef] has refused to join the Organization of African Unity's executive council. [FROM.GetLeader] cites [FROM.GetLeader.GetHerHis] concerns about sovereignty and desire to make agreements with nations outside of the organization without council approval.
loc.BBA_african_union_events.9.a: Why are they even a member state?
loc.BBA_african_union_events.10.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] have started a propaganda campaign in our nation to try and improve the perception of the Organization of African Unity. This is undoubtedly to put pressure on us to pursue greater integration into the organization.
loc.BBA_african_union_events.10.a: They shouldn’t be meddling in our affairs.
loc.BBA_african_union_events.11.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] have threatened members of our government personally if we do not begin aligning our policy objectives with theirs. This is undoubtedly to put pressure on us to pursue greater integration into the Organization of African Unity.
loc.BBA_african_union_events.11.a: We will take greater care in future.
loc.BBA_african_union_events.11.b: We will not be bullied by [ETH.GetLeader].
loc.BBA_african_union_events.12.desc: The African Union has started the process of fully integrating us into their union. Hopefully this will lead to a more positive chapter of history for our people, but it remains to be seen what the ultimate goal of the African Union will be.
loc.BBA_african_union_events.12.a: We knew this day would come.
loc.BBA_african_union_events.13.t: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] Leaves the Organization of African Unity
loc.BBA_african_union_events.13.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has announced [FROM.GetNameDef]’s withdrawal from the Organization of African Unity. They have cited concerns over the direction of the organization and accused us of betraying the values that it was founded upon.
loc.BBA_african_union_events.14.t: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] Leaves the Organization of African Unity
loc.BBA_african_union_events.14.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has announced [FROM.GetNameDef]’s withdrawal from the Organization of African Unity. They have cited concerns over the direction of the organization and accused us of betraying the values that it was founded upon.
loc.BBA_african_union_events.15.t: Organization of African Unity Defense Agreement
loc.BBA_african_union_events.15.desc: The Organization of African Unity has proposed a mutual defense agreement between member states. This would mean an attack on any member would be considered an attack on all member states. This would hopefully deter foreign aggressors from attacking members of the organization and prevent war among members.
loc.BBA_african_union_events.15.b: We aren't interested in such an arrangement.
loc.BBA_african_union_events.16.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has rejected the Organization of African Unity's defense agreement. It remains to be seen if this marks a shift in their long term stance on the organization, or that the proposal is simply badly timed due to domestic politics.
loc.BBA_african_union_events.17.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has agreed to join the Organization of African Unity’s defensive pact. We will now be obligated to protect each other in the event of an attack on either party.
loc.BBA_african_union_events.18.t: Organization of African Unity's Defense Agreement Invoked
loc.BBA_african_union_events.18.desc: A signatory of the Organization of African Unity’s mutual defense agreement has been attacked. As a fellow signatory, we are now obliged to aid them militarily. If we were to refuse, we would doubtlessly be removed from the agreement and potentially damage diplomatic relations with our fellow signatories.
loc.BBA_african_union_events.18.a: Of course we will defend them.
loc.BBA_african_union_events.19.desc: [FROM.GetName] have agreed to uphold their defense commitments as a fellow signatory of the Organization of African Unity’s mutual defense agreement.
loc.BBA_african_union_events.20.desc: [FROM.GetName] have refused to uphold their defense commitments despite being fellow signatories of the Organization of African Unity’s mutual defense agreement. We are now in the process of having them removed from the agreement.
loc.BBA_african_union_events.21.desc: Our economic output took a hit recently with the adaption of the [ETH_GetCentralBankName]’s new currency. However, our production and output is now beginning to increase once again, even beyond previous records. Economists attribute the growth to the removal of trade barriers between [THIS.GetNameDef] and the other members using the shared currency which has allowed for deeper integration of our economies.
loc.BBA_african_union_events.22.desc: The leadership of [FROM.GetNameDef] have responded with indignation to our attempts at intimidating them. It seems unlikely they will be willing to cooperate in the near future.
loc.BBA_african_union_events.22.a: They can’t keep this up forever.
loc.BBA_african_union_events.23.desc: The leadership of [FROM.GetNameDef] have made a concerted effort to alleviate our concerns about policy alignment within the Organization of African Unity. They have gone so far as to promise consultation with our ambassadors before making any rash decisions in future.
loc.BBA_italy_second_italo_ethiopian_war.1.d: We have [FROM.GetName] on the run! Our mighty armies have inflicted such heavy losses that the [FROM.GetAdjective]s are crawling on their bare knees, begging for peace. Our country is a war-torn one and peace would be much welcomed, but this might also be a great opportunity to press our victory even further - to make sure that no other foolish European country tries to conquer unconquerable Ethiopia again!
loc.BBA_italy_second_italo_ethiopian_war.2.d: Our generous offer of peace has been accepted by the Abyssinians. This is far from the glorious victory we imagined at the outset of the war, but perhaps we can take comfort in the fact that the war is now over. We will overcome this humiliation like we have done so many times before, and we will rise up - stronger than ever!
loc.BBA_italy_second_italo_ethiopian_war.3.d: If it is war they want, we will oblige! The Abyssinians have refused our generous peace offer and are determined to fight on. We will show those ungrateful fools what true Italian grit is made of! This is merely a setback. We will push them back into the mountains and then completely overrun them.
loc.BBA_italy_second_italo_ethiopian_war.3.a: We will turn the tide of war!
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.02_north.desc: The expected success of our counter-offensive in Northern Abyssinia is nowhere to be seen. The Duce swears that the entire world is laughing at him and the lack of progress in the war. He is of half a mind to personally take charge of the northern offensive to make sure the troops are properly motivated and led.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.02_north.b: We need a change of leadership!
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.04_south.desc: The Southern counter-offensive in Abyssinia has not reached the goals the Duce wanted, which has left him rambling for hours about being surrounded by incompetency and idiocy. He seems certain that the military high command is working against him and that the Generals want to see the entire war fail.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.04_south.b: We need a change of leadership!
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.03_north.desc: Mussolini has nothing but praise and admiration for the armies in northern Abyssinia and their success in pushing back their fierce opponents. He of course never doubted the prowess of our troops - as long as they got the right motivation from their Duce and the tools to prevail.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.03_north.a: We have them on the run now!
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.05_south.desc: Overjoyed by the recent gains in Southern Abyssinia, Mussolini applauds the bravery of the Italian troops and their dedication to putting an end to this conflict. He never had any misgivings and fully trusted our armies to best the enemies on the battlefield - once they got the proper support from their Duce.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.05_south.a: We have pushed back the enemy!
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.11.desc: The Duce now wants a swift end to the war in Abyssinia, so that Italy can turn elsewhere for further glories. Conquering the ancient lands of Axum would solidify Italy’s place as one of the major empires of the world. \n\nWhatever Abyssinian strongholds that are left need to be dealt with and all of the Abyssinian lands need to be in Italian hands.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.12.desc: The fact that Abyssinia is still free and resisting occupation has had the Duce raging for hours on end, calling it an embarrassment; not only for him personally but for Italy and its people too. If only he could have overseen the last phases of the war himself it would have been done by now, he complains to everyone in his vicinity.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.12.a: The Abyssinians are putting up a hard fight
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.13.desc: Mussolini is ecstatic and brags far and wide to anyone willing to listen or otherwise about our recent victory. He never had any doubt that Italy would prevail and triumph in Abyssinia, despite the various setbacks we encountered. We have finally avenged the failure of the first Italo-Abyssinian war! \n\nThe Duce has hailed the conquest as a victory for the fascist system and his government, calling the Italian people stronger and more unified than ever before.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.13.a: Blood alone moves the wheels of history
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.21.desc: The Duce has publicly declared how the Abyssinians are crushed and on the run, their will broken after their defeat. Privately though, he curses the Abyssinians for their resilience and defiance toward Italian rule. The Duce has given the order to crack down on local opposition with brute force and to institute laws to keep the population in check. He wants the entire country pacified and brought into the Italian fold as soon as possible.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.21.a: We will bring peace and stability
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.22.desc: Abyssinia is still nowhere near being pacified, and the resistance to Italian occupation remains stiff. The Duce has no kind words for either the Abyssinian people or the efforts to quell the opposition and calls the operation a national embarrassment. He complains that the Italian colonists have a rough appearance and crude manners, which is not instilling any respect in the local population.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.22.a: The Abyssinians are tougher than expected
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.23.desc: We have finally managed to quell the resistance in Abyssinia, from the high mountain tops to the low desert plains its people are finding their place within the Italian fold. Delighted, Mussolini has declared that he can finally turn his attention to other matters so that Italy might prosper and claim what rightfully belongs to it.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.31.desc: For Italy to truly flourish, the Duce has a plan to expand our production capabilities. To accomplish this vision of a prospering nation, we need more factories that can sustain the growth of our bustling empire.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.32.desc: The Duce has found the lack of progress to build up the nation’s industrial capacity disturbing. He bemoans the constraints that are put upon him - by no fault of his own - which makes his vision of a prosperous Italy so much harder to realize.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.33.desc: The newly built factories have been hailed by Mussolini as the first step in the modernization of the Italian industries. The Duce is very pleased with how this raises the production capacity of the country and how it will allow him to further his visions for a greater Italy.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.41.desc: Like the Roman Empire of old, our burgeoning empire is stretching far and wide and needs a strong army to protect it from the hordes of barbarians just beyond the borders. The Duce is confident that for Italy to contend with the other major powers we need to be able to put strength behind our words - or no one will take us seriously!
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.42.desc: The lack of Italian soldiers is a returning concern of the Duce who sees our long borders with our rivals as a point of vulnerability. The Duce feels thwarted after our recently failed attempt to bolster the number of troops and has started to question the devotion of the people to his cause of restoring Italian greatness.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.43.desc: Mussolini has personally inspected some of the newly fielded troops that will protect our borders - and expand them if their Duce deems it necessary. He is very pleased with the increased numbers of divisions and boasts about how it is by his foresight alone that Italy now has a respectable army that even our enemies can not deny the strength of.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.51.desc: Our recent conflicts have laid bare certain shortcomings in our logistical support for the army. The Duce has been convinced by the Italian high command to order a new supply fleet of trucks. Originally he wanted 5000 brand new Italian trucks assembled, but he’s been talked down to accepting fewer - after being reassured that it will suffice.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.52.desc: The failed delivery of new trucks for the army has had the Duce criticizing the industrial forces put behind the effort, complaining about the lack of vision. He is convinced that no one but him can truly see the great potential for Italy and its people.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.52.a: Our armies will have to do without
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.53.desc: Mussolini personally congratulated the factories involved in producing the new trucks for the army - calling the workers the backbone of Italy. He is now anticipating a more mobile military force that can move fast over large swathes of terrain without having to be constrained by lagging logistics.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.53.a: Surely this will make our armies invincible
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.61.desc: A modern army marches not only on its stomach but also on its fuel, and if there is none the entire war machine grinds to a halt. The Italian high command has finally persuaded the Duce that a modern military will be stopped dead in its tracks by the lack of fuel. All branches of the military need it, and we must be able to provide gas in large quantities if we are to be successful on the battlefields.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.62.desc: The lack of fuel reserves is a constant worry for the military high command, who fear that airplanes will be grounded, the battleships anchored, and the armies standing still. The Duce is sure that Italy will persevere - as always - but is fuming that his explicit orders haven’t been fulfilled yet.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.63.desc: Mussolini is fully confident that the Italian military is ready to wage a full-scale war now and not run out of fuel immediately. The military high command might not be quite as reassured but are nevertheless alleviated by the reserve that has been gathered so far.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.63.a: Our reserves will surely come in handy
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.71.desc: Ever since the Duce first formed the Regia Aeronautica, it has become a symbol of national pride and one of the greatest air forces in the world. The only problem is that it’s too small, and the Duce has now been convinced to produce additional aircraft to reinforce the Aeronautica.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.72.desc: The production of new aircraft had been planned to be a great propaganda piece by the Duce, who now has to scale back his original intentions. The lack of large amounts of new airplanes has the Duce livid and is looking for someone to blame for this fiasco.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.73.desc: Mussolini has taken a personal interest in strengthening the air force and used the production of new aircraft as an opportunity to showcase Italian industrialism. With the Regia Aeronautica at its center, several pieces of propaganda have been made celebrating Italian aviation and engineering.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.81.desc: The Duce has decided to showcase the superiority of the fascist system, and how it can focus resources and effort more effectively. He aims to show the Italians - and the rest of the world - at what great speed fascism can accomplish great leaps in technology. He also hopes that this will rally and unify the historically divided Italian people under fascism.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.82.desc: Trying to demonstrate the strengths of the fascist system has backfired on the Duce, who has been cursing anyone getting within earshot. Instead of rallying people around fascism, people are more skeptical and whispering among themselves about what a fool Mussolini is. Or so the Duce believes at least.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.83.desc: The advertised technological leap the fascist system could make has paid off, and Mussolini has not hesitated to exhibit the innovations produced under his leadership. The message is as much about fascism as it is about Mussolini and his vision for Italy. Whether this will rally and unify the Italians in the way the Duce had hoped for remains to be seen.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.91.desc: The Duce has been swayed to boost additional resources toward our Intelligence Service, with promises of it becoming one of the world’s finest. This in turn has led him to publicly brag about how our agents have infiltrated every aspect of Italian society to drag communists, criminals, and other harmful elements into the light and brought to justice, making Italy more secure.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.92.desc: Instead of strengthening the Intelligence Service, several classified documents have been leaked - leaving a damning impression of our agents. Even though the documents did not contain secrets of any great significance, it is an embarrassment to the Duce who not long ago boasted about our intelligence apparatus. This will not only anger the Duce but also cause doubt in the minds of the Italian people and our enemies about our capabilities.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.93.desc: The competence of our intelligence service has been proven beyond doubt after several dissenting citizens were captured for plotting to damage the fascist government of Italy with foreign aid. Mussolini has used this success to illustrate how it is by his guidance that Italy will prevail and overcome any hardships the future might bring.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.101.desc: The strong ties between Italy and Albania go back millennia, to the Roman Empire. There is a strong historical connection between our two nations, a connection the Duce is determined to see deepened. He wants to incorporate Albania into Italy and has demanded a swift occupation of the country so that we fully control the inlet to the Adriatic Sea. This will bring glory and prestige to Italy, which for too long has been viewed as a lesser power by many other nations - or so he contends.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.102.desc: The fact that our soldiers struggle to make any headway in Albania has perplexed the Duce who calls it a national embarrassment. In private he furiously mumbles about how this was supposed to be a glorious moment for Italy - and himself - and how it would vindicate our humiliating withdrawal from there almost 20 years ago. Instead, he says, we have been betrayed by incompetence and cowardice.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.103.desc: Mussolini delightfully declared that our troops were victorious in Albania, to an enthusiastic crowd. He continued with how the entire country now is in our grip and how this will lead Italy to further greatness and glory. The days of the old empires are numbered and the days of Italy are yet to come, he proclaimed.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.111.desc: Even though we were among the victors in the Great War and had been promised Dalmatia through the London Pact, we were betrayed by our so-called allies. We never received what was promised to us, so now we have to take it by force, the Duce asserts. He further stated that it lies in Italy’s destiny to take what rightfully belongs to us - no matter what the old powers say.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.112.desc: What was supposed to be a rapid invasion of the Adriatic coast has turned into a slog. Our troops have been bogged down in Dalmatia and have not been able to deliver the grand conquest that was promised to the Italian people. The Duce has been found on a few occasions in an almost catatonic state mumbling about how Dalmatia rightfully belongs to us. This has not been the show of force the Duce had hoped for.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.112.a: This only deepens the injustice toward us
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.113.desc: A grave injustice has finally been rectified! The Dalmatian coast is ours. Mussolini is euphoric, calling this victory a great moment for Italy and its people. He declared that a great grievance has long last been amended. People have taken to the streets to celebrate this momentous occasion.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.121.desc: In a recent speech, the Duce outlined his vision for a greater Italy, where one of the points he made was how we must break the confinements put upon us by the other major powers. He declared Greece a vital point for Italy and its expansion, an obstacle to overcome so that we might expand beyond the bonds beset upon us.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.122.desc: Greece's mountainous terrain has shown to be an insurmountable obstacle for our troops. They find themselves impeded and pinned down. The Duce is still convinced that victory will be ours - must be ours - and refuses to acknowledge any kind of setback. He argues fervently that our superiority will triumph in the end.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.123.desc: Like the Roman legions before us, we have now vanquished the enemy's troops and conquered the whole of Greece. Mussolini held a rousing speech in the shadow of the Parthenon, declaring the Italians and the Greeks brotherly peoples with centuries of shared history, and how they were now free to set their own course through history.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.131.desc: Ever since Hannibal crossed the Alps with his elephants, the mountains have been a highway for barbarians straight into Italy’s heartlands. The Duce has long wanted to secure the northern mountain passes and wants to take the opportunity to incorporate the Italian speakers of Ticino into their Motherland - unifying the Italian people wherever they may be.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.131.a: Save the Italian people in Ticino!
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.132.desc: The Duce knew that Ticino would be hard-fought over by the Swiss, but the lack of progress has him reeling. Not long after our offensive got stalled did the Duce start to meddle with the General’s plans and question their competency, which has not passed the Italian public by.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.132.a: The lack of progress is disturbing
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.133.desc: Mussolini has personally traveled to Ticino to welcome the Italian speakers there to the broader Italian community, ensuring that a bright future awaits them and Italy as a whole. He also stated that the northern borders were now secured and that Italy could stave off any barbarians trying to pass over the Alps.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.201.desc: Finding the right people for the right places is always hard to do - especially if there’s a lack of the right people. The Duce is convinced that for Italy - and fascism - to succeed he will have to find capable and qualified people to fill out the Cabinet and will appoint someone to search far and wide to find these.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.201.a: No stone will be left unturned
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.202.desc: The failure to expand the political cabinet sufficiently has left the Duce furious, calling the political cabinet dysfunctional. He accuses everyone that comes near him of idiocy and villainy for working against him and the greatness he’s trying to bring about for Italy.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.202.a: It’s hard to be surrounded by incompetency
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.203.desc: In a recent speech addressing the Political Cabinet, Mussolini said that only Italy’s most superior minds were fit to serve there. He then boasted how he had left no stone unturned in the search to find the right people to bolster the Cabinet, and his fortitude will serve Italy in the long run.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.211.desc: The perceived lack of competence and experience in the military high command is something the Duce has been prone to point out ever since the Italo-Abyssinian War. He would like to rectify this by promoting worthy candidates to top positions within the military to strengthen our strategic and tactical reasonings in upcoming conflicts.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.212.desc: Worrying that his attention will be spread too thin if he has to take personal charge of military actions, the Duce hasn’t shied away from complaining about the lack of competent people in the military. He is sure that this issue will be the downfall of Italy if things take a turn for the worse.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.212.a: It’s hard to find competent people these days
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.213.desc: With the recent promotions in the military high command, Mussolini feels more confident than ever in Italy’s military capabilities, the Duce stated in a series of speeches. Addressing the different branches of the armed forces he praised their bravery and abilities, telling the troops that he was convinced of their future successes.
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.213.a: Competent leadership is key to success
loc.BBA_italy_missiolinis.council: The Grand Council has more impending concerns...
loc.ITA_missiolinis_reroll_tt: The Grand Council of Fascism will make sure that Mussolini changes his mind and issues a new order soon.
loc.BBA_italy_local_rulers.1.desc: Haile Selassie Gugsa, an Abyssinian army commander as well as a member of the Imperial family, has approached us hoping to make a deal. This is indeed a great moment for us and a humiliating one for the Abyssinians. While we can seize this occasion and exploit it for our own benefit we would be wise to remember that this man is a traitor in many Abyssinian’s eyes; supporting him will come with certain caveats.
loc.BBA_italy_local_rulers.1.a: Granting some concessions might satisfy the locals.
loc.BBA_italy_local_rulers.1.b: Make $ETH_haile_selassie_gugsa$ the governor of the region.
loc.BBA_italy_local_rulers.1.c: $ETH_haile_selassie_gugsa$ and his followers must be subdued.
loc.BBA_italy_local_rulers.1.d: There will be no negotiation with any local rulers.
loc.BBA_italy_local_rulers.2.desc: During our conquest of Addis Ababa we freed the former king of Jimma, Abba Jofir, who collaborated with us before the outbreak of the war. He has now come to us seeking support to restore some of his former powers. This might prove beneficial to us as he still holds some influence, but since he was found out to conspire with us many view him as a traitor as well.
loc.BBA_italy_local_rulers.2.a: Granting some concessions might satisfy the locals.
loc.BBA_italy_local_rulers.2.b: Make $ETH_abba_jofir$ the governor of the region.
loc.BBA_italy_local_rulers.2.c: $ETH_abba_jofir$ and his followers must be subdued.
loc.BBA_italy_local_rulers.2.d: There will be no negotiation with any local rulers.
loc.BBA_italy_local_rulers.3.desc: A deposed Abyssinian nobleman, Hailu Tekle Haymanot, has contacted us claiming we can benefit each other. He offers us his services in return for a position in our government in Abyssinia. Being a former ruler, this might serve our purposes, but being just that - a former ruler - will have ramifications for the local population too, who perhaps will oppose his rule.
loc.BBA_italy_local_rulers.3.a: Granting some concessions might satisfy the locals.
loc.BBA_italy_local_rulers.3.b: Make $ETH_hailu_tekle_haymanot$ the governor of the region.
loc.BBA_italy_local_rulers.3.c: $ETH_hailu_tekle_haymanot$ and his followers must be subdued.
loc.BBA_italy_local_rulers.3.d: There will be no negotiation with any local rulers.
loc.BBA_italy_local_rulers.4.desc: In our stunning victory over the Abyssinians, we managed to capture one of its leading army commanders and a member of the Imperial family; Seyoum Mengesha. We are told that the Abyssinian Emperor Haile Selassie holds this man in very high regard. We can use this prisoner to further humiliate the emperor and maybe secure the loyalty of the people. He will of course hold no real power but do as he is told.
loc.BBA_italy_local_rulers.4.a: Granting some concessions might satisfy the locals.
loc.BBA_italy_local_rulers.4.b: Make $ETH_seyoum_mengesha$ the governor of the region.
loc.BBA_italy_local_rulers.4.c: $ETH_seyoum_mengesha$ and his followers must be subdued.
loc.BBA_italy_local_rulers.4.d: There will be no negotiation with any local rulers.
loc.BBA_italy_air_accident.01.desc: Field Marshal Italo Balbo has been shot down by friendly fire over the skies of Libya. A misidentification led to anti-air batteries opening fire and shooting down his airplane from the heavens. General Giuseppe Tellera, who traveled in a different airplane, survived the accident but has been rattled by the experience.
loc.BBA_italy_air_accident.02.desc: After a misidentification, Field Marshal Italo Balbo’s airplane came under friendly fire from anti-air batteries over the skies of Libya. Luckily, he escaped unscathed, but his Chief of Staff, General Giuseppe Tellera wasn’t as lucky and was shot down and killed. Enraged, Balbo disciplined the entire company - including the officers - rather harshly.
loc.BBA_italy_air_accident.03.desc: Field Marshal Italo Balbo came under friendly fire from anti-air batteries after a misidentification over the skies of Libya. Managing to contact the ground troops and staying clear from the barrage, Balbo persuaded the anti-aircraft crew to stop firing and landed his airplane successfully. The Field Marshal has been hailed for his bravery and for staying calm in a hot situation.
loc.BBA_italy_air_accident.11.desc: While en route to inspect the French border, Chief of Air Force Aldo Pellegrini’s and General Pietro Pintor’s airplane encountered engine problems. The Aircraft crashed, leaving no one alive onboard.
loc.BBA_italy_air_accident.12.desc: While flying to the French border, Chief of Air Force Aldo Pellegrini’s and General Pietro Pintor’s airplane encountered engine problems and started to rapidly lose altitude. Faced with certain death, Pellegrini took the controls and managed to crash land the airplane thanks to his familiarity with Savoia-Marchetti aircraft. Everyone on board survived, albeit bruised up.
We have received an offer from [From.GetName] to join a Naval Cooperation Program with them. Such a program could be quite useful for us, but it would be equally useful for the [FROM.GetAdjective] navy.
The Italians have nothing to offer us.
It would seem that [From.GetName] has made the sensible decision and decided to join our Naval Cooperation Program. This will surely benefit both parties and strengthen our capabilities!
Lets put the experts to work!
[FROM.GetName] has foolishly declined to join our Naval Cooperation Program, mistaking solitude for strength, when the wise knows there is strength in numbers.
The [FROM.GetAdjective]s offer us to partake in a joint naval exercise, saying that only by preparing for war will we be ready for our enemies if they come.
The Italians have nothing to offer us.
[FROM.GetName] has accepted our offer of a joint naval maneuver, realizing the need to be prepared and ready if our enemies should descend upon us.
The short-sightedness of [FROM.GetName] is astounding! Refusing our offer of a joint naval exercise to better prepare and ready our fleets only shows their arrogance.
Our admirals are happy to report that our recent naval exercise has been a great success! We have gained a lot of new insights and are better equipped for future operations on the high seas.
Time to put our learnings into practice!
loc.ITA_joint_maneuvers_with_country_remove_: Effects after completion of the joint maneuvers program, in §Y[?ITA.ITA_joint_maneuvers_with_country_days]§! days:
The [FROM.GetAdjective]s have approached us with an offer to sell some of their escort ships to us. Some of these vessels are rather old and obsolete, but perhaps we could still find a use for them in our navy.
[FROM.GetNameDefCap] Agrees to Purchase our Escort Ships

[FROM.GetName] has agreed to purchase some of our old and obsolete escort ships. They must be truly desperate if they settled for these outdated vessels. Nevertheless, selling and removing them from our service will strengthen our fleet’s capabilities overall by making it faster and more agile.
[FROM.GetName] was not so easily convinced to purchase our old and obsolete escort ships as we had hoped. We have to turn elsewhere to rid ourselves of these outdated vessels.
loc.ITA_cooperation_programs_deal_others_tt: ([ROOT.GetEscortShipsSender]): Transfers §Y2 Curtatone-Class Destroyers§! and §Y2 Maestrale-Class Destroyers§! to [ROOT.GetEscortShipsReceiver].
The [FROM.GetAdjective]s have offered two of their older Destroyers to us. For free. While these vessels might be somewhat outdated, they could still serve our navy well. This is a generous gesture indeed.
Our Aquila-Class Destroyers Arrive to Spain
The [FROM.GetAdjective] Navy has received our Destroyers, which we so generously gifted them. For free. Hopefully, they will be put to good use.
The [FROM.GetAdjective] has somewhat arrogantly rejected our gift of two Destroyers. For free. Mighty indeed must their fleet be to refuse such an offer!
The [FROM.GetAdjective]s have inquired about our interest to purchase five midget submarines. They have limited usability but could serve our needs and expand our naval capabilities.
They can prove useful for our navy.
The [FROM.GetAdjective] Navy saw some advantages with our midget submarines and has decided to buy them. This is indeed a great moment for both our country’s engineers and for our own Navy.
The  [FROM.GetAdjective] Navy didn’t see any benefit with purchasing our midget submarines. This is because they are narrow-minded and quite frankly simple-minded since our submarines are of the utmost quality.
The [FROM.GetAdjective] midget submarines have finally arrived to bolster our naval capabilities! These will surely be a great addition to our fleet and we will put them to good use.
loc.BBA_italy_human_torpedo_raid.1.desc: The Italians managed to avoid our harbor defenses in [?ITA.ITA_raided_state_var.GetName] and infiltrated the naval base there in very small vessels to carry out a raid against our ships docked there. While the raid didn’t sink any of the ships, it did succeed in damaging them which will take some time to repair.
loc.ITA_human_torpedo_raid_tt: This raid can only be carried out once.
loc.ITA_human_torpedo_effect_tt: Will damage enemy naval units docked in the state.
loc.BBA_italy_colonial_management.1.desc: Our colonial possessions have grown considerably ever since the formation of our nation, less than a century ago. This growth has started to strain our manpower, however. There are ways to alleviate these limitations though, by using local police forces such as Meharisti, Savari, Spahi, and others. Recruiting these groups would be less taxing on our own forces and they have the benefit of being native to their lands, with all of what that entails.
loc.BBA_italy_colonial_management.1_do_not_a: Occupation law §Y$colonial_police$§! will be available in controlled [GetAfricanStates][GetAndOrNothing][GetAlbanianStates].
loc.BBA_italy_bop.1.desc: We have lost [?ITA.ITA_lost_core.GetName] to the enemy! This has naturally shaken the Italian people’s faith in our war effort and even raised voices for peace talks. These turn of events have upset many, to put it mildly, and people are looking for someone, anyone, to blame. We must re-take the initiative and push the hostile forces out of Italy!
loc.ITA_losing_cores_tt: Effects will be applied everytime [ROOT.GetName] loses control of a §Ycore state§! to an enemy.
loc.BBA_italy_bop.2.desc: Enemy forces have seized control over [?ITA.ITA_lost_colony.GetName], shocking Italians everywhere! The people were under the impression that the tide of war was in our favor, or at the very least soon would be. While this definitely is a setback, with good planning and fortitude we will surely reclaim [?ITA.ITA_lost_colony.GetName]!
loc.ITA_losing_colonies_tt: Effects will be applied everytime [ROOT.GetName] loses control of a §Ynon-core state§! to an enemy, as long as the value is lower than §Y30%§! towards §Y$ITA_grand_council_side$§!.
loc.BBA_italy_bop.3.desc: Our victorious forces have reclaimed [?ITA.ITA_reclaimed_core.GetName], boosting the spirit of Italians everywhere! This could be the moment when we turn the tides of war and push the enemies back out of our beloved [ITA.GetNameDef].
loc.BBA_italy_bop.3.a: The tides are turning in our favor!
loc.ITA_reclaiming_cores_tt: Effects will be applied everytime [ROOT.GetName] reclaims a §Ycore state§! from an enemy.
loc.BBA_italy_council_deposes_duce.1.desc: To save Italy from ruin, and to preserve the fascist system, we must do the unthinkable; remove [?ITA.ITA_var_deposed_leader.GetName] from power! His incompetency and inadequacy have long weighed down our country and its progress. It is our duty to safeguard the [FROM.GetAdjective] people and their future!
loc.BBA_italy_council_deposes_duce.2.t: The Grand Council considers Direct Intervention
loc.BBA_italy_council_deposes_duce.2.desc: Due to the recent trials and tribulations faced by [ROOT.GetLeader], the Grand Council has begun scheming to take power away and snatch it for themselves, an unpopular move that may eventually even lead to a civil war within our nation. We must do all in our power to mitigate the risk of this happening.
loc.BBA_italy_council_deposes_duce.2.a: We must take drastic measures to ensure this doesn't happen!
loc.ITA_grand_council_considers_intervention: Should power drift further into the hands of the §YGrand Council§!, they may completely §RSeize Power§! from §Y[ROOT.GetLeader]!§!
loc.BBA_italy_civil_war.1.desc: Our beloved Italy has fractured under the strains of the War! Opposing sides are now forming, to fight over what is left of our nation and to fight over what ideals Italy will hold going forward. Hard choices will face us all, but we must persist and persevere so that we once again can blossom.
loc.BBA_italy_civil_war.2.desc: It seems that a newly formed resistance group is causing damage behind our front lines. From what little we can tell about the group, they seem to be largely made up of former Army officers that have switched sides. Efforts to lure them out are underway, but we have too little intel to anticipate their next move as of right now.
loc.BBA_italy_civil_war.3.desc: We have received intel that several small groups of communist partisans, calling themselves Gappisti, have made several successful hit-and-run operations on our territory. They are well trained and armed, which makes us suspect that they’re funded by [FROM.GetName].
loc.BBA_italy_civil_war.4.desc: The resistance and partisan groups in [FROM.GetName] that works tirelessly to liberate the rest of Italy has been a success! In fact, the sinister regime that still holds power there has been forced to launch a new series of harsh anti-partisan measures. This will make it more difficult for our agents to operate in [FROM.GetName], but the fight for a free Italy goes on!
loc.BBA_italy_civil_war.5.desc: Our Italian allies and subjects have requested to be released from our governance and be given full independence. We first assumed control over [FROM.GetName] to make sure that the Italian front wouldn’t collapse completely, but perhaps the time has come to grant them their freedom.
loc.BBA_italy_civil_war.6.desc: Our ally - and temporary - overlord, [FROM.GetName], has listened to our call for freedom and agreed to grant us our independence back! This is a momentous occasion for our wartorn country. Now we can start to rebuild in earnest and the road back to unification can begin.
loc.BBA_italy_civil_war.6.a: Masters of our own fate once again
loc.BBA_italy_civil_war.7.desc: Our tyrannical [FROM.Adjective] overlords have refused our honest request for independence! While they were useful in winning our civil war, they have no right to govern our fate or meddle in our politics anymore. When the time is right it is our duty to remove them from our lands and seize our freedom for ourselves!
loc.ITA_we_will_transfer_the_following_state: The following states will be transferred to §Y[RDS.GetFlag][RDS.GetNameDef]§!:
loc.ITA_we_keep_our_occupied_states_tt: We will keep control over our current occupied states.
loc.BBA_italy_civil_war_fascist_tt: We will keep control over §Y[ROOT.GetFlag][ROOT.GetNameDefCap]§!. §Y[ROOT.GetFlag][ROOT.GetNameDefCap]§! becomes §Y$RSI_DEF$§!. [GetRsiOverlord]
loc.BBA_italy_civil_war_monarchist_tt: We will become §Y$RDS_DEF$§!, the revolter side in the civil war with §Y$neutrality$§! ideology. [GetRdsOverlord]
loc.BBA_italy_civil_war_communist_tt: We will become §Y$RDS_DEF$§!, the revolter side in the civil war with §Y$communism$§! ideology. [GetRdsOverlord]
loc.BBA_italy_civil_war_democratic_tt: We will become §Y$RDS_DEF$§!, the revolter side in the civil war with §Y$democratic$§! ideology. [GetRdsOverlord]
loc.ITA_rsi_overlord_tt: We will become a subject of §Y[?ITA_rsi_overlord.GetFlag][?ITA_rsi_overlord.GetNameDef]§!.
loc.ITA_rds_overlord_tt: We will become a subject of §Y[?ITA_rds_overlord.GetFlag][?ITA_rds_overlord.GetNameDef]§!.
loc.BBA_italy_civil_war.100.desc: We find ourselves in control of Italian territory, fighting alongside an Italian ally. We could free up more of our forces and direct them elsewhere by handing over these territories to [RDS.GetName].
loc.BBA_italy_civil_war.101.desc: [FROM.GetName]’s wise leader, [FROM.GetLeader], has generously given back control over Italian territory to us! Not only is this a great boost to morale for the troops, but it will also bolster our capabilities and strengthen our efforts to liberate all of Italy.
loc.BBA_italy_civil_war.300.desc: Our efforts to unite the [FROM.Adjective] people against fascism have come to a head! No longer can we sit idly by and watch our beautiful country bleed dry. With our gathered strength we now have the means to once and for all topple the fascist regime and free all of Italy from its tyranny!
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.1.desc: In a completely unexpected and outrageous move, the Italian leader [ITA.GetLeader] has defiled our longstanding neutrality by handing us an ultimatum. Within two weeks, we need to hand over the region of [846.GetName] to the Italians, or we will have war. How should we respond?
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.1.a: That's one less weak-point for us to defend
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.1.b: We'd like to see them try!
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.2.desc: The president of [SWI.GetNameDef] has today announced the end of an era for the country. They will cede the Italian area of [846.GetName] to us, and renounce their claims to any Italian-speaking towns in the region. Today marks a reduction to the size and multi-ethnic values of [SWI.GetName], as they have also subsequently revoked Italian as an official language.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.3.desc: The nation of [SWI.GetName] has today announced that they will revoke their neutrality by defying our demands to return [846.GetName] to the Italian world. Due to this foolish choice, we are left with no option other than the complete and utter destruction of the Swiss Cantonal system.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.4.t: Demands to Crown an Italian Prince
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.4.desc: We have received demands from [ITA.GetLeader] to officially crown the Italian prince known as prince Aimone, king Tomislav II of Croatia. If we were to accept these demands, we would surely lose some of our independence, but it might be worth it just to stave off any Italian aggression for the near future.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.4.a: And King Tomislav he shall be!
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.4.b: The Italians will meet their doom on the shores of Dalmatia
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.5.desc: Bells toll in Zagreb today, as the Italian formerly known as prince Aimone is being crowned Tomislav the second of Croatia. Our influence will now extend further into the Balkans, as our days of glory are closing in.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.6.t: Aimone Stopped at the Croat Border
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.6.desc: Prince Aimone has returned to us, and reported that he was stopped and refused at the Croat border on his way to his coronation in Zagreb. It is clear to us that the Croats have nothing to offer us, and that military occupation is the only option for them in the future.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.7.t: The New Head of the National Committee
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.7.desc: Italy has assigned [MNT.GetLeader] as the new Head of the National Committee. This will surely strengthen our regime.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.8.desc: [ITA.GetLeader] of [ITA.GetNameDef] has today sent us an ultimatum demanding us to grant [ITA.GetName] occupation of the region of Dalmatia. If we do not comply with [ITA.GetLeader]'s demands, we will likely have a military conflict on our hands.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.8.b: Who do they think they are?
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.9.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef] has gracefully accepted our demands for occupation of Dalmatia, and has subsequently ceded the territory to us. They would rather appease us than stand against us, which will only help further Italy's goals in the Balkans.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.10.t: The Foolish [FROM.GetLeader] has Rejected our Ultimatum
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.10.desc: The foolish [FROM.GetLeader] of [FROM.GetNameDef] has denied us our rightful clay, and it is now time to strike [FROM.GetName] down, in one swift attack. This will surely secure our claims to Dalmatia for the near future.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.11.desc: [ITA.GetLeader] has demanded that the Montenegrin throne be handed over to the Italian state, and that the crowns be united under one banner. Clearly this is slightly delusional, though not too far from reality, as the Queen of Italy is Montenegrin. How should we answer?
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.11.b: What do they think gives them the right?
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.12.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has declared that they have no reason to resist our will, and that the territory of Montenegro will be transferred to us at once. Today is a great day for the Italian nation!
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.13.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has announced that they will seek no further diplomatic relations with us, and that we need to revoke our claim to the Montenegrin throne at once. Unforgivable, unacceptable!
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.14.t: [ITA.GetName] Demands a Full Demilitarization of Western Anatolia
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.14.desc: [ITA.GetLeader] has issued demands of security guarantees between our two nations, which is fair enough. The more outrageous part is that [ITA.GetLeader] also requires us to fully demilitarize both [342.GetName] and [339.GetName], which could jeopardize our security, as this would mean for us that we could not set up initial defensive positions for in case we were to be attacked by [ITA.GetName] or any of her allies.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.14.a: We have no use stationing troops there anyway
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.14.b: This would mean we can't defend ourselves!
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.15.desc: [FROM.GetName] has agreed to our demands and chosen to completely demilitarize western Anatolia. This means that they will be much weaker, and have no way of putting up an initial resistance were we to attack them.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.15.a: They will never see it coming
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.16.t: [FROM.GetName] Denies us the Right to Feel Safe!
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.16.desc: [FROM.GetName] has denied our friendly request for security guarantees, and refused us the demilitarization of [342.GetName] and [339.GetName]. This is beyond outrageous, and will have to be dealt with in its own way.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.17.desc: Our overlord [ITA.GetName] has today decided to hand the territory of [45.GetName] over to the Hungarians, which we control. This is to strengthen relation between the Italian and Hungarian states, and there is not very much that can be done about it. We will however lodge a small diplomatic protest, even though the higher-ups won't even read it.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.17.a: We can't do much about it...
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.18.t: Italy Approaches us with an Offer
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.18.desc: [ITA.GetNameDef] has approached us with an enticing offer. They offer us ownership of Rhodes and the Dodecanese islands in exchange for an alliance with them. This is an offer that almost seems too good to be true, but isn't. What shall we do?
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.18.a: We are one step closer to Greek reunification!
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.18.b: We will not bow to Italians, no matter the conditions!
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.19.desc: The Greek government has today announced that they have accepted our offer and will begin military cooperation starting as soon as possible, in exchange for ownership of the Dodecanese islands. We will see where this leads us.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.19.a: And an alliance we shall have
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.20.desc: The Greek traitors have rejected our offer to sell them the islands in exchange for an alliance. This shows only of their governments incompetence and weakness.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.20.a: We are better off without them
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.21.t: Italy Approaches us with an Offer
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.21.desc: [ITA.GetNameDef] has approached us with an enticing offer. They offer us ownership of Rhodes and the Dodecanese islands in exchange for an alliance with them. This is an offer that almost seems too good to be true, but isn't. What shall we do?
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.21.a: Take that, Greece! We got it first!
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.21.b: We will not bow to Italians, no matter the conditions!
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.22.desc: The Turkish government has today announced that they have accepted our offer and will begin military cooperation starting as soon as possible, in exchange for ownership of the Dodecanese islands. We will see where this leads us.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.22.a: And an alliance we shall have
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.23.desc: The Turkish traitors have rejected our offer to sell them the islands in exchange for an alliance. This shows only of their governments incompetence and weakness.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.23.a: We are better off without them
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.24.desc: The vile German state is attempting to interfere in Austrian politics and absorb the country into their own. We have earlier issued guarantees to them, and as such our population expects us to stand up to the Germans for them. We might also be able to ask the British and French for assistance. What should we do?
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.24.b: It might be good to ask for help
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.24.c: There is nothing we can do. Retract the guarantees!
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.25.desc: The Italian department of defense has issued a warning to us regarding our attempt to incorporate the Austrians into our country. They state that should we move against Austria, we will face grave countermeasures from the Italian army. How should we respond to this clear provocation?
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.25.a: Their heads are getting too big
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.25.b: We cannot handle this form of confrontation
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events_news.1.desc: News outlets around the world have received reports via the Italian department of defense stating that the Germans have chosen to back down after pressing their claim to Austrian territory. This is a historic day for Europe, and only time will tell what will come of the shattered German state.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events_news.1.a: There was sadly no other option
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events_news.1.b: This proves the weakness inherent in the German system
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.26.desc: Italy has announced that they will not stand against us, now that it has been proven to them that push will come to shove, should they not back down. Today is a glorious day for the fatherland!
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.26.a: This should urge the [AUS.GetAdjective]s to reconsider
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.27.t: Italy Asks us to Help them Contain Germany
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.27.desc_hos: Italy asks us to help them contain the expansionist power of Germany, and want us to guarantee Austrian independence, in order to help protect them. While we have fought side by side before, we are now hosting the Ethiopian government in exile, which has been driven away by the Italians. If [ITA.GetNameDef] wants our help in the upcoming war, they need to settle for peace first.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.27.desc_sta: It has been done during the great war once, but now, yet again, Italy asks us to help them contain the expansionist power of Germany. They want us to guarantee Austrian independence, in order to help protect them. What is our course of action?
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.27.a: Alright chaps, we're going in again
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.27.c: Blimey no, why should we care about the continent?
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events_news.2.desc: The British government has today announced that they will support Austrian independence and stand with Italy against any threats to the nation's sovereignty.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.28.t: Italy Asks us to Help them Contain Germany
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.28.desc: Our neighbors to the south-east have asked us to help them fend off a potential German attack against the state of Austria, whose independence they are currently guaranteeing. They ask us to now do the same. How do we respond?
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events_news.3.t: The French State Guarantees Austrian Independence
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events_news.3.desc: The French have as per the Italian request decided to back the Austrians in their fight for independence, and promised to attack any potential aggressors that may try to intervene in the nation's sovereignty.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.29.t: Italy is Taking [802.GetName] Away From Us!
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.29.desc: Italy is attempting to remove [802.GetName] from us, by adding it to their own kingdom of Albania. If we do not do anything, our claims to the region will be lost forever.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.29.a: There is nothing we can do to stop them
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.29.b: We need to get away from them
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.30.t: Italy Offers [45.GetName] in Exchange for Mutual Guarantees
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.30.desc: [ITA.GetName] has offered to support our claims to [45.GetName] in exchange for mutual guarantees and cooperation treaties. This seems like a good deal to us, should we accept?
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.30.b: And why should we trust an Italian?
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.31.t_negoti: [ITA.GetNameDefCap] Wants to Negotiate their Claims to Somalia
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.31.desc_no_: The Italian government has today approached us with an interesting proposal. They say they want to ratify the Stresa Front, securing their support for our side in the event that a war is to break out in Europe. In order for them to sign this however, they demand territorial concessions, currently [269.GetName] and [903.GetName]. How should we respond? They will at least pay us temporarily if we accept.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.31.desc_pea: [ITA.GetNameDefCap] and [ETH.GetNameDefCap] have set aside their differences and signed a peace treaty, due in no small part to our skillful diplomacy. The Italian government has reminded us of the deal we struck where they would receive [269.GetName] and [903.GetName] in order to ratify the Stresa Front.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.31.desc_no_: Despite our insistence on the matter, the ungrateful [ETH.GetLeader] has refused to enter peace talks with the [ITA.GetAdjective] government, thinking he has the upper hand in the war. This leaves us with no choice but to expel the Ethiopian leader from our country, so we can focus on the Italian proposition, which is more in line with our national interests.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.32.t: [ITA.GetName] Wants to Negotiate their Claims to Djibouti
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.32.desc: The Italian government has today approached us with an interesting proposal. They say they want to ratify the Stresa Front, securing their support for our side in the event that a war is to break out in Europe. In order for them to sign this however, they demand territorial concessions, namely [268.GetName]. How should we respond? They will at least pay us temporarily if we accept.
