loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.33.t: [ITA.GetName] Wants to Negotiate their Claim to [906.GetName]
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.33.desc_fir: The Italian government has approached us today with an interesting proposal. They say they want to ratify the Stresa Front, securing their support for our side in the event that a war is to break out in Europe. In order for them to sign this however, they demand territorial concessions, namely [906.GetName]. How should we respond? They will at least pay us temporarily if we accept.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.33.desc_con: The Italians have returned to us with yet another demand. They now want ownership of the island of [906.GetName]. They state that this is so that they can more easily regulate the flow of tradeable goods being imported and exported in Italian East Africa, and control one of the inlets to the Red Sea, as we control the other. Should we give it to them, they state that they will pay us temporarily for our efforts.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.33.a: A small price to pay for peace
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.33.b: And why should they have it exactly?
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.34.t: [ITA.GetName] Wants to Negotiate their Claim to Tunisia
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.34.desc_fir: The Italian government has approached us today with an interesting proposal. They say they want to ratify the Stresa Front, securing their support for our side in the event that a war is to break out in Europe. In order for them to sign this however, they demand territorial concessions, namely [458.GetName] and [665.GetName]. How should we respond? They will at least pay us temporarily if we accept.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.34.desc_con: The Italians have returned to us with yet another demand. They now want ownership of [458.GetName] and [665.GetName]. They state that this is so that they can have a more fair share of the North of Africa, in comparison to us and the British. Should we give it to them, they state that they will pay us temporarily for our efforts.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.35.t: [ITA.GetName] Wants to Negotiate their Claim to Malta
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.35.desc_fir: The Italian government has approached us today with an interesting proposal. They say they want to ratify the Stresa Front, securing their support for our side in the event that a war is to break out in Europe. In order for them to sign this however, they demand territorial concessions, namely [116.GetName]. How should we respond? They will at least pay us temporarily if we accept.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.35.desc_con: The Italians have returned to us with yet another demand. They now want ownership of the island of [116.GetName]. They state that this is so that they can more easily control the Mediterranean sea. Should we give it to them, they state that they will pay us temporarily for our efforts.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.35.a: They have better use for it
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.36.t: [ITA.GetName] Wants to Negotiate their Claims to the Balkans
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.36.desc_fir: The Italian government has approached us today with an interesting proposal. They say they want to ratify the Stresa Front, securing their support for our side in the event that a war is to break out in Europe. They wish for us to ratify their claims to the Balkans. This is not really in our zone of interest, and as such our government isn't very keen on denying this.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.36.desc_con: [ITA.GetName] now only has one last request of us, before the pact can be signed. They wish for us to ratify their claims to the Balkans. This is not really in our zone of interest, and as such our government isn't very keen on denying this.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.36.a: There is no use arguing this
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.37.desc: Our diplomats have been working hard in France and Britain over the last few weeks in order to secure Italy's territorial gains in the near future. The negotiations are now however over, and the papers are signed.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.37.a: Not all that we wanted, but we will take it
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.38.desc: With the power of the Papacy exceeding that of the Italian monarchy, many ardent supporters of the catholic church have today come out to demand the Pope take up leadership of the country. He has already accepted the role put forth by the people, and declared that what is happening today is indeed the will of God himself. There is not much the monarchy can do to stop him now.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.39.desc: We have finally made the last payment for our new possessions in Africa. This agreement has expanded our colonial territories, unifying and solidifying them, and strengthening our position there. All in all, it has been a very beneficial arrangement for all participants.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.40.desc: Now that territorial concessions have been decided, [ITA.GetName] has initiated a process that will bring Italy and France into a military alliance called the Stresa Front. Now is not the time to sit idly by, for France must act in her own best interest and join Italy against the German menace.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.40.b: France shall never stand besides Italy
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.41.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has approached us with an offer to bring us under their wings, in order to protect us from foreign powers and economic drought. [FROM.GetName] does however seem sort of hostile, and will likely invade us should we reject their demands.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.41.a: An offer too good to reject
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.42.desc: The country of [FROM.GetName] has humbly accepted our offer of protection and bowed down to the rightful rulers of the Mediterranean ocean. Today shines a new bright light on Iberia and [ITA.GetNameDef].
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.43.desc: The country of [FROM.GetName] has rudely rejected our offer of protection, and we will show them what it means to go against us in the truest sense. They shall bow down before us!
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.44.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has started an initiative to ally with the nations of South America and unite the Latin cultures under one dominion. This seems like a good opportunity for protection from the [USA.GetNameDef]. How should we respond?
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.44.b: Why should we convene with imperialists?
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.45.desc: The country of [FROM.GetName] has humbly accepted our offer of an alliance and joined us to fight against our common enemies together as one. Today shines a new bright light on South America and [ITA.GetNameDef].
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.46.desc: The country of [FROM.GetName] has rudely rejected our offer of an alliance, and we will therefore have to do without them. They shall stand isolated on their continent.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.46.a: We can do little to change their minds...
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.50.desc: The Italian government has approached us with an interesting proposal. They say they want to ratify the Stresa Front, securing their support for our side in the event that a war is to break out in Europe. They demand territorial concessions however, currently [269.GetName] and [903.GetName] - and they are at war with [ETH.GetName], whose government we are hosting. They will at least pay us temporarily if we accept.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.50.a: They must sign a peace treaty first!
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.50.b: There will be no deal with these criminals!
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.51.desc: Our reasonable proposal to ratify the Stresa Front in exchange for some minor colonial territories from the British has been met with utter disdain. They must feel strong and confident indeed if they reject our considerable might.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.60.desc: Italy has signed a peace treaty with Ethiopia, returning some of the lands they conquered. The Italian government is now requesting us to uphold our end of the bargain and guarantee Austria's independence in the face of German expansionism.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.70.desc: We have dispatched an envoy to the leader of the [GetAdjective]s inquiring if they are willing to set aside our differences and form a new government under Italian oversight.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.71.desc: An envoy from [ITA.GetNameDef] has approached us, inquiring if we are willing to set aside our differences and form a new government under Italian oversight. The envoy have let us know that they will proceed to set up a new administration in our homeland, with or without our cooperation. Should we refuse this offer, we will be overlooked by the rest of the world in favor of this new administration.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.71.a: There’s not much we can do
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.72.desc: [FROM.GetLeader], the leader of the exiled [FROM.GetAdjective]s, paid a discreet visit to  [ROOT.GetLeader]’s private residence last night to quietly inform of his decision to accept an offer by the Italians to form a new government under their regime. He thanked us for our generosity in these troubling times, but said that he needs to look out for what’s best for his people.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.666.desc: His Holiness, Pope [From.GetLeader], demands that we hand over the state of [454.GetName]. His emissaries claim that such a holy site should only be governed by the Papacy, and refusing such a demand would be heresy. Complying would greatly benefit our relationship with [FROM.GetName], but [454.GetName] lies at the crossroads between Europe, Asia, and Africa - which makes it such a strategically important place, now as throughout history.
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.666.a: We must meet the demands of His Holiness...
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.666.b: The old man can burn in hell!
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.667.desc: This is not only a great day for the Papacy, but for all of Christendom! The [FROM.GetAdjective] leader, [FROM.GetLeader], has wisely listened to our request and agreed to transfer [454.GetName] to our administration. This will lead to stability and prosperity for the region and a new bright future for [ROOT.GetName].
loc.BBA_italy_interaction_events.668.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] is as arrogant as he is ignorant! He refuses to see the sensibility in handing over [454.GetName] to us. Meeting our demands would have brought security and stability to the region, but his actions will only lead to war and misery!
loc.BBA_italy_purge_the_party.1.desc: There are influential allies of Mussolini still in power trying to sway people to reinstate the old Duce. If we are to maintain our control over the government we need to set an example and relieve these fools from their positions.
loc.ITA_characters_will_be_spared_tt: §YThe following characters will be spared from the purge:§!
loc.BBA_italy_decide_the_fate_of_mussolini.1: Having dealt with the internal power struggle and solidifying our hold on Partito Nazionale Fascista, we can finally turn our attention to the old Duce - Mussolini. His ever-looming presence is undermining our position and needs to be handled.
loc.BBA_italy_decide_the_fate_of_mussolini.2: The trial of the century is about to begin, where Benito Mussolini stands accused on multiple charges of corruption and treason - among other things. The trial is merely a theatre for the public to give it a veneer of legitimacy. In actuality, we hold the outcome in our hands.
loc.BBA_italy_decide_the_fate_of_mussolini.3: Plans are in motion to assassinate the former Duce, but we have to carefully take into consideration how the Italian people will react. The question is how do we spin this?
loc.ITA_mussolini_stands_trial_tt: Let the Court of Justice rule his fate - as long as we rule the Court of Justice.
loc.ITA_mussolini_is_assassinated_tt: We can spin his death to our advantage.
loc.ITA_mussolini_walks_free_tt: Mussolini walks and can live his life as a free citizen.
loc.BBA_italy_research_agreement.1.t: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] Suggests a Joint Military Cooperation Program
loc.BBA_italy_research_agreement.1.desc: The [FROM.GetAdjective]s propose a joint research program to strengthen not only our military capabilities but also the bond between our countries. This would enable us to share technologies and research more readily between us and would bring our countries closer together.
loc.BBA_italy_research_agreement.1.b: We do not need such a program.
loc.BBA_italy_research_agreement.2.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has unwisely rejected our proposed military cooperation. This joint program would have strengthened both nations’ military capabilities, but it seems that the [FROM.GetAdjective] have no interest in such a deal. Luckily, we do not need their help to reach our goals!
loc.BBA_italy_pact.1.desc: The [FROM.GetAdjective]s are ready to present a shared declaration of friendship and cooperation between our countries. A non-aggression pact with them would secure our borders and free up resources to be sent elsewhere. Even if we don’t necessarily find them trustworthy, this would allow us to bide our time and build up our strength.
loc.BBA_italy_pact.2.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has rejected our proposal of a non-aggression pact, calling the deal dishonest and one-sided. They are clearly delusional and don’t understand what’s best for them.
loc.BBA_italy_recognize_the_empire.1.desc: [FROM.GetLeader] has declared the dawn of the Italian Empire! While our ambassador to Rome recommends that we merely recognize this fact and let the [FROM.GetAdjective]s have their dreams of grandeur, others are worried about this turn of events. They argue that placating the [FROM.GetAdjective]s will only lead to more concessions and that we should restrain such dangerous dreams of empire.
loc.BBA_italy_recognize_the_empire.2.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] wisely acknowledges our imperial aspirations and sees us as their equals - as they should! Our prestige and glory continue to grow.
loc.BBA_italy_recognize_the_empire.3.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] foolishly scoffs at our imperial ambitions, stating that dreams and wishful thinking alone don’t build an empire. They must pay the price for such insolence! We will bide our time - for now - but we stand ready to show those half-wits the true might of the Italian Empire.
loc.BBA_italy_recognize_the_empire.3.a: They will live to regret this....
loc.BBA_italy_sends_military_support.1.desc: The [FROM.GetAdjective]s want to support us in our war effort and have sent some equipment. It's a rather small shipment but any aid is accepted.
loc.BBA_italy_sends_military_support.1.a: This will surely come in handy
loc.BBA_italy_communist_events.01.desc: With our fledgling Republic secured from the clutches of the fascists, we can finally set a new course for our country! What is needed now is a steadfast leader, that is as wise as he is committed to our cause. Someone that can steer us through the troubling times ahead and not falter in their faith for a brighter future.
loc.BBA_italy_communist_events.01.a: Antonio Gramsci is the rightful leader.
loc.BBA_italy_communist_events.01.c: Sandro Pertini shall lead us forward.
loc.BBA_italy_communist_events.02.desc: Our comrades in the newly formed [FROM.GetName] have called upon us to provide aid. The [FROM.GetAdjective] people have been torn apart in a civil war to secure their Communist rule, and are now turning to other like-minded governments so that they may rebuild and protect the new republic.
loc.BBA_italy_communist_events.02.b: Not a concern for the [ROOT.GetAdjective] people.
loc.BBA_italy_communist_events.03.desc: The Government in [FROM.GetName] has listened to our call for support from fellow communists and has decided to aid us! This will not only strengthen our ties with them but also our defensive capabilities so that we might protect our dear republic.
loc.BBA_italy_communist_events.03.a: United we will never be defeated!
loc.BBA_italy_communist_events.04.desc: No one has answered the call for aid! It would seem that communists around the world have forsaken us and are not too eager to help their own comrades. We can only rely on ourselves in this harsh world - but our revolution will prevail!
loc.ITA_country_supports_new_italian_governm: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] will receive some support from us in the form of §Yequipment§! and a small temporary §Yconsumer goods§! bonus.
loc.ITA_international_support_arrives_tt: We will receive the following benefits from our comrades abroad:
loc.BBA_italy_communist_events.05.desc: We have recently completed a joint exercise with the [FROM.GetAdjective] military. Our generals and admirals are happy to report that it was a great success and that our military performed very well. This will strengthen our ties with [FROM.GetName] and our own capabilities.
loc.BBA_italy_communist_events.06.desc: Our comrades in arms from [FROM.GetName] have proposed a Grand Commission with members from Spain and other countries so that we might expand the cooperation between us. They argue that together we need to oppose capitalism and fascism, so that we one day may tear them down.
loc.BBA_italy_communist_events.07.desc: Our Comrades in [FROM.GetName] have agreed to join forces with us and create a Grand Commission of Cooperation! Together we will be able to withstand the onslaught of capitalism and fascism, and turn the tides to bring our glorious revolution to all corners of the world!
loc.BBA_italy_communist_events.08.desc: The foolish [FROM.GetAdjective] are too shortsighted to see what’s best for them! Together it would have been easier to hold off capitalism and fascism, but we will succeed nevertheless!
loc.BBA_italy_communist_events.09.desc: Antonio Gramsci has finally recovered from the severe illness he sustained while unjustly imprisoned. He is ready to help our cause in whichever way he can with a stronger conviction and fervor than ever before!
loc.BBA_italy_communist_events.09.a: Recovered by the optimism of his will.
loc.BBA_italy_democratic_events.01.desc: With our recent struggles behind us now, it is time to come together and unite, mend our wounds, and start the long journey to recovery. Our Democracy is still young and fragile, so we need a strong but gentle hand to guide us forward.
loc.BBA_italy_democratic_events.01.a: Ferruccio Parri is the most capable leader.
loc.BBA_italy_democratic_events.01.b: The experience of Ivanoe Bonomi is invaluable.
loc.BBA_italy_democratic_events.02.desc: [FROM.GetName] has invited us to join a new research sharing initiative with them. This would expand and deepen the ties and cooperation between our countries.
loc.BBA_italy_democratic_events.03.desc: The Civil War has been the cause of a lot of bloodshed and grief and has shaken the very foundations of [FROM.GetName]. The chaos has also left a power vacuum, which is now being filled by the resurgent Mafia in [?ROOT.ITA_mafia_epicenter_state.GetName]. Suppressing the Mafia was perhaps the only good thing the Fascists managed to do.
loc.BBA_italy_democratic_events.05.desc: The plague that is the Mafia is spreading! The recent chaos in [FROM.GetName] has been a breeding ground for criminals and their likes and, in the absence of strong, local rule, these unwanted individuals are growing in numbers. They have taken advantage of the power vacuum left by the Civil War and are once again asserting their authority all over [FROM.GetName].
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.01.des: With our internal affairs sorted out, we can once again look outwards. We have inherited a great many issues from the fascists, issues that we now must resolve. One of the foremost questions is that of Ethiopia. It was an unjust and brutal war, started by the ever prestige-craving Mussolini, and now that he is gone it is up to us to decide Ethiopia's fate.
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.01.a: We must stop this charade now!
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.01.b: We will liberate the workers of Ethiopia!
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.01.d: We should invest in Ethiopia and the Ethiopian peoples.
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.01.e: We shall keep the status quo.
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.01.f: We must put the oppressive rule of [ETH.GetLeader] to an end!
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.01.g: We will strengthen ties with the Ethiopian people.
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.02.des: The new government of [FROM.GetName] has come to us, requesting a cease-fire to the hostilities. It would seem that after their Civil War, they have had enough of bloodshed and fighting.
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.02.c: Too late, they will bend the knee!
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.03.des: [FROM.GetName]’s [FROM.GetLeader] has agreed to our proposed cease-fire and is willing to give peace a chance. We can finally put one of Mussolini’s greatest atrocities behind us and start anew.
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.04.des: The bloodthirsty [FROM.GetLeader] apparently smells blood after our Civil War, and thinks us weak. [FROM.GetSheHeCap] has refused our generous peace offer and is determined to fight on. We will show [FROM.GetHerHim] that we are far from weak!
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.05.des: The government in [FROM.GetName] is attempting to assume direct control over our territories and integrate us into the greater [FROM.GetAdjective] administration. How this will affect our people, culture, and tradition no one knows yet.
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.05.b: We will not give up our limited autonomy!
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.06.des: The [FROM.GetAdjective] government has realized that integrating into the wider [ROOT.GetAdjective] administration would be beneficial and strengthen all of us.
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.07.des: It would seem that the [FROM.GetAdjective]s think they are better suited to govern themselves and have declined our offer to become a part of our wider administration.
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.08.des: It would seem that the new government in [FROM.GetName] wishes to amend some of their predecessor’s less refined treatment of the [ROOT.GetAdjective] people, and has decided to invest in our country for a change.
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.09.des: The [FROM.GetAdjective] hunger for expansion seems to know no bounds! We have received a delegation from [FROM.GetName] that offers us subjugation. Little would change they claim; we would still rule our lands as we see fit, but with the benefit of extra protection from the [FROM.GetAdjective]s and the occasional conformity.
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.09.a: We will follow our Italian comrades!
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.09.b: We need a change in government!
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.10.des: The [FROMGetAdjective] government has wisely decided to accept our offer of joining forces together and enjoy our protection. This will no doubt strengthen and benefit both countries!
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.11.des: While the [FROM.GetAdjective] leadership did not accept our proposal of protection and cooperation, they have met us halfway and replaced their government with one more alike to our own and more friendly-minded towards us.
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.11.a: A bright future awaits the [FROM.GetAdjective] people!
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.12.des: [FROM.GetName]’s leader [FROM.GetLeader] staunchly opposed our proposal of protection and cooperation and has in no kind words told our delegation to get back home as swiftly as possible.
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.12.a: Time will teach them how wrong they are.
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.12.b: It was a demand, not a proposal.
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.13.des: It seems that the [FROM.GetAdjective]s have gained quite a lot of respect for our forces and capabilities during their war with us. So much so in fact, that they wish to offer us a mutual agreement of non-aggression and guarantee in the face of war.
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.14.des: [FROM.GetLeader] has wisely agreed to sign our proposed mutual non-aggression pact between [FROM.GetName] and [ROOT.GetName] as well as a mutual guarantee - in case either one of us would face an aggressor.
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.15.des: [FROM.GetLeader] has unwisely rejected our proposed defensive pact between [FROM.GetName] and [ROOT.GetName]. This assurance would have brought stability and safety to both our countries, but now we have to face the world on our own.
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.15.b: If they're not with us, they're against us!
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.20.des: It would seem that the newly formed [FROM.GetName] has a newfound sense of virtue and purpose and has taken it upon themselves to dismantle everyone else’s colonial empires. An Italian delegation has asked us to reject our imperial ways and to embrace a future of cooperation and freedom instead of suppression and subjugation.
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.20.a: It's time to make things right!
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.21.des: When we set out to condemn and dismantle the colonial empires in Africa, we were not sure how such an action would be met. Considering how stubbornly countries can hold on to what they perceive as theirs, we must view our efforts as a success. Even the release of a single nation is a great accomplishment!

It seems that our efforts to decolonize the African continent and bring freedom to its subjugated peoples have been brushed aside at every turn. The old colonial powers are obviously in denial about how they are treating their subjects and refuse to listen to reason. They must be held accountable!
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.52.des: The people of North Africa have seen how benevolent and efficient we govern their lands and have voted to join our administration! It would seem that our investments and care in their provinces have paid off. This will surely benefit us all.
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.53.des: While perhaps not a total surprise, we have regrettably been informed that the people of North Africa have rejected the notion of being subject to our rule any longer. They have felt neglected and exploited for quite some time and have therefore voted to leave our administration.
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.54.des: The people of East Africa have seen how benevolent and efficient we govern their lands and have voted to join our administration! It would seem that our investments and care in their provinces have paid off. This will surely benefit us all.
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.55.des: While perhaps not a total surprise, we have regrettably been informed that the people of East Africa have rejected the notion of being subject to our rule any longer. They have felt neglected and exploited for quite some time and have therefore voted to leave our administration.
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.56.des: The people of West Africa have seen how benevolent and efficient we govern their lands and have voted to join our administration! It would seem that our investments and care in their provinces have paid off. This will surely benefit us all.
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.57.des: While perhaps not a total surprise, we have regrettably been informed that the people of West Africa have rejected the notion of being subject to our rule any longer. They have felt neglected and exploited for quite some time and have therefore voted to leave our administration.
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.58.des: The people of Central Africa have seen how benevolent and efficient we govern their lands and have voted to join our administration! It would seem that our investments and care in their provinces have paid off. This will surely benefit us all.
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.59.des: While perhaps not a total surprise, we have regrettably been informed that the people of Central Africa have rejected the notion of being subject to our rule any longer. They have felt neglected and exploited for quite some time and have therefore voted to leave our administration.
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.60.des: The people of South Africa have seen how benevolent and efficient we govern their lands and have voted to join our administration! It would seem that our investments and care in their provinces have paid off. This will surely benefit us all.
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.61.des: While perhaps not a total surprise, we have regrettably been informed that the people of South Africa have rejected the notion of being subject to our rule any longer. They have felt neglected and exploited for quite some time and have therefore voted to leave our administration.
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.62.des: The people of the Middle East have seen how benevolent and efficient we govern their lands and have voted to join our administration! It would seem that our investments and care in their provinces have paid off. This will surely benefit us all.
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.63.des: While perhaps not a total surprise, we have regrettably been informed that the people of the Middle East have rejected the notion of being subject to our rule any longer. They have felt neglected and exploited for quite some time and have therefore voted to leave our administration.
loc.ITA_release_colonies_north_africa_tt: Colonies in North Africa will be released.
loc.ITA_release_colonies_east_africa_tt: Colonies in East Africa will be released.
loc.ITA_release_colonies_west_africa_tt: Colonies in West Africa will be released.
loc.ITA_release_colonies_central_africa_tt: Colonies in Central Africa will be released.
loc.ITA_release_colonies_south_africa_tt: Colonies in South Africa will be released.
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.100.de: We have received a delegation from [FROM.GetName] seeking closer ties with us. They have talked about our shared history at length and how much stronger we would be if we only joined forces with each other. There is no doubt that they see themselves as the leaders of this potential pact. While such an agreement would be beneficial on certain levels, we would lose all autonomy.
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.100.a: Albanian and Italian peoples shall unite!
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.100.b: We will follow the new Italian government!
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.101.de: The great and wise [FROM.GetLeader] of the [FROM.GetAdjective] people have agreed to join with us and unite into one country! This is a momentous day for [ROOT.GetName] and [FROM.GetName] both!
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.102.de: The [FROM.GetAdjective] government has wisely chosen to join with us, albeit not merging into one country but by accepting [ROOT.GetAdjective] leadership and guidance. While not the outcome we were hoping for, this will strengthen our positions in the Mediterranean without shedding blood.
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.102.a: Another victory of the working class!
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.103.de: It is apparent that the [FROM.GetAdjective] people are ruled by an unwise and selfish leader. [FROM.GetLeader] refuses to see reason and join forces with us, which would have strengthened both countries and ensured ever-lasting peace between our peoples.
loc.BBA_italy_anti_colonialism_events.103.b: The days of [FROM.GetLeader] might be coming to an end.
loc.bba_news.107.desc: Pope Pio XI has passed away after leading the Catholic Church for almost 20 years. During his turn as the Pontifex Maximus Pio XI ended the long breach between the Papacy and the Italian government and was crucial in establishing the Vatican as an independent state once again.
loc.bba_news.107.a: A new Pope shall be made
loc.bba_news.108.d:
Diplomats from the newly established government in Italy have been sent to negotiate with Albanian ruler, King Zog, seeking to strengthen the relationship between the two countries and attempting to pressure Zog into applying more socialist policies in Albania. 

Maybe feeling that the days of the Albanian Monarchy are coming to an end, or maybe just out of pure despite for socialism, King Zog has refused to talk to the Italian officials, urging the Albanian people to resist pressure from [ITA.GetNameDef]. 

Nevertheless, foreign military experts agree that [ALB.GetNameDef] has little chance of resisting an invasion should the Italian government take action.
loc.bba_news.109.desc: In an unprecedented move, [FROM.GetName]’s Grand Council of Fascism has seized power and deposed [?ITA.ITA_var_deposed_leader.GetName] and put him under house arrest. This action has been motivated by an effort to save the country from the military failures and incompetency of the Duce, which has caused tension within [FROM.GetName] and some fear that this could lead to Civil War unless steps are taken to ease the situation.
loc.bba_news.110.desc: The newly appointed leader of [FROM.GetName], [FROM.GetLeader], has been unable to address the rising tensions that have divided the [FROM.GetAdjective]s recently. This has caused a Civil War to erupt, tearing the country apart from within. Different groups, ranging from communists to royalists to democrats, are all vying for power and creating shifting alliances while the fascists are determined to maintain their rule. \n\nWhile the outcome of the Civil War is still uncertain, outside help will surely play a major part in the future victory.
loc.bba_news.111.desc_joint_proclamation: [From.GetName] and [SPC.GetName] have made a joint proclamation of the establishment of the Anarchist Confederation, where they pledge to help each other and come to one another’s aid if they are attacked by a foreign power. The joint declaration has seen thousands of anarchists flocking to Italy in support of this proclamation.
loc.bba_news.111.desc_single_proclamation: Thousands upon thousands of anarchists from all over the world are flocking to [FROM.GetName] after the government proclaimed the founding of the Anarchist Confederation. In their proclamation, they made sweeping statements about crushing capitalism and defeating fascism wherever these evils are found.
loc.bba_news.111.a: We shall see how long this lasts
loc.bba_news.666.desc: The Pope [FROM.GetLeader] has shocked world leaders by deposing king [?ITA.ITA_var_deposed_leader.GetName] of [FROM.GetName] and assuming power for himself, claiming that God wills it. While many Italians are shocked as well, the Papacy has wide support in the country and some are hailing this sudden shift in government as the beginning of a new and glorious era for [FROM.GetNameDefCap].
loc.bba_news.200.desc: [GER.GetAdjective] radio has broadcast news that the Führer, Adolf Hitler, has died. The news comes after heavy fighting in [GER.Capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName] and the wider push into [GER.GetAdjective] heartlands by allied and [SOV.GetAdjective] forces. The news was announced by [GER.GetLeader], supposedly the Führer’s chosen successor, who expressed the nation’s sorrow at the loss of Hitler and detailed his death at a command post where he was orchestrating the defense of the nation. Neither Hitler’s death or the manner in which it supposedly took place can be verified. However, the announcement is bound to impact the morale of the [GER.GetAdjective] people.
loc.bba_news.200.b: So the bastard's dead? Too bad we didn't capture him alive!
loc.bba_news.200.c: Can we be sure he’s dead?
loc.bba_news.200.d: This changes nothing. We will fight to the last man.
loc.bba_news.201.desc: Despite a [POL.GetAdjective] government in exile operating from London during the war, the Allies have chosen to recognize the [SOV.GetAdjective] groomed communists as the legitimate government of [POL.GetName]. Diplomatic sources indicate that an agreement was made between the Allies and the [SOV.GetName] over the post-war division of Europe into spheres of influence. Unfortunately for the [POL.GetAdjective] government in London, a major stumbling block to [SOV.GetAdjective] agreement was [SOV.GetLeader]’s desire for Poland to be part of the [SOV.GetAdjective] sphere of influence.\n\nWhile many will consider this a betrayal of [POL.GetName], others argue that with [SOV.GetAdjective] forces already occupying the country, there was little reason in rejecting their ultimatum and jeopardizing the future stability of Europe.
loc.bba_news.201.a: An unfortunate sacrifice for future peace.
loc.bba_news.201.b: The Allies are not to be trusted.
loc.bba_news.201.c: We will never again leave ourselves vulnerable to fascist aggression from Europe.
loc.bba_news.100.t_some_purged: The Purge of the Partito Nazionale Fascista
loc.bba_news.100.desc_some_purged: Some of Mussolini's closest supporters have been removed from the fascist party as [ROOT.GetLeader] strengthens his grip on the party. The purge wasn’t as severe as some had feared, but leaves [ROOT.GetLeader] in a stronger position to pursue his own agenda for Italy.
loc.bba_news.100.t_many_purged: The Great Purge of the Partito Nazionale Fascista
loc.bba_news.100.desc_many_purged: Several high-ranking members of the fascist party were recently removed from power as [Root.GetLeader] emerges as the absolute leader of [ROOT.GetNameDefCap]. This purge eliminates any potential allies of the old Duce, Benito Mussolini, and any hopes to be reinstated as Italy’s leader again.
loc.bba_news.100.desc_none_purged: Rumors of a great purge to oust members loyal to Mussolini from Partito Nazionale Fascista have been swirling around as of late, but it seems a party-wide amnesty was offered instead. This might leave the Party stronger but has weakened [ROOT.GetLeader]'s position as its leader.
loc.bba_news.100.a_none_purged: [ROOT.GetLeader] the Merciful has a nice ring to it.
loc.bba_news.101.desc: After being ousted from power in Italy, Benito Mussolini was put under house arrest for criminal incompetence and treason by inaction, awaiting his fate - which finally caught up with him. Early this morning, the former leader of Italy faced a firing squad in front of a small group of representatives from the government and was buried the same day in a private ceremony attended by his closest family.
loc.bba_news.101.a: And so ends the life of Mussolini.
loc.bba_news.102.desc_innocent: To everyone’s surprise, the ex-Duce was found innocent on all charges and acquitted on all accounts. Mussolini is now free to live out the rest of his life as a free citizen of [ROOT.GetNameDefCap]. While he hasn’t revealed any further plans as of yet, one can not discount the sway the old Duce still holds over many people's hearts and minds.
loc.bba_news.102.desc_guilty: Maybe to no one’s surprise, the former leader of Italy has been found guilty on all charges. The former Duce had pleaded not guilty but was sentenced to serve the rest of his life in prison. One can only assume that the new regime influenced the trial and must be quite pleased with its outcome.
loc.bba_news.103.desc_communists: The former leader of [FROM.GetNameDefCap], Benito Mussolini, has been found dead, apparently executed by Communists. The new regime under [FROM.GetLeader] have acted quickly and rounded up several Communist sympathizers as an agitated atmosphere has gripped the country, with many calling out for justice and vengeance against perceived enemies.
loc.bba_news.103.desc_coverstory: The former leader of [FROM.GetNameDefCap], Benito Mussolini, tried to escape his house arrest where he has been placed after being ousted from power. A handful of armed men stormed Mussolini's quarters and a shoot-out ensued. During the turmoil, Mussolini was hit and died from his wounds.
loc.bba_news.104.desc: [ROOT.GetNameDefCap] signs a joint cooperation program with [FROM.GetNameDefCap] to strengthen both nation’s military capabilities. The deal will enable both countries to share technologies and research more readily and will surely reinforce the bond between them.
loc.bba_news.105.desc: [ROOT.GetNameDefCap] and [FROM.GetNameDefCap] have signed a non-aggression pact, guaranteeing peace between the two nations. This will leave them free to focus elsewhere, but everyone wonders just how long this precarious pact will last.
loc.bba_news.106.desc_king: The old king of [FROM.GetName], Vittorio Emanuele III, has died. Guiding Italy during two World Wars he has served as a symbol of stability and a rallying point for the [FROM.GetAdjective]s during these hardships. Grieving people have taken to the streets to show their appreciation and support for the dead king. \n\n The nation is hoping that the old king’s only heir and successor, Prince Umberto, will be a similarly steadfast fixture for the [FROM.GetAdjective] people. The prince will soon be crowned King Umberto II - long may he reign!
loc.bba_news.106.desc_emperor: The old emperor of [FROM.GetName], Vittorio Emanuele III, has died. Guiding Italy during two World Wars he has served as a symbol of stability and a rallying point for the [FROM.GetAdjective]s during these hardships. Grieving people have taken to the streets to show their appreciation and support for the dead emperor. \n\n The nation is hoping that the old emperor's only heir and successor, Prince Umberto, will be a similarly steadfast fixture for the [FROM.GetAdjective] people. The prince will soon be crowned Emperor Umberto I of [FROM.GetName] - long may he reign!
loc.bba_italian_formables_news.1.desc: Today, the Italian leader [ITA.GetLeader] has announced the start of a process to integrate areas claimed by Italian Irredentists into the Italian state. He has proclaimed that this will strengthen Italy's position as a world power, and finally unite the Italian people under one flag. Many have asked themselves if a nation as vast as this can really keep together, and only time knows what it has in store for Italy.
loc.bba_italian_formables_news.1.a: We are the new hegemons of Europe!
loc.bba_italian_formables_news.1.b: Such a nation will inevitably crumble
loc.BBA_switzerland.1.desc: The political situation inside and around [ROOT.GetNameDefCap] is deteriorating quickly. There is a growing movement advocating for guiding principles to steer the ship in the right direction during the impending storm, but the question is, which one?. \n\n We do not know what our neighbors will do, but we must decide now what course of action will allow [ROOT.GetName] to survive.
loc.BBA_switzerland.1.a: We must protect our democratic and neutral values
loc.BBA_switzerland.1.b: Perhaps we should be more active about protecting our democracy
loc.BBA_switzerland.1.c: Neutrality is untenable under these circumstances
loc.BBA_switzerland.2.t: Nazi Party representative in Switzerland assassinated
loc.BBA_switzerland.2.desc:
David Frankfurter, a Jewish Croat living in Bern, turned himself in to the Graubünden Police and confessed to the assassination of Wilhelm Gustloff, the leader of the Nazi Party's Foreign Organization in Switzerland. 

He cited the Nazi Party's harmful beliefs towards the Jewish people and Gustloff's role in spreading them in [SWI.GetName] as the reason for the shooting. 

How we choose to proceed in this potentially lengthy issue will be used by [GER.GetNameDef] and the rest of the world as a way to measure our dedication to neutrality and the rule of law.
loc.BBA_switzerland.2.a: He will have a fair trial.
loc.BBA_switzerland.2.b: Cover it all up, recruit him as an operative!
loc.BBA_switzerland.2.c: He confessed, so he should get the maximum sentence straight away.
loc.BBA_switzerland.3.desc:
The trial of David Frankfurter, who back in February assassinated a Nazi Party representative in Davos, is near. We have promised for him to have a fair and neutral trial, but there are certainly other options. 

We could secretly free him and recruit him for intelligence operations, or instead, we could try to appease [?SWI.SWI_fascist_germany.GetNameDef] by cancelling the trial and sentencing him right away instead. 

Whatever we do, pleasing every side might be beyond our means.
loc.BBA_switzerland.3.a: The trial will continue as planned
loc.BBA_switzerland.3.b: He will be an asset for our intelligence efforts
loc.BBA_switzerland.3.c: On second thought, he is clearly guilty
loc.BBA_switzerland.4.desc: The leader of [?SWI.SWI_fascist_germany.GetNameDef], [?SWI.SWI_fascist_germany.Getleader] has expressed [?SWI.SWI_fascist_germany.Getleader.GetHerHis] gratitude towards [SWI.GetNameDef] for swiftly dealing with Wilhelm Gustloff's killer, so there is no doubt where [SWI.GetName] stands on matters like these. This omission of human rights and democratic values will certainly improve [?SWI.SWI_fascist_germany.GetName]'s attitude towards us. \n\nDespite [?SWI.SWI_fascist_germany.Getleader.GetHerHis] positive remarks, it was made clear that the ideal outcome for the Nazi Party would've been extradition to [?SWI.SWI_fascist_germany.GetNameDef], even if, for now, that is out of the question for [SWI.GetNameDef].
loc.BBA_switzerland.5.t: [SWI.GetName] decides to continue with the trial of Gustloff's killer
loc.BBA_switzerland.5.desc:
Authorities in [SWI.GetName] have announced that David Frankfurter, who confessed to the killing of the Nazi Party Foreign Organization in Davos, will have a fair and balanced trial under Graubünden laws like any other murder case.

Considering Gustloff was an officer of the Nazi Party, and our influence on our defenseless neighbor, we could send a lawyer to represent Gustloff's widow and push for our ideal outcome. This way, we can ensure his punishment is befitting his crime. 

Speaking more pragmatically, this could also force [SWI.GetNameDef] to take a side, finally breaking that flimsy facade of neutrality they always like to boast about.
loc.BBA_switzerland.5.a: She deserves justice for this heinous crime!
loc.BBA_switzerland.5.b: No need to intervene in [SWI.GetAdjective] affairs
loc.BBA_switzerland.6.t: [GER.GetAdjective] push for a harsh sentence for David Frankfurter
loc.BBA_switzerland.6.desc: The legal representative of Gustloff's widow, no doubt sent by [?SWI.SWI_fascist_germany.GetNameDef], is trying to push for the Federal Council to tilt the court towards a harsh sentence for David Frankfurter. This is a very unusual request, which is unquestionably an attempt by [?SWI.SWI_fascist_germany.GetNameDef] to project power over us. \n\nAccepting this might have repercussions for our international reputation, but we should make sure if we can afford to refuse them if that's what we decide to do.
loc.BBA_switzerland.6.a: This is a matter for the courts
loc.BBA_switzerland.7.desc: Authorities in Graubünden report that David Frankfurter, who was in detention after confessing to the murder of Nazi Party representative Wilhelm Gustloff, was found dead in his cell this morning. Whether this was self inflicted, or caused by an enraged Nazi sympathizer inside the jail is unknown for the moment, but the Federal Police promises to find answers.\n\nWe don't have any proof of wrongdoing but the circumstances of this are very mysterious, and some are very suspicious of the [SWI.GetAdjective] government for not letting [?SWI.SWI_fascist_germany.GetAdjective] representatives inspect the body or the scene of the crime.
loc.BBA_switzerland.8.desc: The whole of [SWI.GetName] and its neighbors have eyes in the trial of David Frankfurter. The result of this trial will not only reveal the fate of the self declared guilty party, but of [SWI.GetNameDef] as a whole, and to what lengths it is willing to compromise in its institutions and traditions. \n\nAll signs from the court are pointing towards a fair prison sentence, but influence from the council could change the outcome of the trial, and perhaps the very essence of the country.
loc.BBA_switzerland.8.a: Let the courts make their decision
loc.BBA_switzerland.8.b: He's done a service to Democracy. He should be pardoned!
loc.BBA_switzerland.8.c: We can't risk alienating [?SWI.SWI_fascist_germany.GetNameDef]. He shall get the maximum sentence
loc.BBA_switzerland.9.desc_default: [SWI.GetNameDefCap], despite our calls for justice, and their pretension of neutrality and rule of law, have pardoned David Frankfurter, who not only killed a member of the Nazi Party, but willingly admitted it!\n\nThis proves that they have picked a side, and will be fair game in a potential war to come. We cannot let this insult to [?SWI.SWI_fascist_germany.GetNameDef] stand.
loc.BBA_switzerland.9.desc_alt: Our agents in [SWI.GetName] report that, despite their pretension of neutrality and rule of law, [SWI.GetNameDef] surreptitiously broke David Frankfurter, the self proclaimed killer of Wilhem Gustloff, out of jail by faking his death and have recruited him as an intelligence agent.\n\nThis proves they cannot be trusted and must be eliminated when we get an opportunity. We cannot let this blatant insult to [?SWI.SWI_fascist_germany.GetNameDef] stand.
loc.BBA_switzerland.10.desc: Representatives from [?SWI.SWI_fascist_germany.GetNameDef] and Gustloff's widow have expressed their gratitude towards [SWI.GetNameDef] for their resolute sentence for Frankfurter, so there is no doubt where [SWI.GetNameDef] stands on matters like these. This will certainly improve [?SWI.SWI_fascist_germany.GetName]'s attitude towards [SWI.GetName]. \n\nDespite [?SWI.SWI_fascist_germany.Getleader.GetHerHis] positive remarks, it was made clear that the ideal outcome for the Nazi Party would've been extradition to [?SWI.SWI_fascist_germany.GetNameDef].
loc.BBA_switzerland.10.a: Perhaps this will guarantee our safety
loc.BBA_switzerland.11.desc_SWI: As the council decided to stay away from the case and leave it to the courts and Grisons law, David Frankfurter, who willfully assassinated Wilhelm Gustloff, was sentenced to 18 years of prison. \n\nWe know [?SWI.SWI_fascist_germany.GetNameDef] would've wanted a much more punitive sentence, so our diplomats will have their work cut out for them in order to appease them, but we couldn't risk seeming to take sides in times like these. Our neutrality is what might keep the [SWI.GetAdjective] people safe during the storm that might come.
loc.BBA_switzerland.11.desc_GER: [SWI.GetNameDefCap] had the gall to give a paltry 18 year sentence to Gustloff's killer! It's unfortunate, but we couldn't have pushed much harder for more punitive sentence, at the risk of inflaming the calls for a boycott of the Olympics. \n\nFor now, we can at least make Gustloff a martyr of [?SWI.SWI_fascist_germany.GetNameDef] and use the murder for propaganda. Maybe in a future invasion we could get a hold of Frankfurter and we can have our justice.
loc.BBA_switzerland.11.a: It is the best we can do right now
loc.BBA_switzerland.12.desc: Now that the war is over and $GER_fascism_DEF$ no longer exists, David Frankfurter, with help from his legal counsel, George Brunschvig, has requested a pardon for the killing of Wilhelm Gustloff back in 1936.\n\nSince we are no longer surrounded by fascist regimes, and Frankfurter's crime has been re-contextualized thanks to Nazi atrocities discovered throughout the war, there would be almost no risk in offering him clemency, and we could even forbid him from re-entering [ROOT.GetName], just in case.
loc.BBA_switzerland.13.desc: The representative we sent to advise Gustloff's widow has returned with fantastic news. The verdict from the judges in [SWI.GetName] gave a very harsh sentence to David Frankfurter, close enough to what we requested.
loc.BBA_switzerland.13.a: Maybe we won't need to invade after all
loc.SWI_frankfurter_trial_will_continue_TT: §YDavid Frankfurter§! will go on trial and events will unfold over time.
loc.SWI_frankfurter_immediate_harsh_sentence: §YDavid Frankfurter§! will be given the maximum sentence without trial.
loc.SWI_frankfurter_german_expectations_TT: §Y[GER.GetNameDefCap]§! will expect a harsher sentence for §YDavid Frankfurter§!
loc.BBA_switzerland.14.desc: The Federal Council has received a petition signed by 200 members of several right wing groups that hope to push [ROOT.GetNameDef] towards a friendlier relationship with [SWI_get_fascist_neighbor] while remaining relatively neutral. They want to achieve this by instituting harsh censorship of any negative press towards them, to avoid their ire.
loc.BBA_switzerland.14.a: We should placate them while ignoring their request
loc.BBA_switzerland.14.c: These are enemies of Switzerland, arrest them!
loc.BBA_switzerland.15.t: [FROM.GetName] is offering to lend us an operative
loc.BBA_switzerland.15.desc: Despite their neutral position, [FROM.GetNameDef] is secretly offering the opportunity to employ one of their operatives for our intelligence missions. \n\nThis is especially beneficial to us, as [SWI.GetNonIdeologyName]'s population shares language with [GER.GetNonIdeologyName], [FRA.GetNonIdeologyName] and [ITA.GetNonIdeologyName], so they have an advantage infiltrating those countries.
loc.BBA_switzerland_fra.15.tt: Will gain a local operative of §Y[FRA.GetAdjectiveCap]§! and §Y[SWI.GetAdjectiveCap]§! nationality
loc.BBA_switzerland_ita.15.tt: Will gain a local operative of §Y[ITA.GetAdjectiveCap]§! and §Y[SWI.GetAdjectiveCap]§! nationality
loc.BBA_switzerland_ger.15.tt: Will gain a local operative of §Y[GER.GetAdjectiveCap]§! and §Y[SWI.GetAdjectiveCap]§! nationality
loc.BBA_switzerland.16.desc: One of our covert agents stationed in [FROM.capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName] has been approached with proposition from the [FROM.GetAdjective] government; A secret pact between our faction and [FROM.GetNameDef], which will mean they'll help us undermine our enemies in Europe, while keeping up their appearance of neutrality, and even abandoning it in our favor when the time comes.\n\nIt will also mean that we'll go in their defense if they were at risk of being invaded.
loc.BBA_switzerland.17.desc: Through our backchannels with [FROM.GetNameDef], we have confirmation that they have agreed to our proposed secret alliance. From now on, they'll have our support against their enemies, and protect us if we ever find ourselves at the edge of being invaded. This does not mean we are safe though, the enemy could reveal our actions and see them as a threat, so we must continue with the same caution we have shown so far, while we prepare for jumping into action.
loc.BBA_switzerland.17.a: It's for the sake of our democracy!
loc.BBA_switzerland.18.desc: Terrible news from our contacts in [FROM.GetCapitalVictoryPointName]. It appears that the [FROM.GetAdjective] government has rejected our proposal for a secret pact, leaving us exposed to invasion from our neighbors. We must now prepare to defend ourselves, or look for another route to keep our independence and democracy.
loc.BBA_switzerland.18.a: We stand alone against our enemies.
loc.BBA_switzerland.19.t: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] is Inviting Us to Join Their Entente
loc.BBA_switzerland.19.desc: Historically, [FROM.GetName] has been staunchly neutral, but it seems they have decided to break it, in response to the current world situation, and seem to be asking other neutral countries to break theirs. If joining their faction is too big a leap from being neutral, we could also guarantee each other's independence.
loc.BBA_switzerland.19.a: Unusual times call for unusual measures
loc.BBA_switzerland.19.c: Our neutrality might be our only protection.
loc.BBA_switzerland.20.t: [FROM.GetName] Won't Join Our Entente but Offers Guarantees
loc.BBA_switzerland.20.desc: After our invitation to join [ROOT.GetFactionName], [FROM.GetNameDef] informed us that, despite rejecting our offer, they will guarantee our independence as long as we guarantee theirs. A compromise so they can keep their neutrality.
loc.BBA_switzerland.21.t: A desperate [FROM.GetName] Asks for Our Guarantee
loc.BBA_switzerland.21.desc: As [?FROM.SWI_angriest_country.GetNameDef] threatens war against [FROM.GetName] for what they perceive to be an ever escalating list of breaches of neutrality, [From.GetNameDef] is requesting we promise to protect them against their warmongering by guaranteeing [FROM.GetAdjective] independence.
loc.BBA_switzerland.22.desc: Diplomatic cables have arrived from [FROM.GetName] bringing excellent news. They have agreed to guarantee our independence, promising to defend us if anyone attacks us, including [?SWI.SWI_angriest_country.GetName].
loc.BBA_switzerland.23.t: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] Rejects Any Commitment to Our Cause!
loc.BBA_switzerland.23.desc: Unfortunately, [FROM.GetName] has decided to ignore our plight against [?SWI.SWI_angriest_country.GetNameDef]. They will not stand beside us against their threats.
loc.BBA_switzerland.23.a: We can only rely on ourselves
loc.BBA_switzerland.24.t: [?SWI.SWI_angriest_country.GetNameDefCap] Considers Us in Breach of Neutrality
loc.BBA_switzerland.24.desc: Our neutrality is not only maintained by our equal attitude towards every other country, but also by their perception of it. According to [?SWI.SWI_angriest_country.GetNameDef], we have broken our promise of neutrality and favored their enemies over them. They have communicated that unless they're appeased soon, they will stop considering us a neutral nation and even declare war on us.
loc.BBA_switzerland.25.desc: Black news, as [?SWI.SWI_angriest_country.GetName] announces their disdain for [ROOT.GetNameDef], they have declared that we are fair game for political wrangling and even conquest.
loc.BBA_switzerland.97.t: Austrian Navy Veteran Offers His Services
loc.BBA_switzerland.97.desc:
Under the guise of a European tour with his musically talented family, a veteran Submarine Captain has crossed our borders from Austria and is offering his services to [ROOT.GetNameDef] in exchange for asylum.

Georg Von Trapp had an impressive record with the Austro-Hungarian Navy, but since the end of The Great War, the dissolution of the empire and the loss of his fortune, he's performed with his family of singers and musicians. Since [GER.GetNameDef]'s annexation of Austria, he is being pressed into service for them, thus he escaped.

Certainly his family's musical flair will be as appreciated as his naval experience, especially since we find ourselves with a coast and no staff to defend it.
loc.BBA_switzerland.97.a: The waves will be alive with the sound of our torpedoes
loc.BBA_switzerland.97.b: He and his family can stay in Switzerland and perform regardless
loc.BBA_SWI_annual_election.1.t: Elections for the President of the Swiss Confederation
loc.BBA_SWI_annual_election.1.desc: Every year, the Swiss Federal Assembly chooses one of the councilors to be President of the Swiss Confederation, first among equals, [?ROOT.SWI_confederation_president.GetSheHe] will use [?ROOT.SWI_confederation_president.GetHerHis] limited powers to represent the council and break any ties in the council to gently steer the council towards safety or glory.\n\n[SWI_get_extra_election_paragraph]Who should the Assembly elect to be the face of the Swiss Confederation this year?
loc.SWI_first_election_text: Once a councilor becomes president of the confederation they will not be able to be assigned as a Political Advisor again, but they will have a powerful Decision at their disposal. When a Political Advisor slot is vacant for too long you will suffer penalties, so make sure to fill the position quickly.\n\n
loc.BBA_SWI_annual_election.2.desc: After the unprecedented ousting of [?SWI_ousted_president.GetName], and a period of political instability in the Federal Council, it is time to elect a new President of the Confederation. Let us hope they can rectify the course of [SWI.GetNameDef] and that they're not the last to hold the position.
loc.BBA_switzerland_trade.1.desc: Despite their historical neutrality, [FROM.GetNameDefCap] is seeking to establish a trade agreement with our nation. Either they seek to align themselves with us, or they are more desperate than we thought. \n\nRegardless, we stand to benefit from tapping into their industrial capacity and convenient location without having to go through the ordeal of invading their heavily fortified country. On the other hand, this could mean strengthening their position in the event of a future invasion by [ROOT.GetNameDef]
loc.BBA_switzerland_trade.1.a: Their factories will fuel our war machine
loc.BBA_switzerland_trade.1.b: Our civilian economies will help each other
loc.BBA_switzerland_trade.1.c: We do not need help from a spineless neutral country
loc.BBA_switzerland_trade.2.t: [FROM.GetName] breaks trade agreement with us prematurely
loc.BBA_switzerland_trade.2.desc: It seems that [FROM.GetName] is refusing to continue the trade agreement we entered with them, despite ample benefits for both parties. \n\nThere is not much we can do about it now, but this lack of commitment will certainly be remembered by [ROOT.GetNameDef].
loc.BBA_switzerland_trade.2.b: We will not let them fool us again
loc.BBA_switzerland_trade.3.desc: The trade agreement we have had with [FROM.GetNameDef] for the past year has been very fruitful for [ROOT.GetName], and now it is time to decide whether we should renew it or not. \n\n Despite the benefits of such a bilateral agreement, and how much a nation like ours needs it, we should be aware that it might be considered a further breach of our neutrality by some countries. We should make sure alienating them is both manageable and worth it.
loc.BBA_switzerland_trade.3.a: Yes, we need these supplies for our survival
loc.BBA_switzerland_trade.4.t: [FROM.GetName] wants to renew our trade agreement
loc.BBA_switzerland_trade.4.desc: It seems [FROM.GetName]'s trade agreement with us has been very beneficial for them, seeing as they are willing to risk breaching neutrality again and secure supplies from us. \n\n This agreement does not have many drawbacks for us, unless we are providing the tools for their defense against our potential invasion of [FROM.GetName].
loc.BBA_switzerland_trade.4.b: Change the focus to Civilian Production
loc.BBA_switzerland_trade.4.c: Change the focus to Military Production
loc.BBA_switzerland_trade.4.d: It is not worth our trouble anymore
loc.BBA_switzerland_trade.5.t: [FROM.GetName] has left our trade agreement lapse
loc.BBA_switzerland_trade.5.desc: Despite the generous terms we have granted [FROM.GetName] in our mutual trade agreement, they have decided not to renew it and instead preferred to go at it alone. \n\n It is beyond us why they would decide to do such a thing, but maybe it is for the best.
loc.BBA_switzerland_trade.6.t: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has accepted our trade agreement proposal!
loc.BBA_switzerland_trade.6.desc: Our delegation is now back from [FROM.GetName] bearing great news. This trade agreement will allow us to secure the necessary supplies to keep our industry and population going. \n\n Other countries might consider this a breach of neutrality but for [ROOT.GetName] it is just the cost of maintaining our independence in this uncertain times.
loc.BBA_switzerland_trade.7.desc: Despite our best efforts, the [FROM.GetAdjective] government has decided to reject our proposal for a mutually beneficial trade agreement. \n\n This potentially leaves [ROOt.GetName] in a precarious position, as the situation in Europe is making it increasingly difficult to secure a stable source for the civilian and military supplies needed to keep our country defended and fed.
loc.BBA_switzerland_trade.8.desc: With the tension between countries rising across the world, trade has become more difficult, and if we find ourselves at war, options for buying and selling gold will become even more limited. If we trust them enough, [FROM.GetName]'s neutrality could be an opportunity for us to store our reserves and trade freely, benefiting our economy, and ultimately our war machine.
loc.BBA_switzerland_trade.8.b: We can't know where they really stand
loc.BBA_switzerland_trade.9.t: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] Will Trade Their Gold Through Us
loc.BBA_switzerland_trade.9.desc: This means they will store their gold reserves with us, allowing them to buy and sell gold freely, without having to worry about embargoes. They're not the only ones that will stand to gain from this, as the influx of money will help our struggling economy, and could even be used as a bargaining chip in the future.
loc.BBA_switzerland_trade.10.t: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] Refuses to Use Our Banking System
loc.BBA_switzerland_trade.10.desc: Despite an obvious mutual benefit, it seems like [FROM.GetName] is not interested in increased trading gold with the rest of the world.
loc.BBA_switzerland_trade.11.t: We Could Further Trade Gold Through [FROM.GetAdjective] Exchanges
loc.BBA_switzerland_trade.11.desc: We are already using markets in [FROM.GetName] to bypass trade barriers set up by the world's political situation. Increasing our reserves there could benefit our economy further, even if it benefits theirs as well.
loc.BBA_switzerland_trade.11.b: We cannot risk making the betrayal worse
loc.BBA_switzerland_trade.12.desc: This is something that we should have seen coming. They have used their veneer of neutrality to stab us in the back. This will have severe consequences for our economy, we must retaliate.
loc.BBA_switzerland_trade.13.t: [FROM.GetName] Wants Us to Invest in Their Country
loc.BBA_switzerland_trade.13.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] is asking for our support in order to withstand the fascist powers knocking at their doors. We can invest in their economy, this way they can be prepared for the worst, or even help fight Fascism directly if they choose, or are forced to break their longstanding neutrality.
loc.BBA_switzerland_trade.13.a: We have to help them stave off fascism
loc.BBA_switzerland_trade.13.b: This will not benefit us at all
loc.BBA_switzerland_trade.14.desc: These investments will help us improve our economy, and allow us to resist any hardships that fascism may cause upon [ROOT.GetName]. They will also bring our nations closer together, maybe even in direct opposition to Fascism eventually.
loc.BBA_switzerland_trade.15.desc: Unfortunately, we have been informed that [FROM.GetName] will not be investing in the [ROOT.GetAdjective] economy. We stand more isolated than we would want to be, considering the impending danger of Fascism.
loc.BBA_switzerland_fascist.1.desc: The puny nation of [FROM.GetName], formerly a Criminal Cheese State, is looking to attach themselves to [ROOT.GetNameDef] by becoming our puppet. This can be considered an admission of weakness, or a declaration of loyalty towards the [ROOT.GetRulingParty]\n\n Their strong defensive capabilities and well trained civilian population might be useful for our future plans.
loc.BBA_switzerland_fascist.2.desc: Despite our overtures towards [FROM.GetName], they have rejected our proposal of submission to the [FROM.GetAdjective] regime. \n\n This puts us in a delicate situation, as we have clearly lost any appearance of neutrality, and we might now survive what's to come on our own.
loc.BBA_switzerland_fascist.3.desc: [FROM.GetNameDef] is claiming that they have a claim on [848.GetName] after an election in 1919 where the majority of the region chose to join what at the time was the Swiss Confederation. As much as they've abandoned Democracy and the vote happened decades ago, giving them responsibility over this state could free up the resources we spend holding the territory, and could work as a test of [FROM.GetName]'s capabilities and more importantly, loyalties.
loc.BBA_switzerland_fascist.3.b: They can't be trusted with it
loc.BBA_switzerland_fascist.4.t: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has denied our request for expansion
loc.BBA_switzerland_fascist.4.desc: Despite clearly showing our loyalty and capabilities, [FROM.GetNameDef] has chosen to reject our request. The expansion of [ROOT.GetNameDef] into [?SWI.SWI_requested_territory.GetName] will have to wait, maybe until we decide our continued subordination to [FROM.GetName] is no longer worth it.
loc.BBA_switzerland_fascist.5.t: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has accepted our request for control of [?SWI.SWI_requested_territory.GetName]
loc.BBA_switzerland_fascist.5.desc: It might've come with a heavy price tag, but the subordination and honor we've shown [FROM.GetNameDef] has paid off. Effective immediately, [ROOT.GetNameDef] will be in control of [?SWI.SWI_requested_territory.GetName] on their behalf and will be incorporated into our territory.
loc.BBA_switzerland_fascist.6.desc: After the apparent success of the [FROM.GetAdjective] occupation of [848.GetName], [FROM.GetNameDef] is offering to defend our [SWI_requested_territory.GetAdjective] territories on our behalf. \n\n Of course this also means relinquishing our control over the area to them, so we should be careful in our assessment of their loyalty.
loc.BBA_switzerland_fascist.7.desc: In a rally in [ROOT.GetCapitalVictoryPointName], [ROOT.GetLeader] announced [FROM.GetName]'s promise of very tight cooperation between our countries, and of protecting [ROOT.GetName] from our enemies, and theirs. \n\nFriendly officers and functionaries from [FROM.GetNameDef], our friends, are streaming into our nation as we speak, to help us develop our military strength and be ready for putting it to their service.
loc.BBA_swiss_expansion.1.desc: Despite the best efforts of our propagandists, Democracy did not spread as much as we expected in the cantons of [?SWI.SWI_influence_target_state.GetName], so unfortunately we don't think a referendum to join us would be successful.\n\nThis does not mean that we should quit, we have planted a seed that can be nurtured further, making us more likely to succeed next time.
loc.BBA_swiss_expansion.1.a: We will not abandon our mission
loc.BBA_swiss_expansion.2.t: Thanks to our influence, [SWI_influenced_state] wants to join our fold
loc.BBA_swiss_expansion.2.desc:
After an extensive propaganda campaign, the people of [?SWI.SWI_influence_target_state.GetName] overwhelmingly support joining the [ROOT.GetNameDef].

This means that were  [?SWI.SWI_influence_target_state.GetName] a democracy such as ours, they would be part of our country. Unfortunately, that's not the case, so they will need our help to become [SWI.GetName]'s newest cantons.

We now can press for a referendum in the state to decide their membership in [ROOT.GetNameDef].
loc.BBA_swiss_expansion.2.a: We must bring true Democracy to them
loc.BBA_swiss_expansion.3.desc: Those supposedly neutral rogues in [FROM.GetName] have the gall to claim [?SWI.SWI_state_being_claimed.GetName] as their own. They allege that support for joining [FROM.GetNameDef] is high enough that a referendum on that question would go towards them, making the state rightfully theirs.\n\nWe can let [?SWI.SWI_state_being_claimed.GetName] have a referendum, which we'll definitely lose, or risk war with them if we refuse.
loc.BBA_swiss_expansion.4.desc: After a peaceful referendum all across [?SWI.SWI_state_being_claimed.GetName] resoundingly in our favor, [FROM.GetNameDef] has accepted to transfer control of the state to us. We will immediately convert the territories inside [?SWI.SWI_state_being_claimed.GetName] into cantons, and they will finally experience our form of democracy.
loc.BBA_swiss_expansion.5.desc: Despite the popular support for democracy and [ROOT.GetNameDef], [FROM.GetName] has decided to ignore the people of [?SWI.SWI_state_being_claimed.GetName] in their quest for a referendum on their membership of the Confederation.\n\nThis is a clear call for us to take up arms and defend our occupied cantons against the tyranny of [FROM.GetNameDef].
loc.BBA_swiss_expansion.6.desc: It seems that [FROM.GetName] is demanding that the state of [848.GetName] join their confederation. They cite a referendum in 1919 where the state overwhelmingly voted to join as a canton of [FROM.GetNameDef], but were rejected by the [FROM.GetAdjective] themselves. It appears they've now changed their minds.\n\nWhether we accept or not, it is obvious they have their sights set on expansion, so we should thread carefully, and be ready to defend our territory even if we accept their demands.
loc.BBA_swiss_expansion.6.a: The risk is not worth such a small state
loc.BBA_swiss_expansion.6.c: We will not be bullied by the pimple on the face of Europe
loc.BBA_swiss_expansion.7.t: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] Has Rejected Our Demand for [848.GetName] Joining [ROOT.GetName]
loc.BBA_swiss_expansion.7.desc: The [FROM.GetAdjective] government has categorically rejected our request, despite our strong claim and the democratic will of the people of [848.GetName].\n\nWe should not let this slight pass by.
loc.BBA_swiss_expansion.8.t: The [FROM.GetAdjective] Government Has Accepted our Request for [848.GetName]'s Freedom
loc.BBA_swiss_expansion.8.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has seen the light and agreed with us that [848.GetName]'s place is with [ROOT.GetNameDef] as its newest canton.\n\nThis is merely the first step into [ROOT.GetName]'s path for a more democratic Europe!
loc.BBA_swiss_expansion.9.desc:
After demanding we hand over [848.GetName] under arguably tenuous pretenses, [FROM.GetNameDef] is offering to take our territories to, allegedly, protect us from [GER.GetNameDef], who they claim will likely try to annex [ROOT.GetNameDef] soon.

While this sounds relatively plausible and together we would have a better chance fending off invasion, paying with our sovereignty might be too high a price.

Of course, we can expect them to attack us if we refuse.
loc.BBA_swiss_expansion.9.a: This might be our only chance of survival
loc.BBA_swiss_expansion.9.b: That's a price we're not willing to pay!
loc.BBA_swiss_expansion.10.desc: Towns across the Alps will celebrate the union of our two Alpine nations! We will be able to better defend ourselves against the great powers that surround us.
loc.BBA_swiss_expansion.11.desc: Despite our attempts to forge a new nation capable of defending itself against the biggest powers of Europe, [FROM.GetLeader] has expressed [FROM.GetLeader.GetHerHis] disgust at our proposal.
loc.BBA_swiss_expansion.11.a: We only have one choice left.
loc.BBA_swiss_expansion.12.desc: In an unexpected turn of events, [FROM.GetNameDef] is laying claim to the [ROOT.GetAdjective] Alps. Their argument is tenuous at best, but they do have a large portion of their population deployed and ready to invade if we refuse. That and a very favorable terrain for them would make it a long and costly war should we say no, so we must weigh our options.
loc.BBA_swiss_expansion.12.desc_FRA: Our sister republic, [FROM.GetNameDef] is looking to take all of the Alps under their wing and has laid claim to them.\n\nOur [ROOT.GetAdjective] Alps have been part of our nation for a very long time, but turning them into part of [FROM.GetAdjective] territory would reward them for their loyalty and drive, making them into an even more powerful ally.
loc.BBA_swiss_expansion.13.desc: The [FROM.GetAdjective] government has made the right call and conceded that their alpine territories rightfully belong to us. This will guarantee our safety from aggressors further.
loc.BBA_swiss_expansion.14.desc: Despite our forceful demand for the [FROM.GetAdjective] Alps, [FROM.GetNameDef] has expressed their dismissal of our claims. We still have other ways of seizing this territory if we choose to go forward with them.
loc.BBA_swiss_expansion.14.a: We'll get them one way or the other
loc.BBA_swiss_expansion.15.t: [FROM.GetName] is Trying to Turn [AUS.GetName] Against Us!
loc.BBA_swiss_expansion.15.desc: Our efforts to unite [AUS.GetNonIdeologyName] with [ROOT.GetNonIdeologyName] are being thwarted by [FROM.GetName], they're campaigning in favor of their disgraceful system of government and against us.\n\nPressing for Anschluss while this slanderous crusade is ongoing will prove impossible, so we will have to wait to fulfill our glorious destiny!
loc.BBA_swiss_expansion.15.a: They are only delaying the inevitable!
loc.BBA_swiss_expansion.16.desc: Despite our protection and support, our subject [FROM.GetName] is now demanding we free them from their privileges and duties to us so they can once again become their own nation.\n\n[GetDemandingAlpsParagraph]
loc.BBA_swiss_expansion.16.b: They shall be an independent country, along with our Alpine states
loc.BBA_swiss_expansion.16.c: They will have to fight for it!
loc.SWI_independence_demand_alps_paragraph: Besides their independence, they're grave enough to also demand we hand over our part of the alps, ostensibly to form a country encompassing all of the Alps.\n\n
loc.SWI_have_alps_but_only_independence: We'll allow independence but no more
loc.BBA_swiss_expansion.17.t_alps: [FROM.GetName] Has Granted Us Our Independence but not Their Alpine Territories
loc.BBA_swiss_expansion.17.desc_alps: It is a momentous day, even if we have not achieved all our goals yet. [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has reluctantly allowed us to part ways with them, granting us our coveted independence. And yet, in the same breath, they have disgracefully declared their unwillingness to part with their Alpine territories.\n\nWe will have to find another way of uniting the Alps under our flag.
loc.BBA_swiss_expansion.17.desc_no_alps: A joyous day for [ROOT.GetNonIdeologyName], [FROM.GetNameDef] has accepted our request for independence. This means that we are free to set our own agenda once again and choose our foreign policy stance. On the other hand, we will also have to fend for ourselves.
loc.BBA_swiss_expansion.18.t: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] Granted Us and the Alps Our Independence
loc.BBA_swiss_expansion.18.desc: Our designs are finally coming together. [ROOT.GetNonIdeologyName] is finally getting its independence back, and along with it, the territories formerly known as the [FROM.GetAdjective] Alps.\n\nWhile we no longer count with our old overlord's protection, the land we've just acquired will make our survival more certain.
loc.BBA_swiss_expansion.19.desc: Our declaration of independence was not taken kindly by our former overlord, [FROM.GetNameDef]. They have declared war on us hoping to take our country by force, let us take up arms and show them that [ROOT.GetName] will not be subjugated that easily.
loc.SWI_delayed_anschluss_TT: §Y[GER.GetNameDefCap]§! will §Rnot be able to push for Anschluss§! until the National Spirit §Y$SWI_swiss_democratic_propaganda$§! is removed from §Y[AUS.GetName]§! in three months.
loc.SWI_press_for_future_canton_TT: Unlocks decision: §YPress country for influenced future canton§!
loc.bba_africa_news.1.t: Formation of the East African Federation
loc.bba_africa_news.1.desc: In the 1920s, Colonial Secretary Leo Amery sought to create a white-ruled East African Dominion composed of Kenya, Uganda and Tanganyika. This was opposed and ultimately not completed. However, the native people of East Africa have used this concept as a basis for forming their own nation, which now makes them stronger than ever before. They have declared, that the era of a European-dominated Africa is coming to an end!
loc.bba_africa_news.1.b: Is this the end of the colonial era?
loc.bba_africa_news.2.t: The Horn of Africa has been unified
loc.bba_africa_news.2.desc: After centuries of separation and fighting, the people of the horn of africa have been unified under one state. This has almost happened before, but the ambitions of nationalists thinking only of themselves has always been a hamper that tears the peoples' relations apart.
