loc.ITA_servizio_informazione_militare_ns_de: Our intelligence agency will help to deter foreign espionage attacks against us, as well as to increase our own international ambitions.
loc.ITA_devaluated_lira_desc: Our recent wars have been costly and hampered our economy. Devaluing the currency has made our products more competitive on the international market, giving our economy a much-needed boost.
loc.ITA_battaglia_del_grano_desc: To be truly independent, we cannot rely on foreign powers for our food supply but must become agriculturally self-sufficient. The Battle for Grains will see us become self-reliant and our might grow only even further.
loc.ITA_battaglia_per_la_terra_desc: Our Battle for Land will drain miles of marshes and create farmland. It will also provide new job opportunities and foreign governments have already been impressed by the unbreakable spirit of the Italian people.
loc.ITA_battaglia_per_la_nascite_desc: In order for Italy to truly flourish we need more soldiers. In order to get more soldiers, we need a larger population. In order to get a larger population, we need mothers. What mothers need is for us to win the Battle for Births.
loc.ITA_camicie_nere_desc: The Blackshirts have sworn a personal oath to [ITA.GetLeader], making them more reliable and loyal than the rest of the Army. Giving them more authority and responsibility will only strengthen our reign.
loc.ITA_italian_irredentism_ns_desc: For [ITA.GetNameDef] to reach its full potential and might, we have to expand to our natural borders and unify all the territories that rightfully belong to the Italian people!
loc.ITA_bandits_war_desc: Mobility and mechanization are the future of warfare. We must invest heavily in modernizing our army for it to be successful on today's battlefields.
loc.ITA_alpine_defense_desc: The brutal fighting up in the mountains during the Great War is still fresh in many people’s memories. We must secure our northern front from any potential attacks by having capable soldiers that can fight effectively in that terrain.
loc.ITA_aviazione_legionaria_desc: Securing Air Superiority is vital for any army to gain the upper hand and push the enemy back.
loc.ITA_sold_obsolete_escort_ships_ns_desc: Exporting warships to other nations has strengthened our industrial capabilities.
loc.ITA_strengthened_heavy_industry_desc: Expanding our industrial capacity will enhance our industrial productivity.
loc.ITA_strengthened_the_army_desc: Expanding the army has taught us a great many things about mobilizing troops and organizing them into a coherent fighting force.
loc.ITA_disgruntlement_in_the_army_desc: Disgruntlement has seeped into the army after being blamed for not being able to expand fast enough.
loc.ITA_efficient_supply_lines_desc: Army logistics won’t be as cumbersome with our supply lines greatly benefitting from the newly built fleet of supply trucks.
loc.ITA_fuel_reserves_desc: Having a large reserve of fuel will free up our military to make more excursions and be more active.
loc.ITA_strengthened_the_airforce_desc: The Italian air force is once again one of the grandest air fleets in the world. The newly trained pilots are eager to showcase just how grand an air force we now have.
loc.ITA_disgruntlement_in_the_airforce_desc: The air force was promised new resources and funds to expand its forces, but nothing has shown up and disgruntlement is spreading among the troops.
loc.ITA_expanded_intelligence_service_basic_: The expanded intelligence service will bolster our homeland security.
loc.ITA_bolstered_political_cabinet_desc: Having the right people in the right places will bolster the fascist system and our rule over [ITA.GetNameDef].
loc.ITA_bolstered_military_high_command_desc: Having competent leadership is crucial for the military to function optimally and to be successful on the battlefields.
loc.ITA_all_within_the_state_ns_desc: Bolstering our capabilities behind the front lines will secure the path forward to victory.
loc.ITA_anti_partisan_measures_ns_desc: Our specialized units are hindering the movements of the partisans, making it harder for them to strike behind the front lines.
loc.ITA_gappisti_ns_desc: Our small partisan units are hitting the enemy hard behind the front lines, demoralizing them and boosting the resistance in the local population.
loc.ITA_grande_rivolta_rurale_ns_desc: We have managed to rally the peasantry in rural areas to our cause!
loc.ITA_liberation_or_death_ns_desc: The final push to liberate Italy from tyranny has begun; there is no turning back now!
loc.ITA_grande_rivolta_rurale_terrain_bonus_: Enables §YMountain Warfare Doctrine§! while this national spirit is active, granting §Y$militia$s§! terrain bonuses in §Y$hills$§! and §Y$mountain$§!: Attack: §G+5%§!, Movement: §G+10%§!
loc.ITA_independence_war_desc: We will liberate Italy from our oppressors!
loc.ITA_nuclear_research_desc: We are pioneering the development of atomic energy, and will soon enough be the greatest military power in the world.
loc.ITA_political_reforms_desc: Reforming the political system will rejuvenate and stabilize our nation.
loc.ITA_papal_support_desc: The Pope still exerts much influence over the Italian people and with his approval and support we will be able to sway many hearts and feelings toward our cause.
loc.ITA_papal_state_desc: With the Papacy reborn and in control over Italy, people are flocking to his Holiness for guidance and support.
loc.ITA_papal_state_catholic_dominion_desc: With the ascension of the Papacy as a major world power, it is up to us to enact the will of God and like a shepherd that guides his flock, protect faithful Christians from evil.
loc.ITA_papal_state_catholic_dominion_puppet: §YReduced cost§! for §YPuppet Country§! action in Peace Conferences.
loc.ITA_disgruntled_military_desc: Cleansing the military from royalist elements that could have threatened our new republic has caused us to lose experienced leadership.
loc.ITA_northern_designer_tt: This designer is located in the Northern part of Italy. Completing the focus '§Y$ITA_strengthen_northern_industry$§!' and '§Y$ITA_new_industrialization_program$§!' will improve the designer.
loc.ITA_southern_designer_tt: This designer is located in the Southern part of Italy. Completing the focus '§Y$ITA_modernize_the_mezzogiorno$§!' and '§Y$ITA_new_industrialization_program$§!' will improve the designer.
loc.ITA_northern_designer_improved_tt: §YThis Northern designer has already been improved§!.
loc.ITA_southern_designer_improved_tt: §YThis Southern designer has already been improved§!.
loc.ITA_shadow_of_mussolini_desc: Even though he has been ousted from power, the shadow of Mussolini is hard to escape as it still looms large over Italian politics.
loc.ITA_divino_duce_1_desc: With a strong cult of personality around [ITA.GetLeader], the Italian people will never waiver or break in their loyalty to their Duce. They will endure any hardship that is thrown upon them with ease and never surrender.
loc.ITA_italian_hegemony_master_1_desc: As the birthplace of Fascism, our purpose is clear; to become its protector and to spread it far and wide. We will instill a sense of duty and loyalty to the fascist system in every people who come under our hegemony.
loc.ITA_italian_hegemony_subjects_desc: Unite under [ITA.GetNameDef]’s hegemony we are the protectors of fascism, acting like a bastion of truth and enlightenment. No one and nothing shall stand in our way!
loc.ITA_prioritizing_the_military_desc: By diverting funds and resources from elsewhere we will be able to focus on our armed forces. While certain areas will suffer from this in the short time, we stand to gain more in the long term.
loc.ITA_impero_italiano_desc: The proclamation of the Italian Empire has emboldened our troops and legitimized our claims in Africa.
loc.SWI_mountaineer_paratroopers_idea_desc: Access to some of the steepest peaks, and centuries of alpine culture give Swiss Paratroopers an advantage over all other airborne infantry. They can descend from our transport planes and dominate mountain peaks as if they were on Monte Rosa or the Matterhorn.
loc.SWI_mountaineer_paratroopers_idea_TT:
§YMountains§!:
 Attack: §G+35%§!
 Defense: §G+10%§!
 Movement: §G+20%§!
§YHills§!:
 Attack: §G+20%§!
 Defense: §G+5%§!
 Movement: §G+10%§!
loc.SWI_air_production_ns_desc: Our factories are dedicated to producing airplanes as fast as possible so our capacity to wage war in the air catches up to our neighbors.
loc.SWI_infiltrated_federal_police_idea_desc: Fascist elements have infiltrated the Federal Police and its intelligence branch. There's no telling all the ways they're helping our fascist neighbour infiltrate [SWI.GetName] society.
loc.SWI_pro_helvetia_idea_desc: For Switzerland to survive, it must be a distinct country from the languages spoken within. That is why  Pro Helvetia has the task of promoting Swiss values, and the corresponding commitment to Democracy that comes with them.
loc.SWI_martial_law_idea_desc: Dangerous times call for dangerous measures. The military must take over to guarantee order and stability. With any luck [ROOT.GetAdjective] can be restored some day.
loc.SWI_no_confederation_president_idea_desc: The unthinkable has happened, and the Federal Council has failed to choose a President of the Swiss confederation. It will take a lot of effort to get out of this situation.
loc.SWI_foreign_fascist_propaganda_desc: While there isn't a large Fascist movement native to [SWI.GetName], our Fascist neighbors are keen on tearing up our confederation from the inside, with fifth column and propaganda operations in every canton, but specially in the [GER.GetAdjective] and [ITA.GetAdjective] speaking ones.
loc.SWI_extensive_fascist_propaganda_desc: Fascist propaganda in Switzerland used to come from outside, but the movement has gained enough momentum to flood the country with Fascist propaganda from within and without.
loc.SWI_banned_foreign_nazi_propaganda_idea_: Nazism has no place in a society such as ours, so we cannot allow the spread of an ideology that threatens the very fabric of our confederation, let alone propaganda coming from a foreign nation.
loc.SWI_army_limitations_TT:
§RCannot train regular forces outside of Citizen Militias, and cannot edit existing templates outside of the Military Readiness decisions§!

§YSwitzerland§! relies on their civilian population to take up arms when needed. A limited amount of militias can be trained, and they will have their §YOrganization§! initially capped.

Once the focus §Y$SWI_armed_neutrality$§! is completed, the militias will be able to be expanded, improved and eventually, deployed using the §Y$SWI_activate_militia$§! decision. While the militias are deployed, penalties to the Swiss economy will stack up over time, but they'll reset after they're recalled.
loc.SWI_citizen_militia_1_desc: Unlike most other nations, in Switzerland, every person that meets the criteria for recruitment is expected to take up arms in their local Militias when called upon. This allows us to have a large percentage of the population in reserve without major consequences to our economy as long as they're not deployed.\n
loc.SWI_infrastructure_rigged_to_blow_desc: We can't let the enemy use our hard earned infrastructure and industry against us, we are ready to blow it all up as soon as the enemy takes control of it.
loc.SWI_aktion_nationaler_widerstand_idea_de: A secret group of civilians representing every facet of Swiss society, determined to promote Switzerland's values and lay the groundwork for resistance if the worst happens.
loc.SWI_old_switzerland_idea_desc: After a long period of gruesome war and immoral expansion, the people of [ROOT.GetName] demand nothing less than a return to the neutrality and democracy of prewar times. These tumultuous times shall be over soon.
loc.SWI_extended_supply_lines_idea_desc: We have improved our logistics so we can stretch our supply lines further, and build new ones more quickly than ever before.
loc.SWI_volunteer_forces_idea_desc: Though as per our usual policy, [SWI.GetNameDef] is not officially part of any conflict, we are allowing, and secretly encouraging, joining as volunteers, specially when it involves defending democracy.
loc.SWI_frozen_assets_desc: After relying on Swiss banking for years, they have shown their true intentions and stabbed us in the back by freezing our assets! We are going to recover financially from this, but it will take time.
loc.SWI_democratic_unrest_desc: After a century of direct democracy, the [ROOT.GetAdjective] people will not stay quiet about the current political state of [ROOT.GetName].
loc.SWI_resistance_groups_funded_by_foreign_: Resistance Groups Being Funded by Foreign Country
loc.SWI_swiss_democratic_propaganda_desc: After their push for Vorarlberg to join them, [SWI.GetNameDef] has continued an extensive propaganda campaign in all of [AUS.GetNonIdeologyName]. They have focused their efforts in promoting their characteristic form of Democracy, opposition to Fascism, and above all, joining their confederation.
loc.SWI_increase_timeout_TT: Timeout for mission §Y$SWI_militia_active$§! is increased by §G$RIGHT|0$§! days.
loc.GRE_1936_election_category_desc: The first elections since George II was returned to the throne are due to take place before the end of the month. George II is determined not to be forced from his throne again and is said to be prepared to go to any lengths necessary to keep his rule secure. \n\nHowever, elements of our army still hold hidden allegiances to the popular exile Eleftherios Venizelos, and they might be able to secure a free-and-fair election for Greece through the use of some rather... heavy-handed tactics.
loc.GRE_the_election_of_1936_desc: The first elections since George II was returned to the throne are due to take place before the end of the month. George II is determined not to be forced from his throne again and is said to be prepared to go to any lengths necessary to keep his rule secure.
loc.GRE_1936_election_tt: If King §YGeorge II§! is not arrested, then he will interfere in the January election and ensure his monarchist supporters keep their governmental mandate.\n
loc.GRE_put_the_king_under_house_arrest: Place The King Under House Arrest
loc.GRE_put_the_king_under_house_arrest_desc: If we stop King George II from interfering in Greece's democratic processes, then the more popular Venezelists will surely win the election.
loc.GRE_1936_arrest_the_king_tt: The King will be arrested and the §YVenezelists§! will win the election.\n
loc.GRE_civil_war_imminent_desc: Tensions between the republicans and the monarchists are coming to a head, and civil war seems to be an unfortunate inevitability...
loc.GRE_civil_war_imminent_1_desc: Tensions between the republicans and the monarchists are coming to a head, and civil war seems to be an unfortunate inevitability...
loc.GRE_civil_war_imminent_2_desc: Tensions between the republicans and the monarchists are coming to a head, and civil war seems to be an unfortunate inevitability...
loc.GRE_civil_war_imminent_3_desc: Tensions between the republicans and the monarchists are coming to a head, and civil war seems to be an unfortunate inevitability...
loc.GRE_civil_war_imminent_4_desc: Tensions between the republicans and the monarchists are coming to a head, and civil war seems to be an unfortunate inevitability...
loc.GRE_investment_decisions_category_desc: Decades of economic mismanagement by past administrations and rampant abuses by foreign powers have left our country destitute of a strong industrial foundation. The sad reality of the situation is that in order to achieve our highest potential we might have to ask for the assistance of some of those very same countries that have left us in this position in the first place.
loc.GRE_invite_politicians_for_investment_ta: An invite to our prestigious nation where we can show off the vast potential of our people and manufacturing sector should bear considerable fruit if we approach the right people!
loc.GRE_hold_national_showcase_for_investors: We shall hold a grand showcase here in the cradle of Western civilization in the hopes of luring investment into our impoverished industrial sector.
loc.GRE_exploit_errata_in_schachtplan_desc: The Schachtplan is just another criminal [FROM.GetAdjective] scheme to plunder poorer European countries, it should be simple to devise a scenario where the [FROM.GetAdjective]s will be obliged to help us for a change and without strings attached.
loc.GRE_invite_entrepreneurs_for_investment_: An invite to our prestigious nation where we can show off the vast potential of our people and manufacturing sector should bear considerable fruit if we approach the right people!
loc.GRE_hold_national_showcase_for_investors: We shall hold a grand showcase here in the cradle of Western civilization in the hopes of luring investment into our impoverished industrial sector.
loc.GRE_trade_manufactured_ship_parts_for_in: Trade Manufactured Ship Parts for Investment
By helping the British maintain their Royal Navy, we can ensure that we will receive a much heftier investment than we would under normal circumstances.
loc.GRE_go_to_paris_to_negotiate_investment_: Go to Paris to Negotiate Investment Talks
An audience with the right people in Paris where we can show off the vast potential of our people and manufacturing sector could yield considerable gains for our nation.
loc.GRE_hold_national_showcase_for_investors: We shall hold a grand showcase here in the cradle of Western civilization in the hopes of luring investment into our impoverished industrial sector.
loc.GRE_bribe_french_trade_unions_to_pressur: Bribe [FROM.GetAdjective] Trade Unions to Harass Their Government
[FROM.GetNameDef] has been enslaved by their trade unions for quite a long time, so by helping the trade unions to foment instability we better our bargaining position by using blackmail.
loc.GRE_italian_influence_tt: Relying too heavily on the §Y[FROM.GetAdjective]s§! could place our sovereignty in peril.\n
loc.GRE_italian_influence_shunned_tt: Shunning the §Y[FROM.GetAdjective]s§! after exploiting their generosity could lead to §Ywar§!!\n
loc.GRE_attend_talks_with_the_presidium_desc: We will send representatives from our nation to the presidium in [FROM.GetNameDefCap] to discuss the potential of our nation persuade them to make a small investment into our military industry.
loc.GRE_host_soviet_bureaucrats_in_greece_de: Representatives from [FROM.GetNameDefCap] will tour our country and then decide if they want to make a moderate investment in our military industry.
loc.GRE_soviet_influence_tt: Relying too heavily on the §Y[FROM.GetAdjective]s§! could place our sovereignty in peril.\n
loc.GRE_invest_back_into_neglected_siberian_: Invest Back Into Neglected Siberian Provinces
We will offer [FROM.GetNameDefCap] to invest in their most neglected regions, in a show of reciprocity that will allow us to reduce the influence the [FROM.GetAdjective]s hold over us.
loc.GRE_soviet_influence_shunned_tt: Shunning the §Y[FROM.GetAdjective]s§! after exploiting their generosity could lead to §Ywar§!!
loc.GRE_pay_back_debt_to_the_ifc_category: Managing the Debt to the I.F.C.
loc.GRE_pay_back_debt_to_the_ifc_category_de:
Greece has been plagued with financial debts since our War of Independence in 1829, and the Great War did not exactly help alleviate our fiscal woes. If we can pay off our debts, it will surely go a long way in securing some semblance of economic stability in Greece. Alternatively, certain radical movements have been known to buck both political and economic conventions. Should we fold to one of these movements, or simply allow the world to unravel as time progresses, more drastic courses of action may very well present themselves...

§YDebt§! to the §YBritish§!: [ROOT.GetDebtPercentageBritain]

§YDebt§! to the §YFrench§!: [ROOT.GetDebtPercentageFrance] 

§YDebt§! to the §YItalians§!: [ROOT.GetDebtPercentageItaly] 

Total §YDebt§! Paid: [ROOT.GetDebtPercentagePaidTotal]
loc.GRE_small_installment_payment_FRA: Small Debt Repayment Payment to the [FROM.GetAdjective]
loc.GRE_small_installment_payment_ITA: Small Debt Repayment Payment to the [FROM.GetAdjective]s
loc.GRE_small_payment_to_british_debt_effect: This decision will clear one quarter of our current §Ydebt§! with §Y[ENG.GetNameDef]§! each time it is completed.\n
loc.GRE_small_payment_to_french_debt_effect_: This decision will clear one quarter of our current §Ydebt§! with §Y[FRA.GetNameDef]§! each time it is completed.\n
loc.GRE_small_payment_to_italians_debt_effec: This decision will clear one quarter of our current §Ydebt§! with §Y[ITA.GetNameDef]§! each time it is completed.\n
loc.GRE_force_debt_clearance_tt: By ending our financial relationship with §Y[FROM.GetNameDef]§!, we will also be walking away from our §Ydebts§! owed to them.\n
loc.GRE_debt_payment_impossible_tt: Communist and fascist governments will be unwilling to pay their debts.\n
loc.GRE_large_payment_to_british_debt_effect: This decision will clear one half of our current §Ydebt§! with §Y[ENG.GetNameDef]§! each time it is completed.\n
loc.GRE_large_payment_to_french_debt_effect_: This decision will clear one half of our current §Ydebt§! with §Y[FRA.GetNameDef]§! each time it is completed.\n
loc.GRE_large_payment_to_italians_debt_effec: This decision will clear one half of our current §Ydebt§! with §Y[ITA.GetNameDef]§! each time it is completed.\n
loc.GRE_restructure_debt_tt: All current §Ydebt§! owed to the §YInternational Finance Commission§! will be halved.
loc.GRE_default_on_debt_effect_tt: Such a drastic action could have §Yunintended consequences§! beyond the severing of financial ties between us and our debtors.\n
loc.GRE_defaulted_on_debt_flag: We have §Ydefaulted§! on our financial obligations.
loc.GRE_recommission_the_american_battleship: The battleships Kilkis and Lemnos have been left in a bit of a sorry state since the Greco-Turkish War, but with some patience and determination we can get them sea-worthy again.
loc.GRE_build_the_salamis_desc: With German assistance, it has become possible to rebuild our old battlecruiser, the Salamis, which we short-sightedly scrapped in 1932. Luckily, we still have the remnants of the old hull so we would not be starting totally from scratch.
loc.GRE_faction_management_category_desc: Greece's internal political state is so fractured that direct intervention from the government is necessary to preserve the nation's integrity.
loc.GRE_ATTITUDE_TOOLTIP:
§YAttitude§! represents the faction's desire to cooperate with the government. 
§GFriendly§! and §GLoyal§! factions will grant stability and manpower bonuses. 
§RHostile§! factions will reduce stability.
Indifferent and §gInconsequential§! factions will not provide any bonuses or penalties.
loc.GRE_no_generals_left_tt: We have recruited all possible generals.
loc.GRE_monarchist_economy_change_radical_tt: The radical shift in economic policy will decrease the §YMonarchist Faction's§! loyalty by §R15§!.\n
loc.GRE_republican_economy_change_radical_tt: The radical shift in economic policy will decrease the §YVenezelist Faction's§! loyalty by §R10§!.\n
loc.GRE_monarchist_economy_change_positive_t: The continuity of long-held economic policy will increase the §YMonarchist Faction's§! loyalty by §G10§!.\n
loc.GRE_republican_economy_change_positive_t: The continuity of long-held economic policy will increase the §YRepublican Faction's§! loyalty by §G5§!.\n
loc.GRE_communist_economy_change_tt: The continuity of long-held economic policy will decrease the §YCommunist Faction's§! loyalty by §R5§!.\n
loc.SOV_set_up_puppet_state_in_turkey: Set Up New Puppet State in Turkey
loc.byz_restore_byzantium_desc: The Second Hellenic Civilization was our most triumphant, and even though the West has tried to hoist on us a new Greek identity we shall never abandon our true heritage!
loc.form_country_dyrrachium_required_states_: Reestablishing the §YTheme of Dyrrachium§! requires the control of §YAlbania§! and §YMontenegro§!.
loc.form_country_paristrion_required_states_: Reestablishing the §YTheme of Paristrion§! requires the control of §YRomania's§! southern and coastal states.
loc.form_country_boulgarias_required_states_: Reestablishing the §YTheme of Boulgarias§! requires the control of all §YBulgarian§! states and §YMacedonia§!.
loc.form_country_sirmium_required_states_tt: Reestablishing the §YTheme of Sirmium§! requires the control of §YYugoslavia's§! southern, central, and coastal states.
loc.form_country_dyrrachium_coring_states_tt: Gain cores on and rename §YAlbania§! and §YMontenegro§!.\n
loc.form_country_paristrion_coring_states_tt: Gain cores on and rename applicable §YRomanian§! states.\n
loc.form_country_boulgarias_coring_states_tt: Gain cores on and rename all §YBulgarian§! states and §YMacedonia§!.\n
loc.form_country_sirmium_coring_states_tt: Gain cores on and rename applicable §YYugoslavian§! states.\n
loc.form_greater_greece_category_desc: The Megali Idea is the supreme dream of all [ROOT.GetAdjective] people. From Epirus to Smyrna, Greece will be made whole once again.
loc.form_country_turkish_coast_coring_states: Gain cores on all western §YTurkish§! coastal states.
loc.GRE_move_capital_to_constantinople_desc: Constantinople, the capital of the Second Hellenic Civilization, has been called 'the dream and hope of all Greeks' and the city of the world's desire. We can move our nation's capital to the old capital as a display of our rediscovered greatness.
loc.move_capital_to_thessaloniki_desc: Athens was the capital of the First Hellenic Civilization, Constantinople was the capital of the Second Hellenic Civilization, but Thessaloniki - the eternal 'co-capital' of Hellenic history - shall be the new capital of the Third Hellenic Civilization.
loc.GRE_appoint_aristotle_onassis_as_prime_m: Appoint Aristotle Onassis as Prime Minister

Aristotle Onassis has been integral in helping to realize Venezelist dreams of the Megali Idea being fulfilled. As a [ROOT.GetAdjective] citizen born in [339.GetName], perhaps the young charismatic magnate is the man to unite us as a nation.
loc.form_macedonian_empire_category_desc: Some would call it mad to harken back to the days of Alexander the Great's empire, but to truly cement the Third Hellenic Civilization we must return wholly to the first from which we originated.
loc.form_macedonian_empire: Honor the Legacy of the Argeads
loc.form_macedonian_empire_desc: It is time to collate our gathered satrapies into one centralized superstate whose unification will show to the world that Greece is no longer a nation to be mocked or bullied, but an empire to be feared.
loc.form_country_southern_yugoslavia_require: Controls all §YBulgarian§! and §YAlbanian§! states, as well as all §YYugoslav§! states south of §YSerbia§!.
loc.TUR_the_constitutional_arrows_category_d: The Six Guiding Principles of [ROOT.GetNameDef] have been codified into our constitution, and as long as we honor them we must believe that our nation will never be torn apart from the inside.
loc.TUR_republicanism_decision_desc: This country was born out of the ashes of the failed Ottoman Sultanate. Now, we answer to no Sultans; no Caliphs; no gods - we are free, and we suffered for that right to be free.
loc.TUR_secularism_decision_desc: If we allow the dogma of archaic faiths that remain trapped in the Medieval Ages to direct our governance and our way of life then we shall never develop the capabilities needed to be regarded as equals among the great powers of the world.
loc.TUR_populism_decision_desc: The people must always be the number one priority of any responsible government. There is no room for debate on the matter.
loc.TUR_nationalism_decision_desc: We have fought and died for our country before, and we must all be willing to do it again.
loc.TUR_etatism_decision_desc: The benefits of operating a command economy is that the executive retains some considerable influence over the direction of the economy through fiscal mechanisms. It would be in the national interest to invoke those mechanisms now.
loc.TUR_reformism_decision_desc: Our people have always been on the cutting edge - even the Ottomans were known to push the envelope at times with their political or social reforms. The dynamism of the [FROM.GetAdjective] people is one of our greatest qualities.
loc.TUR_revolutionism_decision_desc: Casting off the Ottoman yoke and establishing the Turkish nation state was a revolution. We changed, and have continued changing, as we fumble through our national metamorphosis and progress towards the people we were always destined to become...
loc.TUR_liberalism_decision_desc: The freedom to decide one's future is a cornerstone of our dreams for this nation's future. Free trade, free elections, freedom of religion, freedom of opportunity - these are what we must constantly aspire for.
loc.TUR_jihad_decision_desc: By lead and sword, we shall exercise the will of the Almighty and smite the wayward souls who have strayed from His path.
loc.TUR_fidelity_decision_desc: Loyalty to the Sultan; loyalty to the Almighty - here lies the two essential pillars that every citizen should kneel down before in reverence.
loc.TUR_absolutism_decision_desc: The Sultan's rule is absolute; the Ottoman Empire tore itself apart from the inside once, and history must never be allowed to repeat itself again.
loc.TUR_ultranationalism_decision_desc: It is not simply enough to be willing to die for one's country; every citizen must give themselves entirely over in mind, body, and spirit for the wellbeing of the nation.
loc.TUR_socialism_decision_desc: We cast down our royalty of old, and now we must work together with the working class to bring down the arrogant capitalists of today.
loc.TUR_alter_the_royal_laws_of_succession: Alter the Royal Laws of Succession
loc.TUR_alter_the_royal_laws_of_succession_d: A new Sultanate provides a grand opportunity to reform our antiquated succession laws. We shall enact the policy of Agnatic-Cognatic Primogeniture, so that only direct descendants of the Sultan may inherit.
loc.TUR_industrial_projects_category_desc: Given how young the [ROOT.GetAdjective] nation is, fledgling industrial projects often require government assistance in order to become fully realized.
loc.TUR_open_the_nazilli_callico_factory_des: It is the responsibility of the government to assess potential industrial projects on a case-by-case basis.
loc.TUR_finance_the_bursa_merinos_factory_de: It is the responsibility of the government to assess potential industrial projects on a case-by-case basis.
loc.TUR_fund_the_gemlik_silk_factory_desc: It is the responsibility of the government to assess potential industrial projects on a case-by-case basis.
loc.TUR_construct_the_zonguldak_coal_refiner: It is the responsibility of the government to assess potential industrial projects on a case-by-case basis.
loc.TUR_modernise_the_general_directorate_of: Modernize the General Directorate of Military Factories
It is the responsibility of the government to assess potential industrial projects on a case-by-case basis.
loc.TUR_authorise_the_nuri_killigil_factory_: It is the responsibility of the government to assess potential industrial projects on a case-by-case basis.
loc.TUR_sponsored_killigil_armaments_flag: Sponsored §YKilligil Armaments§! through the §YSanayiciler Industrial Projects§! decision.
loc.TUR_sponsor_the_nuri_demirag_besiktas_ai: Sponsor the Nuri Demirağ Beşiktaş Aircraft Factory
It is the responsibility of the government to assess potential industrial projects on a case-by-case basis.
loc.TUR_invest_in_malatya_cigarette_factory_: It is the responsibility of the government to assess potential industrial projects on a case-by-case basis.
loc.TUR_bankroll_the_malatya_clothing_factor: It is the responsibility of the government to assess potential industrial projects on a case-by-case basis.
loc.TUR_subsidise_the_karabuk_iron_steel_fac: It is the responsibility of the government to assess potential industrial projects on a case-by-case basis.
loc.TUR_karabuk_iron_steel_factory_modernise: The §YKarabuk Iron-Steel Factory§! has been modernized through the §YSanayiciler§!.
loc.TUR_sponsor_petrol_olfisis_formation_des: There has been pressure on the government to form a state organization dedicated to oil excavation and petroleum-related energy concerns.
loc.TUR_petrol_ofisi_formed: Petrol Ofisi's formation has been sponsored.\n
loc.TUR_repeal_the_wealth_tax_desc: This tax on non-Muslims is non-sustainable and a blemish on our Kemalist record; the right thing to do is to repeal the tax immediately.
loc.TUR_repeal_the_faith_tax_desc: This tax on religious institutions is non-sustainable, and while our goals were noble the truth is that [ROOT.GetNameDef] is just not ready for such a radical policy. The sensible course of action will be repealing the tax.
loc.TUR_abolish_etatism_desc: Etatism was a glorious achievement of the Kemalist system and a fruitful experiment, but unfortunately it is an experiment that might need to be shuttered permanently for the greater good.
loc.TUR_absorb_the_tpda_desc: The Turkish Public Debt Administration is fused into our industrial sector like a tumor, but we can reintegrate the organization as a national process in order to remove the Debt Administration as a hurdle to our further development.
loc.TUR_pay_off_our_debts_desc: The Ottoman Empire accrued a great deal of debt over its existence, and we happened to spend quite a lot rebuilding our nation too. Currently, we are in a good position to be paying off some of that debt!
loc.TUR_discuss_investment_possibilities_wit: In the past, [ROOT.GetAdjective] policy has been to avoid foreign investment and interference where we can - but we are no longer have much to fear from simple transactions such as investments. They will approach us as equals, and we could depart richer for it.
loc.TUR_investment_in_turkey_pending_flag: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has agreed to our investment portfolio but has not yet committed to it.
loc.TUR_investment_opinion_tt: The higher §Y[FROM.GetNameDef]'s§! opinion of us, the more opportunities for investment there will be.\n
loc.ROOT_invest_in_turkish_state_building_de: [FROM.GetAdjective] critical infrastructure is underdeveloped in many regions of the country; this is something we can rectify.
loc.ROOT_invest_in_turkish_state_light_indus: [FROM.GetAdjective] light industry is underdeveloped in many regions of the country; this is something we can rectify.
loc.ROOT_invest_in_turkish_state_heavy_indus: [FROM.GetAdjective] heavy industry is underdeveloped in many regions of the country; this is something we can rectify.
loc.ROOT_turkish_investment_ai_tt: The better our §Yinvestment§! into §Y[TUR.GetNameDef]§!, the closer we can bind them to our own interests while simultaneously alienating them to our enemies.\n
loc.TUR_kurdish_state_management_category_de: The Kurdish issue is one that has dogged us since even before the Republic's founding, although the issue has certainly only gotten worse since then. Rampant nationalism and doomed attempts at nation building threaten to destroy the legacy of the War of Independence, and we cannot tolerate any scenario in which there is a free Kurdistan born from the rump of our own nation.
loc.TUR_kurdish_state_management_map_categor: These are the states that contain Kurdish rebels.
loc.TUR_agitate_kurdish_state_effect_tt: The £faction_tur_kurdish §YKurdish rebels§! will increase the intensity of their resistance towards the government in §Y[TUR_kurdish_state_event_target.GetName]§!.
loc.TUR_pacify_kurdish_state_effect_tt: The £faction_tur_kurdish §YKurdish rebels§! in §Y[TUR_kurdish_state_event_target.GetName]§! will be pacified.
loc.TUR_placate_kurdish_state_effect_tt: The £faction_tur_kurdish §YKurdish rebels§! in §Y[TUR_kurdish_state_event_target.GetName]§! will be placated.
loc.TUR_kurdish_modifiers_trigger_tt: All £faction_tur_kurdish §YKurdish§! states are either §Ycores§!, or have the modifier §YSeparatist Fatigue§!.
loc.TUR_no_current_integration_targets_avail: Before a£faction_tur_kurdish §YKurdish§! state can be cored §YCompliance§! must be raised to at least §Y70%§!, and §YResistance§! must be lowered to at least §Y30%§!.
loc.TUR_integrate_kurdish_state_effect_tt: The £faction_tur_kurdish §YKurdish§! state will lose its state modifiers and become a core of §Y[TUR.GetNameDef]§!.
loc.TUR_counter_the_rebels_in_diyarbakir_des: The rebels in Diyarbakır are usually less troublesome than they are elsewhere; likely because of Diyarbakır's relatively developed status.
loc.TUR_counter_the_rebels_in_erzurum_desc: Erzurum is a hot-bed of Kurdish political activity and activism, but rarely a sight for political violence. The world is changing in many ways, however...
loc.TUR_counter_the_rebels_in_van_desc: Van is one of our easternmost states and happens to be completely unrecognizable in effectively every single way compared to our westernmost states.
loc.TUR_counter_the_rebels_in_hakkari_desc: The rebels in Hakkâri are usually a little more organized than they are in the other states, and they are significantly harder to root out due to the many mountains and hills.
loc.TUR_offer_conscription_exceptions_to_kur: £faction_tur_kurdish Offer Conscription Exemptions to Kurdish Groups

Many Kurdish groups do not demand full independence, just recognition for a degree of autonomy. We can provide a small degree of autonomy in the name of making peace by offering widespread conscription exemptions.
loc.TUR_integrate_kurdish_state_desc: By cooperating with local leaders we can assure that the Kurdish states of our country are decorously reintegrated into the national framework of our nation-state.
loc.TUR_kurdish_resistance_escalation_missio: The Kurdish rebels are once again intensifying their anti-government efforts in the south-east of our nation.
loc.TUR_fundamentalist_state_management_cate: There are those in this country who were not fully prepared to see the role of religion so abruptly change in the [ROOT.GetAdjective] nation. These individuals require a soft touch, although they cannot be allowed to block our march towards progress.
loc.TUR_fundamentalist_state_management_map_: These are the states that oppose the principles of Kemalism.
loc.TUR_encourage_avid_fundamentalist_discip: £faction_tur_traditionalist Encourage Avid Fundamentalist Disciples to Migrate into Susceptible Communities
loc.TUR_increase_influence_of_fundamentalist: The light of the Almighty must touch every single corner of our proud nation.
loc.TUR_hold_a_march_in_state: £faction_tur_kemalist Hold a March in a Fundamentalist State
loc.TUR_hold_a_march_in_state_desc: The bygone religious elements of this country shall be awed by the display of devotion by our unyielding ideological disciples as they march through the rebel communities.
loc.TUR_acquiesce_to_fundamentalists_desc: For this republic to survive, there must be compromise - even if that means subverting the constitution this nation was founded on.
loc.TUR_empower_fundamentalists_in_state_des: Our coreligionists require all the support from the government that they can get.
loc.TUR_kemalist_state_management_category_d: Adherents of Kemalism tend to live in the larger urban cities and have a proclivity to defend their political views as though they were defending a way of life.
loc.TUR_kemalist_state_management_map_catego: These are the states that are loyal to the ideology of Kemalism.
loc.TUR_kemalist_loyalty_and_power_update_ef: The §YKemalist Officers§! shall readjust their status as a response to the actions of the government.
loc.TUR_kemalist_influenced_state_effect_tt: The £faction_tur_kemalist §YKemalists§! shall take over as the uncontested administrators of the state.
loc.TUR_kemalist_turn_hostile_effect_tt: The £faction_tur_kemalist §YKemalists§! will become §Rhostile§! to the government.
loc.TUR_embed_kemalist_propagandists_into_st: We must work very hard to ensure that the ideology of Kemalism is entrenched in the hearts of as many people as possible if it is to survive in the future.
loc.TUR_the_enemy_within_desc: Our country is divided upon political, ethnic, and religious lines, and those divisions threaten to unravel the nation and plunge us into chaos. Nefarious forces are hard at work in our home: they must not be allowed to triumph over the legitimate government of [ROOT.GetNameDef].
loc.TUR_unaligned_state_management_map_categ: These are the states that currently remain unaligned.
loc.TUR_traditionalist_infiltration_mission_: It would appear that the religious elements of our society are attempting to once again further entrench their followers in areas where they have only middling support.
loc.TUR_thwarting_traditionalist_infiltratio: We must not allow those who would undermine this nation's secularism to spread into the west unchecked; we have a duty to stop them.
loc.TUR_entrench_kemalism_in_state_desc: We must work very hard to ensure that the ideology of Kemalism is entrenched in the hearts of as many people as possible if it is to survive in the future.
loc.TUR_root_out_kemalists_in_state: £faction_tur_traditionalist Root Out the Kemalists in State
loc.TUR_root_out_kemalists_in_state_desc: We shall strike fear into the hearts of the godless Kemalist scourge that continues to plague this nation.
loc.TUR_kemalist_infiltration_mission_desc: The Kemalists, unsatisfied with having being deposed by the public, are still up to their old tricks. They seek a monopoly on power in the west; they must be stopped.
loc.TUR_hostile_kemalists_influenced_state_e: The £faction_tur_kemalist §YKemalist traitors§! will entrench themselves in §Y[TUR_kemalist_state_event_target.GetName]§!.
loc.TUR_thwarting_kemalist_infiltration_desc: Stopping the Kemalists from further spreading their venom is more than just a civic responsibility, it is a divine duty.
loc.TUR_reforming_our_armed_forces_category_: Our armed forces were devastated after the War of Independence: it took everything we had and more to win our freedom from the imperialists, and while military reform was something that could be delayed for some time the world is now rapidly becoming a much more dangerous place.
loc.TUR_modernize_our_tactics_desc: Many of those enlisted in our armed forces are veterans of the War of Independence, but they fail to realize that any future war will be nothing like the war of 1922.
loc.TUR_teach_the_proper_use_of_modern_infra: Instruct the Proper Use of Modern Infrastructure
Many among our armed forces have been slow to adapt to the advent of train carriages and roads and insist on travelling via horseback.
loc.TUR_commence_an_overhaul_of_our_training: Commence Overhaul of Our Training Methods
Our methods of teaching and instruction are ineffectual; our veterans learned through experience, but our new recruits seem to barely have any sense at all.
loc.TUR_streamline_communication_methods_bet: Much of the equipment used on our naval vessels are old, outdated, and unreliable.
loc.TUR_put_new_safety_regulations_regarding: We have always been proud of being on the forefront of aeronautical innovations in Europe, but our pilots have a well-deserved reputation of acting like mavericks.
loc.TUR_etatism_crisis_1_desc: Trying to simultaneously maintain our Etatist economy model while also adopting a war economy is proving to be problematic.
loc.TUR_etatism_crisis_2_desc: Trying to simultaneously maintain our Etatist economy model while also adopting a war economy is proving to be problematic.
loc.TUR_etatism_crisis_3_desc: Trying to simultaneously maintain our Etatist economy model while also adopting a war economy is proving to be problematic.
loc.TUR_etatism_crisis_4_desc: Trying to simultaneously maintain our Etatist economy model while also adopting a war economy is proving to be problematic. If we fail to take some real action on this issue, then we could well destroy our entire economy.
loc.ott_merge_the_eyalets_of_morea_crete_and: Merge the Eyalets of Morea, Crete, and Kibris
loc.ott_restore_the_vilayet_of_the_danube_an: Restore the Vilayet of the Danube and Moldova
loc.ott_merge_the_eyalets_of_jeddah_habesh_a: Merge the Eyalets of Jeddah, Habesh, and Yemen
loc.ott_absorb_the_tunis_and_algerian_eyalet: Absorb the Tunis and Algerian Eyalets
loc.develop_the_iron_mines_in_divrigi: Develop the Iron Mines in Divriği
loc.drill_in_the_garzan_oil_field: Drill in the Garzan Oil Field
loc.expand_the_west_raman_oil_field: Expand the West Raman Oil Field
loc.TUR_appoint_nihal_atziz_as_president_des: Nihal Atsız has been integral in helping to realize our Turanist dreams. With the support of the people, it would be wise to elevate his position.
loc.TUR_the_fading_father_category_desc:
The Father of the Turks, Mustafa Kemal Atatürk, is taking ill more and more frequently. We must confront the unfortunate reality that the messianic founding father of our nation may not live to see [ROOT.GetNameDef] endure through to the end of the current crisis that faces the world. 

Atatürk's current health situation is: [ROOT.GetAtaturkHealthBar].
loc.TUR_ataturk_health_worsening_crisis_desc: As Mustafa Kemal Atatürk grows older, his periods of illness are bound to get worse and worse. How long before the Father of the Turks gets so sick he finds himself unable to recover?
loc.TUR_seek_treatment_for_ataturk_desc: If our Ghazi is to survive the next few years, then it is vital he take some time away from the stressful job of running our nation. We shall send him all across the world to be treated in the most cutting edge sanatoriums and to unwind in the world's finest resorts.
loc.TUR_worsen_ataturks_health_effect_tt: §YMustafa Kemal Atatürk§! will be less efficient as a leader due to his §Railing health§!.
loc.TUR_retire_ataturk_desc: It is a woeful thing to consider, but perhaps our Ghazi would be better served by spending his final days with his family and by travelling the continent at his own discretion. We cannot continue to selfishly lay claim to his life: not after he has already sacrificed so much for this nation and its people.
loc.TUR_ataturk_health_poor_tt: §YMustafa Kemal Atatürk§! will be considered to be in §Ypoor§! health.
loc.TUR_ataturk_health_terminal_tt: §YMustafa Kemal Atatürk§! will be taken into palliative care due to his §Yterminal§! condition.
loc.TUR_acquiesce_to_fundamentalists_tt: This and up to §Y2§! additional £faction_tur_traditionalist §YTraditionalist states§! will begin to cooperate more with the government.
loc.the_national_oath_category_desc: The Ottoman Empire had to fall; it was as inevitable as it was necessary. We lost more than we gambled for when we had to sign the Treaty of Lausanne in 1923 though, and it is past time we reclaimed what was stolen from us.
loc.restore_the_borders_of_1920_desc: With this proclamation, the Treaty of Lausanne is at long last undone and we are truly free of the imperialist yoke.
loc.form_turan_category_desc: For so long Turan seemed like more of a fantasy than a reality, but now we have the opportunity to unite all of the Turkic peoples of the world under one flag. How could we refuse?
loc.form_turan_desc: With the unification of Turan, our status as a Great Power of the world will be affirmed. The Turkic peoples shall never again be oppressed by another power.
loc.BUL_internal_factions_desc: Bulgarian society and politics are divided into multiple factions, striving either to win the favor of the government or to stir up the masses against it. The Bulgarian government must decide which of these factions can serve its interests and which pose a threat that must be eradicated, for the sake of the nation.
loc.BUL_ZVENO_TOOLTIP: The £faction_bul_zveno §YZveno§! is a nationalist organization founded by army officers and currently led by Kimon Georgiev. \nThe £faction_bul_zveno §YZveno§! will appeal to army officers to join their organization and, with time, could even attempt to coup the government and impose a military dictatorship.
loc.BUL_BS_TOOLTIP: The £faction_bul_bs §YBroad Socialists§! are social-democrats supporting broad class alliances. \nThe £faction_bul_bs §YBroad Socialists§! have a great influence among the industrial workers and the Unions, and will call for general strikes if they are disloyal towards the government.
loc.BUL_BZNS_TOOLTIP: The £faction_bul_bzns §YAgrarian Union§! is a political organization banned in 1934 and devoted to questions concerning agriculture. \nThe £faction_bul_bzns §YAgrarian Union§! have a great influence in the rural regions of the country and will attempt to gain popularity among farmers.
loc.BUL_NSM_TOOLTIP: The £faction_bul_nsm §YNational Social Movement§! is a far-right organization led by the former Zveno member Aleksandar Tsankov. \nThe £faction_bul_nsm §YNational Social Movement§! will attempt to gain popularity among the masses by organizing demonstrations and protests throughout the country.
loc.BUL_LOYALTY_TOOLTIP: §YLoyalty§! represents the faction's desire to cooperate with the government. \nThe higher the §YLoyalty§!, the less likely it is that a faction will confront the government. \nBefore integrating a faction into the government, it is necessary to complete certain decisions to align their members with the government and increase their §YLoyalty§! to 100.
loc.BUL_POPULARITY_TOOLTIP: §YPopularity§! represents the support a faction receives from certain sectors of the population (be they military, proletarian, peasant or right-wing radicals). \nThe higher the §YPopularity§!, the more likely it is that a faction will confront the government. \nBefore destroying a faction, it is necessary to complete certain decisions to weaken it and reduce its §YPopularity§! to 0.
loc.BUL_reduced_faction_interaction_cost_tt: Decision cost to activate any §YFaction Management§! decisions is halved.
loc.BUL_reduced_communist_oppression_cost_tt: Decision cost to oppress §YBroad Socialist§! faction is halved.
loc.BUL_improved_faction_effects_tt: Increased effects on factions for all §YFaction Management§! decisions.
loc.BUL_reduced_faction_interaction_cooldown: §YFaction Management§! decisions will take less time to complete and will be available sooner after having activated them.
loc.BUL_a_royal_visit_desc: To increase his popularity among the population, Tsar Boris will visit the municipality of [GetDestinationName]. During his walkabout he will mingle with the crowd while we make sure that plenty of photographs of the event are taken and sent to the press.
loc.BUL_cooperation_zveno_speech_desc: We will allow the [GetZvenoName] to deliver a speech on their proposals regarding economic and social policies, industrial projects, and agrarian reforms.
loc.BUL_cooperation_bs_speech_desc: We will allow the [GetBsName] to deliver a speech on their proposals regarding economic and social policies, industrial projects, and agrarian reforms.
loc.BUL_cooperation_bzns_speech_desc: We will allow the [GetBznsName] to deliver a speech on their proposals regarding economic and social policies, industrial projects, and agrarian reforms.
loc.BUL_cooperation_nsm_speech_desc: We will allow the [GetNsmName] to deliver a speech on their proposals regarding economic and social policies, industrial projects, and agrarian reforms.
loc.BUL_cooperation_zveno_joint_act_desc: We will organize a joint event with the [GetZvenoName] in which we will announce to the public our support for this faction and our willingness to cooperate with them.
loc.BUL_cooperation_bs_joint_act_desc: We will organize a joint event with the [GetBsName] in which we will announce to the public our support for this faction and our willingness to cooperate with them.
loc.BUL_cooperation_bzns_joint_act_desc: We will organize a joint event with the [GetBznsName] in which we will announce to the public our support for this faction and our willingness to cooperate with them.
loc.BUL_cooperation_nsm_joint_act_desc: We will organize a joint event with the [GetNsmName] in which we will announce to the public our support for this faction and our willingness to cooperate with them.
loc.BUL_cooperation_bolster_zveno_desc: After our successful cooperation, we will grant certain privileges to the [GetZvenoName] and allow its exiled members to come back and join the organization once more.
loc.BUL_cooperation_zveno_social_renovation_: Following a proposal from the [GetZvenoName], we shall establish the Directorate of Social Renovation, a propaganda ministry whose objective will be national regeneration.
loc.BUL_cooperation_bs_legalize_faction_desc: We will authorize the [GetBsName] to carry out its political and social activities within a legal framework.
loc.BUL_cooperation_bzns_legalize_faction_de: We will authorize the [GetBznsName] to carry out its political and social activities within a legal framework.
loc.BUL_cooperation_nsm_legalize_faction_des: We will authorize the [GetNsmName] to carry out its political and social activities within a legal framework.
loc.BUL_cooperation_fund_zveno_desc: In order to support our political allies, we will provide the [GetZvenoName] with funds to carry out a propaganda campaign to increase their popularity.
loc.BUL_cooperation_fund_bs_desc: In order to support our political allies, we will provide the [GetBsName] with funds to carry out a propaganda campaign to increase their popularity.
loc.BUL_cooperation_fund_bzns_desc: In order to support our political allies, we will provide the [GetBznsName] with funds to carry out a propaganda campaign to increase their popularity.
loc.BUL_cooperation_fund_nsm_desc: In order to support our political allies, we will provide the [GetNsmName] with funds to carry out a propaganda campaign to increase their popularity.
loc.BUL_cooperation_appoint_zveno_members_de: The [GetZvenoName] has proven to be made up of competent members with plenty of interesting ideas and proposals. We will offer relevant positions within government to the most talented leaders among their ranks.
loc.BUL_cooperation_appoint_bs_members_desc: The [GetBsName] has proven to be made up of competent members with plenty of interesting ideas and proposals. We will offer relevant positions within government to the most talented leaders among their ranks.
loc.BUL_cooperation_appoint_bzns_members_des: The [GetBznsName] has proven to be made up of competent members with plenty of interesting ideas and proposals. We will offer relevant positions within government to the most talented leaders among their ranks.
loc.BUL_cooperation_appoint_nsm_members_desc: The [GetNsmName] has proven to be made up of competent members with plenty of interesting ideas and proposals. We will offer relevant positions within government to the most talented leaders among their ranks.
loc.BUL_cooperation_integrate_zveno_desc: We have been cooperating with the [GetZvenoName] as different, albeit close, entities so far, and it is time to finally integrate them into our government.
loc.BUL_cooperation_integrate_bs_desc: We have been cooperating with the [GetBsName] as different, albeit close, entities so far, and it is time to finally integrate them into our government.
loc.BUL_cooperation_integrate_bzns_desc: We have been cooperating with the [GetBznsName] as different, albeit close, entities so far, and it is time to finally integrate them into our government.
loc.BUL_cooperation_integrate_nsm_desc: We have been cooperating with the [GetNsmName] as different, albeit close, entities so far, and it is time to finally integrate them into our government.
loc.BUL_opression_discredit_zveno_leaders_de: The [GetZvenoName] faction is spreading dangerous ideas and severe criticism of our government among the population, which is completely unacceptable to us. We must publicly discredit their leaders, thus damaging their public image and popularity.
loc.BUL_opression_discredit_bs_leaders_desc: The [GetBsName] faction is spreading dangerous ideas and severe criticism of our government among the population, which is completely unacceptable to us. We must publicly discredit their leaders, thus damaging their public image and popularity.
loc.BUL_opression_discredit_bzns_leaders_des: The [GetBznsName] faction is spreading dangerous ideas and severe criticism of our government among the population, which is completely unacceptable to us. We must publicly discredit their leaders, thus damaging their public image and popularity.
loc.BUL_opression_discredit_nsm_leaders_desc: The [GetNsmName] faction is spreading dangerous ideas and severe criticism of our government among the population, which is completely unacceptable to us. We must publicly discredit their leaders, thus damaging their public image and popularity.
loc.BUL_opression_dispose_of_zveno_generals_: The risk of a [GetZvenoName] coup is real, so we will dispose of any general close to the organization or to the former Military Union, either by transferring them to the reserve or dismissing them from the army right away.
loc.BUL_opression_ban_bs_media_desc: We will prohibit the distribution of any media that belongs to the [GetBsName] or that publicly endorses their faction.
loc.BUL_opression_ban_bzns_media_desc: We will prohibit the distribution of any media that belongs to the [GetBznsName] or that publicly endorses their faction.
loc.BUL_opression_ban_nsm_media_desc: We will prohibit the distribution of any media that belongs to the [GetNsmName] or that publicly endorses their faction.
loc.BUL_opression_repress_zveno_desc: We cannot tolerate dissidents and agitators dividing our nation. The acts perpetrated by members of the [GetZvenoName] against our government will have serious consequences.
loc.BUL_opression_repress_bs_desc: We cannot tolerate dissidents and agitators dividing our nation. The acts perpetrated by members of the [GetBsName] against our government will have serious consequences.
loc.BUL_opression_repress_bzns_desc: We cannot tolerate dissidents and agitators dividing our nation. The acts perpetrated by members of the [GetBznsName] against our government will have serious consequences.
loc.BUL_opression_repress_nsm_desc: We cannot tolerate dissidents and agitators dividing our nation. The acts perpetrated by members of the [GetNsmName] against our government will have serious consequences.
loc.BUL_opression_anti_zveno_speech_desc: We will organize a rally against the [GetZvenoName] where we will deliver a speech on our contempt towards their organization and their anti-government stance.
loc.BUL_opression_anti_bs_speech_desc: We will organize a rally against the [GetBsName] where we will deliver a speech on our contempt towards their organization and their anti-government stance.
loc.BUL_opression_anti_bzns_speech_desc: We will organize a rally against the [GetBznsName] where we will deliver a speech on our contempt towards their organization and their anti-government stance.
loc.BUL_opression_anti_nsm_speech_desc: We will organize a rally against the [GetNsmName] where we will deliver a speech on our contempt towards their organization and their anti-government stance.
loc.BUL_opression_imprison_zveno_leaders_des: We will imprison the [GetZvenoName] leaders, cutting off the head of the snake and dealing a critical blow to the organization.
loc.BUL_opression_imprison_bs_leaders_desc: We will imprison the leaders of the [GetBsName], cutting off the head of the snake and dealing a critical blow to the organization.
loc.BUL_opression_imprison_bzns_leaders_desc: We will imprison the [GetBznsName] leaders, cutting off the head of the snake and dealing a critical blow to the organization.
loc.BUL_opression_imprison_nsm_leaders_desc: We will imprison the [GetNsmName] leaders, cutting off the head of the snake and dealing a critical blow to the organization.
loc.BUL_opression_raid_zveno_supporters_desc: The [GetZvenoName] faction has been severely weakened after the capture of its leaders, and it is time to hunt down the remaining members who are still keeping the organization alive and actively conspiring against us.
loc.BUL_opression_raid_bs_supporters_desc: The [GetBsName] faction has been severely weakened after the capture of its leaders, and it is time to hunt down the remaining members who are still keeping the organization alive and actively conspiring against us.
loc.BUL_opression_raid_bzns_supporters_desc: The [GetBznsName] faction has been severely weakened after the capture of its leaders, and it is time to hunt down the remaining members who are still keeping the organization alive and actively conspiring against us.
loc.BUL_opression_raid_nsm_supporters_desc: The [GetNsmName] faction has been severely weakened after the capture of its leaders, and it is time to hunt down the remaining members who are still keeping the organization alive and actively conspiring against us.
loc.BUL_opression_destroy_zveno_desc: The time has come to deal the final blow to the [GetZvenoName] and rid the country of its threat once and for all.
loc.BUL_opression_destroy_bs_desc: The time has come to deal the final blow to the [GetBsName] and rid the country of their threat once and for all.
loc.BUL_opression_destroy_bzns_desc: The time has come to deal the final blow to the [GetBznsName] and rid the country of its threat once and for all.
loc.BUL_opression_destroy_nsm_desc: The time has come to deal the final blow to the [GetNsmName] and rid the country of its threat once and for all.

loc.BUL_cooperation_integrate_faction_tt: Faction Loyalty is §Y100§!\nFaction Popularity is higher than §Y70§!
loc.BUL_zveno_integrated_flag: The £faction_bul_zveno §YZveno§! faction has been integrated into the government
loc.BUL_bs_destroyed_flag: The £faction_bul_bs §YBroad Socialists§! faction has been destroyed
loc.BUL_bs_integrated_flag: The £faction_bul_bs §YBroad Socialists§! faction has been integrated into the government
loc.BUL_bzns_destroyed_flag: The £faction_bul_bzns §YAgrarian National Union§! faction has been destroyed
loc.BUL_bzns_integrated_flag: The £faction_bul_bzns §YAgrarian National Union§! faction has been integrated into the government

loc.BUL_impending_zveno_coup_size_tt: [GetZvenoName] supporters start a civil war. \nZveno military size in the civil war is based on Zveno popularity.
loc.BUL_macedonian_revolutionary_organizatio: We must seek Macedonian cooperation during a potential Bulgarian occupation in the near future. The IMRO can become the perfect tool to promote Bulgarian sentiment in the region, facilitating the annexation of Macedonia in the long term.

The IMRO has been a scourge all around the Balkans for far too long. We must deal with the remaining cells still active in Bulgaria, imprison their members, who look more like gangsters rather than revolutionaries, and finally end their reign of terror.
loc.BUL_repress_imro_propaganda_desc: We will carry out a national propaganda campaign against IMRO, publicly denouncing the organization through speeches, meetings and demonstrations.
loc.BUL_repress_imro_persecute_activists_des: We will hunt down and bring to justice any revolutionary agitator or activist operating within our borders.
loc.BUL_repress_imro_destroy_organization_de: We will carry out a military operation along the Macedonian border to root out the IMRO once and for all.
loc.BUL_support_imro_make_contacts_desc: We will secretly contact IMRO and let their leaders know that cooperation between their organization and the Bulgarian government would be highly beneficial to both parties.
loc.BUL_support_imro_supply_activists_desc: We will provide arms to the IMRO so that they can infiltrate Yugoslav and Greek Macedonia and destabilize the region.
loc.BUL_support_imro_prepare_bulgarian_occup: The IMRO must organize Bulgarian Action Committees that will immediately take over the local authorities in the event of a Bulgarian occupation of the region.
loc.BUL_support_imro_militias_desc: We must draw on the experience of the Macedonian revolutionaries and form IMRO militia divisions to serve in our army.
loc.BUL_support_imro_garrisons_desc: IMRO members will perform better as peacekeepers in their own region, thus they will be tasked with garrisoning our occupation zones throughout Macedonia.
loc.BUL_macedonian_revolutionary_organizatio: IMRO, a pro-Bulgarian organization that has been a scourge in the Balkans for too long, is now being supported and armed by Bulgaria, with the intention of destabilizing our country and spreading Bulgarian sentiment in the region. We must end this organization and its reign of terror once and for all.
loc.BUL_repress_imro_foreign_desc: We will hunt down and bring to justice any revolutionary agitator or activist operating within our borders.
loc.BUL_destroy_imro_foreign_desc: We must carry out a military operation throughout Macedonia to root out the IMRO once and for all.

loc.BUL_destroy_imro_divisions_central_maced: Has less than §Y4 Infantry§! divisions in §YPlovdiv§! along the border with the state of §YCentral Macedonia§!
loc.BUL_destroy_imro_divisions_thrace_tt: Has less than §Y4 Infantry§! divisions in §YPlovdiv§! along the border with the state of §YThrace§!
loc.BUL_widespread_bulgarian_sentiment_tt: [BUL.GetNameDefCap] will receive bonuses when controlling these states.
loc.BUL_support_imro_militias_tt: Creates IMRO Militia divisions in fully controlled Macedonian states.
loc.BUL_support_imro_garrisons_tt: Receives §Y[?BUL_imro_garrisons_mp_value] Manpower§! for each Macedonian state under full [ROOT.GetAdjective] control.
loc.BUL_support_imro_supply_activists_resist: Unlocks decisions to the owner of the state to eventually root out Macedonian resistance.

loc.BUL_not_justifying_wargoals_tt: Bulgaria is not justifying any wargoals.
loc.BUL_the_fatherland_front_desc_planning:
The leaders of the §YFatherland Front§! are making preparations to stage a coup.
Eventually, they will seek support from the [GetZvenoName], the [GetBsName] and the [GetBznsName].
We can take several actions to hinder their preparations and weaken their attempt to overthrow the government:
-Root out and arrest §YFatherland Front§! sympathizers and leaders.
-Destroy or integrate any of the factions they may approach.
-Having less than 1 §YCommunist Support§! will allow us to deliver the final blow to the §YFatherland Front§!.
loc.BUL_the_fatherland_front_desc_coup: The leaders of the Fatherland Front have planned the coup and now await the right moment to strike.\nProbability of the coup happening:\nBase §Y10%§! [GetAtWarFfPercentage] [GetAllyAtWarFfPercentage] [GetSovNeighborFfPercentage] [GetCommunistSovFfPercentage]
loc.BUL_ff_civil_war_flag: The Fatherland Front has started a civil war
loc.BUL_fatherland_front_formed_flag: The Fatherland Front has been formed
loc.BUL_ff_impending_coup_mission_desc: The leaders of the §YFatherland Front§! are making preparations to stage a coup.
loc.BUL_ff_approaching_zveno_mission_desc: The §YFatherland Front§! is appealing to the [GetZvenoName] to join their coup.
loc.BUL_ff_approaching_bs_mission_desc: The §YFatherland Front§! is appealing to the [GetBsName] to join their coup.
loc.BUL_ff_approaching_bzns_mission_desc: The §YFatherland Front§! is appealing to the [GetBznsName] to join their coup.
loc.BUL_ff_root_out_sympathizers_desc: Those who publicly sympathize with the Fatherland Front and support their ideals must be hunted down and brought to justice.
loc.BUL_ff_massive_arrests_desc: More drastic measures are required to end the threat posed by the Fatherland Front. We will carry out massive raids, arresting anyone related to the organization.
loc.BUL_ff_deal_the_final_blow_desc: We have critically weakened the communists and the fate of the Fatherland Front revolution hangs by a thread... A thread we shall proceed to cut at once!
loc.BUL_ff_approaching_faction_timer_effects: The faction will join the Fatherland Front, subtracting days from §YImpending Fatherland Front Coup§! mission, based on §Yfaction popularity§!. §YFaction loyalty§! towards the government will slightly reduce the effect.
loc.BUL_ff_approaching_faction_cw_effects_tt: If this faction joins the Fatherland Front, the uprising will be strengthened.
loc.BUL_ff_preventive_action_taken_tt: Decrease the chance of the Fatherland Front staging a coup by §G[?BUL.BUL_ff_preventive_actions_base_value]%§!.\nValue capped at §Y[?BUL.BUL_ff_preventive_actions_cap_value]%§!.
loc.BUL_ff_deal_the_final_blow_tt: We will root out the Fatherland Front once and for all!
loc.BUL_rearmament_desc: After our defeat in the Great War and the imposition of the Neuilly Treaty, our army has been subjected to enormous limitations. But turbulent times are looming over Europe now and, if we are to preserve the territorial integrity of Bulgaria and the freedom of its people, we must find a way to leave those restrictions behind and start rebuilding our army.
loc.BUL_demonstrate_our_policies_of_peace_de: Territorial disputes with our neighbors must end if we want to negotiate our military rearmament with the British government.
loc.BUL_pressure_to_lift_army_restrictions_d: We must press [ENG.GetNameDef] to finally agree to lift all the restrictions placed on our army.
loc.BUL_refuse_army_restrictions_desc: Now that we are backed by [GetBulgarianFactionName], we no longer need the consent of [ENG.GetNameDef] to begin our military rearmament.
loc.BUL_rearmament_main_factors_tt:
Main factors that will impact [ENG.GetAdjective] decision: 
§G- Publicly condemning the IMRO 
- Having good relations with §Y[ENG.GetNameWithFlag]§! 
- Completing the focus §YTreaty of Perpetual Friendship§! or §YThe Salonika Agreement§! 
- Leaning towards democracy 
- Having the same government as §Y[ENG.GetNameWithFlag]§!§! 
§R- Having poor relations with §Y[ENG.GetNameWithFlag]§! 
- Supporting the IMRO 
- Appointing Bogdan Filov as an advisor or country leader§!
loc.BUL_purchase_equipment_desc: The [ROOT.GetAdjective] industry is underdeveloped and cannot produce modern weapons at an acceptable rate. We must look abroad for more industrialized countries that can supply us with the military equipment we need.
loc.BUL_purchasing_infantry_equipment_flag: Is already purchasing infantry equipment elsewhere
loc.BUL_purchase_artillery_tt: \nWe will choose between purchasing [?BUL_quantity_purchased_artillery] pieces of §YArtillery§![GetAvailableArtilleryToPurchase], based on [FROM.GetAdjective] research.\n
loc.BUL_purchase_vehicles_tt: \nWe will choose between purchasing [?BUL_quantity_purchased_motorized] §YMotorized§![GetAvailableVehiclesToPurchase] vehicles, based on [FROM.GetAdjective] research.\n
loc.BUL_purchase_armor_tt: \nWe will choose between purchasing [?BUL_quantity_purchased_light_armor] §YLight Tanks§![GetAvailableArmorToPurchase], based on [FROM.GetAdjective] research.\n
loc.BUL_purchase_aircraft_tt: \nWe will choose between purchasing [?BUL_quantity_purchased_fighter] §YFighters§![GetAvailableAircraftToPurchase], based on [FROM.GetAdjective] research.\n
loc.BUL_ships_purchase_rejected_flag: Has rejected Bulgarian proposal to purchase ships in the last 180 days
loc.BUL_purchase_ships_undetermined_tt: If our proposal is accepted, we will choose between purchasing §Y3 Submarines§!, §Y2 Destroyers§! or a §YLight Cruiser§!.
loc.BUL_foreign_agreements_desc: We must focus on establishing beneficial agreements with leading foreign companies willing to establish subsidiaries in Bulgaria or invest in the development of our domestic industry.

loc.BUL_uranium_concession_agreement_desc: We cannot make the most out of the uranium deposits in our soil, and it would be more beneficial not only for us, but also for our [FROM.GetAdjective] allies, to sign a contract granting them exploitation rights in exchange for useful materials and products for our domestic industry and agriculture.
loc.BUL_negotiate_claims_in_the_balkans: Negotiate our Claims in the Balkans
loc.BUL_negotiate_claims_in_the_balkans_desc: Before aligning ourselves with any major power, we must negotiate our territorial demands with Germany. International tension is mounting, and Bulgaria will only support the nation offering the best territorial deal.
loc.BUL_secure_occupation_in_balkan_state_de: We must assume our role as peacekeepers in the Balkans and propose our allies to grant us administrative control over their occupied territories in the region, relieving foreign [ROOT.GetFactionName] garrisons so that they can reinforce other fronts.
loc.BUL_secure_occupation_in_balkan_state_tt: (Countries with low §YManpower§! and §YInfantry equipment§! will be more inclined to accept)
loc.BUL_bulgarian_territorial_expansion_arra: States with §YPre-Arranged Bulgarian Territorial Expansion§! Modifier will be transferred to Bulgaria once any faction ally controls the state and Bulgaria has joined the same faction as Germany
loc.BUL_align_bulgaria_desc: Our diplomatic relations with Bulgaria have been friendly for decades and, thanks to our financial aid, the Bulgarian government was able to manage its crippling debt. Now is the time to entice them to officially become [GER.GetNameDef] allies.
loc.BUL_germany_donate_fighters_desc: We will donate a small number of aircraft to the recently reestablished Bulgarian air force.
loc.BUL_germany_demand_military_access_desc: We must demand military access through Bulgaria, even if they do not join our offensive in the Balkans, so that our troops can use the Bulgarian border as a base of operations from which to launch the invasion of Greece.
loc.BUL_germany_demand_replacement_of_bulgar: Demand Replacement of Bulgarian Prime Minister

Bulgarian Prime Minister Georgi Kyoseivanov has proved himself an incompetent politician, we should suggest to [BUL.GetLeader] that this man be replaced by someone more capable and closer to our ideals, such as Bogdan Filov.
loc.BUL_donate_aircraft_tt: If [BUL.GetNameDef] accepts our donation, we will increase their opinion of us and facilitate cooperation between our countries.
loc.BUL_the_balkan_federation_dream_desc: [ROOT.GetNameDefCap] must champion the formation of a strong Balkan Federation to confront the many enemies of the proletariat, and make the Balkan nations understand that the only way to prevail in our struggle is to develop cooperation and solidarity among our peoples, which will ultimately lead to the unification of the Balkans...
loc.BUL_develop_balkan_federation_project_de: We must bring together experts in different areas, such as economics, industry, politics and society, to analyze why the project of a Balkan Federation failed in the 1920s, and develop a new, inclusive and improved project in which all Balkan nations will be treated fairly and equally.
loc.BUL_balkan_federation_propaganda_desc: We will organize a great propaganda campaign in [FROM.GetNameDef] to win the popular support of the [FROM.GetAdjective] proletarian masses for our Balkan Federation project.
loc.BUL_destabilize_country_desc: We must infiltrate [ROOT.GetAdjective] agents in [FROM.GetNameDef] to gather local activists who support our federation project, provide them with basic training, and form armed partisan groups to destabilize the country.
loc.BUL_fight_alongside_country_comrades_des: We must support the struggle of our comrades in [FROM.GetNameDef] and join their side in the [FROM.GetAdjective] civil war.
loc.BUL_fight_alongside_country_comrades_joi: §Y[ROOT.GetNameWithFlag]§! will join §Y[FROM.GetNameWithFlag]§! in their civil war.
loc.BUL_balkan_federation_industrial_aid_des: We are currently providing assistance to the [FROM.GetAdjective] government to boost [FROM.GetNameDef]'s deficient national industry before they join the [ROOT.GetFactionName].
loc.BUL_balkan_federation_economic_aid_desc: We are currently providing financial aid to the [FROM.GetAdjective] government to prevent [FROM.GetNameDef]'s distressed economy from collapsing, before they join the [ROOT.GetFactionName].
loc.BUL_balkan_federation_military_aid_desc: We are currently providing military assistance to the [FROM.GetAdjective] government to carry out an operation to root out several dissident cells in various rural towns around [FROM.Capital.GetName] before they join the [ROOT.GetFactionName].
loc.BUL_balkan_federation_project_ready_flag: The Balkan Federation Project is ready.
loc.BUL_balkan_federation_demand_turkish_ter: We will send a diplomatic delegation to negotiate with [TUR.GetLeader] the [TUR.GetAdjective] cession of its Balkan territories to [BUL.GetNameDef].
loc.BUL_brainwash_political_prisoners_desc: One of our political prisoners will be pressured and coerced to do our dirty work so that, should our regicidal plan fail, no member of the government can be linked to the assassination attempt.
loc.BUL_persuade_faction_members_desc: We will offer a ridiculously large sum of money to one of the anti-Tsarist members of the government to take charge of finding a suitable individual to carry out our plan.
loc.BUL_draw_up_a_plan_for_regicide: Draw up a Plan for Regicide
loc.BUL_draw_up_a_plan_for_regicide_desc: It is time to make the final preparations and decide when and where our operation will take place.
loc.BUL_seek_foreign_support_desc: We must seek foreign support that helps us not only to carry out the assassination of the Tsar in a subtle way, but also to give credibility to the official report that our government has prepared to make the incident known to the population.
loc.BUL_execute_plan_desc: We have been presented with the perfect opportunity to act, it is time to execute our plan! \nRest in peace, Boris...
loc.BUL_has_imprisoned_faction_leaders_tt: Has imprisoned the leaders of any internal faction
loc.BUL_seek_foreign_support_variable_reduct: Reduces the time needed to carry out the murder of Tsar Boris.
loc.BUL_seek_foreign_support_reduced_stabili: Reduces the stability penalty upon the death of the Tsar.
loc.BUL_assassin_persuaded_flag: Has brainwashed a political prisoner or persuaded a member of an integrated internal faction
loc.BUL_the_fate_of_the_balkans_dec_cat_desc: Bulgaria has long been subject to the interests and whims of foreign powers... \nBut times have changed, our country has grown stronger and [ROOT.GetNameDef] is now in a position to assert its supremacy in the Balkans.
loc.BUL_fate_of_the_balkans_influence_govern: We will establish contact with [FROM.GetAdjective] ministers to influence the decisions of their government in accordance with our interests, inducing them to favor the foreign policies most convenient for [ROOT.GetNameDef], either through bribery or coercion.
[FROM.GetFlag]§Y[FROM.GetNameDefCap]§! will be more inclined to submit to Bulgaria in the future.
loc.BUL_fate_of_the_balkans_ultimatum_desc: We will organize a meeting with the [FROM.GetAdjective] government to pressure them to join the [ROOT.GetFactionName] in exchange for [ROOT.GetAdjective] protection. And we shall also make it clear that our government will not take a [FROM.GetAdjective] refusal lightly.
loc.BUL_fate_of_the_balkans_bring_back_state: We will send a diplomatic mission to [FROM.Controller.GetNameDef] to demand the transfer of [FROM.GetName] to [ROOT.GetNameDef], to which it legitimately belongs.
loc.BUL_fate_of_the_balkans_demand_submissio: A [ROOT.GetAdjective] delegation will be sent to the [FROM.GetAdjective] capital to demand the recognition of [ROOT.GetNameDef] as [FROM.GetName]'s overlord.
Having greater military strength than [FROM.GetNameDef] increases the chances of them submitting to our will.
loc.BUL_dominance_in_the_black_sea_mission_d: We must secure the Black Sea, removing any possible threat from its shores and seizing new territories from which to increase the production of warships to ensure Bulgarian dominance in the seas.
