loc.TUR_the_legacy_of_osmanli_donanmasi_desc: The Ottoman Fleet was truly impressive, and if there is at least one thing worthy of mourning from the fallen empire it would be the illustrious navy it wielded. We can honor that legacy with a more modern navy today.
loc.TUR_the_path_of_the_wolf_desc: Like the wolf, we must always be on the prowl. We shall stay low, and attack when our enemy least expects it. We have the mindset of wolves, and the submarine is the perfect tool to exercise that mindset.
loc.TUR_fortified_defensive_bases_desc: It is said the best offence is a good defense, and our official stance is that we do not disagree!
loc.TUR_turk_silahli_kuvvetleri_desc: Our armed forces have become truly modern and are no longer the shade they had become after the terrible War of Independence. We could take on the world in our current state. We should be proud of how far we have come.
loc.TUR_misak_i_milli_desc: Misak-ı Millî - the National Oath. After the collapse of the Ottoman Empire and the conclusion of the War of Independence, we voluntarily surrendered a great deal of territory that we held and dropped our claims on the territory. The world is different now, and the people in these territories clamor for our return. We shall oblige them.
loc.TUR_alienate_our_allies_tt: \n§ROur radical shift in foreign policy might alienate us from our allies, especially if we begin targeting them.§!
loc.TUR_recover_the_kardzhali_vilayet_desc: The contemptible [BUL.GetAdjective] have been a thorn in our side for too long. They can deny it all they wish, but the Turkic people trapped and oppressed in their vicious rump state cry out for liberation. We do not intend to keep them waiting any longer.
loc.TUR_cypriot_and_oniki_ilhak_desc: The [GRE.GetAdjective]s can cry out for enosis all they wish; we shall beat them at their own game with our own ilhak. Cyprus and Rhodes are rightfully ours, and when we take hold of them again we shall never let them go.
loc.TUR_reuniting_thrace_through_force_desc: There is still a substantial [ROOT.GetAdjective] population in Thrace. We hold the greater part of it in Edirne, but the [GRE.GetAdjective] insist on keeping the territory divided. We must now insist to the contrary.
loc.TUR_rebuke_the_treaty_of_kars_desc: The Treaty of Kars was supposed to put to rest the borders between [ROOT.GetNameDef] and the Caucasus, but how can such a treaty hold weight when the lives of the Turkic places in that accursed region are at stake? We shall fight tooth and claw to save our kin.
loc.TUR_unite_the_azeri_diaspora_desc: It is our solemn duty to unite all the Turkic peoples of the world under one nation, and until we have liberated our Azeri brethren abroad our mission is not yet finished.
loc.TUR_konfederasyon_desc: We have always had a great affinity with the people of Azerbaijan, and it would be an absolute privilege to extend to the Azeri people equal citizenship in our fine conglomeration of Turkic peoples.
loc.TUR_annul_the_ankara_anlasmasi_desc: In 1926, the Mosul Question was seemingly resolved - but as with all crises of the time the result was undeniably in favor of the [ENG.GetAdjective] and the [FRA.GetAdjective]. We shall no longer ignore the plight of the [IRQ.GetAdjective] Turk. The time for action has come.
loc.TUR_liberate_the_kurdish_diaspora_desc: The destinies of the Turkish and Kurdish people are intertwined, and if we are not all in this together then history will be doomed to repeat itself for all of eternity.
loc.TUR_turanist_ambition_desc: We have the will to forge for ourselves a mighty empire, but we risk inciting the ire of the world's still-standing Great Powers. They will try to hinder us, but once Eurasia falls under our control they will be able to do naught to stop us.
loc.TUR_subdue_the_magyars_desc: They may think themselves far beyond their roots after centuries under the Austrian thumb, but we see the Hungarian for what he truly is. He is a Turk who denies it; a wolf who sees himself as a hawk. We shall remind the Magyars of their heritage.
loc.TUR_cin_turkleri_desc: The Turk in China will always be preyed upon without the solidarity of Turks abroad. It is incumbent on us to liberate and safeguard the Turks of China from those who would deny them their heritage.
loc.TUR_crowning_ourselves_with_the_fin_ugor: There is no finer jewel in the Turanist crown than that of [FIN.GetNameDef]. To conquer the [FIN.GetAdjective] is the sum of ultimate ambition, and we fully intend to meet that ambition and complete our Turanist brotherhood.
loc.BUL_acquire_modern_tools_desc: Bulgarian industry mainly consists of old-fashioned, small-scale manufacturing and handicrafts. We need the appropriate tools in order to build up and develop the foundations of a modern industry.
loc.BUL_improve_the_road_system_desc: Bulgarian roads are absolutely underdeveloped, to say the least, making communications difficult and slow. The development of a modern infrastructure industry capable of improving and expanding our current road system will pave the way to solve our transportation issues.
loc.BUL_attract_foreign_capitals_desc: We lack the means to build a powerful and efficient industry on our own, so our best bet is to appeal to foreign investors willing to expand their business and operate in Bulgaria.
loc.BUL_attract_foreign_capitals_dynamic_mod: Gains National Spirit §YForeign Industry§!, which grants (Political Power Gain: §G+5%§!, Construction Speed: §R-10%§!, Factory Output: §R-2%§!, £GFX_prod_eff_cap Production Efficiency Cap: §R-5%§!, £GFX_prod_eff Production Efficiency growth: §R-5%§!)
loc.BUL_invigorate_national_industry_desc: We have been relying on foreign capital to develop our infrastructure, industry and agriculture for far too long. If we seek self-sufficiency and the freedom to develop our country our own way, we must begin by investing in the national industry and the development of new plants.\nIt won’t be an easy task, but it will definitely be worth the effort in the long run.
loc.BUL_expand_sofia_university_desc: By allocating part of our budget to finance the expansion of the facilities of Sofia University, the most prestigious higher education institution in Bulgaria, we will increase our pool of brilliant minds, of which we shall make good use.
loc.BUL_expand_the_tobacco_industry_desc: For decades our main export has been our agricultural production, but it is clear that we can still increase the profits from these exports by switching from grain production to more valuable crops, such as tobacco.
loc.BUL_nationalization_desc: Foreign capital has allowed us to develop new industrial complexes in Bulgaria on a scale never before seen in the Balkans. But the magnates who own them are increasingly leeching off our economy, so it is about time we seize their means of production and push them out of our country. However, this will enrage foreign governments and, if diplomacy fails, we may have to fight for it...
loc.BUL_nationalization_warning_tt: §RAs a consequence of nationalization, foreign countries that have invested in Bulgarian industry might decide to impose a trade embargo on our country, kick us from faction or even declare war on us!§!
loc.BUL_increase_industry_investments_desc: We must develop a heavy industry capable of supporting our great industrial and military growth. Large national investments will be required, but this will bring us closer to our final economic independence.
loc.BUL_utmost_optimization_desc: By prioritizing the development of our national industry, we have experienced a sustained increase in production and many new industries have developed rapidly, although they are not yet very efficient. It is time for us to make the final effort, undertaking a major industrial and land reorganization, which will allow us to achieve maximum efficiency in both industry and agriculture.
loc.BUL_utmost_optimization_dynamic_modifier:
Modify §YForeign Industry§! by
Construction Speed: §G+5%§!
£GFX_prod_eff_cap Production Efficiency Cap: §G+3%§!
£GFX_prod_eff Production Efficiency growth: §G+3%§!
loc.BUL_utmost_optimization_tt: Effects will change if §YAttract Foreign Capitals§! focus is completed.
loc.BUL_national_railway_lines_desc: We need fast and reliable ways to move not only our troops but also our supplies across the country. Expanding our railway lines will improve our logistics capabilities.
loc.BUL_all_that_glitters_desc: The gold deposits in Chelopech could serve our economy well in a time when investments in non-material assets are at great risk. The effect on our national reserves should be noticeable.
loc.BUL_light_metal_exploitation_desc: With our military industry placing great demands on our natural resources, efforts must be made to expand domestic production. Though our deposits remain small, this time of need surely mandates their exploitation.
loc.BUL_steel_plant_in_pernik_desc: Bulgaria is not the richest country in the Balkans in terms of resources, and thus we need to get the most out of the treasures that our soil hides. We must improve our iron plants and coal extraction facilities in Pernik, and build our first steel manufacturing plant there.
loc.BUL_mineral_extraction_in_the_rhodopes_d: The Rhodopes are rich in minerals such as chromite, iron ore, zinc and lead, and our experts are optimistic that proper prospecting of the area can lead to the discovery of new deposits.
loc.BUL_uranium_prospecting_desc: Uranium is becoming an extremely valuable resource for creating powerful and devastating new weapons, and we have discovered potentially rich deposits in Buhovo. We must survey the area, and consider whether it will be more beneficial for us to make use of the resource ourselves or to grant exploitation rights to our allies.
loc.BUL_uranium_prospecting_no_target_tt: Unlocks Decision: §YUranium Concession Agreement§!, granting bonuses to Bulgarian faction leader or major ally. §RRequires Bulgaria to be in a faction.§!
loc.BUL_uranium_prospecting_leader_target_tt: Unlocks Decision: §YUranium Concession Agreement§!, granting bonuses to Bulgarian faction leader.
loc.BUL_uranium_prospecting_major_ally_targe: Unlocks Decision: §YUranium Concession Agreement§!, granting bonuses to Bulgarian major allies.
loc.BUL_georgi_benkovski_aircraft_repair_fac: In order to build a national air force, the construction of airframe repair hangars and engine testing facilities is required. In this regard, we have been presented with an interesting project to establish the Terem Georgi Benkovski aircraft repair plant in Plovdiv.
loc.BUL_pilot_training_program_desc: If Bulgaria is to dominate the skies, we will need a large pool of experienced pilots and crew members, and in order to achieve that, we must develop an optimal training program backed by the necessary air bases and training facilities.
loc.BUL_negotiate_bulgarian_rearmament_desc: The Bulgarian army is in a sorry state due to the Treaty of Neuilly-sur-Seine’s restrictions, and we are almost defenseless against invasion from any bordering country. We must negotiate the lift of those restrictions sooner rather than later, lest our greedy neighbors decide to start another Balkan war.
loc.BUL_reorganize_the_military_industry_des: Our military industry is outdated and inefficient, designed to produce currently obsolete equipment. We must carry out a modernization program before it is too late.
loc.BUL_darzhavna_aeroplanna_rabotilnitsa_de: We should not rely on foreign designers to supply our air force with the aircraft it needs. We will carry out a large expansion and modernization of the facilities of our State Aircraft Workshop in Bozhurishte.
loc.BUL_darzhavna_samoletna_fabrika_desc: DAR facilities in Bozhurishte are already producing Bulgarian fighters to feed our air force. We can now invest in the creation of a State Aircraft Factory in Lovech, with modern installations that will focus on the production of other light aircraft.
loc.BUL_foreign_aircraft_designers_desc: Why should we waste time and effort developing a national aviation industry, when we can just hire foreign designers with decades of experience in military aircraft production?
loc.BUL_kaproni_bulgarski_desc: Italian aircraft construction company Caproni is facing bankruptcy at this very moment, struggling to overcome the lack of resources, which have been diverted to other production chains. This opens up for us the possibility of acquiring its industrial complex in Kazanlak, Kaproni Bulgarski, where we could focus on the production of medium and heavy bombers.
loc.BUL_darzhavna_voenna_fabrika_desc: By expanding the State Military Factory in Kazanlak we can lay the foundations for a suitable national military industry capable of supplying our army with high-quality equipment.
loc.BUL_found_dvf_sopot_desc: The construction of the ammunition factory in Sopot started in 1935, but has not yet finished. We must conclude an agreement for the acquisition of the remaining machinery and equipment to put the complex into operation as soon as possible.
loc.BUL_contract_foreign_companies_desc: Our military industry is far from sufficient to carry out an adequate rearmament program. We must look abroad for fitting designers capable of producing high-quality vehicles with which to supply our army.
loc.BUL_rebuild_the_army_desc: We are surrounded by potential enemies, as history has taught us harshly, and it is crucial that we build a powerful army and develop modern tactics if we are to prevail in any future conflict.
loc.BUL_vasil_levsky_national_military_unive: The National Military University has a long history, but its military education has been drastically reduced since the imposition of the Treaty of Neuilly. It is time to finance a project to expand their facilities and encourage the enrollment of new cadets, who will eventually become successful officers.
loc.BUL_prussia_of_the_balkans_desc: During its early years, the Tsardom of Bulgaria was a heavily militarized state with a large and well-equipped army, identified as Prussia of the Balkans, until it was betrayed by its former, treacherous allies. However, we have rebuilt our country after the humiliating defeats of the past, and now the time has come to regain the former glory of Bulgaria. The world shall call us Prussia of the Balkans once again!
loc.BUL_national_military_academy_desc: The Chief of the National Military Academy has presented us with a project to expand its facilities, with the aim not only of increasing the capacity of the institution, but also of providing better training for our future military commanders.
loc.BUL_war_logistics_desc: We lost the Great War not because of defeats on the battlefield, but due to our inability to feed our people and supply our troops. We must improve our logistics to prevent that from happening ever again.
loc.BUL_defensive_lines_desc: We must begin construction of adequate fortifications and improvement of infrastructure to protect our transportation routes and ensure the flow of supplies for our troops.
loc.BUL_a_black_sea_fleet_desc: If we want to have some sort of naval presence, we need to assemble a fleet suitable for the Black Sea, focusing on the construction of destroyers, for they are the backbone of any modern fleet.
loc.BUL_improve_coastal_defenses_desc: We are extremely vulnerable to any possible naval invasion from the Black Sea, it is imperative that we strengthen our defensive line along the Black Sea coast. The sooner we do it, the better.
loc.BUL_reinforce_naval_bases_desc: We must ensure that our naval bases are well protected and have the capacity to maintain our fleets operating in the area.
loc.BUL_supremacy_on_the_bosporus_desc: Now that we are under the control of the Bosporus Strait, we must build adequate fortifications to ensure Bulgarian dominance over this key strategic region.
loc.BUL_dominance_in_the_black_sea_desc: Dark times call for dire measures to be taken. In order to guarantee not only the integrity of the Bulgarian nation, but also its hegemony, the time has come for us to secure the Black Sea, removing any possible threats from its shores.
loc.BUL_dominance_in_the_aegean_default: Dark times call for dire measures to be taken. In order to guarantee not only the integrity of the Bulgarian nation, but also its dominance in the Three Seas, the time has come for us to secure the Aegean, removing any possible threats from its shores.
loc.BUL_dominance_in_the_aegean_black_sea_su: After our success in securing the Black Sea, it is time to repeat the maneuver in the Aegean. We will drive out any hostile nation present on its shores and seize its valuable territories for the Prussia of the Balkans.
loc.BUL_dominance_in_the_aegean_black_sea_fa: The blow we suffered after the failure in our mission to secure the Black Sea has led to a darkening of the mood of the Bulgarian population, the only way to solve it is to secure, this time successfully, the Bulgarian dominance in the Aegean.
loc.BUL_dominance_in_the_aegean_adriatic_suc: After our success in securing the Adriatic, the morale of the Bulgarian troops and also of the civilian population is higher than ever. We must seize the momentum and secure the Aegean, so that the Prussia of the Balkans will be the sole and undisputed keeper of the three seas.
loc.BUL_dominance_in_the_aegean_adriatic_fai: Our failure to secure the Adriatic has dealt a severe blow to Bulgarian morale. If we want to regain courage and confidence, we must secure Bulgarian dominance in the Aegean.
loc.BUL_dominance_in_the_aegean_total_failur: The blows we suffered after the failure in securing both the Adriatic and the Black Sea has led to a general wave of demoralization and distrust towards the government in the country. If we are to make amends for our mistakes and bring back the glory that the Prussia of the Balkans deserves, we must secure the Bulgarian dominance in the Aegean.
loc.BUL_dominance_in_the_adriatic_default: Dark times call for dire measures to be taken. In order to guarantee not only the integrity of the Bulgarian nation, but also its dominance in the Three Seas, the time has come for us to secure the Adriatic, removing any possible threats from its shores.
loc.BUL_dominance_in_the_adriatic_black_sea_: After our success in securing the Black Sea, it is time to repeat the maneuver in the Adriatic. We will drive out any hostile nation present on its shores and seize its valuable territories for the Prussia of the Balkans.

The blow we suffered after the failure in our mission to secure the Black Sea has led to a darkening of the mood of the Bulgarian population, the only way to solve it is to secure, this time successfully, the Bulgarian dominance in the Adriatic.
loc.BUL_dominance_in_the_adriatic_aegean_suc: After our success in securing the Aegean, the morale of the Bulgarian troops and also of the civilian population is higher than ever. We must seize the momentum and secure the Adriatic, so that the Prussia of the Balkans will be the sole and undisputed keeper of the three seas.
loc.BUL_dominance_in_the_adriatic_aegean_fai: Our failure to secure the Aegean has dealt a severe blow to Bulgarian morale. If we want to regain courage and confidence, we must secure Bulgarian dominance in the Adriatic.
loc.BUL_dominance_in_the_adriatic_total_fail: The blows we suffered after the failure in securing both the Aegean and the Black Sea has led to a general wave of demoralization and distrust towards the government in the country. If we are to make amends for our mistakes and bring back the glory that the Prussia of the Balkans deserves, we must secure the Bulgarian dominance in the Adriatic.
loc.BUL_bulgaria_on_the_three_seas_desc: As it happened in ancient times during the First and Second Bulgarian Empires, the coasts of [ROOT.GetNameDef] are once again bathed by the Aegean, the Adriatic and the Black Sea. The next step is to develop the necessary infrastructure to build a powerful navy capable of securing Bulgarian dominance in the three seas.
loc.BUL_national_submarine_production_desc: Our navy is too weak to challenge foreign fleets and contest the dominance of the seas above the surface. However, we can focus on producing submarines that will harass enemy fleets and threaten their shipping routes from underwater.
loc.BUL_bulgarian_shipping_chamber_desc: We must provide Bulgarian shipping companies and cooperatives with the means they need to continuously increase their fleets, as their convoys are crucial to trade in peacetime, but also to transport troops and supplies during war.
loc.BUL_strike_from_the_seas_desc: There are countless islands and numerous strategic locations along the shores of the Mediterranean and the Black Sea. Therefore, we need a solid force with adequate transports capable of striking from the sea and taking those key positions from which to launch massive offensives.
loc.BUL_expand_varna_naval_base_desc: We must expand the facilities of the Varna naval base and build the adequate dockyards to carry out the production of warships.
loc.BUL_develop_burgas_shipyards_desc: In order to increase our production capacity for warships, we will invest in the expansion of the Burgas naval base and the construction of new shipyards in the area.
loc.BUL_an_aegean_sea_fleet_desc: Now that we have a presence in the Aegean, we must seek total dominance over it. To achieve this, we cannot rely only on destroyers and submarines, we need larger tonnage ships in our fleets.
loc.BUL_a_powerful_bulgarian_navy_desc: We must focus on building capital ships that provide our fleets with the firepower they currently lack. We may not have the largest navy, but if we concentrate our efforts, we may end up in a position to contest dominance of our seas even against major naval powers.
loc.BUL_modern_tactics_desc: A modern navy requires the development of modern tactics to make the most out of it. But we should not rely only on our navy when we face powerful enemy armies, for one of the greatest weaknesses of ships is their vulnerability to air strikes...
loc.BUL_oppose_the_royal_dictatorship_desc: If we want to end the oppressive regime of [GetBulgarianTsar], we must begin by seeking the necessary support to exert significant opposition to the current government, which is entirely made up of tsarist puppets.
loc.BUL_appoint_communist_ministers_desc: We must pressure the Bulgarian government to appoint ministers who seek a change of course from the dictatorial regime of the Tsar. Only from within the government will we be able to bring down the tsarist system.
loc.BUL_the_spanish_struggle_desc: Our Spanish comrades are facing the fascist scum who, thanks to the support of other right-wing powers in Europe, seriously threaten to defeat the Republican government. \nFaced with such atrocity, [ROOT.GetNameDef] cannot look the other way. We must organize brigades of volunteers who will fight side by side with the Spanish militiamen in defense of freedom.
loc.BUL_overthrow_the_tsar_desc: Anti-tsarist sentiment is spreading in Bulgaria and we must seize this valuable opportunity to overthrow [GetBulgarianTsar] and abolish the Bulgarian monarchy once and for all. There is no place in modern Bulgaria for such an obsolete form of government!
loc.BUL_abolish_the_tarnovo_constitution_des: The Tarnovo constitution was considered liberal and advanced in the last century, but today it only serves to legitimize an oppressive dictatorial regime. It is time to abolish this constitution and write a new one, based on the model of the Soviet Constitution of 1936, and which includes fundamental rights such as citizens equality before the law, freedom of speech and assembly and a universal welfare system.
loc.BUL_unify_the_bourgeois_movement_desc: If we want to fight fascism in Bulgaria, we must unify the bourgeois movement into a common movement. To achieve this, the Bulgarian Communist Party must seek cooperation with the socialists, leaving behind the differences between us for the greater good.
loc.BUL_united_front_against_fascism_desc: The next step after unifying the bourgeois movement is to form an anti-fascist bloc, a tactic suggested by the 7th Congress of the Comintern in 1935. We must appeal to agrarians and even democrats to join our front against Bulgarian fascism.
loc.BUL_the_fatherland_front_desc: After gathering significant support from numerous political groups, it is time for our anti-fascist front to become a political movement in itself, uniting the members of all these different political organizations into a single party, determined to resist fascism in Bulgaria at all costs.
loc.BUL_full_voting_rights_for_women_desc: If we want freedom, equality and progress to prevail in our country, it is time to grant women full voting rights and support the Union of Bulgarian Women in its task to raise social awareness on women's issues in [ROOT.GetNameDef].
loc.BUL_the_peoples_republic_of_bulgaria_des: Now that we have gotten rid of the Bulgarian monarchy, we must make some much-needed changes to the governance of our nation. It is time to end the era of despotism and oppression that has plagued the country for so many years and form the People's Republic of Bulgaria. \nUnity makes strength!
loc.BUL_soviet_bulgarian_treaty_of_mutual_as: The [SOU.GetNameDef] represents a powerful ally that can boost our economy and help us ensure the territorial integrity of [ROOT.GetNameDef] in these difficult times. We must try to strengthen ties with the [SOU.GetAdjective] government and gain its valuable support if we are to prevail against the many enemies that surround us.
loc.BUL_follow_the_stalinist_doctrine_desc: It is time for us to formally apply for official [SOV.GetFactionName] membership so that we can develop better cooperation between [SOV.GetNameDef] and [ROOT.GetNameDef], not only on economic and industrial issues, but also on military matters.
loc.BUL_joint_research_effort_desc: We must combine our research efforts in the military area with those of our allies to promote the development of modern weapons that can tip the balance in our favor in a military conflict.
loc.BUL_soviet_military_exercises_desc: Our military forces have much to learn from the competent and disciplined Red Army. We should invite military advisers from [SOV.GetNameDef] to come to [ROOT.GetNameDef] to help us develop a military training program inspired by the Soviet model.
loc.BUL_soviet_bulgarian_war_industry_desc: If we want to lay the foundations for a national military industry capable of supporting a large army, we must call for greater Soviet cooperation in the development and production of modern weapons.
loc.BUL_carry_the_revolution_abroad_desc: Bulgaria must become the vanguard of the communist revolution in the Balkans. We will invite like-minded governments to join our alliance, and we will take it upon ourselves to bring the revolution by force to the rest of our neighbors.
loc.BUL_liberation_of_the_proletariat_desc: It is our duty to put an end to the oppressive regimes to which the working class of neighboring countries is subjected. The Bulgarian people's army will not rest until these tyrannical governments are overthrown, even if it has to fight against the major European powers that support them.
loc.BUL_the_anti_capitalist_fight_desc: Throughout history, the so-called great democracies of Europe have meddled with the economy and borders of the Balkan countries, attending to their own interests and indifferent to the bloody conflicts they were causing. But the time has come for those rotten capitalists to fade away, for now it is Bulgaria's turn to dictate their economies, their governments and their borders.
loc.BUL_united_we_shall_prevail_desc: The Balkans have long been subjected to foreign nations, but now is the time for our peoples to join forces against the invaders and fight for the land that, by right, belongs to us.
loc.BUL_the_unification_of_the_balkans_desc: The time has come to realize our vision of a united and independent Balkan Federation in which all citizens are equal and can move freely regardless of origin, culture or creed.
loc.BUL_the_peoples_militia_directorate_desc: We will establish a Directorate of the People’s Militia, under the direct control of the Ministry of the Interior, charged with political security, maintaining public order, and conducting criminal investigations.
loc.BUL_purge_the_elites_desc: It is time for Bulgaria's privileged classes to stop hoarding their wealth. If we want our country and its economy to prosper, it is necessary for the rich to share what they have with those who have nothing, rather than with the banks.
loc.BUL_collectivization_of_the_countryside_: The crisis in agricultural distribution has caused great unrest in Bulgaria in the past, and the solution to this problem lies in replacing individually owned farms with collectively operated farms, a process that has already been carried out successfully in the Soviet Union.
loc.BUL_heavy_industry_desc: Following the successful agricultural reorganization, we are finally in a position to carry out a modern and ambitious industrialization program in Bulgaria.
loc.BUL_train_the_youth_wings_desc: To make up for the manpower shortage in our armed forces, we must provide basic training courses to instruct members of our youth wings in the use of weapons and military tactics so that they can reinforce our ranks if necessary.
loc.BUL_treaty_of_perpetual_friendship_desc: As a first step in developing good relations with our neighbors in the Balkans, we must approach the Yugoslav government with a proposal to sign a treaty that establishes the basis for cooperation between our countries and by which [ROOT.GetNameDef] finally abandons its irredentist claims in [YUG.GetNameDef].
loc.BUL_balkan_federation_of_socialist_repub: The project of a Balkan Federation failed in the 1920s due to the nationalistic aspirations of the various members. But times have changed, and we must show our new federation project to the rest of the Balkan nations, starting with [YUG.GetNameDef].
loc.BUL_bury_the_grudges_of_the_past: Bury the Grudges of the Past
loc.BUL_bury_the_grudges_of_the_past_desc: It is time to put the disputes of the past behind us and start looking towards a future of solidarity and cooperation in the Balkans. We must urge our neighbors to join our [GetFederationOrConfederation], because our project for a united Balkans will never be complete without them.
loc.BUL_balkan_trade_union_secretariat_desc: We must establish a Trade Union Secretariat that determines the directives to be followed by the different trade unions, with the aim of boosting the economy and fostering cooperation between the countries of our [GetFederationOrConfederation].
loc.BUL_defy_moscow_desc: The Soviet Union has long benefited from rivalries between the Balkan countries, not hesitating to interfere in our politics if it was in their interest. Now is the time for our [GetFederationOrConfederation] to strike before the Soviet government realizes that our united Balkan bloc is in a position to challenge Moscow's hegemony.
loc.BUL_balkan_research_cooperation_desc: We must develop a cooperation program that allows scientists from the different countries of our [GetFederationOrConfederation] to share their discoveries and foster new technological advances.
loc.BUL_recover_italian_territories_desc: Before Italy's territorial ambitions go any further, we must demand that the Italian government transfer control of its occupied territories in the Balkans to the countries to which they legitimately belong, or else face the consequences.
loc.BUL_democratic_principles_desc: While our main objective is to end the authoritarian regime of the Tsar, we cannot allow a totalitarian communist government to be established in its place. We must stay true to democratic ideals and seek to increase the influence of like-minded ministers in government.
loc.BUL_legalize_the_agrarian_party_desc: The ideas of the Bulgarian Agrarian National Union in economic matters may differ slightly from ours, but if we leave these trifles behind, its members could align themselves with our policies. We must therefore proceed to legalize this organization and seek cooperation between our parties, for if we are to lead Bulgaria towards a real democracy, we need all the support we can get...
loc.BUL_form_a_popular_bloc_desc: In order to form a strong united bloc against authoritarianism and oppression in [ROOT.GetNameDef], we must lean towards socialist policies and seek cohesion between left-wing political groups willing to fight against fascist and monarchist regimes.
loc.BUL_abolish_the_monarchy_desc: The monarchy may have been a useful tool in maintaining stability in Bulgaria during the early years of the Bulgarian Third State, but after devastating wars and tyrannical regimes, people have lost faith in this antiquated system of government. The time has come to abolish it.
loc.BUL_seek_cooperation_with_the_tsar_desc: The Tsar still holds too much power within the government and could hinder all our proposals if provoked, so our best option is to try to cooperate with him while we gradually increase our influence in the government.
loc.BUL_legislative_elections_desc: The Bulgarian Democratic Party has garnered massive support and it is now in position to pressure the government to call parliamentary elections, this time free from the rigging they have been subjected to for years.
loc.BUL_petorka_desc: We have received a proposal to collaborate with certain political groups that, like us, seek to defend democratic principles against all those political forces attempting to establish a dictatorial regime, be it tsarist, fascist or communist. This coalition would be made up of five organizations, including the Radical Democratic Party, the National Liberal Party and, of course, the Bulgarian Democratic Party.
loc.BUL_land_reorganization_desc: It is time to carry out an industrial and agrarian reorganization, in accordance with our plans to implement a set of new reforms to strengthen these sectors in the near future.
loc.BUL_agrarian_cooperative_movement_desc: We must take inspiration from the agrarian measures proposed by the Agrarian National Union and promote an organization of the countryside based on cooperatives.
loc.BUL_modernize_the_industry_desc: If we are to establish ourselves as the foremost industrial power within the Balkans we must strive to modernize our industry! Increased budget allocations and improved tools will make our dreams come true.
loc.BUL_the_salonika_agreement_desc: It is obvious that Bulgaria alone does not pose any threat to the nations that formed the Balkan Entente to confront our country together, so we must try to reestablish friendly relations with our neighbors, and what better way to start than by signing an agreement with the leader of [GRE.GetNameDef], [GRE.GetLeader]?
loc.BUL_a_balkan_confederation_desc: The reasons that led to the formation of the Balkan Entente are now obsolete. In these turbulent times, the Balkan nations should leave the conflicts of the past behind and unite to defend themselves against the foreign powers that seek to subdue them.
loc.BUL_approach_the_united_kingdom_desc: [ROOT.GetNameDef] needs the protection of the great democratic powers in Europe if it is to prevail in these uncertain times. We must meet with the [ENG.GetAdjective] government to negotiate a co-operative pact between our countries.
loc.BUL_join_the_allies_desc: We must formalize our desire to join the [ENG.GetFactionName] by submitting an application to the [ENG.GetAdjective] government to consider [ROOT.GetNameDef]'s membership in their alliance.
loc.BUL_consolidate_the_third_bulgarian_stat: After a long period of social conflict, economic depression and international disputes, we are finally ready to stabilize and strengthen the Third Bulgarian State.
loc.BUL_free_balkan_states_desc: It is our duty as a Balkan power to protect our weaker neighbors against the ambitions of any nation seeking to invade our land. We must develop cooperation among the friendly nations of the region and prepare for the defense of the Balkans.
loc.BUL_fight_tyranny_desc: It is time to confront the great European powers that follow worrisome fascist policies and whose leaders dream of nothing but expanding their dominions and subjugating the world.
loc.BUL_assert_our_claims_desc: It is time to address the territorial issues that have plagued our country for decades. We must seek support from the [ENG.GetAdjective] government to redress the affronts that have been made to Bulgaria since its liberation.
loc.BUL_appeal_to_european_capitalists_desc: [ROOT.GetNameDef] needs a new injection of capital to stimulate the development of its national industry and to renegotiate its debt with the large multinationals that have already invested in the country.
loc.BUL_obliterate_the_bolshevik_threat_desc: Sooner or later, the communist nations will seek to bring their cursed revolution to [ROOT.GetNameDef]. Why wait for the Bolshevik lunge when we can take advantage of the element of surprise? We must be the first to strike, and we must strike with such ferocity that their beloved revolution is shattered once and for all!
loc.BUL_research_sharing_desc: Our country lags behind in the field of scientific research. If we want to produce state-of-the-art war machines and develop a modern industry, we must propose to our allies the implementation of a technological cooperation program.
loc.BUL_power_to_the_tsar_desc: The Zveno established an authoritarian military regime before being overthrown by Tsar Boris III in 1935. But the Tsar preserved this power centralization and it is time to make good use of it, if we are to unify a fractured nation.
loc.BUL_condemn_macedonian_organizations_des: We must proclaim our displeasure towards IMRO and start working on hunting down and eliminating any Macedonian revolutionary cells still operating in Bulgaria, finally putting an end to what the Zveno started in 1934 and improving our foreign relations with it.
loc.BUL_support_macedonian_organizations_des: If we want to fulfill our dreams of unifying and annexing Macedonia, it will be more beneficial for us to cooperate with IMRO leaders in exile who can pave the way for a potential Bulgarian occupation of Macedonia in the future.
loc.BUL_dissolve_the_military_union_desc: The Zveno holds too much influence over our officers, and there is real resentment among their ranks after Tsar Boris ousted them from power in 1935. If we want to avoid a new Zveno coup, we must gather our officers in Sofia and announce the dissolution of the Military Union.
loc.BUL_cooperate_with_the_zveno_desc: We must work together with the Zveno, rather than antagonize them. If we decide to grant them some concessions, we could gain a powerful ally.
loc.BUL_the_tsars_regime_desc: Our country is split into multiple factions, social movements and banned political organizations. The Tsar must impose his full authority if he is to eventually bring cohesion and stability to Bulgaria.
loc.BUL_restrained_paramilitary_organization: Members of paramilitary organizations are loyal individuals who already possess some form of military discipline and will be ready to wage war for the greater glory of our country. If we can entice these organizations, they could become a reliable source of manpower.
loc.BUL_ban_far_right_organizations_desc: Far-right radicals do not hesitate to use violence against authority, posing a great threat to our government and to our citizens. We must ban all social movements of this nature and disband any associated paramilitary organizations.
loc.BUL_restore_the_tarnovo_constitution_des: Since the coup d'etat of 1934, the state has been governed under a de facto suspended constitution. It is time that we officially restore the Tarnovo Constitution, which will not only please our citizens, but also legally support our authoritarian regime.
loc.BUL_freedom_of_press_desc: Now that the constitution has been restored, we must guarantee its rights and principles. Allowing the distribution of currently banned newspapers could be the first step into cooperating with certain organizations.
loc.BUL_promote_bulgarian_nationalism_desc: There may be countless threats to our nation from both abroad and within it, but if we Bulgarians stand together and work side by side, we shall prevail in the turbulent times ahead!
loc.BUL_crush_the_communists_desc: Despite having been repressed multiple times so far this century, communists still lurk in the shadows, preying on the miserable and outcast to thicken their ranks. It is our duty to finish them off once and for all, by whatever means necessary...
loc.BUL_illusions_of_a_non_partisan_system_d: The Tsar needs the support of his democratic subjects to fulfill his vision of a united Bulgaria. We must hold what will be an illusion of parliamentary elections, keeping popular opposition parties banned and ensuring that pro-government candidates win a majority of seats.
loc.BUL_limited_womens_suffrage_desc: Bulgarian women call for social progress and equality, and nationalists have already warned that this fight is not only a women's issue, but a matter of social development and nation-building. Therefore, in order to follow the path of progress while preserving full political control, we will grant conditional voting rights to married, non-communist women.
loc.BUL_found_the_brannik_desc: Bogdan Filov has an interesting proposal to found a pro-fascist national youth organization, called Brannik, close to the authorities and loyal to the Tsar, modeled on other German youth organizations. Filov believes that Brannik can become massive, providing us with a substantial source of manpower.\n"Boris, Bulgaria, God!"
loc.BUL_bulgarian_irredentism_desc: Bulgarian nationalism calls for the necessity to redraw the Balkan borders in favor of Bulgaria, and even the communists and the democrats will agree with that. We must emphasize the need to restore Greater Bulgaria, a common goal for all our people.
loc.BUL_strengthen_the_royal_dictatorship_de: We must focus on promoting loyalty to Boris and eradicating all opposition to the regime. Thus paving the way for the Tsar Unifier to finally bring the glory our beloved nation deserves.
loc.BUL_war_industry_desc: An army at war needs a constant flow of equipment, weapons and aircraft. If we are to emerge victorious from this conflict, we need to increase our military production to feed our forces.
loc.BUL_liberalization_of_trade_policies_des: Bulgarian economy has been lurching from one crisis to the next since its independence from the Ottoman Empire. Autarkic policies have proven to be inadequate in the past, so it is time to move towards economic liberalization.
loc.BUL_plot_against_boris_desc_plot: We thought that Tsar Boris was the monarch who would lead the country to greatness, but his authoritarian regime, close to a dictatorship, is proving that we were wrong and threatens to further destabilize the country. It is our duty as loyal servants of Bulgaria to rid our nation of this unworthy ruler and to form a new government, worthy of the people's trust.
loc.BUL_form_a_regency_council_desc: Following the death of Tsar Boris, and due to his heir being [GetSimeonsAge], a Regency Council must be appointed to exercise the country's government on behalf of young Simeon II.
loc.BUL_the_return_of_ferdinand_i: The Return of Tsar Ferdinand I
loc.BUL_the_return_of_ferdinand_i_desc: Despite his advanced age and the fact that he was forced to abdicate in 1918 after the Bulgarian defeat in the Great War, the political experience and military skill of the former Tsar Ferdinand I make him the most suitable candidate to lead the nation to greatness. We must make the necessary arrangements to bring Ferdinand back to the Bulgarian throne.
loc.BUL_amend_old_grudges_desc: It is time to avenge all the damage and humiliation inflicted on Bulgaria by its many enemies in the past, from the treacherous Romanians and Turks who stabbed us in the back during the Second Balkan War to the Entente powers who defeated us in the great war and have been hampering the development of our country ever since.
loc.BUL_the_fate_of_the_balkans_desc: Bulgaria has been subjected for too long to the will of her neighboring countries and the great European powers that support them... But times have changed, our country has grown stronger like no other Balkan nation, and Bulgaria is powerful enough at last to assert its supremacy and subjugate the pathetic states that surround her.
loc.BUL_toppling_giants_desc: Throughout history, rising nations have brought down great and long-standing empires. If [ROOT.GetNameDef] is to become the next great power in Europe, we must first challenge the hegemony of any other powers within our grasp.
loc.BUL_nationalist_propaganda_desc: There are still sectors among the Bulgarian population who oppose Bulgaria's role as the dominant power in the Balkans, claiming that the government's policies are "extremely oppressive". To silence these voices, we must fund a propaganda campaign that will help us justify the actions of our government and reignite Bulgarian nationalism.
loc.BUL_guardians_of_the_balkans_desc: We must preserve Bulgarian hegemony in the Balkans against any enemy power that dares to challenge it, therefore we will redouble our military efforts and urge our puppet governments in the Balkans to act likewise to assist us in the defense of our domain.
loc.BUL_consolidate_dominance_of_the_seas_de: If we want to secure the Balkans, it is not enough that we deploy a large army on the peninsula, we also need to build a powerful navy that guards the seas that surround it.
loc.BUL_appoint_right_wing_ministers_desc: The Tsar's regime, while helpful in exercising firm control over the country, lacks any real goals to improve Bulgaria's situation on the international scene. We must take advantage of the authoritarian nature of the current system to appoint new ministers who are ready to make the political and social changes that Bulgaria really needs.
loc.BUL_the_path_towards_a_greater_bulgaria: The Path Towards a Greater Bulgaria
loc.BUL_the_path_towards_a_greater_bulgaria_: We must begin to adjust our economy so that it can withstand the imminent mobilization of the Bulgarian army. For the path towards a greater Bulgaria is plagued by war and conflict.
loc.BUL_depose_the_tsar_desc: The Bulgarian monarchy has become a liability that can only hinder us in achieving our goals. The Tsar's usefulness has come to an end and it's time to get him out of the way.
loc.BUL_military_dictatorship_desc: We must take full control of the country and rule it under a militaristic authoritarian regime that allows us to take the necessary measures to continue our military efforts.
loc.BUL_support_the_spanish_coup_desc: The first theater in the war against Bolshevism is Spain. If we officially support the military uprising and organize a group of volunteers to support the rebel side, the Spanish civil war could become the perfect testing ground for our troops.
loc.BUL_allow_far_right_organizations_desc: Legalizing certain far-right organizations, such as the National Social Movement or the Ratniks, could provide us with helpful and loyal allies who support our regime and our ideals.
loc.BUL_integrate_the_ratniks_desc: The Ratniks, or the Union of Warriors for the Progress of the Bulgarianness is a recently-founded nationalist paramilitary organization that could prove to be a very useful tool in providing support for the regime and significant amounts of manpower for the army.
loc.BUL_economic_protectionism_desc: We must implement new reforms to boost the national economy and industry, while also protecting basic sectors in Bulgaria such as agriculture and handicrafts.
loc.BUL_industrial_autarky_desc: Our protectionist reforms have been extraordinarily successful in boosting the country's economy and industry, so we must continue in this course of action and implement new reforms that bring Bulgaria closer to autarky.
loc.BUL_corporatism_desc: Inspired by the Italian model, workers and capitalists from different economic sectors must participate in national policymaking, so that we can mediate between these groups and carry out the most beneficial reforms for the national economy.
loc.BUL_approach_germany_desc: While the British and the French have been continually strangling our economy since the humiliation of the Treaty of Neuilly, the Germans have not only shown hints of acknowledging our territorial claims, but have also helped us clearing our debts and buying a large part of our harvest, boosting our economy and allowing us to carry out important industrial and agrarian reforms.
loc.BUL_approach_germany_foreign_industry_tt: Reduced decision cost for §YForeign Agreements§! with [GER.GetNameDef] and increased [GER.GetAdjective] factories cap.
loc.BUL_approach_british_foreign_industry_tt: Reduced decision cost for §YForeign Agreements§! with [ENG.GetNameDef] and increased [ENG.GetAdjective] factories cap.
loc.BUL_approach_soviet_foreign_industry_tt: Reduced decision cost for §YForeign Agreements§! with [SOV.GetNameDef] and increased [SOV.GetAdjective] factories cap.
loc.BUL_cooperation_with_italy_desc: Italians have shown their economic interest in our country several times, and we must not forget the royal marriage between Tsar Boris and princess Giovanni. We shall strengthen both our diplomatic and economic relations with them, as they could prove to be a strong ally in the Balkans in the near future.
loc.BUL_join_the_tripartite_pact_desc_axis: We shall inform the Germans that we are ready and willing to sign the [GetGermanFactionName] and formally join their faction as allies.
loc.BUL_join_the_tripartite_pact_desc_centra: The Kaiser has returned and we must seek to reestablish our old alliance once again. This time we will right the wrongs done to our proud countries. This time nothing will stand in our way to glory and greatness. This time we shall emerge victorious!
loc.BUL_peaceful_development_desc: Why join a war that will bring nothing but death and calamity to our people, when we can simply play the role of peacekeepers over the occupied Balkan regions, reaping territorial gains without having to send a single man to a certain death in some remote battlefront?
loc.BUL_military_secrets_sharing_desc: German technology is far superior to ours, and it could be very beneficial for us to sign an agreement allowing Bulgarian scientists and engineers to access some of Germany's technological wonders, paving the way for us to further develop our own research.
loc.BUL_bulgarian_administration_of_the_balk: To strengthen our claims on the Balkans, we must carry out a Bulgarian integration of the occupied regions, so that, after [GetGermanFactionNameDef] victory in the war, [GetGermanOrIndependent] will be able to see the Bulgarian nature of those territories and will not dare break our national integrity, like the British did in 1878.
loc.BUL_restore_the_bulgarian_patriarchate_d: The Patriarch of Constantinople must be pressured to recognize the autocephaly of the Bulgarian Church and make the necessary arrangements to allow the Holy Synod of the Bulgarian Orthodox Church to elect a Metropolitan, who will become the Bulgarian Patriarch.
loc.BUL_total_war_desc: We must formalize our territorial claims in Romania with the aim of ensuring a source of oil with which to maintain our war effort, for [ROOT.GetNameDef] is finally ready to wage all-out war against the enemies of its allies.
loc.BUL_the_eastern_front_desc: Up until now, our citizens had been reluctant to allow any hostility towards the liberators of the Bulgarian people. But the devastating war between our allies and [SOV.GetNameDef] has changed the mindset of many former detractors, who now support our proposal to join the Eastern Front.
loc.BUL_the_third_bulgarian_empire_desc: We must take the final step on our path to glory and greatness. The countries that belittled Bulgaria in the past will have no choice but to acknowledge the supremacy of our mighty nation. \nIt is time to proclaim the Third Bulgarian Empire!
loc.BUL_oppose_the_royal_dictatorship_tt: Unlocks decisions to cooperate with the [GetBsName] and the [GetBznsName].\nUnlocks decisions to repress the [GetBsName] and the [GetBznsName].
loc.BUL_the_spanish_struggle_tt: §YChief of Airforce§!, §YZachari Zachariev§!, will be sent to fight in the Spanish Civil War as a fighter pilot of the Bulgarian volunteer aviation group. §RRequires sending volunteers to§! §Y[GetSpanishRepublicFlag]Republican Spain§!.

loc.BUL_soviet_bulgarian_war_industry_resear: Research Bonus from Technology Sharing Group increases by §G5%§!.
loc.BUL_carry_the_revolution_abroad_tt: Any independent §YCommunist§! nation in the Balkans will get the event §Y'Bulgaria invites us to their faction'§!.

loc.GRE_debt_to_the_ifc_desc: Greece is heavily indebted to the International Financial Commission, a once influential organization now chaired only by the United Kingdom, France, and Italy. Despite the bloated state of the I.F.C., the countries attached still desire their debts from Greece to be paid in full - meaning that until we've paid our debts, or escaped them some other way, the I.F.C. has us by the purse strings.
loc.GRE_debt_to_the_ifc_2_desc: Greece is heavily indebted to the International Financial Commission, a once influential organization now chaired only by the United Kingdom, France, and Italy. Despite the bloated state of the I.F.C., the countries attached still desire their debts from Greece to be paid in full - meaning that until we've paid our debts, or escaped them some other way, the I.F.C. has us by the purse strings.
loc.GRE_debt_to_the_ifc_3_desc: Greece is heavily indebted to the International Financial Commission, a once influential organization now chaired only by the United Kingdom, France, and Italy. Despite the bloated state of the I.F.C., the countries attached still desire their debts from Greece to be paid in full - meaning that until we've paid our debts, or escaped them some other way, the I.F.C. has us by the purse strings.
loc.GRE_george_ii_desc: George II is the unpopular King of the Hellenes, having been restored to the throne from exile in 1935 thanks to a rigged plebiscite. He is determined to keep his throne this time.
loc.GRE_george_ii_restrained_desc: George II is the divisive King of the Hellenes, having been restored to the throne from exile in 1935 thanks to a rigged plebiscite. Rather than letting the status of this one man tear apart the Greek nation once again, the Venezelists have allowed George II to remain as a constitutional monarch based on the Swedish model.
loc.GRE_schachtplan_desc: The brainchild of German economist Hjalmar Schacht, the Schachtplan guarantees Greek access to German markets in exchange for increased imports of raw materials from Greece to Germany. The Germans have been generously keeping us afloat, and yet we may have fallen right into their trap by becoming so dependent on their generosity.
loc.GRE_schachtplan_modified_desc: The brainchild of the brilliant Hjalmar Schacht, the Schachtplan guarantees Greek access to German markets in exchange for prioritized market access to Greece's raw materials. The Germans have in the past been generously keeping us afloat, and together we have built a truly special economic relationship.
loc.GRE_schachtplan_fascistised_desc: Based on Hjalmar Schacht's original Schachtplan, the new Schachtplan has been meticulously put together by Germany and Greece's greatest corporatist economists: forging a new economic pact based on the tenets of National Socialism. While this economic agreement may not be dependable in the long-term, it shall serve us well enough during these years of strife.
loc.GRE_agrarian_society_desc: Greece has traditionally relied on agriculture and light industry with commercial products like tobacco being Greece's primary export. Our reliance on more traditional forms of manufacturing have made us dependent on the heavy industry of larger powers for construction projects. Conflict is brewing, and we need to innovate - fast.
loc.GRE_foreign_monopolies_desc: Our dependence on the heavy industries of foreign powers has left many of our developing sectors firmly in the hands of powerful companies answerable only to foreign governments. We cannot expect to fully ramp up our modernization process until we either strike a deal with these monopolies or we permanently give them the boot from our country.
loc.GRE_foreign_monopolies_1_desc: Our dependence on the heavy industries of foreign powers has left many of our developing sectors firmly in the hands of powerful companies answerable only to foreign governments. We cannot expect to fully ramp up our modernization process until we either strike a deal with these monopolies or we permanently give them the boot from our country.

§WThe £faction_gre_venezelist §YRepublicans§! are [Root.GetRepublicanLoyaltyLevel].§! [ROOT.GetRepublicanLoyaltyEffects]

Between 1924 and 1935 we have had twenty three changes of government, thirteen coups, and a dictatorship! The people have had enough and are ready for some stability in their government, but they also remain cautiously skeptical about the odds of any one government surviving very long. We must prove them wrong and bring an end to the constant infighting by bringing our political foes to heel.

At least the people are familiar with us as the Devil they know! Unfortunately, the memories of the Anatolian Catastrophe are still fresh in the minds of the Greek people and they have not forgotten the role we played in it either.

At least the people are familiar with us as the Devil they know! It's now up to us to fulfill our legacy, and to finish the journey Greece started in 1919 when we tried to take back Constantinople...

Between 1924 and 1935 we have had twenty three changes of government, thirteen coups, and a dictatorship! For the first time in a very long time, Greece finally has a movement that puts the Greek people first in charge of the nation. But our movement is young, and we have much to prove before the people well and truly trust in our rule.
loc.GRE_political_instability_metaxas_desc:
§WThe £faction_gre_monarchist §YMonarchists§! are [Root.GetMonarchistLoyaltyLevel].§! [ROOT.GetMonarchistLoyaltyEffects]

Under Metaxas' leadership, we shall achieve unity through strength by crushing all of our foes! The Greek people shall come to learn how a government that has the will to establish order in this lawless country operates.

loc.GRE_metaxism_desc: Metaxism promotes neutrality in foreign affairs so that domestic policies of corporatism and nationalism can be better cultivated and developed.
loc.GRE_metaxism_2_desc: Metaxism promotes neutrality in foreign affairs so that domestic policies of corporatism and nationalism can be better cultivated and developed.
loc.GRE_metaxism_3_desc: Metaxism promotes neutrality in foreign affairs so that domestic policies of corporatism and nationalism can be better cultivated and developed.
loc.GRE_metaxism_4_desc: Metaxism promotes neutrality in foreign affairs so that domestic policies of corporatism and nationalism can be better cultivated and developed.
loc.GRE_metaxism_5_desc: Metaxism promotes neutrality in foreign affairs so that domestic policies of corporatism and nationalism can be better cultivated and developed.
loc.GRE_metaxism_6_desc: Metaxism promotes neutrality in foreign affairs so that domestic policies of corporatism and nationalism can be better cultivated and developed.
loc.GRE_metaxism_7_desc: Metaxism is the ideology upon which the Third Hellenic Civilization will be built. Metaxism enshrines corporatism, nationalism, and authoritarianism as tenets from which the whole [ROOT.GetAdjective] nation will grow from and prosper.
loc.GRE_martyrs_of_the_anatolian_catastrophe: We pledge ourselves not just to those who lost their lives fighting the Turks in 1922, but to those forced from their homes and compelled to live in squalor here. It was a failure that can be avenged in only one way: the conquest of Constantinople. A great statesmen once stated, 'Constantinople is the great capital, the City, the dream and hope of all Greeks.' We shall be remembered as the great leaders who finally fulfilled the eternal dream of the Greek people, and in doing so vindicate ourselves of the events of 1922.
loc.GRE_farmer_culture_desc: We do not need to be ashamed of our agrarian roots, we can move forward into the modern age without forgetting the crafts that have defined us for so many centuries. We understand the Greek worker and we are no longer afraid to venerate his craft regardless of its utility to the state.
loc.GRE_industrializing_society_desc: We live in the age of war machines and it can no longer be tolerated that the majority of Greek workers spend their lives toiling on fields of useless luxury products. We have begun a transition that shall fundamentally reshape Greece and the Greek people, though we cannot expect the Greek people to fully catch on for a few decades yet unfortunately.
loc.GRE_industrializing_society_communist_de: We live in the age of war machines and it can no longer be tolerated that the majority of Greek workers spend their lives toiling on fields of useless luxury products. We have begun a transition that shall fundamentally reshape Greece and the Greek people, though we cannot expect the Greek people to fully catch on for a few decades yet unfortunately.
loc.GRE_command_economy_desc: We live in the age of war machines and it can no longer be tolerated that the majority of Greek workers spend their lives toiling on fields of useless luxury products. We have begun a transition that shall fundamentally reshape Greece and the Greek people, and through a state-run economy we shall guide the Greek people in the right direction.
loc.GRE_agricultural_communes_idea_desc: Greece has traditionally relied on agriculture and light industry with commercial products like tobacco being Greece's primary export. Our reliance on more traditional forms of manufacturing used to make us dependent on the heavy industry of larger powers for construction projects, but with all the farms organized under a collectivization scheme we can better prepare for future and more ambitious projects.
loc.GRE_farmer_managed_communes_desc: We do not need to be ashamed of our agrarian roots, we can move forward into the modern age without forgetting the crafts that have defined us for so many centuries. We understand the Greek worker, and we are no longer afraid to venerate his craft or afford him more control over his livelihood.
loc.GRE_rural_exodus_Desc: With our push towards industrialization, people have been leaving their homes in rural regions of the country to flock to the larger urban cities.
loc.GRE_sophistry_and_science_idea_desc: Through fostering a co-dependence between politicians and scientists, we shall bring ourselves one step closer to modernity.
loc.GRE_megali_idea_triumphant_desc: It is done: we have won! The memory of Eleftherios Venizelos has been avenged, and [ROOT.GetNameDef] has finally fulfilled its destiny.
loc.GRE_eon_desc: There is something admirable in the way the Germans and Italians have organized their youths. We can adapt their model to ensure that our youth are not participating in asocial behavior or disrespecting our great leader [ROOT.GetLeader].
loc.GRE_eon_fascist_desc: There is something admirable in the way the Germans and Italians have organized their youths. We can adapt their model to ensure that our youth are not participating in asocial behavior or disrespecting our great leader [ROOT.GetLeader].
loc.GRE_security_batallions_desc: In order to keep the peace in occupied territory and in our own country, we have been forced to form security battalions made up of the most ardent fascists our nation has to offer.
loc.GRE_eee_in_government_desc: Necessity has forced our hand to align ourselves with the fascist party of Ethniki Enosis Ellados. We can only hope this decision to cooperate with the fascists will not come back to bite us in the future...
loc.GRE_booming_tourism_desc: More people are coming to [ROOT.GetNameDef] from abroad than in any other point in recorded history!
loc.GRE_improving_our_defensive_lines_desc: The best offence is a good defense, and we intend to have an utterly unbeatable defense.
loc.GRE_protectors_of_the_mediterranean_spir: The Mediterranean has been our home far longer than it has been anybody else's home. We have a responsibility to this region, and to the people within - and we do not intend to forsake this sacred duty.
loc.GRE_ancient_talents_desc: We have always had a penchant for the nautical, ever since the days of the Bronze Age. By fostering a strong maritime tradition, we are offering respect to a time-honored tradition that runs in our blood.
loc.GRE_hellenic_army_desc: Our armed forces would not seem all that impressive to a visiting observer, but our people have a genuine fighting spirit: a flame inside them that refuses to be snuffed out. Such a quality is rare, and we must not be afraid to exploit it so that we may face our foes on an equal footing.
loc.GRE_hellenic_army_2_desc: Our army will likely never been the biggest in the Balkans, but it shall certainly be the most efficient.
loc.GRE_hellenic_army_3_desc: Our army will likely never been the biggest in the Balkans, but it shall certainly be the most efficient.
loc.GRE_byzantine_army_desc: Not so long ago we were obsessed with having an army that would be able to maintain and defend our borders, but today we equip and train soldiers that are prepared to march halfway across the world to fulfill our bid to claim back an empire. Ours is an army unlike any other in the world, and with it we shall finally reclaim what was taken from us.
loc.GRE_hellenic_air_force_academy_desc: Our pilots are willing, capable, and competent - they command an air force worthy of our nation.
loc.GRE_venerate_the_ancient_hellenes_spirit: Are we not the descendants of the venerable Greeks of old? Do we not share blood with those masters of polemics, philosophy, and war? We shall instill a strong sense of pride back into our people, so that we may take our place as the guiding star of Europe once again.
loc.GRE_venerate_the_ancient_hellenes_2_desc: We shall learn from the ingenuity of the Theban warriors, who toppled the Spartan hegemony through might and sagacity.
loc.GRE_venerate_the_ancient_hellenes_3_desc: We shall learn from the philosophers of Athens, who devised the concept of democracy as we know it today.
loc.GRE_venerate_the_ancient_hellenes_4_desc: We shall learn from the example of the Argeads, who conquered half the known world all from humble Macedonia.
loc.GRE_venerate_the_ancient_hellenes_5_desc: We shall learn from the ingenuity of the Theban warriors who toppled the Spartan hegemony, and from the philosophers of Athens, who devised the concept of democracy as we know it today.
loc.GRE_venerate_the_ancient_hellenes_6_desc: We shall learn from the ingenuity of the Theban warriors who toppled the Spartan hegemony, and from the example of the Argeads, who conquered half the known world all from humble Macedonia.
loc.GRE_venerate_the_ancient_hellenes_7_desc: We shall learn from the philosophers of Athens who devised the concept of democracy as we know it today, and from the example of the Argeads, who conquered half the known world, all from humble Macedonia.
loc.GRE_venerate_the_ancient_hellenes_8_desc: We still retain all the qualities that made our forefathers so great, and with only a small push we can bring those qualities out in our people once again.
loc.GRE_reviving_the_double_headed_eagle_spi: Reviving the Spirit of the Double-Headed Eagle

The Venizelists were cowards who refused to let Greece restore its true lost glory – the glory of Byzantium! Why stop with Turkey’s coasts when we can reclaim all the lost territories of the Empire? A new age of glory for Greece has begun!
loc.GRE_reviving_the_double_headed_eagle_2: Reviving the Spirit of the Double-Headed Eagle
loc.GRE_reviving_the_double_headed_eagle_2_d: The Venizelists were cowards who refused to let Greece restore its true lost glory – the glory of Byzantium! Why stop with Turkey’s coasts when we can reclaim all the lost territories of the Empire? A new age of glory for Greece has begun!
loc.GRE_socialist_economy_spirit_desc: We have implemented an economy that puts people before profits. We have a clear enemy in exploitative capitalists from abroad and in local opportunistic vermin looking to cheat the [ROOT.GetAdjective] worker out of their fair dues.
loc.GRE_socialist_economy_2_desc: The Greek people have bled for too long under the autocratic rule of the false king and the warmongering Venizelists, it is time for the people to finally prosper under a government that puts them first!
loc.GRE_socialist_economy_3_desc: The Party comes before everything; if one is not loyal to the Party, then they are a subversive traitor and a danger to our entire nation.
loc.GRE_socialist_economy_4_desc: The worker comes before everything else; if we as a government put in power by and made up of workers cannot represent the best interests of the workers, then who could?
loc.GRE_red_militias_spirit_desc: There are many who would seek to thwart our efforts in modernizing Greek society, but with the organization of militias dedicated to preserving the Revolution they will find it all the more difficult to stop us.
loc.GRE_red_militias_2_desc: A true communist state requires a people's army which can execute the will of the workers with impunity.
loc.GRE_red_militias_3_desc: Subversive agents who conspire against the Party are everywhere, but you only need to train a small group of talented people to find and uproot them...
loc.GRE_small_investment_desc: We have made a modest investment into the economy of [GRE.GetNameDef].
loc.GRE_moderate_investment_desc: We have made a significant investment into the economy of [GRE.GetNameDef].
loc.GRE_heavy_investment_desc: We have made a substantial investment into the economy of [GRE.GetNameDef].
loc.GRE_battle_for_the_bosporus_desc: The Battle for the Bosporus has begun, and we have the advantage! We must push as hard as we can while we can so that victory becomes all but assured!
loc.onassis_proposition_accepted: §YAristotle Onassis§! has formed his anti-fascist organization.
loc.GRE_macedonian_farmlands_idea_desc: By utilizing the rich farmlands in Macedonia, our army can stay supplied for as long of a time as it possibly can.
loc.TUR_first_five_year_plan_desc: Modeled after the [SOV.GetAdjective] Five-Year Plans, and guided by both [SOV.GetAdjective] and [USA.GetAdjective] experts, our first five year plan came into effect on April 17, 1934. Through this plan, we aim to have 20 new factories built by the time the second plan is implemented.
loc.TUR_widespread_illiteracy_idea_desc: Though the literacy within our nation has increased drastically since the initial implementations of the alphabet and language reforms thanks to Atatürk's literacy drive and national education campaigns, even going as far as earning himself the title başöğretmen, there is still much to be done.
loc.TUR_kemalist_army_officers_powerful_loya: The elite Turkish officer corps are some of the staunchest protectors of Kemalist values. Kemalism has never before been so entrenched in Turkey as it is today, and our state has never been in safer hands than it is under the current administration.
loc.TUR_kemalist_army_officers_powerful_neut: The elite Turkish officer corps are some of the staunchest protectors of Kemalist values. Kemalism has never before been so entrenched in Turkey as it is today.
loc.TUR_kemalist_army_officers_powerful_disl: The elite Turkish officer corps are some of the staunchest protectors of Kemalist values. Kemalism has never before been so entrenched in Turkey as it is today, and the officer corps most assuredly loathe us for acting so contradictorily to Kemalist values at a time when Kemalism is respected by so many.
loc.TUR_kemalist_army_officers_extended_powe: The elite Turkish officer corps are some of the staunchest protectors of Kemalist values. Kemalism has steadily been winning hearts and minds across Turkey as Atatürk hoped it would, and the officer corps stands in solidarity with the current administration against all dangers to Turkish sovereignty.

The elite Turkish officer corps are some of the staunchest protectors of Kemalist values. Kemalism has steadily been winning hearts and minds across Turkey as Atatürk hoped it would, and the officer corps stand ready to ensure the values of Kemalism remain protected against those who would subvert them.

The elite Turkish officer corps are some of the staunchest protectors of Kemalist values. Kemalism has steadily been winning hearts and minds across Turkey, and the officer corps are actively working against the current administration to guarantee the protection of Kemalist values.
loc.TUR_kemalist_army_officers_limited_power: The Turkish officer corps are some of the staunchest protectors of Kemalist values. Kemalism remains challenged as an ideology, but the officer corps stand ready to assist the government in all manners concerning the protection of the state.

The Turkish officer corps are some of the staunchest protectors of Kemalist values. Kemalism remains challenged as an ideology, and the officer corps are working diligently to safeguard Kemalist principles.

The Turkish officer corps are some of the staunchest protectors of Kemalist values. Kemalism remains challenged as an ideology, and the officer corps stand in firm opposition to the stance of the current administration on matters of ideology and governance.
loc.TUR_kemalist_army_officers_decreased_pow: The Turkish officer corps are some of the staunchest protectors of Kemalist values. Kemalism has faced some setbacks in winning over the support of the people, but the officer corps remain committed to supporting the current administration.

The Turkish officer corps are some of the staunchest protectors of Kemalist values. Kemalism has faced some setbacks in winning over the support of the people, and the officers are uneasily observing the mood of the nation.

The Turkish officer corps are some of the staunchest protectors of Kemalist values. Kemalism has faced some setbacks in winning over the support of the people, which the officers corps largely attributes to the policies and actions of the current administration.
loc.TUR_kemalist_army_officers_minimal_power: The Turkish officer corps were some of the staunchest protectors of Kemalist values, but now the listless clique of Kemalist loyalists can do little other than make passing appraisals of the current administration.
The Turkish officer corps were some of the staunchest protectors of Kemalist values, but now they have been reduced to a largely ceremonial role.

The Turkish officer corps were some of the staunchest protectors of Kemalist values, but now the pitiably shrunken cabal of Kemalist loyalists can do little other than make passing condemnations of the current administration.
loc.TUR_disorganised_armed_forces_desc: The Turkish Armed Forces is young much like the country of Turkey itself. Even though our armies emerged from the War of Liberation victorious against the Entente and the Ottomans, our nation paid the price for freedom in blood. There has been little to no enthusiasm for war after losing nearly a quarter of our population in the Great War, but with the spectre of war looming over the world once again it seems that we will have no choice but to either modernize our forces fast, or ensure that the war never reaches our borders.

loc.TUR_sectarian_woes_desc:
§W[TUR.GetNameDefCap]'s internal divisions are represented geographically through§! §YState Modifiers§!§W: the§! £faction_tur_kemalist §YKemalists§! §Wcan be found in the west and in the north, the religious§! £faction_tur_traditionalist §YTraditionalists§! §Wcan be found in the central hinterlands as well as in the south, while the§! £faction_tur_kurdish §YKurdish people§! §Wcan be found in the south-east of the nation.§! 

§WInteractions with the different§! §YFactions§! §Wcan be accessed through the§! §YDecisions Tab§!§W, as well as through some§! §YFocus Effects§! §Wand§! §YEvent Options§!§W.§! 

Turkey is beset by internal divisions that are drawn across ideological, religious, and ethnic lines. The Kemalists hope to turn Turkey into a secularized state, but there is a large percentage of the population who are fundamentally opposed to the very concept of secularism. In the east, the Kurdish people have caused a great deal of trouble for the Turkish government and seem determined to go the way of rebellion over assimilation. To mend the internal divisions of our country, we will either need to approach these issues with a gentle hand or an iron fist.
