loc.YUG_GATHERING_STORM_DESC: Yugoslavia came into existence after the new State of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes merged with the formerly independent Kingdom of Serbia in 1922. Initially Yugoslavia joined both the Little Entente and the Balkan Pact to secure their independence, but recently the assassination of King Alexander combined with growing internal pressure from nationalists and external pressure from Italy and Germany has caused drastic upheaval and reevaluation of their political and strategic position.
loc.YUG_BLITZKRIEG_DESC: Yugoslavia came into existence after the new Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes merged with the formerly independent Kingdom of Serbia in 1922. Initially Yugoslavia joined both the Little Entente and the Balkan Pact to secure their independence, but recently growing internal pressure from nationalists and external pressure from Italy and Germany has caused drastic upheaval and reevaluation of their political and strategic position.
loc.CHI_GATHERING_STORM_DESC: Following the revolution that deposed the last of the Qing Emperors, the young Chinese Republic has struggled to survive. Warlords rule much of the land on the periphery. In the heart of the country, the Communists have set up a base area in a remote mountain valley. Just beyond the borders, the Japanese have created a puppet government under the last Chinese Emperor and will try to reunite the country under his rule.\n\nWith many enemies threatening it, the government of Chiang Kai-Shek will have to make hard choices if it wants to survive and rule supreme in China.
loc.PRC_GATHERING_STORM_DESC: A mere two years ago, the Communist Party of China faced utter annihilation. To survive, it engaged on the epic journey that would become known as the Long March. With only a fraction of the army surviving the rigors of the march and little industry, the prospects of victory in the Chinese Civil War are slim indeed.\n\nBut in time, the population may be swayed to the Communist cause, new armies be raised, new base areas established, and, when the time is right, the revolutionary struggle will be renewed again, until final victory is achieved.
loc.CHI_BLITZKRIEG_DESC: After two years of war against the Japanese, the armies of Chiang Kai-Shek have bled themselves white trying to stop the assault. The enemy has overrun the richest areas of the country. Little support has been forthcoming from the western democracies, and the Communist seem unwilling to engage the enemy in open battle.\n\nWith the war threatening to spread even further, it appears that the worst is still to come. But as the Japanese attack is slowed by the vastness of the country, they may well turn their gaze in other directions, and new alliances may yet turn the tide...
loc.PRC_BLITZKRIEG_DESC: Faced with an all-out Japanese attack, the Nationalists and Communists have struck an uneasy truce. Both sides are well aware that this United Front can not last. The Communist base area in Yan'an now forms the front line in the war against the Japanese.\n\nThe Communists must husband their resources carefully if they want to survive. Any casualties suffered in the fight against Japan will be felt twice over when the time comes to fight the war against the Nationalists, and this may well be what the government of Chiang Kai-Shek is counting on...
loc.MAN_GATHERING_STORM_DESC: Evicted from the Dragon Throne at the age of six, Puyi, the last Chinese Emperor, has been biding his time. While his former realm tore itself apart in the Chinese Civil War, Puyi found new allies in Japan.\n\nFor Puyi, the establishment of the Empire of Manchukuo in 1932 was but the first step in the quest to reclaim his ancestral birthright. For the moment, he is dependent on the Japanese Army to keep his rule, but in time, an opportunity might arise to cast off the shackles of servitude and become what he was born to be...
loc.MAN_BLITZKRIEG_DESC: Evicted from the Dragon Throne at the age of six, Puyi, the last Chinese Emperor, has been biding his time. While his former realm tore itself apart in the Chinese Civil War, Puyi found new allies in Japan.\n\nFor Puyi, the establishment of the Empire of Manchukuo in 1932 was but the first step in the quest to reclaim his ancestral birthright. For the moment, he is dependent on the Japanese Army to keep his rule, but in time, an opportunity might arise to cast off the shackles of servitude and become what he was born to be...
loc.MAN_TSR_GATHERING_STORM_DESC: The Empire of Manchuria lies on a shaky foundation. Formed as a way for the Japanese to legitimize their rule over Manchuria in 1932, they chose to allow Puyi to be emperor over their new state.\n\nThe question now lies in if Puyi will continue to stay in the shadows while the Concordia Association and Japanese Army rule the country or if he will try and take back his power, and in turn potentially lose it entirely to a group of bandits also out for that role?
loc.MAN_TSR_BLITZKRIEG_DESC: Manchukuo, once a rump state carved out of the North of China by the Japanese army, clinging on to any strand of legitimacy by propping up Puyi as Emperor has now become a full member of the Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere. The question now is whether the state will stay in the hands of the Concordia Association or if it will fall in the hands of Puyi.
loc.WARLORDS_GATHERING_STORM_DESC: The weakness of the Central Government may yet provide the opportunity for a sufficiently ambitious man to rise to power. At the periphery of the country, local leaders have carved out their own little fiefdoms, caring little for the orders of the Central Government. \n\nWar is on the horizon, and each of these Warlords faces a difficult choice: Collaboration with the Central Government or an alliance with the Communists? Either option promises a chance for a seat at the table, but there is a third possibility - to take China all for themselves.
loc.WARLORDS_BLITZKRIEG_DESC: The war with Japan has forced the Chinese Warlords to pick a side, but there can be no doubt that this alliance is living on borrowed time. The day will come when it has outlived its usefulness, and on that day the game is once again open for every man ambitious and ruthless enough to make a play for the title of Ruler of China.
loc.MEXICO_GATHERING_STORM_DESC: Mexico faced two decades of civil wars after the overthrow of the tyrant Porfirio Díaz. Centralizers fought regionalists, peasants and socialists rallied against hacienda landlords, and battles over the role of state versus religion came out of the annals of the Enlightenment to terrorize Mexico.\n\nThe secularist government insists that it won these battles, but it is seated on a throne of debris. After Mexico is rebuilt, perhaps a different victor will have emerged.
loc.MEXICO_BLITZKRIEG_DESC: The government of Lázaro Cárdenas has shown itself to be a bigger force for positive social change than that of his predecessor President Plutarco Calles, who has now been exiled to America. With the economic situation stabilized and the foreign oil firms brought under the custodianship of the state, the Mexican government can begin to look outwards. America faces enemies on many fronts and will likely forgive the nationalization of Standard Oil, but those enemies may be even more lucrative to befriend...
loc.NETHERLANDS_GATHERING_STORM_DESC: The Dutch government eyes the mounting global tensions with concern. Between an ailing economy, a powerful pacifist movement, and a firm belief in neutrality to the point of driving potential allies away, they are unable to properly prepare their defenses.\n\nAt the same time, the importance of the Netherlands as a gateway of trade into the continent means that both the British and the Germans desire Dutch 'cooperation' to thwart the other, and may take rejection as a reason for hostility. Perhaps withdrawal to the colonies is the only possible means to resist such an invasion...
loc.NETHERLANDS_BLITZKRIEG_DESC: War between Germany and the other European major powers seems inevitable, and though the Netherlands has put its faith once again in its neutrality, its leaders are contemplating making secret staff plans with their southern neighbors in preparation for possible hostilities.\n\nThe army has been mobilized, and work on the Dutch defensive lines is increasing in pace in an attempt to get the country as ready as possible to defend against any infringement of its sovereignty. Should this fail, there are always the colonies...
loc.SPAIN_GATHERING_STORM_DESC: In the first five years of its existence, the fledgling Second Spanish Republic has already had to deal with strikes, a military coup attempt, and a major revolutionary uprising. Though it has survived these challenges, Spanish society continues to be marred by political polarization and violence between anarchists, communists, and falangists.\n\nBoth sides look towards the upcoming 1936 general election with hopeful eyes, but it is unlikely that the victory of either side will bring a return to stability. And as the violence continues, the military waits and plots...
loc.SPAIN_BLITZKRIEG_DESC: The civil war that has devastated the country for the past three years has finally concluded. Under the guidance of Franco, the victors must now see to Spain's recovery, the elimination of remaining pockets of resistance, and the mending of the divides created by the war.\n\nTime is not unlimited, however, as the world at large continues its inexorable march towards what will undoubtedly be a far larger and still more bloody war. If Spain is to stand its ground, let alone reap the fruits of opportunity presented by this coming conflict, it must ready its industry and its military without delay.
loc.PORTUGAL_GATHERING_STORM_DESC: Since Salazar's rise to power in 1932, Portugal has been gradually distancing herself from the unstable period of the First Republic. Fiscal Autonomy and Political Independence from the major powers led to the creation of the Estado Novo, laying the foundations for the development of the Portuguese industry and the modernization of the army. \n\nNow, Portugal must decide the way forward as political and social instability increases in neighboring Spain and international tensions are hopelessly worsening...
loc.PORTUGAL_BLITZKRIEG_DESC: The conservative government of Salazar allowed Portugal to remain neutral during the Spanish Civil War while actively supporting the Nationalists, thus ensuring the defeat of the Communists and the Anarchists. \n\nNow that the Iberian Peninsula has finally found stability, it is time to look abroad for potential allies and consider the role that Portugal will play on the seemingly inevitable world conflict.
loc.LIT_GATHERING_STORM_DESC: With a Poland still thirsting to entrap Lithuania in a new Commonwealth, the Soviets failing to acknowledge Lithuania's right to self-determination, and a growing Nazi threat in the Memel region, a veteran from the independence war has risen to preserve the stability and independence of the Lithuanian nation. With the limited resources at his disposal, Antanas Smetona sits at the head of an unstable regime; with the fascist Iron Wolf paramilitary prowling the countryside, enraged by the imprisonment of their leader: Augustinas Voldemares. With war on the horizon, Lithuania must defend her people, no matter the cost.
loc.LIT_BLITZKRIEG_DESC: The stage is set. Antanas Smetona has secured the dictatorship and the dreams of restoring a Lithuanian Republic are well beyond reach. An agreement has been struck with the Soviets to return Vilnius to Lithuania upon the partition of Poland, but just how much can Smetona trust Stalin and his thirsty war machine to respect Lithuanian sovereignty indefinitely?
loc.LAT_GATHERING_STORM_DESC: It has been two years since the May Coup and Latvia remains in an uncertain state. Kārlis Ulmanis who once served as Latvia’s Prime Minister now styles himself as dictator, with democratic supporters heavily opposing this attack on Latvian liberty. The fascist Perkonkrust organization has been agitated by the arrest of their leader; Gustavs Celmiņš, and if the dictatorship does not swiftly eradicate this threat, Latvia risks civil war.\n\nWith threats to the East and West, Latvia finds herself walking on a razor’s edge between victory and oblivion.
loc.LAT_BLITZKRIEG_DESC: Latvia’s over-reliance on Soviet trade has at last come back to bite the dictatorship in the neck. The Soviet Union and the German Reich have shown their teeth and are breathing down the neck of Ulmanis. Rapid mobilization is necessary if Latvian independence is to be preserved, unless the dictatorship would rather cower and beg the Soviets for mercy...
loc.EST_GATHERING_STORM_DESC: With a communist threat in the East and a fascist one in the South, Konstantin Päts and the Isamaaliit have seized total control of the nation to secure Estonia’s future. A group of Estonian Independence War veterans have organized themselves into a movement known as the Vaps; right-wing populists who seek to wrestle control of the nation out of neutral hands.\n\nEstonia’s future remains uncertain. Will Päts keep the peace and bring about an Era of Silence, or will the Vaps take control and found a new Estonian state?
loc.EST_BLITZKRIEG_DESC: Estonia is trapped between the Red Menace to the East and the sea, and finds herself without the aid of her past allies. Though capitulation appears inevitable, the Estonian nation may persevere; either as a slave to the USSR or as an underground resistance fighting from the forests.
loc.BUL_GATHERING_STORM_DESC: Since the Liberation War of 1878 and the rejection of the San Stefano Treaty by Western democracies, Bulgaria has lived through a long history of conflict and betrayal in the Balkans. As a defeated member of the Central Powers in the Great War, Bulgaria suffered heavy territorial losses and the Treaty of Neuilly-sur-Seine imposed harsh economic sanctions and severe military restrictions. \n\nBut with the major political and social changes taking place in Europe, it is time for Bulgaria to choose its own path and find its rightful place in the Balkans.
loc.BUL_BLITZKRIEG_DESC: For the past few years, Tsar Boris has consolidated his power, dissolving the conspiratorial organization of Zveno and reorienting Bulgarian international politics towards Germany. Recent negotiations with the Balkan neighbors saw the UK lift the military restrictions imposed on the country after the Great War, in the hope of preventing Bulgaria from aligning with the Axis powers. \nNow the Tsar seeks to retrieve the territories lost in the past without dragging the country into a new conflict, but with international tension growing in Europe, it remains to be seen what the future holds for Bulgaria...
loc.GRE_GATHERING_STORM_DESC: Greece is a nation in crisis. Royalists and republicans have perpetuated a fervent struggle for the nation's soul which resulted in the abolition of the Second Hellenic Republic in 1935. The king, an autocratic foreigner, remains a highly divisive figure with an uncertain future. \n\nDistracted by petty domestic politics, a malignant and revanchist Bulgaria has been allowed to fester in the north, while Greece’s long-time nemesis and new-found ally Turkey undergoes a political metamorphosis to the east, and that is to say nothing of the stirring monster on the other side of the Adriatic...
loc.GRE_BLITZKRIEG_DESC: Under the strong hand of dictator Ioannis Metaxas, stability has been restored to Greece. The Four Year Plan has allowed Greece’s industrial base to grow immensely over the last few years, and the country’s debt - while still inordinately high - appears to be somewhat manageable. \n\nUnfortunately, strong government and sensible economic policy might avail this imperiled nation for naught. A great and terrible war looms on the horizon, and despite Metaxas’ firm insistence that Greece shall maintain its neutrality throughout any possible future conflict, the decision might ultimately not be his to make...
loc.TUR_GATHERING_STORM_DESC: From the ashes of the Ottoman Empire, the Republic of Turkey was born. Turkish independence was won with blood and bullets in the National Campaign of 1923, and while the struggle was righteous the cost continues to weigh heavily upon the Turkish people. \n\nReligious conservatives plague the hinterlands and resist nation-wide modernization efforts in the strongest terms, while Kurdish nationalists wreak havoc in the east of the country. Lionized president Mustafa Kemal Atatürk must unite the country or pass the torch to a leader who can, and they must do it soon as trouble stirs in Europe...
loc.TUR_BLITZKRIEG_DESC: The Father of the Turks, Mustafa Kemal Atatürk, has passed away. Turkey is a nation in mourning, led now by esteemed statesman İsmet İnönü. İnönü inherits a fractured country whose divisions have been made all the more apparent by the death of its guiding light. \n\nDomestic concerns aside, İnönü also faces the prospect of a war in Europe that threatens to surpass even the Great War in terms of devastation. Atatürk often touted the mantra, “Peace at Home, Peace in the World.” Can İnönü hope to keep the peace during these turbulent times?
loc.ETH_GATHERING_STORM_DESC: Ethiopia has a history stretching back centuries and an imperial dynasty to match. While Haile Selassie has made great strides to modernize the empire, the process has been interrupted as Ethiopia finds itself under attack from Italy for the second time in 40 years. The situation is bleak, but if the empire pulls together, it can halt the invaders once again. \n\nFor Ethiopia to remain free, the whole of East-Africa must be liberated from the yoke of European rule, once and for all.
loc.AFA_GATHERING_STORM_DESC: The Afar people have long lived in the vast Danakil desert, spanning from Djibouti in the east to Ethiopia in the west. Recently however, Italy has been gaining increased influence over the state, with Mohammed Yayyo favoring Benito Mussolini over Haile Selassie. \n\nWith the second Italo-Ethiopian war now raging, it seems as though a stance will need to be taken in the near future, will the future of the Afar lie with Italy, or will they be better off on their own?
loc.FIN_GATHERING_STORM_DESC: Finland is a young country, having gained its independence from Russia in 1917, followed by a bloody civil war. The scars of the war are still fresh, and the country's coalition government still struggles to work together effectively. The Soviet Union seems to covet Finnish territory close to Leningrad, and Finland is ill-prepared for a potential conflict, but it still has a long history of military valor and determination, and its soldiers are fiercely loyal to their country. \n\nWith tensions rising and the threat of conflict looming, the future of Finland hangs in the balance.
loc.FIN_BLITZKRIEG_DESC: Finland finds itself caught between the Soviet Union and Nazi Germany, with tensions between the two powers on the rise. Negotiations with the Soviet Union have broken down and the government now faces difficult decisions about how to protect their country's sovereignty. \n\nEfforts have been made to strengthen Finnish defenses, but the army is still poorly equipped, and the air force and navy are virtually non-existent. Despite this, Finland's strong sense of national pride and military valor gives it a fierce determination to protect its independence.
loc.SWE_GATHERING_STORM_DESC: Despite remaining neutral in the Great War, Sweden suffered a great deal of hardship due to British attempts to blockade Germany. As tensions rise on the continent, the Swedish people worry they will once again be forced to suffer at the hands of the great powers. \n\nMeanwhile, the Social Democrats attempt to find a balance between creating a welfare state that can support the beleaguered population and creating a credible military deterrent to maintain the nation's century old commitment to neutrality.
loc.SWE_BLITZKRIEG_DESC: The rumblings of another Great War grow louder by the day as Germany erodes the borders of their neighbors. With the militaristic power being dependent on Swedish iron ore, fears are increasing that their territorial ambitions may soon spread beyond the Baltic and into Scandinavia. \n\nIn anticipation of such a threat, the Swedish military has begun to rearm and modernize thanks to the nation's burgeoning defense industry. All that remains to be seen is whether the nation is capable of deterring an invasion.
loc.NOR_GATHERING_STORM_DESC: Since gaining independence from Sweden in 1905 Norway has struggled to find its political footing, and only now it's starting to show signs of political stability and recovery from the Hard Thirties.\n\nNow as its neighbors to the south start bickering war seems closer than ever, Norway must find a path for keeping its fragile independence, the Nygaardsvold cabinet is betting on neutrality and disarmament to appear as harmless as possible to Europe's great powers, but the merits of this approach remain to be seen.
loc.NOR_BLITZKRIEG_DESC: As the Third Reich grows in power and size, fascist elements inside Norway seem poised to take advantage of a possible German Invasion to seize control of the country and collaborate with the enemy.\n\nVidkun Quisling, an unscrupulous lackey of the Nazi Party seems to be conspiring to gain power for himself and his party Nasjonal Samling. It is time for hasty preparations to begin, and for Norway to stand together to fend off the dangers that lurk within and without.
loc.DEN_GATHERING_STORM_DESC:
As tensions are rising in Europe yet again, Denmark finds itself with a weak military and with the Great Depression still ravaging the economy.

The Danes must find a way to combat the high unemployment and the growing extremist movements on the political fringes, and at the same time re-evaluate the merits of the policy of neutrality and appeasement.

Denmark is still master of its own fate, but for how long remains to be seen.
loc.DEN_BLITZKRIEG_DESC: Denmark is in a precarious situation with a neglected military that has seen budget cuts year after year in an effort to appease the much larger and stronger neighbor, Germany. \n\nAppeasements, however, have not hindered the German Reich from consolidating its power in Europe and laying claim to other nations. Denmark must now put its faith in its declaration of neutrality, which saved them from the disastrous Great War.
loc.ICE_GATHERING_STORM_DESC: Iceland has a long history of isolation and exploration. Having switched hands between her former owner Norway and her current overlord Denmark when Norway became a junior partner of Sweden in 1814, and having just received home rule in 1919.\n\nWith the Great depression striking Iceland, the situation looks bleak, and with conflict looming over the horizon, it may be time to jump ship and cut ties with the Danish once and for all.
loc.ICE_BLITZKRIEG_DESC: With the recent demands from Germany, it is becoming more clear by the day that the situation in Europe is untenable, and that an attack on Denmark is more than likely inevitable.\n\nWith that in mind, Iceland's future hangs on the brink, and she will likely need to seek protection by the Americans if she wishes to stay out of the conflict which is soon to begin.
loc.BRA_GATHERING_STORM_DESC: The Great Depression ruined the Brazilian economy due to over reliance on exports. The following years saw increasing levels of political upheaval as coalitions of military officers, workers and politicians overthrew the oligarchy that ruled the nation and replaced it with a fragile democratic constitution. \n\nGetúlio Vargas has come to the forefront of Brazilian politics, recently stemming a communist coup and assuming emergency powers. It remains to be seen whether democracy will be restored, or whether Vargas will take the nation in a more authoritarian direction.
loc.BRA_BLITZKRIEG_DESC: Getúlio Vargas has seized control of the government and suspended the democratic process. With his grip on power secured for the time being, the Brazilian leader now turns his attention to international affairs. War in Europe seems inevitable and paranoia over an Argentinian incursion into Brazilian territory is on the mind of the nation's leadership. But there is hope that alignment with the United States could help secure Brazil's future.
loc.ARG_GATHERING_STORM_DESC: In 1930, the cabinet of Hipólito Yrigoyen was overthrown in the first military coup since the adoption of the Argentine Constitution, ushering in what was known as the Infamous Decade. Argentina must navigate a rapidly changing world where great powers threaten the fragile peace that has been held since the end of the Great War. \n\nWhat is the more prominent threat? The gathering storm in Europe? Their very own neighbors? Or themselves? Argentina will have to stand its ground and cement its place on the world stage.
loc.ARG_BLITZKRIEG_DESC: Through the most fraudulent election in Argentinian history, the Concordancia continue to hold a majority in government with Roberto María Ortiz now running the country as its president. \n\nHowever as tensions rise between Argentina’s two closest friends in Europe, the country must now prepare for the inevitability of being torn between two factions. Not only that, discontent in the military grows, and paranoia is constantly stoked about their ever slumbering rival in the north. Argentina stands at a major crossroads, and must think carefully on how to react.
loc.CHL_GATHERING_STORM_DESC: As an effect of the Wall Street Crash, the USA stopped importing copper and nitrate from Chile, which was the country's main source of income. This led to Chile becoming the South American country to be the most badly affected by the economic depression, and the political instability, which only got worse with the depression, has not yet been solved. \n\nAs Arturo Alessandri's term draws to one final end, The fascist movement is one the rise, and the country vividly remembers the coups of the previous decade, as well as the Socialist Republic of Chile in 1932.
loc.CHL_BLITZKRIEG_DESC: With the Jorge González von Marées and his fellow Nacistas coup attempt having been recently dealt with, Arturo Alessandri has stepped down and Pedro Aguirre Cerda has been elected the new President of Chile. The military threat still looms closely however, and it seems imminent that General Ariosto Herrera and his supporters attempt their own coup d'etat. \n\nWar also looms above the horizon, as tensions rise not only in Europe and Asia, but in the Amazon, close to the Chilean heartland.
loc.PAR_GATHERING_STORM_DESC: Despite having just emerged victorious from the bloody Chaco War against Bolivia, the country is economically exhausted and heavily militarized, with the unpopular Ayala unable to control the situation as he, together with his right-hand man José Félix Estigarribia, is to blame for the war even happening in the first place.\n\nThe military, rallying behind Rafael Franco and the socialist Feberista movement seem to be preparing to oust the government, and it seems they will not back down without a fight.
loc.PAR_BLITZKRIEG_DESC: With the Feberista coup successfully ousting Ayala and his liberal cronies, many are now looking to Rafael Franco to avenge the nation's numerous humiliations and once again strike at Bolivia, though this seems all the more unlikely. \n\nSome officers are already plotting to overthrow and replace him with Higinio Morinigo using the aid of the fascist paramilitary organization Guión Rojo, seeking closer ties to the Axis powers.
loc.URG_GATHERING_STORM_DESC: In a move referred to as the 1933 Uruguayan coup d'état, President Gabriel Terra couped his own government, dissolving parliament, weakening constitutional checks, and ruling in an increasingly authoritarian manner. Until this point Uruguay had been one of Latin America's most progressive democracies under José Batlle y Ordóñez, under a liberal doctrine called Batllismo.\n\nThe external debt has not helped the political situation, and the oriental republic now finds itself in the midst of a dictatorship, one which cannot last forever.
loc.URG_BLITZKRIEG_DESC: Former dictator Gabriel Terra recently handed over power to his brother in-law Alfredo Baldomir, also a part of the Colorado party. Being more liberal and pro-allied, it seems the nation is destined to once again tread the path of liberal democracy, assisting the great powers in upholding international law and order.
loc.AUS_GATHERING_STORM_DESC: Still shaken by the 1934 'Self-Elimination of the Parliament' and the subsequent assassination of Chancellor Engelbert Dolfuss, tensions are still high within Austria. Bound by the strict Treaty of Saint-Germain-En-Laye and enduring an economical crisis the Austrian leadership under Chancellor Schuschnigg find themselves facing decisions on a monumental scale. Accept their fate, should Germany come for them? Resist to the bitter end, diplomatically or militarily? Or look to the past, an Empire she was, an Empire she shall be?
loc.AFG_GATHERING_STORM_DESC: Under the rule of King Zahir Shah and his uncles, Afghanistan is settling into an era of relative stability. But under the surface of the timeless Kingdom, currents of anger and distrust continue to boil. Some hope for radical modernization as attempted by the exiled Amanullah Khan, who some believe plots a return to his throne. Meanwhile others believe the glacial pace of change under Zahir Shah is still too fast and that the nation requires a return to its traditional roots. But perhaps as the world around destabilizes, the people of Afghanistan can come together to take advantage of the situation.
loc.AFG_BLITZKRIEG_DESC: As King Zahir Shah continues to grow into his role, the challenges facing his rule continue to mount. Britain, Germany and the Soviet Union tussle for influence over the strategically located Kingdom, bringing both investment and threats of intervention. Meanwhile trouble makers pass across the borders with the Raj, stirring unrest on both sides. But as the world descends into war once more, the question in the region is ‘what will Afghanistan do?’
loc.BEL_GATHERING_STORM_DESC: Belgium remains scarred by its experiences in the Great War, with large parts of the nation still lying in ruin and deeper wounds to be found in the psyche of its people. The democratic future of the nation itself is in some question, beset as it is by allegations of corruption brought against them by various fascist factions. \n\nInternationally Belgium treads a tight rope between the treaty obligations to those who turned the nation into a battlefield, and concerns for their ongoing security in an increasingly unsettled world.
loc.BEL_BLITZKRIEG_DESC: Instability still wracks Belgium domestically but this is nothing compared to the instability felt on the world stage at the moment. The nation's military has undergone modernization and expansion, with great attention given to the mighty fortifications rivaling those even of the French Maginot. \n\nThe Belgian government has abandoned their alliances and declared absolute neutrality, however, this has not stopped backroom deals being signed in case of attack. Belgium eyes the mounting militarism of their neighbor with great concern.
loc.COG_GATHERING_STORM_DESC: Still scarred by the Congo Free State and King Leopold II, the Belgian Congo has come far since that time. The colonial government still utilizes cheap labor in the mines, and an invisible roof exists, making sure the majority of the nation's inhabitants are not able to attain higher education, but not all is bleak.\n\nAs the Italian colonial ambitions grow ever larger, and having performed well in the Great War, the Force Publique is once again gearing up to protect the state, under-equipped as it may be.
loc.COG_BLITZKRIEG_DESC: With the Italian conquest of Abyssinia wrapped up, and the German Reich gaining new territory in Europe, the situation is looking dangerous. Italy's colonial ambitions do not stop in East Africa, and may very well threaten us in the near future, while Hitler is actively eyeing up our Belgian overlords as a step in their plan for hegemony over the European continent.\n\nIt seems that the war will come to us soon, if we do not take it to them first...
loc.PER_GATHERING_STORM_DESC: Formerly known as Persia, the great nation of Iran finds itself caught in the crossfire of rumbling giants. As neutral Iran rapidly modernizes with the help of the German Reich, former associates in Great Britain and the Soviet Union look on with suspicion. Reza Shah Pahlavi refuses to let these two nations encroach on Iranian sovereignty, even if invasion is a prevalent risk.\n\nWill Iran's neutrality be respected? Are we ready to protect our homeland from malicious invaders? If all else fails, perhaps it is time to look to our past and rekindle the spirit of the old Persian Empire...
loc.IRQ_GATHERING_STORM_DESC: Under the rule of King Faisal I and later his son, King Ghazi, Iraq navigates the tumultuous aftermath of World War I as a British mandate. The Hashemite monarchy strives to balance modernization and nationalism, but beneath the surface, discontent simmers. Tribal leaders resent central authority, while urban elites push for greater independence from British influence. Pan-Arab sentiments clash with Iraq’s diverse ethnic and religious identities, creating a fragile unity. As the world edges closer to another great conflict, Iraq teeters between consolidation and upheaval, its future uncertain but brimming with possibilities.
loc.IRQ_BLITZKRIEG_DESC: Iraq has found itself in a period of growing turmoil in recent years. The coup of 1936, led by Bakr Sidqi, shattered the fragile authority of the Hashemite monarchy and set a dangerous precedent for military interference in politics. Beneath the surface, tensions simmer between tribal leaders resisting centralization, reformers pushing for modernization, and a restless military emboldened by its newfound power. Pan-Arab nationalism is on the rise, challenging British influence and fostering dreams of regional unity. As the world grows increasingly unstable, Iraq stands at a crossroads, its future uncertain and its people divided.
loc.PER_BLITZKRIEG_DESC: Iran stands at the precipice of a turbulent and uncertain future. As the war begins in Europe, Reza Shah Pahlavi looks on with concern as he finds himself pincered between two major players who seem to show interest in involving themselves in the conflict at large.\n\nIran's sovereignty may come into question if resources are involved, and the Shah's government must be prepared to repel any potential invasion. The question is: will they be able to mobilize in time?
loc.PHI_GATHERING_STORM_DESC: In 1935, The United States had finally agreed to a peaceful transition to independence over a ten year period. The Philippines is still early in the process, but is now increasingly in control of its own destiny. \n\nWill they maintain links with the US, or instead seek out foreign support to expedite the process towards freedom? The Philippines looks forward towards a prosperous future, but are there sharks already circling this fledgling nation?
loc.SIA_BLITZKRIEG_DESC: Since taking power in late 1938, Prime Minister Phibunsongkhram has remade Siam in his own image. The country has a new name — Thailand — and a new creed: military discipline, Pan-Thai nationalism, and territorial ambition aimed at the Thai-speaking peoples still under French and British colonial rule.\n\nAs Europe slides toward war and Japan drives deeper into China, Phibun's army grows stronger by the day. His ambitions are no secret. The only question is who Thailand will stand beside when the moment comes.
loc.PHI_BLITZKRIEG_DESC:
The United States has so far maintained its word, assisting the Philippines on their path to independence. 

Meanwhile, war has broken out between China and Japan, and the island nation looks on with concern towards the imperialist aspirations of their northern neighbor. 

American reinforcements have begun to arrive to bolster the defenses, but will there be enough? Japan already smells blood in the water.
loc.SIA_GATHERING_STORM_DESC: Just four years have passed since the Khana Ratsadon ended centuries of absolute monarchy. Siam takes its first steps as a constitutional state, but unity has already begun to fray: civilian reformists dream of democracy while the military demands strength, discipline, and Pan-Thai expansion.\n\nHemmed in by British and French colonial power, with an emboldened Japan advancing to the north, Siam must navigate carefully. The coming storm may force this young nation to choose a side — or find a way to survive without one.
loc.INS_GATHERING_STORM_DESC: For over three centuries, the Dutch East Indies has been the crown jewel of the Netherlands' colonial empire. Its vast archipelago of islands, languages, and cultures has been bound together by little more than the colonial administration that rules over them.\n\nThe grip of The Hague grows less certain by the day. A population tired of exploitation grows increasingly receptive to nationalist movements. But these movements are far from united, each with a contradictory vision for Indonesia. Whether they can set aside their differences and speak as one may well decide the fate of the Indies.
loc.INS_BLITZKRIEG_DESC: Three years ago, Soetardjo and his fellow petitioners asked The Hague for a conference on self-government within a decade. Last November, the royal decree came back. The answer was no.\n\nThe rebuke has done what years of agitation could not. In May, eight of the largest nationalist organizations set aside their quarrels and joined as a single federation, calling with one voice for an Indonesian parliament. The colonial administration answers as it always has, but Japan grinds further south through China, and the Indies are a long way from The Hague.
loc.infrastructure_desc: This building provides the state with improvement of infrastructure. It increases your supply power in strategic regions and increases your divisions' speed, as well as increasing your raw resource extraction.
loc.arms_factory_desc: This building provides the state with industry for production of new military equipment. Can be converted to civilian industry if needed.
loc.dockyard_desc: This building provides the state with industry for building new ships.
loc.dam_desc: Dams provide additional power to a state, improving industry and resource output.
loc.cataract_dam_mountain_desc: Completed in 1907, the Cataract Dam is one of the great early engineering achievements of colonial Australia. Built on the Cataract River in the Southern Highlands of New South Wales, it remains one of the four main reservoirs supplying the city of Sydney with fresh water.
loc.canal_kiel_desc: The Kiel Canal Locks are needed in place in order for the canal to operate at full capacity, and destroying them would hinder shipping and movement for a long time.
loc.canal_panama_desc: The Panama Canal Locks are needed in place in order for the canal to operate at full capacity, and destroying them would hinder shipping and movement for a long time.
loc.industrial_complex_desc: This building provides the state with industry for production of civilian goods or construction of new buildings. Can be converted to military industry if needed.
loc.air_base_desc: This building provides the state with deployment for your air forces.
loc.naval_base_desc: Extends the range of your fleet and provides repair services for it. Allows overseas supply and export of resources. Higher levels increases the supply throughput.
loc.bunker_desc: This building inflicts an attack penalty of $VALUE|+%0$ for each fort level on the attacker in combat. Attacking from multiple directions will reduce forts effect.
loc.coastal_bunker_desc: This building inflicts an attack penalty of $VALUE|+%0$ for each fort level on the attacker in naval invasion combat.
loc.anti_air_building_desc: This building provides the state with protection from enemy bombers and ability to fire at attacking aircraft.
loc.synthetic_refinery_desc: This building provides the state with
loc.radar_station_desc:
Radar allows you to gain intel on enemy troops in nearby states.
A higher radar level in a state increases the effective range of the radar.
Radar also provides the state with better detection of enemy air forces, giving your planes a better chance to engage them.
In addition radar increases the detection of enemy fleets at sea.
loc.rocket_site_desc: This building provides the state with deployment for produced rockets.
loc.nuclear_reactor_heavy_water_desc: This building provides the state with production of enriched Uranium for use in Nuclear weapons.\nNuclear reactors using Heavy Water are somewhat cheaper to build than Graphite Reactors, but produce less material that can be used to produce nuclear weapons.
loc.nuclear_reactor_desc: This building provides the state with production of enriched Uranium for use in Nuclear weapons.
loc.commercial_nuclear_reactor_desc: This building provides the state with enriched uranium for nuclear weapons and produces electricity for the civilian economy.
loc.nuclear_facility_desc: Experimental Facilities for Nuclear Research allow you to start research projects relating to the use nuclear power.
loc.air_facility_desc: Experimental Facilities for Aerodynamics and Avionics allow you to start research projects for aircraft, rockets and related electronics.
loc.naval_facility_desc: Experimental Facilities for Naval Engineering allow you to start research projects related to Surface Ships and Submarines.\nA Naval Engineering Facility can only be created in a coastal province.
loc.mega_gun_emplacement_desc: Operating on the principle of multi-charge propulsion, this large caliber gun is designed to achieve unparalleled ranges in bombardment. Utilizing a series of underground tunnels, it accelerates shells to supersonic speeds before launching them towards distant targets.
loc.stronghold_network_desc: An extensive defensive system of massive bunkers and strongly fortified positions, designed to repel enemy advances and secure key strategic areas.
loc.land_facility_desc: Experimental Facilities for Land Warfare  allow you to start research projects related to various aspects of land warfare, such as special tanks, or artillery.
loc.landmark_statue_of_liberty_desc: The colossal Statue of Liberty stands proudly in New York Harbor, a major entry point to the United States for immigrants looking to start a new life. Subsequently, it has come to embody the American ethos of life, liberty and the pursuit of happiness.
loc.landmark_big_ben_desc: The Westminster Clock Tower, more commonly known as Big Ben, is a British cultural icon. It is one of the most prominent symbols of the United Kingdom and parliamentary democracy. It was originally completed in 1859 in a Gothic Revival style, and is the third tallest tower in Great Britain.
loc.landmark_colosseum_desc: The Colosseum lies in the center of Rome. It is the largest ancient amphitheater ever built, being used by the Romans, and the people of the city following the downfall of the Romans, for entertainment ever since it's completion by Emperor Titus.
loc.landmark_cristo_redentor_desc: Christ the Redeemer towers over Rio de Janeiro, with its construction being finished in 1931. It is a national symbol of Brazil, and holds great importance among the Catholics in the region.
loc.landmark_eiffel_tower_desc: The Eiffel Tower is named after its creator Gustave Eiffel, and was finished in 1889. Being located on the Champ de Mars in Paris, the Iron Lady has become a global cultural icon of France, and is a symbol of national pride.
loc.landmark_kremlin_desc: The Moscow Kremlin is a fortified complex. Within the complex is the Grand Kremlin Palace, which served as the royal residence of the Emperor of Russia. The Kremlin overlooks the Moskva River to the south, Saint Basil's Cathedral and Red Square to the east, and Alexander Garden to the west. Nowadays it has come to represent the authority of the state and it's control over the people.
loc.landmark_berlin_reichstag_desc: The Plenarbereich Reichstagsgebäude, also known as the Reichstag, is a historic legislative government building on Platz der Republik in Berlin. Up until the Reichstag fire of 1933 it was used by the federal council in Germany, but even so it is a symbolic building that holds great importance in the hearts and minds of the people.
loc.landmark_tokyo_imperial_palace_desc: The Tokyo Imperial Palace is the main residence of the Emperor, and has been so since the Meiji Restoration and the ousting of the last Shogunate. It is a symbol of pride and reverence for the Japanese people, and inspires them to work hard.
loc.landmark_national_diet_desc: The Kokkai-gijidō is the building where both houses of the National Diet of Japan meet. Being completed in early 1936, it is constructed almost entirely of Japanese materials with only a few exceptions. Its predecessor was destroyed in 1925 when another fire ravaged the area. Though the diet building has fallen many times, this time it will surely stand for centuries!
loc.landmark_hakko_ichiu_desc: The Hakkō Ichiu tower has been constructed to commemorate the 2,600th anniversary of the founding of Japan, and as a monument to symbolize the Japanese destiny of unifying the Eight Corners of the World under one roof.
loc.landmark_hofburg_palace_desc: The Hofburg is the former principal imperial palace of the Habsburg dynasty, and faces towards the Heldenplatz. Maybe one day, the palace can once again be used by the rulers of Austria, be it a president or a king.
loc.landmark_berlin_volkshalle_desc: The Volkshalle stands as a testament to our people's indomitable spirit, and their prideful will to dominate the globe. It will show the world that, through the might of conquest, anything is possible, and the fatherland can make even the most impossible task possible.
loc.landmark_sadabad_complex_desc: Built by the Qajars and expanded by the Pahlavis, the Sa'dabad Complex in northern Tehran serves as a royal residence and seat of power. Its palaces and gardens reflect Iran’s shifting political landscape, from conservatism to modernism.
loc.landmark_taj_mahal_desc: The Taj Mahal stands as a masterpiece of Mughal architecture. Its grand white marble domes and intricate gardens make it one of the most iconic symbols of India, a testament to both imperial power and enduring legacy.
loc.landmark_hagia_sophia_desc: Standing at the crossroads of empires, the Hagia Sophia has been a Byzantine cathedral, an Ottoman mosque, and a symbol of Istanbul’s ever-changing rulers. Its massive dome and grand halls reflect both its spiritual significance and the ambitions of those who claimed the city as their own.
loc.naval_supply_hub_desc: This building allows your fleets to resupply and refuel in this base in addition to their Home Bases, potentially extending the operational range of your §YTask Forces§!.\nA Naval Supply Hub can only be constructed in a coastal province that has Naval Base of at least level 8.
loc.naval_headquarters_desc:
This building allows you to assign an admiral to increase effectiveness of §YTask Forces§! operating within range of the Naval Headquarters.

Up to $MAXNUM|H$ headquarters can have an admiral assigned at the same time.
   Currently assigned: $CURRNUM|H$

A Naval Headquarters can only be constructed in a coastal province that has Naval Base of at least level 8.
loc.landmark_great_wall_section_desc: The Great Wall, built over hundreds of years and dozens of administrations, is a logistical masterpiece. Today, it could be said to represent the Chinese people's great courage and defiance in the face of adversity.
loc.landmark_nanjing_presidential_palace_des: The Presidential Palace at Nanjing is an ancient, prestigious complex where, upon the fall of the Qing dynasty, the great Sun Yat-sen himself was inaugurated.
loc.landmark_forbidden_city_desc: As ancient seat of Ming power, the Forbidden City is a symbol of China's long history of harmony and prosperity. Today, the treasures and artefacts contained within have been secreted away in fear of another Japanese invasion...
loc.landmark_prague_castle_desc: The ancient Prague Castle, the largest in the world, has served for centuries as the residence of kings, emperors and now finally the presidents of Czechoslovakia. Its exterior makes clear that is not a defensive structure, but a symbol of power, being reminiscent of grand palaces. While behind its outer walls it features Czechoslovakia's largest church, finished in 1926.
loc.landmark_bojnice_castle_desc: The Bojnice castle once hosted Hungarian kings and other high-ranking nobles, but since its separation from Hungary in 1920, it serves as one of the most beautiful structures in Slovakia.

"If you find yourself in a fair fight, you didn't plan your mission properly."

- Colonel David Hackworth
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_GOING_THROUGH_NOT_AROUND_: Successfully attack and control an area with a level 10 fort in it.

"Out of every one hundred men, ten should not even be there, eighty are just targets, nine are real fighters, and we are lucky to have them, for they make the battle. Ah, but the one, the one is a warrior, and he will bring the others back."\n\n- The Cynic Epistles
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_YOU_SHALL_NOT_PASS_QUOTE: "Combat isn't where you might die -- though that does happen -- it's where you find out whether you get to keep on living. Don't underestimate the power of that revelation. Don't underestimate the things young men will wager in order to play that game one more time."\n\n- Sebastian Junger, War
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_THOUSAND_SPLENDID_SUNS_DE: Detonate 3 atomic bombs within a 12-hour window between detonations.
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_THOUSAND_SPLENDID_SUNS_QU: "Hitherto man had to live with the idea of death as an individual; from now onward mankind will have to live with the idea of its death as a species."\n\n- Arthur Koestler
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_THE_GUNS_OF_AUGUST_DESCRI: Have at least 15 concurrent battles supported by a railway gun bombardment.
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_THE_GUNS_OF_AUGUST_QUOTE: "It is easier to find men who will volunteer to die, than to find those who are willing to endure pain with patience."\n\n- Julius Caesar
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_LEARNING_ON_THE_JOB_DESCR: Have a commander (excluding division commanders) increase their skill four times.
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_LEARNING_ON_THE_JOB_QUOTE: "It takes 15,000 casualties to train a major general."\n\n- Ferdinand Foch
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_THEY_CAME_FROM_ABOVE_DESC: Execute a paradrop plan using 15 paratrooper divisions.
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_THEY_CAME_FROM_ABOVE_QUOT: "They sowed the wind, and now they are going to reap the whirlwind."\n\n- The Bible, Hosea 8th, Verse 7
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_COORDINATED_INVASION_DESC: Execute 4 simultaneous naval invasions for 4 different landing zones.
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_COORDINATED_INVASION_QUOT: "Battles are won by slaughter and manoeuvre. The greater the general, the more he contributes in manoeuvre, the less he demands in slaughter."\n\n- Winston S. Churchill, "The World Crisis"
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_NOT_SO_FAST_QUOTE: "When the local language is violence, be fluent."\n\n- Unknown
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_TANKS_NO_THANKS_QUOTE: "When all is said and done, a tank is a small steel box crammed with flammable or explosive substances which is easily converted into a mobile crematorium for its highly skilled crew."\n\n- Brigadier Shelford Bidwell
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_WE_SHALL_FIGHT_IN_THE_SHA: We Shall Fight in the Shade
Deploy over 5000 aircraft into one airspace region.

"Airplanes suffer from so many technical faults that it is only a matter of time before any reasonable man realizes that they are useless!"\n\n- Attributed to an article in "Scientific American", (1910)
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_ACES_HIGH_DESCRIPTION: Have 20 aces use the same airport as their home base.
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_ACES_HIGH_QUOTE: "The heavens are their battlefield. They are the Cavalry of the Clouds. "\n\n- David Lloyd George
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_BEHIND_ENEMY_LINES_DESCRI: Take control of the enemy capital using a paradrop order.
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_BEHIND_ENEMY_LINES_QUOTE: "We're paratroopers lieutenant. We are supposed to be surrounded."\n\n- Major Winters, Band of Brothers
loc.SUB_MESSAGE_SPLASHSCREEN_TITLE: Earn Medals & Ribbons for prominent results on the battlefield!
loc.SUB_MESSAGE_SPLASHSCREEN_DESC: Medals and Ribbons are new forms of challenges and awards that can be earned in non-ironman games. Check out the list in your Career Profile and compare your statistics and medals with friends. \n\n Also, the Career Profile now support statistics collection for mods!
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_BACKUP_QUOTE_01: "I am the Flail of God. If you had not committed great sins, God would have not sent a punishment like me upon you."\n\n- Genghis Khan
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_BACKUP_QUOTE_02: "There are three kinds of people: Those who are immovable, those who are moveable, and those who move them."\n\n- Attributed to Benjamin Franklin
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_BACKUP_QUOTE_03: "...the men who quell the storm and ride the thunder."\n\n- Teddy Roosevelt
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_BACKUP_QUOTE_04: "Hit the other fellow, as quick as you can, and as hard as you can, where it hurts him most, when he ain't lookin'."\n\n- Sir William Slim
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_BACKUP_QUOTE_05: "When you go home tell them of us and say, for their tomorrow, we gave our today."\n\n- John Maxwell Edmonds
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_BACKUP_QUOTE_06: "Anything worth fighting for is worth fighting dirty for."\n\n- Unknown
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_BACKUP_QUOTE_07: "I'll come back as soon as I can with as much as I can. In the meantime, you've got to hold!"\n\n- Attributed to Douglas MacArthur
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_BACKUP_QUOTE_08: "From somewhere the enemy artillery awoke and the shells came over- you could count them as they came. And then you couldn't count them; they fell in no regular order, one-two-three, but with a conscious knowledge of where we were- to left, to right, ahead, behind, crashing like enormous garbage cans heaved by gigantic men. The broken earth fell on us, the cracked rock spattered against the unbroken stone of the hillsides. The growing night was loud in our ears."\n\n- Alvah Bessie, Men in Battle: A Story of American in Spain (1939)
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_BACKUP_QUOTE_09: "O where will you go when the blinding flash, scatters the seed of a million suns? And what will you do in the rain of ash? But how will it be when the blinding flash, disturbs your body's close-knit mesh, bringing to light your lovely bones? What will you wear in the rain of ash?"\n\n- Excerpt of "Terminal Colloquy", Charles Martin
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_BACKUP_QUOTE_10: "Read over and over again the campaigns of Alexander, Hannibal, Caesar, Gustavus, Turenne, Eugene and Frederic. This is the only way to become a great general and master the secrets of the art of war."\n\n- Napoleon Bonaparte
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_BACKUP_QUOTE_11: "I must study politics and war, that my sons may have the liberty to study mathematics and philosophy... in order to give their children the right to study painting, poetry, and music."\n\n- John Adams
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_BACKUP_QUOTE_12: "An entire sea of water cannot sink a ship, unless it gets on the inside."\n\n- Unknown
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_BACKUP_QUOTE_13: "Sail it like you stole it."\n\n- Unknown
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_BACKUP_QUOTE_14: "They are so many, and we are so few, how are we going to bury them all?"\n\n- Finnish winter war expression
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_BACKUP_QUOTE_15: "It takes a brave man to be a coward in the Red Army."\n\n- Joseph Stalin
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_BACKUP_QUOTE_16: "Your name is unknown. Your deed is immortal."\n\n- Tomb of the Unknown Soldier
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_BACKUP_QUOTE_17: "To die for the Emperor is to live forever."\n\n- Unknown
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_BACKUP_QUOTE_18: "Sun Tzǔ said: In the practical art of war, the best thing of all is to take the enemy's country whole and intact; to shatter and destroy it is not so good."\n\n- Sun Tzu, The Art of War
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_BACKUP_QUOTE_19: "All men are brothers, like the seas throughout the world; So why do winds and waves clash so fiercely everywhere?"\n\n- Hirohito
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_BACKUP_QUOTE_21: "War is life multiplied by some number that no one has ever heard of."\n\n- Sebastian Junger, War
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_BACKUP_QUOTE_22: "The cause doesn't have to be righteous and battle doesn't have to be winnable; but over and over again throughout history, men have chosen to die in battle with their friends rather than to flee on their own and survive."\n\n- Sebastian Junger, War
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_BACKUP_QUOTE_23: "The problem with fear, though, is that it isn't any one thing. Fear has a whole taxonomy—anxiety, dread, panic, foreboding—and you could be braced for one form and completely fall apart facing another."\n\n- Sebastian Junger, War
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_BACKUP_QUOTE_24: "Civilians balk at recognizing that one of the most traumatic things about combat is having to give it up. War is so obviously evil and wrong that the idea there could be anything good to it almost feels like a profanity."\n\n- Sebastian Junger, War
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_BACKUP_QUOTE_25: "Combat jammed so much adrenaline through your system that fear was rarely an issue; far more indicative of real courage was how you felt before the big operations, when the implications of losing your life really had a chance to sink in. My personal weakness wasn't fear so much as the anticipation of it."\n\n- Sebastian Junger, War
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_BACKUP_QUOTE_26: "The Maginot Line is secured, the truce is agreed, and I have her promise not to invade Poland."\n\n- Ferdinand Foch
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_BACKUP_QUOTE_27: "The only thing harder than getting a new idea into the military mind is to get an old one out."\n\n- Captain Sir Basil Liddell Hart, Thoughts on War, 1944.
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_BACKUP_QUOTE_28: "War is a lot of things and it's useless to pretend that exciting isn't one of them."\n\n- Sebastian Junger, War
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_BACKUP_QUOTE_29: "Philosophers and Scientists have shown that adaptation is the secret of existence. History, however, is a catalogue of failures to change in time with the need. And armies, which because of their role should be the most adaptable of institutions, have been the most rigid - to the cost of the causes they upheld."\n\n- Captain Sir Basil Liddell Hart, Thoughts on War, 1944.
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_BACKUP_QUOTE_30: "Change typifies the modern world. You can either deal with change or it will deal with you."\n\n- General Gordon R. Sullivan.

loc.CAREER_PROFILE_SYNTHETIC_SECURITY_QUOTE: "If the women in the factories stopped work for 20 minutes, the allies would lose the war."\n\n- French Field Marshal and Commander in Chief Joseph Joffre, WW1.
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_RUBBER_BARON_DESCRIPTION: Control at least 1000 units of Rubber and have a Closed Economy.
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_RUBBER_BARON_QUOTE: "...capture of the principal rubber producing areas of the Far East in 1942 eliminated the sources of 90 percent of the world's natural rubber production."\n\n- The Southern Economic Journal, January 1947
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_THE_TRUCK_WILL_ALWAYS_GET: The truck will always get through
Have over 5000 supply trucks deliver supply to armies.
"They said that the bomber would always get through. But the trucks were already there."\n\n- Unknown
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_MARE_NOSTRUM_DESCRIPTION: Gain Naval Dominance in the six main sea-regions of the Mediterranean Sea, of which at least one is contested.
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_MARE_NOSTRUM_QUOTE: "When I lost my rifle, the Army charged me 85 dollars. That is why in the Navy the Captain goes down with the ship."\n\n- Dick Gregory
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_BLITZ_THIS_DESCRIPTION: Choose elastic defense as preferred strategy on a general, field marshal, or country.
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_BLITZ_THIS_QUOTE: "Pull back the lines like an archer drawing a bow, then release."\n\n- Unknown
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_SCORCHED_EARTH_DESCRIPTIO: Detonate railways using the "Scorched Earth" feature to slow down enemy advances.
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_SCORCHED_EARTH_QUOTE: "..the enemy must not be left a single engine, a single railway car, not a single pound of grain or gallon of fuel."\n\n- Joseph Stalin, radio address, July 3, 1941
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_RULED_BY_FURNITURE_DESCRI: Have no single person or set of people depicted to be in charge of your nation.
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_RULED_BY_FURNITURE_QUOTE: "Worrying is like a rocking chair, it gives you something to do, but it gets you nowhere."\n\n- Old English proverb
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_THE_THOUSAND_YEAR_BOND_DE: Deploy one hundred cavalry or camelry battalions.
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_THE_THOUSAND_YEAR_BOND_QU: "A horse must be a bit mad to be a good cavalry mount, and its rider must be completely so."\n\n- Steven Pressfield
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_ROCKETS_REIGN_QUOTE: "The rocket worked perfectly except for landing on the wrong planet."\n\n- Wernher Von Braun
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_STEEL_AT_HIGH_SPEED_DESCR: Deploy over 4000 tanks with a Max Speed over 12km/h.
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_STEEL_AT_HIGH_SPEED_QUOTE: "If everything seems under control, you're not going fast enough."\n\n- Mario Andretti
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_ORCHESTRA_OF_BOOM_DESCRIP: Deploy a division containing at least one battalion of "Anti-Air", "Artillery", "Rocket Artillery" and "Anti-Tank", supported by a signal company.
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_ORCHESTRA_OF_BOOM_QUOTE:
"A veritable crescendo of sounds, so continuous as to merge and blend into a single annihilating roar, the roar of a train in a tunnel magnified a millionfold."

- Arnold D. Harvey
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_TASK_FAILED_SUCCESSFULLY_: Fail a raid while having 80% success chance or higher.

"The raid must be considered as a reconnaissance in force... We had to get all the information necessary before launching operations on a much larger scale..."\n\n- Winston Churchill, on Dieppe Raid, September 8, 1942
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_PUNCH_IT_DESCRIPTION: Successfully raid a nuclear facility, while controlling at least one state neighboring the facility
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_PUNCH_IT_QUOTE: "For the sake of the nations life it was necessary to restore the army's will to die"\n\n - Alexander Kerensky on the June Offensive
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_PLAN_L_DESCRIPTION: Starting as a landlocked country, complete 2 naval special projects, build 10 destroyers, 5 cruisers, 2 battleships and 1 carrier.
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_PLAN_L_QUOTE: "It takes the Navy three years to build a ship. It will take three hundred years to build a new tradition. The evacuation will continue."\n\n - Andrew Cunningham, on evacuation of Crete
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_SWEETENER_HEXADECAGON_DES: Research 16 Technologies unlocked by Special Projects
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_SWEETENER_HEXADECAGON_QUO: "When I came to you with those calculations, we thought we might start a chain reaction that might destroy the entire world."\n\n - Robert Oppenheimer, Oppenheimer
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_ISLAND_HOPPER_QUOTE: "You wanna live?! Get off the beach"\n\n - John Basilone, The Pacific
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_IM_THE_CAPTAIN_NOW_DESCRI: As a minor nation, take over leadership of a faction
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_IM_THE_CAPTAIN_NOW_QUOTE: "Look at me, I'm the captain now."\n\n - Muse, Captain Philips
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_THREE_MUSKETEERS_DESCRIPT: Establish three faction theaters that are manned by your officers
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_THREE_MUSKETEERS_QUOTE: "All for one and one for all, united we stand divided we fall."\n\n - Alexander Dumas
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_THE_MORE_THE_MERRIER_DESC: Have a faction research sharing bonus of 30%
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_THE_MORE_THE_MERRIER_QUOT: "No man is an island, entire of itself, every man is a piece of the continent, a part of the main." \n\n - John Donne
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_IM_HERE_TO_RESCUE_YOU_DES: Successfully use a Raid to rescue your captured Commander
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_IM_HERE_TO_RESCUE_YOU_QUO: "I'm sorry we're a few minutes late." \n\n - Lord Lovat
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_DEJA_VU_DESCRIPTION: Successfully use Spy Operation to rescue your captured Commander
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_DEJA_VU_QUOTE: "I raised the question [of a rescue] again. This time it prompted action." \n\n - Major Lapham
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_THE_MORE_THINGS_CHANGES: The More Things Change, The More They Stay the Same
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_THE_MORE_THINGS_CHANGES_Q: "We were expendable. We were a bonus, that's all." \n\n - Major General Colin Gubbins
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_FULLY_DECKED_OUT_DESCRIPT: Design and Deploy a Division that has 5 Divisional Support Units and 5 Regimental Support Units
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_FULLY_DECKED_OUT_QUOTE: "In case of doubt, attack" \n\n - George Patton
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_BACKUP_QUOTE_31: "...many of us thought that we had never heard any more welcome sound than the deep roaring and crashing that started in at our rear."\n\n- Fritz Kreisler
loc.CAREER_PROFILE_BACKUP_QUOTE_32: "Law! What do I care about the law? Aint I got the power?"\n\n- Cornelius Vanderbilt

loc.combat_stat_depth_charges_info:
§HDepth Charges§!

Depth charges are used against submarines, which can not be attacked by other weapon types.
loc.combat_stat_light_guns_info:
§HLight Guns§!

Light Guns are more effective against §YScreen Ships§!. Your fleet's light guns are going to target the closest enemy.
loc.combat_stat_heavy_guns_info:
§HHeavy Guns§!

Heavy Guns are more effective against §YCapital Ships§!. They can reach the two closest groups of enemies and will prefer firing on larger targets.
loc.combat_stat_anti_air:
§HFleet Anti-Air§!

Fleet Anti-Air is calculated using the Anti-Air of all ships in the entire fleet and will disrupt enemy bombers attacking the fleet and reduce the damage they can cause.
loc.combat_stat_torpedoes_info:
§HTorpedoes§!

Torpedoes ignore armor and are much more effective against §YCapital Ships§!. The amount of torpedoes launched against the enemy depends on their §YScreening Efficiency§!.
loc.screening_efficiency_info:
§HScreening Efficiency§!

High §YScreening Efficiency§! defends your §YCapital Ships§! against enemy torpedoes. Your Carriers will be screened by both your Capital and your Screen Ships. Capital Ships will be only be screened by your Screen Ships.
loc.POSITIONING_INFO:
§HPositioning§! represents how well your fleet is positioned compared to the enemy. It is affected by the relative size of the fleets, the weather, and leader's skills. Ships that join combat after it has started will have a temporary penalty to Positioning.

If Positioning is below 100%, the fleet will suffer penalties.

loc.SCREENING_TOOLTIP_NO_SCREENS: A lack of §YScreening Ships§! will allow enemy submarines and other light ships to target your capital ships with torpedoes and will give heavy penalties to Positioning.
loc.SCREENING_BOX_TOOLTIP: The §YScreening Group§! holds all the screening ships - usually Light Cruisers and Destroyers - tasked with keeping enemy screening ships away from the main §YBattleline§!. Insufficient screening will allow enemy screens to make torpedo attacks against the battleline.
loc.CAPITAL_BOX_TOOLTIP: The §YBattleline§! provides the main direct firepower of the fleet, usually in the form of Battleships and Heavy Cruisers. They will also prevent enemy capital ships from firing at friendly §YCarriers§!.
loc.CARRIER_BOX_TOOLTIP: The §YCarrier Group§! provides the main long range striking power of the fleet. Screened from the enemy by both the §YScreening Group§! and the §YBattleline§!, the carriers can launch strikes on the enemy without interference. Should any §YConvoys§! be present in the battle, they will also appear in this area.
loc.SUBMARINE_BOX_TOOLTIP: The §YSubmarine Wolfpack§! will attempt to finish off fleeing ships with its torpedoes while remaining hidden. A lack of dedicated anti-submarine vessels amongst the enemy will allow the submarines to slip away undetected.

loc.NAVAL_MISSION_NAME_PATROL_DESC:
Order the task force to patrol the fleet's area of operation.

A task force can only patrol one region at a time.
It will attempt to spot enemy fleets in its active region. Radar and Air Superiority will help it spot the enemy faster.

Note that the enemy can spot and engage you before you spot them.
loc.NAVAL_MISSION_NAME_STRIKE_FORCE_DESC:
Order the task force to wait at the closest naval base until an enemy task force is spotted.
Once an enemy is spotted by one of your patrol task forces, your strike force will move to intercept it.

When not actively engaging enemies, this mission consumes $PERCENT|%0G$ fuel.
loc.NAVAL_MISSION_NAME_SEARCH_AND_DESTROY_DE: Order the task force to actively seek out and engage enemy fleets in the selected region(s).
loc.NAVAL_MISSION_NAME_CONVOY_RAIDING_DESC: Order the task force to raid enemy convoys in the selected region(s).
loc.NAVAL_MISSION_NAME_CONVOY_ESCORT_DESC: Order the task force to escort convoys in selected region(s) and protect them against enemy raids.
loc.NAVAL_MISSION_NAME_INVASION_DESC: Order a task force to actively support troop transport and invasions in the selected §YInvasion orders§!.\n§GClick§! to enable this mission, then §GClick§! on the invasion arrow if you have drawn one.
loc.NAVAL_MISSION_NAME_MINES_PLANTING_DESC: Order a task force to lay the sea mines in the selected regions. The highest potential penalty for your enemies is:\n
loc.NAVAL_MISSION_MISSED_REQUIREMENT_WARN_SH: The task force will be unable to efficiently help divisions on the shore line in combat due to its low Shore Bombardment capabilities. Consider adding ships with §YHeavy Gun Attack§! to the task force.
loc.NAVAL_MISSION_MISSED_REQUIREMENT_WARN_DE: The task force will be unlikely to damage submarines. Consider adding ships with more §HDepth Charges§!.
loc.NAVAL_MISSION_MISSED_REQUIREMENT_WARN_SU: The task force will be unlikely to detect submarines during combat. Consider adding more ships with §YSonars§!, §YRadars§! or §YAirplane Catapults§!.
The task force will be slow at detecting potential enemies. Consider adding more ships with §YRadars§! and §YAirplane Catapults§!.
loc.NAVAL_MISSION_MISSED_REQUIREMENT_WARN_SP: The task force average speed is too low and will hinder its spotting ability. Consider removing slow ships or adding faster ones.
loc.NAVAL_MISSION_MISSED_REQUIREMENT_WARN_SU: The task force is too visible and can be easily spotted and/or avoided by an enemy. Consider using smaller or less armored ships with a lower Surface Visibility.
loc.NAVAL_MISSION_SET_REASON_FOR_PLANTING_NO: Minelaying is §Rnot possible§!, because none of the ships in your fleet has an ability to do it!

loc.NAVAL_MISSION_NAME_MINES_SWEEPING_DESC: Order a task force to search and neutralize the sea mines in the selected regions. The highest potential penalty that you may suffer from the enemy mines is:\n
loc.NAVAL_MISSION_NAME_NAVAL_INVASION_SUPPOR: Order ships to escort naval invasions and support them with shore bombardment.
loc.NAVAL_MISSION_NAME_TRAINING_DESC:
Order a task force to perform exercises in the region adjacent to the closest naval base.
This has a chance to damage ships over time.
The crew will not gain experience once they reach the Regular level.
You will gain §YNavy Experience§! while training.
The §YPride of the Fleet§! is less likely to get into an accident.

Hold §HShift§! and click to enable §HNaval Exercises§! until all ships are fully trained.

loc.SUPPLY_FLOW_SHOW_RANGE:
§HSupply Hubs§! distribute supply to nearby provinces. Their range and efficiency is dependent on weather, ground conditions, infrastructure, railway level, and motorization.

To increase the range and supply provided by a §HSupply Hub§!, consider using the §HUpgrade Railways§! command, changing the §HMotorization Level§! or upgrade the §HInfrastructure Level§!.

Hold §GShift§! to show range.
§GShift-click§! to toggle motorization.
§GCtrl-click§! to toggle allied supply.
loc.SUPPLY_FLOW_DELAYED_DESC:
§HSupply Remaining§! indicates how much supply is provided to this province, and is made up of state supply and hubs within range. Hub range is affected by weather, ground conditions, infrastructure, railway level, and motorization. 

§HDivisions§! will consume provincial supply based on their supply weight. If their §HStored Supply§! is above the supply ratio provided in their location, they will consume from their internal store until stored supply is at the same level as the local supply.

Hold §GCtrl§! to show flow sources.

loc.NATIONAL_UNITY_DESC: National Unity represents the willingness of the people at the top to prosecute a war to the finish. The higher this value is, the longer they will fight on before considering surrender.
loc.STABILITY_DESC: Stability represents the people's support for the current government. High stability makes political changes easier to push through and helps the economy run smoothly.
loc.WAR_SUPPORT_DESC: War Support represents the willingness of the people to prosecute a war to the finish. Enacting many Laws and preparing your nation for going to war effectively requires high War Support.
loc.POLITICAL_POWER_DESC: Political Power represents the country's leaders' ability to command the state. Spend Political Power to change §HLaws§!, appoint §HPolitical Advisors§! and §HMilitary Staff§!, direct §HResearch & Production§!, and take §HDecisions§! and §HDiplomatic Actions§!.

loc.MANPOWER_DESC: Manpower is derived from the §HRecruitable Population§! of the country and its occupied territories, and represents the men and women available to the armed forces. Enact stricter §HConscription Laws§! to expand the recruitable population and increase available manpower.

loc.INDUSTRIAL_CAPACITY_DESC: Factories form the basis of the country's §HIndustrial Capacity§!. §HMilitary Factories§! produce equipment for the army and the air force, while §HNaval Dockyards§! produce and repair ships for the navy. §HCivilian Factories§! construct and repair buildings and infrastructure as well as facilitating trade.
loc.INDUSTRIAL_CAPACITY_DESC_OCCUPATION: The number of factories you get from the occupied states is influenced by your occupation policies.
loc.ARMY_EXPERIENCE_DESC:
As your equipment is used in combat, you gain Army Experience. This means that you can gain Army Experience when your §HDivisions§! engage in battle or if you have §HLend-Leased§! equipment to your allies' wars.
You also gain experience from conducting §HArmy Exercises§! with troops that are at least at the $UNIT_TRAINING_LEVEL|Y$ level, and from certain §HNational Focuses§!. Some §HMinisters§! can increase experience gained.

Army Experience is needed to create and modify your §HDivision Templates§! and unlock §HDoctrines§!.
loc.NAVY_EXPERIENCE_DESC: As your ships are used in combat and in §HNaval Exercises§!, you gain Navy Experience. Certain §HNational Focuses§! give additional experience and some §HMinisters§! can increase experience gained.\n\nNaval Experience is used to develop better variants of existing ships, design new ones, and unlock §HDoctrines§!.
loc.AIR_EXPERIENCE_DESC:
When your aircraft engage the enemy in missions or practice in §HPilot Exercises§!, you gain Air Experience. This means that you can gain Air Experience when your §HAir Wings§! engage in battle or if you have §HLend-Leased§! equipment to your allies' wars.
Certain §HNational Focuses§! give additional experience and some §HMinisters§! can increase experience gained.

Air Experience is used to develop better variants of existing aircraft, design new ones, and unlock §HDoctrines§!.
loc.COMMAND_POWER_DESC: §HCommand Power§! is used for various military operations and promotion of generals. It can be spent on one time operations or it can be allocated for continuous operations. Growth and maximum capacity of §HCommand Power§! can be increased by various Doctrines and National Spirits.

loc.FRA_communist_civil_war_decision_desc: The rising furore of radical politics is becoming harder to appease - eventually we must confront it one way or another.
loc.FRA_fascist_civil_war_decision_desc: The rising populist sentiment is proving to be an unstoppable tide. There is no avoiding the inevitable.
loc.ETH_defeat_italy_category_desc: Italy once again seeks to see Ethiopia subjugated into a mere colony. We defeated these invaders last time, and we can defeat them again if only we can remove them from our border for good!
loc.seize_some_trains_woo_desc: The merchant rail companies hold sway over our infrastructure. With war looming, we are well within our rights to commandeer equipment for state use.
loc.random_general_monarchy_tt: A random [FROM.GetAdjective] general will gain secret monarchist sympathies.
loc.war_propaganda_casualties_desc: Although the death toll rises, our people must be taught that only in battle are heroes forged.
loc.war_propaganda_convoys_desc: Even civilians can help win the war - by care and attention to our material usage, every gram of steel can be made twice as valuable to the war effort.
loc.war_propaganda_bombing_desc: Though bombs fall all around us, our brave workers soldier on. It is by this spirit that we will be victorious.
loc.CHI_breach_the_yellow_river_desc: The Yellow River is the lifeblood of the surrounding regions, but stands in the path of the oncoming invasion. As a last resort to slow invading forces, the suggestion to blow the complex system of dikes and dams has been made.\n\nThe efficacy of this action is difficult to determine, but the consequences will be severe.

loc.RAJ_industrialize_state_desc: Our nation is once again on the rise. Although the task is great, bringing rural areas into the modern era is sure to pay dividends in the future.
loc.war_propaganda_radio_industry_desc: Technology has developed to a point where a significant proportion of our population has access to a home radio. State sponsored media is the perfect tool for stoking the war effort in the hearts of our people.
loc.DOMESTIC_FILM_INDUSTRY_DESC: The [ROOT.GetAdjective] film industry has developed significantly in the last decade. With a population starved for entertainment, we stand to benefit from a cinematic production designed to stir patriotic sentiment.
loc.IMPORTED_FILM_INDUSTRY_DESC: Our benefactors and allies are making strategic use of propaganda films. With a little investment, we could screen these productions around our own country in order to stir the war effort amongst our people.
loc.the_fleet_that_came_to_stay: The Fleet That Came to Stay
loc.generic_purchase_old_ships_category_desc: With the world becoming increasingly unstable, we need to expand our naval power projection capabilities. Luckily for us, some of the major navies may be willing to part with their older vessels.
loc.generic_refit_civilian_ships_category_de: Our fleet can not realistically hope to compete with the much larger naval forces that threaten us. We must hastily procure a bigger fleet by refitting civilian vessels for military purposes.
loc.diversify_special_forces_desc: Our conventional forces simply aren't enough to combat the oncoming storm. We must innovate.
loc.refit_to_destroyer_mass_nor: Refit Convoys to Destroyers En Masse

loc.DESIGNER_SUPPORT_COLUMN_TITLE: Support Companies. These are support troops keep behind the frontline troops and help out.\n\nYou can only select one of each type.
