loc.DOD_hungary.170.desc: With its old supporters gone, the Treaty of Trianon is no longer worth the paper it was printed on. No one can now refuse our right to bear arms!
loc.DOD_romania.1.t: Romania wants to restore the Alliance
loc.DOD_romania.1.desc: The old alliance with Romania has lapsed in recent years. The threat of Germany and Hungary seemed remote. But in the face of a shifting situation, [ROM.GetLeader] has come to Warsaw to discuss a renewal of the Romanian-Polish Alliance. For the time being, this agreement is only defensive in nature, with both sides promising to support one another in case of war.
loc.DOD_romania.2.desc: Our delegation to Warsaw has returned with a treaty of assistance signed by [POL.GetLeader]. We are now obliged to defend one another should war break out.
loc.DOD_romania.3.desc: [From.GetLeader] has refused to meet with our delegation in Warsaw, sending only a terse message that a closer association with Romania 'is not currently in the interest of the [From.GetAdjective] government.'\n\nRequests for further clarification have not been answered.
loc.DOD_romania.10.desc: Originally intended to contain the spread of Communism and block the Red Army from marching into Europe, the idea of the Cordon Sanitaire has recently been revived by [ROM.GetLeader] to keep the diplomatic outcasts of [GER.GetNameDef] and [SOV.GetNameDef] apart.\n\nThe Romanians have sounded us out about joining in a formal alliance with them.
loc.DOD_romania.11.t: [From.GetNameDefCap] agrees to join the Cordon Sanitaire
loc.DOD_romania.11.desc: the government of [From.GetLeader] has declared its support for the Cordon Sanitaire. A delegation from [From.GetNameDef] has arrived to discuss the specifics of joining our faction and to organize plans of military support in case of war.
loc.DOD_romania.12.desc: Negotiations with [From.GetNameDef] about joining our faction have broken down. The delegation from [From.GetNameDef] have submitted an extensive list of demands as a prerequisite of joining our faction, including far-reaching commitments of military support.\n\nThe General Staff has refused these demands on the grounds that they are impossible to meet, and the Foreign Office now believes that this was a deliberate move by [From.GetLeader] to turn down our offer without appearing responsible for it.
loc.DOD_romania.20.desc: For several months now, we have tried to secure an alliance with [ROM.GetNameDef], if only to keep their oil out of enemy hands. Now [ROM.GetLeader] has declared that a formal guarantee of military support in case of a war is a necessary step before his government would even consider joining our faction.
loc.DOD_romania.20.b: That would only spread us even thinner.
loc.DOD_romania.21.desc: Speaking before a meeting of the Romanian-[From.GetAdjective] Friendship Association, [From.GetLeader] announced that the current borders of Romania are 'unchangeable and permanent', promising that his government would do everything in its power to defend them should war come.
loc.DOD_romania.22.desc: Our recent diplomatic offensive has been met with cold rejection by [From.GetNameDef]. Speaking before parliament, [From.GetLeader] stated that the question of a formal guarantee to Romania 'will be decided if and when it becomes relevant'.
loc.DOD_romania.30.desc: With tensions rising in Europe, [ROM.GetLeader] has come to us with a surprising offer: If we commit to defend Romania from any outside threat, we would be allowed to station troops on Romanian soil. \n\nAs a measure of good will, [ROM.GetLeader] has also relaxed restrictions on the Communist Party.
loc.DOD_romania.30.desc_alt: With tensions rising in Europe, [ROM.GetLeader] has come to us with a surprising offer: If we commit to defend Romania from any outside threat, we would be allowed to station troops on Romanian soil.
loc.DOD_romania.31.desc: [SOV.GetLeader] has personally ordered the [SOV.GetSovietArmyAdjectiveBasedOnIdeology] Army to plan for the defense of Romania in the case of war. A small military mission has arrived to prepare bases and air fields for the imminent arrival of garrison troops.
loc.DOD_romania.31.a: Let us hope we don't come to regret this.
loc.DOD_romania.32.desc: Talks about basing [SOV.GetAdjective] troops in Romania have ended after just a few hours, with the [SOV.GetAdjective]s declaring that they are not interested in guaranteeing our borders.\n\nQuite a few of our Generals have seized upon the disturbing implication that this might be because they don't like their current shape and seek to change them.
loc.DOD_romania.40.desc: Our ambassador to [ROM.GetNameDef] has hurriedly been summoned to the office of [ROM.GetLeader]. Before he could inquire about recent movements of the Romanian military towards our shared border, he was presented with an ultimatum. [BUL.GetNameDefCap], [ROM.GetLeader] insisted, could no longer be permitted to conduct itself without his express consent, and should submit every major policy decision for his approval.\n\nRefusal would be met with force.
loc.DOD_romania.40.a: We must give in to their demands.
loc.DOD_romania.41.desc: [BUL.GetNameDefCap] has accepted our requests and now consults us before making any political decisions.\n\nA Special Representative has arrived in Sofia to coordinate with their government.
loc.DOD_romania.42.desc: When presented with a list of our demands, [BUL.GetLeader] reportedly laughed and then tore up the paper, claiming that no Romanian army could ever best a Bulgarian one in combat.
loc.DOD_romania.42.a: This is not worth the bloodshed.
loc.DOD_romania.42.b: Let's find out if he is right.
loc.DOD_romania.50.t: Romania demands changes to the government.
loc.DOD_romania.50.desc:
When [ROM.GetLeader] publicly demanded that he should be allowed to veto any appointment of the [HUN.GetAdjective] government, simply because it was in the Romanian interest, most people in the diplomatic service considered it simple propaganda meant for a domestic audience. 

It was with some surprise that we received an official note to the same effect a little while later.

The threat of military force if we failed to comply has sent the General Staff into a panic, and the Army High Command has raised grave doubts whether we could hold the Romanians on the border.
loc.DOD_romania.50.c: Better to die free than to live as a slave.
loc.DOD_romania.51.desc: Realizing that military resistance would be both impossible and pointless, the Hungarian government has decided to follow our suggestions and put itself at our disposal, with [HUN.GetLeader] promising to consult with us before any major policy decision.
loc.DOD_romania.52.desc: In response to our recent request for some changes in the Hungarian government, [HUN.GetLeader] has offered a Treaty of Friendship and Mutual Assistance, which would compel them to come to our aid in times of war, but also contains a clause in which we would swear not to interfere with Hungarian politics.
loc.DOD_romania.52.b: That was not what we meant.
loc.DOD_romania.53.desc: Despite of the clear inferiority of his armed forces, [HUN.GetLeader] has refused to see reason and ordered his army to take up defensive positions along our border. For reasons unknown, it appears that a significant part of their army has followed these orders.\n\nIt seems that they want to make a fight out of it.
loc.DOD_romania.53.a: This is not worth the time or effort.
loc.DOD_romania.60.desc: With the Romanian army poised at our borders, rumors have been flying around about their purpose. When our ambassador in Bucharest inquired about the issue, he was told bluntly that [ROM.GetLeader] has decided that a united Yugoslavia is no longer in his interest. Instead, our nation is to be split up into a number of client states under direct Romanian control.\n\nAn official ultimatum is expected within the hour.
loc.DOD_romania.60.a: We can't hope to stand against them.
loc.DOD_romania.61.desc: Mere minutes before the ultimatum to Belgrade ran out, an official communique arrived, stating that the Yugoslavian government had dissolved and transferred its powers to a number of local governments, all of which have declared their loyalty to us.
loc.DOD_romania.62.desc: The [YUG.GetAdjective] government has let the ultimatum run out without a reply. Recon flights have revealed troop movements on the Yugoslavian side of the border, prompting the General Staff to review the invasion plans. Top military advisors have refused to guarantee that a victory against Yugoslavia would be won quickly.
loc.DOD_romania.63.desc: A crisis has arisen between Romania and Yugoslavia, which may produce an opportunity for us. [YUG.GetLeader] has refused the demands of [ROM.GetLeader] to surrender his country. In return, [ROM.GetLeader] has approached us with a deal to split Yugoslavia. He has offered us Slovenia and the creation of an Independent Croatian State under our control.
loc.DOD_romania.63.b: Why would we need their help?
loc.DOD_romania.64.desc: A crisis has arisen between Romania and Yugoslavia, which may produce an opportunity for us. [YUG.GetLeader] has refused the demands of [ROM.GetLeader] to surrender his country. In return, [ROM.GetLeader] has approached us with a deal to split Yugoslavia. He has offered us Dalmatia and the creation of a puppet state in Montenegro under our control.
loc.DOD_romania.65.desc: [From.GetLeader] has signaled his acceptance of the terms. The [From.GetAdjective] Government will support our actions in Yugoslavia.
loc.DOD_romania.66.desc: While not directly warning us away from intervening in Yugoslavia, the government of [From.GetNameDef] have refused to sanction our proposal. \n\nPerhaps they expect us to fail and aim to take Yugoslavia for themselves, without us in the picture.
loc.DOD_romania.66.a: We will be sorry to disappoint them.
loc.DOD_romania.67.desc: Having secured additional diplomatic support, it is time to inform the Yugoslavians that the situation has changed dramatically. Spread thin trying to defend long borders, their military situation is even more hopeless.
loc.DOD_romania.68.desc: Our attempts to reach out to Germany and Italy for support have not been met with success. The breathing space this has provided to the Yugoslavians will no doubt have an impact on the coming campaign, but the General Staff is still cautiously optimistic that we will be able to quickly secure victory.
loc.DOD_romania.69.desc_GER: A second ultimatum has been delivered. This time, the demands were flanked by a similar note from the ambassador of [GER.GetNameDef], who declared his support for the Romanian scheme, and insisted that our Army would not interfere with the occupation of Slovenia and Croatia by German troops.
loc.DOD_romania.69.desc_ITA: A second ultimatum has been delivered. This time, the demands were flanked by a similar note from the ambassador of [ITA.GetNameDef], who declared his support for the Romanian scheme, and insisted that our Army would not interfere with the occupation of Dalmatia and Montenegro by Italian troops.
loc.DOD_romania.69.desc_GERITA: A second ultimatum has been delivered. This time, the demands were flanked by a similar note from the ambassadors of [GER.GetNameDef] and [ITA.GetNameDef], who declared their support for the Romanian scheme, and insisted that our Army would not interfere with the occupation, in order to avoid unnecessary bloodshed.
loc.DOD_romania.69.b: We will fight to the last breath!
loc.DOD_romania.70.desc: The Yugoslavian government has accepted defeat. The forces of the allied powers have taken control of the country and occupied their designated zones.
loc.DOD_romania.71.desc: The Yugoslavian Army has occupied positions along our border and the Yugoslavian Air Force has occupied its war stations. They appear ready to fight. \n\nHowever, a source in the Yugoslavian War Ministry claims that this is merely a gesture of defiance, as [YUG.GetLeader] firmly believes that we are bluffing and that there will be no war.
loc.DOD_romania.81.desc: Magda Lupescu, mistress of King Carol II, has reportedly purchased a new villa in an expensive suburb of Bucharest. How she could afford it was subject of extensive speculation. New evidence in foreign newspapers strongly suggests that the King himself authorized the purchase with government money.\n\nThe scandal is spreading, and we must make a public announcement on the matter as soon as possible.
loc.DOD_romania.81.a: The government has purchased the building and allowed Miss Lupescu residence.
loc.DOD_romania.81.b: The King took the money out of an advance on his allowance.
loc.DOD_romania.82.desc: A new book by a renowned social scientist has recently been released, detailing the extensive influence the King's inner circle has on policy decisions. Most of those decisions end up benefiting the members afterwards. Of particular interest are the dealings of the King's Mistress, who has reportedly used her connections to enrich herself. The King has ordered the author arrested.\n\nLiberal newspapers and the far right are in an uproar over this, albeit for very different reasons. We need to make a statement on this before things get out of hand.
loc.DOD_romania.82.b: The author will be released at once.
loc.DOD_romania.83.desc: Despite being vetted by the King himself, the official coverage of the recent feast at the Royal palace has caused great public dissent. Pictures of the King's mistress in an expensive French evening gown and detailed descriptions of the 7 course meal eaten from golden plates have further inflamed the population, who are still suffering from the after-effects of the Great Depression.\n\nThe King demands that we make a public statement of support at once.
loc.DOD_romania.83.a: The King must be allowed to be representative.
loc.DOD_romania.83.b: The King's private matters are not a government concern.
loc.DOD_romania.84.desc: French newspapers have been full of the exploits of Magda Lupescu in Paris, where she has reportedly been indulging in an extensive shopping spree.\n\nWhile this is not unusual in itself, reports that she enlisted help from the Romanian embassy to move her purchases and told stores to send the bill to the Romanian government have been picked up by the national press. We have been asked to comment on these reports.
loc.DOD_romania.84.a: Miss Lupescu acted at the request of the King.
loc.DOD_romania.84.b: The government does not comment on the actions of private citizens.
loc.DOD_romania.85.desc: Accompanied by his mistress and most of his inner circle, King Carol II has arrived in Nice on a holiday. Taking residence in the Royal Lounge of the Hotel Negresco, the King told local reporters that he intends to spend the next few weeks enjoying the finest food and hospitality, with visits planned to the Nice Opera and short trips to Paris for shopping.\n\nThe local press has been asking pointed questions about the timing of this visit, as well as where the money to pay for it is supposed to come from.
loc.DOD_romania.85.a: It was an official state visit.
loc.DOD_romania.85.b: The King goes to Nice on holiday every year.
loc.DOD_romania.86.desc: Following rumors of corruption in the Army's procurement processes, the King has promised an impartial investigation into the matter. A preliminary report has been leaked to the press, confirming not only the rumors but directly implicating the King's closest advisors in the matter.\n\nThe entire affair has become an embarrassment to the government. The King demands action, but has declared his full support for the advisers in question.
loc.DOD_romania.110.desc: [ROM.GetLeader] has approached us with an offer to deal with [CZE.GetNameDef]. Noting our common interests in the area, he suggests that the country be split three ways: We would gain the western parts, Romania would control Slovakia and Hungary would be granted a tiny sliver of territory in the southern border.
loc.DOD_romania.110.b: Why negotiate for what we can take ourselves?
loc.DOD_romania.111.desc: The German government has approved our draft of the treaty and the proposed demarcation lines. All that remains is to send an ultimatum to Prague.
loc.DOD_romania.113.desc: In an angry meeting with [GER.GetLeader], our ambassador was confronted with a stern refusal to discuss or negotiate on anything concerning [CZE.GetNameDef]. The German government considers that country to be entirely in their sphere of influence and has warned that any interference would be considered to go against the express wishes of [GER.GetLeader].
loc.DOD_romania.114.desc: With German troops massing on our borders, the Ambassadors from Germany and Romania have issued a joint ultimatum: Unless we agree to turn over Slovakia to Hungary and Romania and become a 'Protectorate' of Germany, the German Luftwaffe stands ready to 'eradicate' Prague while Hungarian troops are preparing to invade our country from the south.
loc.DOD_romania.114.b: We will choose Death before Dishonor.
loc.DOD_romania.115.desc: The [CZE.GetAdjective] government has ignored our ultimatum and mobilized their army. [CZE.GetLeader] has promised that any invader would find the army more than prepared to defend the country to the last man.
loc.DOD_romania.120.desc: Several foreign truck companies have expressed interest in opening a factory in Romania, to produce new trucks for the commercial market as well as the military. Choosing one will be considered a flagship deal that could be followed by further production licenses being acquired.\n\nWho should we approach?
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.1.desc:
Following our decision to sign a pact with Germany, a group of Air Force officers has launched a coup. The military has seized key points in Belgrade. King Peter has been declared of age, ending the regency of [YUG.GetLeader].

The general population has been supportive of the coup, with crowds chanting "Better the war than the pact, better the grave than a slave!"

The government is at a crossroads. We can support the coup, which will mean war with Germany. Or we can try to fight against it, which will tear the country apart in a bloody civil war.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.1.a: We should have listened to the officers.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.1.a.tt: §YPeter II§! becomes leader for the §Y[YUG.GetIdeologyNameWithCaps]§! party.\n
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.2.desc: Immediately after the government of Prince Paul signed the Tripartite Pact, a group of [YUG.GetAdjective] Air Force officers executed a well-planned coup that replaced the legitimate government and put the underage Peter II on the throne.\n\nThe Yugoslavian government has folded entirely, with the new leaders declaring Prince Paul's signature null and void.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.3.desc: Immediately after the government of Prince Paul signed the Tripartite Pact, a group of [YUG.GetAdjective] Air Force officers executed a well-planned coup that replaced the legitimate government and put the underage Peter II on the throne.\n\nElements of the former government have denounced the coup and declared a national emergency. Since this is clearly the work of foreign agents, they claim that we are obligated to defend them.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.10.desc: As news of the declaration of war against Germany spread around the country, it quickly became clear that many people in the country have no intention of taking up arms against the invaders. Majority Croatian units have refused orders to move towards the border, and on several occasions have even opened fire on other units that were following orders.\n\nIt appears that we can no longer rely on the Croatians to support us, which has made defense of the border with Germany difficult to say the least.
loc.YUG_CRO_independence_war_troops_tt: One §Y[CRO.GetAdjective] Cavalry§! and Five §Y[CRO.GetAdjective] Infantry Divisions§! will join the uprising
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.20.desc: Realizing a strategic weakness, the [YUG.GetAdjective] Air Force has initiated a crash program to modernize and expand its force. Significant money reserves have been set aside to cover the purchase. A commission is traveling around Europe to look for new sources of fighters and medium bombers.\n\nGiven the urgency of the issue, the [YUG.GetAdjective]s have insisted on immediate delivery or transfer of planes directly from the producer.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.20.a: Approve the sale of fighters from our reserves.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.20.b: Approve the sale of bombers from our reserves.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.20.d: Divert fighter production to cover their order.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.20.e: Divert bomber production to cover their order.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.21.desc: Our purchasing commission in [From.GetNameDef] has secured the sale of a number of fighter planes for our air force. The first planes have already been received, and our pilots have begun conversion training.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.22.desc: Our purchasing commission in [From.GetNameDef] has secured the sale of a number of medium bombers for our air force. The first planes have already been received, and our pilots have begun conversion training.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.30.desc: \nFollowing the return of Austria to the Reich, we now share a border with [YUG.GetNameDef]. The government of [YUG.GetLeader] has been fairly quiet about their stance on our proposed reordering of Europe. Perhaps we should remind them that the time will come when they must make a choice.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.31.desc: A few days ago, the German ambassador cornered [YUG.GetLeader] at a diplomatic reception. Following the Anschluss of Austria, he noted, [YUG.GetNameDef] and [GER.GetNameDef] now share a common border. The ambassador assured [YUG.GetLeader] that Germany was, of course, very interested in friendly relations. \n\nHe only requested that we kept that in mind when making policy decisions in the future.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.31.b: We must keep up good relation with them...
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.32.desc: With [CZE.GetNameDef] out of the picture, the balance of power in south-eastern Europe has shifted dramatically. Czech arms and money were used to support a number of countries that now need to look for new sponsors. Perhaps it is time to remind [YUG.GetLeader] of that fact.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.33.desc:
Mere hours after German troops entered Prague, while the [CZE.GetAdjective] ambassador was still saying his farewells, the ambassador of [GER.GetNameDef] called at the Foreign Office. 

According to him, the German government deeply regrets that it had to take such measures in [CZE.GetNameDef], and [GER.GetLeader] is glad that the actions of [YUG.GetLeader] have not given him cause to consider such actions in regards to Yugoslavia.

The ambassador finished by expressing his hope that this would remain so in the future.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.33.b: This is getting serious, we must crack down on anti-German elements immediately!
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.34.desc: We now stand supreme in Europe. France was long the foundation of stability in south-eastern Europe, but now the entire area is up for grabs. We can pull all the nations there in our orbit, with no one left to stop us. \n\nIt's time to tell the Yugoslavians that they have to make a choice. Either they stand with us - or they will be swept away.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.34.a: Our patience with them is running thin.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.34.b: The Tiger cares not for the opinions of mice.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.35.desc: In a recent meeting at the Berghof, [GER.GetLeader] and [YUG.GetLeader] discussed the situation in Europe, and our role in it. [GER.GetLeader] insists that Yugoslavia can not avoid taking a side in the life-or-death struggle looming in the distance. Nor could Germany tolerate an unaligned country at her borders. \n\nIt would almost be preferable, he ended, if Yugoslavia choose to side with the Allies, just so everyone knew where they stood.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.35.b: No, we must not placate them further!
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.36.desc: After pressing them time and time again to declare for one side, the government of [YUG.GetLeader] still clings to the idea that Yugoslavia can sit out this conflict on the side lines. Now they must face the consequences of their cowardice.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.36.a: If they are not with us, they are against us!
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.36.b: They are, and will forever remain, irrelevant.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.40.desc: Yugoslavia forms the lynchpin of our new Balkan strategy. They have so far remained non-committal, trading with Germany but stopping well short of joining the Axis. We should remind them that we would not tolerate trading with the enemy in case war breaks out.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.40.b: We can't interfere in the affairs of another nation.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.41.desc: [ENG.GetLeader] recently announced a diplomatic offensive in the Balkan region. Part of that advance was a private meeting between him and our ambassador in London. During this meeting, he inquired about our position with regards to Germany. [GER.GetNameDefCap], he noted, accounted for a significant amount of our non-resource exports. We would do well, he continued, to reduce our dependence on Germany.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.42.desc:
The Treaty of Munich might mean peace in our time - or it may not. Germany is hardly the only country seeking to redraw the borders of Europe. The government of [YUG.GetLeader] has so far been surprisingly mum about the fate of their main armament supplier.

This has made quite a few people in the diplomatic service wonder if the Yugoslavians knew what was going to happen, and may in fact have agreed to it. 

We should consider reminding them that any sort of agreement with Germany will be considered a hostile act if war were to break out.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.42.b: They must still be in shock.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.43.desc: A Special Representative has arrived from Britain, here to discuss our opinion on the Treaty of Munich. It appears that [ENG.GetLeader] had hoped for a more firm declaration of support from us during the war scare that accompanied the negotiations. The fate of [CZE.GetNameDef], he reminded us, is tied to our own. Should [CZE.GetNameDef] fall to the Germans, we would find ourselves increasingly isolated on the continent.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.43.a: They are just looking for new pawns.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.44.desc: Despite the war raging for several months now, [YUG.GetLeader] still refuses to declare for one side, even continuing to trade with Germany while observing strict neutrality. While their support for Germany is probably not immediately critical, we must decide if we want to allow them to support a country we are actively at war with.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.45.desc: The British ambassador visited the Foreign Office today, demanding to know why we still traded with Germany. The British government, we were told, considered this to be a hostile act, and would consider 'appropriate measures' unless we stopped at once.
loc.YUG_if_we_dont_side_with_britain_within_: §RIf we don't side with the [ENG.GetAdjective] within the coming year, they may see us as an enemy.§!
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.46.desc: It appears that our pressure on Yugoslavia has not had the intended effect. Rather than ceasing trade with Germany or declaring their support for the allied cause, The government of [YUG.GetLeader] clings to its neutrality and refuses to budge. Lately, MI6 has received reports that the Yugoslavian government considers granting Germany the right to freely move troops through their country.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.46.a: They might as well be an enemy already.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.46.b: We shouldn't make more enemies now.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.181.d: With the foundation of the Pan-Slavic Worker’s Congress, it seems many of [This.GetAdjective]’s working class are beginning to support the idea of [This.GetNameDef] entering the faction as a communist state based on the [From.GetNameDef] model. Though a small movement now, many [This.GetAdjective] officials fear that if these activists are not promptly penalized for promoting this idea, [This.GetNameDef] may well find itself facing nation-wide strikes and even a rise in leftist paramilitarism.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.182.d: All across our nation, supporters of the Pan-Slavic Worker’s Congress have begun adorning the streets of [This.Capital.GetName] with posters and flyers promoting the [From.GetAdjective] model for socialism. They applaud [From.GetLeader] and his regime and believe that the [This.GetAdjective] government would benefit from social reforms akin to those found in [From.GetNameDef]. Though many suspect this is a bold attempt by [From.GetLeader] to undermine [This.GetAdjective] independence, it cannot be ignored that this propaganda is having quite an effect on the attitudes of the average [This.GetAdjective] citizen towards the prospect of communism and a united Balkan alliance.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.183.d: As communist sentiment continues to brew within our nation, many small paramilitary groups are beginning to form amongst our nation’s far-left. The weapons in question seem to be of Yugoslavian origin, and many suspect [From.GetLeader] and his regime have plans to overthrow the [This.GetAdjective] government in favor of one more aligned with his new [From.GetRulingIdeology] state.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.184.t: Communist Militants Demand a Change in Regime
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.184.d: Tensions between the [This.GetAdjective] government and the peasantry have reached a boiling point, with many leftist militants throughout the country arming themselves with weaponry believed to have been acquired from [From.GetNameDef]. The peasants now are demanding that [This.GetLeader] abdicates his position of power and grants it to the people he claims to represent. Their demands carry with them the implicit warning that failing to do as they ask will result in the peasantry taking up arms in the name of a new [From.GetRulingIdeology] government.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.184.a: If it is what the people wish...
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.184.b: Eradicate this band of insufferable peasants!
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.50.desc: The question of marriage and succession in [YUG.GetName] has long been on the lips of the political class. The length of time we have spent without a legitimate king on the throne has made some question the legitimacy of Karađorđević rule. However, at a recent gala in London, the young King Peter’s heart was stolen by a fair noblewoman. Already, members of the royal cabinet are discussing wedding plans to secure the King’s romantic interest with a wedding. No doubt, whomever he marries will have a lasting diplomatic impact on our nation and may influence which other countries would be willing to align themselves with Yugoslavia.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.50.a: Princess Alexandra of Greece has the King’s heart.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.501.desc: The Karađorđevićs of [From.GetNameDef] seek to continue the existence of both their royal line and their nation through a royal wedding. It seems that [From.GetLeader] has become quite infatuated with [Root.GetPrincessName], a royal of the [Root.GetFamilyName] family and has asked her hand in marriage. Should the young lady accept, [From.GetNameDef] and [Root.GetNameDef] shall be joined together in blood. Though this will not immediately result in a joint [From.GetAdjective]-[Root.GetAdjective] alliance, it would push such a thing to become possible in the immediate future.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.19.desc: Ascended to the throne long before his time by the dire circumstances of global conflict, King [Root.GetLeader] has at last come of age and proven himself to be a wise and competent leader. With a legitimate heir of proper age on the throne, the people of [YUG.GetNameDef] have at last gained a symbol of their national identity to rally behind and fight for.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.502.desc: The young King [Root.GetLeader] has professed his love and devotion to [From.GetPrincessName] publicly through the sacred bonds of matrimony in a ceremony held in [Root.GetLondonBelgrade] to cheering crowds, witnessing the fairy-tale romance of two lovers brought together in a time of crisis. [Root.GetWeddingGoodBad] Though this wedding does not solidify the creation of any formal [yugoslavia_wedding_partner.GetAdjective]-[Root.GetAdjective] alliance, it seems like a certainty at this point that cooperation between these nations does not end here.
loc.YUG_wedding_bad: Back home in [Root.GetNameDef] however, the young monarch is facing much criticism from the conservative [Root.GetAdjective] press for choosing to marry during a time of great crisis for the nation.
loc.YUG_wedding_good: From Belgrade to Bucharest, all of the Balkans are united in celebration of the [Root.GetAdjective] monarch’s perseverance in the face of growing doom.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.503.desc: Though King [Root.GetLeader] professes his love to be true, the foreign princess of his dreams remains unmoved by his infatuation. After weeks of intense courtship and romance, [From.GetPrincessName] has rejected the King’s wedding proposal and her decision comes with a public agreement from the [From.GetAdjective] government. Though obviously heartbroken by his scorned affections, the King remains resolute that he shall one day find an appropriate queen for his Kingdom.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.60.peter: For the first time since the dawn of the 20th century, [YUG.GetNameDef] sees its monarch coronated at the Cathedral of Belgrade in a somewhat secular affair, a reflection of the religious diversity present in the modern Yugoslav state. Though some would dispute the young King Peter’s ability to rule at such a young age, the crown now rests on his head and for better or worse, the future of Yugoslavia rests in [YUG.GetLeader.GetHerHis] hands.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.60.paul: For the first time since the dawn of the 20th century, [YUG.GetNameDef] sees its monarch coronated at the Cathedral of Belgrade in a traditional Serbian Orthodox ceremony. Though many still see King Paul as a usurper and more of a fascist dictator than a worthy King, the crown now rests on his head and for better or worse, the future of Yugoslavia rests in [YUG.GetLeader.GetHerHis] hands.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.70.t: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] Seeks to Sign the Tripartite Pact
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.70.desc: A telegram arrived from [From.GetLeader] to [Root.Capital.GetName] today expressing interest in signing a pact of non-aggression with the fascist powers of the world. Fearful of a [SOV.GetAdjective] invasion and growing nationalism within [From.GetLeader.GetHerHis] nation, [From.GetLeader] seeks to align [From.GetLeader.GetHerselfHimself] with [Root.GetNameDef]. Though this does not signify an official alliance, it does however bring [From.GetNameDef] into our sphere of influence and will expedite the process of a [From.GetAdjective] entrance into the [Root.GetFactionName].
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.701.tripartite_rejection: [FROM.GetLeader] has responded to the [ROOT.GetAdjective] proposal to sign the Tripartite Pact with dismissal, stating that they have “other ideas” for the future of our state.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.701.allied_objection: The decision to sign the Tripartite Pact has been deeply controversial both inside and outside of our nation and has thrown the legitimacy of [ROOT.GetLeader]’s right to act as regent for King Peter II, or if even such a regency is necessary. A group of officers from the Royal Yugoslav Army have declared Peter II of age and, with [From.GetAdjective] support, have marched on Belgrade and demanded the immediate removal of [ROOT.GetLeader] from power.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.701.a: We have no choice but to accept.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.702.desc: The [YUG.GetAdjective] government has today joined with the fascist nations in signing the Tripartite Pact. Although this does not yet signify that [YUG.GetNameDef] has joined the [From.GetFactionName], it does show a growing allegiance between the two nations and that [YUG.GetLeader] may hold some fascist sympathies. Many expect a [Root.GetAdjective] response to this worrying development, but [Root.GetLeader] has thus far remained silent on the issue…
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.702.b: I see no need to care.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.80.desc: [From.GetLeader] has today announced that [From.GetNameDef] would be willing to align itself with [Root.GetNameDef] and officially enter the [Root.GetFactionName] but only in exchange for our withdrawal from the Balkans in the form of surrendering our control of [163.GetName].
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.801.desc: Our delegation appears to have been ill-received in [From.GetNameDef] as the ambassador has instead responded by demanding [103.GetName] from us in exchange for [From.GetFactionName] membership.
loc.DOD_yugoslavia.802.desc: The friction on the border with [From.GetNameDef] will at last be resolved as the [From.GetAdjective] government has agreed to return Dalmatian territories currently under [From.GetAdjective] occupation back to their rightful Yugoslav controllers. [Root.GetLeader] has  today declared [From.GetLeader] to be a true friend to [Root.GetAdjective] freedom and self-determination, and the two nations now move forward as allies.
loc.czech.1.d: Our relations with the Czechs have been spotty in the past, but recently their politics have taken a sharp turn towards the right side of history. Combined with increasing pressure from Germany and a lack of faith in the ability of the Western democracies to protect them has resulted in a formal request to join the Comintern.
loc.czech.2.d: [SOV.GetLeader] has accepted our request to join the Comintern. Our delegation has joined the Executive Committee with full voting rights.
loc.czech.3.d: [SOV.GetLeader] has refused our request to join the Comintern, without giving any reason.
loc.czech.3.a: So much for our Slavic ties...
loc.czech.4.d: Relations with Romania have always been strained by their occupation of our rightful territory of Bessarabia, but as if that was not enough the entire nation impedes our ability to come to the aid of our [From.GetNameAdj] allies. Those same allies have now proposed a solution: Partition Romania between us to solve this problem once and for all!
loc.czech.5.d: [From.GetNameDefCap] has approved our solution to the Romania problem. The military is ready, and the campaign can begin at our discretion.
loc.czech.6.d: [From.GetLeader] has turned down our proposition concerning the Romania problem. It appears that he still has plans for Romania.
loc.czech.7.d: From the very beginning of our quest to liberate the workers of the world, Poland has been nothing but trouble. Now our [From.GetNameAdj] allies have made an interesting proposition: Poland has taken land from both of our nations, so why not repay the favor and divide Poland between us?
loc.czech.8.d: [From.GetNameDefCap] has approved our proposed solution to the Polish Situation. We will begin operations as soon as the order is given.
loc.czech.9.d: [From.GetNameDefCap] has not approved our proposal. We must bide our time and consider other options.
loc.czech.10.d: Since the end of the Great War, Poland has occupied German land. As if that wasn't enough, they have constantly attacked their neighbors to aggressively expand their territory. Our [From.GetNameAdj] allies have come to the same conclusion as us: To ensure the peace in Europe, the Polish state must be eliminated.
loc.czech.11.d: [From.GetNameDefCap] has approved our plan to deal with the Polish Situation. We can strike as soon as preparations are completed.
loc.czech.12.d: [From.GetNameDefCap] has rejected our solution to the Polish Situation. Time will tell if another opportunity arises.
loc.czech.14.d: Ever since we removed them from the government, the Slovak Leaders have been burning with resentment and inciting the population to violence. Today, their words have finally succeeded in bringing about the war they so desperately wanted. The Slovak Rebellion has begun.
loc.czech.14.a: If they want war, then they shall have it.
loc.czech.15.d: The last bastions of Slovak power have been crushed. The rebellion is at an end.
loc.czech.16.d: Despite initial misgivings, the Czechs have come to consider Bolshevism as the imminent threat it really is, and are now requesting to join the Axis powers. The government of [CZE.GetLeader] has specifically stated that this does not impact the question of the Sudetenland in any way.
loc.czech.17.d: [From.GetNameDefCap] has accepted our request to join the Axis!
loc.czech.18.d: [From.GetNameDefCap] has refused our request to join the Axis!
loc.czech.19.d: The government of [From.GetLeader] has realized what we have known all along: [From.GetNameDef] can only continue to exist under our protection. Although this precludes the possibility of directly occupying their land, it might be better to have a willing ally, and avoids any meddling by foreign actors.
loc.czech.20.d: [From.GetLeader] has accepted our offer. A [From.GetAdjective] plenipotentiary has arrived in Prague to coordinate policies.
loc.czech.21.d: When presented with our proposal, [From.GetLeader] reportedly exclaimed "Not in a Thousand Years!", before launching into a lengthy tirade about the inferiority of our people, our system of government, and the leadership qualities of [CZE.GetLeader]. No official refusal has been submitted, but our ambassador holds little hope.
loc.czech.21.a: Perhaps it is for the best.
loc.czech.22.d: The government of [From.GetNameDef] has offered up the Sudetenland as a step towards coming to a mutual understanding. On one hand, this is a great opportunity to acquire a rich state for little cost and with little danger. On the other hand, creating a crisis over the Sudetenland would be an excellent opportunity to show the world that the so-called Great Powers holding up the Treaty of Versailles are toothless and morally inferior.
loc.czech.23.d: [From.GetNameDefCap] has accepted our offer. [From.GetAdjective] troops have moved into the Sudetenland to the cheers of the local population.
loc.czech.23.a: They can ask no more, surely.
loc.czech.24.d: [From.GetLeader] has refused our offer to hand over the Sudetenland. He did not give any reason for this move, but the [From.GetAdjective] decision has sent a shockwave through the military, who believes the Germans might have bigger plans for us.
loc.czech.25.d: The government of [From.GetNameDef] has decided to reaffirm the 'Little Entente' alliance, which had lapsed in recent years in the face of growing German influence. Their foreign minister was recently in our capital to discuss whether we would be interested in joining the alliance as a permanent member.
loc.czech.26.d: [From.GetName] has agreed to join the Entente. A military delegation has arrived to discuss defensive arrangements.
loc.czech.27.d: While [From.GetLeader] agreed to meet our delegation, he has so far refused to commit his country to join the Entente. The [From.GetAdjective]s seem to be worried that joining our alliance might destabilize the careful balance of power in the region.
loc.czech.32.d: The Entente lead by [From.GetNameDef] has long been aimed at containing our nation. However, as German power grows, [From.GetNameDef] feels increasingly threatened from that direction. Unwilling to face a threat on two sides, [From.GetLeader] now seeks to come to an understanding with us. \n\nOur government is split on the issue. One faction believes that an agreement with [From.GetNameDef] is the first step to breaking the encirclement, while the other faction points to the fact that this would no doubt draw the wrath of [GER.GetLeader].
loc.czech.33.d: [From.GetLeader] was surprisingly open to our offer. We have signed a Treaty of Mutual Friendship, affirming that neither of us has any territorial claims on the other.
loc.czech.34.d: Surprising few, [From.GetLeader] has rejected our offer, citing our unwillingness to surrender certain territories to Hungary.
loc.dod_news.1.d: [From.GetName] has today announced that the almost-defunct 'Little Entente' alliance system will stand by their commitments. A statement released by the [From.GetNameAdj] Foreign office announced:\n'[From.GetName] is not a Great Power, but it is a Regional Power. It is our firm belief that an alliance of Regional Powers can and will prevent the so-called Great Powers from meddling in our affairs.
loc.dod_news.1.a: Together we are a Great Power.
loc.dod_news.1.c: We haven't forgotten who it was meant against.
loc.dod_news.1.e: We'll make short work of them regardless, if we must.
loc.dod_news.2.a: We will fight alongside our new allies to the bitter end.
loc.dod_news.2.b: They have made a wise choice.
loc.dod_news.2.d: Shocking much of Europe, [CZE.GetName] has signed a treaty of Alliance with [GER.GetNameDef]. [CZE.GetName], formerly strongly Democratic, has been drifting further and further towards the Right in recent months.
loc.dod_news.3.d: Shocking much of Europe, [CZE.GetName] has signed a treaty of Alliance with [SOV.GetNameDef]. [CZE.GetName], formerly strongly Democratic, has been drifting further and further towards the Left in recent months.
loc.dod_news.4.d: In a move that has surprised many, [CZE.GetName] today unilaterally surrendered the Sudetenland region to Germany. When questioned, a source in the [CZE.GetName] Foreign office replied that 'It was obvious which way the wind was blowing, this was the only path to national survival.' \n\nAn unnamed French minister reportedly condemned the [CZE.GetNameAdj] move, claiming the West would have supported [CZE.GetName] had Germany pressured them.
loc.dod_news.4.b: Through their foresight they prevented a crisis.
loc.DOD_romania.999.desc:
An exceptionally inebriated and emotional King Carol II hijacked today's strategy meeting, calling everyone's attention to a 'brilliant' idea he came up with the previous night.

Truly a romantic at heart, the King declared with tears in his eyes that he wished for the women in his life to know the intense and true love he feels for them. Addressing the Chiefs of Staff and the Cabinet with a lengthy, albeit rather slurred monologue, he appealed to their most delicate and heart-felt sensibilities, only to finish by solemnly calling for the renaming of two of the enemy's great cities as a tribute to that greatest and deepest of feelings known to man; love.

The King has clearly become entirely fixated upon this idea in his mind, and he is highly unlikely to budge easily should we wish to dissuade him.
loc.DOD_romania.a: He's truly a genius descended from the heavens!
loc.DOD_romania.b: Throw a party to distract him, instead. A -really- big one.
loc.DOD_romania.16.desc: Though currently aligned with [romania_former_ally_target.GetNameDef], changes within the [FROM.GetAdjective] government has made the nation more in-line with [ROOT.GetAdjective] ideals and [FROM.GetLeader] has expressed interest in joining the [ROOT.GetFactionName]. This is a historic opportunity, with the enemy’s back turned to [FROM.GetNameDef], the absolute last thing they would ever expect is [FROM.GetAdjective] troops turning their guns against them.
loc.DOD_romania.161.desc: Unfortunately, the [FROM.GetAdjective] foreign minister has delivered [FROM.GetNameDef]’s message which is, without question, outright betrayal of the [ROOT.GetFactionName] and [ROOT.GetRulingIdeology] ideals! [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has declared that she will now fight for the [romania_new_ally_target.GetFactionName].
loc.DOD_romania.161.a: We should’ve known [FROM.GetLeader] wasn’t to be trusted!
loc.DOD_romania.162.desc: We have been informed that [romania_new_ally_target.GetNameDef] has accepted our request for entry into the [romania_new_ally_target.GetFactionName] and soon, [romania_former_ally_target.GetLeader] will learn how a true [ROOT.GetAdjective] soldier fights.
loc.DOD_romania.601.desc: Observing the internal strife which has characterized [YUG.GetNameDef], [ROM.GetLeader] has decided to continue [ROM.GetLeader.GetHerHis] policy of Balkan Dominance by dividing the Yugoslav people among several local powers. [Root.GetNameDefCap] is among the nations invited to divide Yugoslavia, and while this is an enticing opportunity to expand our Balkan territories, we will be obligated to join the conflict in the event that Yugoslavia refuses the ultimatum.
loc.DOD_romania.601.b: Perhaps we should stay out of this.
loc.DOD_romania.163.desc: Codreanu was a threat to the future of the Romanian state. His reckless actions were cause for arrest, for the sake of stability. His death shall serve as a valuable reminder that one can choose to be a good example, or a terrible warning. A more measured and responsible leader awaits the fascists of Romania.
loc.HUN_balanced_budget_desc: We must make the best with the resources at our disposal. A well-planned and balanced budget is key to our government's success.
loc.HUN_strengthen_the_monarchists_desc: The first step in returning Hungary to its previous prestige is to strengthen those parties that clamor for a return to a monarchy.
loc.HUN_elect_a_king_desc: Popular support for the nation to return to a monarchy government form is now sufficient that we can begin to think about initiating the process of electing a new King.
loc.HUN_invite_the_habsburg_prince_desc: Long have the Habsburgs ruled Hungary, and under their rule the country was a part of one of Europe's greatest empires. Returning a Habsburg to the helm will surely lead Hungary to greatness once more.
loc.HUN_demand_a_referendum_desc: The dissolution of Austria-Hungary was a mistake. Austria and Hungary are stronger together, and a combination of both is required for either to achieve greatness. The Austrians must be made to hold a referendum on a proposal for the peaceful joining of our two nations.
loc.HUN_take_austria_by_force_desc: The first step in returning glory to Hungary is to re-integrate the Austrian lands. We cannot risk a failure in achieving this diplomatically, so we must do so through force.
loc.HUN_proclaim_the_restoration_of_austria_: With the reunification of our two nations and a Habsburg on the throne, we can now solemnly proclaim the restoration of Austria-Hungary, and see to retaking our rightful historical provinces!
loc.HUN_protect_czechoslovakia_desc: Czechoslovakia has, since its independence, grown powerful and industrious, but their lands are eyed greedily by their neighbors. We will offer them our protection against these threats, either by welcoming them once again as an integral part of our Empire, or by granting them association status.
loc.HUN_claim_transylvania_desc: The area of Siebenbürgen was unfairly taken from us after the last war. It is time to reclaim it.
loc.HUN_march_to_the_shore_desc: A true Great Power requires access to the seas. The coast of the Adriatic is our birthright.
loc.HUN_reclaim_venetia_desc: The treachery of the Italians in the Great War has not been forgotten. It is time to put them in their place, and restore the Empire to its natural borders.
loc.HUN_claim_galicia_desc: The state of Poland is nothing but an artificial construct. It can be created and dismantled as necessary.
loc.HUN_claim_the_bucovina_desc: It may not be the most economically important of our wide-spread holdings, but it is still a part of our Empire. And we will reclaim it.
loc.HUN_reclaim_the_empire_desc: To finalize our de jure territorial demands, we must claim the various titles in Germany, Italy and Palestine that our Habsburg monarch has to his name.
loc.HUN_elect_a_democratic_king_desc: We must seek a King who will uphold the democratic principles of our nation and the rights of our people.
loc.HUN_responsible_government_desc: Traditionally, the government has ultimately answered to the king, allowing it to ignore the will of the people. We will change the constitution to ensure that it is the people, and not the ruler, who holds the government responsible.
loc.HUN_rapproachement_with_little_entente_d: Hostile ideologies surround us, and we must re-affirm our ties to our Little Entente neighbours. We will ask them if they wish to see us rearm.
loc.HUN_join_allies_desc: The future of Hungary and its democratic values lies with the major Western democracies and their alliance. As a member of this alliance, we may lend our strength to theirs, as well as count on their support ourselves.
loc.HUN_the_balkan_pact_desc: The democracies of the West are too far away to aid us, and so we must seek allies closer to home. As the leader of the Balkan Pact, we will offer them our protection and lead them to victory!
loc.HUN_an_unlikely_alliance_desc: We have changed our country fundamentally. We are no longer the war mongers of old. The time has come to reach out to our old enemy and forge a new destiny - together.
loc.HUN_joint_oil_exploitation_company_desc: With the prospect of possible oil fields in our territory, we have attracted foreign attention. Friendly powers are eager to support our oil industry with their technical know-how, and this would be a lucrative opportunity to learn from their advances.
loc.HUN_elect_a_fascist_king_desc: Our nation needs a powerful leader to steer it through the coming turbulent years. Our ruler must be one that the people can look up to, and our enemies can fear.
loc.HUN_economic_intervention_desc: We must direct ample political resources to direct our economy. Though it is adequate, we can make it stronger and more efficient yet.
loc.HUN_strengthen_fascists_desc: Fascist elements in our country must be strengthened and given a public platform to spread their ideology. Their views on the future of Hungary are the most likely to lead the country to greatness once more.
loc.HUN_renounce_the_treaty_of_trianon_tt: §YMiklós Horthy§! or §YFriedrich Franz of Mecklenburg-Schwerin§! becomes the country leader.\n
loc.HUN_renounce_the_treaty_of_trianon_desc: The injustice forced upon our nation at the end of the Great War, ripping away two-thirds of our once-great nation's territory and population, rivals that of the disgrace visited upon Germany in the Treaty of Versailles, and it must be undone.
loc.HUN_renew_the_rome_protocols_desc: In light of Germany's continuing revisionism, we must renew the Rome Protocols drawn up and signed in 1934. The agreements would serve not only to further isolate the German and Yugoslavian threats, but also as a possible precursor to an actual alliance.
loc.HUN_protect_austria_desc: To further stand against Germany we must resist their open ambitions for unification with Austria. We can grant them a guarantee, giving the current government the political strength they need to hopefully stand up to pro-German elements.
loc.HUN_alliance_with_italy_desc: The initial overtures towards an alliance that were made in the Rome Protocols can now be expanded upon. We will send a delegation to Italy to discuss a binding agreement for extensive military co-operation, both defensively and offensively.
loc.HUN_trade_deal_with_germany_desc: The benefits to our industry of increased trade relations with Germany are clear, and claims of potential over-reliance of our economy on the Germans are exaggerated. We will go ahead and sign an extensive trade agreement.
loc.HUN_joint_aluminum_mining_company_desc: As aluminum is an integral part of the modern war industry, we could easily obtain German support to expand the mines in the north of our country.
loc.HUN_join_axis_desc: As our economy is already so reliant on the Germans, it is only logical that we shall follow them in war. We will send them a request for formal entry into the Axis alliance.
loc.HUN_reaffirm_territorial_claims_desc: With the rejection of the Treaty of Trianon, we must now proceed to reaffirm our claims to the territories that were stolen from us.
loc.HUN_demand_transylvania_desc: If we can regain our territories without bloodshed, so much the better. Romania will be given an ultimatum demanding the transfer of our rightful lands.
loc.HUN_demand_southern_slovakia_desc: If we can regain our territories without bloodshed, so much the better. Czechoslovakia will be given an ultimatum demanding the transfer of our rightful lands.
loc.HUN_demand_the_vojvodina_desc: If we can regain our territories without bloodshed, so much the better. Yugoslavia will be given an ultimatum demanding the transfer of our rightful lands.
loc.HUN_claim_overlordship_over_slovakia_des: The remainder of Slovakia must also be re-integrated into the Hungarian state, either directly or by becoming a dependency. We will send another ultimatum.
loc.HUN_proclaim_greater_hungary_desc: Having regained the territory we were due, the size of our country has increased to our historical borders. We may now in full confidence proclaim the formation of Greater Hungary to the world, and set our eyes on new targets.
loc.HUN_demands_tt: When demanding territory, the other side is more likely to hand it over without bloodshed if you have a strong army. However, they may still believe they can stand up to us if they are in a faction. \n
loc.HUN_assassinate_horthy_desc: The old Great War admiral holds far too much power and influence in his current capacity as Regent of the Kingdom of Hungary, and his stance against communism is proving to be quite a problem for our comrades' efforts. He must be removed from power if our nation is to find its way to the Revolution.
loc.HUN_council_of_peoples_commissars_desc: A governing body must be created that can oversee the transition of Hungary into a communist state. Once this has been done, this Council will serve as the analogue to the Western system of a cabinet formed by ministers.
loc.HUN_the_hungarian_red_army_desc: All motherland-loving patriots must do their duty in defense of their homeland. We will form a Hungarian Red Army, following the example of the Soviets in the East, which will protect our fledgling Revolution.
loc.HUN_soviet_hungarian_military_academy_de: Our army is nothing without its leadership. The Soviets have far more experience in military matters, so it may be beneficial to cooperate with them in the training of our finest military minds. To this end we will establish a military academy with the most skilled instructors from both our nations.
loc.HUN_join_comintern_desc: The way forward for the Revolution lies with the Comintern. Standing together with our comrades, we will sweep aside capitalist injustice and the fascist threat that looms in the West.
loc.HUN_the_revolutionary_council_desc: The Comintern has abandoned the struggle against imperialism, instead opting to settle for coexistence. If the workers of the world are to be free, we must carry the torch of Marx and Lenin forward - even against the Soviet Union, if need be.
loc.HUN_pressure_romania_desc: As we focus on the Fascist danger in the West, we cannot allow a potential threat to continue to exist in our rear, especially not when it lies between ourselves and our allies to the East. Romania must be secured as a fellow communist state, or the important land routes to our allies must be turned over to ensure we are able to receive their support.
loc.HUN_intervene_in_czechoslovakia_desc: The Czechoslovaks have been awarded some of the territories taken from us in the Treaty of Trianon. At the same time, we know of the German designs on their lands. Perhaps we would be able to arrange a trade; our rightful lands in return for a guarantee of Soviet military support in the case of German aggression.
loc.HUN_industrial_revitalization_desc: Our industrial base has dangerously decayed in recent years. We must make an effort to adopt new technologies to make up for lost ground.
loc.HUN_support_urbanization_desc: More and more people are leaving the villages and smaller towns to move to the big urban centers, looking for work in new factories. Even if we can not offer them employment straight away, we can build new city quarters to prepare the way for a later expansion.
loc.HUN_institute_for_industrial_techniques_: The ad-hoc nature of industrial research has led to slower growth and lower productivity. We should create a new institute that bundles all research into new industrial methods.
loc.HUN_announce_the_gyor_program_desc: Our military is dangerously weak, and it is imperative that we boost its size and fighting capability. To do this we must significantly bolster our industry, to keep up with the growing demands in equipment. The five-year Györ Program will increase government spending not only on the military itself, but also on ancillary sectors such as industry, agriculture, infrastructure, and education.
loc.HUN_civilian_industry_desc: Despite the need for more military industry, we must not neglect our civilian needs. An expansion of civilian industry is therefore in order.
loc.HUN_reintegrate_the_railroads_desc: The railway networks spanning the old Austria-Hungarian empire have become fragmented since its dissolution in independent nations. We should approach the other former constituent states and propose a reintegration of our railway networks, to improve the infrastructure overall.
loc.HUN_invite_foreign_investors_desc: Hungary lies at the heart of Eastern Europe, and we could well use our central location to attract foreign investors with an interest in improving our infrastructure and industry.
loc.HUN_expand_the_manfred_weiss_steel_works: Expand the Manfred Weiss Steel Works

The massive Manfed Weiss Steel Works have been an integral defense contractor since the Great War saw a huge expansion of the facilities. If we are to increase our military in preparation of the next war, the pride of our national industry will once more have to be enlarged.
loc.HUN_expand_the_aluminum_industry_desc: We require all available resources, both for export and for domestic use. Our aluminum industry, though already expansive, has further room for improvement, and we should direct resources to this end immediately.
loc.HUN_expand_the_technical_university_of_b: Expand the Technical University of Budapest

We require more bright minds to come up with breakthrough discoveries that will aid us in the conflicts ahead. By expanding our capital's university we can increase the pool of skilled engineers and scientists for our military industry.
loc.HUN_support_domestic_industry_desc: The military requires more equipment, and our industry must keep up. We will direct new resources to an expansion of our arms industry.
loc.HUN_domestic_arms_industry_desc: Our arms industry must be supported by a strong civilian industrial base, not only for production of industrial equipment but also for the establishment of new factories.
loc.HUN_autarky_desc: We are far too dependent on foreign sources of oil. We should emulate the German efforts at developing synthetic oil.
loc.HUN_synthetic_industry_desc: Now that we have mastered the technology to liquify coal, we can build a pilot plant to begin production.
loc.HUN_synthetic_oil_tt: Adds a synthetic refinery to a random state. The location will be displayed once research has proven synthetic oil production is feasible.\n
loc.HUN_aeronautic_technology_institute_desc: The air has become a new aspect of warfare, and is proving to be underestimated in importance by many. We must learn to master this new dimension, and allocate resources to the development of new doctrines and equipment that allow us to do so.
loc.HUN_boost_hungarian_aviation_industry_de: Our industrial base must be strengthened to allow for the production of new airplane models in sufficient quantities to gain mastery of the air.
loc.HUN_secret_rearmament_desc: The restrictions imposed on us by the Treaty of Trianon prohibit us from increasing the size of our army. Even so, the world's political climate is becoming ever more turbulent, and conflict looms over the horizon. We cannot remain defenseless, and we must begin to rearm even if it means secretly breaking the stipulations of the peace treaty imposed on us after the Great War.
loc.HUN_secret_rearmament_tt_2: §RSpirit will be removed when increasing conscription beyond §YVolunteer Only§!.§!\n
loc.HUN_war_games_desc: By engaging in small-scale war games, we can discover flaws in our current military structure, and use the experience gained to adjust deficiencies.
loc.HUN_theoretical_air_efforts_desc: We must spend ample resources on working out new theories regarding air warfare. If we go to war the theories that may be developed will be invaluable.
loc.HUN_bled_agreement_desc: Small-scale secret re-armament will not suffice. We must reach out to our neighbors and request redress of the treaty imposed on us after the Great War. Hungary has an equal right to armament.
loc.HUN_bled_agreement_custom_effect_tooltip: Can lead to the replacement of the §HTreaty of Trianon§!.
loc.HUN_establish_the_air_force_desc: With legal restrictions now out of the way, it is time to officially establish the Hungarian air force.
loc.HUN_indigenous_designs_desc: Our own technical expertise is sufficient for our needs. Control over our own design bureau enables us to allocate more resources to it, thereby increasing the speed of development of new designs.
loc.HUN_heavy_fighter_effort_desc: Our fighters must be able to support the more vulnerable bomber airplanes. This requires heavier armament and longer range at the cost of some speed and maneuverability.
loc.HUN_light_fighter_effort_desc: We need fighter aircraft to acquire local air superiority in the skies above our forces, and to intercept any enemy planes that threaten our nation.
loc.HUN_cas_focus_desc: A modern army needs support from vehicles not only on the ground, but also in the air.
loc.HUN_tac_focus_desc: Victory will be achieved by annihilating the enemy's ground forces. We must focus on supporting our own armies with tactical strikes against close and deep targets.
loc.HUN_license_foreign_designs_desc: Foreign air forces have already shown that they possess tried-and-proven designs of very high quality. Rather than tempt fate and rely on our nascent aeronautical expertise, we should request to be allowed to produce these foreign models under license.
loc.HUN_fighter_competition_desc: In order for us to be able to select the best model of fighter airplane to produce under license, we must pit the contenders against each other. We will organize a fighter competition and invite all major powers to send their most modern fighter models to participate.
loc.HUN_bomber_competition_desc: In order for us to be able to select the best model of bomber airplane to produce under license, we must pit the contenders against each other. We will organize a bomber competition and invite all major powers to send their most modern bomber models to participate.
loc.HUN_joint_air_development_desc: The best means of developing new aircraft models is through cooperation with our allies. By bringing together the brightest minds of all our nations, we will attain the best results.
loc.HUN_army_maneuvers_desc: Our army must be brought back in shape for potential future armed conflicts. We will send them on maneuvers to develop new tactics and strategies.
loc.HUN_mobile_focus_desc: A mobile army, with the capacity to strike when and where it will do the most damage, is the key to military success.
loc.HUN_the_botond_desc: To adequately meet our supply and transportation demands we require a new form of truck. Initial renditions of the Rába 38M Botond design have proven to be successful in trials, and with appropriate resources we can finalize the design and begin production.
loc.HUN_develop_tanks_desc: The nations surrounding us have identified the importance of the tank, and are producing them in great numbers. We must develop our own tank designs and attempt to keep up with our allies and adversaries.
loc.HUN_assault_gun_focus_desc: Rather than focus on full-fledged tanks, we will instead rely on assault guns to aid our infantry in affecting break-throughs, as a more cost-effective alternative.
loc.HUN_joint_tank_procurement_desc: Together with our allies we can develop new tank models much more effectively. We will set up a joint procurement bureau where our engineers can work together to identify the best designs to move forward with.
loc.HUN_armored_warfare_desc: Our motorized divisions will require armored support to be truly effective. We must pour more resources into the development of new armor designs.
loc.HUN_mobile_corps_doctrine_desc: With both motorized and armor elements now in production, we must look at new theoretical approaches to how these can work together on the battlefield.
loc.HUN_home_defense_desc: Small mobile forces will not be able to defend our nation in the case of attack. We must form an impenetrable front-line, and develop new doctrines to increase the effectiveness of such an approach.
loc.HUN_danuvia_submachine_guns_desc: Our infantry requires good weaponry to improve their effectiveness. The initial Danuvia 43M prototypes have performed well in tests, and by increasing funding for its development we may soon be able to begin producing the weapon en masse.
loc.HUN_artillery_effort_desc: Artillery is key for improved effectiveness of our forces. We will develop modern artillery models so that they will have the best artillery support we can provide.
loc.HUN_motorized_logistics_desc: The key to mobile warfare is the ability to move men and material across large distances quickly. Even the best tank will quickly become useless if it is not resupplied.
loc.HUN_light_infantry_divisions_doctrine_te:
Enables §HLight Infantry Divisions Doctrine§!
§HInfantry
    Forest§!
      Attack: §G+2%§!
      Movement: §G+5%§!
    §HUrban§!
      Attack: §G+5%§!
      Movement: §G+5%§!
loc.HUN_light_infantry_divisions_doctrine_de: We must make do with the limited manpower at our disposal. If we want more divisions, they necessarily have to be smaller. Light infantry divisions provide an optimal mix of striking power and size, and we will make it the backbone of our military.
loc.HUN_form_parachute_battalions_desc: Infantry landed by air assault will give us the capability to react quickly to any unexpected threat or tactical opportunity.
loc.HUN_naval_warfare_desc: After regaining a coastline, we must focus our efforts on rebuilding a fleet fit for a major power.
loc.HUN_restauration_desc: We can not waste time on experimenting with new and unproven technologies. We will stick with tried and tested designs from the days of the old Empire.
loc.HUN_reform_desc: It makes little sense to create a navy built around outdated ideas. We have been given the opportunity to create a new navy from scratch, without the baggage of the old. We should use it to build the most modern and capable navy we can.
loc.HUN_capital_ships_desc: The core of a navy is the battleship. We must make up for lost time and begin construction of new vessels as soon as possible.
loc.HUN_destroyer_desc: Destroyers are a vital, but often overlooked, part of the fleet. Together with the low cost, they are a good start for any naval expansion program.
loc.HUN_cruisers_desc: Even the most potent force is useless if it can not find the enemy or protect itself against aircraft. Designing new light and heavy cruisers helps us turn a collection of ships into an actual fleet.
loc.HUN_submarines_desc: Submarines came close to beating the most powerful navy on the planet in the last war. We can not be taken seriously as a modern navy if we do not possess submarines of our own.
loc.HUN_carriers_desc: The battleship is a relic of a time long gone. The future of naval warfare is the carrier and the airplane. We will be at the forefront of this development.
loc.fighter_tt: Must have an up-to-date fighter to offer and be at peace with [Root.GetName]
loc.bomber_tt: Must have an up-to-date bomber to offer and be at peace with [Root.GetName]
loc.ROM_preserve_greater_romania_desc: We have at last managed to unite all Romanian speakers in our country. Now, we must ensure that our children may inherit our legacy of a Romania for all Romanians.
loc.ROM_a_deal_with_the_devil_desc: [SOU.GetNameDefCap] is a threat to our eastern border, and territorial demands may only be just over the horizon. Perhaps it would be better to join the [SOU.GetAdjective]s rather than fight them.
loc.ROM_form_peasant_militias_desc: With the communist ideals that we take from our neighbour comes the duty of every man to defend his comrades, his country, and the revolution.
loc.ROM_basing_rights_for_soviet_union_desc: We know the [SOU.GetAdjective]s desire our territory, but we might be able to preclude any hostilities by offering our neighbour basing rights.
loc.ROM_romanian_volunteer_brigades_desc: We will establish volunteer brigades in an effort to support fledgling revolutions in other nations.
loc.ROM_join_comintern_desc: The time has come to finally petition for membership in the Comintern. This will protect our territory against claims from the East, and enable us to more actively champion the cause of communism globally.
loc.ROM_trade_treaty_with_germany_desc: We know of the German economic interest in our country. Arranging increased delivery of goods such as oil will enable us to request German aid in modernizing our military.
loc.ROM_german_romanian_oil_exploitation_com: German need for oil is tremendous, providing us with a lucrative opportunity to expand our oil refineries.
loc.ROM_invite_german_advisors_desc: German aid is essential if we want to modernize our military. They possess the technical know-how that we require, and so we should request the help of their advisors.
loc.ROM_invite_german_advisors_tt: Permit Germany to station troops on Romanian soil.\n
loc.ROM_license_german_equipment_desc: German equipment is superior to our own, but perhaps we could obtain the licenses to produce these weapons, ourselves.
loc.ROM_join_axis_desc: The time has come to join the Axis, so that we may carve out a glorious Romanian future alongside the Germans.
loc.ROM_demand_transnistria_desc: Now that we are strong and have German backing, the time has come to demand the region of Transnistria, incorporating it into Greater Romania.
loc.ROM_renew_the_romanian_polish_alliance_d: Our old ties with Poland have cooled in recent years. As the threats surrounding us have not diminished, and the global political situation grows ever more tumultuous, the time has come to revive our alliance with our northern neighbour.
loc.ROM_the_cordon_sanitaire_desc: We are bordered by dangerous ideologies both to the east and to the west. Together with our neighbours to the north and south, we will establish a barrier, quarantining these dogmas and preventing them from advancing any further.
loc.ROM_demand_a_western_guarantee_desc: If we are to stand against both communism and fascism, we will require Western aid. We will use all of the political leverage at our disposal to obtain such a guarantee.
loc.ROM_military_modernization_desc: Even with Western support, we must see to modernizing the army, so that our allies have time to support us before all is lost.
loc.ROM_join_allies_desc: A guarantee is not enough - it is time to declare for the Western democracies fully, and stand with them in defense of liberty.
loc.ROM_joint_allied_staff_college_desc: In light of our shared interests, we should cooperate with the Western powers in the development of military equipment and tactics.
loc.ROM_civil_works_desc: Greater Romania will require an extensive program of industrial development if it is to support a large-scale military build-up. We will start it now.
loc.ROM_national_defense_industry_desc: We must greatly expand our national arms industry if we are to keep up with increased demands.
loc.ROM_agrarian_reform_desc: Our agrarian sector has ample room for improvement. Streamlining it and improving its efficiency will free up work forces that can be employed in other sectors, such as construction and arms production.
loc.ROM_danubian_transport_network_desc: Our transport capabilities alongside the Danube can be drastically improved upon, both by utilizing the river itself more effectively and the way it is connected to our road and rail networks.
loc.ROM_malaxa_desc: We must expand our domestic automobile industry, so that it may be easily converted and appropriated for military purposes, when required. To this end, one of our business tycoons has some rather interesting ideas that we could make use of...
loc.ROM_invite_foreign_motor_companies_desc: Rather than expend resources on increasing production of unproven domestic automobile designs, we would benefit more from producing tried and tested foreign designs under license.
loc.ROM_hunedoara_steel_works_desc: To feed the needs of our arms production the great steel works in Transylvania must be modernized and drastically expanded.
loc.ROM_invest_in_the_iar_desc: It is critical to keep up with the demands of a modern air force. Our industry must be capable not only of building the machines we require in the first place, but also of doing so at a pace fast enough to replace operational losses.
loc.ROM_expand_ploiesti_oil_production_desc: We possess some of the largest oil fields in Europe in Ploiesti, and these are of tremendous importance not only for ourselves, but also for our allies and other nations in the region. We should increase the fields' production to better meet the demands.
loc.ROM_expand_the_university_of_bucharest_d: By improving the quality and capacity of our university, we can increase the pool of best and brightest that we rely on for our technological advances.
loc.ROM_exploit_the_baita_mines_desc: It is beginning to become clear that uranium is of vital importance to some of the most drastic technological advances in weaponry since the invention of the firearm. We are lucky enough to have a large deposit of the stuff within our borders, and we should set up a mine to exploit it.
loc.ROM_balkans_dominance_desc: The key to a prosperous Romanian future lies not with the revolutionaries of the East, or the democracies or fascists of the West, but with Romanian dominance of the balkans.
loc.ROM_puppet_bulgaria_desc: Warmongering Bulgaria has long been a thorn in their neighbors' sides. We must subjugate them once and for all.
loc.ROM_align_hungary_desc: Hungary must be made to see our point of view. Their government is led by misguided elements that can only serve to lead the country to ruin. They would be stronger with us.
loc.ROM_secure_greece_desc: Greece - though often an ally in the past - must be made to accept Romanian dominance in the region.
loc.ROM_divide_yugoslavia_desc: The current arrangement of the balkan states making up Yugoslavia is not maintainable. We will issue an ultimatum requiring a restructuring of their component states, under Romanian leadership.
loc.ROM_split_czechoslovakia_desc: Czechoslovakia is an artificial construct that can not survive on its own. We can not allow this part to slip into chaos and must intervene before the situation becomes untenable.
loc.ROM_secure_the_bosporus_desc: Our naval access is, for now, limited to the Black Sea. Turkey, straddling the Bosporus Strait, could block our access to the mediterranean in the case of war, and so we must ensure free passage for when we have need of it.
loc.ROM_institute_royal_dictatorship_desc: The time has come to further increase the King's already-extensive powers, bringing political stability to the nation and enabling it to focus on threats from outside.
loc.ROM_fortify_the_borders_desc: Now that the domestic situation is under control, we must look at improving the defence of our borders from outside threats.
loc.ROM_flexible_foreign_policy_desc: We must abandon our principles and forge relations with whoever it would be more practical to do so with. Our survival depends on it.
