loc.defense_of_democracy_goal_desc: Democracy is under threat. We must work together to ensure that the democratic countries in the world do not fall one by one.
loc.containment_of_communism_goal_desc: The world cannot be safe until the Communist threat is put down.
loc.suppress_regional_fascism_goal_desc: Fascism is threatening to spread like a wildfire. The more countries that fall to its claws, the more dangerous the situation around us will become.
loc.suppress_regional_communism_goal_desc: We must do whatever it takes to keep as much of [ROOT.GetCountryContinent] free from the communist yoke.
loc.regional_expansionism_goal_desc: Our Faction should take the lead and dominate in [ROOT.GetCountryContinent]
loc.suppress_regional_democracy_goal_desc: The so-called democratic countries are the biggest threat to our ideals. We need to ensure that they are only in control of a minority of [ROOT.GetCountryContinent].
loc.between_the_seas_goal_desc: By creating a solid wall of allied territory, from the Black sea to the Baltic, we can withstand any potential threat.
loc.little_entente_goal_desc: The Paris Peace Treaties stipulated the borders of [GER.GetName], [HUN.GetName], [BUL.GetName], and [AUS.GetName]. Our main aim is to ensure that these countries do not start annexing border territories, and once again destroy the peace in Europe.
loc.china_territorial_integrity_goal_desc: China should be liberated and united under one ruling party. Only by regaining control of our territories from external and internal enemies, can we can restore China to glory.
loc.china_wang_front_expansion_desc: It is time to counter the colonialist powers' influence over East Asia. We need to build our own power block in the region, so that we will never again be dominated.
loc.strength_in_unity_goal_desc: Countries in our corner of the world should stand together. By building a strong faction, we have the best chances possible of remaining independent and neutral.
loc.conquest_of_territory_goal_desc: In a hostile world, expansion is vital to survival. Expansion creates buffer zones and gives us access to more resources.
loc.spread_of_communism_goal_desc: The time has come for the masses to rise. And where the masses aren't able to rise, we must help them by force of arms.
loc.control_of_the_balkans_goal_desc: External Powers have always tried to spread their influence to the Balkans. We need to ensure that we stand strong together, and counter any foreign incursions into the region.
loc.african_decolonization_goal_desc: The time for Africa to stand up against its adversaries and oppressors has come. We must free the continent, by force if necessary!
loc.habsburg_hegemony_goal_desc: The family is the most important part of any union, and our alliance is no different. We must secure the crowns of Europe, and spread our influence throughout.
loc.indifference_is_a_threat_goal_desc: With a major conflict almost inevitable in Europe, we must ensure that there are no surprises. Any country refusing to take a side must be removed.
loc.security_through_expansion_goal_desc: We need to create a shield around our territory and secure a ring of states around our current borders.
loc.an_iron_curtain_goal_name_desc: In order to better protect the motherland, we must create a curtain of puppet states around us to keep any unwanted visitors out.
loc.eastern_european_security_goal_desc: In order to better protect our interests in Eastern Europe, we must step in and set up like-minded regimes to our west.
loc.mare_nostrum_goal_desc: It has always been the dream of our people to turn the Mediterranean into our own inland sea. The time has come to make that dream a reality!
loc.pax_romana_goal_desc: It has always been the dream of our people to restore the glory of the Roman Empire. The time has come to make that dream a reality!
loc.building_up_guam_goal_desc: We need to secure the connection to [PHI.GetNameDef], in case of a conflict with [JAP.GetName]. Additionally, it would be very advantageous to have a closer staging point for our navies, should we ever go to war with the [JAP.GetAdjective]. [638.GetName] fits the bill perfectly.
loc.the_two_seas_goal_name: Establish Baltic and Black Sea Presence
loc.the_two_seas_goal_desc: We should ensure we have a strong naval presence in the Baltic Sea as well as in the Black Sea.
loc.one_germany_goal_desc: In order to build a strong and united power base, we first must ensure that Germany is strong and united. The Paris Peace treaties forbade any German Reunification. Now is the time to prove that we are not bound by useless treaties.
loc.guardians_of_peace_goal_desc: Storm clouds are building on the horizon. We need to guard against war breaking out too early, so that our alliance has time to properly prepare for the inevitable conflict.
loc.growing_the_faction_desc: Our faction must have more members if it is to be taken seriously on the geopolitical stage.
loc.a_large_faction_goal_name: Invite More Countries to our Faction
loc.a_large_faction_goal_desc: By growing even larger our faction will be able to project its influence even further.
loc.preemptive_strike_on_fascism_goal_name: Launch a Pre-emptive Strike on a Fascist Country
loc.preemptive_strike_on_fascism_goal_desc: We shouldn't wait for them to hit us. We need to ensure that we have the initiative.
loc.a_great_fortress_goal_desc: Preparedness is the key. By securing the border regions, and key points, using the most modern of fortifications, we can ensure that the enemy can't defeat us.
loc.aggressive_defense_goal_desc: We shall not yield one inch to the enemy. Our soldiers must be instilled with the understanding that the key is not to die for our country, but to make the enemy die for theirs.
loc.war_on_communism_goal_desc: We need to stop the spread of communism by any means necessary.
loc.war_on_democracy_goal_desc: We need to strike against our ideological enemies.
loc.defeat_of_communism_goal_desc: To defeat world communism we need to start at home by eradicating communism in our part of the world.
loc.defeat_of_fascism_goal_desc: To stop the spread of fascism once and for all, we need to start at home by eradicating fascism in our part of the world.
loc.defeat_of_anti_communists_goal_desc: The first step towards a world revolution is the successful conversion of regional powers that oppose this. Thus we need to remove any threats on our own continent first and foremost.
loc.defeat_of_anti_fascists_goal_desc: We must aim to destroy the anti-fascist governments on our continent.
loc.defeating_our_enemies_goal_desc: The times are uncertain and war is inevitable. We must ensure that however that war comes, we end up on the winning side.
loc.is_victor_in_pc_tt: Is on the winning side in a peace conference
loc.a_military_base_goal_desc: The crusade against communism requires guns. In order to produce guns in large quantities we need a strong military industry.
loc.resource_control_goal_desc: The faction needs to ensure it has the resources it needs to take on any threat in the world
loc.secure_european_continent_goal_desc: We must ensure that the European Continent is aligned with our cause. The [faction.GetName] should rule supreme in Europe.
loc.secure_north_africa_goal_desc: We should strive to dominate not only Europe, but also ensure that we can get more than just a foothold in North Africa.
loc.an_armored_fist_goal_desc: New times create opportunities for new warfare. Tanks are the future. We need to ensure that we, as a faction, have enough to dominate the battlefield.
loc.an_infantry_army_goal_desc: The backbone of any army is its infantry. We need a sizeable infantry army to back up our claims on both the diplomatic arena, and in the field.
loc.high_seas_fleet_goal_desc: Ensuring our enemies do not have control over the North Atlantic is vital to our operations. If we can disrupt that it both means we won't suffer the effects of a Naval blockade, and that our fleets can roam freely.
loc.control_the_chinese_coast_goal_desc: If attacked, we should strive to maintain access to the sea for as long as possible. Our survival is linked to our ability to receive goods from countries across the sea.
loc.guerilla_expansion_goal_desc: We may not be able to contest the invaders on their own terms, so we shall contest them on our terms.
loc.industrial_expansion_goal_desc: The best way to create a strong faction is to have a strong industrial base. We need to ensure that we have the industrial strength needed to become an important power.
loc.industrial_domination_goal_desc: Modern warfare is all about production capabilities. Let us ensure that we have the largest industrial capability the world has seen.
loc.industrial_research_goal_desc: In order to become a dominant player, we need to ensure that we have the industrial know-how across the faction.
loc.secure_chinese_waters_goal_desc: We can dominate on land, but with a long coastline making sure that no one can invade us should be of highest priority. This safety starts far out at sea.
loc.faction_goal_subjugate_the_faction_desc: The only way that we will be able to resist the onslaught of the foreign invaders is if we present a unified front with strong leadership. From many different voices a great choir shall sound.
loc.faction_goal_north_subjugated_desc: If we were to make a concerted effort in integrating this part of our faction the rest of the warlords would understand which way the wind blows and get in line.
loc.faction_goal_west_subjugated_desc: If we were to make a concerted effort in integrating this part of our faction the rest of the warlords would understand which way the wind blows and get in line.
loc.faction_goal_south_subjugated_desc: If we were to make a concerted effort in integrating this part of our faction the rest of the warlords would understand which way the wind blows and get in line.
loc.faction_goal_no_japanese_in_china_desc: For too long have the Japanese oppressed our people. They can no longer be allowed to stay in China.
loc.faction_goal_the_northern_mandate_desc: If our people shall be able to prosper we will need the territory and resources that can be found in the Siberia. The current control isn't able to utilise it properly so we do have a right to it.
loc.faction_goal_the_southern_mandate_desc: In a glorious past we exerted influence in the areas to our south and we shall do it yet again. With the wealth that can be found in the area there is no end to what we could do.
loc.faction_goal_the_greater_game_desc: Empires sought to impose their will on Central Asia and were repelled. Our hour has come to advance westward and across the steppes again.
loc.suppress_asian_communism_goal_desc: Communism is a threat to traditional ways of life, to the natural order of things. We must unite to defeat communism wherever it shows its ugly head
loc.strategic_resource_control_goal_desc: The one who controls the strategic resources of the world controls the politics of the world.
loc.align_china_goal_desc: The Chinese factions and the threat they represent need to be brought under control. The best solution to this problem is to replace them with a friendly minded regime.
loc.control_the_chinese_capitals_goal_desc: If we gain control of the historical capitals of China, the resistance to our plans will surely lessen.
loc.war_on_communism_in_asia_goal_name: Declare war on Communism in Asia
loc.war_on_communism_in_asia_goal_desc: There is only one way to truly defeat communism; by force of arms. We need to root out communism in all of Asia if we are to ever be safe from its influence.
loc.coastal_security_goal_desc: We should ensure that we have total control of the entire sea front of East and South East Asia. That way we can ensure that the western imperialist colonizers can't maintain a foothold in our region.
loc.secure_the_oil_supply_goal_desc: If we are to fight a long war we need to secure enough oil to sustain it by any means necessary.
loc.secure_the_oil_supply_tech_bonus: Secure the Oil Supply Goal Bonus
loc.protector_of_peace_goal_desc: Ours is not to get involved in wars in Europe or elsewhere. Instead we should strive to maintain peace, and encourage other countries to settle their disputes peacefully and quickly.
loc.african_domination_goal_desc: Our ultimate aim must always be to ensure no foreign influence in Africa. Those that are not with us are against us and need to be made compliant.
loc.contain_japanese_expansion_asia_goal_des: We must do what we can to contain the territorial expansion of [JAP.GetName]
loc.pan_americanism_goal_desc: The entire Americas should be united. By getting everyone onboard, we can secure our part of the world, and create one united front against any outside forces.
loc.amerindian_liberation_goal_desc: The original people of the Americas must be liberated from the foreign oppressors currently ruling over them.
loc.islamic_brotherhood_goal_desc: The Islamic nations of the world need to unite in order to stand up against those who would rather see us conquered and subjugated.
loc.baltic_security_goal_desc: In order to secure the futures of our citizens and civilians, we must protects the Baltic region with all we have. Only by keeping it under our control, will its people be able to prosper.
loc.nordic_defence_goal_desc: In order to secure the futures of our citizens and civilians, we must protect the Nordic region with all we have. Only by keeping the imposing empires out, will we be able to thrive.
loc.european_dominance_goal_desc: If we can unite the majority of Europe under one banner, we can create an alliance that is strong enough to face even the gravest of threats.
loc.asian_dominance_goal_desc: With the majority of Asia under our control, our faction will be a force to be reckoned with.
loc.middle_east_dominance_goal_desc: From the Arabian peninsula and the Levant to the Afghan mountains, we need to unite and establish total control. This region could be a major player if we can just ensure that all are working together.
loc.the_arteries_of_trade_goal_desc: The main shipping lines need to be put under our control in order to ensure the survival of our member countries.
loc.the_atomic_race_goal_desc: We need to ensure that our enemies, current or future, do not gain access to nuclear weapons before we do. Only by being the first we can be sure that no other power can stand against us.
loc.the_atomic_race_complete_trigger: A member of [ROOT.GetFactionName] is the first country to finish $sp_nuclear_bomb$
loc.the_atomic_race_complete_trigger_fail: A country that is not a member of [ROOT.GetFactionName] is the first country to finish $sp_nuclear_bomb$
loc.rule_the_waves_goal_desc: To truly dominate the ocean a grand fleet is needed, and the key component of a grand fleet are the Capital Ships.
loc.eliminate_the_twin_threats_goal_desc: As long as [SOV.GetNameDef] and [GER.GetNameDef] are not brought into line, we can never be safe.
loc.disarm_aggression_central_powers_goal_de: Democracies rarely attack other countries. In order to secure Europe for future generation, we must ensure that these aggressive countries are either turned into democracies, or have them removed completely.
loc.imperial_glory_goal_desc: The key bastions of our empire, and those of our allies, need to hold. By keeping control of possessions all across the globe in times of war, we can show the world that we remain a force to be reckoned with.
loc.production_quotas_goal_desc: We need to have a huge arsenal of weapons to secure the integrity of the [ROOT.GetFactionName] and be prepared to face any threats that come our way.
loc.stall_the_fascist_threat_goal_desc: We need to slow down the spread of fascism in the world. Spain is most likely going to fall, but we need to do our part to delay it until we are ready to defend ourselves against the rising threat of fascism. By tying down enemy troops in a conflict in Spain, we make it harder for them to focus elsewhere, thus buying ourselves valuable time.
loc.the_red_tide_goal_desc: Boots on the ground is what matters the most. What is needed is a ten million strong army. That is how survival is truly secured.
loc.military_infrastructure_goal_desc: A well-developed infrastructure is critical in ensuring our border-defense forces have the supplies lines they require.
loc.ensure_military_r_d_goal_desc: We must ensure our military technology is up to par, by building facilities dedicated to the research and development of advanced prototypes and new concepts.
loc.spy_master_goal_desc: We should specialize one of our members in the art of espionage and intelligence gathering, allowing them to oversee and direct our alliance's operations.
loc.convoy_sufficiency_goal_desc: In order to have sufficient capacity to both supply our troops abroad and ensure the material needs of our industry are met with imports from overseas, we must create a sufficiently-large merchant marine.
loc.develop_mexican_oil_goal_desc: Expanding extraction of Mexican oil reserves would ensure sufficient fuel supplies for industrial and military demands.
loc.develop_curacao_oil_goal_desc: Curaçao’s refineries are integral to the processing of Venezuelan oil. Expanding extraction of them would maintain alliance access of refined petroleum products.
loc.develop_venezuelan_oil_goal_desc: Venezuela’s petroleum extraction can be further expanded to furnish our alliance with the energy access it needs to support its military activities.
loc.develop_guyanan_bauxite_goal_desc: Expanded development of Guyana’s bauxite deposits would provide the raw resources that are essential for large-scale aircraft manufacturing.
loc.develop_suriname_bauxite_goal_desc: Expanded development of Suriname’s rich bauxite deposits would provide the raw materials required for our alliance's growing aircraft industry.
loc.develop_lappland_metals_goal_desc: Expanding extraction of Lappland’s mineral wealth would strengthen the alliance’s supply of iron and tungsten, sustaining our arms manufacturing industry.
loc.develop_ploiesti_oil_fields_goal_desc: As the only oil-fields in Europe, the Ploiești oil fields must be suitably exploited to ensure the alliance has the fuel required for continued military operations.
loc.develop_baku_oil_fields_goal_desc: Developing the Baku oil region would provide extensive refined petroleum products vital to military operations.
loc.develop_iraqi_oil_goal_desc: Expanding Iraq’s oil production capacity could be instrumental in satisfying our military's fuel needs.
loc.develop_persian_oil_goal_desc: Expanding Persia’s oil fields and refining capacity would ensure a continuous flow of fuel for operational needs.
loc.develop_chinese_metals_goal_desc: China’s wealth in various critical metals could be mined more extensively to furnish the alliance's military-industrial base with the resources it needs.
loc.develop_malayan_riches_goal_desc: Development of Malaya’s tungsten and rubber resources would greatly bolster the alliance’s material base, ensuring key inputs for manufacturing and military logistics.
loc.expand_newfoundland_bases_goal_desc: Expanding our bases in Newfoundland would allow us to better exercise control over North Atlantic convoys and project air and naval power across vital shipping routes.
loc.expand_bermuda_bases_goal_desc: Expanding our bases in Bermuda would enable us to more effectively patrol the mid-Atlantic, and maintain more secure supply lines between continents.
loc.expand_bahamas_bases_goal_desc: Expanding our bases in the Bahamas would allow for more effective monitoring of Caribbean sea lanes and protection of maritime approaches into North and South America.
loc.expand_iceland_bases_goal_desc: Expanding the bases in Iceland would allow us to better secure the Denmark Strait and exert more influence over the North Atlantic corridor.
loc.expand_narvik_bases_goal_desc: Expanding the bases in Narvik would allow better maintenance of access to vital iron ore shipments and control over Arctic supply routes.
loc.fortify_danish_belts_goal_desc: Fortifying the Kattegat would let us better exert sole control over naval access between the Baltic and North Seas.
loc.fortify_danish_belts_tooltip: Every province in §YJylland§!, §YFyn§!, and §YSjaelland§! that controls the §YDanish Belts§! strait has a level 1 §YCoastal Fort§! and is manned by one division.
loc.fortify_gibraltar_goal_desc: Fortifying our strategic base on the Gibraltar Strait would allow us to better exert control over the maritime movement between the Mediterranean and the Atlantic.
loc.expand_maltese_bases_goal_desc: Expansion of our bases on Malta would enable better disruption of enemy supply lines and projection of power throughout the central Mediterranean.
loc.expand_cretan_bases_goal_desc: Expansion of our bases on Crete would better allow us to exert dominance over the eastern Mediterranean and facilitate operations in the Aegean and North Africa.
loc.expand_cypriot_bases_goal_desc: Expanding our bases on Cyprus would enable us to better support operations in the eastern Mediterranean and secure vital air routes to and from the Middle East.
loc.fortify_bosporus_goal_desc: Fortifying the Bosporus Strait would ensure our control over all naval access between the Black Sea and the Mediterranean.
loc.fortify_bosporus_tooltip: Every province in §YIstanbul§! that controls the §YBosporus§! strait has a level 1 §YCoastal Fort§!, a level 1 §YLand Fort§!, and is manned by one division.
loc.fortify_dardanelles_goal_desc: Fortifying the Dardanelles would strengthen our ability to dictate fleet and trade movement from the Black Sea.
loc.fortify_dardanelles_tooltip: Every province in §YEdirne§! and §YBursa§! that controls the §YDardanelles§! strait has a level 1 §YCoastal Fort§!, a level 1 §YLand Fort§!, and is manned by one division.
loc.fortify_suez_canal_goal_desc: Continued possession of the Suez Canal is imperative to ensure our sole control over the main traffic artery between Europe and Asia.
loc.fortify_suez_tooltip: Every province in §YSuez§! that controls the §YSuez§! strait has a level 1 §YCoastal Fort§!, a level 1 §YLand Fort§!, and is manned by one division.
loc.fortify_strait_of_hormuz_goal_desc: Fortifying the strategic bases on the Strait of Hormuz would better enable us to exert control over access to vital Persian and Iraqi oil.
loc.fortify_strait_of_hormuz_tooltip: Every province in §YMusandam§! and §YFars§! that controls the §YHormuz§! strait has a level 1 §YCoastal Fort§!, a level 1 §YLand Fort§!, and is manned by one division.
loc.expand_ceylonese_bases_goal_desc: Expanding our bases on Ceylon would strengthen our domination over the Indian Ocean and facilitate protection of vital sea lanes between the Middle East and Southeast Asia.
loc.expand_singapore_naval_base_goal_desc: The monumental fortified naval base of Singapore commands the Strait of Malacca and regulates movement between the Indian and Pacific Oceans. It should be strengthened even further.
loc.fortify_manila_bay_goal_desc: Fortification of the defensible Manila Bay would improve our projection of power across the western Pacific and secure access to the East Indies and South China Sea.
loc.fortify_manila_tooltip: §YManila§! province has a level 2 §YCoastal Fort§! and a level 7 §YNaval Base§!, and §YManila§! state has a level 8 §YAir Base§!.
loc.fortify_okinawa_goal_desc: Fortifying Okinawa would command the approaches to the Japanese home islands and establish a strong defensive perimeter in the Pacific.
loc.fortify_okinawa_tooltip: §YOkinawa§! has level 1 §YAnti-Air§! and a level 5 §YAir Base§!, and §YNaha§! province has a level 2 §YCoastal Fort§!.
loc.fortify_iwo_jima_goal_desc: Fortifying Iwo Jima would command the approaches to the Japanese home islands and establish a strong defensive perimeter in the Pacific.
loc.expand_caroline_islands_bases_goal_desc: Expansion of our bases in the Caroline Islands and the Truk Atoll would facilitate sustained naval and air campaigns across the central Pacific.
loc.expand_guadalcanal_bases_goal_desc: Expanding our bases on Guadalcanal would better allow us to exercise control over naval operations in the South Pacific and the access routes from and to Australia.
loc.expand_midway_island_bases_goal_desc: Development of our bases on Midway would ensure the security of the central Pacific approaches and provide a key base for transoceanic operations.
loc.undoing_brest_litowsk_goal_desc: The disgraceful peace of Brest Litowsk was never fully undone. It is time to erase the last parts of this shameful part of our history.
loc.marine_corps_goal_desc: Expanding our amphibious forces will greatly increase our offensive capabilities and the amount of enemy territory we can threaten.
loc.airborne_corps_goal_desc: Expanding our airborne forces will greatly increase our offensive flexibility and allow us to strike deeper into enemy territory.
loc.mountaineer_corps_goal_desc: Expanding our mountaineer forces will greatly increase our army's ability to contest this rugged and difficult terrain.
loc.submarine_force_goal_desc: A suitable submarine force is critical in degrading enemy supply lines.
loc.convoy_escort_force_goal_desc: To secure our supply lines we must ensure adequate numbers of escort vessels.
loc.air_superiority_goal_desc: Control of the air dictates success on land and at sea. We must have sufficient fighter aircraft to secure our aerial dominance.
loc.control_mexican_oil_goal_desc: Securing Mexican oil reserves would ensure sufficient fuel supplies for industrial and military demands.
loc.control_curacao_oil_goal_desc: Curaçao’s refineries are integral to the processing of Venezuelan oil. Control over them would provide the alliance with reliable access to refined petroleum products.
loc.control_venezuelan_oil_goal_desc: Venezuela’s large petroleum reserves would furnish our alliance with the energy access it needs to support its military activities.
loc.control_guyanan_bauxite_goal_desc: Command over Guyana’s bauxite deposits would expand the alliance’s aluminum output, essential for aircraft manufacturing.
loc.control_suriname_bauxite_goal_desc: Possession of Suriname’s rich bauxite deposits would provide the raw materials required for our alliance's growing aircraft industry.
loc.control_lappland_metals_goal_desc: Access to Lappland’s mineral wealth would strengthen the alliance’s supply of iron and tungsten, sustaining our arms manufacturing industry.
loc.control_ploiesti_oil_fields_goal_desc: As the only oil-fields in Europe, control of the Ploiești oil fields are invaluable in ensuring the alliance has the fuel required for continued military operations.
loc.control_baku_oil_fields_goal_desc: Securing the Baku oil region would give access to extensive petroleum reserves vital to military operations.
loc.control_iraqi_oil_goal_desc: Iraq’s oil production capacity could be instrumental in satisfying our military's fuel needs.
loc.control_persian_oil_goal_desc: Control over Persia’s oil fields and refining capacity would ensure a continuous flow of fuel for operational needs.
loc.control_chinese_metals_goal_desc: China’s wealth in various critical metals could supply the alliance's military-industrial base with the resources it needs.
loc.control_malayan_riches_goal_desc: Control of Malaya’s tungsten and rubber resources would greatly bolster the alliance’s material base, ensuring key inputs for manufacturing and military logistics.
loc.control_indonesian_riches_goal_desc: Indonesia’s diverse natural wealth, including oil, rubber, and minerals, are invaluable to support our industrial base and ensure the alliance's resource independence.
loc.control_newfoundland_bases_goal_desc: Securing bases in Newfoundland would allow us to exercise control over North Atlantic convoys and project air and naval power across vital shipping routes.
loc.control_bermuda_goal_desc: Bases in Bermuda would enable us to more effective patrol the mid-Atlantic, and maintain more secure supply lines between continents.
loc.control_bahamas_bases_goal_desc: Possession of bases in the Bahamas would allow for more effective monitoring of Caribbean sea lanes and protection of maritime approaches into North and South America.
loc.control_panama_canal_goal_desc: Control over the Panama Canal is vital for enabling the rapid redeployment of fleets between the Atlantic and Pacific, ensuring strategic flexibility across both oceans.
loc.control_trinidad_goal_desc: Trinidad's key location makes it imperative for the control of Caribbean oil supplies and lets it serve as a strategic jumping-off-point on South America’s northern coast.
loc.control_azores_goal_desc: The Azores' strategic location enables extended reach across the mid-Atlantic, closing the gap for both submarine and anti-submarine coverage, and ensuring continuous air cover for convoys.
loc.control_iceland_goal_desc: Control of bases in Iceland would allow securing the Denmark Strait and exerting influence over the North Atlantic corridor.
loc.control_faroe_islands_goal_desc: The Faroe Islands are located in a strategic location that enables control of northern sea routes and support for naval operations toward Britain, Scandinavia, and the Arctic.
loc.control_narvik_goal_desc: Securing Narvik would allow maintenance of access to vital iron ore shipments and control over Arctic supply routes.
loc.control_danish_belts_goal_desc: Garrisoning the Kattegat would let us exert sole control over naval access between the Baltic and North Seas.
loc.control_brittany_bases_goal_desc: The strategic bases along Brittany’s coast would allow for wider-reaching submarine and air operations into the Atlantic, as well as securing access into the European mainland.
loc.control_gibraltar_goal_desc: The strategic base on the Gibraltar Strait would allow us to exert control over the maritime movement between the Mediterranean and the Atlantic.
loc.control_malta_goal_desc: Possession of Malta would enable disruption of enemy supply lines and projection of power throughout the central Mediterranean.
loc.control_crete_goal_desc: Control over the island of Crete would allow dominance over the eastern Mediterranean and facilitate operations in the Aegean and North Africa.
loc.control_cyprus_goal_desc: Control of Cyprus would enable support for operations in the eastern Mediterranean and secure vital air routes to and from the Middle East.
loc.control_bosporus_goal_desc: Seizure of the Bosporus Strait would allow us to control all naval access between the Black Sea and the Mediterranean.
loc.control_dardanelles_goal_desc: Holding the Dardanelles would make it possible to dictate fleet and trade movement from the Black Sea.
loc.control_suez_canal_goal_desc: Possession of the vital Suez Canal would give us sole control over the main traffic artery between Europe and Asia, ensuring rapid transfer of forces and resources.
loc.control_gulf_of_aden_bases_goal_desc: The strategic bases along the Gulf of Aden enable protection of the Red Sea approaches and secure shipping routes linking Europe, Africa, and Asia.
loc.control_strait_of_hormuz_goal_desc: The strategic bases on the Strait of Hormuz would make it possible to exert control over access to vital Persian and Iraqi oil.
loc.control_ceylon_goal_desc: Securing Ceylon would allow domination of the Indian Ocean and protection of vital sea lanes between the Middle East and Southeast Asia.
loc.control_singapore_goal_desc: The monumental fortified naval base of Singapore commands the Strait of Malacca and regulates movement between the Indian and Pacific Oceans. It should be ours.
loc.control_manila_goal_desc: Possession of the defensible Manila Bay would allow projection of power across the western Pacific and secure access to the East Indies and South China Sea.
loc.control_okinawa_goal_desc: Control of Okinawa would make it possible to launch operations against the Japanese home islands and establish a strong defensive perimeter in the Pacific.
loc.control_iwo_jima_goal_desc: Securing Iwo Jima would allow support for long-range air operations over Japan and expand our reach into the central Pacific.
loc.control_caroline_islands_goal_desc: Dominance over the Caroline Islands and Truk Atoll would enable sustained naval and air campaigns across the central Pacific.
loc.control_guadalcanal_goal_desc: Securing Guadalcanal would allow us to exercise control over naval operations in the South Pacific and the access routes from and to Australia.
loc.control_wake_island_goal_desc: Holding Wake Island would make it possible to extend reconnaissance and air coverage across the central Pacific routes.
loc.control_midway_island_goal_desc: Control of Midway would allow security of the central Pacific approaches and provide a key base for transoceanic operations.
loc.control_hawaii_goal_desc: Seizing Pearl Harbor would make it possible to anchor Pacific operations and coordinate logistics across the entire oceanic theater, as well as opening up access to the American Pacific coastline.
loc.control_attu_island_goal_desc: Securing Attu Island would allow exerting control over northern Pacific shipping lanes and enable operations along the Aleutian chain towards Alaska and the American Pacific coast.
loc.undo_versailles_goal_desc: It is high time we undo the travesty of this 'Diktat'. We shall retake our rightful territory!
loc.strategic_bombing_campaign_goal_desc: A large-scale strategic bombing campaign will systematically degrade the enemy's industrial capacity, allowing us to wear down their forces.
loc.liberate_territory_goal_desc: The enemy is in possession of our territory. Liberating it should be our first goal.
loc.great_offensive_goal_desc: A great offensive seizing enemy territory should be our first step towards the ultimate conclusion of the war.

loc.FACTION_THEATER_SUPPLY_BONUS_TOOLTIP: Selected countries in a theater receive $VAL$ §HSupply Consumption§! based on the commander's $SKILL1|H$ ($SKILL1VAL|H$) and $SKILL2|H$ ($SKILL2VAL|H$) skills.\n\nAn §HAdmiral§! will convey a higher bonus to naval supply consumption, whereas a §HField Marshal§! will convey a better bonus to land supply consumption.
loc.FACTION_THEATER_MASTERY_GAIN_TOOLTIP: The commander's country receives $VAL|.1G%$ of the £doctrine_mastery §HMastery§! earned by other faction members in the theater, based on the commander's $SKILL1|H$ ($SKILL1VAL|H$) and $SKILL2|H$ ($SKILL2VAL|H$) skills.
loc.FACTION_GOALS_TAB_TT: §HFaction Goals§!\nView and change your active goals.
loc.FACTION_RULES_TAB_TT: §HFaction Rules§!\nView and change the rules that your Faction must abide by.
loc.FACTION_RESEARCH_TAB_TT: §HFaction Research§!\nSet up research sharing and joint research facilities.
loc.FACTION_ARMY_TAB_TT: §HFaction Military Operations§!\nRequest garrison manpower, manage theater commanders and faction theaters, and set up doctrine sharing.
loc.FACTION_INTELLIGENCE_TAB_TT: §HFaction Intelligence§!\nSet up intelligence sharing and change faction spymaster.
loc.FACTION_POWER_RANKING_TOOLTIP: §HFaction Ranking§!\n\nBased on our §HFaction Power Projection§! of $VAL|0H$, our faction is ranked $RANK|H$ in the world.
loc.POWER_PROJECTION_BLURB: \n§gFaction Power Projection affects how likely countries are to accept faction invitations, and acts as a tie-breaker during Peace Conferences.§!
loc.THEATER_COMMANDER_SUPPLY_SKILL_DESC: This commander reduces the supply consumption by $VAL|H$ due to their planning & logistic skills
loc.FACTION_THEATER_POPUP_DESC: Are you sure you want to spend £faction_initiative_texticon£ $COST|0H$ on creating a new faction theater?
loc.FACTION_THEATER_SHOW_PIN_TOOLTIP: Toggle showing §HFaction Theaters§! in §HDefault§!, §HStrategic Navy§! and §HStrategic Air§! map modes.
loc.FACTION_EXECUTE_CAREFUL_DESC: When the plan is carried out, units will not attack heavily fortified locations unless they are unmanned, and will avoid attacking provinces which will weaken the front line by making it longer.\n\n§gNote that this will only affect allied AI controlled units within the theater, not any player controlled units.§!
loc.FACTION_EXECUTE_BALANCED_DESC: The standard rules for carrying out battle plans are in effect. Units will attempt to advance in a manner that keeps the front line as short as possible and may attack fortified locations.\n\n§gNote that this will only affect allied AI controlled units within the theater, not any player controlled units.§!
loc.FACTION_EXECUTE_RUSH_DESC: Units will attack provinces if they are a part of the plan, even if it may mean that the front line becomes longer or may put units in exposed locations.\n\n§gNote that this will only affect allied AI controlled units within the theater, not any player controlled units.§!
loc.GARRISON_SUPPORT_SEND: Requested manpower will be delivered directly to our garrisons in territory we occupy.
loc.WHILE_FOCUSING: While focusing on this, there will be the following effects:\n$EFF$
loc.army_effort_desc: Despite the increasing possibilities of aerial and naval warfare, ground combat is still key in tomorrow's wars. With preparation, we can avoid reliving the hell of the trenches.
loc.equipment_effort_desc: The limits for what equipment can be carried by infantry are constantly being pushed. We will focus on giving our troops the best tools available.
loc.motorization_effort_desc: Mobility and protection are crucial to get infantry into and out of the field safely. Focusing on these developments will allow us to take action quickly.
loc.doctrine_effort_desc: The military doctrines that defined ground combat in the Great War are outdated. We must put our greatest minds to the task of shaping the military thought of tomorrow.
loc.equipment_effort_2_desc: We will continue our efforts to ensure our infantry and support troops are armed with the best possible equipment of our time.
loc.mechanization_effort_desc: Rethinking the possibilities of motorized infantry, we can push the limits of what vehicles can be constructed today.
loc.doctrine_effort_2_desc: The battlefield has changed not just in the interbellum years, but over the course of recent conflicts. We must continuously reevaluate our doctrines to reflect this.
loc.equipment_effort_3_desc: Instead of imitating or buying foreign equipment, we should aim to become world-leading in infantry weapons.
loc.armor_effort_desc: Applying what we have learned from mechanizing our infantry, we can improve our armored vehicles as well.
loc.special_forces_desc: We have need of elite forces; mountain troops and paratroopers should be our priority.
loc.aviation_effort_tt: Not enough building slots for §YAir Base§!
loc.aviation_effort_desc: Nowhere is technological advances more rapid than in aerial warfare. Aviation is a field any modern nation must master.
loc.fighter_focus_desc: We have not seen the last of dogfights in the Great War. Keeping ahead in the development of fighter planes will give us an edge in the future.
loc.bomber_focus_desc: When people of the future speak of the horror of today's wars, fire raining from the skies will prominently feature. We will do our best to ensure those stories are told by our enemies.
loc.aviation_effort_2_desc: Further advances in aviation will be necessary to integrate our air force well with other branches of the military.
loc.CAS_effort_desc: A modern army needs support from vehicles not only on the ground, but also in the air.
loc.rocket_effort_desc: Rocket and jet engines allow for unprecedented speeds for unmanned and manned vessels alike. Pioneering these technologies will allow us to take the enemy by surprise.
loc.NAV_effort_desc: Just as the new naval warfare takes place in part beneath the water's surface, part of it takes place in the air above the waters.
loc.naval_effort_tt: Not enough building slots for §YNaval Dockyards§!
loc.naval_effort_desc: The expansion of our navy should be our first priority. Assign all available resources to new Dockyards and research into light surface ships.
loc.GER_naval_effort2_desc: To truly rebuild a navy worthy of note, we must greatly expand our shipbuilding capacity.
loc.GER_naval_effort2_tt: Builds §Y2 Naval Dockyards§! in §Y2§! coastal states currently controlled by §Y[ROOT.GetFlag][ROOT.GetNameDef]§!
loc.flexible_navy_desc: Reinventing naval warfare to account for the advances in submarine technology will allow us to strike efficiently against enemy convoys.
loc.large_navy_desc: Adapting our naval doctrines to accommodate large ships and ensuring the safety of our trade convoys will teach us much about what sort of ships we need.
loc.submarine_effort_desc: Submarine warfare is the most exciting naval development since the invention of the torpedo boat. We would do well to not just protect against submarines, but also use them against enemy shipping.
loc.cruiser_effort_desc: Before making forays into advanced battleship research, the smaller cruisers are in need of replacement.
loc.destroyer_effort_desc: Studying the design and strategic use of submarines, we have also learned how to counter those strategies. Destroyers will be crucial for this.
loc.capital_ships_effort_desc: The nation with the most battleships will rule the oceans. Battleships and carriers represent the old and the new in naval superiority.
loc.industrial_effort_desc: Focus all our political efforts on building up the civilian industry in a great leap forward.
loc.industrial_effort_2_desc: With iron will and a relentless work ethic, we can mobilize the people in another great industrial effort.
loc.construction_effort_tt: Not enough building slots for §YCivilian Factories§!
loc.construction_effort_desc: Civilian industrial capacity must not be underestimated even when war looms over the world.
loc.production_effort_tt: Not enough building slots for §YMilitary Factory§!
loc.production_effort_desc: If you can build tractors, you can build tanks! We must not allow our military production capacity to lag behind.
loc.construction_effort_2_desc: Continuing to expand our factories will allow us to speed up production of goods for trade and further construction efforts.
loc.production_effort_2_desc: Trying to adapt civilian factories to produce military equipment is inefficient. We should focus on preparing military production now.
loc.production_effort_3_desc: Continued efforts to expand our military factories are necessary to meet the demands for new equipment.
loc.infrastructure_effort_desc: A country without proper infrastructure cannot pursue advanced projects or constructions.
loc.synth_oil_effort_tt: Not enough building slots for §YSynthetic Refinery§!
loc.infrastructure_effort_2_desc: Extending our infrastructure further will enable the transports and communications necessary for high-tech clandestine projects.
loc.construction_effort_3_desc: Expansion of our infrastructure network has significantly improved our capacity for construction.
loc.nuclear_effort_desc: Standing on the edge of a world-changing discovery, we cannot let others light the fire that may one day consume the Earth.
loc.extra_tech_slot_desc: Our industrial expansion and other recent advances might allow us to conduct more R&D in parallel.
loc.extra_tech_slot_2_desc: The rapid industrialization of our nation has opened up new opportunities in R&D that we should pursue.
loc.technology_sharing_desc: By sharing technological advances with our allies, our whole faction will be able to conduct wartime R&D more efficiently.
loc.secret_weapons_desc: It is tempting to expend all extra resources into developing tanks and planes, but the secret to winning wars lies in whole new fields of science; electronics, rocketry and nuclear research.
loc.political_effort_desc: To bring about change in the world, we need to be able to bring about change in our own country. Strengthening our political position should come first.
loc.collectivist_ethos_desc: Our enemies may divide and conquer lesser nations, but our people will stand united. All for one and one for all.
loc.liberty_ethos_desc: In this time of ideological fanatics who seek to suffocate the human spirit, we will safeguard individual liberties and freedom.
loc.militarism_desc: Those who view the military as a necessary evil are doomed to hesitate in the face of war. We will ingrain militarism into our culture to become a people of soldiers.
loc.political_correctness_desc: People holding mildly controversial or otherwise embarrassing opinions appear to be concerned that there is a wide-reaching conspiracy against them. This seems like an excellent idea.
loc.neutrality_focus_desc: While others may claim it takes bravery and wisdom to take sides in a global conflict, we know it takes more to refuse.
loc.interventionism_focus_desc: We value the freedom of all people, not only our own citizens. If preventing tyranny means war, then so be it.
loc.military_youth_desc: Organizations to promote discipline and political education of young people in our nation will foster loyalty and self-sacrifice early.
loc.deterrence_desc: Standing alone, we rarely benefit from war. Fortunately, we know that the best defense is one so well-known you never have to put it to use.
loc.volunteer_corps_desc: Forcing our people to die for ideals of freedom would be an exercise in irony, but establishing means for those who wish to aid people abroad is not.
loc.paramilitarism_desc: Military principles have applications outside of the military. With the development of semi-militarized units to complement our armed forces, more people will have military training.
loc.indoctrination_focus_desc: Having established our ideology as based on the truth, it may be taught as truth. Education and media must reflect this lesson.
loc.foreign_expeditions_desc: With our enemies prepared to intervene in distant conflicts on behalf of their ideals, we must be ready to do the same for ours.
loc.why_we_fight_effect: If we don't have the §YNeutral Foreign Policy§! spirit we will be able to create factions.\n
loc.why_we_fight_desc: The world is growing increasingly unsafe. Our people need to see the atrocities being committed by those who crave power. It is time we rally the people to our cause and ensure everyone is ready to fight for our freedom.
loc.political_commissars_desc: To ensure that our policies are followed in military practice, we will introduce politically appointed officials into military ranks.
loc.internationalism_focus_desc: Ideology knows no borders. Another nation may call itself sovereign, but our convictions are above such claims.
loc.nationalism_focus_desc: Our nation is unique, and our political achievements could only have happened here. We must fight for it at any cost.
loc.ideological_fanaticism_desc: Our politically established values and goals are worth dying for as much as any ancient faith. Any follower should be prepared to face death, and those who stray better be prepared to face death.
loc.air_innovation_desc: Modern wars cannot be won without dominating the skies. We must do everything in our power to develop the air force!
loc.air_innovation_2_desc: Every advantage we can gain in the skies is precious. We should focus all of our efforts on developing our fighters.
loc.naval_air_effort_desc: The efficacy of air strikes against naval targets was demonstrated by the Americans already back in 1921. We should not neglect this branch of the Air Force if we intend to wage war on a naval power.
loc.GER_autobahn_desc: Since its inception in 1933, the [GetAutobahnName] project has been a glorious success. The construction efforts have reduced unemployment, and the wide roads stand as a monument to [GER.GetName]'s economic recovery. Much work remains to be done, however.
loc.GER_west_wall_desc: The Westwall runs parallel to France's vaunted Maginot Line, occupying much of the same ground as the Siegfried Line did in the previous Weltkrieg. Fortifying its defenses will allow us to hold the border with fewer men, freeing up divisions to participate in any potential eastern campaigns.
loc.GER_west_wall_tt: §RIf the Rhineland is remilitarized, you will also gain:§!\n
loc.GER_west_wall_forts: Add §Y12 Land Forts§! on the French border.\n
loc.GER_tactical_air_effort_desc: Victory will be achieved by annihilating the enemy's ground forces. We must focus on supporting our own armies with tactical strikes against close and deep targets.
loc.GER_long_range_escorts_desc: Our tactical and strategic bombers require longer-range escorts to provide protection all the way to the target area and back.
loc.GER_strategic_air_effort_desc: Victory will be achieved by destroying the enemy's industries. We must focus our efforts on design and production of strategic bombers.
loc.GER_army_innovation_desc: Heinz Guderian and other radical theorists are pushing for daring new doctrines emphasizing communication, identification of 'schwerpunkte' and local concentrations of combined arms forces. Giving them free reins might help avoid the meat grinder horrors of the Great War.
loc.GER_soviet_treaty_desc: We can pursue a new research treaty with [SOV.GetNameDef] in order to develop, chiefly, better tanks. If they agree, we can reopen the tank school we closed down in Kama in 1933. [SOV.GetAdjective] cooperation will, of course, mean that they too will benefit from the innovations made...
loc.GER_air_innovation_2_desc: The tasks of the Reich's Air Ministry are of paramount importance. The Luftwaffe must be the most advanced Air Force in the world!
loc.GER_army_innovation_2_desc: The lessons learned at our facilities in the USSR will allow us to further improve our doctrines and equipment. However, this time we will keep the advances to ourselves!
loc.GER_rocketry_focus_desc: Rocket propulsion holds the key to massive innovations in all three of the military branches.
loc.GER_wunderwaffe_desc: Heisenberg and von Braun are chomping at the bit to explore certain ideas they have for true doomsday weapons. All they need is extra resources...
loc.GER_mol_rib_pact_desc: A treaty of friendship and non-aggression with [GER.GetTheUSSRName] might turn the stomach, but it will allow their precious oil to keep flowing into Germany. The secret addendum will divide the territories of Romania, Poland, Lithuania, Latvia, Estonia and Finland into [GER.GetAdjective] and [SOV.GetAdjective] spheres of influence...
loc.GER_mol_rib_pact_tt: Enter into a §Ynon-aggression pact§! with §YSoviet Union§! and agree to §Ydivide Poland§! between [SOV.GetName] and Germany\n
loc.GER_soviet_ally_desc: Perhaps it is possible to put aside our [GER.GetUSSRAllianceDesc] differences with the [GER.GetRussiansDemonym] and instead emphasize what unites us: hatred of selfish liberalism and the decadent West. With [GER.GetTheUSSRName] as an ally, we would have access to all the resources we need - in addition to their military power, of course...
loc.GER_turkey_puppet_desc: Turkey is caught in a vice between us and the Soviet Union. If pressured, the Turks will most likely submit to our will and become a puppet state. As part of the deal, the USSR will get some territory in eastern Turkey. However, if they reject our demands, it would mean war.
loc.GER_rhineland_desc: The Rhineland has been demilitarized since the end of the Great War, but this insult shall stand no longer! Germany is a sovereign nation and is free to move troops anywhere within her borders!
loc.GER_rhineland_ultimatum: §RThe remilitarization may be reversed if you are confronted and back down.§!\n
loc.GER_japan_friend_desc: We have long had a fruitful relationship with China, but our ambitions might be better served by instead aligning with our kindred warrior culture of Japan, even if it means throwing China to the wolves...
loc.GER_china_friend_desc: Let us deepen our long-standing friendship with China. Doing so will alienate Japan, but what is Japan if not merely the Italy of the East?
loc.GER_anti_comintern_pact_desc: Interference by the Communist International in the internal affairs of the nations not only endangers their internal peace and social well-being, but is also a menace to the peace of the world! We will ask many of the non-Communist countries to sign the pact, and make sure that we keep the red menace in check.
loc.GER_anti_soviet_pact_desc: We can take the Anti-Comintern Pact one step further and ask all members to commit to a coalition against the Soviet Union. If any signatory ends up at war with the USSR, all other members must also declare war.
loc.GER_anti_soviet_pact_tt: §YSends offer to all members of the Anti-Comintern Pact to join a defensive alliance against the Soviet Union.§!
loc.GER_anti_soviet_pact_tt_2: §Y The defensive alliance will call members to war if one of them is attacked by Comintern§!
loc.GER_ussr_war_goal_desc: We can focus our propaganda efforts on preparing the German people - and the world - for a righteous war on [SOV.GetNameDef].
loc.GER_turkey_friend_desc: Atatürk's Turkey is on an admirable path towards modernization, and the country controls access to the Black Sea through the Bosphorus and the Dardanelles. Bringing Turkey into our sphere of influence should be our first priority!
loc.GER_anschluss_desc_old: The Anschluss, or union with Austria, is a long held goal of the German people. Although forbidden by the Treaty of Versailles, the time has finally come to bring it about. Let us offer the Austrians a chance at sharing our glorious destiny!
loc.GER_anschluss_eq_trigger_tt: More than §Y50.000§! infantry equipment in the army
loc.anschluss_mefo_bills_double_reduction: Modify §YMEFO Bills§! by §G+0.10§! Daily Political Power Gain\n
loc.GER_demand_memel_desc: The Great War saw the loss of much German territory in the East with the resurrection of Poland and the transfer of Memel to Lithuania. An Ultimatum shall be sent to both nations, but Poland, at least, will likely not bow to mere words.
loc.GER_danzig_or_war_POL_faction_GER_leader: §R[This.GetName] must approve of the agreement for bonuses to take effect. They will leave [Root.GetFactionName] if war is declared.§!\n
loc.GER_danzig_or_war_POL_faction_GER_nolead: §R[This.GetName] must approve of the agreement for bonuses to take effect. You will leave [Root.GetFactionName] the faction if war is declared.§!\n
loc.GER_danzig_or_war_desc: Danzig was German, Danzig has remained German, and Danzig shall be German from now on! If Poland does not cede the territory, we must prepare the German people for the inevitable war. Danzig and the surrounding lands will return to Germany!
loc.GER_czech_friend_desc: The Czechs and the Slovaks are industrious and admirable peoples. It is unfortunate that our territorial ambitions clash with theirs, but it is not too late to pursue friendship rather than subjugation.
loc.GER_demand_sudetenland_desc: The fate of the Sudet-Germans was one of the worst injustices inflicted by the Treaty of Versailles. They must be brought under our protection, regardless of Czech objections.
loc.GER_first_vienna_award_desc: The Hungarians were one of the people that suffered worst after the Great War. In the slaughter of the Austro-Hungarian Empire, many Hungarians were stranded on foreign soil though their ancestors had lived there for ages. We could greatly improve our relations with Hungary by awarding them some territories from Czechoslovakia.
loc.GER_end_of_czechoslovakia_desc: The time has come to divide the old Czech lands between those who can govern them properly. We should also consider the creation of a separate Slovak puppet state to the east.
loc.GER_second_vienna_award_desc: Transylvania has a Hungarian majority and should rightly belong to our friends in Hungary. However, it is hard to say how the Romanian regime and people will react to this demand.
loc.GER_italy_ally_desc: Italians may be untrustworthy - as they proved in the Great War - but Mussolini and his Fascist movement have shown that there is hope for Italy yet. Surely, Germany only stands to gain by allying with Italy, does it not?
loc.GER_nationalist_spain_ally_desc: The nationalist victory in the Spanish civil war has paved the way for a closer relationship between our two countries. Franco holds the key to the Mediterranean.
loc.GER_danzig_vs_slovakia_desc: The Poles stand in the way of our plans for Lebensraum. Still, it is not too late to alter our long-term priorities and seek their friendship instead. The only possible way this could come about is through a trade of territory; Danzig for Slovakia. Poland has already shown some interest in the region by occupying Zaolzie.
loc.GER_poland_friend_desc: Although Poland no longer has access to the sea, we have proved our good intentions by giving them Slovakia. Perhaps we can bring them even closer to us by making vague promises of future territorial gains in the east.
loc.GER_war_with_france_desc: Now that Germany has found a satisfactory solution to the question of her eastern border, for now, it is time to turn our attention west. The loss of Alsace-Lorraine is a stain on the honor of the German people and only through a just and righteous war can we avenge this.
loc.GER_operation_tannenbaum_desc: Switzerland possesses the most disgusting and miserable people and political system. We now finally have time to see to these mortal enemies of the new Germany.
loc.GER_reintegrate_luxemburg_and_alsace_lor: With our successful reconquest of historically German areas, we can now begin the process of their reintegration into the [Root.GetName]. Their populations must be allowed to do their patriotic duty for the fatherland.
loc.GER_naval_rearmament_desc: The Anglo-German Naval Agreement we secured in 1935 allows us to expand our navy greatly. We should spare no effort in doing so.
loc.GER_plan_z_desc: Admiral Raeder believes that the British can best be defeated through a policy of surface raiding. Constructing enough battleships and carriers to accomplish this will be a massive task, and will take time; perhaps too much time... On the other hand, our current surface navy is pathetically inadequate.
loc.GER_u_boat_effort_desc: Commodore Dönitz advocates a strategy of unrestricted submarine warfare as the best way of bringing Britain to its knees. With enough U-boats, we might be able to starve the British home industries of all the required resources from its far-flung empire.
loc.GER_trade_interdiction_desc_old: Our dockyards are committed to churning out U-boats, but we need to develop better ways of utilizing these 'wolf packs'. Give the admirals everything they need to conduct their simulations and war games...
loc.GER_modular_construction_desc: By having parts of our submarines built at various construction facilities, assembly and construction speed are greatly improved.
loc.GER_denmark_friend_desc: Gunboat diplomacy is not dead yet. Our naval expansion plans are well known to our little northern neighbor. In combination with their fear of our vastly superior armies, it should be easy enough to intimidate them into our sphere of influence.
loc.GER_norway_friend_desc: Norway controls much of the precious iron exports from the vast mines in northern Sweden. We should intimidate them into 'friendship' with the threat of our expanding navy.
loc.GER_dutch_friend_desc: The Dutch know full well how long they will last in the case of another Great War. If they can be convinced that Germany can seriously threaten Britain itself, it is possible they might choose alliance with us to avoid a harsh occupation.
loc.GER_sweden_friend_desc: The Scandinavian countries are like dominoes; they stand and fall together. With Norway and Denmark in our sphere, Sweden will surely follow.
loc.GER_improve_national_spirit_desc: With the capital cities of the victors of the Great War in our hands we can finally cast off the shadow of our defeat. A new age is dawning for Germany!
loc.GER_improve_national_spirit_tooltip: We, or our Faction members, must control London and Paris and the states they reside in.
loc.needs_approval: §R[This.GetName] must approve of the agreement for bonuses to take effect.§!\n
loc.GER_demand_slovenia_desc: The Treaty of Saint-Germain-en-Laye saw many historic Austrian territories passed out to successor states. With Austria once again united with the German nation it is time to end these injustices. The historic provinces of Carniola and Styria, which are now known as Slovenia, must be brought home.
loc.GER_first_ljubljana_award_desc: The hypocritical western powers preached national self-determination while handing over many minorities to be ruled by the Serbs. We are in a position to right that historic wrong and make friends at the same time. For those who wish to side with us in the European order we can be very generous.
loc.GER_first_ljubljana_award_tt: All original [YUG.GetAdjective] core states are owned either by §Y[YUG.GetName]§! or any of its subjects.\n
loc.GER_fate_of_yugoslavia_desc: The Yugoslav state was always an artificial construct, and central authority has started to collapse. We must step in to restore order. The only question we face is what would be the best way to do this.
loc.GER_second_ljubljana_award_tt: Event gives the possibility to demand land for [Root.GetName] or a worthy ally.
loc.GER_second_ljubljana_award_desc: With the Yugoslav question solved it is time to turn our attention to Greece. They too have been unjustly aggrandized by the Allies. It is time to see who our friends really are.
loc.GER_war_with_greece_desc: With Greece already at war, it would be a shame for Germany to miss out on a base in the Eastern Mediterranean.
loc.GER_fate_of_greece_desc: Greece has proven that it cannot cope with the new forces unleashed upon Europe. It is time to offer them the protection that only Germany can provide.
loc.GER_weserubung_desc: Norway is a critical strategic point and would be an obvious point of attack for any enemy wanting to disrupt our steel trade with Sweden. We cannot risk our enemies setting up bases in this region. To obtain a good staging area for the invasion of Norway we need to move on Denmark first.
loc.GER_weserubung_tt: \nFully controlling §Y[144.GetName]§! will deliver high grade ore from §Y[SWE.GetName]§! via §YNarvik§! every month. This will result in one additional §Yoffshore civilian factory§! every 6 months, to a max of 8 total §Yoffshore civilian factories§!. These shipments can be interrupted if control over §Y[144.GetName]§! is lost. If [ENG.GetNameDefCap] successfully invades [SWE.GetName] and sabotages the mines, or if [SWE.GetNameDef] blows them up the civilian factories will be lost permanently. Shipments can be resumed if the mines are resumed
loc.GER_weserubung_tt_complete: §YOffshore civilian factories§! gained currently gained from controlling §YNarvik§!: §G[?GER_narvik_civs]§!\nShipment progress until next factory: [?GER_narvik_shipments]/6
loc.GER_around_maginot_desc: If we want to ensure a tactical advantage against France we need to be able to hit them from all sides. They will not expect an attack from the North, which is exactly where we will hit them from, once we've disposed of a few obstacles.
loc.GER_danzig_or_war_POL_civil_war: Take Danzig in exchange for support
loc.GER_danzig_trigger_polish_civil_war: Poland is in a civil war and one of the following must be true\n      Germany has sent volunteers to support one side\n      One side is in a faction with Germany
loc.GER_alone_or_peace_faction_tt: is not in a faction, or is in a faction at peace with [GER.GetNameDef].
loc.GER_four_year_plan_desc: We need an ambitious plan to provide for the rearmament and ultimate self-sufficiency of the nation. This should be achieved within the next four years.
loc.GER_atlantikwall_desc: Now that we have conquered Western Europe, we must entrench ourselves against a possible onslaught from across the Atlantic Ocean. A huge network of fortifications along the shores of Europe should provide us with ample protection.
loc.atlantikwall_tooltip: Place §YCoastal Forts§! in each of the following Atlantic coastal states that are fully controlled by you:\n
loc.GER_ostwall_desc: Despite our gains in the East, we must ensure that if the tide turns we can hold off the enemy advance. We should build a line of fortifications, the Panther-Wotan stellung, along the Dnieper river, from the Black Sea to the Baltic.
loc.GER_ostwall_forts: Place §YLand Forts§! along the Dnieper river to the Baltic, in each of the following states that are fully controlled by your faction:\n
loc.GER_ostwall_tt: Under control of a member of our faction.\n
loc.GER_autarky_desc: For Germany to be truly great, it must be self-sufficient. We must make better use of our resources, and become more efficient in our construction.
loc.GER_hermann_goring_werke_desc: We must rid ourselves of the fickle influence of private capitalists. Therefore, we will form an industrial conglomerate under our control to oversee growth in the mining and steel sectors, as this will form the backbone of our military industry.
loc.GER_kdf_wagen_desc: We will allow our citizens to purchase their own future 'people's car' through a savings scheme, which, in turn, we will use to finance the construction of the factories that will eventually contribute in building these cars.
loc.GER_coal_liquidization_desc: Germany is lacking in oil, and so we must redouble our efforts in the field of synthetic oil.
loc.GER_synthetic_rubber_desc: Large-scale motorization and aviation requires large amounts of rubber, of which we own no sources. We must improve the way we create it synthetically.
loc.GER_german_war_economy_desc: Our great nation's people must be harnessed for the good of the war effort. We will transition to a full war economy, where every man is expected to play their part.
loc.GER_grosraumwirtschaft_desc: We must prepare Germany for its destiny as a centerpiece of Europe. Our infrastructure will bind together the West with the East, and the South with the North.
loc.GER_align_hungary_desc: Hungary is already in our sphere of influence, but we could easily sway them further to our way of thinking, making them even more easily manipulable in the future.
loc.GER_align_romania_desc: Romania is already in our sphere of influence, but we could easily sway them further to our way of thinking, making them even more easily manipulable in the future.
loc.GER_integrate_war_economies_desc: The nations in our sphere of influence have grown to have extreme economic dependencies on us. We could use this to increase our control over their economies and our influence on their foreign policies.
loc.GER_integrate_war_economies_tt: If §Y[HUN.GetName]§! is in a faction with §Y[Root.GetName]§!, add §Y4 Military Factory§! each to §Y[Root.GetName]§! and §Y[HUN.GetName]§!, and §Y[HUN.GetName]§! becomes puppet of §Y[Root.GetName]§!.\n
loc.GER_integrate_war_economies_tt2: If §Y[ROM.GetName]§! is in a faction with §Y[Root.GetName]§!, add §Y4 Military Factory§! each to §Y[Root.GetName]§! and §Y[ROM.GetName]§!, and §Y[ROM.GetName]§! becomes puppet of §Y[Root.GetName]§!.\n
loc.GER_integrate_war_economies_tt3: §R[HUN.GetName] must approve of the agreement for the bonuses to take effect.§!\n
loc.GER_integrate_war_economies_tt4: §R[ROM.GetName] must approve of the agreement for the bonuses to take effect.§!\n
loc.GER_uplift_the_rosenberg_office_desc: There are many things that need to be properly coordinated within the Reich, including governance and control of occupied territories, as well as internal surveillance and the entire intellectual and ideological education of the Nazi Party. All of these things should be centrally decided upon and controlled from the Rosenberg Office, seeing as Rosenberg is an important party theorist and ideologue.
loc.GER_reichskommissariats_tt: Allows for the formation of special §YSubject States§! and §YAdministrative Divisions§! in conquered territories, such as §YReichskommissariats§! and §YProtectorates§!. Also allows the division of Europe into projected spheres of influence.\n
loc.GER_oppose_hitler_desc: Hitler's reign must come to an end. He means to provoke the Western powers by remilitarizing the Rhineland, but doing so will give us the excuse we need to seize power with the help of loyal elements in the Wehrmacht.
loc.GER_oppose_hitler_civil_war: §RThe fascist supporters will start a civil war.§!\n
loc.GER_secure_the_new_state_desc: In light of the civil war that formed it, the provisional government lacks strength. We must ensure that it is secured and cannot easily be overthrown.
loc.GER_clamp_down_on_fascism_desc: In the past few years under the Nazi regime the oppressive, dictatorial, and anti-royalist nature of the government and their fascist ideologues and supporters became but all too apparent. We must ensure their way of thinking is stamped out wherever it may rear its head.
loc.GER_revive_the_kaiserreich_desc: The events of the past decade have shown that democracy is too weak to keep nefarious internal elements at bay. We must return to the strong leadership of a Kaiser, and in preparation for his return we shall revert the constitution back to that of the Deutsches Kaiserreich.
loc.GER_revive_the_kaiserreich_tt: §YThe German Military Junta§! will be known as §Ythe German Empire§!.\n
loc.GER_rebuild_the_nation_desc: After the ravages of the civil war, we must look to rebuilding our nation. We will ask the people to set aside their personal comforts for a time, so that we may focus all our resources on attaining this goal.
loc.GER_fan_the_prussian_militarism_desc: To replace the losses of our civil war, we must appeal to the Prussian sense of militarism to improve recruitment and training of new recruits. That our military has freed us from Nazi dictatorship ensures these Prussian ideals are now more popular than ever.
loc.GER_a_new_and_better_germany_desc: While we are rebuilding our nation, we should aim to go above and beyond what is necessary, so that what we build now will stand the test of time.
loc.GER_bulwark_against_bolshevism_desc: Our nation stands as a shield against [GER.GetBulwarkBolshevismDesc], protecting the West from [GER.GetBulwarkCommunismDesc] influence. We must carry this mantle with pride, and prepare to use arms if necessary.
loc.GER_bulwark_against_bolshevism_tt: §RThis National Spirit will be lost if in a faction with, or fighting a war on the same side of, [SOV.GetNameDef].§!\n
loc.GER_return_of_the_kaiser_desc: The Kaiserreich needs a kaiser, and Wilhelm II still lives, exiled in the Netherlands. We will lift his exile and invite him to return to take the throne, despite what the Western Democracies might think.
loc.GER_focus_on_the_true_enemy_desc: It is not internally, but externally that our enemies can be found. The continued crime of Western colonial monopoly is only overshadowed by the injustice of the Treaty of Versailles that we were subjected to after we sought to take our place in the sun. It ends now.
loc.GER_rebuild_the_high_seas_fleet_desc: We require a program of massive naval build-up to rebuild our once-glorious High Seas Fleet, if we are ever to challenge the West successfully.
loc.GER_our_place_in_the_sun_desc: Let everyone know that the German Empire once more asserts its right to take its place in the sun! Our people will no longer be humiliated in the shadows.
loc.GER_pride_of_the_modern_germany_desc: It will take many years to match the Royal British Navy in size. So, we must overmatch it in quality. Our ships will be the most modern and powerful that have ever plied the seas!
loc.GER_prepare_for_the_next_blockade_desc: The infernal British blockade is what cost us the last war. We will not make the same mistake again. This time, we will go to even greater lengths to prepare the population for what is to come.
loc.GER_break_the_anglo_french_colonial_hege: The time has come to shatter the monopoly the West has held on colonialism, for far too long.
loc.GER_schlieffen_once_more_desc: The Maginot must be circumvented. We will once again pass through Belgium and Luxemburg, in a swift strike for victory.
loc.GER_reinstate_imperial_possessions_desc: With our successful reconquest of historically German areas, we can now begin the process of reinstating them into the [Root.GetName] as fully-fledged provinces. The last disgrace of Versailles is undone at last!
loc.GER_crossing_the_atlantic_desc: With the vanquishing of all continental opposition to our rule, we must see to re-focusing our production effort to the creation of a huge navy, so that we may bring the fight to the British and the Americans. We shall not rest, until in God's good time, the Old World, with all its power and might, steps forth to the subjugation and humiliation of the new.
loc.GER_crossing_the_atlantic_trigger_tt:
Not: Any Enemy Country: 
  Is considered a Major Country 
  Any controlled state:
     Is in §YEurope§!
loc.GER_crossing_the_atlantic_2_factories_tt: Remove §Y2 Military Factory§! from an inland state for each coastal state that receives these dockyards.\n
loc.GER_crossing_the_atlantic_1_factory_tt: Remove §Y1 Military Factory§! from an inland state for each coastal state that receives these dockyards.\n
loc.GER_the_central_powers_desc: We require allies if we are to stand against the West. We will create our own faction to stand against the oppression of the democracies.
loc.GER_prepare_italian_coup_desc: Italy's fall into fascism must be undone. We will approach the Italian royalists with a proposal for a coup with our support.
loc.GER_assassinate_mussolini_desc: The time has come to ensure the end of the linchpin of Italian fascism. German hands will assassinate the leader, after which the Italian royalists will seize power in one swift motion.
loc.GER_italy_declined_assassination_tt: §Y[ITA.GetNameWithFlag]§! has not rejected our assassination proposal
loc.GER_rekindle_imperial_sentiment_desc: Though the Austro-Hungarian Empire shattered after the Great War, those who mourn the Empire's passing can still be found. We will cultivate these imperial sentiments in the hopes that the successor states may decide to rejoin for their own strength.
loc.GER_rekindle_imperial_sentiment_tt: When unaligned support is high enough, enables decisions for these nations to reform the Austro-Hungarian Empire and join the Central Powers.\n
loc.GER_rekindle_imperial_sentiment_tt_2: When unaligned support is high enough, enables decisions for these nations to reform the Austro-Hungarian Empire and join Mitteleuropa.\n
loc.GER_expatriate_the_communists_desc: The internal threat of communism continues to plague our nation. We must rid ourselves of it, no matter where the adherents flee to.
loc.GER_accept_british_naval_dominance_desc: We require allies to fight communism, and the British are a prime candidate. We will alleviate their concerns by accepting their naval superiority and disavowing any extensive naval build-up, in the interest of improved relations.
loc.GER_ally_the_shade_desc: If we cannot take their place in the sun, then we shall ally those who cast the shadow over us.
loc.GER_carte_blanche_for_alsace_and_french_: Carte Blanche for Alsace and French Colonies
We must petition our new ally to allow us free reign in reclaiming our rightful territories of Alsace-Lorraine, and our fair share of African colonies.
loc.GER_bypass_maginot_in_the_south_desc: The British have their interests in the Low Countries, and so we must seek alternative routes around the Maginot. The south, though mountainous and difficult to traverse, must suffice. German ingenuity will see us through.
loc.GER_see_to_the_eastern_front_desc: If we have learned anything from the Great War, it is that we must prepare for an attack on our outlying eastern possessions. These possessions must be restored and fortified against invasion.
loc.GER_see_to_the_eastern_front_tt: Add 6 §YLand Forts§! in 3 provinces on the eastern border.\n
loc.GER_see_to_the_eastern_front_tt2: Add 8 §YLand Forts§! in 4 provinces on the eastern border.\n
loc.GER_danzig_for_guarantees_desc: The Poles surely must feel the danger of the [GER.GetDanzigGuaranteesBolsheviksDesc]. Perhaps we could come to an agreement regarding the return of Danzig, Poznan, and the Silesian Voivodeship, in exchange for guarantees of military support in case of an invasion [GER.GetDanzigGuaranteesRedsDesc].
loc.GER_safeguard_the_baltic_desc: The Baltics were a part of the Russian Empire until a few decades ago, and it stands to reason the [GER.GetRussiansDemonym] may once more try to annex them. We must prevent this, and offer our military support in case of [SOV.GetAdjective] invasion.
loc.GER_support_the_finns_desc: The Finns find themselves in the firing line of the [GER.GetRussiansDemonym]. We will offer them a guarantee against the communist threat, and give them some modest industrial aid.
loc.GER_anti_comintern_pact_unaligned_desc: The military threat is not the only danger we are subjected to. We must look to ways to keep communism at bay, itself, and to that end we will create a pact with our fellow non-communists, resolving to combating its advance.
loc.GER_anti_soviet_pact_unaligned_desc: We should prepare for a military conflict with communism by inviting all signatories of the anti-comintern pact to agree to an additional clause calling for military support against any Soviet aggression. As we are already committed to each other in so many ways, this should be no more than a formalization.
loc.GER_tackle_the_communist_threat_desc: As long as [SOV.GetNameDef] exists, it will be a threat to us. Rather than waiting for them to strike, we shall take the initiative in our own hands.
loc.GER_the_iberian_problem_desc: Bastions of communism still remain. We must ensure all are rooted out, beginning with communist Spain.
loc.GER_reestablish_free_elections_desc: We will make a return to democratic ideals, by re-instating free elections, to be held at a point in the near future.
loc.GER_the_monarchy_compromise_desc: The military that fought for our freedom from Nazi tyranny have clear royalist leanings. To ensure their satisfaction with the path the nation is taking, we must make a compromise and allow the return of the monarchy.
loc.GER_the_great_red_menace_desc: Our actions in the previous war are still in recent memory with many. We must refocus the fears of the continent on the true danger: the great [GER.GetGreatRedMenaceDesc] that looms in the East. We will begin a massive propaganda campaign to open the eyes of the continent.
loc.GER_central_european_alliance_desc: Now that we have focused the attention of the continent on the problem, we must offer the solution: we will lead an alliance for all minor nations in Europe, which will ensure protection against this most lethal threat to our way of life.
loc.GER_danubian_membership_desc: The Danubian successor nations to the Austro-Hungarian Empire have not forgotten what it means to be our ally. We shall offer them membership and protection against the threat of [GER.GetDanubianMembershipDesc].
loc.GER_danubian_expansion_desc: We must seek to expand our influence to those Balkan nations prone to [SOV.GetAdjective] aggression. We shall offer the remaining nations on the Danube membership and protection against the threat of [GER.GetDanubianMembershipDesc].
loc.invite_non_fascist_communist_only_TT: Requires potential member states to not be fascist or communist and not being in a faction already.\n
loc.GER_no_balkan_communism_desc: Communist influences have crept into the Balkans, which we cannot allow. It must be destroyed before it takes root.
loc.GER_no_balkan_communism_tt: Gains §YTopple Government§! war goals against communist nations in the Balkans.\n
loc.GER_no_balkan_communism_HUN_tt: Gains §YTopple Government§! war goal against §YHungarian People's Republic§!.\n
