loc.RAJ_jungle_training_desc: India, Burma and Indochina are covered in jungle and special training is recommended to make our soldiers effective in this dangerous terrain.
loc.RAJ_lessons_of_the_great_war_desc: Indian colonial soldiers participated in the last world war, and the lessons from this conflict should be brought to bear on the training and organization of the army.
loc.RAJ_indianisation_of_army_desc: To properly protect India in a total war, the entire population of India should be mobilized. This will mean not just recruiting more widely from the Indian population, but allowing Indian officers to take command at some place in the chain of authority.
loc.RAJ_indian_gurkhas_desc: The Gurkhas of the Punjabi and Nepalese highlands are legendary for their military skill. They’ve served the Raj loyally for many years, and excel at all kinds of warfare.
loc.RAJ_an_indian_sandhurst_desc: India has been demanding a military school of its own ever since the last war, and at long last we created one in 1932. The Indian Military Academy has been turning out Indian officers for a few years now, giving us a core command group.
loc.RAJ_lions_of_the_great_war_desc: The Sikhs have a strong military tradition and were highly decorated in the last war. The Lions of the Punjab form a strong regiment on their own, and the region is ripe for further recruitment.
loc.RAJ_indian_gentlemen_officers_desc: The gentlemen who have served the Raj through close co-operation with the Imperial authorities are a ready-made supply of commanders, should we need loyal men to lead the new Indian Army.
loc.RAJ_the_bangalore_torpedo_desc: One of British India's greatest contributions to the art of war is the Bangalore Torpedo, a series of connected pipes that can be used to destroy obstacles while the engineers are under fire. This device has gained great popularity around the world.
loc.RAJ_vickers_berthier_gun_desc: The Vickers-Berthier is a little unwieldy but has the virtue of being easy to quickly produce. For a nation like India, this is a very important characteristic in a gun.
loc.RAJ_royal_indian_artillery_desc: The Royal Indian Artillery has existed ever since the East India Company formed a battalion of cannon with Indian gunners in 1748. We can draw on these many decades of experience.
loc.RAJ_army_motorization_desc: India is too large to be covered efficiently by train and horse. The army should have motorized divisions and regular truck transport.
loc.mountain_guns_tt:
Enables §HMountain Gun§!
§HArtillery (Mountains)§!
    Attack: §G+8%§!
    Movement: §G+15%§!
§HAnti-Tank (Mountains)§!
    Attack: §G+8%§!
    Movement: §G+15%§!
loc.RAJ_revive_the_screw_guns_desc: The mountainous terrain of Northern India led to the development of an artillery piece that could be dismantled and carried on muleback to wherever it was needed. This 7 pounder may be a little obsolete, but we shouldn’t ignore its utility.
loc.RAJ_indian_armor_desc: India should focus on developing its own homemade armor and tank division.
loc.RAJ_modernizing_army_desc: For too long the Indian armed forces were seen as little more than a colonial outpost, with few of the benefits and equipment available to the home army in Britain. It is time to modernize what we have in the Raj.
loc.RAJ_indian_defense_research_desc: Now that India is fully a sovereign nation we are no longer receiving access to advanced prototypes and blueprints like we previously did. We must ensure that we always stay ahead of our enemies, and do not fall behind in technology.
loc.RAJ_british_pilot_training_desc: The Royal Air Force has agreed to accept Indian pilots to undertake training. This education will be a great help in the development of our own air wing.
loc.RAJ_expand_air_bases_desc: India is very large, so patrolling and protecting its air space means we must increase our air capacity at bases across the subcontinent.
loc.RAJ_air_support_effort_desc: Combined Arms warfare is the new way of war, so we have to focus some energy in the training and production of aircraft that can support ground and sea forces.
loc.RAJ_fighter_effort_desc: We need fighter aircraft to escort bombers and intercept any enemy planes that threaten our nation.
loc.RAJ_royal_indian_air_force_desc: The time has come to take our small air division and expand it into its own branch of the armed forces. A national air force with independent command will be better able to serve the Indian people and the Empire.
loc.RAJ_the_smiling_buddha_desc: Scientists are close to unlocking the secret of atomic energy - and this will lead to the creation of very powerful explosives. We cannot fall behind in the quest for atomic weapons.
loc.RAJ_great_indian_peninsula_railway_desc: Government control of the Great Indian Peninsula Railway in 1925 means that its expansion and improvement falls upon us. A growing population needs better transportation infrastructure.
loc.RAJ_industrial_expansion_desc: Hundreds of millions of people call India home - there is no reason this population should not be the foundation of an industrial giant.
loc.RAJ_tata_steel_desc: Tata Steel is on its way to becoming the largest steel manufacturer in the Empire. Greater production will further fuel the modernization of India.
loc.RAJ_assam_oil_desc: Assam is the center of Indian oil production, especially the refinery at Digboi. Access to this resource needs to be expanded and exploited.
loc.RAJ_indian_institute_of_science_desc: The Indian Institute of Science campus in Bangalore is allowing the best and brightest of India's population to further our advances.
loc.RAJ_institute_of_fundamental_research_de: Some of our leading scientists and industrialists are championing a new Institute of Fundamental Research to take advantage of the latest discoveries in physical sciences.
loc.RAJ_research_collaboration_desc: The British showed us the advantage of sharing scientific progress between close allies. Our whole faction will be able to conduct wartime R&D more efficiently if we take the steps necessary to coordinate this.
loc.RAJ_expand_mazagon_dock_desc: The Mazagon Dock in Mumbai is our most important shipbuilder on the West Coast. It needs greater capacity in this world crisis.
loc.RAJ_found_scindia_shipyard_desc: We need a dockyard on the East Coast of the country, so establishing the Scindia Shipyard in Visakhapatnam makes sense for our naval future.
loc.RAJ_royal_indian_navy_desc: The Royal [ROOT.GetAdjective] Navy will need to be rapidly expanded. New tactics and new ships should be a priority.
loc.RAJ_screening_effort_desc: India plays a crucial role in defending the southern route to the Suez Canal. Screening and escort missions will help vital supplies and soldiers get to the European and African theaters.
loc.RAJ_cruiser_effort_desc: Cruisers will be sufficient for now in the development and expansion of [ROOT.GetAdjective] naval power.
loc.RAJ_submarine_effort_desc: With the rise of Japanese naval surface power in Asia, it might make sense to direct our energies under the sea, striking from submarines.
loc.RAJ_capital_ship_effort_desc: As a British outpost, India has seen the power of capital ships in dominating the sea. We should build our own heavy cruisers and battleships.
loc.RAJ_modernizing_navy_desc: Better engines, more crew space, faster speed and larger guns. India's navy will soon stand with the best on the continent.
loc.RAJ_east_india_railways_desc: Government control of the East India Railway leaves all decisions for its expansion and improvement in the hands of our ministers.
loc.RAJ_integrate_princely_railways_desc: Some of the Indian princes have financed their own rail systems, but, till now, they have been poorly integrated with the rail lines built by the Raj. Something must be done to tie the nation's trains together.
loc.RAJ_ishapore_arsenal_desc: The Ishapore Arsenal and Rifle Factory has been in operation since the 18th century. It is responsible for many innovations in gun design, and is the centerpiece of our arms production system.
loc.RAJ_clamp_down_on_corruption_desc: Despite the British industrial efforts to expand India's rail system, very few of the benefits of the expansion seem to come to India. There is endemic corruption and double dealing in the transportation sector and we must be seen to do something about it.
loc.RAJ_strengthen_ties_with_british_investo: To expand our factories and resources we still heavily rely on British capital. Until we have a vigorous banking sector of our own, we must go on bended knee to London to seek support.
loc.RAJ_british_rail_investors_desc: Civilian and transportation infrastructure in India needs a heavy cash infusion from British financiers.
loc.RAJ_british_arms_investors_desc: If we want to quickly get our weapons factories moving, we will need to ask British banks to invest in our military infrastructure.
loc.RAJ_indian_sandhurst_tt: A §Y4 Skill General§! named §YKodandera Madappa Cariappa§! will appear.\nA §Y3 Skill General§! named §YKodandera Subayya Thimayya§! will appear.\nA §Y3 Skill General§! named §YJayanto Nath Chaudhuri§! will appear.
loc.RAJ_create_unit_gurkas_tt: Gain an elite unit of Gurkhas in Delhi.
loc.RAJ_create_unit_rani_tt: Gain an infantry unit in Delhi.
loc.RAJ_create_unit_sikh_tt: Gain an infantry unit in Delhi.
loc.RAJ_create_general_rani_tt: \nA §Y5 Skill General§! named §YLakshmi Sahgal§! will appear
loc.RAJ_administrative_oversight_desc: With industrial corruption dealt with and our independence secured, it is time to bring local administrators under the wing of government. While it may seem a difficult task, the tribal leaders and local officials hold sway over great swathes of our population. They must be incorporated for the good of our country in these dark times.
loc.RAJ_enable_local_industrialization: Enables §HRural Industrialization§! decisions, allowing for modification of the §HAgrarian Society§! Spirit.
loc.RAJ_land_clearance_desc: With increased influence channeled through local leaders, we are able to make better use of our natural resources and land in the name of the state.
loc.RAJ_workforce_integration_desc: Using the local power of regional and tribal leaders, we are able to funnel otherwise wasted resources into improvement programmes in rural areas.
loc.apply_integration_effects_retroactively: \nThis will be applied §Hretroactively§! to all states upon which this decision has been taken previously.
loc.continuous_naval_production_desc: By focusing resources on our shipyards and exempting skilled shipbuilders from military service, we can dramatically reduce production time for ships.
loc.continuous_air_production_desc: We can reorganize our aviation industry to eliminate waste and streamline production.
loc.continuous_non_factory_construct_desc: There is still a lot of slack in our construction industry. By focusing our attention on it, we can achieve a significant improvement in construction speed. Unfortunately, the production of machine tools has proven a major bottleneck in the expansion of our heavy industry, so they won't benefit from efforts in this area.
loc.continuous_reduce_training_time_desc: By creating specialized advanced training units within each division, we can deploy even divisions that would previously have been held back to finish training to the front.
loc.continuous_suppression_desc: By infiltrating the major resistance groups in occupied territory and turning their leaders, we can significantly reduce the amount of damage they can do.
loc.continuous_repair_desc: We will form specialized repair teams from factory and construction workers and centrally control their deployment to improve reconstruction of damaged infrastructure.
loc.continuous_tech_share_desc: We will encourage our research institutes and universities to reach out to their counterparts in allied countries. This will gain us a tech sharing bonus.
loc.continuous_boost_freedom_desc: By reorganizing our colonial bureaucracy and recruiting native administrators, we will, in time, be able to take charge of our own affairs.
loc.continuous_restrict_freedom_desc: Our colonial subjects have gotten rather silly ideas about things like "self-determination" or "national independence". It is time to disabuse them of these notions.
loc.continuous_special_facility_desc: We have the opportunity to improve our research facilities to host more scientists to find the new breakthrough that can change our future warfare.
loc.USA_continue_the_new_deal_desc: The policies of the New Deal have proven to work. We must not lose our way now.
loc.USA_suspend_the_presecution_desc: The persecution of American citizens for their political views - no matter how abhorrent they may seem - is fundamentally at odds with the values of this country. It must cease immediately.
loc.USA_desegregate_the_armed_forces_desc: Serving under arms in the armed forces of one's country can be an unwelcome duty - but it can also be a cherished right. A right that many of our citizens are denied on account of their ancestry.
loc.USA_full_desegregation_desc: For too long, some of our states have treated people differently based on old, outdated and inhuman criteria. In a free republic, every citizen must be treated equally - and not separately.
loc.USA_democratic_socialism_desc: No right-thinking person can deny that socialism is the future of human civilization. At the same time, no proud and patriotic citizen of this republic could possibly support a system where government is no longer made by the people and of the people. Like our proud forefathers, we will create a new form of government that combines both.
loc.USA_liberty_for_the_philippines_desc: The people of the Philippines have shown their ability to organize their own affairs, and it is about time that the last vestiges of American control over their country are officially removed.
loc.USA_pacific_decolonisation_desc: There is no justification - none - for the continued presence of European powers in the Pacific, nor for keeping the peoples of the Pacific Islands in servitude to their European masters. America will no longer stand idly by while this injustice continues.
loc.USA_union_representation_act_desc: Work is a core part of human life, and organizing into a union is a fundamental part of organizing a democratic society. It is only proper that we should recognize this and ensure that unions have mandatory representation in Congress.
loc.USA_old_age_pension_act_desc: After a lifetime of work, our people deserve to enjoy financial security and respect in old age. What legislation exists to support them is clearly insufficient.
loc.USA_accumulated_wealth_tax_act_desc: Some people in our country have amassed absurd amounts of capital. This money sits passively in bank accounts or invested in impractically large buildings, gilded furniture and expensive paintings. None of these serve any viable economic purpose. By instituting a new tax we will force those amongst our citizens who have amassed such useless wealth to reinvest the money into the economy.
loc.USA_guarantee_the_american_dream_desc: Most of our people don't wish for much in life: stable employment, good health, and a place to start a family. There is no reason why they shouldn't have that.
loc.USA_worker_management_act_desc: Far too often factories and offices are managed by people who have never worked on the shop floor. Unable to understand the realities of production, they set unrealistic expectations. To safeguard our economy from the damage such incompetent managers can cause, we will enforce management of the workers, by the workers, for the workers!
loc.USA_militia_organization_act_desc: Our proud republic has a long tradition of the citizen soldier. Should our country ever find itself invaded by a foreign attacker, they will face a well-organized and well-armed militia of men and women fighting on familiar territory to defend their homes.
loc.USA_communal_property_act_desc: The needs of the many should never be outweighed by the desires of the few, or even the one. To ensure that this is the case, we will pass new legislation to allow local communities to execute eminent domain more easily.
loc.USA_reintegration_desc: The war has divided our nation, but eventually, even those that rose up against us can yet be redeemed. When the population has learned the error of their ways, they should be allowed to once again rejoin the political process in our proud republic.
loc.USA_reach_out_to_the_ware_group: Reach out to the Ware Group
loc.USA_reach_out_to_the_ware_group_desc: There exists a small group of devoted communists inside our government. They believe that they operate in secret, but we know their names. Perhaps they could see that our goals align and could be persuaded to join the government.
loc.USA_us_ussr_economic_cooperation_desc: Despite its chaotic and bloody birth, the Soviet Union has achieved remarkable progress in building a modern, industrialized society. We should do our part to help them.
loc.USA_secure_china_desc: China has been gripped by a long, bloody civil war. The Nationalist government is deeply corrupt and has lost all support in the population. It is time we start to support the single actor in China who can unite and pacify the country - the Communist Party.
loc.USA_end_monarchism_desc: The monarchies of Europe have plunged the world into one world war already - we can not allow them to do it again. Our forefathers made war on the King of England to gain their freedom - we shall free the world from his tyranny forever!
loc.USA_shatter_the_empires_desc: We were once a colony of a global empire, until we purchased our freedom in blood. Our republic can not truly feel secure until those that dream themselves masters of this world are contained.
loc.USA_agricultural_adjustment_act_desc: Our farmers have been particularly hard-hit by the depression. We must ensure that the people who produce our food are not driven out of business by an unchecked market.
loc.USA_fair_labour_standards_act_desc: With the first signs of a slow recovery taking place, it is time to ensure that the workers get to participate in it. We must ban exploitative practices such as unpaid overtime and introduce a liveable minimum wage.
loc.USA_federal_housing_act_desc: As part of our ongoing efforts to eradicate poverty in the United States, we will create a program of federally-subsidized housing.
loc.USA_office_of_scientific_research_and_de: With war looming on the horizon, we must focus our scientific efforts to ensure that we are not outmatched by any potential adversary.
loc.USA_focus_on_europe_desc: The Great Powers of Europe are once more poised to plunge the world into a world war. We can not, as we did before, wait until it affects us. We must be ready to intervene decisively should any nation in Europe threaten the peace.
loc.USA_focus_on_asia_desc: While most people look with worry towards Europe, we also face uncertainty and instability across the Pacific. It might be in our best interest to intervene abroad before we are attacked closer to home.
loc.USA_magic_desc: The Navy thinks it can break the Japanese encryption codes, which would allow us to read all of their message traffic, including ship movements.
loc.USA_neutrality_act_desc: It seems increasingly certain that war will break out in Europe. During the Great War, American companies sold large quantities of weapons to the Allies, and many believe that the American entry was mostly motivated by a desire to ensure that those deliveries would be paid for. This time, there won't be any war-profiteering.
loc.USA_lend_lease_act_neutrality_tt: \n\nPassing the Neutrality Act will §Rdrastically increase§! the requirements to pass the Lend Lease Act
loc.USA_lend_lease_act_desc: The large democracies of the world are under assault. If they lose the battle, it is only a question of time before war comes to our shores. We must do what we can to support them - even if they can not pay for the equipment immediately.
loc.USA_reestablish_the_gold_standard_desc: Without the Gold Standard, money exists as little more than an article of faith, while rampant inflation eats away our people's savings and devalues their work. We must abandon this fiscally irresponsible path.
loc.USA_adjusted_compensation_act_desc: Our veterans of the Great War were promised a fair pension. Many have fallen on hard times recently as the depression hit. We must do what we can to help those who answered the call of the Republic in its hour of need.
loc.USA_labour_management_relations_act_desc: Businesses all over America are threatened by all kinds of union activities - strikes, organizing, demands for higher wages. We can not allow this to continue.
loc.USA_protectionist_tariffs_desc: Free Trade has opened up our markets to foreign competitors, many of which have raised tariffs and duties of their own. Our companies face stiff competition while theirs enjoy the safety of the customs-wall. This must end.
loc.USA_income_tax_reform_desc: The Income Tax takes money out of every American's wallet - money that our citizens could spend on buying other things and supporting their local economy. We will give Americans the autonomy over their own finances back.
loc.USA_institute_of_american_sciences_desc: The universities and research labs all across the nation have so far conducted their research as they saw fit. This must end. We will create a new organization to coordinate the efforts of our world-class scientists.
loc.USA_america_first_desc: Some people would have us spend our treasures and the blood of our youth in foreign wars. We must not be swayed by these warmongers, and will instead live by a simple maxim: America First - Everyone Else Second.
loc.USA_extend_the_chinese_exclusion_acts_de: With China ravaged by war we must take steps to limit Chinese immigration, lest we be drowned in waves of refugees.
loc.USA_empower_the_huac_desc: The House Committee on Unamerican Activities serves an important function in our healthy democracy. We must not permit disloyal elements from trying to influence the political process.
loc.USA_voter_registration_act_desc: Elections are the most important part of a democracy. It is utterly unreasonable to demand that there should be no checks on who can participate in them - or perhaps, the people who argue for uncontrolled elections have more sinister motivations and wish to subvert the process with vote fraud...
loc.USA_ally_with_the_silver_shirts_desc: To restore our nation to its proper place in the world and claim our manifest destiny, a more fundamental reorganization is necessary. The Silver Shirts will help us achieve this.
loc.USA_national_prosperity_program_desc: The key to ensuring a swift recovery and lasting prosperity lies not in unchecked markets but in carefully guided programs, connecting private and public enterprises.
loc.USA_privatize_the_TVA_desc: The Tennessee Valley Authority has crowded out private competition and has established a stranglehold on construction work in the area. It can not be the government's job to do things the private sector has proven to do better.
loc.USA_de_regulate_the_banking_sector_desc: Following a correction in the financial markets that is perfectly normal in the economic cycle, previous governments have instituted quite unreasonable constraints on financial activities. While no doubt well-intentioned, these restrictions clearly do more harm than good.
loc.USA_national_employment_strategy_desc: Unemployment comes from a simple fact: people don't match up with the jobs offered. Factories lie idle because employers don't find the people they need while people in other parts of the country starve. We will introduce a new strategy that will ensure that any employer can find the people he needs to run his company.
loc.USA_invite_foreign_support_desc: With some very disturbing reports coming in about the loyalty of the military and some state governments, we might have to look abroad for support.
loc.USA_send_lindbergh_to_germany_desc: The famous aviator has offered to go to Europe to investigate how Germany has rebuilt itself after the last war. This should give us valuable experience. Lindbergh has also indicated that he would be willing to join the government in a consulting role.
loc.USA_work_with_the_bund_desc: The German-American Bund has offered to help us communicate our positions to the many Americans of German ancestry. It would ensure that we have a sympathetic base in their states.
loc.USA_work_with_the_bund_tt: Ensures that the following states remain with the government in the event of a civil war: Ohio, Missouri, Wisconsin, Illinois, Indiana and Michigan
loc.USA_recruit_the_free_corps_desc: With the military increasingly suspect, we must turn to the heroes of the Great War. In its hour of need, the German Freikorps came to the aid of the German Republic. We need a similar organization that will stay loyal to us when our hour of need comes.
loc.USA_honor_the_confederacy_desc: For too long, the story of the Civil War was told from the northern perspective - the story of a doomed rebellion. It is time that the other side is heard as well.
loc.USA_war_powers_act_desc: In a world of increasingly fast aircraft carrying increasingly larger bombloads, in a world of submarines and chemical weapons, restricting the President to require the consent of Congress to do what is needed to defend the country is inviting disaster.
loc.USA_seize_cuba_desc: Just off our shores lies an unsinkable aircraft carrier, ready to serve as a base for an aggressor. We must not let that happen.
loc.USA_eliminate_the_southern_threat_desc: Mexico has been an unstable mess for the last generation. Whether the violence spills over our border or someone unites the country and marches north is irrelevant - we must secure our southern flank.
loc.USA_the_canadian_corridor_desc: A small strip of sparsely populated Canadian territory separates Alaska from the lower US. Its defense is therefore dependent on Canadian good-will. However, the most likely attacker is Canada. This can not continue.
loc.USA_north_american_dominion_desc: With our immediate borders secure, we must look further afield to preempt any threat against North America. We can not tolerate any rogue state in the region.
loc.USA_strategic_interests_desc: The world is more connected than ever before. A threat in one part of it can easily grow until it becomes a danger to the entire world. We must build a network of mutually-supporting bases around the globe to enable us to respond quickly to any situation.
loc.USA_protect_south_america_desc: The southern part of our double continent has been the playground of empires since it was discovered. It is time that someone took it upon themselves to ensure that those nations are undisturbed and guided towards a more productive future.
loc.USA_pacific_pacification_desc: Australia and New Zealand are too far from Britain to be effectively defended by them. We can not allow them to be taken over by a nation hostile to [USA.GetNameDef].
loc.USA_secure_asia_desc: The colonial nations in Europe seem either unwilling or unable to effectively defend their Asian colonies. We must take over this burden for them, lest these areas become springboards of further aggression.
loc.USA_global_hegemony_desc: We stand at the cusp of achieving a position of global supremacy that will allow us to prevent conflict just through our mere existence. We just have to ensure that the remaining Great Powers on the planet acknowledge our position.
loc.USA_war_plans_division_desc: While we might desire peace, we must prepare for war.
loc.USA_intervention_in_the_americas_desc: Our first order of business must be to ensure we are prepared for any eventuality in our own hemisphere.
loc.USA_war_plan_green_desc: With Mexico in a constant state of instability following the revolution, we must be prepared to intervene, decisively.
loc.USA_war_plan_crimson_desc: While Canada may be a friendly neighbor now, this may not always be the case.
loc.USA_war_plan_gray_desc: History has shown that the nations of the Caribbean are quite unstable. We might have to move quickly to protect American interests should any of them fall into instability.
loc.USA_hemisphere_defense_desc: Regardless of any foreign entanglements, we must first and foremost look to our own neighborhood.
loc.USA_intervention_in_europe_desc: Less than two decades after the end of the Great War, the nations of Europe are once again poised for war. We must be prepared in case the situation requires swift intervention.
loc.USA_war_plan_gold_desc: France suffers from internal division and increasing political radicalism, but is also one of the greatest military powers of Europe. This combination makes many people uncomfortable.
loc.USA_war_plan_silver_desc: Italy has openly declared its ambition to rule the Mediterranean. If their desires of an Empire conflict with our interests, we must be prepared.
loc.USA_anti_bolshevist_aid_desc: Any gun, shell, bullet and pair of boots we can give to those fighting the spread of the [GetSovietThreatNameAlt] Threat will ultimately help defend us.
loc.USA_war_plan_ruby_desc: India houses untold millions of people, which we must be prepared to face should we come into conflict.
loc.USA_war_plan_scarlet_garnet_desc: In the Pacific, Australia and New Zealand may well come to the aid of their motherland. Any plan to deal with Britain must account for her colonies.
loc.USA_intervention_in_asia_desc: Often overshadowed by the developments in Europe, Asia has its own trouble spots, forcing us to prepare for an intervention.
loc.USA_war_plan_yellow_desc: China has been in a state of civil war for more than a generation. There is no telling when the situation deteriorates to the point where we have to intervene.
loc.USA_war_department_desc: In an age of industrialized warfare, we must have an administration capable of harnessing the resources of our great nation to their fullest potential.
loc.USA_selective_training_act_desc: The United States has historically been slow to adopt a draft, even in times of war. We are no longer able to afford this luxury.
loc.USA_louisiana_maneuvers_desc: Budget constraints have forced us to observe many military developments from afar. Now, we can finally try out some of our theories in practice.
loc.USA_airborne_divisions_desc: The developments in the range and payload of planes have opened up a number of possibilities. Cargo planes could deliver a full division of troops far behind enemy lines, where they would wreak havoc.
loc.USA_army_of_the_united_states_desc: For the fights that are to come, the US Army is too small. To oversee the dramatic increase in size we will have to accomplish, we will need to create a new organization.
loc.USA_womens_armed_service_integration_act: We can not afford to turn away anyone who wishes to serve. Every woman in uniform frees up a man to fight at the front.
loc.USA_tank_experiments_desc: Tanks are indispensable on the modern battlefield. We must find out how to best utilize them.
loc.USA_tank_destroyer_doctrine_desc: A controversial theory developed by some artillery officers, claiming that the best weapon against armored breakthroughs is a fast, lightly armored but heavily armed vehicle.
loc.USA_main_battle_tanks_desc: Experience in the field has clearly shown that a tank must be able to perform a large number of tasks, from infantry support to fighting enemy tanks. Designing vehicles to meet these needs allows us to streamline production.
loc.USA_armored_infantry_desc: Tanks alone can not win a battle. It takes infantry to hold territory. Providing them with armored vehicles allows them to keep up with the tanks and survive anything thrown at them.
loc.USA_build_the_pentagon_desc: The expansion of our military requires a new global headquarters to command it.
loc.USA_department_of_defense_desc: Renaming the war department underlines that we can no longer choose to ignore our protection until the moment it is tested. We must always be vigilant.
loc.USA_escort_fighters_desc: While the bomber might always get through, his wingman might not - unless they are both protected by friendly fighters.
loc.USA_us_army_airforce_desc: The fundamental objective of military airpower is to allow the ground forces to take and hold ground. Everything else is ancillary.
loc.USA_us_air_force_desc: The fundamental objective of military airpower is to win wars. Strategic bombing with ever more devastating weapons will either break the will of the enemy to resist or render them materially unable to do so.
loc.USA_two_ocean_navy_act_desc: With war on the horizon, we must ensure that no enemy can ever set foot on American shores. Our navy must be able to fight any enemy in either of the two great oceans that form our borders.
loc.USA_maritime_commission_desc: While most laymen only focus on the warships, the true experts know that it is the humble cargo vessel that wins wars. To increase the amount of shipping available in times of war, we will form a special board to coordinate construction.
loc.USA_advanced_basing_desc: The further we can keep the enemy from our shores, the better.
loc.USA_naval_radar_desc: Radar offers tantalizing possibilities to take the cover of night away from our enemies and detect them even in bad weather.
loc.USA_fleet_submarines_desc: Our most likely opponents in the naval war both rely on foreign trade, which has shown to be very vulnerable to submarines. These submarines would have to have very long range to allow them to cross the oceans and operate close to the enemy shore.
loc.USA_unrestricted_submarine_warfare_desc: History has shown that whatever well-intentioned treaty tried to control submarine warfare is not worth the paper it is written on. We should not consider ourselves bound by something our enemies will ignore anyway.
loc.USA_great_depression_cooldown: New Legislation is still being drafted
loc.USA_great_depression_cooldown_tt: After this law is passed, it will take §Y230 days§! until further New Deal legislation is drafted and ready to be signed.\n\n
loc.USA_limited_intervention_tt: Passing this law will make it §Rsignificantly harder§! to mobilize your economy.

loc.SWI_add_forts_bordering: [ROOT.GetNameDef] gains §H2 Land Forts§! in every neighboring province.\n\n
loc.ROM_white_squadron_focus_desc: The White squadron, proposed by Marina Ştirbei - a talented pilot of noble birth - is a service of air ambulances piloted exclusively by women. Merely the notion that rescue might be close at hand could keep our soldiers in high spirits.

loc.CAN_demand_labrador_tooltip: §H[ENG.GetName]§! will be §Rvery unlikely§! to accede to our demands unless they are in a desperate situation.\n\n

  - Have the same ideology as us

If they accept:
loc.tfv_canada.63.d: The new government of the [CAN.GetAdjective] state offer us an intriguing proposal for the concession of our territories in Newfoundland. While it is true that the laws of our nation acknowledge an indivisible state, our advisors urge us to consider the possibility of a new front that may distract from the situation in Europe.
loc.CAN_offer_concessions_for_labrador_and_n: The British claim dominion over land adjacent to our heartland. While we do not wish for war with a superior foe, they may be willing to consider a less than optimal trade if their situation demands it.
loc.AST_central_bureau_desc: A Signals & Intelligence bureau coordinated with the US promises to give us a strategic edge in the coming storm. Our expertise in this area should be acknowledged.
loc.HUN_a_new_flagship_desc: The storied history of our naval tradition has been one of trial, tribulation, and betrayal. In an effort to restore the pride of our heritage, our admirals propose a new flagship to inspire the whole nation.
loc.HUN_dockyards_desc: With our sights set firmly on the restoration of our borders, we must begin the task of developing a Mediterranean fleet to rival our past glories.
loc.if_no_depression_get_stuff_TT: If the §H$CAN_great_depression_1$§! has been removed, a different bonus will be applied.
loc.BEL_luxembourg_war_goal_desc: Luxembourg shares much with Belgium, language, culture and geography. Naturally the two should be united!

loc.FE_DIFFICULTY_NORMAL_TOOLTIP: §L"For the enemy is strong. He may hurl back our forces. Success may not come with rushing speed, but we shall return again and again."§!
loc.FE_DIFFICULTY_HARD_TOOLTIP: §L"Thirty years from now when you're sitting by your fireside with your grandson on your knee and he asks, 'What did you do in the great World War Two?' you won't have to cough and say, 'Well, your granddaddy shoveled shit in Louisiana.'"§!

loc.RULE_ALLOW_WARGOALS_ALWAYS_FREE_DESC: Unrestricted for any ideology at any World Tension.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_WARGOALS_LIMITED_DESC: Wargoal Generation is limited by ideologies and World Tension limits.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_WARGOALS_FREE_25_DESC: Wargoal generation is disabled below 25% World Tension, but available for all nations afterwards. This overrides any ideology restrictions, but still allows gaining wargoals through focuses.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_WARGOALS_FREE_50_DESC: Wargoal generation is disabled below 50% World Tension, but available for all nations afterwards. This overrides any ideology restrictions, but still allows gaining wargoals through focuses.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_WARGOALS_FREE_75_DESC: Wargoal generation is disabled below 75% World Tension, but available for all nations afterwards. This overrides any ideology restrictions, but still allows gaining wargoals through focuses.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_WARGOALS_FREE_100_DESC: Wargoal generation is disabled below 100% World Tension, but available for all nations afterwards. This overrides any ideology restrictions, but still allows gaining wargoals through focuses.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_WARGOALS_FOCUSES_ONLY_DESC: Wargoals can only be gained from national focuses, events and decisions.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_WARGOALS_FOCUSES_ONLY_38_DESC: Wargoals can only be gained from national focuses, events and decisions, until 1938.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_WARGOALS_FOCUSES_ONLY_39_DESC: Wargoals can only be gained from national focuses, events and decisions, until 1939.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_WARGOALS_FOCUSES_ONLY_40_DESC: Wargoals can only be gained from national focuses, events and decisions, until 1940.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_ACCESS_FREE_DESC: Countries can gain military access and docking rights from any other country.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_ACCESS_SAME_IDEOLOGY_DESC: Countries can gain military access and docking rights from countries that share the same ruling ideology.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_ACCESS_BLOCKED_DESC: Countries can never gain military access and docking rights from any other country outside of a faction.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_RELEASE_NATIONS_FREE_DESC: Countries may always release nations unless specifically prevented.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_RELEASE_NATIONS_PEACE_ONLY_DE: Countries may only release nations while at peace.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_RELEASE_NATIONS_NOT_BRITAIN_T: §Y[ENG.GetName]§! may only release this country via the §YDecolonization§! branch in the §YFocus Tree§!.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_RELEASE_NATIONS_NOT_YUGOSLAVI: §Y[YUG.GetName]§! may only release this country via the §YSelf-Government§! branch in the §YFocus Tree§!.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_RELEASE_NATIONS_NOT_GERMAN_CO: §Y[ROOT.GetNameDefCap]§! may not release German constituent states.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_RELEASE_NATIONS_COSSACK_TOOLT: This country may only be released via event.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_RELEASE_NATIONS_NOT_ITALY_TOO: §Y[ROOT.GetName]§! may not release §YYugoslavia§! as a country, it can however release any other country with a core in Yugoslavia.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_RELEASE_NATIONS_NOT_ETHIOPIA_: §Y[ROOT.GetName]§! may not release §YEthiopia§! as a country until it has greater compliance than §Y70%§! in all Ethiopian states.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_RELEASE_NATIONS_ITALY_PAP_TOO: §Y[ROOT.GetName]§! may not release §Y[PAP.GetName]§! as a country after having completed the focus §Y$ITA_seek_papal_support$§!.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_RELEASE_NATIONS_SPAIN_TOOLTIP: §Y[ROOT.GetName]§! may only release this country after the Spanish Civil War has concluded.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_RELEASE_NATIONS_ANARCHIST_SPA: §Y[ROOT.GetName]§! §Ris an Anarchist commune and may not release or puppet nations.§!
loc.RULE_ALLOW_RELEASE_NATIONS_SOVIET_TOOLTI: §Y[ROOT.GetNameDefCap]§! may not release this country unless first completing the §Y$SOV_autonomous_soviet_republics$§! focus or the §Y$SOV_reconvene_the_zemsky_sobor$§! focus.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_RELEASE_NATIONS_PEACE_ONLY_TO: Game Rule: §RCountries may only release nations while at peace.§!
loc.RULE_ALLOW_RELEASE_NATIONS_BLOCKED_TOOLT: Game Rule: §RCountries can never release nations.§!
loc.RULE_ALLOW_LICENSING_FREE_DESC: Countries may acquire production licenses from any country.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_LICENSING_SAME_IDEOLOGY_DESC: Countries may only acquire production licenses from countries that share the same ruling ideology.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_LICENSING_SAME_FACTION_DESC: Countries may only acquire production licenses from countries in the same faction.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_LICENSING_BLOCKED_DESC: Countries may never acquire production licenses outside of special decisions and events.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_LEND_LEASE_FREE_DESC: Countries may lend-lease equipment to anyone at any World Tension level.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_LEND_LEASE_LIMITED_DESC: Lend-Lease is limited by World Tension and ideology rules.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_LEND_LEASE_SAME_IDEOLOGY_DESC: Countries may only lend-lease equipment to countries of the same ruling ideology.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_LEND_LEASE_SAME_FACTION_DESC: Countries may only lend-lease equipment to countries in the same faction.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_LEND_LEASE_BLOCKED_DESC: Countries may never lend-lease equipment to any other country.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_VOLUNTEERS_FREE_DESC: Countries may send Volunteers to any country regardless of World Tension.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_VOLUNTEERS_LIMITED_DESC: Sending Volunteers is restricted by World Tension and ideology rules.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_VOLUNTEERS_SAME_IDEOLOGY_DESC: Countries may only send Volunteers to countries that share the same ruling ideology.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_VOLUNTEERS_BLOCKED_DESC: Countries may never send Volunteers to any country.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_GUARANTEES_FREE_DESC: The independence of any country can be guaranteed at any time, regardless of World Tension.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_GUARANTEES_LIMITED_DESC: Issuing a Guarantee of Independence is restricted by World Tension and ideology.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_GUARANTEES_SAME_IDEOLOGY_DESC: Countries can only Guarantee countries that share their ruling ideology.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_GUARANTEES_BLOCKED_DESC: Countries can never Guarantee other countries. This does not affect Guarantees that exist at the start of the game or which are issued through national focuses.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_REVOKE_GUARANTEES_ALLOWED_DES: Guarantees of Independence can be revoked.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_REVOKE_GUARANTEES_BLOCKED_DES: Guarantees of Independence can never be revoked outside of national focuses.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_REVOKE_GUARANTEES_BLOCKED_TOO: Game Rule: §RGuarantees of Independence can never be revoked outside of national focuses.§!
loc.RULE_ALLOW_LEAVE_FACTION_ALLOWED_DESC: Fully sovereign countries may leave a faction while at peace.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_LEAVE_FACTION_BLOCKED_DESC: Countries may not leave a faction except through national focuses and events.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_KICK_FACTION_ALLOWED_DESC: The Leader of a Faction may kick any country from the faction.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_KICK_FACTION_BLOCKED_DESC: The Leader of a Faction may not kick any member of the faction.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_TAKE_OVER_FACTION_ALLOWED_DES: Countries may take over faction leadership if they fulfill the criteria.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_TAKE_OVER_FACTION_BLOCKED_DES: Countries may not take over faction leadership.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_PARATROOPERS_ALLOWED_DESC: Countries may execute parachute drops freely.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_PARATROOPERS_BLOCKED_DESC: Countries may not execute parachute drops under any circumstances. Paratrooper divisions may still be recruited, but will not be able to execute airborne attacks.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_PARATROOPERS_BLOCKED_TOOLTIP: Game Rule: §RCountries may not execute parachute drops under any circumstances.§!
loc.RULE_ALLOW_COUPS_FREE_DESC: Countries may prepare and execute Coups freely.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_COUPS_AI_ONLY_DESC: Countries may only prepare and execute coups against nations not played by a human.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_COUPS_BLOCKED_DESC: Countries may not prepare or execute Coups in any nation.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_PARTY_BOOSTING_FREE_DESC: Countries may boost party popularity in any other country.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_PARTY_BOOSTING_AI_ONLY_DESC: Countries may only boost party popularity in countries not played by a human.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_PARTY_BOOSTING_PLAYER_ONLY_DE: Countries may only boost party popularity in countries with a human player.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_PARTY_BOOSTING_BLOCKED_DESC: Countries may not boost party popularity in any country.
loc.RULE_MAXIMUM_FORT_LEVEL_NORMAL_DESC: Countries may construct land and coastal forts according to normal restrictions.
loc.RULE_MAXIMUM_FORT_LEVEL_DESC: Countries may only build up land and coastal forts to the selected level. Fortifications present at the start of the game are not affected by this. Buildings granted from national focuses, decisions and events may exceed the selected level.
loc.RULE_RESEARCH_AOT_FREE_DESC: Countries may research technologies ahead of time with no restrictions.
loc.RULE_RESEARCH_AOT_THREE_YEARS_DESC: Countries may only research technologies three years in advance.
loc.RULE_RESEARCH_AOT_TWO_YEARS_DESC: Countries may only research technologies two years in advance.
loc.RULE_RESEARCH_AOT_ONE_YEARS_DESC: Countries may only research technologies one year in advance.
loc.RULE_RESEARCH_AOT_BLOCKED_DESC: Countries may not research technologies ahead of time.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_SCORCHED_EARTH_ALLOWED_DESC: Countries may use Scorch Earth freely.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_SCORCHED_EARTH_BLOCKED_DESC: Countries may not use Scorch Earth under any circumstances.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_SCORCHED_EARTH_BLOCKED: Scorched Earth is disabled in custom game rules.\n\n
loc.RULE_FASCIST_HISTORICAL_ITA_AI_DESC: The Italian AI will attempt to follow the historical chain of events as much as possible.
loc.RULE_FASCIST_ALTERNATE_ITA_AI_DESC: The Italian AI will attempt to form an alliance with Spain before joining the Axis, by going down the relevant branch in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_ALT_FASCIST_BALBO_ITA_AI_DESC: The Italian AI will attempt to oust Mussolini from power, and install Italo Balbo instead to seek an independent path forward.
loc.RULE_ALT_FASCIST_GRANDI_ITA_AI_DESC: The Italian AI will attempt to oust Mussolini from power, and install Dino Grandi instead to seek to strengthen ties with the allies.
loc.RULE_OPTION_ITA_MONARCHIST_ROMAN_EMPIRE_: King Vittorio Emanuele will lead Italy towards an absolutist monarchy, trying to achieve Mare Nostrum and reforming the Roman Empire.
loc.RULE_OPTION_ITA_CHRISTIAN_DEMOCRACY_AI_D: King Vittorio Emanuele will depose Mussolini, attempt to form an independent faction and lead Italy towards a constitutional monarchy favoring the Christian Democratic party, led by Alcide de Gasperi.
loc.RULE_OPTION_ITA_COMMUNIST_PLAN_AI_DESC: Italian anti-fascists will join forces to overthrow the fascist regime by force, forming a communist government, abolishing the colonies and seeking to join the Comintern.
loc.RULE_OPTION_ITA_DEMOCRATIC_PLAN_AI_DESC: Italian anti-fascists will join forces to overthrow the fascist regime by force, forming a social-democratic government and seeking to form a Confederation with former colonies in Africa.
loc.RULE_OPTION_FIN_FASCIST_PLAN_DESC: The Finnish Right, led by the Patriotic People's Movement, will overthrow the former conservative democracy, attempting to strengthen ties with Germany and relying on organizations like the Mustapaidat and Suojeluskunta to develop a powerful military and expand the country's borders according to the Greater Finland idea.
loc.RULE_OPTION_FIN_COMMUNIST_PLAN_DESC: Seeking help from the Soviet Union, communists will organize the Finnish left movement, uniting socialists, social-democrats and other left-wing elements in order to coup the government and lead the country towards a new revolution against the capitalist and fascist threats abroad.
loc.RULE_OPTION_FIN_DEMOCRATIC_PLAN_DESC: Finnish Social-Democrats will appeal to the Finnish people and lead a drastic but bloodless change in the course of Finnish politics. Finland will then attempt to join other western major democracies in order to preserve the country's sovereignty and its conservative-left society.
loc.RULE_OPTION_GER_COMMUNIST_STALINIST_AI_D: The German AI will attempt to overthrow the Nazis, and bring the communist revolution to Germany. They will then attempt to establish a dictatorship of the proletariat.
loc.RULE_OPTION_GER_COMMUNIST_SPARTACUS_AI_D: The German AI will attempt to overthrow the Nazis, and bring the communist revolution to Germany. They will then attempt to install a more democratic socialist regime under the new Spartacus League, and spread the communist revolutionary wildfire throughout Europe.
loc.RULE_OPTION_GER_ALT_FASCIST_AI_DESC: The German AI will attempt to replace Hitler with one of the members of the Inner Circle, heed von Neurath's concerns and attempt to enforce its New World Order.
loc.RULE_OPTION_DEFAULT_AI_DESC: The AI will make decisions based on other gameplay settings, such as the option to force historical focuses and other gameplay scenarios. This is the same behavior as in version 1.5 and earlier.
loc.RULE_OPTION_RANDOM_AI_DESC: The AI will randomly decide on a game plan at the start of the game and attempt to execute it.
loc.RULE_OPTION_FASCIST_GER_AI_DESC: The German AI will remain fascist and attempt to take over Europe by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_FASCIST_JAP_AI_DESC: The Japanese AI will pursue its historical path and attempt to strike south against the western allies by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_COMMUNIST_JAP_AI_DESC: The Japanese AI will attempt to turn communist and support other communist regimes in Asia by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_NEUTRALITY_JAP_AI_DESC: The Japanese AI will attempt to strike north against the Soviet Union and likely make common cause with the Axis by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_DEMOCRATIC_JAP_AI_DESC: The Japanese AI will attempt to reform into a democracy by going down the relevant path in the focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_COMMUNIST_RONOHA_JAP_AI_DESC: The Japanese AI will attempt to turn communist and install a Ronoha-led government, leading a crusade against imperialism in Asia by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_KAISER_GER_AI_DESC: The German AI will attempt to return the Kaiser to the throne by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_DEMOCRATIC_GER_AI_DESC: The German AI will attempt to create a constitutional monarchy by going down the relevant paths in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_BOLSHEVIK_PRC_DESC: The AI will go down the 28 ½ Bolshevik path, trying to align with the Soviet Union. If in the Second United Front, the AI will try to influence the faction diplomatically.
loc.RULE_OPTION_ALTERNATE_GUOMAO_DESC: The AI will go down the path of the Unwilling Diarchy, with Mao and Guotao attempting to co-operate against the warlords. The AI will not seek to join the Second United Front.
loc.RULE_DEMOCRATIC_ALTERNATE_FRA_AI_DESC: The French AI will attempt to form the Little Entente to contain Germany. Should Czechoslovakia create that faction, they will join it instead ("Death or Dishonor" DLC required).
loc.RULE_OPTION_COMMUNIST_FRA_AI_DESC: The French AI will attempt to turn communist and join the comintern by going down the relevant branches of the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_DEMOCRATIC_HISTORICAL_FRA_AI: The French AI will attempt to follow the historical chain of events as much as possible.
loc.RULE_FASCIST_FRA_AI_DESC: The French AI will attempt to turn fascist and make common cause with a fascist Germany, by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_AUSTRIA_HUNGARY_HUN_AI_DESC: The Hungarian AI will attempt to restore the Austro-Hungarian Empire by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree, selecting Otto von Habsburg as their ruler if available to them.
loc.RULE_FASCIST_HUN_AI_DESC: The Hungarian AI will progress down the path of the national focus tree that most closely resembles history, and attempt to join the Axis.
loc.RULE_FASCIST_ALTERNATE_HUN_AI_DESC: The Hungarian AI will attempt to form its own faction with Italy and Austria by going down the relevant path in the focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_COMMUNIST_HUN_AI_DESC: The Hungarian AI will attempt to become a communist nation and ally with other major communist nations by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_DEMOCRATIC_HUN_AI_DESC: The Hungarian AI will attempt to become a constitutional monarchy by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree, electing Carl V Wilhelm as it's new Apostolic King.
loc.RULE_FASCIST_ALTERNATE_KING_HUN_AI_DESC: The Hungarian AI will elect a fascist king and join the Axis.
loc.RULE_HABSBURG_HUNGARY_HUN_AI_DESC: The Hungarian AI will elect Joseph August as its king, and restore Greater Hungary, but under Habsburg rule.
loc.RULE_HORTHYIST_KING_HUNGARY_HUN_AI_DESC: The Hungarian AI will crown either Miklos Horthy or his son as king of Hungary, and attempt to establish a Greater Hungarian Kingdom.
loc.RULE_REPUBLICAN_DEMOCRACY_HUN_AI_DESC: The Hungarian AI will oppose Horthy, and attempt to bring democracy to the nation, establishing the Danubian Federation.
loc.RULE_REPUBLICAN_DEMOCRACY_EXPANSIONIST_H: The Hungarian AI will oppose Horthy, and bring democracy to Hungary, eventually embracing the Dragon Movement and attempting to restore Greater Hungary.
loc.RULE_RESTORE_THE_SOCIALIST_REPUBLIC_HUN_: The Hungarian AI will attempt to restore the old Socialist Federative Republic, and bring about a Red Greater Hungarian State.
loc.RULE_ARROW_CROSS_MOVEMENT_HUN_AI_DESC: The Hungarian AI will attempt to establish absolute rule under the Arrow Cross Party, eventually joining the Axis as a faithful ally of theirs.
loc.RULE_OPTION_BALKAN_DOMINANCE_ROM_AI_DESC: The Romanian AI will attempt to establish supremacy over their Balkan neighbors by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_DEMOCRATIC_ROM_AI_DESC: The Romanian AI will attempt to reform the country into a functioning democracy and ally with other major democratic powers by going down the relevant paths in the national focus trees.
loc.RULE_COMMUNIST_ROM_AI_DESC: The Romanian AI will attempt to forge an alliance with a major communist power by going down the relevant paths in the focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_COMMUNIST_YUG_AI_DESC: The Yugoslavian AI will attempt to reform the country into a communist republic by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_DEMOCRATIC_YUG_AI_DESC: The Yugoslavian AI will attempt to maintain a democratic government by going down the relevant paths of the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_FASCIST_YUG_AI_DESC: The Yugoslavian AI will attempt to grow closer to the fascist nations of Europe, aiming to eventually enter into an alliance with them.
loc.RULE_HISTORICAL_YUG_AI_DESC: The Yugoslavian AI will follow the historical chain of events most closely.
loc.RULE_OPTION_DEMOCRATIC_CZE_AI_DESC: The Czechoslovakian AI will attempt to remain democratic and focus predominantly on its internal development by going down the relevant paths of the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_COMMUNIST_CZE_AI_DESC: The Czechoslovakian AI will attempt to reform the country to communism and enter into an alliance with the Soviet Union or another major communist nation.
loc.RULE_OPTION_DEMOCRATIC_ALTERNATE_CZE_AI_: The Czechoslovakian AI will attempt to form a faction of its own to defend itself while remaining democratic, by going down the relevant paths of the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_FASCIST_CZE_AI_DESC: The Czechoslovakian AI will attempt to turn the country fascist and enter into an arrangement with Germany by going down the relevant paths in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_HISTORICAL_CZE_AI_DESC: The Czechoslovakian AI will follow the historical chain of events as much as possible.
loc.RULE_OPTION_MONARCHIST_CZE_AI_DESC: The Czechoslovakian AI will go monarchist and attempt to restore the Bohemian Empire.
loc.RULE_FASCIST_ROM_AI_DESC: The Romanian AI will attempt to follow history and join the Axis by going down the relevant paths of the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_COMMUNIST_AST_AI_DESC: The Australian AI will attempt to turn the country communist and ally with the Comintern by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_DEMOCRATIC_HISTORICAL_AST_AI: The Australian AI will attempt to follow the historical chain of events and decisions in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_DEMOCRATIC_ALTERNATE_AST_AI_DESC: The Australian AI will attempt to gain full independence from the United Kingdom and become a major force in their region, by going down the relevant paths of the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_FASCIST_AST_AI_DESC: The Australian AI will attempt to turn fascist and ally with Japan by going down the relevant path of the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_COMMUNIST_CAN_AI_DESC: The Canadian AI will attempt to turn communist and support the workers of the world in their struggle by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_DEMOCRATIC_HISTORICAL_CAN_AI: The Canadian AI will attempt to follow the historical chain of events and decisions in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_DEMOCRATIC_ALTERNATE_CAN_AI_DESC: The Canadian AI will attempt to gain full independence and create an alliance with the United States, by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_FASCIST_CAN_AI_DESC: The Canadian AI will attempt to turn fascist and ally with Germany by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_COMMUNIST_SAF_AI_DESC: The South African AI will attempt to turn communist and liberate the peoples of Africa from colonial rule, by going down the relevant path of the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_DEMOCRATIC_HISTORICAL_SAF_AI: The South African AI will follow the historical plan as much as possible.
loc.RULE_DEMOCRATIC_ALTERNATE_SAF_AI_DESC: The South African AI will attempt to remain democratic and take a more assertive role in the relationship with the mother country, by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_FASCIST_SAF_AI_DESC: The South African AI will attempt to turn fascist and come to an arrangement with Germany, by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_COMMUNIST_NZL_AI_DESC: The AI will attempt to turn communist and join the Comintern by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_DEMOCRATIC_HISTORICAL_NZL_AI: The AI will attempt to follow the historical chain of events as much as possible.
loc.RULE_DEMOCRATIC_ALTERNATE_NZL_AI_DESC: The AI will attempt to remain democratic and establish full sovereignty by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_FASCIST_NZL_AI_DESC: The AI will attempt to turn fascist and ally with Japan by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_COMMUNIST_RAJ_AI_DESC: The Indian AI will attempt to gain its independence by allying with the Soviet Union, by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_GOE_INDIA_UNITED_RAJ_AI_DESC: India will endeavour to become independent, remain Democratic and join the Allies, but stand united as one country and avoid Partition.
loc.RULE_OPTION_GOE_INDIA_FASCISM_BOSE_RAJ_A: India will go down the path of resistance and pick Chandra Bose as its leader, taking a more militant stance towards independence
loc.RULE_OPTION_GOE_INDIA_FASCISM_HINDUTVA_R: India will go down the path of resistance and pick Savarkar as its leader, taking a more militant stance towards independence and try and form Akhand Bharat
loc.RULE_OPTION_GOE_INDIA_EAST_INDIA_COMPANY: India will break apart and the English will reinstate the East India Company
loc.RULE_OPTION_GOE_INDIA_MUGHAL_RAJ_AI_DESC: India will try and form the Mughal Empire
loc.RULE_OPTION_GOE_INDIA_COMMUNISM_RAJ_AI_D: India will attempt to gain independence via the communist focus tree. If successful, India will focus on agricultural economic growth and establishing its own unique socialist ideology.
loc.RULE_OPTION_GOE_INDIA_COMMUNISM_URBAN_RA: India will attempt to gain independence via the communist focus tree. If successful, India will focus on urbanization and rapid industrialization of society, and will attempt to seek aid from the Soviet Union.
loc.RULE_OPTION_DEMOCRATIC_HISTORICAL_RAJ_AI: The Indian AI will remain loyal to Britain and attempt to follow the historical chain of events.
loc.RULE_FASCIST_RAJ_AI_DESC: The Indian AI will attempt to gain its independence through an alliance with fascist countries by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_HISTORICAL_SOV_AI_DESC: The Soviet AI will attempt to follow the historical chain of events as much as possible.
loc.RULE_OPTION_ALTERNATE_SOV_AI_DESC: The Soviet AI will focus on the Capitalists first and aim its blows against the weaker targets in the middle east, by going down the relevant branches of the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_LEFT_OPPOSITION_SOV_AI_DESC: The Soviet AI will try to re-instate the Left Opposition and re-start the permanent revolution, by going down the relevant branches of the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_LEFT_OPPOSITION_COOPERATIVE_: The Soviet AI will try to re-instate the Left Opposition and include other opposition groups in the party as well as re-start the permanent revolution, by going down the relevant branches of the national focus tree. The goal for the AI is to form the Supreme Soviet.
loc.RULE_OPTION_RIGHT_OPPOSITION_SOV_AI_DESC: The Soviet AI will try to put the Right Opposition in power, by going down the relevant branches of the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_RIGHT_OPPOSITION_COOPERATIVE: The Soviet AI will try to put the Right Opposition in power and include other opposition groups in the party, by going down the relevant branches of the national focus tree. The goal for the AI is to form the Supreme Soviet.
loc.RULE_OPTION_COMMUNIST_POL_AI_DESC: The Polish AI will attempt to come to an understanding with the USSR to protect itself against aggression, by going down the relevant paths in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_HISTORICAL_POL_AI_DESC: The Polish AI will attempt to follow the historical chain of events as much as possible.
loc.RULE_FASCIST_POL_AI_DESC: The Polish AI will attempt to reconcile with Germany for protection, by going down the relevant paths in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_DEMOCRATIC_POL_AI_DESC: The Polish AI will attempt to restore democracy and join the Allies.
loc.RULE_FASCIST_INDEPENDENT_POL_AI_DESC: The Polish AI will attempt to embrace Falangism and stand against Germany.
loc.RULE_COMMONWEALTH_POL_AI_DESC: The Polish AI will crown Friedrich Christian as King and attempt to restore the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth.
loc.RULE_ROMANIA_POL_AI_DESC: The Polish AI will crown a Hohenzollern as King and attempt to form a union with Romania.
loc.RULE_HABSBURG_POL_AI_DESC: The Polish AI will crown Karl Albrecht von Habsburg as King and attempt to form a union with Czechoslovakia.
loc.RULE_BERMONDT_POL_AI_DESC: The Polish AI will crown Pavel Bermondt-Avalov as King and attempt to join the Axis.
loc.RULE_OPTION_HISTORICAL_CHI_AI_DESC: The Chinese AI will attempt to follow the historical chain of events as much as possible.
loc.RULE_OPTION_ALTERNATE_CHI_AI_DESC: The Chinese AI will attempt to consolidate power in China by taking over the warlords before picking a fight with the Japanese through the relevant branches of the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_HISTORICAL_SEA_DESC: The Chinese AI will attempt to follow the historical chain of events as much as possible.
loc.RULE_OPTION_FASCIST_SEA_DESC: The Chinese AI will attempt to go down the fascist path of the focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_WANG_JINGWEI_SEA_DESC: The Chinese AI will attempt to go down the Wang Jingwei path of the focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_DEMOCRATIC_SEA_DESC: The Chinese AI will attempt to go down the Democratic League path of the focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_HISTORICAL_PRC_AI_DESC: The Communist Chinese AI will attempt to follow the historical chain of events as much as possible.
loc.RULE_OPTION_ALTERNATE_PRC_AI_DESC: The Communist Chinese AI will try to create a coalition government with the Nationalists by going down the relevant path of the focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_COMMUNIST_USA_AI_DESC: The US AI will attempt to turn communist by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_DEMOCRATIC_HISTORICAL_USA_AI: The US AI will attempt to follow the historical chain of events as much as possible.
loc.RULE_DEMOCRATIC_ALTERNATE_USA_AI_DESC: The US AI will attempt to take a more active role in world affairs by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_FASCIST_USA_AI_DESC: The US AI will attempt to turn fascist and take over the world through the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_OBEDIENCE_MAN_AI_DESC: The Manchu AI will attempt to remain loyal as much as possible and follow the relevant branch in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_OBEDIENCE_CHINA_MAN_AI_DESC: The Manchu AI will attempt to remain loyal as much as possible and follow the relevant branch in the national focus tree, eventually becoming the Empire of China.
loc.RULE_OPTION_INDEPENDENCE_MAN_AI_DESC: The Manchu AI will attempt to break free and take over all of China and by going down the relevant branch of the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_INDEPENDENCE_FAS_MAN_AI_DESC: The Manchu AI will attempt to break free and take over all of China and Outer Manchuria by going down the relevant branch of the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_INDEPENDENCE_NEU_MAN_AI_DESC: The Manchu AI will attempt to break free and take over all of China as a Constitutional Monarchy by going down the relevant branch of the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_INDEPENDENCE_DEM_MAN_AI_DESC: The Manchu AI will attempt to break free and assume the mantle of the new Beiyang Government going down the relevant branch of the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_INDEPENDENCE_COM_MAN_AI_DESC: The Manchu AI will attempt to break free and becoming the People's Republic of China by going down the relevant branch of the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_GUARANTEES_SAME_IDEOLOGY_TOOL: Game Rule: §RCountries can only Guarantee countries that share their ruling ideology.§!
loc.RULE_ALLOW_GUARANTEES_BLOCKED_TOOLTIP: Game Rule: §RCountries can never Guarantee other countries.§!
loc.RULE_ALLOW_MILITARY_ACCESS_SAME_IDEOLOGY: Game Rule: §RCountries can gain military access and docking rights from countries that share the same ruling ideology.§!
loc.RULE_ALLOW_MILITARY_ACCESS_BLOCKED_TT: Game Rule: §RCountries can never gain military access and docking rights from any other country outside of a faction.§!
loc.RULE_ALLOW_LEND_LEASE_SAME_IDEOLOGY_TT: Game Rule: §RCountries may only lend-lease equipment to countries of the same ruling ideology.§!
loc.RULE_ALLOW_LEND_LEASE_SAME_FACTION_TT: Game Rule: §RCountries may only lend-lease equipment to countries in the same faction.§!
loc.RULE_ALLOW_LEND_LEASE_BLOCKED_TT: Game Rule: §RCountries may never lend-lease equipment to any other country.§!
loc.RULE_VOLUNTEERS_BLOCKED_TT: Game Rule: §RCountries may never send Volunteers to any country.§!
loc.RULE_VOLUNTEERS_NOT_ANARCHISTS_TT: §RSovereign states cannot send Volunteers to Anarchists!§!
loc.RULE_VOLUNTEERS_PORTUGAL_SCW_TT: §RPortugal cannot send Volunteers to a Spanish faction that it does not support.§!
loc.RULE_VOLUNTEERS_BULGARIA_SCW_TT: §RBulgaria cannot send Volunteers to a Spanish faction that it does not support.§!
loc.RULE_VOLUNTEERS_SOVIET_CHINA_SUPPORT_CHO: §RThe Soviet Union cannot send Volunteers to a Chinese faction that it does not support.§!
loc.RULE_VOLUNTEERS_SOVIET_CHINA_ONLY_ONE_TT: §RWe cannot send Volunteers to more than one Chinese faction.§!
loc.RULE_VOLUNTEERS_SOVIET_SCW_TT: §RThe Soviet Union cannot send Volunteers to a Spanish faction that has rebelled against the Republican government.§!
loc.RULE_VOLUNTEERS_SOVIET_SCW_COVERT_POUM_T: §RThe Soviet Union is still under the Stalinist doctrine and cannot send Volunteers to a Spanish faction that has rebelled against the Republican government.§!
loc.RULE_VOLUNTEERS_SOVIET_SCW_POUM_TT: §RThe Soviet Socialist Republic is supporting the POUM and cannot send Volunteers to any other Spanish faction.§!
loc.RULE_VOLUNTEERS_SOVIET_EXILES_SCW_TT: §RThe Russian government can only send Volunteers to Spanish Rebels fighting against the legitimate Spanish government.§!
loc.RULE_VOLUNTEERS_SAME_IDEOLOGY_TT: Game Rule: §RCountries may only send Volunteers to countries that share the same ruling ideology.§!
loc.RULE_KICK_FROM_FACTION_BLOCKED_TOOLTIP: Game Rule: §RThe Leader of a Faction may not kick any member of the faction.§!
loc.RULE_ASSUME_LEADERSHIP_BLOCKED_TOOLTIP: Game Rule: §RCountries may not take over faction leadership.§!
loc.RULE_ALLOW_LEAVE_FACTION_BLOCKED_TOOLTIP: Game Rule: §RCountries may not leave a faction except through national focuses and events.§!
loc.RULE_COUP_BLOCKED_TT: Game Rule: §RCountries may not prepare or execute Coups in any nation.§!
loc.RULE_COUP_AI_ONLY_TT: Game Rule: §RCountries may only prepare and execute coups against nations not played by a human.§!
loc.RULE_BOOST_PARTY_BLOCKED_TT: Game Rule: §RCountries may not boost party popularity in any country.§!
loc.RULE_BOOST_PARTY_PLAYER_ONLY_TT: Game Rule: §RCountries may only boost party popularity in countries with a human player.§!
loc.RULE_BOOST_PARTY_AI_ONLY_TT: Game Rule: §RCountries may only boost party popularity in countries not played by a human.§!
loc.RULE_WARGOALS_BLOCKED_TT: Game Rule: §RWargoals can only be gained from national focuses, events and decisions.§!
loc.RULE_ALLOW_LICENSING_BLOCKED_TT: Game Rule: §RCountries may never acquire production licenses outside of special decisions and events.§!
loc.RULE_ALLOW_LICENSING_SAME_FACTION_TT: Game Rule: §RCountries may only acquire production licenses from countries in the same faction.§!
loc.RULE_ALLOW_LICENSING_SAME_IDEOLOGY_TT: Game Rule: §RCountries may only acquire production licenses from countries that share the same ruling ideology.§!
loc.RULE_OPTION_DEMOCRATIC_ENG_AI_DESC: The British AI will attempt to protect Poland and lead the allies in their defensive war against the Germans, by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_TRADE_UNIONS_ENG_AI_DESC: The British AI will attempt to make concessions to the Trade Unions and become communist, by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_THE_KINGS_PARTY_ENG_AI_DESC: The British AI will attempt to support King Edward VIII's marriage to Wallis Simpson and empower the King's Party, by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_DEMOCRATIC_NO_MORE_APPEASEME: The British AI will attempt to stop its policy of Appeasement and replace it with democratic interventionism, by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_ORGANIZE_THE_BLACKSHIRTS_ENG: The British AI will attempt to organize the blackshirts and become fascist, by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_DEMOCRATIC_HISTORICAL_HOL_AI: The Dutch AI will attempt to join the Allies once invaded, but not relocate their government to the East Indies, by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_LEGACY_OF_THE_DE_ZEVEN_PROVI: Legacy of the "De Zeven Provinciën" Mutiny
The Dutch AI will attempt to revive the legacy of the "De Zeven Provinciën" mutiny and go communist, by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_ORANJE_BOVEN_HOL_AI_DESC: The Dutch AI will attempt to support monarchism and put Queen Wilhelmina in power, by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_DEMOCRATIC_CONTINUE_THE_WAR_IN_BATA: The Dutch AI will attempt to remain democratic, but move their capital to Batavia once capitulated, by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_DEMOCRATIC_CONTINUE_THE_ZUIDERZEE_W: The Dutch AI will attempt to remain democratic, but focus on continental build-up instead of their colonies, by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_CAVE_TO_THE_GERMANS_HOL_AI_DESC: The Dutch AI will attempt to cave to the Germans in the trade war, and ally them once becoming fascist, by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_DEMOCRATIC_LEAD_THE_MINOR_DEMOCRACI: The Dutch AI will attempt to remain democratic and lead Europe's minor democracies in the creation of a European Union, by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_SECULAR_REPUBLIC_DESC: The trend towards moderate secularism and the rule of law will be strengthened in Mexico, with the country aligning itself towards America.
loc.RULE_OPTION_SOCIAL_CATHOLICISM_DESC: Moderate reformers within the Catholic Church will create a new concordat within Mexico, bringing an end to the social strife of totalitarianism and aligning Mexico towards Britain.
loc.RULE_OPTION_FASCIST_DICTATORSHIP_DESC: Plutarco Calles, Saturnino Cedillo and the other military strongmen will abort Mexico's nascent attempts at democracy, aligning towards Germany.
loc.RULE_OPTION_THEOCRATIC_ORDER_DESC: The Synarchists and Cristeros will take power in Mexico, creating a new Latin American order to purge the continent of heretics.
loc.RULE_OPTION_SOVIET_REPUBLIC_DESC: Mexico will align itself towards the Soviet Union, spreading the Revolution into Latin America at the tip of a bayonet.
loc.RULE_OPTION_CARDENISMO_DESC: Lázaro Cárdenas and his left-wing successors will create a Bolivarian Alliance and strike at the Yanqui imperialists.
loc.RULE_OPTION_DEFAULT_COLONIZATION_DESC: The world is colonized as historical.
loc.RULE_OPTION_AMERICAS_DECOLONIZED_DESC: All releasable colonized nations in the Americas are released as free and independent nations upon game-start.
loc.RULE_OPTION_AMERICAS_DEIMPERIALIZED_DESC: All Amerindian tags in the Americas are released upon game-start
loc.RULE_OPTION_QUEBEC_DESC: Quebec is free at game start
loc.RULE_OPTION_AFRICA_DECOLONIZED_DESC: All releasable colonized nations in Africa are released as free and independent nations upon game-start.
loc.RULE_OPTION_GERMANY_FRAGMENTED_DESC: Germany will start fragmented into various smaller states
loc.RULE_OPTION_ASIA_DECOLONIZED_DESC: All releasable colonized nations in Asia are released as free and independent nations upon game-start.
loc.RULE_OPTION_OCEANIA_DECOLONIZED_DESC: All releasable colonized nations in Oceania are released as free and independent nations upon game-start.
loc.RULE_OPTION_OCEANIA_UNITED_DESC: Polynesia will be united into a single country at game start.
loc.RULE_OPTION_DEFAULT_FRAGMENTATION_DESC: No nation-states are fragmented into their constituent parts.
loc.RULE_OPTION_ENG_FRAGMENTED_DESC: All releasable constituent nations comprising the United Kingdom are released as free and independent nations upon game-start.
loc.RULE_OPTION_SPR_FRAGMENTED_DESC: Catalonia, Galicia, and Navarra will be released as free and independent states upon game-start.
loc.RULE_OPTION_SPR_FAMILIAR_DESC: The borders of Spain will be redrawn into something familiar.
loc.RULE_OPTION_FRA_FRAGMENTED_DESC: All releasable constituent nations comprising France will be released as free and independent states upon game-start.
loc.RULE_OPTION_YUG_FRAGMENTED_DESC: All releasable constituent nations comprising Yugoslavia are released as free and independent nations upon game-start.
loc.RULE_OPTION_SOV_FRAGMENTED_DESC: The Soviet Union will have all SSRs released from game start, and will look like it did just after its dissolution at the end of the Cold War.
loc.RULE_OPTION_SOV_UTTERLY_FRAGMENTED_DESC: All releasable Republics, Okrugs and Territories comprising the Soviet Union are released as free and independent nations upon game-start.
loc.RULE_OPTION_SAPMI_RELEASED_DESC: Sápmi will be released from Finland, Sweden and Norway.
loc.RULE_OPTION_NORDICS_FRAGMENTED_DESC: The Nordic countries will be fragmented and split apart.
loc.RULE_OPTION_RAJ_PRINCELY_STATES_FREE_DES: The Indian Princely States will be released upon game start.
loc.RULE_OPTION_ETH_FRAGMENTED_DESC: Ethiopia will be split into the regional states comprising the country
loc.RULE_OPTION_RAJ_FRAGMENTED_DESC: All releasable constituent nations comprising the British Raj are released as free and independent nations upon game-start.
loc.RULE_OPTION_ITA_FRAGMENTED_DESC: Reverses the Risorgimento in Italy and sets the borders back to how they looked just before it.
loc.RULE_OPTION_NATIONALIST_HISTORICAL_DESC: Franco will take control of the Nationalist front and merge the Falangist and Carlist ideologies in a new and unified Spain, attempting to stay neutral in the World War unless attacked.
loc.RULE_OPTION_SECOND_REPUBLIC_DESC: The democratic government of Spain will maintain the Second Republic, rejecting both Fascism and Communism.
loc.RULE_OPTION_FALANGIST_DESC: The Falangists under José Antonio Primo de Rivera will reject Carlism and seek to restore Spanish imperialism.
loc.RULE_OPTION_CARLIST_DESC: The Carlists under Manuel Fal Conde will reject Falangism and ensure a return to the absolutist monarchy of old, under its rightful Carlist King.
loc.RULE_OPTION_ANARCHIST_DESC: The Anarchist communes in Aragon and Catalonia will band together to vanquish the Fascists and Communists alike, and resist the very notion of a nation-state altogether.
loc.RULE_OPTION_INDEPENDENT_COMMUNIST_DESC: The POUM and their Anarchist allies will cast off the Stalinist yoke and seek their own independent communist ideology after the Civil War.
loc.RULE_OPTION_STALINIST_DESC: The true Communists, taking their orders from Moscow, will resist the Anarchists and Fascists, curb the influence of the Independent Communists, and usher in a new age for the Second Republic under Stalinist guidance.
loc.RULE_OPTION_HISTORICAL_POR_AI_DESC: Under the regime of Salazar, Portugal will strengthen the Estado Novo and will attempt to remain neutral during the World War.
loc.RULE_OPTION_FASCIST_POR_AI_DESC: Rafael Pereira will take control of Portugal as a Fascist dictator, supporting the Nationalists during the Spanish Civil War and attempting to join the Axis afterwards.
loc.RULE_OPTION_FASCIST_FIFTH_EMPIRE_DESC: The Portuguese government will embrace Fascism, fighting against the Republicans during the Spanish Civil War and attempting to recover its lost territories in Africa, Asia and America, rising as a major power once again.
loc.RULE_OPTION_NEUTRALITY_MONARCHIST_DESC: After the restoration of the monarchy in Portugal, King Duarte will appeal to the Brazilian monarchists and attempt to restore the Empire of Portugal and Brazil.
