loc.RULE_OPTION_DEMOCRATIC_POR_AI_DESC: Influenced by the United Kingdom, a democratic government will overthrow the authoritarian regime of Salazar and, with the help of the British, focus on developing the national industry before joining the Allies.
loc.RULE_OPTION_COMMUNIST_COMINTERN_DESC: Portugal will align itself towards the Soviet Union, supporting the Spanish Republic and attempting to join the Comintern.
loc.RULE_OPTION_COMMUNIST_INDEPENDENT_DESC: Communists will overturn the government and fight against the Spanish Nationalists during the Spanish Civil War, unifying the Iberian Peninsula as the United European Socialist Republics, the last European bastion against fascism.
loc.RULE_MONARCHIST_ORLEANIST_FRA_AI_DESC: The French AI will attempt to restore the French monarchy and place the Orléanist pretender on the throne by going down the relevant path on the focus tree.
loc.RULE_MONARCHIST_LEGITIMIST_FRA_AI_DESC: The French AI will attempt to restore the French monarchy and place the Legitimist pretender on the throne by going down the relevant path on the focus tree.
loc.RULE_MONARCHIST_BONAPARTIST_FRA_AI_DESC: The French AI will attempt to restore the French monarchy and place the Bonapartist pretender on the throne by going down the relevant path on the focus tree.
loc.RULE_ENTENTE_LIT_AI_DESC: Lithuania will attempt to formalize the Baltic Entente and survive against the Soviets.
loc.RULE_ENTENTE_EST_AI_DESC: Estonia will attempt to formalize the Baltic Entente and survive against the Soviets.
loc.RULE_ENTENTE_LAT_AI_DESC: Latvia will attempt to formalize the Baltic Entente and survive against the Soviets.
loc.RULE_HISTORICAL_EST_AI_DESC: The Estonian AI will remain neutral for most of the campaign but will become a Soviet puppet in the 1940s.
loc.RULE_HISTORICAL_LAT_AI_DESC: The Latvian AI will remain neutral for most of the campaign but will become a Soviet puppet in the 1940s.
loc.RULE_HISTORICAL_LIT_AI_DESC: The Lithuanian AI will remain neutral for most of the campaign but will become a Soviet puppet in the 1940s.
loc.RULE_OPTION_MONARCHIST_LIT_AI_DESC: Lithuania will attempt to restore the monarchy and claim the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth.
loc.RULE_OPTION_COMMUNIST_BALKAN_FEDERATION_: Bulgaria will attempt to form a Balkan alliance, influencing its neighbors to embrace the revolution and ultimately unifying the Balkans.
loc.RULE_OPTION_COMMUNIST_BUL_AI_DESC: Bulgaria will attempt to join the Comintern and fight together with its Soviet comrades against fascism and capitalism in Europe.
loc.RULE_OPTION_DEMOCRATIC_LIBERAL_BUL_AI_DE: The Bulgarian Democratic Party will attempt to join the Allies as it conspires against Tsar Boris to remove him from power and form a pro-Allies regency council.
loc.RULE_OPTION_DEMOCRATIC_SOCIALIST_BUL_AI_: The government led by Nikola Mushanov will follow socialist policies, seeking to improve its relations with neighboring nations to form a Balkan Confederation and defend the Balkans against foreign aggressors.
loc.RULE_OPTION_FASCIST_BUL_AI_DESC: As fascism rises in the country, right-wing leader Hristo Lukov will attempt to join the Axis, eventually overthrowing the Tsar and imposing a military dictatorship.
loc.RULE_OPTION_HISTORICAL_BUL_AI_DESC: Tsar Boris III will lead the country towards the Axis, relying on German arbitration to expand Bulgarian borders peacefully, eventually signing the Tripartite Pact and delaying Bulgarian participation in the war.
loc.RULE_OPTION_THE_RETURN_OF_FERDINAND_BUL_: Following the death of Tsar Boris III, his father Ferdinand I will sit on the throne once again, seeking revenge against those who wronged him decades ago.
loc.RULE_OPTION_METAXIST_GRE_AI_DESC: Greece will pursue a policy of neutrality while developing the ideas of Metaxism.
loc.RULE_OPTION_MONARCHIST_GRE_AI_DESC: Greece will become an absolute monarchy and seek to join the Allies.
loc.RULE_OPTION_MONARCHIST_ALTERNATE_GRE_AI_: Greece will become an absolute monarchy and seek to join the Central Powers with Germany or Austria-Hungary.
loc.RULE_OPTION_STALINIST_GRE_AI_DESC: Greece will attempt to join the Comintern and spark a battle for the Bosporus with Turkey.
loc.RULE_OPTION_ALTERNATE_COMMUNIST_GRE_AI_D: Greece will attempt to fight fascism in Europe alongside communist Yugoslavia.
loc.RULE_OPTION_VENEZELIST_GRE_AI_DESC: Greece will fight for the right to fulfill the Megali Idea.
loc.RULE_OPTION_FASCISM_GRE_AI_DESC: Greece will become a National Socialist republic and attempt to join the Axis alongside Turkey.
loc.RULE_OPTION_FASCISM_ALTERNATE_GRE_AI_DES: Greece will become democratic, suffer a collapse in government, and then go on to aspire for the grandest of ambitions...
loc.RULE_OPTION_HISTORICAL_TUR_AI_DESC: Turkey will pursue neutrality for as long as possible under the leadership of İsmet İnönü, and then attempt to join the Allies.
loc.RULE_OPTION_ALTERNATE_KEMALIST_AI_DESC: Turkey will appoint Fevzi Çakmak to follow in Mustafa Kemal Atatürk's footsteps as President, and will pursue neutrality for as long as possible before attempting to join either the Axis or the Allies.
loc.RULE_OPTION_OTTOMAN_DESC: The Republic of Turkey will collapse and from its ashes the Ottoman Sultanate shall be restored to power once again.
loc.RULE_OPTION_COMMUNIST_TUR_AI_DESC: Turkey will install a communist government and attempt to join the Comintern.
loc.RULE_OPTION_ALTERNATE_COMMUNIST_TUR_AI_D: Turkey will adopt a communist government that maintains its Kemalist qualities and attempt to form a faction of its own.
loc.RULE_OPTION_TUR_DEMOCRATIC_KEMALIST_DESC: Celâl Bayar will transition Turkey into a Kemalist democracy and attempt to join the Allies.
loc.RULE_OPTION_TUR_DEMOCRATIC_ALTERNATE_DES: Adnan Menderes will transition Turkey into a conservative democracy and attempt to join the Allies.
loc.RULE_OPTION_FASCISM_TUR_AI_DESC: Recep Peker shall transition Turkey into a fascist dictatorship and attempt to join the Axis.
loc.RULE_OPTION_TUR_FASCISM_ALTERNATE_DESC: Fevzi Çakmak shall transition Turkey into a conservative quasi-fascist dictatorship and attempt to form a faction with Italy.
loc.RULE_OPTION_BALKAN_ENTENTE_DESC: Turkey will commit itself to maintaining security in the Balkans and attempt to form a faction with Greece, Romania, and Yugoslavia.
loc.RULE_OPTION_EXILES_TSARIST_SOV_AI_DESC: The Soviet AI will expel the Communists through civil war, and reinstate Tsarist Russia, by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_EXILES_FASCIST_SOV_AI_DESC: The Soviet AI will expel the Communists through civil war, and establish a fascist government, by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_FASCIST_LIT_AI_DESC: The Lithuanian AI will attempt to establish a fascist government by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_FASCIST_LAT_AI_DESC: The Latvian AI will attempt to establish a fascist government by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_FASCIST_EST_AI_DESC: The Estonian AI will attempt to establish a fascist government by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_COMMUNIST_BALTIC_AI_DESC: The AI will attempt to establish a communist regime by going down the relevant path in the national focus tree.
loc.RULE_HISTORICAL_ETH_AI_DESC: The Ethiopian AI will attempt to defeat Italy using the League of nations, and if that fails try to go into exile. Thereafter it will try to recover its home territory, and rebuild Ethiopia.
loc.RULE_ETH_IMPERIAL_AI_DESC: The Ethiopian AI will attempt to defeat Italy on its own, without getting the help of the League of Nations. Thereafter it will attempt to expand its empire
loc.RULE_OPTION_ETH_STALINIST_desc: The AI will attempt to turn Ethiopia communist and garner the support of the Soviet Union, turning it into a Stalinist puppet.
loc.RULE_OPTION_ETH_ANARCHIST_desc: The AI will attempt to turn Ethiopia into an anarcho-communist federation with the support of communists and anarchists from across the world.
loc.RULE_OPTION_ETH_COLLABORATIONIST_desc: The AI will stab Haile Selassie in the back and side with the Italians, causing Ethiopia to become a fascist puppet.
loc.RULE_OPTION_ETH_INDEPENDENT_FASCIST_desc: The AI will stab Haile Selassie in the back and side with the Italians, causing Ethiopia to become a fascist puppet. However, it will attempt to break free and become an independent fascist nation.
loc.RULE_HISTORICAL_SWI_AI_DESC: Switzerland will remain neutral, while building up their militias and fortifications in preparation for any attack. They will give some support to the allies towards the end of the war.
loc.RULE_OPTION_SWI_ALLIED_DEMOCRATIC_AI_DES: The AI will arm Switzerland and prepare for war, aligning Switzerland to the democratic powers of the world, eventually breaking neutrality in favor of the Allies
loc.RULE_OPTION_SWI_EXPANSIONIST_DEMOCRATIC_: The AI will try to convince states around Switzerland to join the confederation, and will arm the country in preparation for owner of those states refusing to let their states be free.
loc.RULE_OPTION_SWI_IMPERIAL_AI_DESC: The AI will attempt to form the Alpine Protectorate by abandoning neutrality and democracy in favor of a militaristic and expansionist regime.
loc.RULE_OPTION_SWI_FASCIST_AI_DESC: The AI will make Switzerland align itself with Germany and slowly turn the country fascist, eventually either allying with the Axis or becoming a German Puppet.
loc.OBSOLETE_FOCUS_BRANCHES_VISIBILITY: Show obsolete branches in Focus Tree
loc.RULE_OPTION_HIDE_DESC: Certain obsolete branches will be hidden under the appropriate circumstances for easier navigation of the Focus Tree.
loc.RULE_OPTION_SHOW_DESC_DESC: Obsolete branches will always remain visible in the Focus Tree.
loc.LON_NON_INTERFERENCE_RESOLUTION_CALL: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] cannot be called due to a League of Nations' Non-Interference resolution
loc.LON_NON_INTERFERENCE_RESOLUTION_JOIN: You cannot join [FROM.GetNameDef] due to a League of Nations' Non-Interference resolution
loc.RULE_VOLUNTEERS_ETHIOPIA_ONLY_ONE_TT: You can only send volunteer units to [ETH.GetName] currently
loc.ICELAND_HAS_DECLARED_NEUTRALITY_JOIN: Iceland has declared absolute neutrality and cannot join wars
loc.ICELAND_HAS_DECLARED_NEUTRALITY_CALL: Iceland has declared absolute neutrality and cannot be called into wars
loc.DENMARK_IS_A_PUPPET_FACTION: [DEN.GetNameDefCap] has been granted a special protectorate status and cannot join factions
loc.DENMARK_IS_A_PUPPET_JOIN: [DEN.GetNameDefCap] has been granted a special protectorate status and cannot join wars
loc.DENMARK_IS_A_PUPPET_CALL: [DEN.GetNameDefCap] has been granted a special protectorate status and cannot be called into wars
loc.RULE_NON_GIE_JOIN: §RWe cannot join wars against Government in Exile countries§!
loc.RULE_NON_GIE_CALL: §RWe cannot call allies while only at war with a country in Exile§!
loc.RULE_OPTION_PEACE_SCORE_TO_OVERLORD_YES_: Puppets give a part of their Peace Score to their Overlord. The ratio depends on their Autonomy level.
loc.RULE_OPTION_PEACE_SCORE_TO_OVERLORD_NO_D: Puppets keep all the Peace Score they earned during the war.
loc.RULE_OPTION_PEACE_SCORE_TO_FACTION_LEADE: Faction Members give 10% of their Peace Score to the Faction Leader.
Faction Members keep all the Peace Score they earned during the war.
loc.RULE_OPTION_PEACE_SCORE_RESET_LOW_SCORES: Winners with less than 5% of war participation give all their score to other winners.\nDoes not apply if no winner has at least 10% of war participation.\nDoes not apply to Human Players.
All winners keep all the Peace Score they earned during the war.
loc.RULE_HISTORICAL_SWE_AI_DESC: The AI will attempt to build up the Swedish military while remaining neutral and democratic. It will carefully avoid getting into conflict with the Axis and Comintern, but may offer limited support to the Allies later in the war.
loc.RULE_OPTION_SWE_DEM_ALT_DESC: The Swedish AI will go down the democratic tree but will be more likely to become actively involved in the war by rearming faster, leaning more into right-leaning policies.
loc.RULE_OPTION_SWE_COMMUNISM_DESC: The Swedish AI will go down the communist tree and either ally the Axis or the Allies
loc.RULE_OPTION_SWE_FASCIST_INDEPENDENT_DESC: The Swedish AI will go down the fascist path, remain independent and try to form the Great Nordic Kingdom
loc.RULE_OPTION_SWE_FASCIST_PUPPET_DESC: The Swedish AI will go down the fascist path, become subservient to Germany and remain obedient to their overlord.
loc.RULE_OPTION_SWE_FASCIST_PUPPET_BACKSTABB: The Swedish AI will go down the fascist path, become subservient to Germany and break free from them when the time is right.
loc.RULE_OPTION_SWE_UNALIGNED_DESC: The Swedish AI will go down the unaligned path, return the king to power and try to form the Great Nordic Kingdom
loc.RULE_OPTION_SWE_DEMOCRATIC_NORDIC_DEFENC: The AI will try and form the Nordic Defence Council to protect the Nordics
loc.RULE_OPTION_NOR_STALINIST_AI_DESC: The AI will attempt to increase the popularity of Communism, while aligning Norway to Stalin's Soviet Union, or the biggest Non-Trotskyist Communist country if Stalin has been ousted.
loc.RULE_OPTION_NOR_TROSTSKYIST_AI_DESC: The AI will try to keep Lev Trotskij in Norway, and follow his principles of Communism, going against the Soviet Union if it remains Stalinist, and allying with it if Trotskij becomes its leader.
loc.RULE_OPTION_NOR_FASCIST_AI_DESC: The AI will let Fascism's influence grow over time, and will eventually align with The Third Reich, or go it alone if Germany is no longer Fascist.
loc.RULE_OPTION_NOR_MONARCHIST_AI_DESC: The AI will start pressuring King Haakon VII to dismantle the Storting and turn Norway into an Oligarchic Monarchy.
loc.RULE_HISTORICAL_FIN_AI_DESC: The Finnish AI will attempt to follow the historical chain of events as much as possible.
loc.RULE_HISTORICAL_DEN_AI_DESC: The Danish AI will attempt to stay out of any conflicts and follow the historical events as much as possible. If it becomes a subject, it will try to slowly build support with foreign powers to eventually reassert its independence once again.
loc.RULE_OPTION_DEN_REARMAMENT_AI_DESC: Denmark will try to seek alliances with stronger nations and try to withstand any invasion attempts.
loc.RULE_OPTION_DEN_MONARCHIST_AI_DESC: King Christian X will try to secure natural resources and strengthen Denmark's military capabilities by controlling the rest of the Nordics by any means necessary.
loc.RULE_OPTION_DEN_FASCIST_AI_DESC: The Fascist Party will try to seize power in Denmark and re-establish the North Sea Empire of old.
loc.RULE_HISTORICAL_ICE_AI_DESC: The Icelandic AI will try to maintain neutrality and will seek US protection when needed.
loc.RULE_OPTION_ICE_SUPPORT_AI_DESC: The Icelandic AI will attempt to support a Danish defense against any attacker
loc.RULE_OPTION_ICE_FASCIST_AI_DESC: The Icelandic AI will denounce the Danish King, and try to create a fascist empire in the North Sea
loc.RULE_OPTION_ICE_COMMUNIST_AI_DESC: The Icelandic AI will denounce the monarchy, and establish a communist state in Iceland.
loc.RULE_HISTORICAL_NOR_AI_DESC: Norway will attempt to remain democratic and resist the German invasion before continuing to fight on as a government in exile, alongside the Allies.
loc.RULE_HISTORICAL_CHL_AI_DESC: The Chilean AI will reinforce the democratic system and choose to support social-democratic policies whilst maintaining the power balance, and will join the global struggle only if it drags on.
loc.RULE_OPTION_CHL_COMMUNIST_AI_DESC: The Chilean AI will utilize the instability caused by the fascists to demand Arturo Alessandri's resignation, and increase presidential powers so that they can instate a communist state.
loc.RULE_OPTION_CHL_OPERATION_BOLIVAR_DESC: The Chilean AI will go down the path of fascism, choosing to side with the German Reich if they get the chance, eventually going to war and attempting to restore the Kingdom of Chile of old.
loc.RULE_OPTION_CHL_PAN_HISPANISM_DESC: The Chilean AI will go down the path of fascism, eventually choosing to not side with any of the great world powers. They will later go on to either conquer the Hispanic world, or unite it diplomatically.
loc.RULE_OPTION_CHL_ANTI_IMPERIALISM_DESC: The Chilean AI will choose to support the various Mapuche organizations, eventually having them take control of the country. It will later go on a crusade against Imperialism, outing the European controlled states from South and Central America.
loc.RULE_OPTION_CHL_LE_DELUGE: The Kingdom of Araucanía and Patagonia
loc.RULE_OPTION_CHL_LE_DELUGE_DESC: The Chilean AI will look to tradition and thus oust Alessandri from power, instating Ibáñez in his place. It will then go into a civil war, in which Antoine III will restore the old Kingdom of Araucanía and Patagonia, declaring himself a successor to Napoleon.
loc.RULE_HISTORICAL_BRA_AI_DESC: Vargas will attempt to stay in power by carefully eliminating the political opposition in Brazil before eventually joining the Allies and working with the United States.
loc.RULE_FASCISM_BRA_AI_DESC: The Integralist movement will betray Vargas and install one of their own as leader. They will then attempt to dominate South America through diplomacy and force.
loc.RULE_DEMOCRATIC_BRA_AI_DESC: Brazil will attempt to overthrow Vargas by ending the state of emergency. It will then attempt to reform the nation, increasing democratic participation before ultimately cooperating with the USA against the Axis powers.
loc.RULE_OPTION_MONARCHIST_HENRIQUE_DESC: The AI will attempt to reform the Empire of Brazil by gaining support for Pedro Henrique as the rightful heir to the throne. It will then attempt to conquer or integrate Brazil's neighbors.
loc.RULE_OPTION_MONARCHIST_ALCANTARA_DESC: The AI will attempt to reform the Empire of Brazil by gaining support for Pedro de Alcântara as the rightful heir to the throne. It will then attempt to reunify with Portugal through diplomacy or force.
loc.RULE_OPTION_BRA_COMMUNIST_STALINISM_DESC: Brazil will attempt to overthrow the democratic government and replace it with a Soviet aligned, communist government headed by Luís Carlos Prestes. It will then join the Comintern and aide the Soviet Union.
loc.RULE_OPTION_BRA_COMMUNIST_INDEPENDENT_DE: Brazil will resurrect the ANL and attempt to overthrow the democratic government. It will be replaced by the ANL council who will then implement communist reforms before ultimately attempting to liberate the continent from fascism and imperialism.
loc.RULE_HISTORICAL_ARG_AI_DESC: The AI will attempt to adhere to historical events by avoiding entry into the war and gradually cooperating with the UK and USA.
loc.RULE_FASCISM_ARG_AI_DESC: The AI will attempt to turn the country fascist and will join the Axis powers to open up a new front in South America.
loc.RULE_COMMUNIST_ARG_AI_DESC: The AI will attempt to turn the country communist and will join the Comintern to focus on spreading their ideology in South America.
loc.RULE_DEMOCRATIC_ARG_AI_DESC: The AI will attempt to turn democratic and will join the Allies to safe guard democracy and freedom in South America
loc.RULE_ALLOW_RELEASE_NATIONS_NOT_CHILE_TOO: §Y[CHL.GetName]§! may only release this country via the §YCrusade Against Imperialism§! focus or by going down the §YDemocratic§! or §YCommunist§! branches in the §YFocus Tree§!.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_RELEASE_NATIONS_NOT_QUEBEC_TO: §Y[CAN.GetName]§! may only release this country via by completing either §Y$CAN_forced_quebec_conscription$§! or §Y$CAN_compromise_with_quebec$§!.
loc.RULE_OPTION_HISTORICAL_PAR_AI_DESC: The AI will keep out of global politics and focus on internal issues, going through instabilities keeping it out of the war.
loc.RULE_OPTION_COMMUNIST_PAR_AI_DESC: The AI will keep Rafael Franco's communist government and seek to take revenge against Bolivia for the Chaco War.
loc.RULE_OPTION_DEMOCRATIC_PAR_AI_DESC: The AI will fight against Rafael Franco's coup and enter a civil war to try and keep its democratic government intact.
loc.RULE_OPTION_HISTORICAL_URG_AI_DESC: The AI will attempt to keep out of world affairs and focus on internal industrialization, putting the Colorado party in power. Only joining the allies at the end of the war.
loc.RULE_OPTION_DEMOCRATIC_ALT_AI_URG_DESC: The AI will attempt to keep out of world affairs and focus on internal industrialization, putting the Blanco party in power. Only joining the allies at the end of the war.
loc.RULE_OPTION_FASCIST_AI_URG_DESC: The AI will align with the Axis, turning the country into a springboard for a South American conquest.
loc.RULE_OPTION_DISPERSE_MILITARY_POWER_AI_D: The AI will stay neutral in world affairs and try and develop their own country unless provoked.
loc.RULE_OPTION_DICTATORSHIP_NEUTRAL_AI_DESC: The AI will go down the route of an authoritarian dictatorship but try and remain neutral
loc.RULE_OPTION_DICTATORSHIP_WARMONGER_AI_DE: The AI will go down the route of an authoritarian dictatorship and try to expand their territory
loc.RULE_ALLOW_RELEASE_NATIONS_NO_SLOVAKIA_T: §Y[HUN.GetName]§! and §Y[CZE.GetName]§! may only release this country via events or focuses.
loc.RULE_OPTION_HISTORICAL_AUS_AI_DESC: The AI will turn fascist and attempt to stave off the Anschluss with the Vaterländische Front at the helm.
loc.RULE_OPTION_MONARCHIST_PUPPET_AUS_AI_DES: The AI will attempt to reform the Austro-Hungarian Empire by rebuilding their military and demanding subjugation of the countries that now occupy their old lands.
loc.RULE_OPTION_MONARCHIST_ANNEX_AUS_AI_DESC: The AI will attempt to reform the Austrian Empire by rebuilding their military and then expanding and annexing their old lost territories.
loc.RULE_OPTION_AUS_NEUTRALITY_FEDERATIVE_AI: The AI will attempt to form the Danubian Federation by inviting other nations along the Danube under a non-aligned rule.
loc.RULE_OPTION_AUS_COMMUNIST_SOV_ALIGNED_AI: The AI will attempt to go communist and overthrow the government before aligning with the USSR and joining the Comintern
loc.RULE_OPTION_AUS_COMMUNIST_AI_DESC: The AI will attempt to go communist and overthrow the government. Adhering to a strict Austromarxist agenda they will create a faction of their own
loc.RULE_OPTION_AUS_DEMOCRATIC_FEDERATIVE_AI: The AI will attempt to form the Danubian Federation by inviting other nations along the Danube under a democratic rule.
loc.RULE_OPTION_AUS_DEMOCRATIC_ALLIES_AI_DES: The AI will attempt to join the Allies by re-establishing democracy in Austria.
loc.RULE_OPTION_AUS_DEMOCRATIC_ALPINE_FEDERA: The AI will attempt to re-establish democracy in Austria and form the Alpine Federation.
loc.RULE_OPTION_AUS_ANTI_ANSCLUSS_STRESS_AI_: The AI will largely follow the Historical path, but will attempt to stave off Anschluss by any means possible, fighting tooth and claw for their independence until the bitter end. This might present a challenge or delay to the outbreak of the war
loc.RULE_OPTION_HISTORICAL_BEL_AI_DESC: Belgium will initially try to stave off attacks, but will then fall back to the Congo and continue the war from there.
loc.RULE_OPTION_NATIONALIST_FASCIST_BEL_AI_D: The AI will go with the Rexist Fascists, and establish a tall highly industrial state, then assist the fascists in the war.
loc.RULE_OPTION_EXPANSIONIST_FASCIST_BEL_AI_: The AI will go with the Flemish Nationalist Fascists, and aggressively try to unite the low countries then turn on France.
loc.RULE_OPTION_DEFENSIVE_DEMOCRAT_BEL_AI_DE: The AI will throw off the shackles of their weak-willed king, and attempt to defend Belgium at all costs.
loc.RULE_OPTION_COMMUNIST_BEL_AI_DESC: The AI will allow the Labour party to win the election, and then slowly begin to align themselves with the Communist bloc.
loc.RULE_OPTION_HISTORICAL_COG_AI_DESC: The Congolese AI will stay with Belgium and utilize its relationship with the nation to its fullest potential, eventually looking for increased autonomy
loc.RULE_OPTION_COG_DEM_INDEPENDENCE_AI_DESC: The Congolese AI will attempt to gain its independence as soon as it can through peaceful means, and later campaign for democracy throughout Africa.
loc.RULE_OPTION_COG_COM_INDEPENDENCE_AI_DESC: The Congolese AI will attempt to gain its independence as soon as it can through peaceful means, and later attempt to spread communism throughout Africa.
loc.RULE_OPTION_COG_COM_REVOLUTION_AI_DESC: The Congolese AI will attempt to break free from their colonial overlords through a violent revolution and subsequent civil war, and will then attempt to spread communism throughout the African continent.
loc.RULE_OPTION_HISTORICAL_AFG_AI_DESC: The Afghan AI will attempt to stay neutral throughout the time period while also attempting to gain economic concessions from the Allies, Comintern and Axis powers.
loc.RULE_OPTION_FASCISM_AFG_AI_DESC: The Afghan AI will attempt to oust King Zahir Shah and replace him with Amanullah Khan who will then attempt to rapidly modernize the country. Afghanistan will then look to expanding its borders with the aid of the Axis powers.
loc.RULE_OPTION_DEMOCRATIC_AFG_AI_DESC: The Afghan AI will push King Zahir Shah to oust his uncles before continuing on a path of radical reforms. This will culminate in Afghanistan becoming a democracy and joining the Allies.
loc.RULE_OPTION_COMMUNIST_AFG_AI_DESC: The Afghan AI will cozy up to the Soviet Union and implement radical reforms to transform the nation into a Communist state. It will then join the Comintern and attempt to take control of central Asia.
loc.RULE_OPTION_CALIPHATE_AFG_AI_DESC: The Afghan AI will attempt to oust King Zahir Shah and replace him with the Faqir of Ipi who will then attempt to reverse the modernization of the country. Afghanistan will then look to expanding its borders eventually forming a new Caliphate.
loc.RULE_OPTION_EMPIRE_AFG_AI_DESC: The Afghan AI will attempt to oust King Zahir Shah and replace him with Emir Sayyid Mir Muhammad Alim Khan who will then attempt to unify the Afghan tribes. Afghanistan will then look to expanding its borders eventually forming a new Afghan Empire.
loc.RULE_OPTION_MUGHAL_AFG_AI_DESC: The Afghan AI will attempt to oust King Zahir Shah and replace him with Mirza Khurshid Jah Bahadur who will then attempt to recreate the Mughal Empire. They will then look to expanding their borders eventually forming a new Timurid Empire.
loc.RULE_OPTION_HISTORICAL_IRQ_AI_DESC: The AI will flip-flop between historical coups, culminating in the Golden Square seizing control and going to war with the UK before ultimately restoring the monarchy and surrendering.
loc.RULE_OPTION_FASCISM_IRQ_AI_DESC: The AI will attempt to put the Golden Square in power as soon as possible before joining the Axis to fight the UK. They will then attempt to annex neighbouring Arab territories.
loc.RULE_OPTION_HASHEMITE_IRQ_AI_DESC: The AI will attempt to remain loyal to the UK while building up its power in the region, gradually taking over administration of territory and ultimately forming the Hashemite Arab Federation.
loc.RULE_OPTION_SIDQI_IRQ_AI_DESC: Bakr Sidqi will launch his historical coup but will not be assassinated. Instead, the government will work with Iran and Turkey to form a regional power bloc.
loc.RULE_OPTION_KURDISTAN_IRQ_AI_DESC: The Kurds of Northern Iraq will launch a revolt against the Iraqi government. If they succeed, they will attempt to unify their lands across Turkey and Iran.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_RELEASE_NATIONS_NOT_RAJ_TOOLT: §Y[RAJ.GetName]§! may only release this country by completing §Y$RAJ_a_secular_state$§!, §Y$RAJ_incorporation_of_the_east_india_company$§!, §Y$RAJ_hindutva$§!, §Y$RAJ_netaji$§! or by completing §YPartition§!
loc.RULE_OPTION_HISTORICAL_PER_AI_DESC: The AI will work through political reforms and bolster their military, before being invaded and immediately capitulating.
loc.RULE_OPTION_IMPERIAL_PER_DESC: The AI will establish an absolute monarchy as Reza Shah Pahlavi and work towards a campaign of conquest in the Middle East.
loc.RULE_OPTION_DEMOCRATIC_PER_DESC: The AI will force constitutional limits on the Shah and follow a path of democracy before eventually attempting to join a democratic faction.
loc.RULE_OPTION_COMMUNISM_PER_DESC: The AI will engage in a revolution that will leave the Soviet aligned Tudeh party in power. The communist regime will attempt to destabilize the region.
loc.RULE_OPTION_FASCISM_PER_DESC: The AI will unite the country's nationalists and form SUMKA, bringing a fascist regime to the country. It will attempt to join a fascist faction and declare war on their neighbors.
loc.RULE_OPTION_HISTORICAL_PHI_AI_DESC: The Philippines will remain aligned with the United States.
loc.RULE_OPTION_FLEXIBLE_PHI_AI_DESC: The Philippines will play the USA and the Japanese off against each other, to maximize their potential.
loc.RULE_OPTION_FASCIST_PHI_AI_DESC: The Philippines will align themselves with the Japanese, potentially falling foul of fascism themselves.
loc.RULE_OPTION_MONARCHIST_PHI_AI_DESC: The Philippines will have its election overturned, having $PHI_neutrality_party_long$ take over until eventually having an independence war with support from friendly Hispanic nations and becoming a monarchy.
loc.RULE_OPTION_COMMUNIST_PHI_AI_DESC: The red sun will rise over the Philippines, as maritime communism takes hold and seeks to spread the spirit of equality across the world's oceans.
loc.RULE_OPTION_MACARTHUR_PHI_AI_DESC: After the fall of the Philippine government, a military figure will rise and lead the nation against any and all aggressors.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_RELEASE_NATIONS_ALL_NATIONS_S: This nation may never be released.
loc.RULE_ALLOW_RELEASE_NATIONS_ALL_NATIONS_R: This nation may never be released.
loc.RULE_OPTION_AST_AI_RANDOM_TAOG_HISTORICA: A firmly entrenched, if unstable democracy gives Australia the foundation with which to look out across the wider world, and brace for the coming storm.
loc.RULE_OPTION_AST_ADELA_FASCIST_TAOG_AI_DE: Adela Pankhurst-Walsh leads Australia with an initial goal of expanding the British Empire ever further, though precisely who will inherit that expanded empire remains an open question.
loc.RULE_OPTION_AST_PETER_FASCIST_TAOG_AI_DE: Australia First demands an independent Australia that is free to forge her own future.
loc.RULE_OPTION_AST_RANDOM_DEMOCRATIC_TAOG_A: The voice of the people matters most in Democratic Australia, to whose will the fate of the nation is beholden.
loc.RULE_OPTION_AST_ANTI_COMMONWEALTH_COMMUN: The distant overlord has determined Australia's fate for too long. Now is the time to cast off the imperial yoke... and liberate others along the way.
loc.RULE_OPTION_AST_COMINTERN_COMMUNIST_TAOG: It is only in unity that the Communist utopia can be realized, for this is the path of the worldwide workers' revolution
loc.RULE_OPTION_TRUE_HISTORICAL_INS_AI_DESC: The AI will stay loyal to the Netherlands, but will start a revolution after facing Japanese occupation.
loc.RULE_OPTION_LOYALIST_INS_AI_DESC: The AI will stay loyal to the Netherlands, either seeking independence peacefully through the Soetardjo petition, or maintaining the colonial order.
loc.RULE_OPTION_REVOLUTION_DEMOCRATIC_INS_AI: The AI will start an early revolution. Sutan Sjahrir will take power and establish a democratic government.
loc.RULE_OPTION_REVOLUTION_UNALIGNED_INS_AI_: The AI will start an early revolution. Sukarno will maintain power and opposition movements will be stopped.
loc.RULE_OPTION_REVOLUTION_COMMUNIST_INS_AI_: The AI will start an early revolution. Tan Malaka will have a coup to establish a communist government before spreading the revolution throughout the pacific.
loc.RULE_OPTION_HISTORICAL_SIA_AI_DESC: The AI will follow the historical outcome. The AI will go down the fascist tree, attack Indochina and join the Japanese faction.
loc.RULE_OPTION_MONARCHIST_SIA_AI_DESC: The AI will go down the Monarchist route.
loc.rhineland_desc: The Rhineland has been demilitarized since the end of the First World War, but this insult shall stand no longer! Germany is a sovereign nation and is free to move troops anywhere within her borders!
loc.rhineland_short_desc: §LMove German forces west of the Rhine in defiance of the Versailles Treaty.§!
loc.anschluss_desc: The Anschluss, or union with Austria, is a long held goal of the German people. Although forbidden by the Treaty of Versailles, the time has finally come to bring it about. We must increase local support for fascism in Austria to lay the groundwork for the annexation.
loc.anschluss_short_desc: §LUse covert means to boost popular support for Fascism in Austria.§!
loc.take_state_short_desc: This war goal will make selected states cheaper to pick at the peace conference.
loc.take_state_focus_short_desc: This war goal will make selected states cheaper to pick at the peace conference.
loc.liberate_wargoal_desc: This war goal will make liberation cheaper to pick in the peace conference.
loc.puppet_wargoal_focus_short_desc: This war goal will make it cheaper to puppet state at the peace conference.
loc.take_claimed_state_short_desc: This war goal will make selected states cheaper to pick at the peace conference.
loc.take_core_state_short_desc: This war goal will make selected states cheaper to pick at the peace conference.
loc.annex_everything_short_desc: This war goal will make annexation cheaper to pick at the peace conference.
loc.civil_war_desc: Civil war! The nation is split into factions who battle for control of the state.
loc.civil_war_short_desc: This war goal will make annexation cheaper to pick at the peace conference.
loc.topple_government_short_desc: This war goal will make topple government cheaper to pick at the peace conference.
loc.anti_comintern_pact_desc: It is time to make a pact "recognizing that the aim of the Communist International, known as the Comintern, is to disintegrate and subdue existing States by all the means at its command; convinced that the toleration of interference by the Communist International in the internal affairs of the nations not only endangers their internal peace and social well-being, but is also a menace to the peace of the world desirous of co-operating in the defense against Communist subversive activities."\nThis will improve relations with nations which join the pact.
loc.anti_comintern_pact_short_desc: §LForm a united front against communism together with Italy and Japan.§!
loc.tripartite_pact_desc: To strengthen the Anti-Comintern Pact, for the next ten years the signing nations agree that "their prime purpose is to establish and maintain a new order of things, to promote the mutual prosperity and welfare of the peoples concerned."
loc.tripartite_pact_short_desc: §LForge even closer ties with Italy and Japan by signing a new treaty.§!
loc.demand_sudetenland_desc: The German people of the Sudetenland are being cruelly mistreated by their Czechoslovakian overlords, a crime which cannot be allowed to go on for any longer! The Sudetenland and its people must be immediately ceded to Germany.
loc.demand_sudetenland_short_desc: §LMass forces along the Czechoslovakian border to put pressure on Prague.§!
loc.fate_of_czechoslovakia_desc: With the Sudetenland in our hands, Czechoslovakia lies defenseless. It is time to end this sad rump-state.
loc.fate_of_czechoslovakia_short_desc: §LAssemble forces in the Sudetenland to annex what remains of the Czech state.§!
loc.molotov_ribbentrop_pact_desc: By signing a treaty of friendship and non-aggression with the USSR, we can come to some agreement about what to do with the states that lie between our current borders as well as engaging in higher volumes of trade. In addition to stipulations of non-aggression, the treaty includes a secret protocol that divides the territories of Romania, Poland, Lithuania, Latvia, Estonia and Finland into Nazi and Soviet spheres of influence, anticipating the potential territorial and political rearrangements of these countries.
loc.molotov_ribbentrop_pact_short_desc: §LSign a non-aggression pact with the USSR to avoid Soviet intervention.§!
loc.poland_goal_desc: Danzig was German, Danzig has remained German, and Danzig shall be German from now on! We must prepare the German people for the inevitable war with Poland. A propaganda campaign will steel their will for the coming battle, while the crimes of the Polish nation are exposed to the world. Danzig and the surrounding lands will return to Germany!
loc.poland_goal_short_desc: §LPrepare the German people for war with Poland, then march on Warsaw!§!
loc.test_the_chinese_focus_desc: The Chinese still refuse to acknowledge our liberation of Manchuria, and tensions along the border near Beijing have resulted in several skirmishes. If we manufacture an incident, we can escalate the conflict into full-scale war. This will give us the excuse we need to deal with the Chinese once and for all!
loc.test_the_chinese_focus_short_desc: §LProvoke a confrontation by massing forces along the Chinese border.§!
loc.chinese_border_incident_SUCCEEDED_DESC: Elements of our forces were pulled into a violent skirmish with Chinese soldiers while attempting to establish control over the strategic Marco Polo Bridge just south of Beijing. The fighting ended inconclusively, but we have demanded an apology and additional territorial concessions.
loc.south_pacific_mandate_desc: Our holdings in the Pacific, granted to us by the League of Nations after the last war, will constitute Japan's first line of defense in any future wars against America. These islands are unsinkable aircraft carriers, and we should take steps to fortify them.
loc.south_pacific_mandate_short_desc: §LConstruct new coastal forts on our Pacific islands.§!
loc.south_pacific_mandate_SUCCEEDED: The South Pacific Mandate has been fortified
loc.south_pacific_mandate_SUCCEEDED_DESC: Our engineers have fortified our islands in the South Pacific Mandate. Any attackers will find our forces difficult to dislodge.
loc.demand_indochina_focus_desc: After its defeat in Europe, France's hold over its overseas colonies is tenuous at best. Pressure the new French government into granting Japan full access to its bases in Indochina. This region will be useful as a springboard for future campaigns.
loc.demand_indochina_focus_short_desc: §LPressure the new French government into giving up Indochina.§!
loc.demand_french_indochina_SUCCEEDED_DESC: Our forces are positioned along the borders of French Indochina, making it clear that there will be serious consequences should our proposal be rejected.
loc.test_the_ussr_focus_desc: We must respond to the continued Soviet provocations along our northern frontier. Their incessant violations of the established Manchurian borders can no longer be tolerated. Mass forces in northern Manchuria to discourage future transgressions.
loc.test_the_ussr_focus_short_desc: §LMass forces in Manchuria to discourage Soviet provocations.§!
loc.naval_expansion_focus_desc: We are no longer bound by the Washington Naval Treaty, and as an island-nation the navy is critical to our very survival. Expand our port facilities to increase naval production. Only then can Japan build the fleet it deserves.
loc.naval_expansion_focus_short_desc: §LIncrease Japan's naval production by building more dockyards.§!
loc.increase_naval_production_SUCCEEDED_DESC: We have successfully increased our naval production. Soon the Emperor will command the mightiest armada the world has ever seen!
loc.siamese_puppet_focus_desc: Our forces need access to Siam in order to reach British possessions in Burma and Malaya. A display of force may convince the Siamese government to sign an alliance with us as loyal partners in the Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere.
loc.occupy_philippines_desc: The first step in a successful Pacific campaign is the occupation of the Philippines. The Americans will not hesitate to use the islands as an advance base from which to strike directly at Japan, but we can use it for that same purpose in future operations against the Southern Resource Area.
loc.occupy_philippines_short_desc: §LLand forces on the Philippines to deny its use as a base against us.§!
loc.southern_resource_area_desc: British Borneo and the rich Dutch East Indies constitute vital strategic objectives that are ripe for the taking. Japan must secure access to the oil fields and rubber plantations, or its industries will starve and its war machine collapse.
loc.southern_resource_area_short_desc: §LOccupy the Southern Resource Area to secure raw material for our war industry.§!
loc.british_far_east_desc: Britain needs to be stripped of its Asian colonial empire if Japan is to take its rightful place as the leader of a new order in Greater East Asia. Seize Hong Kong, occupy the Malay Peninsula and advance into Burma. Establish a new frontier along the border towards India.
loc.british_far_east_short_desc: §LComplete the conquest of Hong Kong, Singapore and Burma.§!
loc.isolate_australia_desc: Australia is vital to the Allied war effort in the Pacific, and it must not be allowed to serve as a base where forces are marshaled against Japan and its rightful conquests. By taking key islands in the southwestern Pacific, we can isolate Australia from the United States.
loc.isolate_australia_short_desc: §LIsolate Australia by occupying key islands surrounding it.§!
loc.invade_australia_desc: The time has come to conduct a full-scale invasion of Australia. This will permanently remove the largest bastion of Allied power in the Pacific and secure the southern flank of the Greater East Asian Co-Prosperity Sphere.
loc.secure_the_pacific_desc: American bases throughout the Pacific must be seized, to diminish the force projection capability of their fleet inside our territory. The Imperial Navy General Staff have identified several islands which must be occupied, including the main base of the US Pacific Fleet at Hawaii.
loc.secure_the_pacific_short_desc: §LOccupy key American islands to secure control over the Pacific.§!
loc.close_panama_canal_desc: The Americans rely on the Panama Canal to transfer naval assets between their west and east coasts, and this is their weakness! We must seize the Galapagos Islands to establish a forward base, and then land forces in Panama to close the canal. For the Emperor!
loc.close_panama_canal_short_desc: §LOccupy the Panama Canal to deny its use to the Americans.§!
loc.invasion_of_alaska_desc: The northern approaches to the Home Islands must be secured by occupying the Aleutian Islands. Control of these islands will further enable us to establish a foothold in North America by invading Alaska. The remoteness of this region should make it difficult for the Americans to reinforce.
loc.invasion_of_alaska_short_desc: §LInvade and occupy American territory in Alaska.§!
loc.invasion_of_west_coast_desc: The Imperial General Headquarters have opted to bring our war with America to a decisive end by staging an invasion of their West Coast. Objectives for this operation include Los Angeles, San Francisco and Seattle. Be prepared for possible counterattacks against our beachheads.
loc.invasion_of_west_coast_short_desc: §LCommence an invasion of the American West Coast.§!
loc.invasion_of_india_desc: At long last, the era of British dominion over the Indian subcontinent will come to an end. We must press on from Burma and drive the British completely out of Asia. This will be a blow from which their empire can never recover!
loc.invasion_of_india_short_desc: §LDrive the British out of India by occupying the entire subcontinent.§!
loc.secure_the_indian_ocean_desc: We must establish control over the Indian Ocean to prevent Allied fleet movements towards Asia. Several objectives must be seized, including Madagascar off the coast of Africa. The island could be used as a base from which to disrupt British convoys bound for the Middle East.
loc.secure_the_indian_ocean_short_desc: §LEstablish control over the Indian Ocean with the seizure of key objectives.§!
loc.invasion_of_south_africa_desc: Our unstoppable forces are now in a position to strike at South Africa. Its conquest should make it very difficult for Allied naval units to enter the Indian Ocean without use of the Suez Canal. The decadent British Empire is unraveling before our eyes.
loc.invasion_of_south_africa_short_desc: §LLand forces in South Africa and destroy all opposition.§!
loc.extend_maginot_line_desc: Our border towards Germany is protected by the formidable Maginot Line, but a flanking German thrust through Belgium and Luxembourg, just as in 1914, is always a possibility. We must extend our heavy fortifications all the way to the English Channel, even if this means leaving Belgium at the mercy of the Germans.
loc.extend_maginot_line_short_desc: §LExtend the Maginot Line all the way to the English Channel.§!
loc.improve_alpine_line_desc: The 'Little Maginot Line' defending our southern border towards Italy has always been of secondary importance in our military planning. Fascist Italy is becoming increasingly aggressive, however, and we know they have territorial ambitions in southern France. We must bring the fortifications of the Alpine Line up to the same standards of those of the Maginot Line.
loc.improve_alpine_line_short_desc: §LImprove our defensive fortifications along the Italian border.§!
loc.expand_french_air_force_desc: Air power will be critical in the next war - the surrender of our skies will inevitably mean the surrender of France itself. We must continue expanding the Armée de l'Air to ensure that France possesses one of the finest air forces in the world.
loc.expand_french_air_force_short_desc: §LIncrease the size of our air force to protect the skies over France.§!
loc.french_arms_industry_desc: Another war with Germany seems increasingly likely at this point. We must prepare ourselves by expanding the arms industry. The French Army is all that stands between Germany and dominion over Western Europe!
loc.french_arms_industry_short_desc: §LBuild up the French arms industry to prepare for the coming war.§!
loc.scandinavian_expedition_desc: We must do what we can to keep the war from French territory, and an expedition to Norway and northern Sweden will open a new front for Germany to consider. Much of Germany's steel comes from this region, and by cutting off the supply it may be possible to cripple their industry.
loc.scandinavian_expedition_short_desc: §LOpen a new front for Germany from northern Scandinavia.§!
loc.grand_offensive_desc: While the Wehrmacht is busy contending with the brave Polish forces in the east, we must fulfill the obligations of our alliance and strike deeply into Germany! Occupy their industrial heartland in the Rhine Valley. That should get the attention of the OKW, and possibly force them to abandon their offensive into Poland.
loc.grand_offensive_short_desc: §LOccupy the German industry in the Rhine Valley.§!
loc.seize_berlin_fra_desc: We have no choice but to march on Berlin and plant the Tricolor on top of the Reichstag building. Let us bring this war to a swift conclusion before it has a chance to begin in earnest.
loc.occupy_libya_fra_desc: Italy's colonial empire must be dismantled. Launch an offensive into Italian Libya from our Tunisian protectorate and occupy the Mediterranean coast. Vital objectives include the strategic port cities of Tripoli and Benghazi.
loc.occupy_libya_fra_short_desc: §LLaunch an offensive to occupy Tripoli and Benghazi.§!
loc.occupy_north_italy_fra_desc: It is once again time for French armies to march into northern Italy. Much of the Italian war industry is concentrated there, and Rome must be deprived of its use. Breach the vaunted Vallo Alpino and surge into the Po Valley. Vive la France!
loc.occupy_north_italy_fra_short_desc: §LBreach the vaunted Vallo Alpino and surge into the Po Valley.§!
loc.occupy_south_italy_fra_desc: The southern half of the Italian peninsula must be secured, along with Sicily and Sardinia. Seize all objectives, but do not be distracted from our main target: Rome. Once you have occupied the Eternal City, continue your push along the coast and eliminate any remaining pockets of resistance.
loc.occupy_south_italy_fra_short_desc: §LSeize Sicily and Sardinia along with the Italian capital.§!
loc.claim_bessarabia_desc: The territory of Bessarabia was illegally occupied by Romania in the turbulent period that followed the Russian Revolution. It rightfully belongs to us and must be returned. The Molotov - Ribbentrop Pact gives us a free hand to deal with the Romanians without the threat of German intervention, so the time to act is now.
loc.claim_bessarabia_short_desc: §LForce the Romanians to return Bessarabia to us.§!
loc.claim_baltic_states_desc: The Baltic States are a failed experiment in capitalism that must be ended. Our pact with Germany enables us to act with impunity in the region, and we have prepared ultimatums for Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania to let us establish military bases inside their borders. It will then be a simple matter to incorporate these nations as full members of the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics.
loc.claim_baltic_states_short_desc: §LIncorporate the Baltic States into the Soviet Union.§!
loc.claim_karelia_desc: As per the Molotov - Ribbentrop Pact, Finland lies inside our sphere of interest, and the time has come to revise their generous borders. Their southeastern border on the Karelian Isthmus lies unacceptably close to Leningrad, compromising the security of our nation. We will issue a demand to Helsinki for Finnish territorial concessions, but we must be prepared to fight if they refuse.
loc.claim_karelia_short_desc: §LDemand Karelia from Finland to improve the security of Leningrad.§!
loc.improve_stalin_line_desc: Work on the Stalin Line began in the 1920s along our western frontier, to defend against the bourgeoisie nations of Western Europe who would like nothing more than to bring about our destruction. We must continue to improve these defenses.
loc.improve_stalin_line_short_desc: §LImprove defenses along the Stalin Line to guard against foreign invasion.§!
loc.five_year_plans_desc: The five-year plans for the development of the national economy are absolutely vital to the future of the Soviet Union. Economic and industrial backwardness will mean our eventual destruction at the hands of the capitalist and fascist powers abroad. We must continue to expand our industry and production output!
loc.five_year_plans_short_desc: §LExpand the civilian industrial output of the Soviet Union.§!
loc.operation_zet_desc: The Japanese fascists are waging a war to conquer all of China. Needless to say, it is not in the interest of the Soviet Union to see them succeed. We must provide what support we can to the Chinese. With luck, the Imperial Japanese Army will be dragged into a quagmire that weakens their empire and keeps them occupied for the foreseeable future.
loc.operation_zet_short_desc: §LOffer support to the Chinese in their war against Japan.§!
loc.annex_tannu_tuva_desc: The Tuvan People's Republic is a member of the Soviet Union in all but name. Let us formalize the relationship by officially annexing them into our great nation.
loc.annex_tannu_tuva_short_desc: §LIncorporate Tannu Tuva into the Soviet Union.§!
loc.second_vienna_award_desc: The Treaty of Trianon unjustly stripped Hungary of more than two thirds of its territory. Losing Transylvania to the Romanians was particularly hard to stomach. A new order has been established in Europe, however, and we must petition our friends in Germany for the return of stolen Hungarian land.
loc.second_vienna_award_short_desc: §LPetition Germany for the return of Transylvania to Hungary.§!
loc.claim_memel_desc: Memel is yet another injustice to come out of the hated Treaty of Versailles. The province belonged to Prussia for hundreds of years, and yet the Entente decided to separate it from Germany and leave it to be illegally annexed by Lithuania. It is time to right this wrong.
loc.claim_memel_short_desc: §LDemand the repatriation of Memel to the Greater German Reich.§!
loc.treaty_of_craiova_desc: Southern Dobrudja was taken from us by Romania after the Second Balkan War. The borders of Europe are in the process of being redrawn, however, and Romania has already been forced to make concessions. We must demand the return of our lost territory.
loc.treaty_of_craiova_short_desc: §LDemand the return of southern Dobrudja from Romania.§!
loc.german_advisors_china_desc: German military advisors have been present in China since at least the twenties, providing critical support to the Kuomintang. Given our present war, this can no longer be tolerated. As a signatory of the Anti-Comintern Pact, we are within our rights to demand the immediate withdrawal of all German support to the Chinese. It is time for the Germans to choose sides.
loc.german_advisors_china_short_desc: §LDemand the return of the German advisors aiding China.§!
loc.chinese_coastal_regions_desc: We must take advantage of our naval superiority and isolate the Chinese by occupying key ports along their coast. The Imperial General Headquarters have designated several regions that need to come under Japanese control.
loc.chinese_coastal_regions_short_desc: §LIsolate the Chinese by occupying their coast.§!
loc.chinese_interior_desc: Let us put an end to Chinese resistance once and for all by advancing into their interior. Show them that our reach knows no bounds by crushing all opposition. This will ensure Japanese dominance in Asia.
loc.chinese_interior_short_desc: §LPursue the Chinese west into their interior.§!
loc.russian_far_east_desc: The Soviets must be shown that they are no longer welcome in Asia. Occupy the Russian Far East, starting with the base of their Pacific Fleet in Vladivostok. Northern Sakhalin and Kamchatka also need to be secured.
loc.russian_far_east_short_desc: §LConquer the Russian Far East for Japan!§!
loc.siberia_beckons_desc: We must press on and continue our advance into Siberia. Drive the Russians west until they no longer threaten our possessions in Asia. The Siberian wilderness will serve as a buffer to our empire, and the region's untapped natural resources are sure to benefit future generations of Japanese.
loc.siberia_beckons_short_desc: §LMarch onwards and seize Siberia in the name of the Emperor.§!
loc.conquest_of_abyssinia_desc: The painful memories of the First Italo-Abyssinian War and the defeat at Adwa are behind us now. We are committed to the complete conquest of the Ethiopian Empire and its integration into Italian East Africa. Push forward to victory!
loc.conquest_of_albania_desc: Italian forces were humiliatingly forced to withdraw from the parts of Albania they occupied in 1920, but the time is now right for our return. The annexation of Albania will give us full control over the entrance to the Adriatic, and the territory can serve as a foothold for future campaigns in the Balkans.
loc.strengthen_vallo_alpino_desc: Threats can come from any direction along our northern border. The French, the Austrians and their German friends, even the dastardly Swiss could strike at any moment! Work has begun on a line of fortifications, but progress is slow. Finish the Alpine Wall to make any future invasion of Northern Italy a costly one!
loc.strengthen_vallo_alpino_short_desc: §LSecure Italy's northern border by improving fortifications.§!
loc.industrialize_southern_italy_desc: Northern Italy has always been the industrial heartland of our nation, while the south has remained poor and underdeveloped in comparison. We must take steps to close this economic division by building more industries in our southern states.
loc.industrialize_southern_italy_short_desc: §LThe poor southern half of our country must be industrialized.§!
loc.regia_marina_desc: The fortunes of Italy are directly tied to the Mediterranean, something the old Romans understood well. It is clear that the Regia Marina will play a critical role in any future conflicts against Britain or France. We must expand our dockyards to increase ship production.
loc.regia_marina_short_desc: §LBuild more dockyards to increase naval productions.§!
loc.condemn_japan_desc: The Japanese war of aggression against China is an outrage against civility and liberty, as well as an endangerment to American lives, rights and economic interests in China! Japan must cease their attacks or face the repercussions.
loc.condemn_japan_short_desc: §LCondemn the Japanese war of aggression on China.§!
loc.embargo_japan_desc: Japan's attacks on China have continued despite our warning. The time has come to embargo all trade with Japan.
loc.embargo_japan_short_desc: §LEmbargo all trade with Japan in retaliation to their attacks on China.§!
loc.threaten_japan: Show the flag in the Pacific
loc.threaten_japan_desc: To ensure that Japan knows we mean business it is vital to maintain a power fleet in Pearl Harbor.
loc.threaten_japan_short_desc: §LMaintain a power fleet in Pearl Harbor.§!
loc.build_infrastructure_desc: Building infrastructure won't just make it easier to travel throughout our nation, more importantly it will create jobs and help ease us out of the current recession.
loc.build_factories_desc: Building new factories creates jobs both during and after the construction process, a vital step in improving the economy.
loc.build_factories_short_desc: §LConstruct new civilian factories to improve the economy.§!
loc.anglo_egypt_treaty_desc: Though nominally independent, Egypt has been under our protection since 1882. King Farouk wishes to formalize our relationship by treaty in light of the Italian military operations in Abyssinia. Egypt will join us as an ally, while we retain control over the Suez Canal and pledge to assist in their defense in case of war.
loc.anglo_egypt_treaty_short_desc: §LFormalize Egypt independence while retaining them as an ally.§!
loc.shadow_scheme_desc: The Air Ministry has developed a plan for the creation of 'shadow factories' - civilian factories that will be prepared and expanded so that they can more easily switch to military production in the event of war.
loc.shadow_scheme_short_desc: §LPrepare and expand civilian factories for the eventuality of war.§!
loc.chain_home_desc: The advent of air warfare has rendered Britain vulnerable - we can no longer depend solely on our great fleets to keep us safe. Plans have been drawn up for a network of radar stations along our coast codenamed 'Chain Home.' Its construction will greatly aid us in the defense of our airspace.
loc.chain_home_short_desc: §LBuild a network of radar stations along the British coast.§!
loc.gibraltar_east_desc: Work on turning Singapore into a major naval base has been ongoing since the end of the Great War. This port is to serve as a bastion for the Royal Navy, enabling us to project our influence all across Asia. Finish the work that has begun and improve Singapore's defenses.
loc.home_guard_desc: France has been lost, and now Britain itself faces the threat of invasion. A suggestion has been put forward to establish a new defense organization consisting of local volunteers. Many veterans from the previous war are too old for regular military service, but in this way they can still contribute to our defense.
loc.operation_laudabiliter_desc: The independence of Ireland is a stain upon British honor. For their own good, the Irish must be governed by a firm hand from London. Planning is underway for an invasion that will bring these stray sheep back into the fold.
loc.operation_laudabiliter_short_desc: Invade Ireland and reconquer it for Britain.
loc.expand_the_luftwaffe_desc: The Treaty of Versailles did not permit Germany to maintain an air force, so we have had to build the Luftwaffe from the ground up in record time. We have made significant progress, but much remains to be done. Continue the expansion of the Luftwaffe and turn it into the finest air force in the world.
loc.expand_the_luftwaffe_short_desc: §LIncrease the size of the Luftwaffe to prepare for the coming war.§!
loc.panzerwaffe_desc: Our new theories of mobile warfare necessitates the creation of a hard-hitting tank force. We must further increase the size of our Panzerwaffe in preparation for the inevitable coming war.
loc.panzerwaffe_short_desc: §LForm an armored force by raising new panzer divisions for the Heer.§!
loc.reichsautobahn_desc: Since its inception in 1933, the autobahn project has been a glorious success. The construction efforts have reduced unemployment, and the wide roads stand as a monument to Germany's economic recovery. Much work remains to be done, however.
loc.reichsautobahn_short_desc: §LFinish construction of the autobahn by increasing infrastructure in key states.§!
loc.fortify_the_westwall_desc: The Westwall runs parallel to France's vaunted Maginot Line, occupying much of the same ground as the Siegfried Line did in the previous Weltkrieg. Fortifying its defenses will allow us to hold the border with fewer men, freeing up divisions to participate in any potential eastern campaigns.
loc.fortify_the_westwall_short_desc: §LIncrease the defenses of the Westwall by building new forts.§!
loc.operation_weserubung_desc: Scandinavian iron is critical to the German war industry, and our supply must be safeguarded. We will preempt an Allied occupation of Norway by staging an invasion of our own. As a step towards realizing this goal, Denmark must also be occupied. This will have the added benefit of closing off the Baltic Sea to our enemies.
loc.operation_weserubung_short_desc: §LInvade Denmark and Norway to secure the Scandinavian iron trade.§!
loc.operation_tannenbaum_desc: Switzerland is a pimple on the face of Europe, and the Swiss themselves represent a wayward branch of the German people. They must be integrated into Greater Germany at any cost. Storm their mountain redoubts and put an end to this farce of a nation.
loc.operation_tannenbaum_short_desc: §LInvade Switzerland and annex it into the German Reich.§!
loc.operation_felix_desc: Allied operations in the Mediterranean must be curtailed by closing off the Strait of Gibraltar, but the Spanish cannot be relied on to support our cause. We must force the issue by launching a full-scale invasion across the Pyrenees. Both Spain and Portugal need to be occupied in order to safeguard Germany's southwestern flank.
loc.operation_felix_short_desc: §LInvade the Iberian peninsula and effect the capture Gibraltar.§!
loc.operation_ikarus_desc: To support Kriegsmarine operations in the North Atlantic, the OKW has green-lighted an invasion of Iceland. Control of this island will extend our operational reach farther west, and should greatly aid our efforts in bringing the Battle of the Atlantic to a successful conclusion.
loc.operation_ikarus_short_desc: §LInvade Iceland as a step towards winning the Battle of the Atlantic.§!
loc.operation_herkules_desc: The British base on Malta has been a thorn in our side for too long. It continues to interfere with operations in North Africa, and as long as the island is under Allied control the Central Mediterranean will remain contested. We must see to its capture.
loc.operation_herkules_short_desc: §LCapture Malta and deny its use as a base to the British.§!
loc.fall_grun_desc: Circumvent the main British defenses by establishing a beachhead on Ireland. When the island is under our control, Britain will be in a far more isolated position. From this new base our air and naval forces can pummel the stubborn British into submission!
loc.fall_grun_short_desc: §LConduct an invasion of Ireland to isolate Britain and secure new naval bases.§!
loc.operation_seelowe_desc: Our victory in the West can only be assured by the complete occupation of Great Britain. We must conduct a landing operation across the Channel and establish a beachhead on English soil. Our spearheads can then fan out into the countryside and push forward until all of Britain has been occupied. Their empire should then collapse like a house of cards. Vorwärts!
loc.operation_seelowe_short_desc: §LLaunch a massive amphibious invasion of Britain and seize London.§!
loc.operation_barbarossa_desc: We are about to embark on the greatest military campaign in history - the invasion of the Soviet Union! Where Napoleon failed, we will succeed. Surge forward across the border, encircle and destroy Soviet troop concentrations and continue pushing eastward. The operation will be considered a success if we seize Moscow and manage to establish a front line running along the Arkhangelsk - Astrakhan axis. Drang nach Osten!
loc.operation_barbarossa_short_desc: §LInvade the Soviet Union and reach the Arkhangelsk - Astrakhan line.§!
loc.operation_gertrude_desc: The occupation of Turkey will allow us to more easily shift forces from Europe to the Middle East, and it will give us full control over the only entrance to the Black Sea. Under no circumstances must the Turks be permitted to align with the Allies!
loc.operation_gertrude_short_desc: §LSecure the entrance to the Black Sea by staging an invasion of Turkey.§!
loc.operation_mungo_desc: Following in the footsteps of Alexander the Great, our forces have reached the Indus Valley. We are now in a position to rob the British of the jewel in their empire. Commence a full-scale invasion of India!
loc.operation_mungo_short_desc: §LCommence an invasion of British India and conquer it for the Vaterland.§!
loc.operation_knickerbocker_desc: We must bring the war across the Atlantic. Before we can launch an invasion of the American East Coast, we must secure bases where we can mass our forces. The Kriegsmarine has prepared invasion plans for both Newfoundland and Bermuda. Either of these islands will suit our purposes.
loc.operation_knickerbocker_short_desc: §LSecure bases in the Atlantic in preparation for an invasion of America.§!
loc.operation_buffel_desc: To secure Germany's leadership in the new world order we have created, a full-scale invasion of the continental United States must be conducted. Important political and industrial targets along the northeastern American coast are to be immediately occupied, including the White House in Washington.
loc.operation_buffel_short_desc: §LInvade North America and occupy important targets on the US East Coast.§!
loc.deutsches_afrikakorps_desc: We must aid the Italians in their struggle against the British in North Africa. Transport an expeditionary force to Libya and support the Italian drive towards Egypt!
loc.deutsches_afrikakorps_short_desc: §LSupport Italian operations in North Africa by landing forces in Libya.§!
loc.fall_weiss_desc: The invasion of Poland must be commenced. Important strategic objectives include Warsaw, Krakow and Lwow. We must also establish a land corridor to our forces in East Prussia as soon as possible. Meanwhile, our border towards France must be defended at every cost. Do not let Moselland or Württemberg fall to the French!
loc.fall_weiss_short_desc: §LInvade Poland while holding the Westwall against the French.§!
loc.fall_gelb_desc: The Maginot Line would make a direct assault on France from across our border very costly. Borrowing from the Schlieffen Plan, the OKH have prepared for an invasion through the Low Countries instead. If possible, isolate and destroy Allied forces crossing into Belgium by driving a wedge between them and the rest of France.
loc.fall_gelb_short_desc: §LCircumvent the Maginot Line by invading and occupying the Low Countries.§!
loc.fall_rot_desc: We are now in a position to launch an offensive along a broad front into France. Drive south, force a crossing of the Marne and seize Paris. The Channel coast must also be occupied, and the Maginot Line should be encircled and destroyed when opportunity presents itself.
loc.fall_rot_short_desc: §LAdvance south into France. The Marne will not stop us this time!§!
loc.goal_construction1_desc: A modern military requires a powerful economy to provide the weapons, planes, ships, and tanks that dominate today's wars.
loc.goal_construction1_short_desc: §LA powerful military requires industrial muscle, build more factories!§!
loc.goal_construction2_desc: A modern military requires a powerful economy to provide the weapons, planes, ships, and tanks that dominate today's wars.
loc.goal_construction2_short_desc: §LA powerful military requires industrial muscle, build more factories!§!
loc.goal_construction3_desc: A modern military requires a powerful economy to provide the weapons, planes, ships, and tanks that dominate today's wars.
loc.goal_construction3_short_desc: §LA powerful military requires industrial muscle, build more factories!§!
loc.goal_construction4_desc: A modern military requires a powerful economy to provide the weapons, planes, ships, and tanks that dominate today's wars.
loc.goal_construction4_short_desc: §LA powerful military requires industrial muscle, build more factories!§!
loc.repel_invaders_desc: Our country has been cruelly attacked and at this very moment filthy enemy troops are marching through our fields and towns! This cannot be allowed to continue, rally our forces and repel the invaders!
loc.support_democracy_desc: The current political leadership has taken the wrong direction. With a little manipulation, a touch of propaganda, and perhaps a scandal or two, the government could be made to fall and a more Democratic party could be swept into power.
loc.support_communism_desc: The current political leadership has taken the wrong direction. With a little manipulation, a touch of propaganda, and perhaps a scandal or two, the government could be made to fall and a more Communist party could be swept into power.
loc.support_fascism_desc: The current political leadership has taken the wrong direction. With a little manipulation, a touch of propaganda, and perhaps a scandal or two, the government could be made to fall and a more Fascist party could be swept into power.
loc.take_claim_goal_desc: Take back what is ours from $TARGET|Y$
loc.take_core_goal_desc: Take back what is ours from $TARGET|Y$
loc.victory_or_death_desc: This war must take the highest priority of our nation, all our resources must be turned against them.
loc.support_republican_spain_desc: The Spanish Civil War is viewed by many as a domestic version of the global ideological conflicts that define our times. Sending equipment to the Republican side, we can take a stand against the fascist thugs who seek to oppress the Spanish population.
loc.support_republican_spain_short_desc: Send equipment to support Republican Spain in the Civil War
loc.support_nationalist_spain_desc: The Spanish Civil War is viewed by many as a domestic version of the global ideological conflicts that define our times. Sending equipment to the Nationalist side, we can take a stand against the anarchists and Reds who would destroy the Spanish nation.
loc.support_nationalist_spain_short_desc: Send equipment to support Nationalist Spain in the Civil War
loc.may_provoke_hostility: §R[This.GetName] and other nations may respond with hostility to this course of action.§!
loc.AFG_sheikh_omar_mojadidi: Nurul Mashaw'ikh Shaikh Fazl Omar Mojadidi
loc.IRQ_ghazi_i_desc: Ascending to the throne in 1933, following the death of Faisal I, King Ghazi has made a name for himself as an opponent to British influence in Iraq despite the decades long connections between the Hashemite dynasty and the United Kingdom. Suspicions swirl that the young King is awaiting an opportunity to oust the British by force and for his military to sweep into neighboring strategic areas.
loc.AFG_propose_oil_concession_deal: Propose an Oil Concession Agreement to §Y[FROM.GetName]§!
loc.AFG_radical_students_countdown: Graduates becoming radicalized due to unemployment
loc.AFG_placate_the_graduates: Offer graduates jobs in civil service
loc.AFG_purchase_capital_ships_tt: Unlock decisions to §YPurchase Dreadnoughts§! and other §YOld Capital Ships§! from the great powers.
loc.AFG_promoted_resistance_here: Afghanistan has promoted anti-government resistance here.
loc.AFG_expand_quami_tt: Have increased irregular cap to less than 24 divisions
loc.AFG_expand_quami_tt_2: Increase the recruitment cap for Irregulars by 1
loc.AFG_raise_quami_tt: Deploy all irregular divisions up to our current cap.
loc.AFG_relieve_quami_tt: Disband all irregulars for the time being. They can be raised again in future.
loc.AFG_foreign_intervention_category_desc: Afghanistan sits at a crossroad between various great powers. Historically, the British and Russians squabbled over the status of the beleaguered nation throughout the 19th century. Now, new nations taking an interest in Afghanistan have destabilized the delicate balance in the region and intervention to secure it may be inevitable.
loc.AFG_demand_end_to_communist_influence: Demand an end to communist influence in Afghanistan
loc.AFG_demand_end_to_fascist_influence: Demand an end to fascist influence in Afghanistan
loc.AFG_demand_end_to_democratic_influence: Demand an end to democratic influence in Afghanistan
loc.AFG_invite_to_faction_in_progress: In the process of inviting to faction
loc.AFG_supporting_resistance_in_state_in_pr: Establishing a resistance cell in progress
loc.AFG_disgruntled_minority_desc: The Pashtuns may dominate Afghanistan by virtue of numbers, but they are not the only group in the nation with a rich history, culture and distinct identity. The Tajiks, Uzbeks and many others of northern Afghanistan must not be forgotten about, or they may rally and overthrow the reigning regime as they have done in decades past.
loc.AFG_arranged_expansion_modifier_tt: Bid cost multiplied by §G0.55§! for Afghanistan in peace conference.
loc.AFG_recruited_turkestan_legion_here: Have already recruited Turkestan Legion here.
loc.AFG_a_royal_successor_decision_desc: If we want to properly secure our rule over this land, we must decide on who to take over the role of Prime Minister, now that $AFG_mohammad_hashim_khan$'s ability to lead is coming under question both internationally and internally.
loc.RAJ_stir_unrest_in_the_north_tt: We will retain control of this state when we break away from the British Raj when we complete §Y$RAJ_the_mughal_uprising$§!
loc.RAJ_GOE_famine_trigger: More than 4 shocks has occurred to the food system
loc.RAJ_GOE_famine_shocks: Current shocks to the food system: §R[?RAJ_food_shocks]§!
loc.RAJ_has_crushed_black_market: Has Shut Down Black Markets in [THIS.GetName]
loc.RAJ_black_markets_tt: Every state with §YFamine§! has a §YBlack Market§!, further destabilizing the state.\nShutting down §YBlack Markets§! reduces the risk of §YFamine§! spreading, up to a max of §Y20%§!, scaled to how many §YBlack Markets§! currently exists.
loc.RAJ_reveal_famine_timeframe_tt: Reveals how many months left the famine will last
loc.RAJ_GOE_raise_war_taxes_condition_tt: Current Enemies (§Y[?var:enemies^num]§!) is less than the amount of times raised war taxes (§Y[?var:amount_of_times_raised_taxes]§!)
loc.RAJ_GOE_reduce_war_taxes_condition_tt: Amount of times raised war taxes (§Y[?var:amount_of_times_raised_taxes]§!) is more than 0
loc.RAJ_GOE_foment_independence_tension_tt: Cores will be regained upon completing §Y$RAJ_give_me_blood_and_i_will_grant_you_freedom$§!
loc.RAJ_GOE_try_to_arrest_bose: British Authorities are trying to arrest Subhas Chandra Bose
loc.RAJ_british_authorities_looking_to_arres: British Authorities are trying to arrest Subhas Chandra Bose
loc.RAJ_GOE_try_to_arrest_bose_tt:
The [ENG.GetAdjective] will try and arrest §YSubhas Chandra Bose§!. He can escape captivity by completing §Y$RAJ_go_into_hiding$§!.
Should he be arrested he will start imprisoned when we launch the war for independence and can be rescued by capturing the opposing sides capital.
loc.RAJ_establish_local_recruitment_offices_:
Projected months until recruitment offices reduces the negative effect from §Y$idea_RAJ_agrarian_society$§!: [?var:RAJ_projected_time_left]. Further expanding recruitment offices will speed up this process.

$experience_gain_army_tt$ §R[?RAJ_agrarian_society_experience_gain_army_factor_offices]%§!
$mobilization_speed_tt$ §G[?RAJ_agrarian_society_mobilization_speed_offices]%§!

 $mobilization_laws_cost_factor$: §G[?RAJ_agrarian_society_mobilization_laws_cost_factor_offices]%§!

Up to a max cap of :
