Adds §Y1§! Pressure to [THIS.GetName], pressuring them to join us. Reduces our available capability to pressure states by §Y1§! (Currently [?ROOT.pressure_left]/[?ROOT.default_pressure]) 

§YCurrent Pressure towards state:§![GetPressureTextRAJ]
loc.RAJ_GOE_princely_state_timeout_tt:
By pressuring them we can diplomatically annex their territory. Should we have a clear pressure advantage [FROM.GetName] will surely join us.

At the end of the mission each state will decide of who to join. If a country has more than 25% pressure than any other country in a state that state will join [ROOT.GetName] willingly.
loc.pressure_left_tt: Pressure left to play against Princely States is more than §Y0§!\nCurrently: §Y[?pressure_left]§!
loc.RAJ_akhand_bharat_availability_tt: All previously claimed territories that is core of Akhand Bharat of is under our control
loc.RAJ_akhand_bharat_annex_subject: If [THIS.GetName] is our puppet when taking this decision they will transfer all states that is now our core after taking this decision
loc.defaulted_on_debt_effect_tt: \n§YWe will not need to pay any taxes to [ENG.GetNameDef] this year as assets are sold to wipe out any external debt.§!
loc.RAJ_GOE_eic_the_taxman_defaulted_tt: §YWe defaulted. We will not pay any taxes this year§!
loc.RAJ_GOE_eic_the_taxman_taxes_tt: With our current economy we are expected to pay §Y[?var:taxes_display_tt]%§! of our economy as §Y$MODIFIER_CONSUMER_GOODS_FACTOR$§! based on our controlled civilian factories. (excluding puppets factories and trade).
loc.RAJ_GOE_pay_out_dividends_small: Pay out a §Ysmall§! amount of dividends to investors
loc.RAJ_GOE_pay_out_dividends_normal: Pay out a §Ynormal§! amount of dividends to investors
loc.RAJ_GOE_pay_out_dividends_high: Pay out a §Yhigh§! amount of dividends to investors
loc.RAJ_GOE_pay_out_dividends_small_tt: At the end of the §Yfiscal year§! we will pay out $eic_low_investments_cost_tt$, permanently removing it from a random state. In return we will gain a small amount of additional investment from private investors for the entire duration of the next fiscal year.\n\n
loc.RAJ_GOE_pay_out_dividends_normal_tt: At the end of the §Yfiscal year§! we will pay out $eic_normal_investments_cost_tt$, permanently removing it from a random state. In return we will gain an average amount of additional investment from private investors for the entire duration of the next fiscal year.\n\n
loc.RAJ_GOE_pay_out_dividends_high_tt: At the end of the §Yfiscal year§! we will pay out $eic_high_investments_cost_tt$, permanently removing it from a random state. In return we will gain a large amount of additional investment from private investors for the entire duration of the next fiscal year.\n\n
loc.RAJ_GOE_modify_dividends_2: for the duration of the next §Yfiscal year§!
loc.RAJ_GOE_eic_no_more_taxman: Put an end to the taxes for good
loc.taxes_desc:
We pay tax as a percentage of our income in layers called tax brackets. As our income goes up, the tax rate on the next layer of income is higher.

At the end of every fiscal year we need to pay taxes to the [ENG.GetAdjective] government, depending on how big our industry is. This is determined by our amount of §YCivilian Factories§!.

The amount is paid in §Y$MODIFIER_CONSUMER_GOODS_FACTOR$§!
How much is to be paid is determined by different tax brackets as follows:
loc.eic_industry_tt_on_hover: Currently we own §Y[?var:actually_controlled_civs]§! Civilian Factories factories, and as such we expect to get a [?var:taxes_display_tt] §YConsumer Goods Factories factor§! penalty. To lower the tax bracket we are in we can funnel civilian factories to subjects by completing the §YInstitutional Money Laundering§! focus\n
loc.tier_1_taxes_tt: Being in this tax bracket requires us to have between 0-[?var:tier_two_taxes_threshold] §YCivilian Factories§!, and being inside this bracket will apply a §Y[?tier_one_taxes_tax_tt]%§! Consumer Goods Factories factor penalty.
loc.tier_2_taxes_tt: Being in this tax bracket requires us to have between [?var:tier_two_taxes_threshold_plus_1]-[?var:tier_three_taxes_threshold] §YCivilian Factories§!, and being inside this bracket will apply a §Y[?tier_two_taxes_tax_tt]%§! Consumer Goods Factories factor penalty.
loc.tier_3_taxes_tt: Being in this tax bracket requires us to have between [?var:tier_three_taxes_threshold_plus_1]-[?var:tier_four_taxes_threshold] §YCivilian Factories§!, and being inside this bracket will apply a §Y[?tier_three_taxes_tax_tt]%§! Consumer Goods Factories factor penalty.
loc.tier_4_taxes_tt: Being in this tax bracket requires us to more than [?var:tier_three_taxes_threshold_plus_1] §YCivilian Factories§!, and being inside this bracket will apply a §Y[?tier_four_taxes_tax_tt] %§! §YConsumer Goods Factories factor§! penalty.
loc.tier_taxes_header_1_tt: At the end of the §Yfiscal Year§! we are expected to pay a portion of our income to the English government in §YConsumer Goods Factories factor§!. The more civilian factories we control, excluding trade and factories owned by puppets, the more we will have to pay. The amount of civilian factories needed to stay inside a specific tax bracket are shown in the §YTaxable Income Bracket§! cells, and the rate of taxation is shown in its corresponding cell.
loc.eic_arrow_tt: This is the current tax bracket that we are in.
loc.RAJ_dividend_status_small: We have paid a §Ysmall amount§! of dividends to investors, yielding a small bonus for the next §Yfiscal year§!.
loc.RAJ_dividend_status_normal: We have paid a §Ynormal amount§! of dividends to investors, yielding a moderate bonus for the next §Yfiscal year§!.
loc.RAJ_dividend_status_high: We have paid a §Yhigh amount§! of dividends to investors, yielding a large bonus for the next fiscal year.
loc.RAJ_dividend_status_none: We have paid §Yno dividends§! to investors, yielding no bonus for he next §Yfiscal year§!

loc.eic_normal_investments_cost: When §YEnd of the Fiscal Year§! times out:\nRemove $eic_normal_investments_cost_tt$ permanently

loc.RAJ_propaganda_in_target_desc: Our target has been selected, all we need do now is supply our socialist allies with effective propaganda and soon enough we will have sewn the seeds of rebellion necessary to overthrow the old order, and secure Asia as a red stronghold.
loc.RAJ_communist_coup_target_tt: Has Not Picked a Coup Target
loc.RAJ_red_punjab_operation_decision_desc: Our capital being so close to [PAK.GetAdjective] borders is a vulnerability. We need to ensure control over nearby regions to uphold the security of [RAJ.GetName].
loc.RAJ_secure_west_bengal_decision_desc: Calcutta is isolated, and it is unstable. We need to assert control over the region before they have time to gain a proper foothold.
loc.RAJ_secure_rajahsthan_decision_desc: Rajahsthan is slowly becoming the base for a counter-revolution. We must bring the state into our fold and reassert dominance before this becomes a real threat.
loc.RAJ_red_punjab_operation_decision_tt: If we win we will gain control of the state and remove the Truce with §Y[PAK.GetName]§!
loc.RAJ_uprising_strength_tt: [RAJ_communist_coup_target.GetName] will either become our subject or start a civil war. The strength of the civil war is based on the size of the communist support. The communist side will become out subject.
loc.RAJ_abandon_communist_effort_tt: We will be able to pick another target
loc.RAJ_instigate_generic_desc: as our current priority for instigating a communist revolution over Asia. We will begin operations to slowly but surely destabilize the region. Once the time is right, we can pull the trigger and enable a communist revolution in the region.
loc.RAJ_return_churchill_desc: $ENG_winston_churchill$ has fulfilled his purpose here and it is time for him to go home.
loc.RAJ_investments_from_local_leaders_tt: Select one of the possible Investments from the list above and builds the appropriate buildings in one of our owned states. \n\nAdds buildings in one of our owned states based on the randomly selected Investment Category.
loc.RAJ_local_leaders_investments_infra_tt: Development of local Infrastructure: \nBuild up to §G1§! §YInfrastructure§! and §Y1§! Building Slot in a state.
loc.RAJ_local_leaders_investments_civs_tt: Development of Civilian Industry: \nBuild up to §G1§! §YCivilian Factory§!, §G1§! §YInfrastructure§! and §Y2§! Building Slots in a state.
loc.RAJ_local_leaders_investments_mils_tt: Development of Military Industry: \nBuild up to §G1§! §YMilitary Factory§!, §G1§! §YInfrastructure§! and §Y2§! Building Slots in a state.
loc.RAJ_local_leaders_investments_defenses_t: Development of Territorial Defenses: \nBuild up to §G2§! §YAir Bases§!, §G1§! §YAnti-Air§! and §Y1§! §YRadar Station§! in a state.
loc.RAJ_local_leaders_investments_chance_tt: Chance for each investment to be selected when the mission times out.

Decision cost for the Campaign decisions has reached its maximum value (§R200§! £pol_power).
loc.RAJ_congress_demands_decrease_decision_c: Decreases decision cost for the Campaign decisions by §Y-[?RAJ_congress_decision_cost_increment]§! £pol_power.
Decision cost for the Campaign decisions has reached its minimum value (§R20§! £pol_power).
loc.RAJ_congress_pass_working_conditions_leg: To fulfill the demands of the Congress, we will pass new legislation improving the working conditions for construction workers.
loc.tier_threshold_increase_0: Raises the civilian requirement for staying inside a tax bracket.\n§Y1st§! Bracket:   From §Y[?var:tier_two_taxes_threshold]§! to §G[?var:tier_two_taxes_threshold_plus_4]§! §YCivilian Factories§!
loc.tier_threshold_increase_not_setup: Raises the civilian factories requirement for staying inside a tax bracket by §G4§!
loc.tier_two_threshold_tt: Raises the threshold for remaining in the §Y$tier_one_threshold$§! by: §Y$RIGHT|+=.0$§! §YCivilian Factories§!
loc.tier_three_threshold_tt: Raises the threshold for remaining in the §Y$tier_two_threshold$§! by: §Y$RIGHT|+=.0$§! §YCivilian Factories§!
loc.tier_four_threshold_tt: Raises the threshold for remaining in the §Y$tier_three_threshold$§! by: §Y$RIGHT|+=.0$§! §YCivilian Factories§!
loc.is_trying_to_buy_land: Is already trying to buy land
loc.RAJ_GOE_contact_dissenting_officers_desc: Reaching out to disillusioned elements within the officer corps may open the door to future cooperation, or at least sow uncertainty among the ranks.
loc.RAJ_communist_unions_promised_worker_saf: Promised Unions Increased Worker Safety for Support
loc.RAJ_communist_unions_promised_minimum_wa: Promised Unions Minimum Wage for Support
loc.RAJ_GOE_seek_support_from_the_unions_tt: We will be able to seek support from the Unions. They will support us if we give them a form of concession, reducing the required communist popularity threshold required to complete §Y$RAJ_royal_indian_navy_mutiny$§! by §G-10%§!
loc.RAJ_GOE_accept_russian_muhajir_money_des: Discreet financial support from abroad can accelerate our organizational efforts and reduce our reliance on local funding sources.
loc.RAJ_GOE_meet_with_the_kremlin_desc_NO_US: Seeking to gain support from foreign Communist Aligned groups may yield material assistance and strategic guidance, strengthening our position at home
loc.RAJ_GOE_meet_with_the_kremlin_desc_USSR: Securing a formal dialogue with the Soviet leadership may yield material assistance and strategic guidance, strengthening our position at home
loc.RAJ_GOE_spread_dissent_in_the_army: Use Radical Officers to Spread Dissent in the Army
loc.RAJ_GOE_spread_dissent_in_the_army_desc: Our network of sympathetic officers can be leveraged to question the loyalty of the military to its current leadership and undermine confidence in the existing order
loc.RAJ_GOE_orchestrate_train_robberies_desc: Disrupting rail shipments weakens colonial logistics while providing us with supplies and resources to fund further operations.
loc.RAJ_royal_indian_navy_mutiny_threshold_t: Reduces the required §Ycommunist support§! threshold for completing §Y$RAJ_royal_indian_navy_mutiny$§! by: §Y$RIGHT|G=%$§!\n
loc.RAJ_GOE_infiltrate_the_national_congress: By embedding our sympathizers within the Indian National Congress we can influence its direction from within, amplifying class tensions, undermining moderate leadership and preparing the ground for a more radical shift.
loc.RAJ_GOE_undermine_gandhis_movement_desc: Though Gandhi’s message remains popular, his movement is vulnerable to internal contradictions and class compromise. Through targeted infiltration and subtle agitation, we can expose these weaknesses and steer support toward a more revolutionary alternative.
loc.RAJ_GOE_communism_sway_bose_desc: Subhas Chandra Bose commands significant influence among nationalist circles. Aligning his ambitions with our movement could provide both legitimacy and access to broader support networks.
loc.RAJ_has_met_with_kremlin_flag_NO_USSR: Has Met with Foreign Communist Groups
loc.GOE_form_hindustan_category_desc: With the conquest of all Indian lands on the way, it is high time that [ROOT.GetLeader] declares the unification of Hindustan, to gather both support and attention towards our great nation.
loc.PER_profit_from_war_category_desc: As war rages across the world, we are given a unique opportunity to sell our vast stocks of oil in order to improve our own economy and potentially protect us from external threats. This initiative will make the most of our vast natural resources.
loc.PER_integrate_anatolia_decisions_categor: Anatolia has been a part of our empire's de jure land for hundreds of years, and it is finally time to bring it back under our control. Integrate these territories, and help continue the expansion of [PER.GetNameDef].
loc.PER_absorb_byzantines_category_desc: [BYZ.GetNameDefCap] has finally fallen to our superior empire. We have been able to end a grudge against Greece that stems from our ancient days, and we can finally work to bring these lands under our sovereign rule.
loc.PER_memphis_initiative_category_desc: At long last we have conquered the former territory that was coveted by Cambyses II, bringing Egypt into our fold. In order to safeguard the future of our empire, we must begin to integrate the Egyptian lands under our sovereign rule.
loc.PER_civil_unrest_category_desc: As we have consolidated more power to the Shah, many parties within our government have shown distaste and distrust in our government. As each of them scheme to overthrow us, we must find a way to clamp down on this dissidence before it becomes a real problem for us.\n\n§RWe must take the 'Assessing the Opposition' national focus before we can stop this insurgence.§!
loc.PER_end_civil_war_tt: Completing all three decisions will end the civil war threat.
loc.PER_gulf_decisions_cat_desc: The great powers will never tolerate our direct involvement in the affairs of their Gulf puppets. Therefore, we must use alternative means to undermine their influence in the region and gradually project our influence across it.
loc.PER_anti_gulf_decisions_cat_des: [PER.GetNameDef] is attempting to undermine the interests of anyone who would oppose them in the Gulf region. We must act decisively before their underhanded tactics tip the delicate balance of power too far in their favor.
loc.PER_kur_indy_war_tt: §RAll Kurdish core states we own will rise up and declare an independence war against us!§!
loc.PER_azr_indy_war_tt: §RAll Azerbaijani core states we own will rise up and declare an independence war against us!§!
loc.PER_opposition_cell_tt: §YThis state will side with the opposition should a civil war erupt!§!
loc.PER_establish_cells_tt: §RThe political power cost of taking states after this will increase by [?ROOT.PER_opposition_increment_cost].§!
loc.PER_establish_opposition_hq_tt: §YThis state will be our base of operations and therefore become our capital should a civil war break out against the Shah.§!
loc.PER_opposition_hq_established: Has established opposition base of operations.
loc.PER_opposition_has_already_selected_a_hq: Has already selected a location for a base of operations.
loc.PER_plant_resistance_cat_desc: If we are to increase our chances of succeeding in a pre-emptive strike against our enemies, then we must work to ensure the states that border us have their own problems to deal with in the form of pro-[PER.GetAdjective] resistance groups and cells.
loc.neo_assyrian_empire_category_desc: At its maximum extent, the Neo-Assyrian Empire dominated most of the Middle-East. We should endeavor to restore our state to its ancient glory, and reconquer our empire of old.
loc.neo_mesopotamia_category_desc: The Fertile Crescent is the cradle of civilization and the home of many great states. With territorial integrity now restored, we can finally proclaim the creation of a unified Mesopotamian state.
loc.IRQ_recruiting_arab_legion: Currently recruiting Arab Free Legion here.
loc.IRQ_recruited_arab_legion_here: Have already recruited Arab Free Legion here.
loc.IRQ_coring_state_in_progress: Integration of a state is in progress.
loc.IRQ_inviting_to_federation_in_progress: Currently inviting other nations to the Federation.
loc.is_the_current_invitation_target_of_IRQ_: Is currently being inviting to the Federation
loc.IRQ_flood_the_plains_desc: The Euphrates and Tigris have long been the lifeline for our economy and sustenance. Extensive irrigation works carried out over the last decades however, give us the opportunity to control the flow of their tributaries. A coordinated flood could turn low-lying lands into a defensible marsh for a limited time.
loc.can_flood_plains_tt: Unlock a decision to §Y$IRQ_flood_the_plains$§! in the event of an invasion.
loc.maghreb_formable_category_desc: With the conquest of the western Arab world, we have secured our position on the world stage. It is now time to declare the Maghreb unified, and stand ready to take on any who would challenge our position!
loc.AFG_industrial_events.10.desc: The government of [FROM.GetNameDef] has suggested a joint venture whereby we would aid them in the development of recently found oil fields in exchange for long-term concessions to any produced oil. While the proposal appears genuine, we can not guarantee that we will maintain access to the oil should the whims of the [FROM.GetAdjective] government change.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.10.a: This is in our strategic interest.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.10.b: We have no need to be embroiled in [FROM.GetAdjective] internal affairs.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.11.desc: The [FROM.GetAdjective] government has agreed to invest in the development of our oil resources in exchange for a long-term share of it once production begins.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.11.a: This shall be a great step towards industrialization.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.12.desc: The narrow minded [FROM.GetAdjective] government has rejected our proposal for joint development of our oil resources.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.12.a: We shall find another partner for the project.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.13.desc: The [FROM.GetAdjective] government has nationalized their oil industry despite our heavy investment into it. The nationalization has led to an immediate halt to the long-term oil concession we agreed to. The region now holds its breath awaiting our response.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.13.a: We took a gamble and lost.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.13.b: Those resources will be taken back by force.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.14.desc: The arrogant [FROM.GetAdjective] regime has declared their intention to topple our righteous government for the crime of utilizing our natural resources for the benefit of our own people. It is not yet clear how they intend to carry out their threats, but we should begin preparations for a military incursion into our territory.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.14.a: We cannot be bullied into submission.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.15.desc: [FROM.GetNameDef] government has uttered harsh rhetoric regarding our nationalization of the oil industry. However, there is no sign that they intend to take the matter further.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.16.desc: Due to the recent hostilities between our nations, the government of [FROM.GetNameDef] has suspended our oil concessions in the country. Even if hostilities end, they will likely want to maintain control of their own resources.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.20.desc: The [FROM.GetAdjective] government is pursuing a policy to increase foreign investment in the country and has reached out regarding our own interest. While there is not a huge amount we can gain economically from this agreement, it would be an excellent opportunity to influence the [FROM.GetAdjective] government to our way of thinking.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.20.a: Strengthening our influence in the region is important.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.20.b: [FROM.GetNonIdeologyName] does not factor into our long-term plans
loc.AFG_industrial_events.21.desc: Our friends in [FROM.GetNameDef] have announced their intention to invest significant sums of money into the industrialization of our country. While this is of great benefit to us economically, we must stay vigilant that the [FROM.GetAdjective]’s don’t use this to influence our politics too drastically.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.30.desc: In recent years, the [FROM.GetAdjective] government has orchestrated a number of dam and irrigation projects along its rivers. This has culminated in a number of alterations to the Helmand river, which flows into our Eastern provinces. Water levels flowing across the border are noticeably reducing year on year and our people are becoming concerned that they will no longer be able to utilize the river anymore should this continue. We need to decide whether to simply deal with this internally, or take the matter up with the [FROM.GetAdjective]s.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.30.a: We shall demand negotiations with [AFG.GetNonIdeologyName] over development of the river.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.30.b: We cannot risk a diplomatic crisis right now.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.31.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] government has requested negotiations regarding our recent alterations to the Helmand river. They claim that our dams and irrigation systems are reducing the flow of the river across the border to dangerous levels. Some in our cabinet have suggested establishing a treaty to regulate the flow of water across the border. This would likely mean reducing the benefits of our current alterations along the river, but would also lessen the impact they are having on the [FROM.GetAdjective] people across the border.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.31.a: Perhaps we can establish a water treaty?
loc.AFG_industrial_events.31.b: The water is ours and we may do as we please with it.
loc.AFG_industrial_events_31_tt: §RThis course of action may lead to war with [FROM.GetNameDefCap]!§!
loc.AFG_industrial_events.32.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] government has proposed the establishment of a water treaty between our nations to regulate the amount of water they can use for irrigation projects while guaranteeing a minimum flow of water across the border to us. While the proposals seem reasonable, it is likely this would require us to accept some loss of flow compared with what we have enjoyed historically.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.32.b: Only complete reversal of alterations will satisfy us.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.33.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] government has refused any further negotiations regarding developments along the Helmand river, citing that any water that passes through their territory is theirs to do with as they please. Caving into them at this point may ultimately embolden them to completely cut the flow of water in future. However, any further escalation at this point would require us resorting to armed conflict.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.33.a: We do not have the resources to mount a military escalation.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.33.b: Then we shall rectify the situation by force.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.34.desc: The [FROM.GetAdjective] government has agreed to a water treaty between our nations on the condition that it guarantees an acceptable minimum flow of water across the border to them. While this will force us to not fully utilize our dams as we have done so far, it will at least avoid any chance of conflict over the Helmand river in the near future.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.35.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has refused to accept any treaty and instead is demanding the complete reversal of any projects along the Helmand river that are reducing its flow to them. It seems they are willing to enforce their will by force should we refuse.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.35.a: We cannot allow this to escalate any further.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.35.b: If they cannot be reasonable, there is no point in continuing negotiations.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.36.desc: The [FROM.GetAdjective] government has agreed to reverse many of the alterations they have made to the Helmand river. While this has undoubtedly caused great resentment towards us, we have managed to avoid an armed confrontation for the time being.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.37.desc: [FROM.GetAdjective] armed forces along our border are reportedly mobilizing for an invasion of the Helmand River Valley following the breakdown of negotiations between our governments. It seems we have no choice but to mobilize our own forces in kind.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.38.t: [FROM.GetAdjective] Government Goes Silent on Helmand Alterations
loc.AFG_industrial_events.38.desc: Despite weeks of heated negotiations between our respective governments, it seems the [FROM.GetAdjective]s have given up on disrupting our dam and irrigation projects for the time being. Only time will tell whether they raise the issue again in future.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.38.a: Seems the alterations are safe, for now.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.40.desc: Our efforts to expand higher education have led to a backlash by new graduates who find themselves unable to gain employment that makes use of their skills. This has led to disillusionment among graduates who are now turning to radical politics to vent their frustrations.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.50.desc: Utilizing the cross-border connections of our Pashtun population, we have successfully managed to stir their kin across the border into anti-government protests and demands for unification under our rule.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.51.desc: Rabble rousers from [FROM.GetNonIdeologyName] appear to be crossing the border to stir unrest among the Pashtun population. There are talks of unifying the Pashtuns under [FROM.GetAdjective] rule instead of our own.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.52.desc: Due to the ongoing tensions along some of our predominantly Pashtun territories, the [FROM.GetAdjective] government has had the audacity to approach us with an offer to take control of the unruly regions. Suspicions are rampant that they were behind the recent unrest all along.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.52.a: The territory is more of an issue than it is worth.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.52.b: This is our sovereign territory, regardless of their claims.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.53.desc: Distracted with more pressing concerns elsewhere, the government of [FROM.GetNameDef] has agreed to transfer some of their territory where Pashtun unrest has spiraled out of control. However, we may have irreparably damaged relations with our [FROM.GetAdjective] neighbors over our interference in their internal affairs.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.54.desc: Despite our careful manipulation of the situation along the border with [FROM.GetNameDef], their government has refused to hand over control of any Pashtun territory to us. It seems our only route to taking the territory is to escalate the situation with the threat of military intervention.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.54.a: We have no interest in escalating this situation.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.54.b: We are not afraid to liberate the territory by force.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.55.desc: The [FROM.GetAdjective] government has issued a statement condemning our occupation of supposedly Pashtun lands and has indicated that they are ready to liberate the territory by force if necessary. They may be bluffing of course, but we have no way of knowing their true intentions at this time.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.55.a: We have few options but to placate them.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.55.b: We are prepared to defend our territory at all costs.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.56.desc: Unsurprisingly, the stubborn fools in [FROM.Capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName] have refused to hand us our rightful territory along the border. As such, we must either carry out our threat of military incursion or risk losing face on the international stage.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.56.a: It is time we carried out or threats.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.57.desc: The [FROM.GetAdjective] government has finally seen reason and decided to de-escalate the situation along the border and they have revoked claims to the troubled border territory where tensions have escalated recently.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.57.a: A victory for international law and order.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.58.desc: [FROM.GetAdjective] diplomats have approached us with a peace offer on condition we acknowledge their control of the disputed Pashtun territory along the border. As they currently occupy the territory, we have no guarantee of being able to oust them anytime soon. However, this would set a precedent that [FROM.GetNameDef] can chip away at our borders piece by piece.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.58.b: We will oust them from our land.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.59.desc: The government of [FROM.GetNameDef] has rejected our recent peace offering. They clearly believe they still have the capacity to oust us from our rightful territory.
loc.AFG_industrial_events.59.a: Then we continue to defend our territory.
loc.AFG_political_events.01.desc: Representatives of [FROM.GetNameDef] have approached us with a bold proposal for the reorganization of Central Asia. Their proposal requires us handing over control of a number of states along the [FROM.GetAdjective] border to them and the creation of a new socialist federation under the administration of [FROM.Capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName]. This could allow us to aid in the construction of a powerful buffer state in the region that can take over some of our defense burdens in the region, freeing our military for deployment elsewhere.
loc.AFG_political_events.01.b: We have alternative plans for the region.
loc.AFG_political_events.02.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has accepted our proposal for unifying central Asia as a single political entity under our control. It seems a new era is upon our people after decades of instability.
loc.AFG_political_events.03.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has rejected our proposal for unifying Central Asia into a single political entity under our control. Although it is a massive setback, the dream is not yet dead. We just need to bide our time and wait for the right opportunity to show itself.
loc.AFG_political_events.03.a: They cannot stand in our way forever.
loc.AFG_political_events.10.desc: The government of [FROM.GetNonIdeologyName] has offered an intriguing proposal to strengthen our two nations by forming a confederation with one another. This would see us open our borders to one another in a single economic market and create a joint foreign policy on the world stage. However, this would ultimately limit our own freedom of action.
loc.AFG_political_events.10.b: We have already shrugged off one overlord and have no need for another.
loc.AFG_political_events.11.desc: The [FROM.GetAdjective] government has agreed to our confederation proposal. We can now begin the process of integrating our two political and economic systems into one. This should hopefully act as a deterrent for any of our regional adversaries in the near future.
loc.AFG_political_events.12.desc: The [FROM.GetAdjective] government has rejected our proposal to form a confederation from our two nations. This is a massive foreign policy setback for us and has raised alarm over what our long term relationship with [FROM.GetNameDef] will look like now.
loc.AFG_political_events.20.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap]’s diplomats have approached us with an economic proposal to invest in their economy. They argue that if we were to develop industries there for them, we would stand to gain from any future exports. Furthermore, they made clear that this would undoubtedly upset the [SOU.GetAdjective]s and [ENG.GetAdjective] who have historically been the key players in [FROM.GetNonIdeologyName].
loc.AFG_political_events.20.a: Undermining enemy influence in the nation will benefit us.
loc.AFG_political_events.21.t: [FROM.GetName] Agrees to Invest in our Economy
loc.AFG_political_events.21.desc: [FROM.GetAdjective] diplomats have announced that their government supports our proposal to invest in [ROOT.GetNonIdeologyName]. Engineers and entrepreneurs are already enroute to establish new industries across the country.
loc.AFG_political_events.22.t: [FROM.GetName] Refuses to Invest in our Economy
loc.AFG_political_events.22.desc: [FROM.GetAdjective] diplomats have announced that their government refuses to invest in [ROOT.GetNonIdeologyName]. They argue that our long-term motivations are yet unclear and that they do not want to offer economic aid to a nation that may ultimately fall into their enemies sphere of influence.
loc.AFG_political_events.30.desc: After years of political reforms and compromises between the various factions across our nation, we now have an opportunity to shrug off the shackles of monarchism once and for all. However, we must redefine who we are as a nation.
loc.AFG_political_events.30.a: This is a fresh start and We shall be the [ROOT.GetAdjective] Republic
loc.AFG_political_events.30.b: We are the nation of the Pashtuns above all else
loc.AFG_political_events.30.c: The fusion of democracy and Islam are the way forward
loc.AFG_political_events.40.desc: The representatives from the [FROM.GetAdjective] embassy have issued an ultimatum to our government. They demand that we curtail foreign influence in our nation that could put [FROM.GetAdjective] interests at risk, or face a possible military intervention to replace our government.
loc.AFG_political_events.40.a: We are in no position to argue.
loc.AFG_political_events.40.b: This is bluster and we won't be intimidated by it.
loc.AFG_political_events.41.desc: The [FROM.GetAdjective] government has acquiesced to our demands for an end to foreign interference in their country which could undermine our interests in the region. While they are certainly unhappy with our intervention, it seems they have little stomach for a fight in the near future.
loc.AFG_political_events.41.a: We shall continue to observe them carefully.
loc.AFG_political_events.42.desc: The [FROM.GetAdjective] government has rejected our demands for an end to foreign interference in their country. They argue we have no right to interfere with their internal affairs and the arrangements they have negotiated with other nations.
loc.AFG_political_events.42.a: We will have to use alternative means to align them.
loc.AFG_political_events.42.b: They leave us with no choice.
loc.AFG_political_events.43.desc: Our ambassador to [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has informed us that an agreement of some sort was recently signed with representatives of another country in [FROM.Capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName]. While the details of the agreement are unclear, there can be little doubt that the [FROM.GetAdjective] government is being influenced by nations who may be looking to undermine our interests in the region.
loc.AFG_political_events.43.a: We shall keep an eye on the situation.
loc.AFG_political_events.51.desc: In a discreet message, $AFG_amunullah_khan$, the former ruler of [FROM.GetNonIdeologyName], has reached out to the our government seeking support for his restoration to the throne. He promises that, with German backing, he will establish a strong, modernized nation aligned with our interests.
loc.AFG_political_events.51.a: We could use more allies in the region.
loc.AFG_political_events.51.b: Why interfere in such far off lands?
loc.AFG_political_events.52.desc: The [FROM.GetAdjective] government has responded to our request and regretfully declines to provide support for the restoration of $AFG_amunullah_khan$ to the throne. Citing concerns over potential entanglements and the current geopolitical climate, [FROM.GetAdjective] has decided to focus on other strategic priorities.
loc.AFG_political_events.53.desc: In response to our request, the [FROM.GetName]’s government has agreed to support the restoration of $AFG_amunullah_khan$ to the throne of [ROOT.GetNonIdeologyName]. This backing will include military support and equipment to ensure the success of our endeavor.
loc.AFG_political_events.53.a: The future of [AFG.GetNonIdeologyName] belongs to us!
loc.AFG_political_events.54.desc: As previously agreed, [FROM.GetAdjective] equipment has been made available to us since the outbreak of the civil war. Their operatives in [ROOT.Capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName] have also assured us that covert [FROM.GetAdjective] troops will soon reach the country to aid us in the struggle.
loc.AFG_political_events.60.desc: The government of [FROM.GetNameDef] is forging a new political entity they are calling the Turko-Persian union. It appears to be a weaponization of their Turkish and Persian heritage to unify all our peoples together under one government. The first step of which is the establishment of a military alliance between us. If we accept, it is doubtless that they will push for greater integration under their leadership in time.
loc.AFG_political_events.60.a: We shall embrace our shared destiny!
loc.AFG_political_events.60.b: Who are they to speak on behalf of the [ROOT.GetAdjective] people?
loc.AFG_political_events.61.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has agreed to join our Turko-Persian Union. Together, our militaries will be able to better deter aggression from our common adversaries. But more importantly, we have a foothold to chip away at their independence over time.
loc.AFG_political_events.62.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has rejected membership of the Turko-Persian Union. They are furious at our supposed arrogance in attempting to speak for all [TUR.GetAdjective] and [PER.GetAdjective] peoples.
loc.AFG_political_events.62.a: They will see the error of their ways in time.
loc.AFG_political_events.62.b: If they are not with us, they are our enemy!
loc.AFG_political_influence_major_warning_tt: If [FROM.GetNameDefCap] acquires over §R40%§! support for an ideology that does not align with our own, we will gain the ability to intervene and possibly invade them via §Y$AFG_foreign_intervention_category$§! decisions
loc.AFG_political_events.70.desc: The Durand Line, established in 1893 as the border between British India and [FROM.GetNonIdeologyName], has long been a source of contention. With the rise of [FROM.GetAdjective] nationalism and the desire to unite Pashtun tribes on both sides of the border, [FROM.GetLeader]’s government has officially rejected the Durand Line. [FROM.Capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName] now demands the renegotiation of borders, citing historical grievances and the unjust division of Pashtun lands.They have even gone so far as to threaten war if we fail to reach an accord.
loc.AFG_political_events.70.a: We can ill afford conflict at this time.
loc.AFG_political_events.70.b: We can ill afford a war, but we need approval from [ROOT.OVERLORD.capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName].
loc.AFG_political_events.70.c: The borders are a settled matter and will not be discussed any further.
loc.AFG_political_events.71.desc: Against all odds, [FROM.GetNameDef] has conceded to our demands for renegotiating the Durand Line. Under immense pressure and unwilling to risk a prolonged conflict in the region, the [FROM.GetAdjective] have agreed to redraw the borders, acknowledging our rightful claim to the Pashtun lands. This diplomatic victory not only unites our people but also strengthens the legitimacy of [ROOT.GetLeader]’s rule. [ROOT.GetNameDef] stands more united and stronger than ever.
loc.AFG_political_events.72.desc: The political situation in [AFG.GetNameDef] has reached a critical point. Their government has officially rejected the Durand Line, demanding a renegotiation of borders to unite the Pashtun tribes. The [AFG.GetAdjective] government has made it clear that failure to meet these demands will result in a declaration of war. Faced with the prospect of a costly and protracted conflict, [FROM.GetNameDef] has proposed conceding the disputed territory to  [AFG.GetNameDef] in an effort to maintain regional stability and avoid further escalation.
loc.AFG_political_events.72.a: We must avoid getting embroiled in another conflict.
loc.AFG_political_events.72.b: We will not be threatened into making territorial concessions.
loc.AFG_political_events.73.desc: Given the current global tensions and the potential for a costly conflict in the region, [FROM.Capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName] has decided that it is in their best interest to concede the disputed territory to [AFG.GetNonIdeologyName]. We are instructed to comply with this directive to preserve stability and avoid an unnecessary war.
loc.AFG_political_events.74.desc: The demands from [AFG.GetNonIdeologyName] to renegotiate the Durand Line and cede Pashtun territories have been met with firm resistance from [FROM.Capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName]. Despite the potential for conflict, the [FROM.GetAdjective] government has decided that conceding these territories would set a dangerous precedent and weaken their position in the region. We are instructed to reject [AFG.GetNonIdeologyName]'s demands and prepare to defend the border if necessary.
loc.AFG_political_events.74.a: We will do what we must.
loc.AFG_political_events.75.desc: Despite our claims and the clear desire of the Pashtun people for unity, [FROM.GetNameDef] have outright refused to renegotiate the borders. Their response is resolute, rejecting any notion of ceding territory and warning against further escalation. It seems the only path to liberating the territories will be through conflict.
loc.AFG_political_events.75.a: Then we must prepare for war.
loc.AFG_political_events.80.desc: In a bold move to assert dominance in the Islamic world, [FROM.GetNameDef] has issued an ultimatum. They demand that we join their expanding alliance, aimed at uniting and strengthening the Islamic nations under [FROM.GetAdjective] leadership. Failure to comply with this demand will apparently result in a full-scale invasion.
loc.AFG_political_events.80.a: This is in our best interest.
loc.AFG_political_events.80.b: They have no right to dictate policy to us.
loc.AFG_political_events.81.desc: In response to our ultimatum, [FROM.GetNameDef] has decided to acquiesce to our demands. They have agreed to join our alliance, recognizing the strength and leadership of [ROOT.GetNameDef] in uniting the Islamic world. This strategic move not only expands our influence but also solidifies our position as the dominant power in the region. With them now on our side, our vision of a united Islamic front grows ever closer to reality.
loc.AFG_political_events.81.a: They didn't really have a choice.
loc.AFG_political_events.82.desc: In defiance of our ultimatum, [FROM.GetNameDef] has rejected our demand to join our alliance. The Iraqi government remains resolute in their independence and is unwilling to submit to our authority.
loc.AFG_political_events.85.desc: In a covert communication, the [FROM.GetAdjective] government has reached out to us with a proposal for a defense pact. They seek a mutual agreement to defend one another in case of war, recognizing the strategic benefits of a partnership with us over our enemies. Afghanistan's ambition to become a dominant power in the Islamic world could align with our broader geopolitical interests.
loc.AFG_political_events.85.a: This could be to our advantage.
loc.AFG_political_events.85.b: We won't get caught up in [FROM.GetAdjective] politics.
loc.AFG_political_events.86.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has agreed to our proposal for a defense pact. This pact ensures that both our nations will support each other in the event of war, bolstering our strategic position. With [FROM.GetNameDef]'s military strength backing us, our ambitions to become a dominant power in the Islamic world are now more achievable.
loc.AFG_political_events.86.a: Then we shall begin our expansion across the region.
loc.AFG_political_events.87.desc: In a carefully worded response, [FROM.GetNameDef] has declined our proposal for a defense pact. Despite recognizing the potential strategic benefits, they have chosen to prioritize other partnerships and remain cautious about committing to such an agreement with us at this time.
loc.AFG_political_events.87.a: It will take time, but we shall achieve our goals on our own.
loc.AFG_political_events.90.desc: Reports have emerged that [AFG.GetNameDef], under the rule of [AFG.GetLeader], is actively promoting reactionary activity within our Central Asian republics. [AFG.GetAdjective] agents are believed to be stirring unrest and encouraging anti-[ROOT.GetAdjective] sentiments among the local populations. This subversive behavior is a direct challenge to our authority in the region and threatens the stability of our Central Asian territories. We must counter this foreign interference and maintain control over our republics.
loc.AFG_political_events.90.a: We must deploy additional security forces to suppress the unrest.
loc.AFG_political_events_90_tt: Unlock §Y[AFG_get_turkik_people_name_key]§! decisions to remove resistance cells in Central-Asian states. §RIf we fail to remove the resistance cells and are in a war with [FROM.GetNameDef], the states will rebel against us!§!
loc.AFG_political_events.91.desc: With the outbreak of war with [AFG.GetNameDef], the situation in our Central Asian republics has reached a critical point. Inspired by [AFG.GetAdjective] interference and emboldened by the current conflict, several republics have risen in revolt, declaring their independence from [ROOT.GetNameDef]. This widespread rebellion threatens to destabilize the entire region and stretch our military resources even thinner. We must act swiftly to quell the uprisings and restore order, or risk losing control over Central Asia.
loc.AFG_political_events.91.a: We must suppress the revolts and restore our authority.
loc.AFG_political_events.95.desc: The recent civil war that has engulfed the beleaguered nation of [AFG.GetNonIdeologyName] has caused alarm in [ROOT.Capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName]. However, the situation has taken on a new urgency as reports from the region indicate that [GER.GetAdjective] troops are aiding the forces of [AFG.GetLeader] to overthrow the legitimate government. We can only assume that this indicates an alignment of [AFG.GetLeader] with [GER.GetNameDef] which would be a major threat to our interests in the area. As such, members of the armed forces have drafted plans for our approval that would allow us to covertly aid the legitimate government and prevent a fascist takeover of the nation.
loc.AFG_political_events.95.a: This is essential to regional security, approved.
loc.AFG_political_events.100.desc: The government of [FROM.GetNameDef], has identified the strategic necessity of establishing a buffer state in Eastern [PER.GetNonIdeologyName]. To this end, they have formally requested the transfer of control over a number of territories in Eastern Iran to facilitate the creation of the state of Khorasan. They argue that this new buffer state will serve as a stabilizing force in the region.
loc.AFG_political_events.100.a: If it leads to long-term peace, who are we to argue?
loc.AFG_political_events.100.b: We will do no such thing.
loc.AFG_political_events.101.desc: The government of [FROM.GetNameDef] has agreed to transfer control of the designated territories in Eastern [PER.GetNonIdeologyName]. This transfer will allow us to establish the buffer state of Khorasan as planned.
loc.AFG_political_events.101.a: Our Western flank is finally secure.
loc.AFG_political_events.102.desc: The government of [FROM.GetNameDef] has regrettably declined our proposal to transfer control of the requested territories in Eastern [PER.GetNonIdeologyName]. They have expressed concerns over the implications of such a transfer and the potential impact on regional stability.
loc.AFG_political_events.102.a: We will pursue our agenda using alternative means.
loc.AFG_political_events_110_desc_balochista: The government of [FROM.GetNameDef] has requested the territories of Balochistan. They claim that these lands should rightfully belong to them and argue that the current borders unjustly divide their people and territory.
loc.AFG_political_events_110_desc_durand: The government of [FROM.GetNameDef] has requested a number of our territories along their border. They claim that these lands should rightfully belong to them and argue that the current borders unjustly divide their people and territory.
loc.AFG_political_events.110.a: If it keeps them off our backs.
loc.AFG_political_events.111.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has agreed to transfer the states we requested from them. After decades of dispute, we can finally welcome our long lost people back into the fold.
loc.AFG_political_events.112.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has refused to transfer the states we requested from them. It seems we will have to find alternative means of regaining our rightful territory in the future.
loc.AFG_political_events.112.b: Then we shall take it by force.
loc.AFG_political_events.120.desc: Representatives of the communist movement in [AFG.GetNonIdeologyName] have approached us to request support in their burgeoning revolution. While it is debatable whether the beleaguered nation is capable of supporting a socialist economy, we can not overlook the significance of pushing the frontiers of socialism deeper into central Asia and beyond.
loc.AFG_political_events.120.a: This aligns with our strategic aims in the regions.
loc.AFG_political_events.120.b: [SOU.GetAdjective] blood will never be spilled in [FROM.GetNonIdeologyName]!
loc.AFG_political_events.121.desc: In a demonstration of their commitment to the ideals of international solidarity, [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has agreed to aid us in our struggle.They inform us that fully equipped volunteers of their armed forces will be on route to us in the near future.
loc.AFG_political_events.122.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has rejected our plea for aid. They argue that our revolution is premature and doomed to failure. Our people will likely harbor deep resentments towards [FROM.GetNameDef] for the foreseeable future.
loc.AFG_political_events.130.desc: The government of [FROM.GetNonIdeologyName] have consulted us regarding a proposal to strengthen their nation by forming a confederation with some of our territory along the [ROOT.GetAdjective] border. This would see us adjust our borders but could help create a strong ally in the region.
loc.AFG_political_events.130.b: They are fools to even consult us on this.
loc.AFG_political_events.131.desc: The [FROM.GetAdjective] government has agreed to our confederation proposal. We can now begin the process of integrating our new territory into our political and economic system. This should hopefully act as a deterrent for any of our regional adversaries in the near future.
loc.AFG_political_events.132.desc: The [FROM.GetAdjective] government has rejected our proposal to form a confederation. This is a massive foreign policy setback for us and has raised alarm over what our long term relationship with [FROM.GetNameDef] will look like now.
loc.AFG_political_events.140.desc: This election has been somewhat chaotic given the nation's lack of prior experience with such events. However, a few candidates running on broad platforms have surfaced as the front runners. As polling stations close though, it seems the electorate were swayed by:
loc.AFG_political_events.140.a: The youthful charm of Mohammad Daoud Khan.
loc.AFG_political_events.140.b: The ever consistent Sardar Shah Mahmud Khan.
loc.AFG_political_events.140.c: The staunchly traditional Muhammad Ibrahim Khan.
loc.AFG_political_events.150.desc: The government of [FROM.GetNonIdeologyName] have approached us regarding a proposal to strengthen both of our nations by integrating our military economies to a minor degree. This would mean both of us would be required to aid each other in the case of war, but perhaps that is an acceptable price for closer cooperation?
loc.AFG_political_events.150.b: They are fools to even approach us on this
loc.AFG_political_events.151.desc: The [FROM.GetAdjective] government has agreed to our defense proposal. We can now begin the process of integrating our military complexes with each other. This should hopefully act as a deterrent for any of our regional adversaries in the near future.
loc.AFG_political_events.152.desc: The [FROM.GetAdjective] government has rejected our proposal to coordinate our defense industries, and as such our dreams of friendship with [FROM.GetLeader] come to a drastic end.
loc.AFG_political_events.153.desc: In a discreet message, the $AFG_faqir_of_ipi$, a traditionalist tribal leader in [FROM.GetNonIdeologyName], has reached out to the our government seeking support for his ascension to the throne. He promises that, with our backing, he will establish a strong nation aligned with our interests.
loc.AFG_political_events.153.a: We could use more allies in the region.
loc.AFG_political_events.153.b: Why interfere in such far off lands?
loc.AFG_political_events_153_tt: §Y[JAP.GetNonIdeologyName] will supply us with weapons and send volunteers to aid us when the civil war begins.§!
loc.AFG_political_events.154.desc: The [FROM.GetAdjective] government has responded to our request and regretfully declines to provide support for the ascension of the $AFG_faqir_of_ipi$ to the throne. Citing concerns over potential entanglements and the current geopolitical climate, [FROM.GetAdjective] has decided to focus on other strategic priorities.
loc.AFG_political_events.155.desc: In response to our request, the [FROM.GetName]’s government has agreed to support the ascension of the $AFG_faqir_of_ipi$ to the throne of [ROOT.GetNonIdeologyName]. This backing will include military support and equipment to ensure the success of our endeavor.
loc.AFG_political_events.155.a: The future of [AFG.GetNonIdeologyName] belongs to us!
loc.AFG_political_events.156.desc: As previously agreed, [FROM.GetAdjective] equipment has been made available to us since the outbreak of the civil war. Their operatives in [ROOT.Capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName] have also assured us that covert [FROM.GetAdjective] troops will soon reach the country to aid us in the struggle.
loc.AFG_political_events.157.desc: As previously agreed, [FROM.GetAdjective] equipment has been made available to us since the outbreak of the civil war. Their operatives in [ROOT.Capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName] have also assured us that covert [FROM.GetAdjective] troops will soon reach the country to aid us in the struggle.
loc.AFG_political_events.158.desc: In a discreet message, the $AFG_faqir_of_ipi$, a traditionalist tribal leader in [FROM.GetNonIdeologyName], has reached out to the our government seeking support for his ascension to the throne. He promises that, with our backing, he will establish a strong nation aligned with our interests.
loc.AFG_political_events.158.a: We could use more allies in the region.
loc.AFG_political_events.158.b: Why interfere in such far off lands?
loc.AFG_political_events.159.desc: The [FROM.GetAdjective] government has responded to our request and regretfully declines to provide support for the ascension of the $AFG_faqir_of_ipi$ to the throne. Citing concerns over potential entanglements and the current geopolitical climate, [FROM.GetAdjective] has decided to focus on other strategic priorities.
loc.AFG_political_events.160.desc: In response to our request, the [FROM.GetName]’s government has agreed to support the ascension of the $AFG_faqir_of_ipi$ to the throne of [ROOT.GetNonIdeologyName]. This backing will include military support and equipment to ensure the success of our endeavor.
loc.AFG_political_events.160.a: The future of [AFG.GetNonIdeologyName] belongs to us!
loc.AFG_political_events.170.desc: Mirza Khurshid Jah Bahadur arrived in our nation just a few days ago, and a grand ceremony is now being held in which his claim to the Mughal and Timurid Empires are being recognized, while crowning him the new Emir of Afghanistan. In due time, perhaps we will be able to claim the glory of these empires of old.
loc.AFG_political_events.171.desc: Sayyid Mir Muhammad Alim Khan has been in Kabul since he was exiled from Bukhara by the Soviets. With his coronation as the new Emir of Afghanistan, perhaps we will be able to use his claims to regain central Asia from the [SOV.GetAdjective] menace.
loc.AFG_political_events.172.desc: \nEarlier this week, forces belonging to [FROM.GetNameDef] moved in and occupied our territory of Waziristan, stating that they were on a mission to protect the region from potential occupation by their enemies. This is clearly an act of war, however it is one which we could likely choose to simply ignore, seeing as they are likely not picking a fight with us, but rather seeking to reunify the scattered Pashtun people.
loc.AFG_political_events.172.a: It is not worth fighting over
loc.AFG_political_events.172.b: Who do they think they are?
loc.AFG_political_events.173.desc: Due to many questioning the decisions taken by $AFG_mohammad_hashim_khan$, the decision has been taken to secure the royal rule by appointing one of his siblings as the new leader, subservient to $AFG_mohammed_zahir_shah$. Who will be made to replace him?
loc.GOE_RAJ.1.desc: Our subject [FROM.GetNameDef] has eyed an opportunity to expand our influence on the Indian subcontinent by subjugating the [BHU.GetAdjective] hermit kingdom. This could open a gateway into inner Asia proper.
loc.GOE_RAJ.2.desc: [FROM.GetName] has sanctioned our request for territorial expansion. There should be little resistance standing in our way.
loc.GOE_RAJ.3.desc: [FROM.GetName] has denied our requests for territorial expansion, stating that it is not in the interest of the Crown to destabilize the subcontinent at this time.
loc.GOE_RAJ.4.desc: As the security situation on the continent is rapidly deteriorating [FROM.GetNameDef] has demanded that our Kingdom become firmly integrated into their sphere of influence.\nThe [FROM.GetAdjective] government has emphasized that we would retain some independence, but that it can no longer accept potential security risks to the state.
loc.GOE_RAJ.5.desc: [FROM.GetName] has refused our demands, stressing that it is an independent Kingdom with their own rules and concerns.
loc.GOE_RAJ.6.desc: [FROM.GetName] has accepted our demands, effectively turning their country into a subject state.
loc.GOE_RAJ.7.t: Subhas Chandra Bose proposes toppling the [GetRajAdjective] government.
loc.GOE_RAJ.7.desc: In his efforts to gain independence for [GetRajName] the nationalist leader Chandra Bose has approached us with a proposal to destabilize the [GetRajAdjective] continent. Should we accept, we would be called to help with the overthrow of the imperial occupation of [GetRajAdjective] when the time is right.
loc.GOE_RAJ.7.a_tt: §YWe will be called to go to war against [RAJ.GetName] when Chandra Bose launches his revolution§!
loc.GOE_RAJ.8.desc: [FROM.GetName] has signaled that it will support us in our struggle for independence.
loc.GOE_RAJ.9.desc: [FROM.GetName] has stated that it has plans that would be jeopardized should they get involved in a war against the [ENG.GetAdjective], and will thus refrain from aiding us.
loc.GOE_RAJ.10.desc: Subhas Chandra Bose has launched his revolution. A telegram arrived stating that if we intend to honor our promise now is the time. \nThis has the chance of completely knocking out a major adversary in the Asian sphere.
loc.GOE_RAJ.10.b: We have to break our oath
loc.GOE_RAJ.11.desc: [FROM.GetName] is fully mobilizing and stands ready to aid us in our struggle
loc.GOE_RAJ.12.desc: No [FROM.GetAdjective] soldier stands ready to aid us. The promised help is nowhere in sight and Tokyo is silent. We can only assume that we are alone.
loc.GOE_RAJ.13.t: Hand over the Andaman islands to [GetRajName]?
loc.GOE_RAJ.13.desc: The Azad Hind government could use a dedicated capital for administrative purposes that is far from the front-lines until their victory is solidified.\nThe recently conquered Andaman Islands could be perfect for this.
loc.GOE_RAJ.14.desc: The [JAP.GetAdjective] has successfully invaded the Andaman's islands. They decided to transfer its control to us, so that we might set up a proper government there.
loc.GOE_RAJ.14.tt: We can transfer our Capital to the Andaman's by completing the §Y$RAJ_shaheed_and_swara$j§! focus.
loc.GOE_RAJ.15.desc: [RAJ.GetNameDefCap] has informed us that they intend to retain the Port of Aden under its control, despite previous plans to hand over its control to the crown.\nAs to be expected this has caused quite a stir in parliament, especially from Winston Churchill but no disciplinary actions are planned at this time.
loc.GOE_RAJ.16.desc: As planned under the 1935 Government of India act the [GetRajAdjective] administration has handed over administrative responsibilities of [992.GetName] to us.
loc.GOE_RAJ.17.desc: In an aggressive move [RAJ.GetName] has been posturing on the border with [TIB.GetName], declaring it as their intention to extend their security zone to protect their heartland. This categorically goes against our interests in the region.
loc.GOE_RAJ.17.b: We cannot afford to open another front.
loc.GOE_RAJ.18.desc: As [RAJ.GetNameDefCap] casts off the yoke of its past [RAJ.GetLeader] has become brazen enough to demand a return of our colonial holdings in the area. Uniting the subcontinent into one strong state seems of utmost importance for the newborn country.
loc.GOE_RAJ.18.a: They will have to take it by force
loc.GOE_RAJ.18.b: We can ill afford a war so long from home
loc.GOE_RAJ.19.desc: The [FROM.GetAdjective] government has stubbornly refused to hand over rightful [GetRajAdjective] land, despite repeated warnings that the status-quo is unacceptable
loc.GOE_RAJ.19.a: We will have to take it by force then
loc.GOE_RAJ.20.desc: [FROM.GetName] has begrudgingly accepted our demands. They do make it clear that this type of handfisted politics will not stand for long, and is only made viable as a small recompense.
loc.GOE_RAJ.21.desc: The old government under the yoke of Imperialist Britain has capitulated and its government has fled the country. As we are cementing control of the sub-continent we need to decide how to deal with our old overlords
loc.GOE_RAJ.21.b: There can be no peace for the Imperialists
loc.GOE_RAJ.22.desc: A frantic telegram from Lord Linlithgow has informed us that the rebels lead by [RAJ.GetLeader] has taken control of the country.\nLinlithgow is inbound to the country with an offer of white peace from [RAJ.GetLeader], granted we cede all claims over India.
loc.GOE_RAJ.23.desc: [ENG.GetName] has rejected our peace offer. It is the [ENG.GetAdjective]s intent to continue this war until their pearl is reclaimed.
loc.GOE_RAJ.24.desc: [ENG.GetName] has begrudgingly accepted our peace offer. [GetRajName] is free to forge its own destiny
loc.GOE_RAJ.25.desc: The [RAJ.GetAdjective] has signed a peace with their former overlords, at last gaining full independence from imperial rule. We now have the option of doing the same, walking away with a big morale victory in the process.
loc.GOE_RAJ.26.t: Subhas Chandra Bose freed from prison
loc.GOE_RAJ.26.desc: We have successfully freed our leader from prison. A great boon which will bring structure to our cause.
loc.GOE_RAJ.27.desc: Having broken free from the chains of their oppressors, [RAJ.GetNameDefCap] no longer wishes for our countries to engage in a fruitless war.
loc.GOE_RAJ.28.t: [FROM.GetName] refuses to sign a white peace
loc.GOE_RAJ.28.desc: [FROM.GetName] has rejected our attempt at exiting the conflict. Will this be our downfall, of theirs?
loc.GOE_RAJ.29.desc: As the end of Freeman-Freeman Thomas term as Viceroy for India nears we need to decide if we want to replace him with a suitable candidate, or if we want to extend the Marquess of Willingdons term further.
loc.GOE_RAJ.29.a: Victor Hope will replace the Earl
loc.GOE_RAJ.30.desc: After centuries of rule the [ENG.GetAdjective] administration is finally making its exit from India. Officials pack their offices, colonial administrators draft their final reports and the Union Jack is lowered from government buildings. However the transition is far from smooth; questions about borders and military control remain unresolved, causing some delay in final Independence.
loc.GOE_RAJ.30.a: At long last, we will be free.
loc.GOE_RAJ.30_we_are_leaving_tt: §Y[RAJ.GetName]§! will temporarily remain under our control while we let them sort their administration out. However they will eventually break free.
loc.GOE_RAJ.31.desc: As [RAJ.GetName] tries to recover from the Great Depression its price control seems to have destabilized the country. Tying the Rupee to the Sterling has the risk of throwing both our countries into economic turmoil.\nA conglomerate of private individuals has approached us with the suggestion of splitting up the Raj into two parts, easing the financial burden of the state. One part in private control, and one still under the crowns control.\nDoing nothing might risk an ever worse outcome.
loc.GOE_RAJ.31.a_tt: The East India Company will form, taking over parts of India
loc.GOE_RAJ.32.desc: As planned by the [ENG.GetAdjective] government we are to hand over the Province of Aden to them, but we could probably push to keep it should we so desire.
loc.GOE_RAJ.32.b_tt: We will retain control over §Ythe Province of Aden§!, allowing us to complete the §YTrade Port§! focus
loc.GOE_RAJ.33.desc: A group claiming to be the rightful heirs of a long defunct Empire has declared war for independence in the far North-West, rallying discontented factions under their banner. While most of India remains under control, this rebellion threatens stability. Will this be a footnote in history or the return of an empire?
loc.GOE_RAJ.33.b_tt: Losing control over Gujarat and Delhi will force a white peace
loc.GOE_RAJ_33_c_tt: §RWe must survive for 255 day(s) until a ceasefire is offered. If we occupy all states in Western, Eastern, Central, Southern or Northern India at the time of the ceasefire, we will gain greater territorial concessions!§!
loc.GOE_RAJ.34.desc: Disaster in the [UK_INDIA.GetName]! The local administration has collapsed due to the prolonged war in the west. In order to maintain control of the country, they have offered a territorial compromise to the rebels. We may not recognize these rebels but for now, the war is lost.
loc.GOE_RAJ.35.desc: Without a shot fired, the Raj is no more. We have solidified its control over India, and His Majesty's Government weary of the burdens of empire has opted not to intervene.
loc.GOE_RAJ.37.desc: Our latest occupation policies have predictably led to a surge in resistance activity. This seems to have caught the attention of His Majesty’s Government. A sharply worded letter has arrived, making it abundantly clear that London disapproves of our reckless approach to governance. The message is filled with carefully chosen words that still manage to drip with menace. In no uncertain terms, we are being advised to reconsider our stance, lest we find ourselves forcefully assisted in restoring order in a manner we might not appreciate.
loc.GOE_RAJ.38.desc: It seems the [ENG.GetAdjective] government has had quite enough of our approach to local governance. British forces have arrived in strength under the guise of stabilization operations.. Resistance networks have been uprooted, troublesome elements pacified and our own influence has been neatly brushed aside.\nThe UK insists this is all temporary, a necessary intervention to protect the integrity of the region. However the message is clear: they are in charge here and if we wish to govern, we must do so on their terms.
loc.GOE_RAJ.39.desc: In a dark lit cellar, Union leaders have agreed to meet with us, far from the prying eyes of the government. They hold sway over the farmers, the factory workers and the fishmongers, the common man. They would be willing to support us in our efforts to overturn the current government, but they wish for some concessions in return..
loc.GOE_RAJ.39.a_tt: When we gain power we will be obligated to increase worker safety within §Y6 months§!. Failing to do so will upset the unions. Increased worker safety yields:
loc.GOE_RAJ.39.b_tt: When we gain power we will be obligated to guarantee minimum wage within §Y6 months§!. Failing to do so will upset the unions. Guaranteed minimum wage yields:
loc.GOE_RAJ.39.c_tt: We will be able to meet with them again until we complete §Y$RAJ_royal_indian_navy_mutiny$§!
loc.GOE_RAJ.40.desc: Indian forces have crossed into disputed territory near [986.GetName]. Skirmishes are breaking out across the hills and plains just north of Delhi. They claim the land belongs to the revolution by historic rights. In a radio speech, the Premier called Pakistan a relic of colonial division. Tensions are rising and a clash seems imminent.
loc.GOE_RAJ.41.desc: Indian troops have taken the borderlands. Pakistani forces retreated after heavy fighting and communist banners now fly over the region. Indian broadcasts are calling it a triumph of the people.
loc.GOE_RAJ.42.desc: Indian forces have crossed into disputed territory near [431.GetName]. Skirmishes are breaking out across plains just north of Calcutta. They claim the land belongs to the revolution by historic rights. In a radio speech, the Premier called Pakistan a relic of colonial division. Tensions are rising and a clash seems imminent.
loc.GOE_RAJ.43.desc: Indian troops have taken Calcutta. Pakistani forces retreated after heavy fighting and communist banners now fly over the region. Indian broadcasts are calling it a triumph of the people.
loc.GOE_RAJ.44.desc: Indian forces have crossed into disputed territory near [433.GetName]. Indian troops have seized the Taj Mahal. They claim the land belongs to the revolution by historic rights. In a radio speech, the Premier called Pakistan a relic of colonial division. Tensions are rising and a clash seems imminent.
loc.GOE_RAJ.45.desc: Indian troops have taken [433.GetName]. Pakistani forces retreated after heavy fighting and communist banners now fly over the region. Indian broadcasts are calling it a triumph of the people.
loc.GOE_RAJ.46.desc:
Unrest has boiled over in the countryside as communist agitators, long operating in the shadows, have called the people to arms. Villages have turned against their landlords and banners bearing the hammer and sickle fly over town halls.

The uprising bears the fingerprints of [FROM.GetName] using their slogans and weapons.

 A new war for the heart and soul of our nation has begun.
loc.GOE_RAJ.46.c: We are already on our way to communism!
loc.GOE_RAJ.47.desc:
The People's Republic of India has begun extending its ideological reach beyond its borders.

In recent weeks, pro-Indian voices have grown louder within our political sphere. Publications praise their model of decentralized socialism, their resistance to foreign influence, and their apparent success in transforming a post-colonial state.

Whether this is part of a coordinated effort by [From.GetNameDef] to shift our internal politics remains unclear — but their presence is being felt.
loc.GOE_RAJ.48.desc: Following a series of publications and broadcasts inspired by the [RAJ.GetNameDef], a growing segment of [This.GetAdjective] society is turning toward the Indian model of agrarian socialism. The message of land reform, self-rule and anti-imperial unity is resonating with workers and peasants alike.\n\nWhile still a fringe movement, many within [This.GetAdjective] leadership fear that without a strong response, these sentiments could evolve into mass strikes, or worse, armed agitation aligned with [From.GetNameDef]'s revolutionary goals.
loc.GOE_RAJ.51.desc: Pakistani troops maintain hold over the borderlands. Indian forces retreated after heavy fighting and Pakistan continues to hold the region. Indian broadcasts are censoring the failure to avoid the national embarrassment.
loc.GOE_RAJ.49.desc: Pakistani troops maintain hold over Calcutta. Indian forces retreated after heavy fighting and Pakistan continues to hold the region. Indian broadcasts are censoring the failure to avoid the national embarrassment.
loc.GOE_RAJ.50.desc: Pakistani troops maintain hold over [433.GetName]. Indian forces retreated after heavy fighting and Pakistan continues to hold the region. Indian broadcasts are censoring the failure to avoid the national embarrassment.
loc.GOE_RAJ_famine.1.desc: Brown spot disease has been spotted in [?global.famine_state.GetName]. Officials are concerned that this fungal disease could spread further and impact the winter harvest.
loc.GOE_RAJ_famine.2.desc: A large cyclone followed by several storms has hit [?global.famine_state.GetName]. While damage is extensive it has an additional effect of spreading the Brown Spot Disease in a wider area, further exacerbating the effect of the fungi.
loc.GOE_RAJ_famine.2.a: Surely this is the end of it
loc.GOE_RAJ_famine.3.desc: Official forecasts of crop yields this year predicts a significant shortfall. It is widely known that these forecasts has been wrong in the past though.
loc.GOE_RAJ_famine.4.desc: Indian provinces and Princely states have started to impose inter-provincial trade barriers due to anxiety about rising food prices. These trade barriers risk further inflating the price of food as provinces become more and more isolated.
loc.GOE_RAJ_famine.4.a: The food distribution network is being strangled
loc.GOE_RAJ_famine.5.desc: As the price of grain has increased the local government has tried to implement price controls to aid the local population. Alas this has only meant that large amount of grain has disappeared into the black market, or stored in large warehouses.\nThe local government has already eased the measures but there is still a wide-spread belief that there is a large shortfall of grain, resulting in rampant inflation.
loc.GOE_RAJ_famine.6.desc: The local government has approved a scheme to prioritize basic supplies to upper and middle-classes of the population which are important to heavy industry in the state and sympathetic to Western values and modernization. This has further spiked food prices.
loc.GOE_RAJ_famine.7.desc: Mass civil unrest has broken out in [?global.famine_state.GetName]. Lack of basic supplies has forced the large rural population into overcrowded cities in search for aid.\nThis has quickly spiraled out of control as mobs start to form and clash with each other.
loc.GOE_RAJ_famine.7.tt: §YFamine might spread to adjacent states every month unless preventative measures are taken\nUnlocks the Famine decision category§!
loc.GOE_RAJ_famine.9.desc: [FROM.Getname] is facing a deteriorating situation where part of its country is in a state of famine. Its government has pleaded for any aid that the international community can spare to alleviate the suffering and end the emergency.
loc.GOE_RAJ_famine.9.a: Sorry old chap. We can't spare anything.
loc.GOE_RAJ_famine.9.b: We will send a large amount of aid
loc.GOE_RAJ_famine.9.c: We will send a small amount of aid
loc.GOE_RAJ_famine.10.desc: [FROM.GetName] has informed us that it will not provide any aid to us, stating that it rejects the notion that it has any obligation to our state during such a worldwide crisis.
loc.GOE_RAJ_famine.11.desc: [FROM.GetName] has generously provided a large aid package to us, helping alleviate the famine and preventing its further spread to adjacent states.
loc.GOE_RAJ_famine.12.desc: [FROM.GetName] has provided a small aid package to us, helping alleviate the famine and preventing its further spread to adjacent states. While they certainly could do more, it is better than nothing.
loc.GOE_RAJ_famine.13.desc: The worst of the famine seems to be over. A good harvest has eased the worst of the suffering and food prices are deflating. While it will take a while to restore a sense of normality, it is a first stepping stone in healing the area.\nWith the great tragedy that has befallen we must ask ourselves, what is the true price of victory?
loc.GOE_RAJ_famine.13.a: Miles won with the pain of the common.
loc.goe_japan.1.t: Bose Offers Support for the Burma Campaign
loc.goe_japan.1.desc: Subhas Chandra Bose, leader of the Indian National Army, has approached us with an offer, his forces stand ready to aid our advance into [BRM.GetName]. He envisions this as the first step toward liberating India from [ENG.GetAdjective] rule, and he believes that by striking at Burma we can weaken the British Raj. His men are hardened nationalists, and their knowledge of the terrain could prove invaluable. Do we accept?
loc.RAJ_famine_scripted_timeframe_reveal_des: We have determined that the famine will last for §Y[?RAJ_famine_spread_times]§! more months.
loc.RAJ_famine_scripted_timeframe_non_reveal: We expect the famine to last for §Y[?RAJ_famine_spread_times_min]§! - §Y[?RAJ_famine_spread_times_max]§! more months.
loc.RAJ_famine_risk_scripted_gui_desc: Chance of preventative measures stopping the spread of famine to adjacent states: §G[?RAJ_famine_shield]%§!\nRisk of Famine spreading: §R[?RAJ_famine_spreads]%§!
loc.RAJ_famine_prevention_stats: Our preventative measures has\n-Stopped the Famine from spreading: §Y[?RAJ_times_shield_has_blocked_spread]§! times\n-Reduced the length of the Famine by: §Y[?RAJ_famine_reduction_from_shield]§! months
loc.RAJ_famine_shield_tt: Chance of preventative measures stopping the spread of famine: §G+$RIGHT|0$%§!
loc.RAJ_partition_1.desc: What started as a civil protest descended into violence when local police forces engaged the disenfranchised populace. The [ENG.GetAdjective] police claims that they acted under threats of violence, while the protestors are adamant that they strictly adhered to non-violence.\nNo one was killed but 2 local officers sustained light injuries and 1 protestor was transferred to the local hospital after suffering a concussion.
loc.GOE_RAJ_partition.2.desc: Protests against [ENG.GetAdjective] rule have erupted in [?unrest_target_state.GetName], with local law enforcement reporting escalating violent clashes between demonstrators and authorities.
loc.GOE_RAJ_partition.3.desc: Tensions in [?unrest_target_state.GetName] have reached a critical level, as local police struggle to contain increasingly restless crowds. Government-linked factories have become key targets for agitators, facing frequent acts of sabotage amid the escalating unrest.
loc.GOE_RAJ_partition.3.b: Try and mediate with the agitators
loc.GOE_RAJ_partition.4.desc: As the push for independence gains momentum, a deep and growing divide is emerging. Hindus, determined to preserve a united India, are increasingly at odds with Muslims, who, fearing marginalization in a Hindu-majority state, are calling for the creation of a separate homeland.
