loc.RAJ_contamination_cleanup_crew_desc: Our soldiers need to be ready to fight under the harshest of conditions, even in nuclear fallout.
loc.RAJ_rolling_nuke_barrages_desc: Rolling barrages were commonplace during the Great war. New technologies allow for even more devastating barrages.
loc.RAJ_bathe_in_hellfire_desc: Our foes will only have two alternatives: fall in line, or face the pyre.
loc.RAJ_bathe_in_hellfire_desc_tt: §YNukes§! now destroy §Y50%§! of the target states §YMilitary Factories§! permanently.\n§YThermonuclear Nukes§! now destroy §Y100%§! of the target states §YMilitary Factories§! permanently.
loc.RAJ_jaguar_desc: The Jaguar is a prime candidate for delivering democratic justice from above.
loc.RAJ_ammunition_factory_khadki_desc: To have the capabilities to provide arms to a modern fighting force we need to drastically expand our country's ordnance factories.
loc.RAJ_rifle_factory_ishapore_west_bengal_d: The Ishapore Rifle factory will work in tandem with the Khadki factory to provide small arms to the army.
loc.RAJ_gun_and_shell_factory_cossipore_desc: The Cassiopore factory will further increase our capabilities in terms of Infantry Equipment as well as providing ammunition for the troops.
loc.RAJ_cordite_factory_aruvankadu_tamil_nad: Having good propellants for artillery will give our heavy guns the edge over our enemies.
loc.RAJ_local_recruitment_offices_desc: We have a large population, many of those would be willing to volunteer into the army as a way to uplift their economic situation, instead of us having to call for a general draft. Setting up recruitment offices will give us ample volunteers.
loc.RAJ_local_recruitment_offices_tt:
Every [?RAJ_recruitment_offices_timeout_max]th month will reduce the penalty of §Y$idea_RAJ_agrarian_society$§! by
	 Recruitable Population Factor: §G+[?RAJ_agrarian_society_conscription_factor_penalty_reduction_display]%§!
 Mobilization Speed: §G[?RAJ_agrarian_society_mobilization_speed_penalty_reduction_display]%§!
 Mobilization Law Cost Factor: §G[?RAJ_agrarian_society_mobilization_laws_cost_factor_penalty_reduction_display]%§!
loc.RAJ_military_pensions_desc: Providing military pensions as part of the army package will strengthen the military complex as a whole by retaining staff for longer.
loc.RAJ_legacy_of_military_service_desc: There are many villages around [GetRajName] where the fathers served in the military, so their sons are pressured to as well. It is tradition after all and we can use this to gather more recruits than would be normal.
loc.RAJ_indian_states_force_desc: The princely states has their own forces that could be called upon to defend [GetRajName].
loc.RAJ_frontier_corps_desc: Our country is made up of several biomes, among those are the rugged frontier terrains of the east. Contacting the militia there and incorporating their expertise about harsh environmental warfare would be a boon for us.
loc.RAJ_seven_shackles_2: Fourth to Sixth of the Seven Shackles
loc.RAJ_release_subjects_hint_tt: §YSubjects released by us from the subcontinent will be more likely to prioritize industrial focuses over other focuses.§!
loc.RAJ_famine_impact_reduction: §YThis will reduce the impact of Famine when it happens§!
loc.has_arrested_bose: The British Government has arrested Subhas Chandra Bose
loc.RAJ_heavy_industries_desc: Rapid industrialization is essential to secure [RAJ.GetName] future. By developing a robust heavy industry sector we lay the foundation for military strength and economic independence in the modern world.
loc.RAJ_strike_against_china_desc: If [CHI.GetName] becomes a regional power they will strike against us, maybe not today, but surely tomorrow. We need to strike first
loc.RAJ_strike_burma_desc: [BRM.GetName]s continued existence poses a strategic threat on our eastern frontier. By bringing it under our control we can secure the border and eliminate a potential foothold for foreign powers.
loc.RAJ_seek_financial_aid_from_the_ussr_des: To advance our revolutionary goals and accelerate national development, we will turn to [SOU.GetNameDefCap] for financial assistance. Their support can help us build a new order grounded in solidarity and strength.
loc.RAJ_guided_democracy_desc: A carefully managed democratic process will provide the appearance of choice while ensuring outcomes remain firmly under our control. Stability requires guidance, and we are prepared to offer it.
loc.RAJ_authoritarianship_desc: Strong centralized authority will ensure peace, justice and stability for our new state.
loc.RAJ_the_sun_sets_desc: The age of empire is ending. As the [ENG.GetAdjective] grip weakens we will hasten their decline. The sun shall finally set on their empire, and we will rise from its shadow.
loc.RAJ_great_depression_price_controls_desc: The Great Depression hit the subcontinent hard. By tying the Rupee to the Sterling and implementing various price controls we hope to stabilize the situation.
loc.RAJ_look_to_the_past_desc: The price controls successfully mitigated a factor of the great depression, but consequently the controls are currently wrecking havoc on the economy with inflation spiraling out of control. Desperation leads to dissent, and more local leaders are finding political strength by riling up the populace by tales of past greatness.\nCan what once was rise again?
loc.RAJ_secure_weapons_desc: Our military equipment is a mess of mismatched variants from a number nations. However, with a little help from foreign countries we can gain equipment in preparation to break free
loc.RAJ_secure_weapons_tt: Weapons will be added to the stockpile upon completion of §Y$RAJ_the_mughal_uprising$§!.
loc.RAJ_stir_unrest_in_the_north_desc: The people in the northern parts of the Raj has been impacted disproportionately by the price controls. They are like dry grass, all we need is a spark to light the fire.
loc.RAJ_stir_unrest_in_the_north_focus_tt: We will keep control over the following states when we break away:
loc.MUGHAL_divisions_spawned: §Y4§! fully equipped loyalist divisions will join us when we trigger an uprising.
loc.RAJ_the_mughal_uprising_desc: The remote region in the north acts as a perfect geographical location to break away from the British.\nLocal leaders have stoked the flames in people's hearts about tales of the glorious past, of when the Mughals ruled this land, free to seek their own destiny.\nInshallah, so will we.
loc.RAJ_the_mughal_uprising_tt: We will break away from the §YBritish Raj§! and §Rdeclare a war for independence§!.
loc.RAJ_the_mughal_uprising_tt2: We will own all states that we control at the end of the civil war
loc.6_month_timer_mughal_tt: We will have §Y255§! day(s) to win this war before the devolved administration offers a ceasefire.
loc.RAJ_reform_the_agricultural_system_desc: For too long, India’s food system has been plagued by neglect, mismanagement and exploitation. With the Mughal Empire restored we must ensure that no subject goes hungry again. By investing in irrigation, modernizing agriculture and breaking the grip of predatory landlords we will turn India into a land of plenty where famine is a relic of the past.
loc.RAJ_GOE_enforced_peace_decision_desc_tt: If we manage to hold out for long enough, the [UK_INDIA.GetAdjective] government will offer us a ceasefire.
loc.RAJ_GOE_enforced_peace_decision_desc_eng: If [RAJ.GetName] hold out for long enough, the [UK_INDIA.GetAdjective] government will offer them a ceasefire with territorial concessions.
loc.RAJ_GOE_enforced_peace_decision_desc_2_t: §YWe will retain control over any of the following regions§!: §YWestern India§!, §YSouthern India§!, §YCentral India§!, §YEastern India§!, and §YNorthern India§! provided we control all the states within a given region when the ceasefire takes effect.
loc.RAJ_GOE_enforced_peace_decision_desc_2_1: §YIf we control [443.GetName], [989.GetName], [433.GetName], [428.GetName] and [437.GetName] we will gain greater territorial concessions when the war ends§!
loc.RAJ_GOE_enforced_peace_decision_desc_2_2: §YIf we control [429.GetName], [427.GetName], [424.GetName], [425.GetName], [423.GetName], [982.GetName] and [983.GetName] we will gain greater territorial concessions when the war ends§!
loc.RAJ_GOE_enforced_peace_decision_desc_2_3: §YIf we control [436.GetName], [984.GetName], [426.GetName], [438.GetName], and [435.GetName] we will gain greater territorial concessions when the war ends§!
loc.RAJ_GOE_enforced_peace_decision_desc_2_4: §YIf we control [431.GetName], [985.GetName], [430.GetName], [432.GetName], [990.GetName] and [434.GetName] we will gain greater territorial concessions when the war ends§!
loc.RAJ_the_legacy_of_babur_desc: The Mughal Empire once united vast swathes of the subcontinent under its banner. Now, there are those who dream of restoring its glory, using the legacy of Babur to inspire a new era of imperial resurgence and unity.
loc.RAJ_the_legacy_of_babur_tt: Every state that has been had unrest stirred in it will receive:
loc.RAJ_a_peacock_prince_desc: The Mughal legacy demands a worthy leader to reclaim its throne. Among the princely states, a Peacock Prince must rise—one whose lineage, ambition, and vision can restore the grandeur of the empire and unite the subcontinent once more.
loc.RAJ_halls_of_knowledge_desc: A strong nation is built on the foundation of knowledge. By investing in research and education, we cultivate innovation, empower our people, and ensure [ROOT.GetNameDef]’s place as a leader in science, industry, and progress.
loc.RAJ_sharpen_the_tulwar_desc: The Tulwar, a symbol of strength and defiance, must be sharpened for the battles to come. By modernizing our forces and refining our strategies, we ensure that  [ROOT.GetNameDef] is ready to strike decisively when the moment demands.
loc.RAJ_timurid_bureaucracy_desc: Rooted in the legacy of Timur, the Timurid Bureaucracy provides a model of efficient governance and centralized control. Revitalizing this system will strengthen the Empire’s administration, ensuring stability and prosperity across its vast territories.
loc.RAJ_conquer_afghanistan_desc: Afghanistan, the ancestral heart of the empire, must be reclaimed. By restoring control over this historic region, we honor the Mughal legacy and secure a vital stronghold for the empire’s resurgence.
loc.RAJ_across_the_himalayas_desc: The lands beyond the Himalayas hold untold riches and strategic importance. By expanding the Mughal Empire’s influence across these formidable peaks, we cement our dominance and secure new frontiers for the glory of the realm.
loc.RAJ_skibedi_san_ma_desc: The warlords of Xibei San Ma stand as an obstacle to the Mughal Empire's dominance in Central Asia. By launching a decisive campaign, we can dismantle their power, secure strategic trade routes, and expand the empire's influence in the region.
loc.RAJ_conquerors_of_persia_desc: [PER.GetNameDef], a land of immense wealth and history, once stood as a rival to the empire. By bringing it under Mughal rule, we reaffirm our dominance, secure vital western territories, and solidify the empire’s place as the true inheritor of imperial grandeur.
loc.RAJ_halls_of_knowledge_2_desc: Knowledge is the key to enduring power. By establishing Imperial Academies across the Mughal Empire, we nurture scholars, scientists, and administrators who will drive innovation, strengthen governance, and ensure the empire’s legacy of wisdom and progress.
loc.RAJ_halls_of_knowledge_3_desc: Knowledge might lead to a deep well of chaos where man dares not thread, but tread there we must.
loc.RAJ_elephants_for_the_modern_age_desc: The mighty war elephants of the Mughal Empire once dominated the battlefield. Now, we adapt their legacy to the modern age by investing in armored vehicles and mechanized forces, creating unstoppable engines of war to carry our empire to victory.
loc.RAJ_unite_the_subcontinent_desc: The splintered states of the subcontinent are a shadow of its former glory. By reuniting these lands under the Mughal banner, we restore the harmony, strength, and grandeur of an empire destined to rule from the mountains to the seas.
loc.RAJ_the_true_mongols_desc: [Root.GetNameDef] is the rightful inheritor of the Mongol legacy, blending the strength of the steppes with the culture of the subcontinent. By embracing our roots, we channel the spirit of the True Mongols to conquer and unify as our ancestors once did.
loc.RAJ_halls_of_knowlege_3_desc: A learned society is the foundation of a thriving empire. By constructing grand libraries across the Mughal realm, we preserve ancient wisdom, foster innovation, and inspire future generations to lead the empire to unparalleled greatness.
loc.RAJ_thunder_elephants_desc: The majestic elephants, symbols of Mughal power, return to the battlefield as an embodiment of strength and tradition. Their sheer might and presence will inspire our armies and strike fear into the hearts of our enemies, paving the way for imperial victories.
loc.RAJ_revolt_of_the_princes_desc: The princely states, long subjugated under British rule, shall rise in revolt to reclaim their heritage.
loc.RAJ_revolt_of_the_princes_tt: Upon declaring war on the British Raj the princely states will rise up and join us, becoming a subject.
loc.RAJ_secular_rule_desc: The Mughal Empire thrives on diversity, and a secular administration ensures fair governance for all subjects, regardless of faith. By prioritizing merit and equality, we strengthen the empire’s unity and secure loyalty across its vast and varied domains.
loc.RAJ_theocratic_rule_desc: The rights of non-muslims were highly prescriptive under the Mughal administration. It is time to adjust these matters for a modern world, and prove to all of India that we are an enlightened realm.
loc.RAJ_mughal_court_desc: The Mughal Court gathers the brightest minds and most influential leaders of the realm. By empowering these advisors, we strengthen the empire with their guidance, ensuring that every decision reflects the glory and ambition of our rule.
loc.RAJ_mughal_court_tt: All the Princely States will receive the National Spirit:
loc.RAJ_mughal_court_princely_states_tt: All princes will leave their princely state and join the Mughal Empire as an available advisor or general.
loc.RAJ_the_silk_road_desc: The Silk Road once brought wealth and culture to the Empire. By restoring this historic trade network, we reclaim our place at the center of global commerce, enriching the empire and fostering prosperity across its vast domains.
loc.RAJ_restore_the_timurid_empire_desc: The banners of Timur fly once more, and the empire that once struck fear into the hearts of sultans and kings has risen from the ashes of history. Our rule stretches across the lands once shaped by his conquests, binding East and West under a single dominion. Let the world take heed—the Timurids have returned, and this time, we shall not fade into the past.
loc.RAJ_peacock_throne_for_the_modern_age: Peacock Throne for the Modern Age
loc.RAJ_peacock_throne_for_the_modern_age_de: The Peacock Throne was the ultimate emblem of our ancestors' power and grandeur. By building a new throne in our historic seat of power, we assert our dominance, inspire loyalty, and make clear our vision for the fertile deltas of the subcontinent.
loc.RAJ_the_crown_and_the_world_desc: The Mughal Empire's destiny is to rise as the unrivaled global superpower. By expanding our influence, advancing our strength, and asserting our dominance, we will secure our place as the ultimate ruler of the modern world.
loc.RAJ_conquerors_of_iraq_desc: Iraq was once a vital crossroads of trade and power within Timur’s empire, and its riches fueled our past glories. Now, it lies in the hands of lesser rulers, unworthy of its legacy. By bringing Mesopotamia back under our dominion, we will secure a strategic heartland, control the gateway between East and West, and remind the world that the Timurids do not ask—they take.
loc.RAJ_conquerors_of_turkey_desc: Anatolia was once a battlefield for empires, and history remembers Timur’s triumph over the Ottomans. Yet, the successor of that broken sultanate still stand, clinging to lands that rightfully belong under our rule. By marching west once more, we will shatter their defenses and reclaim our past conquests.
loc.RAJ_reviving_the_workshop_of_the_world: Reviving the Workshop of the World
loc.RAJ_reviving_the_workshop_of_the_world_d: Before British rule, India was a global center of industry, textiles, and trade. Now with the Empire reborn it is time to reclaim that legacy. By modernizing our factories and revitalizing our trade routes and we will transform our economy into a powerhouse that rivals the great nations of the world.
loc.RAJ_legacy_of_timur_desc: The empire of Timur was never meant to fade into history. By reclaiming our ancestral lands and uniting them under a single rule, we will revive the Timurid legacy and forge a new era of strength and ambition. The world will once again tremble before the sons of Timur.
loc.RAJ_forging_the_mughal_arsenal_desc: The wars of the past were won with sticks and stones, those days are gone. If our empire is to stand against the great powers of the modern world we must build an industrial base capable of sustaining a vast military machine. Assembly lines will hum with the sound of Industry and soon our armies will march with weapons forged by our own hands.
loc.RAJ_rebuilding_the_empires_roads_desc: An empire cannot function without the means to move its armies, goods and people. The decayed roads and railways left behind by the British must be expanded and modernized.
loc.unlock_decisions_silk_road_tt: Unlocks decisions to core more §YSilk Road§! territory
loc.create_mwbc_tt: Creates the §Y$mughal_west_britain_company$§! with cores on mainland England and Wales.
loc.RAJ_hedgemony_of_the_subcontinent_desc: We have attained industrial dominance in the subcontinent, pushing away all others who could claim such a title. We have become unassailable, leaving the other breakaways in the dust.
loc.RAJ_hedgemony_of_the_subcontinent_tt: All starting states is owned by [ROOT.GetName]
loc.RAJ_orchestrate_train_robberies_desc: Railway construction has slowed under worker-led management and greater oversight, but each line built is better integrated into the planned economy, yielding higher logistical output and efficiency.
loc.RAJ_revisiting_inquities_desc: Our Empire's historic decline was only hastened by the meddling of foreign trading companies. There are those among us who believe that with our newfound might, it is our right to subject our old foes to the same iniquities they once visited upon us.
loc.RAJ_royal_indian_navy_mutiny_desc: Discontent brews among the Indian sailors, showing support for our cause. We can use this to seize power and stop English reinforcements in their tracks. They will have no choice but to submit.
loc.RAJ_royal_indian_navy_mutiny_tt: §RCommunist Infiltration Decisions will be removed when completing this focus§!
loc.RAJ_royal_indian_navy_mutiny_tt2: §RCommunist Infiltration Decisions will be removed when fulfilling our obligations§!
loc.RAJ_accept_russian_muhajir_money_desc: Foreign gold flows into our hands, fueling the fires of revolution.
loc.RAJ_jugantar_desc: The spirit of Jugantar awakens, spreading resistance across the land. We can use this to seize Bengal once more
loc.RAJ_the_peoples_liberation_army_desc: A disciplined and ideologically committed force, the People's Liberation Army will lead the charge for national liberation. Drawn from the working class and peasantry, it stands ready to defend the revolution and forge a new order.
loc.RAJ_deathblow_to_imperial_remnants_desc: [PAK.GetName] has acted as a proxy for the English, with the latter funneling large amounts of resources to them in a desperate act to counterbalance the rising tide of communism. We will finally end this spat.
loc.RAJ_the_revolutionary_army_marches_desc: With purpose our army march, for the revolution, for India, and for the common man.
loc.RAJ_threaten_princes_desc: The princes will bow to our demands, or face the consequences of their defiance.
loc.RAJ_look_to_the_future_desc: We need to look towards the future, not the past to control this price chaos. A large set of stabilizing measures needs to be implemented, yesterday.
loc.RAJ_lobby_parliment_desc: With the backing of private investors we will lobby Parliament to present privatization as the only viable safeguard against another global economic collapse. Selling off parts of the Raj is not just strategy, it's stability for the empire.
loc.RAJ_lobby_parliment_tt: We will start to form the East India Company
loc.RAJ_orchestrate_train_robberies_tt:
Railway focuses will now modify §YIndian Railway§! Spirit by:
Factory Output: §G+[?RAJ_railway_default_increase_tt]%§!
Railway Construction Speed: §R[?RAJ_railway_default_decrease_tt]%§!
Supply Hub Construction Speed: §R[?RAJ_railway_default_decrease_tt]%§!
Infrastructure Construction Speed: §R[?RAJ_railway_default_decrease_tt]%§!
for each completed railway focus

Every existing completed railway focus will be automatically switched to account for this.
loc.RAJ_jugantar_tt: Upon declaring war on [PAK.GetName] we will gain divisions around Bangladesh
loc.RAJ_bhoodan_movement_desc: Through voluntary land redistribution we will empower the landless and restore justice to the countryside. By giving the soil back to those who work it we earn not just their labor, but their lasting loyalty.
loc.RAJ_nationalize_british_owned_factories_: The factories built on the backs of [RAJ.GetAdjective] labor will no longer serve foreign interests. By nationalizing [ENG.GetAdjective]-owned industry, we return control to the people and reclaim what was unjustly taken.
loc.RAJ_exile_princes_desc: The era of princely rule has come to an end. To secure true national unity we will remove these remnants of feudal power, exiling them far from their palaces and the people they once ruled.
loc.RAJ_integrate_the_princes_desc: Now that we've exiled the princes and have been slowly integrating them into India, it is time to finally integrate the Princely states once and for all.
loc.RAJ_integrate_the_princes2_desc: The Princely states system of semi-autonomy is not something we are interested in maintaining. The princely states will be fully incorporated into India once and for all.
loc.RAJ_join_the_co_prospherity_sphere_desc: Japan is the only local force that is willing to stand up towards Western imperialists. We need to join them for a grander goal.
loc.RAJ_join_the_co_prospherity_sphere_tt: (§Y[JAP.GetName]§!) Gets event '§Y[RAJ.GetNameDefCap] seeks to join the Co-Prosperity sphere§!'.
loc.RAJ_black_swan_sloops_desc: By acquiring and refitting cost-effective Black Swan–class hulls, we can rapidly expand our fleet of light patrol vessels, ideal for coastal defense and convoy protection.
loc.RAJ_coastal_protection_desc: Our large coastline needs some form of protection against foreign threats.
loc.RAJ_the_sword_and_the_saffron_desc: Our destiny is forged through strength and faith. The sword shall defend our land, and the saffron banner will unite our people under one purpose.
loc.RAJ_burn_down_the_cellular_jail_desc: The Cellular Jail stands as an affront to everyone who has ever fought for India independence, it has to be destroyed.
loc.RAJ_indian_marine_corps_desc: We will establish a dedicated Marine Corps, trained in amphibious operations and specialized assaults.
loc.RAJ_madras_ship_repair_factories_desc: Madras will be developed into a key naval support hub with dedicated repair facilities to maintain and refit our growing fleet, ensuring operational readiness across the eastern seaboard.
loc.RAJ_obtain_british_naval_contracts_desc: We will approach [ENG.GetNameDefCap] to secure naval construction contracts, leveraging their industrial capacity to bolster our own fleet while strengthening strategic ties.
loc.RAJ_purchase_decomissioned_british_ships: We will approach [ENG.GetNameDefCap] to acquire decommissioned naval vessels. Though outdated, these ships can be refitted to quickly expand our fleet at minimal cost.
loc.RAJ_request_transfer_of_british_commande: We will request [ENG.GetNameDefCap] to transfer one of their Naval Commanders to us in order to aid in training our new marines.
loc.RAJ_obtain_modern_ship_contracts_desc: To accelerate our naval modernization, we will negotiate with [ENG.GetNameDefCap] for the acquisition of state of the art cruisers, ensuring our fleet remains competitive in the evolving maritime landscape.
loc.RAJ_dominate_the_bay_of_bengal_desc: Securing naval supremacy in the Bay of Bengal is essential to our maritime strategy. By expanding our presence and projecting power across these waters we safeguard trade routes and assert regional dominance.
loc.RAJ_indian_cruiser_development_desc: The time has come to chart our own naval course. By developing domestically designed cruisers we assert our industrial independence and lay the foundation for a modern Indian fleet.
loc.RAJ_increase_funding_for_the_GRSE_desc: We will increase the state funding for the GRSE in order to allow for construction of new dockyards.
loc.RAJ_womens_royal_indian_naval_service_de: We will form the Women's Royal [ROOT.GetAdjective] Naval Service, allowing women to serve a role in the Navy.
loc.RAJ_modernizing_navy_dlc_desc: To assert ourselves as a regional power we must modernize our navy by investing in advanced ship design, improved infrastructure, and strategic doctrine to project influence across the seas of Asia.
loc.RAJ_rashtriya_swayamsevak_sangh_desc: We will organize the youth into a disciplined force, ready to defend our nation and uphold the values of Hindutva at any cost.
loc.RAJ_the_hindu_martial_tradition_desc: From the warriors of Shivaji to the defenders of dharma, we will revive our ancient martial spirit and prepare our people for the battles ahead.
loc.RAJ_cultural_reawekening_desc: A new dawn filled with art, language, and traditions is at hand. Uniting the nation under the timeless spirit of our civilization.
loc.RAJ_mass_production_desc: We will source equipment from private enterprises that provides the lowest cost. Pressing down cost of equipment is key to growth.
loc.RAJ_deathknell_to_the_raj_desc: We have chipped away at the remnant of the Raj by taking more and more control over their land. It is time to end this charade and demand to take full control of the subcontinent.
loc.RAJ_deathknell_to_the_raj_trigger_tt: Annexes the remnants of the Raj
loc.RAJ_learn_from_the_crown_desc: We must learn from the Crown's vast military experience, adopting their proven doctrines to prepare for the challenges ahead.
loc.RAJ_join_the_shadow_scheme_desc: By participating in covert operations, we can expand our intelligence capabilities and strengthen our strategic position.
loc.RAJ_colonial_cadet_exchange_desc: We will send our brightest cadets to train alongside British officers, ensuring our army is equipped with cutting-edge techniques.
loc.RAJ_learn_from_the_secret_intelligence_s: Learn from the Secret Intelligence Service
By working with the British Secret Intelligence Service, we can build a formidable espionage network to safeguard our interests.
loc.RAJ_purchase_british_supply_equipment_de: We must acquire advanced British supply equipment to bolster our forces and improve battlefield logistics.
loc.RAJ_forming_an_indian_doctrine_desc: The time has come to forge our own path. We shall develop an Indian doctrine that reflects our unique strengths and aspirations.
loc.RAJ_model_after_germany_desc: We can emulate Germany's disciplined and efficient military doctrines to transform our forces into a modern war machine.
loc.RAJ_model_after_usa_desc: By studying American military strategies, we can modernize our army with a focus on flexibility and technological innovation.
loc.RAJ_model_after_soviet_desc: The Soviet Union's emphasis on mass mobilization and revolutionary tactics offers a blueprint for our own military evolution.
loc.RAJ_automating_the_army_desc: We will prioritize mechanization and advanced armored divisions, paving the way for a fully modernized army.
loc.RAJ_for_the_people_by_the_people: For the People, By the People
loc.RAJ_for_the_people_by_the_people_desc: Our focus will be on strengthening infantry, artillery, and support divisions to build an army truly rooted in the will of the people.
loc.RAJ_five_year_plan_desc: Any communist state needs a five year plan! We must begin developing ours so that [RAJ.GetNameDefCap]'s' industry can thrive!
loc.RAJ_five_year_plan_flag: Has completed focus §YThe Five Year Plan§!
loc.RAJ_five_year_plan_tt: Completing either §YAgrarian Socialism§! or §YUrban Industrialism§! will alter the Five Year Plan
loc.RAJ_soviet_influence_desc: The Soviet Union stands as a model of revolutionary transformation. By embracing their ideological guidance and institutional frameworks we can chart a similar path for [RAJ.GetName]
loc.RAJ_indian_socialism_desc: Rather than seeking inspiration from a socialist great power, we will create our own socialist doctrine tailored to the needs of [RAJ.GetNameDefCap].
loc.RAJ_soviet_indian_industrial_cooperation: To accelerate our economic transformation, we will forge an industrial partnership with [SOU.GetNameDefCap]. Their technical expertise and experience in centralized development will be instrumental in building a socialist economy tailored to our needs.
loc.RAJ_indian_national_highways_desc: In order to develop [RAJ.GetNameDefCap]'s Industry we must begin at the basics with our supply lines.
loc.RAJ_expand_industry_in_hyderabad_desc: Expanding the factories in Hyderabad will improve our industrial capacity immensely without need for much investment.
loc.RAJ_continue_the_five_year_plan_desc: With the first year of The Five Year Plan over, it is time to look back and see how much progress we've made so far, and we must apply the lessons we've learnt onto the next four years.
loc.RAJ_continue_the_five_year_plan_tt: Will multiply all the modifiers in our §YFive year plan§! by §G+30%§!
loc.RAJ_nationalize_tata_group_desc: We must stop depending on Tata Group for our economy. It is time we take over and nationalize the company.
loc.RAJ_focus_on_military_industry_desc: We must prioritize the safety of our country above all else, we must prioritize expanding our military to ensure our survival.
loc.RAJ_nationalize_gun_carriage_agency_desc: The Gun Carriage Agency is one of our primary sources of weaponry, this kind of power cannot be left in the hands of a private corporation, it must be nationalized.
loc.RAJ_eastern_shipyard_construction_desc: To support the growth of a modern naval force we will expand our shipbuilding capacity along the eastern coast. These new shipyards will serve as the backbone of our maritime ambitions.
loc.RAJ_form_ties_with_leftist_parties_desc: We need to gather support from the socialists and communist in the country.
loc.RAJ_secular_rule_alt_desc: The time has come to reclaim our ancestral heartland, forging a new era from the very mountains that birthed our dynasty. By anchoring the empire in the rugged heart of Afghanistan, we secure our dominion and restore the foundation of imperial rule.
loc.RAJ_theocratic_rule_alt_desc: We are the heirs of conquerors, the inheritors of an empire that once shook the world. To honor the Mongol legacy, we must forge unity through strength, bringing the Indian subcontinent under our rule as one people, bound not by faith or origin, but by allegiance to the throne. Before the might of empire, all shall kneel.
loc.RAJ_secret_weapons_desc: We shall once more establish ourselves as the world leader in rocket development and utilize them for the destruction of our enemies.
loc.RAJ_his_majestys_loyal_government_desc: Though calls for independence grow louder in the streets, the machinery of the [ROOT.GetName] remains steadfast. Governed by His Majesty’s appointed Viceroy and upheld by the Indian Civil Service, we shall carry forth the Crown’s interests with discipline and resolve.
loc.RAJ_the_government_of_india_act_desc: The Government of India Act has opened the door to greater self-governance within our provinces. By delegating more authority to local ministries, we can appease moderate voices and strengthen administrative efficiency, all while keeping the Empire's hand firmly on the reins.
loc.RAJ_work_with_local_leaders_desc: By cooperating with influential provincial figures, we can extend our reach without overextending our resources. These leaders understand the needs of their regions and can implement improvements that serve both their people and the interests of the Crown.
loc.RAJ_concessions_to_the_industrialists_de: To stimulate development without draining the imperial purse, we shall offer favorable terms to industrialists willing to invest in regional growth. In return for modest concessions, local leaders will secure loyalty through prosperity.
loc.RAJ_empower_provincial_authorities_desc: Rather than courting private interests, we shall reinforce the administrative powers of local authorities to oversee development directly. By entrusting investment decisions to provincial governance, we ensure loyalty is rewarded with responsibility.
loc.RAJ_confer_with_the_congress_desc: Though many within the administration would prefer silence, ignoring the independence movement entirely risks greater unrest. By entertaining select demands, we may soothe tempers and bolster internal stability.
loc.RAJ_favor_the_muslim_league_desc: By extending greater recognition and political support to the Muslim League, we can cultivate a loyal counterweight to the dominant nationalist movement. Empowering them introduces helpful friction among those who seek to speak for all of India. In unity, there is strength; in division, manageable politics.
loc.RAJ_the_indian_parliament_desc: With growing demands for self-rule, we will establish an Indian Parliament to assume civil authority from the Viceroy. This transition shall grant real autonomy to native leadership, within the framework of the Empire, of course.
loc.RAJ_court_the_princes_desc: The princely states have long stood as pillars of loyalty and order within the subcontinent. By reaffirming their privileges and involving them more directly in governance, we strengthen the imperial foundation against rising populist agitation.
loc.RAJ_the_integrity_of_india_act_desc: To counter the growing threat of sedition and preserve imperial authority, we shall enact the Integrity of India Act. This legislation empowers us to detain agitators, restrict political dissent, and ensure loyal governance across the subcontinent. Unity, after all, must sometimes be enforced.
loc.RAJ_the_jewel_becomes_the_crown_desc: With the fall of the motherland, it is now up to us to take on the burden of leadership within the imperial family. With renewed vigor, we shall utilize the vast resources of [ROOT.GetNameDef] to liberate the heart of the Empire and destroy all who dared tarnish her green and pleasant lands.
loc.RAJ_the_punjab_accord_desc: By recognizing the unique position of the Sikh community and granting limited autonomy in Punjab, we shall reinforce a time-honored bond of loyalty and service. In return, their continued support shall bolster [ROOT.GetNameDef]'s authority in a region of critical importance and ensure that tradition and stability walk hand in hand.
loc.RAJ_the_dominion_of_india_desc: With order firmly reestablished in the subcontinent, it is time to take our place among our imperial siblings as a loyal and self-governing dominion of the Empire. \nLong live the King!
loc.RAJ_curtail_the_zamindars_desc: The entrenched influence of rural landlords has long hindered efforts to modernize governance and extract [ROOT.GetNameDef]'s full potential. By shifting administrative power and resources toward merit-based officials and more accountable institutions, we can weaken their grip while strengthening the foundations of a more responsive state.
loc.RAJ_raise_import_duties_desc: To reduce economic dependency and foster domestic growth, we shall implement higher import duties on foreign goods. This policy will protect local industries, retain capital within our borders, and ensure that [ROOT.GetNameDef] stands on its own feet.
loc.RAJ_imperial_industry_initiative_desc: To secure [ROOT.GetNameDef]’s position as a pillar of the Empire, we must commit to a sweeping expansion of urban industry. The Imperial Industry Initiative will channel resources into heavy manufacturing and skilled labor, thus ensuring our cities become the engines of resilience and renewal in the subcontinent.
loc.RAJ_rural_development_plan_desc: With agricultural reforms underway, we must now bring industry to the countryside. Mechanization, rural infrastructure projects, and small-scale manufacturing will transform villages into engines of production.
loc.RAJ_the_great_recovery_desc: The scars of the Great Depression have lingered across our economy, slowing progress and sapping confidence. But now, with renewed stability and vision, we shall cast off the burdens of stagnation. This shall not be a mere return to normalcy, it is the beginning of a new chapter for [ROOT.GetNameDef].
loc.RAJ_reform_the_agricultural_sector_desc: Decades of inefficient land use and outdated practices have left the [ROOT.GetNameDef]'s agricultural sector vulnerable to disruption. Through targeted reforms, investment in infrastructure, and modern techniques, we can improve yields and create a more resilient food supply.
loc.RAJ_expand_the_zamindari_system_desc: The Zamindari system has long provided a reliable framework for rural governance and revenue collection. By expanding its reach and reaffirming the privileges of loyal landlords, we can ensure local order and administrative efficiency without overextending the central state.
loc.RAJ_crown_commodities_desc: By prioritizing the cultivation of export-oriented cash crops, we can secure a steady flow of revenue and reinforce our economic importance to the Empire. Tea, cotton, jute, and other staples of colonial trade will be the backbone of prosperity in the countryside.
loc.RAJ_rural_mechanization_program_desc: To boost agricultural output and reduce dependency on outdated labor methods, we shall implement a structured program to introduce mechanized farming across the countryside. Tractors, threshers, and irrigation systems will transform rural productivity and lay the groundwork for a modern, self-sufficient economy.
loc.RAJ_the_riches_of_the_raj_desc: Beneath the vast plains and rugged hills of [ROOT.GetNameDef] lie the resources needed to power an empire at war. Steel, oil, and other vital materials will be extracted, refined, and put to use in the defense of the realm.
loc.RAJ_imperial_rail_renewal_act_desc: To ensure the rapid movement of goods, troops, and supplies across the subcontinent, we shall invest in a comprehensive overhaul of [ROOT.GetNameDef]'s rail infrastructure. The Imperial Rail Renewal Act will modernize aging lines, expand logistical capacity, and tie our vast territories together in steel and steam.
loc.RAJ_exploit_the_frontier_desc: Vast resource deposits lie in remote and underutilized regions of the subcontinent and beyond. By expanding operations and asserting greater control over territories such as [BRM.GetNonIdeologyName], we can secure critical materials like tungsten and fuel our growing war machine.
loc.RAJ_overlords_railway_investment_desc: With the groundwork laid for a modern rail system, we shall invite investment from [ROOT.OVERLORD.GetAdjective] industrial and financial interests to further expand and refine the network. Their capital, paired with our growing infrastructure, will create a rail system worthy of the Empire.
loc.RAJ_territorial_development_scheme_desc: To fully harness the economic potential of [ROOT.GetNameDef], we must reassess how land is allocated and utilized. The Territorial Development Scheme will identify underdeveloped regions, clear obstacles to growth, and prepare new zones for industrial expansion.
loc.RAJ_the_empires_workshop_desc: To ensure the Empire’s strength in the face of growing global demands, we shall deepen economic ties between [ROOT.GetNameDef] and [ROOT.OVERLORD.GetNameDef]. Coordinated investment and factory expansion across both territories will transform our shared industrial base into a single, unified engine of production.
loc.RAJ_institute_of_fundamental_research_GO: With support from leading industrialists and scientific minds, we shall establish the Institute of Fundamental Research to pursue advanced theoretical studies. The institute will serve as the nucleus of cutting-edge experimentation, including the study of atomic energy.
loc.RAJ_keep_calm_and_carry_on_desc: In this most trying hour, we shall not falter. [ROOT.GetNameDefCap] will rise as a bastion of strength, forging the tools of war with tireless resolve. Let the furnaces burn and the forges sing, for victory is not born of comfort, but of courage, sweat, and steel.
loc.RAJ_indian_gentleman_officers_desc: To ensure the future and safety of our great Imperial Jewel, it is imperative that we procure loyal men to lead our new [RAJ.GetAdjective] army. These men, through close co-operation with the Imperial authorities, have served [RAJ.GetNameDef] well enough to be enlisted as our most trusted commanders.
loc.RAJ_the_aden_protectorate_desc: The Province of Aden on the Arabian peninsula falls under our jurisdiction. Thus, it is crucial that we ensure its protection in an effort to prove to [ENG.GetNameDef] that [RAJ.GetNameDef] is capable of defending the [ENG.GetAdjective] Empire's interests in the waters of the Middle East.
loc.RAJ_linlithgows_declaration_of_war_desc: As part of the [ENG.GetAdjective] Empire, it is our responsibility to bear arms and join them in their wars. There is no time to waste by begging the Congress Leaders for permission. One must grab the bull by the horns. Draft the declarations and prepare for war with [ENG.GetNameDef]'s enemies.
loc.RAJ_consult_with_congress_leaders_desc: Rather than force our way into joining [ENG.GetNameDef] in her wars, we must use the official avenues to do so. Let us consult with the Congress Leaders and appeal to them with the hopes that they will allow [RAJ.GetNameDef] to enter the war.
loc.RAJ_preemptive_invasion_of_iran_desc: [PER.GetNameDef] borders us to the west, and if not dealt with swiftly, they could provide our enemies with a straight path to [RAJ.GetNameDef] through the Persian Corridor. Such an invasion could certainly draw the ire from those who strive for peace, but if we are successful, then [PER.GetNameDef]'s rich oil fields will be ours for the taking.
loc.RAJ_mobilization_of_the_indian_army_desc: Our numbers are many, and our spirits are emboldened in the defense of our glorious empire. Although it may take time to draw our forces from all corners of the subcontinent, it is crucial that we begin the mobilization of the [RAJ.GetAdjective] army. It is time to stand and fight for [RAJ.GetNameDef] and [ENG.GetNameDef].
loc.RAJ_support_naval_invasions_desc: This war will not only be fought on the land and in the air, but also at sea. Just as it is important to mobilize our ground forces, we must prepare our navy to support our allies' plans for naval invasions.
loc.RAJ_assume_eastern_naval_responsibilitie: There is no doubt in anyone's minds that [JAP.GetNameDef] is stirring trouble in the east. As their plans manifest, it becomes imperative that we prepare our navy to defend [RAJ.GetAdjective] waters. We must appeal to the crown and request that they send [ENG.GetAdjective] navy ships to aid us in our efforts.
loc.RAJ_south_east_asia_command_desc: As tensions rise, there is a growing demand for a centralized command center for South East Asia. We can be the progenitors of such a movement, building a base of operations that we can use to plan our military campaigns on the continent.
loc.RAJ_desert_training_desc: As part of our efforts to improve the skill and effectiveness of our fighting forces, we are able to set up a training regime in and around the Thar desert. This should help acclimatize our troops to arid environments.
loc.RAJ_fortify_el_alamein_desc: El-Alamein is a point of strategic interest when it comes to holding and securing Egypt. The crown would greatly appreciate our efforts in helping to fortify this region and prevent our enemies from getting a foothold in [ENG.GetAdjective] Northern Africa.
loc.RAJ_jungle_training_GOE_desc: In lands as vast as ours, we are fortunate to have great biome diversity to use to our advantage. [RAJ.GetNonIdeologyName], [BRM.GetNonIdeologyName] and Indochina are covered in jungle, and special training is recommended to make our soldiers effective in this dangerous terrain.
loc.RAJ_defense_of_malaya_desc: [MAL.GetNameDef] could be at risk of invasion given its position between the Indian Ocean and the Pacific. As a fellow crown jewel, we must do our part to help defend and fortify the region. We must maintain control of South East Asia.
loc.RAJ_hill_training_desc: As part of our initiative to diversify the training we offer our troops, we must ensure that they are prepared to fight in mountainous terrain, as well as the jungles, deserts and cities.
loc.RAJ_defense_of_burma_desc: [BRM.GetNonIdeologyName] Lies directly to the east of Bengal, with its jungles serving as the last natural barrier to protect [RAJ.GetNonIdeologyName]'s borders from being penetrated from the menace to the east. It is crucial that we mobilize a defensive force in the region, to stand shoulder to shoulder with the [BRM.GetAdjective] and keep the Indian subcontinent firmly in [ENG.GetAdjective] hands.
loc.RAJ_holding_the_gates_of_india_desc: No matter what, we must protect [RAJ.GetNonIdeologyName] from the rampaging invaders to the east. They may come at us with fervor and fury, but we shall stop their unrelenting conquest at the Gates of [RAJ.GetNonIdeologyName]. They shall not pass.
loc.RAJ_free_abyssinia_desc: For too long have we allowed the region of Abyssinia to remain in enemy hands. We will show our worth to the crown by mounting a powerful naval invasion into the Horn of Africa via Aden, to liberate its people from their occupiers.
loc.RAJ_urban_training_desc: Whilst we hope it may not come to this, there is a chance that we must hold back the enemy on the streets of our great cities. We must be prepared to manage such a scenario with specialized urban training.
loc.RAJ_the_defense_of_hong_kong_desc: As pressure in [CHI.GetNonIdeologyName] mounts, the [ENG.GetAdjective] crown worries about the fate of its holdings in Hong Kong. We stand in a prime position to help protect the city from an invasion, and if we are successful, it would garner us favor and approval from the [ENG.GetAdjective] government.

loc.AFG_expand_telegraph_network_desc: [ROOT.GetNonIdeologyName] has fallen behind its neighbors in a myriad of economic metrics. The first step to modernizing our economy is to improve communications between our cities and our neighbors by expanding the telegraph network.
loc.AFG_sugar_processing_desc: Demand for sugar is growing steadily among our people. We should cater to that demand by establishing a sugar factory to process agricultural products into the valuable substance. Not only will demand be satiated, but more industrial employment will be created.
loc.AFG_fruit_packing_desc: The people of [ROOT.GetNonIdeologyName] are capable farmers, we should take advantage of any surplus they produce by packaging it for export. To do so, we must establish more industrial processing facilities.
loc.AFG_clear_malarial_swamps_desc: Malaria remains a blight in many areas of the nation. By clearing the areas in which malaria carrying parasites breed, we can rid the rural population of a historic grievance and claim new land for development.
loc.AFG_infrastructure_construction_desc: Our lack of infrastructure across the nation is holding back economic development, leaving people content to live as their ancestors have done for centuries. Such an outlook is not in the long-term interest of the nation and must be rectified by investing into infrastructure projects.
loc.AFG_expand_karakul_lambskin_industry_des: Karakul lambskin products are one of the few goods currently being exported in large quantities from [ROOT.GetNonIdeologyName]. We could use this as an opportunity to expand our fledgling industrial base by creating factories for the processing and export of such products.
loc.AFG_spinzar_cotton_factory_desc: The Spinzar Cotton Factory in Kunduz is currently one of our most profitable factories, and it's owners are looking to expand their business. Without government support however, it won't be able to grow much beyond its current size. We should endeavor to establish new subsidiaries, and invest in the future of our cotton industry.
loc.AFG_forge_a_national_identity_desc: Our people do not view themselves as Afghans, but rather as part of their individual tribes and nationalities. We should strive to introduce Pashto and Dari as national languages, and some day we may eventually be able to unite the people under a united Afghan national identity.
loc.AFG_constructing_a_national_identity_tt: When the national spirit §Y$AFG_constructing_a_national_identity_idea$§! is removed:\n
loc.AFG_look_to_other_partners_desc: Our trade agreements with the Soviet Union have raised suspicions of them influencing our domestic politics and foreign policy. Such accusations are of course false, but perhaps it would be in our interest to look elsewhere for trade partners.
loc.AFG_look_to_other_partners_tt: Major nations will get an opportunity to invest in [ROOT.GetNameDef], giving us §Gone off-map civilian factory per country that agrees§! in exchange for §Rinfluencing our politics for one year.§!
loc.generic_higher_opinion_tt: \n§YHigher opinion of [ROOT.GetNonIdeologyName] will increase the chance of target nations accepting proposal.§!
loc.AFG_renew_soviet_trade_agreement_desc: Although our ideologies have differed over the years, the [SOU.GetName] has been a good economic partner for our nation. While some fear the risk of [SOU.Adjective] influence in our internal affairs, we see no issue with renewing the trade agreement between our nations.
loc.AFG_salang_pass_desc: The mountainous terrain of [ROOT.GetNonIdeologyName] makes it difficult to develop convenient transportation routes across the country. However, [SOU.GetAdjective] engineers believe they could construct a tunnel through the mountains at Salang. Their government has offered to carry out the construction, in exchange for some strategic concessions.
loc.AFG_75_year_oil_concessions_desc: Geologists in recent years have discovered significant reserves of oil within our territory. However, we lack the industrial capacity to tap them ourselves. Perhaps if we approach one of the major powers with a mutually beneficial agreement, we could extract the oil together.
loc.AFG_75_year_oil_concessions_tt: §YUnlock decisions to extract oil resources from our territory in collaboration with a foreign power.§!
loc.AFG_rail_construction_desc: For the transportation of vast quantities of resources or people, nothing is as efficient as rail. We must therefore establish a railway company to develop and operate a rail network of our own.
loc.AFG_electrification_desc: Innovations in industry, communication and warfare are becoming increasingly reliant on electricity. We must therefore ensure that our nation is capable of taking advantage of new advancements by expanding electrification across [ROOT.GetNonIdeologyName].
loc.AFG_electrification_tt: \n§YElectrification will start to spread outwards from Kabul as time progresses, with one new core state gaining the modifier every second month.§!
loc.AFG_establish_radio_networks_desc: Radio Kabul was established in the 1920s with now antiquated equipment. We should invest in upgrading its broadcasting equipment so that we can ensure the government has a direct line of communication with as much of the population as possible.
loc.AFG_connect_the_cities_desc: While rail will be of great importance to our long-term development, the benefits of a modern highway system between the major cities cannot be overlooked. By creating a ring road connecting the cities, we can finally erode the economic regionalism that has long plagued our economy.
loc.AFG_expand_kabul_university_desc: The need for professional engineers, doctors and teachers can no longer be satiated by sending students abroad for specialist education. Instead, we must invest in our own institutions and raise a new generation of home grown professionals.
loc.AFG_expand_kabul_university_tt: §RExpanding higher education will lead to graduates becoming radicalized unless the economy grows enough to offer them jobs!§!
loc.AFG_kajaki_dam_desc: We should take inspiration from the Tennessee Valley Authority in [USA.GetNameDef] and establish a similar agency for the Helmand river valley. The organization would be tasked with the economic development of the area for the benefit of the national economy. However, we must be wary of provoking our western neighbors if we begin altering the flow of water along the river.
loc.AFG_kajaki_dam_tt: \n§RFailure to negotiate a treaty with [414.OWNER.GetNameDef] via the ensuing event chain may lead to war!§!
loc.AFG_qargha_dam_desc: The more arid regions of the nation lack adequate irrigation, which in turn puts harvests at risk and has the potential to cause famines. However, we can create dams to increase available water for irrigation which may even lead to agricultural surpluses.
loc.AFG_chaki_dam_desc: As demand for electricity increases, we need to ensure that a steady supply is produced. With the help of foreign experts, we may be able to establish a hydro-electric dam on the Chak river which could supply the surrounding area, including Kabul, with electricity for years to come.
loc.AFG_chromite_mines_desc: Chromium is becoming an increasingly sought after resource in the industrialized world. We should begin excavation of our own chromite resources for export and then use the wealth generated to continue our own industrialization program.
loc.AFG_iron_mines_desc: Tin, copper and iron are essential for the production of many modern necessities. If we are to develop into an industrialized nation, we need to develop and secure our own access to such resources. Luckily we have plenty of untapped resources waiting to be exploited.
loc.AFG_truck_factory_desc: In partnership with our [SOU.GetAdjective] benefactors, we have the opportunity to develop our first large scale factory for the production of vehicles. The trucks developed there could satiate domestic demand for such vehicles in industry and the military.
loc.AFG_maintain_quami_desc: The Quami system of levies has been the flagstone of our defense for centuries. Why should we throw away a system rooted in tradition, which will only benefit the urban elite in the capital? Resistance to this latest wave of reform fads is the only logical choice.
loc.AFG_maintain_quami_tt: §YKeep $AFG_quami_category$ decisions and ability to recruit more irregular divisions.§!
loc.AFG_asymmetric_warfare_desc: While our neighbors are content to throw away their heritage in pursuit of industrialization and ever greater armed forces. We shall overcome them through the use of unconventional tactics and superior knowledge of our terrain. Coupled with the determination of our soldiers, we will repel any invading force.
loc.AFG_khyber_pass_riflining_desc: The cottage industries along the Khyber pass have manufactured copies of foreign weaponry for decades. While their weapons lack in quality, they make up for it in quantity. Perhaps it is time we invested in the region and developed a domestic producer of weapons for our armed forces.
loc.AFG_encourage_jezail_production_desc: Jezail's have long been the favored weapon of choice of the Pashtun tribes due to their cheap production, and have been of great use to us during the Anglo-Afghan wars. We should encourage the tribes to keep up this tradition, in order to field a larger levy.
loc.AFG_scavenging_desc: What equipment we cannot produce ourselves often has a habit of turning up here in the hands of foreign aggressors. We should therefore train our forces to recognize and capture valuable military equipment whenever it is available.
loc.AFG_militia_cavalry_desc: [ROOT.GetNameDefCap] is host to a number of horse breeds specifically bred for the rough terrain of the country. These could be utilized in cavalry brigades rather than having to invest in expensive foreign equipment that is prone to break down and require extensive support.
loc.AFG_mountain_training_desc: New technologies and tactics come and go with time, but the mountains and valleys remain unchanged. Rather than scrambling to keep up with our neighbors in technological terms, we should instead focus on utilizing the land around us to gain a tactical advantage.
loc.AFG_cross_border_ties_desc: The nature of our geography means borders are always porous, with families coming and going across them and settling on either side. Over the generations, this has led to strong interpersonal connections in neighboring countries which in a time of crisis, could be taken advantage of.
loc.AFG_cross_border_ties_tt: Unlock §Y$AFG_cross_border_ties_category$§! decisions to annex claimed territory
loc.AFG_approach_foreign_inteligence_service: We sit at the crossroads of great powers and have long been at the mercy of their grand games. If we were to establish our own intelligence service, we could take advantage of our unique situation by playing our neighbors off each other.
loc.AFG_expand_border_guards_desc: We should train the border police in basic warfare so that they may be called upon to take on greater responsibility in times of crisis and reduce the strain on the conventional armed forces.The royal guards represent the elite of our armed forces and have the training and expertise to match. However, concerns over their limited numbers have been raised as our neighbors descend into conflict.
loc.AFG_utilize_cameleers_desc: Our cameleers have been exported far and wide, being employed by the British Empire for travel and supply in treacherous regions of the Great Australian desert. We should employ these skilled laborers to aid our troops in our own lands.
loc.AFG_establish_camelry_regiments_desc: Camels are a resilient animal, and to ensure our army can perform even in deserts and mountains we must adapt. With the aid of camelry we will be able to fight no matter the terrain and in areas our enemies might not.
loc.AFG_adopt_nufus_desc: The centuries-old system raising of irregular forces for the defense of the realm has long since served its purpose and is unlikely to hold up to an incursion by professional enemy forces. As such, we must replace the system with one of formal conscription and training.
loc.AFG_adopt_nufus_tt: §RWill remove $AFG_quami_category$ decisions and prevent recruiting irregular divisions!§!
loc.AFG_mohammed_daoud_khan_available_as_gen: §YMohammed Daoud Khan§! becomes available as a level §Y2§! General
loc.AFG_new_army_desc: While there remains resistance towards our military reforms from the rural population, we must move forward and  institute a large-scale training program for the latest cohort of conscripts.
loc.AFG_expand_royal_guard_desc: The royal guards represent the elite of our armed forces and have the training and expertise to match. However, concerns over their limited numbers have been raised as our neighbors descend into conflict.
loc.AFG_prussians_of_the_orient_desc: Due to our training by foreign officers, and large amounts of surplus [GER.GetAdjective] equipment, the officials in [GER.GetNameDef] have begun to refer to us as the Prussians of the Orient. We should make sure we live up to this title, and stand tall to any who dare oppose us.
loc.AFG_establish_naval_bases_desc: With the establishment of our first naval base to supply ships along our newly liberated coast, we can begin the arduous task of developing our own navy.
loc.AFG_establish_naval_bases_tt: Add §G1§! §YNaval Base§! in a random coastal state
loc.AFG_expand_academy_desc: With the expansion of a more professional army, the need for well trained officers grows too. The development of a national army academy would be a prudent measure to ensure the army has the leadership and expertise they need to protect our borders.
loc.AFG_foreign_military_advisors_desc: In order to train our army to be up to modern standards, it would be quickest to invite advisors from western nations. They will help train the next generation of [ROOT.GetAdjective] men to be fit to fight on the ever evolving battlefield.
loc.AFG_expand_standing_army_desc: In order to defeat our enemies and secure our independence, our army cannot just be effective, it must also be large. We should as such expand the conscription, and recruit more men into our ranks.
loc.AFG_officialize_the_turkish_afghan_defen: Since 1933, Turkish military personnel have aided in educating the next generation of Afghan soldiers. It is time to utilize these connections, request a defensive treaty, in which we would both be obligated to protect each other from foreign aggression.
loc.AFG_purchase_tanks_desc: Our army lacks the firepower to break through tough enemy lines or the speed to make advancements. We must look to the rest of the world and invest in an armored force to alleviate these issues.
loc.AFG_purchase_aircraft_desc: Our armed forces are too vulnerable to attack from the skies. We need to invest in an air force of our own to counter enemy aircraft.
loc.AFG_expand_equipment_purchases_desc: Our armed forces are becoming increasingly reliant on equipment beyond simple rifles and shells. If they are to remain a credible force, we must procure more support equipment as soon as possible.
loc.AFG_increase_air_purchases_desc: Our air force is rapidly developing the capacity to deter or destroy foreign aircraft from entering our airspace. However, we lack the ability to project power to the ground with our aircraft. We should therefore begin investment into our own bomber squadrons.
loc.AFG_naval_academy_desc: Our historic lack of coast means a complete lack of officers with any naval expertise. We must therefore establish a naval academy and try to entice officers from abroad to train the first generation of [AFG.GetAdjective] sailors.
loc.AFG_shipyards_desc: Even if we are not yet ready to develop ships of our own design, any future ships will require maintenance and refit facilities. By establishing a shipyard now, we can ensure that our future vessels will have the facilities they need to operate for decades to come.
loc.AFG_shipyards_tt: Add §G1§! building slot and §G1§! §Y Naval Dockyard§! in a coastal state.
loc.AFG_research_bonus_1_desc: The great powers will only sell us what they consider obsolete and non threatening to their interests in the region. If we are to develop a modern navy capable of deterring those great powers, we should invest in developing designs of our own.
loc.AFG_purchase_destroyers_desc: It would take decades for us to develop the expertise and infrastructure to support the designing and construction of modern warships. A far more pragmatic approach would be to procure mothballed vessels from other nations and retrofit them for our purposes.
loc.AFG_research_bonus_2_desc: Our expertise in developing smaller ships has paid off, and our engineers are now looking to the challenge of developing much larger designs for the navy.
loc.AFG_purchase_capital_ships_desc: Our navy is beginning to shape with the recent acquisition of smaller vessels, however we still lack the naval firepower of larger ships and should begin looking for any we may be able to purchase.
loc.AFG_state_industries_desc: University graduates are becoming radicalized due to a lack of employment that utilizes their skills. To prevent this, we could establish state run industries to employ more of them while also arming our armed forces with domestically produced equipment.
loc.AFG_state_industries_tt: Unlock decisions to establish §YMilitary Industrial Organizations§! and extend the time limit on graduates becoming radicalized.
loc.AFG_ideology_on_the_rise_tt: §R\n\nMajor powers that do not share [THIS.GetNameDef]s ideology may want to invade [ROOT.GetNameDef] if their influence over us gets too high! (If [THIS.GetIdeologyNameWithCaps] is greater than 40%, other powers may attack us!)§!
loc.AFG_ideology_on_the_rise_flipped_tt: §R\n\n[THIS.GetNameDefCap] may want to invade [ROOT.GetNameDef] if other nations gain too much influence over us! (If any ideology except neutrality or [THIS.GetIdeologyNameWithCaps] is greater than 40%, [THIS.GetNameDef] may attack us!)§!
loc.AFG_foreign_influence_tt: Add §Y[PREV.GetIdeologyNameWithCaps] Influence on the Rise§!, which grants (Daily [PREV.GetIdeologyNameWithCaps] Support: §G+0.02§!) for §Y365§! days
loc.AFG_against_kabul_desc: King Zahir and his uncles are usurpers to the throne, their illegitimate regime must be ousted at all costs.
loc.AFG_contact_amanullah_loyalists_desc: The former King, $AFG_amunullah_khan$, never formally conceded the throne to a successor when he was unjustly ousted by the rabble. We must therefore rally those in [AFG.GetNonIdeologyName] who remain loyal to the King and make preparations for his inevitable return.
loc.AFG_remember_the_khost_rebellion_desc: In 1924 the righteous among us rose up against King Amanullah and his western cronies to return the country from the brink of losing its proud identity. It may have been defeated, but its spirit lives on, and now we know now how to overcome Kabul. It is time to return to tradition!
loc.AFG_crown_the_golden_emir_desc: With the domain secured, a new ruler must rise to claim the title of Emir. Having proven himself on the battlefield, it should be no surprise that Mirzali Khan Wazir is the most popular candidate. He will help us reunify Pashtunistan and unite the Islamic World.
loc.AFG_crown_the_bukharan_emir_desc: With the domain secured, a new ruler must rise to claim the title of Emir. Sayyid Mir Muhammad Alim Khan of Bukhara has been in Kabul for quite a few years, and is a perfect candidate if we wish to restore the glory of the great Durrani Empire.
loc.AFG_invite_the_mughal_prince_desc: With the domain secured, a new ruler must rise to claim Timur's mantle. Whether by blood, merit, or sheer force of will, the choice we make will shape the future of our realm. As such, we should invite the Mughal Prince currently residing in India to take our throne.
loc.AFG_unify_the_islamic_world_desc: For far too long have the Muslim states squabbled over insignificant matters, shirking their responsibility for cooperation. The time has finally come for us to extend an invitation to the Muslim states of the world, to join together in a grand alliance.
loc.AFG_unify_the_islamic_world_tt: Gets event §Y[ROOT.GetNameDefCap] invites us to their faction§!
loc.AFG_extend_a_hand_to_tokyo_desc: Thanks to the aid of the [JAP.GetAdjective] forces, we managed to win the fight for Afghanistan. Now that [JAP.GetNameDef] is looking to unite and liberate Asia, it would be prudent for us to once again approach them.
loc.AFG_extend_a_hand_to_tokyo_tt: We will seek to join §Y[JAP.GetNameDef]'s§! faction
loc.AFG_expand_the_madrasas_desc: In order to better control our populace and teach them the ways by which they should live, we should increase funding to the Muslim educational institutions present within our country.
loc.AFG_promote_muslim_work_ethic_desc: Westerners have long bragged of their ‘protestant work ethic’ while ignoring the hard work of the Islamic world. It is time we reminded them that we are every bit their equals in our dedication and expertise.
loc.AFG_rehabilitate_the_saqqawists_desc: The Saqqawists were successful in overthrowing the decadent rule of Amanullah Khan in 1929, but fortune turned against them and they were all but destroyed a few years later. Perhaps the time has come to honor these heroes who fought valiantly to protect our traditional values.
loc.AFG_ulugh_beg_academy_desc: Ulugh Beg once ruled the mighty Timurid empire as Sultan, but also found time to expand our knowledge of astronomy and mathematics. We should honor his legacy by establishing a new university in his name.
loc.AFG_prepare_the_war_industries_desc: Our current industry lacks the capacity for war production. To prevent being overwhelmed by neighboring countries, we must reorient our factories to support our military instead of catering to the demands of the ruling elite. This transition is crucial for our survival.
loc.AFG_revive_the_workshop_of_the_world: Reviving the Workshop of the World
loc.AFG_revive_the_workshop_of_the_world_des: We will emulate our ancestors by modernizing our factories and revitalizing our trade routes. This transformation will establish our economy as a powerhouse competitive with the world's great nations.
loc.AFG_reorganize_the_royal_guard_desc: The Royal Guards are failing to live up to the honor that has been placed upon them. We shall reinvigorate them with a series of reforms and expansion of their ranks. They must come to embody the strength and resolve of [ROOT.GetNameDef].
loc.AFG_reintroduce_heavy_cavalry_desc: Our ancestors repeatedly took their horses and swept into the plains of India and Central Asia, seizing lands and resources when their rulers were weak. As our neighbors become embroiled in conflict, perhaps another such moment is on the horizon.
loc.AFG_reintroduce_war_elephants_desc: While the world scrambles to figure out how to make ever more elaborate motorized monstrosities, we shall utilize tried and true methods to wage war and strike fear into our enemies by reviving the use of war elephants.
loc.AFG_timurid_bureaucracy_desc: Rooted in the legacy of Timur, the Timurid Bureaucracy provides a model of efficient governance and centralized control. Revitalizing this system will strengthen the Emirates administration, ensuring stability and prosperity across its vast territories.
loc.AFG_hone_the_shamshir_desc: The Shamshir, a symbol of strength and defiance, must be sharpened for the battles to come. By modernizing our forces and refining our strategies, we ensure that [ROOT.GetNameDef] is ready to strike decisively when the moment demands.
loc.AFG_restore_herat_desc: In defiance of the old seat of power in Kabul, it is time that the capital be moved to the main residence of the Durrani Empire, Herat. In doing so, we will be able to strengthen our claim to being the successors of this once great empire.
loc.AFG_enforce_the_pashtunwali_desc: Though the scripts of the Pashtunwali may be outdated, they are still necessary to be maintained to ensure Pashtun dominance in internal politics. The most outdated parts of the laws may be adjusted, but it will stay in place for generations to come.
loc.AFG_form_the_khuddamul_furqan_desc: In order to strengthen the legitimacy of our new government, we must found a proper political party under the helm of the Golden Emir. The only acceptable allegiance is to the Khuddamul Furqan, and it is only this party that will bring salvation to the people.
loc.AFG_instate_a_compulsory_jizya_desc: The rights of non-muslims were highly prescriptive under the old administration. It is time to adjust these matters for a modern world, and prove to all of our subjects that we are an enlightened realm.
loc.AFG_raise_lashkar_regiments_desc: The Faqir's fellow resistance fighters in the Pastun areas of the British Raj branded themselves as Lashkar. Now that he rules [ROOT.GetNameDef], it may be high time to officially establish similar regiments under the states service.
loc.AFG_support_nort_west_frontier_rebels_de: The Pashtun rebels in the [RAJ.GetAdjective] North West Frontier are still fighting bravely against their oppressors, despite the Faqir having gone to [ROOT.GetNameDef]. We should step in and protect them, even if it may mean war with those currently claiming the area for themselves.
loc.AFG_occupy_peshawar_tt: §RThis may lead to war with the owner of [442.GetName]!§!
loc.AFG_occupy_waziristan_tt: §RThis may lead to war with the owner of [987.GetName]!§!
loc.AFG_appraoch_anti_communist_theologians_: There are many muslim scholars and theologians who agree that communism is a scourge on our civil society. Sadly, [SOV.GetNameDef] is currently imposing such a vile ideology on our brothers in Central Asia, and we will have to do everything in our power to put a stop to this foolishness.
loc.AFG_unite_pashtunistan_desc: The ultimate goal of the Faqir's campaign was always for the independence of a Pashtun state in the lands of the British Raj. Now however, he is presented with the chance to establish a Pashtun state outside of said borders, and conquer the remaining regions. Long live Pashtunistan, long live the Emir!
loc.AFG_form_the_turkestan_legion_desc: There are many who wish to fight against communism even on the global stage. We should organize Turkic anti-communist volunteer forces who will fight to the bitter end against the forces that oppose Islam.
loc.AFG_form_the_turkestan_legion_tt: Unlock §Y$AFG_turkestan_legion_cat$§! decisions to recruit divisions from across the Turkic world.
loc.AFG_proclaim_a_new_caliphate_desc: Following the dissolution of the Ottoman Empire, no new caliphate has been declared. In order to lead the lost and misguided, we must take up this new mantle, and live up to the legacy of the Rashiduns of the past.
loc.AFG_proclaim_a_new_caliphate_tt: Gains §YTake claimed state§! war goal against every country occupying states this focus gives you claims on
loc.AFG_proclaim_a_new_caliphate_2_tt: Unlocks decisions to §YIntegrate§! claimed states that we control
loc.AFG_integrate_the_basmachi_movement_desc: Up until 1934 the Basmachi struggled against [SOV.GetAdjective] forces to liberate Central Asia from their tyrannic rule. Though their movement has since been largely crushed, some of their leaders managed to escape. We should endeavor to establish contact with these freedom fighters, and invite them to our court.
loc.AFG_proclaim_the_second_afghan_empire_de: In 1747 Ahmad Shah Durrani united the Afghan tribes and organized them into an empire. At its peak, it ruled over much of central Asia, Eastern India and Iran. It stood alongside the Ottoman Empire as the most significant Islamic empire of the second half of the 18th century, and we must reclaim that legacy!
loc.AFG_can_core_once_controlled_tt: Unlocks decisions to core the claimed states once captured
loc.AFG_return_to_delhi_desc: Delhi was once the seat of the Sultan, and is the home to the Red Fort in which our splendorous Peacock Throne was located. We will now march on the city, and reclaim our long lost capital, and thus live up to the Mughal Emperors of old.
loc.AFG_reclaim_moghulistan_desc: Moghulistan, one of the Chagatai Khanates, was one of the successors to the Great Mongol Empire. As a new state seeking to claim the same glory that they once held, it might be prudent to take these lands for ourselves.
loc.AFG_ally_the_sikhs_desc: The Sikhs are an important religious minority on the Indian subcontinent and are fierce warriors. We should use their aid for conquering the region for ourselves.
loc.AFG_ally_the_brahui_khanate_desc: The Khanate of Kalat was an important ally of ours in the later years of the Durrani Empire, and greatly aided in our victories against the Maratha Confederation. We should make contact with them once again, and strike down the successors to the Marathas!
loc.AFG_the_echoes_of_panipat_desc: The Third Battle of Panipat still echoes in the memories of everyone on the Indian subcontinent. There, we shattered the Maratha forces and established our dominance over north-west India. It is time that we do so again, and strike down the insolent heirs to the Maratha Confederacy!
loc.AFG_the_conquerors_of_persia_desc: [PER.GetNameDefCap], a land of immense wealth and history, once stood as a rival to the empire. By bringing it under our rule, we reaffirm our dominance, secure vital western territories, and solidify the empire's place as the true inheritor of imperial grandeur.
loc.AFG_reclaim_transoxiana_desc: The old lands of Transoxiana once belonged to the Timurid Empire, of which we are the heirs. We must reclaim these lands, lest our legacy be tainted by weakness and indecision!
loc.AFG_rebuild_the_silk_road_desc: The Silk Road once brought wealth and culture to the Empire. By restoring this historic trade network, we reclaim our place at the center of global commerce, enriching the empire and fostering prosperity across its vast domains.
loc.AFG_restore_the_timurid_empire_desc: The banners of Timur fly once more, and the empire that once struck fear into the hearts of sultans and kings has risen from the ashes of history. Our rule stretches across the lands once shaped by his conquests, binding East and West under a single dominion. Let the world take heed—the Timurids have returned, and this time, we shall not fade into the past.
loc.AFG_the_crown_and_the_world_desc: The Empire's destiny is to rise as the unrivaled global superpower. By expanding our influence, advancing our strength, and asserting our dominance, we will secure our place as the ultimate ruler of the modern world.
loc.AFG_the_amu_darya_plan_desc: The Emperor has drawn up plans and made contact with those in his old homeland who wish to escape [SOV.GetAdjective] rule. First, our campaign of liberation must be carefully planned, and only after that can we attack [SOV.GetNameDef].
loc.AFG_reclaim_the_emperors_lost_domain_des: The time has finally come. With the current world situation being as it is, there is no better time to strike against [SOV.GetNameDef]. We will liberate all of Central Asia, once and for all!
loc.AFG_secure_army_support_desc: There remains a number of officers in the armed forces who were appointed by or served under $AFG_amunullah_khan$. With the right incentives, they could be coerced into supporting his return to the throne.
loc.AFG_secure_army_support_tt: §YMore army divisions will join our side in the coming civil war.§!
loc.AFG_contact_rural_loyalists_desc: The [AFG.GetAdjective] elite are easy enough to bribe or influence. The average [AFG.GetAdjective] on the other hand has little interest in material trinkets or political promises. However, by appealing to their traditional values and grievances, we may yet sway them to our cause.
loc.AFG_contact_rural_loyalists_tt: §YMore Pashtun militia divisions will join our side in the coming civil war.§!
loc.AFG_request_german_support_desc: $AFG_amunullah_khan$ has long admired [GER.GetNonIdeologyName] and has garnered a number of high ranking supporters in its government. Perhaps they would support the King's return in exchange for a friendly regime in the region.
loc.AFG_request_german_support_tt: If §Y[GER.GetNonIdeologyName]§! accepts our proposal, they will supply us with weapons and send volunteers to aid us when the civil war begins. §Y[GER_oskar_von_nidermayer.GetName]§! will join us as a general.
loc.AFG_request_japanese_support_tt: If §Y[JAP.GetNonIdeologyName]§! accepts our proposal, they will supply us with weapons and send volunteers to aid us when the civil war begins.
loc.AFG_political_events_53_tt: §Y[GER.GetNonIdeologyName] will supply us with weapons and send volunteers to aid us when the civil war begins.§!
