loc.IRQ_expand_membership_desc: While some scoffed at the notion of our federation, others looked on in awe at our accomplishments. Perhaps it is time to expand membership to those wise enough to realize that we are stronger together.
loc.IRQ_expand_membership_tt: Unlock §Y$hashemite_federation_cat$§! decisions to invite members to become your puppets.
loc.IRQ_restore_al_andalus_desc: The Spanish may think themselves the masters of Iberia, but long before their nation was established it was Al Andalus. Returning it to the Islamic world will be a defeat the Europeans will never forget.
loc.IRQ_promote_kurdish_culture_desc: The Kurdish people are dispersed across multiple nations, but our culture binds us together regardless of where we live. We must promote and protect that heritage before it is dismantled by those who govern us.
loc.IRQ_kurdish_democratic_desc: Kurdish rights are being trampled on everyday by the Arab majority of [IRQ.GetNameDef]. It is time we established our own political movement with the objective of securing a free and independent nation for our people.
loc.IRQ_kurdish_socialist_desc: [SOU.GetNameDefCap] longs for a means to undermine western domination of the Middle East. Perhaps they would be receptive to aiding us in our struggle against the [IRQ.GetAdjective] government, and by extension the [ENG.GetAdjective].
loc.IRQ_kurdish_revolt_desc: The moment has come to declare our independence from [IRQ.GetNonIdeologyName] and to create a truly free nation for the Kurdish people.
loc.IRQ_kurdish_revolt_tt: We will declare independence from the §YIraqi State§!, leading us into a §RWar of Independence§! against them.
loc.IRQ_kurdish_language_desc: With our new found independence, we can finally begin creating an education system that is centered around Kurdish culture and language.
loc.IRQ_kurdish_industry_desc: To prevent ourselves being swallowed up by our stronger neighbors, we must develop an industrial base of our own.
loc.IRQ_kurdish_oil_desc: Oil deposits have been tapped in recent years across our territory, but the wealth they generated was siphoned away from the area. Now we may finally establish our own oil industry and use the wealth for our own people.
loc.IRQ_kurdish_form_the_peshmerga_desc: While our rebellion was successful in crushing the Iraqi military, it may not be so lucky in future. We shall therefore establish a national army with real military training and modern equipment to deter a potential conflict from even occurring.
loc.IRQ_effectivize_the_production_line_desc: For us to secure our independence in the future, one-off efforts will not be enough. We must therefore enact measures to make sure that we continuously improve over time.
loc.IRQ_kurdish_women_in_military_desc: The antiquated view that women must be kept away from conflict must be eliminated if we are to develop a robust military capable of standing up to our neighbors.
loc.IRQ_kurdish_support_resistance_desc: While the people within our borders enjoy true freedom, there remain far too many of our siblings trapped under the rule of foreign powers. We must support them in their attempts to break free.
loc.IRQ_kurdish_reject_ankara_treaty_desc: The treaty of Ankara destroyed earlier attempts at establishing a nation for the Kurdish people. We must make clear to the world that we reject the borders established by that treaty and that we will not rest until the Kurdish people are united.
loc.IRQ_further_ussr_support_desc: Early in our journey towards freedom we relied upon [SOV.GetAdjective] help for success. Reliance upon others is not something that we had initially aspired to, however, if they can be persuaded to regard us as equals and comrades, this relationship could yet still prove fruitful.
loc.IRQ_support_from_skies_above_desc: Given the environment surrounding us, to rely solely upon infantry and ground borne units would be unwise. Though an effort to establish an air force will likely come with a large price tag, it as a measure that we must take.
loc.IRQ_support_from_skies_above_tt: Being in a faction with §Y[SOV.GetNameWithFlag]§! and them having §YClose Air Support§! planes will grant §Y100 Close Air Support§! planes to §Y[ROOT.GetNameWithFlag]§!
loc.IRQ_support_from_the_mountains_desc: With several harsh mountain ranges surrounding us training and equipment tailored to the purpose of fighting in these regions will be of great aid. The initial cost may not be a deterrent.
loc.IRQ_kurdish_attack_turkey_desc: The [TUR.GetAdjective] actively opposes the Kurdish people within their borders, robbing them of their heritage. This can no longer be tolerated, even if it means liberating our people by force.
loc.IRQ_kurdish_attack_iran_desc: The [PER.GetAdjective] regime is a threat to our people. Only through the forceful liberation of the Kurds within their borders and the defeat of the [PER.GetAdjective] military by our hands can we secure a future for our people.
loc.IRQ_kurdish_united_desc: Through great hardship and struggle, we have finally united the Kurdish people under our rule. No matter what comes now, we stand as one united people.
loc.RAJ_re_establish_the_khyber_rifles_desc: We shall Re-Establish the Khyber Rifle militia to defend our rugged terrain, and maybe we can learn something from them as well.
loc.IRQ_invite_oil_mission_desc: Our leverage is in black gold - and our newfound friends need all they can get. A small concession now could mean a much greater gain in the future if the war develops to our advantage.
loc.IRQ_invite_oil_mission_ctt: We will offer §Y[GER.GetNameDef]§! rights to our §YOil§! in §Y[676.GetName]§! in exchange for:
loc.SSB_the_saadabad_pact_desc: We have nothing to lose and everything to gain by remaining friendly with our neighbors. The idea of a treaty formalizing our friendship has been lobbed around on occasion, and it is high time for us to take the initiative and make sure this friendship is codified in a treaty.
loc.SSB_military_cooperation_desc: Facing the growing threat of the great game ending in our subjugation by a major power, military collaboration within the Saadabad Pact has never been more vital. If we fail to unite our defenses, we risk being overwhelmed individually.
loc.SSB_economic_cooperation_desc: With the looming threat of military titans from all directions, the need for economic cooperation between the Saadabad pact is becoming increasingly clear. We must open up our markets to each other and lower our tariffs, lowering our dependency on world powers.
loc.SSB_expand_road_and_rail_connections_des: With the Saadabad pact becoming stronger and stronger, it is only inevitable that we construct a railway from Istanbul to Kabul, binding our infrastructure together.
loc.SSB_integration_of_our_infrastructure_de: With tensions around the globe rising, and us surrounded by superpowers from every direction, a simple economic and military pact is no longer enough. We must complete a full integration of our infrastructure and lift all tariffs between our nations, and pool our resources together.
loc.SSB_joint_military_exercises_desc: We will begin unifying our military training process and work together to lower the barrier between our militaries, creating a semi-unified Saadabad Army.
loc.SSB_coordinate_military_production_desc: Gone are the great days of empire and dominance, we have become weak compared to the rest of the world. But we are no longer alone, we now stand together unified by the Saadabad Pact. Together, we can rise again, and take our place as rulers of this region.
loc.SSB_expand_turkeys_military_infrastructu: [TUR.GetNameDefCap] is full of mountains, and as a result the [TUR.GetAdjective] army is well versed in Mountaineer combat. Sharing this information and technology with the pact is beneficial to everyone.
loc.SSB_expand_afghanistans_military_infrast: [AFG.GetNonIdeologyName] army has plenty of experience with desert combat, and knowledge on how to handle rough terrain. All member states could benefit greatly from this information.
loc.SSB_expand_iraqs_military_infrastructure: In order to stop being dependent on stronger nations, we must expand our own resource production to ensure trade happens within our borders when possible, improving our self sustainability.
loc.SSB_expand_irans_military_infrastructure: We need to expand our military industrial capacity across the union, and everyone must play their part. A new equipment factory is to be constructed in Iran.
loc.SSB_expand_turkish_chromium_deposits_des: Our dependence on world powers is growing too strong and poses a strong risk we cannot afford. We must expand our chromium deposits to ensure we will be self-sustaining on that front.
loc.SSB_expand_iranian_oil_fields_desc: Our dependence on world powers is growing too strong and poses a strong risk we cannot afford. We must expand our oil well infrastructure to ensure we will be self-sustaining on that front.
loc.SSB_form_the_saadabad_alliance: A proposal of a total alliance
loc.SSB_form_the_saadabad_alliance_desc: The Saadabad Pact started off as a simple non aggression pact. It has grown to be much more than that, with joint military and economic development, and with our resources pooled together, it is time we finally form an official Saadabad Alliance.
loc.SSB_combined_arms_desc: With an alliance formalized, it is time to the final step in unifying our militaries and ensuring we can defend each other.
loc.SSB_saadabad_research_cooperation_desc: With an alliance formalized, the logical next step is to group together our research and scientific capabilities and form a unified Science Committee.
loc.SSB_is_leader_tt: Is Leader of the Saadabad Pact
loc.SSB_basic_available_trigger_tt: Is not at war with any Saadabad Pact Member
loc.SSB_is_in_faction_tt: Is a member of the Saadabad Alliance
loc.SSB_accept_tt: We will enter a non-aggression pact with every nations that accepts the Saadabad Pact. We will gain access to a joint focus tree with the other members to help achieve shared goals.
loc.SSB_savak_protect_us_desc: SAVAK is doing a great job protecting our great nation through counter intelligence, we have the opportunity to offer protection to the rest of the pact by sharing our counter-intelligence knowledge, benefitting our allies at nearly no cost to ourselves.
loc.SSB_berlin_baghdad_railway_into_iran_afg: Joint Trade Through the Berlin–Baghdad Railway

The Berlin-Baghdad Railway is a core pillar of [IRQ.GetAdjective] trade and economy. We have an opportunity to connect this railway with the Ankara-Kabul railway and allow the other signatory nations to trade through it.
loc.SSB_baghlan_sugar_factory_branches: New Branches for the Baghlan Sugar Company
loc.SSB_baghlan_sugar_factory_branches_desc: The Baghlan Sugar Company is currently only constructing factories in [AFG.GetNonIdeologyName]. We could allow for new factories to be built anywhere within Saadabad countries rather than just [AFG.GetNonIdeologyName], allowing for mutual economic growth.
loc.SSB_chromium_tt: Imports resources from [TUR.GetName], adding §Y10§! £GFX_resources_strip|6 in the §Ycapital§!.
loc.SSB_chromium_2_tt: Imports resources from the other pact members adding:\n§Y4§! £GFX_resources_strip|1, §Y5§!£GFX_resources_strip|4, §Y6§!£GFX_resources_strip|2, §Y6§!£GFX_resources_strip|5 directly into the §Ycapital§!.
loc.SSB_oil_tt: Imports resources from [PER.GetName], adding §Y10§! £GFX_resources_strip|1 in the §Ycapital§!.
loc.SSB_oil_2_tt: Imports resources from the other pact members adding:\n§Y4§! £GFX_resources_strip|4, §Y5§!£GFX_resources_strip|2, §Y6§!£GFX_resources_strip|4, §Y6§!£GFX_resources_strip|6 directly into the §Ycapital§!.
loc.SSB_faction_invite_tt: We will invite Saadabad signatory countries with the §YNon-Aligned§! ideology to our new faction.
loc.RAJ_constitution_for_the_masses_desc: The People's Republic cannot rest on old imperial law.\nA new constitution must reflect the will of the workers, the farmers, and the landless — not the whims of monarchs or colonial governors.
loc.RAJ_founding_of_the_peoples_republic_des: We have overthrown the old order.\nNow begins the task of building a new one — forged by the people, for the people, and sustained by revolution.
loc.RAJ_agrarian_socialism_desc: The revolution begins in the fields.\nLet the land return to those who till it, and let the villages govern themselves in the name of equality and justice.
loc.RAJ_urban_industrialism_desc: The future lies not in the pastures, but in the factories.\nOnly through rapid industrial development can we secure the revolution and prepare for the battles ahead.
loc.RAJ_urban_industrialism_tt: This will alter the five year plan to be more geared towards Industrial Expansion, giving §G+10%§! Building Speed
loc.RAJ_urban_industrialism_tt2: This will alter the five year plan to be more geared towards Agrarian Socialism, giving:
loc.RAJ_land_of_the_tillers_desc: The landlords are gone, but the struggle remains.\nWe will redistribute the land and break the last chains of feudalism — plot by plot, village by village.
loc.RAJ_focus_on_the_countryside_desc: Our strength lies in the millions who call the soil home.\nLet us invest in them, arm them, and organize them — the revolution belongs to the villages.
loc.RAJ_decentralize_the_party_desc: Authority should not flow from offices in Indraprastha.\nLet the people guide the revolution through local councils and rural soviets.
loc.RAJ_industrialize_the_ganges_desc: The Ganges has fed us for centuries.\nNow it will power our machines, fuel our furnaces, and arm our armies.
loc.RAJ_comrades_of_the_city_desc: The workers of the cities are the vanguard.\nWith education, tools and unity, they shall lead the Republic into modernity.
loc.RAJ_central_comittee_authority_desc: Discipline is strength.\nThe Central Committee will oversee all aspects of governance, ensuring that the revolution does not stray into chaos.
loc.RAJ_reorganize_the_five_year_plan_toward: The current pace of industrialization is insufficient.\nWe must prioritize heavy industry and steel output if we are to defend our revolution.
loc.RAJ_invite_soviet_industrial_experts_des: The Soviets have experience in building an industrial base from nothing.\nLet us learn from their model and accelerate our own transformation.
loc.RAJ_planned_economy2_desc: The market has no place in the revolution.\nEvery resource, every laborer, and every factory must serve the five-year plan.
loc.RAJ_the_red_curtain_falls_over_asia: The Red Curtain Falls Over Asia
loc.RAJ_the_red_curtain_falls_over_asia_desc: We have secured our homeland.\nNow it is time to carry the flame of revolution to our neighbors by word, by pamphlet or by gun.
Unlocks decisions to spread a communist revolution across Asia
loc.RAJ_red_punjab_operation_desc: Our capital is vulnerable towards foreign aggression. We must increase its security zone
loc.RAJ_secure_rajahsthan_desc: The deserts of Rajasthan must not become a base for a counter-revolution.\nWe will bring the state into our fold.
loc.RAJ_strike_eastern_pakistan_desc: The eastern wing of [PAK.GetName] is isolated and unstable.\nNow is the time to strike, before they can gain a proper foothold.
loc.RAJ_arm_the_peasantry_desc: The revolution must reach every field.\nWe will distribute arms to loyal rural militias, ensuring that no village stands defenseless against reaction.
loc.RAJ_every_man_a_gun_desc: In the People's Republic, all citizens are soldiers.\nWe will standardize training and arm the population en masse, turning the nation itself into a fortress.
loc.RAJ_every_man_a_leader_desc: True revolutionary strength comes not from orders, but from initiative.\nWe will train local commanders and militia leaders to act decisively, without waiting for permission.
loc.RAJ_defenders_of_the_revolution_desc: They are not soldiers. They are guardians of an idea.\nWe will elevate our most disciplined and loyal fighters into an elite corps, defenders of both soil and ideology.
loc.RAJ_education_for_the_masses_desc: Without knowledge, revolution decays into tyranny.\nLiteracy, political education, and scientific training will be brought to every village and factory.
loc.RAJ_break_the_zamindars_desc: The landlords are the skeleton of the old regime.\nWe will dismantle their estates, seize their land, and scatter their power to the wind.
loc.RAJ_planned_but_decentralized_desc: We will retain economic planning, but grant local collectives autonomy.\nEfficiency through ideology, not bureaucracy.
loc.RAJ_socialist_self_reliance_desc: We will not depend on capitalist imports or imperialist advisors.\nIndia will feed itself, arm itself, and stand alone if it must.
loc.RAJ_quality_training_desc: Quantity alone does not win wars.\nWe will standardize our training programs, improve officer instruction, and elevate the professionalism of our armed forces.
loc.RAJ_iron_will_indoctrination_desc: Strength is not only in the body — it is in belief.\nWe will instill absolute discipline, ideological clarity, and an unbreakable will to fight in every soldier.
loc.RAJ_purge_the_reactionaries_desc: There can be no compromise with the old world.\nEnemies of the revolution, saboteurs, and counter-revolutionary elements will be rooted out.
loc.RAJ_stopping_the_japanese_threat_into_ce: Stop the Japanese Threat in Central Asia

Japan's ambitions do not end at China's borders. Their eyes now turn toward Central Asia, a potential springboard for further imperial expansion.\nWe must act swiftly. By reinforcing our eastern frontier we will stop the tide of conquest before it reaches the steppes and beyond.
loc.AFG_mohammad_zahir_shah_ns_desc: King Zahir Shah ascended to the throne following the death of his father in 1933. However, due to his young age and lack of a political base of his own, the King’s uncles hold the real power in government, leaving him as little more than a figurehead. Zahir Shah will have to decide whether to bide his time and or quickly oust his uncles from office if he is to pursue any agenda of his own.
loc.AFG_subsistence_economy_modifier_desc: The majority of the population live rural lives, producing only enough food for themselves and their families to see out the harsh winter months. They have little interest in changing their way of life to accommodate sprawling profit generating industries and are unlikely to change that mindset regardless of who supposedly holds power in Kabul.
loc.AFG_pashtunwali_desc: The Pashtun people make up the largest and most politically powerful proportion of the population. A significant proportion of Pashtuns live by the traditional code of ethics and rules known as the Pashtunwali. This has made it difficult for governments to maintain power, let alone make reforms, when they appear to be at odds with the traditional code.
loc.AFG_economic_regionalism_desc: The various regions of Afghanistan lack strong cohesion with the national government or economy due to a lack of suitable infrastructure. This makes sharing economic burdens or gains outside of the respective regions difficult and contributes to their ongoing isolation.
loc.AFG_turkish_military_mission_desc: Since 1933, Turkish military personnel have aided in educating the next generation of Afghan soldiers. Perhaps in time, this arrangement could be expanded upon to bring our great nations closer together.
loc.AFG_democratic_influence_desc: Due to opening up our nation to foreign investment, other countries are using this as an opportunity to influence our politics.
loc.AFG_communism_influence_desc: Due to opening up our nation to foreign investment, other countries are using this as an opportunity to influence our politics.
loc.AFG_fascism_influence_desc: Due to opening up our nation to foreign investment, other countries are using this as an opportunity to influence our politics.
loc.AFG_neutral_influence_desc: Due to opening up our nation to foreign investment, other countries are using this as an opportunity to influence our politics.
loc.AFG_placated_graduates_desc: By expanding the civil service, we have managed to absorb much of the unemployed graduates who would have otherwise become radicalized.
loc.AFG_expanded_education_desc: An increased education budget has led to a swell in teaching opportunities in a greatly expanded education facilities.
loc.AFG_communist_graduates_desc: After graduating, a substantial number of university graduates have become radicalized due to the lack of employment opportunities that utilize their acquired skills.
loc.AFG_republic_idea_desc: Our new republic will offer our people greater freedom and equality than anything that has come before. With increased stability, we can now turn our attention to developing education and the economy.
loc.AFG_counter_elite_on_the_rise_desc: Recent political reforms have created a glut of unconventional thinkers in academia and politics to implement their ideas.
loc.AFG_look_to_the_past_modifier_desc: The people yearn for change and a return to political systems that respect their traditional values. Together they may yet overcome the powers of Kabul.
loc.AFG_reviving_the_workshop_of_the_world: Reviving the Workshop of the World
loc.AFG_crushing_the_heirs_of_the_marathas: Crushing the Heirs of the Marathas
loc.IRQ_golden_square_desc: The Golden Square, a clique of high ranking Iraqi military officers, remains a threat to the stability of the nation. Their sympathies lie with the anti-British regimes of Europe and they have pinned their hopes on them being able to aid in shaking off the yoke of British influence when the opportunity arises.
loc.IRQ_anglo_iraqi_treaty_desc: Although renegotiated in 1930, the Anglo-Iraqi treaty remains a one sided agreement that leaves Iraq a de facto client state of the British Empire. The treaty gives preferential resource rights to Iraq’s oil to the British and allows them to utilize military facilities across the country. This continues to cause massive dissent among the Iraqi people who yearn for real independence. Any government that comes to power will have to decide whether to renegotiate the treaty again, or tear it up and risk the wrath of the British military.
loc.IRQ_agrarian_society_desc: Iraq's industry revolves around its agricultural sector, and the conservative leadership in the region has had no interest in developing and industrializing the land. Proper time and effort will need to be dedicated in order to solve the issues in the state.
loc.IRQ_state_company_for_iron_and_steel: State Company For Iron and Steel
loc.IRQ_royal_army_modifier_desc: Established in 1921 under the watchful eyes of the [ENG.GetAdjective], the Iraqi Army has served as a deterrent to aggression from neighboring states. However, the senior officers of the military long for an opportunity to expand and modernize their forces in order to not only deter neighbors, but dominate them.
loc.IRQ_al_muthanna_club_idea_desc: The Al-Muthanna Clubs are a powerful force in Iraqi society, promoting Arab nationalism and anti-imperialist sentiment. While they inspire unity and pride among Iraq’s youth, their radical rhetoric and influence on politics risk deepening divisions and destabilizing the fragile state.
loc.IRQ_appeasing_the_local_tribes_idea: Investing in Local Tribes and Villages
loc.IRQ_river_navy_desc: We have the biggest river navy of any country in the region, delaying or even preventing enemy incursions into our lands. While it does not hold a candle to ocean going navies it is a key in keeping our country safe.
loc.PER_anglo_iranian_oil_ns_desc: Formally known as the Anglo-Persian Oil Company, the AIOC was founded by [ENG.GetNameDef] in 1909 following the discovery of a significantly sized oil field in Masjed Soleiman. Many in [PER.GetNameDefCap] feel this company is taking advantage of our nation's resources and workforce, and have not fulfilled the many promises they agreed upon.
loc.PER_rural_feudalism_ns_desc: Feudalism is an outdated system of structuring society around the holding of land in exchange for service and labor. Despite being a medieval concept, it is still in play within many of the rural regions of [PER.GetNameDef].
loc.PER_islamic_traditions_ns_desc: Traditionally, Iran has been following Islam for generations. It is considered the state religion and that which the majority of the population follows. There are those in government who seek to secularize religion and state, however doing so will be a monumental task and come with much pushback.
loc.PER_secularized_state_idea_desc: Under the Pahlavi dynasty, it has been decreed that in order to stand with the other great nations of the world, then [PER.GetNameDef] needs to modernize. This includes separating religion and state. People can still practice Islam, however it will no longer have sway in our nation's politics.
loc.PER_unification_initiative_idea_desc: It is no secret that our nation is partially fragmented. Our rule is threatened by potential rebellions from the Kurds and the Azerbaijanis, as well as from within our own government. The Unification Initiative will serve to eradicate these threats and secure our hegemony over [PER.GetNameDef].
loc.PER_azerbaijan_resistance_idea_desc: [PER.GetNameDefCap] encompasses some territory that once used to belong to the Azerbaijani people. As such, there is a significant diaspora of people who are unhappy with our rule. In the years prior, our government was able to crush a number of rebellions from this region of [PER.GetNameDef], but the rebellious sentiment remains.
loc.PER_kurdistan_resistance_idea_desc: [PER.GetNameDefCap] encompasses some territory that once used to belong to the Kurdish people. As such, there is a significant diaspora of people who are unhappy with our rule. In the years prior, our government was able to crush a number of rebellions from this region of [PER.GetNameDef], but the rebellious sentiment remains.
loc.PER_modernizing_iran_idea_desc: Modernizing [PER.GetNameDef] is crucial if we are to stand side by side with the great nations of this world. By running this initiative, it is a sign that we are dedicating ourselves to improving the infrastructure of our great nation, and pledging to improve the lives of its citizens.
loc.PER_a_modern_iran_idea_desc: After significant investments and effort, we have finally achieved our goals of a modern [PER.GetName]
loc.PER_adult_literacy_idea_desc: Literacy in their own language is one of the most crucial ways in which people can feel liberated and empowered. After funding a nationwide campaign to get adults back into education programs, we should see an increase in the development of [PER.GetNameDef] for a period of time.
loc.PER_trans_iranian_railway_idea_desc: The Trans-Iranian Railway is set to be one of our greatest achievements in the realm of engineering within our country. By focusing our efforts in constructing this intra-national railroad, we will be able to increase our mobilization efforts in times of war.
loc.PER_feat_of_engineering_idea_desc: At long last, we have completed the Trans-Iranian Railway. We have managed to snake this crucial lifeline through our rugged terrain to ensure that our cities stay well connected. We should be proud of this fine example of [PER.GetAdjective] engineering.
loc.PER_white_revolution_idea_desc: Aggressive reforms are required in order to speed up the modernization of our country. The White Revolution, or the Shah and the People revolution, shall serve to bring [PER.GetNameDef] alongside the likes of the great nations to the west.
loc.PER_price_stabilization_idea_desc: For too long have the owners of factories and large chain businesses been unreasonably profiteering from their workers and customers. We should strive to stabilize the prices throughout [PER.GetNameDef] to fix the price of goods nationwide.
loc.PER_food_for_all_idea_desc: Famine has been an issue in our country for too long. After rolling out a new program that ensures all of our citizens have access to basic food, we can avoid ever falling into such a dark pit of suffering ever again.
loc.PER_tehran_power_grid_idea_desc: With the establishment of a new series of Power Plants in Tehran, we continue to modernize our nation through increased electricity coverage.
loc.PER_metropolitan_iran_idea_desc: We have successfully expanded the [PER.GetAdjective] metropole to be more than just the confines of Tehran. Our cities grow and flourish due to our vast modernization efforts. This is truly a glorious day!
loc.PER_oil_baron_idea_desc: Our country is absolutely swimming in oil, particularly after the efforts we have taken to remove the [ENG.GetAdjective] influence over our resources. What do we do with all this oil then? Hoard it for ourselves.
loc.PER_future_of_war_idea_desc: There is no denying the fact that the tank is a symbol of the future of warfare. By drawing our resources into developing our armor technology, we have successfully prepared ourselves to participate in a modern war.
loc.PER_military_excellency_idea_desc: We have ultimately decided to focus on rigid and professional training when it comes to our standing army. At the end of the day, well disciplined troops will win the battle. Quality over quantity!
loc.PER_foreign_retraining_idea_desc: By reaching out to foreign officers to come and train our troops, we have taken the first steps necessary to improving our currently poorly trained and disorganized army.
loc.PER_motorization_investments_idea_desc: The investments we have made into developing our motor arms industry will pay off when our troops fly across the battlefields with speed and precision.
loc.PER_desert_training_idea_desc: After many long drills and marching across the sandy plains, we have finally created an effective training program designed to give our troops a better chance of surviving in desert battlefields.
loc.PER_conscription_idea_desc: Desperate times have called for desperate measures. Whilst we cannot dedicate the time and resources into creating a fully professional army, we can instead ensure that any able bodied man is able to take arms and fight for their country.
loc.PER_special_units_division_idea_desc: Our military forces have now been supplemented with a special units division. Now we can expand our forces in a way that will allow us to bring new units to the field as well as pave way for the creation of an espionage program.
loc.PER_savak_idea_no_lar_desc: SAVAK is the special agency and secret police that serves [PER.GetNameDef]. Emboldened by the Persian Lion on the logo, our officers work tirelessly to ensure the national security of our great country.
loc.PER_fund_state_intellignece_idea_desc: In order to improve our ability to monitor state security, we have funneled our resources into establishing a greater control on our state intelligence program.
loc.PER_transfer_officer_idea_lar_desc: As our intelligence agency grows, we have found a need to transfer some new officers into its ranks. Doing so has increased the productivity in the department and will ensure the safety of our nation.
loc.PER_airforce_modifier_desc: The Iranian Air force has never been our top priority, however we believe it is time for us to spend time and resources perfecting our division and training our pilots. We will show the world just how much control we can wrestle over the skies.
loc.PER_coastal_fortifications_idea_desc: Our navy has not always been our strongest asset, so in order to protect [PER.GetNameDef] from naval invasions, we must enact the coastal fortification initiative to ensure that our coastlines remain safe for the duration of any conflict.
loc.PER_legacy_of_greatness_modifier_desc: The Pahlavi Dynasty has cemented itself as a royal family destined to lead [PER.GetNameDef] to greatness and beyond. Whilst their reforms are unpopular with some, there is no doubt that the radical change they are bringing to the country will affect how the rest of the world views us from here on out.
loc.PER_state_atheism_idea_desc: It is our ultimate goal to emulate the nations in the west and bring [PER.GetNameDef] into the modern era. We cannot allow ourselves to be held back by religious doctrine any longer. Although it may upset the clergy of our nation, it is for the good of [PER.GetNameDef] that we encourage atheism among our citizens.
loc.PER_venerated_islam_idea_desc: Despite our initial view on separating state and religion, we can no longer ignore the will of the people. Islam has served as an important part of [PER.GetAdjective] culture for many years, and we would be foolish to absolve ourselves of these traditions.
loc.PER_old_ways_idea_desc: Zoroastrianism is one of the world's oldest monotheistic religions and was founded in ancient Persia in the 6th century BC. Given how vital this religion was to the culture of the old Persian Empires, we have reinvigorated it with the hopes that it will uphold the image of past splendor that we have been striving to attain.
loc.PER_imperial_expansionism_idea_desc: The time has come for us to show the world just how capable [PER.GetNameDef] is. We have fired up the factory lines, we have rallied the people. Soon, we march to war for glory and grandeur!
loc.PER_war_plan_darius_idea_desc: Darius the Great was the third King of Kings of the Achaemenid Empire. Whilst he ruled the empire at its territorial peak, he was the one to push Persian influence all the way into the Indus Valley in modern day Pakistan. Let's channel his expansionist ideals and push against our foes to the east!
loc.PER_paying_for_baluchistan_idea_desc: Unfortunately, [RAJ.GetNameDef] was unwilling to allow this territory to go without a price. We will have to pay off our debt for a year.
loc.PER_sold_baluchistan_idea_desc: When [PER.GetNameDef] came demanding the Baluchistan territories, we were able to squeeze some money out of them for the trouble. We will be receiving payments for about a year.
loc.PER_war_plan_xerxes_idea_desc: Xerxes the Great was the fourth King of Kings of the Achaemenid Empire. He is most famously known for his invasion of Greece in 480 BC, and whilst that ended in Persian defeat, this time we will be the victors. Let us move in on the Aegean and reclaim the Turkish peninsula.
loc.PER_war_plan_cambyses_idea_desc: Cambyses II was the second King of Kings of the Achaemenid Empire. He ruled from 530 BC and his reign was marked by his conquests in North Africa, notably Egypt, where he became the Pharaoh. Following in his footsteps, we must head west and try to reclaim his former territories.
loc.PER_persepolis_idea_desc: As a show of our power as a new imperial power, we have successfully rebuilt the ceremonial capital of the Achaemenid Empire. Persepolis will stand forever more as a symbol to [PER.GetAdjective] excellency.
loc.PER_celebration_idea_desc: The celebration of the old Persian Empire was a success, and as such we have experienced a massive boom in the economy of the country. With increased tourism and trade from our newly forged friendships, we should be able to ride the high of such an opulent display for the next year.
loc.PER_spoils_of_war_idea_desc: After successfully aiding our allies in their war, we have been able to secure our own territories as a direct result of the conflict. It is time we usurp these lands into our own growing sphere of influence.
loc.PER_rapid_appeasement_idea_desc: In order to curb a potential Islamic Revolution, we have offered reparations in order to appease the opposition. This should help to keep our country stable for a while, albeit slow down our development.
loc.PER_opposition_modifier_desc: As disdain for the Pahlavi Regime grows, more and more people are joining together to oppose the current government. If this continues to bubble over, then the country may be facing an uneasy future.
loc.PER_constitutional_shah_desc: Despite being the face for incredible change in [PER.GetNameDef], Reza Shah Pahlavi has now been relegated to the position of constitutional monarch. He is nothing more than a figurehead at this point, as our new government takes control of the country.
loc.PER_aid_communists_cw_desc: Now that we have removed the shackles of imperialism, we must be ready to send aid to other nations across the world who are still suffering under colonial yoke.
loc.PER_communist_industrialization_idea_des: Our new socialist government is going to need to rapidly industrialize if we are to stand the test of time. After all, it is likely we have now become a threat to those who fear the rise of the proletariat.
loc.PER_iranian_radio_idea_desc: Our national radio broadcasting system will aid in promoting state opinion on matters that the public are not entirely fully aligned on.
loc.PER_the_new_economy_idea_desc: Our new economy has been built on the needs of our population instead of following market trends. After all, we want to avoid the damage that capitalism has caused to our working class.
loc.KUR_resistance_modifier_desc: Despite our best efforts, the Kurdish people in our country have grown restless and angry. Slowly but surely, they are starting to rebel against us.
loc.PER_resistance_modifier_desc: This region is plagued by resistance cells orchestrated by [PER.GetNameDef].
loc.PER_gulf_hegemony_idea_desc: Through careful maneuvering, we have finally established ourselves as the principal power in the Gulf region.
loc.PER_restoring_the_nation_idea_desc: By restructuring the government, we have created instability and divide in our nation, we must restore our nations stability and unity before we can move forward with our plans.
loc.PER_fascism_sway_the_rich_idea_desc: In order for our new government to thrive, we need to maintain control over the nation, we need to convince as many Iranian elites as possible to side with us to ensure our grip on Iran remains strong.
loc.PER_invite_foreign_investors_desc: By reaching out to other democracies across the world, we have been able to kickstart and inject resources into our burgeoning economy.
loc.PER_resist_gharbzadegi_idea_desc: Over-Westernization has been a plague upon our great nation. Instead of pandering to the whims of those who have spent centuries colonizing our region, we should work to create a democratic state that can stand on its own.
loc.PER_stand_with_giants_modifier_desc: Ever since his rise to power, Reza Shah Pahlavi has wanted to modernize [PER.GetNameDef] and bring it up to speed with the other great nations of the world. This is the beginning of many new social, economic and political reforms in [PER.GetNameDef], and is bound to evolve as we proceed in this direction.
loc.PER_persian_german_trade_idea_desc: An organization established to encourage positive trade relations between [PER.GetNameDef] and [GER.GetNameDef] as well as ensure the continued modernization of our industry using the model of one of the most prominent industrial powers in the world.
loc.PER_trial_fifty_three_idea: Enacted the Trial Against the Fifty Three
loc.PER_trial_fifty_three_idea_desc: After arresting fifty three Iranians for being involved in communist political activities, we were able to put them to trial for their anti government sentiments. We could not allow such dissidence to take root at such a critical time for our nation.
loc.PER_homeland_not_fall_idea_desc: The time has come to prove our mettle and stand stalwart against those who threaten our home. Rally the troops, believe in your brothers and prepare to fight for the future of our country. [PER.GetNameDefCap] will not fall to these belligerents! Send them running with their tails between their legs!
loc.PER_preemtive_strike_idea_desc: We don't have time to wait around to be invaded! It is crucial that we strike whilst the iron is hot, and ensure that we can create some buffer states between ourselves and the larger nations that dare threaten our sovereignty!
loc.PER_compliant_subject_idea_desc: There is no victory to be had standing against a power like [ROOT.OVERLORD.GetNameDef]. Instead, we must play our part as a subject, and show that we are worthy of being a powerful vassal.
loc.PER_anti_soviet_idea_desc: After taking our territory during the invasion of Iran, it is time we paid back against these warmongers and take back what is rightfully ours. We will not stop until our former territory belongs to us once more.
loc.PER_azadi_idea_desc: Azadi, or 'Freedom' in Persian is going to be our rallying call as we attempt to rise against the forces occupying our lands. We will not bend to their will, but instead fight for our freedom, no matter how long it might take.
loc.PER_offensive_tactics_modifier_desc: The only way in which we will be able to protect [PER.GetNameDef] is to immediately go on the offensive. With these new tactics enacted, we will be in a good position to force our enemy back!
loc.PER_defensive_maneuvers_modifier_desc: Our defenses must be as immovable as a mountain range if we are to keep the enemy from threatening our cities. Our newly enacted defensive maneuvers will hopefully keep enemy forces in their place!
loc.PER_enemy_war_reparations_idea_desc: Due to the failure of our operation in [PER.GetNameDef], we now must pay for the great cost of our invasion. Although this is not ideal, we should be able to finish our reparations within two years.
loc.PER_idea_comintern_research_collaboratio: [ROOT.GetAdjective] scientists shall be taught by top [SOU.GetAdjective] experts before bringing their skills back home in order to rebuild our nation on the [SOU.GetAdjective] model.
loc.PER_idea_one_for_all_all_for_one: One for all, All for one
loc.PER_idea_one_for_all_all_for_one_desc: We must go above and beyond and ensure that every [ROOT.GetAdjective] citizen is ready to defend [ROOT.GetNameDefCap] at a moment's notice. It is only by doing so we can stand a chance against the world powers, and maintain our sovereignty and identity after the Great Game.
loc.PER_idea_reject_foreign_dominance_desc: With foreign powers looming ominously at our borders, we will not cave, we will stand our ground and defend ourselves to the bitter end. [ROOT.GetAdjective] sovereignty and identity will survive, no matter the cost.
loc.idea_RAJ_resistant_to_occupation_desc: The Indian people have been under occupation for a long time and do not take kindly to yet another occupier.
loc.idea_RAJ_sold_parts_of_india_to_private_: Sold Parts of India to Private Investors
loc.idea_RAJ_government_budget_shortfall_des: Local Resistance to taxes has caused a shortfall for the British Government in Delhi. With less staff bureaucratic overhead is piling up
loc.idea_RAJ_demobilization_desc: This country is rapidly demobilizing its armed forces, leading to its military personnel becoming a part of the civilian workforce.
loc.idea_RAJ_military_into_the_workforce_des: Large parts of people previously employed by the military has now found jobs in the civilian economy.
loc.idea_RAJ_schemes_of_a_ungentlemanly_natu: A scheme of an Ungentlemanly Nature
loc.idea_SIA_army_of_siam_desc: The Army of Siam forms the backbone of the nation's defence, its organisation and traditions shaping how men and materiel are raised and sustained across the country.
loc.idea_RAJ_bose_hiding_raj: Bose is traveling in hiding through India
loc.idea_RAJ_bose_hiding_afghanistan: Bose is hiding in Afghanistan destined for the USSR
loc.idea_RAJ_bose_submarine: Bose is in a Submarine destined for Japan
loc.idea_RAJ_princely_state_aggression_tt:
Gains §Y$idea_RAJ_princely_state_aggression$§! which grants:
(§YEvery Princely State§!):
Generate war goal tension against country: §Y-100%§!
Justify War goal Time: §G-75%§! for §Y180 day(s)§!
loc.idea_RAJ_partition_chaos_bad_desc: Chaos, disorder and confusion as India is split
loc.idea_RAJ_partition_chaos_less_bad_desc: It was always going to be hard, but with careful preparation it is less bad than it could have been
loc.idea_RAJ_partition_india_united_desc: India stands united, but bitterness and religious divides do not subside easily
loc.idea_RAJ_help_from_the_secret_intelligen: Help from the Secret Intelligence Agency
loc.idea_RAJ_the_long_goodbye_desc: Britain has agreed to leave...eventually. Until then they must untangle their bureaucracy, pack their bags, and finally make their long overdue exit.
loc.idea_RAJ_flames_of_the_revolution_desc: The old order has crumbled under the weight of its own rot. From the ashes of colonial rule rises a new India, forged not in palaces or parliaments, but in fields, factories and the fire of revolution. Alas the embers of class war still burn hot ... and not all who wear red do so willingly.
loc.idea_RAJ_break_the_zamindars_tt: Once the spirit times out: \n   Add §G3 §!offmap §YCivilian Factory§!.
loc.idea_RAJ_under_the_yoke_of_peacock_thron: Under the Yoke of the Peacock Throne
loc.RAJ_a_loyal_government_desc: Despite the desire for independence from dissidents within [RAJ.GetNameDef], our government remains strong and stable. We will continue to uphold the Crown's interests with discipline and resolve.
loc.RAJ_high_import_duties_desc: We have enacted a new policy with the intention of protecting local industries and retaining the economic output of [RAJ.GetNameDef]. With higher import duties on foreign goods, we shall ensure that [RAJ.GetNameDef] can stand on its own two feet in global economic circles.
loc.RAJ_the_zamindari_system_desc: By expanding the Zamindari System, we have ensured administrative efficiency by empowering the loyal landlords maintaining order in the rural regions of the country.
loc.RAJ_exports_for_the_empire_desc: Colonial trade has been the backbone of the [ENG.GetAdjective] Empire for centuries, and the exports from [RAJ.GetNameDef] are no different. By prioritizing the cultivation of staple crops such as tea, cotton and jute, we have secured a steady flow of revenue for us and for the Empire.
loc.RAJ_war_industry_dec: Through sheer determination and tireless resolve, we must support the war effort by increasing the funding toward our arms industry. Our people will forge our victory through courage, sweat and steel.
loc.RAJ_south_east_asia_command_dm_desc: By establishing the South East Asia Command, we have been able to extend our military influence across the entire region. This will surely aid us in planning our military campaigns on the continent.
loc.SSB_saadabad_pact_desc: A treaty of non aggression with other middle eastern countries, this could possibly lead to further and stronger collaborations.\n\n §RStarting an offensive war against any member of the Saadabad Pact will cause you to permanently lose this spirit§!.
loc.SSB_saadabad_trade_agreement_desc: A mutual trade agreement between the original Saadabad Pact signatories that facilitates further collaboration and a more integrated economy, lifting all tariffs and pooling resources together.
loc.austria_peace: A Waltz For The Glorious Days

loc.EXILE_MESSAGE_REINFORCEMENTS_ARRIVED: $COUNT|H$ exiled divisions escaped from $SENDER|H$ and have arrived in $LOCATION|H$ to fight on our side!
loc.EXILE_MESSAGE_RETURNED: Exile forces that have been fighting for $SENDER|H$ have returned home in $LOCATION|H$.
loc.EXILES_ARRIVED_TITLE: Escaped exile forces ready to fight!

loc.GIE_REINSTATE_EFFECT_DESC: By reinstating the government all $NAMEADJ$ §HExiled Divisions§!, §HArmy Leaders§! and §HShips§! will be transferred back to $NAMEDEF|H$. We will no longer be able to use their §HExiled Veteran Manpower§! for §HExiled Air Wings§! and the planes will be returned to storage.
loc.GIE_REINSTATE_ENABLED_EXILE_VIEWING_LIBE: Our country has been fully liberated. §HLegitimacy§! will be reduced by $VALUE|H2$ daily. If §HLegitimacy§! reaches §H0§!, our government is automatically reinstated.
loc.GIE_REINSTATE_DISABLED_EXILE_VIEWING: $NAMEDEF|UH$ cannot reinstate our government as long as we are capitulated.

loc.DIPLOMACY_FACTION_UNAVAILABLE_US_GIE: Not allowed for Governments in Exile
loc.fascist_influence_desc: Fascist pressure has made fascism very popular, and the country is susceptible to align with other fascists.
loc.communist_influence_desc: Communist pressure has made communism very popular, and the country is susceptible to align with other communists.
loc.democratic_influence_desc: Democratic pressure has made democracy very popular, and the country is susceptible to align with other democrats.
loc.neutrality_influence_desc: Authoritarian pressure has led to new-found respect for those with strong governments and noble royal houses, and the country is susceptible to align with other authoritarian governments.
loc.soviet_german_friendship_desc: The German Reich and The Soviet Union have united in friendship against the decadent west.
loc.sour_loser_desc: Bitterness over defeat in the Great War dominates the politics of this nation.
loc.received_attache_desc: Foreign military attachés residing in our country.
loc.ATTACHE_LIST: We received military attachés from $LIST$. And they give us the following effects:
loc.porsche_desc: Porsche favors tanks with heavy armor.
loc.henschel_desc: Henschel were responsible for all mass-produced Tiger models, tanks which, after early reliability problems were solved, performed remarkably well.
loc.GER_MAN_desc: Most known for the Panther tank, MAN also participated in design and production of earlier Panzer models.
loc.rheinmetall_desc: Rheinmetall designs and builds all types of large guns and cannons.
loc.mauser_desc: Mauser designs and builds all types of small arms.
loc.ig_faben_desc: IG Farben are keenly interested in Industrial research.
loc.messerschmitt_desc: Messerschmitt focuses on the design of Light Aircraft, such as Fighters.
loc.focke_wulf_desc: Focke Wulf has a special interest in designing Medium Aircraft, such as Heavy Fighters.
loc.junkers_desc: Junkers is most famous for having developed the Stuka dive bomber.
loc.todt_desc: Fritz Todt, a German engineer, was the founder of Organization Todt. He will increase the build speed of Civilian Industrial projects.
loc.speer_desc: Albert Speer was a German architect who was the Minister of Armaments and War Production from 1942 to 1945. Often credited with the 'Armaments miracle', his appointment will increase Industrial Efficiency.
loc.raeder_desc: Erich Raeder was a German admiral who favored the use of traditional surface ships and the Fleet in Being doctrine.
loc.donitz_desc: Karl Dönitz was a German admiral with a fondness for Submarines and the Trade Interdiction doctrine.
loc.goering_desc: Hermann Göring was a Great War fighter ace who became one of Hitler's chief supporters. While not the best at this job, he is devotedly loyal.
loc.walther_wever_desc: Walther Wever was an early proponent of the theory of strategic bombing.
loc.ritter_von_greim_desc: Ritter von Greim is a proponent of Tactical Interdiction.
loc.ernst_udet_desc: Ernst Udet was influential in the adoption of dive bombing techniques as well as the Stuka dive bomber.
loc.werner_von_fritsch_desc: Werner von Fritsch, a general of the old guard, favors a focus on Infantry.
loc.ludwig_beck_desc: Ludwig Beck places a special emphasize on Supply.
loc.franz_halder_desc: Franz Halder believes in the striking power of Artillery in the attack.
loc.wilhelm_keitel_desc: Wilhelm Keitel, a general of the Old Guard, favors Infantry. What he lacks in skill he makes up for in loyalty.
loc.ferdinand_schorner_desc: Ferdinand Schörner is skilled in Defense and fighting in cold weather conditions.
loc.general_staff_desc: The German General staff was responsible for the continuous study of all aspects of war, including the drawing up and reviewing of plans for mobilization or campaign. This contributed to a higher level of Organization in the army.
loc.v_weapons_desc: Long range bombardment Rockets would make ideal Vengeance Weapons against our enemies.
loc.hermann_gortz_desc: §HHermann Görtz§! is a skilled German spy.
loc.elyesa_bazna_desc: §HElyesa Bazna§! is widely known under his code name Cicero.
loc.marina_lee_desc: §HMarina Lee§! is a ballerina that specializes in stealing battle plans.
loc.german_advisors_desc: A German military mission led by Alexander von Falkenhausen is present in China, and its advisors are assisting us in bringing our army up to Western standards.
loc.vittorio_emanuele_desc: The "Soldier King" reminds the Italians of their recent victories in the Great War. His presence and their loyalty to him is a great source of unity for the people.
loc.george_v_desc: Rallying around the King of the United Kingdom and the British Dominions, as well as Emperor of India, the British people stand united and proud of their imperial legacy.
loc.clement_attlee_desc: A modest man with much to be modest about.
loc.flight_of_hess: Rudolf Hess has undertaken his famous flight
loc.ivan_konev_desc: According to Sergo Beria, Ivan Konev has wicked little eyes, a shaved head that looks like a pumpkin and an expression full of self-conceit.
loc.SOV_konev_civil_war: Konev is not supporting a civil war against the Soviet Union.
loc.bernard_montgomery_desc: In defeat unbeatable, in victory unbearable
loc.undisturbed_isolation_desc: Still recovering from the Great Depression and the Dust Bowl famine, the nation is slowly rebuilding its infrastructure. America's industries are in most cases working at half capacity, and will keep doing so unless major events rouse the nation from torpor.

loc.idea_group_trade_laws_desc: Chose a Trade Law for our nation
loc.ENROUTE: We have sent a diplomatic request. We cannot bother them with another until §Y$DATE$§!.
loc.ogme_desc: Oficinas Gerais de Material de Engenharia - General Workshops of Engineering Material
loc.ogma_desc: Oficinas Gerais de Material Aeronáutico - General Workshops of Aeronautical Material
loc.fnmal: Fábrica Nacional de Munições de Armas Ligeiras
loc.sisu_desc: Sisu is the uniquely Finnish expression for the resilience of the nation's people. Finland has faced harsh odds and will do so again.
loc.great_depression_desc: Although a worldwide phenomenon, the Great Depression started with a stock market crash in the United States and has caused unemployment rates to soar and tax revenue to plummet. The American people and its government have enough to worry about without getting involved in another war.
loc.new_deal_desc: A set of policies and programs initiated by Franklin D. Roosevelt, a reaction to the hardships suffered during the Great Depression.
loc.wilkies_new_deal_desc: Although Wendell Willkie opposed to some of FDR's suggestions for expanding the New Deal, some aspects have been supported and retained by the new president.
loc.neutrality_idea_desc: Neutrality is sometimes viewed as a craven stance, but this nation trusts that when the dust settles, those who didn't take sides may be better off than those who did.
loc.anti_soviet_pact_refused_call_desc: This nation did not honor the Anti-[SOV.GetAdjective] Pact when called to war. This has caused the people to doubt the current government and spurred a rise in communist supporters.
loc.anti_soviet_pact_desc: If one country in the pact is attacked by [SOV.GetNameDef], all other members will be called to war. Members already at war with [SOV.GetNameDef] will not be called.
loc.ENG_home_guard_assistance_in_factories: Home Guard Assistance in the Factories
loc.MAL_ketuanan_melayu_desc: Despite being culturally diverse, our society is dominated by ideas of segregation, spurred on by the colonial authorities. This must be curtailed if stability is to be achieved.
loc.nationalism_desc: Our people's hearts burn with nationalistic pride and they will fight hard to protect our homeland
loc.internationalism_desc: We strongly believe that ideology span across national borders and do not feel limited in crossing those borders ourselves.
loc.the_long_lance_desc: §LThe Type-93 torpedo, commonly nicknamed The Long Lance, was the most advanced torpedo of the time. It was developed by Japan and never really matched by the west, giving smaller ships an effective way of hurting larger, more armored warships at range.§!
loc.spiritual_mobilization_idea_desc: "Luxury is our Enemy!" With thrift, hygiene and hard work elevated to national virtues, more manpower is made available to the war effort.
loc.office_of_strategic_services_desc: §LThe Office of Strategic Services (OSS) was a United States intelligence agency formed during World War II. It was the wartime intelligence agency, and a predecessor of the Central Intelligence Agency (CIA).§!
loc.nkvd_desc: §LNKVD, The People's Commissariat for Internal Affairs was a law enforcement agency of the Soviet Union that directly executed the rule of power of the All Union Communist Party. It was also tasked with protection of Soviet borders and espionage, which included political assassinations abroad, influencing foreign governments and enforcing Stalinist policy within communist movements in other countries.§!
loc.nkvd_2_desc: §LNKVD, The People's Commissariat for Internal Affairs was a law enforcement agency of the Soviet Union that directly executed the rule of power of the All Union Communist Party. It was also tasked with protection of Soviet borders and espionage, which included political assassinations abroad, influencing foreign governments and enforcing Stalinist policy within communist movements in other countries.§!
loc.idea_political_correctness_desc: People who think correctly are much harder to influence for foreign powers.
loc.air_war_plans_division_focus_desc: Only through supremacy in the air will the Axis powers be defeated. Long-term plans for the production and deployment of fighters and strategic bombers make this not only possible, but attainable.
loc.home_of_revolution_desc: Comrades, with the defeat of the vile Trotskyite counter revolutionaries we were able to focus on defending the revolution. Our goal, our hope, our slogan is Socialism in One Country. We will build a bountiful socialist utopia here in the Soviet Union and the rest of the world will inevitably embrace it.
loc.en_svensk_tiger_desc: If Sweden is to be like a tiger on the prowl then those who spy on us must not know what we do. In these time of conflict and strife it is the patriotic duty of every Swede to keep silent.
loc.state_shintoism_desc: Since the Meiji Restoration we have sought to use the worship at Shinto shrines to promote imperial loyalty and aid in nation building. This has allowed us to build up a country that is ready to sacrifice much in the name of the state.
loc.vittoria_mutilata_desc: §LOur allies betrayed Italy and stabbed us in the back when they broke the Pact of London. We sacrificed so much blood at the Isonzo for their victory and they in turn denied us what was ours by right. Now Italy will take her destiny into her own hands and ensure that justice is done.§!
loc.stiff_upper_lip_desc:
If you can keep your head when all about you
Are losing theirs and blaming it on you,
If you can meet with Triumph and Disaster
And treat those two impostors just the same
Yours is the Earth and everything that's in it,
And - which is more - you'll be a Man, my son.
loc.trotskyite_plot_desc: Paranoia and pathological distrust stemming from old power struggles impact the leadership of this nation.
loc.trotskyite_plot_purged_desc: Despite the purges, the fear of betrayal remains.
loc.officers_purged_desc: The purge of the 'fifth columnists' has left great scars in the ranks of the red army officers, and it will take years for the leadership to replenish itself.
loc.officers_purged_2_desc: The purge of the 'fifth columnists' has left great scars in the ranks of the red army officers, and it will take years for the leadership to replenish itself.

loc.officers_purged_10_desc: The purge of the 'fifth columnists' has left great scars in the ranks of the red army officers, and it will take years for the leadership to replenish itself.
loc.HUN_gyula_gombos_de_jakfa_desc: As the Prime Minster of Hungary, Gyula Gömbös shares powers with Horthy, and is too powerful to be directly dismissed. Therefore, he must instead be removed either in a §YNational Focus§! or through an §YEvent§!
loc.spr_franco_unavailable_tooltip: Franco will not support a communist regime.
loc.SPA_recovering_from_civil_war_desc: This country is currently focused on rebuilding the country and less willing to join a faction.
loc.CHI_communist_uprisings_desc: The tensions between communists and nationalists are present in all corners of the country. If communist support in the country goes too high, the communists will take control of a state.
loc.CAN_dominion_rifle_association_idea: The Dominion of Canada Rifle Association
loc.SAF_ossewabrandwag_desc: The Ox-wagon Sentinel is an Afrikaner nationalist organization vocally supportive of Nazi ideas. They carry out a campaign of sabotage against state infrastructure, and will continue to do so unless we side with the Nazis ourselves.
loc.SAF_ossewabrandwag_2_desc: The Ox-wagon Sentinel is an Afrikaner nationalist organization vocally supportive of Nazi ideas. They carry out a campaign of sabotage against state infrastructure, and will continue to do so unless we side with the Nazis ourselves.
loc.SAF_ossewabrandwag_fascism_desc: The Ox-wagon Sentinel paramilitary unit is being used as a bulwark against foreign agitation and domestic uprisings that target our ruling class.
loc.SAF_scw_veterans: Veterans of the Spanish Civil War
loc.RAJ_azad_hind_desc: The Free India government, supported by enemies of the British, is working towards the liberation of India. They are working with Japan to subvert European rule, in the hopes of establishing a self-governing Indian state.
loc.RAJ_risk_of_famine_desc: The Indian system of food production is very fragile. Even a small interruption might cause a collapse.
loc.RAJ_risk_of_famine_instant_desc:
A §Rfamine§! will trigger if one of these are true:
 -We lose a starting Indian state and fail to take it back within §Y30 day(s)§! (Aden being excluded)
-The new controller is not a releasable that is occupied by us at the start of the game
-The new controller is not our subject.
loc.RAJ_famine_desc: Incompetence, indifference and blatant corruption in the colonial government and the Indian railroads have turned a difficult situation into a full-blown catastrophe. The country will suffer from this for months to come.
loc.RAJ_agrarian_society_desc: The local administrators believe that their agrarian lifestyle has made a large part of the Indian population simply unfit for military service or warfare of any kind. They maintain that we should only recruit from the so-called "martial tribes". This belief is so wide-spread and well-entrenched that it will require at least a generation, or significant rural investment to overcome.
loc.FRA_victors_of_wwi_desc: Having emerged victorious from the Great War, the army has developed a dangerously complacent attitude which causes strategic developments to come slowly and with some reluctance.
loc.FRA_disjointed_government_desc: The state of French politics is far from stable. While reforms are needed and welcome, the nation is divided and getting drawn into a conflict would put it at great risk.
loc.FRA_protected_by_the_maginot_line_desc: Having fortified the border gives France the opportunity to plan and prepare carefully, but it does sacrifice some flexibility in the event of something unexpected.
loc.ENG_george_vi_desc: The first Head of the Commonwealth and last Emperor of India is still considered the inheritor of a great legacy. Like his father before him he is a popular figurehead and unifier for the British people.
loc.ENG_continuation_of_politics_desc: It has proven easy to gain the people's support for intervention in key countries where the political leanings differ from our own. We can use this to our advantage.
loc.SELECT_DESIGN_COMPANY_DESC: By selecting this §YDesign Company§! they will permanently affect capabilities on all equipment researched while they are hired.\n
loc.DESIGN_COMPANY_DESC: \nThis §YDesign Company§! will permanently affect capabilities on all equipment researched while they are active.
loc.american_protection_drift_democratic_des: If an American country declares war on this country @USA §YUnited States§! can intervene.
loc.american_protection_defence_democratic_d: If an American country declares war on this country @USA §YUnited States§! can intervene.
loc.american_protection_drift_communism_desc: If an American country declares war on this country @USA §YUnited States§! can intervene.
loc.american_protection_defence_communism_de: If an American country declares war on this country @USA §YUnited States§! can intervene.
loc.american_protection_drift_fascism_desc: If an American country declares war on this country @USA §YUnited States§! can intervene.
loc.american_protection_defence_fascism_desc: If an American country declares war on this country @USA §YUnited States§! can intervene.
loc.ENG_the_war_to_end_all_wars: The War to End All Wars
loc.ENG_the_war_to_end_all_wars_desc: With the Great War in recent memory, both the nation's people and leaders are reluctant to send another generation to die in the trenches.
loc.rhineland_challenge_met_desc: After predictions that the Rhineland could be remilitarized without Allied intervention, Germany ended up pressured to back down after this turned out to be a mistake.
loc.kaiser_challenge_met_desc: After predictions that the Kaiser could be freed from the Netherlands without Allied intervention, Germany ended up pressured to back down after this turned out to be a mistake.
loc.fascist_revolutionaries_desc: If support for Fascism rises above 70%, the nation will be plunged into civil war. If support for Fascism drops below 30%, revolutionary activity will stop.
loc.communist_revolutionaries_desc: If support for Communism rises above 70%, the nation will be plunged into civil war. If support for Communism drops below 30%, revolutionary activity will stop.
loc.democratic_revolutionaries_desc: If support for Democracy rises above 70%, the nation will be plunged into civil war. If support for Democracy drops below 30%, revolutionary activity will stop.
loc.home_of_the_free_desc: USA considers itself a bastion and maybe even the cradle of democracy and liberty. Whatever they choose to be, their values are difficult to compromise, however tempting some opportunities might seem.
loc.fascism_defeated_desc: Democracy has triumphed over totalitarian fascism, and democratic parties are united against this old threat.
loc.communism_defeated_desc: Democracy has triumphed over totalitarian communism, and democratic parties are united against this old threat.
loc.reign_of_terror_desc: Having recently come to power, the current regime is ruthless in the pursuit of its enemies, shutting down opposition before it arises.
loc.anti_german_military_desc: Factions within the Yugoslavian Air Force are opposed to cooperating with Germany. They may attempt to overthrow the regime if the country opens their borders to or enters an alliance with the Third Reich.
loc.anti_nazi_coup_desc: Having overthrown Prince Paul to prevent cooperation with Germany, the new regime oppose pro-fascist diplomacy.
loc.race_for_the_bomb_desc: We have taken it upon ourselves to be the first nation to successfully deploy an atomic weapon.
loc.race_for_the_bomb_outclassed_desc: Another nation has beaten us to the bomb. We must redouble our efforts at any cost, to achieve strategic security and lessen the national embarrassment.
loc.GER_communist_refugees_desc: Germany has moved to crack down on Communism in their nation to the point where a large portion of their citizens are escaping across the Saar border into our country, causing unrest and joining up with the PCF.
loc.GER_barbarossa_desc: Having taken the [SOV.GetAdjective] government by surprise, we must now press our advantage before they can get back on their feet and initiate any substantial counteroffensives.
loc.GER_mefo_bills_desc: MEFO bills were promissory notes created by Hjalmar Schacht to enable the government to fund rearmament, acting through the balance sheet entity Metallurgische Forschungsgesellschaft to hide this rearmament from French and British eyes. These bills must be extended for six-month periods, or their recipients will have to be paid when they fall due.
loc.GER_mefo_bills_instant_desc: \n§RGoing to war will remove the dependency on MEFO bills, as well as delaying the requirement to pay them until the war's conclusion.§!
loc.GER_mefo_bills_ended_desc: Germany is currently in the process of paying off the MEFO Bills now that they are no longer able to be properly sustained.
loc.USA_great_depression_down_tt: Reduces the effect of The Great Depression\n
loc.MTG_naval_treaty_adherent_desc: We have signed the London Naval Treaty and accordingly are restricted in the size of our capital ships.
loc.MTG_naval_treaty_adherent_reduced_desc: After some signatories of the Washington Naval Treaty have abandoned the London Naval Treaty, we have invoked the Escalator Clause, reducing the restrictions for the size and armament of our capital ships.
loc.GER_western_trade_cooperation_tt: Adds one offsite $arms_factory$ and one offsite $industrial_complex$
loc.POR_unreliable_army_desc: With the constant coups and counter-coups since the implementation of the Republic in 1910, Army officers are more preoccupied with politics than with keeping discipline and promoting training in the army. The rank and file is demoralized, poorly equipped and poorly trained.
loc.POR_unstable_republic_desc: The era of the Republic installed in 1910 was described as one of "continual anarchy, government corruption, rioting and pillage, assassinations, arbitrary imprisonment and religious persecution". It witnessed the inauguration of nine presidents, 44 cabinet re-organisations and 21 revolutions. Even after the Military coup of 1926, there have been several failed revolutionary attempts.
loc.POR_british_influence_desc: The British government is investing in the exploitation of resources in our country. This is a valuable opportunity to boost our advances in R&D.
loc.POR_hydroelectric_power_desc: Thanks to the investments made in the North and Center of Portugal, we have finally built a network of dams that produce electricity and regulate river flows.
loc.POR_if_lose_timor_exports_die_tt: §RWill be removed if we ever lose ownership of [721.GetName]§!
loc.POR_volunteers_in_the_war_desc: The peoples of Spain are struggling in the civil war. We will provide military assistance by organizing a volunteer force that will fight for the rightful side.
loc.POR_improved_production_desc: Thanks to the state's regulations our government implemented after years of precarious financial situation we have managed to stabilize our economic situation and we are investing in more public projects to stimulate our infrastructure.
loc.POR_iberian_workers_united_desc: We must proclaim the unity of the Iberian proletariat against tyranny of all sorts and redouble the support given to our Spanish comrades in their Civil War. Our sacrifices will be rewarded, because this is a just cause!
loc.POR_convoy_build_efficiency_desc: We need to build a large merchant fleet capable of transporting all the resources our economy needs. This can be done by building merchant ships in smaller Dockyards.

loc.ALREADY_HAS_ADVISOR_WITH_TRAIT: There is already an appointed advisor with this trait.
loc.CHANGE_ADVISOR: \nYou can replace this advisor by clicking here and selecting a replacement.
loc.LoN_disbanded_flag: The League of Nations is no longer active
loc.ROM_white_squadron_desc: The White squadron is a service of air ambulances piloted exclusively by women. Merely the notion that rescue might be close at hand keeps our soldiers in high spirits.
loc.MAN_hoankyoku_idea_desc: A secretive organization dedicated to dealing with undesired elements in society.
loc.AST_central_bureau_idea_desc: A joint intelligence taskforce established and coordinated with the USA, which aims to counter the efforts of our enemies in the pacific theater.
loc.SWE_historical_trade_with_Germany_dummy_:
(§YSweden§!) Target country trade cost: §G-20%§!
(§YSweden§!) Trade Opinion modifier: §G+50§!
§YOur domestic steel is of low grade and need high quality steel mixed in to be fully effective. Importing small amounts of foreign steel will drastically increase the resource output of our domestic steel production§!
loc.CAN_unified_communist_party_desc: Old rifts are mended; relationships repaired. Yet our tolerance in service of a shared destiny is looked upon with suspicion by those who pay only lip service to the cause, driven by that basest of motivations: the pursuit of power.
loc.CAN_booming_economy_desc: With the great depression firmly a thing of the past, our economy has begun to improve under the significant demands of the current world situation.
