loc.POR_army_reorganization_desc: We need to reorganize the army, reducing the bloated number of officers and inefficient units, and instituting a proper draft system. This will create the foundations of a modern army.
loc.POR_metropolitan_army_desc: The most preeminent danger to Portugal is being dragged into a European war and seeing our mainland invaded. Only a strong modern army can deter our enemies!
loc.POR_standardization_desc: We need to implement a standardization system that allows our equipment to achieve high levels of compatibility and efficiency in their production.
loc.POR_defend_the_borders_desc: The danger of invasion is always present and we have long borders to defend throughout our territories. We need to build adequate fortifications to resist any possible invasion.
loc.POR_rebuild_the_lines_of_torres_vedras: Rebuild the Lines of Torres Vedras
loc.POR_rebuild_the_lines_of_torres_vedras_d: A number of officers among the top brass claim that our borders are too extensive to defend, and suggest that we rebuild the Linhas de Torres Vedras, refitting the old fortifications for modern warfare. In the event of an enemy breaking our lines we will retreat to Lisbon, following the same strategy that served us well against the French invasion during the Napoleonic Wars.
loc.POR_corpo_do_estado_maior_desc: The Military Reform re-instituted the Army Chief of Staff (Corpo do Estado Maior) as an elite institution for the study of modern warfare. We must invest in new facilities to improve its efficiency.
loc.POR_staff_wargames_desc: We must focus on preparing our officers so they can take full advantage of modern doctrines, organization, training and equipment.
loc.POR_a_royal_wedding_desc: A marriage between Dom Duarte Nuno de Braganza, legitimate heir of the Portuguese throne, and Princess Maria Francisca of Orléans, daughter of the Brazilian throne pretender, will please Monarchist elements in Portugal and Brazil.
loc.POR_the_return_of_duarte_desc: Allowing D. Duarte Nuno de Braganza to return to Portugal will not be accepted by the Republicans, but it is a necessary step for the restoration of the Monarchy.
loc.POR_support_a_spanish_monarchy_in_the_wa: Support a Spanish Monarchy in the War

It is not that we have much appreciation for the Carlists, but of course a Spanish monarchy would be much better than the presence of a fascist or communist regime on the peninsula. We must favor the lesser evil...
loc.POR_assist_the_requetes_desc: Several members of the Portuguese army and air force will be sent to Spain to oversee the war efforts of the Carlists and advise their leaders. While they are there, they will also gather information about the battle tactics used by each side.
loc.POR_join_the_carlist_fight_desc: The best way to ensure a Carlist victory in the Spanish civil war is to fight for the Requetés and defeat the other Spanish factions ourselves.
loc.POR_the_royal_iberian_alliance_desc: We must seek the collaboration of the Spanish monarchy to face the threats present in Europe and beyond. Only united can we emerge victorious in this time of turmoil.
loc.POR_monarchist_uprising_in_brazil_desc: Appealing to Brazilian monarchists will help pave the way for the restoration of the Brazilian throne. We must ensure that they prevail against any opposition.
loc.POR_the_empire_of_brazil_desc: The stage is set for Prince Pedro to claim the Brazilian throne and be crowned Emperor of Brazil.
loc.POR_the_empire_of_brazil_potential_civil: §RIf §YBrazil§R is §RNOT §YNon-Aligned§R and has less than §Y50% Stability§R or §Y70% Neutrality§R when this focus is completed, Brazilian Monarchists will start a civil war, dragging us into it!§!§!§!§!§!§!§!§!§!§!
loc.POR_restoration_of_the_monarchy_desc: We will proclaim the restoration of the Portuguese Monarchy, under the rule of D. Duarte Nuno de Braganza. \nViva o Rei de Portugal!
loc.POR_the_kingdom_reunited_desc: Following the restoration of the Portuguese and Brazilian thrones, we must carry out the unification of our countries before the memories of our common struggles are left behind. \nWe will submit a proposal to the Brazilian government, making it clear that if they do not sign it voluntarily, we will be forced to press on the matter by other means...
loc.POR_remember_olivenca_desc: The Spaniards denied us the sovereignty over Olivença a long time ago. Now we will take it back, as well as other territories in the vicinity...
loc.POR_deal_with_fascism_desc: Fascism is a blight that has brought sorrow and misery to humanity. It is time for us to oppose it, striking straight at its very source. Once we are victorious, we will reshape the world at our will, and it will be for the better.
loc.POR_deal_with_fascism_tt: Gains §YAnnex§! war goal against major or neighboring Fascist nations:
loc.POR_latin_america_desc: Now that our Empire is consolidated, we can look at the territories surrounding our American possessions and reclaim the lands that the Brazilian Empire once held.
loc.POR_the_communist_threat_desc: The Communists are subtly spreading their deceptive ideals among the population, not only in Portugal but throughout the world. We must focus on eradicating this global threat before it devours us from within.
loc.POR_the_communist_threat_tt: Gains §Y[GetWargoalBasedOnGovernment]§! war goal against major or neighboring Communist nations:
loc.POR_promote_the_monarchist_cause_in_port: Promote the Monarchist Cause in Portugal
We must encourage and support the monarchists in spreading the monarchist sentiment among the peoples of Portugal.
loc.POR_kingdom_reunited_tooltip_tt: §Y[POR.GetNameDefCap]§! and §Y[BRA.GetNameDef]§! will now be known as the §YEmpire of Portugal and Brazil§!.
loc.POR_fascist_portugal_joins_scw_tt: §YFascist Portugal§! joins [SPA.GetFlag]§Y[SPA.GetNameDef]§! in their war against [GetSpanishRepublicFlagAndNameDef].
loc.POR_support_the_spanish_republic_effect_: Send §Y2000§! of §YInfantry Equipment§! to [GetSpanishRepublicFlagAndNameDef]. Old ones go first.
loc.POR_the_iberian_socialist_union_tt: ([SPR.GetFlag]§YRepublican Spain§!) Gets event §Y'The Iberian Socialist Union'§!.
loc.POR_the_iberian_socialist_union_cores_tt: §YThe Iberian Socialist Union§! get cores on all Iberia, Islas Canarias and Islas Baleares.
loc.POR_the_iberian_socialist_union_annex_pu: Every Spanish puppet will be annexed.
loc.POR_the_iberian_socialist_union_cosmetic: §YPortugal§! will be known as §YThe Iberian Socialist Union§!.
loc.POR_the_popular_front_bloc_desc: Now that we have emphasized our Iberian identity and consolidated our nation as [Root.GetNameDef], we must spread Communism abroad and look for allies willing to join our cause and fight together against tyranny and oppression.
loc.POR_the_popular_front_bloc_tt: Gets event §Y'Portugal invites us to the Popular Front Bloc'§!.
loc.POR_the_popular_front_bloc_explanatory_t: Any independent §YCommunist§! nation in Europe will get the event §Y'Portugal invites us to the Popular Front Bloc'§!.
loc.POR_latin_american_communism_desc: We must reach to the Latin American peoples. Appealing to the Communist elements present there and supporting their efforts on spreading the idea of a united international bloc, we will create the foundations of an alliance between American and European Socialists.
loc.POR_our_comrades_overseas_desc: We will arrange a conference between those Latin American nations willing to be part of our bloc. It is time to show the world the unity between Latin American and Iberian peoples.
loc.POR_our_comrades_overseas_tt: Any independent §YCommunist§! nation in Latin America will get the event §Y'Portugal invites us to the Popular Front Bloc'§!.
loc.POR_cooperate_with_french_militants_desc: Our comrades in France desperately need aid in their struggle against the Fascist nations invading their country. We must supply them with weapons, equipment and munitions so that they can stand a chance in their fight.
loc.POR_anti_fascism_desc: Fascism is a great threat to our cause and it needs to be dealt with. We must fight by all means to free the world from its evil claws.
loc.POR_anti_fascism_tt: Gains §YTopple Government§! war goal against major or neighboring Fascist nations:
loc.POR_strengthen_the_regime_desc: There are still many dissidents plotting against the regime. We will reinforce the secret police, providing them with the means to root out subversive organizations.
loc.POR_the_capital_of_espionage_desc: There are endless agents and plots in Lisbon: spies gathering information on trans-Atlantic shipments, traitors cooperating with their former foes and double agents transmitting false intelligence to the enemy. We can take advantage of this situation, gathering fragments of the information moving through our territory and improving our own counter intelligence.
loc.POR_appease_monarchists_desc: In order to earn the support of the monarchist elements in our country, we must co-opt them in the government and give the impression that the restoration of the Monarchy is a possibility for the future. These compromises can provide us with the stability and support that the regime needs.
loc.POR_national_gold_reserves_desc: There is profit to be made in this war while remaining neutral. Both sides are competing for our friendship and our goods and, if we manage to meet their demands, our gold reserves can increase substantially.
loc.POR_concordat_with_the_holy_see_desc: We will negotiate an agreement with the Vatican, encouraging the social role of the Church and preventing it from interfering in the political affairs of Portugal.\n\n"Deus, Pátria e Família" - António de Oliveira Salazar
loc.POR_honor_anglo_portuguese_alliance_desc: The Anglo-Portuguese Alliance, dating from the fourteenth century, is the oldest alliance in the world. In these fateful times, we shall honor this treaty and assist [ENG.GetNameDef] in the war.\nTogether we will prevail!
loc.POR_proudly_alone_desc: To join the war will potentially result in the invasion of our country and the loss of our overseas territories. Besides, entering the conflict would destabilize the Iberian Peninsula and put Portugal at risk of being occupied by Spain as well. We must remain neutral and seek the safety of our lands, for there are other threats lurking...
loc.POR_the_eastern_menace_desc: The success of [JAP.GetNameDef] in China and South-East Asia were mainly due to the poor state of the enemy troops they faced. We must prevent the same from happening in our eastern territories. We will strengthen our colonies and strike the first blow before the [JAP.GetAdjective] do it.
loc.POR_ditadura_militar_desc: We finally have the support necessary to remove Salazar from power and restore the Military Dictatorship. We will leave the New State behind and take the measures that Portugal needs to prosper in these fateful times.
loc.POR_field_maneuvers_desc: The Corpo do Estado Maior has developed new maneuvers that will help to reevaluate and update our oldest doctrines; a required step to create a modern army.
loc.POR_tropas_paraquedistas_desc: We will form an elite infantry assault force, capable of being launched in the rear of the enemy forces, providing an invaluable tactical advantage.
loc.POR_regimento_de_comandos_desc: We have need of elite forces, trained for different combat situations and able to perform in the harshest conditions.\n\n"Audaces Fortuna Juvat"
loc.FRA_laissez_faire_tt: Our economy will become more efficient after a period of about two years.
loc.FRA_carry_the_revolution_west_tt: Grants a §YTopple Government§! wargoal against §YSpain§! or any surviving, non-communist factions of the Spanish Civil War.
loc.nationalist_victory: Nationalist Spain has won the Spanish Civil War
loc.republican_victory: Republican Spain has won the Spanish Civil War
loc.SPR_military_disloyalty_desc: The failed "Sanjurjada" military coup attempt in 1932 still casts it shadow over the Spanish military to this day. In the aftermath, various disloyal military commanders, among them the coup's leader José Sanjurjo, fled to exile in Portugal and continue their plotting even now.\n\nEven this failure has not discouraged disloyal officers, however, as even within Spain itself many desire to see a return to a Monarchy, or even a strong Fascist dictatorship. Too strong meddling by the government in the internal affairs of the military may well spark yet another uprising; far more violent and bloody than the last.
loc.SPR_military_disloyalty_tt: §RCannot train units, disband units, or edit unit templates.§!\n
loc.SPR_disbanded_army_desc: The army has proven its disloyalty and has been disbanded by the government. Until we make the loyalty of our officers certain we must rely on people's militias rather than a professional army.
loc.FRA_full_employment_desc: We are in the enviable position of having very low unemployment, partially because of the massive bloodshed of the Great War. However, this has made it difficult for companies to find skilled workers, and the military finds it hard to compete with the labour market for recruits. Extending the draft would only exacerbate the problem. We should try and find other sources of manpower to make up for the shortfall, either in recruitment or in the economy.
loc.FRA_worker_shortage_desc: The demands of the military have been allowed to overrule concerns about labour shortages. Many companies now report shortages in skilled workers that have started to affect production output. Easing up our conscription laws would allow people to return to the factories, but won't solve the underlying problems.
loc.FRA_inefficient_economy_1_desc: While still a major industrialized country, France has been left behind in terms of concentration of production capabilities. Major reforms are needed to make our economy more competitive in the global scale.
loc.FRA_political_violence_desc: Communists and far-right extremist leagues are always ready to resort to violence to advance their political cause.
loc.SPA_awaiting_the_rebellion_desc: The coup has been meticulously planned, and we are ready to spring it at any time. However, we have learned from our previous failures. Rather than have a repeat of the 1932 Sanjurjada fiasco, we will wait until popular sentiment sufficiently supports our cause, ensuring we will not be so easily ousted.
loc.SPA_carlism_desc: In 1830 King Ferdinand VII promulgated the Pragmatic Sanction and made his daughter, the future Isabella II, heir presumptive. This act removed his brother Infante Carlos from the line of succession, and so, upon the King's death, supporters of Infante Carlos ignited a series of civil wars, uniting under the banner of Carlism and fighting for the reinstatement of the Salic line of succession.\n\nA century later, the Carlist movement is still very much alive, and its militias, called Requetés, train unceasingly in preparation for the time where they will once more be needed to defend Christianity and champion the return of the rightful King.
loc.SPR_government_power_struggle_desc: Though victorious in the recent elections, the political parties of the left are fragmented as each vies for dominance of the new government. The office of the president itself is under particular attack, as long-standing feuds the president has had with various parts of the political Left are coming to a head. Eager and ambitious politicians already eye this position hungrily.
loc.SPR_political_violence_desc: The Spanish political scene is one of increasing polarization and violence. Only two years have elapsed since the last big uprising, the Asturias Miners' Strike, and the current political climate appears to have all the makings of a new, far larger and far less localized uprising. It seems unlikely that the upcoming elections will put an end to this downward spiral of societal unrest.
loc.SPR_national_strikes_desc: The country finds itself seemingly in the grips of the starting stages of a workers' revolution; strike upon strike paralyze the industry and daily life as workers demand less work and more pay, and poor tenant farmers increasingly appropriate farmland while the government turns a blind eye.
loc.SPR_scw_not_in_progress_tt: The Spanish Civil War is not in progress
loc.operation_boost_resistance_desc: §LPartisans in enemy-occupied territory are desperate for support to continue the fight. They are tying down significant amounts of enemy troops, and would be a very effective investment.§!
loc.operation_capture_cipher_desc: §LCapturing an enemy codebook, or acquiring it by other means, would give our codebreakers a decisive advantage in their efforts.§!
loc.infiltration_paradrop_desc: Agents will be dropped into the area via parachute. Flying low and at night will avoid any interference from enemy fighters.
loc.infiltration_submarine_desc: Agents will be delivered close to the shore by one of our submarines. We have already reconnoitred possible landing sites and the timing of enemy patrols to avoid detection.
loc.infiltration_border_desc: Agents will infiltrate across a neutral border. Border guards in the area are expected to be less alert and we have already identified a number of areas where border patrols are very infrequent.
loc.infiltration_diplomatic_desc: Agents will use diplomatic passports to enter the country and move around. We expect enemy counter-intelligence to try and tail them, but this can be overcome with sufficient training.
loc.resistance_support_arms_depots_desc: Our agents will set up a number of hidden caches of explosives and other equipment, in preparation of a general uprising once the resistance is strong enough.
loc.resistance_support_distribute_weapons_de: Our agents will organize and coordinate a series of weapon drops. The weapons will then be handed to trusted members of the local resistance.
loc.resistance_support_organize_training_des: Our agents will hold courses in escape & evasion skills as well as basic fieldcraft. The most promising students will then proceed to basic firearms training.
loc.resistance_support_coordinate_groups_des: Our agents will travel around to coordinate various resistance groups. Forging an alliance between the politically fractured units will take some doing.
loc.exfiltration_air_pickup_desc: One of our airplanes will cross into enemy territory at night, find a marked field, land, and pick up our agents.
loc.exfiltration_submarine_pickup_desc: One of our Submarines will be on station at a designated pickup point along the coast. Timing will be of the essence as enemy naval patrols do cover the area.
loc.exfiltration_border_desc: Our agents will escape by crossing the border at night in a remote location. Local guides are standing by to assist in navigating the treacherous area.
loc.exfiltration_go_to_ground_desc: Our agents will lay low and blend into the population until they are ready for the next mission. Should an opportunity arise to exfiltrate by other means, they will take it.
loc.operation_make_resistance_contacts_desc: §LAny support we can offer to the partisans active behind enemy lines would become far more effective if we had a way to communicate and coordinate with them.§!
loc.capture_cyphers_bribe_desc: We have a man on the inside and will provide him with the necessary funds to steal a codebook and turn it over to our agent.
loc.capture_cyphers_raid_desc: Our Agent will scout the area and signal a commando unit to land and capture codebooks and encryption equipment. We will also try to capture one or two encryption specialists for interrogation.
loc.capture_cyphers_seduction_desc: Our Agent will contact a person with access to the cyphers and use their charm  - or other means - to secure a copy.
loc.capture_cyphers_reverse_engineer_desc: A simpler version of the country's primary encryption machine is commercially available. We will acquire a version legally and then use it to help us reverse-engineer a decryption machine.
loc.resistance_contacts_radio_circuits_desc: The team will distribute radios to resistance members and teach basic radio protocol, especially with an eye towards avoiding enemy radio-direction finding.
loc.resistance_support_pidgeons_desc: The team will distribute trained homing pigeons to various breeders connected to the resistance. They will be used to carry messages back to our lines.
loc.resistance_contacts_briefings_desc: Our Agent will brief the leaders of various resistance groups on planned operations to coordinate resistance support.
loc.capture_cyphers_smuggle_desc: One of our double agents will request a new copy of the currently active cypher to be transferred. Coordination with other services is underway to ensure that the drop-off is not interrupted.
loc.operation_steal_tech_airforce_desc: §LWe have received a number of very worrying reports that the enemy is ahead of us in several areas of aircraft design. If this is the case, we could attempt to gain insights into exactly how far ahead they are and utilize these findings to advance our own research.§!
loc.operation_infiltrate_armed_forces_navy_d: §LWhile the close-knit crews of [From.GetAdjective] ships offer few avenues of infiltration, the support staff back home is another matter. Getting someone on the inside would give us valuable information as well as the opportunity to support more difficult operations later.§!
loc.operation_infiltrate_civilian_desc: §LThe [From.GetAdjective] government has numerous weakpoints through which we might infiltrate an agent into its operations. Doing so would give us valuable insight into the internal workings of [From.GetNameDef] as well as giving us an opportunity to utilize this agent in future operations against [From.GetNameDef].§!
loc.operation_infiltrate_armed_forces_airfor: §LThe [From.getAdjective] Air Force is the youngest of the [From.GetAdjective] armed forces. As such, it has in its ranks many people of unusual backgrounds. We could exploit some of them to get a man on the inside.§!
loc.operation_infiltrate_armed_forces_army_d: §LThe [From.GetAdjective] Army has a number of individuals in its ranks that could be turned to provide additional information and support for future operations.§!
loc.operation_steal_tech_army_desc: §LOur intelligence analysts believe that [From.GetNameDef] has made significant advances in the field of Ground Warfare and military engineering. A more thorough investigation, coupled with some more direct methods, might yield some valuable insight for our own research projects.§!
loc.operation_steal_tech_civilian_desc: §LIt appears that our industry is lagging behind [From.GetNameDef] in several areas. With a bit of cunning and a little subterfuge, we may be able to close the gap considerably.§!
loc.operation_steal_tech_navy_desc: §LThe have been reports that the [From.GetAdjective] seem to be ahead of us in some areas of naval engineering. We might be in a position to acquire some of that tech for reverse-engineering.§!
loc.infiltrate_military_bribe_desc: Our agent will identify a person in financial difficulties and offer a substantial sum to provide us with support. Funds will be made available from the treasury.
loc.infiltrate_military_seduction_desc: Our Agent will enter into a very close and intimate relationship with someone on the inside to gain information and leverage on them.
loc.infiltrate_military_turned_pow_desc: We will identify a usable Prisoner of War in our care, turn him to our side, and then repatriate him. He will no doubt be interrogated, but with proper training he will be able to overcome this.
loc.infiltrate_military_ideological_supporte: We will use diplomatic back-channels to identify and contact members of the [From.GetAdjective] administration with political views not shared by their government and encourage them to work for us.
loc.steal_blueprints_bribe_desc: Our Agent will offer a substantial sum to an engineer involved in the project.
loc.steal_blueprints_seduction_desc: Our Agent will get close to a person involved with the project and apply their charms to gain additional insights. While we don't expect anyone to hand over a full set of blueprints for some quality company time, pillow talk is often unguarded.
loc.steal_blueprints_infiltrate_naval_design: Our Agent will enter a smaller supplier in naval construction as a minor employee and use this position to make copies of available plans.
loc.steal_blueprints_steal_prototype_desc: After undergoing basic flight training, and accompanied by a test pilot of our air force, our agent will gain access to a prototype and fly it to our lines. A fighter escort will be arranged to ensure the prototype reaches us intact.
loc.steal_blueprints_middle_manager_desc: Our Agent will utilize provided references and a doctored CV to gain employment in the middle management in a major company. From this position, they should be able to provide information on that company as well as the industry as a whole.
loc.lar_communist_uprising_organise_cells_de: Our agents will work with a few select workers to create Revolutionary Action Committees to carry the seeds of the revolution into every factory.
loc.lar_communist_uprising_infiltrate_civil_: Our agent will ensure that several trustworthy people enter the civil service, to form the core for a civilian administration after the revolution succeeds.
loc.lar_communist_uprising_train_workers_mil: Our agent will organize basic training for a number of hand-picked comrades, who will then form the cadre of militia units.
loc.lar_communist_uprising_organize_strikes_: Our agent will reach out to trade unions and other politically reliable people working in key industries and help them organize a strike, to be executed when the war starts.
loc.lar_fra_coup_pre_position_units_desc: Our agent will take charge of a number of sympathetic army units in the area and assign them objectives to be seized when the operation commences.
loc.lar_fra_launch_coup_desc: Operations will commence upon reception of a coded radio signal.
loc.FRA_coup_in_north_africa_desc: Many Frenchmen in North Africa are still eager to get back in the fight against the invaders. We just need to reach out to them.
loc.FRA_coup_in_syria_desc: Many Frenchmen in Syria are still eager to get back in the fight against the invaders. We just need to reach out to them.
loc.FRA_coup_in_indochina_desc: Many Frenchmen in Indochina are still eager to get back in the fight against the invaders. We just need to reach out to them.
loc.FRA_coup_in_central_africa_desc: Many Frenchmen in Central Africa are still eager to get back in the fight against the invaders. We just need to reach out to them.
loc.FRA_coup_in_west_africa_desc: Many Frenchmen in West Africa are still eager to get back in the fight against the invaders. We just need to reach out to them.
loc.FRA_coup_in_madagascar_desc: Many Frenchmen in Madagascar are still eager to get back in the fight against the invaders. We just need to reach out to them.
loc.targeted_sabotage_plant_explosives_desc: Working with local resistance members, our operatives will infiltrate the plant in the dead of night, place explosives near load-bearing structures, and thus collapse the entire factory hall on top of the production equipment.
loc.targeted_sabotage_organize_more_meetings: Interviews with workers have shown that holding extensive meetings to discuss minor issues has the effect of dramatically slowing down production, at minimal cost for our operatives.
loc.targeted_sabotage_destroy_bridge_desc: Local resistance has identified a bridge forming a lynchpin of enemy supply efforts in the region. Our operatives will bring down the span with a few pounds of high explosives.
loc.targeted_sabotage_collapse_tunnel_desc: The main railway line in the state runs through a narrow tunnel. Our operatives have identified the structural weakpoints in the construction and will utilize explosives to collapse the tunnel.
loc.targeted_sabotage_remove_roadsigns_desc: Our operatives will knock down street signs and turn others around in an effort to make navigation by occupation troops more difficult.
loc.targeted_sabotage_immobilize_rolling_sto: A handful of sand in the lubrication points of a railway carriage will eventually make it grind to a halt, thus blocking a rail line until it can be repaired. Even a small number of disabled cars could collapse the entire system.
loc.targeted_sabotage_burn_storage_desc: Local resistance have identified storage units that contain highly flammable compounds. Under the cover of night, our operatives will set fire to the storage and then withdraw in the ensuing confusion.
loc.targeted_sabotage_destroy_mining_equipme: Local resistance groups have pointed out that a lot of the heavy equipment used in mining is extremely vulnerable. Our agents will utilize explosives to disable a number of critical pieces to grind the entire mining operation to a halt.
loc.operation_targeted_sabotage_industry_des: §LResistance in enemy territory has requested support in disabling a local industrial plant.§!
loc.operation_targeted_sabotage_infrastructu: §LResistance in enemy territory has been waging a low-key effort against enemy infrastructure, but has so far lacked the resources to make a heavy impact.§!
loc.operation_targeted_sabotage_resources_de: §LResistance in enemy territory has informed us of enemy efforts to extract resources in the state. A well-placed wrench thrown into those plans would prevent that.§!
loc.operation_rescue_operative_desc: §LOne of our assets has been taken off the board by the enemy. We must get it back, and quickly, before it is permanently removed from play.§!
loc.free_operative_free_in_transit_desc: Our operative is moved by car between the prison they are kept in and the place where they are being interrogated. We know the route, and will send a small unit to lay an ambush, kill the guards, and free our operative.
loc.free_operative_liberate_camp_desc: While under interrogation, our operative is kept in a camp with other important prisoners. We will mount an attack on the camp with a small unit, overpower any guards present, and liberate our agent.
loc.free_operative_smuggle_in_escape_gear_de: Our scientists have developed a set of escape tools. We have a local contact that has agreed to take the package. Our operative will then utilize the tools given and make their way to the rendezvous for exfiltration.
loc.operation_outcome_consumes_token_tt: This operation might burn an §YInfiltrated Asset§!.
loc.operation_outcome_sabotage_industry_tt: Focuses local resistance on targeting industry and increases the chance of successful attacks.
loc.operation_outcome_sabotage_infrastructur: Focuses local resistance on targeting infrastructure and increases the chance of successful attacks.
loc.operation_outcome_sabotage_resources_tt: Focuses local resistance on targeting resource extraction and increases the chance of successful attacks.
loc.operation_coup_government_desc: §L[From.GetNameDefCap] is ripe for a regime change. A few good, reliable people - with proper support - could topple the rotten structure propping up the [From.GetAdjective] government.§!
loc.collaboration_government_set_up_planning: Our team will meet with some sympathetic politicians to discuss the possibility of a new government being formed to administer [From.GetNameDef] after we occupy it, and form some small work groups that will work out the details.
loc.collaboration_government_train_paramilit: Our team will organize and train some units to aid the new government in maintaining law and order. Until the new government is organized, they will help with keeping the rear areas secured.
loc.collaboration_government_contact_militar: Our team will follow some leads that indicate that some retired military officers are deeply unhappy with the current [From.GetAdjective] government and would be willing to help us create a new government following our occupation.
loc.operation_collaboration_government_desc: §LHaving a friendly government in charge of [From.GetNameDef] would allow us to concentrate on our other enemies and free up troops to pursue other objectives.§!
loc.fake_intel_decoy_tanks_desc: We have invented cheap decoys that look like tanks from a distance. We will place these in easily observable locations and make sure the enemy has plenty of time to notice them.
loc.fake_intel_radio_deception_desc: We will set up a small unit of radio specialists, pretending to be the signals detachment for a much larger formation. They will also be using an older version of our cyphers, to make it easier for the enemy to read their messages.
loc.fake_intel_deliberate_leaks_desc: Some of our agents in foreign countries will ensure that they are being indiscreet around the right people, thus making sure the enemy gets the desired information through 'trustworthy' sources.
loc.fake_intel_press_releases_desc: We will invite reporters to write very detailed stories about some of the things we would like the enemy to know about.
loc.fake_intel_utilize_double_agents_desc: We have turned a number of junior informants of the enemy intelligence service. They will be encouraged to supply the other side with the right kind of information.
loc.fake_intel_plant_evidence_desc: We will mount a small operation at a location the enemy controls but which we are not currently interested in, and make sure that we leave plenty of evidence behind.
loc.fake_intel_release_pow_desc: A captured enemy officer is due to be repatriated home on humanitarian grounds. Before he leaves, we will make sure that he accidentally sees a number of things.
loc.operation_fake_intel_desc: §LWe know that [From.GetAdjective] Intelligence is active in our country. Sometimes, it is better to give someone looking for information just what they want to hear.§!
loc.heavy_water_raid_desc: §LThe Germans have begun producing Heavy Water in a plant in Norway, possibly connected to a program to develop an atomic bomb. Even if the Heavy Water produced is not enough to enable them to build such a weapon, it would no doubt greatly help them in their research.§!
loc.heavy_water_infiltration_desc: A modified bomber will drop a small team of Norwegian commandos in the area to link up with an advance team and local resistance.
loc.heavy_water_attack_desc: Security at the plant is reported to be lax. We have a resistance member on the inside who has provided us with patrol schedules. Once inside, our team will plant explosives and leave evidence that this was a regular military operation.
loc.heavy_water_exfiltration_desc: The team will split up and either join local resistance units or try to make their way back to friendly lines.
loc.bruneval_raid_desc: §LIt appears that the enemy is ahead of us in the development of radar. We have identified an enemy radar installation in a vulnerable location that we believe could be taken by a sufficiently determined assault by a small force to acquire more intelligence.§!
loc.bruneval_infiltration_desc: A company of airborne troops will be assembled, to be dropped at night from low altitude near the objective.
loc.bruneval_attack_desc: The assault force will split into four units to capture the installation and clear the evacuation beach. A specialist will disassemble and photograph the radar set. The unit will also attempt to capture an enemy technician for interrogation.
loc.bruneval_exfiltration_desc: A flottilla of landing craft, carrying troops to cover the evacuation, will land and pick up the assault force. Escort by friendly naval forces will be arranged.
loc.capture_tito_desc: §LYugoslav partisans have grown in strength and are making increasingly bold advances. In many areas, they effectively control the countryside, blocking roads and operating with impunity. The key to this is the Partisan leader Tito, who has been coordinating and controlling these operations. To take him out would deal a serious blow to the resistance in these areas.§!
loc.capture_tito_infiltration_desc: The first wave of paratroopers will be inserted via glider almost on top of Tito's suspected hideout. Utilizing speed and surprise, they will then overwhelm Tito's guards and either capture or kill Tito himself.
loc.capture_tito_attack_desc: A motorized column will advance to link up with the airborne units and in the process destroy all major partisan units that stand and fight.
loc.capture_tito_exfiltration_desc: Once the two assault forces have linked up, they will consolidate and mop up and surviving enemies.
loc.rescue_mussolini_desc: §LAfter being deposed by [ITA.GetLeader], Mussolini has been put under arrest in a small hotel in the Apennine mountains. We have a small window to rescue him and return him to our lines, where he would no doubt help in administering the Italian territories after our victory.§!
loc.rescue_mussolini_infiltration_desc: A specially selected unit will board gliders and land as close to the place where our intelligence service indicates Mussolini is held.
loc.rescue_mussolini_attack_desc: The assault unit will attack and capture the hotel and free Mussolini. Ideally, the garrison will stand down rather than fight it out. Speed and surprise are of the essence.
loc.rescue_mussolini_exfiltration_desc: A small plane with excellent short field capability will land and pick up Mussolini, then turn around and fly him to a friendly airfield.
loc.infiltration_paradrop_outcome: Despite some trouble with finding the dropzone in the dark, the team landed safely.
loc.infiltration_submarine_outcome: With a first attempt dashed by high waves, a second landing attempt the next day was met with success and delivered the team safely to shore.
loc.infiltration_border_outcome: Under the cover of very adverse weather, our team found the previously scouted trail and proceeded across the border without further problems.
loc.infiltration_diplomatic_outcome: The team had no trouble getting into the country and deftly avoided the tail enemy counter-intelligence put on them.
loc.exfiltration_air_pickup_outcome: The small courier plane managed to find the pickup point with little issue, and delivered the team safely back to our lines.
loc.exfiltration_submarine_pickup_outcome: After several tense days of playing hide and seek with a local enemy patrol, our team managed to arrange a pickup and leave the area undetected.
loc.exfiltration_border_outcome: The team escaped by crossing the border under the cover of night, utilizing a local guide to help them find a way through the border defenses.
loc.exfiltration_go_to_ground_outcome: Our team has blended in with local civilians and is currently making plans to either make their way back to our lines or stay in the area for further assignments.
loc.fake_intel_decoy_tanks_outcome: While the enemy conducted a few recon sorties in the area, we can not be certain that they spotted the decoys and were convinced by them. We are awaiting confirmation from other sources that they took the bait.
loc.fake_intel_radio_deception_outcome: Our radio operators produced a lot of traffic. Whether the enemy actually monitored any of it is hard to tell.
loc.fake_intel_deliberate_leaks_outcome: We made sure that enemy agents were supplied with a number of small leaks that paint an altogether different picture of reality. Whether the other side bought it remains to be seen.
loc.fake_intel_press_releases_outcome: Our Department for Public Information has ensured that press coverage in friendly and neutral papers is roughly how we want it to look.
loc.fake_intel_utilize_double_agents_outcome: Our double agents have supplied the other side with a generous helping of information - some of it even correct, to ensure that the enemy continues to trust them.
loc.fake_intel_plant_evidence_outcome: The raid we conducted was a complete success, and the other side recovered plenty of evidence of our operation. Early reports indicate that there have been a number of troop movements in response to it already.
loc.fake_intel_release_pow_outcome: The officer was driven close to several military encampments and was allowed to notice a variety of unit patches for divisions that don't actually exist.
loc.targeted_sabotage_plant_explosives_outco: The team planted the explosives successfully and brought down the building. Damage to the machine tools is reportedly light, but it will still take a lot of time to rebuild.
loc.targeted_sabotage_organize_more_meetings: Our agent successfully infiltrated the middle management of the target company, and has aggressively restructured processes to find greater synergies by driving engagement with key stakeholders. Productivity has dropped significantly.
loc.targeted_sabotage_destroy_bridge_outcome: The team planted the explosives and set the fuze to coincide with a passing train. Between the explosion and the damage of the derailed train, the entire span has dropped into the river.
loc.targeted_sabotage_collapse_tunnel_outcom: After identifying structural weakpoints, the team placed explosives and withdrew. While damage to the tunnel is repairable, it will take some time until the tunnel is fully usable again.
loc.targeted_sabotage_remove_roadsigns_outco: The team successfully removed roadsigns at a number of important intersections and replaced signs on other locations, creating great confusion amongst drivers unfamiliar with the area.
loc.targeted_sabotage_immobilize_rolling_sto: The team infiltrated a railway depot and successfully sabotaged a number of vehicles. The effects should only become apparent after the vehicle has run for a couple of kilometers, stranding it on the open track.
loc.targeted_sabotage_burn_storage_outcome: The team successfully set fire to the local storage areas, destroying hundreds of tons of stored resources and severely impacting the ability to maintain a stockpile.
loc.targeted_sabotage_destroy_mining_equipme: The team managed to sabotage most of the heavy mining equipment. While some of the damage may be superficial, it will still create some serious bottlenecks in the production flow.
loc.steal_blueprints_bribe_outcome: We made contact with an engineer in financial difficulties and convinced him to part with some secret papers in return for some convertible currency.
loc.steal_blueprints_seduction_outcome: Our agent found an engineer in need of some personal company, who has been very open about his work.
loc.steal_blueprints_infiltrate_naval_design: Our agent successfully infiltrated a naval equipment supplier and made copies of a number of key component blueprints.
loc.steal_blueprints_steal_prototype_outcome: The prototype was successfully recovered and flown to a friendly airfield. Our engineers are now taking it apart.
loc.steal_blueprints_middle_manager_outcome: The time spent by our agent in the management of a small company has significantly increased our understanding of the enemy economy. We are still investigating reports that productivity increased while our agent was working there.
loc.capture_cyphers_bribe_outcome: Our agent obtained a full copy of the codebook from an unnamed source in exchange for some valuables.
loc.capture_cyphers_raid_outcome: A small Commando unit successfully raided a radio station and managed to obtain copies of the current cypher before it could be destroyed.
loc.capture_cyphers_seduction_outcome: Our agent was able to convince a person in possession of the cyphers to part with them.
loc.capture_cyphers_smuggle_outcome: Our agent managed to convince their contact in [From.GetNameDef] to send them a full copy of the cyphers used to communicate with them.
loc.capture_cyphers_reverse_engineer_outcome: Our agent has successfully obtained an example of the enemy's encryption machine. While less capable than the military models, it will still allow us a great deal of insight into their operations.
loc.collaboration_government_set_up_planning: The team set up a number of planning groups to organize the new government and ensure a smooth transition of power once combat operations are over.
loc.collaboration_government_train_paramilit: The team has organized a number of reliable men, some with military experience, into small paramilitary units, which will help in guarding the rear of our advancing army.
loc.collaboration_government_contact_militar: Our team has made a few contacts with retired military officers, who may be convinced to help in organizing a new government so long as they may play a role in it.
loc.free_operative_free_in_transit_outcome: With the support of a small Commando unit, our team was able to execute an ambush and recover our agent while they were being moved to a new location.
loc.free_operative_liberate_camp_outcome: Mere hours before the prisoners were due to be moved, a small Commando unit managed to liberate the prison where our agent was being held.
loc.free_operative_smuggle_in_escape_gear_ou: Our agent received the escape tools and successfully broke out of the prison under the cover of night, evading search teams and patrols for several days before being able to make contact.
loc.infiltrate_military_bribe_outcome: Our agent successfully convinced a soldier on active duty to work for us in return for a significant sum of money.
loc.infiltrate_military_seduction_outcome: Our agent has begun a relationship with an active soldier, who has become a quite reliable source of information.
loc.infiltrate_military_turned_pow_outcome: Our Department of Psychological Operations has successfully convinced a prisoner of war about the justice of our cause and sent him back to the other side.
loc.infiltrate_military_ideological_supporte: Our agent has made contact with a number of officers who no longer support the current [From.GetAdjective] regime.
loc.resistance_contacts_radio_circuits_outco: The team has made contact with several resistance units and instructed them in radio technique, leaving a radio operator with each one.
loc.resistance_support_pidgeons_outcome: A number of pigeons were dropped behind enemy lines with instructions on how to feed and care for them.
loc.resistance_contacts_briefings_outcome: The team instructed resistance members of planned operations in their sector, set priorities for intelligence gathering, and arranged supply drops.
loc.resistance_support_arms_depots_outcome: The team set ups several arms and munitions depots in concealed locations to improve the striking power of the resistance.
loc.resistance_support_distribute_weapons_ou: The team distributed weapons to a number of resistance cells and instructed the members in their use.
loc.resistance_support_organize_training_out: The team held courses in basic fieldcraft, small-arms maintenance and demolitions.
loc.resistance_support_coordinate_groups_out: The team gathered representatives of the largest resistance groups to properly coordinate operations on a larger scale and ensuring supplies were directed where they are most needed.
loc.heavy_water_raid_outcome_tt: We will attempt to destroy the German Heavy Water Plant, preventing a breakthrough in their nuclear research project.
loc.bruneval_raid_outcome_tt: We will attempt to secure components of enemy radar technology to aid our own research.
loc.capture_tito_outcome_tt: We will attempt to capture or kill Tito. This is a risky operation which might fail.
loc.rescue_mussolini_outcome_tt: We will attempt to liberate Mussolini. This is a risky operation which might fail.
loc.coordinated_strike_scout_target_desc: The team will reconnoitre the targets, take photographs and provide the latest information on the location of high-value targets.
loc.coordinated_strike_scout_target_outcome: The team provided accurate information on the location of enemy headquarters and other important locations only hours before the attack commenced.
loc.coordinate_strike_mark_targets_desc: The team will use pre-arranged signals and markers to allow our forces to more easily detect high-value targets.
loc.coordinate_strike_mark_targets_outcome: Despite having to be done at short notice and in darkness, the markings were very successful at directing our forces to the most important targets.
loc.coordinated_strike_sabotage_communicatio: Our team will cut telephone lines and ambush messengers to disrupt enemy communications in the crucial first few hours.
Our team successfully disrupted enemy communications, leading to a slow response to our attack.
loc.coordinated_strike_direct_units_desc: When the attack begins, our team will direct our units to the most valuable targets by radio.
loc.coordinated_strike_direct_units_outcome: Our team has been very successful at directing our units, increasing the damage done to the enemy.
loc.coordinated_strike_occupy_bridges_desc: Our team will seize bridges in the area, preventing their destruction and blocking enemy counter-attacks.
loc.coordinated_strike_occupy_bridges_outcom: The team successfully overpowered the guards at a key bridge and cut the wires for the demolition charges, allowing our forces to proceed unhindered.
loc.operation_coordinated_strike_desc: §LTo achieve victory over [From.GetNameDef], we must strike a crushing surprise blow.§!\n\nPrepare §YPort Strike§! and §YStrategic Bombing§! air missions in the target region and they will strike as the operation completes and initiate war between us.
loc.coordinated_strike_tt: We will declare war on §Y[From.GetNameDef]§! through a surprise attack. When activated all prepared Port Strike and Strategic Bombing in the target region will execute multiple times without air defence being able to intercept them.
loc.exfiltration_air_pickup_outcome_fail: §ROur pilot found the designated landing place lit up brightly with floodlights from several enemy anti-air units, and decided that the operation was compromised.§!
loc.exfiltration_submarine_pickup_outcome_fa: §RThe submarine waited at the agreed-upon extraction point for several hours, but no message was received from shore indicating that our team was ready for extraction. The crew reported increased enemy activity on the shore during that period.§!
loc.exfiltration_border_outcome_fail: §RThe guide on the other side of the border waited in vain for our team to appear, until he had to abandon his post due to an approaching enemy patrol.§!
loc.exfiltration_go_to_ground_outcome_fail: §RThe team has so far failed to make contact during the pre-arranged schedule. We have no further information on what happened to them.§!
loc.enemy_has_equal_or_better_radar_tech_tri: The enemy has equal or better radar technology.
loc.OPERATION_BONUS_REWARD: The operation was an immense success, and yielded §Gbonus rewards§!!
loc.targeted_sabotage_resources_2_tt: Local Resistance in [From.From.GetName] will focus more of their efforts on sabotaging local resource extraction.
loc.targeted_sabotage_resources_3_tt: Local Resistance in [From.From.GetName] will make a large effort to sabotage local resource extraction.
loc.targeted_sabotage_industry_2_tt: Local Resistance in [From.From.GetName] will focus more of their efforts on sabotaging local factories.
loc.targeted_sabotage_industry_3_tt: Local Resistance in [From.From.GetName] will make a large effort to sabotage local factories.
loc.targeted_sabotage_infrastructure_2_tt: Local Resistance in [From.From.GetName] will focus more of their efforts on sabotaging local infrastructure.
loc.targeted_sabotage_infrastructure_3_tt: Local Resistance in [From.From.GetName] will make a large effort to sabotage local infrastructure
loc.heavy_water_infiltration_outcome: The team successfully parachuted into the area.
loc.heavy_water_attack_outcome: The team successfully infiltrated the plant, avoiding all guards. Less than an hour later, a major explosion wrecked the plant.
loc.heavy_water_exfiltration_outcome: We have not heard anything from the team since the raid, but this is expected.
loc.heavy_water_exfiltration_outcome_fail: German sources have announced the capture of the Operation Gunnerside team. It appears that the team ran into trouble while making its getaway from the plant.
loc.bruneval_infiltration_outcome: The assault unit landed successfully, with minimal scattering from the paradrop.
loc.bruneval_attack_outcome: The paratroopers moved towards the objective and destroyed the weak garrison in a short but fierce firefight.
loc.bruneval_exfiltration_outcome: The force embarked on landing craft for transportation back to our lines, taking with it an enemy radar technician for interrogation.
loc.bruneval_exfiltration_outcome_fail: Following the evacuation to Britain, it was discovered that our agent was not amongst those recovered from the beach. It is unclear when exactly contact was lost, but we must assume the worst.
loc.capture_tito_attack_outcome: See attached operation report for further information on the operation's outcome.
loc.organise_cells_outcome: Several revolutionary cells were organized and have begun operating in the enemy rear.
loc.infiltrate_civil_service_outcome: We have placed a number of reliable people in positions of power, allowing them to quickly take over administrating liberated territories.
loc.workers_militia_outcome: Several battalions of worker militia stand ready to guard critical installations.
loc.organize_strikes_outcome: Our agent has successfully convinced trade unionists and workers to begin a major strike.
loc.preposition_units_outcome: Our assets in the country have been placed to capture critical infrastructure when the uprising begins.
loc.launch_coup_exfiltration_outcome: On receipt of the start signal, our agent led several units to capture their assigned objectives. The rebels have successfully taken control of a slice of territory.
loc.launch_coup_exfiltration_outcome_fail: In the confusion of the uprising, we have lost contact with our operative. We may never find out what happened.
loc.operation_warsaw_uprising_desc: The brave resistance fighters of Poland long to liberate Warsaw our nation from our enemies. We just need to give them the signal and Poland will live once again!
loc.warsaw_uprising_operation_tt: Trigger a national uprising in Poland, creating new units in its states.
loc.raid_trotskys_villa_desc: Trotsky has been holed up in his villa, corresponding with other party members to plot against the Soviet state. We can send a small team to attack his house and put this to an end.
loc.raid_trotskys_villa_outcome_tt: A small group of assassins will be sent to Trotsky's villa to try and kill him.
loc.raid_trotskys_villa_attack_desc: A small group led by a NKVD officer will breach the villa, overpower any guards, find Trotsky, and execute him for crimes against the state.
loc.raid_trotskys_villa_attack_outcome: The team made its way into the villa and engaged in a firefight with Trotsky's guards.
loc.murder_trotsky_desc: A direct assault is unlikely to succeed. We should use more subtle means to get close to Trotsky, and then strike him down while his back is turned.
loc.murder_trotsky_outcome_tt: We will attempt to assassinate Trotsky using an agent we have placed in his circle.
loc.murder_trotsky_infiltration_desc: Using a forged Canadian passport, our Agent will travel to Trotsky's location and befriend his guards.
loc.murder_trotsky_infiltration_outcome: Our agent successfully gained the trust of Trotsky and his guards, using the access provided by his forged passport.
loc.murder_trotsky_attack_desc: Our agent will isolate Trotsky from his guards by showing him an article he wants to discuss in private. Once alone, he will assassinate Trotsky with an ice pick.
loc.murder_trotsky_attack_outcome: The agent managed to get Trotsky alone and struck a heavy blow with an ice pick. This did not immediately kill Trotsky, but he died later in hospital.
loc.murder_trotsky_exfiltration_desc: Our agent will try to use the confusion and chaos to escape and avoid interrogation.
loc.murder_trotsky_exfiltration_outcome: In the confusion following the attack, our agent managed to get away without anyone getting a good view of his face.
loc.murder_trotsky_exfiltration_outcome_fail: Our agent was apprehended by Trotsky's guard detail and turned over to the authorities. He has been charged with murder.
loc.nuclear_espionage_desc: Our nuclear weapons program is behind other countries. We should plan an operation to infiltrate foreign atomic weapons programs and acquire vital blueprints and data.
loc.nuclear_espionage_outcome_tt: We will place an agent inside the [FROM.GetAdjective] nuclear research program who will attempt to pass technical documentation that can be used in our own atomic project.
loc.SWI_boost_resistance_buff: \nThe §YStrengthen Resistance§! Operation becomes significantly more effective.
loc.LOADING_TIP_0: It is humiliating to remain with our hands folded while others write history. It matters little who wins.\n- Benito Mussolini
loc.LOADING_TIP_1: To make a people great it is necessary to send them to battle even if you have to kick them in the pants. That is what I shall do.\n- Benito Mussolini
loc.LOADING_TIP_2: Every soldier must know, before he goes into battle, how the little battle he is to fight fits into the larger picture.\n- Bernard L. Montgomery
loc.LOADING_TIP_3: If we lose the war in the air we lose the war and we lose it quickly.\n- Bernard L. Montgomery
loc.LOADING_TIP_4: It's good to trust others, but, not to do so is much better.\n- Benito Mussolini
loc.LOADING_TIP_5: From a philosophical and doctrinal viewpoint, I do not believe in perpetual peace.\n- Benito Mussolini
loc.LOADING_TIP_7: As long as there are sovereign nations possessing great power, war is inevitable.\n- Albert Einstein
loc.LOADING_TIP_8: Those who vote decide nothing. Those who count the vote decide everything.\n- Joseph Stalin
loc.LOADING_TIP_9: History shows that there are no invincible armies and that there never have been.\n- Joseph Stalin
loc.LOADING_TIP_10: The Pope! How many divisions has he got?\n- Joseph Stalin
loc.LOADING_TIP_11: Gaiety is the most outstanding feature of the Soviet Union.\n- Joseph Stalin
loc.LOADING_TIP_12: The only real power comes out of a long rifle.\n- Joseph Stalin
loc.LOADING_TIP_13: Any alliance whose purpose is not the intention to wage war is senseless and useless.\n- Adolf Hitler
loc.LOADING_TIP_14: Great liars are also great magicians.\n- Adolf Hitler
loc.LOADING_TIP_15: If today I stand here as a revolutionary, it is as a revolutionary against the Revolution.\n- Adolf Hitler
loc.LOADING_TIP_16: If you tell a big enough lie and tell it frequently enough, it will be believed.\n- Adolf Hitler
loc.LOADING_TIP_17: Germany will either be a world power or will not be at all.\n- Adolf Hitler
loc.LOADING_TIP_18: Success consists of going from failure to failure without loss of enthusiasm.\n- Winston Churchill
loc.LOADING_TIP_19: If you're going through hell, keep going.\n- Winston Churchill
loc.LOADING_TIP_20: The best argument against democracy is a five-minute conversation with the average voter.\n- Winston Churchill
loc.LOADING_TIP_21: Whenever in future wars the battle is fought, panzer troops will play the decisive role.\n- Heinz Guderian
loc.LOADING_TIP_22: The new German Panther and Tiger can be used until they break down without trying to repair them. They have bad engines, transmission and suspension.\n- Department of Weaponry of the Red Army
loc.LOADING_TIP_23: No bastard ever won a war by dying for his country. He won it by making the other poor dumb bastard die for his country.\n- George S. Patton
loc.LOADING_TIP_24: A good plan violently executed now is better than a perfect plan executed next week.\n- George S. Patton
loc.LOADING_TIP_25: Lead me, follow me, or get out of my way.\n- George S. Patton
loc.LOADING_TIP_26: Nobody ever defended anything successfully, there is only attack and attack and attack some more.\n- George S. Patton
loc.LOADING_TIP_27: Wars may be fought with weapons, but they are won by men. It is the spirit of men who follow and of the man who leads that gains the victory.\n- George S. Patton
loc.LOADING_TIP_28: The first time I ever saw a jet, I shot it down.\n- Chuck Yeager, USAAF
loc.LOADING_TIP_29: Theo, Heinrich here. Have just shot down two bombers. No more ammunition. I'm going to ram. Auf Wiedersehen, see you in Valhalla!\n- Heinrich Ehrler, Luftwaffe
loc.LOADING_TIP_30: Leadership consists of picking good men and helping them do their best.\n- Chester W. Nimitz
loc.LOADING_TIP_31: Is the proposed operation likely to succeed? Is it in the realm of practicability in terms of material and supplies?\n- Chester W. Nimitz
loc.LOADING_TIP_32: In preparing for battle I have always found that plans are useless, but planning is indispensable.\n- Dwight D. Eisenhower
loc.LOADING_TIP_33: What counts is not necessarily the size of the dog in the fight - it's the size of the fight in the dog.\n- Dwight D. Eisenhower
loc.LOADING_TIP_34: It goes without saying that when survival is threatened, struggles erupt between peoples, and unfortunate wars between nations result.\n- Hideki Tojo
loc.LOADING_TIP_35: In a man-to-man fight, the winner is he who has one more round in his magazine.\n- Erwin Rommel
loc.LOADING_TIP_36: I would rather be the hammer than the anvil.\n- Erwin Rommel
loc.LOADING_TIP_37: Sweat saves blood, blood saves lives, but brains saves both.\n- Erwin Rommel
loc.LOADING_TIP_38: Poor Neville Chamberlain believed he could trust Hitler. He was wrong. But I don't think I'm wrong about Stalin.\n- Winston Churchill, after the Yalta Conference
loc.LOADING_TIP_39: I believe it is peace for our time.\n- Neville Chamberlain, 1938 after Munich agreement.
loc.LOADING_TIP_40: No enemy bomber can reach the Ruhr. If one reaches the Ruhr, my name is not Göring. You may call me Meyer.\n- Hermann Meyer
loc.LOADING_TIP_41: We have only to kick in the door and the whole rotten structure will come crashing down.\n- Adolf Hitler (on the Soviet Union)
loc.LOADING_TIP_42: I can run wild for the first six to twelve months of a war with the United States and the United Kingdom. After that, I have no expectation of success.\n- Isoroku Yamamoto
loc.LOADING_TIP_43: If we come to a minefield, our infantry attacks exactly as if it were not there.\n- Georgy Zhukov
loc.LOADING_TIP_44: The Russian colossus has been underestimated by us... whenever a dozen divisions are destroyed, the Russians replace them with another dozen.\n- Franz Halder
loc.LOADING_TIP_45: NUTS!\n- Anthony C. McAuliffe, responding to the German demand for surrender
loc.LOADING_TIP_46: It is us today. It will be you tomorrow.\n- Haile Selassie I, 1936
loc.LOADING_TIP_47: Not one step back!\n- Soviet Order No. 227
loc.LOADING_TIP_48: Tora! Tora! Tora!\n- Mitsuo Fuchida, 7 December, 1941
loc.LOADING_TIP_49: Your name is unknown. Your deed is immortal.\n- Tomb of the Unknown Soldier (Moscow)
loc.LOADING_TIP_50: Where is, repeat, where is Task Force Thirty-Four? The world wonders.\n- CINCPAC, Battle of Leyte Gulf
loc.LOADING_TIP_51: The war situation has developed not necessarily to Japan's advantage.\n- Emperor Hirohito, 1945
loc.LOADING_TIP_52: We should have known better after the first war.\n- Gerd von Rundstedt
loc.LOADING_TIP_53: The vastness of Russia devours us.\n- Gerd von Rundstedt
loc.LOADING_TIP_54: I ask you, do you want total war? If necessary, do you want a war more total and radical than anything that we can even yet imagine?\n- Joseph Goebbels
loc.LOADING_TIP_55: One blow from the German army and another from the Soviet army put an end to this ugly product of Versailles.\n- Vyacheslav Molotov (after the fall of Poland)
loc.LOADING_TIP_56: Scratch one flattop! Dixon to carrier: scratch one flattop!\n- Robert E. Dixon, Battle of the Coral Sea
loc.LOADING_TIP_57: Isn't it dreadful? Here we are, two officers of the German General Staff, discussing how best to murder our commander in chief.\n- Henning von Tresckow
loc.LOADING_TIP_58: Hitler is a dancing dervish. He must be shot down.\n- Henning von Tresckow
loc.LOADING_TIP_59: The Nazis entered this war under the rather childish delusion that they were going to bomb everyone else, and nobody was going to bomb them.\n- Arthur 'Bomber' Harris
loc.LOADING_TIP_60: If Hitler invaded Hell, I would make at least a favorable reference to the devil in the House of Commons.\n- Winston Churchill, 21 June, 1941
loc.LOADING_TIP_61: So the bastard's dead? Too bad we didn't capture him alive!\n- Joseph Stalin (on hearing of Hitler's suicide)
loc.LOADING_TIP_62: We have been defeated. We are beaten, we have lost the battle.\n- Paul Reynaud, 15 May, 1940
loc.LOADING_TIP_63: I only need a few thousand dead so that I can sit at the peace conference as a man who has fought.\n- Benito Mussolini
loc.LOADING_TIP_64: The French had lied to the Poles in saying they are going to attack. There is no idea of it.\n- Edmund Ironside
loc.LOADING_TIP_65: Why Die for Danzig?\n- French Anti-War Slogan, 1939
loc.LOADING_TIP_66: There is something phoney about this war.\n- US Senator William Borah, 1939
loc.LOADING_TIP_67: Switzerland possesses the most disgusting and miserable people and political system. The Swiss are the mortal enemies of the new Germany.\n- Adolf Hitler
loc.LOADING_TIP_68: The fruits of victory are tumbling into our mouths too quickly.\n- Emperor Hirohito
loc.LOADING_TIP_69: You will all wind up shining the shoes of the Germans!\n- Italo Balbo
loc.LOADING_TIP_70: Sink, burn, capture, destroy. Let nothing pass.\n- Andrew Cunningham, Battle of Tunisia
loc.LOADING_TIP_71: I think we may be going a bridge too far.\n- Frederick Browning (prior to Operation Market Garden)
loc.LOADING_TIP_72: Thank God for the French Army.\n- Winston Churchill, 1933
loc.LOADING_TIP_73: When you see a rattlesnake poised to strike, you do not wait until he has struck to crush him.\n- Franklin D. Roosevelt
loc.LOADING_TIP_74: Rules are not necessarily sacred, principles are.\n- Franklin D. Roosevelt
loc.LOADING_TIP_75: People who are hungry and out of a job are the stuff of which dictatorships are made.\n- Franklin D. Roosevelt
loc.LOADING_TIP_76: A man has to be alert all the time if he expects to keep on breathing. If not, some German son-of-a-bitch will sneak up behind him and beat him to death with a sock full of shit.\n- George S. Patton
loc.LOADING_TIP_77: Fortifications, artillery, foreign aid - will be of no value, unless the ordinary soldier knows that it is HE guarding his country.\n- Carl Gustaf Emil Mannerheim
loc.LOADING_TIP_78: Through the mud and the blood to the green fields beyond.\n- Unofficial Canadian Armoured Corps motto
loc.LOADING_TIP_79: There is general curiosity in the British Fleet to find out whether the Italians are up to the level they were at in the last war or whether they have fallen off at all.\n- Winston Churchill (on the Italian declaration of war)
loc.LOADING_TIP_80: And we'll fight them with the butt ends of broken beer bottles because that's bloody well all we've got!\n - Winston Churchill (immediately after promising to fight in the fields and in the streets)
loc.LOADING_TIP_81: Experience has shown that attacks against tanks with close combat weapons by a sufficiently determined man will basically always succeed.\n - German Army Group Center anti-tank manual
loc.LOADING_TIP_82: Give me fifty DC-3s and the Japanese can have the Burma Road.\n - Chiang Kai-Shek
loc.LOADING_TIP_83: Politics is war without bloodshed, while war is politics with bloodshed.\n - Mao Zedong
loc.LOADING_TIP_84: Keep men, lose land: land can be taken again. Keep land, lose men: land and men are both lost.\n - Mao Zedong
loc.LOADING_TIP_85: I would rather die in a swamp of Greater Romania than in a paradise of a small Romania.\n - Ion Antonescu
loc.LOADING_TIP_86: People don't matter, only what they represent.\n - Ion Antonescu
loc.LOADING_TIP_87: In wartime, truth is so precious that she should always be attended by a bodyguard of lies.\n - Winston Churchill
loc.LOADING_TIP_88: Vanquished today by mechanical force, in the future we will be able to overcome by a superior mechanical force. The fate of the world depends on it.\n - Charles de Gaulle
loc.LOADING_TIP_89: The long sobs of the violins of autumn wound my heart with a monotonous languor.\n - SOE coded transmission to French resistance
loc.LOADING_TIP_90: A state like Switzerland, which is nothing but a pimple on the face of Europe, cannot be allowed to continue.\n- Adolf Hitler
loc.LOADING_TIP_91: Those who can win a war well can rarely make a good peace, and those who could make a good peace would never have won the war.\n- Winston Churchill
loc.LOADING_TIP_92: An appeaser is one who feeds a crocodile, hoping it will eat him last.\n- Winston Churchill
loc.LOADING_TIP_93: Whoever said the pen is mightier than the sword obviously never encountered automatic weapons.\n- Douglas MacArthur
loc.LOADING_TIP_94: Either I will be decorated or I will be court martialled. Fire!\n- Birger Eriksen
loc.LOADING_TIP_95: In waking a tiger, use a long stick.\n- Mao Zedong
loc.LOADING_TIP_96: If everybody is thinking alike, then somebody isn't thinking.\n- George S. Patton
loc.LOADING_TIP_97: We could do with some of those razor blades, Herr Reichsmarschall.\n- Erwin Rommel, after Göring claimed the Americans only know how to make razor blades
loc.LOADING_TIP_98: I cannot forecast to you the action of Russia. It is a riddle wrapped in a mystery inside an enigma.\n- Winston Churchill
loc.LOADING_TIP_99: However beautiful the strategy, you should occasionally look at the results.\n- Winston Churchill
loc.LOADING_TIP_100: Since the Italian-Greek war, one does not say \"the Greeks are fighting like heroes\", but \"the heroes are fighting like Greeks\".\n- The Montreal Daily Star, 1942
loc.LOADING_TIP_101: Patriotism is when love for your people comes first. Nationalism is when hate for other people than your own comes first.\n- Charles de Gaulle
loc.LOADING_TIP_102: It must be a peace without victory. Victory would mean peace forced upon the loser, a victor's terms imposed upon the vanquished. It would be accepted in humiliation and leave resentment.\n- Woodrow Wilson, 1917
loc.LOADING_TIP_103: If you want total security, go to prison. There you're fed, clothed, given medical care and so on. The only thing lacking is freedom.\n- Dwight D. Eisenhower
loc.LOADING_TIP_104: An army is a team. It lives, eats, sleeps, and fights as a team. This individual hero stuff is bullshit.\n- George S. Patton
loc.LOADING_TIP_105: Never tell people how to do things. Tell them what to do, and they will surprise you with their ingenuity.\n- George S. Patton
loc.LOADING_TIP_106: All men are frightened. The more intelligent they are, the more they are frightened.\n- George S. Patton
loc.LOADING_TIP_107: Human kindness has never weakened the stamina or softened the fiber of a free people. A nation does not have to be cruel in order to be tough.\n- Franklin D. Roosevelt
loc.LOADING_TIP_108: A sincere diplomat is like dry water or wooden iron.\n- Joseph Stalin
loc.LOADING_TIP_109: Throughout history, it has been the inaction of those who could have acted; the indifference of those who should have known better; that has made it possible for evil to triumph.\n- Haile Selassie I
loc.LOADING_TIP_110: Warsaw is not waiting for empty words of praise, for expressions of recognition, not for assurances of sympathy. Warsaw is waiting for weapons and ammunition.\n- Józef Piłsudski
loc.LOADING_TIP_111: Ignorance and obscurantism have never produced anything other than flocks of slaves for tyranny.\n- Emiliano Zapata
loc.LOADING_TIP_112: I'd rather die on my feet, than live on my knees.\n- Emiliano Zapata
loc.LOADING_TIP_113: Gentlemen, you have fought like lions and been led by donkeys.\n- Erwin Rommel, to captured British officers during the siege of Tobruk
loc.LOADING_TIP_114: The trouble with free elections is that you never know how they are going to turn out.\n- Vyacheslav Molotov
loc.LOADING_TIP_115: What does the corpse care who was right and who was wrong?\n- Manuel Azaña
loc.LOADING_TIP_116: Your task will not be an easy one. Your enemy is well trained, well equipped, and battle-hardened. He will fight savagely.\n- Dwight D. Eisenhower, June 1944
loc.LOADING_TIP_117: The quickest way of ending a war is to lose it.\n- George Orwell
loc.LOADING_TIP_118: We do not want any more electoral fraud, nor more lies. We do not want that those who do not work live from those who do.\n- Juan Perón
loc.LOADING_TIP_119: There's the bloody Scheer! Open fire at her!\n- Frederick Secker Bell
loc.LOADING_TIP_120: We must not be defeated by the fear of the very danger which we are preparing to resist. The only thing we have to fear is fear itself.\n- Franklin D. Roosevelt
loc.LOADING_TIP_121: Our freedom has shown its ability to survive war, but our freedom would never survive surrender.\n- Franklin D. Roosevelt
loc.LOADING_TIP_122: Only the greatest folly could lead one to contemplate an invasion. No one will ever land here, not even a single soldier.\n- Benito Mussolini, Sicily, 1937
loc.LOADING_TIP_123: I took up arms to fight against dictatorship in the form of nazism and fascism. If I must die in fighting against a new form of dictatorship, I shall die.\n- Draža Mihailović
loc.LOADING_TIP_124: I know not with what weapons World War III will be fought, but World War IV will be fought with sticks and stones.\n- Albert Einstein
loc.LOADING_TIP_125: I am the leader of one country which has two alphabets, three languages, four religions, five nationalities, six republics, surrounded by seven neighbours, a country in which live eight ethnic minorities.\n- Josip Broz Tito
loc.LOADING_TIP_126: How will future history judge the German people, if not even a handful of men had the courage to put an end to that criminal?\n- Henning von Tresckow
loc.LOADING_TIP_127: The whole world will vilify us now, but I am still totally convinced that we did the right thing. Hitler is the archenemy not only of Germany but of the world.\n- Henning von Tresckow
loc.LOADING_TIP_128: The enemy has begun to employ a new and most cruel bomb, the power of which to do damage is incalculable, taking the toll of many innocent lives.\n- Emperor Hirohito, 1945
loc.LOADING_TIP_129: Rule 1, on page 1 of the book of war, is: \"Do not march on Moscow\". Various people have tried it, and it is no good.\n- Bernard L. Montgomery
loc.LOADING_TIP_130: The lies that Germany will pounce upon Austria tomorrow or the day after are being spread again.\n- Adolf Hitler, 1936
loc.LOADING_TIP_131: The German soldier has astonished the world; the Italian Bersagliere has astonished the German soldier.\n- Erwin Rommel
loc.LOADING_TIP_132: This is the last territorial demand I make in Europe.\n- Adolf Hitler, about the Sudetenland in 1938
loc.LOADING_TIP_133: We are in no position to withstand a prolonged static war. Wherever the allies concentrate their forces they will break through.\n- Gerd von Rundstedt
loc.LOADING_TIP_134: If we have war with the United States, we will have no hope of winning unless the US fleet in Hawaiian waters can be destroyed.\n- Isoroku Yamamoto, 1941
loc.LOADING_TIP_135: You have enemies? Good. That means you have stood up for something, sometime in your life.\n- Winston Churchill
loc.LOADING_TIP_136: This is not a peace. It is an armistice for twenty years.\n- Ferdinand Foch, 1919
loc.LOADING_TIP_137: You can pay too high a price, even for peace.\n- Michael Joseph Savage on Chamberlain's appeasement policy
loc.LOADING_TIP_138: Force is the only language they understand, like bullies.\n- Franklin D. Roosevelt, about Adolf Hitler and Benito Mussolini
loc.LOADING_TIP_139: It has been said that democracy is the worst form of government except all those other forms that have been tried from time to time.\n- Winston Churchill
loc.LOADING_TIP_140: The world will not be destroyed by those who do evil, but by those who watch them without doing anything.\n- Albert Einstein
loc.LOADING_TIP_141: The extreme danger to mankind inherent in the proposal wholly outweighs any military advantage.\n- Robert Oppenheimer on thermonuclear weapons, 1949
loc.LOADING_TIP_142: We knew the world would not be the same. A few people laughed, a few people cried. Most people were silent.\n- Robert Oppenheimer, after the Trinity test
loc.LOADING_TIP_143: Now I am become Death, the destroyer of worlds.\n- Robert Oppenheimer, after the Trinity test
loc.LOADING_TIP_144: Every man is scared in his first battle. If he says he's not, he's a liar.\n- George S. Patton
loc.LOADING_TIP_145: The real hero is the man who fights even though he is scared.\n- George S. Patton
loc.LOADING_TIP_146: Take calculated risks. That is quite different from being rash.\n- George S. Patton
loc.LOADING_TIP_147: There are four hundred neatly marked graves in Sicily, all because one man went to sleep on the job. But they are German graves, because we caught the bastard asleep before his officer did.\n- George S. Patton
loc.LOADING_TIP_148: I have seen war. I have seen blood running from the wounded. I have seen the dead in the mud. I have seen cities destroyed. I hate war.\n- Franklin D. Roosevelt
loc.LOADING_TIP_149: Long live Christ, the king! Long live Austria!\n- Last words of Heinrich Maier, 1945
loc.LOADING_TIP_150: I absolutely reject Nazi Fascism for Austria... This un-Austrian movement promises everything to everyone, but really intends the most ruthless subjugation of the Austrian people!\n- Otto von Habsburg
loc.LOADING_TIP_151: There is no question of ever accepting Nazi representatives in the Austrian cabinet.\n- Kurt Schuschnigg, 1938
loc.LOADING_TIP_152: The king is as fictional an authority as God. This fact made both atheism and republicanism two faces of the same coin.\n- Noe Zhordania
loc.LOADING_TIP_153: There are decades where nothing happens; and there are weeks where decades happen.\n- Vladimir Lenin
loc.LOADING_TIP_154: The raising of that flag on Suribachi means a Marine Corps for the next five hundred years.\n- Secretary of the Navy James Forrestal, Iwo Jima, 1945
loc.LOADING_TIP_155: Let us therefore brace ourselves to our duties, and so bear ourselves that, if the British Empire and its Commonwealth last for a thousand years, men will still say, 'This was their finest hour.'\n- Winston Churchill
loc.LOADING_TIP_156: I am passing through the saddest moment of my life, for I am fulfilling a most painful duty, a duty which for me is worse than death.\n- Jan Syrový, 1938 after accepting the Munich agreement.
loc.LOADING_TIP_157: The Republic is my child. It is in danger of drowning. I am trying to keep it afloat and we are being swept down the river. I call for help to England and America. They stand on the bank and jeer at me. \n- Sun Yat-sen
loc.LOADING_TIP_158: V is the first letter of the words 'Victoire' in French, and 'Vrijheid' in Flemish... Victory of our good friends the English. Their word for Victory also begins with V. \n- Victor de Laveleye, the V for Victory campaign
loc.LOADING_TIP_159: People of the Philippines: I have returned. \n- Douglas MacArthur
loc.LOADING_TIP_160: The fight for freedom is not the fight of one man, nor of one nation. It is the collective struggle of all who refuse to wear the chains of a master. \n- Sergio Osmeña
loc.LOADING_TIP_161: The Coastwatchers saved Guadalcanal, and Guadalcanal saved the South Pacific. \n- William Halsey
loc.LOADING_TIP_162: If I had to take hell, I would use the Australians to take it and the New Zealanders to hold it. \n- Erwin Rommel
