loc.tooltip_raid_category_air_raids: §HAir Bombing raids§! \nAir strikes by a single air wing aimed at striking a specific target.
loc.tooltip_raid_category_nuclear_raids: §HNuclear raids§! \nStrikes carried out by strategic bombers or ballistic missiles carrying nuclear weapons.
loc.tooltip_raid_category_paratrooper_raids: §HParatrooper raids§! \nSmall scale raids performed by Paradropping special forces dropping behind enemy lines, to conduct dangerous sabotage missions.
loc.tooltip_raid_category_naval_commando_rai: §HMarine Commandos raids§! \nSmall scale raids performed by Marines on coastal areas, using small speedboats and similar equipment to make a quick strike and then disappear before the enemy has time to react.
loc.tooltip_raid_category_land_infiltration_: §HLand raids§! \nSmall scale raids performed by land forces behind enemy lines, using stealth and subterfuge to conduct quick hit and run tactics.

loc.raid_type_facility_strike_desc: An Airstrike against an enemy Experimental Facility with the goal of inflicting serious damage to the facility, and any project there.
loc.raid_type_lock_bombing_raid_desc: Aircraft equipped with special bouncing bombs try to destroy the locks, in order to prevent passage through the canal.
loc.raid_type_dam_bombing_raid_desc: Aircraft equipped with special bouncing bombs try to destroy the dam, reducing the effectiveness of it, and making it harder for the enemy to move in the area.
loc.raid_type_gun_emplacement_raid_desc: A flight of bombers equipped with an earthshaker bomb try to destroy an emplacement for a $mega_gun_emplacement$
loc.raid_type_mega_gun_emplacement_strike_de: A strike against a Mega-Gun Emplacement using Earthshaker Bombs
loc.raid_type_oilfield_raid_desc: An Airstrike aimed at knocking a major oil field and its connected Refineries out, in order to seriously disrupt enemy fuel production for an extended period of time.
loc.raid_type_nuclear_strike_desc: A strategic bomber and its escort will fly to the designated target and deploy an atomic bomb. The bomber will then attempt to escape the area to avoid being caught in the blast wave.
loc.raid_type_nuclear_missile_strike_desc: A long range missile will take a sub-orbital ballistic trajectory from the designated launch site towards the intended target. At the appropriate moment, the warhead onboard will detonate an atomic explosion.
loc.raid_type_paratrooper_facility_sabotage_: A team of paratroopers drop on an enemy facility and try to destroy vital equipment using fixed charges, in order to disrupt their scientific progress.
loc.raid_type_mine_sabotage_raid_desc: A team of paratroopers drop on a major enemy mine complex and try to set off charges that will disrupt production for a long time.
loc.raid_type_pathfinder_raid_desc: A team of paratrooper drop behind enemy lines to prepare for an upcoming invasion by destroying critical bridges, setting up ambushes, and generally creating distractions
loc.raid_type_commando_port_raid_desc: A group of marines is sent to damage a large, enemy controlled, $naval_base$. Ships in the port might suffer damage as well.
loc.raid_type_commando_facility_raid_desc: A group of marines is sent to damage an Experimental Facility in a coastal province.
loc.raid_type_rescue_captured_general_desc: A team of soldiers infiltrates behind enemy lines to locate and rescue a Commander being held captive by the enemy.
loc.raid_type_AUS_reichstag_bombing_desc: By sending group of bombers to attack the enemy's main headquarter, and the symbolic place of Germany's power, we can boost our people's morale, while inflicting a blow to our enemies at the same time.
loc.raid_type_ENG_reichstag_bombing_desc: By sending group of bombers to attack the enemy's main headquarter, and the symbolic place of Germany's power, we can boost our people's morale, while inflicting a blow to our enemy's morale at the same time.
loc.raid_type_GER_eben_emael_raid_desc: A storm detachment of paratroopers and glider troops will attack the strategically placed fortress from above, as well as capturing key bridges, roads, and railways in the area to pave the way for the main attacking force.
loc.raid_type_ENG_operation_jericho_desc: Based on information from the French resistance, Germany holds a large number of Resistance fighters captures in Amiens. By sending in a squadron of planes to blow a hole in the prison walls, we should be able to free a large number of those resistance fighters.
loc.raid_type_thermonuclear_strike_desc: A strategic bomber and its escort will fly to the designated target and deploy a thermonuclear bomb. The bomber will then attempt to escape the area to avoid being caught in the blast wave.
loc.raid_type_thermonuclear_missile_strike_d: A long range missile will take a sub-orbital ballistic trajectory from the designated launch site towards the intended target. At the appropriate moment, the warhead onboard will detonate a thermonuclear explosion.
loc.raid_type_CHI_huansheng_raid_desc: Our intelligence states that though valuable targets, the Yawata steel works and the Sasebo Naval Arsenal are too difficult for our airforce to properly strike at this moment. It has therefore been decided that the most effective way to stop this war would be to raise the conscience of the Japanese people against the atrocities committed by the imperialist Japanese warmongers in China, by dropping leaflets over cities such as Nagasaki, Fukuoka, Saga and Osaka.
loc.raid_type_CHI_tokyo_imperial_palace_bomb: By sending a group of bombers to attack the enemy's main headquarters, and the symbolic place of Japan's imperial power, we can boost our people's morale, while inflicting a blow to our enemy's morale at the same time.
loc.raid_type_CHI_national_diet_bombing_desc: By sending a group of bombers to attack the enemy's main headquarters, and the symbolic place of Japan's power, we can boost our people's morale, while inflicting a blow to our enemy's morale at the same time.
loc.raid_type_CHI_hakko_ichiu_bombing_desc: By sending a group of bombers to attack the enemy's symbol of imperialism, we will show Japan's weakness, while we boost our own people's morale.
loc.raid_type_CHI_great_wall_raid_land_desc: The wall does not hold the same defensive value it did in the past, but can still give an entrenched enemy the upper hand. By sending in a small groups of soldiers, we can infiltrate enemy lines and detonate well-placed charges to negate their advantage.
loc.raid_type_JAP_pearl_harbor_strike_desc: By sending a group of bombers to attack the enemy's main naval headquarter and fleet in the Pacific Ocean, we can boost our people's morale, while inflicting a blow to our enemy's morale and naval capabilities at the same time. Through this, our navies will be able to roam freely for 6 months!

loc.operation_jericho_failure_tt: The Raid is a complete disaster, none of the prisoners manage to escape. Enemy control of the area increases
loc.operation_jericho_limited_success_tt: The daring bombing run manages to blow a hole in the prison wall. However, many of the prisoners are injured and or fail to escape.
loc.operation_jericho_success_tt: The daring bombing run manages to blow a big hole in the prison wall. Some of the prisoners are injured or fail to escape, but a substantial number manage to escape, and are picked up by the local resistance.
loc.operation_jericho_critical_success_tt: The daring bombing run manages to blow a huge hole in the prison wall without injuring any of the prisoners. Most prisoners manage to escape, and are picked up by the local resistance.
loc.operation_huansheng_failure_tt: The Raid is a complete disaster, none of bombers reach their designated drop-zones, and many are shot down by naval air defenses.
loc.operation_huansheng_limited_success_tt: The daring bombing run manages to deliver leaflets over most of the designated cities. However, most are scattered in inaccessible areas and quickly cleaned up by enemy forces.
loc.operation_huansheng_success_tt: The daring bombing run manages to deliver leaflets over all of the designated cities. Some leaflets are scattered on roofs or in forested areas, but a majority of them land in accessible and populated areas, and are quickly picked up by local residents.
loc.operation_huansheng_critical_success_tt: The daring bombing run manages to deliver leaflets over all of the designated cities. All of them land in accessible and populated areas, and are quickly picked up by local residents, spreading the news of the Japanese invasion far and wide.

loc.raid_type_SOV_transport_volunteers_to_CZ: Czechoslovakia has requested military aid, but our lack of direct borders complicates logistics, instead, we could assemble a force of volunteers that will be transported by air to fight as part of the Czechoslovak army.
loc.raid_type_INS_militia_increase_activity_:
We will send Militias to the state, where they will make contact with local revolutionaries and establish guerilla cells. If the operation goes smoothly, we will attempt to infiltrate the region and seize control from the Dutch.

§WThe target state must be in range of a Republican-owned §YBunker§!, §YRailway§!, or §YNaval Base§!. These buildings can be used as starting points.§!

§YEffects:§!
§RAssigned division is expended§!
§YSuccess:§!

       Increases escalation by §R1§!§!.
§YLimited Success:§!
       §W Adds §Yone tier§! of militia activity, increasing success chance for future attempts.§!
§YFailure:§!
       §WNo effects§!.
loc.raid_type_INS_militia_port_raid_desc:
We will send militias disguised as fisherman on small boats that will hopefully not be located. They will attempt to establish guerilla cells upon landing, and will work with local guerillas to occupy the naval base if opportunity allows. This is a very risky endeavour, if the militias get spotted, the operation is sure to fail.

loc.MEX_category_church_power_desc: The §YChurch§! has been repressed by the Revolutionary state for many years. Our future policy may be defined either by ideology or by realpolitik, but we must act decisively.
loc.MEX_decision_transfer_lands_to_church_de: The pre-Revolutionary church was large and wealthy. The covetous generals and governors stole vast tracts of church lands from their traditional custodians, but we can now return some.
loc.MEX_decision_nationalize_church_lands_de: The churches and seminaries are officially owned by the government, and the priests and nuns are state employees. The cost is becoming burdensome. Perhaps we can reduce the government's payroll by demolishing some more churches?
loc.MEX_decision_pardon_cristero_fighter_des: President Calles is largely to blame for the incitement of the Cristero War. He has now 'stepped aside', so we can follow the formalities of bringing talented and loyal Cristero fighters into our military.
loc.MEX_decision_assassinate_cristero_traito: The rebels who took up arms against the state deserve no pity and will receive no mercy. Though the terms of the peace negotiated with the Church leaders was meant to close hostilities, we know that the traitors will take up arms again if they get the chance. We should strike first.
loc.MEX_decision_attend_public_mass_desc: For twenty years, Mexican presidents have been openly or tacitly hostile to the Church. A few simple gestures may go a long way to reconcile our political and religious systems.
loc.MEX_decision_prosecute_clergyman_desc: The Constitution of 1917 forbids priests from participating in our political system. Fines for wearing robes in public, imprisonment for making political statements; there is always some way we can attack the Church and show the supremacy of the Mexican state over superstitious elements.
loc.MEX_decision_reconciliation_committee_de: The many crimes committed on both sides during the Cristiada have opened a wound which has still not healed. By shining a light on the injustices of the recent past, perhaps we can help prevent abuses in the future.
loc.MEX_decision_incite_tensions_desc: Our internal enemies are still organizing against us. We must be ready to face any threat! We will muster our supporters at a demonstration to show our unconquerable will!
loc.MEX_mission_cedillos_rebellion_desc: General Saturnino Cedillo and the caudillos aligned to him have acted independently of the central government for many years. [Root.GetLeader]'s attempts to build a unified nation are a threat to their power, and therefore they are seeking to undo our progress by means fair or foul.
loc.MEX_mission_second_cristiada_desc: Our attacks on the superstitious cultists in the 'Holy Church' are angering right-wing elements of the military. We should either moderate our approach or prepare to defeat them in the field.
loc.MEX_mission_second_cristiada_dummy_desc: If the government is too heavy-handed in its approach to the Church, the Cristeros may take up arms once again to overthrow us.
loc.MEX_mission_second_revolution_desc: Our support for the Holy Church is angering left-wing and anti-Church elements of the military. We should either moderate our approach or prepare to defeat them in the field.
loc.MEX_mission_second_revolution_dummy_desc: While some moderation on the issue of religion will be tolerated by the secularists in the government, too close a relationship with the Church may incite a rebellion from the far-left and atheist generals.
loc.MEX_decision_support_spanish_loyalists_d: We will send a shipment of rifles to the Republican government to defend democracy against the illegal usurpers of Franco and his fascist minions.
loc.MEX_decision_support_spanish_fascists_de: We will send a shipment of rifles to the restorers of order in Spain so that they can eradicate the communist menace before it spreads.
loc.MEX_category_territorial_integration_des: Our revolutionary fight in order to overthrow corrupt governments rewards us with control over entire countries. The inhabitants of those regions, have only known oppression, and in order to enjoy true liberation they must be incorporated into [MEX.GetNameDef].
loc.MEX_category_hispanic_solidarity_desc: Our diplomatic efforts must be targeted towards other Latin American countries. We are united by our 'Hispanidad' (Hispanicity) and we must form a proper alliance if we want to resist foreign influence.
loc.USA_raise_the_free_corps_desc: Our preparations are complete. Thousands of veterans from the Great War stand ready to form units to fight for us.
loc.USA_war_plans_desc: The War Department has spent considerable time preparing plans for any contingency. While it is impossible to predict every development, the plans should help us to get through the first few months of the war.
loc.USA_congress_desc: The Hill has its own rules and ideas. We will have to work with them to make things happen, but there are ways to ensure that we have a sympathetic and supportive Congress to work with.
loc.USA_small_lobby_effort_desc: It pays to have an ear to the ground of the Capitol, and to make sure some influential people know what the administration is planning.
loc.USA_medium_lobby_effort_desc: A concerted effort to get the Administration's point across will no doubt pay off in the long run.
loc.USA_special_measures_desc: Sometimes, Members of Congress require a more direct, personal incentive to realize that what is best for their bank account is also what is best for their country.
loc.USA_intervention_mandate_desc: While we may have decided to involve ourselves more in world affairs, we must still work with Congress to get authorization for any military actions.

loc.ENG_trade_unions_demand_minister_appoint: To fulfill the Trade Unions' demands, we will appoint their chosen representative to the cabinet.
loc.ENG_trade_unions_demand_timer: Granted a Trade Unions demand in the last 30 days
loc.ENG_trade_unions_demand_legislation_amen: To fulfill the Trade Unions' demands, we will expend some extra political effort to amend the current legislation proposal, to their wishes.
loc.ENG_trade_unions_demand_conscription_lim: To fulfill the Trade Unions' demands, we will limit our conscription efforts for the time being.
Prevents increasing the Conscription Laws for §Y365 days§!.\n
If current Conscription Law is above §YVolunteer Only§!, reduces Conscription Law by one step.\n
loc.ENG_cannot_increase_conscription_law: Promised the Trade Unions not to increase conscription.\n
loc.ENG_trade_unions_demand_workplace_safety: To fulfill the Trade Unions' demands, we will pass new workplace safety legislation, granting further protection to our workforce, at the necessary cost of some productivity.
loc.ENG_trade_unions_demand_increase_in_paid: Pass Increase in Paid Leave Legislation
To fulfill the Trade Unions' demands, we will pass legislation granting workers more paid leave from their employers.
loc.ENG_trade_unions_demand_minimum_pay_incr: To fulfill the Trade Unions' demands, we will pass legislation increasing the minimum wage for all sectors.
loc.ENG_trade_unions_demand_construction_saf: To fulfill the Trade Unions' demands, we will pass new construction safety legislation, granting further protection for those who work in the construction industry.
loc.ENG_trade_unions_demand_mandatory_union_: To fulfill the Trade Unions' demands, we will pass new legislation requiring all laborers to participate in 'Union Days', educating them on their rights, encouraging them to unionize, and provide a time-slot for other union-related activities.
loc.ENG_trade_unions_demand_referendum_desc: As socialist support has soared, we have no choice but to accede to the Trade Unions' demands for a referendum. The outcome is all but a foregone conclusion...

We shall ask the Trade Unions to support the acquisition of new factories.
loc.ENG_request_trade_union_factory_worker_s: Request Trade Union Factory Worker Support

We will use our connections and goodwill in the Trade Unions to convince them of the importance that factory productivity is increased for the immediate future. With their support, we can motivate the workforce.
loc.ENG_request_trade_union_dockyard_worker_: Request Trade Union Dockyard Worker Support

We will use our connections and goodwill in the Trade Unions to convince them of the importance that dockyard productivity is increased for the immediate future. With their support, we can motivate the dockyard workforce.
loc.ENG_request_trade_union_construction_wor: Request Trade Union Construction Worker Support

We will use our connections and goodwill in the Trade Unions to convince them of the importance that construction productivity is increased for the immediate future. With their support, we can motivate the construction workforce.
loc.ENG_request_trade_union_war_propaganda_s: Request Trade Union War Propaganda Support
We require aid from the Trade Unions to prepare the people for war - it is coming, and they must support the government preparing for it.
loc.ENG_impose_martial_law_on_canada_desc: The people of Canada are misguided, and must be protected from themselves. During this time we can re-educate them and see to their government.
loc.ENG_impose_martial_law_tt: AI is prevented from breaking free for 180 days.
loc.ENG_propaganda_campaigns_in_canada_desc: We will launch a major propaganda campaign to educate the Canadian people on the follies of their government, and the necessity for British guidance.
loc.ENG_replace_government_in_canada_fascism: The Canadian people are ready for a change in government to one more... amenable to our fascist leadership.
loc.ENG_replace_government_in_canada_communi: The Canadian people are ready for a change in government to one more... amenable to our communist leadership.
loc.ENG_replace_government_communism_tt: Will remain a puppet when Decolonization is achieved.\n
loc.ENG_impose_martial_law_on_south_africa: Impose Martial law on South Africa
loc.ENG_impose_martial_law_on_south_africa_d: The people of South Africa are misguided, and must be protected from themselves. During this time we can re-educate them and see to their government.
loc.ENG_propaganda_campaigns_in_south_africa: We will launch a major propaganda campaign to educate the South African people on the follies of their government, and the necessity for British guidance.
loc.ENG_replace_government_in_south_africa_f: Install Fascist Government in South Africa
The South African people are ready for a change in government to one more... amenable to our fascist leadership.
loc.ENG_replace_government_in_south_africa_c: Install Communist Government in South Africa
The South African people are ready for a change in government to one more... amenable to our communist leadership.
loc.ENG_impose_martial_law_on_british_raj: Impose Martial Law on British Raj
loc.ENG_impose_martial_law_on_british_raj_de: The people of India are misguided, and must be protected from themselves. During this time we can re-educate them and see to their government.
loc.ENG_propaganda_campaigns_in_british_raj_: We will launch a major propaganda campaign to educate the Indian people on the follies of their government, and the necessity for British guidance.
loc.ENG_replace_government_in_british_raj_fa: Install Fascist Government in British Raj
The Indian people are ready for a change in government to one more... amenable to our fascist leadership.
loc.ENG_replace_government_in_british_raj_co: Install Communist Government in British Raj
The Indian people are ready for a change in government to one more... amenable to our communist leadership.
loc.ENG_impose_martial_law_on_australia_desc: The people of Australia are misguided, and must be protected from themselves. During this time we can re-educate them and see to their government.
loc.ENG_propaganda_campaigns_in_australia_de: We will launch a major propaganda campaign to educate the Australian people on the follies of their government, and the necessity for British guidance.
loc.ENG_replace_government_in_australia_fasc: The Australian people are ready for a change in government to one more... amenable to our fascist leadership.
loc.ENG_replace_government_in_australia_comm: The Australian people are ready for a change in government to one more... amenable to our communist leadership.
loc.ENG_impose_martial_law_on_new_zealand: Impose Martial Law on New Zealand
loc.ENG_impose_martial_law_on_new_zealand_de: The people of New Zealand are misguided, and must be protected from themselves. During this time we can re-educate them and see to their government.
loc.ENG_propaganda_campaigns_in_new_zealand_: We will launch a major propaganda campaign to educate the New Zealand people on the follies of their government, and the necessity for British guidance.
loc.ENG_replace_government_in_new_zealand_fa: Install Fascist Government in New Zealand
The New Zealand people are ready for a change in government to one more... amenable to our fascist leadership.
loc.ENG_replace_government_in_new_zealand_co: Install Communist Government in New Zealand
The New Zealand people are ready for a change in government to one more... amenable to our communist leadership.
loc.ENG_support_imperialist_coup_in_canada_d: The time has come to support loyalist elements in Canada in preparation for igniting a full-blown civil war.
loc.ENG_renew_support_for_imperialist_coup_i: Canada will have 90 days to suppress the uprising before it happens.\n
loc.ENG_support_imperialist_coup_in_canada_m: Imperial loyalists are fomenting rebellion! If successful, they will plunge the country into civil war!
loc.ENG_suppress_imperialist_coup_in_canada_: We will stamp out this reactionary rebellion wherever it rears its ugly head.
loc.ENG_suppress_imperialist_coup_tt: Britain will have 90 days to increase support for the uprising before it fails.\n
loc.ENG_support_imperialist_coup_in_canada_m: The Canadian government has suppressed our loyalist movements, and unless we act quickly any hope for a rebellion will be irrevocably stamped out...
loc.ENG_renew_support_for_imperialist_coup_i: The loyalists can count on our continued support!
loc.ENG_homeland_defense_decision_cat_desc: [ROOT.GetAdjective] Austerity has proved to win us many wars, and if we wish to never again lose, we must make sure that we are ready to give it our all to defend the homeland. We shall never surrender!
loc.ENG_enforce_blackouts_tt: This national spirit can be removed by decision
loc.ENG_establish_the_local_defense_voluntee: Unlocks decisions to §YRaise Local Militias§! and §YUtilize the Home Guard in the Factories§!.
loc.ENG_utilize_home_guard_in_factories: Utilize the Home Guard in the Factories
loc.ENG_utilize_home_guard_in_factories_tt: This decision is re-enabled every §Y184§! days
loc.ENG_raising_militia_flag: We are currently raising Home Guard units in a state
loc.ENG_raised_home_guard_here_already_flag: Home Guard have already been Raised in this state
loc.ENG_send_the_home_guard_back_home: Send the Home Guards back Home
loc.ENG_disband_home_guards_tt: §RAll Home Guard divisions will be disbanded§!. \n(Manpower and equipment will not be refunded)

loc.ENG_secure_the_dominions_backed_down_aga: Backed down when confronted by the USA.\n

The loyalists can count on our continued support!
loc.ENG_ally_the_canadian_imperialist_uprisi: We will not leave our Canadian loyalists to their fate; they will enjoy our military support, and our continued protection and leadership after the war is won.
loc.ENG_ally_the_south_african_imperialist_u: We will not leave our South African loyalists to their fate; they will enjoy our military support, and our continued protection and leadership after the war is won.
loc.ENG_ally_the_australian_imperialist_upri: We will not leave our Australian loyalists to their fate; they will enjoy our military support, and our continued protection and leadership after the war is won.
loc.ENG_ally_the_new_zealand_imperialist_upr: We will not leave our New Zealand loyalists to their fate; they will enjoy our military support, and our continued protection and leadership after the war is won.
loc.ENG_urge_restraint_desc: It is imperative that our next march goes off without a hitch, lest the violent response to it spills over to the rest of the country and ignites nation-wide unrest, and potentially even civil war. Though it may turn away some of our most hard-line supporters, we must instruct our marchers to refrain from violence at all costs.
loc.ENG_urge_restraint_tt: Greatly reduces the chances of a §YViolent March§! on the next §YBlackshirt March§! held.\n
loc.ENG_blackshirt_march_tt: Fascists take control of the state, ensuring it will be on our side should we get in a civil war.\n
loc.ENG_blackshirt_march_in_northern_ireland: Preparations are under way for a large march of Blackshirts in Northern Ireland, which will certainly sway the state's population to support our cause.
loc.ENG_blackshirt_march_in_the_highlands_de: Preparations are under way for a large march of Blackshirts in the Highlands, which will certainly sway the state's population to support our cause.
loc.ENG_blackshirt_march_in_aberdeenshire_de: Preparations are under way for a large march of Blackshirts in Aberdeen, which will certainly sway the state's population to support our cause.
loc.ENG_blackshirt_march_in_lanark_desc: Preparations are under way for a large march of Blackshirts in Lanark, which will certainly sway the state's population to support our cause.
loc.ENG_blackshirt_march_in_lothian_desc: Preparations are under way for a large march of Blackshirts in Lothian, which will certainly sway the state's population to support our cause.
loc.ENG_blackshirt_march_on_the_isle_of_man: Blackshirt March on the Isle of Man
loc.ENG_blackshirt_march_in_northern_england: Preparations are under way for a large march of Blackshirts in Northern England, which will certainly sway the state's population to support our cause.
loc.ENG_blackshirt_march_in_yorkshire_desc: Preparations are under way for a large march of Blackshirts in Yorkshire, which will certainly sway the state's population to support our cause.
loc.ENG_blackshirt_march_in_lancashire_desc: Preparations are under way for a large march of Blackshirts in Lancashire, which will certainly sway the state's population to support our cause.
loc.ENG_blackshirt_march_in_wales_desc: Preparations are under way for a large march of Blackshirts in Wales, which will certainly sway the state's population to support our cause.
loc.ENG_blackshirt_march_in_west_midlands_de: Preparations are under way for a large march of Blackshirts in West Midlands, which will certainly sway the state's population to support our cause.
loc.ENG_blackshirt_march_in_east_midlands_de: Preparations are under way for a large march of Blackshirts in East Midlands, which will certainly sway the state's population to support our cause.
loc.ENG_blackshirt_march_in_east_anglia_desc: Preparations are under way for a large march of Blackshirts in East Anglia, which will certainly sway the state's population to support our cause.
loc.ENG_blackshirt_march_in_gloucestershire_: Preparations are under way for a large march of Blackshirts in Gloucestershire, which will certainly sway the state's population to support our cause.
loc.ENG_blackshirt_march_in_london_desc: Preparations are under way for a grand march of Blackshirts in London, which will certainly sway the state's population to support our cause, or precipitate a civil war if the violence should escalate.
loc.ENG_blackshirt_march_in_cornwall_desc: Preparations are under way for a large march of Blackshirts in Cornwall, which will certainly sway the state's population to support our cause.
loc.ENG_blackshirt_march_in_sussex_desc: Preparations are under way for a large march of Blackshirts in Sussex, which will certainly sway the state's population to support our cause.
loc.ENG_march_timer_flag: A march is currently in progress.
loc.ENG_march_on_downing_street_desc: A final great march on No. 10 Downing Street will surely push the government to call for a referendum on the future of the nation. They cannot stand against the will of the people.
loc.ENG_speech_against_germany_desc: As Mosley's popularity soars, so does the outlandish criticism he is bombarded with. To assuage fears that he merely wishes to force Hitlerism upon the British people, perhaps a grand and powerfully-formulated speech is required, in which Mosley distances himself in unmistaken terms from the Hitler's variety of fascism.
loc.ENG_speech_against_germany_tt: §RShould stability drop below 50% during the Blackshirt Marches, a civil war will start!§!\n
loc.ENG_reconciliatory_speech_desc: In order to reduce increasing domestic political tensions, a speech with reconciliatory language may well be just what is required.
loc.ENG_the_mosley_plan_desc: A bold restructuring of the economy, combined with ample propaganda and public investments, should galvanize the people in one great effort to repair the nation and kick-start our rearmament.
loc.ENG_imperial_conference_decision_desc: The Imperial Conference has started, and we may push our agenda for the next two months, before Dominion representatives return home again. Improving diplomatic relations with our Dominions will likely increase the chances of those Dominions agreeing with our proposals.
loc.ENG_discuss_imperial_defense_desc: We will put forward a motion proposing that all members of the Commonwealth make a significant contribution to the defense of the Empire.
loc.ENG_discuss_imperial_trade_desc: We will put forward a motion proposing that all members of the Commonwealth increase the preferential trade within the Empire, so that we as a whole may prosper even more.
loc.ENG_discuss_imperial_economy_desc: We will put forward a motion proposing that all members of the Commonwealth make a significant investment in their domestic economies, reducing their reliance on our investments and strengthening the Empire as a whole.
loc.ENG_discuss_appeasement_desc: We have received ample criticism for our policy of appeasement, so we shall put this policy up to the Commonwealth for discussion.
loc.ENG_discuss_imperial_federation_desc: Ever since the previous century, voices have spoken up in favor of joining all parts of the Empire together in one Imperial Federation, rather than progress further to the alternative of 'home rule', involving independence for all Dominions. We will now put forward a motion to discuss it for the last time.
loc.won_british_civil_war: Won a civil war less than one year ago.\n
loc.ENG_abdication_crisis_changed_mind: Edward VIII did not marry Wallis Simpson
loc.governments_in_exile_host_desc: Although their homelands are under enemy occupation, some brave soldiers and citizens are willing to continue the struggle. If we extend our recognition to friendly governments in exile, they can harness the resources of the expatriates, emigres and refugees, forming new units which will fight at our side.
loc.governments_in_exile_exiled_desc: Although our homelands are under enemy occupation, the government has managed to escape. We need to build support for our cause, gather all expatriates, emigres and refugees here, and work with our host to recapture our homeland.
loc.governments_in_exile_ETH_desc: [ROOT.GetLeader] has, for the time being, set up a government in exile from [ROOT.GetLeader.GetHerHis] base in [?ETH.host_nation.GetNameDef]. The situation is dire, but far from hopeless. A number of warriors managed to escape and hopefully more will join us over time. Additionally, the Imperial family is well situated, so we should be able to divert funds to improve our chances of reconquering [ETH.GetName].\n\n   Current balance of Imperial Treasury: §Y[?ETH_treasury]§! £GFX_ETH_imperial_treasury
loc.request_reinstatement_desc: Our faithful allies have helped us to recapture the lands occupied by our mutual enemies and the [Root.GetAdjective] homeland is relatively secure. We should request permission from our host to relocate our government and establish a [Root.GetRulingPartyLong] cabinet in preparation for the end of the war.
loc.grant_parliamentary_audience_desc: The abuses by the occupation forces terrorizing [From.GetNameDef] are utterly intolerable. Let us bring representatives of the [From.GetAdjective] nation before our legislature to testify to the [Root.GetAdjective] people of our just cause for war.
loc.public_support_for_from: Public Recognition of the [From.GetAdjective] Exile Government
loc.exile_recruitment_campaign_desc: Thanks to our friends in [From.GetNameDef], we have a base from which to operate, growing our strength in preparation for our triumphant return to [Root.GetNameDef]. We should focus on gathering useful personnel to aid in the war effort.
loc.exile_extraction_campaign_desc: Although most of the standing army formations were captured and interned when the [From.GetAdjective] government capitulated, there are still demobilized troops in [From.GetNameDef] who would jump at the chance to leave the occupied regions and assist our war effort. We will formulate plans to help retrieve stranded units who can then be armed and trained to fight for their homeland.
loc.expatriate_donations_desc: The suffering populace in [From.GetNameDef] has relatives and refugees living abroad. By appealing to these [From.GetAdjective] communities to make a special sacrifice to free their homeland sooner, we can gather more resources for the war effort.
loc.request_control_of_navy_desc: For the sake of efficiency, our alliance would benefit greatly from the integration of the [From.GetAdjective] navy into our own.
loc.category_exile_forces_desc: Our united front will smash the hated enemy! By joining forces, we will combine the best of the assets available to our nation and overcome any obstacle the aggressor may throw at us!
loc.weapons_for_the_resistance_desc: Patriotic [From.GetAdjective] elements behind enemy lines will wreak havoc upon our mutual foes, if we can deliver reliable munitions to them.
loc.purge_infiltrators_desc: Our friends in the legitimate [From.GetAdjective] government are concerned by the increasing support for Bolshevist and ultranationalist movements within the volunteer forces serving us. We should remove disloyal officers and disarm mutinous formations before things get out of hand. The influence this will win us inside their country will be invaluable, especially post-war.
loc.unity_parade_desc: The veteran soldiers of the [From.GetAdjective] volunteer forces have won many victories against the hated enemy, and our shared sacrifices are a source of pride. We will parade the troops around the Home Front and demonstrate our indefatigable might! Critics of the legitimate [From.GetAdjective] government might oppose this as a waste of resources but our successes will silence the doubters.
loc.joint_training_exercise_desc: By land, sea and air, our combined forces will smash the tyrannical aggressors who drove our [From.GetAdjective] allies from their homes and threatened the future of world civilisation! We will launch a training exercise to learn better methods of waging war against our shared belligerents.
loc.HOL_gateway_to_europe_hol_category_desc: The tug-of-war between the British and the Germans over our trade is mounting. In dealing with their demands we must be careful, as caving to the demands of one is likely to lead to hostilities with the other...
loc.HOL_gateway_to_europe_ger_category_desc: The Dutch form a 'back door', allowing us to circumvent the British blockade and to maintain trade through neutral ports. We must pressure the Dutch to increase the amount of trade they allow to pass to us through their borders.
loc.HOL_gateway_to_europe_eng_category_desc: The Germans are using the Dutch as a 'back door', circumventing our blockade by using neutral Dutch shipping and ports to pass trade through. If we wish to make our blockade more successful, we must bend the Dutch to our will.
loc.HOL_attract_foreign_investors_desc: Attracting more investors to fund parts of our colonial developments with will lighten the financial burden on us, and allow us to dedicate more resources to the continent.
loc.HOL_attract_foreign_industry_desc: Attracting more foreign industry to our colonies will lighten the financial burden on us, and allow us to dedicate more resources to developing our domestic industry.
loc.HOL_attract_west_indies_oil_companies_de: Many foreign oil companies have expressed an interest in building refineries on Curaçao and Aruba, to share in processing Venezuelan oil and all the riches that come with it.
loc.HOL_attract_west_indies_oil_companies_tt: Add §G1§! Building Slot and §Y1 Civilian Factory§! to §YCuraçao§! after taking this decision §Y5§! times.\n
loc.HOL_attract_east_indies_oil_companies_de: With the help of foreign oil companies the refineries in the East Indies could be expanded without great cost to ourselves, allow us to match the increased demand on oil in East Asia.
loc.HOL_attract_east_indies_oil_companies_tt: Add §G1§! Building Slot and §Y1 Civilian Factory§! to §YJava§!, §YSumatra§!, or §YKalimantan§! after taking this decision §Y3§!, §Y6§!, and §Y10§! times, respectively.\n
loc.HOL_inundate_the_water_lines_desc: The carefully-prepared Dutch Water Line must now be flooded to prevent the advance of the enemy, even though it will cause damage to the countryside.
loc.HOL_drain_the_water_lines_desc: The danger has subsided, and we can therefore drain the Dutch Water Line, allowing us to use the countryside once again.
loc.HOL_crack_down_on_pacifist_movements_des: The various pacifist movements have already hampered our military rearmament quite enough. If the voice of the people cannot be swayed, it must be silenced by force.
loc.HOL_establish_pro_war_labor_indoctrinati: As long as the laborers are on our side, the rest will fall in line eventually. At the small cost of some minor workplace productivity, we will instill a sense of patriotism in our people, and make them understand the necessity of a strong military to protect our values.
loc.HOL_anti_pacifist_propaganda_desc: Only hard work and dedicated resources will effect a change in the dispositions of our people. We shall begin a major propaganda campaign that, though not cheap, will get people to understand that we will not for much longer have the luxury of defenselessness without consequences.
loc.HOL_request_equipment_desc: Our military is in dire need of equipment to support the required expansion. Perhaps our potential future allies may be of assistance...
loc.HOL_request_equipment_tt_2: §R[From.GetNameDefCap] must approve of the agreement for the bonuses to take effect.§!\n
loc.HOL_draw_up_combined_staff_plan_desc: Our survival depends on the concerted cooperation of our military with that of a potential future ally. We may send a military mission with the goal of developing a combined staff plan, which will greatly facilitate that cooperation from the very moment of invasion by a hostile power.
loc.HOL_exchange_intelligence_data_desc: Our intelligence service has had some successes, and it may be possible to offer an exchange of information to our potential future allies, greatly increasing both of our nations' preparedness against the most likely opening moves in an invasion scenario.
loc.HOL_prepare_evacuation_of_gold_reserves_: Our national gold reserves - the very foundation of our national government - must be evacuated in the event of an invasion. To not do so would render an exiled government utterly powerless.
This is removed when becoming a §YGovernment-in-Exile§!.\n
Gain §Y100 Political Power§! and an increase in £legitimacy §YLegitimacy§! when becoming a §YGovernment-in-Exile§!.\n
loc.HOL_share_military_knowledge_desc: After almost 150 years of peace, our neighbors are much more advanced in their understanding of military matters than we are. Perhaps our potential future allies might be willing to share some of that knowledge, to aid the future defense of our homeland.
loc.HOL_demand_reduced_dutch_trade_with_germ: Demand Reduced Dutch Trade with Germany
The Dutch must be brought to heel, and fall in line with the trade restrictions placed upon Germany. Certainly they would not want us to include them in those restrictions...
loc.HOL_demand_increased_dutch_trade_with_ge: Demand Increased Dutch Trade with Germany
The Dutch must be... reminded... of their trade obligations to the German state, as well as their military vulnerability as our neighbor. Subtly, of course.
loc.HOL_gateway_to_europe_decisions_tt: If [HOL.GetNameDef] caves to our demands, we will receive an amount of §YPolitical Power§! equal to the total amount invested by all §YGateway to Europe§! participants. Currently this amounts to:\n
loc.HOL_placate_the_british_desc: We must make some concessions to the British in the current trade negotiations, if we are to preclude the threat of being included in their trade sanctions.
loc.HOL_placate_the_germans_desc: We must make some concessions to the Germans in the current trade negotiations, if we are to preclude the threat of invasion in the event of their dissatisfaction.
loc.HOL_radio_oranje_desc: It is time for another Dutch-language "Radio Orange" broadcast on the BBC, to give hope both to those in the occupied homeland as well as those fighting for their freedom alongside our allies.
loc.HOL_obtain_dockyard_access_desc: At the time of the invasion various ships were under construction. We have managed to salvage some of them by towing the unfinished hulls to England, but we now require British assistance to finish them.
loc.HOL_assemble_air_squadron_desc: A number of our recruits have expressed a desire to learn to pilot aircraft to do what they can in the air. We should request aircraft from our allies to let them.
loc.HOL_request_infantry_equipment_desc: If we are to aid our allies in battle, we must obtain the necessary equipment from them to do so.
loc.HOL_pull_strings_with_british_industrial: Anglo-Dutch cooperation in industry has been on-going for many years, and has sprouted various multinationals, such as Philips and Royal Dutch Shell. We might be able to now use these British connections to see to the supply of our exiled forces.
loc.HOL_request_aid_for_the_engelandvaarders: The over 100 miles of North Sea separating England from the Netherlands is no deterrent to Dutchmen seeking to escape the occupation and fight alongside their countrymen for the liberation of the homeland. In rickety small rowboats or kayaks, these "Engelandvaarders" or "England Sailors" brave the open waters, in conditions so difficult that fewer than one in ten survive the voyage. Merely attempting this puts them among the very bravest of the brave, and it is our duty to ask the British to do whatever they can to increase the likelihood of their success.
loc.VEN_abc_islands_desc: The ABC Islands lie just off our shores, and by all accounts should rightfully belong to us. Not only does their geographical proximity make this a natural state of affairs, but almost all of our oil is refined on these islands as well, making them hugely important for our economy. With the current weakness of the Dutch government, they surely would not dare refuse our kind offer of 'aiding' them in the defense of the islands...
loc.HOL_bernhard_desc: The Queen's son-in-law and Princess Juliana's husband, Bernhard van Lippe-Biesterfeld, has shown a great desire to fight the enemy on behalf of his country. Though originally German himself, he now feels entirely Dutch and wishes nothing more than to do his patriotic duty. Considering his free-spirited and independent personality, and his desire to be personally involved in affairs, giving him the position he desires may well have unforeseen consequences...
loc.HOL_give_bernhard_generalship_desc: The Prince has indicated his desire to fight for his new homeland, and wishes to take command of our forces, to share their ordeals, and lead them to victory.
loc.HOL_pursue_diplomatic_grievances_desc: The insults directed at Prince Bernhard and, indeed, our entire government, have escalated to a full-blown diplomatic row to the point of military threats. We demand an immediate and unequivocal apology, or we may well feel forced to follow up on our words...
loc.HOL_pursue_diplomatic_grievances_tt: This may result in a war goal against the target.\n
loc.HOL_relocate_government_to_batavia_desc: Our mainland has been overrun, but our colonies lie untouched. Though it goes against the wishes of the Queen, we can relocate our government to Batavia, the capital of the East Indies, and continue the war effort from there.
loc.HOL_propose_benelux_unification_desc: Global crises abound, and we are but small nations among the great. If we are to weather the coming storm, we must seek unification on all levels of government, even if this means abandoning our sovereignty.
loc.HOL_propose_benelux_unification_tt: §R[BEL.GetNameDefCap] and [LUX.GetNameDefCap] must approve of the agreement for the bonuses to take effect.§!\n
loc.ENG_demand_treaty_compliance_tt: If they do not comply within §Y60 days§!, we will get a §YPuppet Wargoal§! on them.\n
loc.ENG_demand_treaty_compliance_tt2: Navy size in §YBattleships§!, §YBattlecruisers§!, and §YCarriers§! compared to §Y[Root.GetName]§! more than §Y100%§!.
loc.ENG_demand_treaty_compliance_tt3: Navy size in §YBattleships§!, §YBattlecruisers§!, and §YCarriers§! compared to §Y[Root.GetName]§! more than §Y65%§!.
loc.ENG_demand_treaty_compliance_tt4: Navy size in §YBattleships§!, §YBattlecruisers§!, and §YCarriers§! compared to §Y[Root.GetName]§! more than §Y35%§!.
loc.ENG_britain_demands_treaty_compliance_de: [ENG.GetNameDefCap] has demanded that we reduce the numbers of our capital ships to bring us back in line with the stipulations of the Washington Naval Treaty.
loc.ENG_britain_demands_treaty_compliance_tt: Ratio of §YBattleships§! and §YCarriers§! compared to §Y[ENG.GetName]§! not more than §Y100%§!.\n
Ratio of §YBattleships§! and §YCarriers§! compared to §Y[ENG.GetName]§! not more than §Y65%§!.\n
Ratio of §YBattleships§! and §YCarriers§! compared to §Y[ENG.GetName]§! not more than §Y35%§!.\n
loc.foreign_influence_desc: The countries we have taken under our protection deserve only the best and most equitable governance. Destabilizing influences from alien ideologies must be curtailed.
loc.nation_building_desc: We must train a new generation of administrators to lead the [From.GetAdjective] people away from totalitarianism and into democracy and the rule of law.
loc.socialist_education_desc: Enemies of the [From.GetAdjective] people are infiltrating our fraternal allies and sowing dissent against the democratic movement we are fostering. We must assist the legitimate government in re-educating the population in the immortal science of Marx and Engels.
loc.paramilitary_training_desc: Left-wing agitators and other traitorous filth are weakening the [From.GetAdjective] nation. We will assist friendly forces who are willing to collaborate with our army.
loc.military_parade_desc: Democrats, socialists, nationalists and other verminous products of the Enlightenment are making trouble for the [From.GetAdjective] government. We will march our unvanquishable troops through the capital of [From.GetNameDef] and show them the splendour of [Root.GetAdjective] military might.
loc.police_action_desc: The [From.GetAdjective] people are ready to receive responsible self-government from local police and paramilitary forces.
loc.fraternal_republic_desc: The [From.GetAdjective] people demand intervention from our forces to oust the parasitical landlords and capitalists who reign over them.
loc.ultranationalist_coup_desc: The weak [From.GetAdjective] government doesn't deserve our support. We must usher in a new age for their people!
loc.military_dictatorship_desc: There are many weak links in the [From.GetAdjective] government which we must remove. Atheists, trades unionists and even liberals are reported amongst the [From.GetLeader] ministry.
loc.MTG_naval_treaties_desc: In order to limit expenditures and avoid another mutually ruinous naval arms race, the great naval powers of the world have signed a number of treaties, limiting the overall size of their fleets and the size of each individual ship. As a signatory of these treaties, we are subject to certain restrictions, but as long as our opponents follow them as well, the balance of power should be maintained.\n\nWe are currently [GetStrengthRatioBritain] [GetRelevantNavalTreatyNation] in Capital Ship Strength.
loc.MTG_abandon_treaty_democratic_desc: The attempt to contain the march of naval armaments has failed. We must be allowed to rearm to meet the threats of the future.
loc.MTG_abandon_treaty_fascist_desc: The democracies of the world have foolishly shackled themselves to the rule of law. But in the struggle of nations there is but one law: that of nature, and the laws of nature require strength. We will not be contained in our desire to build a mighty fleet!
loc.MTG_abandon_treaty_japanese_desc: The democracies of the world have foolishly shackled themselves to the rule of law. But in the struggle of nations there is but one law: that of nature, and the laws of nature require strength. We will not be contained in our desire to build a mighty fleet!
loc.MTG_cheat_on_treaty_desc: The restrictions put on our ship designs by the Naval Treaties are far too cruel. With some creative accounting, we could perhaps free up some weight for something more useful...
loc.MTG_second_london_conference: Second London Naval Disarmament Conference underway
loc.MTG_invite_FROM_to_treaty: Invite [From.GetNameDef] to join the Naval Treaties
loc.MTG_treaty_reduction_mission_desc: We have publicly committed to a reduction of active capital ships in our navy. We need to urgently dispose of some of them in order to meet the agreed numbers.
loc.MTG_treaty_reduction_signatory_mission: Return to the Treaty Naval Size
loc.MTG_treaty_reduction_signatory_mission_d: As signatories of the Naval Treaty, we are only allowed a certain amount of capital ships. We are currently exceeding the allotted number, and people are starting to wonder if we are as committed to the idea of international arms limitations as we claim.
loc.MTG_escalator_clause_invocation_mission_: One of the signatories of the treaties has decided not to follow the treaty any longer and is even now probably building larger and more powerful ships. Thankfully, a clause in the Treaties permits us to automatically invoke an Escalator Clause, which allows us to relax the restrictions on ship size and armament in this case.
loc.MTG_escalator_clause_tt: This will reduce the restrictions on the cost of Capital Ships for all other signatories.
loc.MTG_send_treaty_warning_to_FROM_desc: It appears that [From.GetNameDef] believes we wouldn't notice the irregularities in their naval buildup. We should inform them about their error in judgment.
loc.ENG_create_pan_north_american_state_tt: Annexes and gains cores on all §YAmerican§! states.\nWill be known as §YDominion of North America§!.\n
loc.USA_readmit_state_tt: The state will start the process to become a core.
loc.ENG_expected_decolonization_tt: A coup attempt will be averted.\n
loc.TUR_recall_ataturk_to_active_service_des: Mustafa Kemal Atatürk, Turkey's first field marshal, played an absolutely pivotal role in securing our independence in the National Campaign. He has one of the sharpest military minds on the continent, and destiny has made it necessary to call upon the Father of the Turks to personally lead our troops to victory once again.
loc.flag_mexico_cedillo_has_revolted: General Cedillo has revolted against the government
loc.mexico.1.title: General Cedillo Revolts
loc.mexico.1.desc: For some time, the generals and governors have seen their personal power dissipate as the central government becomes better at keeping the unruly caudillos in check. Mexico's history of rebellions by regional warlords seemed to be dying out. Unfortunately, we failed to act against General Cedillo of San Luis Potosi, and he has retained the services of enough pardoned rebels and ruthless bandits to try to overthrow the central government, depose [Root.GetLeader], and prevent any more power slipping through his fingers.
loc.mexico.2.title: [From.GetAdjective] Oil Nationalized
loc.mexico.2.desc: [From.GetLeader] has been stirring up populist nonsense aimed against our economic interests in Mexico, and now the [From.GetRulingPartyLong] has passed legislation to nationalize the assets of Royal Dutch Shell, Standard Oil of California, and many other international oil firms! Although their Constitution allows this action, international justice demands compensation for the losses suffered by the firms. The oil barons are demanding we act.
loc.mexico.2.a: It's a fait accompli, there's nothing we can do.
loc.mexico.2.b: We will embargo trade with Mexico until they come to their senses.
loc.mexico.2.c: Our options are limited, and force of arms must be considered.
loc.mexico.3.title: [From.GetAdjective] Embargo
loc.mexico.3.desc: In response to our nationalization of their oil concessions, [From.GetLeader] has decided to accept the demands of the oil companies and has placed an embargo on our country. [From.GetNameDef] will no longer buy or sell resources with us. We should consider either compensating the oil firms, or abandoning the international status quo and seeking our fortunes with the enemies of liberal capitalism.
loc.mexico.3.a: The Mexican people will not stand for this!
loc.mexico.4.title: [From.GetAdjective] Compensation
loc.mexico.4.desc: The government of [From.GetLeader] has agreed to demands from Royal Dutch Shell and Standard Oil of California for compensation in exchange for the losses sustained by the firms during nationalization of the oil fields. Though [From.GetNameDef] will not give back any oil concessions, at least our national prestige and financial interests are sated.
loc.mexico.4.a: Good, we can trade on these terms.
loc.mexico.4.b: Keep the embargo in place, we're holding out for a better deal.
loc.mexico.8.title: [From.GetAdjective] Entry Into The [Root.GetFactionName]
loc.mexico.8.desc: [From.GetLeader] has submitted a request to join the [Root.GetFactionName]. Whether he seeks mutual protection or foreign expansion is unknown, but Mexico's oil is a lucrative asset to have on our side.
loc.mexico.8.a: We will sponsor Mexico's entrance into the [Root.GetFactionName].
loc.mexico.8.b: We have other plans for Mexico.
loc.mexico.9.title: Mexican Entry into the [Root.GetFactionName]
loc.mexico.9.desc: [From.GetLeader] has sponsored a request from Mexico for entry into the [Root.GetFactionName]. Whether Mexico seeks mutual protection or foreign expansion is unknown, but Mexico's oil is a lucrative asset to have on our side.
loc.mexico.9.a: We will sponsor Mexico's entrance into the [Root.GetFactionName].
loc.mexico.9.b: We have other plans for Mexico.
loc.mexico.10.title: The [From.GetFactionName]
loc.mexico.10.desc: [From.GetLeader] has invited [Root.GetNameDef] to join the [From.GetFactionName]. This right-wing bloc of countries will defend Latin America from Communist infiltration, while striking an independent path from the decadent Yanquis.
loc.mexico.10.b: The Americans will not stand for such a plan.
loc.mexico.11.title: The [From.GetFactionName]
loc.mexico.11.desc: [From.GetLeader] has invited [Root.GetNameDef] to join the [From.GetFactionName]. This left-wing bloc of countries will defend Latin America from Fascist tyranny, while striking an independent path from the oppressive Yanquis.
loc.mexico.11.b: The Americans will not stand for such a plan.
loc.mexico.12.title: Sale of British Honduras
loc.mexico.12.desc: [From.GetLeader] has requested that [Root.GetNameDef] sell the small territory of British Honduras, sometimes called Belize. The Spanish empire claimed the region but never settled it, so Mexico has little real claim to the territory. However, we could sell the territory to our Mexican friends as a gesture of good faith.
loc.mexico.12.b: That territory is useful as a naval base.
loc.mexico.13.title: Britain Cedes Belize
loc.mexico.13.desc: [From.GetLeader] has agreed to turn over control of the former colony of British Honduras to us as a gesture of good faith. The state is small, undeveloped and lacks natural resources other than lumber, but this shows Mexico's improved standing on the international stage.
loc.mexico.14.title: Britain Declines Sale of Belize
loc.mexico.14.desc: [From.GetLeader] has refused to sell the colony of British Honduras to us. Citing its usefulness as a naval base, the [From.GetAdjective] government states its preference to retain the colony. Most inhabitants are English speakers so the refusal is understandable, if disappointing.
loc.mexico.14.a: Perhaps the [From.GetAdjective] are not our friends after all.
loc.mexico.15.title: Archbishop Pascual Díaz Passes Away
loc.mexico.15.desc: The Most Reverend Pascual Díaz y Barreto, Archbishop of Mexico City, has passed away today due to colitis. He was 59. His legacy is one of hardline opposition to the socialist policies of the government, together with attempts at compromise towards the end of the Cristero War.\n\nHis successor is Luis María Martínez, a social reformer and personal friend of President Cárdenas. The successor was probably selected by the Pope to ensure continued peace between Church and government in Mexico.
loc.mexico.16.title: Oil Worker Strike
loc.mexico.16.desc: The oil workers unionized in 1935 with the blessing of President Cárdenas, creating the Sindicato Único de Trabajadores Petroleros. They immediately began trying to negotiate higher wages and better working conditions, but were rebuffed by the powerful international oil firms like Royal Dutch Shell and Standard Oil of California. The matter passed to an arbitration committee and eventually went to the courts, with the burning question being whether the oil firms could afford the higher wages.\n\nAccording to recent investigations, the Mexican subsidiaries make even more profit than oil companies in the United States, but still refuse to come to an agreement with the workers. It seems they have the backing of powerful regional strongmen and see themselves as being above the law.
loc.mexico.16.a: Outrageous! This exploitation is unethical and must end!
loc.mexico.17.title: Trotsky Arrives
loc.mexico.17.desc: Exiled from the Soviet Union for opposing the rise of Stalin, blamed for all manner of problems from military setbacks to industrial accidents, and driven from country to country by political pressure, Lev Trotsky, Communist revolutionary and author, has arrived in Mexico after a voyage from Norway on an oil tanker.
loc.mexico.17.a: We aren't Stalin's puppets, give him asylum.
loc.mexico.17.b: Extradite him to the Soviet Union to face trial for his crimes.
loc.mexico.17.c: He's an organizational genius, invite him to join the government.
loc.flag_mexico_invited_trotsky_to_governmen: Trotsky has been invited to join the government
loc.flag_trotsky_dead: Trotsky has been killed by Stalinist agents
loc.mexico.18.title: Election Campaign Begins
loc.mexico.18.desc: The election campaign for the next President is due to begin in the next few days. The 1933 constitutional reform was introduced in response to anger at the idea of Calles becoming president for a second term, and after the outright assassination of Calles' predecessor, Álvaro Obregón, who sought such a second term. This reform prevents an elected official serving twice, even if he was only an interim or provisional caretaker. This helps prevent a repeat of the Porfiriato, which saw dictator Porfirio Díaz serve seven terms in a thirty year period and inspired the 1910 Mexican Revolution, plunging the country into a decade of civil strife.\n\nThis law has the benefit of making patronage networks outside the party more difficult to sustain, but also prevents officials being directly accountable to electors, as they will move to a different tier of government after their term, making them reliant on patronage within the party.
loc.mexico.18.a: This constitutional reform is essential for the stability of the country.
loc.mexico.18.b: Ridiculous! [Root.GetLeader] knows best, he will serve a second term!
loc.mexico.19.title: [Root.GetRulingParty] Successor
loc.mexico.19.desc: The successor to [Root.GetLeader] is being discussed within the party. Competitive elections are still on shaky ground in Mexico, and the ruling [Root.GetRulingPartyLong], in co-ordination with the army and security forces, are certain to win the general election.
loc.mexico.19.a: Francisco Múgica, Revolutionary general and social reformer.
loc.mexico.19.b: Manuel Ávila Camacho, veteran Chief of Staff.
loc.mexico.19.f: Francisco Múgica, Revolutionary general and social reformer.
loc.mexico.19.g: Manuel Ávila Camacho, veteran Chief of Staff.
loc.mexico.19.h: Juan Andreu Almazán, right-wing businessman and general.
loc.mexico.19.j: Francisco Múgica, Revolutionary general and social reformer.
loc.mexico.19.m: Lev Trotsky, hero of the October Revolution.
loc.mexico.19.n: Saturnino Cedillo, Revolutionary general and continuity candidate.
loc.mexico.19.o: Juan Andreu Almazán, right-wing businessman and Revolutionary general.
loc.mexico.19.r: Valentín Campa, a railway syndicalist close to Laborde.
loc.mexico.20.title: Juan Andreu Denounces Election
loc.mexico.20.desc: Right-wing businessman and Revolutionary general Juan Andreu Almazán has denounced the outcome of the recent election. He claims his support was greater and that [Root.GetLeader] only won thanks to manipulating the outcome. While this might be true, Juan Andreu is certainly acting like a sore loser. He has gone into self-imposed exile in America and is trying to organize a coup attempt against the [Root.GetRulingPartyLong]. Remaining on good terms with America would be prudent.
loc.mexico.20.a: Go on, run to the Yanquis.
loc.mexico.21.title: Mexico Extradites Trotsky
loc.mexico.21.desc: Though promised asylum by the Mexican government a few months ago, upon his arrival in the country Lev Trotsky found himself arrested by state security of the [From.GetRulingPartyLong] and immediately embarked back to the Soviet Union to face trial for his many crimes against the revolutionary state. [From.GetLeader] has also expressed his hope that Mexico and the Soviet Union can enjoy closer relations in the future.
loc.mexico.21.a: Beat a confession out of him and shoot him! Call Major-General Blokhin!
loc.mexico.22.title: Lev Trotsky Returns to USSR
loc.mexico.22.desc: After growing anti-Stalinist sentiments in the Soviet Union, the ruling clique of that country has decided to recall Trotsky from exile and place him as their figurehead at the top of the government. Our intelligence staff suggest his will be largely a puppet of other forces within Russia, but Lev Trotsky is adamant on returning to the birthplace of the October Revolution.
loc.flag_trotsky_has_returned_to_ussr_from_m: Trotsky has returned to the USSR
loc.mexico.23.title: Unrestricted Submarine Warfare
loc.mexico.23.desc: With enemy convoy protection stretched thin and our submarines prowling the oceans unmolested, we are able to destroy isolated merchant vessels almost at will. Our submarine captains have taken to calling these 'the Happy Times'. There are many tantalizing targets to choose from, such as neutral Mexican oil tankers. Our admirals request permission to engage these tankers, although the foreign office warns it could have negative consequences on relations with Mexico.
loc.mexico.23.a: Trading with our enemies is tantamount to open belligerence.
loc.mexico.23.b: Best not make more enemies than we have to.
loc.mexico.24.title: German U-Boat Attacks
loc.mexico.24.desc: The Mexican oil tankers 'Potrero del Llano' and 'Faja de Oro' have been sent to the bottom of the Caribbean by German wolfpacks operating under the doctrine of 'unrestricted submarine warfare'. This attack on neutral vessels is an act of war. We would be within our rights to attack German vessels we encounter at sea.\n\nWe should also consider joining the American faction who are fighting the Germans. This would put the Yanquis in our debt and show the world that Mexico is an international player.
loc.mexico.25.title: Mexico Seeks Alliance
loc.mexico.25.desc: [From.GetLeader] is seeking to join the war against Germany after the German policy of unrestricted submarine warfare resulted in u-boats sinking several neutral Mexican oil tankers sailing off the coast of Mexico.
loc.mexico.25.b: We can surely find better allies than the Mexicans.
loc.mexico.26.title: Mexico Joins the [From.GetFactionName]
loc.mexico.26.desc: [From.GetLeader] has welcomed the Mexican President's offer of support in the war against Germany. German wolfpacks recently sank the neutral Mexican oil tankers 'Potrero del Llano' and 'Faja de Oro', an act of war resulting in the loss of civilian life, and the Mexican government has stated its desire to see German u-boat activity in the Caribbean ended once and for all.\n\nThe Mexican government has sought greater recognition from the world powers for some time, and they believe that lending support to America and the [From.GetFactionName] will prove they are an international player.
loc.mexico.26.a: Mexico is well within her rights to go to war for this.
loc.mexico.26.b: Does Mexico even have an army?
loc.mexico.26.c: An attack on neutral shipping is a grave crime according to the laws of war.
loc.mexico.27.title: Firmissimam Constantiam
loc.mexico.27.desc: Pope Pius XI has issued a Papal Encyclical addressing the Mexican situation. While the Cristiada was resolved at the negotiating table and the open bloodshed has been ended, the Church is still worried about the direction Mexico is heading in.\n\nThe Encyclical urges Mexican voters to side with religious candidates in elections, and calls for Mexican religious parties such as Catholic Action to address social problems, such as poverty, to prevent more revolutionary violence.
loc.mexico.27.a: It is good that the anti-Church violence has ended.
loc.mexico.27.b: Superstitious propaganda, prevent publication of this treason!
loc.mexico.28.title: Religious Insurrection
loc.mexico.28.desc: Our attacks on the treacherous Church have evidently not been carried out with enough vigor. The traitors have been busy using the freedom we gave them to organize a coup attempt. Recalling the futile Cristero War we justly defeated many years ago, these superstitious fools have raised their crucifix banners and rallied behind the lying priests and are now seeking to undo the progress we have been making towards modernization.
loc.mexico.28.a: We should have stamped this treason out earlier!
loc.mexico.29.title: Second Cristiada
loc.mexico.29.desc: The forces of Church and Revolution have once again come into conflict in Mexico. With the government renewing its attacks on the Church, the embattled Catholic parties and social movements are launching an armed rebellion to seize control of Mexico. Cristero militias are reforming after a decade of inactivity, supplemented by defectors from the federal military. They have taken over several rural states and are using these as a base from which to operate.\n\nThe first Cristiada ended with a settlement negotiated between senior Revolutionary and Church officials thanks to intermediation by the American government, but it looks likely that this violence will end only with the complete destruction of one of the belligerents.
loc.mexico.29.a: It will be easy to slaughter gullible idiots led by senile priests.
loc.mexico.29.b: 'Long live Christ the King and Blessed Mary of Guadalupe!'
loc.mexico.29.c: The Mexican situation seems too complex for an outsider to understand.
loc.mexico.30.title: Atheist Insurrection
loc.mexico.30.desc1: The wicked men we thought we had defeated have rallied for a final, futile battle against the Servants of God. Agents of Satan such as Plutarco Calles and his tyrannical 'revolutionary' minions are streaming out from their dens of evil armed with rifles and bayonets to skewer the Faithful. We must put down this attack on the Body of Christ, or the work we have done to keep alive and increase the flame of piety will come to an end and twenty centuries of knowledge of the laws of Our Redeemer and King will be forgotten.
loc.mexico.30.desc2: The wicked men we thought we had defeated have rallied for a final, futile battle against the Servants of God. Agents of Satan such as Vicente Lombardo and his tyrannical 'revolutionary' minions are streaming out from their dens of evil armed with rifles and bayonets to skewer the Faithful. We must put down this attack on the Body of Christ, or the work we have done to keep alive and increase the flame of piety will come to an end and twenty centuries of knowledge of the laws of Our Redeemer and King will be forgotten.
loc.mexico.30.a: 'This is your hour, and the power of darkness.'
loc.mexico.31.title: Second Mexican Revolution
loc.mexico.31.desc: The forces of Church and Revolution have once again come into conflict in Mexico. With the Catholic parties and social movements gaining in strength, secularist forces are launching an armed rebellion to take back control of the government. The 'Red Brigades' are reforming after a decade of inactivity, while defectors from the federal military are rallying in states still controlled by anti-Church governors.\n\nThe Cristiada ended with a settlement negotiated between senior Revolutionary and Church officials thanks to intermediation by the American government, but it looks likely that this violence will end only with the complete destruction of one of the belligerents.
loc.mexico.31.a: Long live Christ the King and Blessed Mary of Guadalupe!
loc.mexico.31.b: It will be easy to slaughter gullible idiots led by senile priests.
loc.mexico.31.c: The Mexican situation seems too complex for an outsider to understand.
loc.mexico.32.title: 'Zoot Suit' Riots
loc.mexico.32.desc: Hispanic youths wearing extravagant clothes - 'zoot suits' - have been the target of racialized riots in border cities in the South, stemming from sensationalized reporting over the death of a teenager in Los Angeles. Nine Mexican-American youths have been convicted for murder over the incident.\n\nIntelligence agents have compiled reports stating that the zoot suiters are in fact fascist agents, collaborating with ultra-Catholic Sinarquistas in Mexico in order to assist in a Japanese-German invasion of the Americas.
loc.mexico.32.a: That sounds rather unlikely. How much are we paying these agents?
loc.mexico.32.b: Arrest the zoot suiters anyway. The riots are a threat to our war effort.
loc.mexico.33.title: 'Zoot Suit' Riots
loc.mexico.33.desc: Hispanic youths wearing extravagant clothes - 'zoot suits' - have been the target of racialized riots in border cities to our North, stemming from sensationalized reporting over the death of a teenager in Los Angeles. Nine Mexican-American youths have been convicted for murder over the incident.\n\nAmerican intelligence agents have compiled reports stating that the zoot suiters are in fact fascist agents, collaborating with ultra-Catholic Sinarquistas in Mexico in order to assist in a Japanese-German invasion of the Americas.
loc.mexico.33.a: The Sinarquistas are a threat to both America and Mexico.
loc.mexico.33.b: They are just children! This is an injustice!
loc.mexico.34.title: Mexican Resource Exchange
loc.mexico.34.desc: [From.GetLeader] has offered a trade deal with Germany if [Root.GetLeader] will agree to send Mexico designs on the latest light and medium tanks we have developed. This seems to be the first stage in closer Mexican-German relations so even if it serves no military purpose it may be useful to us geopolitically. Of course, these state of the art tank designs could be falling into the hands of a future enemy...
loc.mexico.34.a: This agreement will help both Germany and Mexico.
loc.mexico.34.b: The Americans will likely end up with any designs we send.
loc.mexico.35.title: German Tank Designs
loc.mexico.35.desc: [From.GetLeader] has agreed to grant us licenses for the latest German light and medium tank designs. This will hopefully serve as the first stage of closer Mexican-German relations as well as being useful military knowledge.
loc.mexico.36.title: Germany Refuses Offer
loc.mexico.36.desc: Citing the possibility of Germany's advanced tank designs falling into enemy hands, [From.GetLeader] has refused our offer of a resource exchange. We will have to develop native tank designs, or pay the Germans for their licenses...
loc.mexico.40.title: Operation Just Cause Succeeds
loc.mexico.40.desc: Our surprise assault on the Yanqui base in Panamá has succeeded. We have driven out the imperialists and now await the response of the decrepit Northern empire. If they choose to throw themselves at our defenses, we will make them pay.
loc.mexico.40.a: Centroamérica will be secure against American aggression.
loc.mexico.41.title: [From.GetAdjective] Seizure of Panamá Canal
loc.mexico.41.desc: The dictator of Mexico, [From.GetLeader], has had the temerity to launch a large attack on our Panamá Canal force from nearby staging grounds. Their 'Operation Just Cause' was a success and our troops are falling back in confusion. The Mexicans are not crossing into the continental United States, so this was not the prelude to a general invasion, but the attack has weakened our ability to project force around the globe and humiliated us on the international stage.
loc.mexico.41.a: We have more pressing concerns, unfortunately. An embargo should be sufficient.
loc.mexico.41.b: Our sovereignty has been threatened. This demands a military response.
loc.mexico.42.title: Operation Just Cause Fails
loc.mexico.42.desc: Our surprise assault on the Yanqui base in Panamá has gone awry. Perhaps we did not deploy enough troops, or the commander was simply incompetent. Either way, we have been driven out by the imperialists and now await the response of the decrepit Northern empire. If they choose to throw themselves at our defenses, we will make them pay.
loc.mexico.42.a: Centroamérica is still threatened by American aggression.
loc.mexico.43.title: [From.GetAdjective] Attack on Panamá Canal
loc.mexico.43.desc: The dictator of Mexico, [From.GetLeader], has had the temerity to launch a large attack on our Panamá Canal force from nearby staging grounds. Fortunately, our brave troops managed to repel their 'Operation Just Cause' and throw back the invaders. The Mexicans are not crossing into the continental United States, so this was not the prelude to a general invasion, but the attack has demonstrated that we are no longer masters of the Americas, humiliating us on the international stage.
loc.mexico.43.a: We have more pressing concerns, unfortunately. An embargo should be sufficient.
loc.mexico.43.b: Our sovereignty has been threatened. This demands a military response.
loc.mexico.44.title: Mexico Seizes Panamá Canal
loc.mexico.44.desc1: Following a [From.GetAdjective] incursion into the American military base at the Panamá Canal, troops on both sides of the border have been mobilizing for war. Though the Mexicans struck first, seizing the strategically important Canal Zone, the Americans seem to be the ones aiming to launch an offensive to punish their insolent neighbor. The 'gutter press' is denouncing the [From.GetRulingPartyLong] as a clique of bandits with no respect for international law, and calling for regime change.\n\nIf a Second Mexican-American War breaks out, it would be fought in the harsh and unforgiving terrain of mountains and deserts, with much greater loss of life than the small scuffle in 1847 which preceded the Mexican Cession.
loc.mexico.44.desc2: Reports of [From.GetAdjective] troops entering the American military base at the Panamá Canal have been confirmed by [From.GetLeader], who claims to have been acting to preserve [From.GetAdjective] interests in Centroamérica following domestic turbulence in the United States. The [From.GetRulingPartyLong] propaganda ministry has requested that all remaining American soldiers in the area give up their arms and respect the 'peaceful handover of power' in the Canal Zone. The American president has been heavily criticized by the 'gutter press' for not fighting harder to preserve national interests in the area, and for failing to follow up the [From.GetAdjective] attack with a general mobilization against [From.GetNameDef].
loc.mexico.44.b: An outrageous attack on America's sovereignty.
loc.mexico.45.title: [MEX.GetAdjective]-American Border Clashes
loc.mexico.45.desc1: American troops on the Southern border have been placed on high alert, as recent [From.GetAdjective] aggression against the American military base at the Panamá Canal raises the possibility of a large scale war between the two neighbors. Though [From.GetLeader]'s surprise attack failed, the American president has reportedly decided to punish the insolent Southern neighbor. The 'gutter press' is denouncing the [From.GetRulingPartyLong] as a clique of bandits with no respect for international law, and calling for regime change.\n\nIf a Second Mexican-American War breaks out, it would be fought in the harsh and unforgiving terrain of mountains and deserts, with much greater loss of life than the small scuffle in 1847 which preceded the Mexican Cession.
