loc.HOL_philips_focus_desc: Philips has long been a market leader in radios and other electronics. Perhaps by contracting and funding this Dutch electronics company we might achieve some breakthroughs of our own in this increasingly-important type of military equipment.
loc.HOL_expand_RD_facilities_desc: Our industrial expansion and other recent advances might allow us to conduct more R&D in parallel, especially if we expand upon Philips' already-existing facilities.
loc.HOL_the_zuiderzee_works_desc: The next stage of land reclamation is the Flevopolder, named after the ancient Flevo lake first mentioned in Roman times. This is a tremendous project that will take many years to be fully finished, but even in the short term it will provide us with ample rewards.
loc.HOL_develop_the_randstad_desc: By developing our largest cities and the areas connecting them even further, we can lay the foundations of what some are already starting to refer to as the 'Rim City'; a roughly circular urban area connecting the major cities of Amsterdam, Den Haag, Rotterdam, and Utrecht, surrounding the 'Groene Hart' or 'Green Heart' at the center of the 'rim'.
loc.HOL_expand_the_ijmuiden_steel_mill_desc: Our war industry requires ample steel, and we must see to expanding the already-existing facilities at IJmuiden.
loc.HOL_fokker_desc: Fokker, the world leader in civil aircraft production, has been jumping at the chance to build more military aircraft. Perhaps we should let them, and support the enlargement of the industry that this requires.
loc.HOL_domestic_jet_engine_designs_desc: Our innovative aircraft builders should be encouraged to experiment with futuristic designs. Though the result may not immediately be a functioning jet engine aircraft, it will undoubtedly result in improvements in production of aircraft in general.
loc.HOL_develop_the_zandstad_desc: Rather than focus all of our efforts in building up our largest cities, we should distribute new industry more among the outlying areas.
loc.HOL_friesland_agricultural_impetus_desc: Increasing the agricultural yield of our small country will go a long way to improving self-sufficiency, and thereby reducing the need for imports.
loc.HOL_daf_desc: Our domestic car industry is not non-existent, and could well be contracted to produce military vehicles. With some state assistance, Van Doorne's Aanhangwagen Fabriek (DAF), could well become able to provide our military with all the motorized and mechanized equipment it might need.
loc.HOL_domestic_vehicle_designs_desc: Giving our automobile industry more freedom in handling its designs may well have side effects in improving production efficiency, as well.
loc.HOL_continental_shipbuilding_desc: Our shipyards in Holland, Zeeland, and Friesland must be greatly expanded to enable any large-scale naval construction plans.
loc.HOL_domestic_innovation_desc: The rapid industrialization of our nation has opened up new opportunities in R&D that we should pursue.
loc.HOL_make_use_of_our_riches_desc: Our nation possesses the resources of a major power while wearing the garb of a minor one. Perhaps if we make better use of the riches that are available to us, we may well ascend to the middling level, if not take our place among the dominant powers of the world once again.
loc.HOL_the_ultimate_deterrent_desc: A powerful air force and a powerful navy are all nice and well, but what would truly deter anyone from attacking our colonies, or otherwise violating our neutrality, would be the development of an atomic bomb.
loc.HOL_overturn_military_budget_cuts_desc: The economy has begun recovering surprisingly quickly after we abandoned the Gold Standard... The military budget cuts we were forced to implement to keep the Guilder from devaluating can now be overturned.
loc.HOL_prepare_the_inundation_lines_desc: Ever since our independence war against the Spanish in the 16th century, inundation, or intentional flooding of the land, has been an integral part of our defenses. Properly prepared, it will surely save us again: we have yet to see a tank that can cross water.
loc.HOL_prepare_the_inundation_lines_tt: These allow for the §YFlooding§! and §YDraining§! of certain provinces surrounding Fortress Holland, giving defensive bonuses.\n
loc.HOL_protect_against_britain_desc: True neutrality means that we shall defend our sovereignty against any that would violate it... Even if this should be the British, in a misguided attempt to safeguard our ports and airfields from the Germans.
loc.HOL_further_reinforce_the_ports_desc: We should further strengthen our coastal defenses, to discourage any British notion of "lending us their assistance" without our express permission.
loc.HOL_southward_defenses_desc: We must establish a defensive line along the Meuse river, to thwart any northward push through Belgium. A further, final strengthening of our coastal defenses should definitively smash any potential British plans to land an expeditionary force in our harbors.
loc.HOL_germany_is_the_greater_threat_desc: In light of Germany's increasing aggression, we should direct our defenses eastward, just in case they are less respectful of our neutrality than they were in the last war...
loc.HOL_fortress_holland_desc: We must bet everything on Fortress Holland. The area north of the great rivers and west of the IJsselmeer encompasses by far the larger part of our population and industry. Sacrificing the rest of the country might allow us to hold out long enough in our industrialized area for a more powerful ally to come to our aid in time.
loc.HOL_modernize_the_grebbeline_desc: The southern front of Fortress Holland is well-defended by the great rivers the Rhine and the Meuse. This leaves only a gap to the east of Amsterdam, between the IJsselmeer to the north and the Rhine to the south. The defensive line located here, the Grebbe Line, must be modernized and reinforced if it is to hold against determined assault.
loc.HOL_war_on_pacifism_desc: Ever since the Great War, pacifism has run rampant among the Dutch public, making it practically impossible to form a modern military. For too long has the 'Will of the People' prevented the full allocation of required funds to the military. They know not the danger they expose themselves to... We will declare a war upon Pacifism, and banish this unproductive sentiment from the minds of our populace!
loc.HOL_war_on_pacifism_tt: These decisions allow for the §Greduction/removal§! of §YShell-shocked Spectator of the Great War§!.\n
loc.HOL_appoint_new_supreme_commander_desc: Our supreme commander is proving to be rather obstinate in his adherence to outright impossible defensive plans. He should be replaced. Henri Winkelman could be recalled from retirement, and would likely prove a more... amenable alternative.
loc.HOL_modernize_our_infantry_equipment_des: Our infantry equipment is horribly out-of-date. If we are to have a decent chance at halting any invasion, this must be remedied.
loc.HOL_modernize_our_infantry_equipment_tt: This will cause us to focus on internal development of equipment over license production in the future.\n
loc.HOL_production_under_license_desc: As we have no domestic arms industry to speak of, we should look at newer models of both small arms and artillery abroad. With luck, we can obtain the rights to produce these domestically, under license.
loc.HOL_production_under_license_tt: This will cause us to focus on license production over internal development of equipment in the future.\n
loc.HOL_light_tanks_for_the_colonies_desc: Light tanks would be perfectly suited to defend the expansive and difficult terrain of our island colonies against amphibious infantry landings.
loc.HOL_light_tanks_for_the_colonies_tt: Depending on whether you elected to focus on modernization or on license production, this focus gives either of the following:\n
loc.HOL_secret_staff_talks_desc: Though we are officially neutral, we should nevertheless look into secret staff talks with our neighbors. Concerted defensive plans worked out with any one of our neighbors, even if unofficial, could be of monumental importance if we are invaded by another.
loc.HOL_secret_staff_talks_tt: These make it possible to obtain §YEquipment§!, §YOffensive§! and §YDefensive§! combat bonuses, §YLand Doctrine§! research bonuses, and Government-in-Exile £legitimacy §YLegitimacy§!.\n
loc.HOL_anti_tank_guns_for_the_continent: Anti Tank Guns for the Continent
loc.HOL_anti_tank_guns_for_the_continent_des: Since the Great War we have seen our continental neighbors improve their tank designs. If invasion comes, these machines will certainly be an integral part of it. We must prepare accordingly.
loc.HOL_lessons_from_the_last_war_desc: Though we might not have been involved, we had a prime spot from which to observe the machinations, and failures, of the Schlieffen Plan on our doorstep. We must draw our conclusions from these observations.
loc.HOL_expand_the_mld_desc: By far the most important part of our air forces is the naval aviation branch: the Marine Luchtvaart Dienst or MLD. We must see to expanding this branch, improving its main base of operations in the East Indies, and developing new tactics and strategies for its use.
loc.HOL_protect_the_mainland_desc: To protect the continental Netherlands we must acquire a fleet of modern fighter aircraft, to maintain air superiority over our skies.
loc.HOL_protect_the_colonies_desc: We must station larger numbers of modern naval bombers in the colonies to discourage any attempt at naval invasion, and to protect against one if necessary.
loc.netherlands_has_no_colonies_tt: §YThe Netherlands§! do not own or have a subject own any of their starting §Ycolonial territory§!.
loc.HOL_modernize_the_air_fleet_desc: We must drastically speed up the acquisition of the aircraft models we require for our immediate defense. Time is short!
loc.HOL_strategic_bombing_defense_desc: If war should come to the Netherlands, it will surely involve strategic bombing on the largest scale imaginable. We must develop new doctrines to deal with this threat, and we must enlarge our continental air bases to allow for the large air force that these doctrines will require.
loc.HOL_longer_range_models_desc: Dominance over the seas is essential for the integrity of our colonial empire. However, the seas are vast, and so we require airplanes with adequate range.
loc.HOL_unsinkable_aircraft_carriers_desc: With the advent of the third dimension of warfare we should see to ensuring adequate air cover for our fleet. However, mere steel, sinkable aircraft carriers are such a fickle investment... Rather, the thousands of islands sprawling across the East Indies could serve as "unsinkable aircraft carriers", if only we were to put some air fields on them.
loc.HOL_aviatic_aspirations_desc: The air is a new theater of war, but not one we cannot master. We already have shown our ability when it comes to the civilian aviation industry, surely it will not be so hard to transfer that to the military sphere, as well.
loc.HOL_prepare_naval_expansion_desc: We should prepare for an enlargement of our navy well in time, and therefore should begin pouring resources into an expansion of Dutch shipbuilding already NOW.
loc.HOL_expand_the_amsterdam_petroleum_harbo: An increase in the size of our navy requires a comparable increase in the size of our fuel stores, lest we are left with ships that we cannot afford to use. The Amsterdam petroleum harbor is already a hub for the import of fuel; we shall increase its storage capacity even further.
loc.HOL_cornerstone_of_colonial_defense_desc: The fleet is the most important pillar of defense for our colonial empire. We should look into how best to make use of what we have.
loc.HOL_rely_on_submarines_desc: Even modern cruisers will be no help against the huge navies we might be expected to have to fight. We will instead invest in modern submarines to delay an enemy advance until the fleet of a more powerful ally can arrive.
loc.HOL_modernize_the_cruiser_fleet_desc: Our cruisers are vital to our defensive plans for the East Indies, but those that we have right now are of aging designs. We will design a new generation of warships that we can begin building as soon as possible.
loc.HOL_the_battlecruiser_plan_desc: Voices have begun to pop up in favor of the creation of a trio of battlecruisers; ships larger than anything we have previously built or designed. With German good-will they might provide us with the plans for the German battlecruiser Scharnhorst, allowing us to use these as a basis from which to create our own designs. These ships would surely deter any attack on our colonies.
loc.HOL_the_battlecruiser_plan_tt: §R[GER.GetNameDefCap] must approve of the agreement for the bonuses to take effect.§!\n
loc.HOL_air_cover_for_the_new_fleet: Air Cover for the New Fleet
loc.HOL_air_cover_for_the_new_fleet_desc: If we invest in large battlecruisers then we should also assure adequate air cover for them, lest the ships are squandered. We will look into the design of an aircraft carrier.
loc.HOL_escorts_for_the_new_fleet_desc: Our battlecruisers require ample escorts to protect against torpedo boats and submarines. We should ensure that any escorts we build are of the most modern design possible.
loc.HOL_naval_heritage_desc: From Piet Hein to Michiel de Ruyter, our nation's history is filled with naval heroes and their successful exploits against the major naval powers of their day. A kinship with the seas runs in our blood, and we need but embrace it to revive our naval pride and heritage.
loc.HOL_form_new_government_desc: Our current government is weak, and is now on the verge of falling yet again. We will give a new Prime Minister the task of forming a stronger cabinet.
loc.HOL_gateway_to_europe_desc: The Netherlands is the gateway of trade into Europe, a fact that is well understood by our trade partners. Though, while our position gives us strength, it also puts us in an unenviable predicament: while the British aim to blockade their likely enemies on the continent, the Germans wish for us to increase the flow of trade to their country through ours, using us as a back door to avoid the blockade.
loc.HOL_gateway_to_europe_tt: These make it possible to give Trade Influence points to §Y[GER.GetName]§! and §Y[ENG.GetName]§!.\n
loc.HOL_cave_to_the_germans_desc: Sharing a land border with the Germans, we could reasonably expect invasion if we refused their demands for increased flow of trade through our country. Let them use us as a back door to avoid a British blockade, if it means our safety!
loc.HOL_trade_influence_tt: Receives an amount of §YPolitical Power§! equal to the total amount invested by all §YGateway to Europe§! participants. Currently this amounts to:\n
loc.HOL_cave_to_the_germans_tt: @GER§Y[GER.GetName]§! has at least §Y15§! Trade Influence points more than @ENG§Y[ENG.GetName]§!.
loc.HOL_cave_to_the_germans2_tt: @GER§Y[GER.GetName]§! has at least §Y25§! Trade Influence points.
loc.HOL_maintain_trade_neutrality_desc: We must resist demands on our trade from either side, and maintain our trade policies as they are now. To pick any one side would likely lead to war with the other...
loc.HOL_maintain_trade_neutrality_tt: Neither @GER§Y[GER.GetName]§! nor @ENG§Y[ENG.GetName]§! have more than §Y5§! Trade Influence points more than the other.\n
loc.HOL_maintain_trade_neutrality2_tt: Both @GER§Y[GER.GetName]§! and @ENG§Y[ENG.GetName]§! have at least §Y50§! Trade Influence points.\n
loc.HOL_cave_to_the_british_desc: The British are engaging in fierce trade negotiations with us, demanding that we reduce the flow of trade through our country to Germany, as they fear the Germans will use us as a back door to escape the British blockade. If we refuse, the British would simply blockade us, too... This would be catastrophic to our barely-recovered economy, and so we have no choice but to do as they wish.
loc.HOL_cave_to_the_british_tt: @ENG§Y[ENG.GetName]§! has at least §Y15§! Trade Influence points more than @GER§Y[GER.GetName]§!\n
loc.HOL_cave_to_the_british2_tt: @ENG§Y[ENG.GetName]§! has at least §Y25§! Trade Influence points.
loc.HOL_volk_en_vaderland_desc: Our decision to favor one neighbor over the other means that we have definitively abandoned our neutrality. The increase of pro-German voices and nationalist rhetoric resulting from our recent decision is starting to become very noticeable in our internal politics, such as in the form of the far-right newspaper 'People and Fatherland'.
loc.HOL_de_jeugdstorm_desc: Swaying a population away from fervent pacifism, and within a few years instill in them a culture of militarism, is no easy feat. But with ample propaganda, rhetoric, and by starting with our impressionable youth, we will manage it to the fullest extent we are able.
loc.HOL_strength_over_blood_desc: Blood should have no bearing on whether someone is a leader or not. Let those who have shown their strength lead our nation, rather than those whose blood was blue upon birth.
loc.HOL_join_germany_desc: We who are of kindred spirit should stick together against the World. It is time for us to request membership of the Axis.
loc.HOL_german_technological_exchange_desc: With access to German technology we will be able to better carry our share of the burden of shaping this New World Order.
loc.HOL_beginnings_of_a_dutch_blitzkrieg_des: With German assistance perhaps we can join in the Blitzkrieg with our own tank forces.
loc.HOL_beginnings_of_a_dutch_blitzkrieg_tt_: Gains a §YProduction License§! for the best §YMedium Tank§! model currently developed by §Y[GER.GetNameDef]§!.\n
Gains research bonuses for all §YMedium Tank§! models currently developed by §Y[GER.GetNameDef]§!.\n
loc.HOL_placate_the_japanese_desc: It is known the Japanese have designs on our rich colonies in the East. Perhaps the time has come to decide whether to give them exclusive rights on the resources of the archipelago, or even outright control of the colonies, in the interest of continued peace and cooperation.
loc.HOL_assume_the_naval_burden_desc: While our ally is an expert in land warfare, perhaps our naval history lends us better to taking up the naval part of the war.
loc.HOL_the_netherlands_first_desc: The Netherlands has all the wealth of natural resources to be a Great Power in its own right. If we make proper use of it, and continue to militarize our society, we do not need German help to carve out our own place in this world.
loc.HOL_implement_the_program_desc: Now that the nation is secure under the leadership of our Leader, it is time to implement the party's 'Program'. A strong government, economic and social reforms, and abolition of press freedom and voting rights are but a few of the points that will make our people stronger. All must do their duty for the Fatherland!
loc.HOL_taking_back_french_flanders_desc: The historical extent of the low countries have since been partitioned by the major powers surrounding it. Of these, France still holds a sizeable amount of land that is considered a part of historical Flanders. We are now strong enough to take it back, and so we should.
loc.HOL_the_united_netherlands_desc: Our peoples are stronger together. Even the British knew this when they created the buffer state of the United Netherlands after the Napoleonic wars. Though short-lived, this only means a stronger leadership is required to make the proposal work. We will return the Belgians and Luxembourgians to the fold, to thereafter stand strong against whoever may come.
loc.HOL_taking_back_our_old_colonies_desc: Our temporary weakness resulting from Napoleon's conquest nearly 150 years ago lost us many of our colonies to the British. The populations of many of these still share our Dutch culture and heritage. We must take back our old colonial possessions!
loc.HOL_imperial_ambitions_desc: As our people revel in the glory that befits our status as an Imperial power, all that remains is to take back our old colonies of Nieuw Nederland in the north-eastern United States of America.
loc.HOL_legacy_of_the_de_zeven_provincien_mu: Legacy of the "De Zeven Provinciën" Mutiny

The mutiny on board the cruiser "De Zeven Provinciën" in February 1933 has been a taboo topic ever since. We must make the topic discussable again, lest we forget the sacrifices those brave men made for the Workers' cause. We should all take an example from their actions, and rise to defend our ideals!
loc.HOL_decolonization_desc: Our homeland has ample troubles, and rather than send our resources overseas to take care of our colonies, while oppressing the native population, we should clearly give them their freedom so that they may rise as a full and equal member of the global community, withdrawing our forces back to the mainland in the process.
loc.HOL_decolonization_tt1: All states in §YIndonesia§!: Fully controlled by §Y[INS.GetNameDef]§!
loc.HOL_decolonization_tt2: All states in §YIndonesia§!: Fully controlled by §Y[HOL.GetNameDef]§!
loc.HOL_decolonization_tt: Creates 8 KNIL units with §Y9 Infantry§! battalions in §YHolland§!.\n
loc.HOL_red_is_the_new_orange_desc: Equality leaves no room for anyone to be raised above the others, even if this should be a family so intertwined with our nation's history. Their titles must be stripped, and their resources seized to further the common good.
loc.HOL_affirm_loyalty_to_moscow_desc: Our party has long taken its instructions from [SOU.Capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName], and it is only natural that we will join them in their fight to spread communism across the globe.
loc.HOL_soviet_technical_teams_desc: Our allies have mastered the art of maximizing production of war equipment. By receiving some teams of experts we can fine-tune our own production lines to make use of their innovations.
loc.HOL_making_the_ends_of_europe_meet: Making the Ends of Europe Meet
loc.HOL_making_the_ends_of_europe_meet_desc: Communism now embraces Europe from both sides. It is time to make those ends meet, and eliminate the power inbetween.
loc.HOL_join_the_french_desc: The communist movement in France has become increasingly successful, and now they have elected to stand separate from the Comintern. As they are much nearer to us geographically, aligning ourselves with them will benefit the cause of communism far more than to rely upon the distant Soviets.
loc.HOL_french_military_mission_desc: The French military is famed throughout the continent. We will invite a military mission, to educate our military thinkers and improve the organization of our army.
loc.HOL_socialist_industrial_support_desc: Our allies have far greater industrial capacity than we do. We will need their assistance if we are to weather the coming storm.
loc.HOL_for_the_common_good_desc: In the interest of the common good for all Communism, we must share our technological advances with each other.
loc.HOL_for_the_common_good_tt: §Y[HOL.GetName]§! and all faction members join §YCommunist Technology Exchange§!.\n
loc.HOL_mobilize_the_masses_desc: The only one who can defend the worker is the worker. The people must rise up in defense of their country and their beliefs!
loc.HOL_bastion_of_true_communism_desc: We stand alone in Western Europe in our interpretation of communism. We have no-one to turn to, and so must rely on ourselves to see through the final victory for the communist cause.
loc.HOL_bring_socialism_south_desc: We must support our ideological comrades in the south, by force if necessary. As we are so distant from Moscow, and are beset by hostile ideologies on all sides, we must form a strong Bulwark of Communism ourselves on Europe's western shores.
loc.HOL_enemies_on_all_fronts_desc: Our nation is small and lacks strategic depth. Our only hope for survival is that every man and woman does their duty, and that any invader is met by a mass of bodies they cannot overcome.
loc.HOL_haven_of_tolerance_desc: The Dutch spirit shines through even in communism. We welcome any and all who have been shunned by their homelands. We do not ask about their past, only that they do their duty to protect this fledgling Eden from the forces that would stifle it.
loc.HOL_pre_empt_western_intervention_desc: As our ideology takes hold, there are those powers who would see it fail in its cradle. We cannot allow this to happen, and rather than wait for the inevitable hammerblow to fall, we must act quickly and take out this threat to our very survival.
loc.HOL_oranje_boven_desc: The history of our country is intertwined with the royal family of Orange-Nassau. As such, the color orange has become a national symbol, reflected both in the custom of adding an orange pennant to the flag on days of national celebration, as well as short patriotic songs such as 'Oranje Boven', or 'Orange Above', celebrating the Queen and the royal family as a whole.
loc.HOL_symbol_of_resistance_desc: Ever since William the Silent secured our independence from the Spanish in the 80 Years' War, the royal family has been a symbol of Dutch independence and resistance to any foreign invader. It is certain that should our borders be violated again, this will not be any different.
loc.HOL_replace_the_defeatist_government_des: Our government is filled with cowards who do not see any point in continuing to resist the aggressor. We must replace these men with those who are willing to do what must be done to see the fight to its successful conclusion.
loc.HOL_the_only_man_in_the_dutch_government: The Only Man In the Dutch Government

As Churchill himself once said, our proud Queen Wilhelmina is 'the only man in the Dutch government'; the only one with the backbone to do what must be done. Rather than rely on those of weaker stomach, perhaps she should assume direct control of the government and rule as she sees fit.
loc.HOL_de_vernieuwing_desc: As part of the Queen's program, the 'vernieuwing' or 'renewal' will do away with the flawed concept of political parties. The Queen's distaste with politicians is well-known, and if she believes we will be better off without them, then perhaps that is so. It will certainly make ruling easier.
loc.HOL_depillarization_desc: The Dutch society has been divided in various strata, called 'zuilen' or 'pillars'. As part of the Queen's new mandate she has aimed to do away with this 'pillarization' that has plagued our country for all these years. Those with one religion, ideology or social status may now freely interact with those of another, improving stability.
loc.HOL_a_new_dutch_unity_desc: With the Queen's mandate progressing well, we can foster a new sense of national pride and unity among the people. Only together will we be strong, and we do not ever need to hang our heads low amongst the major powers of the world because of our tiny nation. As a people, we strike much harder than our small size would indicate.
loc.HOL_revive_the_buffer_state_proposal_des: As the Germans and the French seem unable to refrain from going at each other's throats time and again, perhaps it is time to argue the case for a powerful Low Countries buffer state once again. If the Belgians and Luxembourgians did not wish this, then perhaps they should have done more to contribute to the war effort, like we have?
loc.HOL_royal_arms_purchases_desc: As her interests are now even more intricately tied to that of the country as a whole, the Queen has proposed to use her ample personal wealth to finance the acquisition of new equipment from abroad.
loc.HOL_develop_the_south_desc: Having obtained the remainder of the old United Netherlands, we should now look towards ensuring these lands receive the same investments for industrial build-up as the Dutch heartland did, lest they fall behind compared to the rest of the country.
loc.HOL_WILHELMINISM_FASCISM: The dynastic ties between our own royal house and that of the German Kaiser, who has resided in Huis Doorn since the end of the Great War, are still strong. Perhaps we can use the popularity he still enjoys among many in the German military for our own gains, and, in doing so, create a powerful state that will have reason to be thankful to us when the war ends.
loc.HOL_WILHELMINISM_NEUTRALITY: The dynastic ties between our own royal house and that of the German Kaiser, who until recently resided in exile in Huis Doorn in the Netherlands, are still strong. We who are family should stand together, and the Germans certainly have reason to thank us for hosting their Kaiser for all this time.
loc.HOL_wilhelminism_tt: Gains National Spirit §YGerman Defectors§!, which will periodically generate units with §Y7 Infantry§! and §Y2 Artillery§! battalions and §YEngineer§!, §YRecon§!, and §YArtillery§! Support.\n
loc.HOL_unity_through_democracy_desc: The 'Dutch Movement for Unity through Democracy' ('Eenheid door Democratie') was formed in 1935, and has ever since been an outspoken extra-parliamentary voice against demagogues of all other ideologies. Supporting the movement can in turn pay dividends by defending our democracy and strengthening our government.
loc.HOL_go_with_britain_desc: The British have stood up for democratic ideals in the current crisis, and they share our interest in the integrity of our colonial empires. It is only natural that we should join their cause.
loc.HOL_de_vaarplicht_desc: After 150 years of neutrality, and decades of increasing pacifism, we must prove to our new allies our resolve to fight. Rather than rely on a volunteer-based merchant navy like other nations, we will sign into law the Vaarplicht, or 'Obligation to Sail'. All Dutch citizens who have not yet been conscripted will henceforth be obligated to perform services for, or at the benefit of, the merchant navy.
loc.HOL_request_allied_favors_desc: We may be a minor power, but we have shown our dedication to winning this war. However, to do so, we need help, and it should be expected that we have earned a few favors through our contributions...
loc.HOL_request_allied_favors_tt: These make it possible to obtain §YOffmap Industry§!, §YManpower§!, §YEquipment§!, and more from your allies.\n
loc.HOL_the_singapore_conferences_desc: The British have invited us, together with the Americans and the Australians, to a series of conferences discussing the increasing Japanese aggression of recent years, which threatens all of our interests in Southeast Asia. Together, we will develop defensive plans which, though not binding, will give us valuable insight into the support we might expect from them in the event of a Japanese attack.
loc.HOL_ship_a_day_sinking_quotas_desc: Even if we cannot outright defend the East Indies from a determined assault, we must not make it easy. Our submarine forces must strike incessantly at the enemy's supply lines, and they must both be equipped to do so, as well as be led by an aggressive and capable commander.
loc.HOL_allied_technological_developments_de: Victory lies with technological superiority. We must lend our share to the vast resources pumped into Allied R&D programs, so that we, too, may profit from them.
loc.HOL_american_west_indies_protectorate_de: We should inquire for American protection of our outlying Western territories. They surely do not wish to see any other power meddling with the Monroe Doctrine.
loc.HOL_american_west_indies_protectorate_tt: §R[USA.GetNameDefCap] must approve of the agreement for the bonuses to take effect.§!\n
loc.HOL_combined_chiefs_of_staff_representat: Our contributions have been noted, and with some political pressure it may be possible to gain representation, if not participation, in the exclusive club of Anglo-American strategic planners that is the Combined Chiefs of Staff.
loc.HOL_the_fourth_ally_desc: Despite our humble beginnings, our contributions are undeniable. It is time to take our place as the fourth ally in the war against the fascists - alongside the UK, the USA, and the Soviet Union.
loc.HOL_zandery_military_airport_desc: Due to the importance of Surinamese bauxite and Curaçao oil to the Allied war effort, the Americans have proposed to aid in their defense by establishing a radar post on Curaçao, and building an airport and infrastructure at Zandery in Suriname. Once finished, it should be the largest military airport in South America.
loc.HOL_lead_the_minor_democracies_desc: As the major powers of our day seem hell-bent on another war, it is left to the small democracies of Europe to keep the world from burning, like a crowd keeping two fighters from each other. We shall lead the others in forming a bloc of neutrality against the warmongerers.
loc.HOL_form_the_benelux_desc: We, the small nations of Western Europe, squashed for centuries between the power-houses of Britain, France, and now Germany, have had enough of the conflicts tearing our continent apart. A United States of Europe might some day prevent catastrophes such as the Great War, but by forming a loose union with our southern neighbors we can provide the core of such an organization already today.
loc.HOL_form_the_benelux_bel_tt: Gets event '§YThe Netherlands invites [BEL.GetName] to the Benelux§!'.\n
loc.HOL_form_the_benelux_lux_tt: Gets event '§YThe Netherlands invites [LUX.GetName] to the Benelux§!'.\n
loc.HOL_responsibility_for_our_own_defense_d: Without any major powers to rely on, we have no choice but to see to our own defenses, and take full responsibility for ensuring that they are adequate to whatever challenge may be thrown against them.
loc.HOL_lessons_from_the_low_countries_desc: As the neutral land between two major powers, the Low Countries have seen their share of warfare. We must draw our lessons from this, and be prepared for even more invasions, as one neighbor attempts to flatten us once again in order to reach the other.
loc.HOL_foundations_for_a_european_union_des: From the humble beginnings of our Benelux we must forge a continent-wide Union of Nations, standing shoulder-to-shoulder in the face of the incessant warmongering of the major powers. A European Union will secure peace and prosperity for all.
loc.HOL_the_continents_best_and_brightest_de: Though each of us has but small resources, if we pool them we can achieve whatever the majors are capable of.
loc.HOL_the_best_defense_desc: We must not be caught unawares as we have been in previous wars. If our neighbors will not listen to reason and settle for peace, then we must make them.
loc.mtg_usa_civil_war_warning_tt: §RThis will move you closer to a Civil War!§!\n
loc.fascists_uprising_tt: Fascist elements in the population will begin preparations for an uprising.
loc.USA_intervention_mandate_tt: §YIntervention Mandates§! allow us to request Congress to authorize military action against another country.
loc.USA_honor_the_confederacy_tt: These decisions allow us to rebuild the people's trust in the government in the event of a civil war by reconnecting with the past.
loc.USA_foreign_support_tt: These decisions allow us to approach major countries to lobby for material support.
loc.MEX_callistas_desc: The supporters of Calles are enriching themselves and abusing their power. Appointed for loyalty rather than ability, they perpetuate a patronage system which corrupts every office and rank in the country. Unless they are reigned in, ordinary Mexicans will continue to deride our ruling government as 'robolucionarios', robber-revolutionaries.
loc.MEX_church_power_5_desc: The hated Constitution of 1917 has been undone. After decades of abuses against the dignity of the True Faith, we are finally establishing the Holy Church as the ultimate authority, moral and legal, in Mexico!
loc.MEX_church_power_4_desc: We have reduced the repression of the True Faith by restoring their ownership of seminaries and churches, but much work remains to be done.
loc.MEX_church_power_3_desc: We have ended attempts to stamp out the Catholic Church in Mexico. By allowing the priests a little autonomy, they will respect our control of the state and refrain from seeking to destabilize us.
loc.MEX_church_power_2_desc: The Constitution of 1917 requires measures aimed against the influence of the Catholic Church in Mexico. The Cristeros rebelled in the 1920s because of attempts to enforce those laws, but the people may now be ready for a secular state.
loc.MEX_church_power_1_desc: The Catholic Church in Mexico will become a thing of the past. The priests are counter-revolutionaries and peddlers of superstitious nonsense. We will press ever harder to turn Mexico into a bastion of rationalism and science!
loc.MEX_cedillo_tension_desc: General Saturnino Cedillo and the caudillos aligned to him have lost much of their power, but they are surely seeking to regain it.
loc.MEX_cedillo_tension_2_desc: General Saturnino Cedillo and the caudillos aligned to him are jealously guarding their influence. We may have to act against them if they stand in the way of the government.
loc.MEX_cedillo_tension_3_desc: General Saturnino Cedillo and the caudillos aligned to him are acting independently of the government. They should be assumed to be in contact with the enemies, internal and external, of [Root.GetLeader] and the Mexican people!
loc.MEX_cedillo_tension_4_desc: General Saturnino Cedillo and the caudillos aligned to him are openly amassing troops in preparation for their rebellion against the legitimate government of [Root.GetLeader]. We must act soon to end this threat to Mexico's unity!
loc.MEX_brown_water_navy_desc: We have a coastal defense force capable of threatening submarine and surface raiders, but a dedicated enemy surface fleet would sweep us aside.
loc.MEX_blue_water_navy_desc: Our goal is now a surface navy able to hold its own against the fleets of the great powers of the world.
loc.MEX_raiding_navy_desc: Trying to defeat the navies of the great powers of the world would be futile. We will instead seek to destroy enemy trade and convoys to safeguard Mexico from invasion.
loc.MEX_heavy_artillery_desc: We are focusing on conventional field artillery for fire support.
loc.MEX_aerial_artillery_desc: We are focusing on light and tactical bombers for fire support.
loc.MEX_politicised_army_desc: The rulers of Mexico have been drawn from revolutionary army officers for almost three decades. The turbulent times we went through demanded firm leadership. The question is: has the turbulence passed, or is it becoming more severe? Should we professionalize the army or allow regional strongmen - caciques and caudillos - to carve out petty fiefdoms? Generals like Saturnino Cedillo in San Luis Potosí are raising private militias to protect their power. The many rebellions launched by dissatisfied officers in the past are likely to continue unless we act.
loc.MEX_politicised_army_2_desc: We have managed to reduce the more eccentric tendencies of the regional strongmen by banning the use of political militias, such as the Red Shirts of General Garrido and the Gold Shirts of General Nicolás Rodríguez.
loc.MEX_revolutionary_army_desc: The Mexican Revolution was fought and won by heroes and patriots whom we need by our side to ensure the independence of our country.
loc.MEX_left_wing_paramilitaries_desc: Groups like the Red Shirts of General Garrido of Tabasco will help us destroy the enemies of the people who seek to subvert the Revolution by exploiting it for personal profit. They will help us root out secret supporters of the Catholic Church, counter-revolutionaries who would see Mexico returned to the Dark Ages.
loc.MEX_right_wing_paramilitaries_desc: Groups like the Gold Shirts of General Nicolás Rodríguez Carrasco will help us ensure the unity of the country against leftist traitors and defeatists.
loc.MEX_ejido_worker_militias_desc: The hard-working farmers of the communal ejido system are banding together to protect their interests in the new Mexico we are building.
loc.MEX_caudillo_private_armies_desc: The governors, businessmen and garrison commanders in a region tend to be the same man - a Revolutionary general who accrues power by appointing loyal underlings to positions of influence. These caudillos are a fact of life which we should cultivate, not fight against.
loc.MEX_strike_breaking_desc: Industrial action is treasonous in a time of crisis. By controlling the labor in our strategic industries, we are able to increase output for the benefit of the Fatherland.
loc.MEX_international_struggle_desc: We will assist those we deem worthy of help in ideological and liberation struggles. It is a heavy responsibility, but the Mexican people are strong enough for the task.
loc.MEX_synarchist_influence_desc: The Mexican Synarchist are trying to spread their propaganda on our territory. They try to hide their oppressive objectives behind so-called "hispanic solidarity".
loc.MEX_oil_concessions_desc: In order to exploit oil in Mexico, foreign companies have signed concession contracts ensuring that they can freely extract oil on defined territories for a prolonged period of time in exchange for payments. However the sum paid by the companies was far below the value of the oil extracted and enabled them to get a profit margin much higher than in countries such as the US, while putting the oil reserves of Mexico indirectly under foreign control.
loc.MEX_hispanic_culture_desc: The nations of Latin America have a strong culture, forged from conquest and survival, rebellion and firm rule. Our shared culture is a source of pride and a guiding light for our future progress.
loc.MEX_proletarian_class_army_desc: Only the Proletariat, armed and organized as a class army, will be able to defend and propagate the ideals of the Revolution.
loc.MEX_idea_vanguard_of_the_4th_internation: Our Revolution has become a wind of freedom pushing the workers of the world to greater feats of bravery. The 4th International will liberate mankind from the chains of fascist, bourgeois and Bonapartist reaction.
loc.MEX_luis_montes_de_oca_desc: Luis Montes de Oca is a prominent Mexican banker and advocate of the Austrian School of Economics.
loc.MEX_alberto_pani_desc: Alberto J. Pani is the architect of the Mexican finance industry and one of the heads of the National Bank and Agricultural Credit Bank.
loc.MEX_abelardo_rodriguez_desc: Abelardo L. Rodríguez joined the Revolution in 1913, being promoted up from the ranks thanks to his intelligence and diligence. His loyalty to the Revolution was rewarded in 1932 when he was made President of Mexico for the last two years of Álvaro Obregón's term after his assassination.
loc.MEX_jose_gonzalo_escobar_desc: General Escobar fought against the rebels of Pancho Villa during the turmoil and infighting of the Revolution, leading cavalry charges against the government's enemies. He ran afoul of President Calles and was exiled following his own rebellion attempt in 1929, but with the re-organization of the cabinet, he can return.
loc.MEX_pablo_gonzalez_desc: Pablo González is an army general with a talent for organizing 'wet work'. He helped set up the ambush which killed the popular rebel and caudillo Emiliano Zapata in 1919.
loc.MEX_plutarco_calles_desc: President between 1924 and 1928, Calles continues to exercise a great deal of power over the Mexican state thanks to his powerful network of patronage. He has been labeled the 'Jefe Máximo' (Great Leader) by his political enemies as a way of comparing him to dictator-for-life President Díaz. The term has entered mainstream use, although he insists he is simply a retired statesman giving advice for the benefit of the country.
loc.MEX_vicente_lombardo_desc: A radical trades unionist who has fought for the rights of workers after the Revolution, bringing labour into alliance with the ruling party of Cárdenas.
loc.MEX_jose_vasconcelos_desc: A cultural writer, former cabinet minister and presidential candidate, Vasconcelos blends concepts of Native religion, Catholicism and civic nationalism to form a syncretic Mexican ideology. He supports the reconquest of the Mexican Cession from America.
loc.MEX_bartolome_garcia_correa_desc: A Native Mayan from the Yucatan who has served as governor and senator, implementing populist policies that reconcile Native customs with the state's power.
loc.MEX_aaron_saenz_desc: A right-wing businessman and governor, Aarón Sáenz has been nicknamed 'the Shadow of Calles' for his ability to keep the cabinets of the puppet presidents in line with the goals of el Jefe Máximo.
loc.MEX_manuel_perez_trevino_desc: Manuel Pérez Treviño is a Revolutionary general with expertise in engineering and artillery. He is politically influential, being a founder of the Partido Nacional Revolucionario.
loc.MEX_saturnino_cedillo_desc: A wealthy Northern governor and military leader, General Cedillo exercises power thanks to a patronage system based upon personal loyalty. The waning influence of the caudillos and the centralization of the country is a cause of great concern for him as it threatens his independence from the government.
loc.MEX_othon_blanco: Othón P. Blanco Núñez de Cáceres
loc.MEX_othon_blanco_desc: Othón Blanco is a senior member of the Secretariat of the Navy, having served as a naval officer since before the Revolution. His area of expertise is ensuring the navy has good access to logistical support, going as far as building new settlements.
loc.MEX_heriberto_corona_desc: Heriberto Corona is a Revolutionary general who has been appointed to the Navy to ensure its loyalty.
loc.MEX_manuel_avila_desc: A Revolutionary general who has been appointed to the Secretariat of National Defense to prepare Mexico for the troubles ahead.
loc.MEX_leon_trotsky_desc: Responsible for creating the Red Army almost from scratch during the Russian Civil War, this International Communist League leader will help organize the army.
loc.MEX_tga_desc: An offshoot of the Mexican aeronautics workshop, TNCA, dedicated to armored fighting vehicles.
loc.MEX_astimar_gulf_desc: Astilleros de la Secretaría de Marina del Golfo
loc.MEX_astimar_pacific_desc: Astilleros de la Secretaría de Marina del Pacifico
loc.MEX_tnca_desc: The National Workshop for Aeronautical Construction was founded before the Revolution and was an innovative designer before the disruptions of the civil wars.
loc.MEX_royal_dutch_shell_desc: A British and Dutch firm holding 60% of Mexican oil concessions.
loc.mexican_ford_desc: A local franchise of the Ford Motor Company.
loc.MEX_pemex_desc: Petróleos Mexicanos was formed from the nationalization of local assets formerly belonging to Royal Dutch Shell, Standard Oil of California, and other foreign firms.
loc.MEX_banco_de_mexico_desc: Formed in 1925 to rebuild an economy shattered by civil war, our National Bank is our lender of last resort, issuer of currency, and investor in all manner of ventures for the interest of the state.
loc.MEX_escuela_de_ingeneria_electrica_desc: Escuela Superior de Ingenería Mecánica y Eléctrica, the University of Mechanical and Electronic Engineering, is one of our finest educational institutions, at the cutting edge of research into electromagnetic waves and television.
loc.MEX_capital_reserves_desc: The wealth pouring in from our expanding oil industry will allow us to make purchases of high quality foreign military equipment.
loc.MEX_knights_of_columbus_desc: An international fraternity of Catholics, the Knights of Columbus will help us achieve peace and reconciliation after decades of civil strife. As it says in the Book of Matthew: 'You have heard that it was said, 'an eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth'. But I say to you, do not resist the one who is evil. If anyone slaps you on the right cheek, turn to him the other also.'
loc.MEX_social_catholicism_desc: The industrial revolution has put workers into inhumane situations. In order to counter socialist demands, a particular emphasis was put on the necessity of the management to show compassion for their employees. This gave birth to a variant of Christian non-revolutionary socialism: social Catholicism.
loc.MEX_legion_of_christ_desc: The atheist terrorists have been defeated! Their brutal oppression must be punished in kind. As it says in the Book of Exodus: take eye for eye, life for life. In order to be the vengeful arm of the Almighty, the Legion of Christ will ensure that satanic faithlessness will disappear from our land.
loc.MEX_triumph_of_synarchism_desc: Utterly beaten, our enemies are hiding in the shadows like the henchmen of Satan. We now have free reign to ensure the reconstruction of the state in a way that will ensure its unity both in faith and in political will.
loc.MEX_womens_suffrage_desc: In recent years, many of Mexico's elites have been concerned that women would subvert the ideals of the Revolution by siding with the Catholic Church against the secular Constitution of 1917, but equality under the law is vastly more important and it will allow our society to flourish.
loc.MEX_professional_army_desc: Thanks to our Military School, our generals have learned how to develop efficient supply systems to keep our troops fighting with maximum efficiency.
loc.MEX_international_peacekeepers_desc: The democratic powers of the world plan to create an alliance of equals, a United Nations, to ensure international security by giving the countries of the world a place to reconcile their differences and arbitrate disputes. We will throw ourselves into such a project to help the Latin American nations maintain their independence.
loc.mexico_hispanic_diplomacy_desc: If we want to realize our continental ambitions, we must convince numerous governments of Latin America.
loc.mexico_german_submarine_happy_time_desc: Our submarine captains are enjoying their Happy Time ('Glückliche Zeit') sinking undefended neutral shipping off the coasts of the Americas.
loc.synarchist_youth_desc: The youth are the future of our nation. If they are educated properly, they will become the embodiment of our ideals - strength, loyalty and piety.
loc.ENG_trade_union_factory_worker_support: Support of Trade Union Factory Workers
loc.ENG_trade_union_dockyard_worker_support: Support of Trade Union Dockyard Workers
loc.ENG_trade_union_construction_worker_supp: Support of Trade Union Construction Workers
loc.HOL_wilhelmina_desc: For centuries the family of Orange-Nassau has been interwoven with the very history of the Netherlands itself. Like her forefather William the Silent in the Eighty Years' War, the current Queen, Wilhelmina, will undoubtedly prove an inspiration for Dutchmen rallying to the defense of their homeland, should their country ever be invaded.
loc.HOL_aloof_neutrality_desc: A policy of strict Neutrality has kept the Dutch out of wars with any of its neighbours for nearly 150 years, and, above all, has kept them out of the Great War. The public's belief in their "talisman of protection" is therefore almost fervent, and the weak Dutch government finds itself unable to go against the will of the people and take a strong stand in international politics. Instead, it has resolved to put its faith in the League of Nations, and otherwise adopts an aloof attitude to world events.
loc.HOL_shell_shocked_spectator: Shell-shocked Spectator of the Great War
loc.HOL_shell_shocked_spectator_desc: As the neutral Netherlands was the closest safe haven for refugees from the Western Front, the Dutch have been but all too close a spectator to the horrors of the Great War. As a result, a strong pacifist movement has grown to permeate large parts of the public, and presents the government with great difficulties in implementing any increase of military expenditure. Only the navy still enjoys a certain measure of prestige in the public eye.\n\nA defensive war or a "war on pacifism" would be needed to truly rid the country of this sentiment.
loc.HOL_de_crisisjaren_desc: Due to the peculiarities of global economics, the Great Depression has hit in the Netherlands much later than elsewhere. The Dutch decision to maintain the Gold Standard, while other nations abandoned it rather quickly, has further exacerbated the "crisis years" in the Netherlands tremendously. In keeping the Guilder from devaluating, no funds are left to aid the ailing Dutch economy, let alone improve the poor state of national defenses.\n\nThe crisis can be reduced by investing in public works, and will become largely irrelevant if we capitulate and lose control of the crisis-stricken mainland.
loc.HOL_weak_government_desc: The Dutch government in recent years has been marred by weakness. It would not take much to topple it yet again.
loc.HOL_de_vaarplicht_idea_desc: "Pursuant to Royal Decree A5 all Dutch citizens and Dutch subjects, who have not been conscripted, or, if they have been, have not yet been called to active service, are obligated to perform services for, or at the benefit of, the merchant navy."
loc.HOL_caved_to_the_germans_idea_desc: Rather than face the threat of invasion, the Dutch have elected to concede to German demands in their trade negotiations. Democratic freedom has begun to suffer as a result, and this could be seen as the first tentative step away from neutrality.
loc.HOL_caved_to_the_british_idea_desc: Rather than face the threat of total blockade, which would certainly have spelled economic disaster, the Dutch have elected to concede to the British demands in their trade negotiations. Anti-German and pro-British sentiments are increasingly becoming noticeable in the country's internal politics, and this could be seen as the first tentative step away from neutrality.
loc.idea_weapons_for_the_resistance_desc: Our allies are sending munitions to the brave freedom fighters battling the hated enemy in our homeland.
loc.political_turmoil_desc: This country's government was recently installed by force after the previous leadership fell out of favour with their foreign dominators.
loc.HOL_german_defectors_1_desc: A steady trickle of German defectors regularly forms into units keen on fighting on our behalf, to reinstate their Kaiser.
loc.HOL_german_defectors_2_desc: Misguided loyalty to the old Kaiser has driven a steady trickle of soldiers to defect and fight for the Dutch, in a vain attempt to put the Kaiser back on the throne.\n\nOnly the complete defeat of the Dutch, and the alliance they are a part of, is likely to stamp this movement out, entirely.
loc.ENG_joint_air_training_scheme_desc: The British government has implemented a Commonwealth-wide training program for its members' aircrews. We will be able to benefit heavily from this.

loc.CZE_bop_army_readiness_of_power_category: The Czech Army is united and ready to face the challenges ahead. However, domestic politics and international events could undermine the confidence the Army has in defending the country properly.
The Czech Army is united and ready to face the challenges ahead. However, domestic politics and international events could undermine the confidence the Army has in defending the country properly.
loc.CZE_bop_has_started_tt: §Y$CZE_bop_army_readiness$§! Balance of Power has started in §Y[ROOT.GetName]§!.
loc.CZE_sudeten_promise_mission_desc: By backing Paramilitaries in Sudetenland, we've promised to support them in breaking away from [CZE.GETNAME] and to join us. Going back on this promise would lead to political backlash.
loc.CZE_a_divided_nation_category_desc: There is a rising resentment against the government from the various movements within the country that can no longer be ignored or dismissed. Fixing these issues will dampen the forces trying to pull the country apart. At least for the near future.
loc.CZE_a_divided_nation_category_2_tt: §YEffects when selected§!:\nUnlocks §Y$CZE_a_divided_nation_category$§! Decisions, which will §YRemove§! negative State Modifiers in our §YStates§! and will also lower the negative modifiers on the §Y$CZE_a_divided_nation_dynamic_modifier$ National Spirit§! until it is §YRemoved§!.
loc.CZE_a_divided_nation_category_3_tt: Unlocks §Y$CZE_a_divided_nation_category$§! Decisions, which will §YRemove§! negative State Modifiers in our §YStates§! and will also lower the negative modifiers on the §Y$CZE_a_divided_nation_dynamic_modifier$ National Spirit§! until it is §YRemoved§!.
loc.CZE_a_divided_nation_fake_category_desc: There is a rising resentment against the government from the various movements within the country that can no longer be ignored or dismissed. Fixing these issues will dampen the forces trying to pull the country apart. At least for the near future.
loc.CZE_a_divided_nation_on_map: These States Have Issues That Need To Be Addressed
loc.CZE_a_divided_nation_decision_in_progres: Already working on a issue in another state
loc.CZE_a_divided_nation_sudentenland_german: Bailing out local industry in [FROM.Getname] will quickly win back the political support of the local populace.
loc.CZE_a_divided_nation_czech_states_desc: The lack of skilled personnel is a bottleneck to the rapid growth of industry in the center of our country. We must invest in programs to better educate our population to work in our growing industry.
loc.CZE_a_divided_nation_slovakia_states_des: Previous investment efforts have fallen short of bridging the inequality in the industry within [FROM.GETNAME]. More investments are required to improve the situation.
loc.CZE_a_divided_nation_ukrainian_states_de: Previous investment efforts have fallen short of bridging the inequality in the industry within [FROM.GETNAME]. More investments are required to improve the situation.
loc.CZE_crisis_in_the_sudentenland_desc: Sudetenland Paramilitaries have risen up in Sudetenland and have started to wage partisans warfare against us. Ongoing clashes with our forces have caused the situation to descend into chaos. We need to bring the situation under control, and we need to do so before any enemy can take advantage of the situation.
loc.CZE_soviet_airlift_tt: All troops in §Y[199.GetName]§! will be transported to the [CZE.GetAdjective] airport in §Y[73.GetName]§!
loc.CZE_request_ally_give_ussr_mil_access: Request [FROM.GetName] to Give Military Access to [SOV.GetNameDef]
loc.CZE_request_ally_give_ussr_mil_access_tt: Unlocks Decision: §YRequest [ROM.GetName] to Give Military Access to [SOV.GetNameDef]§!
Unlocks Decision: §YRequest [POL.GetName] to Give Military Access to [SOV.GetNameDef]§!
loc.CZE_skoda_select_little_entente_group: Sell Weapons to Little Entente Partners
loc.CZE_select_continent_middle_east: Sell Weapons in Africa and the Middle East
loc.CZE_select_continent_asia: Sell Weapons in Asia and Oceania
loc.CZE_autonomous_sentiment_desc: Allying with the Autonomous Bloc has come with some drawbacks. One of which is that their demands be met on [SLO.getname] gaining some autonomy. Other parts of our country may want similar treatment as well.
loc.CZE_the_rut_demands_desc: With the Autonomous Bloc having their demands met, $RUT_augustin_voloshyn$'s faction for Ukraine Independence want the same deal.
loc.CZE_escalate_involvement_in_soviet_civil: Escalate Involvement in the Soviet Civil War
loc.CZE_central_european_federation_desc: We have more in common with our neighbors than what keeps us apart. Forming a democratic federation may be the only thing that keeps pluralism in Central Europe alive and well in the face of the many threats to it.
loc.CZE_form_the_european_federation_AUS_tt: Gain cores on Western Austrian States
loc.CZE_form_the_european_federation_POL_tt: Gain Cores on Southern Poland States
loc.CZE_form_the_european_federation_GER_tt: Gain Cores on Some Neighboring German States
loc.CZE_form_the_european_federation_YUG_tt: Gain Cores on Some Yugoslavia States
loc.CZE_the_second_fortification_program_cat: Our countries' less than advantageous border is a pressing national security concern. The countries that surround us have made it clear that they have designs to redraw our borders in their favor. Continuing to fortify our borders will make any possible enemy think twice before attacking us.
loc.CZE_fate_of_the_ro_desc: The Fortification Council is in charge of gathering finances related to our fortification projects. If those funds are not used for anything soon, people will start to question why the funds were gathered in the first place.
loc.CZE_bop_army_bunker_maintenance_desc: Having our fortifications be properly maintain and ready for use will ensure that the army is confident in them if they ever need to be manned.
loc.CZE_fortification_research_desc: The need to fortify our border is clear, but the question is how? Research will help us answer this question.
loc.CZE_fortification_research_subtract_vari: All future §YFortification Programs§! Decisions will take §Y30§! less day(s) to §YComplete§!
loc.CZE_fortification_decision_inprogress: Already working on another fortification program
loc.CZE_second_sudetenland_fortification_pro: The Sudetenland, our mountainous border with Germany, is the perfect place for border fortifications. Having studied the French Maginot line, we can build a similar line of our own.
loc.CZE_third_sudetenland_fortification_prog: The Sudetenland now boasts a decent defensive line, but decent is not good enough when our national survival is at stake.
loc.CZE_fourth_sudetenland_fortification_pro: The Sudetenland has a strong system of fortifications, but they must be stronger still.
loc.CZE_fortify_the_crossroads_with_slo_desc: Any system of fortifications may be broken. To guard against this eventuality we can construct strong points around our most important cities so that they cannot easily be seized by an enemy who breaks through our lines.
loc.CZE_fortify_the_hungarian_border_with_73: Hungarian irredentism is a constant threat to our nation, a system of fortifications along our mutual border will help to ensure our safety.
loc.CZE_fortify_the_polish_border_with_72_de: Polish aggression knows no bounds, but hopefully a well-fortified border will cause them to look for an easier target.
loc.CZE_embezzle_quatermaster_funds_desc: Our soldiers are already well taken care of. Surely no one would notice or care if some of the funds meant for our barracks went elsewhere.
loc.CZE_prioritize_export_contracts_desc: Our Export Industry is what helped us climb out of the Great Depression. Why should we change our behavior now? Any threat to our nation is overblown anyhow. The Armada can afford to wait.
loc.CZE_focus_on_export_designs_desc: The Armada is very demanding on what they want out of our designs. The export market is more forgiving and they also help fund domestic designs for the Armada. So in reality, the Armada should be really thanking us for how much money we save them in Research and Development. You're welcome Armada.
loc.CZE_send_observers_to_the_italo_ethiopia: Sent Observers to the Italo-Ethiopian War

Sneaking in individuals to observe and make secondary contacts with people involved with the fighting on the ground would provide valuable insight into contemporary army doctrine. It may also open up some other opportunities.
§Y$CZE_zbrojovka_brno_organization$§! will inquire about smuggling guns into §Y[ETH.getname]§!.
loc.CZE_warehouse_inspections_desc: You won't know anything is missing until you go and check.
loc.CZE_construction_telephone_stations_desc: Building Telephone stations between our Headquarters will greatly increase our high command's coordination.
loc.CZE_live_fire_exercise_desc: There's no replacement for a day out on the range.
loc.CZE_redirect_military_discretionary_spen: The funds are discretionary, and it's in our discretion to not spend it on the Military.
loc.CZE_field_exercises_desc: Nothing is more valuable than training on the front.
loc.CZE_build_skoda_office_africa: Build a Škoda Office in Africa
loc.CZE_build_skoda_office_australia: Build a Škoda Office in Oceania
loc.CZE_build_skoda_office_north_america: Build a Škoda Office in North America
loc.CZE_build_skoda_office_south_america: Build a Škoda Office in South America
loc.CZE_build_skoda_office_middle_east: Build a Škoda Office in the Middle East
loc.CZE_ai_nations_more_likely_to_buy_weapon: §YNations in this region will be more likely to purchase our weapons from the International Market.§!
loc.CZE_get_weapon_sales_idea_tt: This production capacity will transferred to [ROOT.GetNameDef] after a slight delay, if sufficient weapon sales are on-going, the production capacity will instead be saved up and distributed over a longer period of time.
loc.CZE_skoda_focus_category_tt: The Škoda company contains production in almost all sectors of the armaments industry, this allows for great flexibility in shifting around resources.\n\n$CZE_skoda_optimization_tier_tt$
loc.CZE_skoda_ui_naval_focus_unavailable_tt: §YNaval Focus§!\n\n£GFX_trigger_no Has completed focus §YRestart Naval Gun Production§!

loc.SLO_HUN_test_SLO_in_71_decision_desc: Attacking [SLO.getname]'s positions in [71.Getname] under the guise of seeking additional border adjustments is a perfect opportunity to test our military's effectiveness in combat.
loc.MUN_czech_skoda_priority.d: The Škoda Works company produces a wide range of products, from artillery to tanks, trains and naval guns. This results in a lot of versatility by shifting resources to where demand is the highest, which we can now partly direct.
loc.MUN_czech.2.t.2: Sudetenland Free Corps ask for help
loc.MUN_czech.2.t.3: Sudeten Worker Militias ask for help
loc.MUN_czech.2.d.1: In light of the recent news of our designs on [CZE.getname], many Sudetenland political parties have quickly formed paramilitaries all over the region in hopes of undermining the [CZE.GetAdjective] government. They are now asking for our support in executing cross-border raids and committing acts of sabotage to help our own efforts against [CZE.getname].
loc.MUN_czech.2.d.2: In light of the recent news of our designs on [CZE.getname], the Sudetenland political parties have quickly mobilized their paramilitary: the Sudeten Free Corps. Free Corp units throughout Sudetenland have formed units and have started attacking [CZE.GetAdjective] government property in the Sudetenland. They are now asking for our full support in helping them execute cross-border raids and commit acts of sabotage against [CZE.getname].
loc.MUN_czech.2.d.3: In light of the recent news of our designs on [CZE.getname], the local communist parties quickly mobilized worker militias. These worker militias have started attacking [CZE.GetAdjective] government property in the region. They are now asking for our full support in helping them execute cross-border raids and commit acts of sabotage against [CZE.getname] and other counterrevolutionaries.
loc.MUN_czech.2.b: Might be better to not enable them further
loc.MUN_czech.3.d: In the wake of recent [FROM.getname] interest in annexing the Sudetenland, paramilitaries have started engaging in skirmishes against us. They have started to attack government buildings and are undermining our defenses in a few areas. If we hope to improve our military situation in the area, we need to deal with these paramilitary groups.
loc.MUN_czech.3.a: How can this get any worse?
loc.MUN_czech.4.d: The recent news of military aggression against us has shaken the government to its core. [CZE.GetLeader] has lost faith in his government's ability to lead the country through this crisis. He has demanded that $CZE_jan_syrovy$ take command of the situation and lead the country. $CZE_jan_syrovy$ has said that he is reluctant to lead, however in light of this [CZE.GetLeader] has told him that he has no choice but to take command and lead us through this crisis.
loc.MUN_czech.4.a: We need you more than ever.
loc.MUN_czech.5.d: Masaryk was a stabilizing figure in Czechoslovak politics for well over two decades. When coalitions were thought impossible to build and political impasses too big to overcome, Masaryk, time after time, was able to pull off political miracles to help strengthen and grow Czechoslovakia to what it is today. His presence will be greatly missed and will be felt throughout the nation.
loc.MUN_czech.7.d: News has recently reached us that [GER.getnamedef] wishes to annex the Sudetenland, and would be willing to go to war with [CZE.getnamedef] to achieve this goal. We currently have a defensive agreement with [CZE.getnamedef], meaning that if they go to war with [GER.getnamedef], we'd be obligated to come to their aid. If we want to avoid this outcome, we need to get out of our defensive agreements with [CZE.getnamedef] immediately.
loc.MUN_czech.7.b: We wouldn't stand a chance against [GER.getnamedef]
loc.MUN_czech.1001.d: Hoping to coordinate military actions with [SOV.GetNameDef], [FROM.GetNameDef] has demanded that we cede the border regions of [89.GetName] and [91.GetName] to them.
loc.MUN_czech.1002.t: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] Demands Influence Over the Yugoslav League
loc.MUN_czech.1002.d: After expanding southwards, [FROM.GetName] has come with an unusual demand. They demand not the seizure of land, but control over the Yugoslav Defense League, becoming protector and overlord of north-Balkan countries that our currently our subjects. They say they would be a more capable protector than us, but that could of course just be an excuse.
loc.MUN_czech.1002.b: No, they are under our protection!
loc.MUN_czech.1003.d: Despite the convincing arguments of our diplomats, [FROM.GetNameDef] has refused to give in to our demands.
loc.MUN_czech.1003.a: They leave us with no other option
loc.MUN_czech.1004.d: News has reached [ROOT.capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName] of [FROM.GetAdjective] troops advancing towards the [HUN.GetAdjective] border. Although [HUN.GetAdjective] representatives will undoubtedly contact us soon, we should already figure out whether to assist [HUN.GetNameDef] and gain a potential ally, or whether we should let [FROM.GetNameDef] continue its current plans.
loc.MUN_czech.1005.d: With [FROM.GetNameDef] steadily growing its realm, representatives from them have now come to demand that we cede land that [FROM.GetAdjective] nobles once owned to them. They say this would give them potential access to the Adriatic, apparently not so interested in our thoughts on the matter.
loc.MUN_czech.1006.d: [FROM.GetNameDef] has approached us with a mutual defense treaty, seeking to dissuade any attackers with the combined might of our armies. Interestingly however, there is also a secret part of the treaty, where potential expansion of [ROOT.GetAdjective] influence is laid out, and how [FROM.GetNameDef] could assist.
loc.MUN_czech.1007.d: Mistrust between us and [FROM.GetNameDef] ever since their establishment has lead to them now demanding our alignment or risk an invasion. Interestingly however, [FROM.GetNameDef] is also appealing to our territorial ambitions, and promising that in return for no longer pursuing our claims on their lands, they may help us obtain the other lands we claim.
loc.MUN_czech.1008.d: Representatives from [FROM.GetNameDef], our bridge to central Europe, has proposed expanding our alliance by inviting [CZE_invited_country.GetName].
loc.MUN_czech.1008.b: We cannot be expected to defend all of Europe
loc.MUN_czech.1009.d: Diplomats from [FROM.GetNameDef] have communicated that we would be welcome in their alliance. In the past however, our territorial claims were a point of contention in relations with [FROM.GetNameDef]. We must now decide whether to still press those claims, or focus on establishing more friendly relations.
loc.MUN_czech.1009.b: We will join after our claims are recognized
loc.MUN_czech.1010.d: After recently trying to turn the Little Entente agreements into a real alliance, [FROM.GetNameDef] has come with a proposal: they want us to lead this new faction. They would concede leadership and in return would gain us as a valuable protector, a deal that would expand our sphere, but potentially with nations that are under threat.
loc.MUN_czech.1011.d: As part of an effort to discourage any aggression towards [FROM.GetNameDef], their diplomats have approached us with the draft of a mutual defense treaty. In return for our backing, they would offer the same protection to us, forcing any aggressor into a two-front war.
loc.MUN_czech.1012.d: Emboldened by their newly established alliance, [FROM.GetNameDef] have arrived with a series of demands that would equate to the loss of our sovereignty. With the backing of [SOV.GetName] given its interest in the region, we must now decide if we can afford refusing.
loc.MUN_czech.1013.d: After careful deliberation, the government of [FROM.GetNameDef] announced that it shares the view that an alliance would be advantageous, however, they also announced that they could not overlook their territorial claims. Therefore they have come with a proposal: they will join our faction, but only if we cede them the territory they claim.
loc.MUN_czech.1013.b: We are trying to protect our territory!
loc.MUN_czech.1014.d: Influential diplomats from [FROM.GetNameDef] have approached the foreign minister, requesting that we solidify the vague protection promises outlined in the 1935 Czechoslovak-Soviet treaty.
loc.MUN_czech.1014.a: Perhaps we should try to protect our ally
loc.MUN_czech.1014.b: Let's keep it at vague promises
loc.MUN_czech.1015.d: With us now having the same enemies, [FROM.GetName] has come to us with a proposal that would deepen our cooperation by integration our faction into theirs.
loc.MUN_czech.1015.a: A coordinated effort would save lives
loc.MUN_czech.1016.d: Continuing on the basis of previous talks that were cancelled after a change in foreign policy plans, [FROM.GetNameDef] has proposed to continue talks on a non-aggression pact.
loc.MUN_czech.1016.b: This will get in the way of our ambitions
loc.MUN_czech.1017.d: [FROM.GetNameDef] has approached the top of the [ROOT.GetAdjective] with secret plans to invade [GER.GetNameDef]. After showing how committed they are to eliminating the [GER.GetAdjective] threat, they requested that we would assist, to together overwhelm the mighty [GER.GetAdjective] army.
loc.MUN_czech.1018.d: Despite our best diplomatic efforts, we were not able to gather any foreign support for the preemptive invasion of [GER.GetName] the question now is whether to go through with our attack plans at all.
loc.MUN_czech.1018.d.FRA_POL: Great news has arrived from both [FRA.GetNameDef] and [POL.GetNameDef], our diplomats reporting that both nations have committed to assist us in an invasion of [GER.GetNameDef].
loc.MUN_czech.1018.d.FRA: Our diplomats have returned from [FRA.GetNameDef] with the great news that they would be willing to take part in a joint invasion of [GER.GetNameDef], we must now evaluate if our combined forces would be sufficient.
loc.MUN_czech.1018.d.POL: Our diplomats have returned from [POL.GetNameDef] with the great news that they would be willing to take part in a joint invasion of [GER.GetNameDef], we must now evaluate if our combined forces would be sufficient.
loc.MUN_czech.1018.a: They will never see it coming
loc.MUN_czech.1019.d: Citing a desire to restore previous Bohemian borders, and to legitimize their control over [72.GetName], [FROM.GetAdjective] representatives have delivered an ultimatum that demands we cede [762.GetName].
loc.MUN_czech.1019.a: Perhaps it will keep us safe
loc.MUN_czech.1020.d: Diplomats have arrived from [FROM.GetNameDef], outlining an agreement where their nation would invest in our industry and infrastructure, in return for a resource agreement. This move, coming after failed investments in previous years, suggests a renewed effort in improving our relations.
loc.CZE_investment_effects_tt:
In §Y100 days§! we will gain:
§YInfrastructure§! in §Y3§! random states.
§YCivilian Factory§! in §Y1§! random state.
loc.MUN_czech.1021.t: Return of the Austro-Hungarian Customs Union?
loc.MUN_czech.1021.d: [CZE.GetNameDefCap] has approached us with a draft trade agreement between the former Austro-Hungarian nations. Although happy with their independence, the new [CZE.GetAdjective] government seems especially willing to restore the beneficial elements of the Austria-Hungarian nation.
loc.MUN_czech.1021.b: We must protect our domestic producers
loc.MUN_czech.1022.d: After fierce fighting around the mountains of [69.GetName], [CZE.GetAdjective] troops ended up breaking through, and establishing control over all of Silesia, before the troops they had clashed with were recovered enough to offer serious resistance.
loc.MUN_czech.1022.b: We cannot create yet another enemy
loc.MUN_czech.1023.d: Citing some antiquated reasoning regarding medieval kingdoms and empires, [FROM.GetNameDef] has escalated border skirmishes into a limited war in an effort to establish control over [ROOT.GetAdjective] Silesia.
loc.MUN_czech.1024.d: After border skirmishes in Silesia turned into a full-scale war, [FROM.GetNameDef] has now indicated its willingness to end the conflict if the land they claimed is ceded.
loc.MUN_czech.1024.a: Perhaps we should focus on other areas
loc.MUN_czech.1024.b: The situation is still in our favor
loc.MUN_czech.1024.c: This is not up for negotiation!
loc.MUN_czech.1025.d.1: The [ROOT.GetAdjective] troops sent to [CZE_supported_spanish_faction.GetName] are returning home after helping them achieve victory. The fighting has led to new insights for our troops, and especially their medical detachments.
loc.MUN_czech.1025.d.2: Despite the valiant fighting of [ROOT.GetAdjective] forces in the Spanish Civil War, the side we supported was ultimately defeated. Despite this, our troops and especially their medical teams learnt valuable lessons.
loc.MUN_czech.1025.a: Let's hope we won't have to put these lessons to use at home
loc.MUN_czech.1026.france_refuses_to_lead: Despite the leadership role [FROM.GetAdjective] was offered in return for joining our alliance, they have decided not to do so. It seems the [FROM.GetAdjective] is trying to stay neutral, or is biding time.
loc.MUN_czech.1026.sphere_of_influence: Although [FROM.GetAdjective] government members assured us that our participation in the [ROOT.GetFactionName] is appreciated, they said expanding our influence into the Balkans would go to far and may scare off potential allies.
loc.MUN_czech.1026.guarantee: Our diplomats report that despite their efforts, [FROM.GetNameDef] did not agree with our proposal of a mutual defense agreement. It seems they estimate that we are at more risk than them, let's hope they are wrong.
loc.MUN_czech.1026.faction_merge: Despite our best efforts, our and [FROM.GetAdjective] diplomats could not come to agree on a deal to unify [ROOT.GetFactionName] and [FROM.GetFactionName].
loc.MUN_czech.1026.non_aggression: Despite assurances of their peaceful intentions, [FROM.GetAdjective] diplomats refused to sign a non-aggression pact with our nation, why remains to be seen.
loc.MUN_czech.1026.trade_deal: Citing a desire to remain economically independent, [FROM.GetNameDef] has refused our trade agreement proposal.
loc.MUN_czech.1026.faction_invite: Although our diplomats communicated the arguments why [FROM.GetNameDef] would benefit from an alliance with us, they were ultimately unsuccessful in aligning them.
loc.MUN_czech.1026.weapons_sale: Despite our generous offer, [FROM.GetNameDef] has decided not to buy weapons from us at this moment.
loc.MUN_czech.1026.unification: Despite acknowledging the benefits a federation would bring, [FROM.GetNameDef] has chosen to keep its government in exile as the sole legitimate government for its lands.
loc.MUN_czech.1026.white_peace: Our representatives returned with the sad news today that despite our occupation of [66.GetName], the [FROM.GetAdjective] leadership is not willing to sign a peace treaty. It seems we will have to either go further in our conquest, or hope to tire them out.
