loc.MUN_czech.1027.d: Despite initial ideological differences, [FROM.GetNameDef] has appealed to our pragmatism in approaching us for a trade deal. In return for [FROM.GetAdjective] being allowed to extract resources in [202.GetName], they help provide the machine tools that we so desperately need to expand our industrial capacity.
loc.MUN_czech.1027.b: We should deny them those resources.
loc.MUN_czech.1028.d: Many within the country are now questioning why the government has not continued the fortification projects it had started late last year. The government had earmarked funds for additional fort-building projects through the Fortification Council. With no progress on the program forthcoming, people are demanding that the project either be continued or its funds returned. If we do wish to continue our fortification programs, there is no time to lose in getting the projects restarted so they can be finished on time.
loc.MUN_czech.1028.a: We have no time to lose!
loc.CZE_no_time_to_lose_tt: Our window of time to complete our Fortification Projects before a threat emerges is now very narrow.
loc.MUN_czech.1029.d: Our most recent fortification project has been completed and resources are available to start another project. Our engineers are ready to deploy to another location at a moment's notice to start the groundwork on a new fortification line.
loc.MUN_czech.1030.d: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has demanded that we become part of their union as they seek to expand it. Although they appeal to various countries in the region with various different reasons, Pan-Slavism, Pan-Balkanism and shared history in the Austro-Hungarian empire for others, the appeal also comes with a clear implied threat if we refuse.
loc.MUN_czech.1030.a: Perhaps that wouldn't be so bad
loc.MUN_czech.1031.d: Although [ROOT.GetNameDef] capitulated, the [FROM.GetAdjective] government has come with a drastic proposal that would allow us to fight on: merging what remains of our nation with theirs.
loc.MUN_czech.1031.a: Together we can better protect our homelands
loc.MUN_czech.1032.d: Recent efforts to solve issues in [FROM.getname] have been successful in alleviating anger towards the central government, at least for the time being. Our government's resources are now freed up to commit to other social or economic programs that will continue to fight issues that are dividing our country.
loc.MUN_czech.1033.d: The [FROM.GetAdjective] Government-In-Exile under $CZE_edvard_benesh$ is requesting that we host their delegation as it struggles to regain the sovereignty of [CZE.GetNonIdeologyName].
loc.MUN_czech.1034.d: Due to us giving in to nationalist sentiments by other groups, members of the Slovak People's Party have formed their own paramilitary force that now seeks its own independence or at least autonomy for Slovakia. The question now stands whether to focus on maintaining a semblance of unity through preventing this, or to achieve it by allowing it and focusing on the lands that are loyal to the government.
loc.MUN_czech.1034.b: Arrest them but grant some autonomy
loc.MUN_czech.1034.c_tt: §RWe will be at the mercy of [GER.GetNameDef]'s decision regarding the fate of Czechoslovakia.§!
loc.MUN_czech.1035.t: [FROM.GetName] Offers to Manufacture Weapons for Us
loc.MUN_czech.1035.d: Our integral partnership with [CZE.GetNameDef] has lead them to offer a unique deal: they will manufacture weapons for us that we currently construct domestically, for a price, of course. This in turn would allow us to focus on the other sectors of our industry.
loc.MUN_czech.1035.b: We can't make our army dependent on foreign equipment
loc.MUN_czech.1036.d: The Great depression has done our nation no favors economically or politically. Many regional economic and political issues plague us, and they seem to be getting worse even in the face of our miraculous recovery from the Great Depression. We need to tackle these issues before they divide our nation further.
loc.MUN_czech.1036.a: We need to heal our nation
loc.CZE_divided_nation_event_onbroad_tt: Unlocked §YDecisions§! that allow us to §YRemove§! the negative §YState Modifiers§! on our Core States.\n\nCompleting these §YDecisions§! will also lower the Negative Modifiers on the §Y$CZE_a_divided_nation_dynamic_modifier$§! National Spirit until it is §YRemoved§!.
loc.MUN_czech.1037.d: After noticing the obvious war justifying going on in our country towards [HUN.GetNameDef], [GER.GetAdjective] representatives have made clear that going to war with the [HUN.GetAdjective]s would mean war with [GER.GetNameDef] as well. Whether to proceed now is up to us.
loc.MUN_czech.1038.t.1: [FROM.GetName] Offers to License its Tank Designs
loc.MUN_czech.1038.d: Representatives from the [FROM.GetAdjective] government and their weapon companies have approached us with a proposal for a weapons sale. The price seems fairly normal, and the [FROM.GetNameDef] also offers some weapons that are very modern.
loc.MUN_czech.1039.d: In light of the Autonomy Agreement, we gave [SLO.getname], $RUT_augustin_voloshyn$ has inquired about his region having the same sort of federalization agreement with us. This seems absurd, but given the circumstances, we have to take these demands at face value.
loc.MUN_czech.1040.t: [CZE.getname] offers us a Customs Union Treaty
loc.MUN_czech.1040.d: [CZE.getnameDEFCAP] has recently revisited diplomatic talks regarding a customs union between our two nations. The deal they are trying to strike seems fair, but may include other demands later that we may not be prepared for. This treaty and what's being traded seems trivial and symbolic, so there will be no harm in signing it.
loc.MUN_czech.1041.d: Citing some reasons about how this treaty could upset their economy, [From.getname] has declined to sign the customs union treaty between our two nations. These reasons seem like baseless excuses without merit.
loc.MUN_czech.1042.t: [FROM.getname] Agrees to the Custom Unions Treaty
loc.MUN_czech.1042.d: Seeing that the Treaty is satisfactory, [FROM.getname] has agreed to the terms. Hopefully, this is the first step toward closer ties between our two nations.
loc.MUN_czech.1043.d: Citing the closer ties between our two nations and recent developments around the world. [FROM.getname] has said that it would be better under their protection than all alone. This does seem like a ploy for them to simply occupy our territory. What should we do?
loc.MUN_czech.1044.d: Seeing that they would be better off alone then under us . [FROM.getname] has rejected the chance to join our federation. This is a blow to our goal of strengthening our position within Europe. What should we do now that [FROM.getname] will not come to their senses.
loc.MUN_czech.1044.b: We'll have to try other means
loc.MUN_czech.1045.d: Seeing that they would be better protected under us then by themselves. [FROM.getname] has wisely joined our federation. This will greatly strengthen our position within Europe.
loc.MUN_czech.1046.d: Having tackled many issues within our country, the tensions within our nation seem to be subsiding. After finishing many economic and social programs it now seems our country is now starting to heal.
loc.MUN_czech.1048.d: Reluctantly, [FROM.GetAdjective] officials have informed us that they intend to give in to our territorial demands. Already, [FROM.GetAdjective] troops are withdrawing from the territory.
loc.MUN_czech.1048.d2: After lengthy discussions, our officials and those from [FROM.GetNameDef] have successfully agreed to a new role of the [FROM.GetAdjective] economy as part of our union. This arrangement is sure to bring prosperity to both our citizens.
loc.MUN_czech.1048.d3: Our proposal of a non-aggression pact was met with immediate enthusiasm by [FROM.GetAdjective] representatives, it seems their ambitions are currently focused elsewhere.
loc.MUN_czech.1048.d4: Finding themselves under grave threat, [FROM.GetNameDef] has given into our demands for alignment.
loc.MUN_czech.1048.d5: After lengthy discussions, our officials and those from [FROM.GetNameDef] have successfully reached an agreement where a part of our military industry will be dedicated to producing equipment for them. In return, we will receive trade goods for our markets and production.
loc.MUN_czech.1049.d: The new government of [FROM.GetNameDef] has approached us proposing an alliance. Despite the initial anti-German stance of their new military government, it seems they have been pragmatic and recognized that their old international partners are unreliable.
loc.MUN_czech.1050.d: Our diplomats returned from [FROM.GetNameDef] with the disappointing news that our request to join their alliance was denied. Although the reasons are unclear, we are now in the difficult situation where we've exposed our worries about our traditional allies, without being able to gain a new one.
loc.MUN_czech.1050.a: Then perhaps we should offer more favorable terms
loc.MUN_czech.1050.b: Let us search for better allies
loc.MUN_czech.1051.d: Our new ally, [FROM.GetNameDef] has expressed its interest in expanding its influence across its borders. Consequently, [FROM.GetAdjective] representatives have come seeking permission and support for this expansion, where a clear boundary between areas under [ROOT.GetAdjective] and [FROM.GetAdjective] influence is to be set.
loc.MUN_czech.1051.a: We should strengthen our key [FROM.GetAdjective] ally
loc.MUN_czech.1052.t: [FROM.GetName] Requests We Allow Passage for [SOV.GetAdjective] Troops
loc.MUN_czech.1052.d: After a new diplomatic agreement between [FROM.GetNameDef] and [SOV.GetNameDef], [FROM.GetNameDef] feels confident that [SOV.GetNameDef] would protect them in case of conflict. The only obstacle is the lack of a land connection between the two, consequently, [FROM.GetAdjective] diplomats have approached our government, requesting that we would allow the passage of [SOV.GetAdjective] troops through our territory to [FROM.GetNameDef] if a conflict does take place.
loc.MUN_czech.1052.a: Their fighting will protect us too
loc.MUN_czech.1053.d: After turning [HUN.GetNameDef] into a client state, [FROM.GetNameDef] is now demanding that we accept the same fate. They threaten that if we refuse, they would support [HUN.GetAdjective] claims on [ROM.GetAdjective] territory. Now we must choose between losing our sovereignty or potentially compromising our territorial integrity.
loc.MUN_czech.1054.d: As agreed previously, [FROM.GetNameDef] has come with a proposition that would help strengthen our nation. Namely by unifying forcibly with [LIT.GetNameDef], this would give us access to additional resources and would deny the enemy the possibility of attacking us through [LIT.GetNameDef].
loc.MUN_czech.1054.a: We must expand to resist the expansion of others
loc.MUN_czech.1055.d: In unprecedented feat of aerial logistics, [SOV.GetNameDef] has used its air force to deploy several divisions of volunteers to our airport in [73.GetName] to support our current war effort.
loc.MUN_czech.1056.d: Just like once proposed in the Paris Peace Conference after the Great War, [CZE.GetNameDef] has announced it deems a corridor to its ally, [YUG.GetNameDef], necessary for their alliance's safety. In order to achieve that goal, [FROM.GetAdjective] representatives have delivered an ultimatum that demands we cede [975.GetName].
loc.MUN_the_fall_of_the_republic.1.d: [ROOT.GetLeader]'s recent decision to give up the Sudetenland has led to an outbreak of protests throughout the nation. While the political and military leadership wanted to avoid bloodshed in what they thought was pointless resistance in the face of impossible odds, many throughout the nation felt that they made the wrong decision. Some political movements are now moving in to take advantage of the turmoil to further their own goals.
loc.MUN_the_fall_of_the_republic.2.t.1: The Fall of the First Republic
loc.MUN_the_fall_of_the_republic.2.d: In the wake of the government's choice to Surrender the Sudetenland a large wave of resignations of junior leadership in the army and government has bombarded our country. Some of these people have reportedly fled the country overnight. Major changes are required within our government to stem the bleeding of officials leaving and to restore some faith in our ability to lead.
loc.MUN_the_fall_of_the_republic.3.d: With the recent political chaos that has befallen our nation the small region of Carpatho Ukraine wishes to be more autonomous from [9.GetCapitalVictoryPointName]. Citing long-standing differences between the region and the rest of [ROOT.getname]. However, this request seems like local leaders seizing an opportunity to empower themselves. Denying this request would cost a lot of political capital at a moment where we have none to spare.
loc.MUN_the_fall_of_the_republic.4.d: In the aftermath of the recent chaos that had befallen [CZE.getname], the small region of [RUT.getname] has fallen outside of any country's borders. The small region is claiming to be an independent country and is making diplomatic outreaches to its neighbors. Many within our government worry about such a strategically important region on our border falling into someone else's hands. The army has suggested issuing the breakaway region an ultimatum immediately demanding their annexation.
loc.MUN_the_fall_of_the_republic.4.a: Send them the ultimatum right away!
loc.MUN_the_fall_of_the_republic.4.b: This could be risky, let's wait them out.
loc.MUN_the_fall_of_the_republic.5.d: After our independence, it was only a matter of time before a neighboring country looked to incorporate us into their territory. [FROM.getname] seems to be the first to do so and is demanding our surrender. What should we do?
loc.MUN_the_fall_of_the_republic.5.a: We'll fight you to the last man!
loc.MUN_the_fall_of_the_republic.5.b: We have no choice but to say yes.
loc.MUN_the_fall_of_the_republic.6.d: In a surprise move, [FROM.getname] has rejected our ultimatum and instead seeks to resort to armed resistance against us. They have given us no choice but to invade. Battle plans and routes of attack have already been formulated, all we have to do is give the order to attack.
loc.MUN_the_fall_of_the_republic.6.a_tt: This operation will not affect §Y$HUN_pal_teleki$§! unless [RUT.GetNameDef] has allies
loc.MUN_the_fall_of_the_republic.6.b: This might backfire, best to hold off.
loc.MUN_the_fall_of_the_republic.7.d: In a surprise to no one, [FROM.getname] has accepted our demands and is willing to be annexed into our country in return for some trivial conditions. The small region had no chance of resisting a nation as powerful as ours. Our northern frontier is now more protected than it was before, and the government is very pleased with the easy victory it has achieved.
loc.MUN_czech_bop.1.d: The reform efforts of the first half of the decade are starting to bear fruit. The army is currently one of the most modern in Europe. Yet a sense of complacency has started to set in among some politicians and the heads of many industrial conglomerates. If our army is to remain at peak readiness we have to fight against the possible doubts of our army's ability to fight and those who seek to undermine it for their own personal gain.
loc.MUN_czech_bop.2.d.1: [GER.getnameDEFcap]'s recent remilitarization of the Rhineland has scared some of our military and political leaders. While many have faith in the alliances that the country has made and the preparations the army is currently making to face the possibility of a German threat. Some however, are not as confident that we can stand against any [GER.GetAdjective] threat.
loc.MUN_czech_bop.2.d.2: The recent news that some of our neighbors have taken on programs to greatly expand their militaries has scared some of our military and political leaders. Many have faith in the alliances that the country has made with other nations and the preparations the army is currently making to face the possibility of any foreign threat. Some, however, are not as confident that we can stand up to the possibility of foreign aggression.
loc.MUN_czech_bop.2.a_tt: The rearmament efforts of our neighbors have caused some within our army to doubt our ability to resist possible aggression. We must reassure the army with our actions.
loc.MUN_czech_bop.3.t: [CZE.getname] has sent Observers to our Country
loc.MUN_czech_bop.3.d: [CZE.getname] has recently sent individuals to our country to observe the ongoing conflict. At the same time one of their small arms manufacturers has contacted some of our diplomats through secondary channels wondering if we'd be interested in buying small arms from them. This would involve smuggling arms to our country due to restrictions placed upon us.
loc.MUN_czech_bop.3.b: We can't let them do more than just observe.
loc.MUN_czech_bop_3_tt: §Y[CZE.getname]§! Gun Manufacturer §Y$CZE_zbrojovka_brno_organization$§! may try to smuggle guns to us.
loc.MUN_czech_bop.4.d: [ETH.getname] has made contact with representatives of $CZE_zbrojovka_brno_organization$ arms manufacturer and is interested in smuggling our guns into the country. Despite the League of Nations sanctions against [ETH.GetNameDef], $CZE_zbrojovka_brno_organization$ is willing to go through with this scheme. Violating the League of Nations mandate would prove unpopular internationally if we get caught.
loc.MUN_czech_bop.4.b: This isn't worth the possible backlash
loc.MUN_czech_bop.5.d: Having talked with representatives of the Czech government, $CZE_zbrojovka_brno_organization$ have been given a secret go ahead to start smuggling a small amount of small arms into the country. Their expertise will also be available to us through our backchannels.
loc.MUN_czech_bop.5.a: We'll put these to good use.
loc.MUN_czech_bop_5_tt: This §YManufacturer§! will be §RRemoved§! after the war ends.
loc.MUN_slovakia_little_war.1.d: Our army made a good account of themselves in [71.Getname] by defeating the enemy forces in the area. Our Commanders have learned invaluable information and lessons from the battle that they can use going forward.
loc.MUN_slovakia_little_war.2.d: Despite our best efforts, our forces were defeated in [71.Getname]. The inability to gather enough ammunition and motorized equipment in time for the conflict was a key factor in our loss. Despite this setback, the commanders who were involved in the battle have learned some very important lessons.
loc.MUN_slovakia_little_war.3.d: Even after gaining our territory in the $GER_first_vienna_award$,  [HUN.getnamedef] still seeks to make further border adjustments with us in [71.getname]. We need to meet this challenge with force to show them that we will not concede our land without a fight.
loc.MUN_slovakia_little_war.4.d: Despite our best efforts, our forces were not able to win the skirmish in [71.Getname]. The inability to gather enough ammunition and motorized equipment in time for the conflict was a key factor in our inability to achieve victory. Despite this setback, the commanders who were involved in the battle have learned some very important lessons.
loc.MUN_czech_exile.1.d: In the aftermath of [GER.GetNameDef] dissolving their country following the Munich Conference,  [CZE.GetAdjective] exiles have arrived in many countries, including ours. They are willing to pick up arms to aid us, doing this in the hope that they can one day liberate their country with our help.
loc.MUN_czech.news.1.desc: People in the Sudetenland have started an armed revolt against [CZE.getnameDef]. Reports started coming in that paramilitaries have started to attack police stations and government buildings throughout the region. This has been triggered by recent news that [FROM.getname] seeks to annex the region.\n\nThese revolts seem to be a prelude to a larger conflict between [FROM.getname] and [CZE.GetNameDef]. A conflict that now seems unavoidable.
loc.MUN_czech.news.1.a: This does not bode well for Europe.
loc.MUN_czech.news.2.desc:
Somewhere in the recent chain of events that followed the political chaos in [CZE.getname], the small region of [RUT.getname] had fallen outside of any country's borders. The small breakaway state then declared itself an independent nation and started to form militias to try to protect its new statehood.

[FROM.getnamedefcap] has long had designs on the region and seeing the opportunity has promptly invaded the small breakaway state. Their victory over [RUT.getname] seems like foregone conclusion to many observers.
loc.MUN_slovakia.news.1.desc: Despite regaining [664.Getname] in the aftermath of the $GER_first_vienna_award$, [HUN.getnamedef] still seeks to make additional adjustments with its border with [SLO.getnamedef] in [71.Getname].\n\nThis conflict seems like an excuse for [HUN.getnamedef] to test out how strong its military is against a much weaker opposition. The young army of [SLO.getnamedef] may not be ready to meet the challenge before them.
loc.CZE_coalition_building_desc: The coalition that emerged in the aftermath of the elections must build greater unity among its members if it is to function effectively. Jan Malypetr's recent retirement as prime minister has placed further pressure on the Broad Coalition to consolidate its support.
loc.CZE_merge_the_paramilitaries_desc: Our paramilitaries are spread out and split across many different groups. If we hope to make use of them militarily, we will have to force them to merge.
loc.CZE_integrated_paramilitaries_desc: The military might not be too pleased with the idea, but integrating the paramilitary groups into our military will give us an increased pool of reserves when we need them the most.
loc.CZE_wielding_the_hammer_desc: We can use our supermajority in the National Assembly to make the law-passing process much faster than it currently is. It's of the utmost importance to get our legislative house in order.
loc.CZE_emergency_measures_desc: By deploying emergency measures to help us deal with the many crises our nation faces, and at the same time using some of those measures to help keep a closer eye on those who may be ideologically unreliable to our government. We will be better equipped to face the challenges our nation faces.
loc.CZE_king_of_the_castle_desc: We all know who's calling the shots in our government. In a time of great uncertainty, it's time we stop pretending and let $CZE_edvard_benesh$ lead more directly. Our country's security depends on it.
loc.CZE_closer_ties_with_the_moderate_german: Some Sudetenland parties are willing to work with our coalition and build inroads with the government. Let's deepen those ties.
loc.CZE_complete_reconciliation_desc: We've put in the work to build the bridges of trust. It's time to reconcile with our fellow countrymen.
loc.CZE_bastion_of_liberty_desc: We have been one of the few truly pluralist countries in Europe east of the Rhine this decade. Let's ensure people don't forget that.
loc.CZE_standing_against_the_storm_desc: Despite our shortcomings and possible lack of preparation, we will meet any challenge head-on and stand against the coming storm.
loc.CZE_truth_prevails_desc: Even in the face of great odds and impossible tasks, our country knows that our national motto, 'Truth Prevails,' will ring true when all is said and done. Seek the truth, speak the truth, and it will prevail.
loc.CZE_negotiations_with_the_autonomous_blo: If we want to form a coalition that doesn't concede power to Benes's legion of lackeys in the National Assembly, we'll have to work with the Autonomous Bloc. However, gaining their complete support will come at great cost.
loc.CZE_slovakia_autonomy_agreement_desc: The price for the autonomous bloc's working with our coalition is an autonomy agreement with the government. This is a heavy price to pay, but the consequences of not living up to our end of the bargain could be worse.
loc.CZE_slovakia_autonomy_agreement_tt: §Y[RUT.getname]§! will want the same agreement we give §Y[SLO.getname]§!!
loc.CZE_slovakia_autonomy_agreement_2_tt: $CZE_the_autonomous_bloc_demands$ will be delayed by §Y35 days§! when this focus is selected.
loc.CZE_topple_the_king_desc: $CZE_edvard_benesh$ influence on our government is suffocating. His power is greater than his role as president due to his legion of loyalists within parliament. Now that the conditions are right, we can supplant his influence in the Horní Komora.
loc.CZE_comprise_with_the_carpathians_desc: The region of Ruthenia is striving toward a similar federalization agreement to the one we gave [SLO.getnamedef]. Doing so would greatly weaken our position in the region and in [9.getname]. Cutting a deal with them may be better than totally giving in to their demands.
loc.CZE_the_rut_demands_add_35_CZE_comprise_: $CZE_the_rut_demands$ will be delayed by §Y35 days§! when this focus is selected.
loc.CZE_cut_carpathia_loose_desc: With Slovakia now a federal state, the region of Ruthenia is hoping to make a similar agreement. While this seems unreasonable, without Slovakia under our direct control trying to reign them in would be difficult. Maybe we should just give in to their demands.
loc.CZE_compromise_with_the_veteran_agrarian: The agrarian old guard is a hurdle in making inroads with the growing urban electorate. We need to compromise with them to achieve our goals.
loc.CZE_reorient_the_broad_coalition_desc: The broad coalition has been the leading bloc in our government for many years. The various political parties it encompasses have made the coalition increasingly difficult to lead. A reorientation of ministerial policies is long overdue.
loc.CZE_leverage_sokol_desc: The Sokol movement has been an important organization within our country for decades. In times of crisis, we should leverage them to help provide paramilitary training and recruits for our army.
loc.CZE_deepend_ties_with_the_trademans_desc: The Tradesmen Party is popular among middle-class urban voters. If we empower and work with them we can make inroads with the urban electorate while not alienating our rural voter base.
loc.CZE_apart_but_togather_desc: Our regions now have more autonomy than they ever had, but we are also stronger than we've ever been. We are ready to take on anything.
loc.CZE_contact_henlein_desc: $CZE_konrad_henlein$ has been a constant thorn in the side of our government for years now. However, in light of recent international events, it may be time to start a dialogue with him.
loc.CZE_contact_henlein_focus_warning_tt: If we complete §Y$CZE_no_compromise_with_the_sdp$§!, we'll have to wait §Y350§! days before we may select this §YNational Focus§!.
loc.CZE_contact_henlein_focus_order_warning_: If we complete §Y$CZE_no_compromise_with_the_sdp$§! after completing this §YNational Focus§!, §Y$CZE_konrad_henlein$§! will be retired.
loc.CZE_no_compromise_with_the_sdp: Continue to Lock Out the SdP
loc.CZE_no_compromise_with_the_sdp_desc: The SdP has nothing to offer our coalition. They seek only to cause political tension and to smear our government's actions. In the name of good governance, they should continue to be locked out of any coalition.
loc.CZE_no_compromise_with_the_sdp_focus_war: If we complete §Y$CZE_contact_henlein$§!, we'll have to wait §Y350§! days before we may select this §YNational Focus§!.
loc.CZE_form_a_federation_desc: The dream of a central European federation is no longer out of reach. We will finally achieve it and become a giant of democracy. Together, we will have the power to resist the great powers on our own!
loc.CZE_reassure_the_army_desc: The army is getting nervous about some of our recent decisions and government policies. It's time to reassure them that we stand by them no matter what the government says or does.
loc.CZE_outreach_to_the_western_powers: Further Outreach to the Western Powers
loc.CZE_outreach_to_the_western_powers_desc: The Western democracies say they have our back, but we need to make further inroads with them to make sure that their words will also come with actions when it matters most.
loc.CZE_demand_guarantees_desc: Despite our existing treaties and alliances, we need to make sure our partners do not abandon us in a time of desperation just because it's easier for them. We need something stronger than a guarantee.
loc.CZE_guardian_of_central_europe_desc: We now stand in a position to be an overseer of Democracy in the center of Europe. We can be a guardian for nations who cannot fend for themselves and make sure that democracy stands tall.
loc.CZE_central_european_faction_desc: Despite our focus on strengthening ourselves instead of relying too heavily on diplomacy, it is critical that we do not overextend our influence. It may be time to look outwards.
loc.CZE_strike_at_the_heart_of_bolshevism_1: Strike at the Heart of Bolshevism
loc.CZE_strike_at_the_heart_of_bolshevism_de: Expansion of [SOV.GetNameDef] is an existential threat to Europe and to our nation. We need to be a bulwark against them.
loc.CZE_destroy_the_fascist_threats_desc_ene: We all know who the greatest threat to peace in Europe is. [GER.getnamedefCAP] needs to be stopped sooner rather than later. If no one else is willing, it might as well be by us.
loc.CZE_destroy_the_fascist_threats_desc_bac: For our security, it is of utmost importance that our neighboring countries do not follow expansionist rhetoric that might sooner or later be aimed towards us.
loc.CZE_peace_on_our_time_desc: We've been an afterthought in European international relations for too long. No longer will this be the case! We can stand on our own two feet and set our terms. Be it war or peace.
loc.CZE_free_tuka_desc: $CZE_vojtech_tuka$ prison sentence is up and instead of finding an excuse to extend his sentence, we could instead free him on time and put him to use within our government. It's better to have him working under us rather than against us.
loc.CZE_grow_the_anglo_czechoslovak_prague_c: The Anglo-Czech Credit Bank has been one of the primary drivers of our industry. Without their funds, we wouldn't be able to sustain the large export business we currently have. Establishing new branches in New York and deepening ties with [ENG.GetNameDef] would see the bank grow even further. It would also give [ENG.getname] some stake in our continued survival.
loc.CZE_feeding_the_alligator_desc: [GER.getname] designs on the Sudetenland are a threat to the very existence of our nation. Perhaps if we give them what they desire they will leave us alone.
loc.CZE_complete_capitulation_desc: What choice do we have but to give in? We cannot resist the coming storm on the horizon. Maybe if we cut a deal with [GER.getnamedef] while we still have some leverage they'll leave us with some independence under their yoke.
loc.CZE_stabilize_the_protectorate_desc: The Protectorate is anything but stable. We need to make efforts to convince our population that we are the legitimate government and that we will take care of their needs.
loc.CZE_full_faith_in_hacha_desc: $CZE_emil_hacha$ is much more popular and respected within our population than $CZE_emanuel_moravec$. The job he's doing might be suspect, but you can't replace a more popular figurehead.
loc.CZE_moravecs_bohemia_desc: Rumors are flying that $CZE_emil_hacha$ is trying to undermine our new government. Suppose we hope to succeed and grow under our current conditions, we need leadership that is more in line with the ideology of our overlords.
loc.CZE_form_the_government_army_desc: If we want our country to succeed, we need to form a new army that learns from the failings of its predecessor. We must also ensure its leadership is more politically aligned with the government.
loc.CZE_forced_administration_of_companies_d: Despite massive oversight, some companies still operate outside of our control. It's time to force them under our supervision.
loc.CZE_revisit_custom_union_talks_desc: Custom union talks may have gone very poorly with some of our neighbors compared to some others. It is time to revisit them and make a renewed push for a customs union between our countries.
loc.CZE_revisit_custom_union_talks_tt: We'll still be able to convince them to join, through other §Rmeans§!.
loc.CZE_revisit_custom_union_talks_2_tt: They will be much more likely to accept our demands to join us our Federation
loc.CZE_reintegrate_cross_border_rail_connec: Improving the rail connections with our neighbors is a good way to curry favor with them. More so if we're trying to grow economic connections between us and them.
Cross Border Rail Connections Were Improved
loc.CZE_vonapo_20_desc: We are not alone in seeing the rising threat from [GER.GetNameDef], a plan has therefore been formed to cooperate with [SOV.GetNameDef] in gathering intelligence so we may better thwart [GER.GetAdjective] ambitions.
loc.CZE_increase_funding_from_moscow_desc: The [ROOT.GetCommunistParty] is so underfunded that it currently pays its building with the salaries of its representatives. To grow, we must appeal to [SOV.GetNameDef] for increased funding to spread our newspaper and recruit more members.
loc.CZE_expand_the_communist_press_desc: Our newspaper, 'Red Law,' could serve to inform those that currently don't read any newspapers, all that's needed is an increase in funding.
loc.CZE_anti_rearmament_propaganda_desc: The fall of the fascist government of our main adversary, [GER.GetNonIdeologyName], means we can claim to have been right all along in our stance against military buildup.
loc.CZE_anti_democratic_propaganda_desc: To create support for our party, we must highlight the failings of the previous governments of the Republic and demonstrate how we could have handled the situation better.
loc.CZE_form_workers_brigades_desc: The workers that we are freeing must be prepared to participate in the struggle. They may not be trained soldiers, but they can still contribute as specialists based on their jobs.
loc.CZE_kohler_faction_desc: The faction of Bruno Köhler believes a violent overthrow of the bourgeoisie is necessary to form a successful communist Czechoslovak state.
loc.CZE_gottwald_faction_desc: Loyal to a fault to Moscow, the Stalinist faction of Klement Gottwald foresees a Czechoslovak state in the USSR's image.
loc.CZE_zapotocky_faction_desc: The founders of the communist party, Bohumir Šmeral and Antonin Zápotocký, envisioned a more moderate policy than the one that Klement Gottwald has forced upon the party, we must return to these roots to truly appeal to all [CZE.GetAdjective] peoples.
loc.CZE_ally_with_moderate_socialists_desc: Not every country is prepared to embrace communism through electoral means or develop an admiration for [SOV.GetLeader], so cooperating with more moderate movements is something we should not avoid.
loc.CZE_democracies_willing_to_join_faction_: §YDemocratic nations will be more willing to join our communist faction§!.
loc.CZE_limited_cooperation_desc: While ideologically different, even [SOV.GetNameDef] may recognize our value as a partner and take part in some pragmatic deals, even as they denounce us in their newspapers.
loc.CZE_denounce_stalinism_desc: The reputation of communism is forever tainted by the injustices of Stalin, it is time we take military measures to free the people under regimes like his.
loc.CZE_cooperate_with_tito_desc: [YUG.GetNameDefCap] is attempting a pragmatic version of communism, just like us. They similarly seek to unite various diverse peoples under the red banner. In facing these challenges, we should cooperate on military and political affairs.
loc.CZE_reduce_divided_nation_cost_tt: Reduces the cost and duration of most §YA Divided Nation§! decisions.
loc.CZE_balkan_union_desc: Although more nations in the region now embrace communism, we cannot protect ourselves against the major powers without strong cooperation, a union would be the most effective way to achieve this.
loc.CZE_cooperation_with_the_ussr_desc: Even the most ardent supporters of [SOV.GetNameDef] among the party leadership are aware of the flaws of its collectivization after visiting the country. Even then, cooperating with them in collectivization means we can carefully analyze what went wrong and what went right and how to implement it best for [ROOT.GetNameDef].
loc.CZE_exchange_military_expertise_desc: [SOV.GetNameDefCap], just like most powers with a significant army, has experimented with army tactics. We should request that they share their insights, and we in turn can share ours.
loc.CZE_pressure_romania_desc: [ROM.GetNameDefCap] could pose a serious threat if it aligned with our enemies, possibly disrupting our connection with [SOV.GetNameDef] or providing valuable oil to our enemies. With [SOV.GetAdjective] backing, we pose enough of a threat to potentially align them without war.
loc.CZE_facility_in_state_tt: If there are no other §YExperimental Facilities§! in $STATE|Y$, we will gain §G1§! $FACILITY_TYPE|Y$ in $STATE|Y$.
loc.CZE_spread_the_revolution_desc: With the revolution successful in [ROOT.GetNameDef], we should now encourage the proletariat abroad to fight for their freedom, a struggle which we can support.
loc.CZE_agrarian_reform_desc: The recently disbanded land office was responsible for the redistribution of mainly agricultural land, it is time we reform this institution for more drastic measures.
loc.CZE_realign_the_church_desc: Religion has for too long been an element that divides the [CZE.GetAdjective] peoples. We must reduce its influence over state matters such as education and the news to create a more unified society.
loc.CZE_create_a_secret_police_branch_desc: To ensure stability, we must defend against both external and internal enemies. It will take time for the population to get used to the new system, especially as it is still being perfected.
loc.CZE_promote_urbanization_desc: Now we have established efficient communal farms, we can start programs to attract some of the rural populace to the cities and increase productivity there.
loc.CZE_confiscate_church_lands_desc: The church controls far more land and wealth than necessary for its purposes. We must reallocate some of this land, just as we did for the farmers.
loc.CZE_change_the_narrative_desc: Although the church has not been supportive of our revolution so far, aligning its values with ours may play an important role in creating support for the new regime.
loc.CZE_the_second_fortification_program_des: The first fortification program laid a foundation for defenses that we need to build upon immediately. For the sake of our nation's future, we need to start the second fortification program as soon as possible and grow and develop our fortification lines.
loc.CZE_redirect_the_fortification_councils_: These fortification programs are a massive drain on our economy. Those funds would be better used for funding different programs. The army doesn't need more defenses anyhow, they have plenty.
loc.CZE_jachymov_uranium_mine_desc: The mines in Jáchymov have long served as a source for uranium and other ores, however there had been little use for uranium until recent developments in physics.
loc.CZE_skoda_internal_competition_desc: Within a company as big as Škoda it is hard to keep everyone at peak working ability. Encouraging internal competition will go a long way in improving employee performance at our plants.
loc.CZE_skoda_max_optimization_tt: The maximum §YŠkoda Focus§! optimization level will be increased to 7.
loc.CZE_skoda_increase_cooperation_desc: To improve ourselves we can increase our performance by increasing cross-plant cooperation. This could also lead to expertise sharing between our plants.
loc.CZE_skoda_fast_optimization_tt: Rate §YŠkoda Focus§! £GFX_prod_eff_cap Optimization Tier increases over time toward Maximum Tier: §G+100.0%§!
loc.CZE_master_of_armaments_desc: Škoda Works has been the largest arms manufacturer within our borders since the days of the Austria-Hungarian Empire. Their expertise and experience are unmatched among the industrial conglomerates in our country. It's time we elevate them to the title of Master of Armaments.
loc.CZE_only_the_best_is_good_enough: Only the Best is Good Enough
loc.CZE_only_the_best_is_good_enough_desc: Škoda Works has always been driven by a hard work ethic and an innovative spirit. Our founders always abided by the motto: “Only the best is good enough for our customers!” That motto rings more true than ever in recent times.
loc.CZE_an_industrial_legacy_desc: Having developed our country’s industry to heights previously thought impossible, we can finally embrace and claim our industrial legacy. We are an unmatched powerhouse of industry.
loc.CZE_powerhouse_of_europe_desc: Our industry is now the envy of the world. We must now ensure our energy sector can supply it properly.
loc.CZE_supply_fighters_for_allies_desc: The [FRA.GetAdjective] and [ENG.GetAdjective] governments are very afraid that [GER.GetAdjective] planes would quickly defeat their defenses and target their cities if a conflict starts. Strengthening their airforce may therefore make them a little more confident about their ability to halt [GER.GetAdjective] expansion without significant loss of life.
loc.CZE_allies_more_likely_to_defend_us_tt: §YThe Allies will be more likely to back us against German expansionism regarding the Sudetenland.§!
loc.CZE_allies_more_likely_to_defend_us_2_tt: §YThe Allies will be significantly more likely to back us against German expansionism regarding the Sudetenland.§!
loc.CZE_allies_more_likely_to_defend_us_3_tt: §YThe Allies will be a tiny bit more likely to back us against German expansionism regarding the Sudetenland.§!
loc.CZE_german_nonagressionpact_desc: Negotiations for a non-aggression pact with [GER.GetNameDef] have been going on for a while. However, after signs of instability in [SOV.GetNameDef] and new expansionist plans, these stopped. With [GER.GetNameDef] currently occupied with other enemies, we must attempt to restart these talks.
loc.CZE_revive_the_czechoslovak_legion_dynam: Once again there is unrest brewing in the world, and the brave soldiers of [ROOT.GetNameDef] are ready to defend the fatherland. But as the past has proven, defending the homeland sometimes requires that our troops fighting abroad must once again find those willing to leave their home, precisely to defend it.
loc.CZE_revive_the_czechoslovak_legion_nsb_t: §Y$CZE_legacy_of_the_czechoslovak_legion_army_spirit$§! will be converted from a §YSpirit of The Army§! into a §YNational Spirit§!.
loc.CZE_state_sponsored_recruitment_for_spai: With a new conflict where foreign intervention may play a crucial role, we should encourage the seasoned volunteer fighters of [ROOT.GetNameDef] to support the side that aligns most with our policies. We may even learn some lessons about warfare advances in the last decade in the process.
loc.CZE_support_spain_reward_tt: §YEffects if a Spanish faction has volunteers from us when it wins or loses:§!
loc.CZE_profit_off_the_spanish_civil_war: Profit off the Spanish Civil War
loc.CZE_profit_off_the_spanish_civil_war_des: The Spanish Civil War is becoming a proxy war for the major powers. We should not risk the lives of our brave troops getting entangled in such a conflict. Instead it is the perfect opportunity to fund a build-up of our industry by selling weapons, potentially even to both sides.
loc.CZE_skoda_sell_weapons_to_SPR_tt: Unlocks Decisions: §YCovertly Sell Weapons to Spanish Faction§!
loc.CZE_placate_benes_faction_desc: $CZE_milan_hodza$ needs to come to terms with the fact that his stint as Foreign Affairs Minister has gone horribly. $CZE_edvard_benesh$ is ready to come in with his supporters within the Agrians and reinforce $CZE_milan_hodza$ position as Prime Minister as long as he gives up his Foreign Affairs position.
loc.CZE_claim_lands_of_the_bohemian_crown: Claim Lands of the Bohemian Crown
loc.CZE_claim_lands_of_the_bohemian_crown_de: Because our nation was part of the edge of various empires in the past centuries, our borders were shifted based on conflict, rather than the inhabitants' will, it is now time to correct those shifts.
loc.CZE_demand_katowice_desc: Gaining control over [762.GetName] would not just mean a restoration of our former borders, but would also weaken [POL.GetAdjective] claims on [72.GetName].
loc.CZE_fight_over_silesia_desc: Silesia may be rightfully [ROOT.GetAdjective] land, but an all-out war with [66.owner.GetNameDef] is undesirable. We should therefore demonstrate our strength with large-scale border skirmishes rather than a large-scale war. If [66.owner.GetNameDef] is unwilling to fight in defense of Silesia, may yet deprive them of the territory.
loc.CZE_dismantle_poland_desc: Its inability to defend itself now highlighted, it is clear that [POL.GetNameDef] cannot form a reliable buffer state against our enemies. Instead, we should move to strengthen our own state.
loc.CZE_proclaim_the_restoration_of_bohemia: Proclaim Restoration of the Bohemian Kingdom
loc.CZE_proclaim_the_restoration_of_bohemia_: With our old borders restored, we can now reclaim our legacy and focus on integrating our new lands.
loc.CZE_integrate_lost_territories_desc: The historic lands of the Bohemian Kingdom stretch from the Baltic Sea all the way to the Adriatic, it is now time to appeal to this history as we integrate our new possessions.
loc.CZE_deepen_ties_with_puppet_kingdoms_des: Although we now possess a clear sphere of influence, we will need to make our influence even stronger to benefit the most from these aligned nations.
loc.CZE_a_strong_poland_desc: Possessing one of the strongest armies of Eastern Europe, [POL.GetNameDef] has the potential to become a valuable ally.
loc.CZE_facilitate_a_strong_hungary_desc: Since its independence, [HUN.GetNameDef] has had shaky relations with us. But with conflict brewing, we may be able to align them to our cause.
loc.CZE_subjegate_romania_desc: The claims of our [HUN.GetAdjective] puppet are a useful tool against [ROM.GetNameDef]. By threatening to let [HUN.GetNameDef] press its claims on [ROM.GetAdjective] territory and help them acquire it, we may be able to demand the alignment of [ROM.GetNameDef].
loc.CZE_integrate_hungary_desc: Now we have established a significant sphere of influence, integration of the newly enlarged [HUN.GetName] and other territories could lead to a restoration of the Austro-Hungarian borders, but under [ROOT.GetAdjective] leadership.
loc.CZE_subjegate_serbia_desc: The now weakened [YUG.GetName] no longer serves as an effective buffer state to defend our southern flank. After integrating Slovenia, we should now aim to expand even further.
loc.CZE_strike_the_eastern_threat_desc: The hypocritical [SOV.GetName], justifying its imperial ambitions by criticizing our government, forms an existential threat to [CZE.GetName] that must be eliminated.
loc.CZE_assist_austria_desc: Keeping [AUS.GetNameDef] out of any conflicts is essential for our national security. The [AUS.GetAdjective] border is one of the most vulnerable points in our defenses. Their economy would also be a valuable asset for our enemies, something we cannot allow to happen.
loc.CZE_return_to_democracy_desc: With our home safeguarded, the population are increasingly aware that a military dictatorship is no longer productive. It is therefore time to hold elections and hand power back to a democratic civilian led administration.
loc.CZE_cooperate_with_the_allies_desc: With greater stability in the region established, we should make an effort to restore ties with our traditional allies.
loc.CZE_eliminate_austrian_defeatists_desc: [AUS.GetNameDefCap] has given up the willingness to defend its state, we must intervene now before we find ourselves surrounded.
loc.CZE_the_legacy_of_ottokar_desc: The legendary king Ottokar II expanded the Bohemian realm into Austria and to the Adriatic through the approval of the Austrian nobles. We must once again appeal to the Austrians, noble and unennobled alike.
loc.CZE_demand_the_istrian_peninsula_desc: [ROOT.GetNameDefCap] being landlocked has been an obstacle to our trade and influence for too long. We can no longer accept our economy being at the mercy of neighboring countries and should demand access to the Adriatic.
loc.CZE_demand_slovenia_desc: Slovenia was in the past a notable part of the Austrian Empire, and now that we have assumed control over the core of that empire, we must seek to reclaim their territory once more.
loc.CZE_demand_overlordship_of_yugoslav_leag: While we know as well as [YUG.GetName] that local autonomy is sometimes required in a multi-ethnic nation, their alliance is now too weak to defend itself. We must appeal to [YUG.GetNameDef] to recognize this and allow us to intervene.
loc.CZE_expand_the_rome_protocols_desc: Our new government aligns much more with the one in [ITA.capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName] than [GER.capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName]. With disagreements between the two over Austria, joining the Rome Protocols may give [ITA.GetNameDef] the confidence it needs to stay on its current course instead of turning to [GER.GetNameDef].
loc.CZE_soviet_alliance_desc: The current alliance treaty with [SOV.GetNameDef] is far too ambiguous to be sure of their intervention if we come under attack. We must therefore approach them for a new agreement if we wish to guarantee our security.
loc.CZE_airlift_soviet_support_desc: The lack of borders with our [SOV.GetAdjective] ally has led to the novel idea of flying in [SOV.GetAdjective] troops. A transport operation of such scope has never happened before but would mean that [SOV.GetAdjective] troops wouldn't have to enter the territory of our neighbors, at least on land.
loc.CZE_unlocks_volunteer_transport_raid_tt: Unlocks §YRaid§!:\nAir Bridge For Soviet Volunteers on §Y[73.GetName]§!
loc.CZE_intervene_in_the_ussr_desc: Once again there is unrest in [SOV.GetNameDef], and although the old royal family we once supported won't be returning, the possibility of a more friendly government cannot be ignored.
loc.CZE_forgive_trading_debts_desc: Economic instability and the Great Depression have saddled some of our potential allies with debt to us that they struggle to repay which is straining relations. The government could forgive those debts and compensate our domestic companies impacted by this move.
loc.CZE_improve_balkan_trade_relations_desc: Our greatest asset in winning over potential Balkan allies is our economy, we should show our willingness to spend resources on improving the economic situation of our potential allies.
loc.CZE_ally_austria_desc: Its government nearly overthrown by Nazi thugs just a few years ago, [AUS.GetNameDef] should begin to realize the potential benefits of cooperating with [ROOT.GetNameDef].
loc.CZE_demand_the_czech_corridor_desc: As we build the Little Entente into a proper alliance, it becomes increasingly obvious that redeploying troops to our allies, or receiving theirs, could prove very difficult in the event of a conflict. Having a strip of territory connecting our nation and [YUG.GetNameDef] like once proposed after the Great War could improve our safety and would safeguard our trade.
loc.CZE_ally_hungary_desc: Despite the conflicts that have plagued our relations with [HUN.GetNonIdeologyName] since the birth of [CZE.GetNonIdeologyName], they have recently shown potential in becoming a valuable ally.
loc.CZE_ally_yugoslavia_desc: [YUG.GetNameDefCap] may have struggled with its economy in recent times, but their strategic resources and location cannot be overlooked.
loc.CZE_protect_neutrality_desc: The Great War made clear that trying to stay neutral is futile when in the enemy's crosshairs. Protecting these nations means forcing our enemies into a two-front war when expanding instead of allowing them to divide and conquer.
loc.CZE_if_cooperate_with_moderate_socialist: Effects if §YCooperate with Moderate Socialists§! has been completed:
loc.CZE_mutual_protection_agreement_with_swi: Both we and [SWI.GetNameDef] are working towards a situation where an invasion of our lands is impossible without unaffordable losses, by cooperating, we could field an army with the numbers to not just defend, but to counterattack decisively.
loc.CZE_exchange_technology_desc: Despite an abundance of natural resources, the Balkans lack the profitable colonies or advanced industry of the major powers. Therefore it is key that we cooperate on research to allow a focus on our respective specialties.
loc.CZE_demand_corridor_to_ussr_desc: If [POL.GetNameDef] will not cooperate with us, we must take more serious action to ensure access to our [SOV.GetName] allies.
loc.CZE_ally_poland_desc: With the Polish-Soviet War still in memory and a rising threat to their west, [POL.GetNameDef] finds itself in a similar search for security as us. We must convince the [POL.GetAdjective] that neutrality won't save them, and to cast their lot with us.
loc.CZE_realize_the_polish_czechoslovak_conf: Despite their valiant fight, [POL.GetNameDef] has been defeated. With their government now in exile, ideas have emerged of a union with us. With their government merged with ours, we could rally the [POL.GetAdjective] to this new state and make a coordinated effort to liberate our collective homeland.
loc.CZE_integrate_western_ukrainians_desc: The Ukrainians of [CZE.GetNameDef] has been offered a great deal of assistance and autonomy, we can now attempt to integrate the newly acquired lands into our Ukrainian province.
loc.CZE_ally_russia_desc: Now the government of [SOV.GetNameDef] aligns more closely with ours, we could try to expand upon the vague agreement signed with their previous government.
loc.CZE_claim_ukraine_desc: Ukraine is an important piece of [SOV.GetNameDef], by seizing it, we could form a powerful buffer state.
loc.CZE_strengthen_the_little_entente_desc: Mainly aimed at containing [HUN.GetNonIdeologyName], the Little Entente has the potential to become a serious alliance with a sizable army.
loc.CZE_seek_french_leadership_desc: Despite our initiative with forming this alliance, it is clear [FRA.GetNonIdeologyName]'s army would be a great addition to any alliance. Even if it means ceding leadership.
loc.CZE_increase_food_and_resource_imports_d: With our new allies having a strong agricultural industry, it is now less necessary to subsidize one of our own. Importing resources cheaply will both save us money and give our allies a boost to their economy.
loc.CZE_double_down_on_heavy_industry_desc: The new agreements with our allies will allow us to focus on the industries that are most competitive, like our weapons industry. Any excess can then be sold.
loc.CZE_neutralize_the_hungarian_threat_desc: [HUN.GetNameDefCap] is an obstacle to trade with potential allies to the south, and if aligned with our enemies, could keep a potentially vital part of our army busy despite the impact of the Treaty of Trianon.
loc.CZE_ally_romania_desc: [ROM.GetNameDefCap] is uniquely one of the more self-sufficient nations in the region, producing food and valuable oil. Aligning them would not only give us easier access to each other's resources but would also deny our enemies the raw materials they need to wage war against us.
loc.CZE_divide_germany_desc: The threat from [GER.GetNameDef] is hard to counter alone, we should therefore seek allies who are similarly worried about [GER.GetAdjective] expansion, and have the willpower to act preemptively.
loc.CZE_if_FRA_ally_tt: Effects if §YFrance is monarchist§! and not already aligned with anyone else:
loc.CZE_if_POL_ally_tt: Effects if §YA Strong Poland§! was completed and resulted in a guarantee from [POL.GetNonIdeologyName]:
loc.CZE_revolutionary_brigades_desc: Our revolutionaries that now have experience fighting for [ROOT.GetNameDef] should be further integrated into the regular army.
loc.CZE_recruit_communist_exiles_desc: [ROOT.capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName] has long been a safe haven for exiled revolutionaries, our new government could make use of these foreign radicals.
loc.CZE_destabilize_potential_adversaries_de: The exiled communists we work with have an understanding of their home country that even our spies can struggle to match, we must make full use of this knowledge when deciding a strategy to liberate their homeland.
loc.CZE_nationalize_key_industries_desc: The mines provide the raw material that our industry forges into the weapons of war. Ensuring that supply of material in a time of crisis is best left in the hands of the government, rather than those of financiers and industrialists.
loc.CZE_rehabilitate_the_army_desc: Most generals of the [CZE.GetAdjective] army are veterans of the Czechoslovak Legion, which most prominently fought against the Soviets in their civil war. It will be necessary to ensure their loyalty to the new [CZE.GetAdjective] government.
loc.CZE_unlock_civil_war_army_generals_tt: Regain Commanders Lost in the Civil War
loc.CZE_recruit_ideologically_aligned_genera: It is time to adjust our training programs to enrich the army with new candidates that understand our new values.
loc.CZE_purge_two_random_commanders_tt: Two random commanders will be purged.
loc.CZE_czechoslovak_union_desc: Local autonomy must be increased in [CZE.GetNameDef], this will allow for the communist system to be adjusted to the local circumstances.
loc.CZE_continue_industrial_relocation_schem: For the sake of our national security, we must continue to relocate our more vulnerable factories to areas where they will be better protected from aerial and ground attacks. We cannot risk such a critical industry being put in harm's way.
§RThe factories will need to be rebuilt.§!
loc.CZE_establish_a_armament_factory_in_uher: Found the Uherský Brod Armament Factory

The Uherský Brod Factory is an armament factory that specializes in making and designing automatic weapons for infantry and aircraft. We plan on making it the most advanced factory of its kind in the world.
loc.CZE_appeal_to_the_castle_desc: The 'Castle' in Czechoslovakia refers to the extensive network of influential organizations and people that support its presidents. This power in turn allows the presidents to exert more influence than their limited constitutional duties would suggest. Appealing for support from this group would give an incredible boost to our bid for leadership.
loc.CZE_petition_the_nobles_desc: The noble class of [ROOT.GetNameDef] may no longer have recognized titles, but it is still an influential part of [ROOT.GetAdjective] society, their support would give us both the legitimacy and resources needed to gather further support.
loc.CZE_unify_the_fascist_parties_desc: The landscape of fascist parties is fractured, with many of them so extreme that they can never hope to gain significant support. In defense of the nation, it is necessary that these parties unify and create a vision of Czechoslovakia that appeals not just to the fringe elements of society.
loc.CZE_pro_rearmament_propaganda_desc: To increase support for a more centralized government, we must highlight the currently fragile situation in the world around us. This will also help motivate the populace to support plans to strengthen the army when necessary.
loc.CZE_align_nationalist_parties_desc: Although we should try to appeal to all [ROOT.GetAdjective]s, there is no denying that the traditional Czech nationalist parties are the most influential on the political scene, and it is with them that we can most easily gather support.
loc.CZE_align_slovak_catholics_desc: Catholic and nationalist parties currently have a lot of support in Slovakia. Although appealing to the nationalists would be difficult without serious concessions, we may be able to rally the Catholic elements to our cause.
loc.CZE_align_catholic_parties_desc: The ČSL and other catholic parties were the traditional support base for the monarchist system in the Austro-Hungarian empire, it is time that we try to sway them back to this position.
loc.CZE_restore_the_monarchy_desc: With support for a new system established, it is time we propose the refined idea to the people. With $CZE_karel_schwarzenberg$ as chosen monarch, we appeal both to the old supporters of the monarchy, and new ones since the he is [ROOT.GetAdjective], not an [AUS.GetAdjective] monarch as previously imposed on us.
loc.CZE_semi_constitutional_monarchy_desc: With a monarch now elected, it is time to adjust the constitution, while some advocate for centralizing power to avoid infighting in these troubled times, it is clear that the monarch can't do everything on his own. Therefore it may be best to partly keep the current system to assist in running the country, while also having the monarch there to guide the country.
loc.CZE_restore_noble_titles_desc: Previously disbanded when the republic was founded, it is time to reward the nobility's cooperation by restoring their titles. This will also allow us to bestow honorary titles on heroes such as veteran officers that fought again and again for the [ROOT.GetAdjective] state.
loc.CZE_restore_the_austro_hungarian_customs: One of the undeniable advantages of the Austro-Hungarian empire was the limited trade barriers for our industry, bringing this union back would be the first step to bring the other former constituent countries into our sphere.
loc.CZE_catholic_focus_desc: Despite the Hussites being a famous part of [ROOT.GetAdjective] history, many still have Catholic beliefs that we should appeal to by increasing their role in society.
loc.CZE_hussite_legacy_desc: The Hussites did not just promote a more Protestant style of Christianity, they also stood out for their tolerance of other opinions on the matter, unlike the tyrants who fought wars to oppose them.
loc.CZE_align_with_germany_desc: The new government in [GER.GetNameDef] may not necessarily be less expansionist, but they may prove more willing to be pragmatic in who they form alliances with and who they denounce. We should make an effort to be in the former group.
loc.CZE_rally_against_germany_desc: Czechoslovakians fought bravely for their independence, and we must now appeal to all people to protect this independence.
loc.CZE_integrate_sudeten_germans_desc: Division among the population of the Sudetenland is helping no one. We must aim to address their concerns and work on tackling them. That alone may disarm any independence figures, as their claims of mistreatment would be hard to believe.
loc.CZE_cooperate_with_the_sdp_desc: Although a destabilizing force, the SdP may fall in line if properly encouraged, like with inclusion in the ruling coalition.
loc.CZE_revive_the_december_bloc_desc: The December bloc of fascist, minority, and right-wing parties that opposed Edvard Benes becoming president should be restored to offer an alternative to the current government.
loc.CZE_revert_1926_anti_military_laws_desc: After a coup attempt by $CZE_radola_gajda$, the army and gendarmerie lost their right to vote, as well as certain other privileges. Given the army's crucial position in these trying times, it is only fair that we remove these restrictions and undo the divide between the army and politics.
loc.CZE_bop_to_fascism_support_tt: Add a third of the §Y$CZE_bop_army_readiness$§! value to fascism support:
loc.CZE_power_to_the_military_desc: It is clear that no resources can be spared in defense of the nation. This makes it critical that those in power understand the needs of the army, and there is no better way to ensure that than through a military government.
loc.CZE_militarize_the_associations_desc: The many associations of [CZE.GetNameDef] could contribute to the nation's defense by teaching skills that are essential for a soldier, even before the populace is mobilized.
loc.CZE_aggressive_foreign_policy_desc: The time of trusting fragile pacts is over, we must act decisively to safeguard our security, even if it takes serious sacrifices.
loc.CZE_work_with_germany_desc: With the Sudeten question settled, perhaps [GER.GetNameDef] could now recognize how valuable [ROOT.GetNameDef] would be as an ally.
loc.CZE_control_the_associations_desc: [CZE.GetNonIdeologyName] has many organizations, from people sharing the same job, to free time interests or sports associations, control these and you control much of society.
loc.CZE_diversify_bata_desc: Bat'a is a large consumer company that we could use to our benefit in our resource supply chain. They can help us by providing critical materials that are hard to come by otherwise.
loc.CZE_devaluate_the_koruna_desc: Having a strong currency is a dangerous economic position to be in as a country that relies on exports for a good portion of its economy. Weakening our currency may lead to short-term pain, but in the long run, we'll be better off having done so.
loc.CZE_continue_the_central_bohemia_plan_de: Continuing our plan of expanding the industrial areas in the center of our country would allow us to take advantage of economies of scale. Expanding our industry in a place away from our borders would also be wise from a national security perspective.
loc.CZE_balance_industrial_invevestments_des: Leaving out areas outside of [9.getname] and [75.getname] underdeveloped is one of the reasons our country started to get divided at the beginning of the decade. Growing areas on our country's exterior would help bridge the gap in industrial development between the two areas.
loc.CZE_expand_prf_science_facilities_desc: Prf's science facilities are filled with an army of bright individuals waiting for an opportunity to do something bigger than they're doing right now. Expanding the department and having them work with the government is a good start to improving our research.
loc.CZE_raise_more_industrial_funds_desc: From the time of Austria-Hungary to the present day, industry has been the heart of our nation. By providing essential budget and funding, it will continue to thrive in this troubled Europe.
loc.CZE_skoda_priority_focus_info_tt: Some §YNational Focuses§! will require us to be on a specific £GFX_CZE_skoda_text_icon §YŠkoda Priority§! Focus to complete. These Focuses are indicated with an small icon related to the required £GFX_CZE_skoda_text_icon §YŠkoda Priority§!.
loc.CZE_joint_stock_schemes_desc: Joint stock schemes have served as a source of economic growth when traditional funding sources were lacking. Continuing to leverage these tactics will lead to further growth in our economy.
loc.CZE_the_slovak_arrow_desc: Developing a fast railcar between two of our major cities would be a major source of national pride. It also would give us a good excuse to improve rail infrastructure.
loc.CZE_finish_double_tracking_efforts_desc: Finishing efforts to double-track some of our important secondary rail lines will allow us to have greater traffic throughput on those lines. Leading to better connectivity between some of our secondary cities.
loc.CZE_realize_motorway_proposals_desc: Some motorway proposals were presented to our government that would greatly improve the road connectivity within our borders. We should act upon these proposals and make them a reality.
loc.CZE_build_additional_rail_stations_desc: With our newly developed rail infrastructure, some of our existing rail stations cannot handle the increase in throughput. Improving them would greatly help our ability to get people and goods out to where they need to be at greater volume.
loc.CZE_build_additional_rail_stations_focus: Taking §Y$CZE_devaluate_the_koruna$§! will reduce the time this focus takes down to §G35§! days.
loc.CZE_grow_ckd_secondary_facilities_desc: CKD has a lot of smaller secondary plants that produce some important industrial products such as electrical generators. Expanding these plants would help the growth of our heavy industry.
loc.CZE_bolster_domestic_construction_desc: Our domestic construction sector has been steadily growing since we became independent after the end of the Great War. Providing additional investments to some of the medium-sized construction contractors would further strengthen this growth.
loc.CZE_invest_in_vhht_desc: The VHHT is a company that includes many different metalworking plants throughout our country. Investing and expanding them will help us improve many different areas of our metal production down the line.
loc.CZE_expand_vitkovice_ironworks_desc: The Vítkovické Ironworks is an important supplier of Iron within [74.getname]. Expanding it would greatly increase the output of the plant.
loc.CZE_expand_central_bohemian_mines_desc: The mines in the center of our country are the most important to our energy security. We must expand them as soon as possible.
loc.CZE_increase_bauxite_imports_desc: Our country might not be rich in aluminum, but by using certain refinery processes and increasing our imports of bauxite, we can produce a small amount of the resource here domestically. This would help relieve shortages of resources.
loc.CZE_merge_the_oil_companies_desc: Our oil companies can barely call themselves that. They are all smaller corporations that are built around a few wells. By merging them and bringing the oil industry under state control, we can achieve more with less
loc.CZE_expand_trinec_ironworks_desc: Trinec Steelworks has been a titan of industry in [72.getname] since its founding. Further investments would give us massive dividends in resource production.
loc.CZE_consolidate_mining_operations_desc: Our mining operations could be better optimized if the administration of these companies were combined to be more efficient. This would allow their research and efforts to expand existing mines to be more efficient.
loc.CZE_expand_praga_desc: Praga has been a source of various components for our military industry for years now. It's logical to reward them with additional contracts to help them grow further.
loc.CZE_shrink_educational_disparities_desc: Our rural areas have been lacking the proper education that is offered to their urban counterparts. We need to fight these disparities with major educational programs aimed at these areas.
loc.CZE_kickstart_rapid_rearmanent_desc: Many politicians and businesspeople may see it as a terrible decision, but we need to start rearmament now. The countries around us are not disarming, in fact they are doing the opposite, and it's an open secret. We need to prepare our army while we still have time.
loc.CZE_keep_focus_on_weapon_exports: Keep the Focus on Weapon Exports
loc.CZE_keep_focus_on_weapon_exports_desc: Our large weapon export industries are what got us out of our economic depression. Turning around that trend would be dangerous politically and economically. Staying the course is the best course of action at this time. Any threats to us are overblown anyway.
loc.CZE_force_the_industrialists_hand_desc: The industrialists and conglomerates have held back our ability to rearm effectively for too long. It's time we chose for them, for the sake of the nation.
loc.CZE_embrace_corporatism_desc: We could negotiate with the industrialists to get them to help restart our rearmament if we agree to some of their terms. Some policy changes to benefit them are more than reasonable and in our interests.
loc.CZE_expand_existing_armory_plants_desc: Moving some of our existing armory locations will be a costly investment with little long-term gain. Expanding our existing locations would provide the benefits and opportunities to expand production and research and development at these current locations. Even at the risk of them being in locations that are easier to attack by possible enemies.
loc.CZE_expand_skoda_offices_desc: Our international offices are what drive sales of our weapons. Expanding them to new locations is a sensible decision.
loc.CZE_complete_the_power_grid_desc: The power grid in our rural areas needs further work. It's fallen behind the rest of the country and is a hurdle in making more economic progress
loc.CZE_build_the_slapy_reservoir_desc: Building a Dam near Slapy would lead to greater power generation and economic opportunities in the area. The increase in power generation will greatly help in growing our industry in the region.
loc.CZE_diversify_refinery_processes_desc: Our wells would be able to produce a wide range of different oil byproducts. The only problem is that we lack the know-how to make it happen. If we invest research time into figuring out how, we'll be able to make this dream a reality.
loc.CZE_enlarge_smaller_wells_desc: Despite their size, our smaller wells can produce a lot more than the tiny amount of oil they currently produce. All we have to do is invest the time to make it happen.
loc.CZE_develop_sudetenland_resources_desc: The Sudetenland has a lot of resource deposits that we aren't currently tapping into. It would be a mistake not to invest in building more mines in the area.
loc.CZE_grow_tatras_capabilities_desc: Tatra's currently small tank department has some novel production designs. Giving them additional resources will allow them to continue to make advancements in armor design.
loc.CZE_bailout_moser_desc: Moser has fallen on hard times in the wake of the great depression. Their industries need to be bailed out, plants reopened, and people who were laid off put back to work.
loc.CZE_merge_skodas_consumer_good_plants_de: Škoda has a lot of smaller consumer goods plants in their portfolio that aren't centralized. It would help optimize their production in many areas of those plants. It could also have some positive effects for Škoda in general.
loc.CZE_giant_of_central_europe_industry_des: Heights previously thought impossible. We are now a titan of industry within Europe!
loc.CZE_continue_armed_force_reform_desc: By continuing to modernize our armed forces according to the planned schedule and reassigning military regions toward our provincial headquarters, we will achieve better coordination in any potential conflicts.
loc.CZE_air_force_officer_recruitment_desc: Aero clubs across the states, in collaboration with the Air Force Reserve Officers' School, meet the critical need for reserve officers by offering flying courses and live-fire exercises.
loc.CZE_national_defense_act_desc: This defense act encompasses all measures, whether military or otherwise, intended to counter any threat to or attack on the sovereignty, integrity, unity, and security of our nation, under the supervision of the Supreme Council of National Defence (NROS).
loc.CZE_car_and_oil_rationing_desc: Rationing private motor vehicles and requisitioning them as needed would allow us to focus automotive production and petroleum resources for military needs.
loc.CZE_expand_airfield_capacity_desc: The 3rd Department of Aviation has planned for new aerodromes and hangars to properly operate, store, and repair our aircraft, as well as dormitories for our recently established squadrons and ground crew.
loc.CZE_trust_in_old_guard_desc: The aerial skills and experience from the Great War will be passed on to the new generation by the veterans, in whom we place steadfast trust.
loc.CZE_expand_the_aero_clubs_desc: Aero clubs have proven their usefulness in providing a steady stream of talented pilots for our country; we should further expand them.
loc.CZE_invest_in_the_smaller_air_plants_des: Investing in new and smaller aircraft manufacturers introduces necessary rivalry to our established counterparts; they could assist in handling our broader production requirements.
loc.CZE_continue_avia_expansion_desc: Investing in Avia provides the additional hardware needed to further strengthen their production capacity; this could assist in achieving greater efficiency in producing airframes that are in high demand.
loc.CZE_increase_military_aeronautical_insti: By constructing additional facilities for Aerospace Research and Test Establishment (VZLÚ), it provides better insights into aerodynamics, further advancing and refining our aircraft design.
loc.CZE_air_training_abroad_desc: By sending trainees to the air branches of nations friendly towards us, we gain valuable insights from diverse perspectives and first-hand experience when they return to serve.
loc.CZE_establish_air_defense_zones_desc: We could allocate our new anti-aircraft batteries at key points and factories, and establish Air Defense Zones through communication nodes at the territorial level to optimize our anti-air accuracy.
loc.CZE_establish_air_defense_zones_tt: Static Anti Air hit chance factor: §G+10%§!
loc.CZE_the_air_is_our_sea_desc: Underneath systematic pilot training, empower our pilots to fly bravely and confidently, 'We have neither ocean ports nor ocean-going ships. The air is our sea.'
loc.CZE_bring_kramer_and_lobel_under_state_c: Bring Kramer & Löbl Under State Control
By nationalizing Kramer & Löbl, we could ensure continuous research and timely delivery of essential electrical supplies and radio accessories.
loc.CZE_second_to_none_desc: Our aircraft industries' plane designs are improving by the day. With further research, our designs will be second to none in the world!
loc.CZE_diversify_airframe_production_desc: We can't just rely on our fighters to get things done in the air. Other aircraft and larger airframes are needed to fulfill other mission types.
loc.CZE_projekt_l_52_desc: Jet engine technology is the future of military aircraft. The technology is still a bit rough at the moment, but if we take the time to develop a dedicated project and design an airframe purpose-built for it, we can stay ahead of the curve.
loc.CZE_fund_vladimir_mandl_research_desc: A lawyer by the name of $CZE_vladimir_mandl$ is fascinated with the idea of rocket technology. If we work with him and provide the resources he needs to turn his research into practical technology, we could greatly benefit from this partnership.
loc.CZE_mobilize_the_reserves_desc: The tension at our border is worsening. We must call up reservists and preselected military specialists in accordance with our mobilization cards.
loc.CZE_three_kings_desc: Aiding our resistance groups in an official capacity will greatly increase their ability to do damage to the army. It may also help our army in the field as well.
loc.CZE_form_the_state_defense_guard_desc: By establishing the SOS, we enable an organization specialized in protecting our lengthy borders. Since the members of the guard are militarily organized and trained, they will serve as the first line of defense against any border incursion.
loc.CZE_expand_the_horska_divisions_desc: As our country consists mostly of low hills and plateaus, our soldiers who are specially trained for mountain warfare will be crucial in those difficult terrains.
loc.CZE_develop_horska_artillery_desc: By modifying our current artillery to be lightweight and disassemblable, we will ensure our troops have sufficient firepower in mountainous and hilly terrains.
loc.CZE_develop_horska_artillery_tech_tt:
Enables §YHorská Artillery§!
§YArtillery (Mountains)§!
  Attack: §G+10%§!
  Movement: §G+10%§!
§YArtillery (Hills)§!
  Attack: §G+10%§!
  Movement: §G+10%§!
loc.CZE_bribery_investigations_desc: We have received an anonymous letter regarding the meals and treatment of soldiers. Some of the evidence points to improper conduct by certain quartermaster officers. We must put an end to this before it causes greater harm to our military.
loc.CZE_bribery_investigations_remove_effect: This national spirit will be removed upon completion of the focus '§Y$CZE_bribery_investigations$§!'
loc.CZE_opl_exercises_desc: By conducting anti-aircraft defense (OPL) drills, our army could practice maneuvering with improved coordination and preservation, thereby enhancing overall troop movements and security.
