loc.CZE_rapid_response_divisions_desc: Foreign military has demonstrated the impact of a mobile unit capable of repositioning more quickly than the enemy, highlighting its potential. We could establish similar units for evaluation.
loc.CZE_redouble_tank_development_efforts_de: Our current light tank design is improvable compared to those of other armor users in Europe. We must redouble our efforts to ensure we are on par with them.
loc.CZE_rearmed_and_retooled_desc: Our current heavier tank chassis shows capacity for modernization. We should continue to explore this direction to meet the future expansion of our armored corps.
loc.CZE_establish_the_fall_backlines_desc: We need to be realistic in the fact that in some places our defenses will break. If that happens, having ready-made fallback lines will be the difference between victory and defeat.
loc.CZE_anti_tank_development_desc: With more armies fielding larger and larger armored forces, improvements in our anti-tank guns are a must. Being able to deal with tanks with field pieces is the difference between holding the enemy back and them getting through.
loc.CZE_anti_tank_development_tech_tt:
Enables §YAnti-Tank Improvements§!
§YArtillery§! Piercing: §G+5%§!
§YSupport Artillery§! Piercing: §G+5%§!
§YAnti-Tank§! Piercing: §G+5%§!
§YSupport Anti-Tank§! Piercing: §G+5%§!
loc.CZE_recon_in_force_desc: Having our recon make contact with the enemy while probing their defenses is an invaluable way to gain intel.
loc.CZE_integrate_fortification_engineers_de: When our army fortification engineers are not spending time building static fortifications, we can quickly switch them to frontline duties to improve our defenses. This would aid frontline forces in making better temporary defense structures for our troops.
loc.CZE_concealment_efforts_desc: The widespread use of ground attack and reconnaissance planes has now made camo netting and other concealment tactics a necessity. We need to strengthen our efforts in making sure our troops are well camouflaged in the field.
loc.CZE_elevate_the_vsv_desc: Being the brain of the military is a tremendous national and state responsibility. Therefore, the service of the General Staff requires officers of the best qualities in terms of professional training as well as in terms of reliability, self-control, tact, and character.
loc.CZE_continue_with_snejdareks_plan_no_sne: Continue with the Static Defense Plan
loc.CZE_continue_with_snejdareks_plan_dynami: The conduct of an effective defense network prevents unexpected penetration by enemy troops. It provides protection and creates a strong base for transitioning from strategic defense to offense.
loc.CZE_go_with_vojcechovskys_plan_dynamic_d: The disadvantage of static defenses is that they cannot be maneuvered. Once breached, they can no longer be used for offensive purposes but only as remnants for the initial location.
loc.CZE_improve_the_current_officer_pool_des: We will promote personnel who have shown the capacity to be the backbone of our army, as they are essential in performing supervisory and coordination roles between higher commands and local units.
loc.CZE_elevate_slovak_officers_desc: We will focus on elevating Slovakians to ensure better representation within the ranks. By lowering some requirements for applicants from the Slovak districts, we anticipate improved cohesion within the army in the future.
loc.CZE_promote_moravec_writings_desc: Despite Moravec's works 'Soldiers and Time' and 'State Defense' provoking very contradictory reactions, his recently published 'Military Importance of our state in Central Europe' was discussed in the daily press across Europe. We must encourage him to continue his work as an unequivocal expert on issues of defense policy and military history.
loc.CZE_lessons_of_war_desc: With combat experience against a peer now under our belt, we can take these lessons and use them to improve our high command. There is no replacement for the lessons learned from real engagements with the army.
loc.CZE_lessons_of_war_i_had_war_with_major_: Was in a war with a Major Country
loc.CZE_for_the_homeland_desc: With our military fully prepared for the challenge ahead, we can now say with certainty that we are prepared to defend the homeland. We are ready for any task that lies before us.
loc.CZE_the_lions_roar_desc: The symbol of the Czechoslovakian Lion represents the best qualities of our army. Courage, power, and heroism of the highest degree. Everyone will know the unmatched spirit of our armed forces.
loc.CZE_diversify_our_specialists_desc: We need to diversify our specialists beyond the realm of Horska troops. War is fought in places other than mountains and hilltops.
loc.CZE_merge_the_financial_and_state_guard: Merge the Financial and State Guard
loc.CZE_merge_the_financial_and_state_guard_: With the formation of the State Defense Guard, the financial guards are no longer needed. Merging them into the State Defense Guard would help increase the strength of the SOS quickly.
loc.CZE_logistics_beyond_the_sudetes_desc: If we hope to conduct combat operations outside of the Sudetes Mountains, we need to learn about how long-distance logistics work. It's very different from operating in just our home area.
loc.CZE_logistics_beyond_the_sudetes_tt: Enables §YImproved Supply Dumps§!\n§YLogistics Company§!: Supply Usage: §G-10%§!
loc.CZE_expand_the_river_monitor_fleet_desc: Our river monitor fleet is one of the largest in Europe and helps our army with the defense of inland areas. Expanding it would greatly increase their ability to do this task.
loc.CZE_the_tvp_project_desc: Our army has proposed a General Use Tank (TVP) program to develop a domestic tank design. Some of our manufacturers, who have extensive experience in producing tanks, have shown interest in our project.
loc.CZE_expand_the_land_department_of_vtu: Expand the Land Department of VTÚ
loc.CZE_expand_the_land_department_of_vtu_de: By expanding the land department of the Military Technical Institute (VTÚ), they would gain additional hardware and proving grounds to bolster their research efforts for our future equipment.
loc.CZE_department_two_expansion_desc: Our intelligence wing, Department 2, needs more resources to better protect us from enemy spies. This could also lead to the expansion of specific wings within the agency.
loc.CZE_military_intelligence_desc: Military intelligence is one of the most important aspects of an intelligence agency. Allocating more resources to this area would yield significant benefits.
loc.CZE_air_intelligence_desc: Knowing the number of planes in an enemy air force is a critical component of winning the air war. Accurate information on the enemy's aerial forces is key when engaging them in the area.
loc.CZE_within_the_eagles_nest_desc: Having an army of informants and saboteurs just outside our doorstep would be a huge advantage for our military. With aid from Department 2, our spy networks in these locations could grow to be extensive.
loc.CZE_restart_naval_gun_production_desc: Škoda Works used to be the biggest naval gun designer and producer within the Austria-Hungarian Empire. Restarting production would create opportunities to revive domestic naval manufacturing.
loc.CZE_reform_the_naval_detachment_desc: The Naval Detachment was recently disbanded as it was deemed more suitable to be integrated into the army. However, recent events have made it so it's now a necessity to reform it.
loc.CZE_build_2_dockyards_when_we_have_coast: Will Instantly Build §G2§! §YNaval Dockyards§! in a random coastal §YState§! when one is controlled.
loc.CZE_skoda_naval_yards_desc: Now that we have access to the sea once more we can restart the old naval industries of the Austro-Hungarian Empire using the existing expertise still present within our borders. Getting domestic dockyards up and running should be a top priority.
loc.CZE_build_3_dockyards_when_we_have_coast: Will Instantly Build §G3§! §YNaval Dockyards§! in a random coastal §YState§! when one is controlled.
loc.CZE_legacy_of_the_kriegsmarine_desc: Having aided in the building of large battleships not so long ago, the ability to do so is very much possible. It's in the legacy of the same factories that helped build out the Austria-Hungarian Kriegsmarine.
loc.CZE_build_off_old_ganz_danubius_designs: Build off Old Ganz Danubius Designs
loc.CZE_build_off_old_ganz_danubius_designs_: Resurfacing designs from Ganz Danubius could prove useful in building new cruiser-class ships. People knowledgeable about these designs still live within our borders.
loc.CZE_modernize_trieste_designs_desc: By using old designs from the Austria-Hungarian Navy for smaller-sized battleships, we'll have better insight on how to build this class of ship.
loc.CZE_leverage_gunboat_experience_desc: Our experience with gunboat design can be leveraged for the making of destroyers. Our current expertise base would help speed up the design process.
loc.CZE_revive_kraljevica_designs_desc: By using our knowledge of gunboats, and by studying old Kraljevica designs. We can revive this class of destroyers for our nation.
loc.CZE_wolfs_of_bohemia_desc: Given the experience with submarines that still exist within our borders. It wouldn't be too hard to make wolfpacks of our own.
loc.CZE_raider_lineage_desc: We have a lineage of raiding from former officers who were in the Austria-Hungarian Navy. We should leverage that experience.
loc.CZE_a_modern_navy_desc: Now that we have made advances in our naval technologies, we can finally say that we have a modern and capable Navy.
loc.CZE_build_1_dockyards_when_we_have_coast: Will Instantly Build §G1§! §YNaval Dockyards§! in a random coastal §YState§! when one is controlled.
loc.CZE_naval_aviation_desc: Carriers and their planes seem to be the future of naval warfare. We need to invest time in these new areas of naval combat.
loc.CZE_across_the_atlantic_desc: A navy needs to reach out across the ocean to be effective. We need to make our Navy one that can move across long distances.
loc.CZE_joint_equipment_designs_desc: Both [ROOT.GetNameDef] and [GER.GetNameDef] are at the forefront of tank and plane design, each with our own specialties, we should seek to share information so we can keep focusing on what we do best.
loc.CZE_negotiate_sphere_of_influence_desc: It is undeniable that the military resources of [ROOT.GetNameDef] are of great value to the [GER.GetAdjective] alliance. It is only fair that we request some territorial gains in return.
loc.CZE_set_up_polish_puppet_state_desc: Since [GER.GetNameDef] is interested in establishing a puppet state in Poland, it is obvious that we should look into doing the same.
loc.CZE_usurp_the_mantle_desc: With our kingdom stretching from the Baltic Sea to the Adriatic and ruling over the lands of the historical regional powerhouse Austria, we can now proclaim to be the rightful successor to the Holy Roman Empire.
loc.CZE_austro_hungary_puppets: Every §Ysubject§! targeted by the focus requirement
loc.CZE_decrease_autonomy_tier: Every §Y$autonomy_dominion$§! or §Y$autonomy_puppet$§! subject will lose a level of autonomy.
loc.CZE_prepare_for_exile_desc: The state should covertly assist the efforts of our political leaders to escape abroad and set up a government in exile.
loc.CZE_administrative_chaos_tt: Effect §Yfor the Reichskommissariat§! when §Y$CZE_enter_exile$§! is Completed:
loc.CZE_infiltrate_collaborationist_organiza: [ROOT.GetAdjective]s loyal to the government-in-exile being installed to lead collaborationist organizations may sound odd, but it is the perfect way to undermine and stay informed of their activities.
loc.CZE_enter_exile_desc: With potential allies now finally fighting the [GER.GetAdjective] alligator, our government can prepare and fight for a return of our sovereignty.
loc.CZE_contact_the_czech_and_slovak_legion: Contact the Czech and Slovak Legion
loc.CZE_contact_the_czech_and_slovak_legion_: Brave [ROOT.GetAdjective]s have escaped to [POL.GetNameDef] and [FRA.GetNameDef] to continue the fight for a free [CZE.GetName], we should contact these forces and coordinate them.
loc.GER_integrate_czech_manufacturers_desc: The industry located in Bohemia is a goldmine of manufacturing expertise and industrial resources for our economy. The additional industrial power that Bohemia Manufacturers would add would be a huge boost to our armament industry. It makes perfect sense to integrate them into our production lines.
loc.CZE_national_bank_of_czechoslovakia_desc: NBCS, shorthand for the 'National Bank of Czechoslovakia.'

loc.CZE_walter_co_desc: Walter Co, an informal shorthand name derived from the unwieldy full title of the Company: 'Walter Joint Stock Company, Automobile and Aircraft engine factory.'
loc.CZE_anglo_czechoslovak_bank_desc: Born from the merger of three other Prague based banks in 1930. It's currently the second largest bank in the country.
loc.CZE_ceskoslovenska_armada_dynamic_modifi: The Armada was built from the ashes of Austro-Hungarian Czech Units and the Veterans of the Czechoslovak Legion. The legacy of both still influence how the Armada is run.
loc.CZE_ceskoslovenske_letectvo_dynamic_modi: The planes might not always be ready, but our pilots always are. With possible aerial threats from all sides, we must make the air our sea. Every single pilot must count as if they're three.
loc.CZE_a_divided_nation_dynamic_modifier_de: The [CZE.GetAdjective] state has stood alone in Central Europe as a pluralist state that has protected all within her borders. However, the Great Depression has changed that. Economic hardships have caused resentment to build up against the government from various movements within the country. These resentments are now deeply dividing the nation.
loc.CZE_skoda_works_dynamic_modifier_desc: The Škoda company contains production, construction, and investments in all sectors of our Heavy Industry. Its reach knows no bounds within our borders.
loc.CZE_sudetenland_german_state_modifier_de: Recent economic hardships have befallen industry within the Sudetenland. This has caused the people living in the region to blame the [ROOT.getname] government for their recent misfortunes.
loc.CZE_czech_state_modifier_desc: The fast economic development of the 20th century has been taxing a largely agrarian Czech population. The ability to fill positions with skilled and qualified labor with Czech workers is hard. Efforts must be made to help to prepare young Czech citizens for the changing needs of a modern economy.
loc.CZE_sudetenland_paramilitaries_modifier_: Sudetenland partisans and paramilitaries are currently undermining our forces in this region. They are actively attacking our troops and collaborating with our enemies.
loc.CZE_taticek_of_czechoslovakia_desc: Tomáš Masaryk, often called 'Tatíček Masaryk', meaning 'daddy' or 'father' (of the nation), has been a bedrock of the Czechoslovak nation since its founding. When coalitions were thought impossible to build and political impasses too big to overcome, Masaryk, time after time, was able to pull off political miracles to help strengthen and grow Czechoslovakia. Even in retirement, his sentiments and suggestions to the political leadership are taken more as orders than advice.
loc.CZE_industrialists_veto_desc: The industrialists wield considerable influence over the country's politics, as they stand at the head of many of [CZE.GetNameDef]'s largest conglomerates. Their concerns cannot be ignored in matters of economic policy, and economic mobilization is among the measures they would most fiercely resist.
loc.CZE_agrarian_politics_1_desc: Despite our country's industrial nature, farmers and rural peasants have considerable political sway in many political parties. Their sentiment often influences economic policy decisions, and are a constant political hurdle in making further industrial progress.
loc.CZE_directorate_of_fortification_works_n: The $CZE_directorate_of_fortification_works_no_gd_idea$, better known as the ROP. Is the management entity in charge of overseeing fortification efforts in the country.
loc.CZE_army_readiness_1_desc: An army's readiness isn't all about men and equipment in the field. Having confidence in your preparations, and backing of the country's political and industrial leaders matters when facing down threats. Having the means to fight is one thing, the ability to do so effectively is another.
loc.CZE_army_readiness_3_desc: An army's readiness isn't all about men and equipment in the field. Having confidence in your preparations, and backing of the country's political and industrial leaders matters when facing down threats. Having the means to fight is one thing, the ability to do so effectively is another.
loc.CZE_sudeten_german_quandary_desc: While a majority of people living in the Sudetenland just want greater autonomy under the existing government, many Sudeten political parties and their supporters could quickly become a fifth column if a German state sought to annex any part of the region.
loc.CZE_sudeten_german_quandary_modifier_tt:

If §Y[AUS.GetFlag][AUS.GetNonIdeologyName]§!, §Y[GER.GetFlag][GER.GetNonIdeologyName]§!, or any other [BAY.GetFlag]§YGerman Country§! that borders us justifies or gains a §RWar Goal§! on us while either §Y[69.GetName]§!, §Y[972.GetName]§! or §Y[74.GetName]§! are controlled by us:

loc.CZE_sudeten_challenge_desc: Recent activity by Sudetenland Paramilitaries within the Sudetenland has made many in the international community believe that the current aggressive actions against us is justified! It'll take time to convince the world otherwise.
loc.CZE_sudeten_facde_desc: By not backing local Paramilitaries our justifications for our actions against [CZE.getname] are now seen as a facade throughout the world.
loc.CZE_rural_education_efforts_modifier_tt: When the §YNational Spirit§! is §Yremoved§!:\nGain §G1§! Research Slot.
loc.CZE_joint_stock_schemes_idea_aat_desc: Joint Stock Schemes is a common method that many Czech Companies use to keep growing in the face of political or fiscal shortfalls.
loc.CZE_kramer_and_lobel_research: Kramer and Löbl Research and Development
loc.CZE_semi_constitutional_constitution_des: The new constitution of [ROOT.GetNameDef] ensures a divide between the democratic side of the government representing the people, and the options for intervention by the monarch to safeguard stability.
loc.CZE_widespread_protests_desc: Widespread protests have broken out over our decision to surrender the Sudetenland. The protesters have been chanting: 'give us [ROOT.getleader] or give us arms.'
loc.CZE_federalization_agreement_1_desc: Federalising our Nation has some benefits among the obvious drawbacks.
loc.CZE_mil_access_debuff_cancels_after_mont: §YThis idea will cancel 30 days after military access is ended.\n§!
loc.CZE_back_against_the_mountains_RUT_desc: No one in the international community will come to [ROOT.getname] aid in a time of war.
loc.CZE_integrate_czech_manufacturers_GER_id: With the massive industry that is contained within Bohemia now under our control, our manufacturers will greatly benefit from the additional industrial resources they bring to our armament industry.
loc.CZE_pfot_fortification_destruction_resea: Dismantling this fortification line has given us the chance to experiment with novel ways to penetrate and destroy advanced fortifications.
loc.CZE_sokolov_raid_pfot_limited_success_ns: A carefully planned strike at the fort line in Falknov have rendered the [CZE.GetAdjective]s vulnerable to our attacks. Now is a great time for us to launch a offensive.
loc.CZE_the_fall_of_the_republic_warning_tt: §RMaking this choice will have disastrous political consequences for our Nation. The effects of which we can't even begin to foresee.§!
loc.CZE_the_fall_of_the_republic_warning_mun: §RDeciding to Surrender the Sudetenland will have disastrous political consequences for our Nation. But what choice do we have?§!

loc.d_add_fake_armies_DESC: Creates fake intel armies for the player
loc.BALTIC_entente_desc: We Balts share a brotherhood, characterised by our long history of suffering under foreign imperialism. We cannot bend to foreign powers again, to do so would be handing over the keys to our sovereignty to yet another imperialistic power. Only by banding together can we hope to keep our independence.
loc.formalize_the_entente_desc: We have been hesitant to declare the Baltic Entente as a faction proper, but we feel confident that we have gained enough members to stand on our own against the rising imperialism on our borders.
loc.abandon_the_entente_desc: This was a foolish enterprise. As much as we would like it to be possible, the Baltics standing alone is simply not a viable option for survival. We must cave to a foreign power, whoever it may be.
loc.baltic_entente_leader_flag: Is the leader of the Baltic Entente.\n
loc.baltic_entente_flag: Has agreed to join the Baltic Entente
loc.convert_neighbours_baltic_cat_desc: The revolution has been a resounding success here in [Root.GetNameDef], all that remains now is to spread the word of the revolution to our fellow Baltic brothers. The workers of the Baltic will be liberated from their bourgeois oppressors by their own hands, but some [Root.GetAdjective] assistance will help them on their way.
loc.BALTIC_promote_communism_desc: Many of [From.Owner.GetNameDef]’s peasantry still see socialism as the enemy to their way of life. Although we may never heal the scars that the Red Army left behind, we may convince them that our flavour of revolution is not so bloody.
loc.BALTIC_promote_communism_militancy_desc: Socialist fervor burns so brightly in the hearts of many [From.Owner.GetAdjective] workers, they need only support from an outside force to begin making steps to topple the dictatorship.
loc.infiltrate_belarus_decisions_desc: The USSR claims to represent the interest of the Belarussian lower classes, but the Baltic socialists claim this to be pure posturing. They claim that [SOV.GetLeader] is a bourgeois dictator in every sense of the word, and it is only by arming the people of Belarus that they may truly be liberated in a socialist state.
loc.BALTIC_promote_unity_BLR_desc: When the Belarussian civil war breaks out, all states must decide individually which side of the revolution they favour. We must ensure that [From.GetName] is on the winning side.
loc.BALTIC_belarus_uprising_desc: The Belarussian people are being torn asunder, half of the nation wishing to remain as part of [SOV.GetNameDef], and the other half wishing to defect to the Baltics.
loc.support_polish_falange_decisions_desc: Fascism has succeeded in Lithuania and we see no reason why we should abandon our former brothers in Poland. By spreading Falangist thought amongst its populace, we may be able to empower [POL.GetFascistParty] and from there we may work to assert Polish-Lithuanian supremacy across the continent.
loc.LIT_promote_fascism_desc: For decades, fascism has been pushed into the fringes of Polish politics. While we would love for the Poles to rise up for themselves, they scarcely stand a chance if we do not openly promote fascism in their nation.
loc.LIT_promote_falange_militancy_desc: The [POL.GetFascistParty] is infamous for its riotous and violent methods of demonstration. Many fascists fear the nationalist fervor of [POL.GetFascistParty], but we know this is a mere expression of the patriotism that burns in their hearts that must be supported.
loc.LIT_ignite_civil_war_in_POL_desc: The preparations have been made. Poland will soon be a battleground not just of ideas but of valour and glory. We have done all we can to support the Falangists in Poland, all we need do now is cast the die and hope that God truly is on their side.
loc.LIT_adopt_the_dobuzhinsky_flag_design_de: The colors of our flag must match those of the coat of arms. No green color is present in the coat of arms, and as such it should not be present in the flag either. Thus we should adopt the proposal handed to us by Mstislav Dobuzhinsky and Vydūnas.
loc.march_through_estonia_desc: The weak government of Konstantin Päts has silenced the cry of Estonia’s patriots for long enough. We lack the manpower to fight the Estonian armed forces alone, but perhaps by demonstrating our frustration with the dictatorship in a series of marches throughout the country, we may remind the youth of Estonia that their fathers fought for a good life for them that Päts and his cabal are denying them.
loc.EST_stomp_the_vaps_desc: [EST.GetLeader] knows that we seek to disrupt [EST.GetLeader.GetHerHis] regime and [EST.GetLeader.GetSheHe] is making preparations to crackdown on us and bring an end to our marches. If we do not succeed in toppling the government before then, Estonia faces a civil war!
loc.EST_convert_FIN_cat_desc: The [FIN.GetFascistParty] have long had close connections with the [EST.GetFascistParty] and now that we have claimed dominion over our own nation, we must empower the Finnish veterans to take over theirs.
loc.EST_march_in_FIN_capital_desc: Once we feel the veterans of Finland have been emboldened enough, we need only give the signal to march on [FROM.GetName] and the Fins will at last be empowered under fascism.
loc.promote_baltic_fascism_cat_desc: The Baltic is characterised by its weak infantile regimes incapable of representing the blood of the Balts that flows through the veins of their people. Lithuania, Estonia, and even some in Poland must be reminded of the glory of their ancestors who stood against the Germanics and Slavs who now once again seek to oppress us.
loc.LAT_promote_fascism_desc: Many individuals in [From.Owner.GetNameDef] have not yet accepted that their [From.Owner.GetFascistParty] party is the only way that the [From.Owner.GetAdjective] people may at last rule themselves. This must be corrected with propaganda efforts, and active support of the [From.Owner.GetFascistParty] party.
loc.LAT_promote_falange_militancy_desc: There are those in [From.Owner.GetNameDef] who hold the fury of the Balts in their hearts, and it is our duty to give them the military and political support they deserve.
loc.LAT_ignite_civil_war_in_target_desc: Propaganda can only achieve so much, sometimes direct action is required to bring strength and stability to the state. We have done all we can, now we leave [From.Owner.GetFascistParty] to their own fate.
loc.LIT_iron_wolf_coup_desc: The followers of Augustinas Voldemaras are organizing a rebellion within our nation. If nothing is done to circumvent the Iron Wolf, we risk falling into a civil war. We must decide if we are to grant concessions to the Iron Wolf partisans and risk empowering them or if we simply banish their leader from our nation, leaving his followers scattered and without the strong leadership they claim to have.
loc.LIT_iron_wolf_partisans_desc: The Iron Wolf are organizing in our nation. Over time, they will inevitably increase their support among the Lithuanian people and may eventually feel emboldened to commit a coup on the government.
loc.LIT_iron_wolf_appeasement_desc: We must make efforts to disrupt the activities of the Iron Wolf in our nation. Though none of these measures will stamp them out completely, we may be able to delay their efforts long enough to find a permanent solution.
loc.LIT_relocate_iron_wolf_recruitment_desc: The Iron Wolf rely on local recruiters to bring new men into their ranks. By forcefully relocating these recruiters, we will confuse any would-be followers and potentially prevent their entry into the Iron Wolf group.
loc.LIT_promote_alternative_paramilitaries_d: While we would wish our citizens to join the official Lithuanian military, it is inevitable that some would rather owe their allegiance to a group divorced from the government. Perhaps by promoting other groups like the Lithuanian Riflemen’s Union, we may detract some nationalists from joining the Iron Wolf.
loc.LIT_grant_concessions_to_iron_wolf: Offer Concessions to the Iron Wolf
loc.LIT_grant_concessions_to_iron_wolf_desc: Perhaps by offering some symbolic gestures to the Iron Wolf, we may be able to quell their agitation somewhat.
loc.EST_vaps_revolt_category_desc: A series of veteran’s societies throughout Estonia have organized into a single fascist entity known as the Vaps Movement which threatens to overthrow the government. We must take action to curb this rise in Estonian nationalism if we are to maintain the regime in peace.
loc.EST_vaps_uprising_desc: The Vaps continue to march and demonstrate throughout Estonia despite being an illegal organization. The longer we leave this group of nationalists to fester, the more we risk others joining their cause.
loc.EST_vaps_crackdown_desc: We are coordinating a total crackdown on all societies associated with the Vaps Movement. If the Vaps remain on the political fringes, the crackdown should be trivial, but if they have gathered enough support, the result of our crackdown may be a bloody civil war with some of Estonia’s oldest veterans.
loc.EST_fight_vaps_decisions_desc: The Vaps Movement must be countered if our crackdown is to be successful. Actions that disrupt the Vaps will drastically decrease their influence in our nation and will make their forceful removal all the smoother.
loc.EST_divide_veterans_societies_desc: The Vaps are primarily comprised of those who fought in the Estonian War of Independence, and though it is sad to see our heroes fall under the sway of ultranationalism, we must break up and divide the veteran’s societies that the Vaps have united.
loc.EST_disrupt_vaps_recruitment_desc: Though the Vaps are traditionally veterans ranging from middle age to elderly, they are not short of young sympathisers seeking to join in the name of their fathers and grandfathers. We must find ways to disrupt this recruitment and keep these young men away from the siren song of fascism.
loc.EST_crackdown_on_vaps_desc: The Vaps are growing far too bold, we must conduct a raid on their members if we are to stamp out some of their growing influence.
loc.EST_put_vaps_leaders_on_trial_desc: It is no secret that some members of the government hold sympathies for the Vaps movement. This cannot be allowed to continue; members of our military staff must be tried as traitors for their association with the Vaps.
loc.EST_launch_vaps_investigation_desc: We must dedicate sections of our secret services to infiltrate and shut down Vaps efforts to subvert the government.
loc.EST_anti_vaps_propaganda_desc: We tow the line when promoting anti-fascism in our nation. Many opposed to fascism are democrats and communists, but perhaps they may be convinced to support the dictatorship in our joint-effort to curb the rise of fascism.
loc.EST_delay_the_crackdown_desc: Although we would prefer that the Vaps be dealt with expediently, we cannot risk throwing the country into disarray and the crackdown must be postponed.
loc.EST_vapsid_takeover: A Vapsid government is already ruling the country
loc.LAT_perkonkrust_revolt_category_desc: Ultranationalists glorifying the Baltic tribes and the Latvian ethnicity, the Pērkonkrusts are an existential threat to the Latvia we have fought hard to create. The Pērkonkrusts are an infection on a wounded national pride and must be eliminated.
loc.LAT_perkonkrust_uprising_desc: Over time, the Pērkonkrusts will gather support throughout the country, and if left unchecked, they will feel emboldened to attempt a coup on the government.
loc.LAT_delay_perkonkrust_decisions_desc: Though not a permanent solution, we may enact some campaigns to reduce fascist support in our nation long enough for the Pērkonkrusts to be dealt with, one way or another.
loc.LAT_equality_campaigns_desc: The Pērkonkrusts are opposed to [Root.GetLeader]’s mission to create a Latvia where the sun shines equally over all Latvians, and as such we must make it clear that supporting their supremacist narrative opposes the core values of our nation.
loc.LAT_empower_democrats_desc: Though undesirable, the democrats are vocal opponents of the Pērkonkrusts and pose a much smaller threat to our nation. This will increase support for the democratic opposition, but we must do everything we can to curb the activities of the Pērkonkrusts.
loc.LAT_support_loyalists_desc: By annexing sectors of the opposition, we will be more empowered to push the Pērkonkrusts into the political fringes of our society.
loc.BALTIC_forest_brother_resistance_cat_des: Socialism has not entirely been embraced by everyone in our nation, and none are so vocal and active in their distaste for the new [Root.GetNonIdeologyName] than the Forest Brothers. Staunch supporters of [Root.GetAdjective] nationalism, the Forest Brothers reject all foreign influence in [Root.GetNonIdeologyName] and seek to remove the communist party from power in favour of a more nationalistic government.
loc.BALTIC_forest_brothers_resistance_desc: The Forest Brothers are preparing to commit acts of treason within our nation. We do not yet know what they will do, but we know that it will of course be actively disruptive towards our goal of spreading socialism throughout the country.
loc.POL_purchase_madagascar_desc: Madagascar is an alien landscape, full of flora and fauna unfamiliar to Poles. Although many would see this as making the island inhospitable to Poles, some could see it as an opportunity to live somewhere entirely new. The size of the island and the potential raw resources there makes it an ideal destination to host a Polish government in exile, should it ever come to that.
loc.POL_purchase_gambia_desc: Centuries ago, the Duchy of Courland attempted to colonize [701.GetName] on behalf of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth. Despite good relations with the locals, they were forced out by foreign powers. It is time this was corrected.
loc.POL_purchase_cheap_colony_desc: There has been growing Polish interest in [FROM.GetName]. Although these interests are outside of the purview of the government, their enthusiasm could be used as justification for a Polish purchase of the region.
loc.POL_anti_capitalist_decisions_desc: Capitalism is a disease upon the Earth. Although many of these nations call themselves "Democratic", they merely enslave the proletariat in bourgeois democracy, and it is the duty of any socialist to liberate their comrades.
loc.POL_anti_fascist_revolution_category_des: Fascists have taken the language of the proletariat struggle against the bourgeois to create ultranationalist dictatorships which continue the brutal oppression of the working class. As a socialist state, we must liberate the workers of the world from the terror of fascism.
loc.POL_support_monarchy_in_LIT_cat_desc: With [Root.GetLeader] now sitting on the [Root.GetAdjective] throne, we have the divine right to claim [Root.GetRoyalClaim] as a rightful part of our nation.\n\nOur current claim strength is [Root.GetPolRoyalClaimStrength]
loc.POL_fight_against_monarchy_in_LIT_cat_de: A foreign agent is attempting to claim the [Root.GetAdjective] throne by seeking out internal support within our government. If we can keep popular and internal support low, we may be able to subvert the question of their claim entirely.\n\nThe current claim strength is [Root.GetPolRoyalClaimStrength]
loc.POL_cossack_republic_decisions_desc: During the Russian Civil War, several nations of independent cossack hosts were established, fighting alongside the Whites. With the White exiles now pushing deep into Russian territory, we have the opportunity to revive the fallen republics.
loc.POL_restore_don_cossacks_desc: Fierce opponents of Bolshevism, the Don Cossacks fought alongside the Whites in the Russian civil war. With all of their territory now under our possession, we can invite the Don exiles to resettle these lands and fight alongside their comrades.
loc.POL_restore_kuban_cossacks_desc: The betrayal of the Kuban cossacks was a major turning point for the Russian civil war that secured defeat for the Whites. This time, we shall ensure that the Kubans are lead by a government that will remain loyal.
loc.POL_escelate_the_strike_desc: Debug decision to quickly advance the Peasants' Strike by one stage. This decision should not be visible unless debug mode is active.
loc.POL_expand_strikes_to_factories_tt: Allows us to bring industrialized states into the strike.
loc.POL_sanacja_falanga_decisions_desc: The National-Democrats and the Falangists have taken great influence within the Second Polish Republic. By granting concessions and holding nationwide demonstrations, fascist influence can expand exponentially within the Polish government and among the population.
loc.form_turkestan_category_desc: Throughout our history, the Turkic peoples have been united and divided countless times. If we can bring the entire Central Asian region under our control, we will be able to reclaim the legacy of the great Turkic Khans before us and unite our people into one nation!
loc.POL_promote_falangism_decisions_desc: War with the Germans is on the horizon, and though we are outgunned, [GER.GetLeader] cannot hope to eliminate all of [GER.GetLeader.GerHerHis] enemies at once! With proper falangist support among the people, the good Catholic nations of the world may join us in our struggle against [GER.GetNameDef].

loc.SOV_propaganda_hit_of_hammer: Every Hit of a Hammer Hits the Enemy!
loc.SOV_propaganda_transport: Transport is the Sibling of the Red Army
loc.SOV_propaganda_high_yield: We will Accomplish a High Yield
loc.SOV_propaganda_anti_fascism: Greetings to the Fighters Against Fascism
loc.SOV_propaganda_treacherous_enemy: The Enemy is Treacherous, Stay Alert!
loc.SOV_propaganda_knowledge: Knowledge Breaks the Chains of Slavery
loc.SOV_propaganda_happy_life: You will Live a Happy Life!
loc.SOV_propaganda_campaign_cooldown_tt: This campaign will be available again §Y[?ROOT.SOV_default_propaganda_campaign_cooldown] days§! after its removal. Cost will be multiplied by §R[?ROOT.SOV_propaganda_cost_increase]§!.
loc.SOV_propaganda_builders_of_communism_eff: Every Soviet puppet gains '§Y$SOV_young_builders_of_communism$§!' which grants (Research Speed: §G+1.00%§!, Master Ideology Drift: §G+0.25§!) for §Y[?SOV_default_propaganda_campaign_duration]§! days.
loc.SOV_punished_for_breaking_flag: Has entered a war while this campaign was active. §RBreaking this will cause instability and lock this propaganda campaign forever.§!
loc.SOV_propaganda_more_metal_tt: Providing §G+1§! §Y$state_resource_aluminium$§!, §Y$state_resource_tungsten$§!, §Y$state_resource_steel$§! or §Y$state_resource_chromium$§! for each state producing any of those resources.
loc.SOV_propaganda_death_to_invaders_no_inva: Every core state controlled by an enemy: \n   Add Modifier: §Y$SOV_invaders_must_die$§!
loc.SOV_propaganda_anti_fascism_tt: Gains '§Y$SOV_anti_fascist_campaign_generic$§!' against the §Ymost industrialized fascist country in the world§!, which grants (Attack bonus against country: §G+10.0%§!, Defense bonus against country: §G+10.0%§!) for §Y[?SOV_default_propaganda_campaign_duration]§! days.
loc.SOV_propaganda_anti_capitalism_tt: Gains '§Y$SOV_anti_capitalist_campaign_generic$§!' against the §Ymost industrialized democratic country in the world§!, which grants (Attack bonus against country: §G+10.0%§!, Defense bonus against country: §G+10.0%§!) for §Y[?SOV_default_propaganda_campaign_duration]§! days.
loc.SOV_propaganda_victory_at_hand_available: [ROOT.GetFlag][ROOT.GetNameDefCap] is at war with the major power that disrupted the Third Five Year Plan.
loc.SOV_propaganda_heroes_forward_tt: Up to §Y5 Unit Leaders§! will gain the trait §Y$trait_SOV_determined$§! for §Y[?SOV_default_propaganda_campaign_duration]§! days
loc.SOV_paranoia_system_desc: An atmosphere of suspicion and mistrust hangs over [ROOT.GetNameDef]. [ROOT.GetLeader]'s concerns about factionalism within the party grow as countless accusations and alleged acts of sabotage, wreckage and espionage are being investigated by the NKVD.
loc.SOV_paranoia_bg_tooltip:
If £SOV_paranoia_text_icon §YParanoia§! value increases over §Y25§!, random purge events may occur. 
The higher the £SOV_paranoia_text_icon §YParanoia§!, and the more days it has been that high, the more likely it is for a purge to happen. 
If £SOV_paranoia_text_icon §YParanoia§! value increases over §R75§!, great purge events may occur. 

Certain §Yfocus§!, §Ydecision§! and §Yeffects§! will make £SOV_paranoia_text_icon §YParanoia§! immediately increase/decrease, and certain advisor and country leader traits will slowly increase §YParanoia§! over time. 

Completing the focus §Y[GetAppropriateLastPurgeFocusName]§! will remove the £SOV_paranoia_text_icon §YParanoia§! system.
loc.SOV_paranoia_text_tooltip_not_active: Political Paranoia is no longer active.
loc.SOV_paranoia_increase_based_on_unit_lead: £SOV_paranoia_text_icon Political Paranoia increases based on the level of the unit leader/s not purged: §R[?SOV_unit_leader_level]§!
loc.SOV_paranoia_decrease_based_on_unit_lead: £SOV_paranoia_text_icon Political Paranoia decreases based on the level of the unit leader/s purged: §G[?SOV_unit_leader_level]§!
loc.SOV_daunt_generals_tt: Up to 5 army leaders will get the trait §YCowed by Stalin§!:\n- Division Recovery Rate: §R-10.0%§! \n- Reinforce Rate: §R-2.0%§!
loc.SOV_daunt_generals_minor_tt: Up to 2 army leaders will get the trait §YCowed by Stalin§!:\n- Division Recovery Rate: §R-10.0%§! \n- Reinforce Rate: §R-2.0%§!
loc.SOV_daunt_admirals_tt: Up to 5 navy leaders will get the trait §YCowed by Stalin§!:\n- Retreat Decision Chance: §R-25%§!
loc.SOV_daunt_admirals_minor_tt: Up to 5 navy leaders will get the trait §YCowed by Stalin§!:\n- Retreat Decision Chance: §R-25%§!
loc.SOV_forge_production_reports_desc: Our latest production reports have been slightly concerning. We do not know if the expected figures have not been achieved due to the action of saboteurs or due to a setting of unrealistic quotas. What is clear is that if we want to avoid a new campaign of terror by the NKVD, we had better adjust the production figures to be acceptable.
loc.SOV_inspection_in_the_administration_des: We will carry out an inspection of the local and central administrations to find potential dissidents and saboteurs.
loc.SOV_inspection_in_the_army_desc: We must allow the NKVD to carry out an inspection in the Army to find potential dissidents and saboteurs.
loc.SOV_inspection_in_the_navy_desc: We must allow the NKVD to carry out an inspection in the Navy to find potential dissidents and saboteurs.
loc.SOV_inspection_in_the_airforce_desc: We must allow the NKVD to carry out an inspection in the Air Force to find potential dissidents and saboteurs.
loc.SOV_paranoia_administration_purgeable_tt: Suspicious affairs in the administration can be investigated
loc.SOV_paranoia_army_purgeable_tt: Suspicious affairs in the army can be investigated
loc.SOV_paranoia_navy_purgeable_tt: Suspicious affairs in the navy can be investigated
loc.SOV_paranoia_airforce_purgeable_tt: Suspicious affairs in the air force can be investigated
loc.SOV_paranoia_inspection_cd_tt: \nThis decision will be available again in §Y[?SOV_paranoia_inspection_re_enable_days] days§!.
loc.SOV_paranoia_calm_down_stalin_cd_tt: \nThis decision will be available again in §Y[?SOV_paranoia_calm_down_stalin_re_enable_days] days§!.
loc.SOV_loosen_prohibitions_in_military_acad: We will loosen restrictions on research and consultation documents in our military academies so that our young officers have a wider range of learning sources to develop their skills in a less oppressive environment.
loc.SOV_reinforce_army_officer_ranks_with_ve: We will reinforce our decimated officer ranks in the Army with hardened and talented veterans.
loc.SOV_reinforce_navy_officer_ranks_with_ve: We will reinforce our decimated officer ranks in the Navy with hardened and talented veterans.
loc.SOV_reinstate_mig_design_bureau_desc: We will reinstate this Aircraft Designer and rehabilitate all engineers and designers not linked to any evidence of sabotage or anti-Soviet conduct.
loc.SOV_mig_design_bureau_dissolved_days_tt: Current days since Bureau was dissolved: [?SOV_mig_design_bureau_dissolved_flag:days|Y0]
loc.SOV_ilyushin_design_bureau_dissolved_day: Current days since Bureau was dissolved: [?SOV_ilyushin_design_bureau_dissolved_flag:days|Y0]

loc.SOV_tupolev_design_bureau_dissolved_days: Current days since Bureau was dissolved: [?SOV_tupolev_design_bureau_dissolved_flag:days|Y0]

loc.decision_cost_CP_50_pp_50_NavXP_50_toolt: It costs £command_power  §Y50§! £pol_power  §Y50§! £navy_experience  §Y50§! to take the decision
loc.SOV_gosproyektstroy_bring_foreign_expert: We will sign an agreement with major [FROM.GetAdjective] industrial entities to bring in expert engineers and architects from [FROM.GetNameDef] to act as consultants for our industrial projects.
loc.SOV_gosproyektstroy_focus_civ_desc: During our large-scale industrial modernization we will prioritize the upgrade of our civilian heavy and light industry.
loc.SOV_gosproyektstroy_focus_mil_desc: During our large-scale industrial modernization we will focus on achieving greater efficiency in military production.
loc.SOV_gosproyektstroy_focus_dock_desc: During our large-scale industrial modernization we will focus on achieving greater efficiency in naval production.
loc.SOV_gosproyektstroy_upgrade_in_progress_: Is currently working on an upgrade for Gosproyektstroy
loc.SOV_generic_industry_relocation_desc: Evacuating the heavy machinery of our [FROM.GetName] factories to the Urals is a huge undertaking, but it is necessary to secure our war production.
loc.SOV_industry_relocation_complete_effect_: Up to §Y4 Military or Civilian Factories§! will be removed from §Y[FROM.GetName]§!.\n
loc.SOV_industry_relocation_remove_effect_tt: Removed factories will be relocated in a state in the Urals.
loc.SOV_relocate_industry_repair_tt: §RSome factories will need to be rebuilt.§!
loc.SOV_relocate_industry_lose_control_tt: §RLosing control of [FROM.GetName] will make the factories suffer more damage upon relocation.§!
loc.SOV_industry_relocation_trains_tt: §R[?SOV_industrial_relocation_trains_decision_negative] $train_equipment$s§! will be used for the duration of this decision.
loc.SOV_industry_relocation_aluminium_plant_: §R[?SOV_industrial_relocation_trains_decision_aluminium_negative] $train_equipment$s§! will be used for the duration of this decision.\n
loc.SOV_organize_covert_depots_poum_desc: Our anti-Stalinist contacts in Spain will prepare hidden depots to store the weapons and military equipment that our agents will acquire through various means.
loc.SOV_organize_covert_depots_poum_tt: Effects when the POUM uprising takes place:\n
loc.SOV_send_infantry_equipment_poum_desc: A shipment of new rifles and ammunition will allow our Spanish comrades to continue the war against fascism and the counterrevolutionary bourgeoisie.
loc.SOV_organize_popular_brigades_poum_desc: We will establish contact with members of various political organizations of the Anti-Stalinist Left, both local and foreign, to form international brigades to support our Spanish comrades in the war.
loc.SOV_send_elite_commandos_poum_desc: We have highly trained and skilled people capable of successfully conducting special operations, as well as non-Stalinist ex-civil war combatants and army veterans who know how to wage war. \nWe must make these assets available to the POUM government in its fight against fascism and Stalinism.
loc.SOV_send_elite_commandos_poum_flag: Has sent Elite Commandos to Spain
loc.SOV_organize_popular_speeches_poum_desc: Our Spanish comrades need the full cooperation of the people to continue the war effort. We must carry out, in cooperation with influential members of local organizations, an information and agitation campaign to re-ignite the flame of revolution among the Spanish masses.
loc.SOV_infiltrate_stalinist_plans_in_spain_: Infiltrate the Stalinist Command in Spain

A new batch of Soviet military advisers will be sent to Spain to assist the bourgeois republican government soon, and we have the chance to infiltrate several anti-Stalinist agents among them. \nThese agents will contact and recruit soldiers, Brigadistas and militiamen sympathetic to the POUM in the bourgeois republican side, in order to create a network of informants that will allow us to learn about enemy plans before they are carried out.
loc.SOV_default_poum_cd_tt: \nThis decision will become available again in §Y[?SOV_default_poum_cd]§! days.\n
loc.SOV_long_poum_cd_tt: \nThis decision will become available again in §Y[?SOV_long_poum_cd]§! days.\n
loc.decision_only_once_tt: \nThis decision can only be activated once.
loc.decision_cost_CP_50_pp_15_tooltip: It costs £command_power  §Y50§! £pol_power  §Y15§! to take the decision
loc.SOV_pressure_country_government_baltic_d: We will pressure the [FROM.GetAdjective] government to adopt policies more in line with our interests.
loc.SOV_promote_ideology_rallies_baltic_desc: [ROOT.GetAdjective] agents will carry out political rallies throughout [FROM.GetNameDef] to promote [ROOT.GetIdeologyNameWithCaps] among the [FROM.GetAdjective] masses.
loc.SOV_send_ultimatum_to_country_baltic_des: With an ultimatum, we will put pressure on the [FROM.GetAdjective] government to give in to our demands.
loc.SOV_ultimatum_baltic_effects_tt: This event will pressure §Y[FROM.GetFlag][FROM.GetNameDefCap]§! to be integrated into §Y[ROOT.GetNameDef]§!. ([FROM.GetNameDefCap] can still refuse)
loc.SOV_ultimatum_generic_effects_tt: This event will pressure §Y[FROM.GetFlag][FROM.GetNameDefCap]§! to become a puppet of §Y[ROOT.GetNameDef]§! or to join the §Y[ROOT.GetFactionName]§!. ([FROM.GetNameDefCap] can still refuse)
loc.SOV_pressure_government_effects_tt: This event will pressure §Y[FROM.GetFlag][FROM.GetNameDefCap]§! to join the §Y[ROOT.GetFactionName]§! or to replace their current government by a §Y[ROOT.GetRulingIdeology]§! one. ([FROM.GetNameDefCap] can still refuse)
loc.SOV_promote_rallies_effects_tt: This event will promote §Y[GetIdeologyNameWithCaps]§! throughout §Y[FROM.GetFlag][FROM.GetNameDefCap]§! and will §Ydestabilize the country§! should the [FROM.GetAdjective] government oppose the rallies.
loc.SOV_preparations_for_operation_countenan: We will have §Y[?SOV.SOV_operation_countenance_preparation_days] days§! to prepare before the beginning of $SOV_operation_countenance$ and the declaration of war on [PER.GetNameDef]. \n$SOV_preparations_for_operation_countenance_mission_tt$\n

Once §Y$SOV_operation_countenance$§! mission is active, [GetOperationCountenanceTooltip] troops will have §Y[?SOV.SOV_operation_countenance_mission_days] days§! to capitulate [PER.GetNameDef], before they attempt to join another faction and our population start worrying about our military capabilities.
loc.SOV_agreed_anglo_soviet_invasion_of_iran: Agreed joint Anglo-Soviet invasion of Iran
loc.SOV_send_infantry_equipment_asia_desc: We must send military equipment to our Chinese allies so that they can prevail both against the imperialist nations that surround them and against the ambitious Chinese warlords.
loc.SOV_send_equipment_cd_tt: \nThis decision will become available again in §Y[?SOV_send_infantry_equipment_cd]§! days.\n
loc.SOV_peace_deal_for_south_sakhalin_and_ku: We will offer the [JAP.GetAdjective] government a cessation of all hostilities if they agree to return our former territories of [537.GetName] and the [555.GetName].
loc.SOV_peace_deal_for_hokkaido: Offer Peace for Sakhalin, the Kurils and Hokkaido
loc.SOV_peace_deal_for_hokkaido_desc: We will offer the [JAP.GetAdjective] government a cessation of all hostilities if they agree to return our former territories of [537.GetName] and the [555.GetName], and the transfer of [536.GetName] under [ROOT.GetAdjective] control.
loc.SOV_sinkiang_investment_ongoing_flag: Another aid program is already ongoing in Sinkiang
loc.SOV_sinkiang_mineral_prospection_sik_des: [ROOT.GetAdjective] officials have developed an interest in the gold and rare minerals mined in Altay, [SIK.GetNameDef]. In order to access Sinkiang's market, we will propose to look for new deposits and improve the infrastructure in [619.GetName], a region rich in minerals but with very archaic means of exploitation by our neighbor.
loc.SOV_sinkiang_mineral_prospection_desc: The region of [619.GetName], in the South-Western part of the former Sinkiang, is rich in minerals but only a few deposits are currently being exploited, and in very archaic and unefficient way. We must prospect for resources and improve the region's infrastructure in order to facilitate exploitation.
loc.SOV_sinkiang_oil_prospection_sik_desc: [618.GetName], in the Northern part of [SIK.GetNameDef], is rich in oil and minerals but none of them are being exploited by our neighbor. We will ask for permission to prospect for resources in the region and exploit whatever deposits we find.
loc.SOV_sinkiang_oil_prospection_desc: [618.GetName], in the Northern part of the former Sinkiang, is rich in oil and minerals but none of them are being exploited at this moment. We must prospect for resources and develop the infrastructure in the region to facilitate the exploitation of any deposits we find.
loc.SOV_jiuquan_oil_prospection_desc: Our experts believe that there might be numerous oil deposits in [756.GetName], in the Northern part of the former territory of the [XSM.GetNeutralParty]. We must develop the infrastructure in the region to facilitate the exploitation of any deposits we find.
loc.SOV_sinkiang_military_aid_sik_desc: We will offer military aid to [SIK.GetNameDef] in exchange for increased exports of their local commodity goods needed in our country.
loc.SOV_sinkiang_support_expansion_sik_desc: Our trade agents in [SIK.GetNameDef] are demanding more policies to increase exports to [ROOT.GetNameDef], now that Sinkiangs's territorial expansion has provided them with more goods to trade.
loc.SOV_formalize_of_the_soviet_republic_of_: Formalize the Soviet Republic of Sinkiang
It is time to demand the integration of [SIK.GetNameDef] as an Independent Soviet Socialist Republic, subordinate to the government of [FROM.GetNameDef].
This decision can only be activated once.\n§gAI will always accept.§!

loc.SOV_sinkiang_support_expansion_flag: Has supported Sinkiang's expansion by developing the infrastructure in newly acquired territories
loc.SOV_soviet_aid_decision_category_desc: [SOV.GetNameDefCap] has developed an interest in our country, or rather, in its natural resources, economic market and foreign relations. loc.SOV_promote_ideological_rallies_cd_tt: \nWe can only promote ideological rallies in a country once.

loc.SOV_raid_trotskys_villa_desc: NKVD agent Iosif Grigulevich will lead a group of armed assassins on a raid on Trotsky's villa.
loc.SOV_raid_trotskys_villa_tt:
A group of armed assassins will attempt to kill Trotsky by raiding his villa.

Chances of succeeding in killing Trotsky will increase if §Y[FROM.GetFlag][FROM.GetNameDefCap]§!: 
-Has high communist support 
-Is in faction with [ROOT.GetFlag][ROOT.GetNameDefCap] 
-Is subject of [ROOT.GetFlag][ROOT.GetNameDefCap]
loc.SOV_carefully_planned_assassination_desc: Spanish-born NKVD agent Ramón Mercader will befriend Trotsky's confidants, he will then move to Mexico where the agent will pose as a Trotsky's sympathizer, waiting for the right moment to carry out the assassination.
loc.SOV_carefully_planned_assassination_tt:
A NKVD agent will attempt to infiltrate Trotsky's inner circle and assassinate him. 

Chances of succeeding in killing Trotsky will increase if §Y[FROM.GetFlag][FROM.GetNameDefCap]§!: 
-Has high communist support 
-Has good relations with [ROOT.GetFlag][ROOT.GetNameDefCap] 
-Is in faction with [ROOT.GetFlag][ROOT.GetNameDefCap] 
-Is subject of [ROOT.GetFlag][ROOT.GetNameDefCap] 
-Has already conducted a raid on Trotsky's villa
loc.SOV_attempting_to_kill_trotsky_flag: Another operation to assassinate Trotsky is already ongoing.
loc.SOV_nuclear_espionage_ongoing_flag: Another operation to infiltrate a foreign atomic program is already ongoing.
loc.SOV_infiltrate_atomic_program_desc: We will attempt to recruit agents in [FROM.GetNameDef] who believe in the communist cause and who can gain access to classified information from the [FROM.GetAdjective] atomic program.
loc.SOV_infiltrate_atomic_program_tt:
We will attempt to collect vital information related to [GetAtomicProgramName], in order to boost our own national atomic program.

Chances of succeeding in this operation will increase if §Y[FROM.GetFlag][FROM.GetNameDef]§! has high communist support.
loc.SOV_comecon_industrialization_program_de: We will carry out an industrialization program in [FROM.GetNameDef] to boost the construction of new domestic industry and infrastructure.
loc.SOV_comecon_joint_military_program_desc: We will develop a joint military program with our partner countries to improve their training capabilities.

loc.SOV_factory_worker_militias_desc: We must raise the factory workers in [FROM.GetName] to reinforce the divisions currently stationed in the area, or they will soon have no factories to work in.
loc.SOV_civilian_labor_in_defense_desc: We will put the civilian population in the [FROM.GetName] area to work on building fortifications to defend their city.
loc.SOV_nothing_is_left_behind_desc: If our troops are forced to give ground, we will see to it that they leave absolutely nothing behind that can be used by the enemy.
loc.SOV_staggered_retreat_desc: If we have to give ground to the enemy onslaught, we must do so in an orderly manner, without leaving isolated units behind and preventing our troops from getting encircled by the enemy.
loc.SOV_order_227_decisions_tt:
Unlock decisions to prepare and execute §YMilitary Offensives§!. 

The following decisions will no longer be available: §Y$SOV_nothing_is_left_behind$§!

loc.SOV_military_offensive_in_progress_flag: Another military offensive is already ongoing.
loc.SOV_military_offensive_ongoing_trigger_d: Has control of §Y[?SOV_military_offensive_states^0.GetName]§! and §Yall neighboring states§! that have the §Y$SOV_soviet_military_offensive$§! state modifier.\n Controlling §Y[?SOV_military_offensive_states^0.GetName]§! will prevent us from suffering any penalties if we fail to control any of the neighbor states.
loc.SOV_military_offensive_ongoing_failing_m: Failing to control the main objective, §Y[?SOV_military_offensive_states^0.GetName]§!, when this mission times out will cause us to suffer the following penalties:
loc.SOV_military_offensive_scope_tt: §Y[FROM.GetName]§! and §Yall neighbor states currently controlled by an enemy§!:\nAdd Modifier: §Y$SOV_soviet_military_offensive$§! (Division Attack: §G+10.0%§!, Breakthrough: §G+10.00%§! for [ROOT.GetFlag]§Y[ROOT.GetNameDef]§! in the state).
loc.SOV_military_offensive_activate_decision: \nActivates Mission: §YMilitary Offensive in [FROM.GetName] Ongoing§! (In order to succeed in this mission, we will need to control the main objective, §Y[FROM.GetName]§! and all its neighbor states that are currently controlled by the enemy. Controlling only the main objective will prevent us from suffering any penalties from failing the mission)
loc.SOV_military_offensive_ongoing_not_holdi: §RWe do not control the main objective at this moment.§!
loc.SOV_military_offensive_desc: We will begin preparations for a military offensive to capture [FROM.GetName].
loc.SOV_operation_iskra_desc: We will begin preparations for a military operation to break the siege of [195.GetName].
loc.SOV_operation_iskra_ongoing_objective_tt: The objective of this offensive is to break the siege of §Y[195.GetName]§!, restoring the connection of the state to our capital by the time the mission times out.
loc.SOV_operation_iskra_ongoing_success_tt: \n§GWe have break the siege of §YLeningrad§! and the city is currently connected to our capital.§!
loc.SOV_operation_iskra_ongoing_failure_tt: \n§RWe have yet to break the siege of §YLeningrad§!. The city is still isolated and surrounded by enemies.§!
loc.SOV_operation_iskra_tt: §Y[195.GetName]§!, §Y[208.GetName]§! and §Y[244.GetName]§!:\nAdd Modifier: §Y$SOV_soviet_military_offensive$§! (Division Attack: §G+10.0%§!, Breakthrough: §G+10.00%§! for [ROOT.GetFlag]§Y[ROOT.GetNameDef]§! in the state).
loc.SOV_operation_iskra_activate_decision_tt: \nActivates Mission: §YOperation Iskra Ongoing§! (To succeed in this mission, we need to have broken the siege of §YLeningrad§! and restored the land routes between the city and our capital by the time the mission times out).
loc.SOV_the_rush_for_berlin_desc: It is obvious that our current allies in the fight against the [GER.GetAdjective]s will become our greatest rivals after the war. We cannot allow them to beat us in the race for Berlin.
loc.SOV_raise_penal_units_desc: More meat for the meat grinder.
loc.SOV_add_borderline_state_to_plot: placeholder: add a politically borderline state to fascist plot
loc.SOV_add_borderline_state_to_plot_desc: placeholder: gets a state that might secede to join you in your territory when the war starts
loc.SOV_woo_army_officers_desc: placeholder:When you start the civil war, this officer might join you and bring some of their troops
loc.SOV_woo_navy_officers_desc: placeholder:When you start the civil war, this officer might join you, but they won't bring troops
loc.SOV_noisy_meeting_in_paris: placeholder: have a noisy meeting in Paris
loc.SOV_noisy_meeting_in_paris_desc: placeholder: Not Yet Completed, makes Stalin suspicious of one of his loyal political advisors
loc.SOV_soviet_civil_war_dec_cat_desc: The threat of yet another civil war is upon us. We must prepare ourselves for the worst, and ensure control of as much of the country, and the armed forces, as possible. But we must also be careful and avoid drawing too much attention, or [ROOT.getLeader] might force our hand before we are ready.

loc.SOV_expand_nkvd_opposition_desc: We should take the opportunity to expand the Military branch of the NKVD. These troops can be very useful in securing our future victory.
loc.SOV_expand_nkvd_opposition_tt: Adds 5 NKVD Divisions that will remain loyal when the [GetSovietCivilWarName] starts.
loc.SOV_nkvd_cd_tt: \nThis decision will be available again in §Y120 days§!.
loc.SOV_influence_army_opposition_desc: Having infiltrated the army means we can now start to find lower ranking officers and privates that are sympathetic to our cause, and make sure they join our side if a war starts.
loc.SOV_influence_cd_tt: \nThis decision will be available again in §Y60 days§!.
loc.SOV_influence_army_opposition_level_tt: Support in the army is less than §Y70%§!
loc.SOV_influence_navy_opposition_desc: The navy might not be very useful in a civil war, but they can still help us take key locations and ensure we get supply. So it would be worth ensuring the loyalty of a number of captains. In addition, having a fleet after the war opens up new doors for us on the international stage.
loc.SOV_influence_navy_opposition_level_tt: Support in the navy is less than §Y70%§!
loc.SOV_influence_airforce_opposition_desc: By using our connections in the armed forces, we should be able to find pilots and air commanders sympathetic to our cause. Having the air force on our side will surely make the war a much easier task.
loc.SOV_influence_air_opposition_level_tt: Support in the air force is less than §Y70%§!
loc.SOV_recruit_general_opposition: Recruit a General to your cause
loc.SOV_recruit_general_opposition_desc: We should use our connections inside the Red Army to try and convince high ranking officers to join our side in the event of civil war.
loc.SOV_recruit_general_opposition_tt: One General or Field Marshal becomes loyal to our cause
loc.SOV_recruit_admiral_opposition: Recruit an Admiral to your cause
loc.SOV_recruit_admiral_opposition_desc: We should use our connections inside the Red navy to try and convince high ranking officers to join our side in the event of civil war.
loc.SOV_recruit_admiral_opposition_tt: One Admiral becomes loyal to our cause
loc.SOV_recruit_cd_tt: \nThis decision will be available again in §Y30 days§!.
loc.SOV_army_framejob_desc: By circulating rumors about generals loyal to [ROOT.GetLeader], and by placing some forged "evidence" in the hands of the NKVD we should be able to divert attention away from ourselves for a while. As a bonus effect, if we are lucky, other army personnel might get disaffected by the repressive actions.
loc.SOV_army_framejob_tt: One General or Field Marshal will get framed for treasonous activity.
loc.SOV_army_framejob_cd_tt: \nThis decision will be available again in §Y[?SOV_army_framejob_decision_re_enable_days_display] days§!.
loc.SOV_navy_framejob_desc: By circulating rumors about admirals loyal to [ROOT.GetLeader], and by placing some forged "evidence" in the hands of the NKVD we should be able to divert attention away from ourselves for a while. As a bonus effect, if we are lucky, other navy personnel might get disaffected by the repressive actions.
loc.SOV_navy_framejob_tt: One admiral will get framed for treasonous activity.
loc.SOV_navy_framejob_cd_tt: \nThis decision will be available again in §Y[?SOV_navy_framejob_decision_re_enable_days_display] days§!.
loc.SOV_plan_start_of_uprising_archangelsk_d: The Northern region has access to ports and is relatively close to Moscow, which makes it a good base. However, it has poor internal infrastructure, and low development, so waging a war from here will be somewhat difficult unless something is done to alleviate that.
loc.SOV_plan_start_of_uprising_odessa_desc: The Ukraine is a good base for a revolt. It is a rich region, with big cities, good ports and infrastructure. However, this also means that it will be more difficult to convert states to our cause than it is in the less developed regions of [SOV.GetNameDef].
loc.SOV_plan_start_of_uprising_chita_desc: Siberia is traditionally an anti-stalinist, and anti-bolshevik stronghold. The region may be underdeveloped, but should be relatively easy to win over to our cause.
loc.SOV_plan_start_of_uprising_omsk_desc: Omsk is well placed in western Siberia, also bordering the Urals region and the Great Steppe. Although slightly underdeveloped it should be relatively easy to build a good solid base for an uprising here, and then commence the march on Moscow.
loc.SOV_plan_start_of_uprising_tashkent_desc: Building our base in the Great Steppe Region means having our backs safe. It will mean a long march to reach Moscow, but most of the fighting would be to our front. Also, it should be relatively easy to gain support in this region.
loc.SOV_plan_start_of_uprising_ufa_desc: The Urals have the advantage of being easily defended, and setting our base here also allow us to spread our influence into both Siberia and the Northern region, as well as down south into the Great Steppe area, giving us many different options.
loc.SOV_set_civil_war_state_tt: Opposition Cell established in [FROM.GetName], ensuring the state's loyalty in case of civil war.
loc.SOV_start_infiltrating_state_tt: Work to establish a cell in [FROM.GetName] starts
loc.SOV_sabotage_behind_enemy_lines_decision: Loyal partisans operating behind enemy lines can be used to disrupt enemy communications in [FROM.Getname]. Strikes at command posts, cutting of telegraph wires, or de-railing of trains, make the enemy less prepared to withstand the attacks of our units, and increase the chance of a successful liberation of Russia.
loc.SOV_dismiss_the_counter_revolution_desc: By publicly denouncing any talk of a counter revolution, we should be able to divert the attention of the NKVD away from our agents. However, it might also mean that we lose some supporters who believe in the false dismissal.
loc.SOV_dismiss_the_counter_revolution_tt: Reduces Political paranoia at the expense of future stability and reduced military support
loc.SOV_dismiss_cd_tt: \nThis decision will be available again in §Y60 days§!.
loc.SOV_soviet_civil_war_not_started_tt: The Soviet Civil War has not started
loc.SOV_soviet_civil_war_not_started_tt_NOT: The Soviet Civil War has started
loc.SOV_has_selected_hq_tt: Has set up a secret headquarter
loc.SOV_concessions_japan_vladivostok_SCW_de: The Japanese Military have always coveted Vladivostok. Thus, they should be inclined to help us with an expeditionary force if we use future ownership of the area as a bargaining chip.
loc.SOV_concessions_japan_vladivostok_SCW_ac: If accepted, [JAP.GetNameDef] will supply units that fight with the [GetSovietOppositionName] during the war. [JAP.GetNameDefCap] will get control of Vladivostok at the end of the war.
loc.SOV_concessions_japan_sakhalin_SCW_desc: The rebellion needs weapons. Maybe the Japanese will be prepared to give us some if we show that we are prepared to give them the rest of Sakhalin.
loc.SOV_concessions_japan_sakhalin_SCW_accep: If accepted, the [GetSovietOppositionName] get [JAP.GetAdjective] guns and rifles, and possibly fighters, when the war starts. [JAP.GetNameDefCap] will get control of North Sakhalin at the end of the war.
loc.SOV_concessions_germany_baku_SCW: Baku Oil Rights for Military Buildup
loc.SOV_concessions_germany_baku_SCW_desc: [GER.GetNameDefCap] desperately need oil for their own military buildup. By promising them exclusive rights to our oil-fields after the war, they should be more than willing to help us out.
loc.SOV_concessions_germany_baku_SCW_accept: If accepted, [GER.GetNameDef] will start building Military factories in [?SOV.SOV_civil_war_start_state.GetName]. The [GetSovietOppositionName] get [GER.GetAdjective] tanks and rifles. [GER.GetNameDefCAP] gets Resource Rights to [229.GetName] at the end of the war.
loc.SOV_concessions_germany_ukraininan_oil_S: Although it would be bad to lose the Ukraine, they could become a valuable ally in a war against the Stalinists. Germany can train the Ukrainian militia secretly, and then the Ukrainian insurgents can launch a surprise attack when ready.
If accepted, [GER.GetNameDef] will train Ukrainian units that will launch an uprising when ready. [GER.GetNameDefCAP] gets Resource Rights to Ukrainian territory at the end of the war.
loc.SOV_concessions_uk_belarus_SCW: Independent BLR in return for British Support
loc.SOV_concessions_uk_belarus_SCW_desc: The [ENG.GetAdjective] government are sympathetic to the [BLR.GetAdjective] government in exile's calls for independence. If we promise them to release [BLR.GetNameDef] after the war, they would surely want to supply us with arms.
loc.SOV_concessions_uk_belarus_SCW_accept: If accepted, [ENG.GetNameDef] will start building Military factories in [?SOV.SOV_civil_war_start_state.GetName]. [BLR.GetNameDefCAP] becomes independent at the end of the war.
loc.SOV_recruit_manchurian_cavalry_exiles_de: Adds one Manchurian cavalry brigade in [?SOV.SOV_civil_war_start_state.GetName] when the war starts.
loc.SOV_recruit_cavalry_exiles_desc: Adds one cavalry brigade in [FROM.GetName] when the war starts.
loc.SOV_wreckers_sabotage_contruction_desc: The activists are awaiting for the order to strike at construction works all across the country.
loc.SOV_wreckers_sabotage_dockyards_desc: By damaging the naval production of [SOS.GetLeader], [SOS.GetAdjective] will be diverted elsewhere.
loc.SOV_wreckers_sabotage_railways_desc: Without supplies, armies can neither move nor fight.
loc.SOV_secure_moscow_opposition_desc: Use our connections in Moscow to ensure that partisans rise up in the area, in a bid to capture the capital.
loc.SOV_secure_moscow_opposition_tt: Partisan units will rise up in Moscow when the civil war starts
loc.SOV_secure_leningrad_opposition_desc: Use our connections in Moscow to ensure that partisans rise up in the area, in a bid to capture the city from the centrists.
loc.SOV_secure_leningrad_opposition_tt: Partisan units will rise up in Leningrad when the civil war starts

loc.SOV_the_head_of_the_nkvd_yezhov: The Head of the NKVD - Yezhov
loc.SOV_the_head_of_the_nkvd_yezhov_desc: $SOV_genrikh_yagoda$, the current head of the NKVD, is on friendly terms with many of the right opposition. it shouldn't be impossible to convince him that the path we have chosen is the right one for this country.
loc.SOV_the_head_of_the_nkvd_yagoda: The Head of the NKVD - Yagoda
loc.SOV_the_head_of_the_nkvd_yagoda_desc: $SOV_genrikh_yagoda$ may not be on friendly terms with the leaders of the Right Opposition, but at least he can be reasoned with. It should be possibly to make Yagoda see the values of our proposal, and to convince him that ours is the winning side.
loc.SOV_assassinate_stalin_desc: The only way to peacefully remove the tyranny is by removing the tyrant. It is an act of desperation, but the masses will be spared the horrors of yet another civil war. We should strike him down, and then move on with the plans for the coup, before his successor has had enough time to gather support.
loc.SOV_assassinate_stalin_good_tt:
An assassination attempt is carried out on Stalin
Chance to succeed = §G80%§!
 £trigger_yes base: 50 %
 £trigger_yes $SOV_infiltrate_the_nkvd$: +30%
loc.SOV_assassinate_stalin_bad_tt:
An assassination attempt is carried out on Stalin
Chance to succeed: §Y50%§!
 £trigger_yes base: 50 %
 £trigger_no $SOV_infiltrate_the_nkvd$: +30%
loc.SOV_assassinate_stalin_outcome_tt: ---\nIf the attempt is successful, §Y$SOV_lavrenty_beriya$§! will assume temporary control, creating an opportunity for a successful coup.\nIf the attempt fails, $SOV_paranoia_very_high_increase_effect_tt$.
loc.SOV_send_supporters_abroad_desc: The safest place to be is as far from Stalin's cronies as possible. We need to get key people out of the country, into safety, until it is time to return and finish the work that we have started.
loc.SOV_send_supporters_abroad_exile_tt: The following characters will be sent into exile (§Gcharacters in exile cannot be purged§!):
loc.SOV_send_supporters_abroad_back_tt: \nThese characters will be brought back to the country to support us in the event of a civil war.\n
loc.SOV_align_general_stalin_desc: Using every means at his disposal, [ROOT.GetLeader] attempts to ensure the loyalty of an army leader as preparation for a future conflict.
loc.SOV_permanent_revolution_dec_cat_desc_ta: Marxist theory teaches that the revolution is inevitable if the circumstances are right, and multiple enemy [SOV.GetAdjective] agents operating within our borders are ensuring that the circumstances are right among the working class for a successful armed uprising in [ROOT.GetName].
loc.SOV_organize_fifth_columnists_in_enemy_n: Workers and peasants sympathetic to the Bolshevik Party throughout [FROM.GetNameDef] have made preparations for an armed uprising and they are ready to strike where the enemy least expects it.
loc.SOV_ignite_uprising_timer_mission_desc: [ROOT.GetAdjective] workers and peasants sympathetic to the [SOV.GetAdjective] Bolshevik Party are making preparations for an armed uprising in the country.
loc.SOV_ignite_uprising_timer_mission_tt: §RTrotskyist Revolutionary Militias will rise up in multiple controlled states.§!\n
loc.SOV_ignite_revolutionary_uprisings_effec: Decrease £stability_texticon §YStability§! and increase §YPopularity of Communism§! in [FROM.GetNameDef], based on current §YPopularity of Communism§! in the country. Current effects:
loc.SOV_ignite_revolutionary_uprisings_desc: The workers of [FROM.GetNameDef] have already begun to show their discontent towards the [FROM.GetRulingParty] and their bourgeois policies. It is time to promote the communist ideology among the [FROM.GetAdjective] working class.
loc.SOV_align_admiral_stalin_desc: Using threats, bribery and personal connections, [ROOT.GetLeader] attempts to ensure the loyalty of a navy leader as preparation for a future conflict.
loc.SOV_ukraine_crackdown_timer_desc: The NKVD have decided to target the Ukraine, making mass arrests and interrogations in order to ensure the loyalty of the people in the region.
loc.SOV_ukraine_crackdown_timer_tt: One state in the Ukraine region will be aligned to the Centrists.
loc.SOV_steppe_crackdown_timer: Crackdown in the Great Steppe region
loc.SOV_steppe_crackdown_timer_desc: The NKVD have decided to target the Great Steppe region, making mass arrests and interrogations in order to ensure the loyalty of the people in the region.
loc.SOV_steppe_crackdown_timer_tt: One state in the Great Steppe region will be aligned to the Centrists.
loc.SOV_northern_crackdown_timer_desc: The NKVD have decided to target the Northern region, making mass arrests and interrogations in order to ensure the loyalty of the people in the region.
loc.SOV_northern_crackdown_timer_tt: One state in the Northern region will be aligned to the Centrists.
loc.SOV_siberian_crackdown_timer_desc: The NKVD have decided to target the Siberian region, making mass arrests and interrogations in order to ensure the loyalty of the people in the region.
loc.SOV_siberian_crackdown_timer_tt: One state in Siberia will be aligned to the Centrists.
loc.SOV_urals_crackdown_timer_desc: The NKVD have decided to target the Urals and trans Ural region, making mass arrests and interrogations in order to ensure the loyalty of the people in the region.
loc.SOV_urals_crackdown_timer_tt: One state in the Urals region will be aligned to the Centrists.
loc.SOV_the_stalin_constitution_mission_desc: [FROM.GetLeader] is working to complete the $SOV_the_stalin_constitution$ focus.
loc.SOV_the_stalin_constitution_mission_tt: ---\nWhen the civil war starts, the Centrists will get the modifiers from the §Y$SOV_the_stalin_constitution$§! focus.

loc.SOV_increase_opposition_army_support_tt: Support for the opposition in the army will increase by §G+10%§!.
loc.SOV_increase_opposition_army_support_sma: Support for the opposition in the army will increase by up to §G+5%§!.
loc.SOV_add_armed_forces_support_state_tt: Support for the opposition in the armed forces will increase by up to §G+2%§!.
loc.SOV_increase_opposition_navy_support_sma: Support for the opposition in the navy will increase by up to §G+5%§!.

loc.SOV_decrease_all_opposition_air_tt: Support for the opposition in the air force will §Rdecrease§!.

loc.SOV_socialism_in_one_country_mission_tt: ---\nWhen the civil war starts, the Centrists will get the modifiers from the §Y$SOV_socialism_in_one_country$§! focus.

loc.SOV_behead_the_snake_mission_desc: [FROM.GetLeader] is working to complete the $SOV_behead_the_snake$ focus.
loc.SOV_polish_territory_desc: We currently control a lot of territory that were once part of the so called Polish Republic. If we were to hand some of it back, the leadership we have put in place in [POL.capital.GetCapitalVictoryPointName] would be able to use that as proof of the benefits of cooperation with [ROOT.GetNameDef].
loc.SOV_return_states_to_poland_desc: As a gesture of goodwill, and to demonstrate who is in charge, we should return all the territory west of [95.GetCapitalVictoryPointName] that is claimed by [POL.getNameDef] to the [POL.GetAdjective] puppet regime.
loc.form_mountainous_republic_category: Form the Mountainous Republic of the Northern Caucasus
loc.form_mountainous_republic_category_desc: During the Russian Civil war, the great Tapa Tchermoeff attempted to unite the Republics located in the Northern Caucasus under a shared banner, in order to fend off the Russian invaders. Now once again, shall the people of the Northern Caucasus unite to drive out foreign powers, and restore their glory!
loc.form_transcaucasus_category_desc: The Transcaucasian Republic which was recently dissolved after the 1936 Soviet Constitution, is still an idea etched into people's minds.
