loc.SOV_planned_economy_desc: While it has its flaws, it is obvious that the NEP has also had a number of successes. We are still a long way away from being able to switch to a full Socialist society, but we can now proceed towards planning our economy in a more formal manner. In particular, we should create an economic policy that takes the abilities of our partners and allies into account and creates a more inter-dependent economy.
loc.SOV_planned_economy_dynamic_modifier_tt:
Add §Y$SOV_planned_economy_dynamic_modifier$§!, which grants (Factory Output: §G+[?SOV_planned_economy_industrial_capacity_factory_extra|2+%]§!, Lack of Resources Penalty: §G[?SOV_planned_economy_production_lack_of_resource_penalty_factor_extra|2-%]§!) 
For each subject adopting the §Y$new_economic_policy$§!, grants an extra: 
Factory Output: §G+[?SOV_planned_economy_industrial_capacity_factory_extra|2+%]§! 
Lack of Resource Penalty: §G[?SOV_planned_economy_production_lack_of_resource_penalty_factor_extra|2-%]§! 
(Extra bonuses applied up to a maximum of: Factory Output: §Y+10.00%§!, Lack of Resource Penalty: §Y-10.00%§!)
loc.SOV_paced_industrialization_desc: While Stalin's singular focus on heavy industry has led to a significant underdevelopment in many sectors, we can't ignore this sector in our own planning. In order to allow other sectors to modernize and mechanize, we have to have the industrial base to support it.
loc.SOV_the_trade_union_as_labor_organizer: The Trade Union as Labor Organizer
loc.SOV_the_trade_union_as_labor_organizer_d: Under Capitalism, labor unions exist to ensure basic human rights for the workers and to fend off the exploitation from the factory owners. This is obviously no longer needed in the new system, and therefore the role of the Labor Union must shift towards organizing labor for the purpose of optimizing production.
loc.SOV_incorporate_local_organizations_desc: The local organisations often have a better understanding of the problems the workers face than the people in the capital. We should de-emphasize the role of ministers and other senior party members, and give more power to the locals.
loc.SOV_for_the_common_good_desc: The governing principle of any decisions made by our allies has to be to do the most good whenever possible. Even if at first, sacrifices are not met by an immediate improvement, it must be made clear that in the long run this does the most good.
loc.SOV_victory_over_devastation_desc: The collective efforts of our people have enabled us to move forward from the destruction caused by the civil war. The speed with which the country rebuilt will forever stand as a monument to the skills and dedication of our workers.
loc.SOV_victory_over_devastation_tt:
Modify §Y$SOV_planned_economy_dynamic_modifier$§! by 
Consumer Goods Factories: §Y-2.0%§! 
Party Popularity Stability Modifier: §G+15.00%§! 
Minimum Surrender Limit: §G+10.00%§! 
Factory Repair Speed: §G+10.00%§!
loc.SOV_socialist_humanism_desc: There are some Marxist theorists who believe that humans don't have any agency in their own fates and that their lives are completely determined by material factors. This is obviously wrong and indeed shows a bourgeois view on the working class. People are more than just a set of organs, and we should treat them as such.
loc.SOV_international_revolutionary_marxist_: The Third International fell to Stalinist totalitarianism and is probably beyond saving. We need to offer the communist parties of the world a new way to coordinate and cooperate.
\nEvery independent non-Stalinist communist nation at peace with [ROOT.GetName]:

Every independent non-Stalinist communist nation at peace with [ROOT.GetName]: 
  Gains §Y$SOV_international_socialist_association$§! (Opinion of §Y[ROOT.GetFlag][ROOT.GetName]§! §G+40§!.)
  Gets event '§Y[ROOT.GetNameDefCap] invites us to the [ROOT.GetFactionName]§!'.
Their country leader embraces the sub-ideology of $marxism$.
loc.SOV_a_sustainable_economy_desc: The shift towards the New Economic Policy has come with a marked shift towards producing consumer goods, at the cost of a slower overall speed of industrialization. If we are to be competitive in the long term, we need to shift the economy towards a more sustainable model.
loc.SOV_the_enemies_of_the_people_desc: The forces of reaction are still out there, plotting for the day that they can undo everything we have achieved. We and our allies must be forever vigilant against this threat, and prepare for the eventuality that we will have to fight to defend the revolution.
loc.SOV_proclaim_soviet_hegemony_desc: It is clear that the Soviet system of government, the soviet economy, and the soviet society, are vastly superior in every aspect to the systems that came before. While these outdated systems endure in other parts of the world, there will always be people willing to contest them, and we should utilize them.
loc.SOV_beaten_but_not_defeated_desc: It is clear that the Communists have led our once-proud country down a treacherous path. Sooner or later, the countries at our borders will sense the weakness inherent in the regime, and pounce. If we are to save our beloved motherland, we must remove the Communists from power!
loc.SOV_beaten_but_not_defeated_tt: Starts the process towards the §Y[GetSovietCivilWarName]§! in [ROOT.GetNameDef] between the Communists and the Opposition in Exile.
loc.SOV_unification_of_the_exiles_desc: After the revolution and the civil war, many people preferred exile over the so-called justice of the new regime. They are still out there, dreaming of the day when Russia will once again be free. What that Russia's political system looks like is secondary to them. Before we can create the government the country needs, we will first have to take power, and we can do that better together.
loc.SOV_womens_fascist_movement_desc: While the role of the woman is, naturally, in providing her husband with a comfortable home to rest in and a family to fight for, many men have forgotten what duty they owe to their country and their people. A few dedicated women can, perhaps, be utilized to remind their husbands what is at stake, and encourage them to do what needs to be done.
loc.SOV_the_true_tsars_desc: The Russian people have always needed a strong leader, or they will drift further and further apart, until brother fights against brother and sons fights against their fathers. But the Tsars of old were ill-suited for their role, weak and indecisive. In the future, we will need a Tsar that can live up to the heavy burden placed on him.
loc.SOV_national_unification_desc: If we are to survive the wars to come, we can not allow ourselves to be disunited. Whatever different political views we may hold, ultimately, we are all Russians.
loc.SOV_national_unification_tt: Adds two §Y$arms_factory$§! buildings in the capital when the §Y[GetSovietCivilWarName]§! begins.
loc.SOV_covert_operations_desc: The communists are prone to distrust and infighting. If we play the game right, we might be able to get them to devour each other.
loc.SOV_covert_operations_tt: Unlocks §Ydecisions§! to frame party members and military personnel.
loc.SOV_embrace_the_black_hundreds_desc: Back in the old days, before the chaos of the Revolution, there were groups of men who believed. They believed in a strong Russia, a united Russia, a Russia that would not be afraid of itself. They were called the Black Hundreds. While their surviving members are now spread across many different countries, they still believe. And we can find them and bring them back.
loc.SOV_muster_the_old_guard_desc: There are still many who once fought for Tsar and country. They have grown older and softer, but the experience that war teaches is irreplaceable. If we can reach them, they would form an experienced core for a new army when the time comes to reclaim the country.
loc.SOV_approach_semyonov_desc: $SOV_grigory_semyonov$ has taken up a position as advisor in [MAN.GetName]. With the cause growing stronger by the hour, we should convince him to return. His first task would be to organize a grand cavalry host for the new Russian Empire.
loc.SOV_approach_semyonov_tt: §Y$SOV_grigory_semyonov$§! becomes available as an advisor and a general when the [GetSovietCivilWarName] starts.\nUnlocks §Ydecisions§! to recruit extra cavalry divisions.
loc.SOV_fascist_youth_union_desc: Rather than looking to the past, we must look to the future, to the young and to modern technology. The young Fascists burn with a desire to see Russia restored to its former glory. What they lack in experience they will more than make up for in sheer zeal.
loc.SOV_fascist_youth_union_tt: Recruits Youth Union motorized infantry units to join your side when the §Y[GetSovietCivilWarName]§! starts.
loc.SOV_tolkachi_desc: There exists in the Soviet economy a certain type of person, whose job it is to ensure that the numbers in the production plan match the numbers the industry can actually provide. If we can convince these people to work for us, we could give the Soviets one number and the factory managers another number, and move the difference in production to a place where it can be stored until the time comes.
loc.SOV_organize_wreckers_desc: The Soviets are already expecting a lot of sabotage from spies and class enemies. The security theater in even the smallest steel mill has ironically frustrated many workers, and so we could easily find some people who would try and get back at the petty tyrants of their factory if we gave them the means to do so.
loc.SOV_south_manchuria_railway_desc: The Japanese South Manchuria Railway Company is a state in the state in [MAN.GetName]. With their support, we should be able to prepare the supply network we need for the upcoming struggle.
loc.SOV_the_eyes_fear_desc: The task ahead of us is not an easy one. We have to take on a government that had decades to entrench itself, and which will be supported by a significant percentage of the population. But we know what needs to be done, all we have left to do is do it.
loc.SOV_the_hands_do_desc: The hour has come. We must commit ourselves to this sacred task: to remove the Soviet system of government from our Motherland. So that our children may one day be free from the spectre of Communism.
loc.SOV_call_for_aid_desc: The struggle against Communism in Russia is part of a greater struggle against Communism everywhere. But a victory against Communism in Russia would be a death blow to the world-wide communist movement, and so there are many countries that would be eager to help us.
loc.SOV_request_imperial_protection_desc: Desperate times demand desperate measures. If the only way to defeat communism is to bow to Hirohito, so be it. The time will come when Russia is an Empire of its own. But for now, we need the help of another one.
loc.SOV_request_imperial_protection_tt: If accepted: §Y[JAP.GetNameDef]§! joins the war. §Y[ROOT.GetNameDefCap]§! becomes a puppet of §Y[JAP.GetNameDef]§!.
loc.SOV_sabotage_behind_enemy_lines_desc: Decades of Communist mismanagement have left a great many people angry and disillusioned with the Communist government. Where the Communists still cling to power, we can use these people to hasten their defeat.
loc.SOV_aristocratic_investments_desc: There are still many of the former Russian nobility strewn across the world, a good number of them in possession of considerable wealth. Some of that wealth could be made available for us to buy weapons and equipment.
loc.SOV_consolidate_power_desc: The war that has torn our nation asunder has now been won. We must strengthen our position, and methodically eliminate those who dared oppose us.
loc.SOV_rebuild_the_nation_desc: Our war-ravaged country must now be rebuilt. With propaganda campaigns we can ensure every man, woman, and child makes their contribution to the rebuilding effort.
loc.SOV_bringing_breakaways_back_to_the_fold: Bring the Breakaways Back to the Fold
Having won back the majority of the country, we must now deal with the breakaway countries. Surely they can't expect us to accept the loss of Russian Imperial territory for ever?
loc.SOV_offer_autonomy_to_former_soviet_repu: Offer Autonomy To Former Soviet Republics

We had to accept some losses of Imperial territory to achieve our goals, but everyone must realize that these areas are truly part of the Imperial Russian sphere. But as they did help us retake the empire, we should offer them some autonomy to show our gratitude.
loc.SOV_restore_the_glory_of_the_motherland: Restore the Glory of the Motherland
loc.SOV_restore_the_glory_of_the_motherland_: Under our new leadership, we will ensure Russia becomes more glorious than ever before! We will commence a great program of construction of every kind, and make our nation the envy of the Western world!
loc.SOV_ARTICLE_124_DESC_COMMUNIST: It is possible that in the pursuit of Marxist-Leninist ideals we have been... overly zealous in persecuting religion. Perhaps it still has a role to play in Soviet society. Our new constitution will contain an article guaranteeing freedom of religion for all Soviet citizens.
loc.SOV_ARTICLE_124_DESC_EXILES: The Communists claimed that they were merely separating the church and the state, but in reality, they aimed to eliminate the Church from people's lives. For centuries, the Church as been an integral part of Russian society, and so it must once again become.
loc.SOV_reopen_novodevichi_desc: The Church has long been denied the ability to train new priests. In order to revitalize the Church, we must create a place where it can educate the next generation of priests and monks. The old convent of Novodevichi seems like an obvious choice.
loc.SOV_REBUILD_THE_SAVIOR_CATHEDRAL_DESC_CO: In 1931, the garish Cathedral of Christ the Savior was blown up to make room for a grand "Palace of the Soviets". As the specter of war looms over Europe, it is unlikely we shall have the resources to construct this behemoth. Restoring the old Cathedral would be a suitable olive branch to the religious portions of our population.
loc.SOV_REBUILD_THE_SAVIOR_CATHEDRAL_DESC_EX: In 1931, the beautiful Cathedral of Christ the Savior was blown up to make room for a garish "Palace of the Soviets". Why, precisely, a society supposedly built upon the idea of equality would need a Palace is left as an open question. Now that we have returned to power, we should revert this terrible crime and begin reconstruction of the Cathedral.
loc.SOV_the_synod_desc: With the Seminar in Novodevichi reopened, they should be encouraged to hold a Synod to discuss what matters of faith have appeared since they last were allowed to hold such an assembly.
loc.SOV_THE_DECLARATION_DESC_COMMUNIST: In his famous 'Declaration' of 1927, Patriarch Sergius swore loyalty to the Soviet Union, in spite of religious differences between church and state. Perhaps it is time we allow a more public role of the various Metropolitans who supported this declaration.
loc.SOV_THE_DECLARATION_DESC_EXILES: Patriarch Sergius' infamous 'Declaration' of 1927 swore loyalty to the Soviet Union, in spite of their religious differences. Despite this cowardly act, the infrastructure of the Russian Orthodox Church relies upon the people who supported this Declaration, and so we have no choice but to welcome them back into the fold.
loc.SOV_return_of_the_rocor_desc: The Russian Orthodox Church Outside Russia is comprised of those exiles who, rather than abandon their beliefs and principles, elected exile after the Russian Civil War. Now, with the defeat of the communist government who forced their expatriation, the time has finally come to welcome them back home and reinstate them.
loc.SOV_the_third_rome_tt_2: §YMetropolitan Meletius§! will now be known as §YArch-Patriarch Meletius§!.
loc.SOV_reformalize_the_role_of_the_patriarc: Reformalize the Role of the Patriarchate
loc.SOV_REFORMALIZE_THE_ROLE_OF_THE_PATRIARC: Since the first steps were made with Article 124, the position of the Church in our Union has come a long way. It is clear it cannot be removed from Soviet society - so perhaps we should embrace it and once again accord it a central place in the Soviet Worker's life.
For too long has the Patriarchate been relegated to the shadows of Communism. It is time it once more formally takes its rightful place at the center of Russian society and culture.
loc.SOV_reconvene_the_zemsky_sobor_desc: In ages past, the Russian people would assemble in a form of parliament, called the Zemsky Sobor, to discuss matters and decide issues. Until we have decided on what path to take our country on, we should let the people decide what concerns them all.
loc.SOV_recognized_country_tt: §Y[ROOT.GetNameDefCap]§! is recognized by the international community:
loc.SOV_dismantle_the_zemsky_sobor_desc: The Zemsky Sobor has served its purpose. Too much democracy can be a dangerous thing, as was shown in 1917. We should not repeat the mistakes of the past.
loc.SOV_religious_primacy_desc: The importance of religion in our society cannot be understated. It is time the state accepts and supports this primacy - and to make the first steps towards a unification of church and state.
loc.SOV_romanov_reconstruction_desc: At last our nation once more has a Tsar to lead it. Two decades after the persecution of the last rightful rulers of our country, it is now time to embrace our governing dynasty once more, and to do away with minor impediments to the execution of our Tsar's will.
loc.SOV_CHURCH_CANDIDATES_DESC_TSARIST: The Church has requested permission to send their own candidates to future elections in the Zemsky Sobor. In recognition of the important role the Patriarchate plays in Russian society, we have decided to accept, paving the way to a possibility of a true merger of the will of God and the will of our ruler.
loc.SOV_CHURCH_CANDIDATES_DESC_FASCIST: The importance of religion in our society cannot be understated. It is time the state accepts and supports this primacy - and to make the first steps towards a unification of church and state.
loc.SOV_reinstitute_the_mestnichestvo_desc: Back in the day, the oldest and most distinguished families ran the affairs of state. This ensured that the Elite was loyal to the state that they ran, and that each new generation would be raised to the exacting standards of the old. We should re-instute this system to secure our new regime.
loc.SOV_my_brothers_keeper_desc: The old Romanov Dynasty had dynastic ties to many other noble families. Some of them still hold power, some of them have lost their thrones. Now that we have restored our own monarchy, we should make sure that the right rulers are put in place in these other countries as well.
loc.SOV_the_rightful_heir_to_the_empire: The Rightful Heir to the Empire
loc.SOV_the_rightful_heir_to_the_empire_desc: While the old Byzantine Empire is long gone, someone still needs to protect the pilgrims to the Holy Land. It is clear that the British and the French are not up to the task, so it should clearly fall to us.
loc.SOV_the_third_rome_desc: With our role as protectors of the Holy Places secure, we are the indisputable defenders of the faith. It is only valid that we should style ourselves accordingly. After the Fall of Constantinople, Moscow has become, without a doubt, the Third Rome.
loc.SOV_the_third_rome_tt: §Y$SOV_metropolitan_meletius$§! will no longer be available as an advisor.
loc.SOV_vengeance_for_the_yoke_desc: Many centuries ago the Mongols launched their brutal invasion of the Russian lands. They remain the only people who could ever be said to have truly conquered Russia. They may seem weak now, but we must make sure that they never return to their former strength so that we may never again feel the Tatar Yoke.
loc.SOV_reclaim_uryankhay_krai_desc: In the Mongolian Revolution of 1911 the Uryankhay Republic and the Bogd Khanate of Mongolia broke off from the Qing Empire, and we stepped in to protect them, turning the Uryankhay region into a [ROOT.GetAdjective] territory. With the recent turmoil of civil war however, it seems that they seek independence from us, something which we must not grant them, lest the world powers look down upon us for centuries to come!
loc.SOV_westward_bound_desc: Much of our western possessions were lost with the collapse of our empire, caused by the revolution. The time has come to build up our infrastructure in preparation for reclaiming our rightful possessions.
loc.SOV_the_old_enemy_desc: For years, Sweden was a thorn in the Empire’s side. They have again and again attacked Russia and tried to create coalitions against us. Tsar Peter I first began pushing them back, beating them at Poltava. In 1809 we again defeated them, and one would think that made them know their place. But they've kept trying to contest our interests in the Baltic region. It is time to once and for all squash this tiny nation.
loc.SOV_secure_finland_desc: The Grand Duchy of Finland has guarded our northern borders for over a century, until it broke away in the civil war. The day has come to reunite Finland with the motherland.
loc.SOV_secure_the_baltics_desc: The Baltic region has long been an integral part of Russia. They broke away in a moment of national weakness, and must be recovered as soon as possible.
loc.SOV_panslavic_nationalism_desc: Russia has long been the biggest and oldest brother in our Slavic family. If there is one lesson that we should have learned a long time ago is that the Slavs will always be attacked, bullied, and oppressed unless we stick together.
loc.SOV_panslavic_nationalism_tt: §RCountries must approve of the agreement for the bonuses to take effect.§!\n
loc.SOV_pacify_the_rim_desc: We can not allow a repeat of the war of 1905, when our far-eastern holdings were attacked and found woefully unprepared for the onslaught. We need to invest in the local infrastructure, to be able to quickly shift troops around if the need arises.
loc.SOV_eastern_expansion_desc: Russia's Future lies in the East. After we have tamed Siberia, it is only fitting that we should endeavor to gain even more land and resources here.
loc.SOV_restore_the_old_eastern_empire_desc: There once was a time where our glorious empire stretched across the rim of the Pacific, pushing deep into the Americas. Ill-considered decisions since then have traded these possessions for short-term monetary gains. But under our leadership, Russia may once more reclaim its American possessions. We will simply have to make their current owners withdraw from them.
loc.SOV_intervention_in_the_americas_desc: The many small nations of the Caribbean and of Latin America at large have long been plagued by unstable governments. It is time we flex our political muscle and 'encourage' their domestic political evolution into a direction of strength and stability. Once they develop likeminded governments to our own, they will be offered a place in our growing military alliance.
loc.SOV_intervention_in_the_americas_tt: Countries being influenced are more likely to become Fascist.\nCountries that become Fascist as a result of this influence will be invited to our faction.
loc.SOV_memories_of_1905_desc: The war of 1905 is still a black mark in our people's collective memory. We must exploit this, and exhort the workers in a monumental effort to create a new fleet with which we may dominate the Pacific - and fan the flames of their hatred so that they will call for its use to exact our vengeance against our old enemies.
loc.SOV_rebuild_the_far_eastern_fleet_desc: If we are to secure our Far Eastern interests, much less go on the offensive, we must drastically expand our shipbuilding and repair capacity in this region.
loc.SOV_modernize_the_far_eastern_fleet_desc: Tsushima taught us we cannot rely on weight of numbers. To truly carry the day in a naval engagement we require well-trained crews and flawless, modern warships for them to sail. The new fleet we construct must be able to contend with that of our technologically-advanced adversaries in the Pacific.
loc.SOV_THE_LONELY_ISLAND_DESC_NORMAL: The time has come for us to redress the affront which the Japanese perpetrated upon us in 1905. This time, there shall be nothing stopping us from ruling the Sea of Japan and bringing them to their knees!
loc.SOV_THE_LONELY_ISLAND_DESC_INDEPENDENCE: The price we paid for [JAP.GetAdjective] assistance in our civil war was far, far too high. No more! We will regain our independence at any cost.
loc.SOV_an_empire_in_the_pacific_desc: As our Empire begins to stretch across the Pacific, so too must our ship design follow suit, to be able to exercise our power and influence across these vast swathes of ocean.
loc.SOV_dismantle_the_zemsky_sobor_tt: Half of current §Ynon-Fascist§! support is applied as a §RStability§! penalty:\n
loc.SOV_an_empire_in_the_pacific_tt: Gain §Gclaims§! on all states in §YGreater China§!.
loc.SOV_capital_of_the_tsars_desc: St. Petersburg has throughout history been the capital of our proud nation. Now, with the Winter Palace once more occupied by a Romanov, it is time the official capital is once again relocated to this magnificent city, and that all effort be dedicated to heightening its splendor.
loc.SOV_the_iron_wall_of_russian_resolve: The Iron Wall of Russian Resolve
loc.SOV_the_iron_wall_of_russian_resolve_des: The Tsar envisions the construction of legions of monstrous weapons of war that would dwarf existing tanks and have no equal on the battlefield. The Russian people are unconquered; it is unconquerable! These machines will be the embodiment of that resolve, and upon them shall break every army that is thrown at us.
loc.SOV_the_triple_entente_desc: Our old enemies in central Europe must be contained. An alliance once existed for this purpose, though our ignominious withdrawal from the Great War spelled its end. Now is the time to reforge those ties.
loc.SOV_our_slavic_commitments_desc: We once were the protectors of all Slavs, even entering the Great War to defend our weaker Slavic brethren. It is time we once more bear this mantle, and lend our military might to their defense.
loc.SOV_the_fate_of_romania_desc: Romania has a substantial Slavic minority, and blocks our land access to the Slavic peoples in the Balkans. To solve both problems in one stroke, Romanian independence must come to an end, by military might, if necessary.
loc.SOV_russian_corporate_state_desc: The future of Russia lies not in class conflict, but rather in class co-operation. To this end the state shall establish national unions to reconcile the interests off labor and capital, and through these regulate production.
loc.SOV_the_berlin_moscow_axis_desc: With our new government now firmly installed after the German and Italian models, we should reach out to mend former relations with our western neighbors. If we focus on the views we share, we might well establish a strong and lasting alliance between ourselves and [GER.GetName].
loc.SOV_japanese_overtures_desc: Now that our western flank has been secured, we must see to our eastern one. The Japanese have much in common with the Germans, and more in common with our own new government than they might want to admit. Let us inquire what the Germans think of extending an invitation to them.
loc.SOV_into_central_asia_desc: Conquest of Central Asia will bring us into a position to threaten India, while also netting us access to the Persian Gulf. The strategic necessity is clear, and ours is an empire that will not find its graveyard here.
loc.SOV_the_last_break_southward_desc: A final series of conquests will finally secure the remainder of Western Asia and the Bosporus, allowing us to wrest control from India with our flank secure. We will at long last obtain undisputed access to the seas, from the nearby Mediterranean all the way to the Indian Ocean.
loc.independent_air_force_spirit_desc: The Air Force is an independent branch, and just as important as the Army or the Navy.
loc.industrial_destruction_spirit_desc: 1000 bombers can change the course of the war in a single strike.
loc.material_destruction_spirit_desc: Destruction of equipment and disruption of the enemy's lines of communication shall seal victory faster than any number of inflicted casualties.
loc.air_modernizers_spirit_desc: It hasn't been long since the Fokker E.III was the best fighter in the world. Things change fast.
loc.industry_liasons_spirit_desc: Only frictionless cooperation between the aircraft industry, military, and government will ensure the highest quality.
loc.air_crew_surveys_spirit_desc: After all, they are the ones using the equipment, so why not ask them?
loc.maritime_patrol_spirit_desc: If it floats, we can find it.
loc.long_range_patrol_spirit_desc: Dominating the air space away from home.
loc.efficient_ground_crews_spirit_desc: Ace pilots are all well and good, but what really matters is getting the planes up in the air as fast as possible.
loc.branch_independence_spirit_desc: No army or navy guy can order us around. We do things our way.
loc.air_theory_spirit_desc: There's a science to air combat.
loc.subservience_to_army_spirit_desc: It's a simple job description really, bomb where the Generals tell you to bomb.
loc.subservience_to_navy_spirit_desc: Aircraft are only really useful as naval support weapons and reconnaissance.
loc.no_focus_on_training_spirit_desc: Practice? Why should we do that? This is easy! Also; saves fuel.
loc.disorganized_ground_crews_spirit_desc: Ground crew? Who are they? Why should they matter?
loc.elite_fighter_pilots_spirit_desc: Remember boys, there’s no points for second place.
loc.long_range_navigation_spirit_desc: They can run, but they can't hide.
loc.dogfighting_training_spirit_desc: That's not an Immelman turn, that's a half loop.
loc.expert_marksmen_spirit_desc: It's all about knowing where to aim and when to press the trigger.
loc.battlefield_air_interdiction_spirit_desc: Close cooperation between air and ground forces.
loc.cag_night_fighting_spirit_desc: You think just flying in the dark is hard? Try landing on an aircraft carrier in the middle of the night!
loc.veteran_air_instructors_spirit_desc: Letting the best train the rest.
loc.steel_wings_steel_hearts_spirit_desc: It takes a certain type of courage to wage war at 10,000 feet.\n\n§GThis spirit is available due to our ideology.§!
loc.home_defence_spirit_desc: The vast expanse of the sky holds untold promise for those in search of a legacy.
loc.centralized_control_spirit_desc: Effective management of resources ensures that planes reach the locations where they are needed the most.
loc.air_power_projection_spirit_desc: A special daring is necessary when fighting away from home.
loc.massed_strike_spirit_desc: Disrupting the enemy ground forces is the best way to defeat them.
loc.continuous_strike_spirit_desc: Destruction of key enemy equipment is vital.
loc.strategic_strike_spirit_desc: Massive strategic strikes at the heart of the enemy's core will break their ability to fight.
loc.duelling_obsession_spirit_desc: Going one on one is the only honorable and gentlemanly way of fighting in the air.
loc.lax_safety_regulations_spirit_desc: I mean, no-one really follows the instructions anyway, so what's the point?
loc.officers_clique_spirit_desc: They may be pilots, but they are still just privates, right?
loc.not_worth_the_risk_spirit_desc: Planes are really expensive you know.
loc.merchant_mariners_spirit_desc: Seamanship is second nature to us.
loc.naval_wargames_spirit_desc: Theoretical tactical training saves lives, and fuel.
loc.instilled_aggression_spirit_tt: Admirals: §G50% chance§! to gain §Y+1 Attack§! on level up.
loc.calculated_restraint_spirit_tt: Admirals: §G50% chance§! to gain §Y+1 Defense§! on level up.
loc.signals_training_spirit_desc: In order for every man to do his duty, he must know what his duty is.
loc.signals_training_spirit_tt: Admirals: §G50% chance§! to gain §Y+1 Maneuvering and Coordination§! on level up.
loc.fleet_in_being_academy_spirit_tt: New Admirals: §G50% chance§! to begin with §Y"Gunnery Expert"§! trait.
loc.merchant_mariners_spirit_tt: New Admirals: §G50% chance§! to begin with §Y"Naval Lineage"§! trait.
loc.trade_interdiction_academy_spirit_desc: Merchant convoys require special tactics and training.
loc.trade_interdiction_academy_spirit_tt: New Admirals: §G50% chance§! to begin with §Y"Seawolf"§! or §Y"Blockade Runner"§! traits.
loc.base_strike_academy_spirit_desc: Close co-operation between air and sea units is vital!
loc.base_strike_academy_spirit_tt: New Admirals: §G50% chance§! to begin with §Y"Aviation Enthusiast"§! trait.
loc.damage_control_training_spirit_desc: Well drilled crews means less casualties on our side.
loc.damage_control_training_spirit_tt: New Admirals: §G50% chance§! to begin with §Y"Chief Engineer"§! trait.
loc.best_of_the_best_naval_academy_spirit_de: Tough competition and strict selection breeds the captains we want.\n\n§GThis spirit is available due to our ideology.§!
loc.best_of_the_best_naval_academy_spirit_tt: New Admirals: begin without any personality traits.
loc.naval_academy_scholarships_spirit_desc: It's all about giving the right people the chance to shine.
loc.naval_academy_scholarships_spirit_tt: New Admirals: begin without any personality traits.
loc.traditionalism_naval_academy_spirit_desc: This is the way we have always done it. Why change now?
loc.traditionalism_naval_academy_spirit_tt: Increased chance of new admirals having the §Y"Old Guard"§! trait.\n§G50% chance§! that new admirals gain an extra skill point in two categories.
loc.political_appointments_naval_academy_spi: It's important that only teachers with the right attitude teach at our academy.
loc.nepotism_naval_academy_spirit_desc: My father was a teacher at the academy, like his father before him, and his older brother...
loc.nepotism_naval_academy_spirit_tt: Decreased chance of new admirals getting favorable personality traits.
loc.big_gun_club_spirit_desc: Battleships dominate not just the seas, but also politics.
loc.aviation_enthusiasts_spirit_desc: The future of naval combat will be fought in the air.
loc.cruiser_warfare_spirit_desc: Cruisers are the best type of ship there is, they can do any job.
loc.wolfpacks_spirit_desc: The silent hunters of the sea.
loc.flexible_contracts_spirit_desc: The best contract is one that can be terminated.
loc.integrated_designers_spirit_desc: Constantly adapting our designs is top priority.
loc.naval_refit_yards_spirit_desc: Minimizing time in the dock maximizes the time a ship can be at sea.
loc.fleet_in_being_navy_spirit_desc: Our ships shall patrol the oceans around the globe.
loc.trade_interdiction_navy_spirit_desc: Without supplies, a country cannot fight a war.
loc.base_strike_navy_spirit_desc: Being able to strike anywhere, anytime.
loc.landlocked_spirit_desc: Without access to the sea it is hard to build a naval tradition.
loc.political_connections_navy_spirit_desc: My command has nothing to do with my father being the Minister of Finance!
loc.overbearing_army_spirit_desc: The Navy is but support for the Army.
loc.bureau_of_ordnance_spirit_desc: The Bureau of Ordnance influences any ship designs made.\n\n§GThis spirit is available due to our amazing torpedoes.§!
loc.only_big_guns_spirit_desc: Battleships are the undisputed queens of the high seas.
loc.close_combat_navy_spirit_desc: Getting in close is the key to victory.
loc.night_fighting_spirit_desc: Being used to fighting in the dark gives distinct advantages.
loc.surprise_attacks_spirit_desc: Hitting the enemy before he is aware of the threat.
loc.surface_raiders_spirit_desc: Why just let the subs do all the raiding?
loc.decisive_battle_spirit_desc: Going all in for the battle will always give you the initiative.
loc.inclimate_weather_experience_spirit_desc: There's no such thing as bad weather...
loc.brave_commanders_spirit_desc: Damn the torpedoes, full speed ahead!
loc.brown_water_spirit_desc: Navigating and fighting in the archipelago takes a special set of skills.
loc.green_water_spirit_desc: Keeping close to the shore is the safest bet.
loc.blue_water_spirit_desc: The deep ocean is the true home of a sailor.
loc.poor_damage_control_training_spirit_desc: Who needs to train that anyway? We are supposed to be hitting the enemy, not the other way around.
loc.limited_sea_time_spirit_desc: Keeping the fleet at sea makes it more expensive to run.
loc.cult_of_the_signal_flag_spirit_desc: As long as everyone follows orders, no-one can get blamed.
loc.bold_attack_spirit_desc: As the saying goes: a strong offense is the best defense.
loc.meticulous_preparation_spirit_desc: War is chaos, but chaos can be prepared for.
loc.best_of_the_best_spirit_desc: Few people have what it takes to lead soldiers into battle. Fewer still have what it takes to win that battle.
loc.academy_scholarships_spirit_desc: No one should be prevented from serving their nation due to a simple lack of money.\n\n§GThis spirit is available due to our ideology.§!
loc.political_loyalty_spirit_desc: An unreliable military is a threat to the state it is meant to protect.\n\n§GThis spirit is available due to our ideology.§!
loc.political_loyalty_spirit_tt: New Officers: begin with either §Y"Politically Connected"§! or §Y"Media Personality"§! traits.
loc.inventive_leadership_spirit_desc: A predictable General is a defeated General.
loc.inventive_leadership_spirit_tt: New Officers: §G50% chance§! to begin with §Y"Commando"§!, §Y"Trickster"§!, or §Y"Invader"§! traits.
loc.mobile_warfare_academy_spirit_desc: Wherever future battles are fought, armored troops will play the decisive role.
loc.mobile_warfare_academy_spirit_tt: New Officers: Gain a chance to begin with §Y"Armor Officer"§! trait.
loc.superior_firepower_academy_spirit_desc: There is a lot of science involved in digging a proper ditch.
loc.superior_firepower_academy_spirit_tt: New Officers: Gain a chance to begin with §Y"Engineer Officer"§! trait.
loc.theatre_training_spirit_desc: Some officers may 'go native', but natives are very good at fighting on their chosen terrain.
loc.theatre_training_academy_spirit_tt: §G50% chance§! that new officers are created with the §Y"Brilliant Strategist"§! or §Y"Inflexible Strategist"§! trait.
loc.mass_assault_academy_spirit_desc: Infantry is the Queen of Battle, and the Queen goes wherever she pleases.
loc.underfunded_academy_spirit_desc: There are better things to spend money on than teaching people how to kill each other more efficiently.
loc.nepotism_academy_spirit_desc: My uncle runs the army and he says I can get my own division command whenever I want!
loc.professional_officer_corps_spirit_desc: We are professionals, and war is our profession.
loc.elevated_engineering_corps_spirit_desc: The best judge of a man's ability and character is to give him a shovel and a day to do something useful with it.
loc.proper_heritage_spirit_desc: A good General may be trained, but a great General must be bred. Like horses, in a way.
loc.quick_improvisation_spirit_desc: Understand faster, think faster, act faster - that is the key to victory.
loc.adaptable_modernizers_spirit_desc: A doctrine that can not be changed may as well be called a dogma.
loc.relief_of_command_spirit_desc: The army does not exist to feed the ego of its Generals.\n\n§GThis spirit is available due to our ideology.§!
loc.ideological_loyalty_spirit_desc: Someone who does not have the correct ideology can not be expected to achieve the correct result in battle.\n\n§GThis spirit is available due to our ideology.§!
loc.state_serves_the_military_spirit_desc: The purpose of the state is to wage war against other states. Anything else is either in support of that or a useless distraction.\n\n§GThis spirit is available due to our ideology.§!
loc.mobile_warfare_army_spirit_desc: Strike faster, go further, win harder!
loc.superior_firepower_army_spirit_desc: If artillery doesn't win you battles, you're not using enough of it.
loc.grand_battleplan_army_spirit_desc: The dagger in the night is often more effective than the longsword in the day.
loc.mass_assault_army_spirit_desc: When all is said and done, a tank or airplane can't hold a patch of ground.
loc.political_connections_spirit_desc: Well, we'll see what the minister has to say about that!
loc.entrenched_old_guard_spirit_desc: Who is this idiot, and why is he talking about this 'airplane' nonsense again?
loc.doctrinal_orthodoxy_spirit_desc: That's not how we used to do it back in my day.
loc.excessive_parade_drill_spirit_desc: A soldier's primary purpose is to look good on parade.
loc.static_warfare_spirit_desc: There is no such thing as too much trench work. There is only 'insufficient' and 'barely adequate'.
loc.flexible_organization_spirit_desc: What counts is getting the job done, not following orders to the letter.
loc.aggressive_reconnaisance_spirit_desc: If you want to know what the other side is up to, go over there and ask them directly!
loc.reserve_officers_spirit_desc: Not everyone needs to make the military their profession. But in times of war, they can still serve.
loc.upbeat_command_spirit_desc: A kind word or a shared joke with the common soldier often does more for the overall success of the unit than an extra artillery battery.
loc.victory_or_death_spirit_desc: It is better to die with glory than to live in the shame of defeat.
loc.maneuver_warfare_spirit_desc: A proper, civilized war is more like a chess match than a brawl. Why fight an enemy you can maneuver around?
loc.smoke_and_fire_spirit_desc: A rolling barrage of shells is surprisingly effective at keeping the enemy from shooting back.
loc.logistical_focus_spirit_desc: The troops can eat their belts but the tanks got to have gas.
loc.operational_reserve_spirit_desc: Always have something up your sleeve. Always.
loc.intercommand_rivalries_spirit_desc: The most important battles are fought in appropriation committees, and that is where the ugliest grudges are born.
loc.disregard_for_the_common_soldier_spirit_: The average soldier is the dumbest, ugliest, laziest creature that could be fit in a uniform.
loc.constraining_hierarchy_spirit_desc: If you don't pay close attention to where your subordinates are at all times, someone might end up stealing them.
loc.disdain_for_the_digging_spirit_desc: All this mud gets on the uniform and then the troops will have to spend a lot of time cleaning them.
loc.expeditionary_spirit_desc: Winning a war means going to the other guy's country and breaking a lot of things.
loc.penny_pinching_spirit_desc: Do you have any idea how much money it costs to fire this bullet? And you want to do it for 'training'?
loc.bold_attack_spirit_tt: Officers: §G50% chance§! of §Y+1 Attack§! on level up.
loc.tenacious_defense_spirit_tt: Officers: §G50% chance§! of §Y+1 Defense§! on level up.
loc.meticulous_preparation_spirit_tt: Officers: §G50% chance§! of §Y+1 Planning and Logistics§! on level up.
loc.best_of_the_best_spirit_tt: New Officers: no personality traits gained on hiring.
loc.academy_scholarships_spirit_tt: New Officers: no personality traits gained on hiring.
loc.mass_assault_academy_spirit_tt: New Officers: Gain a chance to begin with §Y"Infantry Officer"§! trait.
loc.nepotism_academy_spirit_tt: §R-50% chance§! that new officers are created with positive traits.
loc.traditionalism_academy_spirit_tt: §R-20% chance§! that a new officer is recruited with the §YArmor Officer§! trait. §R20% chance§! that a new officer is recruited with lower §YAttack§! or §YDefense§! skill.
loc.air_force_academy_spirit: Spirit of the Air Force Academy
loc.BALTIC_recent_skirmish_desc: This nation has recently suffered a skirmish with the local paramilitary resistance.
loc.BALTIC_equipment_siphon_desc: Recent underground criminal activity has caused this nation to lose a significant amount of its production base.
loc.LIT_agrarian_society_desc: Lithuania's economy revolves largely around the agriculture industry. Export of food goods to nearby nations is how Lithuania makes the majority of its income.
loc.LIT_invested_in_farms_desc: With proper investment, the largely agrarian based economy of Lithuania has turned to the state's advantage, with Lithuanian crops fuelling the war economy and proper infrastructure facilitating for the rapid mobilization of the disparate farming communities across the nation.
loc.LIT_invested_in_farms_1_desc: With proper investment, the largely agrarian based economy of Lithuania has turned to the state's advantage, with Lithuanian crops fuelling the war economy and proper infrastructure facilitating for the rapid mobilization of the disparate farming communities across the nation.
loc.LIT_purge_resistance_idea_desc: Through a series of raids and propaganda, this nation is purging all popular ideological resistance against the regime.
loc.LIT_purge_resistance_communism_idea_desc: Through a series of raids and propaganda, this nation is purging all popular ideological resistance against the regime.
loc.LAT_neopaganism_idea_desc: Dievturība is the revival of the ancient Baltic faith, and has become popular within Latvian fascist institutions. Fascist paramilitaries within Latvia have codified that all who wish to join the military must first pledge themselves to Dievs, making Dievturība the official religion of the military.
loc.LAT_state_romuva_idea_1_desc: Dievturība is the revival of the ancient Baltic faith, and has become popular within Latvian fascist institutions. Fascist paramilitaries within Latvia have codified that all who wish to join the military must first pledge themselves to Dievs, making Dievturība the official religion of the military.
loc.LAT_state_romuva_idea_2_desc: Dievturība is the revival of the ancient Baltic faith, and has become popular within Latvian fascist institutions. Fascist paramilitaries within Latvia have codified that all who wish to join the military must first pledge themselves to Dievs, making Dievturība the official religion of the military.
loc.LAT_state_romuva_idea_3_desc: Dievturība is the revival of the ancient Baltic faith, and has become popular within Latvian fascist institutions. Fascist paramilitaries within Latvia have codified that all who wish to join the military must first pledge themselves to Dievs, making Dievturība the official religion of the military.
loc.BALTIC_forest_brothers_reorganized_idea_: Once protectors of Baltic independence, the Latvian chapter of the Forest Brothers has been reorganized into a paramilitary wing of the Pērkonkrusts.
loc.POL_royal_hussars_idea_desc: Our nation has a long and proud tradition of Hussars, and it must be made to be, that these brave men may once again return to serve their liege.
loc.SOV_understaffed_bureaucracy_desc: The NKVD discovered evidence of a large scale conspiracy inside the civilian administration and several bureaucrats have been removed from post.
loc.SOV_anti_soviet_military_thinking_banned: The study and discussion of documents and ideas from disgraced and reactionary theorists is now forbidden for our Army officers in the Academy, and new graduates are scrupulously vetted to ensure that no enemy of the people accesses the ranks of the Red Army.
loc.SOV_training_activities_curtailed_desc: A significant percentage of vehicles experienced mechanical failures and several recruits were injured during recent military exercises. Until we find out the true reason for these mechanical defects, we have curtailed major training exercises to avoid further damage to both our recruits and our military assets.
loc.SOV_purged_junior_army_officers_1_desc: A significant number of junior Army officers have been arrested by the NKVD on charges of sedition, sabotage, and anti-soviet thinking. The loss of so many experienced officers and veterans from past wars has left the Red Army in dangerous disarray.
loc.SOV_anti_soviet_military_thinking_banned: The study and discussion of documents and ideas from disgraced and reactionary theorists is now forbidden for our Navy officers in the Academy, and new graduates are scrupulously vetted to ensure that no enemy of the people accesses the ranks of the Red Fleet.
loc.SOV_shipyard_staff_purged_desc: After a large-scale investigation into multiple allegations of sabotage and other suspicious activities in the Navy, the NKVD has made numerous arrests, leaving some of our shipyards and naval bases seriously understaffed.
loc.SOV_purged_junior_navy_officers_1_desc: A significant number of junior Navy officers have been arrested by the NKVD on charges of sedition, sabotage, and anti-soviet thinking. The loss of so many experienced officers and veterans from past wars has left the Red Fleet in dangerous disarray.
loc.SOV_anti_soviet_military_thinking_banned: The study and discussion of documents and ideas from disgraced and reactionary theorists is now forbidden for our Air Force officers in the Academy, and new graduates are scrupulously vetted to ensure that no enemy of the people accesses the ranks of the Soviet Air Force.
loc.SOV_ground_based_training_desc: After a series of air crashes and accidents were reported during training exercises, the NKVD has initiated an inspection in the Air Force and, following the instructions of the agents assigned to the case, no more flight exercises will be carried out while the investigation is ongoing.
loc.SOV_purged_junior_army_officers_3_tt: §YAll ground vehicles§!: Reliability bonus: §R-30%§!\n§Y$politically_connected$§! will be the only trait available for new Generals.
loc.SOV_purged_junior_navy_officers_3_tt: §Y$politically_connected$§! will be the only trait available for new Admirals.
loc.SOV_anti_capitalist_campaign_generic_des: Capitalists cannot be trusted. When given the choice, the Bourgeoisie will always choose to oppress the proletariat. We must be prepared to take the fight to them.
loc.SOV_anti_fascist_campaign_generic_desc: There can be no peaceful co-existence with the fascists. We must prepare for the inevitable confrontation.
loc.SOV_young_builders_of_communism_desc: We are not building Socialism for the adults of today, we are building it for the children and the generations not yet born. They must be taught how to improve and build on the achievements we make, so that they can complete the work that we have started.
loc.SOV_broken_peace_dreams_attacker_desc: This new war we find ourselves in, not so long after we publicly promised to pursue policies of peace, is causing instability and distrust among the population.
loc.SOV_support_in_china_generic_desc: The [SOU.GetAdjective] government is supporting [ROOT.GetNameDef] in our war against the [JAP.GetAdjective], expecting to develop closer ties with us while also influencing our politics.
loc.SOV_soviet_japanese_reckoning_desc: It is time to bring the war to the [JAP.GetAdjective] and avenge the many wrongs they have caused us.
loc.SOV_soviet_japanese_anti_usa_pact_desc: Together, we will remove [USA.GetNameDef] from the world stage!
loc.SOV_soviet_advisors_spr_desc: Military advisors and other skilled military personnel have arrived from the [SOV.GetNameDef] to support us in our fight against fascism and the reactionary counter-revolution.
loc.SOV_central_headquarters_of_the_partisan: Central Headquarters of the Partisan Movement
loc.SOV_national_academy_of_sciences_puppet_: Modelled after [GetTheUssrAcademyOfSciencesName], [SOV.GetNameDef] has established a new research institute in our country to boost both our scientific development and theirs.
loc.SOV_rehabilitated_military_ns_desc: It is time to rein in the political officers a bit and give the commanders more latitude on how to run things.
loc.SOV_military_reorganization_ns_desc: The [GetSovietArmyAdjectiveBasedOnIdeology] Army is undergoing a huge reorganization, which requires disrupting the existing formations to some extent for a hopefully short period of time.
loc.SOV_expanded_exploitation_of_gold_mines_: The [SOV.GetAdjective] investment in infrastructure and industrial aid in the Northern territories of [ROOT.GetNameDef] has allowed us to increase the efficiency in the exploitation of our gold mines in the region.
loc.SOV_shocked_by_surprise_attack_desc: The enemy military operation against our country, codenamed Operation Countenance, has taken our government and military by surprise. Our forces are overwhelmed, our communications have been cut off, and summoning enemy diplomats to demand an explanation has turned out to be futile. While we try to figure out this chaos, our foreign relations are effectively neutralized.
loc.SOV_shocked_by_surprise_attack_cant_join: Set the rule: £trigger_no Can join factions.
loc.SOV_soviet_commandos_poum_desc: The Right Opposition to Stalinism in [SOV.GetNameDef] has sent highly trained agents to our country to carry out special operations and teach our people how to wage war.
loc.SOV_popular_speeches_poum_desc: With the help of local organizations and influential members of the anti-Stalinist opposition abroad, we are conducting a large information and agitation campaign in our controlled territories to rekindle the flame of revolution among the masses.
loc.SOV_agents_in_the_stalinist_command_poum: The Soviet Right Opposition managed to infiltrate several agents among the latest batch of military advisers sent to the Spanish Republic by [SOU.GetLeader]. These agents have created a network of informants that allow us to learn about the enemy plans before they are carried out.
loc.SOV_organized_wreckers_idea_desc: The enemies of the state have recruited wreckers among the working class, who are disrupting critical industry and making it harder to reach production needs.
loc.SOV_arms_purchases_idea_desc: Arming the Soviet opposition will cost us a bit, but in the long run the gains will more than make up for the temporary cost.
loc.SOV_covert_military_buildup_idea_desc: We are currently secretly aiding the Soviet Opposition, by establishing secret weapons and munitions production facilities.
loc.SOV_covert_ukrainian_military_buildup_id: Using secret training camps, we are training Ukrainian militia in order to create an insurrection against the stalinists.
loc.SOV_the_fourth_international_idea_desc: As the true leaders of the International we can now guide the communist cause in the world.
loc.SOV_foreign_funds_idea_desc: Generous donations from foreign individuals and organisations help fund our revolution.
loc.SOV_support_from_farmers_desc: Having secured support from the farmers, we can better support our armies.
loc.SOV_system_decentralization_idea_desc: Power has been moved away from the politburo in general and the Secretary in particular, and back to the party itself.
loc.SOV_the_local_soviets_idea_desc: The regional and the local Soviets have had some authority restored. This means that they can more easily take decisions in matters that are urgent to them, at the cost of some political control by the politburo.
loc.SOV_strong_trade_unions_idea_desc: Strong trade unions means the workers can better influence production.
loc.SOV_the_peoples_revolution_idea_desc: The revolution has to be carried by the people for it to be truly successful.
loc.SOV_puppet_international_of_soviet_repub: Being part of a greater whole is of huge benefit to our country.
loc.SOV_support_of_the_peasants_idea_desc: Strong support from farmers across the country makes it possible to recruit, and maintain, bigger armies.
loc.SOV_curtailment_collective_farms_idea_de: Small and mid scale farms are far more efficient in terms of output than large farms.
loc.SOV_administrative_reforms_idea_desc: The old Soviet administration was hampered by inefficiency partly due to its size but mainly by a too rigorous control apparatus. By reducing it a little, much has been gained.
loc.SOV_local_organizations_idea_desc: By better incorporating the local organizations in the government of the country, we get access to all the talent available in this country.
loc.SOV_enemies_of_the_people_idea_desc: There will always be those wanting to overthrow the people's government. We must remain ever vigilant against threats, internal as well as external.
loc.SOV_soviet_hegemony_idea_desc: Our system of government has proven itself superior to all others. We must use this opportunity to spread our ideas, enlightening those oppressed by other systems, as well as those who have been fortunate enough to have been included in the union.
loc.SOV_fascist_womens_movement_idea_desc: At the heart of the nationalist movement stands the [ROOT.GetAdjective] woman. Mothers, wives, and daughters of our brave soldiers, organized and ready to support the fight for greatness.
loc.SOV_the_true_tsars_idea_desc: The Tsar is the legitimate leader of [ROOT.GetNameDef]. Rallying behind the Tsar, rather than another individual or ideology, allows us to attract more supporters to our cause.
loc.SOV_comecon_sov_default_desc: There are undergoing measures taken by [GetComeconName].
loc.SOV_soviet_german_trade_agreement_desc: As agreed in our trade pact with [SOU.GetNameDef], they are sending us raw materials such as grain, cotton, oil, metal ores and rubber.
loc.SOV_development_of_eastern_allies_tt: This National Spirit will be removed upon completion of the focus '§YDevelopment Aid for Eastern Allies§!'
loc.SOV_face_western_fascism_ns_tt: Attack bonus against §Ymajor fascist countries in Europe§!: §G+10.0%§!, Defense bonus against §Ymajor fascist countries in Europe§!: §G10.0%§!.
loc.SOV_liberation_of_the_european_proletari: Attack bonus against §Ymajor democracies in Europe§!: §G+10.0%§!, Defense bonus against §Ymajor democracies in Europe§!: §G10.0%§!.
loc.SOV_military_reorganization_ns_removal_t: This National Spirit will be removed upon completion of the focus '§Y$SOV_military_reorganization$§!'
loc.SOV_the_politburo_ns_good_tt: It is possible to manually change the Head of the NKVD §O(Coming Soon)§!
loc.SOV_industrial_concern_upgrade_tt: \nCompleting the focus '§Y$SOV_national_specialists$§!' will improve this designer.
loc.SOV_gosproyektstroy_1_tt: This Designer can be upgraded to add new bonuses and improve existent ones.
loc.SOV_factionalism_modifier_tt: §LFactionalism within the party was always a problem, and with the opposition more vocal, the differences of opinion makes the party less efficient. Properly managed, though, difference of opinion can in the long run be turned into a strength rather than a weakness.§!\n\n
loc.SOV_opposition_popular_support_tt: §LWith a large part of the party members, and public opinion, in support of the opposition, maintaining a losing war is much more difficult.§!\n\n
loc.SOV_workers_government_idea_desc: Long live the worker’s government. The Ruling Elite has been removed from power. The workers once more rule the country.
loc.SOV_revolutionary_spirit_idea_desc: The revolutionary zeal has been reignited by the victory over Stalin. It is time to carry the revolutionary flame to the workers around the world.
loc.SOV_trotskyist_revolutionary_agitation_d: Trotskyist sympathizers and other communist elements aligned with the [SOV.GetAdjective] Bolshevik Party are stirring up the [ROOT.GetAdjective] masses, promoting the Marxist ideology among the working class and calling for an armed struggle against our government.
loc.SOV_trotskyist_revolutionary_agitation_t: Activating the decision §Y$ban_communist_party$§! will reduce the effects from this national spirit.
loc.SOV_politicized_military_desc: Military commissars often hold fervent ideological speeches and political discussions among the ranks, but in many cases they also engage in excessive administration, overzealous scrutiny of military officers, and even obstruction of the orders of unit commanders.
loc.SOV_politicized_military_swap_desc: While we shouldn't let political considerations dictate military decisions, we still have to ensure that these political considerations are accounted for when the decision is reached.
loc.SOV_politicized_military_battle_priests_: Taking on the role of Battle Priests within our military units, the clergy is now in charge of keeping morale high among the ranks, and making sure that the troops know that the Church, and God, are on our side.
loc.SOV_for_the_common_good_allies_desc: Every decision made by us or our allies must be aimed at taking a step forward towards the common good.
loc.SOV_for_the_common_good_subjects_desc: Every decision made by our allies is aimed at taking a step forward towards the common good. Thus, we must support these decisions and make sure to follow the guidelines presented to us, even if our sacrifices are not met by an immediate improvement.

loc.trait_SOV_foreign_military_advisor_desc: Time spent abroad is an opportunity to study tactics we may one day find ourselves pitted against.
loc.trait_SOV_monarchist_sympathizer_desc: Sympathies for the old ways can lie deep. Often alongside resentment.
loc.trait_SOV_determined_desc: The tenacity of certain individuals is quite beyond what others consider reasonable.
loc.heritage_of_accomplishment_desc: The history and accomplishments of our regiments stands testament to the heroism of our soldiers. By habitually recognizing great deeds, every man might aspire to that same greatness.

loc.BECOME_SPY_MASTER_DESC: As §HSpy Master§! you are able to control more Operatives where the amount depends on the size of your Faction.\nThere can only be one §HSpy Master§! per faction and if your faction already has a §HSpy Master§! they must accept for you to take over.

loc.upgrade_economy_civilian_desc: §LOur agents will be trained to assume the role of civilians in enemy territory and operate within their industrial and civil sectors; gathering intelligence on our enemy's industry and economy.§!
loc.upgrade_army_department_desc: §LIntel of enemy military is of paramount importance and it is necessary to establish a department of military intelligence. Our operatives will be trained to infiltrate enemy arms, serving as soldiers and generals and reporting to us the secrets they find behind enemy lines.§!
loc.upgrade_naval_department_desc: §LThe battle on the seas is a key part of securing victory, and with the advance of naval technologies, it has become vital that we establish a Department of Naval Intelligence.§!
loc.upgrade_airforce_department_desc: §LThe Department of Aerial Intelligence will be a useful branch of our agency; responsible for infiltrating the enemy air force and gathering intel on enemy aircraft movements.§!
loc.upgrade_passive_defense_desc: §LThe Home Guard has the potential to be a vital tool to our intelligence. By training our Home Guard and Garrison troops in the ways of espionage and counter intelligence, we shall ensure that we always have a defensive presence at home, even when our experts are otherwise engaged.§!
loc.upgrade_anti_partisan_desc: §LPropaganda is a powerful tool to ensure the loyalty of our own citizens, but creating compliance in enemy lands is much more complex. By training our operatives to infiltrate enemy resistance movements, we may begin being able to make effective arrests and end their disruptive activities. Surely then, foreign partisans will lose any hope of returning to their old regime.§!
loc.upgrade_blueprint_stealing_desc: §LWe know that our enemy has secret projects for experimental weapons and vehicles, what we do not know is exactly what those projects are and what they are building. By infiltrating the experimental weapons departments of our enemies, we will not only gain the opportunity to learn precisely what they plan to use against us, we will also be given the unique opportunity to use this information to advance our own weapons department.§!
loc.upgrade_portable_radios_desc: §LConventional radio communications devices are far too large and sedentary to be useful in a covert environment, but by building compact versions of this technology and disguising it as regular domestic objects like briefcases, our agents shall be able to communicate at all hours of the day without arousing suspicion or alarm.§!
loc.upgrade_invisible_ink_desc: §LA letter written in invisible ink is a mere blank sheet of paper to the naked eye, but the application of UV light or chemicals such as ammonia reveal the contents of the letter. By standardising the use of invisible ink by all of our operatives, our information shall remain secret even if intercepted by our enemies.§!
loc.upgrade_plastic_explosives_desc: §LThe putty-like texture of plastic explosives makes them ideal for sabotaging enemy production so it is only natural that we arm foreign partisans with the substance. The bombs can easily be placed out-of-sight and in vulnerable areas of enemy factories, and the malleable nature of the substance would make it an ideal weapon in a spectacular political assassination...§!
loc.upgrade_suicide_pills_desc: §LWhile undesirable, it is inevitable that a handful of agents will be captured by our enemy. We must offer our operatives a way to evade the horror that awaits them in the interrogation room, and a cyanide pill in place of a tooth will provide them with that escape, should it ever comes to that.§!
loc.upgrade_training_centers_desc: §LWhile our agents are able to adapt to any environment, the cultural norms and languages of foreign lands come more naturally to those born and raised in the culture. If we are to build a worldwide network of spies, we must expand our recruitment and training centres all across the globe and recruit agents of all cultures and backgrounds.§!
loc.upgrade_commando_training_desc: §LWhile our department usually handles the subtler aspects of war, often a small team of heavily armed soldiers are what's needed to complete our operations. By training all of our operatives the ways of Commando warfare, they will become more effective at sabotage operations, less likely to be detected by enemy counter-intelligence and more capable at capturing enemy cryptologic equipment.§!
loc.upgrade_interrogation_techniques_desc: §LOften it can be more effective to break an enemy agent's mind rather than their body. The use of physical force is unreliable and often results in false information; a truly skilled interrogator is capable of breaking the enemy's will without violence. But, if it comes to that, we have ways of making them talk...§!
loc.upgrade_diplo_training_desc: §LTraining our agents to grease the palm of a few foreign investors and diplomats may convince them of the benevolence of our cause and steer their interests away from enemies of the state.§!
loc.upgrade_psycho_warfare_desc: §LPropaganda has been an effective tool in securing our ideological interests within our own state, but no tool has been quite as effective as spreading fear of the enemy regimes and what they may bring to the country. By allying our agents with anti-ideological movements within foreign nations, we shall become far more effective in spreading our ideology worldwide...§!
loc.upgrade_form_department_desc: §LCryptology is the method of creating codes and cyphers to maintain secret communications. Without the necessary code, a message written with a cypher can be almost impossible to understand. It is of equal importance that we encrypt our data as we decrypt that of our enemies.§!
loc.upgrade_decryption_boost_desc: §LRadio waves have made it possible to communicate remotely across long distances, and signals are often encrypted by constantly changing the frequency of the broadcast at an irregular rate. If we are to intercept enemy communications, we must establish an interception group dedicated to cracking enemy radio encryption.§!
loc.upgrade_decryption_boost_2_desc: §LMachines have proven useful in encrypting data already, with machine-assisted encrypted signals proving the most difficult to decipher. Cryptanalysis machines are vital in cracking messages we do not yet know the code for and will be a valuable asset to our deciphering team.§!
loc.upgrade_crypto_strength_desc: §LCodes and cyphers have thus far proven to be the most effective way of establishing and protecting our spy networks overseas. The Government Communication Headquarters shall dedicate itself to the creation of new and elaborate encryption methods that our enemies shall be helpless to decipher.§!
loc.upgrade_crypto_strength_2_desc: §LIt's becoming apparent that our standard method of creating cyphers is insufficient to protect our communications from enemy eyes. Our finest minds have theorised a machine which can scramble the letters of the alphabet to generate new cyphers on as regular a basis as we desire. Deploying such technology would make our encryption methods a total enigma to our enemies.§!

loc.conservatism_desc: Considering rapid changes to society to be potentially harmful, conservatism espouses tradition and moderate reforms, sometimes advocating a return to old moral values.
loc.liberalism_desc: With a long philosophical tradition of valuing personal liberty, liberalism views safeguarding these rights as the primary function of the state.
loc.socialism_desc: Striving for equality and a socialist state by reformist means, democratic socialism aims to abolish or mitigate the effects of capitalism with public mandate.
loc.marxism_desc: Encompassing a broad spectrum of economic and historical views, Marxist politics seek to apply the theories of Karl Marx to political practice. Class struggle and the need for transition to a society based on common ownership of the means of production characterize these ideologies.
loc.leninism_desc: A political ideology based in Marxist thought, Leninism seeks to establish a socialist state by a vanguard party leading a revolution overthrowing capitalist society. Once in power, the party rules through a system whereby policies are open for internal debate until a decision has been made.
loc.stalinism_desc: Identifying as a form of government applying and developing Marxist-Leninist policies, Stalinism emphasizes rapid industrialization and collectivization as well as the need for a strong, authoritative socialist state to purge any counter-revolutionary elements.
loc.anti_revisionism_desc: A reaction to the many ideologies claiming to be successors to Marxism, Anti-Revisionism advocates retaining key elements of original revolutionary theory. Mainly opposing incorporation of capitalist economic elements into socialist states, the ideology is defined as much by what it isn't as what it is.
loc.anarchist_communism_desc: An ideology embracing the idea of communism as a stateless society, Anarchist Communism eschews the idea of a transitionary socialist state and favors a society based on voluntary associations and mutual aid.
loc.nazism_desc: Rooted in extreme nationalism, National Socialism is driven by ideas of Germanic supremacy. It promotes aggressive expansionism and a totalitarian state where the people are united under a leader with absolute power, the Führer.
loc.gen_nazism_desc: Rooted in extreme nationalism, National Socialism is driven by ideas of racial supremacy. It promotes aggressive expansionism and a totalitarian state where the people are united under a leader with absolute power.
loc.fascism_ideology_desc: Encompassing a variety of ultra-nationalist movements, fascism typically venerates devotion to the state and uniting the people under a strong leader.
loc.falangism_desc: An authoritarian ideology with traits of fascism and conservatism, Falangism values national and Catholic identity.
loc.rexism_desc: Strongly opposed to both liberal and communist ideals, Rexism is a staunchly conservative nationalist movement who advocate a corporatist economic policy. Employing increasingly populist and authoritarian rhetoric, their ideals are shifting closer to other fascist movements.
loc.despotism_desc: Despotism is a form of government in which a single person rules with absolute power.
loc.oligarchism_desc: Oligarchy is a form of government in which a group of people rule with absolute power.
loc.moderatism_desc: Moderatism is a form of government which avoids the extremes of left and right by taking a moderate position or course of action.
loc.centrism_desc: Centrism is a form of government which wants to achieve common sense solutions that appropriately address current and future needs, that support the public trust and serve the common good with consideration of risk and capacity in context of these needs.
loc.anarchism_desc: Anarchism is the rejection of authority itself, promoting the division of society into self-managing and self-governing collectives instead of a singular, centralized state.

loc.populism_desc: A political movement with little clear ideological framework. Populists advocate for policies from across the spectrum that are popular with the electorate or are perceived as at odds with the preferences of the political 'elite.'

loc.emperor_fascism_desc: Emperor Fascism is a form of Ultranationalism in which the masses do not hold a say, often referred to as 'fascism from above', where the rule is held by the military and aristocratic bureaucrats, with great reverence for the nations emperor, a monarch who is regarded as an infallible divine figure.
loc.japan_militarism_ideology_desc: Militarism is an ideology in which the leader of the nation holds only nominal control, and acts more like a puppet to the nation's military than an independent politician, constantly forwarding their agenda with the end goal of rapid expansionist policy.
loc.buddhist_socialism_desc: Buddhist socialism, also referred to as Dhammic or Natural socialism, is a political ideology which advocates socialism based on the principles of Buddhism. Both Buddhism and socialism seek to provide an end to suffering by analyzing its conditions and removing its main causes through praxis. Both also seek to provide a transformation of personal consciousness to bring an end to human alienation and selfishness.

loc.engine_1_1x_desc: This basic engine is reliable and cheap, but not particularly powerful.
loc.engine_1_2x_desc: Twin engines give the plane a significant increase in thrust, but at a cost.
loc.engine_1_3x_desc: Three engines give more thrust than a pair of them, without the additional cost of a fourth engine.
loc.engine_1_4x_desc: A quartet of engines provides enough thrust to lift a heavy plane and allow it to carry a significant payload.
loc.engine_1_6x_desc: With six engines, any plane can be made to carry a significant payload over a long range, at a decent speed.
loc.engine_2_1x_desc: A larger and more powerful engine allows for higher speed and greater payload.
loc.engine_3_1x_desc: Incorporating advanced features such as methanol-injection and automatic mixture, this engine is able to put out significantly more power.
loc.engine_4_1x_desc: With extensive engineering to capitalize on every possible performance boost, this engine represents the absolute pinnacle of piston-driven engine technology.
loc.jet_engine_1x_desc: With a completely different approach to powering an airplane, this complex and temperamental engine still offers a large increase in thrust and speed.
loc.rocket_engine_1_desc: Utilizing a number of very volatile fuels and a similarly unstable oxidizer, this engine is capable of putting out a very large amount of thrust to propel a plane to high speeds, at the cost of range.
loc.rocket_engine_2_desc: Improvements in the combustion chamber and slight alterations in the fuel mixture allow even higher performance, with a corresponding drop in range.
loc.light_mg_2x_desc: A set of two rifle-caliber machine guns gives a little added firepower against air targets for a very moderate cost.
loc.light_mg_4x_desc: What this set of four rifle-caliber weapons lacks in destructiveness, it makes up for in sheer volume.
loc.aircraft_cannon_1_1x_desc: An automatic cannon offers a significant amount of firepower against air targets, but the added weight makes the plane both slower and less maneuverable.
loc.aircraft_cannon_1_2x_desc: Two automatic cannons give a plane a fearsome forward-firing armament against air and soft ground targets, at considerable cost in weight and agility.
loc.bomb_locks_desc: Mountings for small bombs under the wings or the fuselage allow the plane to attack ground targets with some hope of success.
loc.heavy_bomb_locks_desc: Mountings for large bombs under the wings or the fuselage allow the plane to attack ground targets with great effect.
loc.armor_piercing_bomb_locks_desc: Mountings for large armor piercing bombs under the wings or the fuselage allow the plane to attack Naval targets with great effect.
loc.torpedo_mounting_desc: Hardpoints to allow a lightweight torpedo to be mounted under the fuselage. This gives the plane a potent weapon to use against enemy ships.
loc.torpedo_mounting_2_desc: Hardpoints to allow a Medium weight torpedo to be mounted under the fuselage. This gives the plane a potent weapon to use against enemy ships.
loc.torpedo_mounting_3_desc: Hardpoints to allow a heavy weight torpedo to be mounted under the fuselage. This gives the plane a potent weapon to use against enemy ships.
loc.armor_plate_small_desc: Steel plating behind the pilot seat and around the engine give the plane increased survivability against ground fire and attacks from behind.
loc.heavy_mg_2x_desc: A pair of heavy machine guns allows penetrating the toughened outer skin of modern airplanes.
loc.heavy_mg_4x_desc: A quartet of heavy machineguns offers terrifying firepower, both in individual performance and in sheer volume of fire.
loc.aircraft_cannon_2_1x_desc: A modern cannon firing a large shell at high velocity, this weapon can bring down even fighters and strategic bombers all the same.
loc.aircraft_cannon_2_2x_desc: Twin cannons give a plane a significant amount of punch, while the increased volume of fire makes scoring crippling hits even easier.
loc.large_aircraft_cannon_1x_desc: Firing a larger and more powerful shell than previous iterations of autocannons but at slower velocities, this weapon can bring down even a large airframe in a single hit.
loc.large_aircraft_cannon_2x_desc: Twin cannons give a plane a significant amount of punch, while the increased volume of fire makes scoring crippling hits even easier.
loc.small_bomb_bay_desc: A small bay to carry bombs. Being inside the fuselage reduces drag, but the structural changes necessary for it mean the plane can not do radical maneuvers in air combat.
loc.medium_bomb_bay_desc: A mid-sized bomb bay allows carrying enough ordnance to strike a wide variety of targets.
loc.large_bomb_bay_desc: A large bay to carry enough ordnance to damage or destroy even extensive factories and other hard targets.
loc.tank_buster_1_desc: Adapted from an anti-tank gun used by the Army, this gun can destroy even modern tanks with well-placed shots. However, its heavy weight and awkward construction severely limit the aircraft's performance.
loc.tank_buster_2_desc: The heavier tanks now in service require a much larger gun to combat. While extremely heavy and unwieldy, it is very capable as a weapon for attacks against enemy positions.
loc.fuel_tanks_small_desc: Devoting more internal space of the airframe for fuel increases the plane's range, but it also makes the plane a lot more flammable.
loc.self_sealing_fuel_tanks_small_desc: By adding a layer of specially-treated rubber around the fuel tanks, a hit to the fuel tank does not cripple an airplane as the tank will seal itself over time, preventing loss of fuel.
loc.armor_plate_medium_desc: Armor around the engines and the more fragile parts of the fuselage gives the plane significantly better survivability, at the cost of range.
