loc.armor_plate_large_desc: Extensive steel plating protects the engines, fuel tanks, and the crew compartment to allow the plane to shrug off anything but a direct hit from anti-aircraft fire, as well as making it a very tough target for fighters to shoot down.
loc.lmg_defense_turret_desc: While somewhat underpowered for air-to-air combat, a light machine gun in a turret will make any attack against this plane a more dangerous undertaking.
loc.lmg_defense_turret_2x_desc: A set of two light machine guns in electrically-powered turrets cover more angles and make the plane a much harder target to attack.
loc.hmg_defense_turret_desc: A heavy machine gun in a rotating turret allows the defender to fight back against a fighter armed with similar weapons with some hope of success.
loc.hmg_defense_turret_2x_desc: A set of two powered turrets with heavy machine guns present any attacking fighter with a dangerous target.
loc.cannon_defense_turret_desc: A modern cannon in a traversable turret significantly alters the balance of power between the defender and the attacker in air combat. Few fighters can withstand a direct hit from a modern cannon and continue to fight.
loc.cannon_defense_turret_2x_desc: Two turrets armed with automatic cannons give the plane a fearsome defensive punch that would make any fighter attack on it a very dangerous prospect indeed.
loc.rocket_rails_desc: Unguided projectiles hung under the wings. Since they are fired ahead of the attacking plane, it is a lot easier for the pilot to aim them at the target compared to bombs.
loc.bomb_sights_1_desc: A complex mechanical computer that takes into account wind drift, terminal velocity and altitude allows the bombardier to drop bombs with a high degree of accuracy.
loc.bomb_sights_2_desc: Where previous generations of bomb sights often required a lengthy set-up process before they arrived at their targeting solutions, this fully stabilized bomb sight only takes a few seconds and can even compensate for shallow dives.
loc.radio_navigation_1_desc: A radio receiver listening for the crossing of two fairly simple radio-navigation beams, making it possible to find a target even in perfect darkness.
loc.radio_navigation_2_desc: A radio receiver that also includes a number of distance measuring aides, telling the bombardier the exact moment that the bombs should be released, even if he can not see the target.
loc.air_ground_radar_1_desc: An airborne radar set that gives the navigator an accurate picture of the surface below the plane, allowing for precise navigation even in darkness or bad weather.
loc.air_ground_radar_2_desc: With a higher resolution than previous models, this radar set allows precision bombardment even through cloud cover.
loc.air_air_radar_1_desc: A set of radar antennas on the airplane allows a trained operator to find an airborne target even in darkness.
loc.air_air_radar_2_desc: With a more powerful transmitter, this radar set can detect targets over a longer distance.
loc.non_strategic_materials_small_desc: By substituting specially-treated wood or fabric for aluminum wherever possible, we can drastically reduce the usage of strategic materials. However, wood and fabric don't stand up very well to modern weapons.
loc.drop_tanks_desc: Small, disposable tanks that hold extra fuel give our fighters some extra range when on offensive missions. Since they are dropped before combat, they don't impede combat performance.
loc.dive_brakes_small_desc: A set of spoilers along the trailing edge of the wing deploy when the plane enters a dive, reducing overall speed and allowing the plane to pull out of steep dives without ripping its wings off. This, in turn, allows the plane to attack from a near-vertical dive, drastically increasing accuracy.
loc.floats_desc: A set of floatation devices mounted under the airframe allows the plane to land on water. This makes scouting missions for enemy naval assets easier, but also drastically reduces agility.
loc.flying_boat_medium_desc: Instead of mounting a landing gear, the underside of the plane can be shaped to be able to land on water. This makes scouting missions over water much easier.
loc.guided_anti_ship_missile_desc: Effectively an anti-ship bomb with a rocket engine and radio guidance, this new weapon of war is a serious threat to all ships currently afloat.
loc.bouncing_bomb_release_desc: A bomb rack for carrying and releasing special bouncing bombs, that skid across the water until they hit their targets. The mechanism sets the bomb spinning backwards during the release, making it more likely to reach its intended structural target.
loc.earthshaker_bomb_release_desc: A bomb rack and release mechanism for the gigantic earthshaker bombs that are designed to penetrate the ground on impact and explode underground, causing great structural damage to their target.
loc.rocket_propelled_bombs_desc: Rocket propelled unguided bombs can inflict considerable damage on ships and similar armoured larger targets.
loc.improved_rocket_propelled_bombs_desc: Even larger rocket propelled unguided bombs, carrying a heavier payload, able to penetrate their targets even more effectively.
loc.fixed_explosive_charge_desc: A fixed hollow charge turns the plane into a flying bomb. If the plane is steered into an enemy ship, it would cause dramatic destruction, but at the cost of the plane and the crew both being lost.
loc.recon_camera_desc: A set of cameras with special lenses, allowing the plane to take accurate pictures of enemy formations and installations even from high altitude.
loc.airdropped_mines_desc: A set of naval mines equipped with a parachute, which allows them to be dropped from a plane.
loc.demining_coil_desc: A large coil mounted on the airframe allows the plane to project a powerful magnetic field, which causes magnetic mines in its flightpath to explode.
loc.small_plane_airframe_0_desc: Since the early days of the Great War, aviation has advanced in leaps and bounds. This airframe represents the culmination of these developments, but it is clear that its growth potential is limited.
loc.small_plane_airframe_1_desc: In recent years, a number of new technologies has emerged, allowing for the construction of very capable, yet small, planes. This airframe represents just the first step on that road.
loc.small_plane_airframe_2_desc: With improved aerodynamics and more robust construction, this airframe represents a clear step forward compared to the basic model.
loc.small_plane_airframe_3_desc: Thoroughly optimized for performance, this airframe represents the absolute maximum of what can be done with a piston-driven airplane.
loc.small_plane_airframe_4_desc: This airframe is designed to take advantage of the great speeds offered by modern engines and solve some of the structural problems that come with flying at high sub-sonic speeds.
loc.small_plane_airframe_5_desc: This advanced airframe, capable of Mach 1 supersonic flight embodies the pinnacle of human engineering
loc.medium_plane_airframe_0_desc: While able to carry a significant payload over a long distance, the growth potential of this airframe is severely limited.
loc.medium_plane_airframe_1_desc: Incorporating a number of new technologies developed recently, this airframe is significantly more capable than previous planes of similar size.
loc.medium_plane_airframe_2_desc: Taking advantage of modern production technologies, this airframe allows the plane to carry a bigger payload over a longer distance.
loc.medium_plane_airframe_3_desc: Engineered to maximize performance and payload, this airframe represents the pinnacle of conventionally-powered airplanes.
loc.medium_plane_airframe_4_desc: With jet-powered planes likely to become dominant, engineers are starting to figure out how to build airframes with jet propulsion in mind.
loc.large_plane_airframe_0_desc: This very large airframe has plenty of space to carry bombs or fuel tanks. However, it is clear that its development potential is severely limited. New generations of strategic bombers are already on the horizon.
loc.large_plane_airframe_1_desc: This airframe was designed to test the potential of a true strategic bomber, able to attack industrial targets deep inside enemy territory, and bring its crew back alive.
loc.large_plane_airframe_2_desc: With the concept of a strategic bomber now well proven, this airframe was designed to improve payload and range, while having sufficient potential for future growth.
loc.large_plane_airframe_3_desc: Optimized for very long range flying at very high altitude, this airframe is capable of carrying a sizable payload deep into the heart of enemy territory.
loc.large_plane_airframe_4_desc: Jet propulsion offers a quantum leap in performance. This airframe was designed to take advantage of this.
loc.large_plane_maritime_patrol_plane_airfra: The fleet needs long-ranged planes to find their enemies far from shore. While somewhat outdated, this airframe offers the necessary range to cover large stretches of ocean.

The advent of more powerful carrier planes makes it necessary to find and destroy enemy fleets far from shore. The first step for this is to find them far out in the ocean, necessitating a new type of plane.
The dual threat of submarines and raiding cruisers requires patrolling vast stretches of ocean. This airframe is optimized for this.
Radar and other sensors make it possible to find enemy fleets even in poor weather or dark nights, but all the new equipment requires a bigger airframe to carry it.
With the dawn of the missile age, maritime patrol planes must be capable of operating even further from shore, and for longer durations.
loc.cv_small_plane_airframe_0_desc: Equipped with an arresting hook and strengthened landing gear, this airframe is capable of operating from an aircraft carrier.
loc.cv_small_plane_airframe_1_desc: Incorporating new technologies developed for land-based planes, this airframe is just as capable, but can be launched from the deck of a carrier.
loc.cv_small_plane_airframe_2_desc: To keep pace with developments in land-based aviation, this airframe was designed with new technologies to increase range and performance.
loc.cv_small_plane_airframe_3_desc: The rigorous nature of carrier aviation limits how big and capable an airframe can be. This airframe represents the absolute maximum that can be achieved with a conventionally powered airframe.
loc.cv_small_plane_airframe_4_desc: This airframe was designed to take advantage of the increased thrust produced by jet engines, and bring them to naval aviation.
loc.small_plane_airframe_desc: What this small, single or twin-engined plane lacks in payload, it makes up for in speed and maneuverability.
loc.cv_small_plane_airframe_desc: Equipped with an arrestor hook and a strengthened landing gear, this small airframe is capable of operating from carriers.
loc.medium_plane_airframe_desc: A mid-sized airframe with two to four engines and a lot of internal space for payload, fueltanks, or defensive equipment.
loc.large_plane_airframe_desc: A large airframe with plenty of space, capable of mounting up to six engines and carrying large payloads over long distances.
loc.early_bombs_desc: Since the early days of the Great War, airplanes have been increasingly used to drop explosives onto enemy targets. Over time, this has developed more and more into a fundamental aspect of aerial warfare.
loc.heavy_bombs_desc: Modern Warfare requires airplanes increasingly used larger bombs on enemy targets. Over time, this has developed more and more into a fundamental aspect of aerial warfare.
loc.armor_piercing_bombs_desc: Warships have steadily increased their deck armor. To defeat this, specialized bombs must be developed to penetrate such armor.
loc.air_torpedoe_1_desc: Lightweight torpedoes can be carried by any capable aircraft in order to extend our ability to strike at sea.
loc.air_torpedoe_2_desc: Standardized mounts and ratings allow the development of larger, more powerful torpedoes as well as increasing their general utility.
loc.air_torpedoe_3_desc: The development of lightweight fittings designed to be shed upon entering the water gives aerial torpedoes significantly greater accuracy as well as enhanced safety for the aircraft performing a drop.
loc.photo_reconnaisance_desc: The first clear military purpose of the aeroplane was to find the enemy and report their location to the Generals on the ground. This still remains one of the most common tasks of military aviation.
loc.aa_lmg_desc: Rifle-caliber machine guns have formed the mainstay of air-to-air weaponry since the days of the Great War.
loc.survivability_studies_desc: By carefully analyzing the battle damage on returning planes, we can accurately determine which parts of a plane are really vital.
loc.aircraft_construction_desc: We have come a long way since the days of plywood and fabric in aircraft manufacture. New technologies allow for planes that are better suited for specific roles.
loc.aa_hmg_desc: Modern planes are capable of withstanding significantly more punishment than older models, while also offering fewer opportunities to score hits. Each hit must therefore do the maximum amount of damage, requiring a bigger cartridge.
loc.aa_cannon_1_desc: A cannon shell can punch through even the toughest airplane, while potentially carrying enough explosives to do crippling damage when it hits.
loc.aa_cannon_2_desc: With a higher caliber and a bigger shell, these cannons can bring down even large planes in a single hit.
loc.aa_cannon_3_desc: With A modern cannon firing a large shell at high velocity, we can bring down even the toughest aircraft.
loc.engines_1_desc: Airplane engines must be powerful, but lightweight and reliable. This engine type provides enough power to get a plane in the air, but somewhat limits it from reaching its full potential.
loc.engines_2_desc: The rapid growth of airplanes requires a corresponding growth of engine power.
loc.range_improvements_desc: While it seems obvious that adding more fuel capacity will increase the range of an airplane, actually adding that capacity to a plane without impacting flight performance too much is far from trivial.
loc.sp_centrifugal_jet_tech_desc: Centrifugal jets use a single stage compressor to compress the intake air, before blasting it out to create thrust. This results in smaller, more easily maintained engines.
loc.jet_engine_axial_1x_desc: Mounting multiple compressors, one after another the Axial Engine is able to multiply the amount of thrust generated by a simple single-stage jet engine.
loc.cv_small_plane_cas_airframe_design_cost_: Small CAS Carrier Airframe Design Cost
loc.AIR_TITLE_MOTHERSHIP_DESC: Motherships are large aircraft designed to carry and deploy smaller planes into battle, significantly extending their operational range beyond what individual fighters could achieve on their own.
loc.POL_danzig_decisions_desc: Danzig has been a thorn in the side of the Polish economy for too long! It is time we took control of the city, but such a thing can only be achieved with some degree of collaboration with the locals…
loc.POL_unification_propaganda_desc: Danzig is a culturally diverse city of Poles, Germans, and countless other minorities and the Nazi Party seeks to disrupt this multicultural cooperation. Effective propaganda can be utilized to turn the city’s minorities to our side, promising them the equality the Nazis would sooner die than give them.
loc.POL_military_appeasement_desc: The Free City of Danzig cannot be integrated with brute force alone, some degree of appeasement may make the Danziger militia more aligned with Poland’s vision for the city.
loc.POL_raid_nazi_resistance_desc: There are those in the city who would hand the keys to their freedom over to the Nazis and make the city subservient to Berlin. These elements must be eliminated from the city at all costs, though harsh military action may have adverse effects on how we are perceived by the locals.
loc.POL_tighten_control_desc: We have gained enough compliance in the city to further tighten our control without causing civil unrest. With this, we shall gain more access to Danziger resources and grow ever closer to achieving unity in the city.
loc.POL_sanation_decisions_desc: The Sanationists are divided into the camps left and right who both seek to disrupt our rule. We must appease and sideline the parties appropriately so that we may create a stable government for Poland’s future!
loc.POL_sanation_left_irritation_desc: Tired of being marginalized and sidelined under Mościcki’s regime, the Sanation Left seek to restore the government of the former Prime Minister, Walery Sławek.
loc.POL_sanation_right_irritation_desc: With most of the military on their side, the Sanation Right seek to undermine the dictatorship and establish a Military Junta guided by Edward Rydz-Śmigły. With ties to both the military and Falangist paramilitaries, the Sanation Right are a dangerous political faction.
loc.POL_sideline_the_left_desc: With the assistance of those on the Right, we may be able to sideline the Left and push them deeper into the political fringes of our society.
loc.POL_sideline_the_right_desc: Though powerful, the Right could be pushed into political irrelevancy by a joint-effort strike from the Left and the Castle.
loc.POL_looming_peasants_strike_mission_desc: The peasants are unhappy, demanding higher pay and dramatically lowered food prices. Poland’s poor rail connections in the East make supplying the region with food and equipment an expensive endeavour, but with further rail investments, we may be able to deliver on what the peasants demand.
loc.POL_peasants_strike_desc: Tensions have boiled over in the East. If we do not resolve this crisis as soon as possible, we may well face a civil war. The strike, organized by Peasant Party leader Stanisław Mikołajczyk has formed a coalition of democrats, socialists, and communists in opposition to the Polish government and if ignored will incite a rebellion.
loc.POL_invite_ford_desc: Cheap, efficient, and American, Ford Motors are capable of mass-producing motor equipment at an unrivalled rate.
loc.POL_invite_vauxhall_desc: The Brits have proven that their motor equipment is much swifter and higher quality on the road than any others in the world.
loc.POL_invite_somua_desc: French motorized and armored vehicles are hardier any others and are capable of taking shells from enemy vehicles while hardly sustaining any damage. These are the types of vehicles we need to survive the war.
loc.POL_diplomatic_mission_to_FIN_desc: If we are to convince other nations to join the Intermarium, we must convince them it is in their best interest. By sending Józef Beck on diplomatic missions, we stand a much better chance of building the defensive alliance we dream of.
loc.POL_diplomatic_mission_to_DEN_desc: If we are to convince other nations to join the Intermarium, we must convince them it is in their best interest. By sending Józef Beck on diplomatic missions, we stand a much better chance of building the defensive alliance we dream of.
loc.POL_diplomatic_mission_to_NOR_desc: If we are to convince other nations to join the Intermarium, we must convince them it is in their best interest. By sending Józef Beck on diplomatic missions, we stand a much better chance of building the defensive alliance we dream of.
loc.POL_diplomatic_mission_to_SWE_desc: If we are to convince other nations to join the Intermarium, we must convince them it is in their best interest. By sending Józef Beck on diplomatic missions, we stand a much better chance of building the defensive alliance we dream of.
loc.POL_diplomatic_mission_to_CZE_desc: If we are to convince other nations to join the Intermarium, we must convince them it is in their best interest. By sending Józef Beck on diplomatic missions, we stand a much better chance of building the defensive alliance we dream of.
loc.POL_diplomatic_mission_to_YUG_desc: If we are to convince other nations to join the Intermarium, we must convince them it is in their best interest. By sending Józef Beck on diplomatic missions, we stand a much better chance of building the defensive alliance we dream of.
loc.POL_diplomatic_mission_to_AUS_desc: If we are to convince other nations to join the Intermarium, we must convince them it is in their best interest. By sending Józef Beck on diplomatic missions, we stand a much better chance of building the defensive alliance we dream of.
loc.POL_diplomatic_mission_to_HUN_desc: If we are to convince other nations to join the Intermarium, we must convince them it is in their best interest. By sending Józef Beck on diplomatic missions, we stand a much better chance of building the defensive alliance we dream of.
loc.POL_diplomatic_mission_to_GRE_desc: If we are to convince other nations to join the Intermarium, we must convince them it is in their best interest. By sending Józef Beck on diplomatic missions, we stand a much better chance of building the defensive alliance we dream of.
loc.POL_diplomatic_mission_to_TUR_desc: If we are to convince other nations to join the Intermarium, we must convince them it is in their best interest. By sending Józef Beck on diplomatic missions, we stand a much better chance of building the defensive alliance we dream of.
loc.POL_diplomatic_mission_to_ITA_desc: If we are to convince other nations to join the Intermarium, we must convince them it is in their best interest. By sending Józef Beck on diplomatic missions, we stand a much better chance of building the defensive alliance we dream of.
loc.POL_defend_in_east_state_desc: The East is remote and underdeveloped, nature rules her as much as we do. We must train our men to use their surroundings to their advantage and leave the Russians invading us scattered and confused.
loc.POL_defend_in_west_state_desc: The West is where most of our industry lies, and it is vital that we defend it from the Germans. We must devise local defensive strategies in the West if we are to contest the overwhelming numbers on our border.
loc.POL_four_year_plan_mission: Prepare for the Next Four Year Plan
loc.POL_four_year_plan_mission_desc: The Four Year Plan is in progress, we must ensure to follow through with our promises to reform and industrialize the country if we are to adequately prepare ourselves for the next four years.
loc.has_monarchy_support_lessthan_40_tt: Has no more than §Y40 Monarchy Support§!
loc.has_monarchy_support_lessthan_20_tt: Has no more than §Y20 Monarchy Support§!
loc.more_likely_to_join_miezymorze_tt: The nation will be more likely to join Poland's faction.
loc.form_commonwealth_flag: A nation has already formed the Commonwealth.
loc.poland.13.d: [From.GetLeader] has requested that the [Root.GetAdjective] government extend an invitation to the [Root.GetFactionName], citing the great strategic benefit a [faction_invitee_target.GetAdjective] alliance would have in the event of an invasion.
loc.poland.1301.d: Already a member of the [From.GetFactionName], [From.From.GetLeader] seeks military cooperation with [Root.GetNameDef] citing the great strategic benefit a [From.From.GetAdjective]-[Root.GetAdjective] alliance would have in the event of a [GER.GetAdjective] or [SOV.GetAdjective] invasion.
loc.poland.1301.b: We are not interested in this “[From.GetFactionName]”.
loc.poland.1302.d: It would appear that [From.GetLeader] does not have as much faith in the necessity of a [faction_invitee_target.GetAdjective] alliance as [Root.GetLeader] does. It is uncertain what the precise reasoning for this decision is, but clearly the [From.GetAdjective] government believes that [faction_invitee_target.GetNameDef] is more of a detriment than a boon to the continued survival of the [From.GetFactionName].
loc.poland.1302.a: Well, it was worth a try.
loc.poland.1303.d: For whatever unknown reasons the [From.GetAdjective] government has decided that they would rather not join us in our fight for freedom on the side of the [From.From.GetFactionName]. Whatever their justification may be, the future does not look bright for continued [Root.GetAdjective]-[From.GetAdjective] cooperation.
loc.poland.15.d: A very worrying telegram arrived on the desk of [Root.GetLeader] today from the [From.GetAdjective] President, demanding that [LIT.GetNameDef] not only abandons her claim on the former capital Vilnius, but also that she lay down her arms and cede all territories to the [From.GetAdjective] state. [From.GetNameDefCap] has been attempting to restore the long-dead Commonwealth ever since [Root.GetNameDef]’s inception, and it seems that now they believe the mere threat of another war will be enough to cause [Root.GetLeader] to crumble.
loc.poland.15.d.notlit: A very worrying telegram arrived on the desk of [Root.GetLeader] today from the [From.GetAdjective] President, demanding that [Root.GetNameDef] lay down her arms and cede all territories to the [From.GetAdjective] state. [From.GetNameDefCap] has been attempting to restore the long-dead Commonwealth ever since [Root.GetNameDef]’s inception, and it seems that now they believe the mere threat of war between our nations will be enough to cause [Root.GetLeader] to crumble.
loc.poland.1501.d: Today is a great day of celebration for [Root.GetNameDef] as the [From.GetAdjective] military has thrown down their arms and allowed [Root.GetAdjective] soldiers to march right into the capital and proclaim the reunification of [Root.GetNameDef] and [From.GetNameDef]! A Commonwealth reborn, the streets of [Root.Capital.GetName] are filled with men and women waving [Root.GetAdjective] and [From.GetAdjective] flags in tandem, although such celebrations cannot be seen in the [From.GetAdjective] capital, where people seem to be strangely somber and mournful.
loc.poland.1502.d: A response has returned from [From.GetAdjective] high-command today outright refusing all [Root.GetAdjective] demands and claiming that they will “not allow [Root.GetLeader] to trample on [From.GetAdjective] sovereignty”. While many would rather not enter another state of war with [From.GetNameDef], if [Root.GetLeader] does not respond soon, future [Root.GetAdjective] demands are unlikely to be taken seriously.
loc.poland.16.b: I see no reason to ally the Poles.
loc.poland.17.d: Walery Sławek has at last managed to restore his place as head of government in [Root.GetNameDef], pushing [Root.GetLeader] into a more advisory role within the government. However, many have often been uncertain of Sławek’s true political leanings. Some believe him to be a socialist seeking reform, while many of his critics believe him to be another authoritarian, no different from [Root.GetLeader] or Rydz-Śmigły. Now that he has at last become head of government, Sławek may put these questions to rest as he once again amends the constitution of Poland.
loc.poland.18.d: Edward Rydz-Śmigły and his following in the Sanation Right have long been the true power behind [Root.GetNameDef], but with [Root.GetLeader] agreeing to the Camp of National Unity, Rydz-Śmigły’s de-facto power has at last become legitimized. With his close ties to the Falangists, some are concerned that [Root.GetNameDef] is flirting too much with the far-right of the political fringes and that Rydz-Śmigły’s fascist sympathies may end up diplomatically isolating [Root.GetNameDef] from her former allies.
loc.poland.19.d: “I am taking away my life. Please do not blame anybody. I have burned all private papers, and those confined to me. If not all, please forgive me. God Almighty will perhaps forgive me my sins, including this final one.” This note and a firearm were found alongside Walery Sławek’s body at precisely 8:45pm yesterday evening. The deftest and most skilled doctors at Piłsudski Military Hospital could not stop Sławek’s body from bleeding and the former Prime Minister was announced dead this morning. Along with his note was a letter for [Root.GetLeader]’s eyes only, and though its contents and Sławek’s reason for this most shocking act remain a mystery, speculation is on the lips of every man and woman in [Root.Capital.GetName]. Many suspect the continued marginalization of the Sanation Left and Sławek’s ever-increasing isolation were great contributing factors to his melancholy, and the death of the Left’s most influential leader will no doubt leave many feeling disheartened and lost.
loc.poland.20.desc.a: An almost total lack of investment over the past four years has led to many declaring the Four Year Plan a total failure. Eastern Poland remains an insular region of impoverished farmers, the so-called ‘central industrial region’ is no more than a few pitiful factories and railway stations, and Polish industry is an embarrassment to the nation. Financial experts are certain that the utter failure of the Four Year Plan will be a lasting detriment to future Polish industrial efforts.
loc.poland.20.desc.b: With modest investments, the Polish industrial sector’s future looks bright, but is still leagues behind its neighbours in the West and East. Though it is not quite the massive industrial undertaking that [Root.GetLeader] promised, the investments made by the government will be of great benefit to the next Four Year Plan!
loc.poland.20.desc.c: The rasped shriek of a locomotive on rails, the acerb stench of soot and smog in the air, the incisive mist of industry stinging the eyes, these are the sensations of progress. To arrive in Poland’s central region today is to arrive into a world of industry and progress. Factories, roads, rail, locomotives, automobiles, the Polish state has at last achieved them all. With Polands Congressional, Greater, and Eastern now linked with a tight network of road and rail, Poland is at last united as a single industrial entity and Kwiatkowski’s Four Year Plan can at last be called a success. Although this does not spell the end for Polish industrial investments, the overwhelming success of the industrialization program has provided stability and employment to the people of Poland, and many feel ready for whatever future hardships the Polish state is to endure.
loc.poland.21.d: As war burns through the streets of [DNZ.GetNameDef], [DNZ.GetLeader] stands strong against [POL.GetLeader]’s forces, but clearly a single city is not enough to withstand the onslaught of all of [POL.GetNameDef]’s forces. As a member of the [Root.GetRulingParty] party, [DNZ.GetLeader] is answerable to [Root.GetLeader] and a [DNZ.GetAdjective] defeat would be unacceptable. [GER.GetNameDefCap] could enter the war as [DNZ.GetNameDef]’s defender, presenting the unique opportunity to seize the city while appearing to be the defender…
loc.poland.2101.d: The [GER.GetRulingParty] party of Germany has offered to support our struggle against the Polish in exchange for more direct control of [Root.GetNameDef] by [From.GetNameDef].
loc.poland.2102.d: [DNZ.GetLeader] has proven to be a useful tool against [POL.GetNameDef], but the autonomous region has long outlived its usefulness and the destiny of [DNZ.GetLeader] is to be Gauleiter of the Reichsgau Danzig-West Prussia, closely integrated with [Root.GetNameDef].
loc.poland.22.d: This war has gone on long enough, and even the perfidious [DNZ.GetLeader] desires peace with [POL.GetNameDef]. With even Gdynia under [DNZ.GetAdjective] control, many worry that we risk more by staying at war with the Free City than we stand to gain. Though the city will inevitably come under [GER.GetAdjective] control, we cannot afford to continue this conflict any longer.
loc.poland.22.b: This war is not over until I declare it so!
loc.poland.23.d: As [Root.GetAdjective] troops advance into [poland_state_withdrawn.GetName] and begin seizing control of the railways and industry, shockingly the entire thing has been rigged with explosive material to detonate. Clearly a trap left behind by the [POL.GetAdjective] army, we can expect this to happen every time we attempt to seize [POL.GetAdjective] industry.
loc.poland.23.a: That won't delay us for long.
loc.poland.24.d: Tensions have boiled over in the East. Police have been deployed in the East to deal with these protestors, but the brutality of the officers is doing little but fan the flames of revolt among the populace.\n\nIf we do not resolve this crisis as soon as possible, we may well face a civil war. The strike, organized by Peasant Party leader Stanisław Mikołajczyk has formed a coalition of democrats, socialists, and communists in opposition to the Polish government and if ignored will incite a rebellion.
loc.poland.25.d: Despite the promise of [hosting_country_target.GetNameDef] to host the [Root.GetAdjective] government in exile, [hosting_country_target.GetLeader] has demanded that [Root.GetLeader] immediately resign from [Root.GetLeader.GetHerHis] position as President of [Root.GetNameDef]. In the chaos of capitulation and exile, [Root.GetLeader] has already fled to a neutral country in Europe, and what few exiles remain of the [Root.GetAdjective] government are left to decide who will lead the struggle to retake the homeland.
loc.poland.25.a: A patriot with no ties to the Sanation.
loc.poland.25.c: This is our chance to restore Polish democracy.
loc.poland.26.d: Throughout [Root.GetAdjective]-occupied Poland there are whispers of a revolution brewing in the underground. Plastered on city-walls are the words “Niech żyje opór!” and similar slogans, calling for the resistance to fight against [Root.GetAdjective] occupation. Until now, resistance activities have been limited to the distribution of propaganda, disruption of production lines, and the occasional bombing and sabotage, but now the resistance lays oddly quiet and the atmosphere in Poland is thick with treachery and mistrust.\n\n[Root.GetAdjective] agents across Poland predict a full-scale rebellion sponsored by the [POL.GetAdjective] government in exile. Only by clamping down on resistance can [Root.GetNameDef] hope to keep a rein on Poland.
loc.poland.26.a: We must round up these traitors.
loc.POL_central_region_strategy_desc: By centralizing factories far from any borders, we will boost our production while also protecting them from any would-be conquerors.
loc.POL_expansion_of_new_towns_desc: With the west now reclaimed from the Germans, we must develop the burgeoning industries in cities like Gdynia which are rapidly coming to rival Warsaw in grandeur.
loc.POL_fill_the_railways_gaps_desc: Poland was once divided between three powers, and as such our rail networks are distant and unconnected. We must unite these three separate railway lines into one if we are to make Poland the centralized industry we need it to become!
loc.POL_start_central_industrial_region_desc: Poland’s old capital of Kraków has been freed from the clutches of the Austrian Empire, but still the city remains shackled by its past; lacking the modern industries it needs to rival the west. With investment, we shall bring Kraków back from the dead.
loc.POL_expand_central_industrial_region_des: Galicia, like Kraków, was once held and neglected by the Austrians, but now that it is once again in Polish hands, we may give it the investments into modernization that it so desperately needs.
loc.POL_the_four_year_plan_desc: We must plan for the expansion of our infrastructure to accommodate not only our present industry, but also the future.
loc.POL_national_defence_fund_desc: Citizens and state alike must contribute to the funding of our growing industry, to prepare for the perils of the years to come.
loc.POL_warsaw_main_railway_station_desc: Warsaw is a nexus of transport and cargo. To avoid bottlenecks, extra effort is to be placed on the management of its railway.
loc.POL_invest_in_the_old_polish_region: Invest In The Old Polish Region
loc.POL_invest_in_the_old_polish_region_desc: Modernize old factories in Kielce, Skarżysko, Radom, Starachowice and Ostrowiec, while also building new ones to strengthen our industry.
loc.POL_develop_upper_silesia_desc: We control but a small region of Silesia, but that which we do have is of great industrial significance. Silesia is one of the most heavily industrialized regions in our nation, and with a little investment, it could continue to support the further industrialization of our entire nation.
loc.POL_additional_research_slot1_desc: Mathematics is central to almost all things in the technological sector. All across Poland; from Lwów to Warsaw, the mathematical schools are flourishing. We must capitalize on this golden age of Polish thinkers, and grant these men all that they need to make Poland the technological powerhouse it deserves to be!
loc.POL_the_bombe_desc: The "Cryptologic Bombe" is a development of the Cyclometer, and allows us to decipher the progressively more advanced versions of the German Enigma cipher.
loc.POL_the_cyclometer_desc: With this invention, the ciphers of the Germans will become plain as clear text. No secrets will be kept from us.
loc.POL_atomic_physics_institute_desc: We must not lose the chance to be the first to discover a way to harness the primal fire of fission.
loc.POL_additional_research_slot2_desc: Warsaw university is where most of Poland’s greatest minds attend to teach, learn, and broaden Poland’s technological capabilities. By investing in an expansion of the university, we shall have seats for yet more minds and thinkers to strengthen the Polish state!
loc.POL_prepare_for_the_next_war_desc: The Great War may only have been the first of its kind. We must prepare for what must surely be an ever-changing battlefield.
loc.POL_the_defence_of_poland_desc: Even bolder stratagems must be devised if the defense of our homeland is to succeed.
loc.POL_romanian_bridgehead_strategy_desc: Should the fighting turn against us, we must have plans in place for effective regrouping and retaliation in concert with our friends and allies.
loc.POL_silesia_fortified_area_desc: More forts constructed in the south will secure additional defenses.
loc.POL_hel_fortified_area_desc: By fortifying key areas we make ourselves less vulnerable, should war again come to our shores and borders.
loc.POL_standardisation_of_equipment_desc: By standardizing the equipment of our soldiers we set the foundation for a modern supply apparatus.
loc.POL_modernising_the_cavalry_desc: While the cavalry still has a role to play, we need new metal mounts for it to compete on the modern battlefield.
loc.POL_study_foreign_tanks_desc: These "tanks" will be a central part of todays armed conflicts, and we must make sure to keep pace with our neighbors, by any means necessary.
loc.POL_cruiser_tank_experiments_desc: With the basics of tank design in place, we are now ready to start forging our own path in the tangled field of mechanized design.
loc.POL_artillery_modernisation_desc: We must not neglect to improve and modernize the support our soldiers require for effective deployment.
loc.POL_anti_tank_guns_desc: Any enemy is sure to deploy tanks against us. We must be prepared to give them a warm welcome.
loc.POL_air_base_expansion_desc: Airbases are as essential to air support as air support is to modern warfare.
loc.POL_fighter_modernisation_desc: The mainstay of any air force, our fighters must not be made obsolete. As the rest of our air force improves, so must they.
loc.POL_air_innovations_desc: There is still much to be done in the field of aerial strategy and tactics.
loc.POL_heavy_fighter_concept_desc: Should we be forced to go on the offensive, we need a new kind of fighter that can operate at length inside hostile borders.
loc.POL_naval_bomber_experiments_desc: Air supremacy is as important at sea as over land. Specialized aircraft developed for the purpose of naval warfare is a way to achieve that aim.
loc.POL_medium_bomber_focus_desc: An extension of the precision bombing philosophy adapted for extended range to be used in support roles.
loc.POL_light_bomber_focus_desc: The value of using dive bombers for close air support should not be underestimated.
loc.POL_air_modernisations_programme_desc: Aviation theory is just as important as technology. New stratagems for our pilots are still waiting to be discovered.
loc.POL_rocket_development_desc: Speed is the attribute on which all other aerial attributes rely. Rocket and jet engines could theoretically allow us to pass all previous limits.
loc.POL_develop_polish_ship_building_desc: Danzig is hopelessly lost to the vile regime of the Nazi party, and Polish trade must find a way to subvert the effective embargo the Nazis hold over our economy. We may never recover Gdańsk, but perhaps we may be able to turn Gdynia into a great seaport to rival Gdańsk in grandeur.
loc.POL_study_foreign_built_ships_desc: The British navy has been an ally to Poland for decades, but as of late, Britain’s policy of appeasement puts Poland in a precarious position with no friends to rely on. Perhaps by studying the designs of the Brits, we will be able to begin producing ships of equal efficiency and grandeur.
loc.POL_a_cruiser_navy_desc: Increasingly larger ships will be needed to make a reality of our plans for a sea presence.
loc.POL_import_submarine_technology_desc: Modern naval warfare is won both above and beneath the waves and if we wish to compete with the U-boats of Germany, we must design and distribute original Polish submarines.
loc.POL_commerce_attack_desc: No navy is complete without submarines. Ours need to be organized for optimal lethality, just like the rest of the fleet.
loc.POL_the_twin_threats_desc: Now that we have regained control of our coastline, we can resume the modernization of our navy. Victory shall come from studying the methods of naval warfare before committing our industry to anything.
loc.POL_coastal_defense_desc: We are a small economy with a small coastline, so the modernization of our navy must be modest. Destroyers are a cheap and efficient way to defend one’s coastline, and we must commit to them.
loc.POL_strike_force_desc: The Polish navy thus far has been modest and meek in its efforts to modernize, but no more. A great Polish dragon will mount the waves, and both Germans and Russians alike will quake at her roar as she rises like a beast on the horizon!
loc.POL_baltic_navy_desc: None shall pass by our blockades, none shall land on the shores of Poland or her allies. The baltic sea belongs to Poland, and no others.
loc.POL_strengthen_the_polish_state_desc: We cannot afford to stand divided. Our strength to enact changes is proportional to our unity in both senate and sejm.
loc.POL_defensive_focus_desc: We will not start the next war, but we will make sure we finish it.
loc.POL_polish_militarism_desc: Previous wars may have bowed us, but we are not defeated. We shall rise again, by the bravery of our soldiers and the cunning of our officers.
loc.POL_polish_revanchism_desc: Few nations have lost so much in so little time. If there is any justice, we will regain it, one way or another.
loc.POL_poland_first_desc: The good of the nation must take precedence to so-called "truths." Just as we forge our own destiny, we must forge our own facts.
loc.POL_ideological_fanaticism_desc: Countless young minds attend universities across the country, and we are missing a golden opportunity to embed the ideals of the Poland we are building into their minds. Young people should be encouraged to become patriots, fighters, and bulwarks of Polish ideals!
loc.POL_the_between_the_seas_concept_desc: Józef Piłsudski had an ambition for an alliance of nations spanning between the seas; Poles, Romanians, former Commonwealth members, and even Italians working together to ensure their mutual continued survival, without giving an inch on their sovereignty. Now, we stand in a position to fulfill Piłsudski’s daring vision. By reaching out to Romania, we will make the first step in making the Intermarium a reality!
loc.POL_treaty_with_lithuania_desc: Old grudges need to stay in the past. Every friend is needed in the dark times ahead.
loc.POL_the_baltic_alliance_desc: One can never have enough friends.
loc.POL_internationalism_desc: The enemies of our enemies can be our friends.
loc.POL_authoritarianism_desc: Democracy is a weak solution to tough problems. If power is to be wielded with force, it must be freed from the shackles of consensus.
loc.POL_paramilitarism_desc: Military principles have applications outside the military arena. With every part of society trained in these disciplines, every citizen will be able to take up arms at a moment's notice.
loc.POL_go_right_desc: Strength is the only quality worth pursuing. Our neighbors have embraced this truth, and so must we.
loc.POL_military_youth_desc: Enrolling our young in organizations promoting discipline and national ideology will breed a loyal generation of future recruits.
loc.POL_seek_accommodation_with_germany_desc: Why should we fight, when we are more alike than different?
loc.POL_go_left_desc: Only by uniting our people can we prevail against the foes that threaten to consume us.
loc.POL_political_commissars_desc: In order to maintain control of the military, political officers will be appointed to ensure military adherence to the party policies.
loc.POL_seek_accommodation_with_USSR_desc: The USSR want war as little as we do. Perhaps there is a way to reconcile our history without bloodshed.
loc.POL_liberalism_focus_desc: We will not stoop to the level of despots and dictators. Never forget that a state serves its people, and not the opposite.
loc.POL_intervention_focus_desc: If we value freedom, we need to safeguard it not only for us, but for nations everywhere. If this means war, so be it!
loc.POL_draw_closer_to_britain_desc: The British have committed to protect our independence in the face of aggressors. We need to make the necessary gestures of appreciation.
loc.POL_volunteer_corps_desc: Freedom cannot be enforced by the unwilling, or it would become a travesty. Those who take arms for liberty by choice must be given the means to do so, however.
loc.POL_central_defence_of_poland_desc: Poland is lacking the equipment it needs to defend against the countless threats to her border. By expanding the Ministry of National Defence, we will be better equipped to fight any army who seeks to brutalize Poland under an occupation.
loc.POL_modernize_congressional_factories_de: Congress Poland was the largest and most unified region of our nation and it holds the greatest potential for growth in all of Poland. By modernizing major cities like Warsaw, we will turn Congress Poland into the industrial heart of our nation.
loc.POL_expand_katowice_mines_desc: Despite its relative small size, Upper Silesia is a treasure trove of steel and aluminium. Although it would be ideal to control the entirety of Silesia, we must for now exploit the Upper Silesian industries to their fullest.
loc.POL_abolish_segregated_seating_desc: Poland is a landscape of people of different ethnicities, cultures, and faiths, yet in our education we keep them separate. If they truly are all Poles, then they should be together and share ideas freely. Segregated seating is little but a constraint on our education and must be abolished.
loc.POL_agrarian_reform_desc: A peasant’s strike is on the horizon. All across the country, food prices are skyrocketing, and both our disjointed industry and the government’s lack of action to aid Poland’s poorest cause great unrest in the peasantry. With sufficient investment and reform however, we should be able to become more than capable of meeting the peasants’ demands.
loc.POL_invest_in_eastern_poland_desc: The east is a barren and desolate place, neglected entirely by both the Russians and the Polish state. There is a plethora of ideal locations for factories, and plenty of men with which to work them, should we choose to invest in such things.
loc.POL_complete_the_plan_desc: The time has come to reflect upon the Four Year Plan and prepare plans for the next four years of Polish industrialization! The more we have invested in Poland and her industry, the better prepared we will be for what lurks in Poland’s industrial future.
loc.POL_woo_the_sanation_generals_desc: The Sanationist military staff are disgruntled and disloyal towards the regime. Some would say that a purge of military staff is necessitated by the Sanation’s own hubris, but we know these men are simply too valuable to be replaced.
loc.POL_sanationist_army_desc: With a loyal Sanation upper command under our control, the time has come to utilize the old guard’s experience among the troops.
loc.POL_purge_the_sanation_desc: The Sanation generals are fickle and disloyal and have proved themselves to have allegiances moreso to themselves than to Poland herself! We must purge our high command of all generals involved in the Sanation coup!
loc.POL_appoint_new_officers_desc: Now that our military staff has been purged of disloyal generals, we have the opportunity to give power to men who care deeply about Polish sovereignty, and hold no loyalty to the Castle, Left, or Right.
loc.POL_new_military_academy_desc: Our high command lays barren and empty, but this leaves a golden opportunity to plant the seeds for the future; ensuring that future generals are loyal to our nation and highly educated in the art of war. By funding military academies across the nation, we will ensure that any new Polish officers are of a higher caliber than any of their predecessors.
loc.POL_attract_foreign_motors_desc: While some would insist that the original Polish designs of LRL are where the future of Polish motorized equipment lies, the question remains why should we reinvent the wheel when we can merely realign it? Foreign motor companies have mastered the art of making materials cheaper, faster, and harder so it would seem prudent to invite them to design equipment for us!
loc.POL_adaptive_designs_desc: Maintaining our licence for foreign designers is coming to be of great expense to the state, but perhaps there are ways we can repurpose our military designs to be of use in the private sector. By distributing a portion of our materials to the wealthy, we may mitigate the cost of maintaining the expense of employing these foreign design companies.
loc.POL_complete_april_constitution_desc: The April Constitution is a series of reforms designed to centralize Poland into a more centralized authoritarian regime under the President. The Sanation government is legitimized by this legislation, but still there are those who long for the old system. The April Constitution must be completed and amended to further the powers of [GetAppropriateLeaderNameInBookmark] and centralize the Polish state!
loc.POL_consolidate_sanation_government_desc: Since the death of Józef Piłsudski, the Sanation government has been fragmented and disorganized. The government has split into three branches: The Castle, the Sanation Left, and the Sanation Right. It’s uncertain if the Castle can maintain control of the dictatorship, but the government must leave this state of indecision soon if it is to have any hope of withstanding the oncoming storm of war.
loc.POL_the_castle_desc: The Castle represents the governors ruling from Warsaw Castle under the leadership of Ignacy Mościcki. Staunch supporters of the status quo, giving support to the government in the Castle will keep the nation stable and prevent the Sanations left and right from having the necessary footing to instigate a coup.
loc.POL_eliminate_socialist_parties_desc: Socialism is an ideology rapidly taking hold of the world, but it is fundamentally incompatible with the ideals of the Castle government. The left oppose us in both the form of agrarian and social-democrat parties, and in the traitorous communist parties. Socialism of all forms must not be accepted and all social parties must be banned for the sake of the continued stability and security of the Polish state.
loc.POL_dissolve_the_sejm_desc: The Sejm has continued to exist under the Sanation government as a mere token of the democracy Poland once embraced. The time has come however to strip the Sejm of all powers and grant all power to the Senate and the Senators of the Castle.
loc.POL_promote_chemical_industry_desc: Before the days of the Sanation government, Ignacy Mościcki was an intellectual and a chemist. Now, at the head of the Polish state, Mościcki stands in a position where he may support the chemical industry and the study thereof.
loc.POL_camp_of_national_unity_desc: The Sanations Left and Right no longer possess the power to be a real threat to the government and all that remains is to officially dissolve them and maintain the leadership of Ignacy Mościcki and guide Poland into a new brighter future.
loc.POL_the_sanation_left_desc: Loyal to Walery Sławek, the Sanation Left represents those who feel Sławek is the true successor to Piłsudski and seek accommodation with the opposition, rather than ostracising them from government entirely as the Right and Castle would. Though cooperation with them will likely upset the Sanation Right, the leftists hold internal power that we need to build a competent cabinet of ministers.
loc.POL_modus_vivendi_desc: The Sanation Left seeks accommodation with the opposition within our state; granting them seats of power within the government. With members of the opposition given proper representation, they may no longer seek to oppose the Dictatorship.
loc.POL_draft_a_new_constitution_desc: It has long been Sławek’s ambition to amend the constitution of Poland, and given the right to do so may grant us more direct control over the Polish state and further improve the April Constitution.
loc.POL_department_for_home_defence_desc: Poland has long lacked the home defence it needs to defend against the enemies on either side of our borders. By establishing the Department for Home Defence, we will master the methods of war necessary to defend our state.
loc.POL_legion_of_merit_desc: A conception of Walery Sławek, the Legion of Merit would award a privileged position to any citizens of the republic who have proven themselves to be of outstanding benefit to the state. The award would guarantee the individual a position in the senate, and any individual invited to the Legion would certainly have little reason to grow disgruntled with the regime.
loc.POL_the_left_chairman_desc: The Sanations Left and Right are fundamentally incompatible ideologically. While we may be able to benefit from reforms proposed by the Right, it is the Left who has the best interests of Poland at heart and perhaps by granting them greater powers, we may sideline the Right entirely…
loc.POL_common_organization_of_society_desc: Sławek has long had the ambition to replace the BBWR with a power structure he calls the “Common Organization of Society”. This structure would uniquely grant great local autonomy to Poland’s states and townships, while centralizing the government in a strong authoritarian regime ready to interfere in local governance in times of war. With the Left in power, Sławek may at last fulfill his ambition.
loc.POL_dissolve_the_bbwr: A New King in the Castle
loc.POL_dissolve_the_bbwr_desc: The Left have grown so influential and powerful within the Dictatorship that Mościcki’s title of President seems entirely symbolic at best. All that remains is to make it official and disband all traces of the Castle from government, bringing Sławek to the lofty peak of power in the state.
loc.POL_the_sanation_right_desc: Followers of Edward Rydz-Śmigły, the Sanation Right is primarily composed of generals and high ranking military staff. The military powerhouse of the Sanation government, the Right are in prime position to take control of the government, but granting powers and concessions to them may ensure their continued loyalty and potential incorporation into the Castle.
loc.POL_support_right_paramilitaries_desc: The Falangists of Poland’s political landscape have often been described as fanatical, fascist, and even comparable with the Nazis, but their rhetoric is appealing to Polish patriots, and Jerzy Rutkowski proposes establishing a paramilitary composed of youthful volunteers ready to fight and die for Polish independence.
loc.POL_codify_national_unity: Codify the Camp of National Unity
loc.POL_codify_national_unity_desc: The Camp of National Unity represents the joint interests of the Sanation Right and the Castle, and thus far the policies and goals of the group have been vague. However, we may amend the April Constitution to lock our values of nationalism, law and order, and anti-communism into the foundation of our republic.
loc.POL_second_man_of_the_state_desc: The Sanation Left has been sufficiently sidelined and now, Śmigły and Mościcki are able to completely oust the Left of all influence in the government. Śmigły shall be made the “second man”, meaning that in times of war, Mościcki must surrender his seat as President to the Sanation Right and the military.
loc.POL_ozon_desc: Though the agreement is that Mościcki surrenders his seat in times of war, it is clear that the threats on our border are more than we can stand against and war is on the horizon. With Śmigły in total control of the nation, our military and civilian governments will be one and we will be ready to fight whomever threatens Polish sovereignty.
loc.POL_align_with_the_west_desc: The British, French, and other western powers have long been stalwart defenders of Polish sovereignty so we would do well to keep our nation aligned with them.
loc.POL_lithuanian_ultimatum_desc: For years, we have officially been in a state of war with the Lithuanians though nobody has taken aggressive action since the annexation of Vilnius. With Germany storming across the continent taking what it desires with the mere threat of war, perhaps we may do the same for Lithuania; demanding an end to these hostilities for the sake of both our nations.
loc.POL_lithuanian_alliance_desc: We have made peace with our former enemies to the north, but now we must learn how to move forward together as friends. Our enemies and allies are common, so it is only natural that the Lithuanians be aligned with the same powers as us.
loc.POL_lithuanian_annexation_desc: With the German anschluss of Austria, it’s become evident that old unions can be restored if one merely asks for it with some aggression. Perhaps we may suggest that the Lithuanians would be much safer if they lived in a larger more powerful state… Poland, for example.
loc.POL_restore_the_sejm_desc: Implementing the April Constitution was clearly a mistake in need of rapid correction. Power must be returned to the Sejm, and from there we must decide the future of our nation through democratic means.
loc.POL_plan_west_desc: The Axis are breathing down our neck. Though some within the government believe our relationship with [GER.GetLeader] to be cordial, we know that the Germans cannot be trusted and extensive plans in the west are necessary to securing Poland’s future.
loc.POL_the_prusya_line_desc: East Prussia is a key invasion point for the Germans, and a great gap in our current defences. By expanding out fortline along the Prussian border, our armies will be more capable of defending our nation from the threat to our north.
loc.POL_invest_anti_air_desc: We are unlikely to be capable of outproducing the Germans in the air, however we need not outnumber them when we can instead invest heavily in constructing anti-air weaponry on the ground. With Bofors in every state, German pilots won’t get far before meeting our guns.
loc.POL_the_prusya_army_desc: Our border with Prussia is woefully undefended. All of our investments in the Prussian fortifications will mean nothing without soldiers manning the forts.
loc.POL_expand_poznan_forts_desc: Poznań is already home to a plethora of bunkers and key defensive structures, but there is much room for improvement. Poznań is the first line of defence against the enemy and must be defended, regardless of the cost.
loc.POL_local_western_plans_desc: There are key strategic regions all along the Polish-German border. Drafting comprehensive plans on a purely local level and executing them at the right time is as necessary for the continued survival of the Polish state as our grander battle plans.
loc.POL_sudeten_mountaineers_desc: The Sudetenland is an insecure border, but it also provides a unique defensive position. By training men who have mastered mountain warfare, we will be able to outmaneuver the Germans in the lofty peaks of Zaolzie!
loc.POL_complete_plan_west_desc: The Polish military high command are satisfied that adequate plans have been drawn for the inevitable conflict with the Germans and the time for Plan West has come to an end.
loc.POL_sabotage_polish_industry_desc: Our enemies have far stronger armies than ours and in greater number. While it would be nice to entertain the idea that we shan’t lose ground, the truth is we are unlikely to hold out forever. By rigging our factories and railways with explosives, we may however be able to render them useless to our enemies in the event of an occupation.
loc.POL_plan_east_desc: We have been in and out of military conflict with the Russians for centuries and we can safely assume that [SOV.GetLeader] will, like [SOV.GetLeader.GetHerHis] predecessors will attempt an invasion of Poland. They must not succeed this time, plans must be drawn to ensure Poland’s decisive victory over [SOV.GetNameDef]!
loc.POL_eastern_conscripts_desc: Many in Eastern Poland sooner identify themselves as Ukrainian or Belorussian than Polish, but they must be convinced to fight nevertheless! While we may find few who would fight for Poland, there are countless among them who would eagerly pick up a rifle against the [SOV.GetAdjective]s!
loc.POL_belorussian_army_desc: There are ample independent military groups willing to fight against [SOV.GetNameDef] within Belarus, all that we need do is grant them official recognition and offer them military leadership.
loc.POL_ruthenian_army_desc: Among Poles and Ukrainians alike, anti-[SOV.GetAdjective] sentiment is palpable in the East. With funding and military leadership, these paramilitarists would be great additions to our armies.
loc.POL_fortification_of_belarus_desc: The north side of Eastern Poland is little but a series of dense forests with scarcely a trace of civilization among them. This cannot continue to be so in the event of an invasion; these forests must be transformed into a shield against Bolshevism!
loc.POL_fortification_of_ukraine_desc: The east is underdeveloped and agrarian, and Polish Ukraine remains a soft spot in Poland’s south primed for an invasion. Some basic fortifications must be constructed along the border if we are to keep our nation safe!
loc.POL_supply_the_rail_nexus_desc: The railways in Eastern Poland are in a sorry state, not nearly comparable to Poland’s central region. A war with [SOV.GetNameDef] would be won or lost with the control of supply, and a decent supply chain to our own men would be a great place to begin.
loc.POL_local_eastern_plans_desc: Often our own military staff can be trusted to devise plans amongst themselves, but in a war like this, direct intervention on a small scale is necessary. Every inch of ground matters, and we must apply our expertise to the smallest of conflicts if we are to halt [SOV.GetAdjective] imperialism!
loc.POL_complete_plan_east_desc: The Polish military high command are satisfied that adequate plans have been drawn for the inevitable conflict with the [SOV.GetAdjective] and the time for Plan East has come to an end.
loc.POL_prepare_for_the_inevitable_desc: We have held out for as long as we can, but with what we have lost, it is time to admit defeat. Poland is gone, but the Polish spirit lives on, and she remains on the prowl even in exile. With enough support from our allies, we shall be capable of fielding an army of exiles, supporting our comrades still resisting occupation back home, and filling our enemy’s ranks with men and women loyal to Poland.
loc.POL_foreign_air_support_desc: With our the assistance from our allies, we may yet be able to field a powerful Polish air force. Purchasing factories and equipment is merely the beginning of the Polish air force in exile!
loc.POL_foreign_army_support_desc: With refugees coming from Poland to serve in our ranks every day, we need only provide them with a rifle and they will be prepared to charge up any mountain for the promise of home. All we need do is request further control of our allies’ industry.
loc.POL_aces_in_exile_desc: The enemy may have taken our homeland, but our finest pilots still yet fill the air and inspire our men to keep pressing home!
loc.POL_foreign_naval_support_desc: What little is left of our navy is in a sorry state. Although we may never be able to restore it to its former glory, support from our sponsors may yet give Polish sailors the means to assist our friends on the sea.
loc.POL_resistance_industries_desc: Although the homeland is lost, we still need a strong industrial base with which to expand Polish intelligence and develop any ground we reclaim from the enemy.
loc.POL_exile_industries_desc: With home becoming a distant memory, we need to work towards preparing for our return with further developments to our exile production base.
loc.POL_expand_polish_intelligence_desc: With our armies shattered, defeated, and forced underground, Poland is forced to carry on the struggle from the shadows. We must prioritize rapid expansion of Polish intelligence if there is even to be the faintest hope of returning home.
loc.POL_pomscimy_wawer_desc: There are whispers coming back to us from the streets of Warsaw that the resistance is preparing for a daring move against the enemy. All across the city, the walls are decorated with foreboding words promising the enemy that we shall have our revenge. It will be difficult, but this uprising may yet be the push we need to finally return home and strike back at the enemy, all the resistance needs is some organization from Polish high command and they may yet succeed…
loc.POL_the_long_push_home_desc: The uprising was a success! All that remains now is to hold out long enough for help to arrive. With a populace who have witnessed the absolute horror and brutality of enemy occupation, the Polish army will fight with the vigor of men forty times their number again! This time: we will not fall!
loc.POL_the_north_sea_desc: Before we can even begin to consider swaying the neutral powers in the North to join our alliance, we must lay the groundwork on the global diplomatic stage. We must make the northern powers aware of our eagerness to cooperate, and send Józef Beck and his silver tongue to the Nordic countries to convince them of the many benefits of aligning themselves with the Międzymorze.
loc.POL_finno_polish_pact_desc: The Fins are in a similar position to us; stuck on the border with the [SOV.GetAdjective]s who want nothing more than to see their nation subjugated once again into an empire. This makes Finland the ideal candidate for an initial Międzymorze expansion into the Nordic countries.
loc.POL_invite_denmark_desc: Though a minor power, the Danes control the straits of Denmark, a key strategic region in the Baltic. By aligning the Danish with our faction, we will secure access into and out of the Baltic. The Danes must merely be trusted to survive.
loc.POL_invite_sweden_desc: The Swedes have had an intriguing concept of neutrality in these times of growing conflict. Perhaps we may be able to sway their foreign ministers that the Intermarium is the most neutral of all alliances in the world and that this mutual offer of defence is their best chance to deter direct intervention from the world’s powers.
loc.POL_invite_norway_desc: It is no secret that the Germans have ambitions and designs for Norway, and already there are men within their nation ready to collaborate with these foreign invaders. By extending an invitation to the Intermarium, we are offering the Norwegians the unique opportunity to resist German aggression without bending to them.
loc.POL_the_mediterranean_desc: Between Poland and the Mediterranean is a herd of lambs with wolves at their back. Yugoslavia, Austria, even Greece and Turkey are prey to the predatory powers in the West. We must make all powers in the Balkans and beyond aware of our desire to protect their sovereignty and the safety of their people, only then can we extend official offers of protection to them and extend the Intermarium.
loc.POL_coerce_czechoslovakia_desc: The Czechs and Slovaks are as brothers to Poland, and it is not only in our best interest to protect them, it is our moral imperative.
loc.POL_austro_hungarian_alliance_desc: Though the Austro-Hungarians once entrapped the Polish people in their empire, they now stand in the crosshairs of the Germans, all the same as us. Collaboration seems all but inevitable for them, but perhaps if we offer them another option, they will avoid the impulse to hand the keys to their kingdom over to [GER.GetLeader].
loc.POL_protect_yugoslavia_desc: Yugoslavia is in a sorry state, and they are prime target for invasion by almost all of their neighbours. We must invite them to the Międzymorze for protection from threats both inside and outside their borders.
loc.POL_invite_greece_desc: The tension between Greece and Turkey remains strong, and with a potential Italian invasion on the horizon, the Greeks could no-doubt benefit from our protection.
loc.POL_control_the_bosporus_desc: The Romanian alliance is utterly meaningless if we are powerless to move armies and navies through the Bosporus strait. Turkey is of vital strategic interest to our nation and they must be convinced to cooperate.
loc.POL_italian_alliance_desc: The Italian government have made it no secret that they are an enemy to the ideals of self-determination that the Międzymorze represents, but with appropriate changes to both the Polish and Italian internal governments, we may be able to align them with our vision for the future of Europe.
loc.POL_anti_blitz_vehicles_desc: Our enemies would seek to overrun us with overwhelming waves of armored divisions. We are unlikely to be able to match enemy tanks, but we can however invest in weaponry designed specifically to break vehicles at great expense to the enemy.
loc.POL_clamp_down_on_danzig_desc: Officially, Danzig is a free city under Polish protection, but as of late, the city has fallen into Nazi control and is a puppet to Adolf Hitler in all but name. This blemish on our Northern border is nothing but an obstruction to Polish trade and we must reassert control over the city, or risk crumbling to the Germans.
loc.POL_attract_poles_to_gdynia_desc: A great seaport needs great men to run it, and there are countless Poles awaiting employment. By encouraging migration to Gdynia, we may continue our development project of the seaport.
loc.POL_ban_the_nazi_party_desc: We have garnered enough support among the populace of Gdańsk that we may officially purge the city of Nazis and reclaim the city for the Polish state!
loc.POL_develop_gdansk_ship_building_desc: Now that Gdańsk is once again under our control, we may give it the naval investments it so desperately needs to begin building the tremendous baltic navy Poland needs!
loc.POL_expand_gdynia_seaport_desc: Now that Gdynia has been developed into a great trading city to rival Danzig, all that remains is to officially open the city for trade and our economy will once again be ours and ours alone to control!
loc.POL_integrate_gdansk_industries_desc: For decades, Gdańsk has been separated from the rest of the nation, but no more! By integrating Gdańsk into our administration, we will be able to reclaim control of our exports and imports!
loc.POL_expand_northern_rail_desc: All Polish goods must enter and exit through the North, but the infrastructure there is far from what it could be. The North must be given proper railway infrastructure.
loc.POL_join_allies_desc: The future of [Root.GetNameDef] exists in the hands of our old allies in the West. Though we are already affiliated with the Allies, officially joining them shall affirm our commitment to the West, and hopefully the West’s commitment to Poland in turn.
loc.uncontrolled_exports_desc: A foreign nation has almost complete control over our exports and imports, essentially rendering our economy in a state of embargo; incapable of trading freely with the rest of the world.
loc.POL_anti_german_offensive_desc: Plans have been drawn to entrap the Germans in the city streets of this state.
loc.POL_anti_soviet_offensive_desc: The Polish armies have received highly specialized plans to counter the [SOV.GetAdjective] offensive in this state.
loc.POL_looming_peasants_strike_desc: Angered by a total lack of action to counter the gross impoverished conditions of Eastern Poland, a Peasants’ Strike is on the horizon for Poland. If not addressed before the year is out, Poland risks unknown levels of civil unrest across the nation.
loc.POL_great_peasants_strike_desc: The lack of action by the government has led to mass-protests across the countryside! Police action is already doing little but agitate and marginalize the protestors further, and if rapid action is not taken, these mass protests could evolve into a full-scale civil war.
loc.POL_four_year_plan_idea_desc: This country has made mass-industrialization efforts across the country.
loc.POL_san_left_desc: Supporters of reform, the Sanation Left believe that Walery Sławek is the true successor to the previous dictator, Józef Piłsudski.
loc.POL_sanation_left_opposition_1_desc: [Root.GetLeftDesc] Currently, the Sanation Left is a very marginal threat to the Dictatorship and is in no position to threaten the stability of the regime.
loc.POL_sanation_left_opposition_2_desc: [Root.GetLeftDesc] Currently, the Sanation Left are building power in the Dictatorship and is capable of disrupting our day-to-day political operations in the civilian sector.
loc.POL_sanation_left_opposition_3_desc: [Root.GetLeftDesc] Currently, the Sanation Left is very powerful and has the power to bring our civilian sector to a grinding halt should they desire it.
loc.POL_sanation_left_opposition_4_desc: [Root.GetLeftDesc] Currently, the Sanation Left are on the brink of attempting to coup the government. Tired of continued marginalization, there is no knowing what Sławek will do.
loc.POL_san_right_desc: The right-wing of the government is largely composed of powerful military staff united behind Edward Rydz-Śmigły.
loc.POL_sanation_right_opposition_1_desc: [Root.GetRightDesc] Currently, the Sanation Right are satisfied with the government and are of very little threat to the regime.
loc.POL_sanation_right_opposition_2_desc: [Root.GetRightDesc] Currently, the Sanation Right are growing a little agitated and are taking Mościcki’s orders as more advice than actual commands.
loc.POL_sanation_right_opposition_3_desc: [Root.GetRightDesc] Currently, the Sanation Right believe the Dictatorship is attempting to undermine the authority of the military and are using their positions in military high-command to disrupt the Polish army.
loc.POL_sanation_right_opposition_4_desc: [Root.GetRightDesc] Currently, the Sanation Right are preparing for a coup on the Polish government. Their power over the military makes them the real power in the dictatorship and if concessions are not made soon, the Right could tear Poland apart.
loc.POL_april_constitution_1_desc: This piece of legislation was passed by the Sejm in 1935 to ensure the continued peace and stability of the Polish state. The constitution grants almost total powers to the President, granting him supremacy over the Sejm and Senate.
loc.POL_april_constitution_2_desc: This piece of legislation was passed by the Sejm in 1935 to ensure the continued peace and stability of the Polish state. The constitution grants almost total powers to the President, granting him supremacy over the Sejm and Senate.
