loc.basic_submarine_snorkel_desc: A simple airtube running from the engine room to the control tower. Extended, it allows the submarine to run its engines and charge its batteries while still submerged.\n\nMounting this module on §YSubmarines§! reduces their §YVisibility§!, making them harder to detect.
loc.improved_submarine_snorkel_desc: An improved design prevents any water from being sucked into the engines and also reduces the radar signature of the snorkel head.\n\nMounting this module on §YSubmarines§! reduces their §YVisibility§!, making them harder to detect.
loc.light_battery_advice_tt: \n\nMounting §YLight Battery§! modules on §YLight Ships§! and §YCruisers§! improves their §YLight Gun Attack§!, which helps with destroying enemy §YScreen Ships§!. §YLight Batteries§! generally perform poorly against armored ships such as §YCruisers§! and §YHeavy Ships§!
loc.medium_battery_advice_tt: \n\nMounting §YLight Medium Battery§! or §YMedium Battery§! modules on §YCruisers§! improves their §YLight Gun Attack§! or §YHeavy Gun Attack§!, enabling them to fight enemy §YScreen Ships§! or §YCapital Ships§!. Mounting any §YMedium Battery§! will designate a ship as a §YHeavy Cruiser§!, while mounting only §YLight Medium Battery§! will designate a ship as a §YLight Cruiser§!.
loc.heavy_battery_advice_tt: \n\nMounting §YHeavy Battery§! modules increases a §YHeavy Ship§!'s §YHeavy Gun Attack§!, allowing it to engage and destroy enemy §YCapital Ships§!. §YHeavy Batteries§! generally perform poorly against smaller vessels such as §YLight Ships§! and §YLight Cruisers§!.
loc.basic_battery_desc: Basic design for the training and elevation mechanics of naval guns.
loc.basic_light_battery_desc: An open, powered mount for a small-caliber gun for use on smaller ships.\n\nMounting this module increases §YLight Gun Attack§!, which helps in engaging enemy §YScreening Ships§!.
loc.improved_light_battery_desc: A closed, powered mount for a small-caliber gun gives the crew some protection from the elements and shell splinters. \n\nMounting this module increases §YLight Gun Attack§!, which helps in engaging enemy §YScreening Ships§!.
loc.advanced_light_battery_desc: An advanced twin mount brings significantly more firepower to bear under armored protection.\n\nMounting this module increases §YLight Gun Attack§!, which helps in engaging enemy §YScreening Ships§!.
loc.basic_light_shell_desc: A compromise between armor-piercing performance and explosive power, this shell does significantly more damage after punching through the weak armor of light ships.
loc.improved_light_shell_desc: A proper armor-piercing shell for small caliber guns gives destroyers and other light ships a fighting chance against armored opponents.
loc.basic_medium_battery_desc: A powered turret with two or three guns of medium caliber for use on cruisers. \n\nMounting a §YLight Medium Battery§! module increases §YLight Gun Attack§!, which helps in engaging enemy §YScreening Ships§!. Mounting a §YMedium Battery§! module increases §YHeavy Gun Attack§!, which helps with engaging enemy §YCapital Ships§!.
loc.improved_medium_battery_desc: An improved turret layout allows faster loading while better armor improves survivability. \n\nMounting a §YLight Medium Battery§! module increases §YLight Gun Attack§!, which helps in engaging enemy §YScreening Ships§!. Mounting a §YMedium Battery§! module increases §YHeavy Gun Attack§!, which helps with engaging enemy §YCapital Ships§!.
loc.advanced_medium_battery_desc: By integrating power loading and remote power control, modern cruisers can reach rates of fire and accuracy that was hitherto considered impossible.\n\nMounting a §YLight Medium Battery§! module increases §YLight Gun Attack§!, which helps in engaging enemy §YScreening Ships§!. Mounting a §YMedium Battery§! module increases §YHeavy Gun Attack§!, which helps with engaging enemy §YCapital Ships§!.
loc.basic_medium_shell_desc: By fitting a ballistic hood, shells can be made more aerodynamic while still maintaining their armor-piercing performance.
loc.improved_medium_shell_desc: A compromise between armor-piercing performance and explosive power, this shell does significantly more damage after punching through the weak armor of light ships.
loc.basic_heavy_battery_desc: A gigantic turret housing massive guns under heavy armor. \n\nMounting a §YHeavy Battery§! module increases a ship's §YHeavy Gun Attack§!, improving performance against enemy §YCapital Ships§!.
loc.improved_heavy_battery_desc: Power Rammers increase the loading speed of heavy guns while automatic flash-tight doors improve safety. \n\nMounting a §YHeavy Battery§! module increases a ship's §YHeavy Gun Attack§!, improving performance against enemy §YCapital Ships§!.
loc.advanced_heavy_battery_desc: Improved Recoil Reduction Mechanisms and delay coils reduce interference of shells in flight and dramatically increase accuracy. \n\nMounting a §YHeavy Battery§! module increases a ship's §YHeavy Gun Attack§!, improving performance against enemy §YCapital Ships§!.
loc.basic_heavy_shell_desc: By fitting a ballistic hood, shells can be made more aerodynamic while still maintaining their armor-piercing performance.
loc.improved_heavy_shell_desc: Weighing well over a ton, these massive shells strike with unprecedented power and pose a dire threat to even the heaviest armor.
loc.secondary_battery_advice_tt: \nA §YSecondary Battery§! allows §YCruisers§! and §YHeavy Ships§! to engage enemy §YScreening Ships§! as secondary targets while dealing damage to another target.
loc.basic_secondary_battery_desc: Placed in openings along the hull, these smaller guns give the ship some defense against smaller ships, but have a limited field of fire.\n\nMounting a §YSecondary Battery§! Module gives a §YCruiser§!, §YCarrier§!, or §YHeavy Ship§! a small amount of §YLight Gun Attack§! and allows it to engage a second target.
loc.improved_secondary_battery_desc: By placing the secondary guns in powered turrets, they gain a much wider field of fire at the expense of heavier weight and reduced stability in heavy seas.\n\nMounting a §YSecondary Battery§! Module gives a §YCruiser§!, §YCarrier§!, or §YHeavy Ship§! a small amount of §YLight Gun Attack§! and allows it to engage a second target.
loc.damage_control_1_desc: Every member of a ship's crew, from the Captain down to the simple sailor, must be able to help in containing and fighting fires onboard the ship.
loc.damage_control_2_desc: By separating the main water lines around the ship, the probability of a hit rendering the ship completely unable to fight fires is much reduced.
loc.damage_control_3_desc: With heavy pumps usually dependent on the main engines for power, a single and fairly light hit in the engine room may render the ship unable to stay afloat.
loc.fire_control_methods_1_desc: To hit the target, the first step is to straddle it by firing a few guns at a time until the impacts hit on both sides of the target.
loc.fire_control_methods_2_desc: Instead of firing over the target and losing track of the impacts behind the enemy ship, shots are deliberately dropped short of the target and the distance between impact and target measured to determine the range.
loc.fire_control_methods_3_desc: Adding small color packages to the shells when they are fired colors the impacts around the target and allows multiple ships to engage the same target without being confused by each other's impacts.
loc.fuel_silos_desc: Mass Storage of fuel requires a complex set of tanks, pipes, and valves to ensure it is both secure and readily available.
loc.fuel_refining_desc: Advancements in chemical cracking allow for better yield of light fuels from oil.
loc.fuel_refining2_desc: Better planning of refinery layouts reduce wastage of fuels.
loc.fuel_refining3_desc: Improved reclamation methods allow refining fuel from by-products.
loc.fuel_refining4_desc: New developments in chemical engineering allow the refining of fuel from new sources.
loc.fuel_refining5_desc: Using new methods and improved layouts in the construction of refineries dramatically increases throughput while reducing wastage.
loc.scout_plane1_desc: Gathering intelligence on enemy troop movements and providing reports of enemy naval deployments has been the original mission for airplanes since their first deployment in the Great War, and is still an important mission.
loc.scout_plane2_desc: By developing dedicated planes to aerial surveillance and long-range reconnaissance, we ensure that we gain and maintain an accurate picture of our opponent's intentions and capabilities.
loc.SURRENDER_REDUCTION_TOOLTIP: Collaboration in $COUNTRY|H$ will reduce their surrender level by $VALUE|+%.0$
loc.COLLABORATION_EFFECTS_TOOLTIP: You have $COLLABORATION|+%.0$ collaboration in $COUNTRY|H$. This will reduce their surrender level by $SURRENDER|+%.0$ and will give $COMPLIANCE|+%.0$ compliance when the enemy capitulates which will be used for unlocking additional compliance modifiers.
loc.COLLABORATION_EFFECTS_OTHER_SIDE_TOOLTIP: $OTHER_COUNTRY|H$ have $COLLABORATION|+%.0$ collaboration in $COUNTRY|H$. This will reduce $COUNTRY|H$'s surrender level by $SURRENDER|+%.0$ and will give $COMPLIANCE|+%.0$ compliance when the enemy capitulates which will be used for unlocking additional compliance modifiers.
loc.masterful_blitz_desc: We may not have invented the Blitzkrieg, but we will develop and refine this strategy so that even the most fortified enemy defense lines will not be able to stop the advance of our glorious army.
loc.penal_infantry_desc: Penal battalions provide an opportunity for convicted soldiers and officers of the Red Army to bleed for the motherland and redeem themselves for the shameful or dishonorable actions committed in the past.
loc.basic_dp_light_battery_desc:
Combining anti-ship and anti-air guns in a single mount allows for more flexibility and saves weight.

Mounting this module increases §Y$EQUIPMENT_DESIGNER_LG_ATTACK_ICON_TOOLTIP$§!, which helps in engaging enemy §YScreening Ships§!. These modules also increase §Y$EQUIPMENT_DESIGNER_ANTI_AIR_ATTACK_ICON_TOOLTIP$§!.
Mounting a §YSecondary Battery§! Module gives a §Y$ship_hull_cruiser$§!, §Y$ship_hull_carrier$§!, or §Y$ship_hull_heavy$§! a small amount of §Y$EQUIPMENT_DESIGNER_LG_ATTACK_ICON_TOOLTIP$§! and allows it to engage a second target.
loc.improved_dp_light_battery_desc:
Powered fully enclosed Twin gun mounts greatly increase firepower and protection while saving weight.

Mounting this module increases §Y$EQUIPMENT_DESIGNER_LG_ATTACK_ICON_TOOLTIP$§!, which helps in engaging enemy §YScreening Ships§!. These modules also increase §Y$EQUIPMENT_DESIGNER_ANTI_AIR_ATTACK_ICON_TOOLTIP$§!. 
Mounting a §YSecondary Battery§! Module gives a §Y$ship_hull_cruiser$§!, §Y$ship_hull_carrier$§!, or §Y$ship_hull_heavy$§! a small amount of §Y$EQUIPMENT_DESIGNER_LG_ATTACK_ICON_TOOLTIP$§! and allows it to engage a second target.
loc.advanced_dp_light_battery_desc:
Automated Rapid fire enclosed gun mounts greatly increase firepower.

Mounting this module increases §Y$EQUIPMENT_DESIGNER_LG_ATTACK_ICON_TOOLTIP$§!, which helps in engaging enemy §YScreening Ships§!. These modules also increase §Y$EQUIPMENT_DESIGNER_ANTI_AIR_ATTACK_ICON_TOOLTIP$§!. 
Mounting a §YSecondary Battery§! Module gives a §Y$ship_hull_cruiser$§!, §Y$ship_hull_carrier$§!, or §Y$ship_hull_heavy$§! a small amount of §Y$EQUIPMENT_DESIGNER_LG_ATTACK_ICON_TOOLTIP$§! and allows it to engage a second target.
loc.basic_dp_medium_battery_desc: Automatic loading Rapid fire Medium enclosed gun Batteries greatly increase firepower.\n\nMounting a §YLight Medium Battery§! module increases §Y$EQUIPMENT_DESIGNER_LG_ATTACK_ICON_TOOLTIP$§!, which helps in engaging enemy §YScreening Ships§!. This module also increase §Y$EQUIPMENT_DESIGNER_ANTI_AIR_ATTACK_ICON_TOOLTIP$§!.
loc.special_forces_doctrine_folder_desc: How our special forces are trained.
loc.MOUNTAINEERS_DOCTRINE_DESC: A strong military focus on regiments accustomed to adverse terrain will give us the edge in outmaneuvering and denying our opponents.
loc.MARINES_DOCTRINE_DESC: An elevated Marine Corps ensures that no enemy coastline will be safe. Our elite Marines excel at operating under fire in the most hostile situations.
loc.PARATROOPERS_DOCTRINE_DESC: Airborne assault is the future of warfare. Elevating the paratroopers brings us the perfect synergy between air power and ground assault.
loc.RANGERS_DOCTRINE_DESC: By being able to operate with large forces in densely wooded areas our army can outflank and outmaneuver the enemy forces.
loc.special_forces_mountaineers_desc: Inhospitable environments and bitter conflicts attract the toughest soldiers to our elite forces. Enshrining their primacy in our doctrinal philosophy ensures we will continue to benefit from the recruitment of the very best.
loc.special_forces_paratroopers_desc: There's nothing quite as terrifying as the skies going dark with the sight of a thousand troop-filled transport planes. Our doctrinal philosophy must take advantage of the shock and awe that the airborne instills.
loc.special_forces_marines_desc: The Marine Corps serves where no other dare go. From home shore to foreign clime, these experts excel at infiltration and amphibious combat. A wide reach and flexible philosophy should be made core to our military doctrine.
loc.special_forces_rangers_desc: Light infantry is key to our success. Sharpshooter traditions, and infiltration tactics should be core in building our elite formations.
loc.ski_troops_desc: Cold weather specialists are vital to our battlefield tactics. By formally recognizing these experts in our military constitution, we can free up resources and training to elevate them even further.
loc.special_forces_recon_desc: Our elite regiments benefit from counter-intelligence and battlefield awareness second to none. Additional training is sure to benefit us further.
loc.mountaineers_combat_1_desc: Our elite forces must focus their efforts on holding the areas in which they specialize. A combination of ambush tactics and improved regimental organization ensure that our special forces present a significant defense-in-depth against invading forces.
loc.mountaineers_combat_2_desc: Mountain Artillery regiments are specialized forces designed for the rapid long range support of our elite divisions, having trained and operated in difficult terrain. Their presence significantly enhances the combat capabilities of our special forces.
loc.mountaineers_combat_3_desc: Though our elite regiments operate on a highly independent basis, augmenting their training regimen with a focus on combined arms operations increases their utility on the field.
loc.mountaineers_keystone_1_desc: The success of our elite special forces mandates a reorganization of our military philosophy around their presence.
loc.mountaineers_keystone_2_desc: With the knowledge our mountain forces have acquired, it would be foolish not to put this to good use within the other branches of our special forces. We shall institute a programme of instructor rotation in the hope of improving our overall institutional knowledge.
loc.paras_dispersed_drop_desc: The nature of our operations mandates that our airborne troops specialize in highly dispersed airdrops, allowing for significant sabotage to take place before the enemy are even aware of our presence.
loc.paras_combat_drop_desc: While dangerous, training our elite forces in direct forced entry techniques can give us significant combat advantages in combination with conventional assault.
loc.SF_PARAS_combat_effect_tt: Enemy divisions in states we §HParadrop§! into will have their current §HOrganization§! reduced.\n\n$PARA_EFFECT_TIMER$
loc.SF_PARAS_sabotage_effect_tt: Enemy controlled states we §HParadrop§! into will receive damage to §HMilitary Factories§!, §HCivilian Factories§!, and §HInfrastructure§!.\n\n$PARA_EFFECT_TIMER$
loc.PARA_EFFECT_TIMER: This effect can occur once per state every §H30§! days.
loc.paras_airborne_light_armor_desc: Certain light tanks can be adapted for airborne drop via heavy glider. This novel method of combat insertion may be niche, but provides us with new opportunities.
loc.paras_bonus_2_desc: Instituting the creation of a dedicated air lift administration means we can better outfit our cargo planes for the specific purpose of airborne insertion.
loc.paras_combat_1_desc: Nothing can compare to a perfect line of communication with our troops behind the lines. Training signal companies for airborne insertion will keep these critical communications going, even in the worst conditions.
loc.paras_combat_2_desc: The scale of our airborne operations has increased to such a degree that even essential medical equipment must be prepared for airborne insertion.
loc.paras_bonus_1_desc: Even the best drop can go awry. We must ensure that our troops are trained well in improvised navigation.
loc.paras_keystone_1_desc: Only the most battle-hardened veterans should be considered for our airborne battalions. While this may reduce our field of recruits, it is bound to pay dividends on the battlefield.
loc.paras_keystone_2_desc: Our armed forces will henceforth be built upon the skill and training of our airborne troops. The skies will darken at their coming, and our enemy shall know fear.
loc.rangers_jaegers_training_desc: Light infantry trained at fighting in Forests, living off what the area has to offer, experts at setting traps, ambushes and excellent shots.
loc.rangers_jungle_training_desc: Adept at not only surviving, but also fighting in the densest of forests, in tropical heat, these rangers are key to operating in areas normal troops dare not enter.
loc.rangers_guerilla_doctrine_desc: Initiative and movement are key ingredients to being able to attack the enemy. Our rangers should excel at using stealth and surprise.
loc.rangers_recon_terrain_training_desc: An essential prerequisite of ranger tactics is the ability to traverse the roughest terrain to strike the enemy where he does not expect.
loc.rangers_fire_support_integration_desc: The integration of forward observers with portable signal equipment into ranger teams means that even small, isolated units need not fight without artillery fire support.
loc.rangers_urban_combat_desc: Forest and city fighting share certain similarities, with short engagement ranges and limited observation. Troops skilled in one environment can be trained to adapt to the other.
loc.elite_rangers_doctrine_desc: Our Rangers are the pride of our armed forces. We must continue recruiting only the very best, and push them to even greater feats.
loc.rangers_backbone_doctrine_desc: The skills our woodland specialists have acquired are something that all our elite forces can benefit from. We must use this knowledge across all branches of light and elite troops.
loc.basic_fortification_tech_desc: By using stronger materials and metal reinforcements within the structures, we can construct larger fortifications without having to worry about them collapsing.
loc.land_fort_tech_1_desc: By making better use of the land surrounding our fortifications, and incorporating new technology to boot, we can strengthen our existing structures and expand them even further.
loc.land_fort_tech_2_desc: By learning from past mistakes and reinforcing not only the structure itself, but also its base foundations, we will be able to construct much larger fortifications, that will be able to hold off even the most seasoned enemies.
loc.coastal_fort_tech_1_desc: By making better use of the land surrounding our coastal fortifications, and incorporating new technology to boot, we can strengthen our existing structures and expand them even further.
loc.coastal_fort_tech_2_desc: By building our bunkers and fortifications further into the cliff-sides and hills, we can construct even larger complexes that have the ability to repel even the greatest of naval invasion forces.
loc.sp_rockets_improved_guidance_desc: Better guidance systems for rockets, will allow us to send our flying bombs further, making them an even bigger threat to our enemies. By improving the guidance systems for smaller rockets, our rocket artillery will be able to improve their aim as well.
loc.sp_armored_lc_naval_engine_conversion_te: Utilizing naval engineering techniques such as reinforced crankshafts, high-torque transmissions and specialized cooling systems can enhance the power output and durability of Land Cruiser engines, allowing them to better manage the immense weight and stress.
loc.sp_armored_lc_transmission_improvements_: Refined gear ratios, clutch mechanisms and torque converters to create more efficient transmissions capable of handling the extreme power and weight of Land Cruisers, improving overall mobility and reducing mechanical strain.
loc.sp_armored_lc_specialized_field_manuals_: Developing detailed training manuals tailored for Land Cruiser crews, covering unique operational procedures, maintenance protocols, and complex battlefield tactics required to effectively command these giant war machines.
loc.sp_armored_lc_weapon_fire_control_tech_d: Implementing advanced targeting optics, rangefinders, and gyroscopic stabilizers to enhance weapon accuracy and firing coordination, ensuring the guns can effectively engage targets despite their massive recoil and slow maneuverability.
loc.sp_armored_engineer_tech_desc: Combining engineering expertise with armored protection, armored engineer units are specialized on clearing obstacles and supporting front-line advances under heavy fire.
loc.sp_armored_maintenance_tech_desc: The use of armored recovery vehicles enables our maintenance personnel to recover and repair all kinds of equipment, ensuring maximum operational readiness on the battlefield.
loc.sp_armored_signal_tech_desc: Equipping our units with command vehicles will ensure secure and reliable battlefield communications and coordination under armored protection.
loc.sp_armored_motorized_military_police_tec: Equipped with military motorbikes, these units are tasked with maintaining order behind the lines, escorting convoys, and conducting patrols. Their speed and mobility allow them to quickly respond to disruptions and, if needed, perform reconnaissance in active combat zones.
loc.sp_cluster_shells_desc: Cluster shells disperse multiple submunitions over a wide area, maximizing damage against enemy troops and equipment
loc.sp_artillery_rocket_assisted_projectiles: Enhanced projectiles for super-heavy howitzers, designed to extend range and improve impact through rocket propulsion.
loc.sp_artillery_purpose_built_gun_motor_car: Specialized vehicles designed to transport and support super-heavy howitzers, ensuring mobility and easiness of battlefield deployment.
loc.sp_multi_product_supply_ships_desc: With the use of the newly produced supply ships, we can ensure smoother transfer of the fuel, ammunition and supplies.
loc.sp_standard_tenshioned_replenishment_alo: Standardized Tensioned Replenishment Alongside Method or STREAM is a further evolution of ensuring a steady resupply of our long range naval operations
loc.sp_aip_engine_improved_tech_desc: With further refinement of the AIP technology, we are seeing improvement both in terms of the performance as well as the material consumption used by the engines
loc.sp_aip_engine_advanced_tech_desc: Our experience and understanding of the Air-Independent Propulsion System have allowed us to develop state of the art engines. Silent, fast and deadly.
loc.sp_refined_pykrete_desc: With the further refinement of Pykrete, we are now able to have much better insulation and protection for our aircraft aboard the Ice Carrier.
loc.sp_ice_composite_runawayas_desc: With the continued development of ice composites, we are looking for the best materials and construction techniques to provide protection for our carrier and planes.
loc.heavy_battleship2_desc: An improvement on our earlier super heavy design with stronger weapons and improved fire control systems.
loc.sp_shock_hardening_techniques_desc: By using various Shock-Hardening Techniques, and utilizing stress equalizers for our components, we lowered the rate of premature detonations, making our projectiles more reliable and effective
loc.sp_variable_time_fuze_shells_desc: With adapting Variable Time Fuze Shells - we have made our field artillery devastating against our opponents. Shells explode before reaching the ground, thus creating much bigger kill-zone.
loc.sp_helicopter_transport_pods_tech_desc: Helicopters equipped with transport pods or towing goods beneath them on a line can move supplies and equipment quickly and without regard for terrain. Getting stuck in the mud is a thing of the past!
loc.sp_helicopter_artillery_observers_tech_d: Helicopters are able get a good vantage point of the battlefield regardless of the actual terrain, and thus make excellent forward scouts to provide accurate feedback to artillery barrages.
loc.sp_helicopter_med_evac_tech_desc: Incoming wounded! We have incoming wounded! Helicopters provide even faster casualty evacuation than regular ambulances.
loc.sp_rockets_dual_chamber_rocket_engine_1_: By adding a second combustion chamber to the engine, we can improve the flight time and effectiveness of our rocket engines.
loc.sp_rockets_dual_chamber_rocket_engine_2_: Further refinements of the dual combustion engine may lead to even greater improvements in the design's effectiveness.
loc.sp_advance_sabot_shells_desc: The additional resources granted toward armor penetrating ammunition research has given us insight in how to improve Sabot stabilization in a multitude of use cases.
loc.reinforced_wings_mothership_desc: Without their mothership, the fighters are essentially stranded in the air, severely limiting their operational effectiveness. Strengthening the mothership's air wings is the most cost-effective strategy to enhance the survivability of the entire squadron.
loc.miniature_fighters_desc: With smaller fighters we will be able to carry more of them into battle without sacrificing much firepower, as well as reducing the weight of the Motherships load
loc.aerial_hangars_desc: Aerial Hangars attached to the mothership allows us to fit even more miniature fighters onto the top of the aircraft, allowing for increased firepower and further reach.
loc.naval_minelaying_research_desc: Developments in magnetic detection and stable ignition sources for naval explosives.

loc.PRC_communist_power_struggle: Power Struggles in the Central Committee
loc.ship_light_battery_1_desc: A relatively small gun for use on destroyers and smaller ships.
loc.ship_light_battery_2_desc: A small gun with a powered mount to allow it to track targets quickly.
loc.ship_light_battery_3_desc: A small gun with a gun shield to protect the crew from shell splinters and harsh weather.
loc.ship_light_battery_4_desc: A pair of small guns in a powered, armored mount.
loc.dp_light_battery_1_desc: A small gun in a special mount, allowing it to engage airplanes as well as surface targets.
loc.dp_light_battery_2_desc: A small gun with a high angle mount and gun shield, allowing it to engage airplanes as well as surface targets.
loc.dp_light_battery_3_desc: A small gun in a high angle enclosed turret, allowing it to engage airplanes as well as surface targets.
loc.dp_light_battery_4_desc: A small, rapid-fire gun in a high angle powered turret, allowing it to engage airplanes as well as surface targets.
loc.ship_heavy_battery_1_desc: A large-caliber cannon dating from before the Great War.
loc.ship_heavy_battery_2_desc: A set of large-caliber cannons in a heavily armored mount. A redesign of the turret allows for higher gun elevation, thus increasing the range.
loc.ship_heavy_battery_3_desc: A heavily armored mount for heavy guns, incorporating a number of new technologies to increase accuracy and firing speed.
loc.ship_heavy_battery_4_desc: The ultimate evolution of heavy firepower, this heavily armored mount allows for a high degree of accuracy over long distances.
loc.ship_super_heavy_battery_1_desc: The biggest gun ever mounted on a ship, these massive cannons were designed to penetrate any feasible armor at any distance.
loc.ship_light_medium_battery_1_desc: A compromise between rate of fire and weight of shell, this gun is intended for the use in light cruisers to defeat smaller ships.
loc.ship_light_medium_battery_2_desc: This gun represents a logical evolution from previous models, and is intended to allow light cruisers to have a comfortable advantage in firepower over destroyers and older cruisers.
loc.ship_light_medium_battery_3_desc: Incorporating a number of new technologies, this lightly armored mount further increases the gap between the main batteries of destroyers and light cruisers.
loc.ship_light_medium_battery_4_desc: Designed from the ground up for a high rate of fire, this mount was created to allow light cruisers to disable even bigger enemies through a multitude of hits.
loc.dp_ship_medium_1_desc: Designed from the ground up for a high angle of fire, this mount was created to allow light cruisers to engage even bigger Ships and Aircraft.
loc.ship_medium_battery_1_desc: While unable to do significant damage to battleships, this medium gun allows a heavy cruiser to confidently engage lighter ships and other cruisers.
loc.ship_medium_battery_2_desc: An evolution of an earlier design, this gun was made to keep pace with the increases in armor and the longer ranges at which naval battles are fought.
loc.ship_medium_battery_3_desc: While not the biggest gun one can feasibly mount on a cruiser, this cannon strikes the best balance between weight of armament and fire power and can reliably defeat cruiser-armor.
loc.ship_medium_battery_4_desc: With caliber restricted by existing ammunition supplies and with an eye to retrofit older ships, this new gun features an advanced auto-loading system to drastically improve the rate of fire.
loc.ship_secondaries_1_desc: Housed in a casemate on the ship's side, this light cannon gives larger ships some measure of defense against smaller ships.
loc.ship_secondaries_2_desc: A small turreted mount for rapid-fire cannons, designed to defend capital ships against destroyers and torpedo boats.
loc.dp_ship_secondaries_1_desc: By combining the duties of the heavy anti-air gun and the secondary battery, this mount drastically boosts the anti-air capabilities of a ship while also providing some measure of defense against smaller surface targets.
loc.dp_ship_secondaries_2_desc: Housing dual purpose secondary guns in a turret greatly increases the crew protection.
loc.dp_ship_secondaries_3_desc: Powered twin dual purpose turrets allow for a large increase in firepower.
loc.dp_ship_secondaries_4_desc: Created for rapid fire against all forms of target these are the ultimate secondary weapons.
loc.ship_fire_control_system_0_desc: A central station high up in the ship's mast determines the range to the target and transmits that information to the gun mounts.
loc.ship_fire_control_system_1_desc: A central director station fires all guns simultaneously at the command of the gunnery officer.
loc.ship_fire_control_system_2_desc: A mechanical computer in the ship continuously updates range and bearing to target from information fed to it by rangefinders and other sensors.
loc.ship_fire_control_system_3_desc: A more complex mechanical computer considers a large variety of factors when calculating the ballistic solutions to engage the target.
loc.ship_torpedo_1_desc: A set of mid-sized torpedoes that can be mounted on surface warships.
loc.ship_torpedo_2_desc: By mounting another torpedo tube in the mount, a surface ship can fire a larger spread with higher chance to hit.
loc.ship_torpedo_3_desc: Larger torpedoes can carry a bigger warhead, doing significantly more damage to the target. This requires the launcher to have fewer tubes, however.
loc.ship_torpedo_4_desc: Having solved the mechanical issues of launching large torpedoes from surface ships, this advanced model can also be rapidly reloaded for another salvo.
loc.ship_torpedo_sub_1_desc: A basic set of torpedo tubes that can be reloaded from inside the submarine.
loc.ship_torpedo_sub_2_desc: A larger torpedo room allows more torpedo tubes to be mounted. It also provides slightly more living space for the crew.
loc.ship_torpedo_sub_3_desc: A set of larger torpedo tubes allows submarines to launch bigger torpedoes.
loc.ship_torpedo_sub_4_desc: The addition of an electric loading ram allows torpedo tubes to be reloaded within minutes.
loc.ship_anti_air_1_desc: A set of heavy machine guns provides a small amount of close-in defence against airplanes.
loc.ship_anti_air_2_desc: A small automatic cannon throws a significantly larger shell, killing an attacking aircraft in a few hits.
loc.ship_anti_air_3_desc: Previous calibers of guns have proven too light to reliably kill an attacking airplane before they can release their ordnance. A larger shell requires a bigger gun, but has a significantly higher chance of destroying the target when they actually hit.
loc.ship_anti_air_4_desc: The latest model of anti-air guns features a powered mount to be able to track fast-flying targets and an advanced director system to coordinate the fire of several gun positions against a single target.
loc.ship_mine_layer_1_desc: Modifications for a surface ship to carry and deploy naval mines.
loc.ship_mine_sweeper_1_desc: Gear to deploy the various sweeping equipments.
loc.ship_mine_layer_sub_desc: Modifications to the hull of a submarine, allowing it to deploy a number of mines.
loc.ship_depth_charge_1_desc: A simple set of rails allows depth charges to be rolled off the stern of the ship when the ship drives over the submerged target.
loc.ship_depth_charge_2_desc: Using a small explosive charge, this device throws a depth charge quite some distance, allowing a single ship to drop a pattern of depth charges across a larger area.
loc.ship_depth_charge_3_desc: A projector for a smaller depth charge with a contact fuze, allowing the ship to engage a target without breaking sonar contact.
loc.ship_depth_charge_4_desc: An evolution of the previous model, this mortar can fire a significantly larger charge over a longer distance.
loc.ship_sub_snorkel_1_desc: A device that allows the submarine to run its main engines underwater, enabling it to recharge its batteries without exposing itself to attack by surfacing.
loc.ship_sub_snorkel_2_desc: Improvements to the design of the schnorkel reduce the problems when using the main engines in heavy seas while reducing the probability of the schnorkel being detected on radar.
loc.ship_airplane_launcher_1_desc: A simple airplane launcher propels a small scout plane into the air.
loc.ship_airplane_launcher_2_desc: An improved launch mechanism that allows the ship to launch a larger plane with greater range and speed.
loc.ship_seaplane_tender_1_desc: Equipment for refueling and recovering seaplanes, keeping them operational with less reliance on shore-based resupply.
loc.ship_seaplane_tender_2_desc: While the earliest seaplane tenders were converted merchant ships, newer types are purpose-built and have greatly improved seaplane support capabilities.
loc.sub_missile_launcher_desc: A submarine-mounted launcher for guided and ballistic missiles.
loc.slbm_launcher_desc: A submarine-mounted launcher for nuclear ballistic missiles.
loc.ship_engine_sub_aip_1_desc: First iteration of the new engine types, allowing submarine to remain operational underwater for a longer time, at the cost of vastly increased fuel consumption and reduced ship range.
loc.ship_engine_sub_aip_2_desc: New version of the air-independent propulsion systems, offering better performance at the lower fuel consumption.
loc.ship_engine_sub_aip_3_desc: We have reached the pinnacle of what we think can be achieved with AIP Engines. This engine offers excellent speed, while at the same time retaining fuel consumption at acceptable levels.
loc.ship_anechoic_tile_desc: Rubber tile coating that is designed to reduce the range at which ship can be detected by both passive and active sonar.
loc.ship_torpedo_sub_nuclear_desc: Torpedoes that carry a nuclear warhead, providing a highly effective weapon against enemy ships, at the cost of higher risk for accidents.
loc.ship_deck_space_desc: A large open area inside the ship that allows the servicing and arming of wheeled airplanes. Adding further hangar space to a ship dramatically drives up cost.
loc.big_ship_deck_space_desc: Open area that allows to service, refuel and resupply airplanes and prepare them for their missions. Allows to store and use non-carrier plane variants.
loc.ship_escort_deck_space_desc: Open area inside the ship that allows the servicing and arming of wheeled airplanes. Much smaller and cramped than hangars on the Fleet Carriers.
loc.ship_submarine_deck_space_desc: A watertight compartment and catapult equipment allowing a submarine to carry, launch and recover a small number of seaplanes.
loc.ship_sonar_1_desc: A simple set of hydrophones to track a submerged target by the sound it makes.
loc.ship_sonar_2_desc: An active noise emitter that sends a short 'ping' into the water, then listens for the echo from a submerged submarine hull.
loc.ship_sonar_3_desc: Improved active sonar array using stronger signal pulses and directional scanning.
loc.ship_sonar_4_desc: State of the art sonar system, providing superior tracking of the submerged targets.
loc.ship_radar_1_desc: A simple radar set that operates in the 50 cm wavelength range allows the detection of surface ships even in bad weather at a range of more than 10 kilometers.
loc.ship_radar_2_desc: An improved radar set working in the 30cm wavelength range can accurately measure the range and bearing of even a small ship at ranges of over 25 kilometers.
loc.ship_radar_3_desc: Equipped with cavity magnetrons, this radar set allows not only the detection of very small targets but even detecting the splashes of shells. This allows for true blind-fire against targets, even at night or in bad weather.
loc.ship_radar_4_desc: Working in the centimeter wavelength range, this radar set is fully integrated into the ships gunnery control and allows highly accurate gunfire control in all weather conditions.
loc.ship_extra_fuel_tank_desc: Extended fuel storage allows greater operational range.
loc.light_ship_engine_1_desc: A small set of steam turbines can propel a small ship at great speed or power a larger ship at slower speeds.
loc.light_ship_engine_2_desc: Using high-pressure boilers, the same weight and space of machinery can produce a higher output.
loc.light_ship_engine_3_desc: New developments in materials allow for much higher steam pressure and thus greater power output.
loc.light_ship_engine_4_desc: Improved engine layouts and turbine gearing allow higher efficiency for the same amount of weight.
loc.sub_ship_engine_1_desc: A combination of diesel and electric engines allow a submarine to operate underwater at a reasonable speed.
loc.sub_ship_engine_2_desc: A more powerful diesel engine gives the submarine the ability to sprint into position when it detects a target.
loc.sub_ship_engine_3_desc: New materials and production methods allow for the creation of engines that can run longer at full power.
loc.sub_ship_engine_4_desc: Advanced engines with turbochargers are able to run much faster for a brief period, either to chase targets or to recharge the batteries quicker.
loc.sub_ship_nuclear_engine_1_desc: A small reactor that provides nuclear propulsion for submarines, ensuring extended underwater endurance and efficient operation for modern naval fleets
loc.cruiser_ship_engine_1_desc: A basic set of boilers providing steam to an ungeared turbine.
loc.cruiser_ship_engine_2_desc: A steam turbine equipped with gearing is dramatically more efficient, allowing the extra weight to be used for additional power.
loc.cruiser_ship_engine_3_desc: Improved boiler arrangements give higher steam pressure for more power.
loc.cruiser_ship_engine_4_desc: Advanced materials make this engine able to run much longer at high load.
loc.heavy_ship_engine_1_desc: Intended to free up weight for guns and armor, this engine was never designed to give particularly high speed.
loc.heavy_ship_engine_2_desc: Dramatically more powerful than previous designs, this engine is intended to give a heavy ship a comfortable speed margin over older models.
loc.heavy_ship_engine_3_desc: As guns and armor grow in weight, this engine was designed to allow for higher speeds to chase down fleeing enemies or keep the range open against superior enemies.
loc.heavy_ship_engine_4_desc: Designed with new materials and improved boiler design, this powerplant is intended to allow a modern battleship to keep up with fast carriers and cruisers.
loc.heavy_ship_nuclear_engine_1_desc: A powerful nuclear reactor, capable of powering the heaviest of ships without need for refuelling.
loc.carrier_ship_engine_1_desc: A basic set of engines allow a mid-sized carrier to reach the speeds necessary for the safe operation of aircraft.
loc.carrier_ship_engine_2_desc: This new powerplant is designed to allow a carrier to outpace most older cruisers and some destroyers, allowing it to evade enemy surface forces.
loc.carrier_ship_engine_3_desc: An engine designed to allow even large carriers to move at very high speeds.
loc.carrier_ship_engine_4_desc: This powerplant was designed to equip a modern 'fast carrier' intended to function as the centerpiece of a carrier group.
loc.carrier_ship_nuclear_engine_1_desc: A powerful nuclear reactor, capable of powering colossal carriers without need them needing to refuel.
loc.ship_armor_bb_1_desc: Designed to protect a ship against guns of its own caliber, this armor scheme ensures that every part of the ship is well-protected according to its usefulness.
loc.ship_armor_bc_1_desc: Designed to protect the ship against smaller guns, this armor scheme weighs far less to allow for higher speed.
loc.ship_armor_bb_2_desc: Featuring an inclined belt, this armor scheme is designed to protect a ship of the line against guns of its own caliber.
loc.ship_armor_bc_2_desc: A compromise between speed and protection, this armor scheme is designed to defend a ship against the guns of cruisers and destroyers.
loc.ship_armor_bb_3_desc: A radical departure from previous armor schemes, this design creates a heavily-armored citadel at the center of the ship but sacrifices protection for other parts of the ship. It is intended to defend a ship against guns of its own caliber.
loc.ship_armor_bc_3_desc: Designed with an eye towards weight limitations, this armor scheme attempts to maximize protection for the vital parts of a ship by leaving other areas exposed. This scheme is not supposed to stand up to battleship-grade weaponry for long.
loc.ship_armor_shbb_desc: The last word in armor design, this armor scheme is intended to defeat all known main battery projectiles, allowing a ship so equipped to engage and sink any other battleship in the world today.
loc.ship_armor_cruiser_1_desc: An armor scheme intended to give a cruiser a slight edge when fighting against destroyers and other lightly-armed ships.
loc.ship_armor_cruiser_2_desc: A heavier belt intended to allow a cruiser to engage older light cruisers and smaller ships with a good deal of protection.
loc.ship_armor_cruiser_3_desc: Copying methods used for armoring battleships, this armor scheme is designed to keep pace with developments in armaments around the world.
loc.ship_armor_cruiser_4_desc: This armor scheme attempts to maximize protection over the areas absolutely needed to keep a ship afloat and in the fight, at the cost of all other areas.
loc.ship_armor_carrier_deck_desc: Heavy armor plates protect the hangar spaces against hits by enemy bombers at the cost of less working space.
loc.ship_armor_ice_carrier_deck_1_desc: Additional construction reinforcements, ensuring stronger and more resilient construction, while also providing better resistance against the elements.
loc.ship_armor_ice_carrier_deck_2_desc: Steel-Reinforced Pykrete provides sturdier construction, capable of withstanding more damage, while offering better insulation.
loc.ship_armor_ice_carrier_deck_3_desc: Materials and methods used offer the best structure resilience and reducing the impact of weather on the ship operations.

loc.ENG_ship_light_battery_4: 4.5in QF Mk IV, RP 50 Mk V  mt

loc.ENG_dp_ship_secondaries_4: 4.5in QF Mk IV, RP 10 Mk II mt
loc.ship_light_battery_sub_desc: A formidable deck gun of a caliber more commonly found on light cruisers.
loc.cruiser_submarine_specialization_desc: Cruiser Submarines represent the pinnacle of heavy sub-surface raiding. What they lack in maneuverability and stealth, they certainly make up for in reach.
loc.midget_submarine_specialization_desc: Small submarines designed for harbor raiding or light convoy raiding suit our naval doctrine perfectly.

loc.sp_land_multi_charge_large_caliber_gun_d: With its multi-charge propulsion system and large caliber, this weapon is capable of delivering devastating bombardment over vast distances.
loc.sp_land_super_heavy_railway_gun_desc: A colossal weapon of unmatched power and precision that will stand as a testament to the military superiority of any country capable of deploying it.
loc.sp_land_stronghold_network_desc: A complex network of heavily fortified bunkers and strongpoints, built to withstand intense assaults and protect critical strategic locations from enemy incursions.
loc.sp_land_flamethrower_tank_desc: An armored vehicle equipped with devastating close-range firepower, designed to unleash torrents of flames upon enemy positions.
loc.sp_land_military_engineering_vehicles_de: Specialized vehicles to enhance battlefield mobility, fortification construction and obstacle clearance under combat conditions.
loc.sp_land_super_heavy_howitzer_desc: A formidable artillery piece boasting a large caliber, that can wreak havoc on enemy defenses with unprecedented destructive force.
loc.sp_land_self_propelled_super_heavy_howit: A self-propelled massive artillery piece with greater maneuverability on the battlefield than its towed counterpart, while accommodating an even larger caliber.
loc.sp_land_land_cruiser_desc: A massive armored behemoth designed to dominate the battlefield. With unparalleled size and firepower, this vehicle represents the pinnacle of armored warfare.
loc.sp_air_radar_desc: By using pulsed radio waves and detecting their reflections, we will be able to monitor enemy movements from land, air and sea.
loc.sp_air_centimetric_radar_desc: Developing centimetric radar will allow for detection of much smaller targets and the use of much smaller antennae.
loc.sp_land_large_caliber_kinetic_energy_sab: A larger caliber version of armor piercing artillery ammunition designed for penetrating fortifications.
loc.sp_land_reward_land_cruiser_chassis_desc: During stress testing, the chassis of the [SpecialProject.GetName] was found to be unable to handle the immense weight, causing structural deformations. The design team is split on whether to add additional reinforcement, which would further increase the vehicle's weight, or to use lighter materials, potentially compromising durability.
loc.sp_land_reward_land_cruiser_engine_desc: Early trials show that the prototype's massive frame is putting a strain on the current engine, making the [SpecialProject.GetName] sluggish and unresponsive. The team suggests two options: develop a new, more powerful engine, or attempt modifications to boost the output of the existing one, risking engine failure.
loc.sp_land_reward_land_cruiser_turret_desc: The enormous multi-turret design is causing severe alignment and aiming issues, delaying weapon integration. The engineering team recommends simplifying the turret layout to improve reliability, but doing so will reduce the [SpecialProject.GetName]'s planned firepower.
loc.sp_land_reward_land_cruiser_track_desc: The weight of the [SpecialProject.GetName] has overwhelmed the track system, leading to constant breakdowns during testing. The options are to reinforce the tracks, which would require significant re-engineering, or reduce the vehicle’s armor to lighten the load.
loc.sp_land_reward_land_cruiser_communicatio: The sheer size of the [SpecialProject.GetName] requires a complex internal communication system to coordinate its crew. The current system is proving inadequate, with orders getting delayed or lost. The team suggests redesigning the internal layout to improve communication flow, or installing a more advanced, yet untested system.
loc.sp_land_reward_land_cruiser_assembly_des: During the assembly phase, engineers successfully refined a precision alignment technique for fitting the massive components of the [SpecialProject.GetName], such as the turret ring and hull plating, significantly reducing the risk of mechanical stress fractures. We can integrate this innovative technique throughout the project to increase structural reliability overall. How should we apply it?
loc.sp_land_reward_land_cruiser_suspension_d: The team has perfected a cutting-edge hydropneumatic suspension system that balances the immense weight of the [SpecialProject.GetName], ensuring stability and reducing strain on the tracks even when traversing rough terrain. [Character.GetName] is confident that this suspension can be reliably implemented for better performance in the field.
loc.sp_land_reward_land_cruiser_ammunition_d: During testing, concerns arose regarding safe storage and transport of the [SpecialProject.GetName]’s high-caliber ammunition, as the standard racks couldn’t handle the explosive shell weight safely. A novel compartmentalized storage system, using reinforced bulkheads and hydraulic loaders, has been proposed, allowing for safer handling and faster shell loading under combat conditions.
loc.sp_land_reward_super_heavy_howitzer_focu: As development progresses, a critical decision must be made: We can prioritize fast production and smaller-caliber guns, or we can invest in bigger and heavier guns, sacrificing production efficiency for unparalleled firepower and devastating impact.
loc.sp_land_reward_stronghold_network_commun: While testing the internal communication network of the testing complex, the team identified inefficiencies that could be used to refine similar systems in traditional fort designs.
loc.sp_land_reward_stronghold_network_leader: As the project advances, [Character.GetName], the lead scientist, must decide how involved [Character.GetSheHe] will be in day-to-day operations. [Character.GetSheHeCap] can choose to oversee construction directly on the field, ensuring precise execution, or remain in the office, focusing on strategy and planning.
loc.sp_land_reward_stronghold_network_breakt: One of the junior engineers has discovered a new reinforcement method that could be applied to standard fortifications. Documenting it now could give our scientists and engineers an edge in future research.

A new reinforcement method discovered by one of the junior engineers has been forwarded to an outside research team for further evaluation. While the findings are still under review, the technique can still be applied to the current project if deemed suitable.
loc.sp_land_reward_option_stronghold_network: A tunnel under one of the main bunkers collapsed unexpectedly, trapping several workers and the lead scientist, [Character.GetName], who was overseeing operations, under the rubble. Emergency measures must be taken to rescue the trapped personnel, but the incident has already caused a delay in overall progress.

A tunnel under one of the main bunkers collapsed unexpectedly, trapping several workers and stalling construction. Emergency measures must be taken to address the situation and safely extract the trapped personnel, but the incident has already caused a delay in overall progress.
loc.sp_nuclear_reactor_desc: Experiments have proven that splitting atoms through fission releases vast amounts of energy, which could be used for power generation. Or perhaps as fuel for bombs...
loc.sp_commercial_nuclear_reactor_desc: Nuclear reactors are good for producing materials for bombs. But the amount of energy produced could instead supply civilian and military industry with power.
loc.sp_nuclear_engines_desc: Engines that can run forever - without needing to refuel. This is the promise of atomic energy. A promise our engineers say that we are very close to fulfilling.
loc.sp_nuclear_bomb_desc: A bomb using the process of nuclear fission to release the stored energy of the atom in one apocalyptic moment. With such a weapon in our arsenal, who would dare oppose us?
loc.sp_thermo_nuclear_bomb_desc: It is truly hard to imagine anything beyond the fission bomb, but with nuclear fusion, it is possible to create an explosion far larger than anything built before.
loc.sp_nuclear_warheads_desc: By creating condensed nuclear weapons, we will be able to utilize them as a payload upon a wide range of rocket-based launch systems, allowing us to strike across vast distances.
loc.sp_nuclear_design_choice_reward_desc: When trying to design a reactor, we need to choose what material to use for the moderator. This will dictate the design of the entire reactor. We can use Heavy Water, or we can use Graphite, both of which have their pros and cons...
loc.sp_nuclear_design_choice_reward_graphite: Purified graphite is the better moderator
loc.sp_nuclear_major_breakthrough_reward_des: A controlled experiment with some of our limited nuclear material has demonstrated the feasibility of our intended design. This has propelled the project forward with renewed enthusiasm.
loc.sp_nuclear_isotope_separation_choice_rew: In order to supply our reactors with nuclear fuel, we need to decide on a process for separating the useful isotopes of uranium from the rest. There are a number of proposals for separation facilities but the two frontrunners are gaseous and centrifugal.
Centrifuges will be more efficient in the long-run.
loc.sp_nuclear_generic_industry_tech_reward_: During the work on the project, our engineers have made several new inventions, that could very likely be adapted for use in other areas as well.
loc.sp_nuclear_minor_progress_generic_reward: Our scientists made some really groundbreaking discoveries while working on the latest prototype. Their findings have advanced our knowledge and research into the field considerably.
loc.sp_nuclear_generic_electronics_tech_rewa: Significant learnings were made during the last iteration on the project. Hopefully, we will be able to put this to practical use, which should allow us to speed up research in related areas .
loc.sp_nuclear_war_support_generic_reward_de: A successful test, and some related, tightly controlled, media coverage has led to the public understanding that we are getting closer to developing some kind of super weapon that can be used to defeat any and all enemies.
loc.sp_nuclear_major_political_interference_: The [SpecialProject.GetName] project has come under increased scrutiny and interference from political leaders, causing delays and potentially forcing changes in project leadership. This has enraged [Character.GetName]. We need to deal with these political challenges to keep the project on track
loc.sp_nuclear_bomb_theoretical_breakthrough: [Character.GetName] has managed to solve a complex theoretical problem during the work with the latest prototype. This has led to streamlining of the bomb design, which will make it less difficult to produce.
loc.sp_nuclear_bomb_critical_mass_generic_re: A critical accident occurred during experiments to determine critical mass, leading to radiation exposure and casualties among key personnel.
loc.sp_nuclear_bomb_information_leak_reward_: One of the workers at the [SpecialProject.GetName] has apparently been leaking information to foreign agents. Whether this was intentional or not is as of yet not known. It is likewise hard to determine the damage this has done to the project
loc.sp_nuclear_reactor_radioactive_leak_stab: Unfortunately there was a serious incident during the work with the reactor. Thanks to the rapid response by the staff, the damage has been contained and the team was able to get valuable data from the incident.
loc.sp_nuclear_reactor_minor_explosion_rewar: While working on the latest iteration of the nuclear reactor prototype, there was a small incident. A minor explosion occurred, damaging parts of the lab, but the fire that ensued could easily be put out. Once the lab is repaired, work should be able to continue as planned, with only a slight delay.
loc.sp_nuclear_reactor_tested_reward_desc: Our first nuclear reactor has been successfully tested, proving the feasibility of controlled nuclear fission. This breakthrough promises a new era of energy production, and potentially much more.
loc.nuclear_reactor_tested_reward_classify: Keep the information classified for now
loc.sp_nuclear_reactor_tested_reward_public_: Other countries might benefit from this
loc.sp_commercial_nuclear_reactor_concerns_r: [Character.GetName] has raised concerns over the lack of filters in the cooling towers of our new reactors. [Character.GetSheHeCap] insists that filters must be added to prevent radiation escaping from the reactor during an emergency. The engineers meanwhile argue they will delay the project significantly.
loc.sp_nuclear_bomb_test_prototype_reward_de: A Prototype Bomb has been produced by [Character.GetName]'s team. Making, and evaluating, a successful test would improve our progress significantly. On the other hand, we have a nuclear bomb now...
loc.sp_nuclear_bomb_test_prototype_reward_ke: We can put this to use against our enemies
loc.sp_nuclear_bomb_espionage_threats_reward: Security officers argue that there is a need to increase security at the site of [SpecialProject.GetName] project and all surrounding activities. The researchers, with [Character.GetName] in the lead, argue that freedom to move about and communicate is vital for the progress.
Increased Security lowers the risk of information theft
loc.sp_nuclear_bomb_breakthrough_plutonium_r: Our scientists have made a significant breakthrough in Plutonium production techniques, increasing the efficiency of bomb production. This can hopefully accelerate the development timeline.
loc.sp_nuclear_bomb_accident_generic_reward_: A fire broke out in one of the warehouses at the facility. Initial investigation points towards it being an accident. But was it really?
loc.sp_nuclear_bomb_design_choice_reward_des: There are two designs for an atomic weapon being pursued by our scientists and debate has emerged over how to proceed with them. One design, known as the gun type, is far simpler to create but also less efficient in its use of nuclear material. The other is the implosion type, a much more challenging design but theoretically more efficient in its use of nuclear material.
loc.sp_nuclear_bomb_design_choice_reward_gun: The gun is a safer bet.
loc.sp_thermonuclear_bomb_test_reward_desc: In order to confirm the theory behind a thermonuclear bomb, our scientists have requested the opportunity to carry out a test detonation. This would require the allocation of an existing atomic bomb to initiate the chain reaction but would significantly accelerate the progress of the project.
loc.sp_rockets_flying_bomb_desc: An unmanned aircraft, using a rocket engine, carrying a significant payload, should be able to strike fear in the hearts of our enemy, demoralizing them.
loc.GER_sp_rockets_flying_bomb_desc: Vergeltungswaffe 1. A rocket powered flying bomb, capable of hitting our enemies from distance, destroying their war industry, without needing trained pilots.
loc.sp_rockets_ballistic_missile_desc: A guided ballistic missile, capable of delivering a warhead from great distances with unprecedented speed and accuracy.
loc.GER_sp_rockets_ballistic_missile_desc: Vergeltungswaffe 2. A guided ballistic missile, capable of delivering a warhead from great distances with unprecedented speed and accuracy.
loc.sp_rockets_medium_range_ballistic_missil: Medium range ballistic missiles shall enable us to deliver a warhead across a continent with astonishing accuracy and devastating impact.
loc.sp_rockets_long_range_ballistic_missile_: An intercontinental ballistic missile, likely the largest missile we need ever build, capable of delivering a warhead with great accuracy basically anywhere on the globe.
loc.sp_rockets_ground_to_air_missile_desc: A large rocket powered anti-air missile, capable of knocking a bomber out of the sky with a single hit. This will shape the future of air defense, for sure.
loc.sp_rocket_interceptor_desc: Combining the power of a rocket with the maneuverability of a small chassis, we will create an unmatched interceptor aircraft.
loc.sp_rockets_scientist_xp_generic_reward_d: Our Scientists have made several new learnings during the course of the work with the latest prototype
loc.sp_rockets_political_interference_generi: Politicians dabbling where they shouldn't have led to the project being forced to redo things that were already done, for reasons that make sense to no-one.
loc.sp_rockets_onsite_explosion_generic_rewa: A major explosion during one of the tests resulted in severe damage to parts of the facility, but has also led to new insights for our scientists
loc.sp_rockets_generic_major_breakthrough_re: During the last prototype iteration, we managed to make a major breakthrough.
loc.sp_rockets_generic_avionics_advancements: During our work we have made many findings in the general Avionics and Aerodynamics field that can benefit our aircraft production.
loc.sp_rocket_design_choice_reward_desc: When designing our flying bomb, our engineers argue that it is important to decide what the main aim of the design of the bomb is. Do we want to maximize range, or is the payload the most important issue.
loc.sp_rockets_flying_bomb_technical_breakth: Technical Breakthrough in Pulse jet Design
Our engineers have overcome significant hurdles in designing the missile's pulse jet engine, crucial for its range and speed.
loc.sp_rockets_flying_bomb_launch_ramp_innov: Our engineers have made significant improvements in the specialized launch ramps necessary for the deployment of the missiles.
loc.sp_rockets_flying_bomb_mass_production_s: We've successfully managed to come up with production improvements, that will allow us to scale up to mass production much faster.
loc.sp_rockets_flying_bomb_engine_optimizati: Our engineers have managed to significantly improve the pulse jet's range and reliability, enhancing the missile's operational capability.
loc.sp_rockets_flying_bomb_technological_inn: During the latest round of prototyping, significant improvements have been made to the guidance system's accuracy and jam resistance, advancing our technological edge.
loc.sp_rockets_flying_bomb_test_flight_failu: Early test flights have resulted in failures due to guidance system malfunctions and structural weaknesses. Our scientists have learned a lot from it, but we need to take a step back and rethink.
loc.sp_rockets_ground_control_improvements_r: [Character.GetName] managed to solve several outstanding issues with the ability to track and control the missile from the ground. This marks a significant step towards being able to target enemy high flying aircraft.
loc.sp_rockets_vertical_launch_reward_desc: After a few failed attempts, [Character.GetName] finally managed to solve the problems around vertical launching of these missiles. The new system should allow the missiles to be launched without problems and reach high altitudes without delay.
loc.sp_rockets_high_speed_flight_control_rew: We have finally managed to get a working control system that can function at high speeds and react to changing flight dynamics. This knowledge can certainly be  useful in other areas as well.
loc.sp_rockets_warhead_detonation_mechanisms: An important part of the whole development is to get the weapon to explode at the right point. It appears that [Character.GetName] has managed to come up with a solution that allows us to detonate it at as favorable time as possible.
loc.sp_rocket_wind_tunnel_choice_reward_desc: Engineers on the ballistic missile project have requested the construction of a supersonic wind tunnel to test scale models of their designs earlier. This would rapidly speed up their iteration process and save resources in the long run.
loc.sp_rocket_glass_wool_choice_reward_desc: During the re-entry phase of the rocket's flight, ice seems to be forming around the fuel tanks and interfering with the rocket's internals. Although a setback, our engineers have suggested adding glass wool around the tanks to prevent this from happening in future.
loc.sp_rocket_guidance_system_choice_reward_: Our engineers are debating the guidance system for the rocket. Some wish to stick with a tested mechanical computer while others wish to utilize new radio technologies to control and monitor the rocket post launch.
loc.sp_rocket_turbo_pump_froth_reward_desc: During high altitude testing, an issue regarding the turbopump was isolated. It seems that the lubricant inside the pumps begins to froth under the strenuous conditions which impacts the overall performance and reliability of the current design.
loc.sp_rocket_turbo_pump_froth_reward_accept: We have to figure this out!
loc.sp_rocket_relay_failure_reward_desc: A defective relay used for the internal control systems of the rocket was detected while preparing for our test launch. Engineers believe we should replace the relay before carrying on, but concerns are mounting over political ramifications of a delay.
loc.sp_rocket_outercoating_reward_desc: Concerns have been raised regarding the external casing of the rocket. When left for an extended period, the materials often rust and corrode. This could leave the rocket inoperable if a solution is not found.
loc.sp_rocket_outercoating_reward_accept: Perhaps a lubricant could be applied?
loc.sp_rocket_launch_site_choice_reward_desc: The sheer scale of the new rocket is causing constraints at the intended launch site. The project managers are therefore requesting funding for a new purpose built site to be constructed elsewhere.
loc.sp_rocket_launch_site_choice_reward_reje: Find a way to make the current site work.
loc.sp_rocket_launch_site_choice_reward_acce: We shall invest in a new facility.
loc.SP_ROCKET_AND_SUBMARINE_SITE_REMINDER_PR: In order to effectively use $PROJECT|Y$ we need to construct Rocket Site or have Submarines with missile strike capability.
loc.SP_ROCKET_SITE_REMINDER_PROJECT: In order to effectively use $PROJECT|Y$ we need to construct Rocket Site.
loc.sp_naval_cruiser_submarine_desc: A submarine with superior range, designed for traversing long distances, without support, would be ideal for attacking enemy shipping.
loc.sp_naval_nuclear_submarine_desc: We should be able to make nuclear engines small enough to fit in a specialized submarine, making the vessel silent and providing it with extreme range.
loc.sp_naval_rocket_launching_submarine_desc: By equipping our submarines with missiles, and launch systems, we should be able to hit our enemies' strategic targets anywhere, and with no prior warning.
loc.sp_naval_torpedo_cruiser_desc: We can inflict significant damage on our enemies' most important and expensive ships, utilizing Torpedo Cruisers, according to the last century's concept - Jeune École.
loc.sp_naval_fleet_submarine_desc: A long-range submarine capable of acting as a fleet escort but without the flaws inherent in the design of the previous cruiser submarines.
loc.sp_naval_super_heavy_battleship_desc: The naval arms race may have diversified in recent years, yet it is hard to deny the sheer majesty of the battleship, and the potential for building even greater behemoths.
loc.sp_naval_nuclear_missile_submarine_desc: If we are able to surface a submarine, fire a missile with a nuclear charge, and then submerge again, our first-strike potential becomes almost limitless.
loc.sp_naval_modern_battleship_desc: Others may believe that the future of the naval combat will be dominated by the carriers, we are here to convince them that they are wrong.
loc.sp_naval_midget_submarine_desc: There exists a niche in our naval capabilities for a lightweight, cheap, and versatile submarine, that could be used for anything from harbor sabotage to convoy raiding.
loc.sp_naval_nuclear_torpedo_desc: With the advent of low-yield tactical warheads, long-range torpedos with these warheads attached could theoretically be deployed by any conventional submarine.
loc.sp_naval_modern_carrier_desc: With the latest developments on ship-building techniques we could build a new generation of aircraft carriers, with vastly improved size and capabilities.
loc.sp_naval_anechoic_tiles_desc: This special rubber tiled coating for submarines, which contains small empty spaces between them; reduce the threats of detection by enemy sonars.
loc.sp_naval_anechoic_tiles_non_mtg_tt: Enables Submarine Stealth Upgrade value of 6 and 7
loc.sp_naval_aip_engine_desc: A new propulsion system that could eliminate the weakness of submarines needing to resurface in order to recharge their batteries and replenish oxygen supply.
loc.sp_naval_aip_engine_non_mtg_tt: Enables Submarine Engine Upgrade value of 6 and 7
loc.sp_naval_ice_carrier_desc: In order to assert our air superiority over the vast oceans, we need carriers that could store and launch long-range regular airplanes, and not just carrier aircraft.
loc.sp_naval_underway_replenishment_desc: Supplying navies far from their home bases was always a limiting factor. With our fleets operating at extreme ranges, we need to develop new methods for resupply.
loc.sp_naval_proximity_fuze_desc: With improved and more reliable radio technology, we can develop new kind of fuzes, that would explode by just being in the proximity of the target, and damaging it.
loc.sp_naval_support_ships_desc: Support Ships will help maintain our superiority at sea, by keeping our fleets afloat and effective even during prolonged deployments.
loc.sp_naval_escort_carrier_desc: To safeguard our supply lines, we want to develop smaller, more economical carriers, providing cost-effective air cover and anti-submarine capabilities across oceans.
loc.sp_naval_submarine_carrier_desc: We are looking to develop a new kind of submarine, capable of storing and launching multiple planes, to carry out missions beyond aerial reconnaissance.
loc.sp_naval_cruiser_submarine_unique_reward: The impotence of the London naval treaties have rendered any real restrictions on submarine deck armament moot. The question remains however, whether we should prioritize prestige armaments over tactical range?
loc.sp_naval_fleet_submarine_unique_reward_a: We have to know on what we need to focus our efforts when designing our new type of long-range submarines. Should our submarines be silent and deadly hunters, or do we want for them to be a more reliant and resilient to dangers
loc.sp_naval_nuclear_submarine_unique_reward: As we are working on a completely new type of submarine, there are growing concerns that the ship production costs will ultimately be too high. How should we proceed with the design?
loc.sp_naval_rocket_launching_submarine_uniq: We need to answer a pressing question, what is the best method to ensure our missiles launched from submarines will reach our foes?
loc.sp_naval_nuclear_missile_submarine_uniqu: If the information about our planned nuclear strike would reach our enemies, they would start a massive search for our nuclear missile submarines. In order to escape hunters, we need to...
loc.sp_naval_nuclear_torpedo_unique_reward_a: With the nuclear torpedoes being close to hitting end target of the project, we must aim for...
loc.sp_naval_midget_submarine_unique_reward_: We have realized that we can potentially specialize parts of our midget submarines, though that will have a few trade-offs.
loc.sp_naval_aip_engine_unique_reward_a_desc: Our scientists working on this technology, shared their findings with their colleagues, working on improving more conventional engines. Don't hold your breath yet, as the resulting improvements likely won't be breathtaking.
loc.sp_naval_anechoic_tiles_unique_reward_a_: During the development of anechoic tiles, we realized that we can adapt our findings to conventional submarine construction in order to enhance our stealth capabilities, or save a bit on costs, while maintaining the current levels of visibility
loc.sp_naval_torpedo_cruiser_unique_reward_a: With the reviving of the old concept of a Torpedo Cruiser, we need to make an important decision about its role within our fleet: should we focus on their strength - torpedoes; or should we address their primary weakness - fighting Destroyers?
loc.sp_naval_super_heavy_battleship_unique_r: Designing a new class of battleships allows us the opportunity to focus our efforts on improving our ability to dominate naval battlefield. What should we prioritize?

Our top naval commanders gave us an impossible task, to make this ship neigh invincible - and while we know it to be impossible, we can at least try to make it so. This time, what should be our priority?
loc.sp_naval_modern_battleship_unique_reward: While many are claiming that the age of the battleship is over, we still believe in them. This ship has a chance to become a new hope for us. Which aspect should we focus on in order to make the dream come true?
In order to prove our point, and maintain our position, we will have to withstand enemy strikes. What should we improve in order to be able to strike back at those who dare to stand in our way?
loc.sp_naval_modern_carrier_unique_reward_a_: With the new generation of carriers we could focus on certain aspects of our ship, in order to better suit our needs. Where should we concentrate our efforts?
loc.sp_naval_modern_carrier_unique_reward_b_: Carriers are undisputedly the kings of naval warfare, however we need to provide them with proper protection and security. What should be our main concern?
loc.sp_naval_ice_carrier_unique_reward_a_des: While investing a tremendous amount of time into constructing this gigantic carrier, we need to be sure that we are giving the best protection we could for it. What is our biggest concern?
loc.sp_naval_underway_replenishment_unique_r: While we are still working on making the system of underway replenishments run as smoothly as possible, we have to make one more decision - do we want to alter our original estimations or not?
loc.sp_naval_proximity_fuzes_unique_reward_a: Proximity Fuzes greatly reduce the amount of shells needed to score a hit against enemy aircraft. As we prepare to use them in our mobile anti-air units, we can adjust amount of ammo supplied, while retaining the expected daily 'hit' ratio.
loc.sp_naval_support_ships_unique_reward_a_d: While the value of support ships is not in dispute, we need to decide what their operational focus shall be: focused replenishment of a small number of ships, or generalized topping-up of the whole fleet's stores.
loc.sp_naval_support_ships_unique_reward_b_d: The key question for our repair ship organization: either a larger number of small repair crews, able to service a great number of ships slowly, or a smaller number of more lavishly equipped crews that can repair fewer ships more comprehensively.
loc.sp_naval_submarine_carrier_unique_reward: Our submarine carriers push the limits of naval engineering, and cannot be equally strong in every area. Shall we prioritize range, hull strength, or stealth?
loc.sp_naval_escort_carrier_unique_reward_a_: The escort carrier attempts to cram a lot of capability in to a quite small hull. We need to choose between an emphasis on range, durability, or speed.
loc.sp_naval_escort_carrier_unique_reward_b_: An escort carrier's air group is necessarily limited in size. Shall they specialize in antisubmarine warfare, or spotting surface targets, or adopt a generalized, multi-role approach?

loc.sp_super_heavy_battleship_eq_bonus_light: Super Heavy Battleship - Light Artillery Improvement
