loc.sp_modern_battleship_eq_bonus_anti_torpe: Modern Battleship - Better Torpedo Damage Control
loc.sp_modern_carrier_eq_bonus_detection: Modern Carrier - Increased Detection and Awareness Capability
loc.sp_modern_carrier_eq_bonus_armor: Modern Carrier - Modern Carrier Deck Armor
loc.sp_modern_carrier_eq_bonus_anti_torpedo: Modern Carrier - Increased Torpedo Damage Protection
loc.sp_mega_carrier_eq_bonus_weather: Ice Aircraft Carrier - Increased Resistance to Weather
loc.sp_naval_escort_carrier_eq_bonus_surface: Escort Carrier - Surface Ships Spotting Focus
loc.sp_naval_generic_reward_navy_xp_1: Change in the Flow of Ideas
loc.sp_air_bouncing_bomb_desc: A bomb that can skip and bounce over water surfaces could be the perfect tool to breach dam defenses, and could prove useful in other situations as well.
loc.sp_air_earthshaker_bomb_desc: A heavy bomb that is constructed in such a way that it penetrates the ground before it detonates, causing massive structural damage to the target.
loc.sp_air_intercontinental_bomber_desc: A huge aircraft loaded with bombs and fuel, designed specifically for long-distance high-altitude flying granting it the ability to cross oceans and continents.
loc.sp_air_mothership_aircraft_desc: A massive aircraft that carries fighter planes into battle, enabling deep escort missions into enemy territory—truly the swarm-lord of the skies.
loc.sp_air_jet_engine_desc: Jet engines are far more powerful than propeller engines, potentially revolutionizing aircraft design and sparking a new era of aeronautical engineering.
loc.sp_air_axial_jet_engine_desc: The first jet engines developed can only compress air to a limited degree. It might be possible to line multiple compressors in serial to boost the thrust even further.
loc.sp_air_supersonic_jet_desc: Advancements in jet engine technology are paving the way for aircraft capable of reaching Mach 1 and breaking the sound barrier.
loc.sp_air_helicopter_desc: The development of a helicopter, with its unique ability to hover in place, could offer critical tactical advantage in military operations.
loc.sp_air_scientist_xp_generic_reward_desc: Our Scientists have made several new discoveries during the course of the work with the latest prototype.
loc.sp_air_political_interference_generic_re: Politicians dabbling where they shouldn't have led to the project being forced to redo things that were already done, for reasons that make sense to no-one.
Two steps forward, one step back
loc.sp_air_generic_major_breakthrough_reward: During the last prototype iteration, we managed to make a major breakthrough.
loc.sp_air_generic_aerodynamics_advancements: During our work we have made many findings in the general Aerodynamics field that can benefit our aircraft production.
loc.sp_air_generic_discoveries_reward_desc: During the course of the work, our researchers have come up with a number of ideas that might prove useful in other situations.
loc.sp_air_bouncing_bomb_backspin_mechanism_: Our scientists have come up with an ingenious solution for stabilizing the bomb once dropped. The mechanism starts a backspin, which keeps it on track to the target.
loc.sp_air_bouncing_bomb_training_accidents_: Unfortunately we have lost a few planes when we have tried low altitude approaches. We need to intensify security procedures and training regimen.
loc.sp_air_bouncing_bomb_aircraft_modificati: During the last test run, we finally managed to nail what modifications are needed to the airframe in order for the release mechanism to be properly fitted.
As long as it works now
loc.sp_air_bouncing_bomb_type_of_explosives_: By using Torpex rather than TNT, we can significantly reduce the size of the bomb while keeping the explosive power.
loc.sp_air_earthshaker_bomb_unique_reward_de: During our development process we have realized that we can use our new findings to further enhance our bomb's destructive power. We could focus on improving bomb's precision, or focus on increasing their destructive strength.
loc.sp_air_intercontinental_bomber_unique_re: In order to make sure our bombers will be able to reach across the continents, we need to decide what should we focus on in order to achieve the most satisfactory results.
loc.sp_air_mothership_unique_reward_desc: In order to get peak performance from mothership aircraft, we could try to specialize them and increase their capabilities in certain aspects. Question is - on which aspect should we focus on?
loc.sp_air_jet_engine_unique_reward_desc: We need to make decision, whether we should concentrate our efforts on making the jet engines best suited to our fighters or bombers. We can also try to make them as universal as possible
loc.sp_air_axial_jet_engine_unique_reward_de: It is happening again. It is happening AGAIN. We are once again standing at the dilemma - should we focus on one type of the planes or try to have a more universal solution
loc.sp_air_supersonic_jet_unique_reward_desc: We realized that the potential costs of supersonic jets may be quite staggering. We could try to lower the costs, stay on the current projected costs or we could go all-in, and use the highest quality materials
loc.sp_air_helicopter_unique_reward_desc: This new equipment will be quite exposed to all kinds of danger, making us concerned about it's longevity on the battlefield. We could try to address that by focusing on helicopter...
loc.sp_earthshaker_bomb_both: Earthshaker Project Integration - Precision and Payload
loc.sp_air_mothership_speed_agility: Mothership - Improved Speed and Dogfighting Capability
loc.sp_air_mothership_strength: Mothership - Stronger Frame and Better Armaments
loc.scientist_trait_genius_desc: A visionary mind that pushes the boundaries of science and technology with unparalleled innovation. This is a kind of talent that emerges only once in a generation.
loc.scientist_trait_gifted_engineer_desc: A naturally talented engineer, adept at solving complex technical problems across a variety of fields.
loc.scientist_trait_brilliant_theorist_desc: A master of abstract concepts and theories, able to revolutionize military strategy and scientific research.
loc.scientist_trait_bright_desc: A sharp, quick-thinking scientist who excels at grasping new concepts and applying them efficiently.
loc.scientist_trait_fast_learner_desc: Quickly adapts to new challenges, learning faster than peers and excelling in diverse scientific fields.
loc.scientist_trait_resourceful_desc: Always finds creative solutions, even when resources are scarce or situations are dire.
loc.scientist_trait_schrodingers_trait_desc: Before an observer opens the box, the wave function describing the trait forms a superposition of the states ''good'' and ''bad''
loc.scientist_trait_aircraft_specialist_desc: A specialist in aerodynamics and aircraft design, capable of developing superior airframes, engines, and designs to dominate the skies.
loc.scientist_trait_rocketry_specialist_desc: Specialized in rocket technology, focusing on the principles of propulsion in ballistic and guided rocketry programs.
loc.scientist_trait_electronics_specialist_d: Specialized in communication, radar, and computing systems, essential for modern warfare.
loc.scientist_trait_helicopter_expert_desc: A pioneer in rotary-wing aircraft, specializing in the mechanics of vertical flight, rotor systems, and early helicopter models.
loc.scientist_trait_jet_expert_desc: An authority on jet propulsion, advancing research into early jet engines and their application in military aircraft.
loc.scientist_trait_bombs_expert_desc: Skilled in developing explosive devices and precision bombs that can be used in new refined strategies for aerial bombing.
loc.scientist_trait_guidance_systems_expert_: An expert in the early development of guidance technologies, with experience improving control systems for long-range, unmanned explosive devices.
loc.scientist_trait_armored_specialist_desc: A seasoned engineer specialized on the design and improvement of tanks and other armored vehicles.
loc.scientist_trait_artillery_specialist_des: A specialist in artillery systems with experience in the refinement of long-range firepower and large-caliber guns.
loc.scientist_trait_submarine_specialist_des: A specialist in submarine warfare, focused on the development of new submarines technology to improve their role in stealthy naval operations.
loc.scientist_trait_surface_ship_specialist_: Specialized in the design, development and deployment of large surface warships, as well as the research of new technology to equip military vessels.
loc.scientist_trait_nuclear_specialist_desc: A physicist at the forefront of atomic research, deeply immersed in the study of nuclear fission and chain reactions.
loc.scientist_trait_nuclear_warfare_expert_d: An expert in the practical application of nuclear physics to weapon development, specializing in the theory behind atomic bomb design.
loc.scientist_trait_nuclear_power_expert_des: A leading authority in nuclear physics, versed in the field of nuclear fission with a focus on power generation.
loc.sp_nuclear_project_events.1.desc: Although entirely coincidental, our agents in [FROM.GetNameDef] have managed to acquire information about an apparent secret project. A worker involved in development of a secret weapon, an atomic bomb, spoke about his work at a small social gathering where one of our agents were also attending.
loc.sp_land_generic_reward_scientist_xp_1_de: [Character.GetName] has achieved a breakthrough, accelerating progress and solidifying [Character.GetHerHis] role as a pioneer in advanced weaponry. With each discovery, [Character.GetHerHis] mastery of engineering grows, shaping the future of military technology.
loc.sp_land_generic_reward_option_scientist_: [Character.GetName] achieved a breakthrough, accelerating progress and solidifying [Character.GetHerHis] role as a pioneer in advanced weaponry.
loc.sp_land_generic_reward_army_xp_1_desc: [Character.GetName] has met with a select group of military officers to discuss the potential of the [SpecialProject.GetName], gaining crucial insights into using the new technology for land warfare. Their collaboration has enhanced our military capabilities, ensuring readiness for future engagements.
loc.sp_land_generic_reward_option_army_xp_de: [Character.GetName] met with a select group of military officers to discuss the potential of the [SpecialProject.GetName], gaining crucial insights into using the new technology for land warfare. Their collaboration enhanced our military capabilities, ensuring readiness for future engagements.
loc.sp_land_generic_reward_major_progress_1_: [Character.GetName] has achieved a major breakthrough, propelling the project significantly forward, validating [Character.GetHerHis] expertise and energizing the research team. With this progress, the project moves closer to its goal, cementing [Character.GetName]'s legacy as a trailblazer.
loc.sp_land_generic_reward_option_major_brea: [Character.GetName] achieved a major breakthrough, propelling the project significantly forward, validating [Character.GetHerHis] expertise and energizing the research team. With this progress, the project moved closer to its goal, cementing [Character.GetName]'s legacy as a trailblazer.
loc.sp_land_generic_reward_test_failure_1_de: A minor setback has occurred during testing, revealing unexpected flaws in [Character.GetName]'s prototype. This hiccup prompts a reevaluation of the approach and refinement of techniques. While temporarily delaying progress, these lessons learned contribute to a stronger and more resilient project in the long run.
loc.sp_land_generic_reward_option_test_failu: A minor setback occurred during testing, revealing unexpected flaws in [Character.GetName]'s prototype. This hiccup prompted a reevaluation of the approach and refinement of techniques. While temporarily delaying progress, these lessons learned contributed to a stronger and more resilient project in the long run.
loc.sp_land_generic_reward_armor_tech_1_desc: Recent developments in the [SpecialProject.GetName] project, led by [Character.GetName], have enabled significant advancements in related fields. These breakthroughs are revolutionizing military capabilities, paving the way for more effective and formidable land warfare strategies.
loc.sp_land_generic_reward_option_armor_tech: Recent developments in the [SpecialProject.GetName] project, led by [Character.GetName], enabled significant advancements in related fields. These breakthroughs revolutionized military capabilities, paving the way for more effective and formidable land warfare strategies.
loc.sp_land_generic_reward_armor_bonus_1_des: Spearheading cutting-edge research, [Character.GetName] unveils groundbreaking discoveries in new alloys set to revolutionize tank armor. These findings promise significant advancements in armored warfare, showcasing the scientist's pivotal role in shaping the future of armored warfare.
loc.sp_land_generic_reward_option_armor_bonu: Integrate this new alloy into our production lines.
loc.sp_land_generic_reward_engine_bonus_1_de: The latest tweaks on the experimental engine for the [SpecialProject.GetName] prototype have resulted in a significant improvement in tank engine performance overall. The meticulous work of [Character.GetName] and [Character.GetHerHis] team has pushed the boundaries of engineering, promising enhanced capabilities if we apply these innovations into our regular tank engines.
loc.sp_land_generic_reward_resource_scarcity: [Character.GetName]'s team is facing shortages of critical materials for the development of the [SpecialProject.GetName] project, forcing [Character.GetHerHim] to find alternative sources and to develop new manufacturing methods to meet the demands.
loc.sp_land_generic_reward_option_resource_s: [Character.GetName]'s team faced shortages of critical materials for the development of the [SpecialProject.GetName] project, forcing [Character.GetHerHim] to find alternative sources and to develop new manufacturing methods to meet the demands.
loc.sp_land_reward_multi_charge_large_calibe: The [SpecialProject.GetName] cannon has just successfully completed a milestone test firing, demonstrating its impressive range and accuracy. This achievement has boosted morale among the research team and garnered attention from high-ranking officials, providing momentum for the project and renewed optimism for its success.
loc.sp_land_reward_option_multi_charge_large: The [SpecialProject.GetName] cannon successfully completed a milestone test firing, demonstrating its impressive range and accuracy. This achievement boosted morale among the research team and garnered attention from high-ranking officials, providing momentum for the project and renewed optimism for its success.
loc.sp_land_reward_multi_charge_large_calibe: During a crucial test trial, a catastrophic explosion rocked the testing site, blowing up the cannon and causing significant damage to nearby infrastructure. [Character.GetName]'s team is investigating the cause of the explosion and managing the fallout from the incident, including public scrutiny and potential setbacks in the project timeline.
loc.sp_land_reward_option_multi_charge_large: During a crucial test trial, a catastrophic explosion rocked the testing site, blowing up the cannon and causing significant damage to nearby infrastructure. [Character.GetName]'s team had to investigate the cause of the explosion and manage the fallout from the incident, including public scrutiny and potential setbacks in the project timeline.
loc.sp_land_reward_multi_charge_large_calibe: [Character.GetName] has made an important breakthrough in propulsion technology, significantly increasing the velocity and power of the [SpecialProject.GetName]'s projectiles. This advancement opens up new possibilities for the weapon's effectiveness on the battlefield and accelerates progress towards completing the project.

loc.STATE_NOT_OCCUPIED: §RYou need to occupy $STATE|H$ to set an occupation policy for it§!

loc.STAT_COMMON_MAX_ORG_DESC: Organization indicates combat readiness and how organized a unit is. A unit with no organization can't fight or move effectively.
loc.STAT_ARMY_DEFAULT_MORALE_DESC: How much extra organization can be regained hourly when not in combat.
loc.STAT_ARMY_DEFENSE_DESC: How many enemy attacks a unit can attempt to avoid while on the defensive, effectively allowing it to hold the line longer.
loc.STAT_ARMY_COLLATERAL_DESC: How much damage this unit causes to infrastructure and forts.
loc.STAT_ARMY_BREAKTHROUGH_DESC: How many enemy attacks a unit can attempt to avoid while on the offensive, effectively allowing it to stay on the offense longer.
loc.STAT_ARMY_HARDNESS_DESC: §T§HHardness§! represents how much of your §HDivision§! is made up of armored or at least protected vehicles.\n\nWhen attacked, a Division adds together all Soft Attacks and Hard Attacks. A Division with high §HHardness§! will suffer fewer §HSoft Attacks§! and more §HHard Attacks§! - and vice versa.§!
loc.STAT_ARMY_SOFT_ATTACK_DESC: How many attacks the unit can make versus enemies with low hardness.
loc.STAT_ARMY_HARD_ATTACK_DESC: How many attacks the unit can make versus enemies with high hardness.
loc.STAT_ARMY_RECON_DESC: The ability to scout ahead and anticipate the enemy. Increases the chance that this unit can pick better tactics in battle and increases the amount of intel gathering from that combat.
loc.STAT_ARMY_ENTRENCHMENT_DESC: The ability to make proper defensive entrenchments before a hostile attack.
loc.STAT_ARMY_FUEL_CONSUMPTION_DESC: How much fuel this unit uses daily.
loc.STAT_ARMY_SUPPLY_CONSUMPTION_DESC: How much supply a unit consumes per day.
loc.STAT_ARMY_SUPPLY_CONSUMPTION_FACTOR_DESC: How much supply a unit consumes per day
loc.STAT_ARMY_CASUALTY_TRICKLEBACK_DESC: The proportion of losses in combat that can be saved and returned to the manpower pool. Saved Casualties will not impact the war support penalty from casualties and damage.
loc.STAT_ARMY_EXPERIENCE_LOSS_FACTOR_DESC: How much experience is lost in a division when they take casualties and have to replace them.
loc.STAT_NAVY_TRANSPORT_CAPABILITY_DESC: How many divisions can be transported.
loc.STAT_NAVY_CARRIER_SUB_DETECTION_DESC: Ability to detect submarines provided by carrier planes.
loc.STAT_NAVY_CARRIER_SURFACE_DETECTION_DESC: Ability to detect surface ships provided by carrier planes.
loc.STAT_NAVY_SURFACE_VISIBILITY_DESC: How hard to find this ship is.
loc.STAT_NAVY_SUB_VISIBILITY_DESC: How easy to detect a submarine is.
loc.STAT_NAVY_SHORE_BOMBARDMENT_DESC: A unit's ability to do shore bombardment to help out in land battles neighboring its sea province when on Hold mission.
loc.STAT_NAVY_MISSION_COVERAGE_DESC: §THow efficient the ship is at spotting enemies. Each ship adds its spotting efficiency.§!
loc.STAT_NAVY_FIRE_RANGE_DESC: The range of a ship's main guns.
loc.STAT_NAVY_EVASION_DESC: Ability for ships to evade enemy fire through maneuvering. When evaluating chances to avoid being hit the target's evasion value is compared to the attacker, so if you have high evasion you will also be better able to hit evasive targets.
loc.STAT_NAVY_TORPEDO_ATTACK_DESC: How much damage we can do when using the ship's torpedoes.
loc.STAT_NAVY_TORPEDO_HIT_CHANCE_DESC: How likely our torpedoes are to hit.
loc.STAT_NAVY_LIGHT_GUN_HIT_CHANCE_DESC: How likely our light batteries are to hit.
loc.STAT_NAVY_HEAVY_GUN_HIT_CHANCE_DESC: How likely our heavy batteries are to hit.
loc.STAT_NAVY_TORPEDO_ENEMY_CRIT_CHANCE_DESC: How likely enemy torpedoes are to strike critical hits.
loc.STAT_NAVY_SUB_ATTACK_DESC: How much damage we can do to the enemy submarines with depth charges.
loc.STAT_NAVY_ATTACK_DESC: The size of the holes we can punch through enemy ships.
loc.STAT_NAVY_ANTI_AIR_ATTACK_DESC: How much anti-air firepower the ship carries for shooting down enemy planes.
loc.STAT_NAVY_ANTI_AIR_TARGETTING_DESC: How well the ship can track enemy planes to shoot them down.
loc.STAT_NAVY_PORT_CAPACITY_USAGE_DESC: How much room the ship requires in a port.
loc.STAT_AIR_RANGE_DESC: How far away missions the plane can perform.
loc.STAT_AIR_DEFENCE_DESC: How many hits a plane can take before being shot down.
loc.STAT_AIR_ATTACK_DESC: How much damage we can do against airplanes. High Air Attack also helps to counter enemy Air Superiority effects.
loc.STAT_AIR_AGILITY_DESC: How agile a plane is. Agility affects how easy it is to hit another plane, and how easily it can avoid being hit.
loc.STAT_AIR_SUPERIORITY_DESC: How much the plane helps the overall air superiority of a strategic area.
loc.STAT_AIR_NAVAL_STRIKE_ATTACK_DESC: How much damage the plane inflicts upon hitting a ship.
loc.STAT_AIR_NAVAL_STRIKE_TARGETTING_DESC: How likely the plane is to hit a ship.
loc.STAT_AIR_GROUND_ATTACK_DESC: How much damage the plane can do to enemy divisions on the ground when helping out in combat.
loc.STAT_COMMON_MAX_STRENGTH_DESC: Strength represents how much damage this unit can suffer before it is destroyed.
loc.STAT_COMMON_BUILD_COST_IC_DESC: §THow much Factory Output a piece of equipment needs. §H1§! factory has a Factory Output of $SPEED|H$ per day.§!
loc.STAT_COMMON_MAXIMUM_SPEED_DESC: How quickly this unit can traverse terrain under optimal circumstances.
loc.STAT_COMMON_MAXIMUM_SPEED_AIR_DESC: How quickly this unit can fly under optimal circumstances.
loc.STAT_NAVY_MAXIMUM_SPEED_DESC: A faster ship has an easier time disengaging from pursuers when attempting to retreat from combat. It is also less likely to be hit by enemy fire, can pursue contacts easier when spotting the enemy, and moves faster outside of battle.
loc.STAT_NAVY_RANGE_DESC: A ship's range represents its onboard stores of fuel and foodstuffs, which limit how far it can travel from the nearest friendly Naval Base.
loc.STAT_COMMON_ARMOR_DESC: Having §HArmor§! that is higher than the opponents §HPiercing§! value makes you take less damage and also makes it possible to perform more attacks in combat as the unit has more freedom of movement.
loc.STAT_COMMON_ARMOR_TRAIN_DESC: §HArmor§! increases the amount of damage that can be taken by enemy logistics strikes before this train is destroyed.
loc.STAT_COMMON_PIERCING_DESC: Having equal or greater §HPiercing§! to the targets §HArmor§! value allow you to do more damage and more effectively pin down their armored forces
loc.STAT_RANGE_DESC: Maximum distance this unit can travel.
loc.STAT_CARRIER_SIZE_DESC: How many planes a carrier can fit on board.
loc.STAT_SUB_CARRIER_SIZE_DESC: How many planes a submarine carrier can fit on board.
loc.STAT_COMMON_ACCLIMATIZATION_HOT_GAIN_DES: The speed at which a unit acclimatizes in a warm climate.
loc.STAT_COMMON_ACCLIMATIZATION_COLD_GAIN_DE: The speed at which a unit acclimatizes in a cold climate.
loc.STAT_AIR_BOMBING_DESC: How good a plane is at strategic bombing.
loc.COMBAT_WIDTH_DESC: The size of the fighting unit. A unit needs to be able to fit into the total §HCombat Width§! of a battle to contribute to it.
loc.STAT_ARMY_INITIATIVE_DESC: The higher the Initiative a unit has, the quicker it can reinforce into a battle, and the quicker it gets its planning done. Initiative also multiplies any Coordination modifiers you may have.
loc.STAT_ARMY_RECOVERY_DESC: The higher the Recovery a unit has, the more equipment is can salvage in the field.
loc.STAT_ARMY_ADDITIONAL_COLLATERAL_DAMAGE_D: The higher the extra collateral damage a unit has, the more damage it will do to fortifications and infrastructure.
loc.STAT_COMMON_RELIABILITY_DESC: The lower the value the more likely the equipment is of suffering random failure, accidents or exploding in a fiery ball of death when lightly bumped. Reliability has no effect above 100%.
loc.STAT_COMMON_RELIABILITY_FACTOR_DESC: An extra reliability bonus from support companies. This bonus is applied to an equipment type's reliability and reduces the chance of breakdowns and accidents.
loc.STAT_COMMON_WEIGHT_DESC: How much the unit will weigh. Heavier units will require more transports to ship and perform invasions effectively.
loc.STAT_COMMON_THRUST_DESC: Thrust represents the ability of the engine to propel the airplane. Any Thrust exceeding Weight adds extra Speed.
loc.STAT_CASUALTY_TRICKLEBACK_DESC: What percentage of manpower makes it back to the manpower pool after being wounded in combat. These casualties will not impact the war support penalty from casualties and damage.
loc.STAT_NAVY_AMPHIBIOUS_DEFENSE_DESC: Extra defense given to units while doing amphibious invasions.
loc.STAT_NAVY_MINES_PLANTING_DESC: Efficiency in laying the sea mines.
loc.STAT_NAVY_MINES_SWEEPING_DESC: Efficiency in finding and neutralizing the sea mines.
loc.STAT_NAVY_RAIDING_COORDINATION_DESC: How quickly the fleet can gather when a target is found while Convoy Raiding.
loc.STAT_NAVY_PATROL_COORDINATION_DESC: How quickly the fleet can gather when something happens during a Patrol mission.
loc.STAT_NAVY_SEARCH_AND_DESTROY_COORDINATIO: How quickly the fleet can gather when a target is found during Search & Destroy missions.
loc.STAT_MISSION_CONVOY_ESCORT_EFFICIENCY_DE: How quickly Escorts can defend a Convoy under attack.
loc.STAT_NAVY_WEATHER_PENALTY_DESC: How much this ship reduces the effect of weather based modifiers.
loc.STAT_ARMY_EQUIPMENT_CAPTURE_FACTOR_DESC: Percentage of the equipment that will be captured from enemy losses.
loc.STAT_ARMY_FUEL_CAPACITY_DESC: How much fuel this unit can store. Higher fuel capacity means that the unit will be able to operate at full capacity longer when it lacks the fuel supply.
loc.STAT_COMMON_FUEL_CONSUMPTION_DESC: How much fuel this unit uses while it is operating. Air and Sea units will consume fuel while on active missions or during training. Land units with fuel consumption will consume fuel in idle as well, but the combat, movement or training will further increase the consumption.
loc.STAT_COMMON_FUEL_CONSUMPTION_FACTOR_DESC: How much fuel this unit uses while it is operating. Air and Sea units will consume fuel while on active missions or during training. Land units with fuel consumption will consume fuel in idle as well, but the combat, movement or training will further increase the consumption.
loc.STAT_NAVY_LG_ATTACK_DESC: Damage done by light guns. Light guns are better at targeting smaller ships.
loc.STAT_NAVY_LG_ARMOR_PIERCING_DESC: Armor piercing of the light guns.
loc.STAT_NAVY_HG_ATTACK_DESC: Damage done by the heavy guns. Heavy guns are better at targeting bigger ships.
loc.STAT_NAVY_HG_ARMOR_PIERCING_DESC: Armor piercing of the heavy guns.
loc.STAT_RAILWAY_GUN_ATTACK_DESC: Bombardment support reduces the penalty incurred from forts, and opposing unit's entrenchment bonus and combat effectiveness.\n\n$STAT_RAILWAY_GUN_ATTACK_DERIVED_MODIFIERS$
loc.RAILWAY_GUN_BOMBARDMENT_FORT_MODIFIER_DE: Effectiveness: $FORTS|=-%1$\n\nBombardment support reduces the magnitude of the penalty incurred from forts.
loc.STAT_RAILWAY_GUN_ATTACK_RANGE_DESC: The maximum distance at which the unit can provide bombardment support.
loc.STAT_RAILWAY_GUN_ANNEX_RATIO_DESC: How many railway guns will be transferred on annexation
loc.STAT_RAILWAY_GUN_HOURS_TO_REDISTRIBUTE_D: Number of hours before a railway gun can move after firing
loc.STAT_NAVY_HIT_PROFILE_DESC: Value based on the ship visibility and speed, which determines what is the unmodified chance to be hit by the following attack types:
loc.SUB_MESSAGE_sub_promo_1_DESC:
Get all DLC ever released for Hearts of Iron IV
for a recurring payment.

You can cancel the subscription at any time.
loc.SUB_MESSAGE_sub_promo_3_TITLE: Get 6 months of access to all DLC
loc.SUB_MESSAGE_sub_promo_3_DESC: Get all DLC ever released for Hearts of Iron IV for a recurring payment every sixth month.\n\nYou can cancel the subscription at any time.
loc.SUB_MESSAGE_POPUP_DLC: All DLC included!\nAccess all expansions, country packs, and unit models immediately. You will also get all new DLC on the day of their release.
loc.SUBSCRIPTION_WIDGET: Subscribe and get access to all DLC!
loc.SUBSCRIPTION_RESTART_DESCRIPTION: You can download and install all DLC in Steam. The game needs to be restarted for the new DLC to be available.
loc.PLAYTHROUGH_STATS_LOCKED: Not available in the observer mode
loc.DLC_DESCRIPTION_dlc018: New national focus trees and events for Canada, Australia, New Zealand, The Raj (India), and South Africa. A Spearhead battleplan command allowing more control over grand encirclements and punching through enemy lines.
loc.DLC_DESCRIPTION_dlc020: Four New Focus Trees: Experience the war from the difficult perspectives of Hungary, Romania, Czechoslovakia, and Yugoslavia.
loc.DLC_DESCRIPTION_dlc022: Modified Focus Trees for Germany and Japan: Two major Axis powers now have alternate history paths, including the chance to depose Hitler or install Communism or Democracy in Japan.
loc.DLC_DESCRIPTION_dlc023: Get new ship designs, traits, and skills for admirals, amphibious vehicles, use naval mines to protects your seas and ship routes to avoid dangers. Includes new focus trees for The Netherlands, United Kingdom, Mexico and USA.
loc.DLC_DESCRIPTION_dlc028: La Résistance adds secret agents, espionage missions, and new options for resistance movements. Send agents into dangerous territory to decipher enemy secrets or prepare the ground for your invasion by propping up collaborators who will be happy for any taste of power.
loc.DLC_DESCRIPTION_dlc031: Adds dedicated national focus trees to the minor powers around the Black Sea and the Aegean. Bulgaria, Greece and Turkey can each chart unique historical and alternate history paths as they resist efforts by the major powers to dominate the strategic sea-lanes of the Bosporus and Dardanelles.
loc.DLC_DESCRIPTION_dlc034: No Step Back adds greater detail for many nations in Eastern Europe, unique game systems to reflect Soviet politics, and many improvements to the military aspect of the game.
loc.DLC_DESCRIPTION_dlc036: Build a new empire, resist foreign aggression or explore the limits of neutrality. By Blood Alone adds new alternate history options and gameplay variety for Italy, Ethiopia and Switzerland, as well as other significant changes.
loc.DLC_DESCRIPTION_dlc038: Write thrilling new histories of the Nordic countries as the major powers of Europe fight for the future of the world. New National Focus trees for Finland, Sweden, Denmark and Norway take center stage. Specialize your arms industry to emphasize efficiency and then sell these weapons on the new International Market.
loc.DLC_DESCRIPTION_dlc040: Trial of Allegiance adds extensive focus trees for Brazil, Argentina, Chile, Uruguay and Paraguay. The stability of an entire continent balances on a knife-edge. Open a new front in the war as you court European benefactors with your most precious commodity: your allegiance.
loc.DLC_DESCRIPTION_dlc043: Develop prototype technology and weapons to deploy against your enemies. Execute raids to destroy your enemies research facilities, dams and landmarks. New and updated focus trees allow you to use the Inner Circle of Germany to reach your goals, recreate the Habsburg empire as Austria or Hungary, and explore the dynamics of Belgium and its colony the Belgian Congo.
loc.DLC_DESCRIPTION_dlc046: Graveyard of Empires introduces unique focus trees to Iran, the Raj, Iraq and Afghanistan. Curtail the influence of meddling external powers and resurrect the fallen pride of your nation as you strive to dominate the Middle-East and South Asia.
loc.DLC_DESCRIPTION_dlc049: Mould new paths in history for Japan, China and the Philippines in No Compromise, No Surrender, an Expansion for Hearts of Iron IV. Seize a greater depth of control over factions, forge new military doctrines and decide the fate of the Pacific and beyond.
loc.DLC_DESCRIPTION_dlc051: Recreate the Kingdom of Bohemia, form a union of Central European states, protect yourself with fortifications or form a network of allies with Peace for Our Time's new focus tree for Czechoslovakia.
loc.DLC_DESCRIPTION_dlc052: Step into the heart of command by deploying your generals to the front lines and give medals to your most successful ship captains. Roll back the Japanese invasion across south east asia as Australia; carve out a new empire as Siam; and decide on the future of Indonesia, with or without Dutch rule.
loc.TACTIC_DESC: Each side's leader will pick a tactic for the battle that will affect how it unfolds. A leader with higher skill or more advanced reconnaissance has a higher chance of picking a counter tactic that negates their opponent's.
loc.MODULE_ALLOWED_ROLE_IS_FORBIDDEN_BY_ANOT: The role $ROLE|H$ is £trigger_yes£ by module $ALLOWING_MODULE|H$ but is £trigger_no£ by module $FORBIDDING_MODULE|H$.\n\n
loc.tank_gasoline_engine_desc: An Engine running on gasoline will be faster for a given Engine Size, but the fuel will be much more prone to catching fire.
loc.tank_diesel_engine_desc: An Engine running on Diesel fuel is more reliable than a gasoline engine, but not as fast for the same Engine Size.
loc.tank_petrol_electric_engine_desc: A combination of a petrol-driven engine providing power to an electric motor. Complex, expensive and unreliable, it does however offer unmatched performance in tactical movements.
loc.tank_gas_turbine_engine_desc: A turbine developed from jet engines. High fuel consumption, but the highest speed of any engine at a given Engine Size.
loc.tank_riveted_armor_desc: Armor Plates bolted to the frame and held together by rivets driven into the edges. A very proven technology that is fairly cheap, but the rivetted edges provide weakpoints in the armor and might hurt the crew if the rivets are hit.
loc.tank_cast_armor_desc: The entire Chassis, including armor, is cast as a single unit. An expensive and time-consuming process that allows for much thicker armor with fewer weakpoints.
loc.tank_welded_armor_desc: Armor plates are welded to the chassis. A faster process than casting, while still providing good protection.
loc.NOR_tank_rikstanken_armor_desc: Made out of sheets of iron instead of steel to save money. Better than no armor... Probably.
loc.tank_torsion_bar_suspension_desc: A fairly reliable suspension system of metal bars fixed to the vehicle chassis that provides a smoother ride than other suspension types.
loc.tank_christie_suspension_desc: Developed by an American inventor, this suspension allows for exceptionally high speeds.
loc.tank_bogie_suspension_desc: A simple and fairly cheap type of suspension in which the roadwheels are mounted individually, allowing them to be easily replaced if damaged.
loc.tank_interleaved_suspension_desc: By overlapping the roadwheels, more of them can be fit in the same length of the hull, thereby improving mobility as well as providing some additional protection in the flanks.
loc.tank_light_one_man_tank_turret_desc: A small turret barely large enough to hold a single crew member, who is tasked with aiming and loading the main armament as well as keeping watch for targets and threats.
loc.tank_light_two_man_tank_turret_desc: A turret that allows for two crew members to share the work of operating the armament and observing the situation. It still does not allow for an effective division of labor amongst the crew.
loc.tank_light_three_man_tank_turret_desc: A turret big enough for the three crew members to divide the tasks of loading and aiming the main armament as well as staying aware of the situation around them.
loc.tank_light_fixed_superstructure_turret_d: A fixed superstructure only allows the main armament to traverse in a small arc without turning the entire vehicle. However, it allows the vehicle to mount a bigger armament while being overall of smaller size, making the vehicle perfect for ambushes.
loc.tank_medium_one_man_tank_turret_desc: A small turret barely large enough to hold a single crew member, who is tasked with aiming and loading the main armament as well as keeping watch for targets and threats.
loc.tank_medium_two_man_tank_turret_desc: A turret that allows for two crew members to share the work of operating the armament and observing the situation. It still does not allow for an effective division of labor amongst the crew.
loc.tank_medium_three_man_tank_turret_desc: A turret big enough for the three crew members to divide the tasks of loading and aiming the main armament as well as staying aware of the situation around them.
loc.tank_medium_fixed_superstructure_turret_: A fixed superstructure only allows the main armament to traverse in a small arc without turning the entire vehicle. However, it allows the vehicle to mount a bigger armament while being overall of smaller size, making the vehicle perfect for ambushes.
loc.tank_heavy_two_man_tank_turret_desc: A turret that allows for two crew members to share the work of operating the armament and observing the situation. It still does not allow for an effective division of labor amongst the crew.
loc.tank_heavy_three_man_tank_turret_desc: A turret big enough for the three crew members to divide the tasks of loading and aiming the main armament as well as staying aware of the situation around them.
loc.tank_heavy_fixed_superstructure_turret_d: A fixed superstructure only allows the main armament to traverse in a small arc without turning the entire vehicle. However, it allows the vehicle to mount a bigger armament while being overall of smaller size, making the vehicle perfect for ambushes.
loc.tank_super_heavy_four_man_tank_turret_de: A massive turret with additional space for a second loader to service the main gun.
loc.tank_super_heavy_three_man_tank_turret_d: A turret big enough for the three crew members to divide the tasks of loading and aiming the main armament as well as staying aware of the situation around them.
loc.tank_modern_tank_turret_desc: A well-laid out turret allows three crew members to efficiently operate the main armament and keep track of their surroundings.
loc.tank_heavy_machine_gun_desc: A machine gun provides decent anti-infantry capability for a low cost. Even with special armor-piercing ammunition, its anti-armor performance leaves a lot to be desired.
loc.flamethrower_desc: Developing flamethrower will allow our troops to be more effective in urban warfare and against fortress. But running with a tank full of fuel on your back and ready to explode can have catastrophic consequences.
loc.advanced_flamethrower_desc: Enhanced flamethrower systems, ideal for clearing fortified positions and inflicting devastating damage in close-quarters combat.
loc.tank_auto_cannon_desc: Adapted from a fast-firing anti-air gun, this automatic cannon can lay down a hail of fire that is devastating to soft targets. The small caliber does limit its anti-armor performance.
loc.tank_auto_cannon_2_desc: Adapted from a fast-firing anti-air gun, this automatic cannon can lay down a hail of fire that is devastating to soft targets. The small caliber does limit its anti-armor performance.
loc.tank_anti_air_cannon_desc: A fast-firing automatic gun designed to engage aircraft. It has limited potential as a fire-support weapon against ground targets.
loc.tank_anti_air_cannon_2_desc: A fast-firing automatic gun designed to engage aircraft. It has limited potential as a fire-support weapon against ground targets.
loc.tank_anti_air_cannon_3_desc: A fast-firing automatic gun designed to engage aircraft. It has limited potential as a fire-support weapon against ground targets.
loc.tank_medium_howitzer_desc: A medium field howitzer adapted to be mounted in a vehicle. Its primary purpose is indirect fire support against soft targets, but it can be fired directly at a target if necessary. Carrying only a small amount of armor-piercing ammunition, it is ill-suited for anti-tank work.
loc.tank_medium_howitzer_2_desc: A medium field howitzer adapted to be mounted in a vehicle. Its primary purpose is indirect fire support against soft targets, but it can be fired directly at a target if necessary. Carrying only a small amount of armor-piercing ammunition, it is ill-suited for anti-tank work.
loc.tank_heavy_howitzer_desc: A heavy field howitzer adapted to be mounted in a vehicle. Its primary purpose is indirect fire support against soft targets, but it can be fired directly at a target if necessary. Carrying only a small amount of armor-piercing ammunition, it is ill-suited for anti-tank work.
loc.tank_small_cannon_desc: A small and cheap cannon, able to fire both anti-infantry and anti-armor rounds. Its small caliber limits its usefulness.
loc.tank_small_cannon_2_desc: A small and cheap cannon, able to fire both anti-infantry and anti-armor rounds. Its small caliber limits its usefulness.
loc.tank_medium_cannon_desc: A general-purpose weapon well suited to a wide variety of tasks. It excels at neither anti-infantry nor anti-tank work, but it provides a vehicle with a lot of flexibility.
loc.tank_medium_cannon_2_desc: A general-purpose weapon well suited to a wide variety of tasks. It excels at neither anti-infantry nor anti-tank work, but it provides a vehicle with a lot of flexibility.
loc.tank_high_velocity_cannon_desc: A cannon specifically designed to achieve a high muzzle velocity. Using specialized ammunition, it has superb anti-armor characteristics, but its performance against soft targets suffers.
loc.tank_high_velocity_cannon_2_desc: A cannon specifically designed to achieve a high muzzle velocity. Using specialized ammunition, it has superb anti-armor characteristics, but its performance against soft targets suffers.
loc.tank_high_velocity_cannon_3_desc: A cannon specifically designed to achieve a high muzzle velocity. Using specialized ammunition, it has superb anti-armor characteristics, but its performance against soft targets suffers.
loc.tank_heavy_cannon_desc: A weapon that can fire a large shell. With exceptional armor penetration and decent performance against soft targets, its biggest drawbacks are the sheer size and cost, which make it too unwieldy to be mounted in most vehicles not specifically designed to carry it.
loc.tank_heavy_cannon_2_desc: A weapon that can fire a large shell. With exceptional armor penetration and decent performance against soft targets, its biggest drawbacks are the sheer size and cost, which make it too unwieldy to be mounted in most vehicles not specifically designed to carry it.
loc.tank_heavy_cannon_3_desc: A weapon that can fire a large shell. With exceptional armor penetration and decent performance against soft targets, its biggest drawbacks are the sheer size and cost, which make it too unwieldy to be mounted in most vehicles not specifically designed to carry it.
loc.tank_super_heavy_cannon_desc: An absurdly large weapon with unmatched performance. There are very few things that this weapon can not destroy, and none of them have any business shooting at a tank.
loc.NOR_rikstanken_turret_desc: It houses the gun, and can rotate. When it wants to.
loc.tank_close_support_gun_desc: A small weapon designed to fire high-explosive shells against enemy field fortifications to help the infantry on the attack. While capable of engaging tanks, its short barrel and limited ammunition make it unable to deal with more powerful enemy tanks.
loc.tank_radio_1_desc: A basic two-way radio allows tanks to coordinate their tactical maneuvers on a small scale.
loc.tank_radio_2_desc: An improved radio allows commanders effective control over larger formations of tanks, permitting large-scale operational maneuvers.
loc.tank_radio_3_desc: With a more powerful transmitter and better reception, this radio allows communications over dozens of kilometers and in the face of enemy jamming.
loc.amphibious_drive_desc: A set of floatation devices and a small screw allow this tank to quickly be rigged to traverse water, either from ship to shore or across a river.
loc.secondary_turret_hmg_desc: A heavy machine gun in a secondary turret. The placement of the turret limits its arc of fire, lowering the gun's overall effectiveness, but it does allow the tank to engage more targets. This is particularly useful when on the attack.
loc.secondary_turret_small_cannon_desc: A small cannon in a secondary turret. The placement of the turret limits its arc of fire, lowering the gun's overall effectiveness, but it does allow the tank to engage more targets. This is particularly useful when on the attack.
loc.secondary_turret_close_support_gun_desc: A close support gun in a secondary turret. The placement of the turret limits its arc of fire, lowering the gun's overall effectiveness, but it does allow the tank to engage more targets. This is particularly useful when on the attack.
loc.sloped_armor_desc: Armor placed at an angle to an incoming shell has a much greater effective thickness than the same amount of armor placed vertically. It also increases the chance that the shell will simply bounce off harmlessly. However, it requires the entire tank to be designed around it, making the vehicle more difficult to assemble.
loc.stabilizer_desc: A mechanical device to keep the gun pointing in the same direction when the tank is moving. While not advanced enough to allow accurate firing on the move, it does allow the gunner to fire accurately during a short stop, without having to re-acquire the target.
loc.smoke_launchers_desc: A battery of pyrotechnic devices that can be triggered from inside the tank to create a thick cloud of smoke to hide the tank. Very useful when on the defensive or after driving into an ambush.
loc.extra_ammo_storage_desc: Additional racks of ready ammunition allow the tank to stay in the fight much longer without resupply. However, if the armor is penetrated, the results are likely to be catastrophic. This is particularly problematic when attacking.
loc.wet_ammo_storage_desc: Water jackets added to ammunition racks dramatically reduce the risk of the ammunition exploding after the tank is hit, which is greatly appreciated by the crews.
loc.armor_tech_1_tt: Enables Armor Upgrade values of 5 and above.
loc.armor_tech_2_tt: Enables Armor Upgrade values of 10 and above.
loc.armor_tech_3_tt: Enables Armor Upgrade values of 15 and above.
loc.armor_tech_4_tt: Enables Armor Upgrade values of 18 and above.
loc.engine_tech_1_tt: Enables Engine Upgrade values of 5 and above.
loc.engine_tech_2_tt: Enables Engine Upgrade values of 10 and above.
loc.engine_tech_3_tt: Enables Engine Upgrade values of 15 and above.
loc.engine_tech_4_tt: Enables Engine Upgrade values of 18 and above.
loc.light_tank_chassis_desc: A small and compact chassis, ideal for a cheap and light vehicle for duties such as reconnaissance and fire support. Its limited load capacity makes it unsuited for carrying heavy armor or large guns.
loc.basic_light_tank_chassis_desc: Technological advances have made the designs of the immediate post-war period effectively obsolete. The modern battlefield requires a new, clean design incorporating advances in metallurgy and interior layout.
loc.improved_light_tank_chassis_desc: A further iteration based on the experiences gained with previous light tanks, this chassis allows for better reliability and maintenance.
loc.advanced_light_tank_chassis_desc: With medium tanks increasingly taking center stage in the fight, light tanks have largely been relegated to supporting roles. A new chassis design is needed that takes the needs of these roles into account.
loc.light_tank_artillery_chassis_desc: A small and compact vehicle, primarily for fire support of advancing infantry.
loc.light_tank_destroyer_chassis_desc: A small and compact vehicle, carrying a powerful gun to destroy enemy armor.
loc.light_tank_aa_chassis_desc: A small and compact vehicle, carrying an anti-air gun to defend against enemy planes.
loc.basic_medium_tank_chassis_desc: While light tanks have formed the backbone of mechanized formations in past years, it is becoming clear that their growth potential is nearly exhausted. In the future, we will need a bigger vehicle, which still retains a high level of mobility.
loc.improved_medium_tank_chassis_desc: Building on the experiences of previous generation of medium tanks, it is clear that a new design with greater carrying capacity is needed to stay relevant.
loc.advanced_medium_tank_chassis_desc: The rapid growth of weight in weapon systems and armor strength requires an even bigger chassis, creating a vehicle the size of earlier heavy tanks.
loc.medium_tank_chassis_desc: A balanced, mid-sized chassis that offers a lot flexibility for building a wide variety of vehicles.
loc.medium_tank_artillery_chassis_desc: A well-balanced vehicle, primarily for fire support of advancing infantry.
loc.medium_tank_destroyer_chassis_desc: A well-balanced vehicle, carrying a powerful gun to destroy enemy armor.
loc.medium_tank_aa_chassis_desc: A well-balanced vehicle, carrying an anti-air gun to defend against enemy planes.
loc.basic_heavy_tank_chassis_desc: A thorough analysis of the Great War has shown that there is a need for a heavy vehicle to break through the enemy trench line and open up the way for lighter forces to exploit the breakthrough. Such a vehicle should heavily armed and well armored, but doesn't have to be very fast.
loc.improved_heavy_tank_chassis_desc: While the nature of warfare has changed, there is still a place for a heavy vehicle with thick armor to create a breakthrough in the enemy lines, or to shore up defenses against an enemy attack.
loc.advanced_heavy_tank_chassis_desc: With the advances in armor and firepower, a modern tank needs to carry thick armor and a large gun to be effective. This necessitates a large vehicle.
loc.heavy_tank_chassis_desc: A large chassis that can mount a heavy gun, thick armor, or both.
loc.heavy_tank_artillery_chassis_desc: A large vehicle, primarily for fire support of advancing infantry.
loc.heavy_tank_destroyer_chassis_desc: A large vehicle, carrying a powerful gun to destroy enemy armor.
loc.heavy_tank_aa_chassis_desc: A large vehicle, carrying an anti-air gun to defend against enemy planes.
loc.modern_tank_chassis_desc: A modernized chassis that borrows heavily from previous medium tanks, but puts a much bigger emphasis on speed and maneuverability, while also allowing for more armor and bigger guns than usually carried on medium tanks. The result is a vehicle that can fill a wide variety of roles.
loc.main_battle_tank_chassis_desc: Experience has shown that the designs of light, medium, and heavy tank are converging more and more. heavy tanks have gotten more mobile, while light tanks are carrying heavier armament and armor to survive. there is therefore value in unifying all three designs into a single type, which will be a universal Main Battle Tank.
loc.modern_tank_artillery_chassis_desc: A modern vehicle, designed to be a fully-functional artillery piece that can keep up with modern tanks and be protected against any threats found on the battlefield.
loc.modern_tank_destroyer_chassis_desc: A modern vehicle, intended to provide a fast response to enemy tank attacks, while having comparable protection levels.
loc.modern_tank_aa_chassis_desc: A modern vehicle, intended to provide mobile and well-protected defense against enemy air attack.
loc.super_heavy_tank_chassis_desc: A gigantic vehicle, capable of mounting the heaviest armor and the biggest gun, but consequently fairly slow and unreliable.
loc.super_heavy_tank_artillery_chassis_desc: A gigantic vehicle, capable of mounting the heaviest armor and the biggest gun, but consequently fairly slow and unreliable.
loc.super_heavy_tank_destroyer_chassis_desc: A gigantic vehicle, capable of mounting the heaviest armor and the biggest gun, but consequently fairly slow and unreliable.
loc.super_heavy_tank_aa_chassis_desc: A gigantic vehicle, capable of mounting the heaviest armor and the biggest gun, but consequently fairly slow and unreliable.
loc.light_tank_flame_chassis_desc: A small vehicle, carrying a flamethrower in its turret to attack fortifications and houses.
loc.medium_tank_flame_chassis_desc: A mid-sized vehicle, carrying a flamethrower in its turret to attack fortifications and houses.
loc.heavy_tank_flame_chassis_desc: A large vehicle, carrying a flamethrower in its turret to attack fortifications and houses.
loc.amphibious_tank_chassis_desc: A small tank hull specifically designed to float. To achieve this, strict limits have to be set on the size of the weapon and the thickness of the armor the vehicle carries.
loc.gwtank_chassis_desc: The tank has proven itself a powerful weapon in the Great War. While development has slowed in the intervening years, it is no doubt going to play a major role in the wars to come.
loc.armor_tech_1_desc: Tanks during the Great War only had to contend with enemy small arms. As such, they got away with fairly thin armor. A new generation of anti-tank weaponry has made the battlefield a much more dangerous place for a tank, and much heavier protection is needed.
loc.armor_tech_2_desc: With heavier and heavier anti-tank weapons being fielded around the world, the next generation of tanks will require even better protection.
loc.armor_tech_3_desc: While the limit of deployed anti-tank guns has likely been reached, a new generation of tanks will carry more advanced weaponry, which is able to pierce any current level of protection at long range.
loc.armor_tech_4_desc: During the war, the threats faced by tanks have multiplied, from enemy tanks, anti-tank guns, dedicated tank destroyers, all the way to modern infantry weapons firing shaped charges that can penetrate even heavy armor. We must develop new protection methods to keep our own tanks alive in the face of these threats.
loc.engine_tech_1_desc: Where the tanks of the Great War were slow, lumbering beasts, the modern tank relies very much on speed and mobility to achieve victory.
loc.engine_tech_2_desc: With bigger guns and heavier armor, the new generation of tanks requires a more powerful engine to remain mobile.
loc.engine_tech_3_desc: Mechanized warfare is a form of combat that requires fast decision making and fast movement of troops and supplies. If our tanks are to carry modern weapons and enough armor to survive on the battlefield, they require powerful engines to keep up with the motorized infantry.
loc.engine_tech_4_desc: The numerous new additions to tanks made necessary by modern warfare have increased the weight of the vehicle substantially. To move all that mass around, we require engines that have a lot of power behind them.
loc.tank_rocket_launcher_desc: A multi-barrelled launcher for unguided, high-explosive rockets. The high volume of fire gives it excellent performance against soft targets, but even direct hits do little against armored targets.
loc.tank_rocket_launcher_2_desc: While there are a number of improvements to accuracy, the main advantage of this improved rocket launcher is that it can hold more rockets to fire at the enemy.
loc.tank_wheeled_suspension_desc: Derived from a truck chassis, this suspension is very limited in its carrying capacity and has limited cross-country performance, but has the advantage of being very cheap to make.
loc.tank_half_track_suspension_desc: A hybrid between a fully-tracked vehicle and a regular wheeled suspension, this setup has a pair of wheels up front for steering and a tracked rear axle to improve cross-country performance. While limited in its carrying capacity, it is still cheaper than a fully-tracked design.
loc.squeezebore_adaptor_desc: A special adaptor at the end of the gun lowers the diameter of the barrel and squeezes a shell down to a smaller caliber. This significantly increases muzzle velocity and thereby the penetration power of the gun. It does require special ammunition made from rare materials.
loc.armor_skirts_desc: A set of thin metal plates mounted on the side of the vehicle, giving additional protection against anti-tank rifles and shaped charges.
loc.dozer_blade_desc: A dozer blade allows the vehicle to quickly build a fighting position in the field without the support of engineers.
loc.auto_loader_desc: An automatic mechanism that loads shells and allows the tank to keep a high rate of fire for a prolonged period of time.
loc.easy_maintenance_desc: Hatches around the vehicle give access to many different components of the vehicle, and allow the crew to perform even complex maintenance fairly easily.
loc.additional_machine_guns_desc: A set of machineguns in sponsons and special pintle mounts give the vehicle improved defense against close-in infantry attack.
loc.light_flame_tank_desc: A company of light, flamethrower-equipped vehicles to provide support in assaulting cities and fortifications.
loc.medium_flame_tank_desc: A company of mid-sized, flamethrower-equipped vehicles to provide support in assaulting cities and fortifications.
loc.heavy_flame_tank_desc: A company of heavy, flamethrower-equipped vehicles to provide support in assaulting cities and fortifications.
loc.light_tank_amphibious_chassis_desc: A light tank equipped with floatation devices and a propeller.
loc.medium_tank_amphibious_chassis_desc: A medium tank equipped with floatation devices and a propeller.
loc.heavy_tank_amphibious_chassis_desc: A heavy tank equipped with floatation devices and a propeller.
loc.expanded_fuel_tank_desc: An externally mounted fuel drum designed to extend the operational range of an armored vehicle.
loc.land_cruiser_chassis_desc: A gargantuan chassis, heavily-armored and designed to support super-heavy weaponry and withstand immense battlefield punishment, but with high fuel consumption and slow speed due to its enormous size.
loc.lc_heavy_naval_guns_desc: The standard main armament for such a massive armored vehicle, these powerful naval-grade cannons are adapted for direct confrontation, delivering devastating firepower against both armored and fortified targets.
loc.lc_super_heavy_railway_gun_desc: This massive gun, originally built for railway platforms, is capable of bombarding targets from extreme ranges with unparalleled destructive power.
loc.lc_high_impact_obliterator_cannon_desc: Specifically designed to penetrate extremely thick armor, this weapon’s high kinetic energy makes it a formidable counter against other super-heavy tanks.
loc.lc_heavy_anti_air_platform_desc: A platform mounting multiple high-caliber flak guns, designed to defend against enemy bombers and reconnaissance aircraft that threaten the Land Cruiser.
loc.lc_medium_naval_guns_desc: Offering a balanced combination of rate of fire and firepower, this guns are effective at engaging lighter vehicles and providing support against unarmored targets.
loc.lc_hull_mounted_railway_gun_desc: A repurposed railway gun built directly into the hull for maximum stability, it provides heavy fire support and can engage distant targets with high precision.
loc.lc_super_heavy_howitzer_desc: A massive howitzer designed to smash fortifications and urban defenses. This variant specializes in delivering high-explosive shells, ideal for clearing entrenched positions and obliterating fortified structures.
loc.lc_heavy_high_velocity_cannons_desc: Anti-tank guns designed to engage and destroy enemy armor with pinpoint accuracy. Their high-velocity projectiles ensure excellent penetration at long ranges.
loc.lc_heavy_anti_air_battery_desc: An anti-air battery equipped with large-caliber guns to target high-speed and high-altitude aircraft, providing a defensive bubble around the vehicle.
loc.lc_medium_cannon_turret_desc: A standard turret-mounted cannon, capable of engaging infantry and light vehicles. Its compact design makes it versatile for close-quarters combat and secondary roles.
loc.lc_assault_gun_desc: Designed for close-range urban warfare and bunker busting. This weapon delivers powerful, high-explosive shells to clear out infantry and hardened targets.
loc.lc_high_velocity_cannon_turret_desc: A turret fitted with a high-velocity cannon to engage enemy armor. Its smaller size allows it to provide quick and responsive fire support against lighter armored threats.
loc.lc_light_anti_air_battery_desc: A light anti-aircraft battery designed to target low-flying aircraft and protecting the vehicle from strafing runs and dive-bombers.
loc.lc_flamethrower_turret_desc: A specialized turret that projects a stream of fire, perfect for clearing out fortified positions, infantry, and ambush points. Ideal for close-quarters engagements in dense urban environments.
loc.lc_rocket_launcher_desc: A modular rocket system mounted on the Land Cruiser, delivering devastating rocket barrages to suppress enemy defenses and overwhelm large formations.
loc.lc_command_center_desc: A fully integrated command center that transforms the Land Cruiser into a mobile headquarters, equipped with advanced communication systems to coordinate large-scale military operations.
loc.lc_radar_desc: An early detection system that increases awareness of enemy aircraft and nearby forces, allowing the Land Cruiser to prepare for potential aerial or ground threats.
loc.lc_aircraft_catapult_desc: A launch system for small reconnaissance aircraft, enabling the Land Cruiser to scout distant areas and provide real-time battlefield intelligence.
loc.lc_helipad_desc: A platform for launching helicopters, designed to provide advanced aerial reconnaissance and improved situational awareness on the battlefield.
loc.lc_armored_skirts_desc: Reinforced armor plating mounted along the sides to protect vulnerable tracks and suspension systems from anti-tank weapons and small arms fire.
loc.lc_bunker_emplacement_desc: An internal fortified structure, transforming the Land Cruiser into a mobile bunker. It allows the crew to hold defensive positions and fire back at the enemy, even when under heavy fire.
loc.lc_obstacle_clearance_gear_desc: Heavy-duty attachments, such as massive bulldozer blades and cranes, designed to clear debris, create paths through difficult terrain, and assist in entrenchment operations.
loc.lc_internal_fuel_tanks_desc: Expanded fuel compartments within the hull, increasing the vehicle’s operational range and reducing the need for frequent refueling stops during extended campaigns.
loc.lc_internal_ammunition_compartments_desc: Reinforced storage areas for carrying additional ammunition, allowing the Land Cruiser to sustain prolonged engagements without resupply.
loc.lc_wet_ammunition_storage_desc: Specialized compartments filled with liquid coolant to minimize the risk of ammunition detonations from enemy hits, greatly enhancing crew safety.
loc.lc_smoke_generators_desc: A system designed to deploy thick smoke screens, masking the vehicle’s movements and reducing its visibility to both ground and air-based threats.
loc.lc_stabilizers_desc: Mechanical devices that reduce the recoil and maintain gun alignment when firing, allowing for quicker target reacquisition and more accurate shooting during short halts.

loc.continuous_tech_share_group_desc: Reduced research time by nations in your faction because of your active Continuous Focus.

loc.YUG_SOV_research_group_desc: Reduced research time for technologies researched by the Soviet Union and Yugoslavia.
loc.YUG_air_research_group_desc: Plane technology shared between Britain and Yugoslavia.
loc.YUG_naval_research_group_desc: Italian naval experts aid Yugoslavia in developing its navy.
loc.HUN_joint_tank_development_group_desc: Hungary and its allies cooperate in developing new tanks.
loc.HUN_joint_air_development_group_desc: Hungary and its allies cooperate in developing new planes.

loc.jap_geacps_research_desc: Reduced research time for technologies researched by other GEACPS members.
loc.socialist_science_pool_desc: Reduced research time for technologies researched by other Communist countries.

loc.german_mexican_technical_mission_desc: A program of mutual support for technological sharing and innovation between Mexico and Germany.
loc.russo_mexican_technical_mission_desc: A program of mutual support for technological sharing and innovation between Mexico and the Soviet Union.
loc.american_mexican_technical_mission_desc: A program of mutual support for technological sharing and innovation between Mexico and the United States.

loc.FRA_legitimist_tech_sharing_desc: Reduced research time for technologies researched by the other part of the Kingdom.
loc.TUR_balkan_academy_of_sciences_name: The Academy of Sciences of the Balkans
loc.TUR_balkan_academy_of_sciences_desc: A place for the greatest minds of Southern Europe to meet and advance the sciences in defense.
loc.TUR_athenian_balkan_academy_desc: Where Southern Europe's best and brightest congregate to advance the interests of the Balkans and mankind as a whole.
loc.BUL_axis_research_desc: Reduced research time for military technologies researched by Germany or other faction members.
loc.BUL_italian_research_desc: Reduced research time for military technologies researched by Italy.
loc.BUL_balkan_research_cooperation_program_: A technological sharing and innovation program between Balkan countries.
loc.BUL_bulgarian_academy_of_sciences_desc: The Bulgarian Academy of Sciences will become a research and innovation center for the brightest minds in the Balkans.
loc.BUL_technological_cooperation_program_de: A Bulgarian initiative promoting technological exchange between faction members.
loc.SOV_soviet_academies_of_sciences_joint_p: Soviet Academies of Sciences Joint Program
A joint program of technological development and research between the different Academies of Sciences of the Soviet Republics.
loc.SOV_imperial_academies_of_sciences_joint: A joint program for technological research and development founded by the Russian Imperial Academy of Sciences.
loc.SOV_comecon_desc: A system of scientific cooperation between the COMECON countries, for the benefit of technologically lagging members.
loc.SOV_common_economic_space_desc: A program of technological cooperation between the Common Economic Space countries, for the benefit of technologically lagging members.
loc.ITA_naval_cooperation_program_research_g: A joint naval program for technological research and development, led by Italian experts.
loc.ITA_program_for_scientific_cooperation_d: An Italian initiative promoting technological exchange between faction members.
loc.ITA_anglo_italian_tech_sharing_desc: A cooperative military technology sharing program between Italy and Great Britain.
loc.ITA_franco_italian_tech_sharing_desc: A cooperative military technology sharing program between Italy and France.
loc.ITA_italian_hegemony_program_desc: A program of technological cooperation between the countries under the Italian hegemony.
loc.FIN_joint_research_and_development_progr: A Finnish initiative to promote technological research and development.
loc.SWE_allies_tech_sharing_group_desc: A military technology exchange between Sweden and its allies
loc.DEN_danish_partnership_tech_sharing_desc: A Danish initiative to promote deepening partnership and technological research and development.
loc.DEN_danish_military_cooperation_program_: A Danish initiative to establish a military cooperation program for technology exchange.
loc.DEN_german_danish_joint_military_program: A joint military program for sharing technological advancements.
loc.DEN_northern_technological_advancements_: A Danish initiative for sharing technological advancements.
loc.ICE_communist_tech_sharing_group_desc: A joint program for social and technological advancements headquartered in Reykjavik, Iceland.
loc.CHL_communist_tech_sharing_group_desc: A joint program for social and technological advancements headquartered in Santiago, Chile.
loc.CHL_fascist_tech_sharing_group_desc: A joint research society founded between the members of the Hispanic Alliance, with the goal of furthering their technology jointly as far as possible.
loc.ARG_italian_argentine_tech_sharing_group: A joint research program developed in honour of Italian-Argentine diplomacy.
loc.BRA_commonwealth_tech_sharing_desc: The member states of the Lusophone Commonwealth have agreed to share their technological developments for the mutual benefit of all.
loc.BRA_USA_tech_sharing_group_desc: The United States and Brazil have agreed to pool their scientific knowledge following maneuvers by the Brazilian government to work more closely with its northern neighbor on matters of foreign policy.
loc.BRA_south_american_tech_sharing_group_de: The nations of Latin America have agreed to pool their scientific knowledge for mutual benefit of the region.
loc.HABSBURG_tech_sharing_group_desc: A joint research society founded between the members of the new Federation upon the Danube, with the goal of jointly furthering their technology as far as possible.
loc.AUS_allied_tech_sharing_group_desc: An initiative started by the [AUS.GetAdjective]s to further develop technology together within the Allies.
loc.GER_JAP_naval_tech_sharing_desc: Initiated by naval engineers in [GER.GetNameDef] the [GER.GetAdjective] leadership have extended a hand to the Japanese in pursuit of excellency in naval technologies.
loc.GER_anglo_german_naval_development_group: Initiated by naval engineers in [GER.GetNameDef] the [GER.GetAdjective] leadership have extended a hand to the [ENG.GetAdjective] for cooperation in the pursuit of excellency in naval technologies.
loc.GER_SOV_industrial_development_group_des: Following progressively deeper industrial relations and cooperation between [GER.GetNameDef] and [SOV.GetNameDef], a hand has been extended from the [GER.GetAdjective]s to the [SOV.GetAdjective]s in effort to further both of their industrial efforts.
loc.EU_tech_sharing_group_desc: A joint research initiative started by the President of the European Union in the name of faster technological progress among the members of the European Union.
loc.AFG_SOV_tech_sharing_group_desc: The people of [AFG.GetNameDef] and [SOV.GetNameDef] have begun to share knowledge and scientific breakthroughs for the betterment of both.
loc.RAJ_naval_tech_sharing_group_name: East India - London Naval Technology Exchange
loc.RAJ_naval_tech_sharing_group_desc: Naval Research Exchange between the East India Company and London. Some diplomats whisper that giving this much power to a company is unwise, but what do they know?
loc.SSB_tech_sharing_group_desc: Unified research agreement between the Saadabad Pact signatories allowing full cooperative research. Perhaps this could lead to an otherwise small region becoming very powerful.
loc.MAN_PRC_technology_sharing_group_desc: With more than one territory under CPC control it also means that communication between the two must be increased so that one part does not fall behind. Coordinating research efforts is one of the most important parts of this communication.
loc.CZE_balkan_tech_sharing_group_desc: Research agreement between primarily Balkan nations and [CZE.GetNameDef] to keep their industrial technology on par with larger nations.
loc.CZE_german_czechoslovak_equipment_design: The scientists of [GER.GetNameDef] and [CZE.GetNameDef] has begun to cooperate in the design of tanks and planes.
loc.cominwealth_allied_research_desc: Reduced research time for technologies researched by the members of the Cominwealth.
loc.siam_tech_sharing_group_desc: Reduced research time for technologies researched by other Thai allied countries.
