loc.ARG_socialist_unification_idea_desc: Through the power of our glorious revolution, we have finally been able to establish ourselves as the dominant ideology in the South American Continent. This war, which was won through blood and valor, has filled our people with the desire for a greater motherland for the South American Socialist Republics.
loc.ARG_eliminate_american_imperialism_idea_: The giant to the north has long stood as a bastion to Capitalism. It is about time that we put an end to American Imperialism and bring forth the Scarlet Sunset.
loc.ARG_women_in_industry_idea_desc: With a woman as the standing leader for [ARG.GetNameDef], it sets a precedence that women should have the right to work in other industries as well. With this large addition to our workforce, we can expect great economic progress for our country.
loc.ARG_socialist_volunteers_idea_desc: In order to help secure the international revolution, we must offer aid to our fellow socialist states whenever the need arises. If we can spare the manpower, we must send volunteers to help fight the bourgeois across the world!
loc.ARG_free_association_idea_desc: The Free Association is a relationship among individuals where there is no state, social class, hierarchy, or private ownership of means of production. According to the Anarcho-Syndicalists in power, this will enable individuals to freely associate without social constraint to produce and reproduce their own conditions of existence.
loc.ARG_no_gods_no_masters_idea_desc: Whilst the other countries on the continent may not see eye to eye with our government, it would be against our ideology to sit and allow them to be conquered by angry, belligerent aggressors. Should any of our neighbors fall to an invader, we must take up arms to liberate them.
loc.ARG_regulated_salaries_desc: We have taken measures to prevent our employed citizens from being underpaid by our domestic industry. The deal struck with both industry and workers has proven to be most beneficial to us as a country.
loc.ARG_social_welfare_fund_ns_desc: An increased spending on social welfare measures has been enacted in [ARG.GetNameDef]. We are currently seeing positive effects from this increased budget in the shape of a more content population as well as an increasingly positive attitude to the government.
loc.ARG_british_argentine_agreement_desc: An agreement for better trade conditions between us and the [ENG.GetAdjective] has been reached. We enjoy a slight discount on our trade with the [ENG.GetAdjective] from now on.
loc.ARG_argentina_for_all_idea_desc: Our great nation has such a wide array of people living within its borders and for a long time, it has been nigh on impossible to unite our population under one banner. It is time we changed our approach. [ARG.GetNameDef] is a country that should be accessible and accepting of all who call it home.
loc.ARG_us_army_training_idea_desc: With closer ties to [USA.GetNameDef], we have been able to adopt their training regimens into our army. If we drill our troops like [USA.GetNameDef] does we will have a stronger and more resilient military.
loc.ARG_monroe_doctrine_idea_desc: The Monroe Doctrine has long stood as a way to prevent European interference in the Western Hemisphere. It is crucial for us to uphold this íf we are to survive the onslaught of war.
loc.ARG_argentina_first_idea_desc: It is never easy to go it alone, especially when we have such lofty goals of conquest in the South American continent. However, if we find ourselves tied up with the fascist movements in Europe, we may end up losing sight on what our true goal really is: a unified South America.
loc.ARG_united_workers_idea_desc: The worker is the backbone of the socialist revolution. The proletariat stand united against the corruption and fraud that capitalism has spread throughout [ARG.GetNameDef]
loc.idea_GUAY_father_of_the_nation_urg: Father of the Nation: José Gervasio Artigas
loc.idea_GUAY_father_of_the_nation_par: Father of the Nation: Francisco Solano López
loc.idea_GUYA_old_powers_FRA: Old Power Partner: [FRA.GetName] - Defense of the Nation
loc.idea_GUYA_old_powers_ITA: Old Power Partner: [ITA.GetName] - Supremacy of the Leader
loc.idea_PAR_the_aftershock_of_the_tripple_a: The Aftershock of the Triple Alliance
Will be removed if controlling §YFormosa§! and §YPonta Porã§!
loc.USA_monroe_doctrine_idea_desc: The United States has long promised to protect the western hemisphere from outside interference by colonial powers, meaning any incursion into our territory would likely mean the USA would come to our aid. However, if our politics no longer align with that of the United States, we may find ourselves unprotected.
loc.USA_monroe_doctrine_enforcer_desc: Since the mid 19th century, we have endeavored to protect the western hemisphere from outside interference by colonial powers. Although the parameters of this doctrine have evolved over time, the crux of it means that our neighbors in North and South America will expect us to aid them in times of conflict. It is of course up to our own government to determine when and how to enforce the doctrine.
loc.idea_VEN_blockade_inactive_instant_desc: Foreign Powers can blockade our oil shipments to §YFascist§! aligned powers if they have more than 2 §YCapital Ships§! in the §YCaribbean Sea§!.\nCurrent Status: §GNo Blockade§!
loc.idea_VEN_blockade_active_instant_desc: Foreign Powers can blockade our oil shipments to §YFascist§! aligned powers if they have more than §Y2 Capital Ships§! in the §YCaribbean Sea§!.\nCurrent Status: §RWe are Blockaded§!
loc.idea_PAR_river_navy_desc: We have the biggest river navy of any country, delaying or even preventing enemy incursions. While it does not hold a candle to ocean going navies it is a key in keeping our country safe.
loc.idea_PAR_very_high_military_spending_des: 45% of our GDP is currently reserved for the military and its adjacent branches.
loc.argentina_militaristic: Path to the Sun of May
loc.chile_militaristic: Victoria en las costas del Pacífico

loc.communist_revolutionary_desc: §LA supporter of the international revolution hoping to aid the country's, and eventually the world's, transition to a communist society.§!
loc.democratic_reformer_desc: §LA firm believer in the people's right to rule themselves, this politician sees empowering them as the first priority and aims for the country to be ruled with their mandate.§!
loc.fascist_demagogue_desc: §LDriven by a will to unite the people under a strong state, this politician emphasizes nationalist and militarist rhetoric.§!
loc.staunch_monarchist_desc: §LThis politician believes that a hereditary ruler serves as a powerful icon to unite the country.§!
loc.seawolf_desc: §LThe Sea Wolf is particularly skilled in Convoy Raiding§!
loc.old_guard_desc: §LWhile not the most brilliant officer, he is unlikely to cause trouble.§!
loc.old_guard_navy_desc: §LWhile not the most brilliant officer, he is unlikely to cause trouble.§!
loc.trickster_desc: §LDoing the unexpected in combat can give you a large advantage.§!
loc.logistics_wizard_desc: §LSupplies are never late, nor are they ever early. They arrive precisely when I mean them to.§!
loc.defensive_doctrine_desc: §LEspecially skilled in fighting on the Defensive.§!
loc.winter_specialist_desc: §LPossesses an intuitive understanding of the difficulties of fighting in Cold conditions.§!
loc.trait_engineer_desc: §LAdept in the arts of crossing rivers and constructing field fortifications.§!
loc.fortress_buster_desc: §LAssaulting a Fort holds no terror for this officer.§!
loc.panzer_leader_desc: §LA natural with Tanks and Mechanized forces.§!
loc.commando_desc: §LSkilled in Amphibious operations, Air Assaults, and Cold weather conditions - the Commando is a man of many talents.§!
loc.fast_planner_desc: §LKnows all the shortcuts when preparing for battle - Efficiency is key!§!
loc.thorough_planner_desc: §LA strategic master mind. Given time, the well-laid plan will be the strongest.§!
loc.organisational_leader_desc: §LKnows every trick to get reinforcements faster than anyone.§!
loc.inspirational_leader_desc: §LA natural leader. Men will face their worst fears when backed by a powerful leader.§!
loc.desert_fox_desc: §LEntirely at home when fighting in a Desert.§!
loc.swamp_fox_desc: §LWhile somewhat soggy, the Swamp Fox knows his way around Swamps and Marshes.§!
loc.trait_mountaineer_desc: §LAn excellent climber and skilled at Mountain warfare.§!
loc.jungle_rat_desc: §LUndeterred by rodents of unusual size, and skilled in Jungle warfare.§!
loc.ranger_desc: §LRangers lead the way, especially when it involves fighting in Forests.§!
loc.urban_assault_specialist_desc: §LAn expert in Fighting In Someone's House and Causing Havoc In People's Streets.§!
loc.blockade_runner_desc: §LAble to rapidly Disengage from Naval Combat.§!
loc.spotter_desc: §LThe Spotter pays special attention to keeping an eye out for enemy fleets.§!
loc.fly_swatter_desc: §LRealizing the danger posed to even our most powerful ships by airplanes, the Fly Swatter swiftly disposes of anything that flies.§!
loc.ironside_desc: §LDetermined to defend our home waters with the most powerful ships our navy can muster.§!
loc.air_controller_desc: §LAn expert in the nascent field of naval aviation, the Air Controller is a natural choice to command carriers.§!
loc.naval_invader_desc: §LAn expert in performing naval invasions. The perfect guy for preparing an invasion of a hostile beach and carrying it out.§!
loc.political_dancer_desc: §LKnows the moves when it comes to political maneuvering on the dance mat of Europe.§!
loc.stalins_puppet_desc: §LAs loyal as he is patriotic, he will never betray the International, the plight of the worker, or his home country. In that order.§!
loc.exiled_desc: §LUnder threat of persecution they have spent much of the recent years of political turmoil abroad.§!
loc.organizer_desc: §LAble to plan and organize the movement of large armies.§!
loc.dealbroker_desc: §LPeople don't like to see how sausages and laws get made. This man knows why.§!
loc.panzer_expert_desc: §LExperience and training makes this leader an expert at commanding tanks.§!
loc.combined_arms_expert_desc: §LAble to combine the strengths of both armor and infantry.§!
loc.cavalry_leader_desc: §LSkilled at using mobile forces to achieve victory.§!
loc.cavalry_expert_desc: §LAn expert at using speed and mobility in battle.§!
loc.aggressive_assaulter_desc: §LThe best defence is a strong offence.§!
loc.scavenger_desc: §LMore likely to scavenge and repair captured equipment for use by their own troops.§!
loc.ambusher_desc: §LExpertly able to trick enemy forces into ambushes.§!
loc.invader_ii_desc: §LNaval invasions may need to fight for a long time before resupply can arrive.§!
loc.naval_liason_desc: §LA good relationship with the navy will ensure that naval fire support will be more plentiful.§!
loc.expert_improviser_desc: §LAn expert in solving problems with whatever means are available.§!
loc.guerilla_fighter_desc: §LThe skilled guerilla fighter is an expert at using natural terrain and obstacles to their advantage.§!
loc.winter_expert_desc: §LHard earned experience has taught this leader how to fight in harsh winter conditions.§!
loc.skilled_staffer_desc: §LSurrounded by some of the best staff, this leader is able to organize and manage a larger number of units.§!
loc.adaptable_desc: §LA natural understanding of how to fight in various terrains and adapt to different environments.§!

loc.SKILL_DEFENSE_DESC: §LDefense skill boosts defensive stats of the units that are being led by the Commander.§!

loc.SKILL_NAVY_LEADER_DEFENSE_DESC: §LDefense skill boosts defensive stats of the ships that are being led by the admiral.§!

loc.treaty_org.1.desc: With the immediate global threat dealt with, tenuous arrangements between [SOV.GetNameDef] and their western allies have begun to deteriorate.\n\nFearing an irrevocable breakdown in communications combined with opposing ambitions in Europe - as evidenced by recent developments in East Germany - [FROM.GetNameDef] has proposed a treaty of mutual assistance, during a hurried conference in Brussels.
loc.treaty_org.1.a: The eastern threat must be contained.
loc.join_brussels_treaty_tt: We will sign the Treaty of Brussels
loc.NATO_brussels_treaty_desc: With the immediate global threat dealt with, tenuous arrangements between [SOV.GetNameDef] and their western allies have begun to deteriorate.
loc.brussels_to_has_already_happened: The conference in Brussels not been convened
loc.TO_will_be_invited_to_join_or_leave: Will choose to sign the Treaty, or will leave [ROOT.GetFactionName].\n
loc.TO_chose_neutrality_desc: With a storm brewing between East and West, our position demands a careful approach.
loc.treaty_org.2.desc:
In a move that reminds the world that the worst is not yet behind us, several of the former allied powers announced the signing of a new treaty in Brussels today.

Although ostensibly intended as a treaty of mutual civil and military cooperation, few are left in any doubt as to the message this sends to the leaders and allies of [SOV.GetNameDef].

Several states caught in the midst of this geopolitical tension have taken the opportunity to declare a principle of formal neutrality.
loc.NATO_form_nato_properly: Ratify the North Atlantic Treaty Organization
loc.NATO_suggest_nato_desc: The expansion of the Brussels treaty is the logical next step for our alliance.
loc.treaty_org.3.desc: The governments of the [USA.GetNameDef] and [FROM.GetNameDef], in a long-expected diplomatic maneuver, announced the formation of the North Atlantic Treaty Organization last night. Promising an auspicious era of civilian, military, and intelligence cooperation, the decision was poorly received by the upper echelons of [SOV.GetNameDef].\n\nPeace, it seems, may be a fleeting affair.
loc.treaty_org.4.desc: The government of [FROM.GetNameDef], in a long-expected but somewhat toothless diplomatic maneuver, announced the formation of the North Atlantic Treaty Organization last night. Promising an auspicious era of civilian, military, and intelligence cooperation, the decision was poorly received by the upper echelons of [SOV.GetNameDef].\n\nPeace, it seems, may be a fleeting affair.
loc.treaty_org.4.b: It doesn't look very North Atlantic.
loc.TO_nato_ratified_desc: A treaty whereby our nations might pool resources and intelligence. For reasons.
loc.NATO_have_warsaw_pact_desc: The only valid response to the Brussels Treaty is to organize a bloc of our own making.
loc.treaty_org.5.d: Fearing being caught between a further conflict between East and West, [FROM.GetNameDef] has announced their intention to leave [ROOT.GetFactionName] immediately. In their position, who can blame them?

loc.tut_1_text_1: Welcome to the §YHearts of Iron IV§! tutorial!\n\nYou will be taking charge of Italy @ITA during the period leading up to the war. Reading the tooltips will help you to understand things as you play, so it is recommended that you make good use of them.
loc.tut_1_text_alert: Start by §Ydealing with the alerts§! at the top of the screen.
loc.tut_2_text_1: Good! Now that the alerts are sorted out you can start diving into the details of waging war. Italy starts at war with Ethiopia and you should not have much difficulty in winning that war once you learn how to do it.\n\nMove your camera in a south-eastwards direction until you find Eritrea in Africa. Once your camera location has changed, §Yselect the Divisions§! in the $STATE|Y$ state by holding down §Gleft-click§! and drag select.
loc.tut_3_text_1: Great! Now you will learn how to start planning an offensive.\n\nDivisions can join together in §YArmies§!. An Army is used to draw Battle Plans and they can be assigned a §YCommander§! to lead them.
loc.tut_3_text_2: While you have divisions selected, click the §YNew Army§! button at the bottom of the screen. Do the same procedure for the divisions to the south, in §YSomaliland§!.
loc.tut_4_text_1:
Good! Creating an Army was the first step.

An §YArmy§! can be given orders by drawing §YBattle Plans§!. 

Click the §YFront Line§! button and then click the border to Ethiopia. Hover over the §YFront Line§! button to get further information on how to draw front lines. If you want to remove a front line you click on §YDelete Order§!.
loc.tut_5_text_1: Good! A §YFront Line§! now exists towards Ethiopia. In order for you to get your troops to attack with §YBattle Plans§! you must first also draw an §YOffensive Order§!.\n\nClick the §YOffensive line§! button and then hold §Gright-click§! and drag between the two highlighted provinces. Do the same procedure for the divisions to the south, in §YSomaliland§!.
loc.tut_6_text_1:
You have now created an Offensive Order to attack the Ethiopian capital. Before you go ahead and give the order to execute the plan, it may be wise to make the correct preparations.

If you allow your units to prepare for $DAYS_OF_PLANNING|0Y$ days they will receive a combat bonus for up to §G+$PLANNING_MAX|0%$§!. Certain £tech_mod  §YLand Doctrines§! can modify for how long you can §YPrepare§! while others might modify how fast you can reach your maximum level of Preparation.

It is also advisable that you prepare your Air Force as well. Click the §YAir Base§! in §YEritrea§!.
loc.tut_7_text_1:
Good! In order for your troops to have a higher guarantee of success in battle, it is also important to give them the proper §YAir Support§! they may require.

§YAir Wings§! assigned to an §YAir Region§! can be sent on missions. §YSupport§! Air Wings can be sent on the §YClose Air Support§! mission, which will enable them to join land combat engagements.

Assign the §YAir Wings§! based in the §YEritrea Air Base§! by §Gright-clicking§! the §YDanakil§! and give them orders once they are assigned.
loc.tut_8_text_1:
Good! You now have §YAir Wings§! assigned to the East Africa §YAir Region§!. Before they start doing anything, however, you must first give your Air Wings §Ymissions§!. If an Air Wing does not have an active mission it will stay in the Air Base.

There are a number of different §YAir Missions§! and the Air Missions an Air Wing can be sent on depends on the type of the Air Wing. §YSupport Air Wings§! can be sent on the §YClose Air Support§! mission, which enables them to join land combat engagements and attack your enemies.

To send an Air Wing on a mission, click the mission icon in the Air Interface.
loc.tut_9_text_1: Good! Now with almost everything set up, it is time to look at executing the §YBattle Plan§! and conquer Ethiopia for Italy.\n\nClick the §YDefault Mapmode§! £GFX_F1    button in the bottom right and then select your Army by clicking the portrait at the bottom of the screen.
loc.tut_10_text_1: Good! Before we begin the assault on Ethiopia you should assign a Commander to your Army if you have not already done it. Click the §Yempty leader portrait§! to the top-left of the screen and select a Commander from the list.\n\nClick the §YExecute Plan§! button at the bottom of the screen to order your troops to begin the invasion.
loc.tut_11_text_1:
Your forces will now begin the offensive on Addis Ababa, Ethiopia's capital. When you have occupied enough of your enemies' territory, they will surrender.

§YUnpause§! the game by pressing £SPACE . You can adjust the game speed by pressing the £KP_PLUS  or £KP_MINUS  keys. It is normal that players often adjust the game speed according to their needs as opposed to play on the same speed all the time.

Hint: If you feel you could control your units better, select a division and §Gright-click§! provinces to manually override the orders units get from Battle Plans.
loc.tut_12_text_1:
Ethiopia has surrendered! You have won!
You can now make demands during the §YPeace Conference§!. We recommend that you choose to §YTake All States§!.

Each demand you make will increase £world_tension_icon  §YWorld Tension§! by a certain amount. The higher the §YWorld Tension§! is, the closer you are to a World War.

Some countries have certain §YDiplomatic Actions§! locked until World Tension is high enough. Read more in the hint below.
loc.tut_13_text_1:
You are victorious! The war is over and Ethiopia has been defeated.

During peace time you may want to §Ytransport troops§! across the ocean to redeploy them to different locations, or perhaps to prepare for war. 

Now that Ethiopia has been defeated you do not need to have so many Divisions there.

Select at least §Y4 Divisions§! and move them to the §Yhighlighted port§! by §Gright-clicking§! the province.
loc.tut_14_text_1: To transfer troops between two friendly territories your troops must first be standing in a port.\n\nSelect the units §Ystanding in the port§! and §Gright-click§! another §Yport in Italy§!.

loc.tut_last_text_1:
You have now completed the guided part of the tutorial!

You can continue playing as Italy if you wish. Read the FAQ or the Italy playthrough if you find yourself having difficulties.

The help button in the top-right will allow you to access the FAQ at any time.

loc.HINT_AIR_BASE_TEXT:
The world is divided up into pre-defined §YAir Regions§!. An §YAir Wing§! is a group of aircraft of the same type (e.g. Fighters or Bombers) and they can be assigned to a region.

When you click an §YAir Base§! on the map it will open that Air Base and automatically select all Air Wings in that base.

To assign a selected Air Wing to a region or to rebase it to another Air Base, §Gright-click§! the Air Region or Air-Base.

You can also attach Air Wings to Armies, by selecting an Air Wing and §Gright-click§! on the Army at the bottom of the screen.
loc.HINT_CONSTRUCTIONS_TEXT:
This is the §YConstructions§! screen and it is used to improve your States and Provinces by constructing buildings. In the beginning of the game, it is suggested that you build £GFX_civ_factory §YCivilian Factories§! for a couple of years before starting to build £GFX_mil_factory §YMilitary Factories§! or more specialized structures. By building Civilian Factories you will be able to construct more buildings in the long-term.

All free Civilian Factories will be constructing new buildings according to their order in the Construction queue. The higher the £GFX_infrastructure_texticon §G80%§! §YState Infrastructure§!, the faster the construction.

Civilian Factories have been highlighted for your convenience. §YClick it to activate Build Mode§!. When Build Mode is active, click on the map to queue the construction of a building. §YHold shift and click to queue the maximum amount.§!
loc.HINT_ARMY_PLANNER_TEXT_1_1:
This is the §YRecruit & Deploy§! screen and this is where you queue new divisions for training and later on deployment. We recommend that you add a §YDivisione di Fanteria§! Division to the queue.

Divisions in training will first attempt to gather the §YEquipment§! they require. Once they have Equipment, they will begin their training. Training progress can never exceed equipment progress.

Click the §YTrain§! button to add a Division for training.
loc.HINT_ARMY_PLANNER_TEXT_1_2: Once Divisions have completed their training, they can be §YDeployed§! to a §Ylocation of your choice§!. You may only deploy Divisions in your core territory.
loc.HINT_ARMY_PLANNER_TEXT_2:
Divisions can be produced serially and/or in parallel.

Divisions that are trained in parallel will gain §YEquipment§! at the same rate, so they will all be finished at roughly the same time. When a Division has all the equipment they need and are fully trained they will be deployed to the location you have chosen.

Click §YAdd Unit§! to add another Division for parallel training.

If the tides of war have turned against you, it may be viable to Deploy your Divisions §Ybefore they have all their equipment and training§!. This should be avoided when you can.

You can read more about what units to recruit on the HOI4 Wiki!
loc.HINT_DIPLOMACY_TEXT:
This is the §YDiplomacy§! screen and here you get an overview of other countries' opinion of you, if they are guaranteed by other countries.

It's good to find out if your intended target has allies they can call upon.

You can also §GRight-Click§! on any country to see the available diplomatic interactions.
loc.HINT_DIVISION_DESIGNER_NOXP_TEXT: This is the §YDivision Designer§! and it is used to create new or edit §YDivisions Templates§!. Editing or creating a new Division Template will cost you £army_experience  §YArmy Experience§!. Army Experience is gained when your units are engaged in combat or are on army exercises. Units that are Experience Level 1 - §YGreen§! do not generate £army_experience  Army Experience.\n\nYou will need more £army_experience Army Experience before you can create or edit a Division Template.
loc.HINT_DIVISION_DESIGNER_XP_TEXT: This is the §YDivision Designer§! and it is used to create new or edit §YDivisions Templates§!. Editing or creating a new Division Template will cost you £army_experience  §YArmy Experience§!. Army Experience is gained when your units are engaged in combat or are on army exercises. Units that are Experience Level 1 - §YGreen§! do not generate £army_experience  Army Experience.\n\nFor your first template edit we recommend you to click the empty slot under the Support column to add £unit_artillery_icon_small §YSupport Artillery§! to your division. Once you have added it, click §YSave§!. Your divisions that use this template will now start asking for Artillery §YEquipment§!.
loc.HINT_EDIT_TEMPLATE_TEXT: You are producing equipment that is not used by any §YDivision Template§!. But you also have £army_experience §YArmy Experience§! to do something about it.\n\nClick §YEdit§! next to the §YDivisione di Fanteria§! or any other Division of your choice.
loc.HINT_EXECUTE_ORDER_TEXT:
Below the portrait, there is a small progress bar (3) indicating relative strength between your Army and possible hostile forces.

 If you have not assigned a Commander to the Army already, you should probably do so now. Click the empty portrait in the top left.

If everything is looking good in your favor the estimated plan light (2) should be green. It it is, click the Execute Plan button (1).
loc.HINT_NAVAL_MISSIONS_TEXT:
This is the §YFleet§! interface and this is where you can view and give orders to a selected fleet. You can make your fleets perform certain jobs by sending them on §YNaval Missions§!.

A fleet is usually split up into several §YTask Forces§!. Fleets can be active in several regions at a time, but Task Forces usually can not. When a fleet is on a Naval Mission it will try to cover all assigned zones, but this may leave it too spread out to resist a strong enemy force. 

To send a fleet on a §YNaval Mission§!, click one of the highlighted mission buttons and then §Gright-click§! on a §YSea Region§!. Ordering your fleet(s) to §YPatrol§! a region might be a good idea.
loc.HINT_LOGISTICS_TEXT:
This is the §YLogistics§! screen and its purpose is to help you see if you are producing equipment faster or slower than you are spending it.

If you are producing more of a type of §YEquipment§! than you think you need, it might be a good idea to reduce the amount of factories working on the §YProduction Line§! that is producing that type of Equipment.

Whether you're divisions are in good §Ysupply§! or not is an important part of your successes on the battlefield. You can check your supply status by switching to the §YSupply Map Mode§! £GFX_F4  .
loc.HINT_LOGISTICS_TEXT_2:
Supply is distributed from the £GFX_capital_hub_texticon §YCapital Supply Hub§! and flows via £GFX_train_texticon §YTrains§! or £GFX_convoy_texticon §YConvoys§! to £GFX_supply_hub_texticon §YSupply Hubs§! or £GFX_naval_supply_hub_texticon §YNaval Bases§! in the different provinces. 

Supply is then distributed to fielded divisions within the hub's range. You can see the range by selecting a £GFX_supply_hub_texticon §YSupply Hub§! and holding £GFX_shift. Range can be affected by motorization which uses £GFX_unit_motorized_icon_small §YTrucks§!.

Efficiency is further affected by the level of the £GFX_railways_texticon §YRailways§! and £GFX_naval_supply_hub_texticon §YNaval Bases§!, lack of £GFX_train_texticon §YTrains§!, and enemy air strikes. This creates §Rbottlenecks§!. These can be mitigate by upgrading the railways to the capital supply hub, provide air defences with fighters and make sure to have enough trains. Supply availability is shown in the §YSupply Mapmode§!  £GFX_F4  .
loc.HINT_NATIONAL_FOCUS_TEXT: This is the §YNational Focus§! screen and it allows your country to select its political goals which will result in effects or bonuses that helps the game progress.\n\nWe have highlighted a couple of National Focuses for your convenience that we recommend that you start with. The reason this path is recommended is because it allows you to gain another §YResearch Slot§! as quickly as possible, which will allow you to research one more £tech_mod  §YTechnology§! simultaneously.
loc.HINT_NO_TEMPLATE_NO_XP_TEXT:
You have clicked the §YNo Template alert§!. Do not worry! It is very good that you keep looking at the alerts for answers, they are there to help you.

Most likely, you created a Production Line that was producing Artillery equipment. At this moment, none of your §YDivisions§! are using that equipment in any of their §YDivision Templates§!.

Once you gain more £army_experience  §YArmy Experience§!, you may edit your Division Templates to include Artillery. £army_experience  Army Experience is gained when your Divisions engage in combat or when they are on army exercises.

You can ignore this alert for now, as this tutorial will help you once you gain more £army_experience  Army Experience.
loc.HINT_NO_TEMPLATE_HAVE_XP_TEXT:
You have clicked the §YNo Template alert§! which shows you that you are producing Equipment that you are currently not using.

To allow your Divisions to start using new types of equipment, you need to edit their §YDivision Template§!. Editing a Division Template costs £army_experience  §YArmy Experience§!.

Go to the §YRecruit & Deploy§! screen and choose a Division Template to §YEdit§!.

By tooltiping this alert you can see what type of Equipment that you are producing, but that you are currently not using.
loc.HINT_POLITICS_SCREEN_TEXT:
This is the §YPolitics Screen§! and this is where you can access things like your country's §YNational Focuses§!, £pol_idea §YIdeas§!, §YLaws§! and more.

£pol_power §YPolitical Power§! represents your country's ability to reach its political goals.
Hiring advisors, justifying claims or guaranteeing independence are all examples of actions that require £pol_power Political Power.

£pol_idea Ideas provide your country with bonuses in different areas, but they also cost £pol_power Political Power to activate.
loc.HINT_PRODUCTION_LINES_TEXT_1:
This is the §YProduction Lines§! screen. Production Lines produce the equipment needed for your war effort. It is recommended that you produce both the equipment you need now and that you might need in the future.

There are two types of Production Lines: Military and Naval. The first uses £factory_item  §YMilitary Factories§! and the latter uses £naval_factory_icon  §YNaval Dockyards§!. The more factories are assigned to a Productions Line, the faster it will produce the equipment you need.

A Production Line can be created by clicking one of the four highlighted buttons.
loc.HINT_PRODUCTION_LINES_TEXT_2: Once you select an equipment type, a Production Line will be created for that equipment type.\n\nRead the §Ynext page§! of this hint to §Ysee recommendations§! on what to produce and how many factories to assign to each Production Line.
loc.HINT_PRODUCTION_LINES_2_1: In the image below you can see an example of a Production Line with §Y10§! £factory_item  §YMilitary Factories§! assigned to it.
loc.HINT_PRODUCTION_LINES_2_2: We recommend that you also create Production Lines for:
loc.HINT_RESEARCH_TREE_TEXT:
This is the §YResearch Tree§!. Although it might seem overwhelming at first, it is actually not too complicated. We have highlighted some technologies that are recommended to research in the beginning of the game.

It is a good idea to research technologies that boost your country's industrial base as well as more general military improvements. As the game progresses it might be valid to research more specialized Technologies such as Tanks or Aircraft. It all depends on what you are trying to achieve.

Technologies take longer to research if you are trying to research something ahead of time. There are §YNational Focuses§! that can reduce the ahead-of-time penalty for certain Technologies.
loc.HINT_RESEARCH_SCREEN_TEXT: This is the §YResearch§! screen. You have a number of research slots that each can research a £tech_mod  §YTechnology§!. Click the empty §YResearch Slot§! to select something to Research.\n\nCountries have a different amount of Research Slots, with Major Powers usually having more. It is possible to unlock an additional slot through §YNational Focuses§!. National Focuses will be covered by another alert and another hint.
loc.HINT_DECISION_SCREEN_TEXT:
§YEvents§! occur throughout the course of play. There are a whole range of events in the game, which can result in positive, negative and mixed outcomes for a player's country. They take the form of a pop-up notification on the player's screen, which may present a player with a choice, or may simply inform the player of the consequences and require they acknowledge the event has occurred.

§YDecisions§! are long and/or short term goals you can strive for. Making decisions costs £pol_power §YPolitical Power§!. 

Some decisions are timed and require certain conditions to be completed within a set amount of time.
loc.HINT_INTELLIGENCEAGENCY_SCREEN_TEXT:
This is the §YIntelligence Agency§! screen. An §YIntelligence Agency§! is required for recruiting spies, gathering intel, establishing spy §Ynetworks§! and undertaking covert §Yoperations§!. §YCryptology§! is another facet of the war, and cracking the enemy's cipher can give you a huge advantage on the battlefield.

The higher your intel is, the more you know about your enemy's troop deployments, industrial capacity, research focuses, and more.

You can §GRight-Click§! a country to show its' §YIntel Ledger§! in the tab next to §YDiplomacy§!.
loc.HINT_OFFICER_CORPS_SCREEN_TEXT_1: This is the §YOfficer Corps§! screen. This is where you appoint the §YMilitary High Command§!, a §YTheorist§!, as well as the §YChief of  Army§!, §YNavy§!, and §YAir Force§!. \n\nMilitary High Command and Chiefs provide daily £army_experience  §YArmy Experience§!, £navy_experience  §YNavy Experience§!, £air_experience  §YAir Experience§! as well as bonuses to specific stats shown below each branch.
loc.HINT_OFFICER_CORPS_SCREEN_TEXT_2: Theorists reduce the cost of Land, Naval and Air §YDoctrines§!, which focus on overall strategy. These are set for each military branch, providing bonuses to fielded divisions, fleets and air regiments.
loc.HINT_OCCUPIED_TERRITORIES_SCREEN_TEXT: In order to combat resistance and police the population, occupied states will need to be garrisoned by military troops to perform police duties. The in-game Garrison represents this and can be assigned from the §YOccupied Territories§! tab in your §YPolitics Screen§!, which is opened by clicking on your country flag in the upper left corner.\n\nThe divisions needed to staff the garrisons are not visible on the map and are allocated and get their equipment automatically. The equipment allocation can be set via the §YRecruit & deploy§! tab.
loc.HINT_SELECT_UNIT_TEXT: It is time to wage war on §YEthiopia§!. You should start by giving your units orders by creating a Battleplan with an Offensive Order.\n\n§YSelect the highlighted Divisions§! in the §YEritrea§! state.
loc.HINT_TRADE_SCREEN_TEXT:
This is the §YTrade§! screen and it allows you to trade your £GFX_civ_factory §YCivilian Factories§! for resources.

The §YInsufficient Resources alert§! will show whenever one of your production lines does not have the required resources. Production lines will continue to produce equipment, but at a reduced speed. Trade is a valid option to solve that problem.

Do note that when you trade away your Civilian Factories for resources, they cannot be used to construct buildings.
loc.HINT_WAR_SCREEN_TEXT: This is the §YWar§! screen and it will show you how a war is progressing.\n\nItaly starts at war with Ethiopia, but you do not have to worry about that right now. Proceed by looking at the other alerts.
loc.HINT_WORLD_TENSION_TEXT:
This is the £world_tension_icon  §YWorld Tension§! screen. All events that affect the World Tension somehow, will be shown in the list here.

World Tension is a measurement of how heated the game has become. Certain countries may have certain §YDiplomatic Actions§! locked until World Tension is high enough.

Generally speaking, Axis powers want the World Tension to stay low to prevent Democratic countries from intervening, while Democratic countries want World Tension to be high so that they can intervene.

Declaring War, justifying claims, annexing territory, completing certain §YNational Focuses§! are all examples of action that might increase World Tension.

The higher the World Tension is, the closer you are to a World War.
loc.HINT_WORLD_TENSION_TEXT_2:
£world_tension_icon  §YWorld Tension§! is a measurement of how heated the game has become. Certain countries may have certain §YDiplomatic Actions§! locked until World Tension is high enough.

Generally speaking, Fascist and Communist powers want the World Tension to stay low to prevent Democratic countries from intervening, while Democratic countries want World Tension to be high so that they can intervene.

Declaring War, justifying claims, annexing territory, completing certain §YNational Focuses§! are all examples of action that might increase World Tension.

The higher the World Tension is, the closer you are to a World War.
loc.HINT_LOW_SUPPLY_TEXT_1: In order to keep your divisions combat-capable you are going to need supplies. Supply is distributed from the £GFX_capital_hub_texticon §YCapital Supply Hub§! and flows via £GFX_train_texticon §YTrains§! or £GFX_convoy_texticon §YConvoys§! to £GFX_supply_hub_texticon §YSupply Hubs§! or £GFX_naval_supply_hub_texticon §YNaval Bases§! in different provinces. \n\nSupply is then distributed to fielded divisions within the hub's range. You can see the range by selecting a £GFX_supply_hub_texticon §YSupply Hub§! and holding £GFX_shift. §YMotorization Priority§! can increase the hub's range, which increases the range at which your divisions receives supply. This will use £GFX_unit_motorized_icon_small §YTrucks§!.
loc.HINT_LOW_SUPPLY_TEXT_2: You can change the §YMotorization Priority§! on an Army, by selecting it and cycle through these three levels in the top left. By default the priority is set to low, which does not use £GFX_unit_motorized_icon_small §YTrucks§!. \n\nSupply availability is shown in the §YSupply Mapmode§!  £GFX_F4  . To get back to the §YDefault Mapmode§! click on £GFX_F1  .
loc.INTERNATIONAL_MARKET_HINT_SCREEN_TEXT:
This is the §YInternational Market§! screen. Here you can buy equipment from other countries and sell your own for £GFX_civ_factory_output $CIC_BANK_HIGHLIGHT$, which will temporarily increase your construction speed.

When you buy equipment you need to assign £GFX_civ_factory §YCivilian Factories§! to the contract, which will produce the £GFX_civ_factory_output $CIC_BANK_HIGHLIGHT$ you need to pay for the equipment. The more factories you assign, the fewer deliveries there are going to be, and you will get the total amount of equipment faster. Note that when you assign your £GFX_civ_factory §YCivilian Factories§! to pay for contracts, they cannot be used to construct buildings.

The §YInefficient Contract alert§! will show on the §YInternational Market§! button whenever one of your contracts is not delivering the expected amount of equipment or producing the expected amount of £GFX_civ_factory_output $CIC_BANK_HIGHLIGHT$. The contract will still go on, but it will take more deliveries to complete.
loc.BUTTON_WIKI_MARKET: Read about the §HMarket§! on HOI4 Wiki!
loc.MILITARY_INDUSTRIAL_ORG_HINT_SCREEN_TEXT:
When you produce, research or design equipment you can assign a $INDUSTRIAL_ORG_TOOLTIP_HEADER$. These organizations provide improvements to the equipment they are researching or designing. On production lines they help with production speed, efficiency and resource needs. 

For every task a $INDUSTRIAL_ORG_TOOLTIP_HEADER$ completes it gains funds which can be used to unlock traits. These traits improve the equipment or production bonuses of the $INDUSTRIAL_ORG_TOOLTIP_HEADER$. 

Each research a $INDUSTRIAL_ORG_TOOLTIP_HEADER$ is assigned to will have a daily £pol_power §YPolitical Power§! cost.

loc.UNIT_LEADER_NEW_LEADER_TOOLTIP: Recruiting new Commanders costs £command_power $VALUE|Y0$\n Up to a cap, the more Commanders you have, the more expensive it gets to recruit new ones, so try to find jobs for the ones you have first.

loc.PLAN_EXECUTE_CAREFUL_DESC: When the plan is carried out, units will not attack heavily fortified locations unless they are unmanned, and they avoid attacking provinces which will weaken the front line by making it longer.
loc.PLAN_EXECUTE_BALANCED_DESC: The standard rules for carrying out battle plans are in effect. Units will attempt to advance in a manner that keeps the front line as short as possible and may attack fortified locations.
loc.PLAN_EXECUTE_RUSH_DESC: Units will attack provinces if they are a part of the plan, even if it may mean that the front line becomes longer or may put units in exposed locations.

loc.TASK_FORCE_AUTO_REINFORCEMENT_DESC:
When the §HAutomatic reinforcement§! of a task force is enabled, it will pull ships from the reserve fleets of its theater in order to match the requirements set.
When enabled, the requirements are shown below the actual number of ships in the task force.

The task force will never return ships automatically if it has more than the requirements.
loc.ENABLE_TASK_FORCE_UNDERWAY_REPLENISHMENT: §GClick§! to §HEnable§! the §HUnderway Replenishment§! for the selected task forces
loc.DISABLE_TASK_FORCE_UNDERWAY_REPLENISHMEN: §GClick§! to §HDisable§! the §HUnderway Replenishment§! for the selected task forces
loc.TASK_FORCE_UNDERWAY_REPLENISHMENT_DESC: When the §HUnderway Replenishment§! for a task force is enabled, it won't need to go to port to get refueled. Convoys will come to the task force while underway to refill their tanks.\nWhen enabled, the range of the task force is increased by $FACTOR_BONUS|%+=0$ at the cost of a number of convoys proportional to the daily maximum fuel consumption.
loc.RESERVE_FLEETS_FOR_THIS_THEATER_DESC: Ships that go out of production and do not have a specific §YDeploy target§! will automatically be assigned to reserve.\nShips in the reserve fleet will automatically move to reinforce task forces which have §YAutomatic reinforcement§! enabled and are not meeting their set requirements.\nLikewise, if a task force has more ships than its set requirements, some will detach and move to the closest port and to reserve.

loc.light_tank_destroyer_brigade_desc: Tank Destroyers are tanks with a larger than normal gun in a fixed mounting in place of a turret. Light Tank Destroyers are based on the chassis of Light Tanks, which means they are fairly mobile but do not carry particularly powerful guns compared to heavier TDs.
loc.medium_tank_destroyer_brigade_desc: Tank Destroyers are tanks with a larger than normal gun in a fixed mounting in place of a turret. Medium Tank Destroyers are based on the chassis of Medium Tanks, meaning they are fairly mobile and carry respectable firepower.
loc.heavy_tank_destroyer_brigade_desc: A heavy tank destroyer has the turret removed to carry an even larger gun in a fixed mounting.
loc.super_heavy_tank_destroyer_brigade_desc: A super heavy tank chassis with an even larger gun in a fixed mount instead of a turret.
loc.modern_tank_destroyer_brigade_desc: A Modern Tank chassis fitted with a much larger gun instead of a turret.
loc.cavalry_desc: Horse mounted infantry. More expensive, but with good mobility.
loc.camelry_desc: Camel mounted infantry. More expensive, but with good versatility.
loc.elephantry_desc: Elephant mounted Infantry. More Expensive, but good against Infantry
loc.medium_armor_desc: Medium tanks are flexible and can do almost any job.
loc.heavy_armor_desc: The strongest tanks with powerful armor and weapons, but slow and tactically inflexible.
loc.super_heavy_armor_desc: Super-Heavy tanks trade mobility and speed for firepower and armor beyond that of the standard Heavy Tanks.
loc.motorized_desc: Motorized infantry transportation, such as trucks and motorcycles.
loc.modern_armor_desc: Modern Tanks have evolved to deal with most battlefield situations. Powerful guns and sloped armor have eliminated the need for specialized tanks.
loc.bicycle_battalion_desc: Meat for the meat grinder, but with extra bits of metal.
loc.paratrooper_desc: By incorporating airborne forces into our army, we can make forced entries and position key troops in previously inaccessible areas, allowing for new tactical opportunities.
loc.marine_desc: Troops specializing in amphibious warfare are growing ever more indispensable. Improvised methods and equipment become things of the past as our naval infantry is supported by specialized landing craft and training.
loc.marine_commando_desc: Troops specializing in amphibious raids are growing ever more indispensable. Improvised methods and equipment become things of the past as our naval infantry is supported by specialized landing craft and training.
loc.mountaineers_desc: Combat in mountain ranges exposes troops to many perils, but sometimes cannot be avoided. By providing our soldiers with specialized training for this environment, we can minimize these risks.
loc.penal_battalion_desc: The ultimate meat for the meat grinder.
loc.blackshirt_assault_battalion_desc: Elite militia units trained and equipped to operate as assault battalions attached to ordinary divisions.
loc.recon_desc: Sending smaller groups to scout ahead before moving in the main force allows us to gather intelligence about where the enemy is and how many we are facing.
loc.mot_recon_desc: Utilizing light trucks and motorcycles, recon companies can range further ahead and cover more ground to protect the flanks.
loc.armored_car_recon_desc: Equipped with armored cars, a recon company can take the fight to the enemy, and prevent enemy scouts from gaining any valuable information.
loc.light_tank_recon_desc: Using light tanks in a recon role, we can conduct reconnaissance by fire and get a better understanding of what we are facing.
loc.engineer_desc: Construction of fortifications and breaching obstacles make combat engineers vital in the field. Giving our engineers a versatile role enables us to deploy them in the diverse situations where they will be needed.
loc.field_hospital_desc: Provides emergency medical attention to wounded soldiers in the field.
loc.logistics_company_desc: Handles planning, requesting and distributing resources for the division.
loc.hq_support_company_desc: A dedicated headquarters staff company that administrates and assists with the unit's activities.
loc.hq_engineer_desc: Deals with matters regarding fortifications and mobility/counter-mobility measures.
loc.hq_recon_desc: Collects and analyzes reconnaissance data received from the field.
loc.hq_military_police_desc: Maintains local order and directs division traffic across the army's area of operations.
loc.hq_maintenance_desc: Plans and supports maintenance & repair efforts on the army level.
loc.hq_field_hospital_desc: Responsible for medical administration and providing efficient casualty evacuation and treatment within the army area.
loc.hq_logistics_desc: Prioritizes and allocates the distribution of supplies and fuel within the army.
loc.hq_signal_desc: Coordinates communication efforts within the army, while also collecting and keeping track of gathered intelligence.
loc.hq_infantry_desc: A smaller infantry battalion, dedicated towards HQ security.
loc.hq_motorized_desc: Infantry in motorized vehicles, allowing more rapid relocation of the HQ.
loc.hq_armored_car_desc: Armored cars escort the HQ, combining mobility with protection and excellent reconnaissance.
loc.hq_paratrooper_desc: Allows an HQ to join an airborne invasion directly, along with providing additional security.
loc.hq_light_armor_desc: Armored battalions lets the HQ unit move quicker on the field as well as survive longer in combat, if the circumstances require it.
loc.hq_medium_armor_desc: Armored battalions lets the HQ unit move quicker on the field as well as survive longer in combat, if the circumstances require it.
loc.hq_heavy_armor_desc: Armored battalions lets the HQ unit move quicker on the field as well as survive longer in combat, if the circumstances require it.
loc.hq_naval_liaison_desc: Provides joint Army-Navy cooperation during amphibious landing operations.
loc.hq_air_liaison_desc: Air-Ground control parties and other units assigned with the task of ensuring close cooperation between the air force and the land units they support.
loc.hq_specops_desc: Staff office for the planning and coordination of Special Forces operations.
loc.military_police_desc: Maintains order and suppresses resistance in occupied territories.
loc.signal_company_desc: Responsible for local communications working in the division.
loc.maintenance_company_desc: Performs various forms of maintenance on division equipment to prevent failure.
loc.amphibious_mechanized_desc: An armored infantry unit in amphibious vehicles.
loc.amphibious_light_armor_desc: A battalion of light tanks, capable of amphibious operations.
loc.amphibious_medium_armor_desc: A battalion of medium tanks, capable of amphibious operations.
loc.amphibious_heavy_armor_desc: A battalion of heavy tanks, capable of amphibious operations.
loc.fire_support_desc: Heavy machine guns, light mortars, and other heavy weaponry that can support infantry operations.
loc.mot_fire_support_desc: Motorization for a Heavy Weapons Company, allowing for greater mobility and breakthrough exploitation.
loc.field_guns_desc: Transportable mortars and lighter artillery pieces that provide indirect fire support to infantry.
loc.rocket_battery_desc: Rocket artillery for support on the regimental level.
loc.UNIT_ADJECENCY_RULE_BLOCKED: Movement is blocked due to the $RULE_NAME|H$ permission

loc.ARMY_COMPOSITION_SPECIAL_HEADER: \nIt also gets bonuses based on this:\n
loc.ARMY_COMPOSITION_DELAYED: The composition controls which bonuses are applied from advisors and commanders. Battalions lacking equipment contribute less than those that are fully equipped.
loc.airborne_light_armor_desc: Using extremely light armored vehicles and an innovative glider mechanism, airborne armor divisions are no longer a thing of fancy. The tactical advantage of such rapid and unexpected deployment is hard to ignore.
loc.rangers_support_desc: Recon Rangers are elite skirmish troops, specializing in infiltration, reconnaissance and close-quarters combat.
loc.ranger_battalion_desc: Rangers are leading specialists when it comes to fighting in dense and vegetated terrain.
loc.rangers_desc: Specializing in infiltration and tactical awareness, we will benefit from accentuating the hostile environment training our Rangers receive.
loc.pioneer_support_desc: Pioneers are talented engineers, adept at solidifying beachheads, general engineering projects, and consolidating gains.
loc.marines_shore_parties_desc: Often first into the breach at landings, shore parties are specialized groups of combat engineers with expertise in establishing a foothold under fire.
loc.marines_jungle_troops_desc: Adept at clearing dense terrain, these marines excel at large scale offensive operations and engineering in rough terrain.
loc.marines_recon_desc: Nothing prepares a man for war, but our combat instructors assure us they can come close enough that only the most hardened recruits make it to where it counts.
loc.marines_commandoes_desc: Our marines have proven their worth at extended operations behind enemy lines. It is time we took the step of cementing this practice in our doctrine, and organizing the troops around effective hit-and-run behaviour.
loc.marines_expeditionary_desc: Coordinated strikes benefit from improved inter-disciplinary planning and logistics. As our doctrinal philosophy advances, lending greater support to these task forces is sure to benefit us.
loc.marines_expeditionary_blowtorch_desc: The perfect combination of naval, air, and specialized land force can render any objective securable. This combined-arms approach to offensive warfare shall become the manifestation of our logistical prowess.
loc.marines_expeditionary_support_desc: By now, the clear importance of branch cooperation is impossible to overstate. Dedicating task force logistics to our operations truly makes us a force to be reckoned with.
loc.marines_commandos_demolition_desc: Demolition is an art that we can put to good use. Sabotage might be a dirty tactic, but there's no denying its efficacy.
loc.marines_commandoes_mechanised_desc: The ability to consolidate upon a successful landing can only be enhanced by equipping our vanguard appropriately. This requires a shift in our production strategy as well as doctrine.
loc.SF_MARINES_exfiltration_effect_tt: Marine Commandos have the ability to exfiltrate from any coastal province.
loc.SF_marine_demoliton_effect_TT: Marine Commando divisions will cause §H1§! level of damage to all strategic state buildings after any successful naval invasion.
loc.marines_commandoes_mechanised_non_mtg_de: Let us enhance our elite cadre of special forces, albeit at the expense of their wider applications.
loc.northern_territory_recon_support_desc: With local knowledge and bushcraft skills, the Northern Territory Reconnaissance Unit surveils even the most remote and inhospitable lands.
loc.winter_logistics_support_desc: Providing the leg infantry with the appropriate gear to fight under winter conditions.
loc.long_range_patrol_support_desc: Elite infantry skilled in reconnaissance and destroy missions.
loc.sturmtruppe_battalion_desc: Elite infantry units trained and equipped to operate as assault battalions attached to ordinary divisions.
loc.assault_engineer_desc: Specialized in breaching fortified positions, assault engineers combine explosives expertise with armored protection, ensuring mobility and fortification even in the most hostile environments.
loc.armored_engineer_desc: Versatile vehicles equipped for constructing fortifications, clearing obstacles and enhancing battlefield mobility under combat conditions.
loc.armored_maintenance_desc: Specialized vehicles designed to recover and repair damaged tanks and other armored units directly on the battlefield.
loc.armored_signal_desc: Specialized vehicles providing battlefield leadership and coordination, equipped with advanced communication systems to direct operations from the front lines.
loc.motorized_military_police_desc: Maintains order and suppresses resistance in occupied territories, and can perform reconnaissance in active combat zones.
loc.helicopter_recon_desc: Specially trained observers mounted on helicopters, able to rapidly scout the area regardless of terrain, and call in precision strikes where needed.
loc.helicopter_transport_desc: Helicopters with cargo capacity modifications or lifting supplies by cable beneath, getting equipment to where it needs to be quickly and without regard to terrain.
loc.helicopter_field_hospital_desc: Attention all personnel! Incoming choppers with wounded! Med-Evac helicopters are able to get casualties off the battlefield far more quickly than a regular ambulance.
loc.helicopter_brigade_desc: General purpose helicopter support brigade, able to provide flexible mobile assistance in a number of different areas.
loc.super_heavy_artillery_desc: A specialized unit equipped with large-caliber howitzers, designed to devastate enemy fortifications and entrenched positions.
loc.self_propelled_super_heavy_artillery_des: Massive-caliber howitzers, mounted on mobile chassis, combine devastating firepower with improved mobility to crush enemy defenses.
loc.land_cruiser_desc: A colossal war machine armed with battleship-grade weaponry and the heaviest armor, but extremely slow and resource-intensive.

loc.wtt_border_conflict_lost_attacker.1.a: We must counterattack as soon as possible!
loc.wtt_border_conflict_lost_defender.1.desc: Forces under the command of [their_country.GetLeader] have succeeded in pushing us out of the disputed area between [our_state.GetName] and [their_state.GetName]. Our forces have retreated in good order and are reorganising should we want to renew the battle in the future.
loc.wtt_border_conflict_lost_defender.1.a: We must counterattack as soon as possible!
The fighting in the [our_state.GetName]-[their_state.GetName] Area has ground to a halt as both sides have proven unable to dislodge the other. Little territory has been gained by either side. Scouts report that the [their_country.GetAdjective] soldiers on the other side are digging in on defensive terrain. It would appear that they intend to keep the territory they have, but probably won't push against our lines.

Scouts report that the [their_country.GetAdjective] soldiers on the other side are digging in on defensive terrain. It would appear that they intend to keep the territory they have, but probably won't push against our lines.
loc.wtt_border_incident_defender_warning.1.d:
Earlier yesterday, [their_country.GetAdjective] soldiers were spotted crossing the border from [attacker_state.GetName] into [defender_state.GetName]. During the night, more [their_country.GetAdjective] forces have poured into the area and set up defensive positions inside our territory. 

This follows a series of minor skirmishes and border violations by forces under the command of [their_country.GetLeader] all along our shared border.

This time, however, it is clear that the [their_country.GetAdjective] forces are here to stay. We must send forces into the region as soon as possible to check their advance.
loc.wtt_border_conflict_escalate_to_war.1.de: Scouting reports indicate that [From.GetAdjective] forces are massing inside [their_state.GetName] for a major operation to push deeper into [our_state.GetName]. Given the amount of resources [From.GetLeader] is willing to expend on this adventure, it is clear that this is no longer a mere dispute over the exact location of a demarcation line.\n\nFull scale war is on the horizon.
loc.wtt_border_conflict_escalate_to_war.1.a: We must be ready to meet them!
loc.form_eu_netherlands_coring_states_tt: Gain cores on all §YDutch§! states in Europe.\n

loc.form_eu_italy_coring_states_tt: Gain cores on all §YItalian§! states in Europe.\n
loc.form_proletarian_state_british_mainland_: Gain cores on all of mainland Britain. \n

loc.form_persia_britain_required_states_tt: Controls all §YBritish§! states in Egypt, the Middle East, and the Eastern Mediterranean.

loc.form_persia_britain_coring_states_tt: Gain cores on all §YBritish§! states in Egypt, the Middle East, and the Eastern Mediterranean.

loc.form_country_saudi_coring_states_tt: Gain cores on all §YSaudi Arabian§! states.\n
