loc.form_arabia_italy_coring_states_tt: Gain cores on all §YItalian§! states in North Africa.\n
loc.form_arabia_britain_coring_states_tt: Gain cores on all §YBritish§! states in Egypt, the Middle East, and Arabia.\n
loc.form_hre_germany_coring_states_tt: Gain cores on all §YGerman§! states except §YOstpreussen§!.\n
loc.form_ottoman_britain_coring_states_tt: Gain cores on all §YBritish§! states in Egypt, the Middle East, and the Eastern Mediterranean.\n
loc.form_ottoman_italy_coring_states_tt: Gain cores on all §YItalian§! states in North Africa and the Eastern Mediterranean.\n
loc.form_scandinavia_denmark_coring_states_t: Gain cores on all mainland §YDanish§! states.\n
loc.reintegrate_austro_hungarian_empire_desc: We have reconquered enough to be able to reintegrate the Imperial Austro-Hungarian lands into our Empire. Let us do so forthwith.
loc.byz_triumph_for_italy_desc: Italy has come under our control, and we should reintegrate it into the empire in a glorious ceremony!
loc.byz_triumph_for_middle_east_desc: The Levant has come under our control, and we should reintegrate it into the empire in a glorious ceremony!
loc.byz_triumph_for_egypt_and_tunis_desc: Egypt and Tunis have come under our control, and we should reintegrate them into the empire in a glorious ceremony!
loc.form_scandinavia_category_desc: With the conquest of all Scandinavian territories, it is time to restore the spirit of the Kalmar Union. All Scandinavia shall prosper under our rule.
loc.form_nordic_league_category_desc: The Nordics have long felt a certain affinity to one another. Now that we control all lands once belonging to the Nordic constituent states, it is possible to bring that kinship to new heights.
loc.form_gran_colombia_category_desc: Though the experiment of Gran Colombia was only short-lived a century ago, we have now once more succeeded in wresting control of its constituent territories. We may, once again, realize Bolívar's dream.
loc.form_austria_hungary_category_desc: The old Austro-Hungarian lands have been conquered, and as their sole remaining successor state it depends on us to restore the Empire. Let us not tarry, and instead do so immediately.
loc.form_commonwealth_category_desc: There is ample history between Poland and Lithuania. Now that we are once again united through force of arms, perhaps it is time to revive the most glorious days of our past.
loc.form_united_netherlands_category_desc: The Treaty of London in 1839 disgracefully separated the North and South of the lowlands, after an all-too brief period of unity. Now, under our leadership, we can recreate those days, and take our intended place as the counterweight to France and Germany.
loc.form_united_central_america_category_des: The powerful state our nation was a constituent of a century ago had an all-too-brief life-span. Now that we have conquered the secessionist states that caused its downfall, we can look towards reconstituting the federal republic, and begin projecting the power of a united Central America.
loc.form_baltic_federation_category_desc: Our previous declarations of regional solidarity and unified foreign policy can only be improved on now that we have the entire baltics under our control. Integrating our former neighbours will provide increased security for all, in the face of the dangers in the West and the East.
loc.form_ottoman_empire_category_desc: Through force of arms we have managed to undo the losses we suffered as a result of our weakness in the Great War. To mark this historic occasion, nothing would serve better than proclaiming the restoration of the Ottoman Empire.
loc.form_european_union_category_desc: Though the concept of a politically unified Europe has only gained any semblance of traction in the past few decades, our recent conquest of the most powerful continental European nations presents us with this unexpected reality. Perhaps a restructuring of the nation is required to take full advantage of the opportunities it offers us.
loc.form_mutapa_category_desc: Having rid the southern parts of the continent from colonial influences, it is perhaps time to rally the people behind the concept of a powerful empire from our past. Multiple have existed in this region, and we need only a name to serve as a symbol.
loc.form_roman_empire_category_desc: The idea of an Empire spanning the Mediterranean has in recent years been revived in the popular mind. Now, our military campaigns have exceeded the wildest dreams of even our most ardent supporters, and we find ourselves on the cusp of being able to realize these ambitions. Roma invicta!
loc.form_persian_empire_category_desc: Our recent conquests have reached the extents of the Persian Empire of old. With our region's rich history, how can we not take this opportunity to identify our realm as a continuation of the empires of yore?
loc.form_byzantine_empire_category_desc: Having rid our old territories of the Turkish yoke, we can now, with some propaganda, claim our nation is the successor of the very Empire the Turks ended five centuries ago. This heritage is sure to see our international prestige soar!
loc.form_arabia_category_desc: For too long have the Arabian states been divided by regional rivalries. Now that we have united the peninsula under our rule, we may at last announce the formation of a united Arabia!
loc.form_majapahit_empire_category_desc: Many centuries ago, a great empire stretched the Indonesian archipelago and dominated its trade. We have succeeded in expanding our borders to encompass the extent of this empire, and using them as a base for a new nation state may well serve as a symbol of the region's unity.
loc.form_rattanakosin_kingdom_category_desc: In recent years we have moved away from the traditional values our nation was originally founded upon. Now that we have reached the territorial extent from our glory days, perhaps it is time to embrace our history more tightly.
loc.form_pan_tai_empire_category_desc: The Great Thai Empire has restored our nation to the borders of its glory days, yet the Tai peoples stretch far beyond them. From the Shan hills to the Dai of Yunnan, the Zhuang of Guangxi and the distant Ahom of Assam, our kin remain divided. Now that these ancestral homelands fly our banner, let us proclaim a single empire for all the Tai.
loc.GER_is_forming_hre: The splendor of our Kaiserin knows no bounds, and neither do the borders of our nation. These have now grown to encompass the limits of the old Holy Roman Empire, and the nations in our way are no longer in a position to object to our policies. The Kaiserin has decreed that the current opportunity shall be seized, and that the nation shall embrace its role as the spiritual successor of the Holy Roman Empire. Aquila Elegit Iovis Omnia Vincit!
loc.GER_is_forming_hre_without_victoria: The splendor of our government knows no bounds, and neither do the borders of our nation. These have now grown to encompass the limits of the old Holy Roman Empire, and the nations in our way are no longer in a position to object to our policies. It has now been decreed that the current opportunity shall be seized, and that the nation shall embrace its role as the spiritual successor of the Holy Roman Empire. Aquila Elegit Iovis Omnia Vincit!
loc.AUS_is_forming_hre: The splendor of our Archduke [ROOT.GetLeader] knows no bounds, and neither do the borders of our nation. These have now grown to encompass the limits of the old Holy Roman Empire, and the nations in our way are no longer in a position to object to our policies. The Archduke has decreed that the current opportunity shall be seized, and that the nation shall embrace its role as the spiritual successor of the Holy Roman Empire. Aquila Elegit Iovis Omnia Vincit!
loc.form_greater_german_reich_category: The Greater Germanic Reich of the German Nation
loc.form_greater_german_reich_category_desc: Our enemies have been brought low before us, and our goals of expansion into the East have been accomplished. Now is the time to make the world understand the greatness of our nation, and to begin the transformation of our capital into something all can look to with pride.
loc.form_greater_german_state_category_desc: Despite opposition from all sides, we have managed to overcome the corrupt governments of Western Europe. No longer can they continue to oppress the workers, whom we now have set free and are rallying to our cause at this very moment. The shackles of Capitalism have been shattered and a new order dawns over Europe - and the world.
loc.form_greater_proletarian_state: Proclaim the Greater German Proletarian State
loc.form_country_andalusia_coring_states_tt: Gain cores on all §YSpanish§! and §YPortuguese§! states.\n
loc.hold_fight_on_the_beaches_speech: Hold 'We Shall Fight on the Beaches' Speech
loc.hold_fight_on_the_beaches_speech_desc: 'We shall go on to the end. We shall fight in France, we shall fight on the seas and oceans, we shall fight with growing confidence and growing strength in the air, we shall defend our island, whatever the cost may be. We shall fight on the beaches, we shall fight on the landing grounds, we shall fight in the fields and in the streets, we shall fight in the hills; we shall never surrender...'
loc.fight_on_the_beaches_speech: 'We Shall Fight on the Beaches' Speech
loc.operation_fork_desc: The newly-independent nation of Iceland occupies an extremely strategically-important location in the North Atlantic. Loss of Norway would put the defenseless island in a vulnerable position. We must beat our enemies to the invasion and occupation of Iceland, lest they obtain the island's strategic bases from which they might endanger our supply lines. Only with our protection will the Icelanders be safe from our enemies.
loc.ENG_operation_valentine_desc: We shall shield the Faroe Islands from all the severities of war and establish ourselves there conveniently by sea and air until the moment comes when they will be handed back to Denmark liberated from the foul thraldom into which they have been plunged by hostile aggression, whilst also strengthening our own position in the North Sea.
loc.invade_ireland_desc: We must secure the safety of our convoys by any means necessary. An invasion of Ireland may not be palatable to some of us, but if that is what it takes to acquire the use of their air bases, then so be it.
loc.macdonald_proposal_desc: We must secure the safety of our convoys, and to achieve this, Irish air and naval bases are of the utmost importance. We will send an envoy to propose a trade of Northern Ireland in return to the immediate entry of Ireland into the war, on our side.
loc.hold_blood_toil_tears_sweat_speech: Hold 'Blood, Toil, Tears, and Sweat' Speech
loc.hold_blood_toil_tears_sweat_speech_desc: 'I have nothing to offer but blood, toil, tears and sweat. [...] You ask, what is our policy? I will say: It is to wage war, by sea, land and air, with all our might and with all the strength that God can give us; to wage war against a monstrous tyranny, never surpassed in the dark and lamentable catalogue of human crime. That is our policy. You ask, what is our aim? I can answer in one word: Victory. Victory at all costs—Victory in spite of all terror—Victory, however long and hard the road may be, for without victory there is no survival.'
loc.hold_this_was_their_finest_hour_speech: Hold 'This Was Their Finest Hour' Speech
loc.hold_this_was_their_finest_hour_speech_d: 'Let us therefore brace ourselves to our duties, and so bear ourselves, that if the British Empire and its Commonwealth last for a thousand years, men will still say, This was their finest hour.'
loc.mers_el_kebir_raid_desc: The French fleet has fallen into the hands of Vichy France, and we cannot allow for it to fall into German hands. No matter how sickening, we must demand the immediate surrender of our former ally's navy, under threat of bombardment.
loc.FRA_scuttle_the_fleet_desc: Foreign forces are making a push to forcibly take control of our naval forces. We cannot allow this to happen, and must scuttle our ships!
loc.women_in_the_workforce_desc: As men leave to go to war, thousands of women take up jobs in factories to keep the war machine running.
loc.scientist_refuge_desc: With the current political climate in Europe, a number of scientists have decided to leave their home country. They have applied for an entry visa in our country. Granting it will give us a bonus to research, but will also upset some people who consider this to be an internal matter that we shouldn't get involved in.
loc.GER_weserubung_sud_desc: To obtain a good staging area for the invasion of Norway we need to move on Denmark first.
loc.GER_weserubung_nord_desc: Norway is a critical strategic point and would be an obvious point of attack for any enemy wanting to disrupt our steel trade with Sweden. We cannot risk our enemies setting up bases in this region.
loc.GER_case_yellow_netherlands_desc: An attack through Belgium forces us to go through too narrow a front. We must expand our war plan to include the Netherlands to avoid the mistakes made in 1914.
loc.GER_case_yellow_belgium_luxembourg_desc: An attack through the Maginot Line is suicide. We will flank it to the north and move through the Ardennes to bypass the heaviest fortifications.
loc.SOV_relocate_industry_from_moscow_desc: Evacuating the heavy machinery of our Moscow factories to the Urals is a huge undertaking, but it is necessary to secure our war production.
loc.SOV_relocate_industry_from_moscow_tt: §RThese effects require control of Moscow when the decision times out.§!
loc.SOV_relocate_industry_from_leningrad_des: Evacuating the heavy machinery of our Leningrad factories to the Urals is a huge undertaking, but it is necessary to secure our war production.
loc.SOV_relocate_industry_from_leningrad_tt: §RThese effects require control of [569.GetName] when the decision times out.§!
loc.SOV_relocate_industry_from_smolensk_desc: Evacuating the heavy machinery of our Smolensk factories to the Urals is a huge undertaking, but it is necessary to secure our war production.
loc.SOV_relocate_industry_from_smolensk_tt: §RThese effects require control of Smolensk when the decision times out.§!
loc.relocate_industry_repair: Some factories will need to be rebuilt!
loc.SOV_order_227_desc: "It is time to finish retreating. Not one step back!"
loc.SOV_scorched_earth_baltics: Execute Scorched Earth in the Baltics
loc.SOV_scorched_earth_moscow: Execute Scorched Earth in the approaches to Moscow
loc.SOV_scorched_earth_caucasus: Execute Scorched Earth in the Caucasus
loc.SOV_scorched_earth_stalingrad: Execute Scorched Earth in the approaches to Stalingrad
loc.GER_reichskommissariats_desc: With the capture of new territories comes resistance and a need for effective administration. As such Reichsminister Alfred Rosenberg has proposed the creation of special occupation regimes which he refers to as the Reichskommissariats, which will help in controlling the local population and dealing with resistance fighters on a more local level than our regular forces could.
loc.reinstate_wilhelm_iv_succession_rights: Reinstate Prince Wilhelm's Right of Succession
loc.reinstate_wilhelm_iv_succession_rights_d: Kaiser Wilhelm III's son was forced to renounce his right of succession by desiring to marry against the approval of the then-head-of-family Wilhelm II. As Wilhelm III has now taken over that role, he might be able to pressure his exiled father in supporting a reversal of this decision.
loc.reinstate_wilhelm_iv_succession_rights_t: The line of succession is altered.\n
loc.modernize_the_succession_laws_desc: The current Kaiser's son, the to-be Wilhelm IV, only has two daughters as heirs. We must secure the line of succession, and so the succession laws must be modernized to allow Princess Felicitas to reign, when the time comes.
loc.request_restoration_of_british_titles_de: In 1917 the British parliament voted to revoke all British peerages and royal titles from German Royal and Princely families. Now that we are allies, and are enjoying excellent relations, perhaps it is time to request the reversal of this decision.
loc.request_restoration_of_british_titles_tt: This will undoubtedly lead to unparalleled rewards...\n
loc.GER_request_polish_war_participation_des: As we are at war with the [SOV.GetName], we require passing our armies through [POL.GetAdjective] territory. As we have vowed to protect them, it is only natural that they should join our war.
loc.GER_reform_austro_hungarian_empire_tt: Request for other Austro-Hungarian successor states to re-form the Empire.\n§RIf they accept, you will inherit all wars they are involved in!§!\n
loc.emergency_factory_conversion_defensive_d: More equipment is desperately needed on the front. We urgently need to convert more factories to produce arms and vehicles to defend our country.
loc.emergency_factory_conversion_offensive_d: Our troops urgently need more equipment. More factories are needed to produce the equipment required to win the war.
loc.war_propaganda_desc: As the world burns around us, our people are woefully unprepared for war. We must rally their support to take up arms for our nation.
loc.desperate_defense_desc: We can't fall back any further. Our soldiers have to dig in and hold the line.
loc.war_bonds_desc: We need more resources for our war economy, and war bonds are just the way to obtain these.
loc.GER_barbarossa_mission_desc: The German Armed Forces must be prepared to crush Soviet Russia in a rapid campaign. The bulk of the Russian Army will be destroyed by daring operations led by armored spearheads.
loc.USA_homeland_defense_desc: The enemy has set foot on the soil of our proud nation. The American people will rise up and push the invaders back into the sea!
loc.USA_establish_personal_communication_wit: A new leader has assumed the role of First Minister in the [ENG.GetName]. We must open a personal dialogue with him, helping us to prepare and coordinate for our inevitable entry into the war.
loc.USA_battle_domestic_isolationism_desc: If isolationist elements would have it their way, we would be defenseless against any hostile nation. For our own good, we must begin deconstructing the prevalent isolationist rhetoric.
loc.USA_emergency_arms_deliveries_desc: France has fallen, and Britain now stands alone against the aggressor, struggling to defend its shores against invasion. Through fiery rhetoric they have indicated their resolve is as strong as ever, and they do not intend to go silently into the night. We owe it to democracy to ensure they are given the means to defend their freedom.
loc.USA_arsenal_of_democracy_decision_desc: Though we shall not yet be dragged into the conflict, we can aid our friends by being their arsenal. Let us make the people understand why this is needed.
loc.USA_women_in_the_workforce_desc: Can you use an electric mixer? If so, you can learn to operate a drill. Throughout the war, over six million American women took up in factories, construction and other physical labor and forever proved that women could do the job just as well as men.
loc.CAN_women_in_the_workforce_desc: Ronnie says: "Keep 'em Coming!" With our men serving in the army, the burden of our military production comes to rest on the shoulders of the women of our nation. Over the course of the war, 800,000 Canadian women took up the jobs those who enlisted left behind, forever proving that women could do the job just as well as men.
loc.CHI_communist_infiltration_desc: There have been reports of Communist groups setting up Base Areas in remote areas of the country. We should send agents to confirm this, so that we can strike against them.\n[Root.GetDiscoveredInfiltration]
loc.CHI_communist_infiltration_none: \n§HWe have not discovered any Communist Infiltration.§!
loc.chinese_infiltration_tt: We will survey our territory in China for Communist Insurgents.
loc.PRC_infiltrate_uprising_header: An §HUprising§! will have the following effects:\n
loc.PRC_infiltrate_uprising_effect_2: Communists will seize control of the state.\n
loc.PRC_infiltrate_uprising_effect_3: Communist militia will appear in the state.\n
loc.PRC_infiltrate_uprising_effect_4: Communist elite divisions will appear in the state.\n
loc.PRC_uprising_is_available: At least one nationalist state has been successfully §YInfiltrated§!.\n
loc.CHI_detect_infiltration_tooltip: We have a §Y10%§! chance of detecting §YCommunist Cells§! in each state they are present.\n
loc.CHI_xian_incident_desc: Our country is weakened by internal fighting while Japan clearly has designs on our territory. We must force the Nationalists and Communists to see reason and form a United Front.
loc.soviet_volunteers_tt: Will receive 100 fighters and 50 bombers from us.\n
loc.owner_of_state_in_faction_tt: All states in Burma are owned by §Y[ROOT.GetName]§! or is in a §Yfaction§! with §Y[Root.GetName]§!.
loc.CHI_expand_the_airlift: Increase the Airlift over the Hump
loc.communist_infiltration_tt: §RIf not counteracted, a successful Communist Uprising would result in the following:§!\n
loc.GER_aid_hun_democratic_civil_war: Intervene in the Hungarian Civil War
loc.GER_aid_rom_democratic_civil_war: Intervene in the Romanian Civil War
loc.GER_mefo_bills_category_desc: In order to fund our growing military industry, and to keep this secret from British and French eyes, we have been forced to use a balance sheet entity to route payments to in the form of promissory notes. If we do not use our political connections to extend the due dates of these notes, we will be forced to repay them and will no longer receive their benefits.
loc.GER_mefo_bills_mission_desc: Our issued bills are soon falling due. We must decide whether to extend them or begin payments.
loc.GER_extend_mefo_bills_desc: Extend the MEFO Bills due date by another 3 months, allowing us to continue to enjoy their benefits for the duration. It will, however, also increase the cost of our eventual payments.
loc.GER_extend_mefo_bills_tt: Decide whether to extend '§YMEFO Bills§!' or begin payments.\n
loc.GER_mefo_bills_mission_tt:
Issue a six-month extension of '§YMEFO Bills§!', to go into effect upon the due date of the current batch of MEFO bills.

The cost of each extension will progressively increase, until war breaks out, at which point reliance on MEFO bills is removed and payment is delayed until after the war's conclusion.
loc.GER_mefo_bills_effect_in_days: The following will happen in [?Root.days_mission_timeout@GER_mefo_bills_mission|H0] days:\n
loc.GER_mefo_bills_extension: Less than 60 days since MEFO Bills were extended.
loc.GER_renew_mefos_desc: The Reichsbank is crucial in rebuilding and rearming our nation. It's clear we made an error in our decision to pay off our debts, and we should extend the MEFO Bills for another few months.
loc.GER_cancel_mefos_desc: We have relied on the Reichsbank for the reconstruction of our arms industry for too long. It is time we made good our promissory arrangement with our arms manufacturers and end this "MEFO Bill" charade.
loc.GER_case_anton_category_desc: The intent behind the creation of Vichy France was always to keep the French colonies and the French fleet out of the hands of the allies. However, it is an agreement we may choose to rescind at any time. We have a plan drawn up to forcibly integrate the area, as well as making a lightning push for the French fleet's base at Toulon.
loc.GER_case_anton_tt2: Does not control the majority of French states in North Africa.
loc.GER_case_anton_desc: Our puppet state in France has outlived its usefulness. We will begin integration into the [Root.GetName] immediately, and, if we move sufficiently swiftly, we may even be able to commandeer the remnants of the French fleet.
loc.GER_case_anton_tt:
Annexes Vichy France in 7 days and seizes the French fleet.

§RFrance will be able to scuttle their fleet unless German troops are in Toulon within 2 days!§!
loc.ban_fascist_party_desc: In the current situation, allowing fascist parties to continue to organize would undermine our ability to govern effectively. Drastic measures will need to be taken.
loc.ban_democratic_party_desc: The parties in the political center have been a thorn in the side of our government for too long. Their insistence on the 'rights' of the individual undermine our efforts to create a better nation for the whole of our population.
loc.ban_communist_party_desc: The Communist Party has been protesting against the government at every turn, sowing discontent and making it hard to govern. It is time to crack down on this.
loc.anti_fascist_raids_desc: We must crack down on fascist elements in our nation for the sake of long-term domestic stability. Their influence is too great, and may potentially become a problem to the government.
loc.anti_democratic_raids_desc: We must crack down on democratic elements in our nation for the sake of long-term domestic stability. Their influence is too great, and may potentially become a problem to the state.
loc.anti_communist_raids_desc: We must crack down on communist elements in our nation for the sake of long-term domestic stability. Their influence is too great, and may potentially become a problem to the government.
loc.anti_neutrality_raids_desc: We must crack down on dissident activities in our nation for the sake of long-term domestic stability. Their political ideals are too far apart from ours, and may potentially become a problem to the government.
loc.object_to_attaches_desc: Our enemies are receiving foreign aid! We must issue a strong objection and demand the removal of any attachés.
loc.infrastructure_building_slot_flag: Has not already received an extra building slot from infrastructure.
loc.war_building_slot_flag: Has not already received an extra building slot from land appropriation.
loc.JAP_ichi_go_desc: The end of the war is in sight. With a final push and determined effort we can bring the conflict to a swift conclusion. However, should we not be able to grasp victory within the next year, we may suffer internal instability as public opinion rises against the increased war effort...
loc.JAP_southern_expansion_desc: Continuing the Navy's doctrine of Nanshin-ron, it is time we encroach on the imperialist and colonialists in the south and expand our domain to cover all of the southern road.
loc.JAP_sue_for_peace_TT: No mainland §YChinese§! or §YKorean§! cores are controlled by §YJapan§! or any of its subjects.
loc.JAP_sue_for_peace_CHI_desc: We have lost our hold on the mainland. The Military thinks it is unlikely that we will be able to recover the lost territories. The civilian government suggests that we should seek terms to at least keep our sovereignty over the islands.
loc.JAP_sue_for_peace_MAN_desc: We have lost our hold on the mainland. The Military thinks it is unlikely that we will be able to recover the lost territories. The civilian government suggests that we should seek terms to at least keep our sovereignty over the islands.
loc.JAP_sue_for_peace_nuke_desc: The enemy has employed a new and most cruel bomb. The war is developing not necessarily to our advantage. We must endure the unendurable.
loc.JAP_sue_for_peace_nuke_mission: Execute nuclear strikes on Japanese soil
loc.JAP_sue_for_peace_nuke_mission_desc: The recent successful test of a nuclear bomb offers an alternative to a full-scale invasion of the Japanese Home Islands. Intelligence suggests that if we wrest control of Okinawa and Iwo Jima away from the Japanese, and reduce their fleet to a mere 30 ships, striking two places in the Home Islands with nuclear bombs in rapid succession will compel the Japanese government to surrender unconditionally.
loc.JAP_request_soviet_support_desc: We require assistance in our current civil war, and the closest likely supporters of our cause are the Soviets to our north. Perhaps we could trade the South Sakhalin Peninsula in return for a group of Soviet volunteer divisions.
loc.JAP_nuke_1: First nuclear strike on Japan executed
loc.JAP_nuke_2: Second nuclear strike on Japan executed
loc.JAP_break_the_london_naval_treaty_desc: The outrageous restrictions of the London Naval Treaty is a threat to the security of our nation. We must have the freedom to build a navy that can stand up to any nation that would challenge what is rightfully ours.
loc.JAP_tora_tora_tora_desc: The first blow awaits. Afterwards, we must continue swiftly, using the momentum we have gained to cripple our enemies before they know what has happened.
loc.JAP_war_with_soviet_union_desc: Our allies in Europe have signed a non-aggression pact with [SOV.GetNameDef]. However, our war cannot wait; we must unilaterally pursue a conflict with the Communists, even if it risks alienating our allies.
loc.prospect_for_resources_desc: Our geologists have found a number of promising resource deposits within our territories. We can spend some capital to develop these fields. Advances in extraction technology might make more deposits viable for exploitation.
loc.institute_press_censorship_fascist_state: These are dangerous times and we can't allow dissenting voices to tear our country apart. Restricting the freedom of the press is necessary to ensure that the truth is heard loud and clear.
loc.institute_press_censorship_democratic_st: These are dangerous times and we can't allow dissenting voices to tear our country apart. Restricting the freedom of the press is necessary to ensure that the truth is heard loud and clear.
loc.institute_press_censorship_communist_sta: These are dangerous times and we can't allow dissenting voices to tear our country apart. Restricting the freedom of the press is necessary to ensure that the truth is heard loud and clear.
loc.institute_press_censorship_neutrality_st: These are dangerous times and we can't allow dissenting voices to tear our country apart. Restricting the freedom of the press is necessary to ensure that the truth is heard loud and clear.
loc.JAP_colonial_independence_desc: With the reconquest of former imperial possessions, it is high time we liberate their people and grant them the independence they deserve.
loc.PRC_return_manchuria_communist_desc: The Japanese imperialists took Manchuria away from its rightful owners - the free people of China. Now that our comrades in Japan have ousted the oppressors, we should ask that it is given back to the people.
loc.JAP_interservice_rivalry_desc: The Imperial Navy and the Imperial Army are locked in a vicious conflict over our limited resources. We have instituted regular conferences to ensure our resources are spent in the right place. Favoring one over the other will have far-reaching consequences.
loc.JAP_war_conferences_cd: The Imperial War Conference has convened in the last 6 months
loc.war_propaganda_against_tension_desc: We must stand up against the threat of [From.GetName]. Our nation depends on every man doing their part to keep us safe.
loc.war_propaganda_against_warmonger_desc: The nation calls for every man, woman and child. A war like that of [From.GetName] could happen here as well.
loc.war_propaganda_against_warmonger_neighbo: Tomorrow [From.GetName] could be our enemy. We need YOU to defend your country TODAY!
loc.develop_taiwan_aluminium_deposits: Develop the Sun Moon Lake Aluminum Industry
loc.JAP_develop_west_papuan_oil_deposits: Prospect the West Papuan Oil Fields
loc.develop_new_york_aluminium_deposits: Develop Aluminium Production in New York
loc.develop_washington_aluminium_deposits: Develop Aluminium Production in Washington State
loc.develop_cuba_steel: Expand Iron Ore Mines in Cuba
loc.develop_quebec_steel: Expand Iron Ore Mines in Quebec
loc.develop_newfoundland_steel: Expand Iron Ore Mines in Newfoundland
loc.develop_west_africa_aluminium_deposits: Exploit Bauxite Deposits in West Africa
loc.develop_west_africa_aluminium_deposits_2: Expand Bauxite Mines in West Africa
loc.develop_sirte_oil_fields: Develop the Oil Fields in the Sirte
loc.develop_caucasus_tungsten_deposits_1: Develop Tungsten Mines in the Caucasus
loc.develop_caucasus_tungsten_deposits_2: Expand Tungsten Mines in the Caucasus
loc.develop_kursk_steel_deposits: Develop Iron Ore Mines near Kursk
loc.develop_kursk_steel_deposits_2: Expand Iron Ore Mines near Kursk
loc.develop_kursk_steel_deposits_3: Strip Mine Iron Ore Deposits near Kursk
loc.develop_Belgorod_steel_deposits: Develop Iron Ore Mines near Belgorod
loc.develop_Belgorod_steel_deposits_2: Expand Iron Ore Mines near Belgorod
loc.develop_Belgorod_steel_deposits_3: Strip Mine Iron Ore Deposits near Belgorod
loc.CHI_suspend_the_inter_party_coordination: We can suspend the IPCC should their work become actively harmful to the country. We can reinstate it later should the situation change.
loc.close_burma_road_explanation: They will lose access to §Y[?THIS.CHI_burma_road_current_level]§! free military factories until the road is re-opened.\n
loc.close_ledo_road_explanation: They will lose access to §Y[?THIS.CHI_ledo_road_current_level]§! free military factory until the road is re-opened.\n
loc.close_hanoi_route_explanation: They will permanently lose access to §Y[?THIS.CHI_hanoi_route_current_level]§! free military factories.\n
loc.close_the_hump_explanation: They will lose access to §Y[?THIS.CHI_the_hump_current_level]§! free military factory until the Hump is re-opened.\n
loc.reopen_burma_road_explanation: They will gain access to §Y[?THIS.CHI_burma_road_closed_level]§! free military factories.\n
loc.reopen_ledo_road_explanation: They will gain access to §Y[?THIS.CHI_ledo_road_closed_level]§! free military factory.\n
loc.reopen_the_hump_explanation: They will gain access to §Y[?THIS.CHI_the_hump_closed_level]§! free military factory.\n
loc.CHI_burma_road_reopen_state: Reopen Burma Road in this state.\n
loc.CHI_burma_road_closed_state: Burma Road closed in this state.
loc.CHI_ledo_road_reopen_state: Reopen Ledo Road in this state.\n
loc.CHI_ledo_road_closed_state: Ledo Road closed in this state.
loc.crisis_solution_in_progress: Already attempting to resolve the crisis.
loc.demobilization_desc: With the threat of war seeming distant, people are no longer willing to accept the hardships of wartime laws. We need to review our laws and consider changing them to quiet the protesters before the situation escalates.
loc.demobilization_economic_desc: With the threat of war seeming distant, people are no longer willing to accept the hardships of a war economy. We should review our economic laws and consider changing them to produce more consumer goods to meet their demands.
loc.draft_dodging_mission_desc: Unless solved quickly, the issue of recruits refusing the draft will only get worse and may lead to people questioning the authority of the government itself.
loc.SOV_seize_manchuria_desc: As a result of the Japanese civil war, [MAN.GetName] has broken free of Japanese rule. We have a golden opportunity to finally establish Soviet rule over the area, if we move quickly.
loc.SOV_return_manchuria_desc: We will return Manchuria to the only rightful people's regime in China.
loc.fascism_on_the_rise_desc: Vocal political elements have begun to speak up in favor of fascist values, finding support with an increasing number of the population. The nation's path to fascism lies open, merely awaiting the choice of peaceful or violent transition.
loc.prepare_for_fascist_civil_war_desc: We have no time to wait for the slow changes in the minds of the people. For their own sake, we must force the matter swiftly, even if some may lose their lives in the process. Unlike a peaceful referendum, a civil war will cause tremendous devastation to our armed forces and the country's industry and infrastructure, but it is also quicker, and ensures we will be able to force our will through more forcefully afterwards.
loc.expand_civil_fascism_support_desc: We must ensure the continuing spread of support for our cause among the people, and encourage them to publicly challenge the authority of the present government. As the position of the government is increasingly undermined and civil unrest continues to mount, it will become easier for us to achieve our goals. This holds especially true if, unlike a legal change in government, these goals involves a more... sinister means of regime change.
loc.army_support_for_fascist_civil_war_desc: Without ample support of the military, any hope of victory in an armed ideological struggle would be vain. We must ensure the loyalty of well-placed units of our military forces.
loc.army_support_TT: Each time army support is increased, 10% is added to the strength of your faction in the civil war, up to a maximum total strength of 70%.\n
loc.ensure_general_loyalty_for_fascist_civil: It is possible certain generals harbor secret sentiments in favor of fascism. We must approach them and ensure their loyalty for when the fighting starts.
loc.ensure_marshal_loyalty_for_fascist_civil: It is possible certain field marshals harbor secret sentiments in favor of fascism. We must approach them and ensure their loyalty for when the fighting starts.
loc.siphon_equipment_stockpiles_for_fascist_: By skimming the nation's equipment stores we can create a minor cache of weaponry to aid us in our future struggle.
loc.formulate_surprise_attack_plan_for_fasci: The enemy has no idea of the impending calamity. We must ensure this remains so, all the while directing our battle plans to make maximum use of the element of surprise.
loc.formulate_surprise_attack_plan_for_civil: The Surprise Attack Plan gives a 25% attack bonus to all divisions on core territory, for 30 days.\n
loc.ignite_the_fascist_civil_war_desc: The time has come to take the plunge. All preparations we deemed necessary have been made. There is no turning back now.
loc.rebuild_the_nation_fascism_desc: After the civil war, the time has now come to rebuild our ruined nation.
loc.open_up_political_discourse_fascism_desc: We must open up the acceptance of diverging viewpoints in the government. Perhaps this will eventually make it possible to affect a peaceful change in the politics of our nation.
loc.discredit_government_fascism_desc: By pointing out our current government's many flaws we can make people think about the ideological causes of these failures.
loc.hold_the_fascist_national_referendum_des: With sufficient support, we may now safely hold a referendum to affect a change of government, without bloodshed.
loc.democratic_on_the_rise_desc: Vocal political elements have begun to speak up in favor of democratic values, finding support with an increasing number of the population. The nation's path to democracy lies open, merely awaiting the choice of peaceful or violent transition.
loc.prepare_for_democratic_civil_war_desc: We have no time to wait for the slow changes in the minds of the people. loc.ensure_marshal_loyalty_for_democratic_ci: It is possible certain field marshals harbor secret sentiments in favor of fascism. We must approach them and ensure their loyalty for when the fighting starts.
loc.siphon_equipment_stockpiles_for_democrat: By skimming the nation's equipment stores we can create a minor cache of weaponry to aid us in our future struggle.

loc.hold_the_communist_national_referendum_d: With sufficient support, we may now safely hold a referendum to affect a change of government, without bloodshed.
loc.military_support_for_fascist_civil_war: Has military support for the civil war.\n
loc.military_support_for_democratic_civil_wa: Has military support for the civil war.\n
loc.military_support_for_communist_civil_war: Has military support for the civil war.\n
loc.blow_suez_canal_desc: We cannot allow our enemies the use of the strategically vital Suez Canal. We must therefore begin preparations to inflict enough targeted damage to the canal so that it will remain out of commission for a lengthy duration. This will greatly limit the enemy's ability to move ships from Asia and East Africa into the Mediterranean.
loc.blow_panama_canal_desc: We cannot allow our enemies the use of the strategically vital Panama Canal. We must therefore begin preparations to inflict enough targeted damage to the canal so that it will remain out of commission for a lengthy duration. This will greatly increase the difficulty for the enemy to move ships from the Pacific to the Atlantic, and vice versa.
loc.rebuild_suez_canal_desc: The Suez Canal is of the utmost importance to our war effort. We must allocate any resources needed to the rebuilding of this great canal, so that we may use it to traverse ships and troops freely between the Mediterranean and the Indian Ocean.
loc.rebuild_panama_canal_desc: The Panama Canal is of the utmost importance to our war effort. We must allocate any resources needed to the rebuilding of this great canal, so that we may use it to traverse ships and troops freely between the Pacific and the Atlantic Oceans.
loc.MAN_banditry_category_desc: The Kwantung Army shows little interest in helping the denizens of Manchuria, seeing it as a military occupation rather than nation building. The government of Manchukuo, such as it is, has been given few resources to maintain order by the Japanese. Into this vacuum of power pours all manner of bandits: sometimes self-styled 'freedom fighters', murdering and stealing in the name of abstract ideals like 'national liberation' or 'proletarian internationalism', but more often without any stated ideology to mask their abuses.
loc.MAN_bandit_raids_desc: Roaming brigands and terrorists are stealing everything not nailed down and burning the rest! Raise more troops and stop them!
loc.PRC_border_clashes_desc: The terrain of China forces everyone to pick their battles carefully. That gives us an opportunity to seize some vulnerable terrain without engaging in all-out warfare.
loc.MAN_pacify_bandits_mission_explanation: Maintain divisions in the state for [?Root.MAN_maintain_control_timer|H0] days to pacify bandits in the region.\n
loc.MAN_pacify_bandits_in_the_northern_count: Pacify Bandits In the Northern Countryside
loc.MAN_pacify_bandits_in_the_eastern_countr: Pacify Bandits In the Eastern Countryside
loc.MAN_pacify_bandits_in_the_western_countr: Pacify Bandits In the Western Countryside
loc.targeted_race_for_the_bomb_desc: We cannot allow others to develop an atom bomb before us. We must do whatever we can to ensure our technological superiority is not threatened.
loc.CHI_border_clashes_desc: The terrain of China forces everyone to pick their battles carefully. That gives us an opportunity to seize some vulnerable terrain without engaging in all-out warfare.
loc.improved_worker_conditions_desc: Factory work is hard and fraught with many hazards. Improving the conditions for our factory workers will reduce output in the short term, but the long term benefits are worth it.
loc.promises_of_peace_desc: History has taught us the horrors of war. We must never let it happen again. It is time for our nation to know peace and prosperity.
loc.refuse_the_tribute_desc: The Soviet demands are bleeding our country dry. We can not allow our so-called "comrades" to exploit us like that.
loc.barbarossa_mission_tt: Applies the §YUnternehmen Barbarossa§! National Spirit until the mission's conclusion.\n
loc.war_propaganda_campaign_running: Already running a war propaganda campaign
loc.JAP_test_the_soviets_desc: We share a long border with [SOV.GetNameDef] in Korea and Manchuria. A large number of potential flashpoints exist where our forces might clash at any moment. For us, this creates an opportunity to test the [SOV.GetAdjective] response to a minor provocation.
loc.JAP_border_conflict_warning_SOV_desc: There has been a clash between our border guards and Japanese soldiers at our shared border in Korea. Intelligence sources in Japan report that this may just be the first step in a larger confrontation. We should reinforce the border with Japan immediately.
loc.JAP_border_conflict_escalation_warning_S: Aerial recon has confirmed major troop movements at the Japanese side of the border. We don't know if or when the Japanese have decided to strike, but we must be ready.
loc.JAP_border_incident_forgotten_desc: If we want to use the incident at the Soviet border to Korea, we must strike quickly.
loc.JAP_escalate_incident_to_border_conflict: It appears that the Soviets are not backing down from the conflict. At this point, we must either escalate to an armed confrontation or back down ourselves.
loc.JAP_border_conflict_time_until_cancelled: At the current rate, we can only sustain combat operations for so long before we need to break off combat.
loc.JAP_border_conflict_escalate_conflict_de: The conflict at the border with [FROM.GetNameDef] has stalled. Perhaps by escalating further and committing more troops to the theater, we can still achieve a victory.
loc.JAP_border_conflict_escalate_to_war_desc: Fighting in the disputed region has been going on for a while now, and shows no sign of stopping. We must be prepared to take the next step and see this conflict as the first step in a general war.
loc.JAP_border_conflict_back_out_of_conflict: The danger of this conflict spiralling out of control and becoming a full-scale war between our countries is simply too big. We should cut our loses now and send out diplomatic feelers to the other side.
loc.sov_jap_border_conflict_won: Experience from the border clash in Korea:
loc.recall_von_lettow_vorbeck_desc: With the Hohenzollern restored to the throne, the old Lion of East Africa once again offers his services.
loc.GER_sharpen_air_safety_regulations_desc: With more rigid safety regulations in place, we can prevent some of the more common causes for catastrophic accidents, including those with airships.
loc.MAN_recruit_bandits_north_desc: Every bullet spent hunting down bandits is one less available for the fight to come. Instead of fighting our own subjects, we should offer them a way to redeem themselves through service to the Emperor.
loc.MAN_recruit_bandits_west_desc: Every bullet spent hunting down bandits is one less available for the fight to come. Instead of fighting our own subjects, we should offer them a way to redeem themselves through service to the Emperor.
loc.MAN_recruit_bandits_east_desc: Every bullet spent hunting down bandits is one less available for the fight to come. Instead of fighting our own subjects, we should offer them a way to redeem themselves through service to the Emperor.
loc.MAN_recruit_bandits_generic_desc: Our prisons and work camps are filled with those who once fought against us. We need every soldier and every rifle in the fight for our freedom. The Emperor could show his legendary mercy and grace by giving these criminals a way to redeem themselves through service.
loc.MAN_release_bandits_desc: The former criminals and lowlives have shown that they are willing to sacrifice for their Emperor and can now be safely released back into society.
loc.MAN_raise_manchu_banner_desc: In the days of old, the Qing Emperors could call upon their bannermen to fight in their wars. Although times have changed, the same principles apply. The house of the Qing requires the services of their banners once more.
loc.MAN_disband_the_banners_desc: Their service complete, the Manchu banners can once again be sent to their homes and families - until they are required once again.
loc.MAN_fund_underground_gun_shops_desc: While they don't gain the same economies of scale as major factories - and have a very mixed quality control - distributing weapons production to smaller workshops spread around the country is the best way to increase production in a hurry.
loc.MAN_remove_underground_gun_shops_desc: The weapons workshops we created have served their purpose. It is time to return to a more organized form of weapons production.
loc.MAN_divert_machine_tools_desc: With the Railways under our control, we can ensure that some shipments of machine tooling get 'lost' in an 'administrative error'.
loc.MAN_prepare_to_seize_arms: Prepare to seize Japanese Arms Depots
loc.MAN_prepare_to_seize_arms_desc: The depots and supply dumps spread around the country are poorly guarded. A well-planned and timed assault could take them with a minimum of casualties, giving us access to modern arms and at the same time depriving the Japanese of ammunition and supplies. Spending more time and resources on this will allow us to seize more depots.
loc.MAN_can_prepare_more_tt: Further preparations can still be made to seize additional depots.\n
loc.develop_baghdad_oil_fields: Develop Az Zubair and Nahr Umr Oil Fields
loc.burma_road_expansion_tt: Has completed either §YThe Burma Road§! or §YBurma Road§! focus, or is in a faction or a subject of a country that has.
loc.generic.8.d: We have used the world's first nuclear weapon, firmly placing us in the lead of the current arms race. Our immense efforts have paid off, and for now the world will have no choice but to marvel at our power. They might some day match us, but we have ensured they will never outmatch us.
loc.generic.9.d: Others have used the world's first nuclear weapon, placing them firmly in the lead of the current arms race. Despite our best efforts, we are left with no defense and no means of retaliation. Utterly outmatched, we have no choice but to redouble our efforts and bridge the gap before they can unleash much more of this devastation.
loc.generic.9.a: The program must get all we can spare.
loc.generic.10.d: Our allies have used the world's first nuclear weapon, firmly placing our alliance in the lead of the current arms race. Though we have been outmatched, the weapon is mastered by our ally, ensuring our ability to retaliate should any enemy master the atom, themselves.
loc.wtt_denmark.1.d: With the severance of contact after the invasion, the Icelandic Parliament has taken control of the nation's own foreign affairs. This is understood to be a temporary measure, until the end of the occupation.
loc.news.331.t: Iceland Takes Control of Foreign Affairs
loc.news.331.desc: With the capitulation of its union partner Denmark, the Icelandic Parliament has taken control of its own foreign affairs, and in doing so has essentially become a fully independent nation. The newly-elected provisional governor has already proclaimed Icelandic neutrality in the current conflict, despite the invasion of its parent nation.
loc.wtt_britain.24.d: With the current war putting a strain on British convoys, our Eastern neighbours have become increasingly anxious for the use of our air and naval bases, from which they hope to expand their protective coverage of their convoy routes. A British envoy by the name of Malcolm MacDonald has now arrived to propose the return of Northern Ireland to sovereign Irish control, in return for our immediate entry into the war on the side of the United Kingdom.
loc.wtt_britain.24.b: The prize is not worth the cost.
loc.wtt_britain.25.d: British fleets have appeared outside our fleet's main harbors, and we have received an ultimatum demanding the immediate surrender of our navy. If we do not sail our ships to British ports immediately, the British admiral has threatened to open fire.
loc.wtt_britain.25.b: We shall never let any other nation take our fleet!
loc.wtt_britain.26.d: The French have made the wise decision to sail their ships to our ports. We now have complete control over the French fleet.
loc.wtt_britain.26.a: At least we kept it out of the hands of the Germans.
loc.wtt_britain.27.d: The French have rejected our demands. We are now left with the unenviable choice of backing down or turning on our erstwhile allies...
loc.wtt_britain.27.a: We cannot allow the French fleet to serve German interests!
loc.wtt_britain.27.b: This is too unpalatable. We must back down.
loc.news.332.desc: Yesterday, British naval units blockaded their French counterparts in important naval bases in North Africa, issuing an ultimatum for the French to sail to British ports immediately and surrender control of their fleet, or the British would open fire upon their former ally. Faced with superior firepower, the French accepted the ultimatum, and their fleet is now under British control.
loc.news.332.e: They will continue the fight under the British.
loc.news.333.desc: Yesterday, British naval units blockaded their French counterparts in important naval bases in North Africa, issuing an ultimatum for the French to sail to British ports immediately and surrender control of their fleet, or the British would open fire upon their former ally. Upon French rejection of the British demands, an exchange of gunfire took place that sank at least one French battleship and severely damaged sizeable portions of the French fleet.
loc.news.333.a: We did what had to be done.
loc.news.333.d: We will not soon forget this treachery!
loc.wtt_britain.28.d: The Irish Government has accepted our proposal, and have joined our cause in return for Northern Ireland.
loc.wtt_britain.29.d: The Irish Government has rejected our proposal, refusing to join our fight for Democracy.
loc.wtt_britain.29.a: Who will help them when the Germans come for them?
loc.wtt_britain.30.d: The American government, with the gracious support of the American Committee for Defense of British Homes, has sent us an emergency shipment of old rifles, equipment, and some artillery pieces. It is too varied an assortment to be of true use for our army, but they will no doubt go a long way to hastily equipping the Home Guard garrisons.
loc.wtt_britain.30.a: They have saved us from invasion!
loc.wtt_germany.1.d:
Latent dissatisfaction with Hitler's rule has come to a head with the current crisis, caused by the administration's move to remilitarize the Rhineland. A number of Wehrmacht generals have rallied behind the well-known Field Marshal August von Mackensen, who has put in motion plans aiming to depose Hitler, and to remove the Nazi party from Germany.

With the split in the German high command becoming clearly apparent even abroad, foreign powers have elected not to protest against the remilitarization, more concerned with the growing internal German instability. The aging Field Marshal has moved quickly, already establishing a provisional government, to which scores have flocked in their opposition to the Nazi government.

The military coup is already well on its way.
loc.wtt_germany.1.a: Purge this Nazi scum from our lands!
loc.wtt_germany.2.d: After the recent harsh treatment and forced expatriation in their home country, many of our displaced German comrades have flocked to our environs. With some leadership, we have managed to create a number of divisions from these eager recruits, and they now stand ready to fight our enemies!
loc.wtt_germany.3.t: Germany Lifts Exile of Wilhelm II
loc.wtt_germany.3.d: Germany has invited Wilhelm II to return to his fatherland as Kaiser. With recent tumultuous events, this may aid the Germans in establishing peace and stability to their nation. The eyes of the world are upon us, however, as many have not forgotten the terrific conflict the old Kaiser plunged us into a mere two decades ago.
loc.wtt_germany.3.a: We must allow him to return and lead his people.
loc.wtt_germany.3.b: We must stop him - we cannot risk another Great War.
loc.wtt_germany.4.d: In the midst of ecstatic celebrations, Wilhelm II has returned as Kaiser to the German Empire! The Netherlands is owed a debt of gratitude for allowing him safe refuge these past decades, and for refusing his extradition to our former enemies on multiple occasions. Though the nation has suffered much in the recent civil war, it is hoped that the Kaiser's return will bring further stability and unity.
loc.wtt_germany.4.a: He shall undoubtedly lead the nation well.
loc.wtt_germany.5.t: Netherlands Prevents Return of the Kaiser
loc.wtt_germany.5.d: The dastardly Netherlands, having so long nobly offered Wilhelm II refuge, have now blocked the Kaiser's attempts at crossing the border to Germany, and have escorted him back to his residence, Huis Doorn. The Dutch cite concerns for the stability of the continent as their reasons for denying the Kaiser's return to the German throne.
loc.wtt_germany.5.a: We shall give them some more immediate concerns!
loc.wtt_germany.5.b: Perhaps they have a point... We have other candidates.
loc.wtt_germany.5_tt: The old Kaiser may well be able to aid his son in his rule.\n
loc.wtt_germany.6.d: Our forces, after clearing the area surrounding Huis Doorn of Dutch forces, found the Kaiser in good health and returned him to Germany in motor convoy. Wilhelm II triumphantly crossed the border only a few hours ago, and solemnly accepted the responsibilities of Kaiser of the German Empire upon his arrival in Berlin.
loc.GER_fascism_civil_war_tt: The fascist supporters start a civil war.\n
loc.wtt_germany.7.d: With the gradual spiral deeper into [From.GetNameDef]'s sphere of influence, our economy has become more and more dependent on that of our ally. When, today, the Germans at last moved to take further control over our economy, we were powerless to stop them. As a result, German control over our foreign policy has reached unprecedented levels.
loc.wtt_germany.7.a: We must make do with the situation... For now.
loc.wtt_germany.8.t: Germany Offers Support for Monarchist Coup
loc.wtt_germany.8.d: [From.GetNameDefCap] has approached pro-monarchy and anti-fascist elements of the Italian government and the underground with plans for the assassination of Mussolini and the institution of Vittorio Emanuele III as leader of the nation. The Germans ensure us they can handle the assassination; all we have to do is affirm our willingness to create a replacement government, and to pledge our future military support to German endeavours.
loc.wtt_germany.8.a: We must look to the Monarchy in the time ahead.
loc.wtt_germany.8.b: Preposterous! We will never abandon our ways!
loc.wtt_germany.9.d: Elements in the Italian government and underground have accepted our proposal for a coup. They are making preparations for a swift seizure of power for the King, as soon as the assassination has happened.
loc.wtt_germany.9.a: We can set our plans in motion.
loc.wtt_germany.10.d: The elements of the Italian government and underground we contacted have told us, in not too gentle terms, that they are uninterested in our proposal for a coup. They have threatened to reveal our plans to the Italian government if we dare make the same offer again.
loc.wtt_germany.11.d: The German plan has been put in action and Mussolini was shot in his car in the streets of Rome today. King Vittorio Emanuele III has taken the reins of the nation, and has pledged to join the Central Powers alongside [From.GetNameDef].
loc.wtt_germany.12.d: Our plan has been executed flawlessly, and Vittorio Emanuele III has taken up the mantle of leadership of his nation. His first act was to sign a treaty ensuring Italian entry into the Central Powers alliance.
loc.wtt_germany.13.d: With our support, [From.GetOldName] has taken the lead in the reunification of the Austro-Hungarian empire. Treaties between the involved parties were signed this morning, undoing two decades of separatist sentiment. The new unified government immediately pledged their military support to our cause, becoming a member of the Central Powers.
loc.wtt_germany.13.a: Our old ally has returned to our side.
loc.wtt_germany.14.d: [From.GetNameDefCap] has approached us with an offer that they say may benefit both parties. In light of the current political situation, and the threat on our Eastern border, the Germans propose to issue a guarantee that they will come to our military aid in the event that we come to war with [SOV.GetNameDef]. In return, they only ask for the return of their lost territories of Danzig and Poznan.
loc.wtt_germany.14.a: Their military might is more use to us than land.
loc.wtt_germany.14.b: We will never give up our lands!
loc.wtt_germany.15.d: The Poles have decided to accept our offer, and have made arrangements to transfer their border provinces to us. They have put their faith in us, and urge us to stand ready in case of [SOV.GetAdjective] aggression..
loc.wtt_germany.15.a: This blight of Versailles undone at last!
loc.wtt_germany.16.d: The Poles have decided to reject our offer. In powerful language they have made it clear that they shall never relinquish their territory willingly, and would rather face any enemy alone if this is the price for help.
loc.wtt_germany.16.a: We will never relinquish our claims!
loc.wtt_germany.16.b: Perhaps we must come to terms with it.
loc.wtt_germany.17.d: The German government has cracked down on communism, and has banished them abroad. As a result we are now receiving a large influx of communist ideologues from our neighbour...
loc.wtt_germany.17.a: If only this doesn't destabilize the country too much...
loc.wtt_germany.17.b: Increase police funding and limit their influence over our politics!
loc.wtt_germany.18.d: At long last we have freed our country from the grip of our enemies, and those loyal citizens who rose up to support our cause may now finally return to their homes. As a nation, we may begin the long and arduous process of rebuilding our nation. The country's leadership, in turn, is free to begin looking ahead at what might come in the future: democracy, or a return to the old monarchy.\n\nOne last thing remains to be taken care of, however. With the end of the civil war, our troops have managed to capture a large group of the Nazi leadership. Now, there only remains the decision of what to do with this unsavory part of our recent history.
loc.wtt_germany.18.b: Imprison them for life, they might come in useful in the future.
loc.wtt_germany.19.d: Recent German rhetoric aimed against us has become increasingly harmful to our reputation in Europe. Slanderous accusations of our supposed 'aggression' are beginning to cause fear and misunderstanding of our intentions.
loc.wtt_germany.19.a: Start a series of huge military exercises to intimidate them all!
loc.wtt_germany.19.b: We must salvage our reputation and smooth relations.
loc.wtt_germany.19.c: Do they think we care what they say of us?
loc.wtt_germany.20.d: Continuing to embark on their slanderous campaign against us, the Germans have now announced the creation of a new alliance. There is little doubt it is aimed against us and that they mean to interfere with our sphere of influence.
loc.wtt_germany.20.a: They better stay out of our sphere of influence!
loc.wtt_germany.20.b: We must not give them any excuse to escalate further.
loc.wtt_germany.21.d: The Germans have offered membership to a nation in our immediate sphere of influence. The threat to the motherland is clear!
loc.wtt_germany.21.a: We must strike to secure the rest!
loc.wtt_germany.21.b: We cannot afford to antagonize the West.
loc.wtt_germany.24.d: Through both official and unofficial channels, the Germans have made it clear that [GER.GetGreatRedMenaceEventDesc1]. They have urged us to remember that we are not alone in enduring [GER.GetGreatRedMenaceEventDesc2], and that, if only the continent unites, we can beat down the Bear.
loc.SOV_GREAT_RED_MENACE_EVENT_DESC_1_COMMUN: [SOV.GetNameDef] is, and has been, the greatest threat to the stability of Europe since its inception two decades ago
loc.SOV_GREAT_RED_MENACE_EVENT_DESC_1_EXILES: [SOV.GetAdjective] imperialism is, and has been, a major threat to the stability of Europe all throughout recent history
loc.wtt_germany.24.a: Let us hope they are right.
loc.wtt_germany.25.d: The Soviet Union has made a concerted effort to alleviating the concerns of European nations. With a public announcement they have claimed they do not have any hostile intentions, and hope that their restrained reaction to the belligerent German rhetoric will speak for them.
loc.wtt_germany.26.d: Last night Wilhelm II, our beloved Kaiser, passed away peacefully in his sleep. Despite his long exile, providence had seen fit to allow his return to the fatherland well before his death, and ever since his return he had led our nation well. His son, Friedrich Wilhelm, has now taken up the reins of the nation, and after his coronation will become known as Wilhelm III.
loc.wtt_germany.27.d: Last night August von Mackensen, our most esteemed field marshal, passed away peacefully in his sleep. His celebrated exploits in the Great War and in ousting the fascist oppressor from our homeland, will long be remembered. The exiled Kaiser's son, Friedrich Wilhelm, has filled the power vacuum of the nation, and after his coronation will become known as Wilhelm III, ruling the Empire as the first Kaiser since the 1918 abdication of his father.
loc.wtt_germany.28.t: Germany Lifts Exile of Wilhelm II
loc.wtt_germany.28.d: The German Empire has lifted the exile of Wilhelm II, and has now approached the Netherlands for the return of the old Kaiser. It seems that, despite numerous extradition appeals to the Dutch government to hold him accountable for starting the Great War, the warmongerer will return to take the reins of the German Empire.
loc.wtt_germany.28.d.2: The German Empire has lifted the exile of Wilhelm II, and has now approached the Netherlands for the return of the old Kaiser. In the face of Dutch refusal to allow his return, they have now escalated this to a military conflict!
loc.germany.60.c: They shall not stand alone! Rally the British to war!
loc.wtt_germany.29.d: The German Empire has lifted the exile of Wilhelm II, and has now approached the Netherlands for the return of the old Kaiser. It seems that, despite numerous extradition appeals to the Dutch government to hold him accountable for starting the Great War, the warmongerer will return to take the reins of the German Empire.\n\nThe French have already decided that this is unacceptable, and seem intent on issuing an ultimatum backed by military force. Popular opinion in Britain is against a war, but if we refuse to stand by the French our alliance with them will be dissolved.
loc.wtt_germany.29.d.2: The German Empire has lifted the exile of Wilhelm II, and has now approached the Netherlands for the return of the old Kaiser. In the face of Dutch refusal to allow his return, they have now escalated this to a military conflict!\n\nThe French have already decided that this is unacceptable, and seem intent on issuing an ultimatum backed by military force. Popular opinion in Britain is against a war, but if we refuse to stand by the French our alliance with them will be dissolved.
loc.germany.61.c: We must come to the aid of the Dutch!
loc.wtt_germany.30.d: The German Empire has lifted the exile of Wilhelm II, and has now approached the Netherlands for the return of the old Kaiser. It seems that, despite numerous extradition appeals to the Dutch government to hold him accountable for starting the Great War, the warmongerer will return to take the reins of the German Empire.\n\nThe French seem content to limit their response to this outrage to diplomatic objections, and public opinion in Britain is firmly against a war.
loc.wtt_germany.31.d: The British are refusing to support us against Germany, claiming that the question of German monarchy is an internal one. If we go to war with the Germans, it looks like we will be on our own.\n\nPublic opinion in France is against a war, but Germany will only grow stronger, and the return of the Kaiser may well elicit renewed imperialist sentiment. Issuing an ultimatum would be less threatening without Britain on our side. Should we proceed against them alone?
loc.wtt_germany.32.d: Though popular support for a war is lacking in Britain, the British government has recognized the threat posed by the Germans and they have offered us their full support. We will issue a final ultimatum to Germany to prevent a return of the warmongerer Kaiser. If they refuse, it is time for our forces to drive deep into Germany and put an end to their tyrannical regime!
loc.wtt_germany.33.d: The British and French have refused to accept the return of our Kaiser, calling it an 'outrage' that the supposed instigator of the Great War is allowed to return to his throne. They are mobilizing their forces against us and have issued an ultimatum that our forces back down at once and return the Kaiser to his exile, or our nations are at war.
loc.wtt_germany.33.a: We cannot back down! Long live the Kaiser!
loc.wtt_germany.34.d: The British have seen reason and accepted the return of the Kaiser, but the mad French are refusing to back down! Claiming that this incident constitutes a direct threat against the security of their nation, they are mobilizing their forces and may sweep in across the border at any moment! We are at war!
loc.wtt_germany.35.d: Despite our clarification that the return of Wilhelm II to the German throne would be viewed as an act of war, Germany has refused to back down and return their Kaiser into exile, ignoring our warning. This means that despite our best efforts to maintain peace, war has once again broken out in Europe.
loc.wtt_germany.38.desc: [FROM.GetNameDefCap] has spewed more and more rhetoric lately, urging for a return to colonialism. They have now, through diplomatic channels, issued a formal request to restart the lease of their old enclave in Qingdao, in hopes of regaining their long lost empire. Though potentially another unequal treaty in our era of humiliation, this could perhaps we can use this to come to a lucrative arrangement...
loc.wtt_germany.38.a: Demand the continued support of Von Falkenhausen in return.
loc.wtt_germany.38.b: Perhaps they will be useful to have in the area.
loc.wtt_germany.38.c: We will never again give up our sovereign territory!
loc.wtt_germany.39.desc: Chinese officials have contacted us with an offer of a potential trade, which they say will satisfy both parties. They propose to return Qingdao to rightful German hands, in return for a guarantee that we will not recall Von Falkenhausen's mission.
loc.wtt_germany.39.b: No, we must keep our options open.
loc.wtt_germany.40.desc: [From.GetNameDefCap] has utterly rejected our demands for the return of Qingdao. We will have no choice but to seek its return at a later date.
loc.wtt_germany.41.desc: The German Empire has accepted our proposal for a trade for Qingdao. They have guaranteed us the continued support of Von Falkenhausen.
loc.wtt_germany.42.desc: The German Empire has rejected our proposal for a trade for Qingdao. They must not have desired their enclave very badly.
loc.wtt_germany.43.desc: The German Empire has spewed more and more rhetoric lately, urging for a return to colonialism. Despite the nature of their loss of Qingdao - our seizure of it in 1914 - the Germans have now decided to open diplomatic negotiations, requesting the return of their old enclave in Qingdao. Perhaps we can use this to come to a lucrative arrangement...
loc.wtt_germany.43.a: Demand the Germans withdraw Von Falkenhausen in return.
loc.wtt_germany.43.b: They will never set foot in the Far East again!
loc.wtt_germany.44.desc: Japanese officials have contacted us with an offer of a potential trade, which they say will satisfy both parties. They propose to return Qingdao to rightful German hands, in return for the immediate withdrawal of Von Falkenhausen's mission in China.
loc.wtt_germany.46.desc: The German Empire has accepted our proposal for a trade for Qingdao. They have immediately withdrawn the mission of Von Falkenhausen to China.
loc.wtt_germany.48.desc: [From.GetNameDefCap] has accepted our demands, and arranged for the immediate return of Qingdao to German hands!
loc.wtt_germany.49.t: Nazi Expulsion Takes Heavy Toll on [nazi_state_withdrawn.GetName]
loc.wtt_germany.49.desc: We have finally managed to secure control over [nazi_state_withdrawn.GetName], but fighting has been severe. The Nazis grow ever more fanatical and desperate as we advance, often fighting until the surrounding area lies in ruins. There have also been reports of scorched-earth tactics, in accordance with Hitler's 'Nerobefehl'.\n\nWe can undoubtedly expect further destruction on this scale until we end this war.
loc.wtt_germany.49.a: A small price to rid our fatherland of them.
loc.wtt_germany.50.desc: With the capture of Berlin, our troops discovered the corpse of Hitler in a bunker in the city. Choosing death over seeing anti-fascist elements take over the country, the leader evidently took his own life rather than risk capture.\n\nIn his stead, Heinrich Himmler has now stepped up to lead the Nazis, and he has already affirmed that the government will not abate in their fight against 'anti-German treason'.
loc.wtt_germany.50.a: It is the beginning of the end for the Nazis.
loc.wtt_germany.51.desc: The war has become so protracted and devastating that now all adult Germans have been called upon to serve. Though they may not fit in with our ideological views, the captured Nazi leadership does possess skills that may prove useful to us in this time of need.\n\nWe could make them an offer to regain their freedom after the war, in return for lending their skills to our cause now.
loc.wtt_germany.51.a: Yes, partly reinstate the Nazi leadership.
loc.reinstate_nazi_leadership_TT: Fascist-only advisors are once more eligible for service.\n
loc.wtt_germany.51.b: No, they are fine where they are.
loc.wtt_germany.51.c: We cannot allow them to regain freedom should the war go badly... Hang them!
loc.wtt_germany.52.desc: Democratic elements in [From.From.GetName] have launched a civil war to re-establish free elections and return power to the people. They may well require our help, and their success will ensure a future ally for our cause.
loc.wtt_germany.52.b: They will have to solve their own problems.
loc.wtt_germany.53.desc: German sentiment in our southern neighbor Austria has increased remarkably now that we have been allies for some time. It would not be outside the realm of possibility that a referendum calling for unification with Germany might meet with the Austrian people's approval. Should we urge the Austrian government to hold one?
loc.wtt_germany.53.a: Yes, the Lesser German solution was a mistake.
loc.wtt_germany.53.b: No, the Greater German solution would be a mistake.
loc.wtt_germany.54.t: German Government Urges Referendum for Unification
loc.wtt_germany.54.desc: The German government has approached us with a proposal for unification, should the Austrian people wish it. They urge us to hold a referendum so that we may find out.
loc.wtt_germany.55.desc: The Austrian people have voted in favor of unification with their northern brethren. Integration of the Austrian states and their military will commence immediately.
loc.wtt_germany.55.a: A great day for the German Question!
loc.wtt_germany.56.desc: Our war with the Soviet Union is not proceeding well, and we risk losing everything. To our West, Germany has undergone rapid changes the last few years, but is now a stalwart defender of democratic values. Arranging a quick return of the old German Territories of Danzig and Poznań would undoubtedly save millions from oppression under the Soviet boot.
loc.wtt_germany.56.b: Never! What is Polish shall fall Polish!
loc.wtt_germany.57.t: Poland Offers Return of German Territories
loc.wtt_germany.57.desc: As the Polish war with the Soviet Union is not going well, their government has reached out to us through secret channels, offering the rapid return of our old territories of Danzig and Poznan. They argue that their people will undoubtedly fare better under democratic German rule, than under the oppressive Soviet boot.
loc.wtt_germany.57.a: Such guile! We will keep them safe.
loc.wtt_germany.57.b: No, we cannot risk Soviet retaliation.
loc.wtt_germany.58.desc: The Austrian people has rejected our calls for unification, preferring to continue Austrian independence at least for a little while longer.
loc.wtt_germany.59.desc: The German government has decided to accept their old territories, and has solemnly vowed to stand for the protection of the region's Polish citizens.
loc.wtt_germany.59.a: At least they will be safe.
loc.wtt_germany.60.desc: The German government has informed us that they are unable to accept our offer. They fear Soviet retaliation, and so feel they cannot take the risk.
loc.wtt_germany.60.a: Who will help them when all have fallen to the Reds?
loc.wtt_germany.62.desc: With the end of the recent war, the companies we have issued MEFO bills to are now pushing for us to issue payments. They claim there is no longer any necessity to withhold payments 'for the good of the fatherland'.
loc.wtt_germany.63.desc: The [GER.GetAdjective] government has issued legislation stipulating the reintegration of Alsace-Lorraine and Luxemburg into the [GER.GetName]. Mass drafting of our population has already begun...
loc.wtt_germany.65.desc: [From.GetNameDefCap] has informed us that they require our land to march their forces to the Soviet enemy. They remind us that we are under their protection against the communists, and that we therefore owe them our assistance in their current war.
loc.wtt_germany.65.a: They are correct - we will join their war.
loc.wtt_germany.65.b: Who do they think they are?! Never!
loc.wtt_germany.66.desc: [From.GetNameDefCap] has decided to join us in our war against [SOV.GetNameDef], which has the added benefit of allowing our forces passage through their country.
loc.wtt_germany.67.desc: [From.GetNameDefCap] has rebuffed our demands for war participation, and continues to close their borders to our troops. If the Poles are not willing to grant us access for our forces, then we shall simply have to go over them.
loc.wtt_germany.68.desc: The [From.GetAdjective] government has approached us with a proposal for reintegration of the old Austro-Hungarian Empire. Since pro-imperial sentiment is quite high in our respective nations, they claim that it would be in the best interests of everyone to unite our nations.
loc.wtt_germany.68.a: An excellent idea! We shall accept.
loc.wtt_germany.69.desc: The [From.GetAdjective] government has responded to our proposal for reintegration of the old Austro-Hungarian Empire. They acknowledge the benefits of this move, and have stated their willingness to integrate their nation with ours, should all parties accept.
loc.wtt_germany.70.desc: The [From.GetAdjective] government has responded to our proposal for reintegration of the old Austro-Hungarian Empire. In no uncertain terms, they have indicated that they will never willingly accept our leadership in such a venture.
loc.wtt_germany.71.t: The Re-formation of the Austro-Hungarian Empire
loc.wtt_germany.71.desc: Both our neighboring Austro-Hungarian successor states have accepted the proposed re-integration of their lands into our nation, and thereby re-forming into the Austro-Hungarian Empire. The signing of the treaty of re-unification has been greeted by ecstatic masses in the streets, and the [GER.GetAdjective] government has eagerly welcomed us back into their alliance.
loc.wtt_germany.71.a: A new era for Austria-Hungary dawns.
loc.wtt_germany.72.desc: As we are already closely allied, [From.GetNameDef] has come with a proposal to aid us in the expansion of our military economy, by integrating our economies more fully. This would greatly aid our military growth, but it would also make us subordinate to them in matters of foreign policy.
loc.wtt_germany.72.a: A great idea - our fates were intertwined anyway.
loc.wtt_germany.72_tt: §RWe will lose control over any subjects we might have.§!\n
loc.wtt_germany.72.b: We think not; our sovereignty is too valuable.
