Government-directed propaganda has flared up, extolling the "glorydays of the Empire" in a clear effort to rally the population behind the wide-spread national reforms and a return to imperial norms.\n\nAs a part of these, the [From.GetOldAdjective] government has announced the restoration of [From.GetNameDef], and has changed the nation's official name to reflect this.
loc.wtt_news.57.desc: As Poland and Lithuania are once more governed by a single state, the [From.GetOldAdjective] government has begun drawing on history for its propaganda in an effort to unite the people behind its policies. 'Historical experts' bombard the population with the various ways in which a united Poland and Lithuania could stand against the threats on their borders, recounting tales from the height of power of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth. The approach seems to be having some effect on redirecting the people's outrage, and on focusing their thoughts on the glorydays of old.\n\nToday, the [From.GetOldAdjective] government has taken this one step further and proclaimed the restoration of the Commonwealth, re-naming the country to '[From.GetNameDef]'.
loc.wtt_news.57.a: If God is with us, then who is against us?
loc.wtt_news.57.b: Will it survive partition this time?
loc.wtt_news.58.desc: With the [From.GetOldAdjective] conquest of the other Low Countries, their government has quite vocally defended its actions. They now claim to be the immediate and lawful successors to the United Kingdom of the Netherlands, and have repudiated the Treaty of London of 1839 with the claim that it was, at the time, criminally forced upon their government by outside forces. Thus, as the nation never ceased to be, [From.GetOldNameDef] has merely reasserted control over land that already belonged to them.\n\nFollowing through on their words, the [From.GetOldAdjective] government has renamed the country to '[From.GetNameDef]', and large propaganda efforts are already under way in an attempt at unifying the people, using current global crises as an external threat to rally against.
loc.wtt_news.58.b: Yes... This does all seems to be an internal affair...
loc.wtt_news.59.desc: With the [From.GetOldAdjective] conquest of the other Central American states, their government has quite vocally defended its actions internationally. Considering itself the lawful successor to the Federal Republic of Central America, it has branded the nations that seceded in the late 1830s as illegal separatist governments, and consistently refers to the recent fighting as their rightful attempts at 'reasserting control' over these territories.\n\nFollowing through on their words, the [From.GetOldAdjective] government has renamed the country to '[From.GetNameDef]', and large propaganda efforts are already under way in an attempt at unifying the people, using current global crises as an external threat to rally against.
loc.wtt_news.59.a: A necessary first step to ascending the world stage.
loc.wtt_news.59.b: Another United States of the Americas arises.
loc.wtt_news.60.desc: With the conquest of all of lands belonging to the Baltic states, the [From.GetOldAdjective] government has now begun increasing moves towards integration of the newly-conquered territories. As a result, in an attempt to rally the people behind the state, there has been an increase in pan-nationalist propaganda with clear support from the government.\n\nA [From.GetOldAdjective] official was quoted as saying "The Baltic countries have always felt a strong kinship to each other. It is only natural that they should be unified, especially in light of the threats on our borders. Only by standing together can our peoples remain independent and free." They have therefore now proclaimed "true Baltic unity", renaming the country to '[From.GetNameDef]'.
loc.wtt_news.60.a: It is necessary for our survival.
loc.wtt_news.60.b: But will the new state be strong enough?
loc.wtt_news.61.desc: Having secured all of the pre-war Ottoman lands, the [From.GetOldAdjective] government, as representatives of the Ottoman successor state, has now begun with re-integrating these territories. Government-directed propaganda has flared up, denouncing the partitions of the Allies in the Great War, and extolling the "glorydays of the Empire" in a clear effort to rally the population of newly-conquered lands behind the wide-spread national reforms and a return to imperial norms.\n\nAs a part of these, the [From.GetOldAdjective] government has announced the restoration of [From.GetNameDef], and has changed the nation's official name to reflect this.
loc.wtt_news.61.a: We have undone the partitions at last!
loc.wtt_news.61.b: The Eternal State has risen again...
loc.wtt_news.62.desc: The main powers of continental Europe lay conquered before [From.GetOldNameDef], and for the first time the recent dreams of a united Europe seem attainable. A variety of 'experts', presumably on the government payroll, have already begun repeatedly citing the current political situation as the only way to "prevent future European conflict".\n\nIn further efforts to give the outward appearance of a "nation for all Europeans", government reforms on the national and the local level are being pushed through at an impressive rate, and as a part of those it was announced today that the country shall henceforth be known as '[From.GetNameDef]', so that "all Europeans may feel welcome in it".
loc.wtt_news.62.a: Is this an end to all European war?
loc.wtt_news.62.b: Let us see if they can pull it off.
loc.wtt_news.63.desc: As the [From.GetOldAdjective] nation grows into its neighbours, government attempts at creating historical continuity have become more and more apparent, evidently in an attempt to unify the people. The achievements of the Great Zimbabwean Empire have been strongly romanticized, but incessant propaganda seems to be having an effect on public opinion.\n\nToday, the [From.GetOldAdjective] government has taken this one step further and re-named the country to '[From.GetNameDef]', an announcement that was greeted by exuberant crowds in the streets of the major cities.
loc.wtt_news.63.b: Is this the end of colonial Africa?
loc.wtt_news.64.desc: The [From.GetOldAdjective] military advance seems utterly unstoppable, and the idea that many sneered at in recent years - the creation of a new Roman Empire - now seems entirely within the Italians' grasp. Most continental European powers that could oppose them have been virtually eliminated, leaving the Italians free to enforce their will upon the conquered peoples.\n\nIn addition to beginning integration of what they have already begun referring to as "reconquered Roman Territories", the Italian government has now announced the rebirth of the Roman Empire, renaming the nation to '[From.GetNameDef]'.
loc.wtt_news.65.desc: As the [From.GetOldAdjective] advance continues, the historical parallels have not gone unnoticed by those versed in Persian history. Notable public figures have already begun comparing this expansion to the times of Cyrus the Great, and nationalist pride is rising throughout [From.GetOldAdjective] society.\n\nAs government control is expanded over the new territorial acquisitions, and as the government rides this wave of high public approval, it has now been confirmed by officials that the nation will be officially renamed to '[From.GetNameDef]'.
loc.wtt_news.65.b: Will it bring peace and stability to the region?
loc.wtt_news.66.desc: [From.GetOldAdjectiveCap] ascendancy has perplexed many military experts across the globe, but the results speak for themselves. In but a few years, the Greeks have utterly dominated the Balkans, reconquered Istanbul, and crushed any organized Turkish resistance in Anatolia. It seems that the ultimate conclusion of over five centuries of Greco-Turkish conflict has now been reached.\n\nTo further bolster national pride, the [From.GetOldAdjectiveCap] government has utilized historical continuity, and styled their military achievements as a 'Byzantine reconquest against the Turkic invader'. As part of this propaganda, and in the midst of an extravagant ceremonial parade in newly-renamed Constantinople, it was announced that [From.GetOldNameDef] has changed its official name to '[From.GetNameDef]'.
loc.wtt_news.67.desc: With the [From.GetOldAdjective] conquest of most of the Arab Peninsula, the government has seized upon a renewed wave of Pan-Arabism spreading through the region. As international disagreements have been 'solved' through the outright removal of obstinate foreign governments through military means, Arab unification has seemed within easy reach, and the [From.GetOldAdjective] government has already shown its willingness to pursue this goal.\n\nWhether merely to 'ride the wave' of this public goodwill, to appeal as a home to all Arabs, or simply to facilitate regional integration, [From.GetOldAdjective] officials have now confirmed that the nation's official name shall be changed to '[From.GetNameDef]'.
loc.wtt_news.67.b: Will this lead to a lasting peace in the region?
loc.wtt_news.68.desc: As the [From.GetOldAdjective] nation grows into its neighbors, government attempts at creating historical continuity have become more and more apparent, evidently in an attempt to unify the people. The achievements of the Majapahit Empire among others have been strongly romanticized, but incessant propaganda seems to be having an effect on public opinion.\n\nToday, the [From.GetOldAdjective] government has taken this one step further and re-named the country to '[From.GetNameDef]' in homage to the region's history, hoping that it is something everyone in the region can relate to.
loc.wtt_news.68.a: This is the end of Asian colonialism!
loc.wtt_news.68.b: They have seized their own destiny.
loc.wtt_news.69.desc: As the [From.GetOldAdjective] nation grows into its neighbours, the government has re-evaluated their departure from the Rattanakosin name. As their present borders more and more resemble those from the kingdom's historical high-point, the achievements of the Rattanakosin Kingdom have been increasingly used to influence public opinion.\n\nToday, the [From.GetOldAdjective] government has taken this one step further and officially re-named the country to '[From.GetNameDef]' in an attempt to draw legitimacy from history.
loc.wtt_news.70.desc: Under the rulership of [FROM.GetLeader], [From.GetOldNameDef] has greatly expanded their borders, surpassing even those of the old Holy Roman Empire. All continental foes that would challenge her rule have been brought to their knees by the [From.GetOldAdjective] military machine, leaving her unopposed to pursue her policies further.\n\nNow, [FROM.GetLeader.GetSheHe] has decreed that the current opportunity shall be seized, and that the nation shall become the spiritual successor of the Holy Roman Empire. To represent this, the nation has now been officially renamed, and with it she has at last achieved the political unification of the region that has eluded the Emperors for centuries.
loc.wtt_news.70.b: Her splendor and glory cannot be denied!
loc.wtt_warlord_vs_prc.1.desc: A delegation from [warlord.GetLeader] has arrived in Moscow to sound us out about possible support in an internal party power struggle. They claim that [communist_china.GetLeader] is not sufficiently committed to the cause of communism and may, in fact, harbor reactionary thoughts and betray the revolution in its most critical phase.\n\n[warlord.GetLeader] instead proposes that we back him, promising eternal and undying loyalty to the communist cause in general and [SOU.GetLeader] in particular.
loc.wtt_warlord_vs_prc.1.a: A loyal puppet may prove useful.
loc.wtt_warlord_vs_prc.1.a_tooltip: This will lead to a war with §H[communist_china.GetNameDef]§! if they refuse.\n
loc.wtt_warlord_vs_prc.1.b: We have no use for such blatant opportunism.
loc.wtt_warlord_vs_prc.2.desc: The representative of the [SOV.GetAdjective] government has informed us that [SOV.GetLeader] harbours grave doubts about the accuracy of [communist_china.GetLeader]'s interpretation of Marxist theory. In this critical phase of the class struggle in China, we must not deviate from the correct application of Marxist-Leninist teachings. It appears that Moscow believes that [warlord.GetLeader] has a better understanding of what is needed to advance the Communist cause in China. As far as Moscow is concerned, the party would do well to accept [warlord.GetLeader] as the new chairman, or suffer the displeasure of [SOV.GetLeader].
loc.wtt_warlord_vs_prc.2.a: Send [communist_china.GetLeader] to Moscow to straighten this out.
loc.wtt_warlord_vs_prc.2.b: We will never bow to traitors!
loc.wtt_warlord_vs_prc.3.desc: [SOV.GetLeader] reportedly remains unconvinced of our loyalty or ability to lead. The [SOV.GetAdjective] government continues to support [communist_china.GetLeader] as chairman of the Communist Party of China.
loc.wtt_warlord_vs_prc.4.desc: Desperate appeals by [communist_china.GetLeader] to [SOV.GetLeader] did little to sway the Soviets to his side. Recognizing a lost fight, [communist_china.GetLeader] has publicly acknowledged his mistakes and promised to work with us to ensure the victory of the revolution.
loc.wtt_warlord_vs_prc.10.desc: Faced with the choice between giving up power or calling the Soviet bluff, [communist_china.GetLeader] chose the latter. Unfortunately, it seems that [SOV.GetLeader] was not bluffing and hostilities have commenced. Given our precarious position, we have been subjected to intense pressure by both sides, with the Soviets demanding we help them in ousting the traitor.\n\nRefusal, they say, would be the same as choosing to side with [communist_china.GetLeader].
loc.wtt_warlord_vs_prc.10.b: We will not be party to this.
loc.wtt_warlord_vs_prc.21.desc: A message from [From.GetLeader] has arrived, demanding that we step up deliveries of the previously agreed on economic aid.
loc.wtt_warlord_vs_prc.21.a: This is the price we pay.
loc.wtt_warlord_vs_prc.22.desc: Despite the usual protests from [From.GetLeader], he has agreed to increase the pace of the payments as we requested.
loc.wtt_warlord_vs_prc.22.a: He should pray we don't alter the deal any further.
loc.wtt_warlord_vs_prc.23.desc: [From.GetLeader] has answered our request for additional support with a flat refusal, claiming that his nation is utterly unable to make the "absurd" payments we demand.
loc.wtt_warlord_vs_prc.23.a: He promised, and we will get what is ours!
loc.wtt_warlord_vs_prc.23.b: Let it slide just this once.
loc.wtt_warlord_vs_prc.31.desc: A message from [From.GetLeader] has arrived, saying that our stage of the revolutionary struggle is a particularly vulnerable one that could easily fall victim to the counter-revolution. His special representative has been instructed to keep a close watch on proceedings in our nation and advise us on how to achieve victory in the class struggle.\n\nThe note goes further to say that any deviation from his 'suggestions' will be considered a sign that reactionary elements have taken hold of our government, and that the necessary steps would then be taken.
loc.wtt_warlord_vs_prc.31.a: We welcome the opportunity to learn.
loc.wtt_warlord_vs_prc.31.b: We don't need anyone to tell us what to do.
loc.wtt_warlord_vs_prc.32.desc: [From.GetLeader] has welcomed our special representative and appointed him his personal adviser. We now have very good control about their internal and external policies.
loc.wtt_warlord_vs_prc.33.desc: Although receptive of the idea, [From.GetLeader] has politely but firmly declined our demand of being allowed to influence their policies more directly. It would seem that we are 'unfamiliar' with the conditions on the ground and should leave implementation of Marxist teachings to the local experts.
loc.wtt_warlord_vs_prc.33.a: Maybe we need to repeat ourselves more forcefully.
loc.wtt_warlord_vs_prc.34.desc: [From.GetLeader] has ignored increasingly more forceful demands that he transfer the payments we agreed on previously. Even requesting that he come to Moscow to explain himself are left unanswered.
loc.wtt_warlord_vs_prc.34.a: So he wants to test us?
loc.wtt_warlord_vs_prc.35.desc: [From.GetNameDefCap] has requested that the Chinese communists join into a single faction, a People's Front, to defeat the nationalists, reactionaries and foreign invaders under one banner.
loc.wtt_warlord_vs_prc.35.a: The People are the heroes now!
loc.wtt_warlord_vs_prc.36.desc: [From.GetNameDefCap] has refused the obviously advantageous path of a People's Front united against the nationalists, reactionaries and foreign invaders, stating instead that our alliance would be 'against [From.GetAdjective] interests.'
loc.wtt_warlord_vs_prc.36.a: We will just have to go it alone.
loc.wtt_warlord_vs_prc.36.b: We may as well disband the United Front altogether.
loc.wtt_manchukou.1.desc: It appears that [From.GetLeader] has made the decision to finally spread his authority to the far areas of China. A representative from the [From.GetAdjective] Government has arrived, demanding that we bow to the one true Emperor of China, the Son of Heaven, [From.GetLeader]. Refusing to do so, he continued, would be punished as treason of the highest order.
loc.wtt_manchukou.1.a: This whole Republic thing was never going to work anyway.
loc.wtt_manchukou.2.desc: [From.GetLeader] has sent the messenger back with a personal note, promising strict obedience and welcoming [MAN.GetLeader] as the true leader of China.
loc.wtt_manchukou.3.desc: [From.GetLeader] has replied to our generous offer with a string of insults and curses, making statements about the ancestry and personal qualities of Emperor [MAN.GetLeader] that are both inaccurate and very offensive.
loc.wtt_manchukou.11.desc:
The new Five Year Plan detailing how our government expects to grow the economy over the coming years is slowly coming together. Significant differences still exist between the various departments about where the main focus should be. 

While a consensus exists that an expansion of the heavy industry should be the goal, what these new factories should be producing is still under discussion. 

A decision by must be made to break the deadlock.
loc.wtt_manchukou_bandit_sabotage.21.desc: Reports have come in from one of our factories in [FROM.GetName], reporting that a major fire broke out last night. Local firefighters are still tackling the blaze, but are confident that they will have the fire under control by the end of the day. The damage to the factory appears to be significant, as the fire appears to have started in the storage area for highly flammable chemicals.\n\nMilitary Intelligence has started a thorough investigation to find out how the fire could break out despite the strictest safety measures. First leads indicate arson as a strong possibility.
loc.wtt_manchukou_bandit_sabotage.21.a: These terrorists must be hunted down!
loc.wtt_manchukou_bandit_sabotage.23.desc:
Sometime during the last night, a major railway bridge in [FROM.GetName] collapsed under the weight of a passing ammunition train. Rescue and recovery efforts have been made difficult by the secondary explosions from the ammunition. The crew of the train is still missing, presumed dead.

Military Intelligence has dispatched a team to investigate the site as soon as it is safe to do so, to find out how a sturdy bridge could collapse with no warning signs.

Local witnesses report seeing a small group in the valley below the bridge on the day before the collapse. Their whereabouts are currently unknown.
loc.generic.11.d: The war that has torn our nation has at last ended. We may now begin the task of unifying the people, and of repairing the destruction.
loc.generic.11.a: Together, we will work for a better future!
loc.generic.12.d: Military intelligence indicates the [From.GetAdjective] intend to use large-scale demolitions and blockships to sabotage the Suez Canal. If we wish to stop them, we do not have much time.
loc.generic.13.d: Military intelligence indicates the [From.GetAdjective] intend to use large-scale demolitions and blockships to sabotage the Panama Canal. If we wish to stop them, we do not have much time.
loc.generic.14.d: [From.GetAdjective] envoys have lodged a strong diplomatic protest with our government regarding the presence of our attachés in nations they are currently in a military conflict with. They demand the immediate recall of our military mission.
loc.generic.14.b: Our attachés will be sent where we please.
loc.attache_political_power_tt: Due to our relative strength and our §Yopinion§! of them this will have the following effect:\n
loc.attache_fascism_tt: Due to the amount of §YFascism§! support in our country this will have the following effect:\n
loc.attache_communism_tt: Due to the amount of §YCommunism§! support in our country this will have the following effect:\n
loc.attache_democratic_tt: Due to the amount of §YDemocratic§! support in our country this will have the following effect:\n
loc.attache_neutrality_tt: Due to the amount of §YUnaligned§! support in our country this will have the following effect:\n
loc.generic.15.d: In response to our demands, [From.GetNameDef] has withdrawn their military mission to our enemies.
loc.generic.16.d: In spite of our demands, [From.GetNameDef] has refused to withdraw their military mission to our enemies, stating that "we have no business interfering with internal [From.GetAdjective] affairs".
loc.canals_tt: Wrest control of the canal's banks within the next month to prevent the enemy plan.
loc.japan_border_conflict.1.desc:
As part of maintaining the demarcation line on the border between us and [JAP.GetNameDef], a work party was sent out to check the demarcation markers near Lake Khasan. When approaching the border, the work party was taken under fire by a local Japanese outpost. 

 We have lodged a formal diplomatic protest, but the Japanese ambassador maintains that the work party was sent to move the markers to allow us to claim more territory.

The Japanese have assured us that they will respect the border but will not allow any "tampering" with the current demarcation and will respond with force should we attempt to do so.

 This effectively means that we can no longer move freely about our territory in the area.
loc.japan_border_conflict.2.desc: Following a clash between [SOV.GetAdjective] and Japanese forces in the border area around Lake Khasan, the [SOV.GetAdjective] forces are reportedly in full retreat. Japanese units have occupied a number of strategic hills around the area and begun to fortify their positions.\n\nDuring the battle, the Japanese captured a number of [SOV.GetAdjective] tanks, which have been shipped to Tokyo for evaluation.
loc.japan_border_conflict.2.a: We have settled this matter honorably.
loc.japan_border_conflict.2.b: We must prepare an appropriate response.
loc.japan_border_conflict.3.desc: Following a clash between [SOV.GetAdjective] and Japanese forces in the border area around Lake Khasan, the Japanese ambassador in Moscow has requested a cease-fire. \n\n Several Japanese assaults on [SOV.GetAdjective] positions failed with heavy casualties during the battle, raising concerns in the Japanese military about the capabilities of their forces.
loc.japan_border_conflict.3.a: It is better to fail with honor than never to try at all.
loc.japan_border_conflict.3.b: Our forces have acquitted themselves well.
loc.japan_border_conflict.4.desc: Fighting between Japanese and [SOV.GetAdjective] forces around Lake Khasan has died down after both sides withdrew from the contested region to regroup and resupply. Recognizing the futility of further offensives, the Japanese military has asked for a cease-fire and negotiations to fix the border.
loc.japan_border_conflict.5.desc: Fighting continues between Japanese and [SOV.GetAdjective] forces around Lake Khasan. In an effort to break the deadlock, Japanese forces in other areas have also started to engage [SOV.GetAdjective] forces in that sector. Intelligence suggests that the Japanese may soon reinforce the attack with fresh troops transferred from other parts of their Empire.
loc.japan_border_conflict.6.desc: Fighting continues between [FROM.GetAdjective] and [JAP.GetAdjective] forces around Lake Khasan. In an effort to break the deadlock, [FROM.GetAdjective] forces in other areas have also started to engage [JAP.GetAdjective] forces in that sector. Intelligence suggests that [FROM.GetNameDef] may soon reinforce the attack with fresh troops transferred from other parts of their country.
loc.wtt_prc.30.desc: Working under the cover of night, our comrades in [JAP.GetManchuriaPuppet] have sabotaged a Japanese factory. Details about the damage done are sparse as the Imperialists have declared the entire area a restricted area.\n\nThis fact alone should tell us that we have struck true. It remains to be seen if this will prompt the Japanese into action.
loc.wtt_prc.31.desc: Working under the cover of night, our comrades in [JAP.GetManchuriaPuppet] have managed to sabotage a vital bridge. The small commando force reports that the bridge has been completely destroyed and took an ammunition train with it as it collapsed. \n\n\they have made sure to be seen by the locals, making it clear that this was an act of sabotage. It remains to be seen if this will prompt the Japanese into action.
loc.wtt_prc.32.desc: We have successfully ambushed and annihilated a Japanese patrol in [JAP.GetManchuriaPuppet]. Their bodies were left at the scene to make sure the Imperialists get the right message. \n\nTime will tell if they consider this action reasons enough to go to war.
loc.wtt_prc.20.c: We should withdraw from the continent altogether.
loc.wtt_germany.1006.t: The Kaiser is preparing a coup!
loc.wtt_germany.1006.desc: The Servizio Informatzione Militaire has reported of suspicious activity in the monarchist inner circles. It appears that some of those loyal only to the king have recently been in contact with foreign agents, German ones at that. It seems as though the monarchists are being recruited and rallied into opposing our great leader, but all is not lost. We can send in the gangs to take care of them, and beat them back while we still have a chance to do so. How should we proceed?
loc.wtt_germany.1006.a: Banda Carità can deal with them
loc.britain.25.desc: The [ENG.GetAdjective] government, seemingly alarmed after the fall of [DEN.GetNameDef] alongside the presence of [GER.GetAdjective] diplomats in [ICE.GetNameDef] has invited us to join the allies as co-belligerents. They cite concerns about their national security in which the [GER.GetNameDef] could potentially use Icelandic bases as a springboard for raids on English convoys or cities.\nTheir threats were thinly veiled, citing the current world situation that any claims of “supposed neutrality” from our side is eclipsed by the safety of British citizens and the war against fascism.
loc.britain.25.a: We have no choice but to join [ENG.GetFactionName]
loc.britain.25.c: We must abide by our neutrality, even if it means invasion
loc.britain.26.desc: Our diplomats currently stationed in [ICE.GetNameDef] has sent us a flurry of messages that the fledgling [ICE.GetAdjective] government has been threatened with occupation by English forces unless they submit. Lacking any other viable alternative [ICE.GetLeader.GetName] has requested our protection from the English threat. Maybe a base so close to the British mainland would be beneficial to us?
loc.britain.26.a: The people of [ICE.GetNameDef] must be protected
loc.britain.27.desc: The [ICE.GetAdjective] government has rejected our ultimatum for compliance, citing their belief in neutrality and the vehement opposition to being dragged into a war which they had no part in.\nThey charge that with this order their independence is both being infringed upon and flagrantly violated. Sadly this is modern war, and in modern war there can be no neutral parties; while we regret this course of action we must do what we must do.
loc.CHI_secure_internal_politics_desc: If our government is to survive in the confusing mess of Chinese politics, we must not be distracted by internal squabbles. Any internal opposition must be rooted out.
loc.CHI_strenghten_warlord_authority_desc: In order to secure our zone of control, and ensure that we aren't undermined by the Kuomintang, the communists and the Japanese, we must strengthen the authority of [ROOT.GetLeader].
loc.CHI_uplift_the_cavalry_regiments_desc: Our region has a long and proud tradition of horsemanship and equestrianism. We should honor these traditions, and ensure that our cavalry is held in the highest regard, and brought to the forefront of our armed forces.
loc.CHI_uplift_the_mountain_brigades_desc: The lands of the Chinese interior are harsh and difficult to traverse. As such we must train special brigades with the purpose of fighting in hilly and mountainous terrain, so that we can properly protect our lands.
loc.CHI_cooperation_with_the_nationalists_de: The Nationalists offer the best chance of uniting the country and defeating the Japanese. We should ensure that they don't see us as a threat.
loc.CHI_cooperation_with_the_nationalists_ef: [WTT_communist_china.GetNameDefCap] and the Warlords who have sided with the Communists can start §HBorder Conflicts§! with us in response to this.
loc.CHI_technological_cooperation_desc: Our cooperation with the Central Government will ensure that we have access to any new technologies they develop.
loc.CHI_new_model_province_desc: While the Central Government struggles to drag the country into the modern age, we will implement reforms on a much smaller scale and be regarded as shining beacons of progress in contrast to the backwardness of the rest of the nation.
loc.CHI_root_out_corruption_desc: For decades, government officials have been abusing their position to fill their own pockets and harass the population, turning a blind eye on criminals that lined their pockets. This ends now.
loc.CHI_embrace_the_opium_trade_desc: A country needs money to function. In our current situation, we can't be too choosey about the sources.
loc.CHI_land_reform_desc: The communists are pursuing an aggressive program of land redistribution, winning them many supporters amongst the peasants. We should implement a less radical program to get the population on our side.
loc.CHI_reform_the_administration_desc: All our efforts on the governmental level are for naught if they are not executed at the local level. We must ensure that the officials on the spot are able and willing to execute our orders.
loc.CHI_join_the_republican_government_desc: With our territory strengthened and our government reformed, it is time to approach the Central Government and demand a seat at the table. Once we are a recognized party in the government, we can use this new-found legitimacy to build support in other states to grow our base of power.
loc.CHI_power_struggle_desc: Our political influence on state affairs has grown significantly. We can now try to approach other countries as equals.
loc.china_nationalist_focus: the Focus Tree of Nationalist China
loc.china_communist_focus: the Focus Tree of Communist China
loc.CHI_cooperation_with_the_communists_desc: The KMT has tried and failed to build a modern nation. The country is more divided than ever, the peasants live in fear of the government, corruption is rife at all levels of the government, and the Japanese Imperialists sit right behind the borders. Perhaps Communism is the better vision for the future.
loc.CHI_cooperation_with_the_communists_effe: Warlords who have sided with the Nationalists can start §HBorder Conflicts§! with us in response to this.\n
loc.CHI_land_redistribution_desc: The peasants are being ruthlessly exploited by the landlords, even though they form the basis of our economy. Making the people who farm the land the people who actually own the land will lead to a much fairer and more productive society.
loc.CHI_ideological_education_desc: The basis of our future success is made today. Future generations must be taught the fundamental truth that all history is a history of class struggle, and their role within it.
loc.CHI_land_value_tax_desc: Taxing the land directly gives us a much more stable and fair taxation system that takes money from those that have the most to spare.
loc.CHI_judiciary_reforms_desc: If our administration is to make a difference, we must ensure that all judges have been sufficiently educated to apply our laws correctly.
loc.CHI_communist_administrators_desc: The old guard of administrators is too entrenched to ever be swayed to our way of thinking. We should replace them entirely with new, younger administrators with more radical ideas.
loc.CHI_join_the_chinese_soviet_desc: The revolution can only succeed if the Communists stand together. Of course, we must ensure that no counter-reactionary elements within the party attempts to derail the revolution before it even started.
loc.CHI_the_yanan_incident_effect_tt:
Ask §H[SOU.GetNameDef]§! for support to replace §H[WTT_communist_china.GetNameDef]§! as communist leader.
This will lead to a war with §H[WTT_communist_china.GetNameDef]§! if they refuse.
This deal with §H[SOU.GetNameDef]§! will open us up to demands from [SOU.GetLeader]
loc.CHI_the_yanan_incident_desc: The current leader of the party has turned his back on the socialist brothers in the Soviet Union. We should approach the Soviets to secure their support in carrying the revolution through all of China.
loc.CHI_opposition_effect_tooltip: §H[WTT_current_china_leader.GetNameDef]§! can start a border war with us in response to this.
loc.CHI_opposition_desc: The Central Government is corrupt and weak. The Communists wish to destroy 5000 years of Chinese history. This situation calls for a Great leader, someone who is willing to make the hard choices and unite the country - by any means necessary.
loc.CHI_public_works_desc: The population must be able to see that we are working for their own good. A few high-profile projects will serve as useful propaganda props and give them a taste of what all China could look like if they supported us more.
loc.CHI_labor_reform_desc: The methods and customs of working in China have developed over millennia. It is time to move them into the modern age.
loc.CHI_rural_militias_desc: In the widespread countryside, military support often takes a long time to reach the site of an incursion. By raising local militias, we can ensure that any invader will find it hard to move through our country side.
loc.CHI_war_taxes_desc: Desperate times require desperate measures. While the war continues, we must mobilize the economic resources of the population to the fullest possible extent.
loc.CHI_seek_japanese_support_desc: Both the Central Government and the communists have powerful allies. If we want to stand supreme at the end of this, we will have to find a guardian of our own.
loc.CHI_personal_leadership_desc: Splitting command of the military risks an officer with ideas above his station trying to usurp power. We must ensure that our soldiers are always loyal to the government.
loc.CHI_personal_leadership_tt: §YChen Jitang§! becomes available as a level §Y3§! Field Marshal
loc.CHI_personal_leadership_custom_tt: [ROOT.GetLeader] gains one of the following traits at random: §Y$brilliant_strategist$§!, §Y$career_officer$§!, §Y$cavalry_officer$§!, §Y$infantry_officer$§!, §Y$old_guard$§!, §Y$politically_connected$§!, §Y$war_hero$§!.
loc.CHI_cult_of_personality_desc: The people need to know who leads them through these dark days into the bright future beyond, as well as the many outstanding qualities that man has.
loc.CHI_provoke_border_clashes_desc: We can not risk all-out war just yet. A small, contained conflict allows us to gain valuable ground without being crushed outright. Ideally, we will strike right when our opponent has committed his forces elsewhere.
loc.CHI_defensive_posture_desc: This conflict is a marathon, not a sprint. To challenge the other factions too early would invite disaster. For now, we will remain on the defensive.
loc.CHI_rapid_mobilization_desc: To become a viable contender for the leadership of China we must increase the size of our military. We will develop new methods to streamline training and create an army that can measure up to any challenge.
loc.CHI_proclaim_rival_government_desc: It is time to make our ambitions official. We require nothing less than full control over China, and we will negotiate with the rest of the world on equal terms.
loc.CHI_industrial_investment_desc: While our resources may be limited, we should still funnel what capital we have into improving our economy.
loc.CHI_public_education_reform_desc: The foundation of a modern nation is knowledge and science. We must first improve and strengthen that foundation.
loc.CHI_local_arms_production_desc: As long as we are seen as merely an insignificant minor faction in the war, we can not rely on deliveries of weapons from outside. We will have to develop our own arsenals to build weapons.
loc.CHI_long_term_economic_planning_desc: Our bureaucratic apparatus is not as big as that of the Central Government. This allows us to cut much of the red tape that hinders economic development and focus our modest efforts to get the highest possible payoff.
loc.CHI_local_arms_development_desc: Producing crude copies of foreign guns is not enough. If we want to keep pace with the rest of China, we must develop new weapons.
loc.90_days_tt: This will take about 90 days to implement.\n
loc.CHI_heavy_weapons_development_desc: With resources scarce, we must make maximum use of what little heavy firepower we have. We should order new artillery guns to be developed.
loc.CHI_anti_opposition_campaigns_desc: Our enemies are gathering just beyond our borders. We can not allow them to remain there unchecked. A series of small offensives will throw them back and buy us more space.
loc.CHI_anti_opposition_campaigns_effect_too: Unlocks £decision_icon_small §HDecisions§! to start §HBorder Conflicts§! with Warlords who are not cooperating with the same side as us.\n
§RNo Warlords have sided with the Communists yet.§!\n
§RNo Warlords have sided with the Nationalists yet.§!\n
loc.CHI_institute_cross_border_raids_desc: We won't be taken seriously as an independent contender in the struggle for Chinese leadership unless we demonstrate to the world that we are able and willing to fight for our lands. A few small incursions will show our determination and might allow us to seize some undefended territory.
loc.CHI_institute_cross_border_raids_effect_: Unlocks £decision_icon_small §HDecisions§! to start §HBorder Conflicts§! with Warlords and [WTT_communist_china.GetNameDef]\n
loc.CHI_provoke_border_clashes_effect_toolti: Unlocks £decision_icon_small §HDecisions§! to start a §HBorder Conflict§! with [WTT_current_china_leader.GetNameDef]\n
loc.CHI_invite_foreign_investors_desc: Humiliating though it may be, the best way to industrialize our nation is by approaching the very people who have been exploiting us.
loc.CHI_mission_to_germany_desc: The pariahs of Europe have made great strides in reforming their country and returning to their former glory. We can learn much from them.
loc.CHI_give_falkenhausen_citizenship_desc: The German advisors have rendered stellar service in rebuilding and modernising our military. We should ensure that they can stay here, no matter how the political situation might change.
loc.falkenhausen_tt: Any other nation has already offered citizenship to von Falkenhausen.
loc.CHI_chinese_general_staff_desc: A well-organised General Staff is the key to planning complex operations. We should learn from the German example and create a similar organisation.
loc.CHI_wargaming_division_desc: We should form a special department in the General Staff that focuses on predicting future wars and develops new tactics and strategies on how to beat our enemies. They could perhaps use some sort of computational device to simulate a world war...
loc.CHI_closer_ties_with_germany_desc: Our mission to Germany has opened up the possibility of even greater cooperation, including a loan to fund further industrial development.
loc.CHI_purchase_tanks_desc: Armored vehicles will form the spearhead of modern warfare. We should make a modest purchase of tanks in preparation of forming the first armored units of the Chinese army.
loc.CHI_chinese_panzers_desc: German tanks are, without a doubt, the best in the world. We should learn from their example and develop our own tanks on their patterns.
loc.CHI_tank_plant_desc: With research into new tanks progressing, we can now invest in a dedicated plant to build them.
loc.CHI_experimental_mechanised_unit_effect: Gain a Division with 2 §YLight Tank§! and 4 §YMotorised§! battalions\n
loc.CHI_experimental_mechanised_unit_desc: Theorists in Europe have long debated the best way to employ tanks. It seems that a unit combining mobile infantry with quick tanks is the best approach. We will raise such a unit.
loc.CHI_combined_arms_warfare_desc: While trucks are good enough for the initial experimentation in modern mechanised warfare, their poor cross-country performance and lack of armor makes them ill-suited for front-line work.
loc.CHI_hire_soviet_designer_desc: The Soviets have experimented with tanks for a long while and have some of the best tank designers in the world. We could hire one of them to design armored fighting vehicles for us.
loc.CHI_joint_tank_development_desc: After the experience gained from working with Soviet designers, we should form joint design teams to better coordinate the work and learn from each other.
loc.CHI_mission_to_the_soviet_union_desc: The Soviet Union has expressed an interest in China, mainly to create a counter-weight to Japanese expansionism. We should send a mission to Moscow to see if our goals align.
loc.CHI_rapprochement_with_soviet_union_desc: While we may have some ideological differences with the Soviet Union, it is clear that they have the same interests as we do. We should formalize our new relationship and sign a mutual non-aggression pact to show the world that we stand together.
loc.CHI_invite_soviet_advisers_desc: The Soviets have offered to send a military mission to help us rebuild our military.
loc.soviet_advisers_tt: The Soviets have already sent a military mission to a faction in China
loc.CHI_the_soviet_volunteer_group_focus_des: Our airforce remains woefully understrength compared to other powers in the region. The Soviets seem open to the possibility of sending a volunteer group.
loc.CHI_reach_out_to_france_desc: Even though the French have repeatedly humiliated us and forced new concessions on us, in the current situation we may well end up needing their help.
loc.CHI_small_arms_expertise_desc: The individual rifle is still the decisive weapon in our army. We should focus our modest resources on keeping as modern as possible in this area.
loc.CHI_elite_mountaineers_desc: Alpine Warfare is an entirely different beast than combat in the plains. We should train specialised divisions in this art to make the best use of our terrain.
loc.CHI_free_mountain_template_tt: Gain a template with §Y7 Mountain§! and §Y2 Artillery§! battalions.\n
loc.CHI_heavy_weapons_desc: An army without supporting artillery is unable to stand up to any serious attack. We must ensure that our army is adequately equipped for this.
loc.CHI_guarantee_the_hanoi_route_desc: The Route through Hanoi and up north to our borders offers the highest possible amount of support from the outside world, should a war break out with Japan.
loc.CHI_construction_battalions_desc: If there is one thing our country has in abundance, it is people. We can form special units that require little more than shovels to do essential military engineering work.
loc.CHI_french_military_mission_desc: The French Army is one of the best trained in Europe. We can learn much from them.
loc.CHI_french_drill_desc: The French experience in the Great War has created an army that excels in defense. By adopting their training methods and standards, we can improve our own defensive capabilities.
loc.CHI_modern_logistics_desc: Without a working logistics system, we will not be able to maintain an army in the field.
loc.CHI_renegotiate_the_unequal_treaties_des: For too long, the westerners have dictated how we should conduct business inside our own borders. Their citizens are protected from our laws, and we have no say about how they do business in our cities. This must end. We will stand as equals to them once again.
loc.CHI_one_china_policy_desc: In the turmoil that followed the revolution, a number of areas broke away and attempted to form their own states. Some merely ceased to listen to the central government, others pretended they were sovereign states again. Strengthened as we are now, we will publicly declare that we lay claim to the old Chinese borders that have stood for centuries before.
loc.CHI_integrate_tibet_desc: The experiment of Tibetan independence is over. A military invasion is an option, but we should try and bring them back into the fold by peaceful means.
loc.CHI_conquer_tibet_desc: Tibet occupies strategically critical terrain between us and India. They are too weak to defend themselves. We must intervene to protect our southern flank.
loc.CHI_renounce_the_mcmahon_line_desc: The old border drawn up between the Imperial Government and the British was never correct, even when the British pretended to respect it. For decades, we have been too weak to contest it. No more.
loc.CHI_demand_mongolia_desc: Trapped between us and Russia, Mongolia could fall to them at any time. We must strike first.
loc.CHI_lessons_of_war_completed: Completed all steps of §YArmy Reform§! and §YLessons of War§!\n
loc.CHI_anti_imperialism_desc: We stand today as one of the first nations that have thrown off the shackles of colonialism. it is our sacred duty to ensure that the other peoples in Asia can determine their own fate as well.
loc.CHI_guidance_and_support_desc: The peoples of Indochina will still need aid in building up their own nations. We will ensure that they don't fall to outside pressure again.
loc.CHI_indian_cooperation_desc: The peoples of India are struggling to throw off the last shackles of colonial oppression. We should reach out to them, support their fight and work together for a brighter future for both of our nations.
loc.CHI_commit_to_korean_independence_desc: The Koreans were the first victims of Japanese occupation. They will stand as a free people amongst the nations of the world once more.
loc.CHI_influence_mongolia_desc: Having Mongolia as a buffer state between us and Russia will secure our northern flank. We just have to ensure that they are able to take care of themselves.
loc.CHI_imperial_legacy_desc: China has stood as the dominant force in the East for millennia, guaranteeing peace and stability in the region. It is time we reclaim our former position.
loc.CHI_overlordship_over_indochina_desc: Indochina has been dependent on Chinese protection since the days of old. The fact that the area fell to the French shows that they are unable to protect themselves.
loc.CHI_dominate_japan_desc: For decades, Japan has posed the greatest threat to our independence. They have allied with the Western Powers to subjugate us before. We can not allow them to launch another attempt. We must strike first.
loc.CHI_secure_the_peninsula_desc: It is in our best interest to ensure that the Korean peninsula will never again be occupied by a hostile power.
loc.CHI_british_cooperation_desc: While they may be the arch-imperialists, working with the British offers the best chance to modernize our air force and ensure a steady flow of supplies.
loc.CHI_burma_road_desc: The Burma Road forms our lifeline with the west. It needs to be protected at all costs and expanded upon to ensure a smooth flow of supplies.
loc.CHI_ledo_road_desc: The Burma Road alone can not sustain us. We must find new ways to bring supplies to keep us in the fight.
loc.CHI_fighter_purchases_desc: Our Air Force needs modern fighters to keep up with foreign threats. Our industry is unable to produce them yet, so we must purchase them abroad.
loc.CHI_camco_desc: If we want to create an independent aviation industry, we must first learn the techniques and methods to assemble and maintain the aircraft we already have.
loc.CHI_local_fighter_production_desc: With the workforce now familiar with basic maintenance tasks, we can continue with producing all components for a modern fighter plane.
loc.CHI_local_bomber_production_desc: After we have mastered production technologies for single-engine airplanes, we can attempt to develop and produce heavier, multi-engined models for ground support.
loc.CHI_the_hump_desc: The airlift operation across the Himalayas is a poor replacement for the other avenues of transport, but it is a lot more difficult to disrupt.
loc.CHI_chinese_expeditionary_force_desc: In order to better coordinate with our allies, the Americans have sent one of the Generals to lead a joint force.
loc.CHI_the_chu_x_po_desc: The Chu X-PO represents the pinnacle of development in China - the first locally developed and produced fighter plane, able to hold its own against any enemy.
loc.CHI_mission_to_the_us_soong_us_decision: As long as §YSoong Mei-Ling§! is a §YPolitical Advisor§! the US will be able to support our war against §YJapan§!\n
loc.CHI_mission_to_the_us_desc: China has long had strong allies in the US. They represent the best chance of getting the support we need.
loc.CHI_hire_chennault_desc: Claire Chennault is an American air warfare theorist who has shown an interest in working for us. We should hire him to rebuild our air force.
loc.CHI_invite_the_flying_tigers_desc: Our friends in America have organized a volunteer group of pilots and bought a number of modern planes to support us. We just need to say so.
loc.CHI_sino_american_cooperative_organizati: American intelligence is willing to work with us to organize special operations behind enemy lines. This can help us to develop our own capabilities in this field.
loc.CHI_light_cruiser_project_desc: The first step in creating a credible blue-water navy is to modernize our cruiser fleet. Our first project should not be too ambitious.
loc.CHI_heavy_cruiser_project_desc: With the success of the previous cruiser design, we can scale it up and improve its performance, creating a more capable ship to defend our fleets.
loc.CHI_naval_aviation_desc: The future of naval warfare is the aircraft carrier. We will never be considered a true naval power unless we possess carriers of our own.
loc.CHI_carrier_air_wing_desc: A carrier is only as good as the planes that fly off of it. We must ensure that these are the most capable and most modern types available.
loc.CHI_investment_into_shipbuilding_desc: A large fleet requires a large industrial base to support it. We should invite foreign investors to help us build up our dockyards.
loc.CHI_order_destroyers_desc: As a first step to naval rearmament, a small group of destroyers should be produced.
loc.CHI_train_marines_desc: Our long coastline is vulnerable to enemy landings, but it also provides the opportunity to attack from an unexpected direction should an enemy invade overland.
loc.CHI_collaboration_with_the_japanese_desc: Whatever their designs on China, the Japanese have made it clear that they are willing to work with us if we show sufficient respect.
loc.CHI_modern_submarines_desc: The Japanese are unwilling to provide us with the technical knowledge to challenge their fleet in open combat, but they consider submarine warfare an auxiliary arm. We, of course, do not necessarily need to share that opinion.
loc.CHI_coastal_patrol_planes_desc: Our long coast lines can only effectively be patrolled from the air. Modern naval bombers will allow us to defend our coasts without expending too many resources.
loc.CHI_three_principles_of_the_people_desc: The founder of the republic, Dr. Sun Yat-Sen, established three fundamental principles that should shape it: Minzu, Minquan and Minsheng - Nationalism, Democracy and Social Welfare.
loc.CHI_welfare_desc: A modern state looks after its citizens, so that in the time of need, the citizens will be able and willing to defend it.
loc.CHI_refugee_relief_agency_desc: With the upheaval of the war, millions have been made homeless. We will create an agency to assist them in finding a new place to stay.
loc.CHI_land_tax_reform_desc: Our finances are in desperate need of reform. Part of that is the need to broaden our tax base.
loc.CHI_refugee_resettlement_desc: The millions of desperate and homeless refugees created by the war need to be settled somewhere. Giving them shelter in our territory means we can keep them as a recruiting pool for our army and the economy.
loc.CHI_new_life_movement_desc: The four virtues of Morality, Honesty, Justice and Loyalty will henceforth guide our citizens to a better and more productive life.
loc.CHI_unemployment_assistance_desc: Unemployment should never reduce a citizen to poverty and destituteness. Hunger is the best ally of the Communists.
loc.CHI_free_hospitals_desc: A great nation does not leave her citizens alone in their time of sickness. By creating a comprehensive health care system, we will ensure an improvement in the overall health of our population. They will rally to defend it.
loc.CHI_rural_schooling_desc: A well-educated population is the key to modernising a nation. We can not rely on a small handful of educated administrators, but need to carry the spirit of knowledge and science into every village.
loc.CHI_democracy_desc: The journey started by Dr. Sun Yat-Sen must eventually lead to a republic. It will no doubt be a long journey, but we take it one step at a time.
loc.CHI_constitutional_reform_desc: The problems facing us today stem, in part, from the lack of a constitution that reflects the realities in China. We must rectify this.
loc.CHI_republicanism_desc: Many in the west wonder if we are sincere about becoming a republic after the western model. We should make a public declaration about our intentions.
loc.CHI_inter_party_coordination_council_des: A first step to turning our country into a functioning multi-party democracy and ending the necessary tutelage of the people will be an organisation that allows other interested parties to have their say in policy making.
loc.CHI_judicial_yuan_desc: Dr. Sun Yat-Sen envisioned a modern republic with a separation of powers. Our judiciary needs to be independent of outside influence and decide cases based on the law, and the law alone.
loc.CHI_control_yuan_desc: Corruption is inevitable in any government. Effective government requires an effort to keep it in check. We will create a separate branch of government, equal to the legislative, executive and judiciary branches.
loc.CHI_examination_yuan_desc: For thousands of years, Chinese bureaucrats were selected in stringent examinations. While the necessary texts may have changed, the principle remains the same.
loc.CHI_executive_yuan_desc: The core of the government is the Executive, which executes the laws. It only makes sense that creating it is the first step to creating a functioning republican government.
loc.CHI_legislative_yuan_desc: The ability of the people to elect a body to make the laws that govern them sits at the heart of the modern republic. Our nation must not be found wanting.
loc.CHI_nationalism_desc: The idea of belonging to a nation - rather than a tribe or a religion - is what turns a group of people into a state.
loc.CHI_foreign_threats_desc: A few years ago, the Japanese wrenched manchuria away from us and created a puppet state. They will not stop until they have subjugated all of China. We must be ready to face them, even if it means making deals with local strongmen.
loc.CHI_prioritize_the_interior_desc: Before we can even entertain the notion of taking back the territory stolen from us by the Japanese, we must secure our interior. Divided into a collection of regions fighting against one another, we will not stand a chance.
loc.CHI_united_front_desc: With the Japanese breathing down our neck, we must be willing to accept help where we can get it - even from the communists.
loc.CHI_pick_a_fight_with_japan_desc: For years, the Japanese have heaped demand upon demand on us. These days are over. The next time they make even the slightest demand of us, we will not yield an inch.
loc.CHI_anti_communism_desc: Communism represents the greatest threat against our nation. It must be wiped out relentlessly.
loc.CHI_subjugate_the_warlords_desc: In our moment of weakness, local military leaders took control of large swaths of the country. It is time to remind them that they answer to us - one way or the other.
loc.CHI_war_of_resistance_desc: We are not yet strong enough to carry the war to the Japanese. We must resist the invaders until such time that we can go on the attack again.
loc.CHI_industrial_evacuations_desc: A modern war is won in the factories. An army without guns is nothing but a group of people with silly hats.
loc.CHI_war_of_national_liberation_desc: With the Japanese assault defeated, we can go on the offensive and liberate all of our territory.
loc.CHI_scorched_earth_tactics_desc: In a struggle for national survival, nothing is unthinkable and every option must be considered.
loc.CHI_war_of_anti_imperialism_desc: With our lands free of oppression, we can now turn our eyes on the enemy lines, to ensure that no invasion will ever be launched from them.
loc.CHI_forced_conscription_desc: Our current recruitment methods don't produce enough soldiers to meet our demands. Defeat in this war means annihilation, so we must ask even more of our people.
loc.CHI_dare_to_die_corps_desc: The struggle for the republic has already created plenty of martyrs. There will be plenty more before it is over. Their sacrifices will be remembered by generations to come.
loc.CHI_military_affairs_commission_desc: Our military has shown a shocking lack of competence. Reform of the high command is just the first step to rectify the issue.
loc.CHI_fortify_shanghai_desc: If Japan attacks, the first blow will fall on Shanghai. We must be prepared.
loc.CHI_army_reform_desc: Corruption, incompetence and cowardice are rife at every level of command in our army. Solving this will be a long process.
loc.CHI_bureau_of_investigation_and_statisti: We can't allow traitors and spies to run around our country while we are engaged in a war for the future of our nation. The methods employed by this new agency may seem unpleasant, but the work still needs to be done.
loc.CHI_the_chinese_hindenburg_line_desc: Our German advisers have given us many useful tips on how to build fortifications learned from the Great War. Any attempts by the enemy to break out of Shanghai will shatter on these fortifications.
loc.CHI_60_divisions_plan_desc: Instead of relying on the mass of bodies to solve the problem, our foreign advisers propose a radically new plan: A smaller force of highly trained divisions to match the enemy. A pilot project has already started.
loc.CHI_whampoa_military_academy_desc: An army is useless without proper leadership. If we want to turn our military into a force of the first rank, we must have well-trained officers to lead it.
loc.CHI_unified_industrial_planning_desc: Our aggressive program of industrialisation must not be delayed.
loc.CHI_expand_the_academica_sinica_desc: For millennia, China has led the world in development of the arts and sciences. Increased funding for our universities is just the first step to reclaim that position.
loc.CHI_chemical_research_institute_desc: While we would never be the first to use chemical weapons, we must still be ready to defend against them in case of an attack. We should fund a new research institute to develop the necessary methods and technologies.
loc.CHI_rural_reconstruction_movement_desc: While we have made great progress in improving the life of our urban population, a mere few kilometers separate them from the peasants living in medieval conditions. We will ensure that every one of our citizens can enjoy the fruits of our labor.
loc.CHI_mining_commission_desc: Resources are critical for the war effort. We must take charge of our mining industry to ensure that it produces what we need.
loc.CHI_taiyuan_arsenal_desc: The Taiyuan Arsenal is one of the few places in China which can produce heavy weaponry. We should expand it to supply our troops with artillery and other weapons.
loc.CHI_develop_the_hanyan_arsenal_desc: The Hanyang Arsenal has long supplied the Chinese armies with guns. Expanding it will ensure that this remains so in the future.
loc.CHI_financial_policy_desc: The state's finances are not particularly solid, and the ambitious programs of government raise the spectre of runaway hyperinflation. Financial reform must be one of our first priorities.
loc.CHI_price_controls_desc: The first step to keep inflation under control is to ensure that key goods are sold at fixed prices. this will not be popular with the merchant class.
loc.CHI_grain_tax_desc: The government-issued notes have less and less purchasing power. Soon, we won't be able to feed our armies anymore. We could institute a new law that the peasants must pay their taxes in grain, thus bypassing the market. They won't like that, and there is a danger of this leading to a full-blown famine.
loc.CHI_reform_the_national_bank_desc: A new National Bank will coordinate all financial activities of the government and provide the necessary funds.
loc.CHI_forced_loans_desc: The merchants and industrialists have amassed incredible riches in the period of relative peace. It is surely not too much to ask them to make part of that wealth available for the government in these desperate times, with a promise of prompt repayment as soon as the situation permits.
loc.CHI_purchase_tanks_tt: We will receive 100 old light tanks from our supporter.
loc.CHI_purchase_fighters_tt: We will receive 50 old fighters from our supporter. Securing the support of both Britain and the US will secure fighter sales from both.
loc.PRC_strengthen_the_central_secretariat_d: Following the Long March, we must reorganize our political organisation to create a state that can compete with the Nationalists.
loc.PRC_marxist_orthodoxy_desc: The key to achieving true communism is to implement Marx' teachings to the greatest possible degree.
loc.PRC_soviet_leadership_desc: The Soviet Union stands as the premier country on the path towards full communism. We should acknowledge this and learn from their example.
loc.PRC_soviet_economic_aid_desc: The devastation of the Long March would take generations to overcome without outside help. We should approach the Soviets to ask for economic assistance.
loc.PRC_internationalism_desc: The workers and peasants of the world must unite to cast off their shackles. Shoulder to shoulder, we will build a better future.
loc.PRC_agrarian_socialism_desc: China is not like the industrialised nations of the world. To expect a communist revolution as Marx imagined is to misunderstand the position our country finds itself in.
loc.PRC_rectification_campaign_desc: There have been a number of misconceptions about the course our struggle should take. We should give the misguided comrades a chance to acknowledge the error of their ways.
loc.PRC_maoism_desc: The Great Chairman has spent long months developing his political theories into a coherent ideology that will guide our country forward.
loc.PRC_socialism_with_chinese_characteristi: Although no doubt brilliant, Marx wrote from a specifically European perspective. China's particular situation will be reflected in our implementation of socialist policies.
loc.PRC_proclaim_the_peoples_republic_desc: With victory over the nationalists, it is time to take our rightful place as the legitimate government of China. Much work still remains to be done, but the future looks brighter than ever.
loc.PRC_socialist_market_economy_desc: The path towards socialism and communism must, by definition, lead through capitalism. China has never developed a proper capitalist market economy, making progress towards socialism all but impossible. We must first develop the capitalist modes of production before we can progress further.
loc.PRC_social_democracy_focus_desc: The radical policies of the party have made things worse, not better. The Nationalists, for all their flaws, are our allies in the struggle to build a better future. We must move towards them in the political sphere.
loc.PRC_coalition_government_desc: While unification of our country is obviously still a ways off, forming a joint government with the Nationalists will smooth the way.
loc.PRC_purge_the_radicals_desc: Certain elements in our party still believe in the doctrine of class struggle and opposition to the so-called exploiting class. They will have to go.
loc.PRC_strengthen_the_left_wing_of_the_kmt: Strengthen the Left Wing of the KMT
loc.PRC_strengthen_the_left_wing_of_the_kmt_: The Nationalists have their own problems with internal factions trying to sabotage efforts to come to an agreement between our regimes. We should do everything in our power to ensure that our allies in the KMT win this power struggle.
loc.PRC_remove_chiang_kai_shek_desc: Despite our efforts, the Generalissimo still considers us to be communists at heart. His virulent opposition has become a problem. Measures will need to be taken.
loc.PRC_national_leadership_desc: With Kai-Shek gone, the last opposition to reunification is gone. It is only proper that we should take the lead in this combined government.
loc.PRC_land_redistribution_desc: For centuries, the people who work the land have been forced to pay rent to the people who actually own it. We will change this.
loc.PRC_the_yanan_base_area_desc: The foundation of our revolution is the area in Yan'an. If we want to prevail in the upcoming struggle, it must be expanded and improved.
loc.PRC_prepare_for_war_with_japan_desc: The Japanese militarists pose the greatest threat to our nation. They wish to carve it up and exploit it in ways no Chinese government would ever imagine. The struggle against the Nationalists pales by comparison.
loc.PRC_government_of_national_defense_desc: A country divided is a country inviting defeat. We must join forces with the Nationalists to coordinate our defense.
loc.PRC_confrontation_with_the_warlords_desc: Some elements in China ignore the central government, refusing to pick sides in the struggle. Some of them might even secretly harbor designs on taking over the country or collaborating with the Japanese. They must be brought in line.
loc.PRC_anti_japanese_expedition_desc: Facing the Japanese in open combat in our current position would be more foolish than brave. We should first prepare the ground by sending small groups into enemy territory to build base areas. When the time is right, we will call the uprising.
loc.PRC_revolutionary_military_commission_de: The revolutionary struggle against our enemies must be coordinated through a specially created body.
loc.PRC_provoke_japan_desc: For three generations, we have lived under the shadow of the Japanese threat. Opposition to Japanese expansion will make us heroes in the eyes of the Chinese people. And if the Japanese don't want to give us the war we need, then we will make them.
loc.PRC_protracted_warfare_desc: We must conduct the war on our terms. China has plenty of people and plenty of time. To face the enemy in open combat would be suicide.
loc.PRC_mobile_warfare_desc: We can't hide in the mountains and forests forever. The time has come to take the fight to the enemy, and show the world that we are not afraid to fight them in the open.
loc.PRC_peoples_war_desc: Other countries may believe that it is technology and firepower that wins wars. We know better. There is no technology that can stand up to a determined people willing to sacrifice.
loc.PRC_100_regiments_campaign_desc: We have focused on small battles and skirmishes for now. Our enemies think us weak and a mere nuisance. Lulled in a sense of security, they will be ill-prepared for a major offensive.
loc.PRC_central_military_commission_desc: With our position more secure, we can move on from the revolutionary struggle for survival to the struggle for national leadership.
loc.PRC_peoples_liberation_army_desc: The Chinese Red Army has accomplished great deeds. In the future, it will win even greater honors as we fight to liberate our people.
loc.PRC_peoples_volunteer_army_desc: The struggle to liberate the workers and peasants of the world is fought in many countries. It is not always wise to intervene directly in these conflicts. Sometimes, a small force is all that is needed to shift the balance of power.
loc.PRC_military_intelligence_department_des: We have many friends amongst the general population, providing valuable information to us. We have even more enemies. We must create an organisation to separate one from the other.
loc.PRC_central_security_bureau_desc: We can not allow the counter-revolution to take hold in even the smallest village. Our goal must be to find every single traitor before they can do any damage.
loc.PRC_focus_on_china_desc: We can not hope to stand up to the Japanese while we are still fighting against the Nationalists and warlords. We must first defeat them before we can take on the Japanese.
loc.PRC_exploit_the_weak_neighbours_desc: Our neighbours are weakened by corruption and infighting. This presents a perfect opportunity to expand our territory.
loc.PRC_infiltration_desc: The Nationalists would like us to fight them in the open. We must not give into the temptation. We will send small groups of soldiers into hostile territory to build base areas. When the time is right, we will trigger an uprising and catch the Nationalists by surprise.
loc.PRC_enforce_the_three_rules_desc:
1: Follow Orders.
 2: Don't steal from the Peasants.
 3: Turn in everything captured from the enemy.
 With these simple rules we will show the people that we are on their side.
loc.PRC_permit_opium_trade_desc: Despite the unfortunate side-effects, allowing the peasants to cultivate poppy will grant us the cash needed to supply our armies.
loc.PRC_ban_the_opium_trade_desc: Opium has been the instrument by which the western powers brought us to our knees. We can not allow this evil to spread.
loc.PRC_abolish_the_land_rent_desc: Private ownership of land is an absurd concept. The land belongs to whoever works it. Allowing the peasants to organize themselves will ensure their support.
loc.PRC_literacy_programs_desc: The first step in creating a modern society is to ensure that all of its citizens can understand the issues at hand and help solve them.
loc.PRC_china_medical_university_desc: Hygiene and medical care will keep our army in the field and allow us to better the lot of our citizens. We will ensure we develop new methods in these fields and teach them to our population.
loc.PRC_form_the_academy_of_sciences_desc: We will combine all our various research facilities and universities and create a new organization to administer them more efficiently.
loc.JAP_the_unthinkable_option_desc: The future of our nation requires a path that has never been conceived of by our leaders. This option must now be contemplated in earnest.
loc.JAP_approach_the_young_officers_desc: The older generations are too set in their ways to be easily swayed to the new way of thinking. We shall start with the younger generations, instead.
loc.JAP_if_man_accepts: If §HManchukuo§! accepts the following will happen:\n
loc.JAP_exchange_the_exiles_desc: While we previously sent our left-leaning officers and civil servants into unofficial exile in Manchuria, we shall now exchange them for our more right-leaning ones, instead.
loc.JAP_open_up_the_universities_desc: All must be allowed to study, no matter their heritage or social status.
loc.JAP_cast_the_die_desc: Our political and military base is secure enough. It is time to seize our destiny!
loc.cast_the_die_TT: §RCapture of Tokyo will end the civil war quickly.§!\n
loc.JAP_the_fate_of_the_imperial_family: The Fate of the Imperial Family
loc.JAP_the_fate_of_the_imperial_family_desc: The time has come to see to the last vestiges of hereditary rule in Japan. We must decide what fate shall befall the Emperor and his family.
loc.JAP_rebuild_the_civil_service_desc: To manage our nation properly, we shall rebuild the civil service with those people who are most capable.
loc.JAP_reeducation_campaign_desc: Unrest is rife in the aftermath of our great revolution. We must re-educate the people to reinforce the behaviour we find most appropriate.
loc.JAP_finish_the_fight_desc: We must bring the fight to our old colony, and eliminate the last bastion of our Japanese ideological adversaries.
loc.JAP_join_comintern_desc: We cannot stand alone against the world. We must stand together with the birthplace of communism to protect the revolution!
loc.JAP_red_brigades_desc: Every man and woman most do their duty to protect the state. We will ensure they have the opportunity to do so.
loc.JAP_communist_volunteers_desc: Our struggle does not end here. We must see to lift up other nations, as well. Our best and brightest shall be sent forth to champion our cause in those nations that have embraced the revolution!
loc.JAP_asian_communist_solidarity_desc: We must stand with our Asian brethren. The Western form of communism has no place here, but together with our neighbours we can spread a version of it that suits Asian needs.
loc.JAP_nationalize_the_zaibatsus_desc: The largest corporations of our nation have long had unprecedented political and economical power. It ends here. The state's control will not be challenged.
loc.JAP_people_owned_mines_desc: The people will be allowed to own a stake in the mines they work in, improving worker motivation and efficiency.
loc.JAP_public_works_desc: A new series of public works will ensure work for all, as well as improvements in nation-wide infrastructure.
loc.JAP_tokyo_aluminum_plant_desc: We will harness the power of our workers to increase the nation's self-sufficiency.
loc.JAP_purge_the_kodoha_faction_desc: A new faction has appeared, intent to take control of the government and strike north into the Soviet Union. We must eliminate them before they can do too much damage.
loc.JAP_liaison_conference_desc: By sending liaisons of all branches of government and of the military to a central conference, we can greatly increase our decision-making speed.
loc.JAP_greater_east_asian_co_prosperity_sph: The time of Western imperialism has come to an end. The peoples of Asia must band together and stand as a strong, unified continent, under our leadership. Asia for the Asiatics!
loc.JAP_intervene_in_china_desc: [Root.GetNameDefCap] is poor in resources, but our neighbours are not. We must take from them what we lack, and only require an excuse to begin doing so. Such an excuse could be provided by a few enterprising soldiers, after which the Emperor will have no choice but to assent to a war, no matter how ill-prepared...
loc.JAP_secure_china_desc: Chinese resistance is proving to be stubborn and unceasing. We must redouble our efforts to pacifying the mainland with all haste.
loc.JAP_develop_chinese_resources_desc: We must develop the rich Chinese resources that have fallen into our hands so that they may be useful for the next war.
loc.JAP_strike_south_doctrine_desc: Though rich, China does not possess all resources we require. Not far away to the south, though, lie the Dutch East Indies and the British colonies of Malaya and Borneo. For true self-sufficiency we must wrest control over these areas away from the European imperialists.
loc.JAP_non_aggression_pact_with_the_soviet_: Our northern border must be secured if we are to have the freedom to strike south. We shall begin negotiations with the [SOV.GetNameDef] immediately.
loc.JAP_bypass_the_philippines_desc: The Philippines are an unwelcome distraction on the way to our true goal. We shall ignore it, for now.
loc.JAP_secure_the_philippines_desc: The Philippines are a necessary base on the way to our true goal. We must secure it for future military operations.
loc.JAP_strike_on_the_southern_resource_area: Strike on the Southern Resource Area
The time has come to set our plan in motion. We will strike south and take the resource-rich Western colonies for ourselves.
loc.JAP_alliance_with_siam_desc: Siam is located in a prime location to aid us in our coming war with the Western powers. By getting them on our side we will greatly facilitate the inevitable invasion of Malaya and, thereby, the East Indies.
loc.JAP_exploit_the_southern_resource_area_d: We must greatly expand the exploitation of the East Indies' abundant resources to nourish our forces in our war.
loc.JAP_sign_tripartite_pact_bypass_tt: Either Germany or Italy does not have a fascist government or we are at war with one of them.
loc.JAP_sign_tripartite_pact_desc: The task that lies before us may well prove a challenge for our abilities. We should reach out to other governments with similar goals, so that we may engage in some measure of cooperation.
loc.JAP_guide_the_zaibatsus_desc: The largest corporations of our nation have long had unprecedented political and economical power. With some finesse, we may be able to guide their efforts in our favour.
loc.JAP_nationalize_war_industry_desc: Increasing state control over our war industry will go a long way to improving efficiency and, therefore, output.
loc.JAP_coal_liquification_desc: [JAP.GetNameDefCap] is lacking in oil, and so we must redouble our efforts in the field of synthetic oil.
loc.JAP_national_mobilization_law_desc: New legislation will make military service more ubiquitous, thereby instilling in the people a sense of duty, as well as making the necessity of war clear to them.
loc.JAP_national_research_policy_desc: Government support and control of our research institutions will allow us greater flexibility and productivity in our R&D programs.
loc.JAP_imperial_arsenals_desc: Increasing imperial control over our war industry will go a long way to improving efficiency and, therefore, output.
loc.JAP_national_defense_state_desc: Every citizen must be made to see the urgency of transforming our nation into a bastion capable of withstanding any assault.
loc.JAP_spiritual_mobilization_desc: By cultivating those tenets of Shinto that play on the people's sense of military duty we can increase the amount of new recruits.
loc.JAP_warrior_spirit_desc: State Shinto allows us to instill in the people the need to sacrifice oneself for the good of the state and the Imperial family.
loc.JAP_strengthen_the_divine_wind_desc: Kamikaze, the tactics of the Special Attack Unit, have changed suicide attacks from an improvised last measure to an established doctrine. With new planes, essentially manned missiles, these attacks will be unstoppable.
loc.JAP_support_the_kodoha_faction_desc: A new faction has appeared, intent to take control of the government and strike north into the Soviet Union. For the sake of the Emperor and the Empire's future, we must ensure this faction prevails!
loc.JAP_challenge_the_zaibatsus_desc: The largest corporations of our nation have long had unprecedented political and economical power. We must remind them they are still subordinate to the Emperor's wishes.
