loc.paratroopers_b_desc: What goes up, must come down.
loc.paratroopers_c_desc: What goes up, must come down.
loc.marines_a_desc: There are only two kinds of people that understand us: Marines and the enemy. Everyone else has a second-hand opinion.
loc.marines_b_desc: There are only two kinds of people that understand us: Marines and the enemy. Everyone else has a second-hand opinion.
loc.marines_c_desc: There are only two kinds of people that understand us: Marines and the enemy. Everyone else has a second-hand opinion.
loc.mountaineers_a_desc: 'One more hill'? Yeah, that's the name of the mountain we need to climb.
loc.mountaineers_b_desc: 'One more hill'? Yeah, that's the name of the mountain we need to climb.
loc.mountaineers_c_desc: 'One more hill'? Yeah, that's the name of the mountain we need to climb.
loc.support_weapons_a_desc: We've managed to put together an even better kit, much to the relief of our troops on the front lines.
loc.support_weapons_b_desc: We've managed to put together an even better kit, much to the relief of our troops on the front lines.
loc.support_weapons_c_desc: We've managed to put together an even better kit, much to the relief of our troops on the front lines.
loc.support_weapons_d_desc: We've managed to put together an even better kit, much to the relief of our troops on the front lines.
loc.support_weapons_e_desc: We've managed to put together an even better kit, much to the relief of our troops on the front lines.
loc.night_vision_a_desc: The ability to see the enemy while they cannot is paramount. This new technology helps us toward that goal.
loc.future_radar_desc: Our Airborn Interception Radar is now quite sophisticated, and can begin to make a visible difference in engagements.
loc.future_radar_2_desc: Further advances in the sensitivity and range of our systems have allowed us to develop even better units for mounting with our aircraft.
loc.future_radar_3_desc: We continue to refine our systems and develop even better units for inclusion with our aircraft.
loc.future_computing_machine_desc: The bigger they are, the harder they compute.
loc.future_computing_machine_2_desc: We've integrated an even faster read-write ability, and can reliably write programs into the system.
loc.future_computing_machine_3_desc: Now our systems are so powerful that we can begin automating certain office tasks, and are now ushering in a new era of productivity.
loc.future_computing_machine_4_desc: The bipolar transistor is better than the vacuum tube in every way and we anticipate its rapid adoption, with great advances in computing to follow.
loc.future_decryption_desc: 'It's worked for five years. Why would we need to change it?' (Logged by J. Williams, 18:45, RS8)
loc.future_encryption_desc: At this point I think they've started encoding their grocery lists just to mess with us.
loc.future_encryption_2_desc: Assume it's dangerous - that's the first rule. Worry about the other rules once you figure out the how and why.
loc.future_decryption_3_desc: The holy grail for us is always a list of pet names, and maybe birthdays at a close second.
loc.future_encryption_3_desc: Our codes are now so complicted, not even our own guys can use them.
loc.rdf1_desc: By intercepting illegal transmissions from Partisans we will strengthen our counter-insurgency ability.
loc.rdf2_desc: By intercepting more precisely illegal transmissions from Partisans we will strengthen our counter-insurgency ability.
loc.rdf3_desc: By intercepting illegal transmissions from Partisans via early triangulation we will strengthen our counter-insurgency ability.
loc.rdf4_desc: By intercepting illegal transmissions from Partisans via more precise triangulation we will strengthen our counter-insurgency ability.
loc.rdf5_desc: By intercepting illegal transmissions from Partisans via nearly exact triangulation we will strengthen our counter-insurgency ability.
loc.rdf6_desc: We can detect them wherever they are. There's no hiding, no running, and certainly no chance they'll succeed.
loc.streamlined_line_a_desc: The worker will keep their left hand six inches away from the machine at all times. Their foot shall be between the central lever and the red...
loc.flexible_line_a_desc: Hear that droning in the sky? Means we're about to build a new line from scratch. Again.
loc.streamlined_line_b_desc: We have hybridized both the streamlined and flexible manufacturing schools of thought in order to create an even better process.
loc.streamlined_line_c_desc: Further advances in tooling have led to better techniques and capabilities in manufacturing.
loc.streamlined_line_d_desc: Our abilities in manufacturing are now state of the art, and allow for large-scale production of almost anything.
loc.concentrated_industry_a_desc: For every bullet they make, we'll do a thousand. Make so much that even if our boys miss every shot, the enemy will still drown in metal.
loc.dispersed_industry_a_desc: It isn't so bad when you get used to it. The only things here are bats, a bad smell, and a whole lot of guys that don't remember what the sun looks like.
loc.concentrated_industry_b_desc: The mega-factories of today put even the most advanced facilities on only a few years ago to shame.
loc.dispersed_industry_b_desc: We have made significant advances in our boring ability, and are now able to excavate vast facilities underground.
loc.concentrated_industry_c_desc: Vertical integration of our production processes has provided for greater advances in our capabilities.
loc.dispersed_industry_c_desc: Even with heavy bombing of the surface area, we can still endure down below and continue our production unabated.
loc.concentrated_industry_d_desc: We can stack just about any industry with another, and reap the benefits of supreme concentration.
loc.dispersed_industry_d_desc: Our supply chains are diffuse but effective, and our factories are fully reinforced against even the most severe of attacks.
loc.construction_a_desc: The increases in our ability to add new machines keeps the construction going.
loc.excavation_a_desc: The earth is bleeding, and it's your job to make sure the blood keeps flowing.
loc.construction_b_desc: If you want it built fast and cheap, we can do it. Just don't ask too many questions.
loc.excavation_b_desc: There's even more mineral wealth in those hills, and we're going to get at it no matter what.
loc.construction_c_desc: We can scale up to just about any project on the fly. Maybe it won't be completely sturdy, but it will still get the job done.
loc.excavation_c_desc: Machines like these would have scared the hell out of anyone even a decade ago. For us though, they mean one thing only: More.
loc.construction_d_desc: Modern techniques mean we can build anything, anywhere, at any time. That doesn't mean we're going to pay those bastards any extra.
loc.excavation_d_desc: The marrow of the Earth is our sustenance, and its veins of ore are tapped.
loc.rubber_plant_a_desc: Using our knowledge of synthetic oil production, we can now create artificial rubber products.
loc.rubber_plant_b_desc: Further improvements in our synthetic production process has resulted in even greater yields.
loc.rubber_plant_c_desc: We can now produce great amounts of rubber from our advanced plants, and at a very cheap rate.
loc.semi_modern_landing_craft_desc: Just tuck in your knees and hope for the best.
loc.modern_landing_craft_desc: How many more people can we possibly fit on this thing anyway?
loc.aluminum_production_1_desc: Recent advances in milling techniques now allow us to ramp up our Aluminum production.
loc.aluminum_production_2_desc: Advances in milling techniques enable us to moderately boost our Aluminum production.
loc.aluminum_production_3_desc: With our new milling techniques we can increase our Aluminum production considerably.
loc.steel_production_1_desc: Recent advances in milling techniques now allow us to ramp up our Steel production.
loc.steel_production_2_desc: Advances in milling techniques enable us to moderately boost our Steel production.
loc.steel_production_3_desc: Our milling techniques are now considerable, and we can regularly produce a fairly large amount of the metal if we so choose.
loc.steel_production_4_desc: Our steel production is now so advanced that we can practically flood the market, much to the relief and frustration of other nations.
loc.nuke_naval_desc: We've theorized that our largest and most powerful ships can be given nuclear reactors. Hopefully with time we can find a way to make this a reality.
loc.nukes_2_desc: Designs have been laid out for a bomb that uses fission to produce an even more powerful fusion reaction. With this, we should be able to significantly increase our yields.
loc.semi_modern_rocket_engines_desc: These new rockets incorporate ideas and theories acquired from other countries.
loc.modern_rocket_engines_desc: We have begun to test and lay the groundwork for rockets capable of entering space, and thus deliver a payload to any point on the planet.
loc.tech_engineers_a_desc: Combat Engineers of the future will ensure that no matter where our troops are attacked, they will be prepared.
loc.tech_engineers_b_desc: Combat Engineers of the future will ensure that no matter where our troops are attacked, they will be prepared.
loc.tech_engineers_c_desc: Combat Engineers of the future will ensure that no matter where our troops are attacked, they will be prepared.
loc.tech_recon_a_desc: Deep reconnaissance operations, mixing espionage and commando training, will aid our tactical and choices and allow us to adapt our decision-making rapidly.
loc.tech_recon_b_desc: Deep reconnaissance operations, mixing espionage and commando training, will aid our tactical and choices and allow us to adapt our decision-making rapidly.
loc.tech_recon_c_desc: Deep reconnaissance operations, mixing espionage and commando training, will aid our tactical and choices and allow us to adapt our decision-making rapidly.
loc.tech_military_police_a_desc: Safely policing occupied territory is as much about returning normalcy as it is about ruthlessly eliminating opposition. Our military police must ensure that this process starts early, to ensure safety for soldiers and civilians alike.
loc.tech_military_police_b_desc: Safely policing occupied territory is as much about returning normalcy as it is about ruthlessly eliminating opposition. Our military police must ensure that this process starts early, to ensure safety for soldiers and civilians alike.
loc.tech_military_police_c_desc: Safely policing occupied territory is as much about returning normalcy as it is about ruthlessly eliminating opposition. Our military police must ensure that this process starts early, to ensure safety for soldiers and civilians alike.
loc.tech_maintenance_company_a_desc: Experiences with designing for active redundancy in the Great War can be renewed to work with more modern equipment to make maintenance easier.
loc.tech_maintenance_company_b_desc: Experiences with designing for active redundancy in the Great War can be renewed to work with more modern equipment to make maintenance easier.
loc.tech_maintenance_company_c_desc: Experiences with designing for active redundancy in the Great War can be renewed to work with more modern equipment to make maintenance easier.
loc.tech_field_hospital_a_desc: Although many improvements have been made in field medicine, many advances are improvised and we lack an established doctrine. With more experience, we can explain the role of these units more clearly and make improved innovations permanent fixtures.
loc.tech_field_hospital_b_desc: Although many improvements have been made in field medicine, many advances are improvised and we lack an established doctrine. With more experience, we can explain the role of these units more clearly and make improved innovations permanent fixtures.
loc.tech_field_hospital_c_desc: Although many improvements have been made in field medicine, many advances are improvised and we lack an established doctrine. With more experience, we can explain the role of these units more clearly and make improved innovations permanent fixtures.
loc.tech_logistics_company_a_desc: Developing standardized classifications for supplies will minimize confusion and make planning more efficient.
loc.tech_logistics_company_b_desc: Developing standardized classifications for supplies will minimize confusion and make planning more efficient.
loc.tech_logistics_company_c_desc: Developing standardized classifications for supplies will minimize confusion and make planning more efficient.
loc.tech_signal_company_a_desc: Among our signal specialists are people with unparalleled first-hand knowledge of field use of this equipment. By involving them in the research of new communication technologies, we can make use of their expertise.
loc.tech_signal_company_b_desc: Among our signal specialists are people with unparalleled first-hand knowledge of field use of this equipment. By involving them in the research of new communication technologies, we can make use of their expertise.
loc.tech_signal_company_c_desc: Among our signal specialists are people with unparalleled first-hand knowledge of field use of this equipment. By involving them in the research of new communication technologies, we can make use of their expertise.
loc.etax_doctrine_desc: We must establish a division that will focus our research efforts, and allow us to concentrate our military and industry in ways that will benefit the nation.
loc.etax_army_focus_desc: The capabilities of our land forces are of the utmost importance, and will take priority over the other operational branches.
loc.etax_navy_focus_desc: Without a capable navy, a nation will die. That is why we must make every effort to expand and strengthen this branch of our military.
loc.etax_air_focus_desc: The skies are the future, and so it is appropriate that we dedicate ourselves to making our force the strongest in the world.
loc.etax_army_firepower_desc: An emphasis on firepower will see us through to victory. This focus has yielded powerful small arms and general improvements in their effectiveness.
loc.etax_army_firepower_2_desc: The special research we have conducted has enable us to add significant stopping power to our big guns.
loc.etax_army_defense_desc: Our army can take hits that would leave anyone else dead in their tracks. With this, we can easily endure any conflict.
loc.etax_army_defense_2_desc: The enemy might throw everything they have at us, but the sheer depth of our defenses will wear them down to the bone.
loc.etax_navy_firepower_desc: Our ships can, with some effort, be made to hit nearly any target at range. The effects on enemy effectiveness and morale will be devastating.
loc.etax_navy_firepower_2_desc: Our navy knows how to strike and focus its firepower, and can tear apart even the most confident opposition.
loc.etax_navy_defense_desc: With the increase of enemy weapon effectiveness and air strikes, it's only appropriate that we modify our navy to counter this threat.
loc.etax_navy_defense_2_desc: Knowing where the enemy is at all times is itself the most valuable kind of weapon that can be imagined.
loc.etax_air_firepower_desc: Few can contest the skies where our craft operate, and the speed at which they can intercept the enemy is unmatched.
loc.etax_air_firepower_2_desc: Our bombers can lay waste to anything within their sights, and leave nothing but ruin in their wake.
loc.etax_air_defense_desc: Every effort has been made in coordinating our defenses so that no patch of land nor bird in the air goes without some form of cover.
loc.etax_air_defense_2_desc: Sometimes speed is more valuable than any armor might be, and in a dogfight proves to be the deadliest part of the equation.
loc.etax_the_means_desc: As we push forward we must not forget that we should stay true to our principals. If our soldiers can take pride in our cause, they will be able to weather any adversity.
loc.etax_the_ends_desc: Our advantage lays in our ability to do what others do not dare. If we push ourselves beyond the boundary, then the tools at our disposal become limitless.
loc.etax_business_interests_desc: By developing our private sector we can add increase the number of factories able to produce goods.
loc.etax_cost_plus_desc: As long as the money keeps flowing through thick and thin, our businesses will continue to deliver.
loc.etax_production_in_depth_desc: We can pull from a vast array of sources to build our goods and equipment, and the sheer depth of it is such that the enemy can't hope to cut us off.
loc.etax_unity_desc: Everyone fights for the same just purpose, and that keeps our forces going for longer and harder than any would expect.
loc.etax_broad_support_desc: We can draw from all quarters of our society and absolutely no one is left out. If you have a pulse, you can fight.
loc.etax_inclusive_science_desc: Our scientists come from a diversity of backgrounds, and we do not let ideology or undue bias prevent us from moving forward.
loc.etax_desperation_desc: With some effort we can convince our population to make do with a little less, all while fighting just as hard.
loc.etax_no_qa_desc: The immediate needs of the frontline require that we cut some corners here and there. While the quality may be lower, in the end the sheer bulk of our efforts will overwhelm.
loc.etax_expendable_labor_desc: The bricks that line our walls were paid for in blood, and the cement is lined with bones. Let no one say we did not pay the price needed for victory.
loc.etax_glory_desc: There is nothing more noble and true than the art of combat. A person is not truly tested until they throw themselves into battle and let the forge of war shape their hearts.
loc.etax_purity_desc: We have weeded from our forces those that are unfit to serve, and only the very strongest and most dedicated remain.
loc.etax_great_leap_desc: While others are content to plod along with their small efforts, we are not afraid to take a risk and bet on the technologies that will shape our world far in the future.
loc.etax_grand_projects_desc: You can't defeat the enemy with slightly better cement. It takes firepower, and death from above.
loc.etax_practical_projects_desc: Our forces are focused on the basics, and have come up with ways to promte the fundamentals of production up and down the supply chain.
loc.etax_moonshot_desc: Our focus on dominating the air has yielded some truly marvelous advances. With this, our mastery of the sky is absolutely beyond dispute.
loc.etax_super_soldiers_desc: We've developed a small drug that allows our soliders to move farther, faster, and for longer than what the human condition normally allows.
loc.etax_the_bomb_desc: Our scientists have poured all of their effort into an absolutely frightening yet brilliant idea. In the end it didn't produce what we aimed for, but through it we managed to advance every area of inquiry immeasurably.
loc.etax_seashot_desc: Our ships are terrifying to behold, and can tear through all but the most resolute of enemy forces with ease.
loc.etax_quality_desc: We've done everything to ensure the proper tooling and rigorous testing necessary to field equipment that lasts.
loc.etax_great_works_desc: Money has been poured into pushing our nation's capacity to its limit, and beyond. Everything about our economic and productive institution is designed to inspire awe.
loc.jungletroop_desc: Jungle Specialists are trained to sustain the harsh conditions of Jungle Warfare and challange the Enemy on their own terms.
loc.desertinfantry_desc: Combat in the Desert ranges exposes troops to many perils, but sometimes cannot be avoided. Providing our soldiers with specialized training for this environment, we can minimize these risks.
loc.shocktroop_desc: Shock Troops can smash into Enemy lines to achieve a break through. This is almost essential to any form of Deep-Battle and can greatly contribute to throwing the Defenders into disarray.
loc.jaegers_desc: Jaeger are forces that specialize in surviving the wilderness of the boreal forest. Usually these troops are native to their territorry and take a long time to train.

These units have a higher break through and hard attack compared regular infantry. However Shock Troops or Stoßtruppen also have a higher supply consumption and an elevated recovery time.

loc.desertinfantry_at_desc: The sandy Mountains of the desert can be treacherous to your regular Infantry. To be able to cope in this Environment you can train you Desert Infantry to gain an upper Hand in the Desert.
loc.desertinfantry_at2_desc: The sandy Mountains of the desert can be treacherous to your regular Infantry. To be able to cope in this Environment you can train you Desert Infantry to gain an upper Hand in the Desert.

loc.tech_flamethrower_desc: Flamethrowers are very useful in close Combat and can be used very effectively in Urban Warfare and against fixed Fortifications. These also add a substantial soft attack to your Divisions.
loc.tech_flamethrower2_desc: Flamethrowers are very useful in close Combat and can be used very effectively in Urban Warfare and against fixed Fortifications. These also add a substantial soft attack to your Divisions.

loc.plate_skirt_desc: Adding plate skirts to our tanks and half-track will add some protections against new AT infantry weapons, but will add extra weight to our units.
loc.bed_spring_skirt_desc: By replacing the metal plates by wiremesh type armor we will improve armour and remove the extra weight from the previous upgrade.
loc.bed_spring_skirt_2_desc: By replacing the metal plates by with even lighter materials we will improve armour and remove the extra weight from the previous upgrade.
loc.bed_spring_skirt_3_desc: By replacing the metal plates by with even lighter materials we will improve armour and remove the extra weight from the previous upgrade.
loc.bed_spring_skirt_4_desc: By replacing the metal plates by with even lighter materials we will improve armour and remove the extra weight from the previous upgrade.
loc.sniper_rifle_desc: Adding a sniper unit in each platoon will effectively increase unit's recon ability and attack.
loc.sniper_rifle_2_desc: We have improved the rifles and training available to our Sniper Teams, allowing for a notable increase in their effectiveness.
loc.sniper_rifle_3_desc: The extensive experience and feedback of our Sniper Teams has enabled us to produce even better equipment.
loc.sniper_rifle_4_desc: Out teams have the very best equipment and employ nothing less than the most modern equipment.
loc.flamethrower_2_desc: Advances in armor and weight reduction have improved the safety and effectiveness of our flamethrower teams.
loc.flamethrower_3_desc: Our teams are well experienced, and have given us extensive feedback on the kind of equipment they need. We've integrated these suggestions into our production lines, resulting in improvements combat effectiveness.
loc.painting2_desc: New camouflage for our tanks. This new paint is directly applied at the factory allowing better ambush defence and infiltration.
loc.painting3_desc: New camouflage for our tanks. Allowing our army to modify the factory camo with their own design will increase tank ambush defence and infiltration.
loc.painting4_desc: New camouflage for our tanks. We've made it easier to apply prefab paints in the field, and increased the durability of the first factory coat.
loc.painting5_desc: New camouflage for our tanks. The applications are versatile and strong, able to withstand nearly anything the enemy throws at it.
loc.camo_desc: Solid Color uniforms modeled after those in the Great War.
loc.camo1942_desc: New camouflage design allowing our troops to be less locatable while ambushing or infiltration.
loc.camo1948_desc: New camouflage design that is lighter and also even more adept and enabling ambush and infiltration.
loc.camo1955_desc: Now you see it, now you don't.
loc.winter_clothes_gw_desc: Winter clothes made of wool. Not really effective, but better than nothing.
loc.winter_clothes_1939_desc: More decent winter clothes. Made of warm cotton wool-padded jacket.
loc.winter_clothes_1941_desc: Advanced winter clothes made of natural warm wool and synthetic fur, coated with early hydrophobic material and tainted in white.
loc.winter_clothes_1944_desc: Modern reversible winter clothes made of warm synthetic fabric and coated with removable hydrophobic windstopper jacket. Tainted in white, black and brown to be more effective in combat. It will lighten our soldiers and keep them warm and dry.
loc.jngdst_clothes_gw_desc: Desert & Jungle clothes made of cotton. Not really effective but better than nothing.
loc.jngdst_clothes_1939_desc: More descent desert & jungle clothes. Made of thin cotton. Goggles have been added to help soldiers fighting in sandy environment.
loc.jngdst_clothes_1941_desc: Advanced desert & jungle clothes made of natural thin cotton, coated with a special coating, it dry faster to help soldiers fighting in hot/wet environment.
loc.jngdst_clothes_1944_desc: Modern desert & jungle clothes made of special light fabric and coated with heat repeller jacket. Tainted in tan, black and brown to be more effective in combat. It will lighten our soldiers and keep them fresh and dry.
loc.droptank40_desc: Adding and external tank to our planes will increase their range.
loc.droptank45_desc: Most recent drop tank. It will improve plane's range but need Jet Reactor to compensate it's weight.
loc.droptank55_desc: Our tanks are now lighter and able to take an even greater amount of fuel.
loc.elite_forces_02_desc: Only the best of the best will become special forces. The soldiers that make it through the training will be stronger, faster and fight harder than anyone else.
loc.elite_forces_03_desc: Only the best of the best will become special forces. The soldiers that make it through the training will be stronger, faster and fight harder than anyone else.
loc.BALKAN_POWDER_KEG_DESC: Although constantly arguing over some new crises since the Vienna Conference a major European war has been avoided on the European continent for almost a hundred years. But increasingly so in the past few decades tensions have been increasingly rising in the Balkans with various empires seeking to secure their dominance in the region. It will only takes one small spark to blow the Balkan Powder keg.
loc.GE1_BALKAN_POWDER_KEG_DESC: The German Empire was created at Versailles in 1871 with blood and iron after the defeat of France a year previously. But following the rise of Wilhelm II whom sacked Bismarck and his attempts at status quo Germany soon found itself with potential enemies on two fronts. These facts could not have been far from the German military’s mind as 1914 came: as Chief of Staff von Moltke put it - "war is inevitable, and the sooner the better". Time is running out. Can the 'place in the sun' and German dominance in the world still be achieved?
loc.AUH_BALKAN_POWDER_KEG_DESC: The Dual Monarchy had been created in 1867 from a compromise between Emperor Franz Josef and the nobility of Hungary. A patchwork empire, it was composed of eleven major ethnic groups. the empire centred around the capital, Vienna, and held together to a great degree by the strength of Emperor Franz Josef’s character. To limit Russian influence in the Balkans, Austria-Hungary aligned itself with Germany in 1879, and then with Italy in 1882 to form the Triple Alliance. However, with Germany the dominant party in the alliance, Austria-Hungary would find its foreign policy wishes subordinated to the desires of its senior partner. The rulers of Austria-Hungary.
loc.TUR_BALKAN_POWDER_KEG_DESC: By the 18th century the Ottoman Empire was shrinking with its power eroded by a loss of internal authority and the expansionist ambitions of the European powers. The 19th century and early 20th century saw attempts at reform, including the creation of an executive branch, and a centralised government. But also witnessed the Ottoman Empire's substantial territorial decline. Meanwhile, the Turkish government was largely unable to collect its own taxes and the empire's communications and infrastructure remained primative, causing many to refer to Turkey as the "sick man of Europe". Can the Ottoman Empire modernise and survive or will it pass into the bygone era to where many argue it belongs?
loc.RUS_BALKAN_POWDER_KEG_DESC: Russia's eyes have fallen on the Balkans and Constantinople, which controls the vital sea route to the outside world. To support this ambition, Russia has the largest army in the world and a rapidly modernising industrial base. However, for all its strength Russia suffers from dangerous weaknesses and severe unrest amongst the populous. Some members of the Tsar's council advise that a "short, victorious war" might rally the people and distract them from their woes. But if the war went badly for Russia, could the Tsar's rule survive the consequences?
loc.EN1_BALKAN_POWDER_KEG_DESC: At the turn of the century, all appeared well for the British Empire - covering two-fifths of the world's land surface, accounting for a quarter of the world's population, policed by the most professional army in the world and guarded by the mightiest fleet ever built. But beneath the assurances of imperial grandeur lay insecurity about the future: economically and industrially, the United States was outperforming the British and the Germans had commenced an ominous fleet building program to challenge the Royal Navy's dominance of the seas.
loc.FR3_BALKAN_POWDER_KEG_DESC: Once the greatest Power of Europe, France is now a troubled country. Economically, she has been overtaken by many of her rivals. A declining birthrate seems to promise further decline, and in an age of mass armies might prove a fatal weakness. Politically, the Third Republic is unstable. On the international scene, the defeat by Prussia in 1871 and Germany's occupation of the provinces of Alsace and Lorraine is a festering sore, and demands for 'revanche' - revenge - against Germany remain strong.
loc.US2_BALKAN_POWDER_KEG_DESC: Since gaining independence from Great Britain in 1783 the United States and its people have mostly concerned themselves with their own continent, and to a lesser extent Central and South America, following the declaration of the Monroe Doctrine in 1823. Following the defeat of Spain in the Spanish-American War the United States has emerged as a world power, but with its very small army, is still not considered a 'Great Power' in the European sense, although it has vast potential to do so. This potential comes from the population and vast economy that in is greater than Britain, France, Russia and Germany combined.
loc.OTHER_BALKAN_POWDER_KEG_DESC: The nations of the world, great and small, will be affected by this conflict that spans across several continents around the world.
loc.THE_GREAT_WAR_DESC: For the first time in one hundred years in europe a conflict is brewing which will take more lives than any other time in history and last an unusually long time. For the first time in history man and machine will be combined inventing dozens of new methods to kill and destroy, this is the Great War.
loc.GE1_THE_GREAT_WAR_DESC: The German Empire was created at Versailles in 1871 with blood and iron after the defeat of France a year previously. But following the rise of Wilhelm II whom sacked Bismarck and his attempts at status quo Germany soon found itself with potential enemies on two fronts. These facts could not have been far from the German military’s mind as 1914 came: as Chief of Staff von Moltke put it - "war is inevitable, and the sooner the better". Time is running out. Can the 'place in the sun' and Germany's dominance in the world still be achieved?
loc.AUH_THE_GREAT_WAR_DESC: The Dual Monarchy had been created in 1867 from a compromise between Emperor Franz Josef and the nobility of Hungary. A patchwork empire, it was composed of eleven major ethnic groups. the empire centred around the capital, Vienna, and held together to a great degree by the strength of Emperor Franz Josef’s character. To limit Russian influence in the Balkans, Austria-Hungary aligned itself with Germany in 1879, and then with Italy in 1882 to form the Triple Alliance. However, with Germany the dominant party in the alliance, Austria-Hungary would find its foreign policy wishes subordinated to the desires of its senior partner. The rulers of Austria-Hungary.

The 19th century and early 20th century saw attempts at reform, including the creation of an executive branch, and a centralised government. But also witnessed the Ottoman Empire's substantial territorial decline. Meanwhile, the Turkish government was largely unable to collect its own taxes and the empire's communications and infrastructure remained primative, causing many to refer to Turkey as the "sick man of Europe". Can the Ottoman Empire modernise and survive or will it pass into the bygone era to where many argue it belongs?

However, for all its strength Russia suffers from dangerous weaknesses and severe unrest amongst the populous. Some members of the Tsar's council advise that a "short, victorious war" might rally the people and distract them from their woes. But if the war went badly for Russia, could the Tsar's rule survive the consequences?

But beneath the assurances of imperial grandeur lay insecurity about the future: economically and industrially, the United States was outperforming the British and the Germans had commenced an ominous fleet building program to challenge the Royal Navy's dominance of the seas.

A declining birthrate seems to promise further decline, and in an age of mass armies might prove a fatal weakness. Politically, the Third Republic is unstable. On the international scene, the defeat by Prussia in 1871 and Germany's occupation of the provinces of Alsace and Lorraine is a festering sore, and demands for 'revanche' - revenge - against Germany remain strong.

Following the defeat of Spain in the Spanish-American War the United States has emerged as a world power, but with its very small army, is still not considered a 'Great Power' in the European sense, although it has vast potential to do so. This potential comes from the population and vast economy that in is greater than Britain, France, Russia and Germany combined.
loc.OTHER_THE_GREAT_WAR_DESC: The nations of the world, great and small, will be affected by this conflict that spans across several continents around the world.
loc.SOMME_DESC: The Great War has been going on for almost two years. After the German army launched a surprise attack through Belgium, the Tripple Entente was able to stop the advance. Both factions have dug into trenches and have been waging a fierce battle for a few kilometres of land every day ever since.
loc.EN1_SOMME_DESC: Britain does not suffer as much from the great war as France or the Russian Empire. Even if Britain is at war with the Central Powers, only volunteers have to take part in the war. The Royal Navy rules the waves and blocks trade routes to Germany across the North Sea.
loc.FR3_SOMME_DESC: The Western Front in France is most likely the most important scene of the entire war. Both factions have become deep entrenched in trenches, and the sound of artillery fire burns into the heads of the soldiers. How long can they last? Only Time can tell.
loc.GE1_SOMME_DESC: The Tripple Entente was able to stop the Schlieffen Plan just before Paris. The German Empire still has the Inintiative. We must take advantage of this and we must not waste time. The successes on the Eastern Front give our soldiers the confidence they need. God with us !
loc.TUR_SOMME_DESC: The Ottoman Empire has a major problems in the Middle East. But not only on the front line. Internal unrest is causing great problems for the sick man of Europe. Many peoples are calling for independence and freedom in the occupied territories. Drastic changes are needed.
loc.AUH_SOMME_DESC: Germany's most important ally is increasingly in jeopardy. The dual monarchy, with its many different ethnic groups, does not seem to be up to the task of conflict. Comrades shooting at each other don't seem to be uncommon. It's all a matter of language.
loc.RUS_SOMME_DESC: The Russian Empire is experiencing another disaster. After the embarrassing defeat against Japan in 1905, the poorly equipped Russian army has to hold its own against the German army. Not enough precautions have been made and now there is not even enough ammunition for the armed forces. It doesn't look good for the Russian tsar.
loc.US2_SOMME_DESC: The United States has opted for neutrality in the conflict. Even if the majority of Americans support this neutrality, this opinion may change at any time.
loc.KAISERSCHLACHT_DESC: For four years now a brutal stalemate has remained on the Western Front but in the east there is no longer a front with the collapse of the Russian Empire and the subsequent signing of the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk. It has allowed hundreds of thousands of German Soldiers to transfer to the west culminating in a plan for one final great offensive never before seen, the Kaiserschlacht. Austria-Hungary, Turkey, and Bulgaria however are in a very weak state and if a significant victory in the west does not happen it is very likely that not only will Germany collapse but the whole alliance.
loc.GE1_KAISERSCHLACHT_DESC: For four years now a military stalemate has lasted on the Western Front but with the surrender of the Russian Empire, Germany can use those divisions for a momentary numerical superiority over the allied forces on the Western Front. It is critical that we break through the front lines and force an armistice on France whilst the Americans are still in small numbers, once they come here we will stand no chance. The supply situation is getting worse every day and manpower is trickling away like sand through fingers. We have to put all of our effort together to make this one last push or suffer the consequences of capitulation.
loc.AUH_KAISERSCHLACHT_DESC: The Austro-Hungarian Empire throughout the war has been a disaster but the October 1917 Battle of Caporetto has been a major victory for the Empire and the soon after collapse of the Russian Empire and Treaty of Brest-Litovsk  has relieved our forces in the east to focus on Italy and the Balkans. Though the Empire is still struggling to keep itself together with major war exhaustion and a large anti-war sentiment amongst the people. This will by no means be an task in either winning the war or keeping the empire intact, or both...
loc.TUR_KAISERSCHLACHT_DESC: The Allies thought that Turkey would be a pushover, but the war in the Middle East went its own wild way. A struggling empire that is seriously behind in almost every term compared to the west, the Ottoman Empire has managed to hold on four long years of fighting however the tide has turned and the British have taken Jerusalem the holy city, along with Baghdad and is now advancing from both Mesopotamian and Jordan-Israeli fronts towards Damascus and Mosul. If they are to fall so will we, however with the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk signed, our forces in the caucasus are finally free for other use.
loc.SOV_KAISERSCHLACHT_DESC: Over the course of the Great War the weak Russian Empire grew heavily unstable and many lives were lost to which the soldiers and working class alike lost any trust and patriotism towards the Imperial Government and has formed its own Communist Government led by Vladimir Lenin. The disastrous Treaty of Brest-Litovsk was signed but we had no choice, and now in the midst of all this there is still a larger conflict ahead of us, the Russian Civil War.
loc.EN1_KAISERSCHLACHT_DESC: The United Kingdom has fought in the fields of Flanders, the plains of Africa, and in the desert of the Middle East. Tremendous amounts of life has been lost over the course of the war and a victory does not seem any closer at times, but with the naval blockade against Germany, our enemy is severely weakened with mass starvation of civilians and military alike as well a heavy decline in morale and war effort. Whilst we are no better with our own war effort as it loses popularity by the day the Americans will soon arrive and provide fresh troops and a industrial superiority over the Central Powers, but we must survive the onslaught of the Ludendorff Offensive first.
loc.FR3_KAISERSCHLACHT_DESC: The French people desperately outnumbered and outgunned by the Germans have fought on for four years with assistance of the British but the front has barely moved in those four years with a tremendous amount of life that has been lost with it. The Germans however have not managed to break through, not in Verdun, and not on the Belgian Front, however with their troops relieved from Russia they will gain numerical superiority against us, on the flip side the Americans will soon come and relieve us with fresh troops so we must hang on.
loc.US2_KAISERSCHLACHT_DESC: The United States has largely remained neutral throughout the Great War but with the sinking of the Lusitania, Zimmerman Telegram, and the Black Tom sabotage as well as the loans we have given to the Allied Powers for which we must see repaid, we have been forced to enter the Great War or else face a grave loss of money if the Allied Forces fall. But whilst we have joined the war the year before, the transfer of troops has taken a lot longer than expected and we will only start arriving in Europe in large numbers in the following months.
loc.OTHER_KAISERSCHLACHT_DESC: The nations of the world, great and small, will be affected by this conflict that spans across several continents around the world.
loc.OPERATION_BARBAROSSA_DESC: With the start of Operation Barbarossa on the 22nd of June 1941, Germany has officialy broken the Molotov-Ribbentrop Pact. The first phase was the first and only attack along the entire frontline, and captured a huge stroke of USSR territories. The German army seems unstoppable and the Luftwaffe reportedly destroyed 4,000 Soviet Aircraft while only losing 80 of their own. Libya is still holding strong and so far the Soviets seem unable to resist the German Panzers. Japan stands poised to attack the allies in the Pacific...
loc.ENG_OPERATION_BARBAROSSA_DESC: After the Battle of Britain which existed of daily night raids on airfields, civilian targets, convoys and others, the UK is barely left standing. German U-Boots are sinking dozens of convoys in the Antlantic and Empire is starting to starve. But we shall never surrender !
loc.FRA_OPERATION_BARBAROSSA_DESC: With the rapid breakthrough of the German troops through the Ardennes and the subsequent encirclement of france's best troops, the Third French Republic considered the continuation of the war to be pointless. The north of the country is occupied by the Germans and in the south a puppet state was installed under Phillipe Petaine. Now it is up to the remaining forces, who are still loyal to the third French Republic, to continue the struggle.
loc.GER_OPERATION_BARBAROSSA_DESC: The Germans have achieved great military successes in the last two years since the beginning of the war. With the capitulation of France and the slowly starving British, there is only one ideological goal that must be achieved. It is time for the greatest invasion in the history of mankind.
loc.ITA_OPERATION_BARBAROSSA_DESC: The Italian army is not in good condition. Defeats in North Africa and Greece made the Allies see Italy as Germany's soft underbelly. Let us hope that Mussolini can prevent another catastrophy to the military.
loc.JAP_OPERATION_BARBAROSSA_DESC: Japan's sphere of influence is stagnating, but the rest of the Pacific is colonized by the Allies and America. Japan's navy, however, cannot deal with the American one. There must be a way to destroy the Pacific Fleet before the war begins.
loc.SOV_OPERATION_BARBAROSSA_DESC: The fascist traitors have broken the Molotov-Ribbentrop pact and are advancing further into the motherland. The Soviet troops are not prepared for this battle and are suffering heavy losses. Only a miracle can save the Soviets now.
loc.USA_OPERATION_BARBAROSSA_DESC: The Americans remain neutral in the ongoing conflict. Most Americans support this neutrality. The Japanese, however, are threatening to disrupt this peace. Japan has already turned its eyes to the Philippines and the American islands in the Pacific. It is only a matter of time. And that time is running out.
loc.STALINGRAD_DESC: The year is 1942. The Second World War has been raging for almost three years. After the invasion of Poland in September 1939, the Third Reich and its "invincible army" won one victory after another. However, the tide seems to be turning slowly. The supply of troops is no longer guaranteed and many vehicles are left behind due to fuel shortages. The balance of power on the Eastern Front seems to be tilting.
loc.ENG_STALINGRAD_DESC: The United States of America joined the war last year. This drastically improves the situation of the Allies. With the superiority of the Royal Navy and American economic capacity, the Third Reich will have a tough time ahead of it.
loc.FRA_STALINGRAD_DESC: The French resistance fighters have still not given up. The resistance is still confident. It is time to liberate the French people from the Nazis and we will not rest until Paris raises the French flag again. Vive la resistance !
loc.GER_STALINGRAD_DESC: The Russian winter has stopped the German advance in Russia. Hitler had hoped that Stalin would have capitulated until before. Now that winter is over, it's time for the Summer Offensive. But the clock is ticking, the Great German Empire is running out of ressources and will not likely withstand a defeat.
loc.ITA_STALINGRAD_DESC: Together with the Germans and Erwin Rommel, Italy pushed the British back to Al-Alamein in North Africa. After it was not possible to take the strategically important city in July, we will launch another attack.
loc.JAP_STALINGRAD_DESC: The Japanese Empire has dramatically expanded its sphere of influence since the attack on Pearl Harbor and the Allies. However, the war against China is not progressing, and the Americans will not stand idly by as Japan becomes stronger.
loc.SOV_STALINGRAD_DESC: The Red Army has been able to stop the advance of the Germans for the time being. However, the Russians are far from fully equipped and there are still internal problems in the army. But the Russians know that the German Forces are stretched out and the fight is far from over.
loc.USA_STALINGRAD_DESC: On December 1, 1941, the American Pacific Fleet was attacked by Japan's naval and air force at Pearl Harbor. The United States of America is now at war against the Japanese Empire and the Third Reich. But we have a problem. Who will we take care of first ?
loc.TURNING_TIDE_DESC: The tide has finally turned for the Axis, Germany has been beaten out of Stalingrad and North Africa with the Battle of Kursk now being the battle that will make or break the future of German offensive military operations, Sicily has been taken by the allies and Italy is threatening to switch sides, in the Pacific the Japanese Empire has finally reached its zenith and is starting to regress.
loc.ENG_TURNING_TIDE_DESC: The United Kingdom's finest hour has long passed and it is no longer alone in this conflict, the Germans have been decisively defeated along with their Italian allies in North Africa and Sicily has now been invaded pushing Italy off its balance.
loc.FRA_TURNING_TIDE_DESC: Mainland France has been conquered by the enemy which has held on to it for three years now but the French have not given up, resistance continues elsewhere in the colonies where there are plans for coming back and pushing out the enemies which have occupied France.
loc.GER_TURNING_TIDE_DESC: With Stalingrad being a disaster and us being pushed out of the Caucuses all hope is lost for gaining control of the Soviet Union's vast oil resources, our luck is no better in Africa where we have been decisvely beaten and now Italy has been invaded and may very likely switch sides if we do not keep them in the Axis by force. However all is not lost, we have been planning a major operation under the codname Citadel which plans to cut off the Kursk Salient, if we manage to beat the Soviets here and push them back we will be back on track.
loc.ITA_TURNING_TIDE_DESC: The past year has been a disaster for Italy, not only have we been pushed out of North Africa and our other colonies but the Allies have just recently invaded Sicily and are now threatening to invade the mainland country with bombing raids already causing panic and discontent with the war. It may be time to switch sides and get rid of the Duce...
loc.JAP_TURNING_TIDE_DESC: The Empire of Japan has been so far largely undefeated in its efforts to expand, but it has finally reached its Zenith and has started to regress in power and influence with the onslaught of the United States in the Pacific, we need to regroup ourselves and push towards victory or forever live with the consequences of defeat...
loc.SOV_TURNING_TIDE_DESC: The Great Patriotic War has raged on for two years now, we have lost a great deal of lives in this conflict to keep the motherland safe from the fascist beast invaders but it was not in vain, the Germans have been badly beaten on all fronts, with Stalingrad and the Caucasus secured we must focus on defending the Kursk Salient after getting information from the British that there will be an attack specifically centered on that area. We must also lift the Leningrad siege which has lasted two years now costing almost two million lives, as they say it takes more courage to retreat than advance in the Red Army.
loc.USA_TURNING_TIDE_DESC: The United States has been unwillingly pushed into this global conflict following the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor, the Japanese have proven a capable enemy but we are not a perfect match, the industrial might of the United States shall crush the Japanese Empire's power in the Pacific and once we are done with them the Japanese language will be spoken only in hell.
loc.OTHER_TURNING_TIDE_DESC: The nations of the world, great and small, will be affected by this conflict that spans across several continents around the world.
loc.KAMPF_DEM_VATERLAND_DESC: The German Reich is being pushed back heavily from all directions, the Allies in the West took back all of France, Belgium, and are now dangerously close to breaking through and infiltrating the heart of the Reich itself, in the east the Russians are still quite a ways behind the Oder River but the front has extended greately and our allies Romania has surrendered with Hungary dangerously close. Italy is at a standstill and in Asia the situation for Japan is not getiing any better.
loc.ENG_KAMPF_DEM_VATERLAND_DESC: The Allies have over a period of a few months pushed the Germans back compeltely from France and Belgium, in Italy they have advanced fairly north and the United Kingdom has recently taken Greece from the Germans, let us gather our forces and crush the beast once and for all.
loc.FRA_KAMPF_DEM_VATERLAND_DESC: France for the last five years has been under occupation of the German Reich, however with Operation Overlord a success France has been liberated, but will it fall victim to Hitler's last gamble?
loc.GER_KAMPF_DEM_VATERLAND_DESC: The Reich has lost its holdings in France and Belgium and is now getting pushed back into its own territory while Hitler rolls the dice for what will be Germany's last major offensive and major gamble. In the east the Soviets have taken Bulgaria and Romania and turned them against the Reich as well as extending the Front as south as Croatia, though they are still behind the Oder river the Reich will not last under this pressure forever.
loc.ITR_KAMPF_DEM_VATERLAND_DESC: The situation is not developing to Mussolinis advantage. With the Allies pushing forward it does not look good for the Italian Social Republic. This seems to be the end for the dream of the Novus Imperium Romanum.
loc.JAP_KAMPF_DEM_VATERLAND_DESC: The Japanese peoples have fought bravely for the past four years in the pacific theatre however the awoken giant, America has been getting closer and closer. In Burma Japan is getting pushed back by the British whilst the Chinese are finally getting the Upper Hand and thinning the Japanese lines, but the war is far from over the people will not surrender until total annihilation of Japan.
loc.SOV_KAMPF_DEM_VATERLAND_DESC: The Fascist beast has pushed us back as far as Moscow four years ago but here we are four years later pushing them back to Berlin. We will continue this struggle until we reach Berlin itself and we shall show no mercy!
loc.USA_KAMPF_DEM_VATERLAND_DESC: Japan has been rid from the list of the worlds greatest naval powers and now it is all but island hopping to Tokyo to claim the final victory, on the western front the United States and her allies have taken back France and Beglium and pushed further north into Italy. It is clear that the war has been lost for the enemy, but it is far from over.
loc.OTHER_KAMPF_DEM_VATERLAND_DESC: The nations of the world, great and small, will be affected by this conflict that spans across several continents around the world.
loc.GOTTERDAMMERUNG_DESC: The German Eastern Front is on the brink of collapse. The Allies are quickly advancing through France after D-Day and almost half of Italy is in their hands. And while the German Reich is falling, their Japanese Allies are increasingly under pressure from the American giant which is ever so slowly creeping toward mainland Japan.
loc.ENG_GOTTERDAMMERUNG_DESC: The British Empire has not seen any battles in Europe following their retreat from Dunkerque, but now five years later we have landed in Normandy with our Allies and our airforce is now easily taking control of the German skies. Will we succeed to force Germany to surrender, or will our costly invasion of Normandy fail and force us to seek peace? In addition to Normandy we also hold most of Southern Italy with the capital Rome.
loc.FRA_GOTTERDAMMERUNG_DESC: After capitulating in 1940 to the German government the French nation had been all but a government in exile, however now our allies have gained a foothold in Normandy, perhaps we may be liberated.
loc.GER_GOTTERDAMMERUNG_DESC: After roughly five years of warfare the Reich has been driven back on all fronts along with its allies. In June of 1944 the allies have gained a foothold in Normandy, the allies have a foothold in Italy, and even worse the Soviet menace is outnumbering us 10 to 1 in some areas and driving ever so slowly towards Berlin. Our Airforce and Navy are  nothing like it had been in the past, our industry slowing disentegrating due to allied air raids. Will you be able to save the reich?
loc.JAP_GOTTERDAMMERUNG_DESC: Our war against the United States has led to a least favorable situation, however the Japanese Empire is far from dead still holding many resources. However due to heavy allied commerce raiding and naval supremacy our supplies is extremely low and industry is far from booming. All that we can do now is fight to the death and that is what we shall do.
loc.ITR_GOTTERDAMMERUNG_DESC: Following the Allied invasion of Sicily the previous summer which had let the allies invade the rest of Italy, Mussolini had been ousted by his own peoples and forced to create a government in-exile only recognized by Germany and Japan, the Italian Social Republic. However the war is far from over and our losses can be reversed.
loc.SOV_GOTTERDAMMERUNG_DESC: The Fascist invaders have greately underestimated the strength of the Russian peoples united with the will to defend their motherland, after three diastrous years of fighting the German Reich and her allies have been heavily pushed back on the eastern front, defeat after defeat. Now we must launch Operation Bagration to crush the beast once and for all and liberate Belarus.
loc.USA_GOTTERDAMMERUNG_DESC: Following the attack on Pearl Harbor the United States officially entered the War, by 1944 the United States and her allies landed in Normandy and control Southern Italy. In the pacific the United States strategy of Island Hopping has been bringing them ever so closer to the Japanese mainland, but we are still far off.
loc.OTHER_GOTTERDAMMERUNG_DESC: The nations of the world, great and small, will be affected by this conflict that spans across several continents around the world.
loc.ENDSIEG_DESC: Aided by air blows which paralyzed communications throughout the length and breadth of Germany, the Allied Armies have surged across the Cologne Plain. Powerful elements of the Red Army consolidated bridgeheads have regrouped along the Oder while significant advances were made by forces on the flanks. What is left of the once mighty German Army is now the very old and young who are left to defend what remains, meanhwhile in Berlin, Hitler has already entered his bunker.
loc.ENG_ENDSIEG_DESC: With Germany being defeated in all but name the United Kingdom continues its intense bombing raids on the remaining German industry as the allies enroach on the remenants of German resistance.
loc.FRA_ENDSIEG_DESC: Germany is no more, although it is defated in all but name the German Army is still putting up fierce resistance but it is only a matter of time before we break through past the Rhine and force a surrender on Germany.
loc.GER_ENDSIEG_DESC: Germany is on its knees, its enemies have infiltrated the German homeland itself and are contuing the advance, kids as young as ten and men as old as seventy have joined the Volkssturm to defend the Reich at all costs. The Fuhrer is confident the war can still be won with Goebbels still relaying that Endsieg is near, how far this is from the truth we do not know but the fight shall go on!
loc.ITA_ENDSIEG_DESC: Italy has been reduced to but a shimmer of its glorious past. With the establishment of the Social Republic, the fascists are desperately trying to hold on, but the Allies are pushing further and further...
loc.JAP_ENDSIEG_DESC: The Japanese Empire has been slashes on the heel, we no longer have enough naval power to defend against the United States even remotely, in Iwo Jima the United States has concentrated a portion of its navy to bombard the area in an attempt to capture it, we must not let it fall at all costs! To surrender is a great dishonor and for that we must fight to the bloody end even if it means the nation of Japan will be blown off the face of the earth!
loc.SOV_ENDSIEG_DESC: The Great Patriotic war is coming to a close with the Germans behind the Vistula and the Red Army coming ever so closer to Berlin the very heart of the beast itself, but with the Great Patriotic War coming to a close a new line is being drawn in the middle of europe between us and the Allies with our different ideologies.
loc.USA_ENDSIEG_DESC: The United States has successfully driven back the Japanese who are now not even one third of what they used to be, it is only a matter of time before the whole of Japan comes crashing down, our invasion of the Phillipines is so far a success and Iwo Jima is looking to be won over soon as well. The next target is perhaps the Japanese mainland itself...
loc.OTHER_ENDSIEG_DESC: The nations of the world, great and small, will be affected by this conflict that spans across several continents around the world.
loc.SO2_INT_transport_reconstruction_desc: The civil war left rail junctions and freight depots worn down. A coordinated repair program will reconnect industrial regions and make future expansion easier.
loc.SO2_INT_public_health_campaign_desc: Rural clinics and anti-epidemic campaigns can restore confidence in the new state and keep more workers healthy.
loc.SO2_INT_trade_delegations_desc: Soviet representatives will seek machinery, expertise and commercial links abroad while preserving our political independence.
loc.SO2_INT_comintern_press_desc: Schools and printers can give the international communist movement a steadier voice across borders.
loc.SO2_INT_far_eastern_trade_desc: Border commissions have reduced immediate friction. Commercial offices can now open practical channels across the Pacific frontier.
loc.SO2_INT_armored_corps_desc: Experimental vehicles need permanent crews, maintenance methods and a clear place in field exercises.
loc.SO2_INT_red_army_logistics_desc: Deep operations depend on fuel, rail timetables and supply officers as much as on doctrine.
loc.SO2_INT_aircraft_design_bureaus_desc: A network of design teams and flight schools will turn experimental aircraft into an effective air force.
loc.SO2_INT_frontline_air_control_desc: Forward liaison officers can coordinate pilots with advancing ground formations.

loc.INT_whr_news.1.d: The White coalition has held constituent elections. Alexander Kerensky now heads a civilian government, marking a break with the provisional military arrangements of the civil war.
loc.INT_whr_news.2.d: The restored royal government has brought its cabinet and industry under a lasting constitutional settlement.
loc.INT_whr_news.3.d: Years after the civil war, Admiral Kolchak's directorate remains the center of political authority in White Russia.
loc.INT_whr_news.4.d: The White Russian government says its railways, banks and factories have recovered from years of war and the global slump.
loc.WHR_INT_reconstruction_cabinet_desc: A wartime coalition cannot administer peacetime recovery without a common budget and clear authority.
loc.WHR_INT_white_coalition_desc: Civilian ministers and former front commanders must learn to govern together.
loc.WHR_INT_civic_ministries_desc: Transfer routine administration from headquarters to accountable ministries.
loc.WHR_INT_constituent_elections_desc: The restored assembly can give the republic a government with an electoral mandate.
loc.WHR_INT_republic_1935_desc: A stable civilian government now speaks for the whole country.
loc.WHR_INT_dynastic_council_desc: The restored court needs a council that can mediate between the crown and the former White armies.
loc.WHR_INT_crown_and_cabinet_desc: The monarch must decide how much authority to entrust to ministers.
loc.WHR_INT_royal_industry_desc: Chartered firms will rebuild workshops and rail links under the crown's patronage.
loc.WHR_INT_monarchy_1935_desc: The crown has weathered the turmoil of reconstruction and established a durable state.
loc.WHR_INT_admiralty_cabinet_desc: Kolchak's government will bring civilian administration under a central wartime command.
loc.WHR_INT_officer_government_desc: Experienced officers will reorganize the provinces and train a loyal administrative corps.
loc.WHR_INT_emergency_statutes_desc: The government must decide when exceptional security measures should give way to normal law.
loc.WHR_INT_kolchak_1935_desc: The admiral's directorate has survived its provisional years and can now set a longer course.
loc.WHR_INT_village_land_titles_desc: Clear title to small holdings will settle years of rural uncertainty.
loc.WHR_INT_cossack_compact_desc: Regional autonomy and military service can be negotiated together.
loc.WHR_INT_university_reopening_desc: Scholars and engineers can return to classrooms and laboratories as the civil war recedes.
loc.WHR_INT_debt_commission_desc: Foreign loans and wartime supplies must be reconciled before normal trade can resume.
loc.WHR_INT_renegotiate_loans_desc: A settlement with our former patrons can free capital for reconstruction.
loc.WHR_INT_emigre_networks_desc: Russian communities abroad can raise funds and maintain diplomatic contacts.
loc.WHR_INT_pacific_trade_desc: Commercial ties in the Far East can bring machinery without new territorial concessions.
loc.WHR_INT_border_commissions_desc: Negotiators should settle practical frontier questions before they become military crises.
loc.WHR_INT_nonaggression_treaties_desc: New neighbors need written assurances that the civil war's fronts are closed.
loc.WHR_INT_foreign_recognition_desc: Sustained diplomacy can replace exceptional wartime missions with regular relations.
loc.WHR_INT_officer_academies_desc: A professional army needs doctrine schools rather than rival field headquarters.
loc.WHR_INT_siberian_command_desc: The eastern formations will codify their experience of long distances and winter campaigning.
loc.WHR_INT_motor_transport_desc: Trucks and repair depots will reduce the army's dependence on worn railheads.
loc.WHR_INT_artillery_school_desc: Standardized fire plans can make the existing guns more effective.
loc.WHR_INT_mobile_reserve_desc: The reconstituted army will keep trained formations ready for rapid deployment.
loc.WHR_INT_aircraft_bureaus_desc: Designers and mechanics need stable workshops after years of improvised wartime production.
loc.WHR_INT_flight_regiments_desc: Permanent squadrons will give pilots consistent training and command.

loc.WHR_INT_grain_exports_desc: Stable export contracts can finance imports while protecting domestic supply.
loc.WHR_INT_industrial_consortia_desc: Factory owners and the state will coordinate heavy industrial investment.

loc.WHR_INT_recovery_1935_desc: The repaired transport, credit and industrial systems can support a lasting recovery.

loc.interwar_greece.1.d: The Vardar Offensive was fought between the 15th and 29th of September 1918 which ultimately led to the defeat of the Kingdom of Bulgaria on the Macedonian Front an ultimate armistice was signed. A combined force of Serbian, French, and Greek troops attacked the Bulgarian-held trenches in Dobro Pole, present day Macedonia. Being defeated twice already the allies preceding artillery preparation and assault had a devastating effect on Bulgarian morale which led to mass desertions along the front in a chaotic manner. After the allies captured the former HQ of Uskub and endangered the remenants of the 11th Army with the development of an anti-moanrchist Radomir Rebellion, the Kingdom of Bulgaria was forced to sign the Armistice of Salonica and withdrew from the war. \n\n If you're a player you get the idea 'Vardar Offensive' which gives you tons of bonuses, good luck!
loc.interwar_greece.2.d: On October 2, 1920, King Alexander while trying to separate a barbary macaque monkey attacking his German Shepherd Dog got in the process bit deeply in the leg and torso by another monkey. The king did not consider the incident serious and his wounds were promptly cleaned and dressed. However in the evening his wounds became infected and he gained a strong fever and septicemia set it. His doctors considered amputating his leg but nobody wanted to take responsibility for such a drastic act. 23 days later on October 25, 1920, Alexander died of sepsis and his body was conveyed to Athens Cathedral.
loc.interwar_greece.3.t: Referendum for Return of Constantine I
loc.interwar_greece.3.d: A Referendum on the return of King Constantine I was held in Greece on the 22nd of November 1920, it followed the death of his son, King Alexander. The Proposal was happily approved by 99.0% of the voters. The result ensured and affirmed the dominance of the Anti-Venizelist camp in the country.
loc.interwar_greece.4.d: Following the failed Asia Minor Campaign the king's new-found popularity was lost again and following the army revolt Constantine abdicated the throne once again on 26 September, 1922 and was succeeded by his eldest son, George II.
loc.interwar_greece.5.d: The 11 September, 1922 revolution was an uprising by the Greek army and navy against the government in Athens. Following the Greek Army's defeat in the Asia Minor campaign and the army's evacuation from anatolia to the Greek islands in the eastern Aegian there was high discontent amongst the middle-ranking officers and men for the campaign's conduct by the royal government boiled over into an armed revolt led by pro-Venizelist and anti-royalist officers. The mutiny spread quickly and managed to seize power inAthens forcing King Constantine I to abdicate and leave the country not longer after and left the military government in control of the country until 1924 when the Greek Monarchy was officially abolished.
loc.interwar_greece.5.a: The monarchy has brought nothing but trouble!
loc.interwar_greece.6.d: After being exiled to Italy following his abdication he lived a mere four months of his life being dying on January 11, 1923 at Palermo, Sicily of heart failure. His life and reign that started under the brightest of auspices ended in utter ruin.
loc.interwar_greece.7.d: The Second Hellecnic Republic was proclaimed on 25 March, 1924, in the aftermath of Greece's deeat by Turkey in the Asia Minor Campaign which was widely blamed on the royalist government.
loc.interwar_greece.8.d: A referendum on becoming a republic was held in Greece on 13 April 1924, it followd the catastrophic outcome of the Asia Minor Campaign in which the Greek dreams of recapturing Constantinople were dashed and as a result Constantine I was forced to abdicate and George II, the heir presumptive went on to live in Romania while the government debated the fate of the Monarchy. Ultimately a plebiscite in which 70% people voted for the republic and only 30% voted against.
loc.interwar_greece.9.d: The Italian Government has given us a list of silly demands such as rendering a salute to their fleet, depositing 50,000,000 lire, apologising for something we were not even reponsible for. The question is, is it worth it to just give up or keep our prestige and risk a war between our two countries?
loc.interwar_greece.10.d: On June 24, 1925, officers loyal to Pangalos, fearing that the political instability was putting his country at risk, overthrew the government in a coup and forced President Pavlos Kountouriotis to appoint Pangalos as Prime Minister. Pangalos immediately abolished the young republic and began to prosecute anyone who could possibly challenge his authority, including his old chief, Plastiras. Freedom of the press was abolished, and a number of repressive laws were enacted (including a law dictating the length of women's skirts - no more than 30 cm above the ground), while Pangalos awarded himself the Grand Cross of the Order of the Redeemer.
loc.interwar_greece.11.d: After Theodoros Pangalos took power in a quick and fast military coup abolishing the republic for pear of instability and the country being put at risk he soon began to use his powers irresponsibly and passed a series of repressive laws such as dicating length of women's skirts - no more than 30 cm above the ground, awarded himself the Grand Cross of the Order of the Redeemer, and prosecuted anyone who opposed him. On August 29, 1926 a counter coup led by General Georgios Kondylis deposed him and Pavlos Kountouriotis returned to power as president while Pangalos was imprisoned for two years in the Izzeddin Fortress.
loc.interwar_greece.11.a: Get out of here you dictator!
loc.interwar_greece.12.d: Greek situation \n\nGreece had just entered the war on the side of the allies in the summer of 1917 following the deposition of the pro-German, King Constantine I, and the rise of his pro-Allies son Alexander I. Thus forming the Macedonian front which had mostly stayed stable for now...
loc.interwar_soviet.1.d: Following the unfortunate dissolution of the Second International we have founded the Communist International otherwise known as the Comintern or the Third International following a congress held at moscow today against the backdrop of the Russian Civil War. At the congress there had been 52 delegates present from 34 parties whom decided to form an executive committee with representatives of the msot important sections and that other parties joining the International would have their own representatives.
loc.interwar_soviet.2.d: With the Persian Socialist Republic in a weak state and in need of help we have decided to lend a hand to our fellow communists and supply them with weapons to use for their glorious fight against the capitalists!
loc.interwar_soviet.2.a: Lets hope they can make good use of those supplies!
loc.interwar_soviet.3.d: With the former areas ceded to Germany and her puppets now abandoned by the Ober Ost garrisons which have been withdrawn back to Germany following their defeat we have decided to move our troops back into these abandoned lands to reintigrate them back where they belong, with us!
loc.interwar_soviet.3.a: We will have our land back!
loc.interwar_soviet.4.t: Intervention on the side of the Hungary
loc.interwar_soviet.4.d: With the Hungarian Soviet Republic in a disadvantaged position to spread the glory of Communism to those wretched capitalists surrounding them, seeing as we are in a position to aid our fellow communists bordering their enemies, the Rumanians we have decided to join their efforts and make sure they are not in vain!
loc.interwar_soviet.5.t: Intervene on the side of Red Finland
loc.interwar_soviet.5.d: With Red Finland in a disadvantaged position to spread the glory of Communism to those wretched capitalists surrounding them, seeing as we are in a position to aid our fellow communists we have decided to join their efforts and make sure they are not in vain!
loc.interwar_soviet.6.d: With the Central Powers defeated in the First World War there is no treaty or foreign armies left to defend these wreteched lonely and isolated capitalist states whom belong with the motherland!
loc.interwar_soviet.7.d: With the Central Powers defeated in the First World War there is no treaty or foreign armies left to defend these wreteched lonely and isolated capitalist states whom belong with the motherland!
loc.interwar_soviet.8.d: With the Central Powers defeated in the First World War there is no treaty or foreign armies left to defend these wreteched lonely and isolated capitalist states whom belong with the motherland!
loc.interwar_soviet.9.d: With the Transcaucasian states defeated we have decided to establish a common border between our Turkish friends and us, the treaty which has been signed in the city of Kars, has returned the territory of Kars which was formerly taken by the Russian Empire in the Russo-Turksih war of 1877-78 back to the now Republic of Turkey.
loc.interwar_soviet.10.d: With Red Finland in a weak state and in need of help we have decided to lend a hand to our fellow communists and supply them with weapons to use for their glorious fight against the capitalists!
loc.interwar_soviet.10.a: Lets hope they can make good use of those supplies!
loc.interwar_soviet.11.d: With the Hungarian Soviet Republic in a weak state and in need of help we have decided to lend a hand to our fellow communists and supply them with weapons to use for their glorious fight against the capitalists!
loc.interwar_soviet.11.a: Lets hope they can make good use of those supplies!
loc.interwar_soviet.12.d: With Rumania defeated in their war against failed attempts to stop the spread of the ever so glorious communism we have decided to make use of this opportunity and establish a communist state in Rumania replacing the old government, for where we defeat our enemies we must make new allies!
loc.interwar_soviet.13.d: With the Hungarian Soviet Republic in a weak position to oppose us and largely dependent on our support for their defense we have decided to not let this opportunity go to waste and have created a puppet state for ourselves to insure the beacon of communism remains in the center of europe and to aid us should we need it in the future.
loc.interwar_soviet.14.d: Following negotiations which have lasted several month the Treaty of Tartu has confirmed the final border between Finland and our country following the Finnish Civil War. The treaty has been signed in Tartu and registered in the League of Nations.
loc.interwar_soviet.15.d: With Red Finland in a weak position to oppose us and largely dependent on our support for their defense and hold on to power in the country we have deicded to not let this opportunity go to waste and have created a puppet state for ourselves to insure Finland at least in some way remains connected us like in the old days.
loc.interwar_soviet.16.d: The Japanese have been large supporters of the Whtie Faction most likely in the hopes of gaining territory or more influence in the far east, however with the defeat of White Russia we will not let any more Japanese involement go unnoticed, they must leave.
loc.interwar_soviet.17.t: Reintegration of the Far Eastern Republic
loc.interwar_soviet.17.d: With the Japanese threat largely diminished we have taken actions to re-absorb the Far Eastern Republic with the government dissolving itself and transferring all of its authority and territory back to our government in Moscow.
loc.interwar_soviet.18.d: With our relations heavily damaged during the civil war following Japans support of the White Faction and subsequent occupation of territory in the far east we have decided to hopefully normalize relations between our two countries by signing te Soviet-Japanese Basic Convention treaty.
loc.interwar_soviet.18.a: Good we should not be enemies
loc.interwar_soviet.19.d: With Roman von Ungern-Sternberg's, of the White Movement, invasion of Mongolia in hopes of re-establishing this so called 'Mongolian Empire' it our duty to help the Mongolians fight against this imperialistic megalomaniac.
loc.interwar_soviet.21.d: With the goal of keeping towns and the red army stocked with food and weapons we haveadopted the system of War Communism which is neccesary due to the ongoing war disrupting the normal economic mechanisms and relations. \n\n War Communism will include the following policies 1. Nationalization of all indutries 2. State control of Foriegn Trade 3. Strict discipline for workers, strikes forbidden 4. Obligatory labor duty by non-working classes 5. Prodrazvyorstka 6. Rationing of food and most commodities 7. Private enterprises banned and 8. Military-style control of the railways.
loc.interwar_soviet.22.d: Established by theCouncil of People's Commissars the CHEKA has come under the leadership of Felix Dzerzhinsky who will lead this secret police organisation. The CHEKA will police labor camps, conduct requisitions of food, subject political opponents to secret arrest (detention, torture, and summary execution). It will also put down rebellions and riots by the workers or peasants and mutinies in the desertion-plagued Red Army.
loc.interwar_soviet.23.d: With the cossacks largely beign against us and our ideals we have decided to conduct a systemic repression against the cossacks of the former Russian Empire, especially the Don and Kuban cossacks whom have openly provided large support for the White Movement in southern regions. This will hopefully eliminate the cossacks as separate ethnic, political, and economic entity.
loc.interwar_soviet.24.d: With the need for political repression against the enemies within who seek to destroy us we have started a country-wide effort to get rid of these traitors in any way neccesary...
loc.interwar_soviet.25.d: The New Economic Policy which has been proposed by the ever so glorious Vladimir Lenin, has been described by him as a progression towards 'state capitalism' within the workers' state of the USSR. Lenin ahs charactized that his NEP policies will include 'a free market and capitalism both subject to state control' while socialized state enterprises are to oeprate on a 'profit basis'. All of this is deemed necessary following the deadly and destructive Russian Civil War in order to help foster the economy of the country which has been almost completely ruined.
