loc.ww2_soviet.7.d: The Estonian War of independence beginning on November 28th, 1918 was a defensive war against the the Soviet Western Front offensive along with the aggression of the Baltische Landeswehr which fought to preserve German supremacy in the Baltics.
loc.ww2_soviet.7.a: The Red Army is the strongest
loc.ww2_soviet.8.d: The Latvian War of INdependence starting on December 5th 1918 started when the RSFSR invaded Latvia part of its Westward Offensive. The war also involved the German Baltische Landeswehr which wished to preserve German supremacy in the Baltic States and aimed for a German domination of Latvia.
loc.ww2_soviet.9.d: The Kronstadt rebellion which started on March 7th, 1921, was a major uprising on Kotlin Island, Kronstadt a naval fortress, against the Bolsheviks in March 1921. It consisted mainly of Russian sailors, soldiers, and civilians, and was caused by Lenin’s reason to loosen control of the Russian economy (New Economic Policy). However the rebellion was largely unsuccessful and crushed after a 12 day military campaign that resulted in roughly 3-4 thousand deaths total.
loc.ww2_soviet.10.d: After a long and brutal war between the Russian SFSR and the White Movement the Russian Reds have finally surrendered after the White Movement captured the major strong points of Moscow, Petrograd, and Tsaritsyn. While the Reds have lost for good, the path is still not clear for the very split White Movment which has been shown even throughout the Civil War with several leaders rather than one. The power struggle that will follow is surely to leave the nation even more stressed, however for the moment we have won against the evil Bolshevik forces and for that is what is most important now...
loc.ww2_soviet.11.d: The Far Eastern Republic (FAR) was established following the aftermath of the Russian Civil War. Whilst the area was under the control of the White Siberian government led by Kolchak, following the evacuation of Japanese and white forces a political vacuum ensued in the region. A new central authority was established at Chita to govern the FAR. It was viewed as a temporary buffer state between the Russian SFSR and the territories still occupied by Japan and the allies. However by April 1920 American forces evacuated Siberia leaving Japan the sole occupying power. The Bolsheviks viewed the FAR as a sort of Treaty of Brest-Litovsk in the east with the FAR providing the regime breathing space to allow it to recover economically and militarily acting as a buffer state with Japan. Japan eventually recognized the new buffer state in a truce with the Red Army signed 15 July 1920.
loc.ww2_soviet.12.title: White Movment Defeated! Bolshevik Victory...
loc.ww2_soviet.12.d: After a long and brutal war between the Russian SFSR and the White Movment the split and undecided White Movement eventually fell due to its own faults and never again recovered with the Reds establishing total dominance in politics and government of the new state. The Whites have lost for good, but hard times are still ahead for the country, we must make a successful path to Communism from this current state of affairs and show spread the revolution!
loc.ww2_soviet.13.d: On 26 May, 1921, a white coup backed by Japanese occupying forces took place in Vladivostok in which a provisional government was proclaimed. It prevented unsuccessfully to rally anti-Bolshevik forces and following the Japanese evacuation starting June 1922 the Whites found themselves isolated.
loc.ww2_soviet.13.a: This is only a house of cards...
loc.ww2_soviet.14.d: The Japanese hoped for a while to establish a buffer state/puppet between the Russian SFSR and themselves from fear of communism and personal interests. However after all of the allies evacuated and left Japan was left alone and was soon after pressured by the Allied Powers to evacuate as well which they did following June 1922. Communists take over FAR\n\n As the Japanese Forces evacuated the Far Eastern Republic, the Red Army disguised as the Army of the FAR approached and re-established the communist regime and retook Vladivostok on 25 October 1922 which effectively brought the Russian Civil War to a close.
loc.ww2_soviet.15.d: With the Civil War finally over the Russian SFSR absorbed the FAR on 15 November 1922. The government of the Far Eastern Republic dissolved itself and transferred all its authority and territory to the Bolshevik government in Moscow. However Japan still retained the northern half of Sakhalin Island until 1925.
loc.ww2_soviet.16.d: The First Congress of the Comintern was an international gathering of communist, revolutionary, and syndicalist delegates which was held in Moscow and officially established the Communist International, also known as the COmintern. The gathering held from March 2 to 6, 1919, was attended by 51 representatives of more than two dozen countries from around Europe, North America, and Asia.
loc.eg_soviet.20.d: After a two-year long siege by German forces, one of the longest and most destrcutive sieges in history has finally ended with the fascist beast finally being driven away from the outskirts of the city. We have suffered great losses in this with close to two million dead, they will be forever remembered as heroes who did not cave in under any circumstances to the fascist beast!
loc.eg_soviet.21.d: At the request of the Tuva's Small People's Khural, Tuva shall become part of our great nation as the Tuvan Autonomous Oblast following the decision of the Presidium of the Supreme Soviet. The annexation will be officially formalized on 1st November, 1944.
loc.afghan.1.d: Emir Habibullah was assasinated while on a hunting trip at the Laghman Province on February 20, 1919. His brother Nasrullah Khan who was behind the assasination briefly succeeded him as the Emir of Afghanistan and held power for a week between February 21 and February 28, 1919, before being ousted and imprisoned by Habibullah's third son, Amanullah Khan.
loc.afghan.2.d: The Third Anglo-Afghan war began on May 6, 1919, following Amir Habibullah’s assassination and his son’s subsequent rise to power whom needed a way to placate the conservatives in Afghanistan to hold on to power. Looking for a diversion from the internal strife and sending civil unrest in India, Amanullah decided to invade British India.
loc.afghan.3.d: The Anglo-Afghan Treaty of 1919 was an armistice between the UK and Afghanistan following the end of the Third Anglo-Afghan war. In the document the United Kingdom recognised Afghanistan's independence and agreed that British India would not extend past the Khyber Pass and stopped British subsidies to Afghanistan.
loc.eg_romania.1.d: The Treaty of Bucharest, signed May 7th, 1918 was a final peace treaty between Romania and the Central following Romanias isolation on the eastern front after Russia's exit from WWI. The terms of the treaty were to return Southern Dobruja the the southern part of Northern Dobruja to Bulgaria with the rest of Northern Dobruja remaining under joint control of the Central Powers. Romania additionally had to give Austria-Hungary minor concessions of the passes for the Carpathian Mountains. Romania also had to lease oil wells to Germany for 90 years but additionally in favor of Romania the Central Powers recognized the Union of Bessarabia with Romania. Behind the curtain Romania had been made into a 'de facto' German puppet with German civil servants having the power to veto decisioms by Romanian cabinet ministers and to fire Romanian civil servants as they had been apponted to oversee every Romanian ministry.
loc.eg_romania.2.t: Treaty of Bucharest Declared Null and Void
loc.eg_romania.2.d: Following the Armistice of 11.11.18 the Treaty of Bucharest had been in effect declared null and void. Once Germany was forced to sign the Treaty of Versaille in 1919 it was also forced to renounce all benefits provided by the Treaty of Bucharest. The territorial transfers to Austria-Hungary and Bulgaria were annulled by the treaties of Saint-Germain, Neuilly and Trianon.
loc.eg_romania.3.d: On April 9th 1918, the National Council of Bessarabia officially proclaimed a union with the Kingdom of Rumania. The Rumanian prime-minister Alexandru Marghiloman however insisted that the unification was rather decided in Rumania rather than Bessarabia as the leaders of Molavia were aware of the wide-spread distrust of Rumanian rule and thus feared an overt annexation would lead to a rather revolutionary situation similar to that of russia.
loc.eg_romania.4.d: Following a successful Soviet offensive into Northeastern Romania, King Michael who had been viewed as a mere figure head in Romanian politics successfully overthrew Ion Atonescu and alligned himself with the allies declaring war on Germany shortly after, however King Michael only shortly remained the Head of State of Romania being being replaced by a Soviet Communist Puppet Government.
loc.eg_romania.4.a: The war continues, now on Germany!
loc.crybabia.1.d: The Conquest of Ha’il also known as the Second Saudi-Rashidi War was fought between Saudi forces which received British military assistance against the Emirate of Jabal Shammar under the last Rashidi ruler who would surrender Jabal Shammar to the saudi forces on November 2, 1921.
loc.industrialisation.1.d: Traditionalists in the government have argued against our move towards a industrial society arguing that we have lived for hundreds of years on an agrarian based economy and that there is no need to move towards an industrial society now. \n\n None-the-less the reform will be going through but the traditionalists will keep the government somewhat divided for the time being...
loc.industrialisation.2.d: With Industrialisation in our country moving forward ever so slowly it has not come without its troubles as many factory owners have started instead of searching for skilled workers, taken the unskilled workers for cheaper labor. Due to this there has been growing unrest in the new working class, whilst not quite serious yet the bubble will burst eventually...
loc.industrialisation.3.d: We are now considered by the world to be a Pre-Industrial Society and have effectively moved away from being the Agrarian Society we once were. Of course our path to this stage has not come without its troubles but the path ahead of us is still long and windy.
loc.industrialisation.4.d: In order to increase the efficiency of goods being transported across the country our government has taken the initiative to start construction of a major railway, this alone should employ many workers however the costs will be quite high though worth it in the end if we plan to move further.
loc.industrialisation.5.d: Despite our efforts to start industrialisation reforms many of our people still have a backwards mentality toward industrialisation. Many of our rich capitalists still prefer to invest in land rather than buisnesses, they see investments in industry risky making land purchases much more appealing.
loc.industrialisation.5.a: This is a bad mentality for the long run!
loc.industrialisation.6.d: We are now considered by the world to be an Early Industrial Society, effectively moving away from our former status as a Pre-Industrial Society. Now we can be considered to be  more like some of the European nations that have progressed somewhat significantly in terms of industry.
loc.industrialisation.7.d: Issues from the past with unskilled workers being employed for cheap wages over the skilled have not been forgotten. A major workers strike has been held in one of our major industrial areas where workers have been protesting for higher wages and less work hours which have put a strain on our production output, if this isn't resolved quick it will turn into a problem.
loc.industrialisation.8.d: As we start to move forward even further the traditionalists have not gone away by any means, there is still a large struggle not only with some backwards politcians but the people themselves that have the same tradtionalist mentaility refusing change!
loc.industrialisation.9.d: Due to the fact that our nation does not have enough land suited for farming required to feed our growing population is making things quite difficult, many say that if we continue going forward we will have to continually rely on other nations for food products.
loc.industrialisation.10.d: We are now considered by the world to be a Basic Industrial Society, like most European nations, we are just below the major countries.
loc.industrialisation.11.t: Workers Strike Spirals Out of Control!
loc.industrialisation.11.d: Workers in our most industrialised region have started a strike for higher wages, less work hours, better working conditions, and universal suffrage. Whilst the strike started off small it quickly grew in size to thousands of people protesting, the local government in turn sent out an army unit to keep control of the protest where it quickly turned into a blood bath as shots were fired onto the crowd.
loc.industrialisation.12.d: As we push even further in terms of industrialisation it is getting rather difficult as much of the resources required do not currently have or produce enough of which means our progress will be significantly slowed down for now.
loc.industrialisation.13.d: With our industrial growth promoting large immigration towards our cities/industrial centers we have found ourselves unequipped to handle this large urban population growth where not enough residences can be constructed in time to house enough people. Many are forced to live together in horrible conditions and then go to work in such conditions giving birth to a new social class that may be very well susceptible to revolutionary ideas....
loc.industrialisation.14.d: We have reached the top of the ladder and are now considered to officialy be an Industrial Society, we are now largely ahead of most countries in the world.
loc.ww1_britain.1.d: Ever since the death of Queen Victoria and Kaiser Wilhelm II's imperialistic and naval ambitions which threaten our nation there has been a great schism between Germany and the United Kingdom.
loc.ww1_britain.1.a: Those Huns won't get ahead of us!
loc.ww1_britain.2.d: The fuse leading to the Powder Keg has been lit, it is only a matter of time before the war breaks out for which we must prepare for the better or the worst of what it may turn into.
loc.ww1_britain.3.d: Although we have heavily aligned ourselves with the Entente we have declared neutrality in this conflict for the time being, whilst it doesnt mean we will remain neutral for the whole of the war, we will for now keep a watchful eye on how the war goes and may enter later.
loc.ww1_britain.3.a: We will keep a safe distance for now...
loc.ww1_britain.4.d: With the Germans violating Beglian Neutrality and going against any sort of British Interests we have taken neccesary steps to join the Entente in the war against them.
loc.ww1_britain.4.a: We won't let our allies down!
loc.ww1_britain.5.t: Britain Declares War on Central Powers
loc.ww1_britain.5.d: Whilst we have previously proclaimed temporary neutrality, we have spectated the war and have now taken actions to get involved ourselves on the side of the Entente whom ultimately protects British interests.
loc.ww1_britain.5.a: We will not accept German hegemony over Europe!
loc.ww1_britain.6.d: In an effort to restrict the maritime supply of goods to the Central Powers, we have taken actions to blockade any convoys heading to Germany or any other Central Powers members. The German Empire heaily relies on imports to feed their population and supply their war industry, thus this should have a serious affect on their internal stability and war efficiency.
loc.ww1_britain.7.d: Whilst our attempts to conscript the Irish populous have been met with serious protest and we have been on shakey terms following the Easter Rising, it is none the less neccesary as we are in dire need of more manpower to fill the ranks.
loc.ww1_britain.8.d: Calls for conscription in Ireland have been met with serious protest and opposition and thus we have decided to not go through with instating conscription in Ireland. Whilst it may deprive us of neccesary manpower it will be none-the-less more worthwhile and keep the nation more stable in a time where stability is neccesary to avoid revolution.
loc.ww1_britain.8.a: Dissent is the last thing we need
loc.ww1_britain.9.t: Call for Scandinavia to Break with Germany
loc.ww1_britain.9.d: Like the United States has decided to break with Germany we have asked the Scandinavian monarchs, Haakon VII of Norway, Gustav V of Sweden, and Christian X of Denmark, to consider breaking with Germany. Whilst the North Sea Blockade is effective, it will never be 100% efficient if the Scandinavian nations continue to trade with Germany.
loc.ww1_britain.9.a: Hopefully they will follow Americas lead
loc.ww1_britain.901.t: Scandinavia Refuses to Break with Germany
loc.ww1_britain.901.d: The Scandinavian monarchs have recently held a conference in Copenhagen and have ultimately declined to break off diplomatic and trade relations with Germany because of the 'ruthless' submarine warfare.
loc.ww1_britain.902.t: Scandinavia Agrees to Break with Germany
loc.ww1_britain.902.d: The Scandinavian monarchs have recently held a conference in COpenhagen and have ultimately agreed to break off diplomatic and trade relations with Germany because of the ruthless submarine warfare.
loc.ww1_britain.10.d: The Portuguese have long since remained close with us, it is well known that the Portuguese and Germany are not on good terms with some serious tension between the two when it comes to submarine warfare.
loc.ww1_britain.11.d: With the Portuguese and Germany facing serious tension due to Germany's decision to enact unrestricted submarine warfare, which has as a result sank many Portuguese ships, the Portuguese have ultimately decided to join the Entente.
loc.ww1_britain.12.d: Bulgaria is key to success in the Balkans, should the Central Powers get Bulgaria to join them our ally Serbia will likely fall and thus Germany will be able to directly send supplies to Turkey. However, should Bulgaria join us Turkey's capital Constantinople will be severely threatened and Serbia's position furthermore reinforced. The thing is, we have unlike the Central Powers, little to offer to Bulgaria. However, we have urged Serbia to cede some of its territory to Bulgaria in hopes of getting Bulgaria to join us. However, it is not as much as the Central Powers are offering, the Bulgarians will likely not consider our offer but there is still a chance they will.
loc.ww1_britain.12.a: Lets hope they will consider it
loc.ww1_britain.1201.d: The British have attempted to sway us to their side, they have offered some of our claims in Serbia and Edirne from the Ottoman Turks. Although it isn't as much as the Central Powers are willing to offer, would it be likely that Germany will win this war given their inability to control the seas?
loc.ww1_britain.1202.d: The Bulgarians have thankfully accepted our generous offer of territorial gains, although it isn't as much as what the Central Powers were likely offering it seems they have come to their senses that we will ultimately win this war in the end.
loc.ww1_britain.1203.d: As we have predicted, the Bulgarians have unfortunately rejected our offer of territorial gains, it is very much likely due to the fact that the Central Powers have promised far more than we could offer. As unfortunate as it is that we could not sway Bulgaria to our side we will ultimately win this war, with them or not.
loc.ww1_britain.13.d: The Bulgarians have finally finished preparing to join the conflict and have officially declared their entrance into the Entente. With their help we will keep Turkey and Germany divided and threaten Constantinople as well as reinforcing Serbia's position for good.
loc.ww1_britain.14.d: Whilst the United States has declared neutrality in the European conflict they ultimately favor us far more than the Central Powers given our democratic status.
loc.ww1_britain.14.a: Hopefully we can get them to join
loc.ww1_britain.15.d: The United States has long since been aiding the Entente throughout the war and it ultimately any sort of neutrality they have declared has withered away over time and they have ultimately decided to join the European conflict formally.
loc.ww1_britain.16.d: The Suez Canal is a critical strategic point, and thus we have taken neccesary actions to fortify the canal in case of a future war.
loc.ww1_britain.17.d: Given Turkey's likely entrance on the side of the Central Powers we have taken actions to secure the South Persian oilfields and the route to India.
loc.ww1_britain.18.t: Turkish Ships Incorporated into Royal Navy
loc.ww1_britain.18.d: The Turkish Ships 'Osmân-ı Evvel' and 'Reşadiye' have been incporated into the Royal Navy on the orders of Winston Churchill who does not want to risk the ships being used against us. However, given the fact that the pay for the ships was funded by public subscriptions partially, by taverns, cafes, schools, and market, this action has caused considerable ill will in the Ottoman Empire. The seizure of the ships has influenced the Ottoman public opinion of us in a seriously negative way.
loc.ww1_britain.19.d: Hussein bin Ali, the Sharif of Mecca, has initiated the Arab Rebellion with the aim of securing independence from the ruling Ottoman Turks in hopes of creating a single unified Arab State. The Sharif claims that the Young Turks have violated the sacred tenets of Islam and has called upon Arab Muslims to the sacred Rebellion against the ostensibly 'impious' Ottoman Government. \n\n Whilst the revolt is being assisted by our government it is none-the-less not as popular as we could have hoped it would become with the majority of Arabs still staying loyal to the Ottoman Empire.
loc.ww1_britain.20.d: With support of the British Government we have allocated enough funds to the British Raj, giving it a significant boost of industrial growth which should hopefully strengthen the colony and provide more jobs.
loc.ww1_britain.21.d: With support of the British Government we have allocated enough funds to South Africa, giving it a significant boost of industrial growth which should hopefully strengthen the state and provide more jobs.
loc.ww1_britain.22.d: With support of the British Government we have allocated enough funds to Australia, giving it a significant boost of industrial growth which should hopefully strengthen the colony and provide more jobs.
loc.ww1_britain.23.d: With support of the British Government we have allocated enough funds to Canada, giving it a significant boost of industrial growth which should hopefully strengthen the colony and provide more jobs.
loc.ww1_britain.24.d: Although the recruits from British Raj are arguably not the best, usually suffering in terms of quality training and performance, we have none-the-less managed to gain an huge chunk of manpower to use on the European Theatre.
loc.ww1_britain.25.d: A daring plan has been proposed by the British Admiralty to land troops on the Gallipoli Peninsula and from there to head up and to hopefully eventually seize the capital of the Ottoman Empire, Constantinople which means a great deal to the Turks. Should we take it we would likely force them out of the war.
loc.ww1_britain.26.d: The landings in Gallipoli have begun, however unfortunately our troops have landed in the wrong area leaving them somewhat strategically weakened, but oh well. Within two months more reinforcements should arrive, hopefully we can take advantage of the invasion whilst we still can and have the power to force the turks out taking Constantinople.
loc.ww1_britain.26.a: We must force the Turks out!
loc.ww1_britain.2601.d: Reinforcements to aid the initial Gallipoli landing have finally arrived, hopefully we will be able to use them to their full effectiveness and beat the Turks back.
loc.ww1_britain.27.d: The Canadian Expeditionary force has arrived in France ready to fight with a total of around 300,000 men from the Dominion of Canada enlisting to fight on the Western Front as of yet.
loc.ww1_britain.28.d: Admiral Lord Fisher has promoted this 'Baltic Project', he assures a speedy victory over Germany. The plan involves landing a substantial force, either of British or Russian soldiers, or both, on the flat beaches of Pomerania on the North German Coast which happens to be a bit less than 100 miles from Berlin. \n\n However, of course such a plan would require a huge specialist fleet with submarines and extensive mining to keep the landing force safe from the German Navy. It could be done but will it be ultiamtely worth it?
loc.ww1_britain.29.t: Gathering Resources for the Baltic Project
loc.ww1_britain.29.d: We have decided to go along with the Baltic Project and have started to put together the fleet required to keep the landing force safe from the German Navy, it will require some 600 vessels which includes landing craft, minesweepers, destroyers, light cruisers, monitors, and some heavy shallow draft support ships.
loc.ww1_britain.30.d: Our ships have arrived off the coast of Pomerania and the landings have begun with the German Imperial Navy unable to do anything about it, if we are to take advantage of this we must deliver a final knockout blow to Germany by attacking Berlin and forcing them to surrender.
loc.ww1_britain.301.t: First Reinforcements Wave Arrives at Pommerania
loc.ww1_britain.301.d: The first wave of reinforcements have arrived at Pomerania with several Russian divisions getting involved in the struggle.
loc.ww1_britain.302.t: Second Reinforcements Wave Arrives at Pommerania
loc.ww1_britain.302.d: The second and last wave of reinforcements has finally arrived at Pomerania, hopefully we this will be enough to take a strategic position and beat back the Germans forcing them to surrender.
loc.ww1_britain.31.d: Following eight years after the end of the Second Boer War and after four years of negotiation, the act of the British Parliament in 1909 granted nominal independence finally the Union of South Africa being formed today containing former territories of the Cape, the Natal Colonies, Transvaal, and the Orange Free State.
loc.ww1_britain.32.t: United in the Face of Agression
loc.ww1_britain.32.d: With the German Empire forcing our hand to join this largely unneccesary war by violating Belgian neutrality our people have largely decided to set aside their differences or oppositions towards the government and unite in the face of German aggression.
loc.ww1_britain.33.d: The Military Service Act has been passed specifying that single men aged from 18 to 40 years old are now liable to be called up for military srvice unless they are widowed with children or are ministers of a religion. Due to the political situation, conscription will only be applied in England, Scotland, and Whales ignoring Ireland.
loc.ww1_britain.34.t: Defense of the Realm Act Passed
loc.ww1_britain.34.d: The Defense of the Realm Act (DORA) has been passed, giving the government wide-ranging powers such as the power to requisition buildings or land needed for the war effort, or to make regulations creating criminal offences. DORA has also given the government power of censorship and other authoritarian social control mechanisms.
loc.ww1_britain.34.a: A much needed change in this time of war
loc.ww1_britain.35.d: In an effort to maximize our war effort even more we have taken even more actions shifting the focus of all production toward military production.
loc.ww1_britain.36.d: In an effort to put an end to this war as soon as possible we have decided to put our full focus on the front line to give us an edge over our enemies, however this will mean somewhat neglecting the home front which can cause issues later on.
loc.ww1_britain.37.d: In an effort to put an end to this war as soon as possible we have decided to put our full focus on the front line to give us an edge over our enemies, however this will mean somewhat neglecting the home front which can cause issues later on.
loc.ww1_britain.38.d: In an effort to put an end to this war as soon as possible we have decided to put our full focus on the front line to give us an edge over our enemies, however this will mean somewhat neglecting the home front which can cause issues later on.
loc.ww1_britain.39.d: We have decided to focus on our home front, whilst still heavily focused on the frontline itself we will refrain from neglecting the home front completely and still put a significant focus on keeping things at home stable.
loc.ww1_britain.40.d: We have decided to focus on our home front, whilst still heavily focused on the frontline itself we will refrain from neglecting the home front completely and still put a significant focus on keeping things at home stable.
loc.ww1_britain.41.d: We have decided to focus on our home front, whilst still heavily focused on the frontline itself we will refrain from neglecting the home front completely and still put a significant focus on keeping things at home stable.
loc.ww1_britain.42.d: Our King, Edward VII has unfortunately passed away today, with his son George V succeeding as the next King of the United Kingdom. The Kings funeral was the greatest assemblage of royalty and rank every gathered in on place so far.
loc.ww1_britain.43.d: Lord Kitchener and his staff have unfortunately drowned today after boarding the HMS Hampshire for an expected diplomatic mission to Russia. Shortly before 19:30 hrs the same day, steaming towards the Russian port of Arkhangelsk, the HMS Hampshire struck a mine laid by a German U-boat and sank off the west coast of the Orkney Islands. Of the 749 on board, only twelve have managed to survive. \n\n The news of Kitcheners death is definately a shock to the people of the Commonwealth, many held firm beliefs that Britain's victory was assured if Kitchener was to live, but now there is not even the slightest of glimmer of hope in these dark times, he will be mourned.
loc.ww1_britain.44.d: An armed insurrection has begun in Ireland during Easterweek! According to reports, the Rising has been launched by Irish Republics who intend to 'end British rule in Ireland and establish an independent Irish Republic'. They have taken a jab at us while we are heavily engaged elsewhere dealing with German Imperialism. This is arguably the most significant uprising in Ireland in the last hundred years and we must deal with it quick before it gets out of hand!
loc.ww1_britain.45.d: The Dervish War lasting for roughly ten years now has been a fairly long and drawn out conflict with Mohammed Abdullah Hassan (nicknamed the "Mad Mullah" by our men) and his Dervish Troops who have as of yet remained undefeated. Although this 'Mad Mullah' certainly does not pose all that much of a threat it would be non-the-less best to wipe these rebels out of existance.
loc.ww1_britain.45.a: We are coming for you Mad Mullah!
loc.ww1_britain.46.d: Recently, the resistance in our share of Libya has increased hundredfold. The Senussi religious group has claimed control over the area, and with the limited amount of operatives in the area we can hardly contest them. What should we do?
loc.ww1_britain.46.a: Let them have that piece of dust!
loc.ww1_britain.46.b: Giving up now is giving up forever!
loc.ww1_bulgaria.1.d: During the First Balkan War we together with the Balkan League succeeded in driving out the Ottoman Empire from most of its European holdings, however, due to the creation of an independent Albania which was supposed to go to Serbia the spoils in Macedonia which were promised to us via the secret agreement between us and Serbia had been denied with Serbia instead taking hold of our claims. It is now our duty to fight for what is ours!
loc.ww1_bulgaria.1.a: We will show them the might of Bulgaria!
loc.ww1_bulgaria.1.b: We are happy with what we got
loc.ww1_bulgaria.101.d: With Bulgaria at war with its former allies over the disputed territory of Vardar Macedonia perhaps we should take advantage of the situation and join Serbia and Greece in their fight against Bulgarian imperialism for the territory of Southern Dobruja.
loc.ww1_bulgaria.102.d: With Bulgaria at war with her former allies over the disputed territory of Vardar Macedonia perhaps we should take advtange of the situation and join Serbia and Greece in their fight against Bulgarian imperialism for our lost territory of Adrianople.
loc.ww1_bulgaria.102.c: With them on our side we're unstoppable!
loc.ww1_bulgaria.2.d: With Bulgaria defeated the Kingdom of Serbia's territory has increased from 38,300 to 87,780 km2 with the eastern frontiero f Serbia drawn from the summit of Patarika, on the old frontier and following the watershed between Vardar and the Struma rivers to the Greek-Bulgarian boundary thus embracing Central Vardar Macedonia. Greece's boundary was rawn from the crest of Belasica to the mouth of the Mesta on the Aegian sea, the territory annexed cinluded large parts of Macedonia, including Thessaloniki and restricted the Aegian seaboard of Bulgaria to a inconsiderable extent of 110km. Romania gained Southern Dobruja and in a seperate peace treaty with the Ottoman Turks the area of Adrianople was ceded back to the Turks.
loc.ww1_bulgaria.3.d: With the war turning against us, the front in Vardar Macedonia being pushed back by the allies whom have had little trouble dealing with our war exhausted demoralied troops we have had no choice but to sign an Armistice with the entente at Salonica whch had ended our participation in the First World War, the armistice has called for an immediate demobilization of all Bulgarian military activities and ordered the evacuation of Bulgarian-occupied Greek and Serbian territories placing. We have been forced to give the Entente full military access across Bulgaria and our former allies are being given a four week time limit to withdraw their troops from our borders.
loc.ww1_bulgaria.4.d: With the war turning against us, the front in Vardar Macedonia being pushed back by the allies whom have had little trouble dealing with our war exhausted demoralied troops we have had no choice but to sign an Armistice with the entente at Salonica whch had ended our participation in the First World War, the armistice has called for an immediate demobilization of all Bulgarian military activities and ordered the evacuation of Bulgarian-occupied Greek and Serbian territories placing. We have been forced to give the Entente full military access across Bulgaria and our former allies are being given a four week time limit to withdraw their troops from our borders.
loc.ww1_bulgaria.6.t: Victory in the Second Balkan war!
loc.ww1_bulgaria.6.d: We have shown the entire world that we are the strongest nation in the Balkan region. Should we force the territories we should have owned already to be transferred, or do we deter from it to safeguard us from future conflict?
loc.ww1_china.1.d: Recently a new uprising has popped up in Guangzuo involving a conflict between citizens and local police against the New Army. After the revolutionary leader Ni Yingdian was killed by our forces however the remaining revolutionaries were swiftly defeated with the uprising failing to gain any traction luckily.
loc.ww1_china.2.d: Recently another uprising has occured in Guangzuo which ended in another defeat of the revolutionaries however unfortunately the 72 revolutionaries who could be identified were then hailed as martyrs to the revolutionary causing increased dissent within the country!
loc.ww1_china.3.d: On October 9th, revolutionaries with the intent on overthrowing our dynasty had built bombs one of which had gone off causing them to start the uprising earlier than expected although the uprising proved harder to handle and ultimately ended up resulting in success for the revolutionaries capturing the entire city of Wuchang. If we dont crush this now the revolution will spread like wildfire!
loc.ww1_china.4.d: Following the successful uprising in Wuchang, in Changsha, Jian Dafend and Chen Zuoxin have headed an armed group of revolutionares in a campaign to try and extend the uprising even further down into Changsha and ended up capturing the city and killing the local imperial general.
loc.ww1_china.5.d: In Shaanxi another uprising was launched in an effort to capture Xi'an which was successful after a tough two day struggle between both sides proving the revolutionaries victorious.
loc.ww1_china.6.d: On Octoer 23, Lin Sen, Jiang Qun, Cai Hui, and other members of the Tongmenghui in the province of Jiangxi plotted a revolt of New Army units and achieved victory establishing the Jiujang Military Government.
loc.ww1_china.7.d: On October 2, Yan Xishan of the New Army led an uprising in Taiyuan the capital of the Shanxi Province and managed to kill the Qing Governor and take control of Taiyuan.
loc.ww1_china.7.a: This is the end of the Qing Dynasty
loc.ww1_china.8.d: On October 30th, in the Yunna province, several revolutionaries managed to capture Kunming with the help of the New Army officers.
loc.ww1_china.9.d: Recently in Tibet a Tibetan formed militia has attacked our garrison and has therefore effectively ousted out of Tibet establishing an independent Tibetan state.
loc.ww1_china.10.d: On November 3rd, several revolutionaries in Shanghai have managed to organize an armed rebellion recieving support of the local police officers. The rebels swiftly captured the whole city of Shanghai from our men.
loc.ww1_china.11.d: On November 4th, Revolutionaries in Zhejiang and Guizhuo led successful uprisings capturing Guiyang in Guizhuo and Hangzhuo in Zhejiang.
loc.ww1_china.12.d: On November 5th, in the provinces of Jiangsu and Anhui uprisings were launched by revolutionaries proving successful with the defeat of our forces in the areas.
loc.ww1_china.12.a: This is the end of the Qing Dynasty
loc.ww1_china.13.d: On November 7, the Guangxi politics derpartment decided to secede from the Qing government with Lu Rongting said to become the new governor of the province to replace the former Qing governor Shen Bingkun.
loc.ww1_china.14.d: On November 11, the entire Fujian province declared independence and the New Army launched an uprising against the Qing army which was shortly after swiftly defeated by the revolutionary forces.
loc.ww1_china.15.d: Several local militians in Guangdong have launched uprisings across the Guangdong province in an effort to oust our forcesand the local represetatives of Guangdong have decided to support the revolution.
loc.ww1_china.16.d: On November 13, several officers of the New Army and Qing governor of Shandong, Sun Baoqi, have agreed to secede from or government announced Shandong's independence supporting the revolution.
loc.ww1_china.17.d: On November 23, an uprising was launched in the province of Ningxia with the Ningxia Revolutionary Military Government being established shortly after supporting the revolution.
loc.ww1_china.18.d: On November 22 Chengdu and Sichuan declared independence and have agreed to support the revolution with Qing officals being murdered.
loc.ww1_china.19.d: Following the start of the Wuhna Uprising our forces have been unable to contain the revolution which has spread like wildfire across the empire. Yuan Shikai, the strongman dispatched by our court to crush the revolution has himself failed and many ahave no wish to fight for a dynasty which is seen as having lost the Mandate of Heaven. \n\n Following a deal brokered by Yuan Shikai, Empress Dowager Longyu endorsed the 'Imperial Edict of the Abdication of the Qing Emperor' with the Qing Empire ceasing to therefore exist. Puyi is to to retain his imperial titles and remain in the northern half of the Frobidden City earning ah efty annual subsidy granted by the Republic.
loc.ww1_china.20.d: With tension heating up between the KMT and Yuan over Yuan Shikai's dictatorial actions Sun Yat-sen has fled to Japan and called for a Secon Revolution but this time against our leader Yuan Shikai. In reaction to this call for a Second Revolution Yuan Shikai has taken action by dissolving the national and provincial assempings, and the House of Representatives and Senate which were replaced by the newly formed Council of State. \N\N Yuan Shikai has labeled the KMT a siditious organization and ordered the dissolution evicting all members from parliament.
loc.ww1_china.21.d: Following Yuan's significant contribution to the revolution by convincing the Empress Dowager to sign the edict for the abdication of the emperor Yuan Shikai has rightfully asked for his position of president for his deed. Following some internal bickering Sun Yat-sen has agreed to Yuan's presidency.
loc.ww1_china.22.d:
Today on 20 November 1915, the president Yuan Shikai has held a specialyl convened 'Representative Assembly' which has unanimously voted offering Yuan the throne. Yuan has since accepted the invitation proclaiming himself Emperor of the Chinese Empire under the era name of Hongxian. 

 The new Empire of China is set to formally begin on the 1 January 1916, when Emperor Yuan Shikai intends to conduct the accession rites and has placed an order for a 40,000 piece procelain set costing 1.4 million yuan, a large jade seal, and two imperial robes costing 400,000 yuan each. 

 Although it must be said domestically and internationally there have been many open protests throughout China denouncing the Emperor, even Japan whom promised to support the accession of Yuan has grown indifferent or openly hostile not giving Yuan his anticipated recognition, and now rumours are going around that Sun Yat-sen who has fed to Tokyo is organizing another plot to overthrow Yuan.
loc.ww1_china.23.d: Following Yuan Shikai's revival of the monarchy and accession to the throne there has been significant unrest within China, something the government of Yuan Shikai has badly miscalculated with no international support or recognition either. In Yunnan provincial military leaders such as Tang Jiyao, Cae E., and Li Liejun, have declared their independence and have launched expeditions against Yuan.
loc.ww1_china.24.d: Faced with amounting pressure Yuan Shikai is now forced to choose one of two options either to completely abandon the monarchy in order to hopefully please the people and his enemies reinstating the Republic with himself as president still or to cling onto the throne and attempt to decisvely crush this large rebellion.
loc.ww1_china.25.d: With Yuan Shikai's death the National Protection has been proclaimed a sucess with the provinces whom have rebelled rescinding their declarations of independence. \n\n Yuan Shikai has died of Uremia at 10 a.m. at the age of fifty-six, his funeral procession is to take place in Beijingsoon where his remains will be placed in a large mausoleum.
loc.ww1_china.26.d: Many of Yuan Shikais supporters have advocated for a revival of the monarchy saying that the Republic had only been effective as a transitional phase to end Manchu rule. Points were made such as that China's political situation demanded stability that only a monarchy could ensure and the Chinese masses have long been used to autocratic rule.
loc.ww1_china.27.d: Hang in there you will get one more event after this which will load in the Republic of China OOB.
loc.ww1_ethiopia.1.d: The Emperor has already previously been a shadow of  his former self after suffering a masive stroke in 1909 after which it is said his mind and spirit died and in the early morning hours of today he died of natural causes. Following his death the council of regency which took over folowing his stroke has continued to rule the nation with Lij Iyasu taking up power as regent.
loc.ww1_ethiopia.2.d: With Iyasu V never crowned due to being widely disliked by the nobility for his unstable behavior and the church holding him in suspicion for alleged Muslim sympathies he was forcefully removed from power today. Zewditu has been in turn summoned to the capital and the Church has deposed Iyasu in favourof Zewditu with her title now "Queen of Kings".
loc.ww1_france.1.d: In an effort to sway the Kingdom of Italy to our side we have presented to them a proposal supporting all of their claims within the Austro-Hungarian empire and giving it to them in the final treaty should they join the Entente.
loc.ww1_france.101.d: The French Republic hs proposed a secret treaty that shoud we accept the French Republic will support all of our claims located within the Austro-Hungarian empire and give them to us in the final peace treaty with Austria after the war ends should we join the Entente.
loc.ww1_france.102.d: The Kingdom of Italy has gladly to our proposal on supporting all of their claims within Austria and transfering it to them on wars end, they shall join the Entente soon.
loc.ww1_france.103.d: The Kingdom of Italy has unfortunately declined our proposal in supporting all of their clais within Austria and transfering it to them on wars end, they have decided to rather remain neutral or perhaps they are plotting to join the Central Powers against us after all...
loc.ww1_france.2.t: Ceding Savoy and Corsica to Italy
loc.ww1_france.2.d: In a desperate attempt to get the Kingdom of Italy onto our side we have decided to cede their claims on our territory being Savoy and Corsica. Following this they will have no choice but to join us in our war against the Central Powers.
loc.ww1_france.3.d: The Kingdom of Italy has finally gotten ready to join us in the war against the Central Powers.
loc.ww1_france.4.d: In an effort to aid our Serbian allies against the full onslaught of the Austro-Hungarian army we have decided to send over several of our own divisions to aid in the defense of the country and anticipation of a counter-offensive eventually.
loc.ww1_france.4.a: Lets hope it will make a difference
loc.ww1_france.5.d: In an effort to force Greece to join the war agaisnt the Central Powers on our side we have begun a blockade against Greece to try and force King Constantine I to step down or submit.
loc.ww1_france.5.a: Greece is key to the Balkan Front
loc.ww1_france.6.d: Following our successful blockade of Greece which led to the abdication of Constantine I and his pro-Entente son, Alexander I coming into power, Greece has officially joined the Entente against our fight versus the Central Powers.
loc.ww1_france.7.d: In order to help out and increase effectiveness of our Greece on the Balkan Front we have taken actions to send a good chunk of military equipment over which should hopefully make a difference.
loc.ww1_france.8.d: In order to increase Greece's combat effectiveness on the Balkan Front we have gone in and sent several well-trained and well-equipped French divisions whom should sufficiently reinforce the Greek Army.
loc.ww1_france.9.d: Our ship the Liberté, a pre-dreadnought battleship, has suffered an accidental explosion today on 25 September 1911 in one of her forward ammunition magazines for the secondary guns which destroyed the ship. This explosion of the secondary magazines spread and caused the main magazines to later blow up which caused a 37-metric-ton chunk of armor plate to hurdle towards the battleship Republique causing significant damage.
loc.ww1_france.10.d: Following our request that Russian troops be sent to fight alongside our army on the Western Front, the Russian Emperor Nicholas II agreed to send several units to France which will serve alongside ours. In return we are to grant a feasable sum of French munitions to the Russians.
loc.ww1_france.11.d: The Kingdom of Romania which has for now remained neutral in this war could be swayed by both sides at this point, it shouldn't take much to sway them to our side with us offering all of their territorial claims, being Bucovina and Tansylvania. However Romania's entrance is also key on the state of Russia, if Russia is in a bad state than they are not going to join our side.
loc.ww1_france.1101.d: The French Republic has sent us a secrret proposal that should we join the Entente on their side against the Central Powers they will on wars end force the Austrian government to cede all of our claims in Trarnsylvania and Bucovina.
loc.ww1_france.1102.d: The Kingdom of Romania has graciously agreed to our proposal offering Transylvania and Bucovina in return for their support in our war against the Central Powers, they shall join the war effort once they are ready
loc.ww1_france.1103.d: The Kingdom if Romania has unfortunately declined our generous proposal offering Transylvania and Bucovina in return for their support in our war against the Central Powers, they cite Romanian neutrality as the main reason refusing to join the war, for now at least.
loc.ww1_france.12.d: The Kingdom of Romania has agreed to our proposal offering them Bucovina, and all of Transylvania should they join the Entente and declare war on the Central Powers.
loc.ww1_france.13.d: The United Kingdom has now been officially cemented within our faction joining our war effort against the Central Powers.
loc.ww1_france.14.d: Our nation which is in dire need of more men on the front has recieved plenty more from the United Kingdom whom is ready to take control of the Northern Half of the Western Front. This should thankfully put an end to German numerical superiority meaning we can start conducting our own counter-offensives.
loc.ww1_france.15.d: The Germans have long since been our enemies, most recently cruelly taking the territory of Alsace-Lorraine and utterly humiliating us in the Franco-Prussian war. The German beast will get his due!
loc.ww1_france.15.a: We do not forget or forgive..
loc.ww1_france.16.d: The Russian Empire and our country both share one man enemy between, the German Empire, which has rather isolated itself in between us. As long as Russia is on our side the Germans will forever be between two larger powers which should insure the safety of France.
loc.ww1_france.17.d: We have sent substantial forces in the interior of Morocco, however Germany whilst not objecting to France's expansion has called for territorial compensation for Germany threatening warfare and sending a gunboat over. This has stirred up many angry German nationalists and negotiations have quickly goen underway between Berlin and Paris which have resolved the Crisis, we have taken over Morocco and in return have given Spain the Rif territory whilst giving Germany their requested concessions in Cameroon.
loc.ww1_france.18.d: The fuse leading to the Powder Keg has been lit, it is only a matter of time before the war breaks out for which we must prepare for the better or the worst of what it may turn into.
loc.ww1_france.19.d: In an effort to defend our border further more against any German threat we have decided to increase fortifications along ours and Germany's border which should prove substantial enough to hold off any sort of German invasion should one happen to occur.
loc.ww1_france.20.d: The union sacrée has been formed today following the outbreak of the First World War being a political truce with the lef-wingagreeing not to oppose the government or call any strikes. Made in the name of patriotism, it will stand in opposition to the pledge made by the rench Section of the Workers' International and its former leader Jean Jaures, not to enter any 'bourgeois war'.
loc.ww1_france.21.d: In an effort to provide more defense to our colonies we have started construction of minor defenses throughout our colonies in Africa.
loc.ww1_france.22.d: In desperate need of more and more men on the Western Front we have decided to transfer more men from the colonies to mainland France where they will serve and hopefully somewhat solve our manpower issues.
loc.ww1_france.23.d: In desperate need of more and more men on the Western Front we have decided to transfer more men from the colonies to mainland France where they will serve and hopefully somewhat solve our manpower issues.
loc.ww1_france.24.d: In desperate need of more and more men on the Western Front we have decided to transfer more men from the colonies to mainland France where they will serve and hopefully somewhat solve our manpower issues.
loc.ww1_france.25.d: Jean Jaures, a French Socialist leader was assassinated today on 31 July 1914, by a fanatic. After going to dine at the Cafe du Croissant, a Raoul Villain, a 29-year-old French young nationalist, walked into the restaurant window firing two shots into Jaure's back. This has caused shock waves through the streets of Paris with one of the most charistmatic and compelling orators being assasinated.
loc.ww1_france.26.d: In an effort to focus and shift all attention toward the war effort against Germany we have called for unity across the nation above all else to aid in the war as an act of honor and patriotism.
loc.ww1_france.27.d: In an effort to maximize our war effort even more we have taken even more actions shifting the focus of all production toward military production.
loc.ww1_france.28.d: In an effort to provide more defenses across France with the outbreak of war with Germany we have begun to initiate construction which should hopefully stall the German Advance.
loc.ww1_france.28.a: Lets hope we can build it in time
loc.ww1_france.29.d: In order to try and increase military productivity we have advocated for more construction of military factories which are key to winning this war.
loc.ww1_france.30.d: We have decided to focus on our home front, whilst still heavily focused on the frontline itself we will refrain from neglecting the home front completely and still put a significant focus on keeping things at home stable.
loc.ww1_france.31.d: We have decided to focus on our home front, whilst still heavily focused on the frontline itself we will refrain from neglecting the home front completely and still put a significant focus on keeping things at home stable.
loc.ww1_france.32.d: We have decided to focus on our home front, whilst still heavily focused on the frontline itself we will refrain from neglecting the home front completely and still put a significant focus on keeping things at home stable.

loc.ww1_france.36.d: Today on 29 January 1916, for the first time our capital, the city of Paris has fallen victim to a German air raid were a group of Zeppelins have bombed the city. It is unfortunate that we could not prevent this, however we have assured the people this will be the last time something like this happens.
loc.ww1_france.37.d: Ernest Monis from the Radical-Socialist Party has taken over as the new Prime Minister of France.
loc.ww1_france.38.d: Joseph Caillaux from the Radical-Socialist Party has taken over as Prime Minister.
loc.ww1_france.39.d: Raymond Poincare from the Republican Democratic Party has become the new Prime Minister of France
loc.ww1_france.40.t: Aristide Briand Becomes Prime Minister Again
loc.ww1_france.40.d: Aristide Brinad from the Republican-Socialist Party has once again taken over as Prime Minister.
loc.ww1_france.41.d: Louis Barthou of the Republican Democratic Party has become the new Prime Minister of France
loc.ww1_france.42.d: Gaston Doumergue from the Radical-Socialist Party has become the new Prime Minister of France
loc.ww1_france.43.t: Alexandre Ribot becomes new Prime Minister
loc.ww1_france.43.d: Alexandre Ribot of the Republican Democratic Party has become the new Prime Minister of France
loc.ww1_france.44.t: Rene Viviani Becomes New Prime Minister
loc.ww1_france.44.d: Rene Viviani of the Republican Socialist Party has become the new Prime Minister of France
loc.ww1_france.45.t: Aristide Briand Becomes Prime Minister Again
loc.ww1_france.45.d: Aristide Briand of the Republican-Socialist Party has once again taken over to become the new PM
loc.ww1_france.46.t: Alexandre Ribot Becomes Prime Minister Again
loc.ww1_france.46.d: Alexandre Ribot of the Republican Democratic Party has again taken over as the new Prime Minister of France
loc.ww1_france.47.t: Paul Painleve Becomes New Prime Minister
loc.ww1_france.47.d: Paul Painleve of the Republican-Socialist Party has taken over as the new Prime Minsiter of France
loc.ww1_france.48.t: Georges Clemenceau Becomes New Prime Minister
loc.ww1_france.48.d: Georges Clemenceau of the Inepdendent party has taken voer as the new Prime Minister of France.
loc.ww1_france.49.d: With war imminent the government has called for general mobilization with reserve divisions across the country ready for action. The men are rather confident that the war will by over, at least but christmas.
loc.ww1_france.50.d: Following the stall of the German 'Kaiserschlacht' or Ludendorff Offensive in mid July and the German armies subsequent internal deterioation due to supply issues the Allies launched a series of counter offensives against Germany from the 8th of August till Armistice Day. This was known as the 'Hundred Days Offensive' which pushed the Germans out of France and forced them to retreat beyond the Hindenburg Line which ultimately led to the signing of the armistice on 11/11/18. \n\n If you're a player (well ai too but) you will get an idea called 'Hundred Days Offensive' which shall give you an edge over the Germans for 120 days, use it well!
loc.ww1_france.50.a: Kick in that rotten door and it will all come crashing down
loc.ww1_france.51.d: The United States only arrived in full force in Europe by Summer 1918, which was the main reason behind the German Spring Offensive 1918. The U.S. was able to deploy roughly 100,000 men per month to France which allowed the Allies to gain substantial numerical superiority over the German Empire which had by this point used up its reserves and struggled to keep up with its losses.
loc.ww1_germany.1.d: Today an alliance between our great empire and that of the Ottoman Turks has been officially ratified. The alliance is part of a joint-cooperate effort which will strengthen and help modernize the Turkish military whilst provoding German troops safe passage into neighboing British Colonies.
loc.ww1_germany.2.d: In an effort to fight British imperialism through other means than direct war between our two countries we have decided to supply the Dervish State which is currently fighting for freedom in the area of Somalia for almost two decades now.
loc.ww1_germany.3.t: Our Friends the Emirate of Jabal Shammar
loc.ww1_germany.3.d: We have recently sent diplomats to the Emirate of Jabal Shammar a close ally of the Ottoman Turks and perhaps us in the near future. Our diplomats have found out that we share many of the same interests and enemies, particularly Britain and their allies, specifically the Nejd Emirate pretaining the Emirate of Jabal Shammar.
loc.ww1_germany.4.d: The Dervish State is less a state more than it is an active rebellion however non-the-less we share many of the same interests when it comes to our enemies, the British Empire. In the future we may be direct allies with the Dervish State should a war break out between us and the British.
loc.ww1_germany.5.d: The Dervish State has now officially joined us and our allies in the fight against the Entente. We share the same enemy, we share the same interests, and now we fight together in the same war.
loc.ww1_germany.6.d: The Emirate of Jabal Shammar hs now officially joined us and our allies in the fight against the Entente, with the entry of the Emirate of Jabal Shammar there shall now be even more resistance against the British in the Middle Eastern campaign. Additionally we have promised should the German Empire and our allies win the Great War we will help the Rashid family in an offensive war against the Saud family (Emirate of Nejd).
loc.ww1_germany.7.d: Our effort to connect Berlin with the Ottoman city of Baghdad continues every so slowly, once it is complete we shall gain access to the suspected oilfields of Mesopotamia as well as the port of Basra on the Persian Gulf increasing our power.
loc.ww1_germany.7.a: Lets hope it gets finished soon!
loc.ww1_germany.8.d: Our effort to connect Berlin with the Ottoman city of Baghdad continues every so slowly, once it is complete we shall gain access to the suspected oilfields of Mesopotamia as well as the port of Basra on the Persian Gulf increasing our power.
loc.ww1_germany.8.a: Lets hope it gets finished soon!
loc.ww1_germany.9.d: Our effort to connect Berlin with the Ottoman city of Baghdad continues every so slowly, once it is complete we shall gain access to the suspected oilfields of Mesopotamia as well as the port of Basra on the Persian Gulf increasing our power.
loc.ww1_germany.9.a: Lets hope it gets finished soon!
loc.ww1_germany.10.d: Now that the Berlin-Baghdad Railway is officially completed we should have not only more influence in the Middle East to threaten the British, but also the suspected oilfields of Mesopotamia giving us an edge over the British who have held their Persian Oil over our heads, additionally comes the Port of Basra which will provide useful in connecting with our colonies in East Africa.
loc.ww1_germany.11.d: In an effort to keep the Kingdom of Italy neutral in this war the Reichstag has come up with a plan to offer the territory of Silesia to Austria in return only if they cede South Tyrol to Italy, should they agree to stay Neutral on the terms they get it.
loc.ww1_germany.11.a: Sound good, lets see how it goes!
loc.ww1_germany.1101.d: Our ally the German Empire has offered to cede us the territory of rich industrial territory of Silesia if we shall in return cede South Tyrol to the Kingdom of Italy shall they agree to stay neutral in the war on the terms they get it.
loc.ww1_germany.1102.d: The Austro-Hungarian Empire has offered us the territory of South Tyrol only on the terms that we stay neutral in the conflict.
loc.ww1_germany.12.d: Negotiations have gone underway with the Kingdom of Sweden, our diplomats are trying to push the Swedes to join the war on our side, however it will most likely be unlikely though if it should happen it will overextend the Russian Front which should ease up our situation on the Eastern Front.
loc.ww1_germany.13.d: A supposedly secret diplomatic communication issued from our Foreign Office in January of 1917 has proposed a military alliance between Germany and Mexico in the event that the United States joins the First World War against Germany. We have offered Mmexico Texas, Arrizona, New Mexico shall the U.S. join the war against us. However unfortuantely it was intercepted and decoded by the British Intelligence and has thoroughly angered the United States to where they will probably now join the war...
loc.ww1_germany.1301.d: A supposedly secret diplomatic communication issued from the German Foreign Office has offered us a deal which in the case that the United States joins the First World War against Germany we should Germany in the fight against the United States where if we end up victorious, which of course we will...we regain Arizona , New Mexico, and Texas.
loc.ww1_germany.1301.b: Sounds tempting but we'll have to decline
loc.ww1_germany.14.d: Recently several German diplomats have arrived in Stockholm to discuss a deal, that is if we the Kingdom of Sweden join Germany in her war against the Entente, particularly Russia, we will regain the area of Finland should we wish to take it.
loc.ww1_germany.14.b: War is not in our interests
loc.ww1_germany.15.d: We have recently sent over diplomats to Bucharest offering the Rumanians Bessarabia in event of German victory agaisnt the Russian Empire, in return if the Rumanians agree to this deal they will have to remain neutral throughout the whole conflict. Though it maybe unlikely as they have more to gain through joining the Entente and taking back Austro-Hungarian Transylvania, but who knows right?
loc.ww1_germany.1501.d: In the event of German Victory against the Russian Empire the Germans have offered us the territory of Bessarabia, if we Rumania agree to remain neutral throughout the whole conflict. However as we see it we have more to gain joining the Entente should the right time come.
loc.ww1_germany.16.d: We have built several defensive structures across German East Africa in the event of a war our colonies should be properly defended.
loc.ww1_germany.17.d: We have built several defensive structures across German Southwest Africa in the event of a war our colonies should be properly defended.
loc.ww1_germany.18.d: We have built several defensive structures across German Cameroon in the event of a war our colonies should be properly defended.
loc.ww1_germany.19.d: In news the French have sent substantial forces in the interior of Morocco, whilst not objecting to France's expansion the Kaiser has called for territorial compensation for Germany threatening warfare and sending a gunboat over. This has stirred up many angry German nationalists and negotiations have quickly goen underway between Berlin and Paris which have resolved the Crisis, France took over Morocco and in return have Spain the Rif territory whilst giving us concessions in Cameroon.
loc.ww1_germany.20.d: Unlike the Schlieffen Plan, following the Rupprecht plan we will instead of invading through Belgium invade through Switzerland, that ought to surprise those French baguettes! However it will most likely be very difficult traversing through the Swiss mountanous terrain and even so we will be quite a ways from Paris.
loc.ww1_germany.21.d: Created by the German Chief of Staff, Alfred von Schlieffen, the Schlieffen Plan was in short a plan to invade through Belgium thereby passing by the heavily defended Franco-German border and passing into meagerly defended French territory taking Paris and forcing a quick peace with the French Republic.
loc.ww1_germany.22.d: The Kronprinz Plan was simple, instead of invading Beglium or Switzerland and risking British entry into the war Germany would just fight France along the Franco-German border and leave a smaller force needed to defend whilst taking the majority of our forces and letting them deal with the larger threat, the Russian Empire towards the east.
loc.ww1_germany.23.d: My Kaiser! In the Medditeranean sea our ships the SMS Goeben and the SMS Breslau part of the Mittelmeerdivision have been followed by the British Mediterranean Fleet who unsuccessfully have tried to intercept them, luckily the Goeben and the Breslau have managed to evade the British Mediterranean Fleet and passed throguh the Dardanelles reaching Constantinople where we handed them over to the Ottoman Empire. \n\n If all goes to plan we can bring the Ottomans into the war sooner or later...
loc.ww1_germany.24.d: Prince William of Albania has been quite stubborn with the outbreak of war refusing to pick a side calling for Albanian neutrality, however with the Austrians unable to convince the Prince we have sent our own diplomats over who have threatened to cut off his renumeration which will likely put the Prince out of power. We have also promised in event of German victory, which of course is very likely, Albania shall get the Kosovo region from Serbia. \n\n Realizing the true state of things the Prince reconsidered his former call for neutrality and has ratified an alliance between our two countries which shall be announced to the world soon.
loc.ww1_germany.25.d: In an effort to assist the Ottoman Turks in their Middle East Campaign we have decided to send a detachment of the German Army, along with a medical expedition to help Ottoman sanitary units combat epidemics and treat soldiers we have also sent over some pioneers to assist in construction of roads in areas where it is needed. Hopefully out Ottoman allies can make use of this.
loc.ww1_germany.2501.d: The German Empire has sent us a detachment of the German Army to assist us in our campaign, the expedition sent over also includes Medical units to help combat epidemics and treat the wounded along with Pioneers to assist us in construction of where roads are needed, particularly Sinai.
loc.ww1_germany.2501.a: Much thanks to our German ally!
loc.ww1_germany.26.d: We have sent several German military commanders over to Turkey in an effort to strengthen and make Ottoman military forces more effective under German command.
loc.ww1_germany.2601.d: The German Empire has sent over several German military commanders/advisors in an effort to help us make our military a more effective force all-together.
loc.ww1_germany.27.d: We have successfully negotiated with Manie Maritz who has decided to cooperate with us and break off from South Africa's initiative to seize control of our colony, German South Africa, and instead take up arms against the South Africans themselves.
loc.ww1_germany.28.t: Our Friends the Tsardom of Bulgaria
loc.ww1_germany.28.d: The Bulgarians have previously in the Second Balkan War have lost much of their core territory and are eager for vengeance, our diplomats in Bulgaria have managed to work out a reasonable deal promising Bulgaria their share of Macedonia that the Serbs own should they invade, currently preparations are under way before Bulgaria officially joins the war.
loc.ww1_germany.28.a: Great, lets hope they join soon.
loc.ww1_germany.2801.d: Several German diplomats have recently made successful talks with us regarding our territorial claims on Serbia if we join the war on the side of the Central Powers, however it will be several more months before we can be ready to enter the war.
loc.ww1_germany.29.d: The Tsardom of Bulgaria has today officially joined the Central Powers declaring war on Serbia, hopefully with Bulgarian assistance the Serbian opposition will be crushed for good. In addition their entry will provide a geographical conduit for material assistance from Germany to Constantinople increasing the Turkish war effort.
loc.ww1_germany.2901.d: Today we have officially joined the First World War on the side of the Central Powers by declaring war on Serbia, the Serb's surely were not expecting our sudden entry and their western border should be empty, something we should quickly take advantage of.
loc.ww1_germany.30.d: The Septemberprogramm has recently been drafted which contains our plan for territorial expansion should victory come soon. Largely the plan has been ordered to learn about the opinion of our economic, and military elites.
loc.ww1_germany.30.a: Lets hope this plan can be somewhat realized
loc.ww1_germany.31.t: Formation of the Kingdom of Poland
loc.ww1_germany.31.d: Hoping to replace military losses, generals Hindenburg and Ludendorff who are the currennt supreme commanders of the German Military have insisted on establishing a polish state dependant on Germany and thus accelerated the process of creating a Polish State. \n\nA Provisional Council of State has been thereby established as the provisional government and hopefully soon we can start recruiting Poles into the army who shall celebrate us as liberators from their former Russian rulers.
loc.ww1_germany.32.d: The assemblance of the Polish Legion into a German military force is going underway where the units are going to pledge an oath of loyalty to the Kaiser.
loc.ww1_germany.3201.d: The German Empire has demanded that our Polish Legions commanded by Jozef Pilsudski swear an oath oof allegiance and obedience to Kaiser Wilhelm II, however it appears that should Germany win the war Poland will become nothing more than a puppet buffer state of Germany.
loc.ww1_germany.3202.d: To much dismay the Polish Legions when asked to swear an oath of allegiance and obedience to our Emperor, Wilhelm II, have in majority declined which has supposedly been persuaded by Jozef Pilsudski, the commander of the Polish Leegions who as a result is now to be arrested. \n\n But non-the-less our efforts in Poland to form a Polnische Wehrmacht has been very dismal and largely a huge disaster...Austria-Hungary went ahead however and forcibly conscripted a force of 3,000 men from the Polish Legion.
loc.ww1_germany.3203.d: The Polish Legion went ahead and pledged an oath to the Kaiser, now their forces are officially under our full command our efforts to create Polnische Wehrmacht should draw several tens of thousands of men to be recruited in the Polish region.
loc.ww1_germany.33.t: Lenin on the Train to Russia
loc.ww1_germany.33.d: A prominant Communist Revolutionary, by the name of Vladimir Lenin, has negotiated a passage to Russia from Germany after helping us recognize how Lenin and his fellow dissidents could cause many internal problems for our Russian enemies. He was put aboard a sealed train carriage and should arrive in Petrograd in the coming days...
loc.ww1_germany.33.a: Hopefully he can do some real damage...
loc.ww1_germany.35.d: Instead of putting our faith so much into the military itself we have decided to put our faith rather in the Kaiser himself meaning that in the future should it come to it we will not allow any military commander to subsequently take over control.
loc.ww1_germany.36.d: We have decided to put out faith into the military, the Kaiser himself puts his faith here saying "The soldiers and the army, not Parliamentary majorities and decisions, have welded the German Empire together. I put my trust in the army."
loc.ww1_germany.38.d: The RMS Lusitania had recently been torpedoed by one of our German U-boats the U-20, around 124 Americans were beleived to be onboard that had died, intotal 1,198 died with 761 survivors remaining. This will definately push the U.S. against us and perhaps push them to enter the war itself.
loc.ww1_germany.39.d: Unlike abiding by Prize rules which require submarines to surface and search merchantmen placing the crews in a "place of safety" before sinking them, we have decided to disregard the law. This should starve the British of the supplies coming in and or out of their Island, however this may anger some nations, particularly the U.S...
loc.ww1_germany.39.a: We will starve them into submission
loc.ww1_germany.40.d: We have decided to focus on our home front, whilst still heavily focused on the frontline itself we will refrain from neglecting the home front completely and still put a significant focus on keeping things at home stable.
loc.ww1_germany.41.d: We have decided to focus on our home front, whilst still heavily focused on the frontline itself we will refrain from neglecting the home front completely and still put a significant focus on keeping things at home stable.
loc.ww1_germany.42.d: We have decided to focus on our home front, whilst still heavily focused on the frontline itself we will refrain from neglecting the home front completely and still put a significant focus on keeping things at home stable.
loc.ww1_germany.43.d: In an effort to put an end to this war as soon as possible we have decided to put our full focus on the front line to give us an edge over our enemies, however this will mean somewhat neglecting the home front which can cause issues later on.
loc.ww1_germany.44.d: In an effort to put an end to this war as soon as possible we have decided to put our full focus on the front line to give us an edge over our enemies, however this will mean somewhat neglecting the home front which can cause issues later on.
loc.ww1_germany.45.d: In an effort to put an end to this war as soon as possible we have decided to put our full focus on the front line to give us an edge over our enemies, however this will mean somewhat neglecting the home front which can cause issues later on.
loc.ww1_germany.46.d: With the takeover of Pavlo Skoropadsky in Ukraine who is very much Pro-German we should be getting more sufficient shipments of grain from the Ukraine. Hopefully it will somewhat counter the Northsea Blockade that the British have been conducting for several years now.
loc.ww1_germany.47.d: The fuse leading to the Powder Keg has been lit, it is only a matter of time before the war breaks out for which we must prepare for the better or the worst of what it may turn into.
loc.ww1_germany.48.d: With the war just now kicking off many believe it will be over quite quickly in a matter of days or weeks at most but definately by Christmas! The Kaiser himself has publicly stated to the soldiers that "They shall be home before the leaves have fallen from the trees."
loc.ww1_germany.49.d: Due to extreme losses in the field of battle we need to replace those losses which leads us to shorten the training period and get those boys on the field as soon as possible. Although it will somewhat hamper their abilities to be true specialists it is better to have the holes in the ranks filled in as quickly as possible.
loc.ww1_germany.50.d: With the Ottoman Turks declaring a jihad not being enough to drive the Afgahni's to join us in our war effort against the Entente we have decided to send over an expedition to Afgahnistan to discuss and share our interests which had turned out to be quite similar.
loc.ww1_germany.50.a: Hopefully we can drag them into the war...
loc.ww1_germany.51.d: Our expedition which had previously been sent to Afgahnistan to increase relations between our two nations have discussed Afgahnistan's entry into the First World War on our side. It is critical for Afgahnistan to invade India in order for Britain to lose it, which would definately turn the war in our favor. The real issue is that the Afgahn sultan's main source of income is British subsidies which means he may be reluctant to accept our deal and join the war on our side.
loc.ww1_germany.5101.d: The German diplomatic mission to Kabul has increased relations between our two nations recently however they have recently proposed us a deal offering us territory from India and perhaps also from Russia should we be victorious. However the issue is that the Sultan's main source of income comes from British subsidies given to him, and if we choose to put ourselves on the side of the Central Powers we would lose this thus getting rid of our main source of income, not to mention if we are to lose the results for our country would likely be disastrous...
loc.ww1_germany.5102.d: The Sultan of Afgahnistan has declined our offer of promising land from British Raj, and perhaps Russia, should we be victorious. More likely it is because the Afgahn sultan's main source of income is from the British making war something not in their interests.
loc.ww1_germany.5103.d: The Sultan of Afgahnistan has graciously accepted our offer and Afgahnistan is now an official member of the Central Powers, hopefully they will be able to do some real damage against British Raj and drive the Indians to rebellion.
loc.ww1_germany.52.d: In an attempt to instigate a rebellion within British India we have brokered a deal with the President of the first Provisional Government of India led by Indian freedom fighter, Mahendra Pratap as President. If the plan works out there should be a successful revolt from the Indian revolutionary underground and exiled or self-exiled nationalists along with a Pan-Indian mutiny in the British Indian Army going from Punjab to Singapore. \n\n It will however, not be an easy task by any means and will easily be thwarted should the British intelligence catch on in any way.
loc.ww1_germany.5202.d: Against all odds our plot to incite a Pan-Indian revolt in British Raj has been largely successful and is within the few days due to spread all across India like a sweeping wildfire. The Provisional Government of India has been set up in northern India near Afgahnistan for now with Mahendra Pratap taking lead of the revolution and aligning the revolutionary state with the Central Powers. \n\n If all goes well and the revolution succeeds it is beyond a doubt that the end of the British Empire is near...
