loc.ww1_germany.52021.d: Local revolutionaries in the state of Guharat have taken up arms and formed a local militia joining Mahendra Pratap in his revolution for Indian Independence against British hegemony over India.
loc.ww1_germany.52022.t: Insurrection in Mumbai, Madhya Pradesh, and Jharkhand
loc.ww1_germany.52022.d: Local revolutionaries in the states of Mumba, Madya Pradesh, and Jharkhand have risen up taking up arms against us joining Mahendra Pratap's revolutionary forces to fight against British hegemony over India.
loc.ww1_germany.52022.a: Is this the end of the British Raj?
loc.ww1_germany.52023.t: Insurrection in Mysore, Madras, Orissa, and Bihar
loc.ww1_germany.52023.d: Recently local revolutionaries in Mysore, Madras, Orissa, and Bihar have taken up arms against the British Raj joining Mahendra Prataps revolution against British hegemony over India.
loc.ww1_germany.5203.d: Unfortunately our plot to incite a Pan-Indian revolt in British Raj has been uncovered by British Intelligence and thus foiled, although a few garrisons across india have continued with the plan taking up arms anyway they have quickly been crushed by the British. \n\n Although, who knows, perhaps if we continue this war long enough there shouldn't be a need to incite a rebellion it may just happen by itself...
loc.ww1_germany.52031.d: Thanks to the success of British intelligence we have been able to thwart a planned Pan-Indian Mutiny in British Raj which would have likely saw us lose our grip over the colony had it gone to plan. Although some Indian garrisons have still risen up as mutineers these have been very limited cases which have been easily crushed with little to none resistance.
loc.ww1_germany.5301.d: Following a negotiation with Captain Franz von Rintelen of the German Navy Intelligence and Victoriano Huerta over a purchase of weapons and a U-boat landing arangement to provide support for Huerta's return for which he promised as a bargaining ship to make war on the U.S. should he be successful, United States forces have who were observing the meetings between the two managed to intercept Huerta after his attempt to cross back into Mexico where he has supposedly been awaite dby Pascual Orozco and some well-armed Mexican supporters.
loc.ww1_germany.5302.d: Following a negotiation with Captain Franz von Rintelen of the German Navy Intelligence and Victoriano Huerta over a purchase of weapons and a U-boat landing arangement to provide support for Huerta's return for which he promised as a bargaining ship to make war on the U.S. should he be successful, Huerta has against all odds managed to evade United States forces waiting for him in Newman, New Mexico and has crossed the border into Mexico where he has been met with support of General Pascual Orozco and taken power again.
loc.ww1_germany.5303.t: Huerta Arrested; Plot to return FOILED
loc.ww1_germany.5303.d: According to U.S. intelligence, Captain Franz von Rintelen (German Navy Intelligence) was intercepted in his communication with Victoriano Huerta whom made a deal to declare war on the U.S. should Germany support him with weapons to return to Mexico where he would have made an attempt  to come back to power. Luckily however, on his way there to Mexico, Huerta was intercepted by United States forces in Newman, New Mexico and never managed to cross the border where he was awaited by General Pascual Orozco.
loc.ww1_germany.54.d: Wilhelm II's role in wartime has been lately of ever-decreasing power as he has now largely been only responsible for handling awards ceremonies and honorific duties with much of the power being in the hands of the powerful generals Hindenburg and Ludendorff. As a result of this the German Empire has now be de-facto turned into a military dictatorship under the control of Field Marshal Paul von Hindenburg and General Erich Ludendorff. \n\n The Kaiser has been increasingly cu off from reality and the political decision-making process, being vacillated between defeatism and large dreams of victory. Although nevertheless Wilhelm II still retains ultimate authority in matters of political appointment and his consent is needed for major changes to the high command.
loc.ww1_germany.55.d: Due to previosu actions earlier this year with Portugal honoring its de-facto alliance with Great Britain by seizing our ships which had been anchored in Lisbon's harbor and our previous hostility with Portuguese aid to the Entente forcing us to sink their convoys. At this pointwe might as well be at war, the lines have been drawn and the Portuguese have sided with the enemy.
loc.ww1_germany.55.a: It was only a matter of time
loc.ww1_germany.56.d: There is a new ace in Germany going by the name of Manfred von Richtofen otherwise known by the pseudonym of 'The Red Baron' due to the unusual paintjob of his aircraft whom he says is meant to strike fear into the enemy.
loc.ww1_germany.57.d: Admiral Henning von Holtzendorff has made strong arguments that if we resume unrestricted submarine warfare attacks on the entente we will successfully starve the British and without it we will not have any chance of winning the war. Although this very likely means the entrance of America against us the high command has calculated that American mobilization would be too slow to stop our victory on the Western Front.
loc.ww1_germany.58.d: With the war turning heavily against us and the Entente making significant progress in the battlefield, we have reluctantly been forced to sign an Armistice which has ended all of the fighting. Amongst the terms, the entente demands an imediate cessation of hostilities, withdrawal of German troops to behind ther own borders, preservation of infrastructure, echange of prisoners, a promise of reparations, the disposition of German warships and submarines, and conditions for prolonging or terminating the armstice. \n\n We will just have to wait and see for what they come up for a treaty...
loc.ww1_germany.59.d: With the war turning heavily against us and the Entente making significant progress in the battlefield, we have reluctantly been forced to sign an Armistice which has ended all of the fighting. Amongst the terms, the entente demands an imediate cessation of hostilities, withdrawal of German troops to behind ther own borders, preservation of infrastructure, echange of prisoners, a promise of reparations, the disposition of German warships and submarines, and conditions for prolonging or terminating the armstice. \n\n We will just have to wait and see for what they come up for a treaty...
loc.ww1_germany.61.t: Red Baron Dies Over The Somme
loc.ww1_germany.61.d: On the 21st of April 1918, after the fog has lifted over Cappy Airfield JG1 took off after reports of enemy air activity reports. Jasta 11 takes off led by Manfred von Richtofen (The Red Baron), with Hans Joachim-Wolff, and Richtofen's cousin Wolfram who is heading into battle for the first time. \n\n At 1150 hours, Mellersh spots a lone Triplane, half rolls and forces him down. May circles on the edge of the fight until he sights Richtofen's cousin Wolfram crossing his front, Richtofen sees his cousin under fire and closes in, opens fire. The inexperienced May, falls out of control probably saving his life. Richtofen breaks his own rule and follows him down as May plunges earthward but he regains control just over the Somme and follows the river West - and to the safety of his own lines. May's friend Roy Brown sees the pursuit and dives to help, a low level chase follows. With a strong easterly win, Richtofen is pushed further and further over enemy lines... alone... and under constant ground fire. Richtofen seems to become target fixated, unaware of Brown diving behind him; at this exact time Cedric Popkin, of the 24th Australian Machine Gun Company fires at the Red Triplane along with soldiers from the 53rd Battery, Royal Australian Artillery. As Brown fires a burst the Triplane rears up to the right, at 1200 hours near Vaux-sur-Somme, Richtofen receives a single, fatal, bullet wound to the chest. The Red Triplane Fokker falls vertically but pulls up at the last moment, most likely still under the control of Richtofen, but by the time the aircraft stops... Richtofen is dead. To this day nobody who knows who killed the Red Baron as the Sopwith and the ground fire both used the Vickers .303. However May, Mellersh, and LeBoutillier all claim to have seen the Triplane rear up as Roy Brown fired, though the shot that enetered the under right of his armpit exiting under his left nipple gave high credence to groundfire bringing him down.
loc.ww1_germany.62.d: The Ace of all Aces, Manfred von Richtofen alternatively known as 'The Red Baron' flying his Red Colored Fokker Tripline to envoke fear in the foul enemy has emerged from another successful air engagment with his 81st Kill after spotting Wilfred May eyeing his young cousin, Wolfram. Non-the-less both have emerged victiorious and alive and well, our troops look up to him in their trenches, he is their angel in the air.
loc.ww1_germany.63.d: The Kaiser Wilhelm Geschütz otherwise known as the Paris Gun, our long range heavy howitzer has once again taken action in bombarding the city of Paris, although the gun's damage is pretty ineffective in terms of structure damage it serves a good demoralizer for the inhabitants of Paris whom are most likely terrified, knowing at any time a shell from that gun could wipe them out.
loc.ww1_germany.64.d: An illegitamate government, the Taurida Soviet Socialist Republic controls the territory of Crimea and Cherson. As such, we have decided to invade the Crimean Peninsula with Ukranian assistance to take the prized port of Sevastopol for the Kaiserreich!
loc.ww1_germany.64.a: A port in the Black Sea will be useful..
loc.ww1_germany.65.t: Formation of the Crimean Regional Government
loc.ww1_germany.65.d: We have established the Crimean Regional Government which is to be under German Protection with the Lipka Tatar General Maciej Sulkiewicz as Prime Minister. Whilst there were some efforts by the Ukraine to exert control over Crimea we have quickly subdued these efforts ensring the separation between Crimea and Ukraine.
loc.ww1_germany.65.a: Give Cherson to Ukraine, give the Tatars only the Crimean peninsula
loc.ww1_germany.65.b: Give the tatars all the former territories of the Taurida SSR!
loc.ww1_germany.66.d: After a successful offensive the Taurida SSR has surrendered and we have transfered all territory to be for now under direct German military control. However, there have been efforts from the Ukraine to try and get us to transfer the territory to them, if we accept we will lose the ability have a strong strategic position in the Black Sea later on...
loc.ww1_germany.67.d: With the German Empire actively seeking an armistice with the allies and a revolution threatening the unstable political situation of Germany by the end of the war calls for the Kaiser to abdicate grew in intensity. Wilhelm II himself was deeply reluctant to make such a sacrifice. Whilst his military advisers insisted that the army could no longer be relied on Wilhelm still expressed a notion to lead the armies back into Germany from the Western Front. Following the Kiel mutiny however Wilhelm II lost all hope and the navy was his greatest joy and achievement for which once it rebelled he had realized that the war had indeed been lost and seeing the fate of the Russian Royal Family, his cousins, he had a tough decision to make. Does the Kaiser abdicate?
loc.ww1_germany.67.a: He was but a 'Shadow Kaiser' anyway
loc.ww1_germany.67.b: No! He is but a puppet but he shall remain!
loc.ww1_germany.67.c: No! Our loyal leader will lead us to victory!
loc.ww1_germany.68.d: With war imminent the government has called for general mobilization with reserve divisions across the country ready for action. The men are rather confident that the war will by over, at least but christmas.
loc.ww1_germany.69.d: The war has now gone on for four long years, but not all is bad for us as we have recently have knocked out Russia, this means we can focus all of their eastern divisions on the Western Front giving us numerical superiority over the Entente. Erich Ludendorff has been planning this operation for a while now naming it the 'Kaiserschlacht' or the Kaiser's Battle claiming this operation if successful, will drive us to Paris and thus our final victory. On the inside our society is slowly falling apart however, desertion particularly with our allies Austria-Hungary and Turkey, the blockade, and war exhaustion is all taking its toll and we will either win quick or lose quick.
loc.ww1_germany.70.d: Now that we are at war, it is time to choose our warplan. Will we choose the Schlieffen plan, which goes through Belgium and Luxemburg to circumvent the heavily fortified French lines, or will we do the exact same but through Switzerland with the Rupprecht Plan. Finally we have the option to ignore other fronts, and force Russia out of the war first.
loc.ww1_italy.1.d: Our claims on Libya have dated back to the defeat of the Ottomans in the Russo-Turkish War of 1877, and now is the time to realize those dreams and take what is ours, for those Turks are not making use of that land. Libya would surely be better under our jurisdiction!
loc.ww1_italy.101.d: With the Ottoman Turks defeated, our diplomats have secured a favourable peace at Ouchy near Lausanne. The Ottomans withdraw all military personnel from Libya, and Italy receives the Dodecanese islands.
loc.ww1_italy.101.b: We shall conquer the entirety of Turkey!
loc.ww1_italy.102.d: We have succesfully kicked out the Italians out of Libya. We can now decide to take a whitepeace, or we can decide to stump out the Italians entirely.
loc.ww1_italy.2.d: Our claims on libya have dated back to the defeat of the Ottomans in the Russo-Turkish war where our diplomats hinted the great powers if there would be any opposition. We signed a treaty with French backing which accorded freedom of intervention in Tripolitania and Morocco. \N\N To appease the masses we have began a large-scale lobbying campaign in favour of an invasion of Libya depicting the area as rich in minerals, well-watered, and defended only by 4,000 turkish troops. The population is also to be desctibed as hostile to the turks and friendly to us Italians, for the invasion will be little more than a small military exercise for us.
loc.ww1_italy.3.d: In order to bring law and order to Libya we have put in a much larger presence in our North African colony in order to subue any sort of dissidents, particularly those who aim for independence and fight or aid the Senussi Order.
loc.ww1_italy.3.a: Order, but not via the Senussi.
loc.ww1_italy.4.d: Although we have beaten the Turks in Libya, the Senussi Order as they call themselves are a bunch of rebellious killers whose army consists of some of the same militia that fought against us in the Italo-Turkish war. The Senussi Order is preventing us from creating order in our new colony and whatever means we must take to supress them are neccessary for the safety of our troops and the development of our new colony.
loc.ww1_italy.4.a: Ah, Imper- I mean order, yes?
loc.ww1_italy.5.d: The fuse leading to the Powder Keg has been lit, it is only a matter of time before a great war breaks out for which we must prepare for the better or the worst of what it may turn into.
loc.ww1_italy.6.d: Whilst the Germans are allied to the Austro-Hungarians whom have a large amount of Italian territories perhaps it would be better to side with them and instead look westward at the French whom hold Savoy and Corsica for now.
loc.ww1_italy.6.a: Two new Nations, Two nations united.
loc.ww1_italy.7.d: With the Great War breaking out we are technically speaking a member of the Triple Alliance which requires us to support our allies that are now at war. However, we will not be joining our allies with the government making it clear even before the war began as we have differed on the Austrians opinion of this attack on Serbia being of 'defensive nature'. The Prime Minister has made it clear that the terms of the 1882 Triple Alliance do not apply becuase neither Austria-Hungary or Germany have been attacked and with a sizable oppositon to war in Italy we will remain neutral at that.
loc.ww1_italy.7.a: We probably won't go to war... Probably.
loc.ww1_italy.8.d: We have decided to side with the Entente with our government growing convinced that support of Austria, the traditional enemy of our country, will not gain Italy the territories it so desperately needs. Although there have been negotiations with the Central Powers who have tried to keep us neutral we will not remain neutral with such territorial gains ahead of us on the side of the Entente.
loc.ww1_italy.8.a: We shall unite all of Italy!
loc.ww1_italy.9.d: In the recent days we have revoked the Triple Alliance publically however the majority of the pariament still opposed declaring war contrary to the nationalistic crowds whom demostrated for the war. With the London Pact signed and in order to prevent a conflict between the Crown and Parliament and the consequenced of both internal stability and foreign relationships the Parliament has accepted the declaration of war.
loc.ww1_italy.10.d: We have not exactly come completely prepared for such a long and drawn out conflict and as a result we are in need of support which luckily the British and French have managed to provide sending equipment and a few infantry divisions to help us out.
loc.ww1_italy.11.d: In an effort to maximize our war effort even more we have taken even more actions shifting the focus of all production toward military production.
loc.ww1_italy.12.d: With our allies now at war the time has come for Italy to honor the Triple Alliance, whilst there are a fair amount of territories we seek to gain on the side of our allies there are also an equal amount in the hands of the French.
loc.ww1_italy.13.d: Whilst we are not for joining the Triple Alliance in their war of agression we might as well make use of the situation and put our support up for sale with the price being South Tyrol.
loc.ww1_italy.13.a: A fair price if you ask me
loc.ww1_italy.1301.d: In order for Italy to join our side in the war they have put up a price being South Tyrol, if we cede the territory they promise to join our war or at the very least stay neutral in the conflict.
loc.ww1_italy.1302.t: Austrians Refuse to Cede South Tyrol
loc.ww1_italy.1302.d: The Austrians upon hearing news of our offer for support on their side for the price of South Tyrol have apparently bitterly disagreed saying that South Tyrol will never be a part of Italy.
loc.ww1_italy.1303.t: Austrians Agree to Cede South Tyrol
loc.ww1_italy.1303.d: The grateful austrians upon hearing news of our offer for support on their side for the simple price of South Tyrol have quickly agreed to cede the state without much of a fuss.
loc.ww1_italy.14.d: With our allies now at war the time has come for Italy to honor the Triple Alliance, whilst there are a fair amount of territories we seek to gain on the side of our allies there are also an equal amount in the hands of the French.
loc.ww1_italy.15.d: Our claims on French territory are equally as numerous as those on the Austro-Hungarians. Pethaps it would not be wise to compromise our well-established and strategic alliance with the Central Powers, I am sure we can sacrafice our territorial ambitions in Austria, for now at least.
loc.ww1_italy.15.a: All those lands belong to us
loc.ww1_italy.16.d: In an effort to maximize our war effort even more we have taken even more actions shifting the focus of all production toward military production.
loc.ww1_italy.17.d: In an effort to put an end to this war as soon as possible we have decided to put our full focus on the front line to give us an edge over our enemies, however this will mean somewhat neglecting the home front which can cause issues later on.
loc.ww1_italy.18.d: In an effort to put an end to this war as soon as possible we have decided to put our full focus on the front line to give us an edge over our enemies, however this will mean somewhat neglecting the home front which can cause issues later on.
loc.ww1_italy.19.d: In an effort to put an end to this war as soon as possible we have decided to put our full focus on the front line to give us an edge over our enemies, however this will mean somewhat neglecting the home front which can cause issues later on.
loc.ww1_italy.20.d: We have decided to focus on our home front, whilst still heavily focused on the frontline itself we will refrain from neglecting the home front completely and still put a significant focus on keeping things at home stable.
loc.ww1_italy.21.d: We have decided to focus on our home front, whilst still heavily focused on the frontline itself we will refrain from neglecting the home front completely and still put a significant focus on keeping things at home stable.
loc.ww1_italy.22.d: We have decided to focus on our home front, whilst still heavily focused on the frontline itself we will refrain from neglecting the home front completely and still put a significant focus on keeping things at home stable.
loc.ww1_italy.23.d: With Italy now at war with her mortal enemies whom seek to prevent a greater Italian nation and the unification of all italian peoples our people have presented a large amount of nationalistic support for the war with thousands of men voluntarily sigining up as of now even coming from other countries to fight for none other than the glory of Italy!
loc.ww1_italy.24.d: The Senussi are a Muslim religious group sponsored by the Ottomans. After the Ottoman defeat in Libya, resistance has become fierce, and now the group has openly declared ownership of our colonies in Africa. We must strike back!
loc.ww1_italy.25.d: After our strike in 1914 against the religious group, they have fled to English controlled territories where they continued their reign of terror. We now have a window of opportunity, of defeating the group forever. Doing so however may cost a big amount of equipment and men, something our nation might not be prepared for. Now is finally the time where we wipe them out completely.
loc.ww1_italy.25.b: We must focus on our economy.
loc.ww1_japan.1.d: Honoring our 1902 alliance agreement with the United Kingdom we have served the German Empire wih an ultimatum demanding all of their pacific colonies excluding the Solomon Islands, Bismarck Archipeligo, and German New Guinea. This war will be a great opportunity for us to pursue our own interests in the far east!
loc.ww1_japan.101.d: The Japanese Government has sent us an ultimatum demanding practically all our pacific colonies excluding New Guinea, the Bismarck Archipeligo, and the Solomon Islands. Whilst it may be somewhat hard to let go of our colonial possesions perhaps it would be ultimately better to agree with their ultimatum and possibly avoid their intervention in this war lessening the power of the enemy?
loc.ww1_japan.102.d: The German Empire has accepted our Ultimatum and agreed to cede the territories demanded within the ultimatum immediately, whilst we could honor our promises we could always still side with our allies and declare war on Germany regardless.
loc.ww1_japan.103.d: The German Empire has not responded to our ultimatum which will be taken by our government as a complete rejection and therefore we shall take matters into our own hands and take thosee territories regardless!
loc.ww1_japan.104.d: The Japanese Government has sennt us an absolutely unimaginable ultimate demanding ALL of our pacific colonies, such an ultimatum is absolutely absurd, however do we really want to add another enemy to the list?
loc.ww1_japan.105.d: The German Empire has accepted our Ultimatum and agreed to cede the territories demanded within the ultimatum immediately, whilst we could honor our promises we could always still side with our allies and declare war on Germany regardless.
loc.ww1_japan.106.d: The German Empire has not responded to our ultimatum which will be taken by our government as a complete rejection and therefore we shall take matters into our own hands and take thosee territories regardless!
loc.ww1_japan.2.d: Today, on the 12th of July 1918, despite being inspected several months before with no problems being discovered the Kawachi has unexpectedly blew up, the ship has sunk within roughly four minutes after the explosion and led to the death of 600 sailors with 443 survivors. No plausible suspect or reason for the explosion could be found and it is reported the cordite in her magazine might have spontaneously ignored due to decomposition. In the end whilst the navy considered salvaging the ship they decided it would be expensive and would delay the construction of one battlecruiser by over a year and was stricken from the navy list.
loc.ww1_japan.3.d: Recently a series of popular disturbances have erupted throughout Japan from July to September 1918 caused by a precipitous rise in the price of rice that has caused extreme economic hardship, particularly in rural areas where rice is the main staple of life. The rice riots are said to be unparalleled to any other sort of protest in the past on terms of scope, size, and violence. The initial protest was said to have started peacefully but the disturbance quickly escalated into full scale riots, strikes, looting, incendiary bombings of police stations, and government offices, as well as armed clashes. Some 25,000 people were arrested, with 8200 being convicted of various crimes. Prime Minister Terauchi took the responsibility for the incident which brought the collapse of the Terauchi Masatake Administration in Japan.
loc.ww1_japan.3.a: We must put an end to this!
loc.ww1_japan.4.d: The March 1st Movement is a clear public display of Korean resistance over our rule on the Korean peninsula. Supposedly, following the hearing of Wilson’s Fourteen Points speech many Korean students studying in Tokyo who were inspired published a statement demanding freedom from colonial rule. This was also escalated by death of the former Korean Emperor Gojong in January which has been filled with controversy and suspicion that he was poisoned.
loc.ww1_japan.5.d: Today the Emperor of Korea has graciously and willingly approved the Japan-Korea Annexation Treaty signing it with a sharp smile on his face, in this treaty our nation will formally integrate Korea following the earlier Japan-Korea Treaty of 1905 in which Korea became a protectorate of our nation and the later Japan-Korea Treaty of 1907 in which Korea graciously gave away their rights of adminstration and internal affairs handing them over to us. Many of our fellow Japanese commentators predict that the Koreans will easily assimilate into the Empire!
loc.ww1_japan.6.d: The Emperor Meiji has unfortunately passed away today of uremia, not long after his death the Japanese Diet has passed a resolution commemorating his role in the glorious Meiji Restoration. An iris garden in an area of Tokyo where Emperor Meiji had been known to visit is chosen to be the buildings location for the Shinto shrine Meiji Jingū. What the Emperor did will never be forgotten, he has presided over a time of rapid change for the better in Japan where we quickly changed from an isolation feudal state to a capitalist and imperial world power following the industrial revolution.
loc.ww1_japan.7.d: The General Nogi Maresuke who has been for a long time a national hero in Japan, a model of feudal loyalty, and self sacrifice has commited the seppuku ritual suicide due to his desire not to outlive his master, Emperor Meiji, whose death motivated his suicide on the day of the Emperor's funeral.
loc.ww1_kuk.1.d: Even though Bosnia and Herzegovina is still formally a part of the Ottoman Empire, our authorities have had factual control over the country and now the perfect chance to incorporate Bosnia and Herzegovina has come with the Young Turk Revolution in the Ottoman Empire. We have said we are afraid of the revolution spreading to Bosnia and Herzegovina gaining support from the Bosnian Muslims and Serbs, as a result Franz Joseph has announced the annexation of Bosnia and ordered the Minister of Finance to compose a constitution with the annexation to be announced two days after. \n\n This may spark a brief crisis however...
loc.ww1_kuk.2.d: The Serb's constantly support ethnic irrdentist claims over our regions, sch as Vojvodina, Bosnia-Herzgovina, and provide sympathy for other South Slavic minorities within the Empire. If we are to fully make Serbia submit we must crush pan-Slavism and establish a complete and total sphere of influence in the Balkans.
loc.ww1_kuk.3.t: Dominating the Balkans Sphere of Influence
loc.ww1_kuk.3.d: In our efforts to dominate the Balkan Sphere of Influence to secure our position there and crush pan-Slavism we have obviously managed to upset the Russian Empire a great deal which is allied/friendly with much of the Balkan States promoting pan-Slavism in the area. \n\n None-the-less we will not bbe able to fully crush pan-Slavism or establish our sphere of influence and dominate the region until Serbia is cut down to size...
loc.ww1_kuk.4.d: We have recently recieved a visit from Kaiser Wilhelm who has arrived at heir presumptive Archduke Franz Ferdinand's hunting lodge in Konopischt, Bohemia. Both men have discussed a great deal about the future between our two countries but largely political matters in the Balkans and such, none-the-less the Archduke has told the Kaiser about the Serbian threat asking for backing should the Serbs get agressive in the future, to which the Kaiser had somewhat but not fully yet agreed which is understandable.
loc.ww1_kuk.5.t: Our Friend the Tsardom of Bulgaria
loc.ww1_kuk.5.d: We have recently sent diplomats to the Sofia, Bulgaria in order to improve relations with Bulgaria whom we hope will counteract Serbia's dominance and strength in the Balkans as well as providing a larger front for the Serbians. Along with Bulgaria being secured on our side, we shouldn't worry about Constnatinople being threatened and we should be able to transfer more supplies and perhaps even troops to the Ottoman Empire if we can eliminate Serbia.
loc.ww1_kuk.6.d: We have recently sent diplomats to Constantinople, Turkey in an effort to recuperate and build upon formerly bad relations. Whilst in the past us and the Turks have not particularly been good friends, they do provide some sort of strength in the Balkans especially if with Bulgaria and a good counter against Russia in the caucasus.
loc.ww1_kuk.7.d: The fuse leading to the Powder Keg has been lit, it is only a matter of time before the war breaks out for which we must prepare for the better or the worst of what it may turn into.
loc.ww1_kuk.8.d: With Albanian neutrality violated we have been forced to follow Serbian troops into the region but have luckily managed to set up an Albanische Legion consisting of 9 battalions which should prove somewhat useful at least.
loc.ww1_kuk.9.d: With Serbia falling under our control we have taken the action to pillage the countryside in search of grain and any other food source for our own army which is desperately lacking such supplies. Although perhaps unethical it is what we must do to cope with food shortages.
loc.ww1_kuk.9.a: It's what has to be done
loc.ww1_kuk.10.d: One of our promises made to Bulgaria should they join the conflict was to return any lost territory and we might as well give them their chunk of Serbian Macedonia to govern over until the war ends and it fully becomes part of their country.
loc.ww1_kuk.11.d: In an effort to maximize our war effort even more we have taken even more actions shifting the focus of all production toward military production.
loc.ww1_kuk.12.d: With Franz Josef gone the new Emperor, Charles I, who is much less reluctant to continue the war is attempting to set up a talk with the Entente leaders in order to get Austria-Hungary out of the war in one piece, if the Germans are to find out however they will not be happy one bit...
loc.ww1_kuk.12.b: Nevermind I am not a coward!
loc.ww1_kuk.13.t: Our Friend the Kingdom of Italy
loc.ww1_kuk.13.d: We have recently sent diplomast to Rome, Italy, in an effort to improve relations. Although we are officially allied (Triple Alliance) the Italians are not exactly 'cemented' in our alliance, they still have strong distaste of our control over what they call 'rightful italian territory'. Whilst we managed to have good talks, the only way we can certainly cement the Italians would be to give them what they want which may not be in our interests...
loc.ww1_kuk.14.d: In an effort to keep Italy out of the war at all costs we have offered the Italians what the Entente is probably offering them except without the needless loss of men in war. \n\n However, promises only go so far if we do not act on them there will be war no matter what with the Italians so we need to act on this as fast as possible.
loc.ww1_kuk.15.d: Going along with our promises we have given the Italians South Tyrol, instead of South Tyrol and Istria. This however may be seen as a betrayal by them and they could get back on the side of the Entente if they see they can grab the remainder of their claimed territory from us that way.
loc.ww1_kuk_1501.d: Sir, the Austro-Hungarian government has given us an offer, promising that should we stay neutral in the war they are willing to give South Tyrol with no bloodshed, we could take the offer however it is a little less than what the Entente has been promising us.
loc.ww1_kuk_1502.d: The Kingdom of Italy has graciously accepted our offer to cede the territory of South Tyrol in return for Italian neutrality in the war. We are glad more bloodshed could be prevented and this should permanently secure our Western Front.
loc.ww1_kuk_1503.d: The scum of the Kingdom of Italy have declined our fair offer in ceding South Tyrol in return for their neutrality, if more blood is to be spilled we will give them what they want and show those filthy Italians what are made of!
loc.ww1_kuk.16.d: Going along with our promises we have given everything we promised to the Italians, their neutrality is therefore de facto guaranteed for the rest of the war.
loc.ww1_kuk.1601.d: The Austro-Hungarian government has graciously went along with their full promise in ceding all of our strong claims on their territory to us for which we have in return agreed for complete neutrality for the rest of the war.
loc.ww1_kuk.17.d: In an effort to maximize on our previous success with Italy we can perhaps offer them Corsica and Savoy from France in order to try and get them to join our side in the war, this would strongly benefit us even more than having the Italians keep their neutrality.
loc.ww1_kuk.17.a: Lets hope they like the idea
loc.ww1_kuk.1701.d: The Italian government has accepted our proposal in offering the territories of Savoy, and Corsica should the Kingdom of Italy join the war on our side. Now all that is left is to get them to join the war...
loc.ww1_kuk.1702.d: The ungrateful Italian government has unfortunately declined our proposal in offering the territories of Savoy, and Corsica should they join the Central Powers in the war.
loc.ww1_kuk.1702.a: Well at least they are neutral
loc.ww1_kuk.1703.d: After securing our neutrality, the Austro-Hungarian government has been kind enough as to propose a deal with us, being that should we join the Central Powers in their war against the Entente and win we are to get the claimed territories of Corsica, and Savoy. It sounds like a good deal, but the question is that is it worth the risk?
loc.ww1_kuk.18.d: With Italy accepting our offer of having Corsica and Savoy from France should we be victorious they have officially become members of the Central Powers and will join the war effort within a day or two.
loc.ww1_kuk.19.d: With our army largely plagued by poor leadership, the Germans who have seen our relatively poor turnout on the battlefield have in turn offered support in the form of sending over Imperial German officers whom are more than capable of leading, this will hopefully improve the KUK's performance.
loc.ww1_kuk.20.d: Whilst we have already recieved German Advisors in the form of officers to improve our leadership we have also recently recieved a small reinforcement of German divisions to help us in our military operations.
loc.ww1_kuk.21.d: In an effort to help our ally Germany with their military operations on the western/east front we have decided to send a good chunk of equipment to our ally, after all we should be very thankful for their help they have granted to us so far.
loc.ww1_kuk.22.d: In an effort to tie up the Western Front for good we have decided to send several Austro-Hungarian divisions to Germany to use in any western operations, the additional divisions should provide additional numeral superiority which the Germans have largely lacked against the combined forces of France/Britain so far.
loc.ww1_kuk.22.a: Lets hope it can make a difference
loc.ww1_kuk.2201.d: The Austro-Hungarian government has kindly offered and sent us several of their unused divisions to be used on the Western Front in hopes of providing us any more additional men that are desperately needed.
loc.ww1_kuk.23.d: Our ally the Ottoman Empire has kindly sent over reinforcements to fill in on the Eastern Front following our somewhat poor performance and need of more troops.
loc.ww1_kuk.24.d: Whilst we cannot promise the Turks much in terms of troops as we could use all the ones we have, we have agreed to provide a substantial ammount of troops to support the Ottomans in their military operations and to garrison important areas.
loc.ww1_kuk.24.a: I hear its hot down there
loc.ww1_kuk.25.d: The Ottoman Empire is by far an industrial state which is capable of producing its own military equipment which is why we have offered to give them a substantial amount of what we can give, hopefully they can make use of this.
loc.ww1_kuk.26.d: Due to such a large amount of different ethnicities within the Empire in such an age of nationalism it has become relatively unstable and held together like a house of cards. The main thing that is keeping the Empire together for now is the long reign of Franz Josef, therefore we are to be making more compromises to insure the stability of the Empire for years to come.
loc.ww1_kuk.27.d: Instead of focusing on using all of our political resources to keeping the Empire together we have instead decided to take the path of increasing our military spending and modernizing the army, navy, and airforce. Whilst this could eventually fall back on us it would definately help us in any sort of military conflict later on.
loc.ww1_kuk.28.d: Instead of focusing on using even more of our political and economic resources on the military we have decided to instead focus on the internal issues within the Empire to guarantee stability for the future.
loc.ww1_kuk.29.d: In an effort to reduce dissent within the Empire we have taken actions to supress the rebellious minorities such as the Serbs whom constantly are going on and on about pan-Slavism and a great united slavic state in the Balkans.
loc.ww1_kuk.30.d: The Empire is being held together by a thread, and as much as we like it or not the secure the future for good we have taken actions to keep the Empire together by offering more autonomy to each of the ethnicities within the Empire like with Hungary.
loc.ww1_kuk.30.a: Lets hope it was worth it...
loc.ww1_kuk.31.d: With the outbreak of war the formation of the Polish Legions has been declared by Jozef Pilsudski. Our government having jurisdiction over the area, has officially agreed to the formation with the unit becoming an independent formation of the Austro-Hungarian army.
loc.ww1_kuk.32.d: With the war starting, we have garnered Hungarian support to act with us together in contributing to the war as much as possible.
loc.ww1_kuk.33.d: With the unfortunate death of Franz Josef, whom has ruled our empire for almost seven decades it is now time for Charles the heir presumptive to take his position who has attended his coronation oath at the Holy Trinity Columb outside Matthias Church today. It is said that in his Croatian Coronation oath he has recognized the union of the  Triune KIngdom of Croatia, Dalmatia and Slavonia with Rijeka and has favored the creation of a third Croatian political entity which none-the-less has upset the Hungarians somewhat who do not want to share power with anyone else.
loc.ww1_kuk.34.d: We have begun to take more actions to ensure more effiency towards military production and more resources be diverted to the war effort with a rationing set in place to help conserve supplies/food within the country.
loc.ww1_kuk.35.d: We have begun to take more actions to ensure more effiency towards military production and more resources be diverted to the war effort with a rationing set in place to help conserve supplies/food within the country.
loc.ww1_kuk.36.d: We have begun to take more actions to ensure more effiency towards military production and more resources be diverted to the war effort with a rationing set in place to help conserve supplies/food within the country.
loc.ww1_kuk.37.d: In an effort to put an end to this war as soon as possible we have decided to put our full focus on the front line to give us an edge over our enemies, however this will mean somewhat neglecting the home front which can cause issues later on.
loc.ww1_kuk.38.d: In an effort to put an end to this war as soon as possible we have decided to put our full focus on the front line to give us an edge over our enemies, however this will mean somewhat neglecting the home front which can cause issues later on.
loc.ww1_kuk.39.d: In an effort to put an end to this war as soon as possible we have decided to put our full focus on the front line to give us an edge over our enemies, however this will mean somewhat neglecting the home front which can cause issues later on.
loc.ww1_kuk.40.d: We have decided to focus on our home front, whilst still heavily focused on the frontline itself we will refrain from neglecting the home front completely and still put a significant focus on keeping things at home stable.
loc.ww1_kuk.41.d: We have decided to focus on our home front, whilst still heavily focused on the frontline itself we will refrain from neglecting the home front completely and still put a significant focus on keeping things at home stable.
loc.ww1_kuk.42.d: We have decided to focus on our home front, whilst still heavily focused on the frontline itself we will refrain from neglecting the home front completely and still put a significant focus on keeping things at home stable.
loc.ww1_kuk.43.d: As a result of developing pneomonia of the right lung several days after catching a cold while walking in Schonbrunn Park with the King of Bavaria our Emperor has unfortunately passed in Schonbrunn Palace today in the evening. He is to be succeeded by his grandnephew Charles I, however it is questionable as to how the Empire will remain intact with the loss of such a grand central figure whom has reigned for two years short of seven decades.
loc.ww1_kuk.44.d: Today on 28 June, 1914, Archduke Franz Ferdinand of Austria, heir to the Austro-Hungarian throne, and his wife, Sophie, Duchess of Hohenberg, were shot dead in Sarajevo, by Gavrilo Princip, one of a group of six Bosnian Serb assassins coordinated by paramilitary group going by the name 'the Black Hand'. The political objective of the assassination was to break off Austria-Hungary's south-Slav provinces so they could be combined into a 'Greater Serbia' \n\n Though the liberal-minded Franz Ferdinand is not overly mourned by the ultra-conservative Austrian government, Emperor Franz Josef and the Austrian military leaders are said to be using his death as a convenient excuse to start pressing for a war with Serbia.
loc.ww1_kuk.45.d: We have sent count Hoyos to Berlin in order to confirm Germany's backing in this current crisis with Serbia should it come to war...
loc.ww1_kuk.4501.d: The Austro-Hungarian government has requested our promise to assist them should the situation with Serbia heat up into a full scale conflict.
loc.ww1_kuk.46.d: We have sent Alexander, otherwise known as Count Hoyos to Berlin with the memorandum and the Emperor's letter to secure Ambassor Szogyeny's support. In the evening Szogyeny- cabled about the Kaiser's pledge of 'full German backing' with Hoyos recieving a similar message from Zimmerman during his meeting. The following day the two diplomats met with German Chancellor, Bethmann-Hollweg and Zimmerman, and the Kaiser's commitments were confirmed with Austria-Hungary recieving the 'blank cheque' for dealing with Serbia.
loc.ww1_kuk.47.d:
We have sent an ultimatum to the Kingdom of Serbia demanding the Serbian state formally and publically condemn the 'dangerous propaganda' directed towards our country, the ultimate aim of which, is believed to be, to 'detach from the Monarchy territories belonging to it'. Moreover, Belgrade should 'supress by every means this criminal and terrorist propaganda'. \N\N In addition, the Serbian government is to be recquired to 

 1. Supress all publications which 'incite hatred and contempt of the Austro-Hungarian Monarchy' and are 'directed against its territorial integrity' 

 2. Dissolve the Serbia nationalist organisation Narodna Odbrana (The People's Defense) and all other such socities in Serbia 

 3. Eliminate without delay from schoolbooks and public documents all 'propaganda against Austria-Hungary 

 4. Remove from the Serbian military and civil administration all officers and functionaries whose names the Austro-Hungarian Government will Provide. 

 5. Accept in Serbia 'Representatives of the Austro-Hungarian Government' for the 'suppression of subversive movements'. 

 6. Bring to trial all accessories to the Archduke's assassination and allow 'Austro-Hungarian delegates' to take part in investigations 

 7. Arrest Major Vojislav Tankosic and civil servant Milan Ciganovic who were named as participants in the assassination plot.  

 8. Cease the cooperation of the Sebian authorities in the 'traffic in arms and explosives across the frontier'; dismiss and punish the officials of Sabac and Loznica frontier service. 'guilty of having assisted the perpetratrs of the Sarajevo Crime'. 

 9. Provide 'explanations' to the Austro-Hungarian Government regarding 'Serbian Officials' who have expressed themselves in interviews 'in terms of hostility to the Austro-Hungarian government'. 

 and finally 10. Notify the Austro-Hungarian Government 'without delay' of the execution of the measures comprised in the ultimatum.
loc.ww1_kuk.47.a: Are we hoping they comply? or rather that they dont...
loc.ww1_kuk.48.d: Serbian Prime Minister Nicola Pasic has apparently ordered the Serbian army to mobilize and at te same time delivered the Serbian answer to the ultimatum to Gieslingen at the Austrian embassy, just before the 6 p.m. deadline. Serbia's response has effectively accepted all terms of the ultimatum but one being that it would not accept Austria-Hungary's participation in any internal inquiry, stating it would be a violation of the Constitution and of the law of criminal procedure. This response has appealed to Pasic and his country as well as to many international observers however it has made very little difference to us with with Dual Monarchy breaking diplomatic relations with Serbia.
loc.ww1_kuk.49.d: Following the refusal to accept all terms of the Ultimatum sent to Serbia Franz Josef has gone ahead and issued a manifesto 'To my people's' - 'An meine Volker', in BadIschl on 28 July 1914. The text was a typical headline of war manifestoes printed following the Empire's declaration of war on Serbia. The document has been distributed all over the empire and is being widely published by news sources. The text has presented the agressiveness of Serbia as the reason for war, claiming that the Empire has tried all ways to avoid the conflict.
loc.ww1_kuk.50.d: Following the assasination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand there has been a large-scale amount of anti-Serb violence in Sarajevo being encouraged by the government. The violent demonstrations assumed the characteristics of a pogrom, leading to ethnic divisions unprecedented in the city's history. Two serbs have been killed so far and many more attacked, whilst numberous houses, shops, and institutions owned by Serbs has been razed or pillaged.
loc.ww1_kuk.51.d: As much as it is painful to admit, our troops have been defeated and have ceased to exist as a combat force resulting a chaotic withdrawal in these last weeks. Not only that but the nation itself has ceased to exist in more ways than one with the declaration of independence of several states including Hungary which is half of our name. With the army so weak our commanders have been forced to seek a ceasefire and have signed the Armistice of Villa Giusti signed outside of Padua in Veneto taking effect today with the Kingdom of Italy already annexing Southern Tyrol as well as Trieste and Austrian Littoral.
loc.ww1_kuk.51.b: We must continue the fight for the good of our nation...
loc.ww1_kuk.52.d: Today in the Banat region the leading members of the Social Democartic Party have decided to proclaim independence establishing a republic headed by Social Democrat leader Otto Roth. Made up of several large ethnicities the Rumanians being the largest ethnic group have reportedly said they do not want autonomy but rather unification with the Kingdom of Romania.
loc.ww1_kuk.52.b: This nation will be kept together with blood and iron!
loc.ww1_kuk.53.d: Prompted by the imminent collapse of the Habsburg Austro-Hungarian Empire the declaration of independence of the Czech nation has been proclaimed by its provisional government. With a draft of declaration of independence based on Wilson's fourteen points proclaimed and presented th the United States the U.S. Secretary of State Robert Lansing has replied that the allies were now committed to the causes of the Czechs, Slovaks,and Sout Slavs saying that th tenth of the Fourteen Points (autonomy for the nationalities) - was no longer enough with Emperor Charles I attempting to keep the empire together on those terms.
loc.ww1_kuk.53.a: This is the death certificate of the empire...
loc.ww1_kuk.53.b: Keep it together at all costs!
loc.ww1_kuk.54.t: West Ukranian People's Republic Calls for Independence
loc.ww1_kuk.54.d: Today the West Ukrainian People's Republic has been proclaimed taking the Poles by surprise with the Polish Liquidation Committee which wwas ready to transfer from Krakow to Lviv and there has been deep resent with the Polish citizens in Lviv whom do not wish to be apart of this Ukranian nation.
loc.ww1_kuk.54.a: We will manage without those Ukrops
loc.ww1_kuk.55.t: Martin Declaration United Slovakia with Czechs
loc.ww1_kuk.55.d: The Martin Declaration has been proclaimed in Martin, Slovakia, as a declaration of independence from the Hapsburg monarchy roughly ten days following the declaration of the Czech independence. Although there were calls for Slovak independence completely including that from the Czech Republic, the Slovak's separatist ambitions were largely suspended by the Czechs who would not agree to an terms of Slovak independence. \n\n The Slovak people were mistaken however, they would not be equal partners in this state and with Edvard Benes the FM of the Provisional Czech Gov. declaring it would be a Swiss-style federated state the Slovak's quickly found themselves being relegated to the status of a national minority.
loc.ww1_kuk.56.d: Led by the Social Democrat, Count Mihaly Karoly, who established the Social Democratic Hungarian National Council (HNC) Karolyi demanded secession of Hungary from the Hapsburg Empire today with support of soldiers fro the Hungarian Army. HNC Protesters have worn aster flowers whilst helping seize public buildings throughout Budapest with PM Sandor Wekerle resigning and the former PM Istvan Tisza murdered.
loc.ww1_kuk.56.a: This means the dissoluation of the Empire
loc.ww1_kuk.56.b: I will not accept this coup!
loc.ww1_kuk.57.d: With the Banat Region proclaiming independence as a Republc not more than two weeks ago it has been a troubled state so far. The ethnic majority in the country, the Rumanians have called for unification with the rest of the Rumanian nation and there are a fair chunk of Yugoslavs on the other half of Banat. Considering the fact that the only international support this state has gotten is from the defeated Hungary we could invade it and split it between ourselves and Rumania with no international backlash.
loc.ww1_kuk.58.d: With our troops taking full control of the Banat Region it is time to split the state between us and the Kingdom of Rumania based on ethnic majorities for fairness.
loc.ww1_kuk.59.d: As much as it might be painful to admit, our troops have been defeated and have ceased to exist as a combat force resulting a chaotic withdrawal in these last weeks. Not only that but the nation itself has ceased to exist in more ways than one with calls for independence from all corners of the country including the Kingdom of Hungary which is half of our name. With the army so weak our commanders have been forced to seek a ceasefire and have signed the Armistice of Villa Giusti signed outside of Padua in Veneto taking effect today with the Kingdom of Italy already annexing Southern Tyrol as well as Trieste and Austrian Littoral.
loc.ww1_kuk.60.d: The war has now gone on for four long years, but not all is bad for the Central Powers whom have knocked out Russia, this means they can focus all of their eastern divisions on the western front giving them numerical superiority. This has prompted Erich Ludendorff to plan the 'Kaiserschlacht' otherwise known as the Kaiser's Battle or Spring Offensive. But on the inside the Central Powers are slowly falling apart, desertion, war exhaustion, and the blockade is all taking its toll and they will either win quick or lose quick.
loc.ww1_kuk.61.d: Italy has had some very... Suspicious activities on the border as of late. With their forces massing on the border, one would think that they are preparing to betray us and invade us, despite the Triple Alliance. As such, our own citizens, living in the border regions, have formed well-trained mountaineer militias to defend against this potential Italian aggression.
loc.ww1_mexico.1.d: In early 1919 Gen. Pablo Gonzalez ordered his subordinate to commerce operations against the Zapatistas in the mountains, but when Gonzalez found his subordinate Guajardo carousing in a cantina he was arrested. On March 21st, Zapata attempted to smuggle a note to Guajardo and invited him to switch side but the note never reached Guajardo and wound up instead on Gen. Gonzalez’s desk. However Gonzalez used this to his advantage promising to pardon Guajardo if he would tell Zapata he would bring over his men and supplies with Zapata agreeing to all his terms. On April 10, 1919, Guajardo invited Zapata to a meeting, intimating that he intended to defect to the revolutionaries but when Zapata arrived Guajardo’s men riddled him with bullets as he was gunned down.
loc.ww1_mexico.1.a: Our nation is closer to being united without him!
loc.ww1_mexico.2.d: On Friday, 20th of July 1923, Villa was killed while visiting Parral. He frequently made trips from his ranch to Parral for banking and other errands, where he generally felt secure. Villa was usually accompanied by his entourage of Dorados (his bodyguards), but had gone into the town without them on that day, taking only a few associates with him. He went to pick up a consignment of gold from the local bank with which to pay his Canutillo ranch staff. While driving back through the city in his black 1919 Dodge touring car, Villa passed by a school, and a pumpkinseed vendor ran toward his car and shouted Viva Villa!, a signal to a group of seven riflemen who then appeared in the middle of the road and fired more than 40 shots into the automobile. In the fusillade, nine dumdum bullets, normally used for hunting big game, hit Villa in the head and upper chest, killing him instantly.
loc.ww1_mexico.3.d: Our great leader Porfirio Diaz has no doubt won the elections, although there remains a huge controversy of whether or not the elections were rigged or not as the Madero campaign met fierce resistance from the Diaz regime. Shortly before the elections he was been arrested on the charges of inciting a rebellion and many have noted election fraud at the polls.
loc.ww1_mexico.4.d: Francisco Madero who is running for president has been lately very successful in his campaign drawing large crowds and appeasing the people with his plans for reform and change in Mexico should he win the election, this man will be a huge obstacle should we plan to stay in power a little while longer...
loc.ww1_mexico.5.d: Whilst Francisco Madero has been imprisoned shortly before the elections he none-the-less managed to slip between our fingers running away across the Mexican border into the United States on horseback where it is said he may be even planning a revolution to take us out of power...
loc.ww1_mexico.6.d: Madero who has taken refuge in the United States has recently crossed the Rio Grande River with his followers and issued a manifesto declaring the 1910 Mexican Election null and void on claims of election fraud. He has claimed the office of President and Vice-President of Mexico vacant and proclaims himself as the provisional president of Mexico.
loc.ww1_mexico.7.d: Porfirio Diaz, encouraged by his advisor Jose Yves Limantour has made a wise choice to step down from power following significant victories on the side of the Maderistas. All fighting has stopped and Diaz is to be exiled from Mexico. However Madero's planned social reforms which were vaguely promised never came to light and thus dissent in Mexico is still high....
loc.ww1_mexico.8.d: Emiliano Zapata has joined the revolution with Madero after Madero has made some vague promises regarding land reforms which is the only issue Zapata cares about.
loc.ww1_mexico.9.t: Emiliano Zapata Urges for Land Reform
loc.ww1_mexico.9.d: Regarding that vague promise Madero made to Zapata during the early stage of the revolution about taking Zapata's ideas for land reform into action which still has not been done has made Zapata quite angry if we dont do something about this we may face a rebellion...
loc.ww1_mexico.10.d: One of Madero's former generals Pascual Orozco has recently launched a rebellion in Chihuahua with Madero reacting by dispatching troops under the command of Victoriano Huerta  following Jose Gonzelez Salas's defeat. The rebellion is very minimal and will unlikely gain any traction.
loc.ww1_mexico.11.d: Bernardo Reyes a former general under Porfirio Diaz has launched a rebellion in Nuevo Leon however it has met with limited usccess and been defeated after 11 days with Reyes being imprisoned in Mexico City.
loc.ww1_mexico.11.a: There will be stability in Mexico!
loc.ww1_mexico.12.d: The Nephew of Porfirio Diaz has launched a rebellio in Veracruz saying that he is to "reclaim honor of the army trampled by Madero." however luckily the rebellion was quickly crusehd within days and Diaz has been imprisoned in Mexico City
loc.ww1_mexico.13.t: Rumors of Huerta Conspiring with Enemies
loc.ww1_mexico.13.d: Victorianoo Huerta the current commander of the armed forces is said to be conspiring with Felix Diaz, Bernardo Reyes, and the US Ambassador Henry Lane Wilson against the current president Francisco Madero. Two of those individuals have actively rebelled against Madero in the past...
loc.ww1_mexico.13.a: Something fishy is going on here...
loc.ww1_mexico.14.d: On the night of February 8, 1913 Felix Diaz has been freed after a brief parley which resulted in the death of the commander of the civilian pententiary retreating into the city arsenal were he took control of the armory. \n\n Madero had full and complete confidence this Rebellion would non-the-less be supressed as had the previous ones. With fighting in the capital going on for several days General Victoriano Huerta ended up forming an alliance with Felix Diaz betraying Madero and arresting his brother and murdering him and offering Madero protection from the Diaz/Reyez forces only to be betrayed by Huerta and arrested where he was shortly after forced to resign and subsequently assasinated.
loc.ww1_mexico.15.d: If we accept Zapata's land reforms we won't have to worry about him rising up against us and the future of Mexico could still be peaceful however should we break our vague promise for reform we may face a rebellion from Zapata which could potentially dwelve Mexico into another revolution/civil war.
loc.ww1_mexico.16.d: Angry with Madero ignoring his vague promise to institute land reforms across Mexico Zapata has take up arms against us! Although his force is small and won't poise much of a danger for now it is better to put out the fire quickly...
loc.ww1_mexico.17.d: Following the rise of Victoriano Huerta who imposed a harsh military dictatorship on Mexico the forces of Venustiano Carranza have launched a rebellion against Huerta in order to force him out of power and restore democracy in Mexico.
loc.ww1_mexico.18.d: Following the rise of Victoriano Huerta who imposed a harsh military dictatorship on Mexico the forces of Pancho Villa have joined Venustiano Carranza's Constitutionalistas against Huerta in order to force him out of power and restore democracy in Mexico.
loc.ww1_mexico.19.d: Following the rise of Victoriano Huerta who imposed a harsh military dictatorship on Mexico the forces of Emiliano Zapata have joined Venustiano Carranza's Constitutionalistas and Pancho Villa's Villista's against Huerta in order to force him out of power and restore democracy in Mexico.
loc.ww1_mexico.20.d: Following immense internal and external pressure along with repeated defeats in the field against the Villista-Constitutionalista-Zapatista alliance Victoriano Huerta has chosen to reluctantly resign from his position of 'president' today.
loc.ww1_portugal.1.d: The Monarchy of the North, officially called the Kingdom of Portugal was a short-lived revolution and monarchist government that was proclaimed in Porto, North of Portugal on the 19 January 1919. The movement was led by Henrique Mitchell de Paiva Couceiro a prominent member of the Portuguese imperial government who said the revolution was necessary because “if the North does not agree with the South, I will be, until the end, on the side of the faithful to tradition.”. However the revolution failed to gain strong popular support throughout the country with a unorganized structure, this led to its quick demise and the re-establishment of the Portuguese Republican regime in Porto.
loc.ww1_portugal.2.d: Known in Portuguese as Noite Sangrenta, A radical revolt took place in lisbon on the night of October 19th 1921. During the Bloody Night, The head of Government, Antonio Granjo; Politicians Machado Santos and Jose Carlos da Maia who were involved with the October 1910 revolution that established the First Portuguese Republic, with others were murdered in cold blood. The insurrection took place on the night of October the 19th 1921 after the anniversary of the Proclamation of the Republic. When a group of soldiers rose up against the dismissal of the government headed by Liberato Pinto, protector of the Guarda Nacional Republicana.
loc.ww1_portugal.3.d: After the president made his way to the Lisboa-Rossio Railway Station on the evening of 14 December 1914 previously enjoying dinner at the restaurant Silva, he was accompanied by his brother and son planning to take the train to Porto in order to confer with the NOrthern Military Juntas. However when he entered the station at around 11 PM, he was received by a Republican Guard ordered to protect the president, however, this couldn't ruin the mood as a band played a popular song when the President entered the station. Inside the station Jose Julio da Costa a left-wing activist was waiting for him concaeling a pistol in his cloak. As the president passed Da Costa penetrated the double police cordon surrounding the President and fired two shots into Pais who at first was still alive but died of his wounds en route to the hospital.
loc.ww1_portugal.3.a: What will we do without him?
loc.ww1_portugal.4.d: On December 5, 1918, during an award ceremony for survivors of the navy trawler Augusto de Castilho there was an assassination attempt against the president-king, Sidonio Pais, however luckily nobody got hurt.
loc.ww1_portugal.5.d: The 28 May 1926 coup d'état, sometimes called 28 May Revolution or, during the period of the authoritarian Estado Novo, the National Revolution, was a military coup of a nationalist origin, that put an end to the unstable Portuguese First Republic and initiated the Ditadura Nacional. The chronic political instability and government's neglect of the army created opportunities for military plots. Already in 1925 there were two failed coup attempts on April 18th and July 19th. The plotters were acquitted by military court. During winter of 1925 and spring 1926 a group of junior officers planned a new coup and were looking for a senior officer to be the figurehead of their movement. They decided on General Manuel Gomes da Costa, who agreed to join the plotters on May 25th.
loc.ww1_portugal.6.d: Cabecadas served as the ninth President of the Republic, which was a military dictatorship. Other revolutionaries however Gomes da Costa and Oscar Carmona judged him as incapable and in am eeting in Sacavem on 17 June 1926 Mendes Cabecadas was forced to renounce posts of the President of the Republic in favour of Gomes da Costa. He then joined opposition to the regime and involved himslef in several revolutionary attempts and subcribed to many manifestos against the dictatorship.
loc.ww1_portugal.7.d: Gomes da Costa's government lasted nearly as little as his predecessor as it was overthrown in a new coup on July 9 the same year. This attempt was imitiated by Joao Jose Sinel de Cordes and OScar Carmona, after Gomes da Costa attempted to have Carmona removed as minister for foreign affairs. Carmona, the new president used the pretext that Gomes da Costa was "unfit for office" and sent him to exile in the Azores Islands whilst also making him Marshal of the Portuguese Army.
loc.ww1_portugal.8.d: After President Carmona appointed Salazar as Minister of Finance he was very impressed by his charima and qualities and nominated him as Prime Minister in 1932 and effectively turned over control of the government to him.
loc.ww1_portugal.8.a: Salazar will lead us to victory!
loc.ww1_portugal.9.d: With the Kingdom of Portugal being highly destabilized in the rescent years by British pressure on Portugal's colonies, the royal family's expenses, and the regicide of King Carlos and the Heir Apparent, proponents of the republic have taken advantage of the situation proclaiming a republic on 3rd October 1910 with two thousand soldiers and sailors rebelling. A provisional government led by Teofilo Braga have deposed the constitional monarchy and have called for Manuel II to be exiled from Portugal.
loc.ww1_portugal.10.d: The Portuguese Monarchist forces have requested aid in their current struggle within the Portuguese Civil War fighting the Republic forces, it would benefit us to have these Republicans rid of lest our own people start getting ideas in their mind about doing something similar in Spain...
loc.ww1_portugal.11.d: With Monarchist forces once again entering the Republican capital of Lisbon, the Republic has largely started to collapse elsewhere leading to a decisive monarchist victory in Portugal. It will be time to ramp up the authoritarian powers of the King in order to thwart any more future revolutions from the Republicans should they arise once more.
loc.ww1_portugal.12.d: An attack led by Royalist Leader, Henrique Paiva Couceiro has been thwarted in the town of Chaves, the royalists who have been supposedly descreetly armed by the Spanish king, Alfonso XIII, came in from Spanish Galicia but luckily their attack has ended with a deicisve defeat from which Paiva Couceiro has said has led him to abandon the monarchist cause.
loc.ww1_portugal.13.d: Alfonso XIII of the Kingdom of Spain has made the decision to grant aid to pass through from Spain into our hands for use against the Republic forces. Hopefully we will be able to make use of them, and we won't forget this act of generosity from the Spanish.
loc.ww1_portugal.14.d: With political instability at an all time high with many of the parties in legislature opnely hostile to eachother and the Assembly largely unmanageable, the president Manuel de Arriaga wishing to reduce the influence of the Portuguese Republican Party has dissolved the National Assembly unilaterally. As a result of this he has also installed Joaquim Pimenta de Castro to run the government. \n\n Pimenta de Castro immediately appointed several military officers in various ministries, dissolved the National Assembly, and is running the government as a dictator.
loc.ww1_portugal.14.a: They are traitors to the Republic...
loc.ww1_portugal.15.d: Today on May 14th, a political-military uprising has started in Lisbon, with the objective of taking power from the dictatorship of General Pimenta de Castro and returning the government to the principlesof the 1911 constitution. \n\n On the morning of May 14, a group of revolutionaries including naval marines and regular soldiers occupied the Naval Arsenal in Lisbon, immediately taking possession of arms. Pimenta de Castro's forces attempted to encircle the Naval Arsenal however were bombarded by Republican ships including the NRP Vasco da Gama. \N\N Although Pimenta de Castro's government managed to escape they had eventually surrendered due to disproportionate forces that were armed against them. Although a small and short event there have been according to some sources 200 people killed, 1000 injured.
loc.ww1_portugal.16.t: Military Junta, Sidonio Pais Takes Power
loc.ww1_portugal.16.d: Today on 5 December, 1917, with Portugal's participation in the Great War leading to political, economic, and social conjuncture of the country, Sidonio Pais has led a triumphant military revolt resulting in the constitution of a Military Junta. The Parliament has been dissolved and the Afonso Costa government has been overthrown with the president Bernardino Machado removed. \n\n Pais has proposed the creation of a 'New Republic' and has suspended the 1911 Constitution. He has been elected by direct suffrage for the Presidency of the Republic creating a professional Senate.
loc.ww1_portugal.17.t: Law of Separation of Church and State
loc.ww1_portugal.17.d: In an attempt to normalize relations with te Roman Catholic Church, which has been at war with the Republican regime since 1911, the president has amended the Law of Separation of Church and State today. Although it has prompted an immediate and fierce reaction from the raditional Republicans and Freemasons it has garndered widespread support from Catholics, moderate Republicans and the rural population, in all the vast majority of the Portuguese population.
loc.ww1_portugal.18.d: Today on 11 March, Sidonio Pais has made another 'unconstitutional' move by decreeing the direct election of the President by plebiscite, through universal suffrage.
loc.ww1_romania.1.d: Carol I has ruled the Rumanian nation for a long time and thus has helped with the quick development during his reign which the Rumanian people are surely thankful for. Although he was inclined to enter the war on the side of the Central Powers convinced entering the war in support of the German Empire to support his cousin Wilhelm II would be the honorable thing to do. But he has passed away and thus the future of Romania lies in the hand of his Ferdinand.
loc.ww1_romania.1.a: What will be the destiny of Romania?
loc.ww1_russia.1.d: With the war still ongoing we have made successful talks with Romania regarding their neutrality, unless we can make significant progress on our front against the Central Powers Romania does not want to get involved.
loc.ww1_russia.2.d: We have greately improved our relations with our slavic bothers in the Balkans, particularly with Serbia and Montenegro.
loc.ww1_russia.3.d: With Franz Ferdinand dead we must act fast before Austria makes a move and guarantee the independence of Serbia to protect them should Austria think about declaring war.
loc.ww1_russia.3.a: We wont let Serbia become a victim!
loc.ww1_russia.4.d: To protect the capital it would be wise to build several naval/coastal forts should the capital be threatened by an enemy navy.
loc.ww1_russia.5.d: A large amount of indsutrial investments have been coming in from the wests which have been encouraged during our recent era of industrialisation which has been somewhat successful.
loc.ww1_russia.6.d: The Trans-Siberian railway which once finished will connect Moscow with he Far East (Vladivostok), so far it has been under construction for roughly two decades, once finished we will be able to participate in more trading opportunities in the far east improving our economic opportunities.
loc.ww1_russia.7.d: The Trans-Siberian railway which once finished will connect Moscow with he Far East (Vladivostok), so far it has been under construction for roughly two decades, once finished we will be able to participate in more trading opportunities in the far east improving our economic opportunities.
loc.ww1_russia.8.d: The fuse leading to the Powder Keg has been lit, it is only a matter of time before the war breaks out for which we must prepare for the better or the worst of what it may turn into.
loc.ww1_russia.9.d: With the previous Anglo-Russian agreement promising us full influence of Northern Persia, we have decided to take the action of occupying the area based on security reasons with the Ottoman Empire now hostile with us.
loc.ww1_russia.10.d: In an effort to put an end to this war as soon as possible we have decided to put our full focus on the front line to give us an edge over our enemies, however this will mean somewhat neglecting the home front which can cause issues later on.
loc.ww1_russia.11.d: In an effort to put an end to this war as soon as possible we have decided to put our full focus on the front line to give us an edge over our enemies, however this will mean somewhat neglecting the home front which can cause issues later on.
loc.ww1_russia.12.d: In an effort to put an end to this war as soon as possible we have decided to put our full focus on the front line to give us an edge over our enemies, however this will mean somewhat neglecting the home front which can cause issues later on.
loc.ww1_russia.13.d: With the cities of Lviv and Kovel being lost the previous year to the Central Powers, Tsar Nicholas who had previously taken personal command of the Army has approved for an offensive plan drawn up by Alexei Brusilov.
loc.ww1_russia.14.d: Our ally France has requested that Russian troops be sent to fight alongside their own army on the Western Front, whilst some have been opposed to sending any troops the Tsar approved sending several units over.
loc.ww1_russia.14.a: Hopefully they can make use of this
loc.ww1_russia.15.d: Due to our poor pre-war stocks we have not been able to produce enough weapons for the amount of soldiers we have in total, luckily however our allies have been able to send us limited arms too perhaps help us in some way at least.
loc.ww1_russia.16.d: Due to our poor pre-war stocks we have not been able to produce enough weapons for the amount of soldiers we have in total, luckily however our allies have been able to send us limited arms too perhaps help us in some way at least.
loc.ww1_russia.17.d: Due to the Xinhai revolution in China we have had the opportunity to seize some territory and establish a quasi-independent buffer state, that being Mongolia.
loc.ww1_russia.18.d: Taking advantage of the Xinhai revolution even more we can perhaps get away with even larger demands in the future and establish our own dominance in Asia after Japan.
loc.ww1_russia.19.d: Taking larger advantage of the Xinhai Revolution beyond establishing a quasi-independent Mongolian buffer state we have decided to go ahead and occupy all of Manchuria, of course this will most likely largely upset Japan.
loc.ww1_russia.20.d: Since the 1905 Revolution, revolutionaries in Russia have largely been a threat to the our autocratic government and thus must be supressed to keep stability in the nation.
loc.ww1_russia.21.d: In an effort to establish russian culture amongst our non-russian populations we have taken actions to demolish catholic churches and attempt to eradicate foreign languages from the youth through means of education.
loc.ww1_russia.22.d: As a result of the outbreak of war between our country and Germany, the imperial government has taken actions to rename the city of St. Petersburg to Petrograd removing the German words 'Sankt' and 'Burg'.
loc.ww1_russia.22.a: Not sure what good that'll do...
loc.ww1_russia.23.d: In an effort to defend our slavic brothers in the balkans from Austro-Hungarian agression we have decided to guarantee the independence of Serbia and Montenegro who are currently under constant threat of Austrian ambitions in the Balkans.
loc.ww1_russia.24.d: The February Revolution has broken out in Petrograd following longstanding discontent with the monarchy which has resulted in an eruption of mass protest against the food rationing on 8 March. Revolutionary activity was largely confined to the capital and its vicinity lasting about eight days. It involved mass demonstrations and armed clashes with the police and gendarmes, the last royal forces of the Russian monarchy. Finally on the 12th of March mutinous Russian Army forces sided with the revolutionaries who have put the monarchy in jeopardy.
loc.ww1_russia.25.d: Following the end of the February Revolution, Nicholas II has chosen to abdicate the throne, first abdicating in favour of his son Alexi, but backtracking a few hours later after being given advice that the Tsarevich would not live long seperated from his parents whom are to be exiled. Nicholas thus abdicated on behalf of his son and drew up a new manifesto naming his brother, Grand Duke Michael, as the next Emperor of all the Russias whom has declined to accept the throne bringing three centuries of Romanov rule to an end.
loc.ww1_russia.26.d: In an effort to appease the Poles to the same extent the Central Powers have we have decided to create a seperate Polish Legion within the army, it will be deployed in St. Petersburg.
loc.ww1_russia.27.d: The Tsar has recently assumed the role of commander-in-chief after dismissing his cousin, Nikolay Nikolayevich. Due to this he will be staying away at a remote HQ at Mogilev from the governance of the Empire. The move is largely symbolic as all important military decisions are made by his chief of staff.
loc.ww1_russia.28.d: We have decided to focus on our home front, whilst still heavily focused on the frontline itself we will refrain from neglecting the home front completely and still put a significant focus on keeping things at home stable.
