loc.ww1_russia.29.d: We have decided to focus on our home front, whilst still heavily focused on the frontline itself we will refrain from neglecting the home front completely and still put a significant focus on keeping things at home stable.
loc.ww1_russia.30.d: We have decided to focus on our home front, whilst still heavily focused on the frontline itself we will refrain from neglecting the home front completely and still put a significant focus on keeping things at home stable.
loc.ww1_russia.31.d: The Head of the Russian provisional government, Prince Lvov has regretfully resigned today after being unable to rally enough sufficient support from the people. He has resigned in favor of his Minister of War, Alexander Kerensky who is now the new head of the provisional government.
loc.ww1_russia.32.d: On 16 July, soldiers, sailors, and industrial workers in Petrograd have engaged in spontaneous armed demonstrations against the Russian Provisional Government. Compared to the demonstrations of the February Revolution, the mood of the demonstrators was even angrier and darker, the Provisional Government has put blame on the Bolsheviks for the violence and in a subsequent crackdown on the Bolshevik Party, the party was dispersed, many of the leadership arrested. Vladimir Lenin is said to have fled to Finland, whilst Leon Trotsky is among those arrested.
loc.ww1_russia.32.a: Crack down on those commie bastards!
loc.ww1_russia.33.d: Lavr Kornilov has previously beem requested to move forces loyal to the provisional government intro Petrograd to counter the threat of the radical Petrograd army garrison under control of the Soviets. As a result, Kornilov then marched on Petrograd intent on allegedly 'purging' the Provisional Government of revolutionary elements, which were possibly with the intention of establishing a military dictatorship. Kerensy countered Kornilov by arming the Bolshevik-influenced Soviets including Leon Trotsky's Red Guards. As a result Kornilov's army failed to enter Petrograd and he and his closest advisers have been imprisoned at the cost of the Bolsheviks permanently being armed and empowered...
loc.ww1_russia.34.d: With the Kornilov Affair exposing the weakness of the Provisional Government the Bolsheviks gained much popularity with Kerensky's government losing popularity. Along with this the Bolsheviks have just recently won the majority in the Petrograd Soviet. As a result of this seeing a huge opportunity, Vladimir Lenin, who was still hiding out in Finland, disguised himself as an old drunk with a tooth ache and traveled unnoticed into Petrograd hiding out at the Smmolny Institute. In the darkness of the night Bolshevik troops started occupying strategic areas within Petrograd with no shots fired in the process, by the morning the Provisional Government located in the Winter Palace is completely surrounded and Kerensky flees. \n\n Only a day later is the Winter Palace garrisoned by the Junkers and containing remaining ministers of the Provisional Government is stormed and all the ministers arrested and imprisoned in the Peter and Paul Fortress.
loc.ww1_russia.35.d: The Constituent Assembly Elections has yielded the following results with the Sociliast-Revolutionary Party (going in coalition with the Bolsheviks) earning 40.4% of the vote, by far the majority. The Bolsheviks on the other hand coming in second, with only 24.0% of the vote. The Constitutoal Democrat arty also known as the Kadets have won only 4.7% of the vot with Mensheviks coming in last with 2.6% of the votes along with a 18.40% from various other minority parties.
loc.ww1_russia.36.d: The Constitutent assembly meeting today on 5 January, 1918, with the Bolsheviks, was the first and only day in session, on which the Constituent assembly has come into conflict with the Soviets rejecting Soviet decrees on peace and land which has ultimately resulted in the Constituent Assembly being dissolved by force by order of the Congress of Soviets.
loc.ww1_russia.37.d: The leader of the Bolsheviks, Vladimir Lenin, who has previously spent life outside the borders of Russia in exile has made a return from Switzerland with the help of the German government which allowed for him to travel to Petrograd by train via Germany and Finland.
loc.ww1_russia.37.a: Lets hope he doesn't stir up trouble
loc.ww1_russia.38.d: Upon his return to Petrograd from exile, Vladimir Lenin has issued a series of ten directives. The Theses were mostly aimed at fellow Bolsheviks in Russia and returning to Russia from exile. He has called for soviets to take power taking the slogan 'all power to the soviets', denouncing liberals and social revolutionaries in the Provisional Government, and calling for Bolsheviks to refuse cooperation with the Provisional Government and instead call for new commnist policies.
loc.ww1_russia.39.d: Support for the Bolsheviks has suddenly bolstered following the incident with the Milyukov note with widespread mistrust of the Russian Provisional Government growing. The Bolsheviks who have for a while now believed the Provisional Government was continuing the war in the same fashion that the Tsarist Government had, had little proof of this and had been waiting for a time to take action in spreading mistrust of the Provisional Government. Forerign Minister Pavel Milyukov sent the Allied Powers a telegram, one which would prove to be a harmful, containing the statement that the Provisional Government would continue the war with the Tsarist war aims. \n\n The Telegram was leaked to the Bolsheviks by an insider and protests began against the Provisional Government which promised the people that the terror of Tsardom had ended.
loc.ww1_russia.40.d: Today on 1 March 1913 we celebrate the 300th year of the Romanov Dynasty in power marking a country-wide celebration of the ruling Romanov Dynasty. After a grand display of wealth and power in St. Petersburg, and a week of receptions at the Winter Palace, the Imperial family embarked on a tour following Mikhail I Romanov's route after his election as king in 1613, with a sort of pilgrimage to the towns of ancient Muscovy. \n\n The celebrations have been described as an 'extravaganza of pageantry' and a tremendous propaganda exercise; but among its principal goals are to 'inspire reeverence and popular support for the principle of autocracy', and also a reinvention of the past, to 'recount the epic of the 'popular Tsar'. These celebrations have showed the 'true devotion' of the Russian peasant masses to the tsar.
loc.ww1_russia.41.d: The Ice March otherwise known as the First Kuban Campaign was a military withdrawal lasting from February to May 1918, being one of the defining moments of the Russian Civil war with the Volunteer Army, under attack by the RedArmy advancing from the north retreating from the city of Rostov south twards the Kuban where they had hoped to gain the support of the Don Cossacks against the Bolshevik government.
loc.ww1_russia.42.d: A revolt of the Czechoslovak Legion has broken out with the legionaries taking control of Chelyabinsk, meanwhile Russian officers' organizaitons have overthrown the Bolshheviks in Petropavlovsk and in Omsk. Already the Whites are controlling most of the Trans-Siberian Railroad between Lake Baikal and the Urals with Bolshevik power in Sibera practically being eliminated. The Volunteer Army (Whites) howevver are spread far and thin with several leaders and are not connected between their Western and Eastern theatres, if the Bolsheviks are to win they should prevent both theatres from connecting by taking Tsaritsyn.
loc.ww1_russia.43.d: After several months of brutal negotiations a final treaty has been agreed upon between our government in an effort to stop further advances by the Germanand Austro-Hungarian forces. According to the treaty, we will default on all of Imperial Russia's commitments ot the Triple Entente alliance. In the treaty we will cede all of the Baltic States to Germany meant to become German vassal states under German princelings, recognize the independence of Ukraine, cede Byelorussia, cede Kars Oblast in the South Caucasus to the Ottoman Turks. The terms are far above harsh and it is even said the German negotiator has been shocked by the harshness.
loc.ww1_russia.43.a: We will get those lands back later!
loc.ww1_russia.44.d: With war imminent the government has called for general mobilization with reserve divisions across the country ready for action. The men are rather confident that the war will by over, at least but christmas.
loc.ww1_russia.45.d: The Finnish Declaration of Independence has been adopted by the Parliament of Finland today on 6 December, 1917. The declaration has declared Finland an independent nation, among nations ending its autonomy within Russi as its Grand Duchy of Finland, with reference to a simultaneously delivered bill to the Diet to make Finland an independent republic instead.
loc.ww1_russia.45.a: We will not let this slide...
loc.ww1_russia.46.d: Finnish society has experienced rapid population growth, industrialisation, urbanisation, and the rise of a labour movement in the years past, this combined with the collapse of the Russian Empire causing a power vacuum in Finland has led to a struggle for dominance between the left-leaning labour movement in the south whom live amongst the industrial regions and the conservatives whom are situated up north towards the most rural regions.
loc.ww1_serbia.1.d: With the Ottoman Turks weakened from their defeat in the recent Italo-Turkish war and considering they still hold a sizable amount of the Balkan Peninsula it would be a wise idea to take this situation to our advantage and form an alliance with the other Balkan states against the Ottoman turks. With this alliance we will finally be able to push the turks out of europe for good!
loc.ww1_serbia.1.a: The time has come to show our might!
loc.ww1_serbia.101.d: Serbia has proposed an interesting idea - that the nations of the balkans band together and remove the Turkish yoke once and for all!
loc.ww1_serbia.101.a: Of course! We shall join the balkan league.
loc.ww1_serbia.102.t: What shall we do with the Balkan League?
loc.ww1_serbia.102.d: Serbia has proposed the formation of a Balkan League, almost certainly to kick out the Turks from Europe. What shall we do?
loc.ww1_serbia.2.d: With the Balkan League formed the Ottoman Turks will be strategically and numerically disadvantaged against all of us, with our combined armies we will hopefully overcome them and capture all the remaining European territories of the Ottoman Empire!
loc.ww1_serbia.3.d: With the First Balkan War concluded and the Ottoman Empire defeated the great powers of Europe have gathered to deal with the new territorial adjustments out of the conclusion of the war. Unlike our plans unfortunately, the great powers particularly Italy and Austria-Hungary have strongly pushed for the creation of an independent Albanian state which has forced us to break our to the Bulgarians to cede the territory of Vardar Macedonia since if we will not get Albania in this war we wouldn't get anything if we also ceded the Vardar region.
loc.ww1_serbia.3.a: The map of Europe is redrawn once again.
loc.ww1_serbia.301.d: The Turks have lost control of most, if not all of their European posessions. Ideally, we sue for peace before they gather up their strength and strike back at us.
loc.ww1_serbia.301.b: It shall be total victory, or total defeat.
loc.ww1_serbia.302.d: We have been driven out of Europe... The Serbians are offering us peace terms, and we are to surrender almost all of our European possessions to the Balkan nations as they desire.
loc.ww1_serbia.302.a: So be it. The balkans are nothing but trouble.
loc.ww1_serbia.302.b: No, we will push back the dirty giaours!
loc.ww1_siam.1.d: King Chulalongkorn has sadly passed away today at the Amphorn Sathan Residential Hall in the Dusit Palace being succeeded by his son Vahiravudh, otherwise known as Rama VI. Chulalongkorn's achievments and accomplishments for the nation he loved so much will not be forgotten, now we can only hope that our next ruler be more like our last.
loc.ww1_siam.2.d: Today a group of plotters who claim to have been dissatisfied with the new kings reign and his favourism towards the Wild Tiger Corps. Around seven army officers then decided to overthrow the king which later grew to 91 officers, but fortunately Captain Yut Khongyu who was selected by lottery by the plotters to assassinate the monarch, was filled with guilt and confessed to all the plans and named the conspirators who had there after swiftly been arrested and given their sentences at a subsequent military tribunal.
loc.ww1_siam.2.a: This lesson should not be lost on the King...
loc.ww1_turkey.1.d: During a recent diplomatic meeting we have realized that we and the German Empire have very much of the same views, including our particular distaste towards Britain which is largely using us as a tool. The Germans on the other hand have offered to help us with modernizing military and have for the past decade almost been helping construct the Berlin-Baghdad railway.
loc.ww1_turkey.2.d: Enver Pasha has previously called for Admiral Souchon to maneuver in the Black Sea attacking the Russian fleet should 'a suitable opportunity present itself'. This order was not passed thrrough the normal command-chain, Souchon has taken action today by taking his preffered warship, the Goeben, now flying under our flag, and several destroyers opening fire on the shore batteriees of Sevatopol sinking several small Russian vessels later. As a result of this action the Russian Empire has declared war on us and a state of war now exists between us and the Entente.
loc.ww1_turkey.3.d: We have decided to hold on to all of our remaining territory in the Balkan's and should any of the minor nations want a piece of our territory they will have to fight for it!
loc.ww1_turkey.3.a: We won't go without a fight...
loc.ww1_turkey.4.d: Instead of holding on to our territory within the Balkans and delaying the inevitable major war between us and the Balkan states over their core territory we have instead decided to cede our territory which will make us look weak, however, we wont be losing much than prestige.
loc.ww1_turkey.5.t: Our Friend the Tsardom of Bulgaria
loc.ww1_turkey.5.d: We have recently sent diplomats to the Sofia, Bulgaria in order to improve relations with Bulgaria whom we hope will counteract Serbia's dominance and strength in the Balkans as well as providing a larger front for the Serbians. Along with Bulgaria being secured on our side, we shouldn't worry about Constnatinople being threatened and we should be able to have a direct connection to our German allies once Serbia falls.
loc.ww1_turkey.6.d: In an effort to support our Bulgarian allies against their Balkan neighbors we have decided to send equipment and troops for them to use against their enemies.
loc.ww1_turkey.6.a: Hopefully they can make of it
loc.ww1_turkey.7.d: Besides the fact that the British Empire has rather taken advantage of us somewhat, we have come to see that any war against the British is destined to fail and we would benefit more from being on their side than on the losers.
loc.ww1_turkey.7.a: Better to be on the winners side
loc.ww1_turkey.8.d: The fuse leading to the Powder Keg has been lit, it is only a matter of time before the war breaks out for which we must prepare for the better or the worst of what it may turn into.
loc.ww1_turkey.9.d: In order to further solidify our friendship with the British we haave decided to join the Entente.
loc.ww1_turkey.10.d: History of our both nations military relations go back into almost 30 years and the German military mission has proven to be very instrumental in the modernization of how our army works. The Germans have taught us many things and forced us to reform our army to work more efficiently.
loc.ww1_turkey.11.d: The fuse leading to the Powder Keg has been lit, it is only a matter of time before the war breaks out for which we must prepare for the better or the worst of what it may turn into.
loc.ww1_turkey.12.d: Sultan Mehmed V has today officially declared a Jihad saying 'Oh Muslims. Know that our Empire is at war with the mortal enemies of Islam: the governments of Muscovy, Britain, and France. The commander of the Faithful summons you to the Jihad'.
loc.ww1_turkey.12.a: The call goes out for Jihad
loc.ww1_turkey.13.d: In an effort to do harm against our former enemies, the Kingdom of Italy, which took vast territories in Africa from us we have in turn decided to aid their enemies the Senussi Order whom are still involved in guerilla war against the Italians across Libya.
loc.ww1_turkey.13.a: Lets hope they can make us of it
loc.ww1_turkey.14.d: In an effort to maximize our war effort even more we have taken even more actions shifting the focus of all production toward military production.
loc.ww1_turkey.15.d: In an effort to protect Istanbul from a possible larger naval force, particularly that of a possible British/French united fleet, we have decided to increase fortification of the Dardanelles in order to protect our capital in case of such an operation.
loc.ww1_turkey.16.d: The area of Gallipoli remains a vulnerable area where the allies could possibly launch a naval invasion, in prepartion we could built fortifications in the area to deter any possible attempts should they occur.
loc.ww1_turkey.17.d: We have continued with the German military mission which has consistantly been aiding our army, several German commanders are now serving within the Ottoman military and general Liman von Sanders has taught us a great deal against our enemies the Russian Empire and how their forces work.
loc.ww1_turkey.18.d: Should the possibility of a fall back on the Mesoptamian front happen we are starting construction of defenses in Baghdad to hold the city at all costs.
loc.ww1_turkey.19.d: Should the possibility of a fall back on the Palestinian front occur we are starting construction of defenses in the important religious center of Jerusalem.
loc.ww1_turkey.20.d: Should the possibility of a major fall back from Jerusalem occur we are starting construction of major defenses in Damascus in order to hold the city at all costs and prevent allied troops from spilling into Asia Minor.
loc.ww1_turkey.21.t: Our Friends the Emirate of Jabal Shammar
loc.ww1_turkey.21.d: We have long remained friendly to the Emirate of Jabal Shammar, in fact we share many of the same interests and values. It has been long known that the Rashidi dynasty of the Emirate of Jabal Shammar have been long-time enemies of the Saud and vice-versa, perhaps we could somehow help them with this in the future...
loc.ww1_turkey.22.d: In a recent diplomatic mission to Persia we have realized both of our nations have shared common enemies, particularly Russia and the United Kingdom, to whom have been fighting over influence in Persia splitting it like a cake.
loc.ww1_turkey.23.d: Persia is a relatively weak neighbor for which we should take advantage of and fulfill pan-turkism proceding to unite the rest of the Turks in Central Asia at a later date.
loc.ww1_turkey.24.d: We have sent a mission to Afgahnistan in an attempt to create an alliance between our two nations, the entrance of Afgahnistan would be key to our war goals with a possible Afgahn invasion of British Raj.
loc.ww1_turkey.2401.d: We have received a diplomatic mission from the Ottoman Empire which is trying to convince us to join the war on their side claiming that this is an important Jihad against their enemies of Britain calling us as loyal servants to allah to join in this fight the caliphate is involved in.
loc.ww1_turkey.2402.d: Our diplomatic mission to Afgahnistan has been a great success, the Emir of Afgahnistan has agreed to join the war and will invade India which should prove a very useful diversion and should relieve pressure on our front.
loc.ww1_turkey.2403.d: Our diplomatic mission to Afgahnistna has unfortunately been a failure, the Emir of Afgahnistan claims that he is payed by the British to remain neutral which is his main source of income which leaves him no choice but to remain neutral if he wants to keep the money coming.
loc.ww1_turkey.25.d: We have taken action and decided to back the Emirate of Jabal Shammar should they come into any conflict with their neighbors, perhaps in the future we can help them squash the Emirate of Nejd.
loc.ww1_turkey.26.d: We have decided to back Jabal Shammar in a war against the Emirate of Nejd led by the evil House of Saud, concerning our military capabilities, Saud will certainly be squashed like a bug with us on the Rashidi's side.
loc.ww1_turkey.26.a: We shall crush Saud like a bug!
loc.ww1_turkey.27.d: We have been working with Libyan locals in this recent war between us and Italy with many of the locals joining our defensive stature against the oncoming Italian forces.
loc.ww1_turkey.27.a: We are glad to have their support
loc.ww1_turkey.28.d: Following our defeat in the Italo-Turkish war we may have gone home but there is still a large amount of armed forces hidden deep within Libya where the Senussi Order is continuing to operate against the Italian forces. We are going to back them in an effort to harm the Kingdom of Italy through subsersive means...
loc.ww1_turkey.29.d: The CUP is spreading dangerous reforms throughout the Empire and subjecting the Empire to westernization which should not be tolerated, the Sultan also no longer has any power. This must be changed, we must be brought back to good old days.
loc.ww1_turkey.30.d: The Young Turks have recently been overthrown by the masses whom have reinstalled the Sultan's ability to execute absolute rule which was removed by the Young Turks in 1908.
loc.ww1_turkey.31.d: Going further along with purging what remains of the Young Turks we have any of their reforms.
loc.ww1_turkey.33.d: We have taken more action and reinstating true power to the Caliph making the Caliphate an influential part of the Muslim world rather than a figurehead with no true power.
loc.ww1_turkey.34.d: The Committee of Union and Progress has very progressive ideas for the Empire to follow with plans of reform which should hopefully return our country into its rightful place in the sun making it a great power once again.
loc.ww1_turkey.35.d: Today a coup d'état was carried out by a number of Committe of Union and Progess (Young Turks) members led by Enver Pasha and Tallat Pasha, whom made a surprise raid on the central Ottoman government buildings, the Sublime Porte. During the coup, the Minister of the Navy, Nazim Pasha was assassinated and the Grand Vizier, Kamil Pasha has been forced to resign. \N\N With the fall of the former government, the new government has fallen into the hands of the Young Turks who are now under the leadership of the triumvirate or the 'Three Pashas', made up of Enver, Talaat, and Djemal Pasha.
loc.ww1_turkey.36.d: Going along with their promises the Committee of Union and Progress now in power has begun to perform reforms within the Empire which will hopefully make our country great again and worthy enough to be next to the rest of the great powers.
loc.ww1_turkey.37.d: Going along with their promises the Committee of Union and Progress now in power has begun to perform reforms within the Empire which will hopefully make our country great again and worthy enough to be next to the rest of the great powers.
loc.ww1_turkey.38.d: Going along with their promises the Committee of Union and Progress now in power has begun to perform reforms within the Empire which will hopefully make our country great again and worthy enough to be next to the rest of the great powers.
loc.ww1_turkey.39.d: With the Young Turks coming into power, the empire has officially adopted a more nationalistic ideology and leaders, mainly Enver Pasha, have been promoting ideas of Pan-Turkism with several pan-Turkic movements arising.
loc.ww1_turkey.40.d: With the entrance of the CUP into power, Ottomanism which had previously remained dormant has enjoyed a revival. The idea promotes equality among all the ethnicities of the empire regardless of their religion making all subjects equal before the law.
loc.ww1_turkey.41.d: Tensions between Armenians and Turks have risen to a new level. Some Armenians in the region have actively been siding with the Russians, and Enver Pasha's has released 'Directive 8682' on 'Increased security and precautions' to all military units calling for a removal of all ethnic Armenians serving in Ottoman forces from their posts and for their demobilization.
loc.ww1_turkey.42.d: The Anglo-Ottoman Convention of 1913 was an agreement between the Sublime Porte of the Ottoman Empire and the Government of the United Kingdom which defined the limits of the Ottoman jurisdiction in the area of the Persian Gulf with respect to Kuwait, Qatar, and Bahrain, and the Shatt al-'Arab. Signed, but never ratified, the long-lasting impact of the agreement was that of the status of Kuwait.
loc.ww1_turkey.43.d: Today on 3rd October, 1914, an earthquake struck BUrdur at 00:007 local time. Appearing to be a 7. on the surface wave magniture scale, with a maximum intensity of a IX on the Mercalli intensity scale. The earthquake centered near Lake Burdur in southwestern Anatolia destroying more than 17,000 homes and causing 2,344 casualties. Nearly 100% of the homes in Burdur were destroyed.
loc.ww1_turkey.44.d: The Armenian congress at Erzurum, held from the end of July to AUgust 2, 1914, was a watershed event where the representatives of the Committee of Union and Progress party requested the Armenian Revolutionary Federation incite a rebellion of Russian Armenians against the Tsarist regime in order to faciliate the conquest of Transcaucasia in the event of war with ww1_russia. However the Armenians declined to attempt to force their compatriots to incite a rebellion in the Russian Empire.
loc.ww1_turkey.45.d: The Armenian militia of Hunchaks of the city of Zeitun have resisted with an armed conflict which has started today on 30 August. Reports say there are around 20,000 armed Armenian Militia, our troops are moving there right now and will crush these rebellious scum.
loc.ww1_turkey.46.d: The Armenian militia of the Hunchaks which had previously rebelled on 30 August and had been crushed have once again risen up in the city of Zeitun, none-the-less they shall be crushed once more like in the past.
loc.ww1_turkey.47.d: There has been reported Armenian resistance in Urfa, Armenians have put up quite a bit of resistance against our forces however are expected to ultimately be crushed as the Zeitun rebellion has been.
loc.ww1_turkey.48.d: The Tehcir Law otherwise known as the Relocation and Resettlement Law has been passed by the Ottoman Parliament today on 27 May, 1915 authorizing the deportation of the Empire's rebellious and anne frankely scum population.
loc.ww1_turkey.48.a: This will teach them a lesson!
loc.ww1_turkey.49.d: An group of Armenian militia has risen up today on 19 April, 1915, and taken control of the city of Van. There are around 2,000 miltia in the city which are currently under siege from our forces.
loc.ww1_turkey.50.d: Today on 9 October, 1911, at Daan in the Yemen Vilayet, the Treaty of Daan has been signed by a representative of the Sultan and Imam Yahya Muhammad Hamid ed-Din, the Zaydi Imam of Yemen which is supposed to expand Yemen's autonomy in the Ottoman Empire. According to the treaty, the imamate was to be governed by sharia law and the imam is to be given the power to appoint governors and judges as well as collect taxes, while remaining under Ottoman authority.
loc.ww1_turkey.51.d: The early general elections have been held in April 1912, with the ruling Committee of the Union and Progress winning a stunning 2269 of the 275 seats in the Chamber of Deputes whilst the opposition party, the Liberal Entente, won only the remaining six seats.
loc.ww1_turkey.52.d: Today on 17 July, 1912, there has been a reported military coup in the country against the Committee of Union and Progress (CUP) government which has recently been elected. The coup has been carried out by a group of military officers calling themselves the 'Saviour Officers' who are the military wing of the Liberal Entente becoming the main opposition party following the 1912 election.
loc.ww1_turkey.53.d: Reported today was yet another Albanian revolt in a series of numerous revolts during the recent years, apparently this time due to changes for the Albanians introduced by the Young Turks who have increases taxes, conscription for Albanians, and have become disarming the Albanian civil population.
loc.ww1_turkey.54.d: There has been a revolt today in Albania in reaction to the new centralization policies of the Young Turk Otoman government situated in Albania. Rebels have been supposedly supported by the Kingdom of Serbia. Martial law has been declared in the area following the killing of an Ottoman commander, insurgents blocking the railway, and Albanian attaacks on Ottomans in Pristine and Ferizovik.
loc.ww1_turkey.55.d: There has been another revolt in Albania this year which has started today on 24 March, 1911. It is said the Kingdom of Montenegro has supported the rebellion with the main headquarters of the rebels in Montenegro and Montenegro providing weapons for the insurgents. It is also said the King of Montenegro has promised to support them with arms and to provide a shelter to their families. All the while telling us that they were observing 'the strictest neutrality' while being clearly involved! \n\n It is likely King Nikola's strategy is to stimulate unrest in Northern Albania to intervene and annex more territory for Montenegro.
loc.ww1_turkey.56.d: The Karak revolt was an uprising against Ottoman authority in the tranasjordanian town of Al-Karak which erupted on 4 December, 1910. The revolt came after Sami Pasha, the governor of Damascus, wanted to apply the same measures of conscription, taxation, and disarmament to the inhabitants of Al-Karak that previously provoked the Hauran Druze Rebellion. Luckily the rebellion has been brutally supressed after a random massacre and ten revolt leaders being executed, although it has greately angered the Karaki's.
loc.ww1_turkey.57.d: Today on 28 August 1910, during the celebration of Prince Nicolas's jubilee, Prince Nicholas assumed the title of king, in accordance with a petition from the Skupstina officially making the Montenegro and independent entity seperate from the Ottoman Empire for good.
loc.ww1_turkey.58.d: With the war turning against the side of the Central Powers and our troops largely in rags demoralized retreating more every day we have had no choice but to sign an armistice with the Entente. The armistice was signed today by the Minister of Marine Affairs, Rauf Bey and the British Admiral, Somerset Arthur Gough-Calthorpe, on board the HMS Agamemnon in Moudros harbor on the Greek island of Lembnos. As part of the several conditions we have had to surrender remaining garrisons outside of Anatolia and grant the Entente the right to occupy forts controlling the Straits of the Dardanelles and the Bosporus; and the right to occupy the same 'in case of disorder' any Otoman territory in the event of a threat to the Entente's security. We have had to forcibly demobilize the air force and army and make all ports, railways, and other strategic points made available for use by the allies.
loc.ww1_turkey.59.d: With the war turning against the side of the Central Powers and our troops largely in rags demoralized retreating more every day we have had no choice but to sign an armistice with the Entente. The armistice was signed today by the Minister of Marine Affairs, Rauf Bey and the British Admiral, Somerset Arthur Gough-Calthorpe, on board the HMS Agamemnon in Moudros harbor on the Greek island of Lembnos. As part of the several conditions we have had to surrender remaining garrisons outside of Anatolia and grant the Entente the right to occupy forts controlling the Straits of the Dardanelles and the Bosporus; and the right to occupy the same 'in case of disorder' any Otoman territory in the event of a threat to the Entente's security. We have had to forcibly demobilize the air force and army and make all ports, railways, and other strategic points made available for use by the allies.
loc.ww1_turkey.60.d: The Sultan Mehmed V tragically passed away today on the 3rd of July 1918 at the age of 73. During his Reign since the forced abdication of his Brother Abdulhamid II by the Young Turk Revolution in 1908, Mehmed V has had no 'real power' he has been mainly a figure head. His main political actions was declaring a Jihad, agaisnt the Entente Powers on November 14th 1914 follwing the Ottoman Empire's decision ot join the war on the side of the Central Powers. None-the-less he will be mourned.
loc.ww1_turkey.60.a: A tragic loss for the nation
loc.ww1_turkey.61.d: The Istanbul government has signed the Treaty of Sèvres. Its terms concede territory, place the Straits under international supervision, and grant Greece a position in western Anatolia and Thrace. The Grand National Assembly in Ankara rejects the treaty as a settlement imposed without the nation's consent.
loc.ww1_turkey.62.d: Ankara's reorganized forces face the Greek army across western Anatolia. The local resistance has become a war between armies, while the other Allied powers watch the fighting without joining the front directly.
loc.ww1_turkey.63.d: The government in Ankara and Soviet Russia have reached an agreement. Both reject the imposed postwar order; Moscow recognizes the national movement and the parties set out the principles of their northeastern frontier.
loc.ww1_turkey.64.d: Greek forces have landed at Izmir. The occupation alarms Anatolia and encourages local defense associations to coordinate their opposition to the postwar settlement.
loc.ww1_turkey.65.d: Ottoman representatives and the Caucasian governments settle their wartime claims around Batum. The agreement belongs to the final months of the Great War, before the later national movement and its frontier treaties.
loc.ww1_turkey.66.d: The peace conference has signed a new treaty recognizing Turkish sovereignty. The rejected Treaty of Sèvres is superseded, and the frontiers won or negotiated by Ankara become the basis of a durable postwar settlement.
loc.ww1_turkey.67.d: Local resistance to French occupation continues in the southern towns and countryside. Ankara coordinates the movement while concentrating its regular army against Greece.
loc.ww1_turkey.68.d: The eastern army advances against Armenian forces while Ankara seeks a defensible Caucasian frontier. The campaign and its diplomacy will decide the fate of Kars.
loc.ww1_turkey.69.d: Fighting in Cilicia slows as both sides explore a settlement. France must decide how long it will maintain a costly occupation while Ankara needs its resources on the western front.
loc.ww1_turkey.70.d: France and the government in Ankara agree on a southern boundary and the withdrawal of French troops from Cilicia. Hatay remains under French administration, leaving one question unsettled.
loc.ww1_turkey.71.d: Constantinople's principle train station at Haidar Pasha on the Bosporus has been rocked by a huge explosion, caused either by the hasty handling of ordnance or the efforts of British agents. Considerable amounts of ammunition and oil have been unfortunately lost in the inferno, this has severely hampered the war effort in the process.
loc.ww1_turkey.71.a: A catastrophe for the Ottoman war effort
loc.ww1_ukraine.1.d: On April 28th following the dispersal of the Central Council of the Ukrainian People’s Republic the Ukraine was turned into a provisional dictatorship under the leader of Pavlo Skoropadsky who had claimed the title ‘Hetman of Ukraine’ hence the state of the Ukraine could be referred to as the Ukrainian Hetmanate the Ukrainian State. The coup had been sanctioned and agreed upon by the German Empire itself which was dissatisfied by the inefficiency of the Republican government to deliver the promised and much needed grain supplies to the starving German Army. Skoropadsky that same day was Christ mated by the church and became the Hetman of Ukraine. Many Ukrainian nationalists accused Skoropadsky of being a German collaborator who was supported by wealthy landowners. He was considered too Pro-Russian and dictatorial. However despite this his government was very efficient, organized, and built many schools and universities as well as create a temporary peace with the USSR.
loc.ww1_ukraine.1.a: The Hetman shall restore true order
loc.ww1_ukraine.2.d: The Polish-Ukrainian War started on the 1st of November 1918 lasting to the 17th of July the following year over the complicated issue of Galicia. Due to a complicated history in Galicia under the rule of the Habsburgs for many years, a national identity of Ukrainians was developed over time to counter Polish autonomy demands. After the de facto dissolution and collapse of the Austro-Hungarian government in October of 1918 two regiments consisting largely of Ukrop’s in an effort to unite the West Ukrainian lands within the former Austro-Hungarian Empire took control of the cities of Lviv proclaiming it as their capital. The Polaks which had been a majority in the city were shocked to be in a Ukrainian state and eventually fighting began between Ukrainian and Polish forces mainly concentrated around the city of Lviv.
loc.ww1_ukraine.2.a: We will defend our rightful lands!
loc.ww1_ukraine.3.d: Following the defeat of the Central Powers inW orld War I, Skoropadsky could no longer rely on German and Austrian support and on November 13, 1918 Skoropadsky's opponents set up a rival body known as the Directory, whose forces were headed by the newly formed Sich Rifles. Most of Skoropadsky's troops joined with the Directory and Skoropadsky turned to some Russian officers fighting along with Denikin to form a small force but they were not able to face the Directory troops and once the Directory troops took Kiev they officially took full power overthrowing Skoropadsky's regime and re-establishing the Ukranian People's Republic.
loc.ww1_ukraine.4.d: Act Zluky was an agrement signed on January 22, 1919 by the Ukranian People's Republic and the West Ukranian People's Republic on St. Sophia Square in Kiev. It was aimed at creating a unified Ukranian state however the Act Zluky did little to unify the states bu rather acted as purely symbolic in that both governments still retained their own seperate armies, administrations, and government structure. The text of the unverisal made by the Directorate of the Ukranian People's Republic states "The territory of Ukraine, divided over the centuries, including Galicia, Bukovyna, Carpathian Ruthenia, and Dnieper Ukraine will now become a great united Ukraine. Dreams, for which the best sons of Ukraine fought and died for, have come true.". However in the end the Ukraine was never able to gain independence.
loc.ww1_ukraine.5.t: Crimea has been transferred to us!
loc.ww1_ukraine.5.d: The Germans have decided to give us control of the former territories of the Taurida Socialist Republic!
loc.ww1_usa.1.d: Whilst we do not wish to participate or personally get involved in this European conflict, ultimately the German Empire is a autocratic state which is an enemy to democracy so it would be better to support the Entente who at least share our democratic values.
loc.ww1_usa.2.d: Whilst we are still a neutral country, we have managed to persuade the French government of the value of an volunteer American air unit flying for France. Perhaps, with their efforts recognized by the American public it could rouse American interest in abandoning neutrality and joining the fight ourselves.
loc.ww1_usa.3.d: Whilst the American people do not wish to get involved in the European war, and act alone in diplomacy, the Ceentral Powers winning this war would be far from our interests. So, whilst we cannot join the fight currently ourselves, we could make contributions in other terms of supplies, raw material, and money.
loc.ww1_usa.4.d: Whilst the American people do not wish to get involved in the European war, and act alone in diplomacy, the Ceentral Powers winning this war would be far from our interests. So, whilst we cannot join the fight currently ourselves, we could make contributions in other terms of supplies, raw material, and money.
loc.ww1_usa.5.d: Whilst the American people do not wish to get involved in the European war, and act alone in diplomacy, the Ceentral Powers winning this war would be far from our interests. So, whilst we cannot join the fight currently ourselves, we could make contributions in other terms of supplies, raw material, and money.
loc.ww1_usa.6.t: U.S. Condemns German Unrestricted Submarine Warfare
loc.ww1_usa.6.d: The Germans have been caused tremendous outrage amongst U.S. citizens and the Goverment for sinking U.S. ships, most famous was the rescent Lusitania which sank with some 100 U.S. Citizens on board. We have demanded the Germans stop unrestricted submarine warfare or else we might remain neutral no longer, we will wait on their response to this...
loc.ww1_usa.601.t: U.S. Demands We Stop Unrestricted Submarine Warfare
loc.ww1_usa.601.d: The United States has condemned our actions in unestricted submarine warfare, whilst it is a good way to counter the United Kingdom's North Sea Block, perhaps we should stop with it before the United States itself gets involved in this war and perhaps tips the scales towards our enemies favor. Of course we could always continue with the unestricted submarine warfare, but the U.S's response is uncertain...
loc.ww1_usa.602.d: The German Empire has reieved word of our extreme dissaproval of continuing their actions of unrestricted submarine warfare and promptly has responded to us saying that they will immediately stop.
loc.ww1_usa.603.d: The German Empire has recieved word of oru extreme dissaproval of continuing their actions of unrestricted submarine warfare and have promptly responses saying that they will continue with it and if we wish for them to stop then the British must first lift the North Sea Blockade, of course we could always stay neutral in face of this response but the most responsible thing to do would be to take action against the German Empire!
loc.ww1_usa.603.b: It is time to get involved
loc.ww1_usa.7.d: The Germans have completely betrayed any trust we had between us recently by sending the Zimmerman telegram to Mexico asking for them to wage war upon us! Offering our land, a whole peace treaty drawn up dividing our country! Such actions are ABSOLUTELY unacceptable and it is amazing that we have not yet entered the war as of yet.
loc.ww1_usa.7.a: We will hold on to neutrality
loc.ww1_usa.8.d: For too long have we sat back and done nothing in the face of German agression against our country! They have sent a telegram to Mexico offering OUR land, and have restarted unrestricted submarine warfare despite promising to stop with it. The American people have at the start of this war wanted neutrality, but with recent actions we have been forced into this war ourselves.
loc.ww1_usa.8.a: Those Kraut will get a piece of us!
loc.ww1_usa.9.d: The French and English are in dire need of fresh troops on the Western Front which we have graciously been able to provide them now that we have gotten enough transport ships, we will be sending around 100,000 men over across the atlantic each month, hopefully it will be enough to tip the scales once and for all.
loc.ww1_usa.9.a: We're coming over and we wont come back til it over over there
loc.ww1_usa.10.d: The United States has already declared its neutrality in the European conflict however we will not in any way favor either side in this war, whoever wins will win, this form of European diplomacy is ultimately not worth any of our men to shed their blood over or any of our money to be spent on.
loc.ww1_usa.11.d: We have ultimately chosen the policy of non-interventionism throughout this whole conflict avoiding being drawn into any alliances and thus wars which are not related to our direct territorial self-defense. Many people within the country agree with this policy and thus we will stand by it.
loc.ww1_usa.12.d: With tensions arising in Mexico with the current revolution an ongoing battle, on the border several American towns have been unfortunately the victims of this battle in Mexico somehow spilling over into our borders. To put an end, or to at least severely limit this we have decided to send the army to guard the borrder so no such incidents will occur in the future.
loc.ww1_usa.12.a: We won't let it spill over
loc.ww1_usa.13.t: U.S. Intervention on side of Maderistas
loc.ww1_usa.13.d: The Porfirio Diaz regime is not a popular one, and thus we have decided to support Francisco Madero who has rightfully won the recent election in Mexico and has seeked refuge in our country, it is unlikely that Porfirio Diaz will even attempt to hold on to his power with the might of the U.S. against him, he will ultimately fold and cede power to Madero.
loc.ww1_usa.14.d: The Porifirio Diaz regime is not a popular one, and recently we have decided to support Francisco Madero who has rightuflly won the recent election in Mexco but has been forced out of the country by Porfirio Diaz whom seeks to hold on to his position. Hopefully, Madero will ultimately win with our help in supplying his revolution and restore democracy in Mexico!
loc.ww1_usa.15.d: Going along with our decision to send a portion of the U.S. army to the Mexican-American border to prevent any spill-overs from the Mexican side, we have taken actions in fortifying the border as well in the case of war, which is not off the list due to current tensions between our country.
loc.ww1_usa.16.d: Victoriano Huerta is no friend of Democracy, just like Porfirio Diaz, Huerta is a brutal dictator but perhaps even worse. He has previously unfortunately ousted the beloved, Francisco Madero tricking him into his death and assuming power. Now with the rise of Huerta a new alliance has formed between the Villistas, Constitutionalistas, and Zapatistas to restore stability to Mexico and get rid of Victoriano Huerta.
loc.ww1_usa.17.d: With the fall of the Huerta regime in Mexico we have rightfully decided to return the territory of Veracruz which was previously occupied. Hopefully, our good relations with Mexico can be restored.
loc.ww1_usa.18.d: The U.S. government heavily dissaproves of the rise of Victoriano Huerta in Mexico, his actions of a brutal dictator have rippled across Mexico scheming and bringing down the previous president, Francisco Madero who was rightfully elected.
loc.ww1_usa.19.d: In order to hopefully bring down the Huerta regime as soon as possible we haave taken actions to supply the Anti-Huertista Alliance with military equipment in hopes of aiding their efforts.
loc.ww1_usa.20.d: Previously a good ally to the United States, Mexican Revolutionary Pancho Villa has quickly become an enemy of the United States. In retaliation for our support of the Venustiano Carranza's Constitutionalistas whom Villa has effectively split from after the fall of Huerta, Villa has attacked U.S. border towns and will likely continue doing so, if he doesn't then we must retaliate as soon as possible.
loc.ww1_usa.21.d: President Wilson has assured the American people that the United States will stay neutral in this new european conflict and that as long as he remains president we will stay out of the war. His comment on U.S. neutrality has been met with agreement amongst the American citizens who wish for the country to remain neutral as well.
loc.ww1_usa.22.d: In order to support our cause in the war we have issued Liberty Bonds with a total of 5.5 million people purchasing bonds raising around 2 billion USD for the war effort.
loc.ww1_usa.22.a: Make sure to purchase a Libert Bond!
loc.ww1_usa.23.d: In an effort to maximize our war effort even more we have taken even more actions shifting the focus of all production toward military production.
loc.ww1_usa.24.d: In order to raise a national army for service in the war the United States governent has passed the Selective Service Act after the President realizing that volunteer troops would not be enough and the country would need a much larger army to participate.
loc.ww1_usa.24.a: Get ready to go over there!
loc.ww1_usa.25.d: The government has denounced the illegitimate Soviet government which has overthrown the rightful and democratic Russian Provisional Government recently. With Russia now effectively out of the war thanks to the communists in power Germany will wield an even greater power on the Western Front.
loc.ww1_usa.26.d: With the Russian Civil War kicking off the government has decided to aid the White, the legitimate government, in their efforts against Soviet Russia. Hopefully if all goes to plan and White Russia wins this internal struggle democracy will once again be restored to the country as it was supposed to be under the Russian Provisional Government. Some of our men have been sent over as well, but largely to garrison, particularly in Vladivostok.
loc.ww1_usa.27.d: If anything is a greater threat in the world to democracy it has to be the Bolsheviks who are actively inspiring Communist revolution and there is a very likely and large threat there could be a Communist-inspired revolution here in the United States as well. Due to this we have begun to supress radical organizations, allowed for illegal search and seizures, as well as unwarranted arrests for those suspected to be radicals or anarchists.
loc.ww1_usa.27.a: Lets hope it doesn't spread over here!
loc.ww1_usa.28.d: With the German steamer, the SS Ypiranga, about to deliver weapons and munitions to the Huerta government in violation of the arms embargo instituted by us and Huerta's refusal to do the 21-gun salute to the U.S. flag following the unwarranted seizure of several unarmed U.S. Sailors the President was forced to order the U.S. military seizure of the port of Veracruz. This has been a very unpopular move and has brought ours and the Mexican government to the brink of war.
loc.ww1_usa.28.a: At least it is not in the hands of Huerta
loc.ww1_usa.29.d: Democratic candidate Woodrow Wilson has won a sweeping vicotry across the United States today with an electoral vote of 435, William H. Taft who was running for re-election however only managed to win 8 electoral votes being 3rd after Thedore Roosevelt who won 88 electoral votes.
loc.ww1_usa.30.d: After ten long years of construction on the Panama Canal we have finally managed to finish the 50-mile-long passage.
loc.ww1_usa.31.d: Today the Federal Reserve Act has been officially created s an Act of Congress establishing the Federal Reserve System, otherwise known as the central banking system in the U.S. and has created the authority to issue Federal Reserve Notes. The Act was officially signed into law by President Woodrow Wilson.
loc.ww1_usa.32.d: On the authority of President Woodrow WIlson around 330 US Marines have landed in Port-au-Prince, Haiti, taking control of the country following the murder of dictator President Vilbrun Guillaume Sam by insurgents who were angered by his political executions of elite opposition. The United States has regarded the revolt against Sam a threat to American business interests in the country prompting the invasion following Rosalvo Bobo's emergence as the next president who was increasingly anti-American.
loc.ww1_usa.33.d: Today in New Mexico, a raid conducted by Pancho Villa's Divsion of the North on the United States border town of Columbus, New Mexico has resulted in a full-scale battle between the Villistas and United States Army. Whilst Villa was ultimately driven back into Mexico by the elements of the 13th Cavalry Regiment he was none-the-less able to conduct a signficant amount of damange on the city and this attack was very much angered many U.S. citizens and the president who may be compelled to act on this.
loc.ww1_usa.34.d: Today on July 30, 1916, in Jersey City, an explosion took place on Black Tom island were many American-made munitions which were to be supplied to the allies were ultimately destroyed. The explosion was equivalent to an earthquake between 5.0 and 5.5 on the Richter scaleand has been reportedly felt as far away as Philadelphia and windows as far as 25 miles away being broken. Upon investigation this explosion waas by far no means an accident but the work of German agents!
loc.ww1_usa.35.t: U.S. Occupation of the Dominican Republic
loc.ww1_usa.35.d: With the Dominican Republic's Secretary of War, Desiderio Arias, recently seizing power from Juan Isidro, the U.S. government has not responded kindly. Rear Admiral William B. Caperton has ordered Arias to step down threatening Santo Domingo with naval bombardment, whilst attempts were made to resist the invasion our forces ultimately gained the initiative and restored order throughout most of the republic with some minimal resistance continuing across the country.
loc.ww1_usa.35.a: It will be better under our supervision
loc.ww1_usa.36.t: Wilson Talks About a Peace Without Victory
loc.ww1_usa.36.d: Woodrow Wilson has made a statement calling for European opponents to come together to form a truce between both sides, a peace without either a winner or loser, a peace without victory. However, it is far from likely that something like this will come to be as both sides have lost too much for just a white peace and have arranged to many plans of expansion...
loc.ww1_greece.1.d: As George the First approached the fiftieth anniversary of his accession, the King made plans to abdicate in favor of his son Constantine immediately after the celebration of his golden jubilee in October 1913. George went about Thessaloniki without any meaningful protection force. While out on an afternoon walk near the White Tower on 18 March 1913, he was shot at close range in the back by Alexandros Schinas, who was \"said to belong to a Socialist organization\" and \"declared when arrested that he had killed the King because he refused to give him money\". George died instantly, the bullet having penetrated his heart. The Greek government denied any political motive for the assassination, saying that Schinas was an alcoholic vagrant.
loc.ww1_greece.2.d: Under Allied pressure and amid the National Schism, Constantine I has left the throne. His son Alexander has succeeded him, opening the way for Greece to join the Entente.
loc.ww1_greece.3.d: With Constantine gone, Greece can enter the war alongside the Entente against Germany and Bulgaria.
loc.aidumb.1.d: Want to know why this is even a country, just wait for the next event
loc.aidumb.2.d: Want to know why this is even a country, just wait for the next event
loc.aidumb.3.d: Hi, I apologize for the whole \"Britain\" 2 and \"Britain 3\" as I call them however they are neccesary because the AI is dumb and it does dumb things and people who do dumb things die. Non the less if you would like to control the AI from the Mesopotamian Front you may do so.
loc.aidumb.3.a: I want to control the Mesopotamian Front
loc.aidumb.4.d: Hi, I apologize for the whole \"Britain\" 2 and \"Britain 3\" as I call them however they are neccesary because the AI is dumb and it does dumb things and people who do dumb things die. Non the less if you would like to control the AI from the Palestinian Front you may do so.
loc.aidumb.4.a: I want to control the Palestinan Front
loc.aidumb.5.t: Control The Mesopotamian and Jerusalem fronts?
loc.aidumb.5.d: Since you, a player, are playing the British... It's likely that you can manage the fronts better than the AI ever could. So, would you like control over the Palestinian and Mesopotamian fronts?
loc.ww1_germany.52032.d: The final peace settlement has not been accepted within the stipulated time. The Armistice of Compiègne has collapsed, and the Entente resumes the war against Germany.
loc.ww1_germany.52032.a: Armistice failed. Back to the Arms!
loc.ww2_france.1.d: After the augmenting pressure of the Lebanese people the French government had finally yielded to their demands and has given Lebanon independence this morning of Monday NOvember 22, 1943. The first Lebanese flag was raised on 11 November 1943 in the residence of Hussein El Halabi.
loc.ww2_france.2.d: The combined forces of the Western Allies are slowly filling into the crack in Normandy which shall relieve us of the pressure of their counter offensives and attempts to push back the invasion into the sea.
loc.ww2_france.2.a: We need as many men as we can get!
loc.ww2_france.8.d: The Allied invasion of Normandy, otherwise known as Operation Overlord or termed D-Day has started today, it is crucial we hold back the allies from getting any kind of foothold in the west for if they do they can send more and more reinforcements and open up a whole other front and possibly retake France.
loc.ww2_france.8.a: If we give them an inch they will go a mile...
loc.ww2_france.9.d: The Allied invasion of Southern France has started, otherwise known as Operation Dragoon. The landing needs to be crushed immediately as we cannot focus on so many fronts at once, it would be wise to kill this operation in its infancy before it captures and more major ports which would allow for more allied supplies to flow in.
loc.ww2_germany.1.d: Most commonly known as the Armistice of 11 November 1918 was an armistice between the Entente and Germany which officially ended the First World War in all. It went affect at 11 a.m. Paris time on the 11th of November 1918 'The eleventh hour of the eleventh day of the eleventh month'. Whilst the Germans responded largely due to the policies proposed by President Woodrow Wilson in his Fourteen Points the actual terms of the later Treaty of Versaille were largely written and decided upon by the French six months later which concluded the peace. The armistice included the cessation of all hostilities, withdrawal of German troops to their own borders, preservation of ifnrastructure, exchange of prisoners, promose of reparations, and disposition of German warships and submarines to allied command.
loc.ww2_germany.3.d: The Ace of all Aces, Manfred von Richtofen alternatively known as 'The Red Baron' flying his Red Colored Fokker Tripline to envoke fear in the foul enemy has emerged from another successful air engagment with his 81st Kill after spotting Wilfred May eyeing his young cousin, Wolfram. Non-the-less both have emerged victiorious and alive and well, our troops look up to him in their trenches, he is their angel in the air.
loc.ww2_germany.4.d:
Welcome the Endsieg: Total Victory! 

 This mod is developed by one person as of now, thanks to my some of my friends however for some limited help in gfx. The mod is meant to give the player an option to play through the interwars eventually, currently the interwars are under construction but getting to completion, the 'Kaiserschlacht' March 21st 1918 is not the main start of the mod or the main point it is just there to give a challenge for the player should he want a challenge, for now. Later on the Kaiserschlacht start will be given more importance as winning as the Central Powers gives an alternative Interwars and alternative WWII. 

 What is 'Kaiserchlacht'? 

 The Kaiserschlacht (pronounced KAI-SER-SH-LA-AH-HH-T) also known as Operation Michael, the Ludendorff Offensive, or the Spring 1918 Offensive/s was the last German roll of the dice during the latter part of the First World War and the last ditch effort to breach the Allied lines and seize the Channel Ports which supplied British Expeditionary Forces, however Ludendorff changed the plan towards the end and decided to aim for an offensive along the whole of the British front north of the River Somme designed to seperate the British and French armies driving the British into the sea and leaving the French isolated. Non-the-less the plan was very successful at first with the Germans gaining A LOT OF LAND in WWI terms but Germans as far as they advanced did not have enough Supply to hold the territory they captured which was also battered by Artillery fire and very undefendable.
loc.ww2_germany.5.d: Manfred von Richtofen most commonly known as the Red Baron has claimed his 80th kill today on the 20th of April 1918. \N\N Richtofen's 80th kill on the 20th of April wouldtop off all of the other aces of WWI and he would be known as the Aces of Aces (During WWI at least, see Erich Hartmann for the Aces of Aces of Aces of Aces...). Richtofen's life however had been plagued by tragedy, most of his friends and fellow comrades close to him had fallen from the skies like flies in the previous year and Richtofen was reported to have fallen into a deep depression and saw life as useless. Before he left on his flight the next day he told his mother his tooth hurt and she replied with 'Go to the dentist' yet Richtofen said 'I don't need to, I'll be gone anyway'.
loc.ww2_germany.6.d: The Kaiser Wilhelm Geschütz more commonly known as the Paris Gun was a long range heavy howitzer that bombarded the city of Paris several times throughout the war, while rather very ineffective it did cause damage to morale of the inhabitants of the city.
loc.ww2_germany.6.a: That is a long way to go for a shell
loc.ww2_germany.7.d: Starting April 13th 1918, the newly formed Taurida Soviet Socialist Republic was invaded by the forces of the Ukraine People’s Republic and the German Empire who provided assistance. By the end of April 1918 the majority of the leaders of this short-lived Crimean Communist State were arrested and shot by insurgent Crimean Tatars and on April 30th that same month it was officially abolished and replaced with a German-protected Crimean Regional Government.
loc.ww2_germany.7.a: The warm water ports of Crimea shall be ours!
loc.ww2_germany.9.d: DUring the night on October 29th-30th of 1918 the German fleet was anchored in Wilhelmshaven in expectation of a planned final battle before the wars end. However the sailors on board the SMS Thuringen and SMS Helgoland committed mutiny and sabotage in response to plans for an attack which they viewed was a final throw of the dice by the high command and completely meaningless, which it had been largely. A day later however torpedo boats pointed their cannons at these ships and the mutineers gave up with no resistance. The Third Navy Squadron was ordered back to Kiel as the crew's loyalty could no longer be relied on. This later led to the Kiel Mutiny on November 3rd which largely triggered the German revolution and swept aside the Monarchy within a few days leading to the end of the German Empire.
loc.ww2_germany.9.a: Our own men have given risen up against us, the war is lost
loc.ww2_germany.8.d: The Crimean Regional Government was established on 25th June 1918 shortly after the April 1918 Crimean Offensive led by Ukrainian and German Forces. Following the fall of the Taurida Socialist Republic the former area of TSR was annexed by Germany and later the Crimean Regional Government was established and formed under German protection. Whilst there were efforts by Ukraine to exert control over Crimea they fell short with German support which kept the regional government separate from the Ukraine.
loc.ww2_germany.8.a: This will serve as a good port
loc.ww2_germany.10.d: With the Great War nearing and the undeniable failure of the 1918 Ludendorff Offensive, the Chancellor of Germany, Prince Max von Baden in order to make the peace settlement land less harshly on Germany accepted Wilson's Fourteen Points hoping to please the western powers and make Germany more democratic to appease them. In effect with accepting this Germany was also forced to abandon its occupied administrative areas in Eastern Europe. If we do not accept the fourteen points we will surely face larger consequences, but if we do we have nothing to lose at this point, the war is lost, let us make the best of it while we still can.
loc.ww2_germany.11.d: The Taurida SSR has surrendered and its territories shall be transfered straight to us to keep under control. Whilst the Ukranian State viewed the territory of the Taurida SSR rightfull theirs and hoped for a federation the German Empire kept both seperate and monitored the former TSSR territory personally keeping it under their control and de facto seperate from Ukraine.
loc.ww2_germany.11.a: It is better in our hands
loc.ww2_germany.12.d: With the German Empire actively seeking an armistice with the allies and a revolution threatening the unstable political situation of Germany by the end of the war calls for the Kaiser to abdicate grew in intensity. Wilhelm II himself was deeply reluctant to make such a sacrifice. Whilst his military advisers insisted that the army could no longer be relied on Wilhelm still expressed a notion to lead the armies back into Germany from the Western Front. Following the Kiel mutiny however Wilhelm II lost all hope and the navy was his greatest joy and achievement for which once it rebelled he had realized that the war had indeed been lost and seeing the fate of the Russian Royal Family, his cousins, he abdicated on November 9th which was announced by the Chancellor, Prince Max von Baden in a proclamation on that same day and went into exile in Holland. The Kaiser’s abdication proclamation was formally published on the 30th of November 1918 and facing much criticism over the nature of the abdication the German Army Chief of Staff. Paul von Hindenburg issued a statement on 20 March 1919 explaining the sequence of events and defending the Kaiser’s role.
loc.ww2_germany.12.a: He was but a 'Shadow Kaiser' anyway
loc.ww2_germany.13.d: The Treaty of Versaille, signed on 28 June 1919, exactly five years after the assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand officially ended the state of war between Germany and the Allied Powers. Within the Treaty of Versaille Germany was to accept responsibility of 'Germany and her allies for causing all loss and damage during the war'. This was one of the most important and controversial things required which became later known as the 'War Guilt caluse'. In whole the treaty forced Germany to disarm, make territorial concessions to France, Belgium, and Poland, pay reparations assessed at 132 billion marks equivalent to 442 Billion USD in 2017. Many people at the time viewed the treaty as "too harsh" whilst others such as Ferdinand Foch the French Field Marshal saw it as too lenient saying "This is not a peace. It is an armistice for 20 years" for which he was all but a 3 months off.
loc.ww2_germany.14.d: The Schleswig Plebiscites were two plebiscites organized according to section XII, articles 109 to 114 of the Treaty of Versaille on the 28 June, 1919 in order to determine the future border between Denmark and Germany through the former Duchy of Schleswig. The process was monitored by representatives from France, UK, Norway, and Sweden with the end result being of Southern Jutland/Schleswig being handed over to Denmark following an effective referendum in which the danish populace in South Jutland voted to be part of Denmark.
loc.ww2_germany.14.a: We are being robbed from every corner...
loc.ww2_germany.15.d: The Greater Poland Uprising was a military insurrection of Poles in the 'Greater Poland' region against German rule. The uprising had a large and significant effect on the Treaty of Versaille which ended up granting the Second Polish Republic the area won by the Polish insurrectionists. The region was part of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth before the Second Partition of Poland in 1793 which granted the territory to the Kingdom of Prussia.
loc.ww2_germany.16.t: German Fleet Scuttled at Scapa Flow
loc.ww2_germany.16.d: After the singing of the Armistice at Compiegne, France, which effectively ended WWI. The Allied powers were unstable to agree upon what would happen to the German surface fleet, whilst the Americans suggested the German  surface fleet be interned in a neutral port until a final decision was agreed upon two countries that were approached Norway and Spain refused. After that it was suggested they be interned at Scapa Flow, Britain with a skeleton crew of German sailors being guarded by the Grand Fleet and such was agreed upon. Once at Scapa Flow the mood amongst the sailors was still very mutinous and all of them had been heavily demoralized unable to go ashore and the food supplies coming from Germany of very poor quality. In addition none of the sailors were allowed to visit other ships or communicate. At the negotiations at the Paris Peace Conference the French and Italians wanted a quarter of the ships whilst the British wanted all of them destroyed since they saw redistribution as a threat to the supremacy of the Royal Navy. Rear-Admiral Ludwig von Reuter who had been given command of the ship's heard of the possible terms and began to prepare detailed plans to scuttle his ships, on June 18th he gave out orders which stated “It is my intention to sink the ships only if the enemy should attempt to obtain possession of them without the assent of our government.” While the signing of Versaille was scheduled for noon 21 June 1919 the First Battle Squadron prepared to board the German ships to check for signs of the crew preparing to scuttle however they had been misinformed the deadline of the treaty was extended to 19:00 23 June. Around 10:00 a.m. on 21 June 1919 Ludwig von Reuter sent a signal flag ordering the fleet to scuttle which began almost immediately. There was no noticeable effect until noon when the ‘Friedrich der Grosse’ began to list heavily starboard and all the ships hoisted the Imperial German Ensign on their main masts. It was a great disaster for the Allies as 52 of the 74 ships sunk. Whilst Admiral Fremantle in charge of the supervision of the German surface fleet scorned Von Reuter and his men he privately remarked “I could not resist feeling some sympathy for von Reuter, who had preserved his dignity when placed against his will in a highly unpleasant and invidious position.
loc.ww2_germany.17.d: The Abstimmung in Ostpreußen also known as the Allenstein and Marienwerder Plebiscite, was a plebiscite for self-determination of the regions of Warmia (Ermland), Masuria (Mazury, Masuren) and Powiśle, which had been parts of the East Prussian Government region of Allenstein and of the West Prussian Government region of Marienwerder, in accordance with the Treaty of Versailles. Prepared early in the year, It took place on July 11th 1920.The Plebiscite was conducted by German authorities. Both the German and Polish Governments believed that the outcome of the plebiscite was decided by the ongoing Polish-Bolshevik War, a part of the Russian Civil War, which threatened the existence of the newly formed polish nation itself and as a result, even many German citizens of Polish ethnicity in the region voted for Germany out of fear that if the area was allocated to Poland it would soon fall under Soviet rule.
loc.ww2_germany.18.d: On March 13th 1920, Wolfgang Kapp and Walther von Lüttwitz launched a planned coup to overthrow the Weimar Republic and establish a right wing oriented government in its place. It was supported by parts of the Reichswehr and other conservative, nationalist and monarchist factions. The coup started in Berlin and forced the legitimate Weimar government to flee the city. It failed after a few days when large sections of the German populace when the general population spurred on by the legitimate government, started a General Strike, where participants refused to work with Kapp and his allies. Despite its failure, the putsch had significant consequences for the future of the Weimar Republic, and would be a precursor of things to come.
loc.ww2_germany.18.a: We are in a fragile state...
loc.ww2_germany.19.d: The Ruhr Uprising, or March Uprising, took place in the Ruhr region of Germany in March 1920. It was a left-wing workers' revolt and the uprising initially was in support of the call for general strike issued by the Social Democrat members of the German government, the unions and other parties in response to the right-wing Kapp Putsch of 13 March, 1920. However, the communists and socialists in the Ruhr had previously laid plans for 'winning political power by the dictatorship of the proletariat' in the event of a general strike.
loc.ww2_germany.20.d: The Spartacist uprising was a general strike with armed battles accompanying it in Interim Germany from 4 to 15 January, 1919. \n\n Whilst Germany was in the middle of a post-war revolution, two of the perceived paths forward were either a Social Democracy or a Council/Soviet Republic. The uprising was primarily a power struggle between the moderate Social Democratic Party (SPD) and the moerradical communists of the Communist Party led by Karl Liebknecht and Rosa Luxemburg whom both were later executed after the uprising was crushed.
loc.ww2_germany.21.d: On the 6th of April 1919, a Soviet Republic was formally proclaimed in Bavaria. It was initially ruled by USPD members and anarchists. On Sunday, 12 April 1919, the Communist Party formally seized power, with Eugen Levine as their leader who started to enact communist reforms and started the formation of a Red Army, seized cash, food supplies, expropriated luxurious apartments and gave them to the homeless and put factories under the ownership and control of the workers. But the Republic was short lived after the remaining loyal ements of the German Army crushed the opposition and executed Levine.
loc.ww2_germany.22.d: An explosion of epic proportions has happened in the German town of Oppau on the 21st of September, 1921, reports are coming in that a tower silo storing 4,500 tonnes of a mixture of ammonium sulfate and ammonium nitrate fertilizer have exploded at a BASF plant in Oppau, Germany. 500-600 people have been killed and 2,000 more injured.
loc.ww2_germany.23.d: The Hamburger Aufstand was an insurrection in the Weimar Republic, starting on the 23rd of October by one of the most militant sections of the Hamburg district Communist Party (KPD), the KP Wasserkante. The rebels stormed 24 police stations, 17 in Hamburg and seven Schleswig-Holstein province stations in Prussia. Over 100 people died during the uprising.
loc.ww2_germany.23.a: This insurrection shall be dealt with
loc.ww2_germany.24.d: The Küstrin Putsch, also known as the Buchrucker Putsch, was a reaction to the September 26th quelling of resistance by the German government to the occupation of the ruhr region. Led by Bruno Ernst Buchrucker, groups of the Black Reichswehr wanted to bring down the Reich government of Chancellor Gustav Stresemann and replace the parliamentarian-democratic Republic with a national dictatorship. Another motive for the putsch was the Reichswehr’s decision to disband work details, causing many of their members to lose their livelihood. The attempt to occupy Küstrin, a garrison city, was prevented by units of the Reichswehr. Buchrucker and other officers were arrested and sentenced for high treason to imprisonment in a fortress or prison. The bulk of the rebels were soon released and were not punished.
loc.ww2_germany.25.d: On the 8th of November, 1923, Hitler and the SA stormed a public meeting of 3,000 people organized by Gustav Ritter von Kahr in the Bürgerbräukeller, a beer hall in Munich. Interrupting Kahr’s speech, he announced that the national revolution had begun and declared the formation of a new government with Ludendorff. Retiring to a back room, Hitler demanded and got the support of Kahr, Seisser and Lossow at gunpoint. Hitler’s forces initially succeeded in occupying the local Reichswehr and police headquarters, but Kahr and his cohorts quickly withdrew their support. Neither the army nor the state police joined forces with Hitler. The next day, Hitler and his followers marched from the beer hall to the Bavarian War Ministry to overthrow the Bavarian Government, but police dispersed them. Sixteen NSDAP members and four police officers were killed in the failed coup.
loc.ww2_germany.25.a: The nation stands on weak supports
loc.ww2_germany.26.d: As a result of the Beer Hall Putsch, at the Bürgerbräukeller, Hitler fled to the home of Ernst Hanfstaengl and by some accounts contemplated suicide. He was depressed but calm when arrested on the 11th of November 1923 for high treason. His trial before a special People’s Court in munich began in February 1924, and Alfred Rosenberg became temporary leader of the NSDAP. On April 1st, Hitler was sentenced to five years’ imprisonment at Landsberg Prison. There, he received friendly treatment from the guards, and he was allowed mail from supporters and regular visits by party comrades. Pardoned by the Bavarian Supreme Court, he was released from jail on 20 December 1924, against the state prosecutor's objections.
loc.ww2_germany.27.d: On April 1st, 1924 Hitler was sentenced to five years’ imprisonment at the Landsberg Prison. However he was later pardoned by the Bavarian Supreme Court and was released from jail on 20 December. 1924 against the state prosecutors objections. Including time on remand, Hitler served just over one year in prison.
loc.ww2_germany.28.d: Mein Kampf was authored by Adolf Hitler whilst serving his jail time and was published less than a year after his release on 18 July, 1925. It outlined Hitler’s political ideology and future plans for Germany and was edited by Hitler’s deputy Rudolf Hess. He began the book while imprisoned for what he considered to be ‘political crimes’ following his failed Putsch in Munich. However he received many visitors initially and he soon devoted himself entirely to the book. As he continued he realized that it would not have to be a two-volume book with the first volume scheduled for release in early 1925. The governor of Landsberg noted that at the time “He [Hitler] hopes the book will run into many editions, thus enabling him to fulfill his financial obligations and defray the expenses incurred at the time of his trial”.
loc.ww2_germany.28.a: I will make sure to read it!
loc.ww2_germany.29.t: Hitler Becomes Leader of Nazi Party
loc.ww2_germany.29.d: By 1921, Adolf Hitler was becoming highly effective at speaking in front of ever larger crowds and in February he spoke before a crowd of nearly six thousand in Munich. However as Hitler left Munich to visit far right nationalist groups in Berlin the headquarters of the Nazi Party the party faced an inner revolt. The party which was still run by an executive committee whose original members considered hitler to be highly overbearing and dictatorial wanted to weaken Hitler’s position forming an alliance with a group of socialists from Augsburg. Hitler in response rushed back to Munich and countered them by announcing his resignation from the Party on July 11, 1921. The party realized the loss of Hitler would effectively mean the end of the Nazi Party and Hitler seized the moment and announced he would return on the condition he was made chairman and given absolute power. Infuriated committee members held out at first but eventually backed down and during a vote hitler received 543 for and only 1 against. At the next gathering July 29, 1921 Hitler was introduced as Führer of the Nazi Party marking the first time the title was publicly used to address him.
