loc.ww2_germany.30.d: Matthias Erzberger was a German publicist and Politician, and as an authorized representative of the Reich government he personally signed the armistice between Germany and the allies. This act let him to become infamous amongst the political right and he was eventually murdered on 26 August, 1921, while out in on a walk in Bad Griesbach. The killing was masterminded by Manfred von Killinger, leading member of the Germanenorden, who recruited two members of the ultra-nationalist death squad Organisation Consul.
loc.ww2_germany.31.d: The Klaipeda Revolt took place between January 10-15, 1923 in the Klaipeda Region, otherwise known as Memelland. The region was detached from East Prussia in the Treaty of Versailles and became a mandate of the League of Nations and placed under provisional French administration until a more permanent solution could be worked out. Lithuania wanted to unite with the region due to the large Lithuanian-speaking minority and the major port in Memel was the only viable access to the Baltic Sea for Lithuania. As the Conference of Ambassadors instead favored leaving the region as a small free city like the Free City of Danzig the Lithuanians organized and staged a revolt as a consequence which ended to the region being given to Lithuania.
loc.ww2_germany.32.d:
Welcome to Endsieg: Ultimate Victory! This mod is currently being developed by one person so if you would like to help feel free to contact me! Thanks to some my friend Soldier who helped with some technology gfx and Dethorath who wrote a good amount of events for the interwars. 

 Kursk Scenario 

 You have chosen the Kursk Scenario! Your main objective will be to eliminate the Kursk Salient at all costs, however beware the Soviets have gotten information beforehand that we were to attack at Kursk and thus have heavily reinforced the area. It won't be an easy fight, and our fellow Italian friends who have been invaded by the Anglo-American forces in Sicily may be at risk of defecting and switching sides.
loc.ww2_germany.33.d: After the Gran Sasso Raid with the rescue of Mussolini, Hitler forced the reluctant Mussolini into setting up a new Fascist state in Northern Italy called the Italian Social Republic. It claimed Rome as its capital but the de facto capital became the small town of Salo between Milan and Venice. The Italian Social Republic is little more than a puppet state dependent entirely upon Germany, anyone can see that now.
loc.ww2_germany.34.d: Following the ousting of Mussolini and his capture along with the new government headed by King Victor Emanuele III and Pietro Badoglio, the thought of Italy switching sides is not too far off from fiction, it should be quite imminent following this series of events seeing the will of the Italian's to fight on drop dramatically. We must send a considerable amount of troops to Italy to prepare for their defection and to seize control before the Allies can.
loc.ww2_germany.34.a: We must seize control of Italy!
loc.ww2_germany.35.t: France Surrenders! Armistice of Marne Signed!
loc.ww2_germany.35.d: With our successful Spring Offensive and the subsequent capture of Paris, the Third French Republic has officially agreed to an armistice which has been signed at Marne today ending the war between our two countries. France has agreed to demobilize its military and expell British forces from the mainland as soon as possible with a treating to be soon undergoing by our fellow politicians. \n\n With the French out of the war the British, Italians, and Americans shall follow suit with negotiations on an armistice soon.
loc.ww2_germany.36.d: After Hitler had found out about the discussions Miklos Horthy was having with the allies regarding an armistice, the German Führer, feeling betrayed by the Hungarians, ordered German troops to implement Operation Margarethe to capture critical Hungarian Fascilities on March 12, 1944. Hitler had invited Horthy to the palace of Klessheim in Austria and while they conducted their negotiations German forces quietly slipped into Hungary with the meeting being a mere ruse to keep Horthy out of the country and leave the army without orders.
loc.ww2_germany.37.d: East Prussia has fallen to the rapidly advancing Red Army, our civilians and soldiers alike are frantically trying to escape their advance boarding refugee ships attempting to escape some of which were sunk with the total number of civilians killed estimated to be around 300,000.
loc.ww2_germany.38.d: Today while the Führer was inside his 'Wolf's Lair' field headquarters in East Prussia there was an attempt on his life with the apparent purpose of killing our beloved Führer to seize political control of Germany and its armed forces to make peace with the western Allies as soon as possible. We rounded up as many conspirators as possible and they shall be severely punished for this in retaliation!
loc.ww2_germany.39.d: The Führer with the rapidly advancing Red Army approaching his Führerbunker street by street has valiantly fought on until the last moment and has decided to kill himself to spare the lives of the German people by relieving them of their oaths. It is without a doubt his death is not but of cowardice but of bravery, he now rests with the millions of other Volk who have risked and died for the Reich.
loc.ww2_germany.3901.t: Jodel and Keitl Surrender All German Forces
loc.ww2_germany.3901.d: Today the definitive text for the German surrender of all forces was signed in Karlshorst, Berlin, the representatives of three armeds ervices of the Oberkommando der Wehrmacht (OKW) and the Allied Expeditionary Force together with the Supreme High Command of the Red Army, with further French and U.S. representatives signing as witnesses. The first instrument of surrender was signed at Reis by Alfred Jodl who had unfortunately failed to negotiate better terms of surrender. However a few hours later the Soviet Union  called for a unique surrender in Berlin were this 'German agression' has first sprung from also making a point the surrender at Reims did not explicitly require German soldiers to law down their arms and give themselves up. Eisenhower then agreed and the definitive act of unconditional surrender for the German military was signed in berlin by Field-Marshal Wilhelm Keitl.
loc.ww2_germany.40.t: Turkey Ends Diplomatic Relations With Us!
loc.ww2_germany.40.d: During WWII Turkey maintained diplomatic relations with Germany until August 1944. In 1941 Germany and Turkey signed the German-Turkish Non-Agression pact on June 18 which was soon followed by the "Clodius Agreement" in which Turkey would export 45,000 tons of chromite ore to Germany and 90,000 tons of mineral, to counter this the U.S. and U.K would try to buy out the Turkish chromite ore before Germany could even if they did not need any. When the Red Army entered Bulgaria in August of 1944 however which cut overland contact between Turkey and the Axis Powers, Turkey decided to sever diplomatic and commercial relations with Germany.
loc.ww2_germany.40.a: We are being buried alive by the world...
loc.ww2_germany.41.d: In Warsaw the Polish Resistance Home Army has risen up and has taken momentary control of the city and has rounded up our troops. This uprising most likely has taken place due to the rapidly advancing Red Army which is currently approahcing the suburbs of the city, however they have no outside support so it will not be hard to crush them.
loc.ww2_germany.41.a: We shall smash Warsaw to pieces for this!
loc.ww2_germany.43.d: Erin Rommel who had been wrongly accused, innocently mixed up in the July 20th plot was sentenced to death via execution, however Hitler knew that doing such would mean branding Rommel a traitor and damaging morale on the home front giving Rommel a chance to take his own life. On October 14th 1944 he took a cyanide pill and was pronounced dead, witnesses were struck by the smile of deep contempt on Rommels face post-death, never seen in his own lifetime. His wife had thought it was for Hitler.
loc.ww2_germany.44.d: The Führer has recently received word that Miklos Horthy, the leader of Hungary, has been secretely negotiating his country's surrender to the advancing Red Army. As of this moment he has sent Otto Skorzeny to deal with the situation along with other special forces. The Führer worried that this surrender will expose Germany's southern flank greately where Romania has already joined against the Reich and cut off many of our troops.
loc.ww2_germany.45.d: Field Marshal Gunther von Kluge has been found dead today, he has killed himself with a cyanide pill after being recalled by the Führer to Berlin following the failure of the monstrous assasination attempt whom Kluge had a minor role, but significant in his traitorous betrayal of the Reich and its people.
loc.ww2_germany.46.d:
Welcome to Endsieg: Ultimate Victory! This mod is currently being developed by one person so if you would like to help feel free to contact me! Thanks to some my friend Soldier who helped with some technology gfx and Dethorath who wrote a good amount of events for the interwars. 

 Battle of Bulge/Endsieg Scenario 

 Germany is in a bad position right now, VERY VERY BAD, with the allies advancing from three sides, in Italy, East, and the West there is little hope for success , the Reich still possesses great amount of power over the territory it still controls and the Volksdeutsch are willing to fight one to the last man.
loc.ww2_germany.47.d: The city of Konigsberg has reluctactly fallen into enemy hands, we must get it back at all costs!
loc.ww2_germany.48.d: The city of Danzig has reluctactly fallen into enemy hands, we must get it back at all costs!
loc.ww2_germany.49.d: The city of Prague has reluctactly fallen into enemy hands, we must get it back at all costs!
loc.ww2_germany.50.d: The capital of our ally Croatia, Zagreb has reluctactly fallen into enemy hands, we must get it back at all costs!
loc.ww2_germany.51.d: The city of Breslau has reluctactly fallen into enemy hands, we must get it back at all costs!
loc.ww2_germany.52.d: With the fighting going on street by street, house by house, to the last man or woman, the capital of the Reich, Berlin itself has finally fallen into enemy hands reluctactly after some of the fierciest fighting seen so far. But with Berlin or not, the war shall go on!
loc.ww2_germany.53.d: The capital of our ally Hungary, Budapest, has reluctactly fallen into enemy hands, we must get it back at all costs!

loc.ww2_germany.57.d: On 8 August 1944, Anglo-Canadian forces launched Operation Totalize. Under the cover of darkness, British and Canadian tanks accompanied by soldiers seized tactically important high ground near the town of Saint-Aignan-de-Cramesnil. Here they paused waiting for an aerial bombardment that would signal the next phase of the attack. unaware of the reason the Allied forces had halted, Kurt Meyer, of the 12th SS Hitlerjugend Division ordered elements of his command to counterattack and recapture the high ground. \n\n Panzer Ace Michael Wittmann, also known as the 'Black Baron' who had 135 confirmed tank kills, would lead a group of seven Tiger tanks supported by additional tanks and infantry. His group of tigers crossing an open terrain towards the high ground was ambushed by tanks from A Squadron 1st Northamptonshire Yeomanry, A Squadron Sherbrooke Fusilier Regiment, and B Squadron 144th Regiment Royal Armoured Corps. During the ambush, anti-tank shells - fired from either the British or Canadian tanks managed to penetrate the upper hull of Wittmann's tank igniting the ammunition. The resulting fire engulfed the tank and blew off the turret. The crew of the destroyed tank were then buried in an unmarked grave.
loc.ww2_germany.58.d: Michael Wittmann, know otherwise as the 'Black Baron' has come back from another battle emerging from his Tiger tank once again victorious! His legend envokes fear in the enemy more than any other and  he is a well known hero of the Reich and its people whom need a hero at this moment now more than any other when times are dark and the future gloomy...

loc.ww2_germany.71.d: The Führer has delivered a New Year's Day address to all the fellow Volksdeutsch today offering no information on the battlefield situation or any hint that the war was nearing its end with only a declaration that the war would still continue until victory has been achieved.
loc.ww2_germany.72.t: Führer's Last Meeting at Western Front
loc.ww2_germany.72.d: The Führer has today held a last meeting with Rundstedt and Walter Model at the Alderhorst, giving them strict instructions to hold the Western Allies at bay for as long as possible so that the Reich can focus its attention at defeating the bolshevik beast to the east. \n\n After this the Führer boarded a train, never to visit the Western Front again....
loc.ww2_germany.72.a: We must hold them back for as long as possible
loc.ww2_germany.73.t: Adolf Hitlers new residence in the Führerbunker
loc.ww2_germany.73.d: The Führer has recently returned to Berlin and taken up new residence in the Führerbunker where he will spend most of his time planning new strategies to win the war for the Reich.
loc.ww2_germany.74.d: The Volkssturm has been created today in order to show the rest of the world that the Reich and its people, the Volksdeutsch, shall not give up in this struggle for victory! Dr. Goebbels has delivered a speech in Berlin today to Volkssturm recruits saying "Men of Berlin's Volkssturm, you have just sworn as men of the Volkssturm, the oath to the Führer, to the freedom of the Reich and to the future of our people to prove to your people and the world that along the front line and at home Germany has millions of men at her disposal who are determined to fight and who have unshakeable will, never to surrender at the sight of the enemy and never to capitulate." \n\n It is made up of males between ages of 16 and 60 not already serving in the military and with this the reich has finally completed the final component of total war.
loc.ww2_germany.74.a: We shall overcome military strength through force of will!
loc.ww2_germany.75.d: The Führer has today made a rare public appearance, perhaps even his last in a while before victory is won, and has awarded several members of the Hitler Youth personally. These boys aged 10-16 are the utmost example for everyone in the Reich willing to sacrafice their lives for the defense of Germany at all costs.
loc.ww2_germany.76.d: The Battle of the Bulge, otherwise known as Operation Watch on the Rhine began on December 16, 1944, and was the last major German offensive campaign in the western theater for the rest of the war. It was launched through the densley forested Ardennes region of Wallonia in Belgium, France, and Luxembourg. Accompanied with dense fog which halted Allied air activity and the Allied forces being caught off guard the Germans made a significant push which was eventually however halted andseverely depleted Germany's remaining military strength. The operation was intende to stop the Allied use of the port of Antwerp and to split the allied lines to allow German forces toencircle and destroy four Allied armies and force the Western Allies to the peace table.

loc.ww2_germany.114.d: With Berlin about the be captured the Führer has said his farewells fighting on with the volksdeutsch until the end when German fighter ace Hannah Rietsch, the only woman in the Reich to win the Iron Cross first class flew the Führer to safety where the fight will continue until victory!
loc.ww2_germany.115.d: But even now Hitler still has one guardian angel, fighter pilot Hannah Rietsch, the only female ace pilot in to win the Iron Cross First Class, she is utterly devoted to the Führer. She has piloted a light aircraft into the heart of the embattled Berlin landing in the Tiergarten near the Bradenburg Gate where she has made a perilous journey to Hitler's Bunker with General Ritter von Greim. \n\n Hannah Reitsch is Hitler's last chance to escape, but he will not leave, he chooses to meet his ultimate destiny in Berlin...
loc.ww2_germany.116.d:
Welcome to Endsieg: Ultimate Victory! This mod is currently being developed by one person so if you would like to help feel free to contact me! Thanks to some my friend Soldier who helped with some technology gfx and Dethorath who wrote a good amount of events for the interwars. 

 Battle of Bulge/Endsieg Scenario 

 Germany is in a bad position right now, VERY VERY BAD, with the allies advancing from three sides, in Italy, East, and the West there is little hope for success , the Reich still possesses great amount of power over the territory it still controls and the Volksdeutsch are willing to fight one to the last man.
loc.ww2_germany.117.d: Kurt Knispel, a Sudeten German, and our best tank ace wtih 168 confirmed tank kills has been killed today near Urbau, Czechoslovakia. Undoubtedly he has gone with honor fighting the Bolsheviks to our last days...
loc.ww2_germany.118.d:
Kurt Knispal was a Sudeten German and is the most successful fighter in armored warfare with 168 (possibly as high as 195) confirmed tank kills, however he is very rarely heard of, why? 

 Unlike Michael Wittmann who is perhaps the most famous tank ace then and now, Kurt Knispel on the other hand is relatively unknown despite his achievments. During his time serving in the armoured forces he fought in virtually every type of tank and served as a gunner, loader, and commander eventually receiving the Iron Cross First Class and Tank Assault Badge in Gold. 

 Knispel however was never rapidly promoted or given the Knights Cross even though reccomended several times for it due to his rebellious attitude and getting into fights with his superiors as well as not being perfect "propaganda" material due to his neutrality towards the ideas of national socialism. Kurt Knispel never sought fame or recognition, he was just a very skilled tank commander, loader, gunner and described by his fellow comrades as friendly and very helpful and known for giving his comrades tank kills.
loc.ww2_germany.118.a: One of the best soldiers and one of the most least known
loc.ww2_germany.119.d: With the fall of France and the expulsion of British forces from mainland Europe the United Kingdom has bitterly agreed to an Armistice between our two nations which has been signed today at Calais. While the process of drawing up a final treaty shall start soon between our nations it is unlikely that we will be able to make any drastic decisions as the United Kingdom still has the worlds largest fleet and the best protection from invasion in the form of an island.
loc.ww2_germany.120.d: The Americans who have just last year joined the war taking a major part only early this year have agreed to an Armistice at Calais with the British following the surrender of France, the peace which stands between our two nations is and will be a white peace with the Americans most likely returning back to their isolationist stature.
loc.ww2_germany.121.d: With France gone and the United Kingdom with the Americans shortly following suite the Italians have reluctantly agreed to an Armistice near Vittorio Veneto along with pressure of the people to whom the unpopularity of the war has grown very much over these past few years, the process of drawing up a final treaty shall begin soon.
loc.ww2_germany.122.d: The Kingdom of Greece has agreed to an armistice which was signed today at Vardar, Macedonia, ceasing all hostilities in the Balkan region between Greece and the Central Powers. The Greeks agreed to terms of exchange of prisoners, cessation of hostilities, promise of reparations, surrender of the Greek Naval forces to the Ottoman Turks, and the withdrawal of all Greek forces to behind their own borders, Albania has been reinstated as a sovereign nation with Austro-Hungarian and Greek forces leaving the territory and William of House Wied retaking power, and finally Western Thrace has also been temporarily ceded back to Greece by Bulgaria and negotiations for a final treaty will commence in the coming months.
loc.ww2_germany.123.t: Treaty of Antwerp Talks Begin, Belgian Question
loc.ww2_germany.123.d:
Today talks with Britain have begun over the future of Belgium 

 Format your own peace treaty! Each option has its ups and downs listed 

 Annexing Belgium would severely limit our negotiating power with Britain later on as the British would view our annexation of Antwerp as a direct threat due to its position of being a buffer state to Britain and the port of Antwerp being in our hands would be seen as a threat to their position. 

 Puppeting Belgium would likewise with annexing it be viewed very similarly. 

 Taking everything behind the Meuse leaving the rest of Belgium independent would be the most ideal for the British. 

 Likewise with taking Liege and the land behind the Meuse, we can also take the Belgian Congo 

 Splitting Belgium into two separate states of Wallonia and Flanders, under which Wallonia will fall under our rule by de facto puppet we could have our own buffer state against the British aligned Flanders and France. In addition Belgian Congo will also fall under our control. However the British will not be as inclined to give up as many of their other possessions if we take such a more aggressive approach.
loc.ww2_germany.123.dd: Take land behind Meuse and Belgian Congo
loc.ww2_germany.123.e: Split Belgium and take the Belgian Congo
loc.ww2_germany.124.t: Belgian Question Answered Germany Says "Annex Belgium"
loc.ww2_germany.124.d: We have decided to annex the whole state of Belgium to insure our utmost security in Europe and get an upper hand over the British however this will come with very great repercussions and may be the only main topic of the treaty with little to none other territorial concessions.
loc.ww2_germany.125.t: Belgian Questioned Answered Germany Says “Puppet Belgium”
loc.ww2_germany.125.d: We have decided to Puppet the state of Belgium and install a pro-german regime, however whilst this is a better option than just annexing the whole state of Belgium it is still very threatening if not as equally as annexing the whole country and we will have have very little other territorial concessions to demand elsewhere from the United Kingdom following this decision.
loc.ww2_germany.126.t: Belgian Questioned Answered, Germany Says “Take land behind Meuse, Leave Belgium Independent”
loc.ww2_germany.126.d: We have decided to take the land behind the Meuse River and leave the rest of Belgium independent and neutral as it had been pre-war. This will go very well with the British and we will have further flexibility in negotiations to demand concessions elsewhere.
loc.ww2_germany.127.t: Belgian Questioned Answered, Germany Says “Take land behind Meuse and Belgian Congo”
loc.ww2_germany.127.d: We have decided to lake all the land behind the Meuse river as well as taking their colony of the Belgian Congo. This may be viewed a little more aggressive and limit our territorial concessions but not by a great extent, we would still have relatively good flexibility in further negotiations with Britain.
loc.ww2_germany.128.t: Belgian Questioned Answered, Germany Says “Split Belgium Into Two States, take Congo”
loc.ww2_germany.128.d: We have decided to split Belgium into two separate states, Wallonia and Flanders, one of which (Wallonia) will become our puppet and Flanders will be an independent state north in which we will still respect British defense interests in keeping Belgian ports out of our hands. In addition with this deal Congo will fall into our hands and it will be viewed are a mildly aggressive act however we would still have “ok” flexibility in negotiations, just no ridiculous demands.
loc.ww2_germany.129.t: Treaty of Ghent, the Suez Question
loc.ww2_germany.129.d:
By taking Suez ourselves it would severely undermine British power projection in the mediterranean and we would most likely not be able to get away with any more serious demands, however on the flip side we would have a lot of power controlling the canal 

 Leaving Suez we will be able to get away with more demands later on as the discussion progresses 

 Giving Suez to the Turks would satisfy the Ottoman Empire and make the British more willing to cede the territory however it will be up to the Turks as to who ‘owns’ it. Though they are technically our puppet, if a change in leadership changes we could be threatened. 

 Forming an independent Egypt would severely limit our further limits of demands from the British however this would remove all British power projection in the mediterranean and guarantee the Egyptian Sultanate as a de facto puppet of the Empire. 

 Giving Egypt to the Turks would also limit our demands later on and if our alliance with the Turks splits later on we won't have any of these benefits 

 Incorporating Egypt as our colony would be perhaps the most drastic decision drawing up a lot of infamy and severely limiting further negotiations.
loc.ww2_germany.130.t: Belgian Question Answered: Germany Says Leave Belgium Independent, No Concessions
loc.ww2_germany.130.d: We have decided to leave Belgium in its pre-war state, this will be the best option for the British and we will surely have much more to get away with later on as the treaty will begin to progress.
loc.ww2_germany.131.t: Suez Question Answered "Germany Says, We Will Take Suez"
loc.ww2_germany.131.d: We have decided to take the Suez whilst letting the British keep the rest of their Egyptian colony, this will greatly boost our naval power in the seas but we must keep our new holding secure as the threat of British invasion is never too far off with them likely being vengeful and next door.
loc.ww2_germany.131.b: I want to choose another option
loc.ww2_germany.132.t: Suez Question Answered, Germany says “Give Suez to the Turks”
loc.ww2_germany.132.d: We have decided to not take the Suez canal for ourselves but give it to our allies the Ottoman Empire, this would be seen as a more neutral approach for the British however whilst the Ottoman Turks are heavily under our influence, if we were to fall out the fate of Suez might shift hands.
loc.ww2_germany.132.b: I want to choose another option
loc.ww2_germany.133.t: Suez Question Answered, Germany says “Form Independent Egypt”
loc.ww2_germany.133.d: We have decided not only to take the Suez canal but to force the English to forfeit their whole Egyptian colony in the hopes to secure the region in general, it will now be under our influence as a puppet and we should fear no invasion from a neighboring enemy colony. However this will greatly reduce how much more after this we can ask for.
loc.ww2_germany.133.b: I want to choose another option
loc.ww2_germany.134.t: Suez Question Answered, Germany says ‘Transfer Egypt to Turks”
loc.ww2_germany.134.d: We have decided seeing Turkish interests in the region to transfer the Egyptian colony to Turkish hands, this would be seen as a more neutral approach from the British point of view as the colony would not be completely under our control, just under our influence. Though this means any falling out with the Turks could mean a shift of Egypt into enemy hands.
loc.ww2_germany.134.b: I want to choose another option
loc.ww2_germany.135.t: Suez Question Answered, Germany says “Incorporate Egypt into the Reich”
loc.ww2_germany.135.d: We have decided to shift the Egyptian colony directly from under British to our total and absolute control, however this would be viewed as a very aggressive act by nature and will greatly reduce what else we can ask for.
loc.ww2_germany.135.b: I want to choose another option
loc.ww2_germany.136.t: Suez Question Answered, Germany says "Leave Suez"
loc.ww2_germany.136.d: We have decided to leave the Suez Canal and Egypt fully under the control of the British in order to seek more concessions elsewhere.
loc.ww2_germany.136.b: I want to choose another option
loc.ww2_germany.137.t: Treaty of Ghent, the Suez Question
loc.ww2_germany.137.d: As we have decided to fully Annex the country of Belgium we have the one small choice of simply giving Suez to the Turks.
loc.ww2_germany.138.t: Treaty of Ghent, the Suez Question
loc.ww2_germany.138.d:
By taking Suez ourselves it would severely undermine British power projection in the mediterranean and we would most likely not be able to get away with any more serious demands, however on the flip side we would be given that power projection. 

 Giving Suez to the Turks would satisfy the Ottoman Empire and make the British more willing to cede the territory however it will be up to the Turks as to who ‘owns’ it. Though they are technically our puppet, if a change in leadership changes we could be threatened. 

 Leaving Suez we will be able to get away with more demands later on as the discussion progresses.

loc.ww2_germany.242.d: The Treaty of Frankfurt, signed 28 June, 1919, exactly five years after the unfortunate death of Archduke Franz Ferdinand officially ended the state of war between us and France. Within the Treaty of Frankfurt France was to cede to territories of Nancy and a small part of Champagne in mainland europe, however elsewhere Germany seized swathes of French colonial territory mostly in Mittelafrika to achieve their Mittelafrika Plan, otherwise Morocco had also been seized. In whole, the treaty forced France to disarm, make various territorial concesiions to Germany, as well pay reparations assessed at around 100 billion marks. Many French have viewed this as knife twist in the wound of the 1871 French defeat in the Franco-Prussian war.
loc.ww2_germany.243.d: The Treaty of Ghent, signed 15 July, 1919, by the Central Powers and one side with Britain and Belgium on the other, the treaty proved a much different treaty, unlike the likes of France which had faced total capitulation being on the same landmass as Germany, Britain still had the largest navy in the world, one which Germany could not beat, at least not now...none-the-less Britain agreed to cede territory only on terms that mainland Belgium remain free and independent from any German influence leading Germany to take minor territorial concessions in Europe and taking all of the Belgiun Congo, in Africa Germany seized the Suez at most as the British still held a lot of leverage over the Germans. In return for the German seizure of the Suez the British did not get much in terms of reparations unlike their French counterpart with British seal of approval on Germany expanding her fleet.
loc.ww2_germany.244.d: The Treaty of Constantinople was signed on 25 August, 1919, by the Central Powers on one side and Greece on the other, because Greece had joined the war so late into the war the lashback was not as harsh as on France or Britain even, minor concessions like the whole of Thrace to Bulgaria and some of the Aegian islands to the Ottoman Turks were made along with Alexander I beign deposed from power being replaced by his formerly deposed father, Constantine I who had been a sympathizer of the German Empire.
loc.ww2_germany.245.d: The Treaty of Sarajevo signed on 10 September, 1919, by the Central Powers on one side and Serbia and Montenegro on the other, due to the fact that Serbia and Montenegro had capitulated and by de-facto ceased to exist 3 years prior, the Treaty of Sarajevo was very harsh with Serbia being reduced to a small rump state to be largely under the control of the Austro-Hungarian military for 'security reasons', Montenegro as well had become a de-facto permanent Austro-Hungarian puppet. Bulgaria got most of Serbian Macedonia which they had already been in control of for half of the war.
loc.ww2_germany.245.a: Thats what happens when you kill the Archduke!
loc.ww2_germany.246.d: The Treaty of Innsbruck signed on August 5th, 1919, by the Central Powers on one side and the Kingdom of Italy on the other, in this peace negotiations there was a definate strong hate unpleasantness between both sides with Italy being a traitor to the Triple Alliance Pact made, however the treaty was not quite harsh in terms of land seizure with Austria-Hungary annexing the state of Veneto, the Kingdom of Italy was then forced to grant Germany a 'most-favoured nation' in terms of trade and navigation wih a sum of 30 billion marks to be payed in terms of reparations.
loc.ww2_germany.247.d: In terms of Corsica we could be nice and try to ease Italy into accepting German economic and political dominance in Europe by offering them some sweets to counter the sour in the form of Corsica from France, however we could always just let the French keep it.
loc.ww2_germany.248.d: Kuwait in southmost Iraq could be used as a strategic port by us however, it would likely not be as important now with us owning most of Middle Africa, though it wouldn't hurt, on the other hand we could always be fair and just and give it back to the Ottoman Empire whom would surely appreciate the return of this territory from British Imperialism.
loc.ww2_germany.249.d: The Japanese much like the British have been kept safe from a largely humilating and debilitating peace treaty by their island status, navy, and relative distance from Germany along with them controlling all of our Asian colonies. However, whilst we could just end our conflict with Japan in ceding our Asian colonies reluctantly with a sour attitude we could always play nice with the Japanese and offer them French Indochina as well, not only would this cement good relations between our two nations and show that Germany is not an enemy of Japan but the Japanese likely will in in a decade or two aspire to controll British colonies in the Pacific, combined with both of our Naval power we could put that Empire to rest should it come to it.
loc.ww2_germany.250.d: As the war in Europe has officially come to a close it is time we shift our gaze towards the east for one last time and put down the barbaric Bolsheviks whilst they are still in the cradle, if we do not act fast now and get rid of them we may face serious consequences later on with threat of the 'red plague' spreading to Germany itself. \n\n We have seen what they are capable of, the red beast shows no mercy or care for human life, it is our job to take them out of this world as we have taken them into it.
loc.ww2_germany.250.b: I am a filthy bolshevik wanker and like communism
loc.ww2_germany.251.d: With the capture of Moscow by German troops the Bolshevik government has officially collapsed under pressure from with thrust eastward and pressure from White Russian forces. Temporarily Alexander Kolchak, deemed Supreme Ruler of Russia, will be in charge of managing the country in its interim state. Many of our politicians have questioned this move as Kolchak might not want to let go of his grip over the vastness of russia. \n\n However the fate and future of Russia will hang in our hands in how we handle and decide who and which government to install.
loc.ww2_germany.252.d: The Treaty of Mocsow has been signed by the Russian Interrim government today with minor changes being made such as the establishment of the Kuban People's Republic and the Mountainous Republic.
loc.ww2_germany.253.d: If we wish to be on good terms and possibly in the future ally the Japanese in face of British colonialism and sea power we could offer the territory of Vladivostok which has been eyed by the Japenese.
loc.ww2_germany.254.d:
With the Treaty of Moscow settled the final question to be resolved is who will rule Russia? 

 We could choose Alexander Kerensky to once again take office and become president of a democratic Russian Republic, it would suit us with Russia most likely remaining a rump state with a very slow recovery from the injuries of the Great and Civil Wars. 

 We could always keep Kolchak in power, however unlike the latter there could be many possibilities and Kolchaks will be unpredictable, with many different routes for Russia being possibly good or bad for us... 

 Then again we could always reinstate the Monarchy but it would be a bad idea with the legitimacy of the monarchist government going down the drain ever since Nicholas II's horrific handling of the First World War, it will most likely be wiped out by an impending coup which could leave practically anyone in power. 

 Finally we could always install a son of the Kaiser on the throne, like the latter however the monarchy could be wiped out by a coup, perhaps even faster as the Russian people would most likely not tolerate a foreign ruler that has formally been at war with them. This leaves the same possibility of practically anyone coming to power in Russia once a coup occurs. 

 Remember...Murphy's Law, anything that can go wrong will go wrong.
loc.ww2_germany.255.d: Following the end of the First World War earlier plans proposed by German officials to annex a Border Strip from the Kingdom of Poland, comprised of up to 30,000 km^2, roughly the size of Belgium, has finally been taken into action. It is expected that with the annexation of this territory the roughly three million polish inhabitants will soon be removed by force to mak room for German settlers seperating the Polish inhabitants of Prussian-held Greater Poland from those in Congress Poland.
loc.ww2_germany.256.d: The Egyptian Revolution of 1919 has taken off across our protectorate of Anglo-Egyptian Sudan. Many Egyptians and Sudanese in the wake of our de-facto defeat in the First World War and its leader Saad Zagloul have taken up arms against the British Empire and demanded that Egyptian independence be recognised as well as Egyptian sovereignty over Sudan. However it is unlikely the government will come to terms with them without a fight...
loc.ww2_germany.257.d: With an Egyptian independence moving kicking off in Anglo-Egyptian Sudan we could very well benefit by supplying the Egyptians in order to secure their independence from the United Kingdom, that way we will not longer have to worry as much about the Suez Canal being threatened by the British next door...
loc.ww2_germany.258.d: Today, Adolf Hitler as decreed that the Hitlerjugend will take a bigger role in the army, to the joy of our people. They are as fierce as they are efficient, and they will do a good job of reinforcing our front line.
loc.WW2_italy.7.d: After the successful invasion of Sicily and the ousting of Benito Mussolini with the new government headed by Pietro Badoglio and Vitorio Emmanuel taking over, following secret negotiations with the allies to a secret armistice was signed on 3 September in Sicily and is now being officially announced. It is only a matter of time before the Italians who have publicly declared they would keep fighting alongside the Germans come into conflict with the Axis. But due to the time it has taken for the new Italian government to negotiate the armistice it should be assumed the Germans may be prepared to for this widespread defection that shall take place soon.
loc.WW2_italy.7.a: It is time to move against Germany!
loc.WW2_italy.7.b: I am a player and I don't feel like capitulating
loc.WW2_italy.8.d: On 25 July, 1943, Benito Mussolini has been voted out of power by his own Grand Council and arrested upon leaving a meeting with King Vittorio Emanuele who has told the Il Duce that the war is lost and has removed him as prime minister. The Il Duce has been reported to have barely reacted and have been groggy and unshaven objecting no nothing he is now to be moved to a secret area where he will be held prisoner until wars end
loc.generic.20.d: Our country now has an industry to compare to those of the Europeans, and we can now afford to invite scientists for research!
loc.germany.258.d: Hitlers speeches and show of power has made our youth proud. They are willing to jump into the fray without fear of dying, and fight as well as a filthy communist. The Hitler Youth is being used to fill our ranks, as our army is getting more and more depleted.
loc.germany.258.a: They know very well what the alternative is.
loc.ww2_germany.800.d: Earlier today the final trenches have been dug and manned in Berlin. The capital of the Thousand year reich must not fall no matter the cost!

loc.soviet_reconquer_category_desc: The collapse of German authority in the east opens the former imperial borderlands to the Red Army. The new republics are arming to resist us.
loc.invade_belarus_desc: German troops are withdrawing from Belarus. We can move west before another government consolidates control of the former imperial provinces.
loc.invade_ukraine_desc: The German withdrawal has left Ukraine contested. The Red Army can support the local soviets and challenge the Ukrainian government.
loc.invade_estonia_desc: Estonia has declared independence. Our western offensive can carry the Red Army toward Tallinn, though the Estonians are preparing to defend their republic.
loc.invade_latvia_desc: As the German army leaves Latvia, our forces can cross the frontier and seek to establish Soviet authority in Riga.
loc.invade_lithuania_desc: The Lithuanian republic is consolidating its independence. Our army can enter the borderlands and contest its hold on the former imperial territory.
loc.invade_poland_desc: The frontier between Poland and Soviet Russia is unsettled. An advance west risks a long war with a state determined to defend its independence.
loc.market_liberal_on_the_rise_desc: Vocal political elements have begun to speak up in favor of market liberal values, finding support with an increasing number of the population. The nation's path to market liberalism lies open, merely awaiting the choice of peaceful or violent transition.
loc.prepare_for_market_liberal_civil_war_des: We have no time to wait for the slow changes in the minds of the people. For their own sake, we must force the matter swiftly, even if some may lose their lives in the process. Unlike a peaceful referendum, a civil war will cause tremendous devastation to our armed forces and the country's industry and infrastructure, but it is also quicker, and ensures we will be able to force our will through more forcefully afterwards.
loc.expand_civil_market_liberal_support_desc: We must ensure the continuing spread of support for our cause among the people, and encourage them to publically challenge the authority of the present government. loc.send_lenin_decision_desc: We could send Lenin over to Russia, but this could cause revolutions in Russia that may in turn backfire on us.\n\n§RSending Lenin via decision or focus is needed to fire Brest-Litovsk!§!
loc.puppet_poland_decision: Create the Regency Kingdom of Poland
loc.puppet_poland_decision_desc: We should consolidate our control over the Polish territories by creating a state.
loc.request_polish_divisions_desc: We should ask for manpower from Poland, now that we have \"liberated\" the Poles.
loc.russian_army_reform_desc: This decision, §B after one month of being fired §!, will halve the debuff from the national spirit \"Poor Military Leadership\"
loc.russian_army_more_reform_desc: This decision will §B halve the debuff yet again after one month! §!
loc.russian_army_final_reform_desc: §G This decision will remove the \"Poor Military Leadership\" debuff after a month! §!
loc.german_warplan_selection_schlieffen_desc: The Schlieffen plan was the German warplan to invade Belgium.
loc.german_warplan_selection_kronprinz_desc: This alternate-history warplan invades §Rneither Belgium or Switzerland§, in favor of invading only France and Russia. \n\n§GThis should delay the UK's entry to the war, until they decide to via focus.§!
loc.german_warplan_selection_rupprecht_desc: This alternate-history plan invades Switzerland, and is only reccomended if you want a challenge as Germany, or if France has built extensive fortifications on the Belgian border.
loc.form_saudi_arabia_category_desc: The region of Saudi Arabia has long been home to our enemies. It is time we show them our force and take control of our rightful homeland.
loc.form_transcaucasia_category_desc: For multiple ages, the people of the Caucasus have had to suffer under oppressing regime. It is time to finally unite the region under one banner, and remove outside influences.
loc.ger_forify_berlin_desc: The Soviets are at the gates of the capital of our great reich. We must make them bleed before it. Building a series of trenches in Berlin will hopefully hold the savage soviets back!
loc.ww1_home_front_category_desc: The endurance of the civilian population is as important to victory as the strength of the armies at the front.
loc.ww1_strengthen_civilian_confidence_desc: Fund public relief and reassure the population that the government can endure the hardships of war.
loc.ww1_mobilize_national_spirit_desc: Organize rallies and patriotic appeals to sustain public support for the war effort.
loc.ww1_mittelafrika_category_desc: Establish Mittelafrika and support its administration against resistance in the colonies.
loc.ww1_establish_mittelafrika_desc: Over 180 days, place all German-owned African territories, including Madagascar, under a unified German puppet administration led by Wilhelm Solf.
loc.ww1_establish_mittelafrika_effect_tt: All German-owned African states, including Madagascar, become part of Mittelafrika, a German puppet led by Wilhelm Solf. Germany relinquishes its claims to those states.
loc.ww1_expand_mittelafrika_constabulary_des: After 180 days, reduce resistance by 2 in one random non-core state of Mittelafrika with active resistance.
loc.ww1_mittelafrika_local_councils_desc: After 180 days, one random non-core state of Mittelafrika below 70 compliance gains 3 compliance and loses up to 2 resistance.
loc.ww1_mittelafrika_factory_investment_desc: After 180 days, one random Mittelafrika state under its control gains one building slot and either one civilian or one military factory. The project can be repeated.
loc.ww1_mittelafrika_resource_survey_desc: After 180 days, one random Mittelafrika state under its control gains either two rubber or two steel resources. The survey can be repeated.
loc.ww1_german_east_asia_category_desc: Support German East Asia's administration and develop its industry and resources.
loc.ww1_expand_german_east_asia_constabulary: After 180 days, reduce resistance by 2 in one random non-core state of German East Asia with active resistance.
loc.ww1_german_east_asia_local_councils_desc: After 180 days, one random non-core state of German East Asia below 70 compliance gains 3 compliance and loses up to 2 resistance.
loc.ww1_german_east_asia_factory_investment_: After 180 days, one random German East Asia state under its control gains one building slot and either one civilian or one military factory. The project can be repeated.
loc.ww1_german_east_asia_resource_survey_des: After 180 days, one random German East Asia state under its control gains either two rubber or two steel resources. The survey can be repeated.
loc.ww1_postwar_settlement_category_desc: The Armistice has ended the fighting. The terms of the final peace must now be imposed.
loc.ww1_treaty_of_versailles_desc: Signed on 28 June 1919, the Treaty of Versailles formally ended the war between Germany and the Allied Powers. Its territorial, military and financial provisions remade Germany's eastern and northern borders. Formal ratification takes 180 days and must be completed before the 360-day deadline.
loc.ww1_establish_weimar_republic_desc: The German Republic must adopt a durable constitutional identity before it can accept the final peace settlement. This transition takes 30 days.
loc.ww1_treaty_of_versailles_weimar_prerequi: The Weimar Republic has been established
loc.ww1_peace_treaty_due_desc: The final peace settlement must be ratified within 360 days of the Armistice of Compiègne.
loc.ww2_soviet.18.d: External pressure from the Soviet Union for the end of the hostilities between us and the Chinese Red Army has led to people in our ranks taking matters into their own hands. Two generals have had [Root.GetLeader] arrested, attempting to force a truce between us and the communists to unite China against external threats. International pressure for a peaceful solution, along with the weakness of China divided in this era are factors in favor of establishing a united front. What course should we take?
loc.ww2_soviet.18.a: Contact the communist party for peace talks.
loc.ww2_soviet.19.d: Disagreements within the Nationalist ranks have led to a precarious situation. Their leader, [From.GetLeader] has been arrested in an effort to force our enemies to accept a truce with us to unite China against foreign enemies. Although we would like to see the Kuomintang leadership facing punishment for their crimes against us, this is a rare opportunity to cooperate and ensure that China does not fall in the hands of foreign imperialists.
loc.ww2_soviet.19.a: We accept a truce for now.
loc.ww2_soviet.19.b: The revolution cannot be set aside for this!
loc.ww2_soviet.20.d: Despite the kidnapping of [From.GetLeader], the Nationalists have refused to enter negotiations for a truce with the Communists. Sadly, the Chinese will remain in violent conflict with their own people, making them easy prey for their enemies.
loc.ww2_soviet.21.d: The negotiations in Xi'an have borne results. Both Nationalists and Communists have agreed to a truce, putting an at least temporary end to the hostilities and allowing the parties to cooperate against foreign threats.
loc.ww2_soviet.21.a: There is hope for China yet.
loc.ww2_soviet.22.d: Despite the best efforts of Kuomintang generals to achieve a truce with the Communist Party leaders, the communists refuse to make even a temporary peace as long as the leader of the Nationalists is alive. It appears that the hostilities will not end so easily.
loc.ww2_soviet.22.a: At this rate, China's enemies may divide and conquer.
loc.ww2_soviet.23.d: The Soviet Union has other threats to worry about and does not wish to further increase hostilities with our Empire. As a sign of desiring peace between our nations, they have ceded some territory to us, hoping that this will strengthen our diplomatic ties.
loc.ww2_soviet.23.a: Perhaps this can be a turning point.
loc.ww2_soviet.24.d: The persecution of enemies of the people, those who would reverse or subvert the revolution, has been ongoing policy since the Party came to power. The internal power struggles that followed have shifted our focus, and purging the Party ranks themselves has been given more emphasis since Trotsky's exile. Stalin has made himself an icon, but at the cost of making many real enemies and innumerable imaginary ones.\n\nHaving seen the worst of internal power struggles, the General Secretary is prone to act on the slightest suspicion. Being purged from the Party means imprisonment or death. Dark times lie ahead for those who show disloyalty - or just a bit too much loyalty to seem credible.
loc.ww2_soviet.24.a: Are Zinoviev and his ilk still in touch with Trotsky?
loc.ww2_soviet.25.t: Trial of the Anti-Soviet Trotskyist Center
loc.ww2_soviet.25.d: Despite Leon Trotsky being forced into exile, Joseph Stalin fears that he has secret supporters within the party. A series of rapid arrests and brutal interrogations have yielded confessions and testimonies conveniently pointing to some of Stalin's rivals. However, the more questions are asked and the deeper the secret police delves into letters and journals, the more people are implicated, if indirectly.\n\nParty members are beginning to believe that Stalin's absolute power and the death of his wife have isolated him to the point where he perceives anyone as a threat, but isn't that exactly what a traitor would say?
loc.ww2_soviet.25.a: Kalinin's wife is suspected. He cannot be trusted either.
loc.ww2_soviet.25.b: Khrushchev dabbled with Trotskyism in the past. He must go.
loc.ww2_soviet.25.c: Radek's confession points to several people within the party.
loc.ww2_soviet.25.e: Party members can be trusted. This paranoia must cease.
loc.ww2_soviet.26.d: The Red Army has always been home to subversive elements, ever since Trotsky himself was Commissar of War. Documents acquired by the NKVD have implicated several high-ranking officers as not only traitors, but spies. Mikhail Tukhachevsky is among the most prominent of the suspects, and one Stalin is keen to rid the army of. Meanwhile, the navy's frequent contact with foreigners has led to many of them being arrested as well.\n\nAlthough there are documents from our enemies proving their guilt, there is no telling if they fabricated them, or if they were given false information by those who wanted this purge in motion to begin with.
loc.ww2_soviet.26.a: Tukhachevsky must be tried in secret and executed immediately.
loc.ww2_soviet.26.b: Rokossovsky refuses to confess, but cannot be allowed to live.
loc.ww2_soviet.26.c: False documents and forced confessions are not proof.
loc.ww2_soviet.27_tt2: §RWill lead to a civil war in the future.§!
loc.ww2_soviet.27.d: After several rounds of arrests and trials, the Great Purge has weaved a narrative that led up to this trial. Among the accused are not only old leaders like Nikolai Bukharin, but a number of diplomats, politicians, military officials and even many high-ranking NKVD officers. The charges are also more extensive than previously, including decade-old plots to murder Soviet leaders and sell the Union to its enemies.\n\nThe fact that the NKVD themselves are now among the targets of the purge has in a sense brought the proceedings in full circle. Threats and beatings have led to many confessing to all charges, even the most outlandish ones. The leading defendants face execution.
loc.ww2_soviet.27.a: The navy and air force have been getting off easy so far.
loc.ww2_soviet.27.b: As we suspected, enemies are everywhere.
loc.ww2_soviet.27.c: This has gone too far. Soon we will have killed all of our own.
loc.ww2_soviet.28.d:
The world may never know if Stalin's paranoia was targeting the right people, or whether he made more enemies trying to exterminate every Trotskyist in the Party. What is known is that what he feared eventually came to pass. Today, Leon Trotsky reemerged as having returned from his exile, and with the support of several influential party members and NKVD officers, launched a coup overthrowing Stalin's rule.

The former General Secretary was attacked in his home with an ice axe, and was swiftly executed along with several of his supporters. Tearing down the cult of personality he built up will take time, but the people know now at least that he was not immortal.

 One of the few survivors who managed to escape was Ivan Konev. The fierce supporter of Stalin has managed to gather some support and declared war on the Trotsky government, in an attempt to take back power and 'fulfill the vision of Comrade Stalin'.
loc.ww2_soviet.28.a: Leaders come and go, but the people remain.
loc.ww2_soviet.29.t: France wants to join the Comintern.
loc.ww2_soviet.29.d: Our comrades in Parti Communiste Francais have made great progress. The nation of France is ready to join the Comintern.
loc.ww2_soviet.100.d: Due to the Soviet Union and ourselves being at war with a common enemy, they seem to have toned down support to our domestic communist parties.
loc.ww2_soviet.100.a: Glad to be rid of them!
loc.ww2_soviet.30.d: Romania cannot expect to withstand the might of the Red Army, if we send them a demand for our rightfully claimed land in Bessarabia they may just hand it over without a fight.
loc.ww2_soviet.30.b: No, we'll pay the iron price!
loc.ww2_soviet.31.d: Finland cannot expect to withstand the might of the Red Army, if we send them a demand for our rightfully claimed land in Karjala they may just hand it over without a fight.
loc.ww2_soviet.31.b: No, we'll pay the iron price!
loc.ww2_soviet.32.d: Estonia cannot expect to withstand the might of the Red Army, if we send them a demand for basing rights and control of their border security we can effectively annex them without fighting.
loc.ww2_soviet.32.b: No, we'll pay the iron price!
loc.ww2_soviet.33.d: Latvia cannot expect to withstand the might of the Red Army, if we send them a demand for basing rights and control of their border security we can effectively annex them without fighting.
loc.ww2_soviet.33.b: No, we'll pay the iron price!
loc.ww2_soviet.34.d: Lithuania cannot expect to withstand the might of the Red Army, if we send them a demand for basing rights and control of their border security we can effectively annex them without fighting.
loc.ww2_soviet.34.b: No, we'll pay the iron price!
loc.ww2_soviet.35.d: Recent political turmoil in [From.GetName] has left their government with a strong vision for the future that aligns with our own. They have seen the good a powerful Soviet Union can do for the world and are willing to give everything for the Motherland.
loc.ww2_soviet.35.b: The time is not right for such a move.
loc.ww2_soviet.36.d: Recent political turmoil in [From.GetName] has left their government with a strong vision for the future that aligns with our own plans. They seek our protection and offer their unconditional support. Officially they will continue as a nation of their own, but they will follow the Motherland in every move.
loc.ww2_soviet.36.a: Another tool to aid our progress.
loc.ww2_soviet.36.b: They will require too much protection.
loc.ww2_soviet.37.d: Our new officers are proving up to the task and are adapting to their new roles in the military high command. With a loyal officer corps in charge of our military [Root.GetLeader]'s purge seems to have some of the effect we hoped for. The Red Army is regaining its power and will soon be stronger than ever.
loc.ww2_soviet.46.d: Although we still have a lot of work left in rebuilding our military high command, the advancement of the [From.GetAdjective] army on our borders has sparked ingenuity and a patriotic will to fight within out new officer corps. We grow stronger with each blow we take as we prepare to rise up and strike back with all the might of the [Prev.GetName]. Every soldier is willing to throw down their lives and stand firm against our enemies. We expect this to greatly benefit the training and commitment of our new officers even after this war is won!
loc.ww2_soviet.46.a_tt: Adds §YGreat Patriotic War§! which counters some of the penalty from §YOfficers Purged§!
loc.ww2_soviet.48.d: Although countless people have been executed and imprisoned as traitors and counterrevolutionaries over the past years, leading positions have been largely safe. They have not been exempt from suspicion, however. With the creation of the Fourth International, Stalin appears posessed by the thought that those closest to him were never truly on his side. Those who try to gain his trust have further fueled this idea to cast themselves in a better light.\n\nThe current situation is one of exceptional irony: the distrust within the current administration has rendered it unsustainable, and a coup is now imminent. Some party members are arguing that reinviting Trotsky and turning the purges on the Stalinists could minimize the damage of the civil war that will ensue. Can this plan, which has been the General Secretary's greatest fear for years, truly be executed?
loc.ww2_soviet.48.a_tt: §YA massive civil war will break out soon§!
loc.ww2_soviet.48.b: Communism in one country has failed. We need Trotsky.
loc.ww2_soviet.48.b_tt: §YA minor civil war will break out when Trotsky returns§!
loc.ww2_soviet.49.d:
With Stalin's increasing paranoia, the Party and military have become divided. Those who have managed to earn his trust - at least temporarily - want to keep him in power and retain the cult of personality he has built up, but many others have been informally cut out of the loop. Some of them believe that Stalin's rule has failed, others suspect they are simply waiting for the day when the NKVD will find or make an excuse to have them arrested.

Together, they have formed a faction powerful enough to challenge the current administration. Their stated goal is to overthrow Stalin's tyranny and transition from a totalitarian state, with a board of military officers overseeing the process.

Stalin's supporters in the military and the Party have rallied to retain the current regime, calling their opponents counterrevolutionary traitors. A new civil war is at hand.
loc.ww2_soviet.50.d: The foundation of the Fourth International has reawakened Stalin's fear of traitors in the Party and military command. Having seen the trials and executions in the Great Purge, many suspect another one is incoming. In response, a number of generals led by Andrey Vlasov have formed the Committee for the Liberation of the People of Russia, with the goal of overthrowing Stalin's regime before it can do any more damage.\n\nAlthough the stated long-term goal is a transition to democracy, the exact form is unclear as of yet. All that is clear is that they intend to remove Stalin from power and end the rule of the Bolsheviks.
loc.ww2_soviet.51.d: The foundation of the Fourth International has reawakened Stalin's fear of traitors in the Party and military command. Having seen the trials and executions in the Great Purge, many suspect another one is incoming. The NKVD, which has been a crucial tool in the purges, has also been acutely aware of the fact that the agency itself a potential target. Rather than waiting to be imprisoned, executed and replaced, its leaders have decided to strike first and launch a coup with support from the similarly concerned military officials.\n\nHowever, despite its influential position, the NKVD has found it difficult to gain the trust of military leaders. The coup has only succeeded in gaining control of a limited area of the Union, but with the remnants of the old agency now facing certain execution, they are unlikely to surrender.
loc.ww2_soviet.52.d: The foundation of the Fourth International has reawakened Stalin's fear of traitors in the Party and military command. Having seen the trials and executions in the Great Purge, many suspect another one is incoming. With so many gone, there are only a few under suspicion who managed to avoid execution. Having been brutally interrogated and in some cases imprisoned, they know very well that they will be the first victims of another purge. In an act of desperation, these generals have decided to attempt to overthrow Stalin's regime before this happens.\n\nAlthough unlikely to succeed in the attempt, some survivors of the Great Purge have managed to seize control in some areas of the Union. The reign of the General Secretary has at the very least been destabilized.
loc.ww2_soviet.52.a: We must stabilize it as quickly as possible.
loc.ww2_soviet.53.d: In the wake of the foundation of the Fourth International the hunt for Trotsky's supporters was intensified and several people close to Stalin were excecuted. Left with no one but himself, Stalin has retreated to his mansion. With every treacharous friend and family member finally dealt with he can now find some rest and focus fully on bringing glory to the Soviet Union.
loc.ww2_soviet.53.a: Time to hang up the axe
loc.ww2_soviet.54.d_nopurge:
With the waning power of the communist party, it has long been clear that the Stalinist system is unsustainable.
New forces have risen up to seize power, invoking Russian ideals to guide our country along a new path.

Symbolising this transition, [Root.GetLeader] has had Stalin deposed and placed in house arrest, far from the halls of power where he devised so many of his dangerous projects.
As a new Russian system grows to replace the decaying corpse of the Party, the secrecy, paranoia and political plotting of the old General Secretary is at an end.
loc.ww2_soviet.54.d_purge: It has become clear that the greatest threat to the Russian state is not conspirators against the Communist Party, but the Party itself. With the disillusionment of the communist dream in Russia, new forces have seized power in order to bring our country into the future.\n\nFollowing the deposition of Stalin by [Root.GetLeader], the old General Secretary was given an expedient trial. His paranoid witch hunts being described as the destruction of the nation's leadership at a time of desperate need, Stalin was sentenced to death for treason. The old system goes with him into an unmarked grave.
loc.ww2_soviet.54.a: A new dawn for Russian politics.
loc.vanilla_poland.1.d: Having been forced to cede Gdansk to the Germans, we are now locked in a vise between two empires threatening our sovereignty. As we're losing territory in the west, not being able to trust the Allies to protect us from German aggression, we could consider aligning with the German ambitions and reclaim portions of our old Commonwealth now absorbed into the Soviet Union. We will be easy prey if we remain neutral, and have fought too hard to see another partition of Poland.
loc.vanilla_poland.1.a: It's time to turn the Axis from a threat to an ally.
loc.vanilla_poland.1.b: Working diplomatically with the Soviet is preferable.
loc.vanilla_poland.2.d: Having reasserted their claims on our eastern territories, the Soviet Union has now put pressure on us to cede this land to them, suggesting that this is the only way to avoid another invasion and possible annexation or partition.\n\nOrdinarily, giving in to such threats easily would be out of the question, but the Soviet Union is far from our only concern. If we agree to their demands, we may have less to worry about on the eastern front, although it would also position the eastern front significantly further to the west.
loc.vanilla_poland.2.b: Poland will not surrender without a fight!
loc.vanilla_poland.3.d: After we put pressure Poland to give in to our rightful claims on its eastern territories, they have agreed to cede what we demanded without further conflict. However, we can probably abandon any hopes of forming a stronger bond with the nation in the future. Having given us our due, they seem to hope we'll have as little contact as possible.
loc.vanilla_poland.3.a: As long as they recognize our claim, there is no problem.
loc.vanilla_poland.4.t: Poland Refuses to Cede the East
loc.vanilla_poland.4.d: Despite our effort to resolve the dispute with Poland peacefully, they have refused to cede their eastern territories and forced us into a position where the only option for claiming them is through war. Clearly, this troublesome country won't avoid a partition even when they are given the chance.
loc.vanilla_poland.4.a: Do they think they can stand against us?
loc.vanilla_poland.5.d: After the Soviet Union claimed their right to eastern Poland, we assumed another attack as impending. However, a recent offer from the Soviets indicate otherwise. Apparently, provided we cede the claimed territory, they are willing to let us join them in an alliance. Furthermore, they promise that in the event of a war with Germany, we will be compensated for the loss by being granted new land in the west.\n\nWhile this may be a better offer than we expected, we can't know if this supposed future war will ever be pursued. Perhaps the Soviet Union is only looking for an easy land grab and forcing us into their sphere of influence. Nevertheless, it may be the best protection we can count on.
loc.vanilla_poland.5.a: We must accept now, before it's too late.
loc.vanilla_poland.6.d: Offering to take Poland under our wing and guide them to future conquest in the west in exchange for territory in the east turned out to be a successful approach. Being promised a share of Germany in case of a successful war and our protection, they agreed to cede their eastern territories peacefully.
loc.vanilla_poland.6.a: An ally against Germany is much preferable to another partition.
loc.vanilla_poland.7.d: Despite making the most generous offer we possibly could, attempting an agreement where Poland would cede its eastern territory for a promise of a future share of Germany, [From.GetLeader] has rejected our diplomatic efforts. Poland has chosen the hard path, for us, but even more so for themselves.
loc.vanilla_poland.7.a: What cannot be bought must be seized.
loc.vanilla_poland.8.d: As previously agreed upon, after the annexation of eastern Germany territories by the Soviet Union, some of these will be come under Polish control as recompense for the past transfer of eastern Poland to the Soviet Union.
loc.vanilla_poland.8.a: A shift to the west was the best we could hope for, under the circumstances.
loc.vanilla_poland.9.a: The situation seems resolved to our mutual satisfaction.
loc.vanilla_poland.10.d: Acknowledging the need for unity against the threats surrounding our countries on every side, [From.GetLeader] today announced to the world that [From.GetName] has entered a treaty with [Root.GetName] for the sake of our mutual safety.
loc.vanilla_poland.11.d: In a foolish act of imagined self-preservation, [From.GetLeader] today announced that [From.GetName] will refrain from any diplomatic action that may be seen as threatening to their powerful neighbors. It has therefore declined our request that they join the [Root.GetFactionName].
loc.vanilla_poland.11.a: The only safety is standing together.
loc.vanilla_poland.12.d: Private Wojtek has proven himself a uniquely valuable member of our supply lines. Even during the heat of combat, small arms fire brushing the hair on his head, arms and legs, he did not drop a single crate of munitions. This brave soldier ensured our artillery could keep firing, and was thereby instrumental in defeating the enemy. As a result of this it has been decided that Wojtek should be promoted.
loc.vanilla_poland.12.a: May we all take inspiration from his bravery
loc.VAN_usa.1.d: As American mobilizes for war, we have received an unusual request. Amelia Earhart, the famous aviator who successfully circumvented the globe not long ago, wishes to enlist in the Army Air Corps as a fighter pilot. She has demonstrated considerable skill in mock dogfights, but there are many within the military establishment who frown on the idea of a having a woman flying combat missions. Should we make an exception in her case and let her join?
loc.VAN_usa.2.d: The unique foundation and history of the United States makes it our duty to preserve democracy and freedom in the world. The last decade has proven that this mission cannot be fulfilled without taking up arms against those who seek to destroy it. From now on, every oppressor will have to answer to us, and our armed forces will liberate people across the globe.
loc.VAN_usa.3.d: The diplomatic and economic sanctions we have suffered from the United States appears to have been the beginning of something more threatening. The American Pacific Fleet has been stationed in the naval base in Pearl Harbor, Hawaii, clearly signaling that the Americans will maintain a strong presence in the Pacific and continue supporting our enemies. Striking against the base at this point may give us the element of surprise.
loc.VAN_usa.3.a: Who knows how long the opportunity will last?
loc.VAN_usa.4.d: Having taken a stance against the Germans, the US appear interested in ensuring Britain stands strong against the German threat. They are, however, also concerned with maintaining their own naval presence in the Atlantic. In exchange for several of our naval bases, they will supply our nation with destroyer ships. The ships have been in reserve, but accepting will still strengthen the military bonds between our nations, and may be a wise decision.
loc.VAN_usa.4.a.tt: We will gain 34 American Destroyers.\nCanada will gain 6 American Destroyers.
loc.VAN_usa.4.b: This is clearly more favorable to the US, and unacceptable.
loc.VAN_usa.5.d: Despite our preparations and good intentions, Britain has refused our offer of old Destroyers in exchange for their naval bases.
loc.VAN_usa.6.d: The day of the presidential election has arrived. Incumbent Franklin Delano Roosevelt has already implemented several of the programs referred collectively to as the New Deal, intended to take the US out of the Great Depression.\n\nWhile many of the efforts have been popular, his plans to further extend the role and power of the government have been met with criticism from his opponent, Republican Alf Landon. Coming from the oil industry, Landon wants to see greater economic freedom, while Roosevelt and the Democratic Party want to expand Social Security and ensure economic stability. The election may be a close call, or a major victory for the Democrats.
loc.VAN_usa.6.b: The Republicans. We must safeguard the ideals of the American system.
loc.VAN_usa.7.d: Since the office of President of the United States was first established, no president has ruled for three consecutive terms. However, in light of the precarious state of the world and international developments in the last few years, President Roosevelt has decided to break with tradition and run for a third term. Republican Wendell Willkie, characterized as a dark horse candidate with a background as an industrialist with limited political experience, has been critical both of Roosevelt's economic interventionism and his justifications for running for a third term.\n\nAlthough the candidates have much in common in their foreign policies and Willkie wants to retain some form of the New Deal, many still consider this election a determining point for the future of American democracy.
loc.VAN_usa.8.d: President Landon put a stop to the Democrats' continued New Deal reforms four years ago, choosing to rely on the nation's strength lying in industrial companies such as those he helped establish prior to his presidency. Roosevelt, who has continued to campaign in favor of completing the programs he originally planned for his second term, is now running for president again. While he remains a popular candidate, Landon has continued to criticize his efforts to concentrate power in the hands of the president, and has accordingly avoided similar policies himself.\n\nThreats abroad, both to our own nation and others, remain a reality and neither candidate is in favor of the United States turning a blind eye to them. The question is who will lead the arsenal of democracy through these dire times.
loc.VAN_usa.8.a: The Republicans. Landon is devoted to our values.
loc.VAN_usa.8.b: The Democrats. Roosevelt is prepared to do what's necessary.
loc.VAN_usa.9.d: The presidency of Franklin D. Roosevelt has already been exceptional in many ways. Despite his declining health and the unprecedented length of his presidency, he aspires to continue leading our country through the war effort. The Republicans have been limited in their choices of candidates due to many potential nominees serving in the war, but have chosen Governor Thomas E. Dewey to represent them.\n\nRoosevelt continues to have popular support, but many suspect he may not live to see the end of his term. But is that sufficient to grant Dewey a victory over the man who has taken us this far?
loc.VAN_usa.10.d: Although many aspects of the New Deal were retained by [Root.GetLeader], Roosevelt still sees the opportunity to make his original plans for continued development of the programs reality. Despite declining health, he has managed to retain much of the support which landed him the presidency previously, and is now campaigning for the Democrats again.\n\n[Root.GetLeader] is arguing that a change of leadership in America's sensitive situation would be irresponsible, which is somewhat ironic since the same claim was made before his previous victory over Roosevelt. Despite this, he may have a point.
loc.VAN_usa.10.b: America is ready for a new New Deal.
loc.VAN_usa.11.d: With the continued threat of being drawn into a war, both Democrats and Republicans have aspired to find a candidate from the military. General Douglas MacArthur, normally devoted to his military duties, has taken the opportunity to campaign for the Republican nomination while our nation is at peace and won. He is now challenging Roosevelt, supporting the conservative coalition.\n\nRoosevelt continues to be popular, but MacArthur's charisma and sense of duty has made a strong impression on voters. Does the military really know best?
loc.VAN_usa.11.a: Roosevelt and Truman will pull through.
loc.VAN_usa.11.b: MacArthur is a man of peace as much as war.
loc.VAN_usa.12.d: To challenge Roosevelt's record-length presidency, the Republicans have looked to respected military commanders, hoping to find a potential candidate to take America through this war. General Douglas MacArthur has been a popular nominee among the conservatives, but he is also an indispensable asset in the ongoing conflict and has been reluctant to spend his time campaigning for the presidency.\n\nHe nevertheless remains one of the more promising conservative candidates and can perhaps be convinced to campaign to avoid getting a moderate Republican president. Is it worth the sacrifice?
loc.VAN_usa.12.a: MacArthur is needed more on the front lines than in the White House.
loc.VAN_usa.12.b: We need him to challenge Roosevelt.
loc.VAN_usa.13.d: Although President Roosevelt's health has been in decline for some time, his strong presidential campaign convinced many that he had many years left. However, the possibility of FDR's death while still in office has remained, and today he passed away after suffering a stroke. Vice-President Harry S. Truman has now taken the oath of office, requesting the support and prayers of the people. The old cabinet remains, and Truman has vowed to continue many of the policies of his predecessor.
loc.VAN_usa.13.a: So ended an era, and so began another.
loc.VAN_usa.14.d: Our great role-model, Nazi Germany, has betrayed their deepest principles and has allied themselves to the great enemy: The Communists. As the knowledge spreads, unrest follows in its wake. The people were willing to follow us this far, through fear of a Communist revolution, but with Germany's defection our great revival is being questioned.
loc.VAN_usa.17.d: The world is already an unsafe place. Can we really allow war in our own region or should we ensure that the peace is kept? We can send [From.From.GetName] an ultimatum to make peace with [From.GetName] or leave them to fight it out.
loc.VAN_usa.17.a: Let [From.From.GetName] know we are prepared for war.
loc.VAN_usa.17.a_tt: §RIf [From.From.GetName] backs down it will result in white peace.§!\n
loc.VAN_usa.17.b: We will not intervene this time.
loc.VAN_usa.18.d: [From.GetName] is displeased with our conflict war against [being_attacked.GetName]. They threaten us with a war of their own if we do not immediately sign a peace deal with [being_attacked.GetName]. \nShould we back down?
loc.VAN_usa.18.a: Let [From.GetName] know we are prepared for war.
loc.VAN_usa.20.d: The [From.GetName]'s advocation for democracy is starting to affect our country. Radio broadcasts allow speeches from [From.GetLeader] to reach our people and we have found many [Root.GetAdjective]'s being attracted to the [From.GetAdjective] way of life. [Root.GetName] is no puppet, nor will we allow our politics to be dictated by The [From.GetName]. However, we cannot deny the influence that [From.GetAdjective] politics have on our country.
loc.VAN_usa.20.a: In our hearts we will always be [Root.GetAdjective]
loc.VAN_usa.21.d: The [From.GetName]'s advocation for communism is starting to affect our country. Radio broadcasts allow speeches from [From.GetLeader] to reach our people. We have even found propaganda leaflets encouraging [Root.GetAdjective] workers to organize and promoting the [From.GetAdjective] way of life.
