[Root.GetName] is no puppet, nor will we allow our politics to be dictated by The [From.GetName]. However, we cannot deny the influence that [From.GetAdjective] politics have on our country.
loc.VAN_usa.22.d: The [From.GetName]'s advocation for fascism is starting to affect our country. Radio broadcasts allow speeches from [From.GetLeader] to reach our people and we have even found propaganda leaflets promoting the [From.GetAdjective] way of life being distributed in some parts of the country. [Root.GetName] is no puppet, nor will we allow our politics to be dictated by The [From.GetName]. However, we cannot deny the influence that [From.GetAdjective] politics have on our country.
loc.VAN_usa.23.d: The [From.GetName] are now enforcing the Monroe doctrine much stricter. Besides the political influence they already have on our country, [From.GetName] officials now declare that they are prepared to intervene in any conflict between American countries.
loc.VAN_usa.23.a_tt: [From.GetNameWithFlag] can now intervene in American wars
loc.VAN_usa.24.d: The Soviet Union, the inspiration that convinced many of how overthrowing capitalism was possible, has betrayed the international revolution and aligned itself with Nazi Germany. Between socialism in one country and this alliance with fascists, people are beginning to doubt the sincerity of the communist ideals worldwide. Is American communism just another tool [Root.GetLeader] has used to consolidate power?
loc.shared_INT_improve_relations_with_soviet: Improve Relations with the Soviet Union
loc.INT_GER_political_turmoil_desc: The armistice has ended the war, but hunger, demobilization and political violence threaten the peace at home.
loc.INT_GER_food_relief_desc: Food imports and public works can ease the hardship left by blockade and demobilization.
loc.INT_GER_reichswehr_compromise_desc: A small professional army must remain loyal to the state while the new political order takes shape.
loc.INT_GER_reconstitute_civil_service_desc: Preserve the administrative machinery needed to govern after imperial collapse while bringing it under the new constitutional order.
loc.INT_GER_rebuild_economy_desc: Convert wartime capacity to civilian production and restore confidence in German industry.
loc.INT_GER_reparations_crisis_desc: Phase II - Stabilization. Reparations demands strain the treasury while businesses struggle to plan ahead. Secure the authority to negotiate a path through the crisis and toward monetary stabilization.
loc.INT_GER_end_ruhr_resistance: End Passive Resistance in the Ruhr
loc.INT_GER_end_ruhr_resistance_desc: The occupation and the costly policy of passive resistance have pushed the economy toward collapse. Ending the campaign makes monetary reform possible.
loc.INT_GER_retain_the_republic_desc: The parliamentary republic offers a peaceful way through the postwar crisis. Friedrich Ebert will lead the transition.
loc.INT_GER_hold_national_assembly_1919_desc: The National Assembly can secure civil rights and establish the institutions of the new republic.
loc.INT_GER_establish_the_reichstag_desc: Give parliament the means to govern through coalition and public debate.
loc.INT_GER_defeat_kapp_putsch_desc: A general strike and loyal institutions can resist the attempted coup of March 1920.
loc.INT_GER_stabilize_currency_desc: Phase II - Stabilization. End the inflationary spiral and restore confidence in wages, savings and commercial contracts. Monetary reform opens the way to the investment choices of the Roaring Twenties.
loc.INT_GER_modernize_industry_desc: Replace worn machinery and reorganize civilian production. Modernization opens a one-time machinery investment decision alongside the immediate expansion of industrial capacity.
loc.INT_GER_unemployment_insurance_desc: A national insurance system can soften the impact of job losses, though its benefits will place new demands on the budget.
loc.INT_GER_expand_exports_desc: Rebuild commercial links for German machinery and manufactured goods. Export expansion can proceed independently of the unemployment insurance program, opening the way to an export guarantee scheme.
loc.INT_GER_dawes_plan_desc: A revised reparations schedule and foreign credit can support German recovery.
loc.INT_GER_elect_hindenburg_desc: The 1925 presidential election brings Paul von Hindenburg to the head of the republic.
loc.INT_GER_locarno_treaties_desc: Accept the western borders and improve relations with France, Belgium and Britain.
loc.INT_GER_join_league_of_nations_desc: Germany's admission in 1926 restores a seat in international diplomacy after years of isolation.
loc.INT_GER_young_plan_focus_desc: Seek another revision of the reparations schedule to ease pressure on the German economy.
loc.INT_GER_presidential_cabinet_focus_desc: The depression and collapsing coalitions have shifted power toward emergency presidential government.
loc.INT_GER_defend_democracy_desc: Restore parliamentary legitimacy and resist those who would end the republic.
loc.INT_GER_appoint_hitler_desc: Hindenburg appoints Adolf Hitler chancellor in January 1933, opening the way to dictatorship.
loc.INT_GER_merge_presidency_chancellorship_: President Hindenburg has died. The presidency and chancellorship are now combined under Hitler, ending the last formal division of power at the head of the Reich.
loc.INT_GER_reichswehr_oath_desc: Germany's soldiers swear loyalty to Hitler personally after he assumes the powers of president and chancellor.
loc.INT_GER_mefo_bills_focus_desc: Schacht's MEFO bills finance rearmament through a concealed system of promissory notes. Their payments will become a mounting obligation.
loc.INT_GER_republican_recovery_desc: A functioning parliament can pursue industrial recovery without surrendering democratic institutions.
loc.INT_GER_european_security_accord_desc: Seek an agreed end to military restrictions with France and Britain while keeping the Rhineland demilitarized.
loc.INT_GER_european_security_accord_tt: The Reichswehr division limit and reparations end. The Rhineland remains demilitarized.
loc.INT_GER_gleichschaltung_desc: The new regime destroys political opposition and centralizes power.
loc.INT_GER_rearmament_1935_desc: Open rearmament and conscription violate Versailles, while the Rhineland remains demilitarized until a separate decision.
loc.INT_GER_rearmament_1935_tt: The Reichswehr division limit and reparations end. The Rhineland remains demilitarized.
loc.INT_GER_a_new_leaf_desc: The revolutionary left replaces the Weimar government with a socialist state.
loc.INT_GER_workers_councils_desc: Give workers' councils a place in the new government and secure support for the transition.
loc.INT_GER_socialize_industry_desc: Bring key industries under public direction and reorganize production.
loc.INT_GER_red_reichswehr_focus_desc: Rebuild the army around the new government's political and military priorities.
loc.INT_GER_peoples_republic_desc: Stabilize the revolutionary government and define its long-term institutions.
loc.INT_GER_military_research_with_the_sovie: The Rapallo treaty restores diplomatic relations with Soviet Russia and settles outstanding wartime claims. Cooperation can now grow without binding either country to a military alliance.
loc.INT_GER_eastern_trade_commissions_desc: Joint commercial missions can reopen markets and exchange industrial expertise across the German-Soviet frontier.
loc.INT_GER_reichswehr_red_army_contacts_des: Quiet staff contacts keep military knowledge moving between two armies constrained by different political and strategic pressures.
loc.INT_GER_berlin_treaty_desc: A friendship and neutrality treaty reassures Moscow that Germany’s western diplomacy has not ended the relationship begun at Rapallo.
loc.INT_GER_lipetsk_training_desc: A covert training and testing site in Soviet Russia helps German aviators preserve skills prohibited by the Versailles settlement.
loc.INT_GER_armored_trials_in_the_east_desc: Secret exercises and technical trials on Soviet soil allow the Reichswehr to study armored warfare without openly breaking its treaty limits.
loc.INT_GER_saar_plebiscite_desc: After the 1935 vote, bring the Saar back under German administration while maintaining its demilitarized status.
loc.INT_GER_dismantle_the_republic_desc: Conservative elites seize the postwar crisis as an opportunity to end parliamentary rule.
loc.INT_GER_rally_old_elites_desc: Draw on the support of monarchists, officers and the traditional administration.
loc.INT_GER_federal_compromise_desc: Negotiate the role of the German states in a restored monarchy.
loc.INT_GER_secure_officer_corps_desc: Win the army's support before deciding the crown's constitutional powers.
loc.INT_GER_state_of_the_nation_desc: Decide whether a restored crown will share power or rule without parliament.
loc.INT_GER_continuation_of_democracy_desc: Restore the Kaiser under a constitution and retain elections.
loc.INT_GER_instate_new_monarchy_desc: Return Wilhelm II to the throne and replace the republic with imperial rule.
loc.INT_GER_power_to_the_new_kaiser_desc: Concentrate authority around the restored Kaiser and his government.
loc.INT_GER_undermine_versailles_desc: Prepare to challenge the postwar settlement despite the diplomatic and domestic risks.
loc.INT_GER_clandestine_staff_training_desc: Officers can preserve operational knowledge through restricted exercises and informal instruction despite the treaty's limits.
loc.INT_GER_secret_armaments_desc: Dispersed industrial contracts give the army a small base for future production while the treaty still forbids open rearmament.
loc.INT_GER_prepare_treaty_revision: Prepare to Renounce the Military Clauses
loc.INT_GER_prepare_treaty_revision_desc: Build political support and coordinate the officer corps before a public challenge to the treaty restrictions.
loc.INT_GER_repudiate_versailles_desc: Reject the treaty's military and economic restrictions while postponing the remilitarization of the Rhineland.
loc.INT_GER_repudiate_versailles_tt: The Reichswehr division limit and reparations end. The Rhineland remains demilitarized.
loc.INT_GER_reintegrate_veterans_desc: Millions of returning soldiers need work, housing and a place in civilian life. A deliberate demobilization program can prevent the army's collapse from becoming a lasting social crisis.
loc.INT_GER_restore_transport_links_desc: Repair the railways and freight networks disrupted by war and blockade so food and raw materials can reach the factories again.
loc.INT_GER_municipal_reconstruction_desc: Town councils are best placed to reopen schools, utilities and local services after years of war.
loc.INT_GER_veterans_assistance_desc: Support disabled veterans and families of the fallen, while employment assistance helps able returning soldiers rejoin civilian life and the trained reserve.
loc.INT_GER_state_elections_desc: The republic must take root beyond Berlin. Competitive state elections give the new order a local foundation.
loc.INT_GER_coalition_bargaining_desc: Agreement among the republican parties will keep ministries functioning while the Reichstag confronts postwar disorder.
loc.INT_GER_safeguard_civil_rights_desc: The constitution's guarantees mean little unless courts and state governments protect them in practice.
loc.INT_GER_social_partnership_desc: Bring employers and trade unions to the bargaining table to settle disputes without paralysing reconstruction.
loc.INT_GER_expand_universities_desc: Scientific institutes and technical colleges can train a generation of engineers for a peaceful industrial recovery.
loc.INT_GER_public_broadcasting_desc: Radio broadcasting can connect distant regions and make public debate accessible beyond the printed press.
loc.INT_GER_reichsbahn_reform_desc: Modern freight administration can move Ruhr coal and industrial goods more efficiently across the republic.
loc.INT_GER_support_mittelstand_desc: Small workshops and family firms need access to credit and stable contracts after years of inflation.
loc.INT_GER_chemical_industry_desc: Germany's chemical firms can again lead in industrial processes if research and production are rebuilt together.
loc.INT_GER_housing_construction_desc: Housing shortages hold back urban recovery. Support municipal construction and open a one-time housing project that eases hardship while placing demands on current resources.
loc.INT_GER_rationalize_production_desc: Standardized methods and new machinery can make the recovering factories competitive in foreign markets.
loc.INT_GER_industrial_safety_desc: Safer workplaces will protect the skilled workforce on which recovery depends.
loc.INT_GER_railway_workers_councils_desc: The councils will bring railway labor into the socialist administration without halting essential traffic.
loc.INT_GER_communal_relief_desc: Local councils can distribute food and fuel while the new government rebuilds its administrative reach.
loc.INT_GER_red_militias_desc: Revolutionary volunteers need training and a clear chain of command if they are to defend the new republic.
loc.INT_GER_collectivize_transport_desc: Coordinated rail and freight planning can keep coal, food and factory inputs moving during the transition.
loc.INT_GER_local_soviets_desc: Regional councils can represent workers while a central government coordinates defense and trade.
loc.INT_GER_socialist_science_desc: Public research institutes can direct technical training toward civilian reconstruction.
loc.INT_GER_princes_congress_desc: The old dynasties must decide whether a restored crown will govern through a federal compact or claim stronger royal prerogatives.
loc.INT_GER_imperial_civil_service_desc: Experienced officials can organize the crown's records, procurement and industrial administration, while defining their duties to the states and the Reich.
loc.INT_GER_joint_industrial_surveys_desc: German and Soviet technical delegations can identify machinery and markets suited to reciprocal exchange.
loc.INT_GER_technical_missions_desc: Engineers and commercial representatives can deepen the practical relationship opened at Rapallo.
loc.INT_GER_eastern_grain_trade_desc: Regular grain contracts can ease pressure on German food supplies while sustaining eastern commerce.
loc.INT_GER_kama_tank_school_desc: Covert trials at Kama let German officers test armored doctrine beyond the reach of treaty inspectors.
loc.INT_GER_preserve_pilot_training_desc: Lessons from the eastern training sites can be retained for a future air arm without openly reestablishing one.
loc.INT_GER_municipal_emergency_relief_desc: City governments can keep soup kitchens and employment offices operating through the worst of the depression.
loc.INT_GER_vocational_retraining_desc: Technical retraining can return displaced workers to factories as demand begins to recover.
loc.INT_GER_republican_public_works_desc: An elected government can fund local construction while defending representative institutions.
loc.INT_GER_restore_civic_confidence_desc: Visible recovery and open parliamentary government can win back voters alienated by the crisis.
loc.INT_GER_national_labor_service_desc: The new regime directs public works and labor mobilization toward its political and economic goals.
loc.INT_GER_enter_1936_desc: The interwar years are over. The German focus tree for the coming era replaces this one after the republic, council state, conservative settlement, restored monarchy, 1935 rearmament or treaty revision reaches its conclusion.
loc.SO2_INT_republics_council_desc: The new union needs a forum where its republics can argue over budgets, administration and the meaning of federal autonomy.
loc.SO2_INT_party_secretariat_desc: A permanent secretariat can coordinate appointments and policy across a rapidly growing party-state.
loc.SO2_INT_electrify_villages_desc: Carry the GOELRO program beyond the major cities so rural industry and agriculture can use reliable power.
loc.SO2_INT_nep_market_towns_desc: Regional markets can reconnect the countryside to urban workshops without abandoning state control of heavy industry.
loc.SO2_INT_union_constitution_desc: Define the institutions and rights of the union republics in a durable constitutional settlement.
loc.SO2_INT_lenins_legacy_desc: Lenin's death forces the party to decide how its leadership and revolutionary program will continue.
loc.SO2_INT_cooperative_credit_desc: Loans to cooperatives can raise rural output while retaining the mixed economy of the NEP.
loc.SO2_INT_left_opposition_desc: Trotsky's supporters defeat the party apparatus and put international revolution and internal debate back on the agenda.
loc.SO2_INT_general_secretary_desc: Stalin uses the party secretariat to build a governing majority and isolate his rivals.
loc.SO2_INT_right_opposition_desc: Bukharin's coalition secures the party leadership and argues that the countryside needs time to prosper.
loc.SO2_INT_permanent_revolution_desc: The Left Opposition makes international revolutionary organization a central task of Soviet policy.
loc.SO2_INT_socialism_one_country_desc: The party concentrates on securing the Soviet state and building the material base for socialism at home.
loc.SO2_INT_preserve_nep_desc: Retain small private trade and peasant incentives while the state directs strategic industry.
loc.SO2_INT_party_democracy_desc: The Left Opposition relaxes administrative discipline to let rival socialist programs compete inside the party.
loc.SO2_INT_grain_procurement_desc: Shortages in the cities expose the limits of voluntary grain deliveries and push the government toward a new agricultural policy.
loc.SO2_INT_peasant_incentives_desc: Offer farmers stable prices and a reason to bring more grain to market instead of relying on forced requisition.
loc.SO2_INT_international_bureau_desc: Coordinate revolutionary parties abroad while keeping the Soviet government focused on its own reconstruction.
loc.SO2_INT_first_five_year_plan_desc: Replace the NEP's mixed economy with state targets for steel, machinery and electric power.
loc.SO2_INT_gradual_industrialization_desc: Use the proceeds of agriculture and trade to fund factories at a pace the economy can sustain.
loc.SO2_INT_industrial_democracy_desc: Give factory councils a voice in production targets while the state coordinates investment.
loc.SO2_INT_collectivize_agriculture_desc: Rapid collectivization channels agriculture into the plan but brings severe disruption to the countryside.
loc.SO2_INT_build_magnitogorsk_desc: A new industrial city in the Urals will anchor the plan's steel and heavy-machinery targets.
loc.SO2_INT_cooperative_farms_desc: Voluntary farm cooperatives can share tools and credit without an abrupt campaign of forced collectivization.
loc.SO2_INT_left_industrial_plan_desc: The opposition combines public ownership with worker oversight and targeted industrial investment.
loc.SO2_INT_stabilize_collective_farms_desc: New equipment and more predictable procurement must restore output after the upheaval of collectivization.
loc.SO2_INT_second_five_year_plan_desc: Shift from emergency construction toward transport, machinery and higher industrial productivity.
loc.SO2_INT_cooperative_industrialization_de: State firms and cooperatives will expand together, with investment guided by demand rather than compulsory quotas.
loc.SO2_INT_workers_republic_desc: Consolidate the Left Opposition's institutions and prepare the Soviet state for a new European era.
loc.SO2_INT_heavy_industry_1935_desc: The plans have transformed the industrial base; the next challenge is turning new capacity into reliable output.
loc.SO2_INT_nep_recovery_1935_desc: A longer NEP has built a steadier partnership between farmers, cooperatives and state industry.
loc.SO2_INT_enter_1936_desc: The interwar struggle has shaped the Soviet Union. The national focus tree for the coming era will now take its place.
loc.SO2_INT_rapallo_diplomacy_desc: Settle outstanding wartime claims with Germany and reopen diplomatic and commercial exchange.
loc.SO2_INT_berlin_treaty_desc: Assure Germany that western diplomacy will not erase the relationship forged at Rapallo.
loc.SO2_INT_comintern_schools_desc: Train organizers from abroad in the methods and lessons of the revolution.
loc.SO2_INT_pacific_border_commission_desc: Clarify the frontier and maintain communications with neighboring governments in the Far East.
loc.SO2_INT_international_recognition_desc: Working embassies can help the Soviet Union trade even with states that reject its ideology.
loc.SO2_INT_armored_proving_grounds_desc: Testing grounds turn experimental vehicles into lessons for mobile warfare.
loc.SO2_INT_rifle_standardization_desc: Common specifications ease the supply burden of an army assembled from Civil War formations.
loc.SO2_INT_artillery_bureaus_desc: Specialized design teams improve guns and ammunition for a modern field army.
loc.SO2_INT_red_army_academies_desc: Professional education preserves Civil War experience while training officers in operational planning.
loc.SO2_INT_deep_operations_desc: Operational theorists propose striking through an enemy front and exploiting disruption at depth.
loc.SO2_INT_flight_schools_desc: A larger corps of trained pilots is essential before the air force can absorb new aircraft.
loc.SO2_INT_air_ground_cooperation_desc: Linking aircraft to army headquarters makes reconnaissance and close support more useful.
loc.SO2_INT_ural_steel_desc: Steelworks east of the old industrial heartland broaden the Soviet productive base.
loc.SO2_INT_machine_tool_plants_desc: Machine tools bridge the gap between ambitious plans and working factories.
loc.SO2_INT_tractor_works_desc: Tractor plants serve farms and teach techniques relevant to vehicle production.
loc.SO2_INT_ural_rail_links_desc: Rail capacity must grow with the factories if steel and machinery are to reach the rest of the country.
loc.SO2_INT_baltic_fleet_repairs_desc: Restore surviving ships and shore facilities after years of war and neglect.
loc.SO2_INT_black_sea_fleet_repairs_desc: Rebuild the Black Sea dockyards and train crews for the fleet's surviving vessels.
loc.WW2_shared_industrialisation_desc: Food may be essential in day-to-day life, but consumption of food alone does not make a country great. As Britain from its industrial revolution has shown, these so-called industries are essential to a nation's power in this day and age.
loc.WW2_GEN_pre_industrial_path_1_desc: We must first overcome nobles who hold large tracts of land, and are very much eager to prevent themselves from going bankrupt due to uncompetitive prices and both de facto and de jure serfdom.
loc.WW2_GEN_pre_industrial_path_2_desc: Even the common citizen does not fully know how poorly he lives, and protests against change. We ought to change this opinion...
loc.WW2_GEN_pre_industrial_path_3_desc: With the initial obstacles from industrialization out of the day, now we ought to get into actually being able to turn what little industry, if we can even call it that, into a proper one.
loc.WW2_GEN_early_industrial_path_1_desc: First, we must link up our disparate industries, and railroads certainly are the way to do this.
loc.WW2_GEN_early_industrial_path_2_desc: We must shake the people from their old views and convince them that industrialization shall benefit not just the nation, but the people as a whole! Furthermore, we ought to start teaching the majority of our populace how to read...
loc.WW2_GEN_early_industrial_path_3_desc: With our lands connected, and a more enthusiastic and educated population, we can now begin to industrialize our nation properly.
loc.WW2_GEN_basic_industrial_path_1_desc: With a more literate population comes a more concious population. Rampant lack of safety, long work hours, and abhorrent conditions for workers in factories has lead to many demanding better conditions both in work and society.
loc.WW2_GEN_basic_industrial_path_2_desc: Despite the positive effects of industrialization, there remains those who are unemployed by it, or run out of business. Merchants, Farmers, Artisans, and nobles alike protest against the march of progress, for progress to them means worsening living conditions, wealth, and opportunity.
loc.WW2_GEN_basic_industrial_path_3_desc: As people move to the cities and living costs skyrocket, people are able to afford less children. Despite more modern and productive farms, the rent is still too high!
loc.WW2_GEN_basic_industrial_path_4_desc: We have now established a solid industrial base. However, the factories themselves are likely not as efficient or safe as those found in Europe or the United States. We still need to work on obtaining new technologies and standardizing factories...
loc.WW2_GEN_industrial_path_1_desc: Machine tools, interchangable parts, and the Bessemer process. All of these are important aspects of a modern industry which we must implement as soon as possible!
loc.WW2_GEN_industrial_path_2_desc: The Production Line, an idea that has streamlined production whilst making factories easier to manage.
loc.WW2_GEN_industrial_path_3_desc: Electricity. One may initially think of it as a novelty, but when combined with appropriate infrastructure and industry, by Gods, we shall live in luxuries and light like never before.
loc.WW2_GEN_industrial_path_4_desc: All that remains is one final push to formalize some regulations, and some touchups to the government departments. We have now modernized our industry to that of the highest standard!
loc.shared_army_effort_desc: Despite the increasing possibilities of aerial and naval warfare, ground combat is still key in tomorrow's wars. With preparation, we can avoid reliving the hell of the trenches.
loc.shared_equipment_effort_desc: The limits for what equipment can be carried by infantry are constantly being pushed. We will focus on giving our troops the best tools available.
loc.shared_motorization_effort_desc: Mobility and protection are crucial to get infantry into and out of the field safely. Focusing on these developments will allow us to take action quickly.
loc.shared_doctrine_effort_desc: The military doctrines that defined ground combat in the Great War are outdated. We must put our greatest minds to the task of shaping the military thought of tomorrow.
loc.shared_equipment_effort_2_desc: We will continue our efforts to ensure our infantry and support troops are armed with the best possible equipment of our time.
loc.shared_mechanization_effort_desc: Rethinking the possibilities of motorized infantry, we can push the limits of what vehicles can be constructed today.
loc.shared_doctrine_effort_2_desc: The battlefield has changed not just in the interbellum years, but over the course of recent conflicts. We must continuously reevaluate our doctrines to reflect this.
loc.shared_equipment_effort_3_desc: Instead of imitating or buying foreign equipment, we should aim to become world-leading in infantry weapons.
loc.shared_armor_effort_desc: Applying what we have learned from mechanizing our infantry, we can improve our armored vehicles as well.
loc.shared_special_forces_desc: We have need of elite forces; mountain troops and paratroopers should be our priority.
loc.shared_aviation_effort_tt: Not enough building slots for §YAir Base§!
loc.shared_aviation_effort_desc: Nowhere is technological advances more rapid than in aerial warfare. Aviation is a field any modern nation must master.
loc.shared_fighter_focus_desc: We have not seen that last of dogfights in the Great War. Keeping ahead in the development of fighter planes will give us an edge in the future.
loc.shared_bomber_focus_desc: When people of the future speak of the horror to today's wars, fire raining from the skies will prominently feature. We will do our best to ensure those stories are told by our enemies.
loc.shared_aviation_effort_2_desc: Further advances in aviation will be necessary to integrate our air force well with other branches of the military.
loc.shared_CAS_effort_desc: A modern army needs support from vehicles not only on the ground, but also in the air.
loc.shared_rocket_effort_desc: Rocket and jet engines allow for unprecedented speeds for unmanned and manned vessels alike. Pioneering these technologies will allow us to take the enemy by surprise.
loc.shared_NAV_effort_desc: Just as the new naval warfare takes place in part beneath the water's surface, part of it takes place in the air above the waters.
loc.shared_naval_effort_tt: Not enough building slots for §YNaval Dockyards§!
loc.shared_naval_effort_desc: The expansion of our navy should be our first priority. Assign all available resources to new Dockyards and research into light surface ships.
loc.shared_flexible_navy_desc: Reinventing naval warfare to account for the advances in submarine technology will allow us to strike efficiently against enemy convoys.
loc.shared_large_navy_desc: Adapting our naval doctrines to accommodate large ships and ensuring the safety of our trade convoys will teach us much about what sort of ships we need.
loc.shared_submarine_effort_desc: Submarine warfare is the most exciting naval development since the invention of the torpedo boat. We would do well to not just protect against submarines, but also use them against enemy shipping.
loc.shared_cruiser_effort_desc: Before making forays into advanced battleship research, the smaller cruisers are in need of replacement.
loc.shared_destroyer_effort_desc: Studying the design and strategic use of submarines, we have also learned how to counter those strategies. Destroyers will be crucial for this.
loc.shared_capital_ships_effort_desc: The nation with the most battleships will rule the oceans. Battleships and carriers represent the old and the new in naval superiority.
loc.shared_industrial_effort_desc: Focus all our political efforts on building up the civilian industry in a great leap forward.
loc.shared_industrial_effort_2_desc: With iron will and a relentless work ethic, we can mobilize the people in another great industrial effort.
loc.shared_construction_effort_tt: Not enough building slots for §YCivilian Factories§!
loc.shared_construction_effort_desc: Civilian industrial capacity must not be underestimated even when war looms over the world.
loc.shared_production_effort_tt: Not enough building slots for §YMilitary Factory§!
loc.shared_production_effort_desc: If you can build tractors, you can build tanks! We must not allow our military production capacity to lag behind.
loc.shared_construction_effort_2_desc: Continuing to expand our factories will allow us to speed up production of goods for trade and further construction efforts.
loc.shared_production_effort_2_desc: Trying to adapt civilian factories to produce military equipment is inefficient. We should focus on preparing military production now.
loc.shared_production_effort_3_desc: Continued efforts to expand our military factories are necessary to meet the demands for new equipment.
loc.shared_infrastructure_effort_desc: A country without proper infrastructure cannot pursue advanced projects or constructions.
loc.shared_synth_oil_effort_tt: Not enough building slots for $YSynthetic Refinery$!
loc.shared_infrastructure_effort_2_desc: Extending our infrastructure further will enable the transports and communications necessary for high-tech clandestine projects.
loc.shared_construction_effort_3_desc: Expansion of our infrastructure network has significantly improved our capacity for construction.
loc.shared_nuclear_effort_desc: Standing on the edge of a world-changing discovery, we cannot let others light the fire that may one day consume the Earth.
loc.shared_extra_tech_slot_desc: Our industrial expansion and other recent advances might allow us to conduct more R&D in parallel.
loc.shared_extra_tech_slot_2_desc: The rapid industrialization of our nation has opened up new opportunities in R&D that we should pursue.
loc.shared_technology_sharing_desc: By sharing technological advances with our allies, our whole faction will be able to conduct wartime R&D more efficiently.
loc.shared_secret_weapons_desc: It is tempting to expend all extra resources into developing tanks and planes, but the secret to winning wars lies in whole new fields of science; electronics, rocketry and nuclear research.
loc.shared_political_effort_desc: To bring about change in the world, we need to be able to bring about change in our own country. Strengthening our political position should come first.
loc.shared_collectivist_ethos_desc: Our enemies may divide and conquer lesser nations, but our people will stand united. All for one and one for all.
loc.shared_liberty_ethos_desc: In this time of ideological fanatics who seek to suffocate the human spirit, we will safeguard individual liberties and freedom.
loc.shared_militarism_desc: Those who view the military as a necessary evil are doomed to hesitate in the face of war. We will ingrain militarism into our culture to become a people of soldiers.
loc.shared_political_correctness_desc: People holding mildly controversial or otherwise embarrassing opinions appear to be concerned that there is a wide-reaching conspiracy against them. This seems like an excellent idea.
loc.shared_neutrality_focus_desc: While others may claim it takes bravery and wisdom to take sides in a global conflict, we know it takes more to refuse.
loc.shared_interventionism_focus_desc: We value the freedom of all people, not only our own citizens. If preventing tyranny means war, then so be it.
loc.shared_military_youth_desc: Organizations to promote discipline and political education of young people in our nation will foster loyalty and self-sacrifice early.
loc.shared_deterrence_desc: Standing alone, we rarely benefit from war. Fortunately, we know that the best defense is one so well-known you never have to put it to use.
loc.shared_volunteer_corps_desc: Forcing our people to die for ideals of freedom would be an exercise in irony, but establishing means for those who wish to aid people abroad is not.
loc.shared_paramilitarism_desc: Military principles have applications outside of the military. With the development of semi-militarized units to complement our armed forces, more people will have military training.
loc.shared_indoctrination_focus_desc: Having established our ideology as based on the truth, it may be taught as truth. Education and media must reflect this lesson.
loc.shared_foreign_expeditions_desc: With our enemies prepared to intervene in distant conflicts on behalf of their ideals, we must be ready to do the same for ours.
loc.shared_why_we_fight_desc: The world is growing increasingly unsafe. Our people need to see the atrocities being committed by those who crave power. It is time we rally the people to our cause and ensure everyone is ready to fight for our freedom.
loc.shared_political_commissars_desc: To ensure that our policies are followed in military practice, we will introduce politically appointed officials into military ranks.
loc.shared_internationalism_focus_desc: Ideology knows no borders. Another nation may call itself sovereign, but our convictions are above such claims.
loc.shared_nationalism_focus_desc: Our nation is unique, and our political achievements could only have happened here. We must fight for it at any cost.
loc.shared_ideological_fanaticism_desc: Our politically established values and goals are worth dying for as much as any ancient faith. Any follower should be prepared to face death, and those who stray better be prepared to face death.
loc.shared_air_innovation_desc: Modern wars cannot be won without dominating the skies. We must do everything in our power to develop the air force!
loc.shared_air_innovation_2_desc: Every advantage we can gain in the skies is precious. We should focus all of our efforts on developing our fighters.
loc.shared_naval_air_effort_desc: The efficacy of air strikes against naval targets was demonstrated by the Americans already back in 1921. We should not neglect this branch of the Air Force if we intend to wage war on a naval power.
loc.GER_fall_of_france_desc: We have succeeded in conquering France!
loc.GER_fall_of_uk_desc: We have succeeded in conquering the United Kingdom!
loc.GER_fall_of_soviet_union_desc: We have succeeded in conquering the Soviet Union!
loc.GER_operation_seelowe_desc: Operation Seelöwe, or Operation Sealion was the codename for the invasion of Britain. Following the Fall of France, we had hoped the English would seek an armistice, but seeing as they declined we will have to resort to more definitive measures. To dare this operation, we would need an immense amount of vessels and air support.
loc.GER_fall_grun_desc: Fall Grün, or Case Green, was a full-scale operations plan for the invasion of Ireland in support of Operation Sea Lion. It was mostly a divisionary plan, but we could of course put the plan to actual action.
loc.GER_operation_wacht_am_rhein_desc: Also known as the Battle of the Bulge, this is our final chance to pull off an incredible victory against the Allies. We can recreate our initial victory against the French through the Ardennes, and they should have no time to respond. We should be able to encircle huge amounts of divisions, which will free up our men to defend in the east.
loc.GER_operation_nordwind_desc: In order to support Operation Wacht Am Rhein, we must provide support the attack through the Ardennes and break through the American lines. If this were to succeed, we should be able to destroy the entire army stationed there.
loc.GER_operation_typhoon_desc: Our plans to attack the Soviet capital can finally be put to use. Our attack will consist of two pincer offensives, one from the north of Moscow against the Kalinin Front, and the other to the south of Moscow Oblast against the Western Front. This operation will have a huge part in determining the outcome of this war.
loc.GER_fall_anton_desc: With the attack of the Allies on the Vichy Regime, it is time to act to protect our interests.
loc.GER_operation_citadel_desc: We've lost the battle for the oil fields and the Caucuses, however the war is not lost. We still control large portions of the Soviet union, enough to fight a staggered retreat across the front to wear down the Soviets, but before we can begin defensive operations we must make one more offensive to stabalize the frontline.
loc.GER_fall_blau_desc: We failed to capture our objectives of the last year, however we have not yet lost the innitiative on the Eastern front. The majority of the Soviet forces are situated in and around Moscow and along our central front. We have the option to strike south and capture the vital baku oil fields, along with the City of Stalins name, which would be a striking blow to the Bolsheviks.
loc.shared_industrialisation_desc: Food may be essential in day-to-day life, but consumption of food alone does not make a country great. As Britain from its industrial revolution has shown, these so-called industries are essential to a nation's power in this day and age.
loc.SOV_new_ww2_soviet_man_desc: The New Soviet Man is selfless, learned, disciplined and healthy; a living triumph over base instincts and false consciousness. Men will gladly lay down their lives for the good of all, and women will bear many children for the future of Soviet society.
loc.SO2_industrial_effort_desc: Repair factories and transport damaged by years of war so the republic can produce for its own needs.
loc.SO2_homefront_desc: Choosing to focus on the homefront means gaining more stability within your country instead of war support.
loc.SO2_homefront_2_desc: Choosing to focus on the homefront means gaining more stability within your country instead of war support.
loc.SO2_homefront_3_desc: Choosing to focus on the homefront means gaining more stability within your country instead of war support.
loc.SO2_shorter_training_desc: With the war dragging on and taking more and more lives we need more men to refill the casualties so shortening training would help with that.
loc.SO2_war_front_desc: Choosing to focus on the frontline means gaining more war support but losing stability on the homefront.
loc.SO2_war_front_2_desC: Choosing to focus on the frontline means gaining more war support but losing stability on the homefront.
loc.SO2_war_front_3_desc: Choosing to focus on the frontline means gaining more war support but losing stability on the homefront.
loc.SO2_army_effort_desc: Turn the Civil War's improvised forces into a trained and supplied national army.
loc.SO2_form_airforce_desc: Bring aircraft production, pilot training and airfields under a single military program.
loc.SO2_naval_effort_desc: Preserve the surviving ships and crews while repairing the fleet bases left by the Civil War.
loc.SO2_diplomatic_effort_desc: Reopen contacts with foreign governments and revolutionary movements while the new state secures its borders.
loc.SO2_treaty_of_tartu_desc: With the Finnish Civil War over we should define the final borders of our countries.
loc.SO2_send_supplies_HNN_desc: The Hungarian Soviet Republic desperately needs our support in any way possible as it is surrounded by enemies.
loc.SO2_intervene_in_hungary_desc: In order to intervene in Hungary we must make sure we share a border with Romania and aid the Hungarians in their war against them.
loc.SO2_puppet_hungarian_sr_desc: The Hungarisn are already dependent on us for their protection, all that is left is to take the final step forward.
loc.SO2_establish_rumanian_sr_desc: With Rumania defeated and occupied we should spread Communism further and establish a loyalist communist government in the country.
loc.SO2_send_supplies_FNR_desc: RedFinland desperately needs our support in their losing battle against the numerically superior White Finnish Movement.
loc.SO2_intervene_finland_desc: Red Finland will never win the war on their own, we must come to their aid if we wish to spread Communism to the Finnish borders.
loc.SO2_puppet_fnr_desc: Red Finland is already dependent on us for their protection and economy it is just one more step forward to do this...
loc.SO2_integrate_FNR_desc: Finland has been a part of the Russian Empire for a long time in the past and they will become a part of the motherland once again.
loc.SO2_reconquista_desc: With the Central Powers defeated in the First World War the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk remains all but a fictional piece of paper, it is time for the reconquista of our formerly ceded lands.
loc.SO2_westward_offensive_desc: In order to reconquer our old territories we have gathered an army on the Western Front of red guard ready to invade the enemy and reconquer our lands!
loc.SO2_treaty_of_kars_desc: With the transcaucasian states defeated and reintgrated it is time to finalize our borders with the Republic of Turkey.
loc.SO2_intervene_PSSR_desc: The Persian Socialist Republic will not win on its own they will need the help of the mighty of the Red Army to overcome the evil autocrats in Tehran.
loc.SO2_supply_PSSR_desc: The Persian Socialist Republic will only get our supplies we cannot risk sparking another allied intervention over there.
loc.SO2_demand_jap_evac_desc: It is time for the Japanese to get out of our country!
loc.SO2_reintegrate_FAR_desc: With the Japanese no longer a threat the time has come for us to reintegrate the Far Eastern Republic.
loc.SO2_SO2_JAP_convention_desc: We should try and restore our relationship with the Japanese which has been ruined during the Civil War.
loc.SO2_invade_mongolia_desc: With Roman von Ungern-Sternberg invading Mongolia for his own imperialistic purposes this serves as a perfect casus beli to invade and save the people of Mongolia.
loc.SO2_war_communism_desc: Central control and requisitioning sustain the Red Army, but impose severe costs on the civilian economy.
loc.SO2_new_economic_policy_desc: Replace emergency requisitioning with limited markets and incentives to restore agriculture and trade.
loc.SO2_treaty_of_creation_ussr_desc: The union treaty joins the Soviet republics under common institutions while defining their federal relationship.
loc.SO2_GOELRO_desc: An electrification program will connect new power stations to industry and the countryside.
loc.SO2_political_effort_desc: The new government must establish authority while the Civil War and foreign intervention continue.

loc.US2_homefront_2_desc: Choosing to focus on the homefront means gaining more stability within your country instead of war support.

loc.US2_war_front_2_desC: Choosing to focus on the frontline means gaining more war support but losing stability on the homefront.
loc.US2_war_front_3_desc: Choosing to focus on the frontline means gaining more war support but losing stability on the homefront.
loc.US2_neutrality_desc: We meant it when we said we are neutral and not getting involved!
loc.US2_support_entente_desc: Although we do not wish to get involved in this European conflict the Entente is the good in this war and no matter what we will aid democracy against their fight versus the autocrats. Though the fact Russia is amongst the Entente is quite unsettling for us...
loc.US2_condemn_unrestricted_sub_desc: The Germans must not be able to get away with their hostile and inhumane actions of unrestricted submarine warfare, we will not let any more American citizens perish at the hands of u-boots.
loc.US2_condemn_zimmerman_desc: The Germans are lucky we haven't declared war yet! Their recent actions trying to get Mexico to join them in a war against us is absolutely traitorous! We just can't be left in peace it seems...
loc.US2_declare_war_on_germany_desc: The time has come for us to declare war on those evil Huns whom seek to establish a new imperialistic order in Europe.
loc.US2_send_expeditionary_force_france_desc: In order to aid our French allies with badly needed fresh manpower on the front we need to send in the American Expeditionary Force.
loc.US2_send_army_to_border_desc: With the Mexican revolution on-going we will not tolerate any of the fighting over there from spilling into our borders!
loc.US2_support_revolution_desc: The Maderistas are democratic and wish to restore the true results of the recent elections in Mexico, we for one welcome such a government.
loc.US2_intervention_in_mexico_desc: The Maderistas are democratic and wish to restore the true results of the recent elections in Mexico, we for one welcoem such a government and are willing to put up a quick fight to bring down Diaz.
loc.US2_fortify_border_desc: With the revolution spilling over into our borders at time and some of the revolutionaries calling for a war with us it would be a wise idea to fortify our border with Mexico.
loc.US2_withdraw_from_veracruz_desc: It is time to withdraw from Veracruz, we wouldn't want to upset the Mexican Revolutionaries any more than we already have.
loc.US2_condemn_huerta_desc: Huerta is an exact copy of his previous counterpart Diaz, he is nothing but a brutal dictator that must be laid to rest where he belongs in hell!
loc.US2_back_revolutionaries_2_desc: With the rise of the Constitutionalistas and Villistas against Huerta we can support the end of the Huerta regime through silent means.
loc.US2_condemn_villa_desc: Villa was an ally of ours in the past but now he has turned into a menace and a menace that must be eliminated!
loc.TUR_homefront_desc: Choosing to focus on the homefront means gaining more stability within your country instead of war support.
loc.TUR_homefront_2_desc: Choosing to focus on the homefront means gaining more stability within your country instead of war support.
loc.TUR_homefront_3_desc: Choosing to focus on the homefront means gaining more stability within your country instead of war support.

loc.TUR_war_front_2_desC: Choosing to focus on the frontline means gaining more war support but losing stability on the homefront.
loc.TUR_war_front_3_desc: Choosing to focus on the frontline means gaining more war support but losing stability on the homefront.
loc.TUR_hold_on_to_land_desc: European Turkey will always remain a part of the Empire!
loc.TUR_let_go_of_land_desc: Perhaps it would be a better idea to avoid any more death and destruction in the future and simply cede the the majority of our European holdings.
loc.TUR_befriend_bulgaria_desc: Bulgaria would make a good ally in the Balkans seeing as we would be their only friend in the area.
loc.TUR_send_aid_desc: We should aid our Bulgarian allies in their war effort on the Balkan Front.
loc.TUR_befriend_britain_desc: Perhaps it would be a better choice to go with the old order who has always won in the past no matter the opposition.
loc.TUR_befriend_germany_desc: The British are our enemeis, they have been using us establishing their colonies from what used to be our land, exploiting our economy, there is only one way out and that is with the new order!
loc.TUR_german_reform: German Reform of the Military I
loc.TUR_german_reform_desc: The Turkish army has seen much better days, however with German training we could probably learn a great deal and in turn improve the performance of our army.
loc.TUR_army_reform_II: German Reform of the Military II
loc.TUR_army_reform_II_desc: The Turkish army has seen much better days, however with German training we could probably learn a great deal and in turn improve the performance of our army.
loc.TUR_strike_russian_port_desc: The time has come for us to join this Great War against the evil imperialists whom seek to profit from our misery.
loc.TUR_senussi_revolt_desc: Ever since we have left North Africa there has been a lot of dissent and guerilla fighters, perhaps we should aid the largest group, the Senussi Order into an all out revolt.
loc.TUR_befriend_jabal_shammar_desc: The Emirate of Jabal Shammar has long been close with us with their mortal enemies being the Nejd Emirate ruled by the Saudi's whom we are by no means friends either...
loc.TUR_befriend_persia_desc: Persia like us is being fought over by the Great Powers of europe particularly Britain and RUssia whom seek to control it, we should befriend them and fight against this european imperialism together.
loc.TUR_anti_persia_desc: All of Pesia belongs into the greater Ottoman Empire, soon they will become a part of it.
loc.TUR_mission_afgahnistan_desc: If we could get Afgahnistan on our side they could be of great use in distracting the British and stirring up dissent in India with their invasion.
loc.TUR_back_shammar: Back the Emirate of Jabal Shammar
loc.TUR_help_shammar_defeat_saud_desc: If we help the House of Rashid eliminate the Saudi's once and for all we could have a powerful and controllable ally in Arabia with us.
loc.TUR_libya_work_locals_desc: Many citizens of Turkish Tripolitania have volunteered to aid us in our war effort agaisnt Italy in any way possible such as guerilla fighting.
loc.WHR_homefront_desc: Choosing to focus on the homefront means gaining more stability within your country instead of war support.
loc.WHR_homefront_2_desc: Choosing to focus on the homefront means gaining more stability within your country instead of war support.

loc.WHR_war_front_2_desC: Choosing to focus on the frontline means gaining more war support but losing stability on the homefront.
loc.WHR_war_front_3_desc: Choosing to focus on the frontline means gaining more war support but losing stability on the homefront.
loc.WHR_battle_of_the_chiefs_desc: In the summer of 1918, the Southern Whites had two historical options. The first is Pyotr Krasnov, who is ready to ally with Ukraine and the new independent states from the former Russian Empire to fight the Bolsheviks. His priority is to attack Tsaritsyn and connect with the Eastern Whites before attacking Moscow with them.\n The second option was supported by Anton Denikin, who refuses to give up control of the Russian Empire territories. Denikin's priority is to free the Kuban and North- Caucasus before attacking Moscow from the South through the Ukraine.
loc.WHR_request_allied_support_1_desc: The Western Allies are willing to support us with uniforms and ammunition for now but if we are to fall out of grace with them we will be just as easily cut off from this free stockpile of supplies.
loc.WHR_request_allied_support_2_desc: The Western Allies are willing to support us with uniforms and ammunition for now but if we are to fall out of grace with them we will be just as easily cut off from this free stockpile of supplies.
loc.WHR_request_allied_support_3_desc: The Western Allies are willing to support us with uniforms and ammunition for now but if we are to fall out of grace with them we will be just as easily cut off from this free stockpile of supplies.
loc.WHR_request_allied_support_4_desc: The Western Allies are willing to support us with uniforms and ammunition for now but if we are to fall out of grace with them we will be just as easily cut off from this free stockpile of supplies.
loc.WHR_offer_siberian_land_desc: There is no doubt that the Japanese take our civil war as a possible opportunity to seize a good portion of our Siberian territory but they are still skeptical, perhaps if we are to offer a fair chunk of Siberia too them they will join the Civil War fully on our side and help us crush the Bolsheviks, we could deal with the Japanese later...
loc.WHR_restore_order_desc: The nations that have declared their independence which has formerly been part of the Tsars' Empire are nothing but illegimate in their existance, it is our duty to bring them back into the motherland!
loc.WHR_war_baltic: Restore Order in the Baltic Region
loc.WHR_war_caucus: Restore Order in the Caucasus Region
loc.WHR_british_tanks_desc: Now that the First World War was over the British were willing to unlike the French to give away vast amounts of their left-over military equipment for free, some of which included their tanks which were used by the Western Whites in the battle of Tsaritsyn 1918-1918
loc.WHR_recognize_ex_tsarist_states_desc: Instead of giving these newly independent states the cold shoulder and even showing an open possiiblity of war for re-integration later it might be a wiser idea to ally with them and work together in trying to eliminate the one enemy we all have in common, the Bolsheviks
loc.WHR_white_terror_desc: We must purge the country of any and all Bolshevik's!
loc.WHR_conscript_prisoners_1_desc: This decree will allow soldiers to be recruited out of captured prisoners from the enemy side.
loc.WHR_conscript_prisoners_2_desc: This decree will allow soldiers to be recruited out of captured prisoners from the enemy side.

loc.IT1_war_front_2_desC: Choosing to focus on the frontline means gaining more war support but losing stability on the homefront.
loc.IT1_war_front_3_desc: Choosing to focus on the frontline means gaining more war support but losing stability on the homefront.
loc.IT1_claims_libya_desc: Every since the 1877 Russo-Turkish War we have publicly with the the acceptance of the other great powers set our eyes on Tripolitania.
loc.IT1_italo_turkish_war_desc: The time has come to back what is ours from the sick man of europe, this war should be a simple military walk at most and soon the resource rich North Africa will be ours!
loc.IT1_supress_senussi_desc: Ever since we have conquered Tripolitania the Senussi Order seperatists have been at war with us fighting as guerillas in the deserts of Tripolitania.
loc.IT1_establish_italian_presence_desc: Since the transfer of Tripolitania into our hands the occupation has not exactly been easy, the people of Tripolitania are very against our rule in nature and support dissidents such as the Senussi Order which is why it is important to establish a stronger military presence to curb thes dissent in North Africa.
loc.IT1_support_germany_desc: Perhaps we should stick with the good old Triple Alliance, after all it is quite strategic and we still have a lot to gain.
loc.IT1_claim_france_desc: The Italian people in Corsica and Savoy ever since the French takeover have lusted over the reunification with our great nation, whislt there are many in Austria as well we can deal with their reunification later...
loc.IT1_demand_tyrol_desc: The Central Powers obviously need us so why not try to make a deal with them to at least cede Tyrol for our pariticipation in their war.
loc.IT1_honor_alliance_desc: The time has come for us to honor the Triple Alliance and join our allies in their war.
loc.IT1_honor_alliance_2_desc: The Time has come for us to honor the Triple Alliance and join our allies in their war.
loc.IT1_neutral_stance_desc: We will not be joining our 'allies' in their war of agresssion against Serbia as the Triple Alliance was meant to be defensive pact and we are not obliged to join in an offensive war..
loc.IT1_deal_with_france_desc: We have formuated a secret pact between us and the Entente where the Entente has promised us large sqaths of Austria-Hungary to the North of Italy and the east across the Adriatic. The British have also promised funding.
loc.IT1_join_war_desc: The time has come for Italy to join the Great War. If we achieve victory, we will unite with all Italians currently subjected by Austria-Hungary.
loc.IT1_entente_diplomacy_desc: Improving our relations with the Entente is critical given they are our current wartime allies.
loc.IT1_request_allied_support_desc: On our own we have been struggling lately with getting behind the war and achieving total victory, compounded with below average results from the front lines.
loc.GE1_alternative_diplomacy_desc: Perhaps we will be able to strike a few deals with other countries neutralizing them or bringing them into our sphere, however none of it is guaranteed.
loc.GE1_negotiate_sweden_desc: We can try and negotiate with Sweden offering them their former territory of Finland back if they join the war against Russia, however it is very unlikely they will accept.
loc.GE1_silesia_to_austria: Offer Silesia to Austria for Italian Neutrality
loc.GE1_silesia_to_austria_desc: We can offer Silesia to Austria-Hungary where in return they will cede South Tyrol to Italy to keep them neutral in this conflict, though this is not guaranteed to work out.
loc.GE1_offer_bessarabia: Offer Besserabia to Romania for Neutrality
loc.GE1_offer_bessarabia_desc: We can offer Romania the territory of Bessarabia following the collapse of Russia in order for them to keep neutral in this conflict, but this is far from guaranteed.
loc.GE1_invite_sweden_desc: Since Sweden has agreed during our negotiations with them on joining the war with the terms that Finland is ceded back to them we can now officially invite them to join the Central Powers.
loc.GE1_zimmerman_desc: With the United States already threatening to declare war on us due to our policy of unrestricted submarine warfare, it would beneficial if we could get Mexico on our side in the case that the United States shall directly intervene on behalf of the Entente.
loc.GE1_diplomatic_effort_desc: Improving our diplomatic stance across Europe and the world will better prepare us for a potential future global conflict.
loc.GE1_mittelafrika_plan_desc: Mittelafrika (Central Africa) articulated Germany's foreign policy aim prior to the First World War of bringing the region under German domination particularly the region between the colonies of German East Africa, South West Africa, and Cameroon, creating a contiguous entity covering the bdeath of the African continent from the Atlantic to the Indian Ocean.
loc.GE1_reinforce_colonies_desc: We should try to reinforce and better fortify the colonies should a conflict break out.
loc.GE1_befriend_turkey_desc: Whilst Turkey is known as the 'Sick Man of Europe' and is largely a shell of its former self, it would still be in our benefit to befriend them and have them as an ally, their ports in particular could be quite useful to us.
loc.GE1_ottoman_german_alliance_desc: Allying Turkey would threaten British holdings in case of a war such as those in Persia which have lots of oil fields and the Suez Canal for which controls the quickest access to British India.
loc.GE1_befriend_jabal_Shammar: The Emirate of Jabal Shamar whilst a weak state could still provide support against the British in the Middle East.
loc.GE1_invite_jabal_shammar: Invite Jabal Shammar to Central Powers
loc.GE1_invite_jabal_Shammar_desc: It's time to bring Jabal Shammar into the Central Powers. By them joining, we can assist the Ottomans with their struggle in the Middle East and stabilise their fronts.
loc.GE1_berlin_baghdad_1_desc: The Berlin-Baghdad Railway if completed would allow us to establish a port on the Persian Gulf and thus avoid the Suez canal to access the eastern parts of our colonial empire whilst also increasing Turkish influence and infrastructure.
loc.GE1_berlin_baghdad_2_desc: The Berlin-Baghdad Railway if completed would allow us to establish a port on the Persian Gulf and thus avoid the Suez canal to access the eastern parts of our colonial empire whilst also increasing Turkish influence and infrastructure.
loc.GE1_berlin_baghdad_3_desc: The Berlin-Baghdad Railway if completed would allow us to establish a port on the Persian Gulf and thus avoid the Suez canal to access the eastern parts of our colonial empire whilst also increasing Turkish influence and infrastructure.
loc.GE1_berlin_baghdad_4_desc: The Berlin-Baghdad Railway if completed would allow us to establish a port on the Persian Gulf and thus avoid the Suez canal to access the eastern parts of our colonial empire whilst also increasing Turkish influence and infrastructure.
loc.GE1_colonial_defense_desc: We should try to reinforce and better fortify the colonies should a conflict break out.
loc.GE1_colonial_defense_2_desc: We should try to reinforce and better fortify the colonies should a conflict break out.
loc.GE1_agadir_crisis_desc: With France persuing territorial expansion in Morocco we should in turn ask for territorial compensation for ourselves elsewhere, while this is a very risky and hostile move it is only fair we get our slice of the cake.
loc.GE1_prepare_for_war_desc: A Great War looms on the horizon. With the advent of the Agadir crisis, our diplomats are urging our government to arm and prepare ourselves. §Y Unlocks German Warplan Decisions §!
loc.GE1_rupprecht_plan_desc: The Rupprecht Plan, different from the Schlieffen Plan with the fact the main swing into France would be through the neutral Switzerland versus Belgium, however it will be much harder due to the Swiss mountainous terrain. \n §RThis focus can be taken through event after you are at war with France.§!
loc.GE1_schlieffen_plan_desc: The Schlieffen Plan called for an invasion of Belgium to swing past the main French fortifications on the border with Germany and quickly conquer Paris forcing a French capitulation and calling an end to the war.\n §RThis focus can be taken through event after you are at war with France.§!
loc.GE1_kronprinz_plan_desc: The Kronprinz Plan was different from the Schlieffen Plan as it avoided any sort of invasion of Belgium and called for a war only against Russia and France.\n §RThis focus can be taken through event after you are at war with France.§!
loc.GE1_goeben_breslau_desc: With the SMS Goeben and SMS Breslau stuck in the Mediterranean Sea and the British Mediterranean Fleet trying to intercept them we can evade the British fleet by passing through the Dardanelles reaching Constantinople where we will hand them over to the Ottoman Empire.
loc.GE1_albania_negotiations_desc: With Prince Wilhelm of Wied being of German origin we can attempt to negotiate with him on an entrance of Albania on the side of the Central Powers despite the neutrality of Albania within the treaty of London.
loc.GE1_boer_revolt_desc: We can support the Boer's in South Africa who are still willing to fight again and re-establish the South African Republic, thus if all goes well we will be allied with the new South African Republic and threaten British interests.
loc.GE1_asien_corps_desc: We can aid our Turkish allies by sending in units to help with construction of roads and to work with Ottoman sanitary and medical units
loc.GE1_advisors_turkey_desc: We can further aid our Turkish allies by sending military advisors to help them in their campaigns.
loc.GE1_befriend_bulgaria_desc: Bulgaria is critical to our success in the Balkans. If we are to lose Buglaria to the Entente not only is victory against Serbia even more exaggerated but it could very well threaten Constantinople itself.
loc.GE1_invite_bulgaria_desc: With Bulgaria poised to join the Central Powers, we can take the pressure off Austria-Hungary in Serbia and knock Serbia out of the war, providing desperately needed reinforcements for Austria-Hungary against Russia.
loc.GE1_septemberprogramme_desc: The Septemberprogramm was a plan for territorial expansion of the German Empire at the expense of the Russian Empire, France, and Belgium. It gave insight to Germany's war aims and the scopes of its territorial expansions.
loc.GE1_polish_puppet_desc: As we have conquered the area of Poland we can promise the poles a restoration in order to legitimize our military occupation and possibly in the future gather volunteers for the war effort against the entente.
loc.GE1_polish_volunteers_desc: As we have created a Polish Puppet State promising independence we can also request volunteers to continue our war effort
loc.GE1_send_lenin_desc: In an effort to de-stabilize Russia and knock it out of the war we can send back the exiled Vladimir Lenin who holds a great deal of influence over the communists in Russia who are calling for revolution.
loc.GE1_huerta_power_desc: In an attempt to get Mexico on our side it would be best to collude with Victoriano Huerta, whom has made promises should we assist him in regaining power that he will undoubtedly show his support for the Kaiser, even if it means declaring war on the United States...but who knows? Perhaps it is a bluff...
loc.GE1_grain_ukraine: Enforce a Authoritarian Regime in Ukraine
loc.GE1_grain_ukraine_desc: In an effort to better our food situation we can enforce a more authoritarian regime in Ukraine to quicken the pace of the grain deliveries.
loc.GE1_supply_dervish_state_desc: The Dervish State has long been at war with much of the Entente, particularly Britain if we were to supply them then it would distract some of the British forces.
loc.GE1_befriend_dervish_desc: Us and the Dervish State have similar enemies, for that reason why not be friends?
loc.GE1_invite_dervish: Invite Dervish State to Central Powers
loc.GE1_invite_dervish_desc: Sisnce we are fighting the same enemy we might as well officially invite the Dervish state into the Central Powers
loc.GE1_power_to_kaiser_desc: If we support the Kaiser we can enact more reforms and decisions. Doing this would make keeping the Kaiser in rule easier.
loc.GE1_power_to_military_desc: If we support the military, we will receive several bonuses for our troops at the cost of lessening the power of the Kaiser and raising the power of the military.
loc.GE1_fund_insurrectionists_india_desc: Whilst a very daring and big plot if it managed to turn out as planned the British could see an armed insurrection within India which would provide a huge backhand blow.
loc.GE1_befriend_afgahnistan_desc: Afgahnistan could provide as a good base to invade India from should they later agree to an alliance
loc.GE1_negotiate_afgahnistan_desc: However unlikely it is based on the fact that the Afgah Emir is payed by the British themselves, if we are to throw out a deal based territorial gains in India and the Afgahn Emir were to agree we could strike a significant and the Afgahn attack would serve as a thorn in the back of British India diverting troops and resources.
loc.GE1_continue_unrestricted_sub_desc: Despite facing a possibility of going to war with the United States the general staff have said that it if we are to win this war we must resume unestricted submarine warfare, saying that U.S. intervention if it should happen won't be a threat because it will take too long for the Americans to get involved and by then we would have won.
loc.GE1_industrial_effort_desc: Our Empire has already become the strongest power in the region, and further industrialisation will increase our chances of winning a future war.
loc.GE1_infrastructure_effort_1_desc: Infrastructure is critical to our country, as our territory stretches from Metz to Memel. Larger than most other countries in Europe, having extensive infrastructure will improve standards of living while compounding the effectiveness of our rapid mobilisation in the Schliffen Plan.
loc.GE1_infrastructure_effort_2_desc: Further development of our infrastructure will help decrease unemployment in our Empire while also providing a better standard of living for our citizens.
loc.GE1_infrastructure_effort_3_desc: Continuing to improve our infrastructure will no doubt place us as the foremost power, both economically and military in not just Europe, but perhaps the whole world.
loc.GE1_homefront_desc: Choosing to focus on the homefront means gaining more stability within your country instead of war support.
loc.GE1_homefront_2_desc: Choosing to focus on the homefront means gaining more stability within your country instead of war support.
loc.GE1_homefront_3_desc: Choosing to focus on the homefront means gaining more stability within your country instead of war support.
loc.GE1_shorter_training_desc: With the war dragging on and taking more and more lives we need more men to refill the casualties so shortening training would help with that.
loc.GE1_war_front_desc: Choosing to focus on the frontline means gaining more war support but losing stability on the homefront.
loc.GE1_war_front_2_desC: Choosing to focus on the frontline means gaining more war support but losing stability on the homefront.
loc.GE1_war_front_3_desc: Choosing to focus on the frontline means gaining more war support but losing stability on the homefront.

loc.AUH_home_front_2_desc: Choosing to focus on the homefront means gaining more stability within your country instead of war support.
loc.AUH_home_front_3_desc: Choosing to focus on the homefront means gaining more stability within your country instead of war support.
loc.AUH_war_front_1_desc: Choosing to focus on the frontline means gaining more war support but losing stability on the homefront.
loc.AUH_war_front_2_desC: Choosing to focus on the frontline means gaining more war support but losing stability on the homefront.
loc.AUH_war_front_3_desc: Choosing to focus on the frontline means gaining more war support but losing stability on the homefront.
loc.AUH_seperate_peace_desc: Separate peace with the Entente could save our country.
loc.AUH_befriend_italy_desc: It would be best to improve relations with the Italians as much as we can.
loc.AUH_subdue_italy_desc: In order to prevent western infuence from getting hold in Italy offering territorial concessions on our behalf withour our benefit we should be the first to go in and offer these concessions, it would not be pleasant to deal with three fronts at once...
loc.AUH_cede_tyrol_desc: Whilst the Italians would much rather prefer South Tyrol along with Istria, we could have a lucky throw of a dice and see if they will accept this proposition.
loc.AUH_cede_tyrol_and_istria_desc: The Italians would very much likely accept this offer, however there is always a chance they won't.
loc.AUH_promise_italy_desc: We could promise the Italians a sizeable chunk of French territory once victory is assured and they are sitting comfortably at the peace table.
loc.AUH_italy_central_power_desc: Italian alignment with the Central Powers is now assured, now all that is left is to invite them.
loc.AUH_annex_bosnia_desc: With the Young Turks revolution in Turkey and a momentary state of internal crisis, now would be the perfect time to snatch the territory of Bosnia from them and annex it into the Empire.
loc.AUH_anti_serb_rhetoric_desc: The Serbs are a threat to our dominance in the Balkans
loc.AUH_dominate_balkan_SOI_desc: If we have a sphere of influence over the Balkans we can effectively control the region, however such is unlikely as long as Serbia is around.
loc.AUH_pro_germany_desc: Despite being a former foe, the German Empire now is very much our friend.
loc.AUH_bulgaria_friend_desc: If there is one thing Austria and Bulgaria have in common it is our hatred of Serbia
loc.AUH_ottoman_friends_desc: Whilst the Ottomans and us have previously left off on bad terms with Bosnia and control of the Balkans, currently all of that is behind us and it is better if we focus on the future being friends with the Turks.
loc.AUH_confiscate_serb_grain_desc: As we now control the whole of Serbia, it would be a wise idea to strip the country of its grain supplies in order to feed our own men whom are lacking such needed supplies
loc.AUH_volunteer_albania_desc: A few thousand Albanian volunteers have agreed join the Austro-Hungarian military
loc.AUH_cede_macedonia_bulgaria_desc: As we have promised Bulgaria their rightful claims in Macedonia, we could always transfer over military control of the area to them so we won't have to deal with those rebellious killers.
loc.AUH_german_advisors_desc: With our military leadership rather lacking, it would be a good idea to request German officers in order to increase the efficiency of our troops
loc.AUH_german_troops_desc: In order to further increase our military efficiency, we could request several German divisions whom could help with our military efforts.
loc.AUH_send_germany_aid_desc: Our ally Germany is heavily involved with the brunt of the war effort against Russia and France, we could surely help them out quite a bit offering a sizable chunk of military hardware
loc.AUH_send_germany_troops_desc: The Germans desperately need more numerical superiority on their front against the French, we could surely aid them by seending over several of our divisions
loc.AUH_turkish_reinforcements_desc: We have recently been taking heavy casualties on the Eastern Front, the Turks are willing to send some reinforcements to help us out if we wish to recieve them.
loc.AUH_send_turkey_troops_desc: In order to help out our ally Turkey on their frontlines, we could offer to send over several garrison divisions and sizeable fighting divisions to aid them.
loc.AUH_send_turkey_weapons_desc: It is a well known fact that the Ottoman Empire is by far a industrial nation which can sufficiently produce its own war supply, if we help them out with this it should surely do them a lot of good.
loc.AUH_political_effort_desc: As a loosely held empire of dozens of ethnicites, playing hardball with our politics might be the only way to save our great nation.
loc.AUH_imperial_stability_desc: The Empire is far from stable with nationalism at its highest these days, which is why imperial stability is key to preserving the Empire.
loc.AUH_focus_military_desc: Focusing on the military means ignoring the internal issues, this could put the Empire at an even greater risk of collapse.
loc.AUH_focus_internal_issues_desc: Focusing on internal issues means somewhat sidelining focus on the military, however it will insure the stability of the Empire for a much longer time.
loc.AUH_supress_minorities_desc: The nationalistic tendencies amongst the minorities must be supressed or else everything could go sideways.
loc.AUH_war_effort_1_desc: Rallying our citizens behind war would unite our country and, perhaps for a little while, make those pesky nationalists scattered across our empire, at least for a moment, disregard their long-time views of independence.
loc.AUH_war_effort_2_desc: Rallying our citizens behind war would unite our country and, perhaps for a little while, make those pesky nationalists scattered across our empire, at least for a moment, disregard their long-time views of independence.
loc.AUH_war_effort_3_desc: Rallying our citizens behind war would unite our country and, perhaps for a little while, make those pesky nationalists scattered across our empire, at least for a moment, disregard their long-time views of independence.
loc.AUH_hungarian_support_desc: If we are to enter this war, and anticipate any degree of success, we require extensive support from the Hungarian side of the Empire.
loc.AUH_coronation_desc: With the death of Franz Joseph, it is time to introduce the new King and Emperor, Charles I (IV)
loc.AUH_dockyard_1_desc: While our navy may not be amongst the foremost in the world, some extra dockyards can bring about a moderate level of naval success against our Mediterranean rivals.
loc.AUH_dockyard_2_desc: While our navy may not be amongst the foremost in the world, some extra dockyards can bring about a moderate level of naval success against our Mediterranean rivals.
loc.AUH_dockyard_3_desc: While our navy may not be amongst the foremost in the world, some extra dockyards can bring about a moderate level of naval success against our Mediterranean rivals.
loc.AUH_dockyard_4_desc: While our navy may not be amongst the foremost in the world, some extra dockyards can bring about a moderate level of naval success against our Mediterranean rivals.

loc.FR3_homefront_2_desc: Choosing to focus on the homefront means gaining more stability within your country instead of war support.
loc.FR3_homefront_3_desc: Choosing to focus on the homefront means gaining more stability within your country instead of war support.
